m: Motie van het lid Van Gerven c.s. over een backpay-regeling voor weduwen van ambtenaren of militairen die tijdens de Japanse bezetting een dienstverband hadden met het Nederlands-Indisch Gouvernement
Asks the cabinet to examine whether a backpay-style financial scheme is feasible for widows of civil servants and military personnel who were not fully paid during the Japanese occupation.
asks the cabinet to investigate whether such a financial scheme is feasible and implementable
vraagt het kabinet, te onderzoeken of een dergelijke financiële regeling haalbaar en uitvoerbaar is
Motie van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Bergkamp over een plan van aanpak om te komen tot een brede langetermijnvisie op de ouderenzorg
Asks the government for a plan of action, by Q1 2021, to develop a broad long-term vision on elderly care with all relevant ministries and stakeholders.
to outline by Q1 2021 in an action plan how to arrive at a broad long-term vision on elderly care
om uiterlijk in het eerste kwartaal van 2021 in een plan van aanpak te schetsen hoe te komen tot een brede langetermijnvisie op de ouderenzorg
Amendement van de leden Ellemeet en Laan-Geselschap 35570-XVI-59 over structurele financiering van organisatie Zonder Stempel
Shifts €100,000 structurally from the health budget's ministry-controlled article to Zorgbreed beleid to fund the organisation Zonder Stempel.
With this amendment €100,000 is structurally freed up to continue the activities of Zonder Stempel
Met dit amendement wordt er structureel € 100.000 vrijgemaakt om de activiteiten van Zonder Stempel voort te zetten
Amendement van het lid Bergkamp c.s. 35570-XVI-58 over middelen voor de Mantelzorglijn
Shifts 300 thousand euro within the health budget to expand the Mantelzorglijn helpline for informal carers in 2021.
With this amendment an amount of 300 thousand euros is made available in 2021 to expand the current Mantelzorglijn for informal carers.
Met dit amendement wordt in 2021 een bedrag van € 300 duizend vrijgemaakt om de huidige Mantelzorglijn voor mantelzorgers uit te breiden.
Amendement van de leden Slootweg en Laan-Geselschap over een evaluatie binnen 4 jaar
Amendment requiring the minister to report to the States General within four years on the effects of the Wlz/Zvw quality-standard registration rules.
Within four years after entry into force, the Minister sends the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of that section in practice

Onze Minister zendt binnen vier jaar na de inwerkingtreding van artikelen 1, achtste lid, 11b, derde lid, 11c, 11d, 11e aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van die paragraaf in de praktijk
Motie van de leden Ellemeet en Laan-Geselschap over samen met de zorgverlener beslissen over de gewenste behandeling
Asks the government to direct a transparency subsidy scheme toward outcome information for shared decision-making for frail older patients.
to direct the transparency subsidy scheme 2020 toward promoting outcome information
de subsidieregeling transparantie 2020 te richten op het bevorderen van uitkomstinformatie
Motie van het lid Laan-Geselschap c.s. over verlagen van de drempel voor gesprekken over euthanasie met de huisarts
Asks the government for an action plan to lower the threshold for patients to discuss end-of-life wishes with their GP, sent to the House by summer 2020.
requests the government to come up with a concrete action plan to stimulate conversations between GP and patient
verzoekt de regering, met een concreet actieplan te komen waardoor de gesprekken tussen huisarts en patiënt gestimuleerd worden
Motie van het lid Laan-Geselschap c.s. over kwaliteit van leven van cliënten centraal stellen
Asks the government to encourage cooperation among care stakeholders, strengthen the innovation helpdesk, and explore a special experimental status for initiatives blocked by rules.
requests the government further, if there is reason, to explore whether a special experimental status can be granted for initiatives running into laws and rules
verzoekt de regering voorts, als er aanleiding is, te verkennen of voor initiatieven waar tegen wet- en regelgeving aangelopen wordt, een bijzondere experimenteerstatus
Motie van het lid Laan-Geselschap c.s. over gebruikmaken van de kennis van het Expertisecentrum Euthanasie
Motion asking the government to explore making Expertisecentrum Euthanasie modules available to all GPs and report before summer.
requests the government, in consultation with the professional associations, to investigate how these modules can become available to all GPs
verzoekt de regering, in overleg met de betrokken beroepsverenigingen, te onderzoeken hoe deze modules van het Expertisecentrum Euthanasie voor alle huisartsen in Nederland beschikbaar kunnen komen
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Toorenburg c.s. tvv nr 12 over het uitzonderen van personen uitgezonden door het ICRC of het Rode Kruis
Amendment exempts persons deployed by the ICRC or the Red Cross from the requirement of prior permission to stay in areas controlled by terrorist organisations.
persons delegated by the Red Cross do not need prior permission to stay in the area
personen die worden afgevaardigd door het Rode Kruis geen voorafgaande toestemming voor het verblijf in het gebied behoeven
Amendement van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Van Toorenburg over het verhogen van de strafmaat
Proposes raising the maximum penalty for entering an area controlled by a terrorist organisation from one year to two years and from third to fourth category.
in Article 134b, first paragraph, 'one year' is replaced by 'two years'
wordt in artikel 134b, eerste lid, «een jaar» vervangen door «twee jaren»
Amendement van de leden Van Toorenburg en Laan Geselschap over  het uitzonderen van  personen uitgezonden door het ICRC of het Rode Kruis
Exempts persons delegated by the ICRC or the Red Cross from the prior permission needed to stay in terrorist-controlled areas.
persons delegated by the Red Cross do not need prior permission to stay in the area
personen die worden afgevaardigd door het Rode Kruis geen voorafgaande toestemming voor het verblijf in het gebied behoeven
Motie van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het fiscaal aantrekkelijk maken om naast een reguliere baan werkzaam te zijn bij de politie
Motion asks the government to study making it fiscally attractive for people to work part-time at the police alongside a regular job.
requests the government to examine how it can be made (fiscally) attractive to work at the police alongside a regular job
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken op welke wijze het (fiscaal) aantrekkelijk kan worden gemaakt om naast een reguliere baan werkzaam te worden bij de politie
Motie van het lid Ronnes c.s. over een update van de voortgang van het Digitaal Stelsel Omgevingswet
Asks the government to have the ICT assessment bureau BIT provide an update on the Digital Environment Act system's progress and inform the House of the results.
requests the government to have the BIT provide an update in December 2019 on the progress and status of the Digital Environment Act system and inform the House of the outcomes
verzoekt de regering, het BIT in december 2019 een update te laten doen naar de voortgang en stand van zaken van het Digitaal Stelsel Omgevingswet, en de Kamer over de uitkomsten te informeren
Motie van het lid Van Dam c.s. over een landelijke inleveractie
Asks the government to organise a national weapons amnesty where people can hand in illegal firearms without punishment.
requests the government to consult police and the Public Prosecution Service to organise a national weapons collection campaign
verzoekt de regering, in overleg te treden met politie en het Openbaar Ministerie om een landelijke inleveractie te organiseren
Amendement van de leden Ronnes en Laan-Geselschap ter vervanging van nr. 9 over verbreding experimenteerbepaling met de Wilg
Adds the Wet inrichting landelijk gebied to the list of laws from which an AMvB may deviate for experiments under the Crisis- and recovery act, widening executive discretion.
the scope of article 2.4 of the Crisis and Recovery Act is further widened by adding the Spatial Planning Act for rural areas to the list of laws
de reikwijdte van artikel 2.4 van de Crisis- en herstelwet (Chw) verder wordt verbreed door de Wet inrichting landelijk gebied (Wilg) toe te voegen aan de lijst van wetten
Amendement van het lid Ronnes c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 11 over de aanpassing van de ondergrens naar 5 woningen
Lowers the minimum project size for accelerated housing decision-making under the Crisis- and Recovery Act from 12 to 5 homes.
In the first paragraph, part a, '12' is replaced by '5'.
In het eerste lid, onderdeel a, wordt «12» vervangen door «5».
Motie van het lid Laan-Geselschap  over het schrappen van artikel 6p
Asks the government to delete article 6p of the Crisis- and recovery act decree, which lets six municipalities deviate from the national energy performance norms.
Requests the government to delete article 6p of the Crisis- and recovery act implementing decree (seventeenth tranche).
verzoekt de regering, artikel 6p Besluit uitvoering Crisis- en herstelwet, (zeventiende tranche) te schrappen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Laan-Geselschap over 'Nog steeds geen onderzoek Sarah'

MPs Regterschot and Laan-Geselschap asked whether national inspectorates should have investigated the fatal 2018 stabbing of Sarah Papenheim and whether such incidents can be independently investigated at case level. The minister replied that no Wmo calamity investigation was legally possible because the victim was not a client, that inspectorates cooperate in specific cases, and that municipalities can commission independent case investigations.

In this event the victim was not a client. Therefore the Wmo Supervision Rotterdam-Rijnmond and TSD concluded that in this case there is no legal basis for Wmo supervision to start a calamity investigation.

In deze gebeurtenis was het slachtoffer geen cliënt. Daarom hebben het Toezicht Wmo Rotterdam-Rijnmond en TSD geconcludeerd dat in deze casus voor het Wmo-toezicht geen wettelijke basis is een calamiteitenonderzoek te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het programma ‘Zaak van je Leven’ van WNL en de rol van het Waarschuwingsregister Zorg en Welzijn

A VVD MP asked whether the minister still supports making the Waarschuwingsregister Zorg en Welzijn mandatory and how misconduct by care staff moving between providers will be prevented. The minister answered that he has dropped plans for a legal obligation to join the register due to practical and legal objections, and that alternatives will be discussed with stakeholders in early 2021.
As indicated in my letter to your House, I have decided to refrain from a statutory obligation to join the Warning Register.
Zoals aangegeven in mijn brief aan uw Kamer, heb ik besloten af te zien van een wettelijke verplichting tot aansluiting bij het Waarschuwingsregister.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over de monitor Langer Thuis 2020 van het RIVM

The VVD MP Laan-Geselschap asked the minister whether the RIVM Langer Thuis 2020 monitor is adequate for parliamentary oversight, given that many indicators show outdated or unchanged figures and no interim results before summer 2021, and asked for an interim report in 2020. Minister De Jonge explained the unchanged indicators by program timelines or data not yet available, and pointed to the second progress report sent the same day as providing the most recent results, without committing to a separate interim report.
I share your interest in having a good picture of the progress of the Langer Thuis programme.
Ik deel uw belang om een goed beeld te hebben van de voortgang van het programma Langer Thuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp Van Eijs, Beckerman, Laan-Geselschap, Dik-Faber, Nijboer Geluk-Poortvliet en Terpstra over de noodzaak tot investeren in wonen voor senioren

MPs from several parties asked whether a 80,000-unit shortage of senior housing exists, what the government is doing with the taskforce on housing and care, and whether municipalities should be obliged to build senior homes. The minister answered that the shortage figure's source is unclear, that a senior housing monitor will be sent by year-end, that no binding national targets will be imposed, and that the government is supporting local action through taskforces, agreements and subsidy schemes.
Even after inquiry, it is not clear to us what the source of this figure is.
Het is ons, ook na navraag, niet duidelijk wat de bron is van dit aantal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Laan-Gezelschap over het bericht ‘Elise moet door haar spierziekte extra oppassen voor Corona’

MPs Kerstens and Laan-Gezelschap asked the Health Minister about a news report on a child with muscular disease at extra risk from coronavirus, and whether care-indication renewals by insurers should be paused for families under strain. The minister answered that the parties agreed a protocol under which current indications can be extended by three months, while renewals remain possible where care needs change.
On re-indication when the care input has not changed, the advice summarised briefly states that the current indication can be extended by three months or as much shorter as applicable.
Over herindicatie wanneer de zorginzet niet gewijzigd is, stelt het advies kort samengevat dat de huidige indicatie met drie maanden verlengd kan worden of zoveel korter als van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Lodders over een bericht van het Operationeel Centrum van de politie-eenheid Den Haag

Two VVD MPs asked why the Den Haag police unit tweeted that selling meat from vans during the Offerfeest was legal, and questioned the NVWA oversight, food safety and equal treatment behind it. The minister explained that the NVWA had granted a permanent general permission for transporting uncooled carcasses, that the tweet was meant to inform the public, and that the controls were sample-based, without committing to any new action.
That regulation also allows the competent authority, in this case the NVWA, to grant permission for transporting meat and delivering it to citizens via (mini) vans.
Deze verordening maakt het ook mogelijk dat de bevoegde autoriteit, in dit geval de NVWA, toestemming verleent voor het vervoer van vlees en aflevering aan burgers via (mini)vrachtwagens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Zorgverzekeraars, Per Saldo, V&VN en VWS maken afspraken over indicatieproces kindzorg thuis’

Two MPs asked the minister why the parent organisation BVIKZ was not included in agreements on the indication process for child home care, and whether parents' maatwerk and the indication norms were changed. The minister answered that the agreements rest with the Zvw-pgb parties, that BVIKZ is involved in the wider process, that the policy is unchanged, and that no extra meetings are currently planned.
I was, am and remain willing to involve BVIKZ in the solutions on this file; the parliamentary questions asked are, in my view, separate from that.
Ik was, ben en blijf bereid om BVIKZ te betrekken bij de oplossingen op dit dossier, de gestelde Kamervragen staan hier wat mij betreft los van.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Laan-Geselschap over het feit dat belangenbehartigers niet worden betrokken bij de kwestie van lagere pgb’s voor ouders die hun zieke kind thuis zelf verzorgen

MPs Kerstens and Laan-Geselschap asked why patient representatives were not involved in talks on lower personal budgets (pgb) for parents caring for their seriously ill child at home. The minister replied that representative organisations are consulted, that different meetings with different goals took place from 4 to 7 February, and that he will answer the written questions as soon as possible.

Consultation with interest representatives such as Per Saldo, Stichting Kind en Ziekenhuis, Spierziekten Nederland, Kenniscentrum Kinderpalliatieve Zorg and the Belangenvereniging Intensieve Kindzorg does indeed take place.

Er vindt wel degelijk overleg plaats met belangenbehartigers zoals Per Saldo, Stichting Kind en Ziekenhuis, Spierziekten Nederland, Kenniscentrum Kinderpalliatieve Zorg en de Belangenvereniging Intensieve Kindzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Ouders die thuis voor ernstig ziek kind zorgen, krijgen minder geld’

MPs Kerstens and Laan-Geselschap asked the Minister of Health about reports that parents caring for a seriously ill child at home receive less personal budget (pgb) funding, and about the conduct of KinderThuisZorg, the handling of such care as 'usual care', and related questions. The minister answered that the rules have not changed, that the cited passage is meant to clarify practice, that above-usual care remains reimbursable to parents at the informal tariff, and that VWS is monitoring insurers and practice variation.
VWS is in consultation with the professional group V&VN to look into unexplained practice variation in needs assessments.
VWS is met de beroepsgroep V&VN in overleg om te kijken naar onverklaarbare praktijkvariatie bij indicatiestellingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Bosch en Laan-Geselschap inzake “het krijgen van een assistentiehond”

MPs Van den Bosch and Laan-Geselschap asked why the PTSD assistance-dog study for veterans has not yet concluded and why waiting lists and limited choice of trainers persist. The minister replies that the first study was finished and presented in June 2018, that a follow-up longitudinal study with Utrecht University is expected to report in September 2021, and that the results will guide future policy on dog deployment, training and funding.
The research result is expected to be ready in September 2021. Defence is of course following this closely.
Het onderzoeksresultaat zal naar verwachting in september 2021 gereed zijn. Defensie volgt dit uiteraard aandachtig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Kuiken, Laan-Geselschap, Van Toorenburg en Den Boer over terrorismeverdachten die airsoft speelden als mogelijke voorbereiding op een aanslag

MPs from SP, PvdA, VVD, CDA and D66 asked the Justice Minister how airsoft, which RTL reported terrorism suspects played as possible attack training, is controlled, including whether introduced guests need a certificate of conduct (VOG). The minister said current oversight is adequate, that screening looks back eight years, and that he will discuss how to combat misuse with the airsoft association but sees no reason to change the rules now.
I do not comment on individual case matters.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Laan-Geselschap over dode dieren die gedumpt zijn in het buitengebied van Haaren

MPs Weverling and Laan-Geselschap asked the ministers about dead hares and a wild boar dumped in the Haaren countryside, possible use as prey in illegal dog betting, and rising illegal activity and enforcement gaps in rural areas. Minister Grapperhaus answered that police received no report, no examination has taken place so cause of death is unknown, dog-prey betting is not legal, and the rural enforcement action plan is still being implemented with a progress report promised for early 2020.
I have promised the House to report on the progress of the elaboration of the action plan in early 2020.
Ik heb de Kamer toegezegd begin 2020 te rapporteren over de voortgang van de uitwerking van het plan van aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Laan-Geselschap over het berechten van Nederlandse Syrië-gangers door de Koerdische autoriteiten in Noord-Syrië

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign and Justice ministers whether they would support local trials of Dutch jihadists by Kurdish authorities in northern Syria, including financial and legal support and detention facilities. The government said it is exploring regional prosecution with international partners but is reluctant to deal with non-state Kurdish authorities, offers only indirect support through UNITAD and IIIM, and will not fund local detention centres.

The cabinet is reluctant to make agreements or cooperate with non-state entities that actually exercise authority over an area where the government in question effectively no longer exercises authority.

Het kabinet is terughoudend met het maken van afspraken of samenwerken met niet-statelijke entiteiten die feitelijk gezag uitoefenen over een gebied waar de betreffende regering effectief geen gezag meer uitoefent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Hermans en Laan-Geselschap over het af en toe in een instelling kunnen verblijven van ouderen en gehandicapten

Three MPs asked the minister about respite and part-time residential care (logeerzorg and deeltijdverblijf) for elderly and disabled people, including pilot results, administrative burden, and the fixed co-payment from 1 January 2020. The minister answered in detail on pilots, bureaucracy reduction for carers, and the Wlz co-payment change, while deferring the final pilot results to November and not addressing the Wmo case fully.
For that reason, research is currently being conducted via the national panel of MantelzorgNL and ANBO into the need for structural respite care.
Om die reden wordt momenteel onderzocht via het landelijke panel van MantelzorgNL en ANBO wat de behoefte is aan structurele logeerzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over de brief ‘Uitvoering motie van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Van Toorenburg over de intrekking van het Nederlanderschap’

An MP asked whether sources beyond AIVD reports or in-absentia verdicts could support stripping Dutch nationality from jihadist travellers, how trial in absentia and the right to be present interact with that, and why prosecution interests are weighed against national security. The minister answered that other sources such as open-source material can be used, that presence rights are not absolute and temporary lifting of the entry ban can be requested, and that intelligence material may be withheld but is available to courts.
An official report is always based on underlying data.
Een ambtsbericht is altijd gebaseerd op onderliggende gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Laan-Geselschap over het artikel ‘Speciale opvang voor jihad-kinderen bij terugkeer in Nederland’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a Parool report on special reception for children returning from IS territory, and whether such children pose a security threat. The government answered that the children are primarily victims, that the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming did not set up locations, that children are placed in specialised trauma care and observed, and that the youth court decides on protective measures based on multidisciplinary advice.
The RvdK has not set up any locations.
De RvdK heeft geen locaties opgericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma, Laan-Geselschap, Ziengs en Nijkerken-De Haan over de berichtgeving over gezichtsbedekkende kleding in het openbaar vervoer

VVD MPs asked the government whether it supports a bus driver who refused to continue with a niqab-wearing passenger, whether the face-covering ban is being applied consistently in public transport, hospitals and other institutions, and what steps will be taken to clarify enforcement with police and operators. The minister answered that operators and staff should first ask the person to remove the covering or leave, that police should be called if needed, that the practice is being clarified with sector bodies, and that the government will keep monitoring implementation.

The cabinet supports compliance with the law by institutions, paying attention to how the procedure is designed so that it takes account of safeguarding a safe public task and the roles that employer and employee have in compliance with this law.

Het kabinet ondersteunt de naleving van de wet door de instellingen, met aandacht voor de invulling van de werkwijze die rekening houdt met het zorgen voor een veilige publieke taak en de rol die de werkgever en werknemer bij deze wet met betrekking tot de naleving hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Laan-Geselschap en Worfsdorfer over het bericht ‘Deze nieuwe en gevaarlijke cyberaanval wordt gewoon met de post bezorgd’

Four VVD MPs asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers about 'warshipping', a reported cyberattack using parcels to plant devices that breach local wifi networks, and how it could be detected, handled and countered. The government answered that it knows the technique but has no known cases in the Netherlands or abroad, that organisations can screen parcels, and that the NCTV and NCSC are aware of the risk and would advise if needed.
I am not aware of any cases in which warshipping has been detected in the Netherlands.
Er zijn mij geen gevallen bekend waarin «warshipping» is geconstateerd in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Weverling over de ‘bewapening van boswachters’

MPs Weverling and Laan-Geselschap asked why green BOA rangers at Recreatie Noord-Holland lost their baton and pepper spray, and whether the procedure is clear enough. Minister Grapperhaus explained that the extension was granted with handcuffs only after negative advice from police and prosecutors, that the weapons decision still needs careful review, and that the procedures are clear enough, with the issue to be raised with the BOA unions.
Because the procedure regarding a possible award of these weapons is still ongoing, I refrain from further explanation of this case.
Omdat de procedure ten aanzien van een eventuele toekenning van deze geweldsmiddelen nog loopt, onthoud ik mij van een nadere toelichting op deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘De mobiele lokdoos werkt niet met 5G’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that IMSI-catchers (mobile 'lokdoos' interception devices) do not work with 5G, and about Europol's concerns over identifying and locating suspects on 5G networks. The government answered that a working group is adapting investigative procedures and rules for 5G, that it is in contact with telecom providers and foreign counterparts, and that private possession of IMSI-catchers remains prohibited.

At present, the interdepartmental working group '5G and investigation', chaired by the police and including the Public Prosecution Service, Agentschap Telecom and the Ministries of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Justice and Security, is working out which changes in procedure are needed to enable identification and localisation of persons on the 5G network.

Op dit moment wordt in de ambtelijke werkgroep «5G en opsporing» onder voorzitterschap van de politie met daarin het Openbaar Ministerie, Agentschap Telecom en de Ministeries van Economische Zaken en Klimaat en van Justitie en Veiligheid uitgewerkt welke aanpassingen in werkwijze noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht “Recordvangst crystal meth in Rotterdam ter waarde van honderden miljoenen”

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a record crystal meth seizure in Rotterdam, police concern, Mexican cartel involvement, European cooperation, user numbers and convictions. The minister answered that no suspects were arrested, three to four labs were found in the Netherlands in 2019, there is no concrete evidence of cartels gaining a foothold, and cooperation with Mexico and Europe is good, while conviction and user figures are not specifically recorded.
The investigation is still ongoing and, in its interest, no further statements can be made at this time.
Op dit moment is het onderzoek nog in volle gang en kunnen in het belang daarvan geen verdere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht 'Onderwereld beraamt weer aanslag op Brabantse agent'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the criminal underworld plotted another attack on a Brabant police officer, why a January death-threat case is still under investigation, and how threats against police are prosecuted and protected against. The minister declined to discuss ongoing investigations, described the prosecution approach and a proposed higher maximum penalty for threats, and outlined existing protection and aftercare measures for officers.
No, I cannot provide information about ongoing criminal investigations.
Nee, over lopende opsporingsonderzoeken kan ik u geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Buitenlanders ontlopen parkeerboete, landen willen adressen niet geven’

Two VVD MPs asked why foreign drivers escape parking fines because some countries, notably Germany, no longer provide registered-keeper addresses, and what can be done. The minister acknowledged the problem (roughly tens of thousands of unpaid fines, at least EUR 1 million a year), explained that EU cross-border rules cover only traffic offences not parking, and committed to exploring bilateral data exchange, starting with Germany.

Together with my colleagues at the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, I will examine what options exist for reaching a similar exchange with other countries.

Ik zal, samen met mijn collega´s van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat, onderzoeken welke mogelijkheden er zijn om met andere landen tot een soortgelijke uitwisseling te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Laan-Geselschap over de aanpak van mestfraude

MPs Lodders and Laan-Geselschap asked about the government's approach to manure fraud, including reporting channels, how reports are registered and handled, and cross-border enforcement with Belgium. Minister Schouten answered that no single body collects all reports, that reports via official channels are registered, and that 63 processes-verbaal from 2017 led to mostly convictions and some transactions, while declining to give full regional report counts for the police.
There is no body that collects all reports, including those from all other bodies.
Er is geen instantie die alle meldingen, ook van alle andere instanties, verzamelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Nederlanderschap afpakken van Syriëganger blijkt ondanks wet lastig’

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Justice and Security why citizenship revocation of Dutch Syria travellers is proving difficult, whether the public prosecution service and AIVD cooperate and prioritise it, and how more revocations can be achieved. The Minister answers that revocation under article 14(4) RWN is a bestuurlijke maatregel executed by the IND, that OM and AIVD cooperate within their legal frameworks, that a motion is being implemented with results due before the summer recess, and that 13 revocations have occurred, two annulled by the Raad van State.

On 2 April 2019 the House adopted the motion by Laan-Geselschap and Van Toorenburg requesting the government to assess, before the 2019 summer recess, the files of all identified Dutch travellers, men and women, for the possibility of revoking nationality in the interest of national security, and to inform the House.

Op 2 april 2019 is in uw Kamer de motie van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Van Toorenburg aangenomen waarin de regering wordt verzocht om «uiterlijk voor het zomerreces 2019 actief de dossiers van alle onderkende Nederlandse uitreizigers, man of vrouw, te beoordelen op de mogelijkheid van het intrekken van het Nederlanderschap in het belang van de nationale veiligheid, en de Kamer hierover te informeren».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Becker over het bericht ‘Staatsvijand nummer één deradicaliseert maar niet’

VVD MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about press reports that a convicted jihadist (Samir A.) was not deradicalised despite a government-supported trajectory, and about how agencies coordinate, who leads, whether financing of terrorism is prosecuted, and what happens to those who are not receptive. The minister acknowledged the trajectory failed, defended the TER team's effectiveness, described the coordination mechanisms and roles, and stated that prosecution is an opportunity decision for the OM, but gave no concrete new commitment.
When in 2015 it appeared that the intended goal, demonstrable deradicalisation of A., was not achieved, the deployment of this expert was ended.
Toen in 2015 bleek dat het beoogde doel, aantoonbare deradicalisering van A., niet werd behaald, is de inzet van deze expert beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap, Remco Dijkstra en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Venlo hotspot voor snelwegcrimineel’

MPs asked about rising cargo theft and mobile banditry targeting truck drivers near Venlo, including secure parking, EU action and prosecution of foreign suspects. The minister answered that incidents are falling, cited secure truck parking projects, joint task forces and prosecution measures, and committed to continued talks with the transport sector.
Compared with other European countries, the number of registered reports of transport crime in the Netherlands is relatively higher.
Vergeleken met andere Europese landen is het aantal geregistreerde meldingen van transportcriminaliteit in Nederland relatief hoger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Becker over het bericht 'Ter Apel wil van opvangcentrum af wil, tenzij er meer politie komt'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Security ministers about reports that Westerwolde wanted to end its reception centre contract unless more police were deployed, and about the police capacity agreed for Ter Apel. The minister answered that police allocation is handled regionally and nationally, outlined the 2010 agreement and the current capacity arrangements, and committed to a meeting with the regional mayor and the Westerwolde mayor and a further letter before the summer recess.

As I also reported to your House in the Police committee meeting on 4 June, I have nonetheless arranged a separate meeting in the short term with the regional mayor of Noord-Nederland and the mayor of Westerwolde to discuss this problem.

Zoals ik uw Kamer ook in het AO Politie op 4 juni jl. heb gemeld, heb ik desalniettemin op korte termijn een aparte afspraak met de regioburgemeester Noord-Nederland en de burgemeester van Westerwolde om over deze problematiek te spreken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Van Wijngaarden en Laan-Geselschap over de berichten ‘Tientallen jongeren met grensoverschrijdend gedrag worden niet behandeld’ en ‘Aanhoudingen in Rotterdam voor groepsverkrachtin

Three VVD MPs asked the Ministers for Legal Protection and Health about press reports on untreated youths with sexual boundary-crossing behaviour and group rape by minors in Rotterdam. The government answered that trends in juvenile sex offending are falling, that municipalities are responsible for youth care ordered by courts, and that financial shortfall does not exempt municipalities from their duty.
Under the Youth Act, municipalities are responsible for the provision of youth care. Financial shortage does not release municipalities from their youth care obligation.
Op grond van de Jeugdwet zijn gemeenten verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de jeugdhulp. Financiële krapte ontslaat gemeenten niet van hun jeugdhulpplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Becker over het bericht ‘Amby wil ‘jihadbruid’ Aïcha niet in de buurt’ en het Limburg programma Avondgasten ‘Jihadbruid’ Aïcha uit Maastricht

MPs Laan-Geselschap and Becker (VVD) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that a returned foreign-fighter woman would live in a Maastricht neighbourhood, including whether mandatory deradicalisation, notification of residents and municipal supervision apply. Minister Grapperhaus answered that no mandatory deradicalisation is imposed in such cases, that location restrictions are possible via conditions or a temporary anti-terror order, that the BIJ notification scheme does not yet cover terrorism convicts, and that a multidisciplinary case consultation monitors individuals.
A improvement plan for the BIJ scheme is currently being drawn up.
Op dit moment wordt er een verbeterplan voor de BIJ-regeling gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laan-Geselschap en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Opgesloten terrorist moet kunnen verdienen’

MPs Van Laan-Geselschap and Van Wijngaarden asked why prison authorities would let frozen-asset terrorist detainees earn and receive money, and whether this undermines the sanctions regime. The minister replied that only a capped internal prison account (500 euro, one contact person) is exempt, other frozen accounts stay blocked, the sanctions rationale still holds, and sanctions beyond asset freezing (travel and contact bans, supervision, nationality deprivation) exist.

By making the exemption possible only for limited amounts on the internal prison current account intended for activities within the penal institution, the exemption does not detract from the risk reduction intended by the sanction measure.

Door de ontheffing alleen mogelijk te maken voor beperkte geldbedragen op de interne rekening courant die bestemd zijn voor activiteiten binnen de penitentiaire inrichting, doet de ontheffing geen afbreuk aan de risicoverkleining zoals bedoeld in de sanctiemaatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Remco Dijkstra, Koopmans en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht dat Defensie zich nog geen raad weet met steeds kleinere drones

VVD MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs, among others, about the difficulty of countering increasingly small drones, expert recommendations, inter-ministerial coordination, and Defence's counter-drone research and industry cooperation. The ministers replied that research is ongoing with international partners, coordination with the police and Justice and Veiligheid exists, and Nederland is pursuing counter-drone categories in EDIDP, without committing to new checks on the executive.
The cabinet will return on this matter shortly in a letter that will be sent to the House soon.
Het kabinet komt op korte termijn ter zake in een brief die uw kamer spoedig zal toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘AIVD: zorgen over radicalisme bij naschoolse Arabische lessen’

MPs Becker and Laan-Geselschap asked about AIVD concerns over radicalism at informal Arabic-language after-school lessons and whether supervision of such informal education should be broadened. The minister answered that the government lacks full insight into informal schooling, will commission an independent exploration in three stages including possible supervision and intervention options, and pointed to the evaluation of the Wet op de Jeugdverblijven due in summer 2019.
Therefore the cabinet will commission an exploration of forms of informal schooling in the Netherlands to gain more insight into their nature and scope.
Daarom gaat het kabinet een verkenning laten uitvoeren naar vormen van informele scholing in Nederland om meer inzicht in aard en omvang ervan te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Laan-Geselschap over inzake het bericht ‘Belgische politie gaat bolides van roekeloze autopatsers direct in beslag nemen’

MPs Dijkstra and Laan-Geselschap asked whether Dutch law can seize cars from reckless drivers as Belgian police do, and how reckless driving is currently tackled. The minister replied that existing criminal and administrative powers already allow strong action, that car seizure is limited to specific grounds with prosecutor consultation and court review, and that no administrative seizure system like Belgium's is planned, pointing instead to two pending bills.
I therefore see no reason to introduce a seizure system such as the one described in the article.
Ik zie daarom geen redenen om een systeem van inbeslagname zoals in het bewuste artikel wordt beschreven te invoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Lodders en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht 'Kwart miljoen boetes voor 1 km/u te hard: 'Dit riekt naar spekken staatskas'

VVD MPs asked the government whether fining drivers for speeding just 1 km/h over is justified, given that administration costs (9 euro) nearly equal the fine, and raised questions about the 130 km/h lower tolerance, foreign offenders and camera-based enforcement. The Justice Minister defended enforcement of small speeding offences for road safety, explained the cost breakdown and the abolition of the lower tolerance on 130 km/h roads, and reported on cross-border enforcement and the start of camera use by the tax authority.
Traffic enforcement exists to promote compliance with traffic rules and thereby safeguard road safety.
Verkeershandhaving is er om de naleving van de verkeersregels te bevorderen en daarmee de verkeersveiligheid te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Nijkerken-de Haan en Laan-Geselschap over ‘Politie Limburg wil DNA-onderzoeken onderbrengen bij een commercieel forensisch instituut’

MPs of the VVD asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a plan by Limburg police and the prosecution to have DNA and digital trace examinations carried out by a commercial institute (TMFI) rather than the NFI, asking about capacity, delays, the expected acceleration, and data protection. The minister replied that the trial is still in its research phase, that such arrangements are already possible via the NFI's One Stop Shop, that effects can only be measured after about three years, and that private partners must meet NFI and GDPR privacy requirements.
It is unclear which traces the article refers to; the article does not distinguish between digital traces and DNA traces.
Het is onduidelijk op welke sporen in het artikel wordt gedoeld, het artikel maakt geen onderscheid tussen digitale sporen en DNA-sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Onze veiligheid in eigen hand houden’

MPs Weverling and Laan-Geselschap asked the government about a proposed national secure communications network (NVC) and whether it is needed for critical infrastructure, emergency services and C2000 back-up, and about security audits of C2000 technology. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the government does not see the need for an NVC, that vital providers bear primary responsibility, and that a study into a C2000 solution independent of states with offensive cyber programmes will be reported after the summer.
In this letter I committed to carry out an exploration of a solution that does not depend on countries that have been established to run offensive cyber programmes against Dutch interests.

In deze brief heb ik toegezegd een verkenning uit te voeren naar een oplossing die niet afhankelijk is van landen waarvan is vastgesteld dat ze een offensief cyberprogramma voeren tegen Nederlandse belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht 'Haatpreek wint terrein'

Two VVD MPs asked ministers about salafist hate preachers in mosques and online, and about counter-strategies, sanctions and closing mosques. The government answered that it applies criminal prosecution, travel bans, the Twbmt, a planned civil-law route to ban radical organisations, and an integrated approach, while declining to comment on specific individuals or to commission a further investigation into online platforms.
I cannot make statements about possible ongoing actions against the spiritual leaders mentioned in the article.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over mogelijk lopende acties tegen de in het artikel genoemde voormannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Laan-Geselschap, Groothuizen en Van Dam over de procedure en de capaciteit bij het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens

MPs asked about budget problems at the Council of Europe and the European Court of Human Rights, the reopening of Dutch criminal cases after a unilateral state acknowledgement of a Convention breach, and extra staff for Dutch cases at the Court. The minister said the Netherlands must meet its payment obligations and wants the Court spared from cuts, that the government will examine whether the reopening rules need amending, and that talks are underway on extra support for the Court's registry.

In view of this, I will examine whether amending the statutory provisions is necessary and desirable to ensure that revision is possible on the basis of a decision by the ECtHR following a unilateral government declaration that the Convention has been breached.

Gelet hierop zal ik bezien of aanpassing van de wettelijke regeling nodig en gewenst is om te verzekeren dat herziening mogelijk is op grond van de beslissing door het EHRM na een eenzijdige verklaring van de regering dat het verdrag is geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Koerhuis over het bericht 'Negen jaar Crisis- en Herstelwet: de (dis)balans'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether lengthy objection and appeal procedures, allegedly abused by querulous stakeholders, delay housing projects and whether settlement payments to objectors should be curbed, and whether legal rules could be changed to speed up procedures. The Minister answered that existing law already allows abuse to be countered, that settlements are private and not monitored, and that further restriction of appeal rights is not desirable, though further acceleration measures in the Crisis- and Herstelwet are being pursued.
I am aware that project developers and other clients sometimes reach a settlement with a party that has lodged an objection or appeal. These settlements are not made public.

Ik ben er van op de hoogte dat projectontwikkelaars en andere opdrachtgevers soms een schikking treffen met een partij die in bezwaar of beroep is gegaan. Deze schikkingen worden niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Ondernemer zwicht voor bedreigingen en stapt uit windmolenproject De Monden’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Justice about a report that an entrepreneur withdrew from the De Monden wind farm after threats, asking about condemnation, prosecution, NCTV classification, victim support and lessons learned. The government condemned threats, said a police and prosecution investigation is ongoing, and gave limited operational detail while noting a very small group breaks the law.
The police and the Public Prosecution Service are currently conducting a criminal investigation, so I cannot go into the substance of the case.
Politie en OM doen momenteel strafrechtelijk onderzoek, waardoor ik inhoudelijk niet op de zaak kan ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Rudmer Heerema en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘ADO supporters bekladden Amsterdam’

MPs from the VVD asked the government about reports that ADO Den Haag supporters defaced Amsterdam monuments, including the Dokwerker, with anti-Jewish slogans, asking about arrests, club responsibility, and nationwide stadium bans. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that a complaint is under review by the Public Prosecution Service, that the KNVB and clubs can impose stadium bans as a private-law measure, and that he will discuss antisemitism in football with the KNVB.
In the interest of the investigation, I cannot make further statements about the investigation.
In het belang van het onderzoek kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Incidenten verwarde mensen heftiger’

MPs De Lange and Laan-Geselschap (VVD) asked the Justice and Health ministers about a report that incidents involving people with confused behaviour were becoming more severe and that police registrations had doubled. The minister answered that E33 registrations are not diagnoses, that the rise cannot yet be explained, and pointed to a person-centred approach, regional support teams, and planned information-sharing legislation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Den Boer, Van der Graaf en Laan-Geselschap over leren van geweld

MPs asked whether the attacks on mosques in New Zealand warranted revising protection policy for mosques and religious institutions, and whether threat levels had changed. The Minister answered that there are no concrete indications the threat to religious institutions has risen, that existing policy and local measures are sufficient, and pointed to guidance documents and his letter of 21 March 2019.
At this moment I therefore see no reason to revise the existing policy.
Op dit moment zie ik daarom geen aanleiding om het bestaande beleid te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Laan-Geselschap en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht 'Tienduizenden boetes trajectcontrole A2-tunnel bij Maastricht zijn onterecht'

MPs asked whether unclear signage at the A2 tunnel near Maastricht made tens of thousands of average-speed fines invalid after a court ruling, and how affected drivers would be compensated. The minister replied that the signage met the rules, was clarified in late 2017, that the court only set one fine to zero on its facts, and that no collective correction is planned.
Rijkswaterstaat has indicated that the signage on the A2 meets the requirements for traffic signs. There is therefore no question of wrongly imposed fines.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft aangegeven dat de bebording op de A2 voldoet aan de eisen inzake verkeerstekens. Er is dan ook geen sprake van onterecht opgelegde boetes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht 'Twee Amsterdammers aangehouden na reeks plofkraken'

MPs Van Dam and Laan-Geselschap asked the Justice Minister about the trend in ATM explosive robberies (plofkraken), clearance rates, bank and government prevention, pilot approaches, and risks from the new Geldmaat ATM rollout. The minister reported the Dutch count rose in 2015-2016, fell in 2017-2018, and recent data show 13 cases in early 2019, with stricter prosecution guidelines, bank-police-prosecution cooperation, and pilots extended to end 2019.
Because of the large number of ongoing investigations in which further arrests are expected, the number of solved cases will still rise.
Vanwege het grote aantal lopende onderzoeken waarin nog aanhoudingen zijn te verwachten, zal het aantal opgeloste zaken nog stijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Laan-Geselschap over illegale bewoning op vakantieparken

MPs Koerhuis and Laan-Geselschap asked the government about illegal residence on holiday parks, including ZKA findings that a third of parks lack a tourist future and about ten percent face serious safety problems. Minister Ollongren answered that an action agenda 2018-2020 is being implemented, pilots will report by end 2020, an information base with the Kadaster will help municipalities, and conversion to housing is possible locally.
I will inform you about the results after the pilots are completed.
Ik zal u na afronding van de pilots over de resultaten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Aartsen en Laan-Geselschap over het kraken van het Fort bij Velsen in de gemeente Beverwijk door oud-ADM-krakers

VVD MPs asked whether the government will act against squatters who occupied the listed Fort bij Velsen, whether the owner filed a complaint, and whether monumental buildings should get priority for eviction and damage recovery. Minister Grapperhaus said squatting is illegal, the owner filed a report, a court allowed eviction, and no change to prosecutorial priorities for monuments is planned, while withholding details on individual cases.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele zaken doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Nederlandse politie verknalt (onnodig) miljoenen aan peperdure munitie op de oefenbaan’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security to explain why the price police pay for ammunition is withheld, after a report about costly ammunition at the training range. The minister confirmed the price is commercially confidential, given an ongoing tender, but offered to make it available to the House confidentially under usual conditions.
I am willing to make the information you requested available for confidential inspection by your House under the usual conditions.
Ik ben bereid de door u gevraagde informatie – volgens de gebruikelijke voorwaarden – vertrouwelijk bij uw Kamer ter inzage te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Van Oosten over het bericht Fikse straffen bij geweld tegen hulpverleners? Rechters blijken milder dan OM

MPs Laan-Geselschap and Van Oosten asked the Justice Minister why courts impose lower sentence increases than the prosecution's 200% guideline for violence against public-service workers, and about snelrecht use and a reporting obligation for New Year's Eve offenders. The minister answered that the 200% is one factor within a case-specific demand, that courts largely follow prosecution demands, that the courts cannot quantify such figures, and that new measures are under discussion with relevant bodies.
When asked, the Council for the Judiciary informed me that it cannot generate overviews.
Desgevraagd heeft de Raad voor de Rechtspraak mij bericht geen overzichten te kunnen genereren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht: “Konijnenfokkers bedreigd: Ik ben bang voor een kogel door mijn raam”

MPs Lodders and Laan-Geselschap asked about threats against rabbit farmers, inspection and offence figures, and police and government protection measures. The minister condemns all threats, reports that 15 of 45 inspections found violations (none classed as serious), and says the police do not register victims by occupation, so no figures on reports or convictions are available.
The police do not register victims by their profession and therefore have no figures available on this.
De politie registreert niet specifiek op het beroep van slachtoffers en heeft hierover dan ook geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht Nederlandse politie verknalt (onnodig) miljoenen aan peperdure munitie op de oefenbaan

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why police use expensive operational ammunition for training and whether separate practice ammunition would save 1.5 to 2 million euros a year. The minister answered that operational ammunition is used for training to avoid mix-ups and over-penetration risks, that the price difference is small, and that separate practice ammunition would add storage and administration costs, so the police deliberately chose not to use it.
The price the police pay for its ammunition is commercially confidential information and is therefore not made public, partly in light of the ongoing tender.
De prijs die de politie betaalt voor haar munitie is commercieel vertrouwelijke informatie en wordt daarom, mede in het licht van de lopende aanbesteding, niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht dat duizenden mensen illegaal op een vakantiepark wonen

Two VVD MPs asked the Interior and Justice ministers about reports that thousands of people live illegally on Veluwe holiday parks, including whether the government will prevent criminal groups from exploiting them and whether it will publish quantitative and per-park overviews. The minister answered that no national data exists on permanent occupancy and deferred enforcement to municipalities, while promising support, a learning network, pilots and better data.
No quantitative overview is available at national level of holiday parks where permanent residence takes place.
Op landelijk niveau is geen kwantitatief overzicht beschikbaar van vakantieparken waar permanente bewoning plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Burgemeesters verbolgen over einde aan lintje voor brandweervrijwilligers’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the end of automatic royal honours for volunteer firefighters with 20 years of service, and whether the government would reverse the decision. The minister answered that the honours policy no longer fits current practice, pointed to alternative recognitions such as Brandweer Nederland's own awards and a 10-year volunteer medal, and declined to reconsider.
I understand this decision, which was taken after consultation with me as the minister responsible for the fire service system.
Ik heb begrip voor dit besluit dat na overleg met mij als verantwoordelijke voor het stelsel van de Brandweerzorg is genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Bouwen in het groen? Wel doen’

MPs Koerhuis and Laan-Geselschap (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about the Chief Government Architect's public stance against building in green areas and its implications for housing policy and decentralised housing responsibility. The minister answered that the advisory views are non-binding, that the government must prioritise accelerating housing construction, that regions should first use inner-city space but some may need greenfield sites, and that the National Environmental Vision will set the direction for a national vision.
The advice of the College of State Advisers and the Chief Government Architect is not binding and aims to promote spatial, and therefore integrated, thinking.
De adviezen van het College van Rijksadviseurs c.q. de Rijksbouwmeester hebben geen bindend karakter en hebben als doel het denken vanuit een ruimtelijke, dus integrale, invalshoek te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap en Van den Bosch over het bericht ‘Vergunning in strijd tegen criminaliteit’

Two VVD MPs asked whether a licensing requirement with financial checks for certain branches or streets, as used in Rotterdam, could help fight undermining crime, and whether mayors have a factsheet of administrative tools. The minister answered that municipalities may introduce such licensing within the limits of higher law and that existing information for mayors is sufficient, so no factsheet or new guidance is planned.
No, there is already sufficient information available for municipalities.
Nee, er is voor gemeenten al voldoende informatie beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Overlast door bruiloftsstoet: de feiten’

MPs Laan-Geselschap and Dijkstra (VVD) asked whether wedding convoys disrupting traffic with antisocial manoeuvres, including a Rotterdam convoy throwing fireworks, are being tackled, how many such incidents occurred, and whether rental-car operators could be blacklisted. The minister replied that police act on reports and issue fines, that no separate registration exists, that investigation of the Rotterdam incidents is ongoing, and that no blacklist is considered necessary.
The police have informed me that no separate registration of these is kept.
De politie heeft mij laten weten dat hiervan geen aparte registratie wordt bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘BOA wacht lang op politiehulp’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report that BOAs (special investigating officers) wait long for police assistance, and about the division of tasks and powers in the security chain. The minister confirmed awareness, explained the roles of police, BOAs and private security, said the monopoly on force stays with police, and pointed to a forthcoming WRR exploration of the police function in 2020.
I have committed to sending this study, with a policy response, to your House.
Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd dit onderzoek, voorzien van een beleidsreactie, toe te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over aangifte van een geweldsmisdrijf op het Leidseplein in Amsterdam

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether a victim of a violent crime on the Leidseplein in Amsterdam could report it much sooner than the one-week wait mentioned on social media, and about waiting lists and differences between police units. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case, said police aim for fast, low-threshold contact, estimated a two-to-five-day wait in Amsterdam based on practice, and noted that reporting is arranged by appointment with capacity planned in advance.
I will not go into individual cases. That is a matter for the local authority.
Ik ga niet in op individuele zaken. Dat is aan het lokale gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Tilburgs zwembad doet deuren dicht tijdens feestje, vier meisjes mogelijk aangerand’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that a Tilburg swimming pool locked its doors during a party where four girls were possibly assaulted, and about measures such as finger scanning for entry. The minister answered that pool order is a local matter, that the mayor has informed the council, that no criminal complaint has been filed so far, and that camera footage was handed to police.
Enforcing order and rules in swimming pools is a local matter.
De handhaving van de orde en regels in zwembaden is een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Weverling over het bericht ‘112 onbereikbaar door accudieven’

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that battery theft from telecom masts threatens 112 availability, and whether it is being tackled. The minister answered that emergency calls are largely protected by roaming and call priority, that police registered 136 theft reports in 2018 with few arrests, that no data exists on outages caused by theft, and that police prioritise theft by seriousness and indicators, with regional consultations possible.
Theft of emergency power batteries therefore does not directly lead to reduced availability.
Diefstal van noodstroomaccu’s leidt dan ook niet direct tot een verminderde bereikbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Ruim duizend automobilisten onder invloed van drugs’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the backlog of over a thousand drug-driving cases, sentencing levels, drug-test practice and enforcement capacity. The Minister said cases are being scheduled in stages, sentences follow the prosecutors' guideline with a higher penalty proposed in a pending bill, and the police are reviewing how they register test results.
I intend to speak with the police about options for more separate registration, and this point will also be addressed.
Ik ben voornemens met de politie te spreken over mogelijkheden voor meer afzonderlijke registratie, waarbij ook dit punt aan de orde zal komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Wel vragen, geen zorgen over breken politiehandboeien’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how an arrestee could break police handcuffs in two, whether the equipment is sound, and whether the cause would be investigated. The minister answered that handcuffs must not break, that the manufacturer is investigating the cause, that police see no reason for extra measures now, and that the broken pair belonged to the old series being replaced gradually.
Handcuffs, after all, should not break.
Handboeien horen immers niet te breken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Weverling over het bericht ‘Ecologen: zonneparken zijn funest voor de natuur’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether they share experts' concern that large solar parks harm nature and soil life, and about rooftop priority, land competition, the number of solar parks under construction, the government's role, and innovative placement such as noise barriers. The ministers answered that ecological effects depend on site and design, that spatial planning is primarily a responsibility of municipalities and provinces, that rooftops should be prioritised per the draft NOVI, and that they will inform parliament in early 2019 on a national assessment framework.
I will inform you early in 2019 about the implementation of this motion and also involve it in drafting the draft NOVI.
Ik zal u begin 2019 informeren over de uitvoering van deze motie en deze ook betrekken bij het opstellen van de ontwerpNOVI.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘NCTV: Windmolenhaters radicaliseren, boeren gesaboteerd’

MPs Yesilgöz-Zegerius and Laan-Geselschap asked about reports that opponents of wind turbines are radicalising, including threats, intimidation and sabotage, and what protection and data exist. The minister condemns such acts, says individuals and employers are first responsible for their own safety, notes police do not record windmill-related offences separately, and cites the DTN 48 threat assessment.
Offences committed in relation to windmills are not registered by the police under a separate code.
Delicten die worden gepleegd in relatie tot windmolens worden door de politie niet geregistreerd onder een aparte code.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over de culturele invulling van handelsmissies

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how culture is incorporated into trade missions, including how cultural institutions are selected, whether innovative firms can join, and whether art can be promoted as an export product. The minister answered that culture is not a standard part of trade missions, there are no formal selection criteria, creative-sector firms are routinely invited, and the government supports promotion of Dutch culture mainly through facilitation.
Cultural programmes are not a standard part of trade missions.
Culturele programma's maken geen standaard deel uit van handelsmissies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht 'Wie koopt bunker van nazi-topman Seyss-Inquart?'

An MP asked whether the Julianabunker (Seyss-Inquart's command bunker, a rijksmonument) and its cultural-historical value will be protected when the state sells it, and why it is not maintained to standard. The government says the monument's heritage value is protected under the Erfgoedwet and the Nota van Uitgangspunten, that sale goes by open tender with heritage-respecting plans, and that storm damage repair is delayed by a power-supply split.
The repair of this damage will take place soon, after connection to the regular power network.
Het herstel van deze schade zal binnenkort plaatsvinden, na aansluiting op het reguliere stroomnetwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Rekenkamer: OCW controleert slecht op cultuursubsidies’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why OCW failed to enforce four performance requirements on cultural subsidies, as the Court of Audit found, and whether subsidies would be reclaimed and the policy changed. The minister said the requirements were only partly applicable, that subsidies were budget-based and not tied to specific performance, that the Court of Audit did not find subsidies wrongly granted, and that the specific requirements are no longer separately included in decisions, while promising to answer before the 2017 closing budget law debate.

By including only a few specific performance ambitions as performance requirements in the grant decision, the impression can be created that those performances are more important than the other performances the institution itself intended.

Door in de verleningsbeschikking slechts enkele specifieke prestatie-ambities op te nemen als prestatie-eis, kan de indruk worden gewekt dat die prestaties belangrijker zijn dan de overige door de instelling zelf voorgenomen prestaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het beschermingsprogramma wederopbouw 1959-1965

A VVD MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why many post-war (wederopbouw) buildings outside the 1959-1965 protection programme remain unprotected, why iconic buildings like the St. Petrus Bandenkerk and Fatimahuis are not safeguarded, whether municipalities should be able to nominate municipal monuments for national status, and whether consultation with heritage actors was adequate. The Minister replied that the government uses a deliberately selective, programme-based designation policy, that consultation was extensive, that she sees no reason for renewed talks, and that municipalities are involved whenever national monuments are designated in their area.

For the 1959–1965 protection programme, a great deal of time was in fact set aside for consultation with the heritage sector, municipalities, provinces and heritage organisations such as Heemschut and the Cuypers Genootschap.
Bij het beschermingsprogramma 1959–1965 is juist veel tijd ingeruimd voor overleg met het erfgoedveld, gemeenten, provincies en erfgoedinstellingen zoals Heemschut en het Cuypers Genootschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Gemeenten misbruiken Crisis- en herstelwet’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether municipalities are misusing the Crisis and Recovery Act by adding sustainability requirements to housing projects that delay construction, and what the government will do about it. The minister rejects the claim of misuse, says sustainability and housing speed are compatible, and says she is in discussion with municipalities and provinces on speeding up housing production.
I do not share NEPROM's view that the Crisis and Recovery Act is being misused.
Ik deel de mening van de NEPROM niet dat de Crisis- en herstelwet misbruikt wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over diversiteit in de theatersector

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the Council for Culture's suggestion of a diversity quota in theatre and whether talent should outweigh skin colour. The minister said the quota is only being studied for effectiveness within the wider cultural policy advice, that diversity should be promoted, and that considering team composition in hiring is not positive discrimination.
The Council advises examining the effectiveness of a quota for cultural diversity at theatre organisations in its theatre sector advice.
De Raad adviseert in het sectoradvies theater de effectiviteit te onderzoeken van een quotum voor culturele diversiteit bij theaterorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht in het Dagblad van het Noorden van 6 februari jl. “Het Noorden laat veel subsidie voor Rijksmonumenten liggen”

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why Rijksmonument loans from the Nationaal Restauratiefonds are used less in the periphery than in the Randstad, and requested data on loans and average amounts. The minister explained the regional differences by weaker economic demand for non-residential monuments outside urban zones, provided loan figures, and committed to asking the fund to raise awareness where large restorations stall.
The Ministry of OCW will ask the Restauratiefonds to bring this message more to attention when large-scale restorations and repurposings struggle to get off the ground.
Het Ministerie van OCW zal het Restauratiefonds verzoeken om deze boodschap nog meer onder de aandacht te brengen, wanneer grootschalige restauraties en herbestemmingen moeizaam van de grond komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht in het Brabants Dagblad van 24 januari jl. "Toezicht op erfgoed kan beter"

An MP asked the education, culture and science minister about a newspaper report that some Brabant municipalities have weak or abolished heritage advisory commissions, and whether this is widespread. The minister answered that the province supervises these commissions, the situation has improved, a fuller monitoring report is expected, and a joint cabinet response on the supervision law will follow.
Within the framework of inter-governmental supervision, the province of Noord-Brabant supervises heritage care in the Brabant municipalities.
In het kader van het interbestuurlijk toezicht houdt de provincie Noord-Brabant toezicht op de monumentenzorg bij de Brabantse gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht dat de oudejaarsconference van BNNVARA subsidie heeft ontvangen

MPs Laan-Geselschap and Yesilgöz-Zegerius asked whether BNNVARA's New Year's Eve cabaret show received subsidy from the CoBO Fund on top of public broadcasting funding, and whether this was justified and transparent. Minister Slob answered that CoBO's contribution comes from the public broadcaster's own programme funds, that the decision is independent, that costs are capped at 20% and that the government committed to annual budget transparency reporting by the NPO.
I have no opinion on the CoBO board's decision to make a contribution to BNNVARA's New Year's Eve conference.
Over het besluit van CoBO om een bijdrage te geven aan de Oudejaarsconference van BNNVARA heb ik geen oordeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Lodders over het bericht ‘Kans op onnodig betalen van leges steeds groter’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities may charge permit fees under outdated, unextended zoning plans, which the Wro prohibits after ten years, and how overcharged businesses can be compensated. The Minister says such fees are unlawful and disapproves of them, but places the duty to ensure valid grounds and to remedy overcharging mainly on municipalities and provinces, without estimating the scale.
Article 3.1, fourth paragraph of the Wro clearly provides that it is not permitted to collect leges when the zoning plan is more than ten years old.
In artikel 3.1, vierde lid van de Wro is duidelijk bepaald dat het niet is toegestaan om leges in te vorderen wanneer het bestemmingsplan meer dan tien jaar oud is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht dat de buste van Johan Maurits is weggehaald uit de foyer van het Mauritshuis

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the Mauritshuis moving a bust of Johan Maurits out of its foyer amid debate over slavery's legacy, and whether such removals of historical figures' statues and names should be stopped. The minister answered that the museum decides how to present its history, that the figure has been presented in a revised context since 2017, and that museums and municipalities may join the debate with added context.
I leave it to the Mauritshuis to decide how it wants to present and integrate art and history in its public activities.
Ik laat aan het Mauritshuis over op welke wijze zij de kunst en de geschiedenis willen presenteren en integreren in hun publieksactiviteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over inzake het bericht 'Christelijke scholen hebben geen zin in Wilhelmusplicht'

An MP asked the minister about reports that Christian schools oppose the coalition plan requiring pupils to learn the Wilhelmus, and how that plan would be implemented and when. The minister said the plan will be part of the curriculum revision, with development teams preparing proposals and legislation targeted for 2019 applying to all schools.
The cabinet aims to introduce legislation for an updated curriculum in 2019, based on the proposals of the development teams.
Het kabinet streeft ernaar om – op basis van de voorstellen van de ontwikkelteams – in 2019 te komen met wetgeving voor een geactualiseerd curriculum.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de gemeente Rotterdam medische gegevens opvraagt bij de huisarts om te bepalen of mensen recht hebben op warmtetoeslag

MP Hijink asked the minister about reports that Rotterdam requests medical records from GPs to decide on heating allowance claims, questioning the relevance, storage, privacy and proportionality of such requests. The minister answers that the Participatiewet and AVG permit requesting medical information for individual special assistance, that the SMA doctor alone has access and requests are rare (about 3% of cases), and that the government sees no reason to intervene with Rotterdam.
As long as work is done according to current laws and regulations, such as the Participatiewet, AVG and KNMG guidelines, I see no reason to enter into discussion with a municipality.
Zolang er gewerkt wordt volgens vigerende wet- en regelgeving, zoals de Participatiewet, AVG en KNMG-richtlijnen zie ik geen aanleiding om in gesprek te gaan met een gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het arrest van het Gerechtshof Arnhem-Leeuwarden over de vergoeding van een door een apotheker bereid ADHD-geneesmiddel

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether the Arnhem-Leeuwarden Court of Appeal ruling on reimbursement of a pharmacist-prepared ADHD medicine undermines the government's position on tapering strips, and whether insurers, the Zorginstituut and SKGZ should be pressed to revisit generic negative stances. The Minister answered that the ruling does not extend to tapering strips, that individual medical judgement does not determine basic-package content, that the insurers and SKGZ act independently and must judge individual cases themselves.

The Zorginstituut and the SKGZ carry out their tasks independently. It is not appropriate for me to enter into discussion with them to give substantive instructions on how they should perform their tasks.
Het Zorginstituut en de SKGZ voeren hun taken onafhankelijk uit. Het is niet gepast dat ik met hen in gesprek ga om inhoudelijke aanwijzingen te geven hoe zij hun taken moeten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over gedwongen verhuizingen van mensen in zorgwoningen in Horst aan de Maas

An SP MP asked whether forced relocation of 18 residents of Pluryn care homes in Horst aan de Maas is acceptable, whether residents' legal protection is adequate, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister answered that the closure is driven by quality and financial sustainability concerns, that Pluryn is consulting residents, families, staff and the municipality, and that the minister sees no role for himself beyond trusting local consultation.
I see no role for myself in this and rely on good consultation on the ground.
Ik zie voor mijzelf geen rol hierin en vertrouw op het goede overleg ter plekke.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Hijink, Mohandis, Werner en Sylvana Simons over het ratificeren van het facultatief protocol bij het VN-verdrag voor rechten van mensen met een beperking

Five MPs asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport whether she would keep her promise to decide by the end of Q1 2023 on ratifying the optional protocol to the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities, and to give clarity within a week.
