The minister confirmed the commitment, explained that the decision requires broad consultation across the cabinet because the Council of State advised on related protocols, and promised the cabinet decision by mid-May 2023.
My aim is to send you the cabinet decision by mid-May 2023 at the latest.
Mijn inzet is erop gericht om u uiterlijk medio mei 2023 het kabinetsbesluit te doen toekomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de aangekondigde stakingen bij de ziekenhuizen en het feit dat KPMG aangeeft dat ziekenhuizen in de rode cijfers komen als ze akkoord gaan met de cao-eisen van d

SP MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about planned hospital strikes, a KPMG finding that hospitals would run losses if they accepted union wage demands, and related pay, premium and pharma-profit questions. The minister answered that a new collective agreement had been reached, that the annual overheid bijdrage (ova) is the government's contribution to wage development, that hospitals must negotiate compensation with insurers, and that a study on care-sector pay will be sent to parliament in the autumn.
In the autumn I will inform your House of the outcomes.
In het najaar zal ik uw Kamer over de uitkomsten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de open brief ‘Voorop voor gelijke gezondheid’ van artsenfederatie KNMG en ruim 70 organisaties

MP Hijink (SP) asked the government how it responds to an open letter from the KNMG and about 70 organisations on health inequality, cost barriers to care, and calls to legally anchor health goals and address poverty. The State Secretary answers by pointing to GALA funding, Welzijn Op Recept, the poverty and debt approach, an SER advisory request, and rejects legally anchoring health goals while promising further consultation and a proposal on health-promotion competences.
Legally anchoring health goals and target values in the law does not do justice to the shared responsibility of all parties that is needed.
Het wettelijk vastleggen van gezondheidsdoelen en streefwaarden in de wet doet geen recht aan de gezamenlijke verantwoordelijkheid van alle partijen, die nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Artsen protesteren voor eigen ziekenhuis, want afdeling Verloskunde moet waarschijnlijk sluiten’

An SP MP asked the health minister for reaction to reports that Gelre Ziekenhuizen in Zutphen plans to close its maternity and emergency departments, and about effects on travel times, care quality, stakeholder consultation and access. The minister answered that travel times stay within norms, nearby hospitals remain available, the hospital has consulted stakeholders as required, and a continuity plan and regional acute-care planning will follow.
It is the responsibility of care providers to decide on the organisation of their own care organisation, provided this is within the applicable norms.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van zorgaanbieders om te beslissen over de inrichting van de eigen zorgorganisatie, mits dit binnen de geldende normen is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat er het afgelopen jaar een recordaantal fusies en overnames was in de zorg en dat de rol van private equity groeit

An SP MP asked the health minister about a record number of healthcare mergers and acquisitions and the growing role of private equity, and whether this should be curbed. The minister acknowledged risks to quality and access, pointed to existing supervision by the IGJ and NZa, and said a forthcoming bill on integrity of business operations may allow conditions on profit distributions that threaten care quality.

I intend to create, in the forthcoming bill on integrity of business operations of care and youth care providers, the possibility to impose conditions where necessary on profit distributions that pose risks to the quality, availability or accessibility of care.

Wel ben ik voornemens om in het in voorbereiding zijnde wetsvoorstel Integere bedrijfsvoering zorg- en jeugdhulpaanbieders de mogelijkheid te creëren om zo nodig voorwaarden te kunnen stellen aan winstuitkeringen die risico’s vormen voor de kwaliteit, beschikbaarheid of toegankelijkheid van zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘UMCG getroffen door Russische cyberaanval, meer ziekenhuizen onder vuur’

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about a reported Russian DDoS cyberattack on the UMCG and whether hospitals are prepared for such attacks and what the risks are to patient care. The minister answered that no comparable attacks had been recorded before, that patient care was not disrupted, that hospitals are bound by NEN security norms and Z-CERT support, and that the ministry is pursuing awareness, norm revision and Z-CERT expansion.
I find it very worrying that Dutch hospitals are the target of DDoS attacks.
Ik vind het zeer zorgelijk dat Nederlandse ziekenhuizen het doelwit zijn van DDoS-aanvallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de eisen die Menzis stelt aan fysiotherapeuten om patiënten met COPD te mogen behandelen

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether insurer Menzis may require physiotherapists treating COPD patients to join the Chronisch ZorgNet network to be reimbursed, and whether insurers should set such demands in general. The Minister answered that insurers have contracting freedom under their statutory duty of care, that joining the network is voluntary, and that insurers may differentiate on quality, while agreeing to talk with insurers about harmonising requirements.
I do not have the requested information.
Ik beschik niet over de gevraagde informatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg, Agema, Kuiken, Westerveld, Koekkoek, Stoffer, Azarkan, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Pouw-Verweij, Hijink, Van Esch en Van der Plas over longcovid onderzoek

MPs from many parties asked the health minister about the future of Long COVID research, the 2022 motion calling for more structural biomedical research, earlier incorrect answers on biomedical studies, the funding available and its duration, and whether structural money will be provided. The minister answered that about 14 million euro is currently spent on around twenty studies, thirteen with a biomedical component, that a knowledge agenda is being commissioned from ZonMw, and that extra multi-year funding and an expertise centre are being considered, to be decided in May.
In addition, I intend to make extra budget available for multi-year research and an expertise centre for post-COVID.
Daarnaast ben ik voornemens om extra budget beschikbaar te maken voor meerjarig onderzoek en een expertisecentrum post-COVID.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de subsidie voor de bouw van ouderenwoningen op de plank blijft liggen

An SP MP asked the minister whether she would respond to reports that part of the subsidy for building senior housing is stalled, and how the government would speed up the slow housing-care process. The minister replies that a EUR 312 million scheme for clustered care will open around summer 2023, that regional agreements and an ambassador role are being arranged, and that the target of 290,000 senior homes is set for 2030.
For this scheme, 312 million euros is available.
Voor deze regeling is 312 mln. euro beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de medische industrie casht met nutteloze apparatuur

An SP MP asks the health minister how patient benefit is weighed when medical devices are approved, purchased and reimbursed, and whether the government will stop spending on useless devices. The minister rejects the premise, says benefit is assessed through reimbursement and procurement criteria, declines to disclose profit margins, and points to an ongoing review of the basic insurance package.
This generally concerns commercially sensitive information that is not shared with me.
Dit betreft over het algemeen bedrijfsgevoelige informatie die niet met mij wordt gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat het Meningokokkenvaccin ACWY nog steeds niet vergoed wordt voor mensen met een niet-functionerende milt

MP Hijink asks why the meningococcal ACWY vaccine remains unreimbursed for people without a functioning spleen, despite a 2020 ministerial commitment that the manufacturer would be asked to submit a reimbursement file. The minister confirms the manufacturer has not applied, says it is in principle the manufacturer's responsibility, and commits to contacting the patient association and Zorginstituut Nederland to explore the process.
In principle it is up to the manufacturer to submit a reimbursement file.
In principe is het aan de fabrikant om een vergoedingsdossier in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de dreigende sluiting van de huisartsenpost in Oss

An SP MP asks the health minister whether the threatened closure of the Oss out-of-hours GP post, and related concerns about access, personnel and privatised decision-making, is acceptable. The minister replies that a RIVM analysis shows the 30-minute accessibility norm would still be met, that any closure must follow the statutory decision procedure, and outlines workforce measures.
If they were to proceed to a decision-making process on whether or not to close the HAP in Oss, the steps in the AMvB and the Acute Care regulation must be followed.
Wanneer zij over zou gaan tot een besluitvormingsproces over het al dan niet sluiten van de HAP in Oss, dan zullen de stappen in de AMvB en regeling Acute Zorg 2 gevolgd dienen te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraar VGZ gratis en voor niks reclame maakt voor bepaalde apotheekketens

An SP MP asked the minister whether it is acceptable that insurer VGZ promotes certain online pharmacy chains to its insured and whether it should be called to account. The minister replied that insurers may inform insured persons about contracted providers if the information is accurate and balanced, that variety in pharmacy models is desirable under the Integraal Zorgakkoord, and that the inspectorate supervises online pharmacies, without committing to action against VGZ.
It is important in this regard that the information provided is correct and balanced.
Het is daarbij van belang dat de verstrekte informatie juist en evenwichtig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Hijink over Het bericht ‘Inval commerciële verpleeghuizen, ouderen verwaarloosd’

MPs Werner and Hijink asked about reports of police raids on Orpea's commercial care homes, private-equity involvement, profit disclosure to residents, property sale-and-leaseback, and IGJ supervision. The minister answered that providers must follow existing law, that the IGJ enforces care quality, and gave figures on private-equity concentrations and Orpea's growth, while declining to comment on ongoing inspections.
The IGJ does not make statements about whether investigations are ongoing.
De IGJ doet geen mededelingen over al dan niet lopend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Leijten over het bericht ‘GGD trekt stekker uit digitaal jeugddossier ondanks investering van miljoenen’

MPs Hijink and Leijten asked why three GGDs stopped developing a digital youth health dossier after millions in investment, and about alternatives, data safety and oversight. The State Secretary answered that the decision belongs to the GGD boards, that no data-safety problem exists, that alternatives will be bought from the market, and that national information standards and municipal responsibility apply.
It is not for me to respond.
Het is niet aan mij om met een reactie te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Fysio’s stoppen ermee: 'Salarisverhoging niet mogelijk zonder bedrijf in gevaar te brengen''

An SP MP asks the health minister how to respond to reports that physiotherapists are leaving the profession because insurers pay tariffs far below cost, and whether collective bargaining or nationwide cost-covering tariffs should be pursued. The minister calls the situation undesirable, points to the Integraal Zorgakkoord and a forthcoming letter on collective negotiation, says tariffs are for providers and insurers to agree, and promises talks with insurers and work on a new benefit for physiotherapy.
In the short term I will discuss this with health insurers.
Op korte termijn ga ik hier met zorgverzekeraars over in gesprek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Bevers, Van der Plas, Den Haan, Hijink en Kuik over het bericht ‘Openbaar Ministerie wil tien mensen vervolgen voor verstrekking 'Middel X'

MPs from several parties asked the Justice and Health ministers about prosecutions over the supply of suicide-enabling substance 'Middel X' linked to the Coöperatie Laatste Wil, and about prevention, victim research, and whether the criminal law or chemical sales rules should be tightened. The government said ten people are being considered for prosecution, that voluntary industry measures remain in place with no new substances found, that regulation by law is complex and of limited effect, and that research on victims and support for bereaved families is underway, while declining to comment on the ongoing criminal case or the adequacy of current law.
As long as the criminal case is ongoing, it is also not appropriate for me to give a judgement on the current legal framework.
Zolang de strafzaak loopt past het mij evenmin om een oordeel te geven over het huidige wettelijke kader.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat patiënten alleen in aanmerking komen voor bepaalde vormen van revalidatiezorg uit de basisverzekering als ze eerst uit eigen zak (of via een aanvullende verzeker

An SP MP asked the Health Minister whether patients must first pay out of pocket for physiotherapy before being granted medical specialist rehabilitation care covered by the basic insurance, and what will be done to ensure access. The minister replied that medical specialist rehabilitation is the most intensive option reserved for highly complex patients, that stepped care applies so cheaper first-line care comes first, that self-care and some first-line care are not insured, and that the Zorginstituut is reviewing the physiotherapy benefit.
To answer your question concretely, registration data on out-of-pocket payments would be needed.
Om uw vraag concreet te beantwoorden, zijn registratiegegevens nodig voor eigen betalingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de toename van het aantal mensen dat de tandarts mijdt om financiële redenen

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health why people are skipping dental visits for financial reasons and why the government rejects reinstating dental care in the basic insurance package. The Minister answers that a targeted, locally tailored approach is preferred over free or insured dental care, and commits to research on the scale and causes of avoidance, but refuses to restore coverage.
I am of the opinion that a good problem analysis, followed by a targeted and specific approach, is more appropriate.
Ik ben van mening dat een goede probleemanalyse, gevolgd door een doelgerichte en specifieke aanpak, meer opportuun is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over  problemen rondom de zorg aan onverzekerden

The SP MP Hijink asked the Minister of Health about problems in providing care to uninsured people, including rising uninsured numbers, registration and address rules, administrative burden for GPs, and refusals of care. The Minister acknowledged concern, described the existing reimbursement schemes and recent digitalisation and legal-basis fixes, and promised to restore the notification route via a Wmo amendment, though he did not commit to a faster timeline or to new measures beyond that.
Underlying medical data of uninsured persons are not known on an individual basis, not even at the CAK, so I cannot answer this question.
Achterliggende medisch gegevens van onverzekerde personen zijn niet -ook niet bij het CAK- op individuele basis bekend, deze vraag kan ik daarom niet beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de uitzending van In het vizier van De Jager over ouderenmishandeling

An SP MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care about a broadcast on elder abuse in care homes, including a whistleblower dismissed after reporting unresolved abuse and the difficulty of reporting. The minister acknowledged the mistreatment, pointed to prior research, a guidance handreiking and a serious game, and said reporting to the inspectorate is possible though the employer must handle the dismissal.
I have been in contact with Vilente. There appear to be some nuances there. It is up to the organisation to judge the dismissal of this employee.
Ik heb contact gehad met Vilente. Daar blijken enkele nuances. Het is aan de organisatie om een oordeel te geven over het ontslag van deze medewerker.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de toch wel bewaarde audiobestanden van OMT-vergaderingen

MP Hijink (SP) asks why RIVM checked for and found retained audio recordings of OMT meetings, why the deletion request of June 2022 was not acted on, and why the recordings were kept rather than deleted. Minister Kuipers answers that the recordings were found unintentionally in the VWS data, that a deletion request was delayed for other priorities, that about 29 recordings are now held and kept temporarily to avoid creating faits accomplis, and that the OMT's deliberations remain confidential.
It is standing policy not to delete documents within the scope of a request when the House asks for them or when a Woo request has been submitted.
Het is staand beleid om geen documenten (die onder de reikwijdte van het verzoek vallen) te verwijderen als de Kamer erom vraagt of als er een Woo-verzoek is ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de sluiting van de huisartsenpost in Hengelo

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about the proposed night-time closure of the Hengelo GP out-of-hours post due to GP shortages, its consequences for emergency care and patient access, and the government's responsibility. The Minister replied that the proposal is still under study, that closure would follow a formal decision process if pursued, that the 30-minute accessibility norm stays, and that responsibility is shared among regional GPs, insurers, and the government.
The research is still ongoing and it is too early to go into any results of this research.
Het onderzoek loopt nog en het is te vroeg om in te gaan op enige resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de nazorg voor burgerhulpverleners

MP Hijink asked the Minister of Health about aftercare for civilian first responders and whether contact with the people they helped can be facilitated. The minister said HartslagNu asks responders about aftercare needs, HartslagSamen enables contact if both parties consent, and he will discuss process improvements and awareness with these organisations.
I will consult with HartslagNu on how the process and the awareness of HartslagSamen can be improved.
Ik zal met HartslagNu in overleg gaan over hoe het proces en de bekendheid van HartslagSamen verbeterd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Hijink over misstanden bij Ambulancezorg Groningen

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about a culture of fear, sexual misconduct and weak quality policy at Ambulancezorg Groningen, including the employer searching staff email metadata to find leakers. The minister acknowledged the reports, said the lawfulness of the email search depends on GDPR conditions overseen by the Data Protection Authority, and pointed to inspectorate oversight and planned sector measures without committing to a new inspection.
At this moment I see no reason to ask the IGJ to again talk with those involved, including whistleblowers.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding de IGJ te vragen opnieuw met betrokkenen, waaronder klokkenluiders, in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over problemen met Wmo-voorzieningen bij een verhuizing

An SP MP asked why people moving between municipalities may be left without Wmo support, and whether the new municipality must take over existing indications and whether the Wmo should be changed. The state secretary said no such signals are known, that temporary takeover of indications is good practice, that a 2021 moving covenant exists for hulpmiddelen, and that no amendment to the Wmo is needed after a court ruling.
Following this ruling and parliamentary questions, I contacted the VNG. The VNG has committed to bring the ruling to the attention of all municipalities.
Ik heb naar aanleiding van deze uitspraak en Kamervragen contact opgenomen met de VNG. De VNG heeft mij toegezegd de uitspraak onder de aandacht te brengen van alle gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat vier van de tien zorgmedewerkers de zorg dreigen te verlaten

An SP MP asked ministers about reports that four in ten care workers may leave the sector, the rising costs of voluntary deductibles, pay, autonomy and occupational risk insurance. The minister answered that only 9% plan to leave, cited programmes (TAZ, zeggenschap subsidies, 675 million extra for middle groups) and said pay and deductible choices are individual or for social partners.
The mandatory deductible amounts to 385 euro.
Het verplichte eigen risico bedraagt 385 euro.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Zorgpersoneel met long covid radeloos, vakbonden stellen ultimatum aan kabinet’

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport how the government would respond to unions' ultimatum over financial compensation for care workers suffering long COVID who lost jobs or income. The minister replied that the government will seek Council of State advice on a follow-up to a joint exploration and will inform parliament as soon as possible, without committing to a specific payment.

After receiving the advice from the Council of State, the cabinet will decide on the follow-up to the exploration and will inform the House of Representatives about this by letter as soon as possible.
Na ontvangst van de voorlichting van de Raad van State beslist het kabinet over het vervolg op de verkenning en zal uw Kamer daarover zo spoedig mogelijk per brief worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over Problemen met tolkenvoorzieningen in de zorg

An SP MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about bureaucratic procedures at UWV for interpreter provision for deaf and hard-of-hearing people, the length of request times, limits on extra interpreting hours abroad and daily caps, and the lack of team interpreting for shorter assignments. The minister replied that user and interpreter satisfaction with UWV is largely positive, that the 8-week statutory deadline is met with a 10-day target, that the caps are needed for transparency and sustainability with case-by-case exceptions, and that team interpreting for the living domain is being explored, with ongoing optimisation planned.
For the living domain I am currently exploring the impact of lowering the minimum duration of team interpreting assignments from two hours to assignments longer than one hour.
Ik ben voor het leefdomein op dit moment bezig met het verkennen van de impact van het verlagen van de minimumduur van teamtolkopdrachten van twee uur naar opdrachten die langer dan één uur duren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Paulusma, Van den Berg, Agema, Hijink, Bikker, Stoffer, Van Esch, Azarkan, Westerveld, Kuiken, Koekkoek, Van der Plas, Den Haan, Gündoğan en Sylvana Simons over de aangenomen moti

MPs asked the health minister about the adopted motion on Long COVID research, citing US and Dutch figures on prevalence and work incapacity, and asked for an estimate of its size in the Netherlands and a letter on implementation. The minister answered that around one in eight people report lasting symptoms, that 18 ZonMw studies and a RIVM LongCOVID study are under way, and that a joint knowledge agenda and an expert centre are being prepared, without a fixed timeline for the letter.
I refer to the annex 'Preparation and protection – other relevant topics related to the long-term approach to the coronavirus' attached to the letter on the long-term COVID-19 approach.

Antwoord 5 Ik verwijs hiervoor naar de bijlage «Voorbereiding en bescherming – andere relevante onderwerpen die verband houden met de langetermijnaanpak van het coronavirus» 6 bij de Kamerbrief langetermijnaanpak COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit die ongevraagd gegevens van honderdduizenden patiënten in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg opvraagt

MPs Leijten and Hijink asked why the Dutch healthcare regulator NZa collects mental health patients' medical data without consent, whether this is acceptable given remaining re-identification risk, and whether providers refusing on confidentiality grounds face fines. The minister replies that the NZa has a statutory basis under the Wmg and GDPR art. 9(2)(g)/(h), that data are pseudonymised and destroyed after two years, that consent is not required for legally mandated transfers, and that enforcement is for the NZa to decide.
It is correct that patients are not asked for consent to share their medical data with the NZa, and that is also not necessary, because the NZa has a statutory basis to request this data.

Het klopt dat patiënten niet om toestemming gevraagd wordt om hun medische gegevens te delen met de NZa en dat is ook niet noodzakelijk, omdat de NZa een wettelijke grondslag heeft om deze gegevens op te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de financiële crisis bij het Ikazia ziekenhuis

An SP MP asked the health minister about the financial crisis at the Ikazia hospital, including the reasons for limited covid compensation, low tariffs, consequences for staff and patient safety, and whether the hospital could be prevented from failing. The minister answered that the NZa and IGJ monitor the situation, that the hardship clause produced partial compensation, that no other hospitals are known to be in the same position, and that a recovery plan is being prepared with insurers and banks.
When necessary, I will inform your House about this.
Wanneer nodig zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over lekkende zorgdata

MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the ministers how a commercial software firm could leak medical data of tens of thousands of patients, why warnings from a former employee were not acted on, whether patients and GPs must be informed, and whether additional protections against commercial use of medical data are planned. The government answered that providers are primarily responsible, that the AP supervises GDPR compliance, that it cannot comment on AIVD/MIVD investigations, and that existing rules are sufficient with further awareness and enforcement efforts.
No public statements are made about the working methods and investigations of the AIVD and MIVD.
Over werkwijzen en onderzoeken van de AIVD en MIVD worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het uitsluiten van de uitvaartbranche van de zorgbonus

The MP asks why funeral sector workers were excluded from the COVID-19 care bonus, whether the ministry will talk with the sector, and why a 2020 letter from a funeral supplier association went unanswered. The minister replies that the subsidy is limited to the care and welfare sector, the funeral sector falls outside it, and extending it is not on the table, while acknowledging correspondence from the sector.
The funeral sector does not fall under this sector and for that reason was not eligible to submit a subsidy application.
De uitvaartbranche valt niet onder de deze sector en kwam om die reden niet in aanmerking om een subsidieaanvraag in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de spoedeisende hulppost van het LangeLand Ziekenhuis die drie dagen per week gaat sluiten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health why LangeLand Hospital's emergency department closes three days a week until 1 October, what the consequences are for staff and patients, how the hospital communicates this, and whether neighbouring hospitals have capacity. The Minister says safe care comes first, the closure is needed to restore staffing and quality, staff use the time for training, patients are directed to GP, out-of-hours post, 112 or neighbouring EDs, and the hospital reports communication and regional capacity.

On the state of affairs regarding the unbundling of the Reinier Haga Group and the planning specifically for LangeLand Hospital, I have already gone into this in my answers to earlier questions from MP Hijink (SP).

Op de stand van zaken rondom de ontvlechting van de Reinier Haga Groep en de planning specifiek voor het LangeLand Ziekenhuis ben ik al eerder ingegaan in de beantwoording van de vragen van het lid Hijink (SP).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het Toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de

The MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the Ministry of VWS what measures it has taken after the childcare benefits scandal regarding harsh and disproportionate effects of laws and rules, and about its information management such as retention of chat messages and FOI request handling. The minister answered that departments are conducting inventories of harsh regulations under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, referred to letters and annexes for details, and described the chat-message retention policy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de ingrijpende veranderingen in het Langeland Ziekenhuis

An MP asked the Health Minister about reported plans by LangeLand Hospital in Zoetermeer to cut acute obstetrics, intensive care and the emergency unit, and about transparency, staff and municipal involvement. The minister answers that no decision has been taken on the Reinier Haga split and fusion, that the hospital's future is still under negotiation, and that any change to acute care must follow the Amvb acute zorg procedure, while declining to provide the confidential outline agreement.
I do not have the confidential outline agreement.
Ik beschik niet over het vertrouwelijke hoofdlijnenakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de marktwerking in de eerstelijnszorg

MP Hijink (SP) asked the health minister whether primary care should be treated as a marketable product and whether competition law blocks cooperation among primary care providers, including whether primary care should be designated a service of general economic interest. Minister Kuipers answered that cooperation is already permitted under competition rules, that the ACM provides guidance and enforcement flexibility, that DAEB designation would not solve the problems, and that remaining obstacles will be addressed with stakeholders in the Integraal Zorgakkoord.

As also mentioned in the article you refer to, research agency SEO (in cooperation with Maverick Advocaten) conducted research at the request of your House a few years ago into possible exceptions to the Competition Act for primary care.

Zoals ook wordt genoemd in het artikel waarnaar u verwijst, heeft onderzoeksbureau SEO (in samenwerking met Maverick Advocaten) op verzoek van uw Kamer enkele jaren geleden onderzoek gedaan naar mogelijke uitzonderingen op de Mededingingswet voor de eerstelijnszorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraar Zilveren Kruis personenalarmering bij stichting ATA niet meer vergoedt

An MP asked the health minister whether he would respond to health insurer Zilveren Kruis ceasing to reimburse personal alarm services from Stichting ATA, and whether he agreed the Amsterdam care chain was being fragmented and would talk to the insurer. The minister replied that contracting is a matter for insurers and providers under contractual freedom, that transition agreements exist for existing clients, and that he will not intervene in this specific case but discusses care developments generally with the parties.

It is not for me to intervene in this specific situation, given the statutory role of health insurers and care providers regarding the contracting of care in the basic insurance and the contractual freedom regarding supplementary insurance.

Het is niet aan mij om te treden in deze specifieke situatie, gezien de wettelijke rol van zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders wat betreft de contractering van de zorg in de basisverzekering en de contractsvrijheid ten aanzien van aanvullende verzekeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'GGD-GHOR laat onverzekerde burgers stikken'

An SP MP asked the health minister how the GGD-GHOR could stop processing notifications about uninsured people, why the GDPR was cited, what the consequences are, and whether the registration rules excluding homeless people from health insurance will be changed. The minister answered that no legal basis exists for processing these notifications, that care remains financed via the subsidy scheme, that a legislative change is being prepared, and that talks with GGD GHOR continue.
I will examine which legislative procedure this amendment can accompany, so that it can take effect as quickly as possible.
Ik zal bezien met welk wetstraject deze wijziging mee kan lopen, zodat deze zo snel mogelijk in werking kan treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat het MCL het ziekenhuisgebouw in Harlingen te koop zet en de zorg daar deels verdwijnt

An SP MP asked the health minister for a reaction to reports that MCL is selling its Harlingen hospital building and moving some care to Leeuwarden, and about effects on access, guarantees, consultation and the sale's rationale. The minister answered that the provider and insurers are responsible, that the NZa sees no objections, that the lower-rise building will keep a care function, and declined to intervene or talk with MCL.
It is up to the care provider and health insurers concerned to together ensure accessible, high-quality and affordable care for residents of the region.
Het is aan de betrokken zorgaanbieder en zorgverzekeraars om samen te zorgen voor toegankelijke, kwalitatief goede en betaalbare zorg voor de inwoners uit de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Wat gaat er mis in de wereld van de huisartsen? Waarom stoppen er zoveel?’

An MP from the SP asked the health minister about the pressure on GPs, psychiatric patients remaining with GPs, administrative burden and training numbers, with 12 questions in total. The minister acknowledged the workload concerns, pointed to the forthcoming Integraal Zorgakkoord, administrative-burden programme and training expansion, and gave no binding new measures beyond promised letters.
I want to make agreements with GPs and other care providers in primary care on reducing workload and maintaining job satisfaction.
Ik wil samen met huisartsen en andere zorgverleners in de eerste lijn afspraken maken over vermindering van de werkdruk en behoud van werkplezier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Hijink over het artikel 'Zorgbestuurders amper gecheckt op dubieus verleden’

MPs Van den Berg (CDA) and Hijink (SP) asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport whether care directors with criminal records or dubious care histories can still easily start new youth or home-care organisations, and why none of the 1,270 new care businesses reporting in early 2022 were asked for a VOG or subjected to integrity checks. The minister replied that a board ban blocks registration at the Chamber of Commerce, that the licence application asks about board members' past, that the number of new businesses is not alarming, and that the IGJ is still analysing the figures.

The fact that no VOG has yet been requested or integrity investigation started for the Wtza licence only means that, based on the application form and the information sources checked, there has so far been no reason to do so.

Het feit dat bij de Wtza-vergunning nog geen VOG is opgevraagd of integriteitsonderzoek is gestart zegt uitsluitend dat er bij deze zorgaanbieders op basis van het aanvraagformulier en de gecheckte informatiebronnen vooralsnog geen aanleiding is geweest om dit te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de problemen bij de woonlocatie Oosterparkheem Groningen

MP Hijink (SP) asked the State Secretary for Health about the problems at the Oosterparkheem care location in Groningen after the bankruptcy of MartiniZorg, including why elderly residents and former addicts were housed together, and whether La Hacienda's high past profits made it a suitable successor. The government answered that the municipality and health insurer are responsible for continuity of care, that most residents have been relocated, that IGJ intervened against MartiniZorg, and that a bill on conditions for profit distribution is being prepared.
For the Wlz, profit distribution is currently prohibited for intramural care and permitted for extramural care.
Voor de Wlz geldt op dit moment dat winstuitkering verboden is voor intramurale zorg en toegestaan voor extramurale zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de ggz in het eerste kwartaal al een miljoenenverlies lijdt

MP Hijink asked the minister about reports that mental health care (ggz) providers face multi-million euro losses in Q1 2022, why major providers still lack contracts with insurers, what will prevent recurrence, and whether no client will be left without care. The minister answered that contracting is the responsibility of insurers and providers, that the NZa and IGJ supervise continuity of care, that monitoring will be reported before summer, and that the NZa will be asked to examine recent treatment cutbacks for structural problems.

Because the recently announced adjustments to treatment offerings are happening in a short period, I have asked the NZa to examine the cases more closely and inform me of any common underlying factors.

Omdat de recent aangekondigde aanpassingen van behandelaanbod in korte tijd plaatsvinden heb ik de NZa gevraagd om de casuïstiek nader te bezien en mij over eventuele gemeenschappelijke onderliggende factoren te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de vergoeding voor stroomkosten van zuurstofapparaten niet toereikend is

MP Hijink asked whether electricity costs for home oxygen or ventilation devices should be fully reimbursed, and how the current reimbursement rule works given rising energy prices. Minister Kuipers said the allowance (about 0.06 euro per hour, or 1 to 1.44 euro per day) is set by insurers as reasonable and fair, that it is not indexed to electricity prices, that he is talking with Zorgverzekeraars Nederland about adjusting it this year, and that he will point insurers to CBS-index practice.
I am working on this and am in discussion with Zorgverzekeraars Nederland about the possibilities to align the level of the allowance with the signal about rising energy costs during this year.

Ik zet mij daarvoor in en ben met Zorgverzekeraars Nederland in gesprek over de mogelijkheden om de hoogte van de tegemoetkoming gedurende dit jaar nog aan te sluiten bij het signaal over de stijgende energiekosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de voorzitter van DSW stelt dat zorgverzekeraars onnodige kwaliteitscontroles opleggen

An MP asked the health minister how she responds to claims that health insurers impose unnecessary quality controls on care providers, and whether such added demands should be curbed. The minister agrees administrative burden should be reduced and says a study on uniform procurement and accountability requirements is underway, with results expected before summer, though she does not consider additional insurer requirements necessarily undesirable.

In addition, a study is currently being carried out on my instruction into the possibilities of harmonising the procurement and accountability requirements that apply to care sectors falling under the Health Insurance Act.

Daarnaast wordt er op dit moment in mijn opdracht een onderzoek uitgevoerd naar de mogelijkheden om de inkoop- en verantwoordingseisen die gelden voor zorgsectoren die vallen onder Zvw te uniformeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de groep mensen die hun coronatoegangsbewijs verliezen

The MP asked how fast people lose their COVID certificate (CTB) through expiring vaccination or recovery validity and how many will lose it on given dates. The minister gave dated estimates, stated the 3G certificate was phased out, and defended the shortened validity as proportionate given waning immunity.
I have endeavoured to answer your questions as quickly as possible.
Ik heb er naar gestreefd uw vragen zo snel mogelijk te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op de vragen van lid Hijink over het bericht dat Achterhoekse huisartsen ernstig gedupeerd worden door de wisseling van zorgverzekeraar

An SP MP asked the health minister how she views reports that GP practices in the Achterhoek lose funding for elderly care and practice nurses after a switch of preferred health insurer, and whether the government will intervene. The minister says the parties are monitoring the impact and negotiating, that the acute problem is for now resolved, and that the NZa will keep monitoring, but she does not commit to a new intervention beyond that.
Health insurers conduct their own (procurement) policy, and differences can therefore arise when the preferred health insurer changes.
Zorgverzekeraars voeren hun eigen (inkoop) beleid en er kunnen daardoor verschillen optreden bij een wisseling van preferente zorgverzekeraar.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Hijink, Omtzigt, Van der Plas en Pouw-Verweij over de positie van zorgverleners die als gevolg van long covid lange tijd thuis zitten

Four MPs asked the health minister about healthcare workers off work for long periods with long COVID, including compensation, income loss and whether those costs are covered. The minister replied that no special social security regime exists for long COVID, that a temporary subsidy for employers retaining such workers was introduced, and that causation from workplace infection cannot be established in many cases.
No registration is kept of the number of healthcare workers who are partly or fully off work after a coronavirus infection.
Er wordt geen registratie bijgehouden van het aantal zorgverleners dat na een coronabesmetting deels of volledig thuiszit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat ieder jaar 3 miljard euro zorggeld verdwijnt in de zakken van mensen die mensen leveren die zorg leveren

An SP MP asked the government about a newspaper report that 3 billion euros of care funds yearly go to intermediary, recruitment and staffing agencies, and whether agency margins and wage-cost ratios were excessive. The minister answered that most of this sum pays wages and employer charges of agency staff, that margins are roughly 10 to 20 percent, and listed measures to reduce reliance on intermediaries.
The picture that paying costs for non-employed staff results in an annual profit of 3 billion euros for agencies is in any case incorrect.
Het beeld dat de betaling van kosten voor personeel niet in loondienst voor de bemiddelings- en uitzendbureaus resulteert in een jaarlijkse winst van € 3 miljard, is in ieder geval onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Bernhoven in zwaar weer: ontslag voor 120 man en aansluiting bij groter ziekenhuis’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about Bernhoven hospital's financial trouble, job cuts, possible merger, and whether productivity incentives in the system caused it. The Minister answered that early-warning monitoring by NZa and IGJ is in place, quality of care is not at risk, insurers are supporting the hospital, and no concrete new action was committed beyond continued monitoring.
The NZa and also the IGJ closely follow the situation and actively inform me about it.
De NZa en ook de IGJ volgen de situatie nauwgezet en informeren mij daar actief over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat laboratorium PAMM overgenomen gaat worden

An SP MP asked the health minister how the government views the planned takeover of the PAMM laboratory by Eurofins, a commercial foreign company, and whether profits on publicly funded COVID tests can be ruled out. The minister answered that the takeover requires prior approval from the NZa and ACM, that profit-making by the testing labs is currently permitted under the contracts, and that the state-owned STRIP test robots would be moved if approval is given.
I cannot guarantee that; this is also not part of my system responsibility for healthcare.
Dit kan ik niet garanderen, dat is ook geen onderdeel van mijn stelselverantwoordelijkheid ten aanzien van de zorg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kuiken, Pouw-Verweij, Hijink, Gündoğan, Simons en Omtzigt over het behoud van personeel bij de GGD’en

MPs asked the health minister about GGD staffing shortages, the medium-term outlook for testing and contact tracing, and whether temporary staff can be retained given rising demand. The minister replied that GGDs are responsible for their own personnel policy, that enough staff exist for the booster campaign, and that cost compensation and permanent contracts for essential staff provide assurance, though long-term plans are still under review.
Each GGD is responsible for its own personnel policy, and the way its staff is organised can vary considerably.
Elke GGD is verantwoordelijk voor zijn eigen personeelsbeleid, waarbij de manier waarop het personeelsbestand is vormgegeven sterk kan variëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat VGZ en Menzis draconische bezuinigingen vragen aan het HMC

An SP MP asked the health minister how she views insurers VGZ and Menzis demanding large cuts from Haaglanden Medisch Centrum, and whether she will engage insurers over their demands on hospitals. The minister replied that contract negotiations are ongoing, that patients should not be unsettled by negotiations, and that the Hoofdlijnenakkoord growth cap for 2022 will be applied with flexibility for COVID-related care.
It is undesirable to conduct these negotiations at the expense of patients/insured persons, because I believe patients are thereby unnecessarily and prematurely worried.
Het is onwenselijk om deze onderhandelingen over de rug van patiënten/verzekerden te voeren omdat ik van mening ben dat patiënten hierdoor voorbarig en nodeloos ongerust worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de recente mediabriefing van de Wereld Gezondheidsorganisatie

An SP MP asked the Health Minister how the government responds to the WHO's December 2021 call for more monitoring, testing and sequencing, and what share of tests is sequenced. The minister answered that Dutch sequencing exceeds the ECDC norm, cited the RIVM monitoring network, and argued that self-tests make variant detection harder only in the sense that a positive result needs PCR confirmation.
The RIVM follows the ECDC norm for germ surveillance, comfortably meets it and can, if necessary, scale up.
Het RIVM volgt de ECDC-norm voor kiemsurveillance, haalt deze ruimschoots en kan, indien noodzakelijk, opschalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Simons en Hijink over financiële tekorten en gevolgen in de ouderenzorg

MPs Simons and Hijink asked the minister whether structural financial shortfalls in elderly care, such as job cuts at Hilverzorg, reflect low insurer payments, and whether corona-related costs will be compensated. The minister answered that rates have risen overall, that the 97-96% reimbursement level is in line with other insurers, that welfare activities remain part of care profiles, and that corona costs are covered by an NZa scheme, but declined to commit to renegotiation with insurers.
There is no decrease in reimbursements, but a reduction in the percentage of the maximum NZa tariffs that is reimbursed.
Er is geen sprake van een daling van de vergoedingen, maar van een verlaging van het percentage dat van de maximum NZa-tarieven wordt vergoed.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Westerveld, Hijink, Kuiken, Agema, Tellegen, Bikker, Van der Laan en Werner over bescherming medische gegevens in de intensieve kindzorg

MPs asked whether insurers sharing medical data of chronically ill children with third parties for efficiency checks, without parental consent, complies with GDPR article 9, and whether a consent requirement is needed. The minister answered that insurers remain controllers responsible for processors, that the AVG applies, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens supervises compliance, and that no consent requirement is planned.
It is not for me to assess a specific data processing operation. That is for the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de beoordeling van een specifieke gegevensverwerking. Dit is aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de plannen om de ambulancezorg in Limburg te fuseren en daarbij de ambulancezorg in Zuid-Limburg te privatiseren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether the planned merger of ambulance services in Limburg, which would privatise the south of the province, is acceptable, and about public control and local oversight of ambulance care. The Minister answered that no formal merger request has been received yet, that public quality standards and supervision apply regardless of legal form, and that a decision will follow advice from IGJ, NZa, insurers and regions.
Once I receive the formal request from the RAVs, I will among other things seek advice from the IGJ, NZa, health insurers, safety regions and ROAZ.
Zodra ik de formele aanvraag van de RAV's ontvang, zal ik mij onder meer laten adviseren door de IGJ, NZa, zorgverzekeraars, veiligheidsregio's en ROAZ.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Sportsector verbaasd: aanstaand Minister Ernst Kuipers houdt interne fitnessclub in ziekenhuis open'

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health why the Erasmus MC staff gym stayed open while sports were restricted for the public, and whether sport should be permitted again, including for under-18s, in line with OMT advice. The Minister answered that sport is important for everyone, that the cabinet decided on 14 January to allow indoor and outdoor sport again for all age groups without time restrictions, and that the questions could not be answered before the press conference.
Sport and exercise are very important for staying or becoming fit. That applies to everyone.
Sport en bewegen is heel belangrijk om fit te blijven of te worden. Dat geldt voor iedereen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat veel gepensioneerde verpleegkundigen bereid zijn te helpen in de boostercampagne, maar daarvoor eerst een BIG-opfriscursus van drie maanden moeten volgen

An SP MP asked the minister whether it is undesirable that retired nurses must first complete a three-month refresher course before helping with booster vaccinations, and whether a temporary licence could be granted. The minister answered that non-registered nurses may vaccinate under supervision of a registered professional if competent, that a short refresher suffices rather than three months, and that no licence is needed.
It is therefore possible to deploy non-BIG-registered nurses in the booster campaign, provided they are competent to vaccinate.
Het is dus mogelijk om niet-BIG-geregistreerde verpleegkundigen in te zetten in de boostercampagne, mits zij bekwaam zijn om te vaccineren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de dure betalingsregeling van Infomedics de tandarts onbetaalbaar maakt

MP Hijink (SP) asked the minister whether it is acceptable that Infomedics charges extra servicekosten for payment plans, which can make dental care unaffordable for financially vulnerable patients, and whether Infomedics' profits and the fees are legally sound. The minister answered that private debt-collection services are a free choice, that the fees are within legal limits, that he has no insight into Infomedics' accounts, and that talks with the parties on solutions are ongoing, without ruling out the practice.
I do not have insight into Infomedics' complete accounts.
Ik heb namelijk geen inzage in de volledige boekhouding van Infomedics.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat het Streekziekenhuis Koningin Beatrix in Winterswijk en zorgverzekeraar Menzis het niet eens kunnen worden over het contract van 2022

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about the failed 2022 contract talks between Winterswijk hospital SKB and insurer Menzis, and whether Covid costs and the hospital growth cap hinder negotiations. The minister said parties must keep within the macro framework while Covid-related spending, including catch-up care, is not capped, and that the NZa is checking communication transparency.

The main-lines agreement on medical-specialist care contains numerous actions across many areas: quality, cooperation, the labour market, digitalisation, the right care in the right place, and appropriate care.
Het hoofdlijnenakkoord medisch-specialistische zorg bevat tal van acties op veel terreinen: kwaliteit, samenwerking, arbeidsmarkt, digitalisering, Juiste Zorg op de Juiste Plek en gepaste zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Onverzekerdenkwestie lijkt veel op toeslagenaffaire’

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about reports that the uninsured-care scheme resembles the childcare benefits scandal, including bureaucratic burdens for providers, numbers of people whose insurance was cancelled after leaving the BRP, and compensation for uninsured people. The State Secretary defends the existing schemes as working well, denies the administrative burden is excessive, states the number of cancelled insurance cases is unknown, and rejects compensation because care was provided.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de uitzending van Undercover in Nederland over de misstanden bij zorginstelling Zuster Norma

An SP MP asked the Health Minister how the government would respond to abuses at care home Zuster Norma shown on Undercover in Nederland, including neglect of dementia patients and unqualified staff performing medical tasks, and how the IGJ missed these after earlier clearing the home. The minister said the IGJ has conducted follow-up on-site research and will publish its report, while declining to comment on the ongoing inquiry, deferring finances to the provider's annual report, and affirming that reserved medical tasks may only be performed by qualified staff.
The IGJ will publish the research report on its website once it has been finalised.
IGJ zal het onderzoeksrapport op haar website publiceren, zodra dit is vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat een gezin € 300 per maand moet betalen voor de essentiële medicatie van hun dochter

MP Hijink asks the State Secretary why midodrine, which a family must pay for at €300 per month after insurer CZ stops covering it informally, is not reimbursed under the GVS, whether it is covered in Germany, and what short-term prospects patients have. The State Secretary answers that the Zorginstituut found insufficient evidence of effectiveness, that a re-assessment was refused for lack of new data, that reimbursement is a national matter, and that no short-term coverage can be guaranteed; he will ask the manufacturer whether a dossier is feasible.
In the short term I unfortunately cannot guarantee reimbursement.
Op korte termijn kan ik helaas geen vergoeding garanderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de recente misstanden bij gehandicaptenzorginstelling De Trans

The MP Hijink asked the State Secretary about serious problems at care institution De Trans, including staff alone with high-need groups, inspection criticism, and use of a budget calculation tool allocating fixed shares to overhead and returns, and whether staffing norms should exist. The State Secretary said the institution is responsible for its own allocation and staffing, declined to investigate other institutions or set staffing norms, and committed to talks with the sector on a vision for care for people with VG7 indications.
It is up to the care institution itself how it distributes the tariffs that belong to the care profiles.
Het is aan de zorginstelling zelf hoe zij de tarieven die horen bij de zorgprofielen verdeelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat zelfstandige klinieken graag meer patiënten zouden behandelen die op inhaalzorg wachten, maar daarvoor niet de ruimte krijgen

An SP MP asks whether independent clinics could treat up to 100,000 more patients waiting for postponed care, and why their capacity is not used, possibly because insurers would pay twice. The minister says insurers and providers must cooperate under the agreed framework, that the NZa is supervising and surveying insurers on how they contract independent clinics, and that the 100,000 estimate cannot be assessed.
The NZa is also conducting, in response to these signals, a survey of health insurers on how care at independent clinics is contracted.
De NZa doet daarnaast naar aanleiding van deze signalen een uitvraag bij de zorgverzekeraars over de manier waarop zorg bij de zelfstandige klinieken wordt ingekocht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Wilders, Agema, Hijink, Westerveld, Kuiken, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Gündoğan, Van Esch, Simons en Den Haan over de uitspraken van dhr. Gommers dat hij over 10 dagen code zwa

MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the November measures were working, given expert warnings of a 'code black' hospital crisis, and questioned testing, boosters, staffing, supplies, security and a medium-term strategy. The Minister answered that pressure on care is rising, phase 2d was declared with planned care being scaled down, and that no indication yet exists for phase 3, while defending booster timing and deferring some points to earlier letters.
I am in constant contact with field parties in order to maintain a sharp view of the current situation on the shop floor in various care sectors.
Ook ben ik constant in gesprek met veldpartijen, om scherp zicht te houden op de actuele situatie op de werkvloer in verschillende zorgsectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Hijink over de dreigende uitzetting van een Armeens gezin

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Hijink asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why an Armenian family, whose children were born and raised in the Netherlands and who appear to fall under the children's pardon, faces deportation, and whether the IND can correct the procedural error. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, stated that the Afsluitingsregeling conditions apply without requiring Dutch birth, rejected the claim of arbitrariness and the call for discretionary power, and said the case will not be reviewed again once proceedings are concluded.
As your House is aware, I cannot comment on individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Hijink over een commandant die zijn bemanning niet wil laten testen

SP MPs asked whether a navy commander refusing to test crew with Covid-19 symptoms on Zr.Ms. Rotterdam was acceptable and what Defence policy is. The Minister says medical care aboard is the commander's responsibility, Defence follows government policy with exceptions for operational readiness, and crew were quarantined and tested only on return.
That is why Defence chooses, also because of the high vaccination rate, not to test routinely but to treat patients based on the actual clinical picture.
Daarom kiest Defensie ervoor om, ook vanwege de hoge vaccinatiegraad, niet standaard te testen, maar patiënten te behandelen op basis van het daadwerkelijke ziektebeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over het besluit om coronatoegangsbewijzen verplicht te stellen voor ouders die hun kind naar zwemles komen brengen

Two MPs from the SP asked why the government extended the COVID certificate requirement to parents bringing children to swimming lessons, and whether exemptions could be made. The Minister defended the measure as an OMT-advised step to reduce transmission, noted parents can obtain a QR code by vaccination, recovery or testing, and refused to create an exemption.
I choose not to make an exception for this.
Ik kies ervoor om hier geen uitzondering voor te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij , Omtzigt, Den Haan, Gündoğan, Hijink en Westerveld over het tijdspad van boostervaccinaties

MPs asked the Dutch health minister why the Netherlands had not yet started voluntary COVID-19 booster vaccinations for over-65s and care residents, citing declining vaccine effectiveness, rollouts in Denmark, Sweden and the UK, and vaccine stock. The minister answered that vaccine effectiveness remained high, that the Health Council had advised boosters for the oldest groups and institutional residents, that a start date of 19 November was set, and that preparation (staffing, invitations, GGD capacity) required time.
From 19 November, booster vaccination will start.
Met ingang van 19 november start het vaccineren met de booster.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over het bericht 'Ziekenhuis OZG door deal met PowerField in de armen van commercie geduwd en het unieke Oldambtster landschap wordt vermarkt: 'Onoorbaar en amoreel''

Two SP MPs asked whether a deal in which a solar park developer offers EUR 20 million to a Groningen hospital, conditional on a solar park being built, amounts to commercialising care and the landscape. The government answered that spatial development is bound by existing law and policy, that the hospital is not dependent on the donation, that no care funds are involved, and that local authorities make the public interest assessment.
Moreover, I point out that there is no legal obligation to return proceeds to the surrounding area.
Overigens wijs ik erop dat er geen sprake is van een wettelijke verplichting om opbrengsten terug te laten stromen naar de omgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat kinderfysiotherapeuten door zorgverzekeraar Zilveren Kruis verplicht worden een scholing op het gebied van datarapportage te doen

Hijink (SP) asked the minister about insurer Zilveren Kruis requiring physiotherapists to take a data-reporting e-learning course, and whether this is compatible with reducing bureaucracy. The minister answered that the module is a voluntary contract choice paired with a tariff increase, that the course counts toward registration, and that the insurer's contractual requirements are a matter for the insurer and the profession.
It is not an obligation but a voluntary choice for a practice to add the module 'Continuous Improvement' to the contract.
Het is geen verplichting, maar een vrijwillige keuze voor een praktijk om de module «Voortdurend Verbeteren» aan het contract toe te voegen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Hijink over het bericht dat driekwart van de huisartsen de werkdruk te hoog vindt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that three-quarters of GPs find their workload too high, including longer consultation times, administrative burden and training places. The minister said he is in ongoing talks with the LHV, pilots on longer consultations will be rolled out, administrative burden reductions are underway with the precise follow-up left to the next cabinet, and training places are being increased within capacity limits.
The precise design of a follow-up approach to further reduce administrative burden is up to the next cabinet.
De precieze invulling van een vervolgaanpak om de administratieve regeldruk verder te verminderen is aan het volgende kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat er bij een derde van de bezoeken aan restaurants en cafés geen check op de coronapas plaatsvindt

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about reports that a third of restaurant and café visits involved no check of the corona pass, and whether the pass's effect on infections can be measured. The minister acknowledged the risk, pointed to enforcement by municipalities and safety regions with €45 million support, and said the pass's effect cannot be isolated, while providing a cluster analysis; he did not send answers before the next debate.
To check whether citizens and businesses comply with the law, enforcement services are deployed.
Om burgers en ondernemingen te controleren op het naleven van de wet, worden handhavingsdiensten ingezet.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Hijink over de brief die het Ministerie van VWS stuurde aan het LNAZ

An SP MP asked why the Ministry of Health sent a letter asking the LNAZ to find ways to reach more than 1,350 ICU beds after earlier saying this was not feasible, and what this means for measures. The minister explained that the LNAZ concluded a short peak of up to 1,350 ICU beds is feasible, while going beyond that is not, mainly due to staff shortages, and that measures follow OMT advice, but declined to answer all questions before the next debate.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat Siriz verboden staatssteun heeft ontvangen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether the continued grant to Siriz, which NRC reports was unlawful state aid, was defensible, and why advice from civil servants was disregarded. The State Secretary defended the grants as a transition to a new open-house funding model, rejected recovery of the aid, and said the subsidy ended in 2020 after the state-aid review.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Rotavaccin op de lange(re) baan geschoven: ‘Onbegrijpelijk. Dit kan duizenden opnames schelen’

An SP MP asked why the government postpones the decision to add rotavirus vaccination to the national vaccination programme despite a Health Council recommendation, and about costs and timing. The State Secretary says he is positive about the advice, but a decision must await the next cabinet and structural budget funding at the spring budget decision, with a RIVM implementation plan in preparation and an estimated cost of about 20 million euro per year.
However, given the caretaker status of the cabinet, it is up to the next cabinet to take a definitive decision following this advice.
Het is echter, gelet op de demissionaire status van het kabinet, aan het volgend kabinet om naar aanleiding van dit advies een definitief besluit te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Geen geld voor de tandarts: 'Mondzorg moet terug in het basispakket'’

MP Hijink (SP) asked the minister how he views reports that people skip dental care for financial reasons, whether this costs society more, and whether dental care should return to the basic insurance package. The minister acknowledges the problem but says data is limited, announces a long-term oral health monitor, and refuses to restore dental care to the basic package, pointing instead to municipal tailored support and local arrangements.
No. As previously stated, the basic principle is that adults have their own responsibility for caring for their teeth.
Nee. Zoals eerder aangegeven is de basis dat volwassenen een eigen verantwoordelijkheid hebben voor de verzorging van hun gebit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over het testevenement 538 Oranjefeest

Two MPs asked the government about the 538 Oranjefeest test event, including resale of tickets at high prices, subsidies, selection, health-worker staffing and ticket fraud controls. The minister answered that the event was a research pilot, that the ticket auction was not intended and gave a wrong impression, that tests were required before entry and recommended afterwards, and that a national resale ban was not effective, pointing to a pending EU-based consumer law implementation.
The cabinet financed the research carried out at the field tests.
Het kabinet financierde het onderzoek dat wordt gedaan bij de praktijktesten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat een aantal medewerkers van GGD-regio’s op non-actief is gesteld vanwege mogelijke fraude met vaccinatiebewijzen

MP Hijink asked the Health Minister about reports that GGD staff were suspended over suspected fraud with vaccination certificates, including how it was discovered, how easy it is to create false records, and what controls exist. The minister answered that the staff were suspended and reported to police, that the GGD cannot yet give numbers because the investigation is ongoing, and that controls exist and detected the fraud, though full prevention cannot be guaranteed.
GGD GHOR indicates that, in the interest of the investigation, no statements can yet be made about this.
GGD GHOR geeft aan dat hierover in het belang van het onderzoek nog geen mededelingen kunnen worden gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het feit dat patiënten soms zonder medische noodzaak moeten wisselen naar een andere dosering van medicatie, waardoor zij meer moeten bijbetalen voor dezelfde hoeveelheid werkza

An MP asked whether patients are forced to switch to another dosage of a medicine without medical need, paying more for the same active ingredient, and what can be done about it. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem stems from reimbursement limits, supply shortages and pharmacy purchasing, pointed to a planned modernisation of the reimbursement system and a EUR 250 annual cap on co-payments, and rejected calling the situation unfair.
I do not know how often this occurs.
Ik weet niet hoe vaak dit voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over het bericht ‘Ziekenhuizen op ramkoers met artsen die cashen op coronatesten’

SP MPs asked the health minister how he reacts to reports that private microbiologists at Microvida earn large profits from corona lab tests and how this fits with the medical profession and public funds. The minister said he lacks a full picture and it is not his role to judge the dispute, that the Kluytmans conflict of interest is not in question, and that he has no overview of the hospitals or amounts involved, while noting the test fee caps and that excessive earnings from the crisis should be reconsidered.
Moreover, it is not for me to pass judgement on this conflict between an individual partnership and a number of hospitals.
Het is bovendien ook niet aan mij om een oordeel te vellen over dit conflict tussen een individueel maatschap en een aantal ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de berichten dat de kosteloze verstrekking van CGRP-remmers voor migrainepatiënten die hiervan afhankelijk zijn stopt

An SP MP asked whether the state should accept the end of free provision of CGRP migraine inhibitors for patients dependent on them, and why Zorginstituut advice had been delayed. The Staatssecretaris answered that the free supply is the manufacturers' choice, that reimbursement for therapy-resistant chronic migraine starts 1 November 2021, and that episodic migraine patients must rely on alternatives or manufacturers until a further advice is issued.
It is up to manufacturers whether and to whom they provide their medicines free of charge during an assessment by the Zorginstituut.
Het is aan fabrikanten of en aan wie zij hun medicijnen kosteloos ter beschikking stellen tijdens een beoordeling door het Zorginstituut.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de datadiefstal bij de GGD veel groter is dan gemeld en dat gedupeerden niet zijn geïnformeerd

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether the GGD data theft was larger than reported and whether victims were not informed, and asked why the House was not told. The minister answered that no evidence so far shows the theft is larger, that about 1,250 victims were identified and all informed by letter, and that RTL refused to share its files, so the claim cannot be verified.
As far as is currently known, this concerns 1,250 victims.
Voor zover nu bekend gaat het om 1.250 gedupeerden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink over het bericht ‘Grijs goud: Europese ouderenzorg is goudmijn voor internationale investeerders’

MPs Marijnissen and Hijink asked the Minister of Health about reports that commercial and private-equity investors are profiting from elderly care, including profit extraction, tiered access, and care-cost shifting. The minister answered that profit-distribution rules do not cover extramural home-care packages, that a Wibz bill may add conditions on profit distribution, and that diversity of providers is acceptable, while leaving open possible tightening of public conditions and declining to state a preferred policy given the caretaker cabinet.
I have no information on the level of these specific results.
Over de hoogte van deze specifieke resultaten heb ik geen informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat enkele Limburgse zorginstellingen niet blijken te zijn verzekerd tegen overstromingsschade

An SP MP asked the Health Minister whether it is acceptable that some Limburg care institutions lacked flood insurance, may be paid more slowly if insured via pool consortia, whether displaced residents can return quickly, and whether damage will be compensated via the disaster fund. The minister replied that insurance is the institutions' own responsibility, that the government will generously apply the Wts disaster compensation act because the damage was not reasonably insurable, and that this is a one-off case.
The cabinet wants to assist residents and organisations in Limburg affected by the floods by generously applying the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts).
Het kabinet wil de door de overstromingen getroffen inwoners en organisaties in Limburg graag bijstaan door de Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) ruimhartig in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de VS achter het voorstel staat om de patenten van de coronavaccins vrij te geven

MPs Hijink and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the government supports the US position backing a waiver of COVID-19 vaccine patents, the EU's role as a blocker in the WTO, and whether Netherlands will back patent suspension. The minister answered that the government supports broad vaccine access, will press the European Commission to engage constructively in the WTO, but does not endorse the India/South Africa waiver as proposed and rejects several premises of the questions.

In line with the Piri et al. motion (Kamerstuk 35 663, no. 21), the cabinet will urge the European Commission to engage constructively within the WTO on proposals for temporary suspension of patents on COVID-19 vaccines.

In lijn met de motie Piri c.s. (Kamerstuk 35 663, nr. 21 ) zal het kabinet er bij de Europese Commissie op aandringen dat de EU constructief engageert binnen de WTO wat betreft voorstellen tot tijdelijke opschorting van patenten op coronavaccins.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Alarmerende situatie: Braziliaanse virusvariant drie keer dodelijker voor twintigers'

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that the Brazilian (P.1/Manaus) coronavirus variant is more contagious and about three times deadlier for people in their twenties, asking about its spread in the Netherlands, travel restrictions and vaccination strategy. The minister answered that causality is not yet proven, the variant's share in the Netherlands is falling, travel measures follow EU risk assessments, and no change to the vaccination campaign is needed for now.
The share of this variant is now declining in the Netherlands.
Het aandeel van deze variant daalt inmiddels in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Gehandicaptenzorg in gevaar door tekort aan testcapaciteit'

Mr Hijink (SP) asked the Minister of Health about reports that disability care is endangered by a shortage of COVID-19 test capacity, including five-day waits for care workers' results, travel to distant test sites, and priority testing for care providers. The minister referred to a letter on temporary changes to the COVID-19 testing policy as the answer.

The written questions from Mr Hijink (SP) to the Minister of Health about the report 'Disability care endangered by shortage of test capacity' were answered by way of the letter 'Temporary adjustment of COVID-19 testing policy'.

Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Hijink (SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Gehandicaptenzorg in gevaar door tekort aan testcapaciteit» ( 2020Z16043 ) zijn beantwoordwoord middels brief «Tijdelijke aanpassing testbeleid covid-19» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over problemen met prioriteit voor zorgverleners bij testen

MP Hijink (SP) asked the health minister whether healthcare workers who are refused a priority COVID-19 test slot cannot book a regular slot through the same number, how often this happens, whether such bureaucracy will be addressed, whether mental health and youth care workers are excluded from priority testing, and what other problems with priority testing are known. The minister answered by referring to the letter 'Stand van zaken brief COVID-19' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 656) rather than answering the questions directly.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Hijink over ernstig dementerenden die gedwongen moeten vertrekken uit een kleinschalige woonvorm

MPs Kwint and Hijink asked the Minister of Health why residents with severe dementia must leave a small-scale care home (Het Kristal, Apeldoorn) because the operator says it is loss-making, and whether the ministry will intervene. The minister replied that closure is primarily the responsibility of the care provider and the care office, that the Inspectorate has no concerns about quality, that the ministry has contacted both parties and asked to be kept informed, and that group sizes of 8 are better suited to small-scale dementia care.
At this moment it is up to the care provider and the care office to reach acceptable solutions for the clients.
Het is op dit moment aan de zorgaanbieder en het zorgkantoor om tot acceptabele oplossingen voor de cliënten te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het tweemaal betalen van eigen risico voor hetzelfde behandeltraject als gevolg van uitgestelde behandelingen door het afschalen van de reguliere zorg

An SP MP asks the health minister about patients paying their deductible twice for one treatment trajectory when care was postponed during COVID-19, and asks whether a compensation scheme will be created.
