The minister acknowledges the problem and the NZa advice to decouple the deductible from DBC rules, but declines a compensation scheme on the grounds that patients pay only for care received, and says a decoupling exploration is nearly finished and will be sent before the summer recess.
Are you willing to create a goodwill compensation scheme to compensate these people for having had to pay their deductible twice as a result of the scaling down of regular care?

Bent u bereid om een coulanceregeling in het leven te roepen om deze mensen te compenseren voor het feit dat zij, als gevolg van het afschalen van de reguliere zorg, twee keer een eigen risico hebben moeten betalen?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over sociaaleconomische gezondheidsverschillen door de coronapandemie

MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the government how socioeconomic health inequalities have grown due to the coronavirus pandemic, and how communication about vaccination and measures reaches people who are digitally or functionally illiterate, and how many communication staff the government employs. The minister answered that research on the widening gap is ongoing with results expected by year-end, cited existing data and studies, listed communication staff numbers (811.5 fte at department communication directorates, 15 fte on the vaccination communication team), and described outreach tools for low-literacy and digitally less skilled groups.
It is expected that in the coming months it will become clearer what the consequences of the pandemic are for socioeconomic health inequalities in the Netherlands.
Naar verwachting zal de komende maanden meer duidelijk worden wat de gevolgen zijn van de pandemie voor de sociaaleconomische gezondheidsverschillen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Hijink en Leijten over het afschuiven van uitbetalingen bij letselschade door verzekeraars aan gemeenten

MPs Van Nispen, Hijink and Leijten (SP) asked about insurers redirecting injury-claim victims to municipalities for costs insurers should bear, and about slow payouts and municipal recovery of costs. The minister answered that insurers may not require victims to first go to the municipality, that victims may choose, that no fixed settlement term exists, and that municipalities are responsible for recovering costs, with no direct national role beyond pointing to a convenant option.
An insurer of the liable party may not require a victim to first approach the municipality to claim support under the Social Support Act 2015.

Een verzekeraar van de aansprakelijke partij mag niet van een slachtoffer verlangen dat hij zich eerst tot de gemeente wendt voor een beroep op ondersteuning via de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de uitzending van Zembla ‘Stoppen met de pillen’

MP Hijink (SP) asked the Minister of Medical Care about a Zembla broadcast on the difficulty of stopping antidepressants, including the high cost of tapering medication, uneven reimbursement by insurers, and whether tapering medication should enter the basic package. The Minister answered that the evidence base for tapering is insufficient, that insurers reimburse tapering according to the multidisciplinary guideline and case-by-case, and that further research (TAPER-AD) is under way, so basic-package inclusion is not yet justified.
Without evidence, I cannot include treatments in the basic package.
Zonder bewijs kan ik geen behandelingen opnemen in het basispakket.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Hijink over misstanden bij een evangelische leef- en woongemeenschap in Overijssel

MPs Kwint and Hijink asked the minister to respond to alleged abuses at an evangelical living community in Balkbrug, including poor care, misuse of care funds and inadequate housing, and why authorities acted late and what investigations found. The minister reports that the Wmo supervisor found mostly non-compliance with quality rules, with a deadline of 1 July 2021, that building inspection found the building met code, and that a preliminary administrative inquiry found no urgent facts; the IGJ is not currently investigating, and the community is not obliged to publish annual figures because it is funded by personal budgets.
Given a few findings where possible unlawfulness must be examined further, the supervisor advises commissioning a (more in-depth) Wmo lawfulness investigation.

Gelet op een paar bevindingen waarbij eventuele onrechtmatigheid nader onderzocht moet worden, adviseert de toezichthouder om een opdracht te verstrekken voor een (meer verdiepend) rechtmatigheidsonderzoek Wmo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijnink over de overnameplannen van het IJsselland Ziekenhuis door het Erasmus MC

The SP MP Hijink asked the Minister for Medical Care about the planned takeover of IJsselland Hospital by Erasmus MC, including distance, patient choice, financial performance, consultation and whether cooperation would suffice. The Minister answered that the ACM is examining the takeover's effects on quality, accessibility and affordability, that the hospital is financially healthy, and that the ACM will assess the matter, declining to intervene.
The question of the extent to which such a takeover would lead to greater travel distances and less freedom of choice for patients is therefore the subject of the further investigation by the ACM.
De vraag in hoeverre een dergelijke overname zal leiden tot grotere reisafstanden en minder keuzevrijheid voor patiënten is dus onderwerp van het nadere onderzoek door de ACM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de aanschaf van beademingsapparatuur die niet bruikbaar is op de intensive care

Two SP MPs asked whether part of the first 100 ventilators from Philips, and planned Demcon machines, are unsuitable for ICU use, and asked about expert advice, serial numbers, distribution lists and disposables. The minister answered only by referring to a COVID-19 update letter, providing no substance on the questions themselves.

The written questions from MPs Hijink and Marijnissen (both SP) to the ministers of Medical Care and Economic Affairs and Climate about the purchase of ventilation equipment unusable in intensive care (2020Z06022) have been answered by way of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen (beiden SP) aan de ministers voor Medische Zorg en van Economische Zaken en Klimaat over de aanschaf van beademingsapparatuur die niet bruikbaar is op de intensive care ( 2020Z06022 ) zijn beantwoordwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de onzekere toekomst van het ziekenhuis in Zutphen

An MP asks the Minister about the uncertain future of the Gelre hospital in Zutphen, including whether emergency care, acute obstetrics and other basic services will be lost and how the proposed scaling-down is justified given the hospital's financial health. The Minister answers that Gelre is still examining its future configuration with stakeholders, that no closure decision has been taken, that the RIVM accessibility analysis would be required before any closure of acute services, and that the broader care landscape is a matter for a future cabinet.
Moreover, if there is a concrete intention to close the Zutphen location, an accessibility analysis must be requested from the RIVM by the hospital.
Overigens geldt als er een concreet voornemen is om de locatie Zutphen te sluiten er een bereikbaarheidsanalyse moeten worden opgevraagd bij het RIVM door het ziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat criminele zorgaanbieders kwetsbare cliënten inzetten voor drugshandel of gedwongen prostitutie

MP Hijink asked the minister how criminal care providers exploit vulnerable clients for drug work or forced prostitution, how long this has gone on, and what measures will prevent and prosecute it. The minister acknowledges the problem as unacceptable, says representative data are lacking so no new national study is planned, and points to existing and forthcoming instruments (Wtza, Wibz, Wet Bibob, Wbsrz) and enforcement by the Openbaar Ministerie without naming specific providers.
Representative data on this are not available.
Hierover zijn geen representatieve data beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over de problemen met het halen van je recht na een medische misser

MPs Van Nispen and Hijink asked about long claim-settlement times and high rejection rates for victims of medical errors, and about measures such as GOMA, a no-fault fund and a faster complaints route. The Minister of Medical Care answered that long durations are largely due to complex causation questions, that existing measures and a Chamber for long-running injury cases are being pursued, and that a no-fault fund is not supported because the Belgian experience showed little gain.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht '1.5 miljoen Nederlanders kunnen de tandarts niet betalen, Richard is een van hen: 'Mijn tanden waren afgebrokkeld''

Written questions from MP Hijink (SP) ask the Minister for Medical Care about reports that 1.5 million Dutch people cannot afford dental care and that funds in some cities are overwhelmed, and whether this justifies reversing the decision to exclude dental care from the basic insurance package. The Minister says the data on dental avoidance is unclear, points to municipal support and a planned review of compensation, rejects reinstating dental care in the basic package in favour of targeted local measures and a dental health monitor, and calls the economic-loss estimate uncertain.
I consider it of great importance that everyone in the Netherlands has access to good dental care.
Ik vind het van groot belang dat iedereen in Nederland toegang heeft tot goede mondzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Westerveld en Hijink over het bericht 'Durfinvesteerders zien brood in tieners met lichte psychische klachten, zwaardere patiënten belanden op wachtlijst'

MPs Kuiken, Westerveld and Hijink asked about reports that venture investors target teenagers with mild mental health complaints while severe patients face waiting lists, and about profit limits, foreign investment and the treatment of suicidal youth. The state secretary said gemeenten can set profit caps and tariffs, pointed to the planned Wibz and Wet verbetering beschikbaarheid zorg voor jeugdigen, and reported that only a few investment firms are active in youth care.
I do not have an overview of the owners of institutions in youth mental health care.
Ik heb geen overzicht van eigenaren van instellingen in de jeugd-ggz.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Nederland liep kans op miljoenen Oxford-vaccins mis'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about a news report that the Netherlands risked missing millions of Oxford COVID-19 vaccines, and why a 2020 financial support request to Halix and the Oxford consortium was not pursued. The minister rejected the framing, explained the EU joint procurement strategy and the TIVA alliance that secured over 80 million doses, and said no concrete Oxford request was made and no investment was needed.
I do not recognise myself in the title of the report you refer to. The Netherlands did not miss out on Oxford vaccines.
Ik herken mij niet in de titel van het bericht waaraan u refereert. Nederland is geen «Oxford» vaccins misgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat duizenden zorgmedewerkers de zorgbonus missen

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care why thousands of healthcare workers who believed they qualified for the COVID-19 care bonus did not receive it, whether this is unjust, how many were wrongly excluded, and whether the scheme was unclear. The Minister replies that the bonus was an employer-judged supplement, that applications depended on the care provider, that most eligible staff did receive a bonus, and that the criteria were clear except the broadly defined 'exceptional performance'.
Whether or not to grant the bonus was within the care provider's room for assessment.
Het wel of niet toekennen van de bonus behoorde tot de beoordelingsruimte van de zorgaanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Hijink over het bericht dat tientallen miljoenen sneltests stof verzamelen in de opslag en het onderwijs aan een lijntje wordt gehouden

MPs Kwint and Hijink asked why tens of millions of rapid COVID tests sit in storage while schools are kept waiting for them. The minister answered that professional-supervision requirements blocked school testing, that self-tests were approved and are being rolled out to schools gradually, and that he will continue working on broader availability.
I have adopted the advice of the expert panel.
Ik heb het advies van het deskundigenpanel overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de pilots met testbewijzen

An SP MP asked the health minister about COVID-19 access-test pilots run by commercial providers via Stichting Open Nederland, including costs, procurement, profit margins and why GGDs were not used. The minister answered that participation is voluntary but a negative test is required for certain activities, that the state pays costs until 1 July, and that profit margins are monitored, while several cost and procurement details were deferred pending the open-house tender and a separate letter.
I have sent you the most important documents relating to the agreements between the Ministry of VWS and Stichting Open Nederland.
Ik heb u daarbij de belangrijkste documenten doen toekomen die betrekking hebben op de afspraken tussen het Ministerie van VWS en Stichting Open Nederland
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat het ministerie in strijd met de wet, en zonder toezicht 925 miljoen euro stort voor entreetesten

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about reports that the ministry channelled 925 million euros to Stichting Open Nederland for entry tests without open tender and without oversight, questioning cost control, governance, salaries, contracts, and possible liability. The minister defended the direct award as necessary for speed, described phased go/no-go funding with accountability and external audit, and declined to answer the questions on the parliamentary debate timing.
The cabinet decides for each phase whether to further scale up the testing capacity.
Het kabinet besluit immers steeds per fase om de testcapaciteit verder op te schalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Massale diagnosefraude bij behandeling burn-out’

An SP MP asked the minister about reports of mass diagnosis fraud in burn-out treatment, whether psychologists are changing diagnoses to get treatment reimbursed, and why burn-out care was removed from the basic insurance package. The minister called misdeclaration unacceptable, pointed to NZa oversight and past fines, explained burn-out is not a disorder and refers people to occupational care and GPs, and declined to reconsider.
When care for a burn-out diagnosis is claimed from the health insurer as basic-package care, there is at least unlawfully claimed care.
Wanneer bij een diagnose burn-out de zorg wordt gedeclareerd bij de zorgverzekeraar als zorg die onder het basispakket valt, is op zijn minst sprake van onrechtmatig gedeclareerde zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘GGD en RIVM wijzen naar elkaar voor niet halen vaccinatiedoel’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health why GGD and RIVM blame each other for missing the vaccination target, why vaccine stocks remain high while booths stand empty, and about call-centre problems, the July target, post-summer vaccination and contracts. The Minister explained the late-March surge in call-ins and the stock-buffer policy, announced call-centre expansion and online booking, and said he will ask the Health Council for long-term advice and that contracts for 2022 are being negotiated.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Hijink over het testprotocol COVID-19 bij kinderen onder de 13 jaar

MPs Kwint and Hijink asked why children under 13 could only be tested for COVID-19 when symptomatic, whether schools' case increases were reported, and why GGD school case figures were not public. The minister answered that testing policy for under-13s was tightened in February 2021, testing capacity is sufficient, GGD school-level data stay regional or aggregated, and the RIVM has central registration by region and age.
I do not have information on the precise figures of the School Reporting Point, however.
De precieze cijfers van het Scholenmeldpunt heb ik echter geen informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over onrechtmatig handelen van zorgverzekeraars aangaande de uitvoering van de Zorgverzekeringswet

MP Hijink asks the minister about health insurers allegedly pressuring ALS patients to move from the Zvw to long-term care (Wlz), refusing care hours and undermining palliative care agreements. The minister replies that insurers may not refuse patients for financial reasons, that the Wlz is only reached via CIZ assessment, and that insurers may check, but not force, Wlz eligibility, while promising no change beyond existing procedures.
It is not permitted for health insurers to try to exclude patients for financial reasons.
Het is niet toegestaan dat zorgverzekeraars uit financiële overwegingen patiënten proberen te weren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht 'EU erkent: wel degelijk Nederlandse productie AstraZeneca-vaccin'

SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about reports that Dutch company Halix produces AstraZeneca vaccine, its production capacity, any Dutch negotiations or investment, and why the UK contract was prioritised. The minister replied that the Netherlands acted through EU and Inclusive Vaccine Alliance contracts, that AstraZeneca selects its own contract manufacturers, that no specific Dutch production arrangements were made, and declined to share export and Halix output details citing confidentiality.
The specific data on export licences are commercially confidential and for that reason cannot be shared.
De specifieke gegevens met betrekking tot de exportvergunningen zijn bedrijfsvertrouwelijk en kunnen om die reden niet worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Hijink over het bericht ‘KLM to resume SA flights to Amsterdam’

Two MPs asked whether KLM was resuming flights from South Africa to Amsterdam despite the travel ban and whether the government would act against it. The minister said airlines decide commercially, KLM screens passengers for exemptions, six passenger flights ran in late February, and airlines must check travellers' test results, with regional safety authorities checking on arrival.
It is up to the airlines themselves to assess whether flights to destinations under a flight ban are commercially attractive based on the estimated number of exempt cases.

Het is aan de luchtvaartmaatschappijen zelf om te beoordelen of vluchten naar bestemmingen waarvoor een vliegverbod geldt, commercieel interessant zijn op basis van het geschatte aantal uitzonderingsgevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht 'Austria sounds alarm over South Africa Coronavirus Variant in Tyrol region'

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about the spread of the South African coronavirus variant in Austria's Tyrol region and whether Dutch sequencing capacity is sufficient to detect new variants early. The minister described Austria's measures, the current variant prevalence in the Netherlands, and said sequencing is being scaled up in line with ECDC advice, without committing to a specific percentage of positive tests.
The RIVM is therefore scaling up to a higher and sustainable capacity.
Het RIVM schaalt dan ook op naar een hogere en duurzame capaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht 'Gemeentegrens wordt gesloten voor ongewenste zorgvragers'

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary about reports that municipalities shift care recipients to each other and that 40% of municipalities are stricter in granting care to outsiders, and about the consequences of the 2015 decentralisation. The State Secretary answered that the 40% figure comes from a survey of 151 municipalities that the ministry cannot verify as representative, committed to a new residence principle for youth care (2022) and for sheltered housing (2023), and deferred a structural budget solution to the next cabinet.
The Ministry of VWS has no insight into whether the 151 respondents form a representative cross-section of the Netherlands.
Het Ministerie van VWS heeft geen inzicht of de 151 respondenten een juiste afspiegeling vormen van heel Nederland
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Restcapaciteit reguliere zorg bleef lang onbenut'

MP Hijink asked whether the minister is shocked that regular-care capacity stayed partly unused during the first COVID wave for strategic reasons, whether hospitals avoided referring patients out of competition concerns, and whether insurers' safety-net arrangement encouraged hospitals to keep patients. The minister denied knowledge of deliberate withholding, attributed the unused capacity to nationwide scaling-down and reduced referrals, and committed to no further action beyond existing monitoring and a planned insurer-hospital financial settlement framework.
I am not aware of any facts indicating that care capacity was deliberately left unused during the first wave.
Er zijn mij geen feiten bekend over zorgcapaciteit die tijdens de eerste golf doelbewust onbenut is gebleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Hoe een bejubeld personeelsplan in de zorg toch sneuvelde’

Two SP MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about press reports that a praised staffing plan for healthcare was dropped, and about the slow results of regional and national scale-up plans for covid-era staffing. The minister's answers largely defer to other parties and existing programmes, describe the scale-up plans and subsidies, and decline to say how much extra staff was delivered.
I have no insight into how much extra staff the local and regional scale-up plans have delivered.
Ik heb geen zicht op hoeveel extra personeel de lokale en regionale opschalingsplannen hebben opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Slechte eigenrisicokeuzes maken de zorgverzekering duurder voor laagopgeleiden'

MP Hijink (SP) asked the Minister for Medical Care how to respond to research showing that people with lower education or income more often choose a low voluntary deductible, making insurance more expensive for them, and whether abolishing the voluntary deductible would be fairer. The Minister acknowledges the pattern, points to consumer information initiatives and financial literacy efforts, notes that about 13 percent of insured persons choose a voluntary deductible, and argues that the cross-subsidy cost is small (about 3 euro per person) and that abolishing it would raise care spending by about 100 million euro per year.
I consider it important that insured persons are well informed about the voluntary deductible.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat verzekerden goed geïnformeerd worden over het vrijwillig eigen risico.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht 'HTM-directeur Bruno Bruins wordt commissaris bij vaccin-instituut'

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether appointing former minister Bruno Bruins as a supervisory board member of Intravacc, shortly after leaving office, creates conflict of interest given the lobbying ban and his role in planning its privatisation. The minister replied that the Corporate Governance Code and the lobbying circular were applied, that Bruins was recruited for his political-administrative experience and had no role in the operational decision, and that the post pays EUR 27,500 per year.
The appointment process took into account the Dutch Corporate Governance Code and the Circular on the lobbying ban for ministers and state secretaries.
In het benoemingsproces zijn de Nederlandse Corporate Governance Code en de Circulaire lobbyverbod Bewindspersonen meegewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht dat het kabinet het vaccininstituut Intravacc alsnog wil verkopen

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked why the cabinet would sell vaccine institute Intravacc during the pandemic despite the need for domestic vaccine production and dependence on foreign supply. The minister replied that no sale decision has been taken; Intravacc is placed in a temporary state-owned holding for up to two years, with a final decision left to the next cabinet.
There is therefore currently no question of a decision to sell the vaccine institute Intravacc.
Er is op dit moment dan ook geen sprake van een besluit tot het verkopen van vaccininstituut Intravacc.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink over de onderzoeken naar de werking van mondmaskers

MPs Marijnissen and Hijink asked the Minister for Medical Care about the scientific basis for claims that face masks could create false security, and about whether RIVM guidance discouraged medical mask use in care settings. The minister referred to earlier answers, said RIVM guidance is evidence-based, denied that its statements covered medical masks in care, and noted that a procurement route via ROAZ existed.
RIVM does not speak in its guidance of reluctance to use medical face masks in care.
Het RIVM spreekt in de uitgangspunten niet over terughoudendheid in het gebruik van medische mondmaskers in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Ruim twintig mensen besmet in Fries woonzorgcentrum, deels met Britse variant'

An SP MP asked the health minister about a COVID-19 outbreak at a Frisian care home, including why FFP2 masks were not used, whether preventive testing should expand, and whether care workers will have enough FFP2 masks. The minister expressed regret, explained that surgical masks suffice in most cases under RIVM guidance, said preventive testing is not yet justified, and stated supply is adequate while agreeing with social partners to clarify practical guidance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het tekenen van een contract om de zorgbonus terug te moeten betalen als deze niet wordt uitgekeerd

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether employers require staff to sign contracts agreeing to repay the healthcare bonus if the employer does not receive the subsidy, and what the government will do. The minister says this is not good employership, that the risk should not be shifted onto care workers, and that employers have been asked to act in line with the subsidy rules, while staff are advised to raise concerns with the works council.
In my view this does not reflect good employership, and the risk of not meeting the subsidy conditions and obligations is not meant to be shifted onto the care professional.

Het getuigt wat mij betreft niet van goed werkgeverschap en het is ook niet de bedoeling dat het risico van het niet voldoen aan de subsidievoorwaarden en -verplichtingen wordt afgewenteld op de zorgprofessional.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over uitgiftepunten voor gecertificeerde mondneusmaskers

An SP MP asked the health minister whether the Landelijk Consortium Hulpmiddelen could supply FFP2 masks to food banks and other groups, whether FFP2 mask requirements should be introduced, and why some care workers still lack FFP2 masks. The minister answered that the supplied masks are CE-certified Type II R surgical masks, that the OMT advises against stricter public mask rules, that care workers may deviate from the norm with employer consultation and can report to the Inspectie SZW, and that supplies are sufficient.
I would like to hear where this happens, so that we can enter into discussion with these care institutions.
Ik verneem graag waar dit gebeurt, zodat we met deze zorginstellingen in gesprek kunnen treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de avondklok in de praktijk

An SP MP asked whether grandparents may babysit after 21:00 when parents must work, and whether an exception should exist for parents in vital professions without other childcare options. The Minister replied that the curfew deliberately contains few exceptions, that parents should first seek alternatives, and that in truly unavoidable cases the babysitter can invoke the 'someone urgently needs my help' exception on the Eigen Verklaring form with an explanation.
In designing the curfew, it was deliberately chosen to make as few exceptions as possible.
Bij de vormgeving van de avondklok is er bewust voor gekozen om zo min mogelijk uitzonderingen te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Voor deze ouderen geen plek meer’

An SP MP asks the health and medical care ministers about older patients who cannot be placed in nursing homes or receive home care after hospital treatment, and whether this has worsened during the coronavirus crisis. The minister reports current care-capacity figures, notes staffing shortages as the main cause, describes the regional and national procedures for staff support, and points to funding for small-scale housing for older people.
For privacy reasons, figures broken down by age are not available.
Vanwege privacyoverwegingen zijn cijfers op basis van leeftijd niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de tekorten aan budgetten in de Wmo en de jeugdzorg

An SP MP asks the minister whether the VNG call on municipalities to take cost-control measures (income-based limits, budget ceilings, waiting lists) under the Wmo subscription tariff is acceptable, and how support and budgets for Wmo and youth care will be secured. The minister replies that such measures outside the legal framework are not allowed, that municipalities are sufficiently compensated, and that a stuurgroep and bestuurlijke weging on youth care will inform the next cabinet, with no additional budget now.
However, proposals under which municipalities create waiting lists and introduce budget ceilings so that people can no longer use the Wmo 2015 are not permitted.
Echter, voorstellen waarbij gemeenten wachtlijsten laten ontstaan en budgetplafonds instellen waardoor mensen geen gebruik meer kunnen maken van de Wmo 2015 zijn niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Geen zorgtoeslag door mogelijke fraude met de Basisregistratie Personen’

An SP MP asked the government about a tenant denied childcare allowance because the landlord and her child remained registered at the address in the Personal Records Database, despite a rental contract showing they did not live there. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case, citing confidentiality, explained that the tax authority may depart from the registry only when there is reasonable doubt and that a registry check is the municipality's responsibility, and promised a discussion with the policy ministries.

However, if the Tax and Customs Administration/Allowances has reasonable doubt about the accuracy of the registration (for example following an objection), it must notify the municipality so that the municipality investigates the accuracy of the registration.

Indien de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen echter gerede twijfel heeft over de juistheid van de inschrijving (bijvoorbeeld naar aanleiding van een bezwaar), dient deze hiervan melding te doen aan de gemeente, zodat de gemeente onderzoek doet naar de juistheid van de inschrijving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht dat het verdwijnen van spoedeisende hulpen funest is voor kleinere ziekenhuizen

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the Minister for Medical Care how she responds to warnings that disappearing emergency departments would harm smaller hospitals such as in Winterswijk and Doetinchem, and whether this is acceptable given the role hospitals played during the COVID-19 crisis. The Minister answered that the acute care sketch is a non-binding consultation document, that only highly complex acute care would be concentrated, that accessibility would be maintained, and that final decisions rest with the next cabinet.
After I have received the responses, I will bundle, summarise and send them to your House.
Nadat ik de reacties heb ontvangen zal ik die reacties bundelen, samenvatten en aanbieden aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het artikel “Hoe 'testen, testen, testen' stukliep op een muur van eigenbelang”

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about a Follow the Money article on conflicts of interest hampering the scale-up of COVID-19 testing, including dual roles of OMT member Vossen and fees of specialists. The minister largely disputed that testing was deliberately blocked, said a 70,000-per-day shortfall was never the case, and pointed to new steps to strengthen testing governance, while giving only generic answers on fees and conflicts.
Ms Vossen, as chair of the NVMM, together with several experts took the initiative in March to establish the diagnostics taskforce with the aim of increasing testing capacity.
Mevrouw Vossen heeft als voorzitter van de NVMM samen met enkele deskundigen in maart het initiatief genomen tot oprichting van de taskforce diagnostiek met als doel de testcapaciteit te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht van Bits of Freedom over de Coronatester

MP Hijink (SP) asked the health minister about a planned CoronaTester app and whether it would become a corona health passport, and about voluntariness and societal risks. The minister said the app is being explored to support testing, that privacy, fundamental rights and voluntariness will be weighed, and that the Health Council will advise, but gave no firm details and promised to inform parliament later.
As I informed you by letter of 18 November, the OMT advises in its 85th advice to explore the possibility of requiring a negative test result on entry to the Netherlands for all travellers.

Zoals ik u bij brief van 18 november heb gemeld adviseert het OMT in haar 85e advies om de mogelijkheid te verkennen van het eisen van een negatieve testuitslag bij binnenkomst in Nederland voor alle reizigers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het voorstel in de gemeente Oldenzaal om de huishoudelijke verzorging uit de Wmo te halen

MP Hijink (SP) asked the minister whether the Oldenzaal motion to move household care out of the Wmo into special assistance is lawful, and about its wider effects and the deficits in the social domain. The minister answered that the plan conflicts with the Wmo 2015 and is not permitted, that he has contacted Oldenzaal and may use interbestuurlijk toezicht, and that a monitor of the subscription tariff is being followed.
The intention to remove domestic help from the Wmo 2015 and make it part of special assistance runs counter to the law's principles and is not permitted.
Het voornemen om huishoudelijke hulp uit de Wmo 2015 te halen en onderdeel te maken van de bijzondere bijstand staat haaks op de uitgangspunten van de wet en is niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het artikel ‘Top verdienen aan jeugdzorg in Tilburg’

The MP Hijink (SP) asked the state secretary about reports that youth care providers in Tilburg and elsewhere earn high profits while municipalities face deficits, and about tariffs, procurement models, staff costs and supervision. The state secretary answered that municipalities set their own tariffs and procurement, that the Wibz bill will allow conditions on profit distribution, that financial supervision lies with municipalities and quality supervision with the Inspectie, and that a study on extra structural funding for youth care is underway.
Financial supervision lies with the municipality, which must check whether providers meet the conditions of contracting and tendering.
Het financieel toezicht ligt bij de gemeente die moet controleren of aanbieders voldoen aan de voorwaarden van de contractering en aanbesteding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over ventilatiesystemen in schoolgebouwen

Two SP MPs asked whether school ventilation systems meet standards, how quickly they could be improved, which countries the RIVM cited for keeping schools open, and what it would cost to fix ventilation in all Dutch schools. The minister said the OMT and RIVM saw no reason to change ventilation policy, pointed schools to existing Bouwbesluit requirements and guidance, noted that 11 percent of school buildings in an incomplete survey fell short, and referred to a 360 million euro fund that municipalities can draw on with schools.
The advice to schools is, insofar as they have not yet done so, to check their ventilation against the applicable requirements.
Het advies aan scholen is – voor zover dat nog niet gedaan is – hun ventilatie te controleren op de daarvoor geldende eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Testlijnmedewerkers kunnen bij persoonsgegevens, ook als dat niet mag'

Written questions from MP Hijink (SP) asked the Minister of Health about a report that COVID test-line call-centre staff could access personal data even where not permitted, and whether this violates the GDPR. The minister replied that staff need access to records to schedule appointments and check results, that logging and confidentiality agreements provide safeguards, that the GGD addresses misuse with consequences, and that the AVG applies to the call centre.
Let me first state that I consider care in handling personal data to be of great importance.
Laat ik vooropstellen dat ik zorgvuldigheid bij het omgaan met persoonsgegevens van groot belang vind.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de onderzoeken naar de werking van mondmaskers

Two SP MPs asked the minister to explain the basis of RIVM's claims that medical face masks could create false security, given that the RIVM said no scientific study showed this and later cited preprints. The minister answered that the remarks concerned FFP2 masks used in care, were based on expert opinion and WHO/ECDC consensus, and that the earlier reference to studies was an error, but did not provide the studies requested.
Unfortunately, confusion has arisen about Mr Van Dissel's statements on the use of face masks during the technical briefing of 22 April 2020 and the possible occurrence of false security.

Er is helaas onduidelijkheid ontstaan over de uitspraken van de heer Van Dissel over het gebruik van mondneusmaskers tijdens de technische briefing op 22 april 2020 en het mogelijk optreden van schijnveiligheid daarbij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Hijink en en Wörsdörfer over wederom een datalek in de jeugdzorg

MPs asked the State Secretary for Health whether a new data leak at a youth care provider (Kenter/Jeugdriagg) could have been prevented given an earlier 2019 leak, and what steps have been taken on the earlier motions about securing youth care data, Z-CERT affiliation, penetration tests and ethical hacking rules. The State Secretary acknowledged the leak resulted from an old unclosed domain name, described the steps taken with branch organisations and Deloitte-run penetration tests, and said Z-CERT affiliation could start in early 2021 while stressing providers bear primary responsibility.
Through Z-CERT's risk-driven approach we will again examine the possibilities for affiliation.
Door de risico gestuurde aanpak van Z-CERT gaan we opnieuw de mogelijkheden voor aansluiting onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over het bericht 'Apothekers vrezen dat patiënten uit regio Amersfoort ’s avonds en in het weekend naar Utrecht moeten voor medicijnen'

MPs Van Gerven and Hijink asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that Zilveren Kruis and other insurers did not renew the contract of the Dienstapotheek Eemland, so out-of-hours pharmacy care would move to Utrecht. The minister answered that insurers cite lack of transparency in the pharmacy's proposed tariff, that care will be delivered from Utrecht with home delivery, and that insurers must meet their duty of care.

I assume that health insurers in the Eemland region will fulfil their duty of care and that good pharmaceutical care will therefore be provided in that region during out-of-hours periods, also in 2021.
Ik ga er vanuit dat zorgverzekeraars in de regio Eemland hun zorgplicht nakomen en dat dus in die regio goede farmaceutische zorg wordt geboden tijdens ANZ-uren, ook in 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht 'Testlabs kunnen wél meer aan, maar deze concurrentiestrijd zit in de weg'

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health why COVID-19 testing was allocated to existing hospital and medical microbiology labs rather than large labs, and about pricing and central coordination. The Minister defended the phased allocation, said central coordination through the LCDK will be strengthened, and gave test prices for the Netherlands, France, Germany and Belgium.
I want to position the LCT more firmly and have appointed a new chair. The LCDK will become a service of the Ministry of VWS.
Ik wil de LCT steviger positioneren en heb een nieuwe voorzitter benoemd. Het LCDK wordt een dienst van het Ministerie van VWS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over bonussen die uitgekeerd worden aan personeel op het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

An SP MP asked the health ministry how many staff received corona-related one-off bonuses, their highest and average amounts, the criteria used, and whether they had been paid. The minister reported 373 of about 1,500 staff received bonuses of 100 to 3,500 euro net (average 1,092 euro), based on overtime and duration, consistent with union agreements, and that all have been paid.
The employees who were granted a one-off reward have now received it.
De medewerkers die een incidentele beloning toegekend hebben gekregen, hebben deze inmiddels ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Westerveld en Hijink naar aanleiding van het bericht dat broertjes en zusjes vaak niet samenblijven bij een uithuisplaatsing

MPs Westerveld and Hijink asked about reports that siblings are often not placed together when children are taken into care, and about the causes, data, reimbursement of travel costs and pleegouder numbers. The government answered that a WODC study on separated placements will report by autumn 2021, that CBS data is unavailable, that siblings are placed together where possible under existing guidelines, and that travel costs can be reimbursed, while legislation is not planned for now.
The WODC is going to carry out research this autumn into separated placements of siblings in out-of-home placements.
Het WODC gaat dit najaar onderzoek doen naar gescheiden plaatsingen van broers en zussen bij een uithuisplaatsing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Mondkapjes blijven ‘made in China’, Arnhemse fabriek mag nog steeds geen medische mondkapjes maken'

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that an Arnhem mask factory was still not allowed to make medical masks, and why certification of the three government-selected domestic mask producers was taking so long. The minister explained the factory had self-certification problems with microbiological findings and that the three producers were in advanced certification stages with deliveries expected within weeks.
Mondmaskerfabriek BV is now having an independent test laboratory examine whether the microbiological deviation can be resolved through sterilisation with gamma radiation.
Mondmaskerfabriek BV laat nu in een onafhankelijk testlaboratorium onderzoeken of de microbiologische afwijking door middel van sterilisatie met gammastraling opgelost kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Is de voorraad aan mondkapjes voldoende om een volgende besmettingspiek door te komen?’

An SP MP asked the minister whether the stock of face masks suffices for a next infection peak, including whether a ten-week buffer is needed and what happens if shortages arise. The minister answered that the national stockpile (LCH) can cover a second and for most products a third wave, longer than ten weeks, and pointed to a letter on preventive mask use and to ongoing monitoring of supply.
The results of the stress test showed that the LCH has sufficient stocks, in various scenarios, to meet a second wave and for most products even a third wave.
De uitkomsten van de stress test hebben laten zien dat het LCH voldoende voorraden heeft, in verschillende scenario's, om een tweede en voor de meeste producten zelfs een derde golf aan te kunnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Restitutieverzekering onder druk’

An MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about the pressure on restitution health insurance policies, the risk that contracting rules narrow patient choice and favour large providers, unclear co-payments for non-contracted care, and fraud enforcement, and whether the minister will limit free choice of provider. The minister replies that insurers decide which policies to offer, that contracting and risk equalisation are being improved, that the NZa monitors contracting and transparency, and that free provider choice is not being restricted.
It is up to the health insurer to make such choices.
Het is aan de zorgverzekeraar om dergelijke keuzes te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over bonussen aan personeel op het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

MPs Hijink asked whether ministry staff at VWS are dissatisfied with a 500 euro bonus, whether some received up to 5,000 euro, and how many received bonuses and how much. The minister answered that dissatisfaction is not known, that incidental rewards are standard practice across ministries under Rijk-wide frameworks, and that corona-related one-off rewards were agreed with unions, without giving the individual figures requested.
Incidentally, there is no question of a generic reward here.
Van een generieke beloning is hierbij overigens geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat zorgsectoren bakkeleien over opleidingsplaatsen gz-psychologen

The MP asked why the government will not provide more structural training places for gz-psychologists despite rising demand, and why the allocation system favours larger training institutions. The state secretary replied that places follow the Capacity Organ's advice and budget room, that the 787 places for 2021 match the maximum advice, that the allocation system is the responsibility of the TOP foundation, and that the government will not change the system but will inform parliament after a November interim forecast.
I am awaiting the interim forecast of mid-November and do not want to anticipate it.
Ik wacht de tussentijdse raming van medio november af en wil daar niet op vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Zorg moet fundamenteel anders volgens 'coronaminister' Hugo de Jonge: 'Regie terug bij overheid’'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether the COVID-19 crisis shows that healthcare can work without markets, and about his remarks on greater state steering, cooperation, and limits on insurer competition. The minister answered that cooperation should be strengthened within the existing framework, that patients' free choice of provider and insurer should not be absolutised, and that the policy direction would be set out in a later discussion note, without committing to structural change now.

We will consider these experiences, together with administrative and practical experiences such as the movement toward the right care in the right place, in the discussion note 'Care for the Future' which we will send to the House before the budget debate.
Deze ervaringen zullen we samen met de bestuurlijke en praktische ervaringen, zoals in de beweging naar de juiste zorg op de juiste plek, betrekken bij de discussienota «Zorg voor de toekomst».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Ploumen over onafhankelijk advies over welke lessen geleerd kunnen worden van de coronamaatregelen

MPs Hijink and Ploumen asked how the government is implementing the motion on independent lessons-learned advice on the corona measures, whether a kwartiermaker for evaluation was appointed with party ties to the minister, and whether the evaluation will be truly independent. The minister replied that over 90 external experts contributed through the Lessons Learned trajectory, that the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid is conducting an independent evaluation, and that the government is accountable to parliament on the evaluation's design and results.
On how the evaluation is shaped and its results, the cabinet will account to your House.
Over de wijze waarop evaluatie wordt vormgegeven en de resultaten ervan legt het kabinet verantwoording af aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de richtlijnen van het RIVM die tot onveiligheid in de ouderenzorg leidden

MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked the Minister of Health whether RIVM guidelines and the shortage of protective equipment contributed to infections and deaths in elderly care, and whether employers and inspectorates were adequately responsible. The minister answered that responsibility lies with employers and that inspectorates applied RIVM norms as a temporary starting point, while denying a conclusive link between the guidelines and harm.
Employers are responsible for a safe working environment and for good and continuous care to patients and clients.
Werkgevers zijn verantwoordelijk voor een veilige werkomgeving en voor goede en continue zorg aan patiënten en cliënten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over compensatie van mutatiedagen

An SP MP asked whether care providers funded by personal budget (pgb) with 24-hour residence cannot claim vacancy ('mutatiedagen') compensation that in-kind care providers can, and asked who qualifies and why not pgb providers. The Minister confirmed that only in-kind residential providers can claim these days under NZa rules, explained the exceptions, and argued that pgb funding cannot buy residence and that the NZa rules fit institutional funding; corona-related budget measures for pgb were noted.
It is correct that in the Nursing and Care sector, the compensation for vacancy days can only be claimed by care providers that deliver residential care in kind.
Het klopt dat in de sector Verpleging en Verzorging (VV) de compensatie van mutatiedagen alleen kan worden aangevraagd door zorgaanbieders die verblijfszorg leveren via zorg in natura.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink over het bericht ‘VWS hielp met taaleis Duits lab van de testmarkt te weren’

Two SP MPs asked the health minister why extra conditions, including a Dutch-language requirement for an arts-microbioloog, were imposed on a German lab seeking to test for COVID-19, despite RIVM approval, and whether this breached EU law and why the lab's capacity was not used sooner. The minister replied that the conditions derive from quality-of-care law, that two German labs now offer testing with Dutch partners, that the conditions were not meant to exclude providers, and that the government will consult on reorganising the test landscape.
I want to emphasise that these requirements were not intended to keep parties out of the market, and it did not turn out that way.
Ik wil benadrukken dat deze eisen niet bedoeld was om partijen te weren van de markt, en het heeft zo ook niet uitgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Toezichthouder NZa: de zorg is te veel een verdienmodel geworden’

The MP asked how financial incentives in healthcare, such as pay-per-service production incentives, can be reduced, and what share of cancelled care was unnecessary. The minister replied that advice from the NZa and Zorginstituut on digital care, appropriate use, and bundling/outcome-based contracting is awaited, with a RIVM study on indirect COVID effects, and gave no firm estimate of unnecessary care.
It is difficult to determine what percentage of the care that was cancelled is not sensible.
Het is moeilijk vast te stellen welk percentage van de zorg die is uitgevallen niet zinnig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het pr-beleid van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

MP Hijink asks the health minister why a corona evaluation letter was sent to the media under embargo before Parliament, whether this reflects a PR strategy outranking parliamentary information, and for an overview of letters sent to media first, and a pledge that Parliament will be informed first. The minister answers that the embargo respected Parliament's information position, that no overview exists because the ministry does not seek media coverage before informing Parliament, and does not commit to changing the practice.
By applying an embargo until after the Parliamentary letter was sent, the information position of the House was respected.
Door het hanteren van een embargo tot na het versturen van de Kamerbrief werd de informatiepositie van de Kamer gerespecteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het afschalen van het bron- en contactonderzoek voor covid-19 door de GGD’en in opdracht van het ministerie van VWS

SP MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked whether the health ministry cut the basic capacity for COVID-19 contact tracing from 850 to 550 FTE in a June 2020 service agreement with the GGD's, and whether financial considerations drove this. Minister De Jonge denied any scaling-down plan or cost motive, stated the state bears all scaling costs, and attached the service agreement.
No, this is incorrect. Between VWS and GGD GHOR, financial agreements were made on scaling up the national capacity in line with the scaling plan from late May.
Nee, dit is onjuist. Tussen VWS en GGD GHOR zijn financiële afspraken gemaakt over de opschaling van de landelijke capaciteit conform het opschalingsplan van eind mei.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over het bericht 'Lucratief beleggen in ouderen met dementie'

Two SP MPs asked the health minister how to respond to a report on investors profiting from dementia care, including promised 7% returns on care property, private nursing home growth, sale-and-lease-back structures, foreign takeovers, inspection report publication and concentration oversight. The minister answered each question, saying he cannot judge the returns, that care leaders must buy property at market rates, that he is preparing the Wibz bill allowing profit-distribution conditions, that the IGJ oversees quality, and that he sees no need for nationality-based rules.

However, I am working on the bill on integrity of care provider business operations (Wibz), in which I want to introduce the possibility of attaching additional conditions to profit distribution in sectors where there is currently no ban on profit distribution.

Ik werk echter aan het wetsvoorstel integere bedrijfsvoering zorgaanbieders (Wibz) waarin ik de mogelijkheid wil introduceren aanvullende voorwaarden te stellen aan winstuitkering voor sectoren waar nu geen verbod op winstuitkering geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht 'Ergernis en chaos bij werving GGD'

Two SP MPs asked the health minister how a blank cheque for the GGD fits with years of budget cuts, whether recruitment criteria for contact tracers and outsourcing to commercial agencies are acceptable, and whether central coordination is planned. The minister said GGDs are adequately funded with federal covering of extra COVID costs, that regional criteria follow a national job profile, that outsourcing is understandable given the crisis, and that central coordination via GGD GHOR Nederland is already in place without guaranteeing capacity at all times.
I am therefore committed to resolving all emerging bottlenecks as quickly as possible together with the GGDs.
Ik zet mij er dan ook voor in om alle knelpunten die opspelen zo snel mogelijk samen met de GGD’en op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de actuele voorraden persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen

An SP MP asked the health minister about current stocks of personal protective equipment, the LCH procurement criteria, RIVM guidelines and domestic production. The minister answered that the LCH covers an emergency supply sufficient for a second wave based on March/April peak use, and listed Dutch producers, while deferring stock-analysis details to late September.
I expect to inform you further about this at the end of September.
Ik verwacht u daar eind september verder over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over test- en ventilatiebeleid bij corona

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about the accessibility of COVID-19 test sites, the closure of the Breda test site, and ventilation checks in nursing homes. The minister referred to a letter on testing for most questions, explained that the Breda site closes for locational and football reasons while a new one opens, and said a central ventilation team check would add no value while Actiz surveys members.
Actiz is currently conducting a survey among its members and will inform me about it.
Actiz voert op dit moment een inventarisatie onder de leden uit en zal mij daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Hijink over de recente Zuid-Koreaanse studie naar de overdraagbaarheid van COVID-19 door kinderen

Two SP MPs asked the Health and Education Ministers about a South Korean study on children's transmission of COVID-19 and its implications for school reopening. The government answered that the study rests on few children, offers no new insight into transmission and did not study school openings, and committed to monitoring the literature and reporting school-linked clusters to OCW.
RIVM informs the Ministry of Health about the latest developments so they can be taken into account in policy-making.
Het RIVM informeert VWS over de meest recente ontwikkelingen, zodat deze meegenomen kunnen worden in de beleidsvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht 'Oud-topman RIVM: 'We moeten meer testen, anders blijft het een smeulende veenbrand''

SP MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the health minister how he views a former RIVM chief's call for more COVID-19 testing, including testing of asymptomatic people, and why the OMT downplays asymptomatic spread. The answer was given by reference to a separate letter on OMT advice and COVID-19 measures, without substantive answers in this document.

The written questions from MPs Hijink and Van Gerven (both SP) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (2020Z13783) have been answered by letter 'Adviezen OMT en maatregelen COVID-19' (Kamerstuk 25 295, no. 504).

De schriftelijk vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ( 2020Z13783 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief «Adviezen OMT en maatregelen COVID-19» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 504 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de werking van de Overheidsbijdrage in de Arbeidskostenontwikkeling (OVA)

Two SP MPs asked the health minister how the Overheidsbijdrage in de Arbeidskostenontwikkeling (OVA) was set up, how it is determined and reported, and what a lower OVA in 2021 due to the COVID-19 recession would mean for care wages. The minister answered that the OVA is governed by the 1999 OVA-convenant and set from CPB forecasts, that deviating requires representative employer agreement, and that the Chamber is not routinely informed to avoid a floor in collective bargaining.
That is why the OVA-convenant agrees to avoid publicity about the OVA.
Daarom is in het OVA-convenant afgesproken om publiciteit over de OVA te mijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over onderzoek naar nut van mondkapjes

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about the evidence for face masks, the Norwegian study and RIVM behavioural research, and the constitutional basis for local mask obligations. The minister replied that there is no conclusive evidence of a health benefit, that distance remains the core measure, and that local experiments in Amsterdam and Rotterdam run under emergency ordinances pending the proposed Temporary COVID-19 Measures Act.
With a view to the future, the cabinet has submitted the bill Temporary COVID-19 Measures Act.
Het kabinet heeft met het oog op de toekomst het wetsvoorstel Tijdelijke wet maatregelen covid-19 ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Hijink over het bericht dat bij een slachthuis in Helmond werknemers, al dan niet in opdracht van de werkgever, ziekteklachten verzwegen

MPs Futselaar and Hijink asked the government about reports that workers at a Helmond slaughterhouse concealed COVID-19 symptoms and falsified forms, and about enforcement, GGD inspections, NVWA oversight and sector culture. The ministers said such conduct is unacceptable, pointed to Inspectie SZW powers and planned extra enforcement powers, and described NVWA and GGD actions and a sector review.
I intend to give the Inspectorate SZW more legal powers to enforce effectively
Ik heb het voornemen om de Inspectie SZW meer wettelijke mogelijkheden te geven om effectief te kunnen handhaven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Hijink over de keuze voor Facebook om mensen te informeren over kabinetsbesluiten

Two SP MPs asked the Prime Minister why the government chose Facebook to inform the public about cabinet decisions, noting not everyone uses it, and why Parliament was not informed first, and whether this makes Facebook the new communication policy and whether pre-Prinsjesdag documents will be leaked there. The Prime Minister answered that Facebook is one channel for reach, that the post shared no new cabinet decisions, that the same information is always available on government websites, that Parliament had already received the relevant OMT advice, and denied any change in communication policy or future leaks.
Incidentally, no new cabinet decisions were shared in the relevant post.
Overigens zijn in het betreffende bericht geen nieuwe kabinetsbesluiten gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over de gevolgen van beleidskeuzes bij de bestrijding van de coronapandemie in Nederland

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about expected infection and death levels under the Dutch mitigation policy, the basis for policy choices, and whether a hard lockdown would be better. The minister answered that infection levels are being monitored through serological studies, that policy aims at controlling the virus rather than herd immunity, and that the measures prevented about 90% of expected ICU admissions, but he did not give mortality projections for the policy options.
Calculations made concern the number of ICU and hospital admissions. Mortality is a derivative of these calculations.
Berekeningen die worden gemaakt betreffen het aantal IC- en ziekenhuisopnames. Sterfte is een afgeleide van deze berekeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'PGB 2.0 loopt half jaar vertraging op'

An SP MP asked the Minister of VWS about a six-month delay and EUR 12.5 million in extra costs for the PGB2.0 payment system, including how costs were underestimated, timelines, and cost-benefit. The minister attributed the extra costs to technical adjustments, said VWS bears them, and committed to sending a revised budget once the rollout schedule is financially calculated.
This rollout planning is being costed financially; once its budget is established I will provide you with a revised budget.
Deze invoeringsplanning wordt financieel doorgerekend, zodra de begroting hiervan is vastgesteld zal ik u een aangepaste begroting verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de verspreiding van het coronavirus in verpleeghuizen

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about COVID-19 spread in nursing homes, including full ward isolation, staff protective equipment, return of residents from hospital, testing capacity and the delayed answers. The minister answered all questions, describing cohort isolation, PPE supply via the LCH, revised testing policy and procedures for returning residents, while stating that he would respond separately after a late answer.
I now answer the questions posed on 30 March 2020 after all.
Ik geef alsnog antwoord op de op 30 maart 2020 gestelde vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de situatie in de verpleeghuizen

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about the COVID-19 situation in nursing homes, including infection and death figures, scenarios, protective equipment, testing, inspection reports and a weekly update. The Minister gave detailed figures (about 8,400 confirmed infections and 2,800 deaths by 6 July), described visitor rules, a knowledge coalition and research efforts, said the LCH can meet demand for protective equipment, reported about 90 inspectorate reports, and agreed to answer in future weekly updates.
Will you answer these written questions instead of including the answers generally in your weekly update on developments of the coronavirus?
Vraag 9 Wilt u deze schriftelijke vragen beantwoorden in plaats van de antwoorden algemeen mee te nemen in uw wekelijkse update over de ontwikkelingen van het coronavirus?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘De jaknikkers van Hugo’

An MP asked the minister why GGD public health services were delayed in scaling up contact tracing for COVID-19, including funding, timing of instructions, and the app. The minister rejected the criticism, said GGDs were involved in decisions and funded by municipalities, and noted the Inspectorate has started an inquiry.
On 24 June the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate started an inquiry into the quality of the test sites and contact tracing carried out by the GGDs.
Op 24 juni is de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) gestart met een onderzoek naar de kwaliteit van de teststraten en het bron- en contactonderzoek
Antwoord opvragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Experts: coronabeleid snel evalueren van levensbelang'

MP Hijink (SP) asked the Minister of Health why the government chose to draw lessons learned rather than an interim evaluation of the COVID-19 policy, and disputed the claim that a group-immunity strategy is still pursued. The minister answered that the government is focusing on lessons learned to prepare for a second wave, that the strategy is to control the virus, that the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid will conduct a full evaluation later, and that most recommendations of the report are already in line with existing policy, though some are not adopted.
A comprehensive policy evaluation will nevertheless be carried out by the Dutch Safety Board (Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid) at the request of the cabinet.
Een uitgebreide beleids evaluatie wordt evengoed wel uitgevoerd door de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid, op verzoek van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'ZN weigert coronaschade ziekenhuizen volledig te compenseren'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that health insurers refuse to fully compensate hospitals for COVID-19 damage, and about their earlier pledge to cover all costs. The minister replied that insurers and hospital associations agreed a compensation scheme neutralising COVID-19 effects on hospital revenue and costs, including a hardship clause, but that the total amounts and damage are not yet known, and declined further state financial support.
It is not yet known what amount is involved in the scheme and how large the COVID-19 damage to hospitals is.
Het is nog niet bekend welk bedrag er met de regeling gemoeid is en hoe groot de coronaschade is voor ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het Kerstens over het document ‘Ouderlijke verantwoordelijkheid voor zorg in de zorgverzekeringswet’

MPs Kerstens and Hijink asked whether the minister knew of a document on parental responsibility for care under the Zorgverzekeringswet and why parents caring for seriously ill children were being assessed lower on indications based on it. The minister said the document has no official status, that the professional body V&VN has put its new care norm on hold, and that he will talk with stakeholders and parents, while declining to dictate the professional group's timetable.
I am going to discuss this with the involved child-care parties.
Ik ga hierover met de betrokken kindzorg-partijen in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over blijvende signalen van tekorten aan persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen voor zorgverleners

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about persistent shortages of personal protective equipment for care workers, including outside hospitals, and why PPE is not provided preventively. The minister reported 71 million items distributed, said PPE use is risk-based with professional discretion added from 1 May, and that preventive provision is not desirable because it could create scarcity.
Generally deploying personal protective equipment preventively is not desirable because it could in turn create scarcity.
Algemeen preventief inzetten van persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen is niet wenselijk omdat daardoor juist weer schaarste kan ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Fysiotherapeuten maken zich druk over tekortschietende corona-compensatie: “Dit is een vitaal beroep”’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about physiotherapists' concerns over the COVID-19 continuity contribution from health insurers, including its conditions, reduced reimbursement for catch-up care, data disclosure and the possibility of insurers refusing payment. The minister replied that the scheme is a necessary, separate arrangement agreed with insurers, that catch-up care is paid at a lower rate to avoid double payment, and that insurers must be accountable but may be asked for disclosure only proportionately.
The conditions that health insurers attach to the support they provide must be verifiable.
De voorwaarden die zorgverzekeraars stellen aan de steun die zij bieden, moeten controleerbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Hijink over acute geldproblemen bij kleine woonzorginstellingen door corona

MP Hijink asked the minister whether small PGB-funded dementia care homes facing vacancies and lost income due to COVID-19 would receive compensation like in-kind care providers, and whether they would be allowed to convert to in-kind contracting. The minister answered that PGB-related measures were taken (declaring undelivered care, raising budgets, opening the EKC scheme), explained structural differences with in-kind care, and pointed to the zorgkantoor for conversion, while the detailed compensation design was still being worked out.
Together with the relevant field parties, I am currently further developing this solution direction.
Samen met betrokken veldpartijen werk ik deze oplossingsrichting momenteel verder uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over het Hoenderloo College

MPs Hijink and Kwint asked the ministers about an open letter from Hoenderloo College staff alleging misconduct by Pluryn toward the works council, parents and youth, the inspectorate's role, and the closure and social plan. The minister answers that responsibility lies primarily with Pluryn, that the inspectorate monitors closely and rejects the staff's description of its role, that placements are being arranged with ongoing monitoring, and that a social plan was agreed on 26 June 2020.
The education inspectorate supervises the quality and continuity of education.
De onderwijsinspectie ziet toe op de kwaliteit en continuïteit van het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het jaarverslag van Witte Kruis over 2018

The MP asks whether the legal structure of Witte Kruis (ambulance service) is clear, why its equity of 13.1 million euro is not reinvested, what the 'other reserves' are, and whether money parked there could benefit the foreign owner Transdev. The minister explains the ownership chain, states that RAVs must hold sufficient equity under the Tijdelijke wet ambulancezorg, that the supervisory board must ensure no funds are withdrawn, that Transdev is the shareholder, and that no profit has been distributed since 2007; the answer to the final question on timing is that it could not be met.
The supervisory board must ensure this happens and that no funds are withdrawn from equity, which could jeopardise the continuity of ambulance care.

De Raad van Commissarissen dient erop toe te zien dat dit gebeurt en dat er geen gelden aan het eigen vermogen worden onttrokken, waardoor de continuïteit van de ambulancezorg in het geding kan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Leijten over overwerk in relatie tot toeslagen

Two SP MPs asked whether the government will protect care and other essential workers from losing childcare, rent and healthcare allowances because of overtime during the coronavirus crisis, and whether it will give certainty about having to repay allowances. The government answered that it cannot identify overtime effects on household income, that allowances must follow actual income, and that it will focus on communication and individual arrangements rather than a special scheme, apologising for the delay.

The cabinet will now primarily focus on communication to point citizens to the importance of reporting expected changes in household income for 2020 to the Tax and Customs Administration/Allowances as soon as possible.

Het kabinet zal nu primair inzetten op communicatie om burgers te wijzen op het belang om verwachte wijzigingen in het huishoudinkomen van 2020 zo snel mogelijk door te geven aan de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kerstens over de aanhoudende problemen die gezinnen met ernstig zieke kinderen ervaren

MPs Hijink and Kerstens asked the Health Minister how government will resolve persistent problems families of seriously ill children face with insurers and care indications, why the minister will not respond to case files submitted by the BVIKZ, and about the upcoming indication guidelines. The minister refers to earlier letters, says he cannot judge individual cases, points to the SKGZ complaints body, and says a professional-standards handbook is being drafted with consultation of parent organisations.
I cannot judge the content of the cases, as I do not have the (nursing) knowledge and expertise for that.
Ik kan niet oordelen over de inhoud van de casussen, daar heb ik de (verpleegkundige) kennis en expertise niet voor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de productie van persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen in Nederland

MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked the Minister about domestic production of personal protective equipment, including which producers exist, certification capacity for masks in the Netherlands, and whether small firms are treated equally to large ones in procurement via the LCH. The Minister answered that no full registry exists, listed selected contracts and certifying bodies, said the government will not set up its own notified body, and that firms bear the risk of failed certification.
A general overview of all manufacturers of protective equipment in the Netherlands cannot be given, because this is not registered.
Een algemeen overzicht van alle fabrikanten van beschermingsmiddelen in Nederland is niet te geven, omdat dit niet wordt geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de aankoop van vijf miljoen afgekeurde mondkapjes

Two SP MPs asked the Minister why around five million government-purchased face masks were rejected as unfit for care, what their type, financial impact and recovery prospects are, and what happens to them. The Minister said the LCH procurement consortium checks quality at three stages, withholds payment on rejected goods and has no recall insurance, and that the risk to the ministry cannot yet be quantified and rejected masks are being checked for other uses.
The LCH generally pays part of the purchase price in advance, but for part of the purchases no financial obligation was entered into in advance.
Het LCH betaalt, in de regel, vooraf een gedeelte van de koopsom aan, maar voor een deel van de aankopen is vooraf geen financiële verplichting aangegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over het invoeren van een draagplicht voor niet-functionele mondmaskers in het openbaar vervoer

MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked how a mandatory face-covering rule in public transport would be enforced, and questioned why non-medical masks need no CE marking or minimum quality standards and why masks are not provided free of charge. Minister Bruins answered that enforcement runs through existing transport supervisors without checking mask type, that NEN is drafting recommendations for non-medical masks, and that people are responsible for buying their own masks, with VAT lowered to 0%.
People themselves are responsible for purchasing a face mask.
Mensen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het aanschaffen van een mondkapje.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars specialisten ouderenzorg in de wijk frustreren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health why insurers' contracting conditions make it hard for geriatric specialists to work in the community, and about tariff cuts for elderly care. The Minister replied that insurers have a duty of care overseen by the NZa, that the conditions are being discussed with insurers and Verenso, and that tariff cuts reflect cost research and the lack of a quality framework.
That is why I have invited both Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN) and Verenso to discuss the contracting conditions.
Daarom heb ik zowel Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN) als Verenso uitgenodigd om over de inkoopvoorwaarden in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over stopzetten van de huishoudelijke verzorging in de gemeente Montferland

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health whether the municipality of Montferland may withdraw home-care indications when clients pause care out of fear of COVID-19, and how the minister judges this. The minister answers that unilateral withdrawal without careful individual assessment conflicts with the Wmo 2015, that the municipality has said it will not withdraw such decisions, and that the minister will consider interbestuurlijk toezicht if the council's intervention fails.
Unilaterally withdrawing a decision whose term has not expired, without prior and careful investigation of the individual client's circumstances, is not in line with the provisions of the Wmo 2015.

Het eenzijdig intrekken van een beschikking waarvan de looptijd niet verstreken is, zonder voorafgaand en zorgvuldig onderzoek naar de individuele omstandigheden van de betreffende cliënt, is niet in overstemming met het ter zake bepaalde in de Wmo 2015.
