Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over de brief van een wetenschapper uit Milaan dat meer concrete kennis door meer systematisch onderzoek nodig is om ons door de CoV crisis te loodsen'

Two SP MPs asked the health minister how the government responds to a Milan scientist's letter calling for more systematic research on COVID-19, including transmission, immunity and severity. The minister agreed research is needed, cited ongoing Dutch and EU studies and provided preliminary figures, but did not answer question 6 on timing.
I have therefore forwarded this letter to the RIVM with the request to look at his proposal.
Ik heb deze brief dan ook aan het RIVM doorgestuurd met het verzoek om te kijken naar zijn voorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de handelwijze van Facilicom/Axxicom in de thuiszorg

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health why Facilicom/Axxicom urged thuiszorg staff to take holiday days, whether staff can be forced to take leave, and why home-care workers lack protective equipment and testing. The minister replied that employers may request but not force leave, that protective equipment and testing are available in specified cases, and that the employer bears the risk of reduced work.
However, an employee is not obliged to do so.
Een werknemer is hiertoe echter niet verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht Expertisecentrum Euthanasie stopt met hulp wegens corona

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the Expertise Centre for Euthanasia suspending its assistance due to COVID-19, including shortages of protective equipment and whether SCEN doctors and GPs continue their work. The Minister responded that the Centre resumed care in phases since week 18, that it meets RIVM guidelines and is eligible for PPE, and that GPs and palliative care continue, with monitoring of medicine supplies.
The situation has since changed: the Expertise Centre for Euthanasia has gradually resumed its assistance since week 18.
Inmiddels is de situatie veranderd: het Expertisecentrum Euthanasie heeft sinds week 18 de hulpverlening gefaseerd hervat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘SKB blaast fusie met Slingeland af’

SP MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the minister about reports that the SKB hospital in Winterswijk called off its merger with Slingeland (Santiz), including the reasons, the IGJ's role, the new Doetinchem building, and the regional care plan. The minister answered that no final defusion decision has been taken, that a mediator will be appointed to restore stability and start a regional dialogue, that the IGJ has placed Santiz under heightened supervision, and that he has no role in the building plans or in the decision on defusion.
It is up to the Santiz board of directors to give clarity on how they have concretely given and will give shape to the new building. I have no role in this.
Het is aan de raad van bestuur van Santiz om duidelijkheid te geven over hoe zij concreet invulling hebben gegeven en gaan geven aan de nieuwbouw. Ik heb hier geen rol in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over de wanhopige oproep van de docenten van de Hoenderloo Groep en de huidige stand van zaken

MPs Hijink and Kwint asked about teachers' distress over the closure of the Hoenderloo Groep, including the lack of a social plan, placement of pupils, and whether the school should stay open. The minister answers that a social plan is under negotiation, pupils are being transferred to suitable youth-care places, and he sees no reason to keep the school open, while promising to keep the Chamber informed.
The Minister of VWS is willing to keep the Chamber informed of the progress of the closure, as he has done in the recent period from his system responsibility.
De Minister van VWS is bereid de Kamer, zoals hij ook de afgelopen periode heeft gedaan vanuit zijn stelselverantwoordelijkheid, op de hoogte te houden van de voortgang van de sluiting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de briefing inzake het testbeleid en de persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen

MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked the health and medical care ministers about the procurement of personal protective equipment, the shortage claims, and the reasons no additional suppliers were added during COVID-19. Minister Van Rijn answered that the LCH buys from over fifty suppliers, that RIVM guidelines are risk-based rather than shortage-based, and that the LCH is working to expand procurement and transport, but gave no precise delivery dates.
I have instructed the LCH to procure as much protective equipment for healthcare as possible.
Ik heb het LCH opdracht gegeven om maximaal beschermingsmiddelen voor de zorg in te kopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over gemeenten die zich zorgen maken over de sluiting van de Hoenderloo Groep

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about municipalities' concerns over Pluryn's plan to close the Hoenderloo Groep, including a two-day response deadline, the limited influence of municipalities, the Inspectorate's concerns, and timing of clarity for youth and staff. The minister said the two-day deadline did not fit a careful process, a revised plan was circulated, the Inspectorate supports the closure as traceable while monitoring intensively, and clarity for youth and staff will come case by case.
Setting a two-day deadline for a response that must also be coordinated among many municipalities does not fit such a careful process.
Het stellen van een deadline van 2 dagen voor een reactie die ook nog tussen vele gemeenten moet worden afgestemd past niet in een dergelijk zorgvuldig proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het pleidooi voor separate COVID-19Ziekenhuizen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care to respond to a proposal by intensivist Girbes for dedicated COVID-19 hospitals and whether the OMT and government had discussed it. The minister agreed the care system needs reorganising and described four lines of action, leaving the regional concentration of COVID-19 care to regional structures, and stated the proposal was not discussed in the OMT and that hospital federations generally oppose separate COVID-19 hospitals.
The proposal to set up separate hospitals for COVID-19 patients was not discussed in the OMT.
Het pleidooi om aparte ziekenhuizen in te richten voor COVID-19 patiënten is niet besproken in het OMT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het voorkomen van extra kosten voor mensen wier zorg is uitgesteld vanwege de coronacrisis

MP Hijink asked whether patients whose care was postponed by the COVID-19 crisis should be charged the deductible only for the first DBC, to avoid paying twice, and whether the deductible could be abolished. The Minister explained that patients pay only for care actually received, that it is not necessary to exempt follow-up DBCs, and that the NZa advice on follow-up DBCs is expected around summer; abolishing the deductible is not being investigated.
As I indicated above, people only pay deductible for care they have actually received.
Zoals ik hierboven heb aangegeven betalen mensen alleen eigen risico voor zorg die zij daadwerkelijk hebben ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Ontslag dreigt voor ruim 50% fysiotherapeuten’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care why the compensation scheme for paramedical care (including physiotherapists) was delayed, what percentage of lost revenue would be compensated, whether non-contracted providers can participate, how non-insured costs are handled, and whether the minister will take responsibility rather than leaving finances to insurers. The minister answered that insurers' continuity-contribution scheme opens to providers from 15 May, based on normal insured revenue, that non-contracted providers must sign a payment agreement, that Rijksregelingen apply only to uninsured revenue after insurer support, and that the answers were late due to the COVID workload.
Are you willing, if necessary, to not leave the financial care to health insurers but to take your responsibility as Minister?
Bent u bereid om, als dat nodig blijkt, de financiële zorg niet aan zorgverzekeraars over te laten maar als Minister uw verantwoordelijkheid te pakken?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Wie vormen het Landelijk Consortium Hulpmiddelen (LCH)?'

An SP MP asked the Health Minister which parties and individuals sit in the Landelijk Consortium Hulpmiddelen (LCH), who holds what responsibility, whether there is conflict of interest or profit, and how it was set up. The minister answered at length: the LCH is a temporary, non-profit public-private cooperation of individual experts (not organisations), VWS commissions and guarantees it, distributors work at cost, and the LCH was set up at the sector's request.
The LCH consists of individuals and not of organisations and institutions.
Het LCH bestaat uit personen en niet uit organisaties en instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink over zelftesten voor corona

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about unreliable and unlawfully marketed COVID-19 self-test kits, including imports from China, and asked what the government will do about enforcement, monitoring by the IGJ, sanctions and customs checks. The Minister's reply is a referral to a letter on the COVID-19 situation, meaning the questions were answered by reference to another document rather than on substance.
The written questions from MPs Marijnissen and Hijink (both SP) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (2020Z07032) have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink (beiden SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ( 2020Z07032 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over het beleid voor testen en beschermingsmiddelen bij mensen die werken in de huishoudelijke verzorging

SP MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked the Minister of Health whether RIVM guidelines provide testing for home care workers, whether they should be tested and protected with personal protective equipment, and why the guidance on contact with coughing patients was loosened. The Minister referred the answers to the COVID-19 update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 315) rather than answering each question in this document.
The written questions from MPs Hijink and Marijnissen (SP) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (2020Z07555) have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen (SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ( 2020Z07555 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Test op antistoffen, dat is nu essentieel’ en ‘onderzoek relatie corona en vuile lucht’.

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about a newspaper op-ed on antibody testing and the mechanics of immunity after a mild COVID-19 infection, a proposal to test a representative sample, and a possible link between air pollution and COVID-19 severity. The minister answered that research on antibodies and immunity is still ongoing, that an expert task force will advise on testing strategy, that the Pienter-Covid study already tests a broader population sample, and referred the air pollution question to earlier answers.
The task force will among other things assess whether and for which persons it is desirable for an antibody test to be deployed on a large scale.
De taskforce zal onder andere beoordelen of en voor welke personen het wenselijk is dat een test op antistoffen op grote schaal ingezet gaat worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de financiering van zorgkosten tijdens de coronapandemie

An SP MP asked whether insurers would cover all extra COVID-19 care costs so patients pay nothing extra, how hospital budget caps and transport are handled for COVID and non-deferrable care, and how patients with budget policies are protected when transferred. The minister answered that patients will not be charged extra COVID costs, hospitals' extra costs will be reimbursed, transport covered under the Zvw, and budget-policy holders receive the same access as others.
Charging patients for extra costs resulting from the COVID-19 outbreak is indeed not an issue.
Extra kosten als gevolg van de uitbraak van COVID-19 in rekening brengen bij patiënten is inderdaad niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over uitstel van de Wet geneesmiddelenprijzen

Two SP MPs asked why the Minister postponed the Medicines Prices Act sharpening by six months, why the 150 million euro cost falls on premium payers, how COVID-related drug price controls are lifted, and why compulsory licensing was not used. The Minister answered that the postponement gives market parties financial room to build stocks, that the cost is about 150 million euro, that maximum prices may be lifted for COVID drugs if shortages threaten, and that compulsory licences would not address supply shortages.
I did call on parties to act responsibly with the extra financial room I am giving them.
Ik heb partijen wel opgeroepen verantwoordelijk om te gaan met de extra financiële armslag die ik hen hiermee bied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het testbeleid in zorginstellingen

The SP MP Hijink asked the Minister of Health about healthcare workers with mild symptoms who cannot get tested, the division of testing responsibilities between employers, GP and GGD, and what workers should do when referred back and forth. The minister's answer refers to a separate letter on the state of affairs (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 277) rather than answering the questions in substance.

The written questions from MP Hijink (SP) to Minister De Jonge (Health, Welfare and Sport) and Minister van Rijn (Medical Care) have been answered by letter <COVID-19 – Update on the state of affairs>.

De schriftelijk vragen van het lid Hijink (SP) aan Minister De Jonge (Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport) en Minister van Rijn (Medische Zorg) ( 2020Z07031 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief <COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken>
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars de revalidatiezorg het mes op de keel zetten

An MP asked the minister whether insurers' cost-cutting is squeezing rehabilitation providers, waiting lists and quality, and whether NZa tariffs are adequate. The minister responded that the NZa and insurers have been asked to act on access and tariffs will be revised for 2021, while leaving contracting largely to providers and insurers and noting existing NZa and IGJ enforcement powers.
That is why I have asked the Netherlands Competition Authority (NZa) to take the lead in ensuring that care other than COVID-19 care proceeds as well and efficiently as possible.
Daarom heb ik de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) gevraagd om regie te nemen op het zo goed en efficiënt mogelijk doorgang te laten vinden van andere zorg dan COVID-19 zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de tekorten aan beschermende middelen bij zorginstellingen

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister twelve questions about shortages of protective equipment at care institutions, including bureaucracy and delays at the national procurement consortium LCH, untested supplies, and rejected offers. The minister's reply is a cross-reference: the questions were answered in a broader COVID-19 status letter rather than individually.
The written questions from MPs Hijink and Marijnissen (both SP) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport have been answered by way of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen (beiden SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de berichtgeving dat het sterftecijfer door het coronavirus hoger is dan eerder gemeld

SP MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked why Dutch COVID-19 death figures may be about twice the officially reported number, whether CBS and RIVM should combine data, whether suspected cases are recorded, and whether testing of elderly care residents will be expanded. Minister De Jonge acknowledged the deaths are higher than RIVM figures, which only count confirmed cases, referred to earlier answers for the data questions, and said the government will strengthen protection of the vulnerable and point to its testing policy letter.
The total number is larger than the RIVM figures that RIVM publishes; we also explain this when publishing those figures.
Het totaal aantal is groter dan de RIVM cijfers die het RIVM publiceert, dat leggen we ook uit bij de publicatie van die cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Karabulut over toeristen in Nederland die vanwege het Coronavirus niet terug kunnen keren

Two SP MPs asked whether the government would act on reports that tourists in the Netherlands with expiring visas cannot return home due to coronavirus, and how many are affected. The minister said visa extensions can be requested by phone from the IND, which judges each case individually, but could not give exact numbers and does not track these cases.
In addition, the IND does not register the number of people who cannot return due to the coronavirus and who for that reason submit a request to extend a visa.
Daarnaast registreert de IND niet het aantal mensen dat niet kan terugkeren vanwege het Coronavirus en om die reden een verzoek om verlenging van een visum indienen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over de brandbrief van fysiotherapeuten over een effectief noodplan voor fysiotherapiepraktijken dat per direct voorziet in financiële ondersteuning

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the Minister for Medical Care nine questions about letters and press statements from physiotherapists and dental professionals warning of bankruptcy, asking why they are excluded from existing COVID-19 support and when compensation will be clear. The answers were not given in this document; the minister referred to the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 219) instead.

The written questions from MPs Hijink and Van Gerven (both SP) to the Minister for Medical Care (2020Z06224) have been answered by letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, no. 219).

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de Minister voor Medische Zorg ( 2020Z06224 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 219 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het uitbreiden van de testcapaciteit (ingezonden 7 april 2020).

Two SP MPs asked the minister about unused laboratory testing capacity, how far testing could be scaled up using companies, scientists and biotech parks, whether vendor lock-in limits testing, and whether the government would use military coordination, compulsory licences or relax procurement rules. The reply is a Kamerbrief reference stating the written questions were answered in a separate COVID-19 update letter, without substantive answers in this document.
The written questions from MPs Hijink and Van Gerven (both SP) to the Minister for Medical Care have been answered by letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de Minister voor Medische Zorg ( 2020Z06299 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over het bericht 'Onrust bij thuiszorg, wijkverpleging, gehandicaptenzorg en ouderen zorg bij gebrek aan bescherming en beperkt testen personeel'

SP MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked the ministers, following press reports, about shortages of protective equipment and limited testing for staff in home care, district nursing, disability care and elderly care, including how the ministry's purchasing collective, alternative supplies, industry contributions, domestic production, expanded testing and a passed motion would be handled. The answer is a referral: the questions were answered in the broader COVID-19 update letter to parliament rather than individually.

The written questions from members Hijink and Marijnissen (both SP) to the Ministers for Medical Care and of Health, Welfare and Sport (2020Z06304) have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen (beiden SP) aan de Ministers voor Medische Zorg en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ( 2020Z06304 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over het coronavirus en onderwijs

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about school closures and childcare during the coronavirus outbreak, including whether schools should serve as childcare, whether parents may keep children home under the Compulsory Education Act, and the Inspectorate's stance. The minister confirmed that in-person teaching and childcare are suspended until 28 April with online teaching where possible, and set out exam, internship, study-advice and funding adjustments.
Until and including Monday 28 April, no on-site teaching will take place in primary, secondary, vocational and higher education, and regular childcare will be suspended.

Tot en met maandag 28 april wordt er geen les gegeven op locatie in het primair onderwijs, voortgezet onderwijs, middelbaar beroepsonderwijs en hoger onderwijs, en de reguliere kinderopvang wordt gestaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink over de gevolgen van het coronavirus op bewoners en medewerkers van verpleeghuizen

SP MPs Marijnissen and Hijink asked the Minister of Health about COVID-19 infections among nursing home residents and staff, testing and mortality counting, visitor restrictions and their effects on residents, protective equipment, and related staffing and visiting policy. The answer refers the MPs to the government's COVID-19 status update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 200) instead of answering each question directly.
The written questions from MPs Marijnissen and Hijink (both SP) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (2020Z05791) have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 – Status update'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink (beiden SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ( 2020Z05791 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht «De eerste 100 extra beademingsapparaten van Philips zijn binnen: «mooi nieuws»

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about the use of Defence, veterinarians, private clinics and other parties for ventilator supply during COVID-19, including counts of available and deployed ventilators, and whether answers could be given before the plenary debate. The answers were not given in this document; the minister referred to a letter 'COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 200) instead.
have been answered by way of the letter 'COVID-19 – Update on the state of affairs' (Parliamentary paper 25 295, no. 200)
zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 200 )

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink, Van Gerven en Marijnissen over het opkopen van een Duits bedrijf dat aan een coronavaccin werkt door de Amerikaanse president Trump om een vaccin uitsluitend voor Amerikanen te ver

MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care how she would respond to reports that President Trump sought to buy a German COVID-19 vaccine developer for exclusive US access, and how to ensure affordable, universal access to any Dutch-funded vaccine or therapy, including whether to block private sale, suspend patents and set price limits. The minister replied that CureVac denied any such offer, that the medical need should guide access, that the existing patent law and compulsory licensing options are sufficient for now, and that she supports international price negotiations and will oppose excessive prices.
It is also not my intention in this crisis to develop a vaccine publicly and, if successful, to have distribution to the world population handled by a public organisation.

Het is ook in deze crisis niet mijn voornemen om publiekelijk een vaccin te ontwikkelen en bij een eventueel succes de distributie vanuit een publieke organisatie naar de wereldbevolking te verzorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink, Beckerman en Van Nispen over huisuitzettingen tijdens de coronacrisis

SP MPs asked why eviction summary proceedings are treated as urgent or postponed during the coronavirus crisis, whether evictions should be halted, and whether a law banning evictions is needed. The minister answers that eviction cases are postponed except in exceptional superspoed cases, that landlord associations agreed to avoid evictions during the crisis, and that the government will use emergency legislation to extend temporary leases.
Eviction cases have not been classified as urgent by the judiciary, so for now no oral hearings take place unless the judge in summary proceedings decides a hearing must go ahead.

Huisuitzettingen zijn door de rechtspraak niet aangemerkt als urgente zaken en voorlopig vinden er daarom geen mondelinge behandelingen plaats, tenzij de rechter in kort geding oordeelt dat een zitting moet doorgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Vertrouwen tot nulpunt gedaald: ‘We zijn enorm geschrokken, SKB moet zich nu echt afscheiden’’

Two MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about the collapse of trust over a planned hospital merger in the Achterhoek (SKB Winterswijk and Doetinchem), including loss of separate works and client councils, IGJ findings, possible conflicts with NMa conditions, and whether the minister would commission an independent investigation and request sharing of withheld information. The minister answered that the hospital board is responsible for its strategy, the IGJ sees no threat to care quality, a regional picture is due in May 2020, and the board decides what information is commercially sensitive, declining an independent investigation.
No. The Board of Directors of Santiz is responsible for the business operations and strategic direction of its hospital.
Nee. De Raad van Bestuur van Santiz is verantwoordelijk voor de bedrijfsvoering en strategische koers van haar ziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over het artikel ‘Overleg over mogelijk tekort aan medicijnen’

SP MPs asked the minister whether the planned Wet geneesmiddelenprijzen was being postponed after pharma firms warned that low drug prices risk shortages during the coronavirus crisis, and about shortage prevention measures. The minister said options including room under the price law are being examined, that no corona-related shortages have yet been signalled, and that a further letter will follow next week.
I expect to be able to provide more insight on this next week, and I will inform you separately by letter.
Ik verwacht hier volgende week meer inzicht in te kunnen geven, ik zal u daarover separaat per brief informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over de sluiting van de onderwijstak van De Hoenderloo Groep

MPs Hijink and Kwint asked the ministers whether Pluryn's separation of the Hoenderloo College education branch into a separate foundation was used to strip teachers of their rights and funds, and what action the government would take. Minister Slob answered that the closure of the Hoenderloo College followed inevitably from closing the care locations, that the Inspectorate monitors Pluryn's finances and compliance, and that Pluryn has promised a social plan and new posts for teachers.
The Inspectorate of Education supervises compliance with laws and regulations, and if irregularities are found it will take appropriate measures.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs ziet toe op naleving van wet- en regelgeving en als blijkt dat er onrechtmatigheden zijn begaan dan zal de inspectie passende maatregelen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat daklozen van de gemeente Den Haag geld krijgen om de stad te verlaten

An SP MP asked the minister about a Den Haag pilot paying homeless people to move to other cities, and whether this is a sustainable response to the shortage of beds and housing. The state secretary defended the pilot as voluntary, support-oriented casework, said he would present an overarching plan before summer, and welcomed the pilot's results while not withdrawing it.
The pilot is therefore explicitly meant for people who themselves indicate they want to live somewhere other than The Hague.
De pilot is dus nadrukkelijk bedoeld voor mensen die zélf aangeven ergens anders te willen wonen dan in Den Haag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Westerveld, Agema, Hijink en Van der Staaij over de mogelijke doorstart van de Hoenderloo Groep

MPs Kuiken, Westerveld, Agema, Hijink and Van der Staaij asked the Minister of Health about the Hoenderloo Groep closure, his contacts with parents, steps toward a possible restart and its consistency with the Chamber's motion. The Minister replied that he visited the site, held talks with Pluryn, gemeenten and the IGJ, asked KPMG to test restart plans, and that Pluryn has offered placements for all youths while the IGJ oversees the transfer process.
I informed your House on 20 February 2020 about this, in line with my commitment in the committee debate on financial problems at youth care institutions and the Hijink et al. motion.
Ik heb uw Kamer, conform mijn toezegging in het AO «financiële problemen bij diverse jeugdzorginstellingen» en motie Hijink cs, hierover op 20 februari 2020 geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Hijink over het rapport van de Inspectie Gezondheid en Jeugd inzake DeSeizoenen

MPs Slootweg (CDA) and Hijink (SP) asked the Minister of Health about the IGJ report on DeSeizoenen, including the governance structure, service arrangements with Care Shared Services, transparency of costs and dividends, legal costs of the dispute with the Central Client Council, and alleged pressure on vulnerable clients. The Minister answered that the personal union is expected to end by 1 July 2020, that the IGJ found no basis to pursue dividend or Belastingdienst information, and that no continuity or bankruptcy signals were received, while describing pressure on vulnerable clients as unacceptable.
Het onder druk zetten van kwetsbare mensen is onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat ‘Frankrijk beslag laat leggen op de voorraden en productie van mondkapjes’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether he would respond to France seizing face-mask stocks and production, whether the Netherlands could take a similar measure, and whether he would answer before the debate. The minister said he lacks the legal power for such a seizure, that GGD-GHOR will coordinate distribution, and that he will raise the issue at the EU health council.
I do not have that legal authority.
Die wettelijke bevoegdheid heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de communicatie rondom de melding van de eerste coronabesmetting in Nederland

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care why the first coronavirus infection was announced live during an NOS broadcast, whether the minister knew beforehand, and whether the hospital was surprised. The minister answered that the test still required confirmation and notification of the patient and family, that the announcement was coordinated with the RIVM, GGD and the hospital, and that the standard procedure was followed.
During the broadcast I was told that everyone had been informed, and I chose to make this news public.
Tijdens de uitzending kreeg ik te horen dat iedereen geïnformeerd was en heb ik ervoor gekozen dit bericht bekend te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over normenkaders voor de intensieve kindzorg

MP Hijink asks the Minister of Health about two competing assessment frameworks (normenkaders) for indication in intensive child care, one accredited by the Zorginstituut and one used by some home-care organisations and insurers, and whether the government should act. The Minister states that the V&VN professional norm is the common standard, that insurers rely on it, that the NZa does not govern care content, and that V&VN will clarify the norm for child home care by 1 May.
Such an assignment does not fall within the powers of the NZa.
Een dergelijke opdracht past niet binnen de bevoegdheden van de NZa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het Coronavirus op de MS Westerdam

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care whether passengers of the MS Westerdam left their cabins in Cambodia against instructions, how the government learned of this, and whether those passengers are known to the GGD. The minister replied that quarantine was the responsibility of Cambodian authorities, all Dutch passengers tested negative and are being monitored by the GGD, and that quarantine in the Netherlands is not deemed necessary.
The quarantine measures in Cambodia were imposed by, and are under the responsibility of, the Cambodian government.
De quarantainemaatregelen in Cambodja zijn opgelegd door, en onder verantwoordelijkheid van de Cambodjaanse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman en lid Hijink over het bericht dat een man in hongerstaking gaat

MPs Beckerman and Hijink asked the government how it will help Dhani Hoekstra, who announced a hunger strike over Groningen earthquake damage, and what it will do for people suffering psychological distress from gas extraction. The minister said the case is handled by responsible bodies, declined to comment on the individual case, and outlined gas-extraction phase-out, extra funding for social-emotional support and mental health care, without giving a count of users.
Beyond that, I will not comment on this individual case.
Voor het overige doe ik geen uitlatingen over deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de falende controle op zorgfraude

MP Hijink (SP) asked the Minister of Health about rising healthcare fraud, the risk-free fraud reported by DSW, insufficient enforcement capacity, family-based care fraud, the Wtza bill, and municipal oversight after the 2015 decentralisations. Minister De Jonge answered that fraud cannot be precisely quantified, outlined a chain-wide enforcement approach with new measures and extra Inspectie SZW capacity, and said municipal oversight should remain locally organised.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over gedwongen verhuizingen

An SP MP asks whether forced relocations of residents of care institution Reinaerde, from Woerden to locations hundreds of kilometres away and separated from family, are acceptable and reflect a careful process, and whether residents can stay near home. The Minister answers that the closure of verpleegkundige staffing made intensive care unavailable locally, that a careful search was conducted with the zorgkantoor and IGJ, and that alternatives in Ermelo, Zeist and Katwijk were offered, with no one moved to Friesland.
I am of the view that Reinaerde is carrying out a careful search process.
Ik ben van mening dat Reinaerde een zorgvuldig zoekproces doorloopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over tijdelijke uithuisplaatsingen vanuit gezinshuizen

An SP MP asked the minister whether foster parents employed by gezinshuizen lose income when a child is temporarily placed elsewhere for treatment, and whether such losses are monitored. The minister answered that employment terms follow the CAO Jeugdzorg, that bridging arrangements are for employer and employee to agree, and that no register exists to quantify affected foster parents.
No, that is not known to me. It is not possible to find that out, because there is no register with the names and addresses of foster parents.
Nee, dat is mij niet bekend. Het is niet mogelijk om dat uit te zoeken, omdat er geen register is met de namen en adressen van gezinshuisouders.
Antwoord op het vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Stilleggen van het dataverkeer door het Medisch Centrum Leeuwarden naar aanleiding van een hackpoging’

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care how a hacking attempt on the Medisch Centrum Leeuwarden went undetected or unaddressed despite earlier Citrix warnings, and what role Z-CERT and the NCSC played. The minister answered that hospitals bear primary responsibility for their ICT security under supervision of the IGJ, that the MCL reports no data reached internal systems, that the MCL failed to apply a December workaround in time and is investigating, and that the government is exploring making Z-CERT membership mandatory with results due before summer 2020.

I consider it of the utmost importance that patient and healthcare institution data are safe, and therefore I attach importance to healthcare institutions being supported by Z-CERT when taking measures.

Ik vind het van het grootste belang dat de gegevens van patiënten en zorginstellingen veilig zijn en daarom hecht ik eraan dat de zorginstellingen bij het treffen van maatregelen worden ondersteund door Z-CERT

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over het bericht dat zorginstellingen misbruik lijken te maken van de regeling waarmee zij aanstelling of ontslag van een bewindvoerder, mentor of curator mogen vragen

Two MPs (Van Nispen and Hijink, SP) asked about reports that care institutions are misusing their power to request appointment or dismissal of guardians and administrators, and whether judges adequately check such requests and whether guardians are dependent on care institutions. Minister Dekker answered that the figures were misread (about 20 institutional requests per year since 2017), that safeguards against conflicts of interest exist, and that the evaluation did not show clear misuse, while promising to ask care umbrella organisations to raise the issue with members.
When a care institution files a dismissal or appointment request, the judge assesses the merits of the request and weighs all interests involved.
Als een zorginstelling een ontslag- en benoemingsverzoek indient, beoordeelt de rechter de gegrondheid van het verzoek en weegt hij alle betrokken belangen af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de tien tips voor de toekomst van de wijkverpleging

An MP asked the minister how to respond to claims by the director of Buurtzorg that fewer care hours could be needed through better interventions, and whether a standard, integrated approach and a single tariff should be pursued. The minister largely defers to care providers and professionals, points to existing quality frameworks and ZonMw funding, and says he will reduce non-contracted care and wait for NZa advice on tariffs.
I agree that the current system contains incentives to provide unnecessarily more and longer care.
Ik ben het ermee eens dat er in het huidige stelsel prikkels zijn om onnodig meer en lang zorg te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over gemeenten die nauwelijks zicht hebben op de besteding van zorggeld

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether municipalities' lack of oversight over care spending, and the excessive profits of care providers, is acceptable and what municipalities can do. The Minister calls excessive profits unacceptable, points to planned measures on entry and profit conditions, and says municipalities already have instruments to act on unjustified profits.
I have previously stated that I consider excessive profits socially unacceptable.
Ik heb eerder aangegeven excessieve winsten maatschappelijk onacceptabel te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de hogere instroom van cliënten in de Wmo als gevolg van de invoering van het abonnementstarief

An SP MP asked the minister about rising Wmo home-care demand after the subscription tariff was introduced, the shifting of budgets by municipalities, how income groups are monitored, and how the Hijink motion will be implemented. The minister says the increase was anticipated, commits to an ongoing monitor with VNG and to annual discussion, but draws no conclusions yet and sees no current need for additional compensation.
I consider it important that the effects of the subscription tariff are closely monitored.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de effecten van het abonnementstarief goed worden gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘GEZOCHT: 100 aanstaande MOEDERS voor nieuw GREEN VACCIN!’

An SP MP asked the state secretary for health about a blog offering a free juicer to parents who choose not to vaccinate their children, whether it was misleading, what would be done against it, and whether financial rewards for not vaccinating are permitted. The state secretary called the action irresponsible and misleading, said the IGJ had contacted the blog owner and that the Reclame Code Commissie would rule on the advertising, but gave no new binding measures.
The IGJ asked the owner of the blog «Miss Natural Lifestyle» to adjust the call and invited her for a conversation.
De IGJ heeft de eigenaar van de blog «Miss Natural Lifestyle» gevraagd om de oproep aan te passen en haar uitgenodigd voor een gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over problemen bij de verstrekking van hulpmiddelen

An SP MP asked the health minister how to view a Emmeloord woman who was housebound for four months because her adapted wheelchair was not delivered, and about financial problems at the Hulpmiddelencentrum causing supplier refusals. The minister said municipalities remain ultimately responsible for timely aid provision, outlined a capital injection and an action plan, and gave partial answers on how many municipalities and suppliers are affected.
However, the municipality always remains ultimately responsible for the timely provision of an adequate aid.
De gemeente blijft echter altijd eindverantwoordelijk voor de tijdige verstrekking van een adequaat hulpmiddel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Verdachte steekpartij Den Haag 'gevaar voor zichzelf en omgeving', maar werd niet opgepakt'

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about a stabbing in The Hague by a man previously flagged as dangerous who was not detained, asking how oversight failed and whether mental health care cuts were to blame. The government answered that several investigations are ongoing, that the IGJ has ordered an independent inquiry at Parnassia and the Wmo supervisor is also investigating, and it declined to discuss specifics because of the criminal case.
Because of the ongoing investigations, I cannot currently go into specific aspects of this case.
Vanwege de lopende onderzoeken kan ik op dit moment niet ingaan op specifieke aspecten van deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over meerdere keren het eigen risico aanspreken

An MP asked the health minister whether repeated application of the eigen risico for one DBC is unjust, whether the government supports the NZa call to abolish the DBC system, and whether a proposal to charge only the first DBC's eigen risico will be implemented. The minister answered that patients should pay only once per DBC but that vervolg-DBCs cause confusion, that the government is working toward outcome-based contracting, and that the NZa will advise by summer 2020 before any change is decided.
I can well understand that this situation causes confusion among patients and I understand that they experience this as unjust.
Ik kan mij heel goed voorstellen dat deze situatie voor verwarring zorgt bij patiënten en ik begrijp dat zij dit als onrechtvaardig ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over vorderingen voor het overschrijden van het budgetplafond

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about insurers' retroactive claims over mental health budget caps that threaten provider bankruptcies, and about how caps are set and whether they are fair. The State Secretary says insurers and providers are private parties with contractual freedom, points to arbitration and courts, and describes planned improvements to the contracting and add-on contracting process, including a new mental health funding model.
I am not a party to cases concerning retroactive claims by health insurers, because they concern contractual agreements between care providers and insurers and their implementation.
Ik ben geen partij bij casussen met betrekking tot navorderingen door zorgverzekeraars, omdat het gaat om contractafspraken tussen zorgaanbieders en verzekeraars en de uitvoering ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over het bericht ‘Ziekenhuis Winterswijk verliest intensive care, kinderafdeling en verlosafdeling’

MPs Van Gerven and Hijink (SP) asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that the Winterswijk hospital would lose intensive care, paediatrics and obstetrics, and whether closures were planned without proper consultation. The Minister said the hospital board must follow the consultation steps of the draft AMvB on acute care before deciding, that acute obstetrics cannot close under the 45-minute accessibility norm, and that the board has paused the decision and set up a regional group.
I have informed the Board of Directors that closing acute obstetrics in Winterswijk is ruled out for as long as these conditions are not met.
Ik heb de Raad van Bestuur ervan op de hoogte gesteld dat het uitgesloten is dat de acute verloskunde in Winterswijk kan sluiten, zolang er niet aan deze voorwaarden voldaan is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'NZa draait patiëntenstop Parnassia terug'.

The SP MP Hijink asks the State Secretary for Health about the NZa's intervention in the Parnassia-VGZ contracting dispute, waiting lists in mental health care, VGZ's contracting limits, marketing by Parnassia, and related issues. The State Secretary says the NZa acted rightly to protect continuity of care, sets out waiting-time data and the NZa's oversight findings, and points to existing commitments on contracting and workforce, while declining to comment on private contract talks and having no insight into marketing budgets.
I stand behind the NZa's approach and I am pleased with the outcome.
Ik sta achter de handelwijze van de NZa en ik ben blij met de uitkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over de sluiting van residentiële bedden bij Oosterpoort

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health why residential youth-care beds at Oosterpoort are being closed amid municipal budget cuts, and how youths are protected from falling through the cracks. The minister replied that the closure was a joint regional decision, that municipalities have arranged alternative family-based care, and that municipalities are responsible for youth care provision.
Municipalities are responsible for youth care and have a statutory youth-care obligation.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de jeugdhulp en hebben een wettelijke jeugdhulpplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de overname van jeugdzorginstelling Juzt is afgeketst

An SP MP asked why the takeover of the near-bankrupt youth care provider Juzt failed, who guarantees the funding, and how clients and staff are affected. The minister explains that bankruptcy was averted through municipal loans and a €3 million liquidity loan from VWS, that care is being transferred in phases to other providers, and that regional and national cooperation on youth care will be strengthened.
Before 1 March 2020 we will inform the House further about our policy intentions in this regard.
Voor 1 maart 2020 zullen wij uw Kamer nader informeren over onze beleidsvoornemens daartoe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de kosten van het organiseren van de ouderenzorg

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about municipal warnings that home care for older people will cost about 7% more over five years, and about related funding strains, workforce and care gaps. The Minister said the trend cannot be concluded from a small sample, will monitor the Wmo abonnementstarief impact with a national study and discuss measures with the VNG in 2020, and pointed to the funding framework and the 2015 care reform.
Based on the outcomes of the monitoring study, I will discuss this annually with the VNG.
Op basis van de uitkomsten uit het monitoronderzoek zal ik jaarlijks met de VNG het gesprek hierover voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het gebrek aan volledige dekking fysiotherapie in verzekeringen

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the Minister why no insurer offers unlimited physiotherapy cover in 2020, whether medical selection effectively excludes full cover, and how ME/CVS and rheumatism patients needing physiotherapy can be helped. The Minister rejected the premise that the situation is undesirable, pointed to a range of supplementary policies with physiotherapy cover and the Zorginstituut's ongoing advisory work, and said the answer was delayed by the need for external information.
I do not share that view. We have an extensive and solidarity-based basic package in the Netherlands.
Ik deel die mening niet. We hebben in Nederland een uitgebreid en solidair basispakket.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de concurrentie tussen zorgorganisaties

An SP MP asked the health minister whether competition law prevents care organisations from cooperating to find places for elderly patients, and what role the ACM plays. The minister answered that such cooperation is permitted, explained the Competition Act and ACM guidance, and said competition is a means rather than an end and that he will support cooperation.
Of course care organisations may consult to see where a place is available for a patient.
Natuurlijk mogen zorgorganisaties overleggen om te kijken waar plek is voor een patiënt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Raak over het bericht dat mensen niet meer naar buiten durven vanwege een gebrek aan openbare toiletten

MPs Hijink and Van Raak asked why many municipalities do not provide public toilets and whether a national minimum norm should be imposed. Minister De Jonge answered that municipalities are responsible for deciding how many public toilets are needed, pointed to voluntary programmes and alternatives, and said a national norm is not appropriate.
Municipalities themselves have the freedom and responsibility, together with residents with and without disabilities, to determine how many (semi-)public toilets are needed.
Gemeenten hebben zelf de vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid samen met inwoners, met en zonder beperking, te bepalen hoeveel (semi)openbare toiletten nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de sluiting van de Vlinderhof en Bloesemhof in Montfoort

An MP asked the health minister whether closing the Vlinderhof day-care and the small Bloesemhof nursing home in Montfoort is acceptable given the shortage of care places, and what the government will do. The minister says closure is justified on quality grounds, that residents are being relocated in consultation, that alternative capacity exists nearby, and that the decision is final while he will monitor the relocations.
The decision to close De Vlinderhof and De Bloesemhof is final and no further steps in the decision-making on this are expected.
De beslissing om De Vlinderhof en De Bloesemhof te sluiten is definitief en er zijn geen verdere stappen in de besluitvorming daarover te verwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Marketingspersoneel zorgverzekeraar VGZ kon bij medische gegevens’

An MP asked the minister about reports that marketing staff at health insurers VGZ and Menzis had access to patients' medical data, and whether Menzis had taken sufficient action. The minister confirmed the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens imposed penalties on both insurers, that Menzis paid a 50,000 euro penalty payment after incomplete compliance, that the insurers have since changed their working methods, and that no evidence of actual marketing use was found.
At both health insurers, marketing staff had improperly had access to personal health data.
Bij beide zorgverzekeraars hadden marketingmedewerkers ten onrechte toegang tot persoonsgegevens betreffende de gezondheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het faillissementen in de verpleeghuiszorg

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health why care homes such as Het Grotenhuis (Trimenzo) went bankrupt after the competition authority ACM blocked or conditioned mergers, and how this squares with the national shortage of nursing home places. The Minister rejects the claim that ACM caused the bankruptcies, explains the merger control rules and defenses available, and says the care was continued by Sensire after a takeover, which ACM has now approved.
The conclusion that the nursing home went bankrupt because a merger was rejected by the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) is one I do not share.
De gevolgtrekking dat het verpleeghuis failliet is gegaan door het afkeuren van een fusie door de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de dreigende sluiting van Reinaerde

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the threatened closure of care home Reinaerde, which serves 26 residents with physical disabilities, and what options exist to keep it open. The Minister answered that the provider decides how care is organised, that the building is too small and staff recruitment is insufficient, that the IGJ monitors developments, and that the Chamber will be informed early next year.
The decision to organise care differently is a decision of the care provider.
De keuze om de zorg op een andere manier te organiseren is een besluit van de zorgaanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over zorgorganisatie DeSeizoenen die de gedragscode voor de zorg schendt

MPs Hijink and Slootweg asked the Minister of Health about conflicts of interest and governance failures at care provider DeSeizoenen, including shared directors with Care Shared Services and weak administration. The Minister said conflicts of interest are unacceptable, that the provider has committed to restructuring its governance by next year, and that further measures will be set out in a letter to parliament.
I find it undesirable when care providers violate the governance code for care.
Ik vind het onwenselijk als zorgaanbieders de governancecode zorg schenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over de wachtkamer van de zorg: overvolle Twentse hospices

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the health minister about hospices in Twente functioning as waiting rooms for nursing homes, terminally ill people dying at home for lack of hospice beds, hospital transfers to hospices, the decline of care homes, and the financing of bed capacity. Minister De Jonge said hospices should not serve as a general care function for older people, that dying people should be able to reach hospices where preferred, and that he is consulting the hospice sector and palliative networks and will send a letter on nursing home building needs in December.

I am in discussion with the hospice industry association, VPTZ Nederland, and the palliative care networks to see how better regional coordination can ensure people do not go to a hospice too late or too early.

Ik ben in gesprek met de brancheorganisatie van hospices, VPTZ Nederland, en de netwerken palliatieve zorg om te bezien hoe betere afstemming in de regio ervoor kan zorgen dat mensen niet te laat of te vroeg naar een hospice gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de indexatie van Jeugdzorgtarieven

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether agreed national indexation of youth care tariffs exists, given the VNG's statement that no national agreements can be made, and what the government will do if municipalities do not index. The minister answered that bilateral agreements with the VNG exist, that a general administrative order (AMvB) with a binding indexation obligation is being prepared, and that the VNG will publish indexation percentages annually.
The AMvB will in any case contain an obligation to index.
De AMvB zal in ieder geval een verplichting tot indexatie bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de problematiek rondom hulpmiddelen en verhuizingen

An SP MP asked the health minister about persistent problems with keeping assistive devices after moving to another municipality, the findings of Ieder(in), whether investigations should give way to firm agreements, whether lifelong devices could move to the Zorgverzekeringswet, and the status of agreements with the VNG. The minister answered that an action team and a board table were set up, 434 signals were received with 144 requiring action, that a broader review of device reimbursement schemes will be explored, and that an action plan will follow in January 2020.

I intend to send Parliament the action plan on improving the provision of assistive devices after the board table in January next year, and to inform Parliament of progress on all actions before summer 2020.

Ik ben voornemens uw Kamer na de bestuurlijke tafel in januari volgend jaar het actieplan verbetering verstrekking hulpmiddelen te doen toekomen en voor de zomer van 2020 uw Kamer te informeren over de voortgang van alle acties uit het actieplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de berichtgeving dat de werkdruk zo hoog is in de zorg dat zorgpersoneel steeds vaker psychische hulp nodig heeft

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that the share of healthcare workers receiving psychological care rose about 40 percent over four years, whether work causes these complaints, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledged the rising trend as worrying, noted work contributes to complaints for part of the workforce, and listed retention measures and a TNO study on burnout.
A rising trend in the share of healthcare workers receiving psychological care I find worrying and all the more reason to invest further in improving the working climate for healthcare workers.

Een stijgende trend in het aandeel zorgmedewerkers dat psychische zorg ontvangt vind ik zorgelijk en eens te meer reden om extra in te zetten op het verbeteren van het werkklimaat van zorgmedewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Familiedrama in Winschoten: ‘Ze belde 113, maar dat nummer bestaat helemaal niet’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the 113 suicide prevention number confusion after a tragedy in Winschoten, and whether the number could be made available quickly. The State Secretary expressed sympathy, acknowledged the confusion, and explained the numbering-plan constraints and ongoing talks with EZK, promising a short-term fix and an exploration of making 1-1-3 available.
I am now in discussion with the Ministry of EZK to take action on this and to adapt the message into a clear referral or forwarding to the correct number
Ik ben inmiddels met het Ministerie van EZK in gesprek om hier actie op te ondernemen en de melding aan te passen in een duidelijke verwijzing of doorschakeling naar het juiste nummer

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat het Amsterdam UMC doorgaat met de invoering van functiedifferentiatie onder verpleegkundigen (wetsvoorstel BIG-II), ondanks de oproep een pas op de plaats te mak

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care how he views Amsterdam UMC continuing to introduce nursing function differentiation and the regieverpleegkundige role despite his call to pause, and whether he will act against employers who do not pause. The minister replies that the pause concerned the BIG-II bill, not employers' internal job structures, that he has appointed an explorer and will inform the House soon, but that he will not monitor or intervene with individual employers.
Creating positions is a matter for employers and must therefore be seen separately from the bill.
Het creëren van functies is een aangelegenheid van werkgevers en moet dan ook los worden gezien van het wetsvoorstel
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de noodsituatie in de psychiatrische zorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports from GGNet staff of a crisis in psychiatric care, including shortages of beds, long intake waits, insurers' duty of care and government action. The State Secretary answered that there is no shortage of acute treatment beds at GGNet, that intake waits exceed the four-week norm in most diagnosis groups, that insurers bear the duty of care supervised by the NZa, and that the sector works through the existing mental health agreement without announcing new measures.
I am currently not aware that the number of treatment beds for acute situations would be insufficient.
Er is mij op dit moment niet bekend dat het aantal «behandelbedden» voor acute situaties onvoldoende zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over Zuid- en Oost-Europeanen die omgeschoold worden voor de Nederlandse zorg

An SP MP asked the health minister about recruiting Southern and Eastern European nurses for Dutch care, including the role of agencies such as EMTG and language risks. The minister answered that hiring foreign staff is left to care institutions within EU free movement and BIG registration rules, that language proficiency is required, that foreign nurses are a small share, and that the focus should be on retaining and recruiting Dutch staff.
There is no complete picture of the extent to which care institutions want to bring foreign care workers to the Netherlands.
Er is geen compleet beeld van de mate waarin zorginstellingen buitenlandse zorgverleners naar Nederland willen halen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de uitzending van De Monitor over ICT in de zorg

MP Hijink (SP) asks the Minister for Medical Care how the government will respond to a broadcast on ICT in healthcare, including the market power of EPD vendors Epic and Chipsoft, their profits, and poor data exchange between hospitals. The Minister says the government will help the sector bundle its negotiating power, relies on the ACM for competition oversight, opposes excessive vendor profits in principle, and commits to legislation mandating electronic data exchange and open systems in 2020.

In December 2018 I already announced that I would take the lead in accelerating the establishment of electronic data exchange in healthcare, including by making electronic data exchange legally mandatory.

In december 2018 heb ik daarom al aangekondigd regie te nemen op het versnellen van de totstandkoming van elektronische gegevensuitwisseling in de zorg, onder anderen door het wettelijke verplicht stellen van elektronische gegevensuitwisseling
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over onderzoek naar mogelijk misbruik bij zwaar gehandicapten kinderen en jongvolwassenen

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about a police investigation into suspected abuse of severely disabled children and young adults at care provider Dichterbij, the closure of the location, the status of agency staff suspected of involvement, and whether the Chamber would be informed of the investigation's outcome. The minister said the provider rightly reported the abuse, described the relocation of residents and the dismissal of three agency workers, declined to comment on individual criminal cases, and confirmed that the same VOG (certificate of conduct) requirements apply to temporary staff as to permanent staff, which the inspectorate checks.
We do not go into individual (criminal) cases.
Wij gaan niet in op individuele (straf)zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de ontmanteling van jeugdzorgaanbieder Juzt

The SP MP Hijink asks the Minister of Health why the government did not intervene earlier in the financial problems of youth care provider Juzt, whether it has an inventory of other providers in financial trouble, and how it views the consequences of the 2015 decentralisation of youth care. The minister answers that the ministry was informed in 2016, gave transitional subsidies, and that the Youth Authority and municipalities now manage a controlled wind-down, while pointing to an early warning instrument, a Youth Authority analysis of provider finances, and extra municipal funding.
To detect in time the financial and organisational problems that could lead to discontinuity of care, the Youth Care Action Programme agreed that an early warning instrument will be introduced.

Om financiële en organisatorische problemen die kunnen leiden tot discontinuïteit van zorg tijdig te kunnen signaleren, is binnen het Actieprogramma Zorg voor de Jeugd afgesproken dat er een early warning instrument komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over de podcast 'Met 30 jaar zorg-ervaring terug naar school door de wet BIG 2'

SP MPs Van Gerven and Hijink asked the Minister of Medical Care about a podcast claiming the BIG-II bill would strip nurses of tasks and pay, and whether it is a cost-saving measure. The minister denies that the bill removes any nurse tasks or powers, calls the transitional arrangement a quality measure, and says the bill will not be pursued in its current form while Rinnooy Kan explores alternatives.
In view of all recent developments, I do not see the current bill on the nurse-practitioner role working in this form.
Gelet op alle recente ontwikkelingen zie ik het huidige wetsvoorstel rondom de regieverpleegkundige in deze vorm niet vliegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het overleg met betrekking tot de overgangsregeling BIG II

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked whether a consultation on the BIG II transitional regulation for nurses would take place on 10 September 2019, whether the action committee of nurses was excluded, and whether it would be invited. The minister replied that the meeting was postponed on parties' request while an explorer, Rinnooy Kan, talks with stakeholders, including the action committee.
He will also enter into discussion with the BIG II action committee.
Hij zal ook met het actiecomité BIG II in gesprek gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over miljoenentekorten bij de grootste zorginstelling van Nederland

An SP MP asked the state secretary about multi-million deficits at the Parnassia Groep, its high sick-leave rate, planned staff cuts and training limits, the high salary of its board chair, and its BV structure. The state secretary answered that the organisation is financially sound and that the IGJ and NZa monitor quality and finances, that the WNT salary exceeds the norm only under transitional rules and the CIBG is checking this, and that no governance investigation of the BV structure is warranted.
I have asked the CIBG, the independent supervisor of the WNT in the care sector, to investigate whether the transitional law at Parnassia has been applied correctly.
Ik heb het CIBG, de onafhankelijk toezichthouder op de WNT in de zorgsector, gevraagd te onderzoeken of het overgangsrecht bij Parnassia juist is toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Ploumen over het faillissement van Huize de Berg

MPs Hijink and Ploumen asked the minister about the bankruptcy of Huize de Berg, a convent whose facilities staff were sold to a commercial group, including whether staff are owed wages and whether a sister company restart is planned. The minister answered that the bankruptcy concerns the hospitality subsidiary, not care provision, that the causes are for the curator to investigate, that workers may claim wage guarantees via UWV, and that Blueprint Group denies planning a restart, and provided an overview of group entities.
From my position I cannot pass judgment on this specific case.
Ik kan vanuit mijn positie geen oordeel vellen over dit specifieke geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat Careyn de inspectie op het verkeerde been heeft gezet

An SP MP asks the minister about reports that care provider Careyn misled the health inspectorate (IGJ) during an announced visit to a care home, including whether the inspection's findings on a resident relocation were correctly represented. The minister defends the IGJ's choices on visit setup and scope, states the inspectorate does not verify relocation procedures, and points residents to the provider's complaints procedure.
The IGJ has not checked whether the relocation was carried out correctly. This is not a task of the IGJ.
De IGJ heeft niet getoetst of de verhuizing correct is uitgevoerd. Dit is geen taak van de IGJ.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Nieuwbouw bij De Boerderij in Reek van de baan, GGZ verplaatst autismezorg naar Huize Padua 'Dit is een ramp voor de bewoners’

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary about GGZ Oost-Brabant's decision to relocate autism care residents from De Boerderij in Reek to Huize Padua, questioning consultation, alternatives and the reasons for the move. The State Secretary acknowledged the impact, said the move is a considered decision by the care provider not expected soon, that the provider consulted residents and alternatives, and that he cannot intervene in such a decision.
Do you consider it acceptable that the residents of De Boerderij must move to Huize Padua, with all the consequences, purely for real estate reasons?
Vindt u het acceptabel dat de bewoners van De Boerderij moeten verhuizen naar Huize Padua, met alle gevolgen van dien, puur en alleen vanwege vastgoedoverwegingen?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over problemen met de toekenning van de kwaliteitsgelden verpleeghuiszorg

An SP MP asked the health minister about nursing-home quality funds: whether an organisation that hired staff in 2018 in anticipation was wrongly denied 2019 quality money, and whether the rules force cutbacks. The minister answered that the funds were properly allocated, the 2019 budget was granted, and that 2020 rules allow case-by-case deviation, with the health insurer's office to discuss a solution.
See answer 3. The administrative agreements on the 2020 quality budget give the health insurance office more room for tailored solutions.
Zie antwoord 3. De bestuurlijke afspraken over het kwaliteitsbudget 2020 bieden het zorgkantoor meer ruimte voor maatwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over aanbestedingen in het sociaal domein

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about the high share of social-domain care contracts awarded outside EU procurement rules, whether the Aanbestedingswet should change, why the Netherlands has no simplified national procedure, and what uniform tariffs or procedures the state could impose. The minister answered that municipalities choose their own instruments, that the light regime for social services is hard to apply, that the state is pursuing an EU-level evaluation of the directive, and that it is supporting municipalities through guidance, training and dialogue rather than a single national procedure.
That is why I am pursuing an evaluation of the procurement directive in Brussels.
Daarom zet ik in Brussel in op een evaluatie van de aanbestedingsrichtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat een ALS-patiënt een rekening van € 20.000 heeft moeten betalen door een fout van het zorgkantoor

MP Hijink asked the minister to respond to a case where an ALS patient received a EUR 20,000 bill from the CAK because a care office reported her care late, and asked about the scale of such stacked bills and remedies. The minister acknowledged the delayed data and said he shortened the period for initial levies, ordered data-matching checks, and plans further measures, though he did not provide a breakdown by responsible party.
I have shortened the period within which the CAK may impose an initial levy of the personal contribution from 36 to 12 months.
Ik heb de termijn waarover het CAK een initiële oplegging van de eigen bijdrage mag opleggen verkort van 36 naar 12 maanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over problemen met de indicatie voor ernstig zieke kinderen

MP Hijink asked the ministers whether health insurers frustrate indication and re-indication for seriously ill children, shorten indication periods, push children toward Wlz or municipalities, pressure nurses to reduce hours, and why the denktank on children with intensive care needs was dissolved. Minister De Jonge stated that the child nurse decides indication, insurers have a legal role to check lawfulness, individual cases are not commented on, and he will discuss indication issues with care parties under the 2019-2022 agreement.
In answering parliamentary questions I do not go into individual case details.
In beantwoording van Kamervragen ga ik niet in op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over zorginstellingen die ten onterechte kosten in rekening brengen voor het opbaren van overledenen

An SP MP asks whether care homes may charge relatives for laying out deceased residents in their rooms, whether this should be banned or regulated by the NZa, and whether the 13-day vacancy allowance should be extended. The minister says laying-out costs fall outside the Wmg and NZa regulation, that no ban or new rules are planned, and that ActiZ will be asked to improve communication with relatives.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over berichten dat een directeur ruim €1,5 miljoen aan zorggeld heeft vergokt

Opposition MP Hijink asked the minister to respond to reports that a care-agency director in Almelo gambled over EUR 1.5 million of care funds, and asked about inspection, municipal oversight and the handling of the case. The minister said the matter is under criminal investigation and that recovery lies with the municipality, defended the municipalities' tendering and oversight, and promised to keep the Chamber informed.
Given the confidentiality of the investigation, I cannot comment on its content or progress.
Gezien de vertrouwelijkheid van het onderzoek, kan ik over de inhoud en het verloop ervan geen uitlatingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over een Frans beursfonds dat toetreedt in de Nederlandse zorg

MP Hijink asks the health minister about French listed funds investing in Dutch commercial elderly care, whether charging residents high rent and service costs while care is reimbursed is desirable, and whether profit distribution via separate property and care companies amounts to disguised profit-making nursing homes, and asks for investigation and a ban. The minister says care access and quality come first, that separating housing and care costs is possible, and that studies on profit distribution will be shared before summer.
We aim to inform your House before the summer about the outcomes of these studies and the conclusions we draw from them.
Wij streven ernaar uw Kamer voor de zomer over te informeren over de uitkomsten van deze onderzoeken en de conclusies die we daaraan verbinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over de zaak Tuitjenhorn

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister about the Tuitjenhorn case, including the Inspectorate's court challenge over a documentary, the naming of inspectors, its handling of the Council of State ruling, and whether GPs can practise without fear of orders. The Minister defended the Inspectorate, noting it accepted the ruling, apologised, and that an independent commission found its conduct largely sound.
The inspectorate accepted the Council of State's ruling of 1 June 2016 and has drawn lessons from it.
De inspectie heeft de uitspraak van de Raad van State van 1 juni 2016 aanvaard en heeft hier lering uit getrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Ook jouw medische data liggen nu bij Google’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that medical data of hospital patients, processed by MRDM, is stored in Google's cloud, and raised concerns about privacy, pseudonymisation, US access under the Cloud Act and oversight. The minister answered that hospitals are the controllers, that pseudonymisation plus double encryption and Dutch/EU storage are safeguards, that the Data Protection Authority has started an investigation, and that an independent study on non-European cloud platforms will be commissioned.
I will have independent research carried out into the desirability of using non-European cloud platforms to store care data.
Ik zal onafhankelijk onderzoek laten doen naar de wenselijkheid van het gebruik van niet-Europese Cloud platforms voor het opslaan van zorgdata.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Patiëntdossiers in te zien door lek bij ziekenhuis OLVG’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a reported data breach at hospital OLVG that exposed patient records, including whether the breach was reported, whether other hospitals are affected, and whether the response was adequate. The minister said hospitals are responsible for data security, the AP is investigating, OLVG reported the breach and took measures, and the IGJ and OVV are reviewing hospital digital safety with results expected in Q3 2019.
I am not aware of which hospitals have experienced similar situations.
Het is mij niet bekend bij welke ziekenhuizen sprake is van soortgelijke situaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over noodzakelijke terminale zorg die niet altijd vergoed wordt door zorgverzekeraars

An SP MP asks the health minister why insurers reimburse only part of the palliative care nurses deem necessary, why home-care organisations cannot always deliver it, and whether insurers are overriding professional indications. The minister responds that contracted care is fully reimbursed, that insurers use authorisation (machtiging) requirements only for non-contracted care under statutory review duties, and that insurers deny allegations of indication-cutting targets and of capping hours.
Health insurers have the statutory task under the Health Insurance Act to check the lawfulness and efficiency of care.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben in de Zorgverzekeringswet de wettelijke taak om de rechtmatigheid en doelmatigheid van de zorg te toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over facturen van het CAK

An SP MP asked the health minister why CAK invoices showed very high total care costs, such as nearly €97,000 for household help and €34,800 for a handbike, and whether these should be removed. The minister explained that these are theoretical total costs shown only on request in itemised invoices, not the actual co-payments, apologised, and agreed to stop showing full care costs on invoices.
I have decided, in consultation with CAK and ZN, to no longer show the full amounts of care costs on the invoice.
Ik heb in overleg met CAK en ZN besloten om de volledige bedragen van de kosten van zorg niet meer op de factuur te vermelden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over misstanden in woonzorginstellingen en gebrek aan toezicht hierop
