MPs Hijink and Van Nispen asked about drug use, weapons incidents and unreported problems at residential care facilities for forensic clients, and about inspection gaps and the award of contracts to small providers. The State Secretary largely rejected a systemic problem, said inspections and municipalities had acted adequately, and promised a letter on the forensic residential care supply and supervision structure.
The picture painted in the Omroep Gelderland articles is not a pretty one.
Het beeld dat geschetst wordt in de artikelen van Omroep Gelderland is geen fraai beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het tekort aan bedden bij de kinderafdeling van het AmsterdamUMC

SP MPs asked the health minister about a shortage of paediatric intensive care beds at AmsterdamUMC after the VUmc child ICU closed, and whether the merger reduced capacity. The minister replied that concentration at AMC was planned, bed numbers rose to 10 operational with a target of 16, and staffing shortages and sick leave persist while the IGJ maintains its usual oversight.
The Amsterdam UMC has informed me that, like many hospitals in the Netherlands, it faces a staffing shortage in the paediatric ICU.
Het Amsterdam UMC heeft mij laten weten dat het, net als veel ziekenhuizen in Nederland, kampt met een personeelstekort op de kinder-IC.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Hijink over de zorg in het aardbevingsgebied

SP MPs asked about strain on healthcare in the Groningen earthquake area, including uncertainty over reinforcement of care buildings, staff stress, sick-leave data and the status of the care plan. The minister replied that the Groninger Zorgakkoord was signed, that support coaches are provided for care staff, that no sick-leave figures exist specifically for the area, and that reinforcement costs are borne by NAM.
There are no known figures on sick leave in care and welfare specifically in the earthquake area.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over het ziekteverzuim in zorg en welzijn specifiek in het aardbevingsgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over ontbrekende zorg

An SP MP asks the health minister about the long wait for a wheelchair-accessible home adaptation for a family with a severely disabled child, and whether the fragmented care system leaves families passed between bodies. The minister says the municipality is handling the request, that delays reflect complex assessment, that he has no power to intervene in individual Wmo cases, and points to ongoing cooperation programmes.
As Minister, I cannot intervene in the handling of individual cases under the Wmo 2015.
Als Minister kan ik op grond van de Wmo 2015 niet ingrijpen in de behandeling van individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over problemen bij de invoering van het abonnementstarief

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about municipalities classifying home care as general provisions, leading to higher co-payments and double bills under the subscription tariff. The minister defended the phased introduction of the subscription tariff, denied any misapplication of the AMvB, and promised to have municipalities and the CAK clarify information for citizens.
I have since had the general information on the CAK and government websites further clarified regarding the difference in contribution for general provisions and tailored provisions.

Ik heb inmiddels de algemene informatie op de websites van het CAK en rijksoverheid verder laten verduidelijken met betrekking tot het verschil in bijdrage voor algemene voorzieningen en maatwerkvoorzieningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de minister gerommel met zorggeld in de doofpot stopt

An SP MP asks the health minister whether he will publicly condemn the spending of health funds on a costly report and the use of foundations to evade the WNT pay cap, and questions the ministry's handling of Espria's account. The minister answers that spending must be careful but that judging the report's value is for the supervisory board, notes that CIBG found no WNT violation, and promises to strengthen external oversight with proposals around summer and a bill to bring subcontractors under the WNT.
I find it undesirable that structures are set up that are solely intended to circumvent laws and regulations.
Ik vind het onwenselijk dat er constructies worden opgetuigd die enkel zijn bedoeld om wet- en regelgeving te omzeilen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over nieuwe voorbeelden van naheffingen bij het CAK

An SP MP asked the health minister to respond to a case where a CAK error led to a retroactive bill over 6,000 euros, and whether the minister would request forgiveness or limit repayment to 12 months. The minister admitted errors and communication failures, said the CAK cannot generally waive contributions except in specific cases, and announced an AMvB shortening retroactive revisions to 12 months, to be in force 1 January 2020.
Because this individual case is still before the court, I will not go into the substance of the case further.
Omdat deze individuele zaak nog onder de rechter ligt ga ik verder niet inhoudelijk in op de zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Dimence werkt met Skype-psychiater in India: geniaal of gek?’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about Dimence using a psychiatrist in India to treat Dutch patients via Skype, questioning its safety, quality and whether it is a substitute for in-person care. The State Secretary said e-health can help reduce waiting times, that providers are responsible for quality under the Wkkgz, that patients should have choice, and that the Inspectorate and regulations (including the rule on in-person contact before prescribing) govern such care, without committing to a new concrete step.
Ultimately the care provider is responsible for the quality of care, and the provider is also best placed to determine whether video calling is in certain cases a suitable or even better alternative.
Uiteindelijk is de zorgaanbieder verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van de zorg, de aanbieder kan ook het beste bepalen of beeldbellen in bepaalde gevallen een passend of zelfs beter alternatief is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Gat in wet GGZ zorg Grensgangers’

An SP MP asks whether children of cross-border workers, who since decentralisation cannot receive Dutch youth mental health care, have a workable alternative given language barriers in Germany. The minister acknowledges the parents' concern but states that living abroad is a free choice and that compensating its disadvantages through new legislation is undesirable.
Compensating all these disadvantages by the Dutch State through new legislation is undesirable.
Het compenseren van al deze nadelen door de Nederlandse Staat in nieuwe wetgeving is onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Herstel van gebroken been is te meten, maar geldt dat ook voor een depressie?’

An MP asked the state secretary for health about a Nieuwsuur report on mental health care quality measurement, including the Data Protection Authority's delayed ruling on a complaint about a GGZ benchmark database and Menzis's ROM-based pilot with Volante. The state secretary said the AP must give its own judgment and he cannot set a deadline, that patient consent should be obtained in the meantime, and that quality measurement method choice is for the sector, supporting the AKWA approach.
It is up to the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) to give a considered judgment.
Het is aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) om een gewogen oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Grote ICT-storing treft ziekenhuis, maar Luus (hier 10 uur oud) komt gewoon’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a major IT outage at hospitals in Alkmaar and Den Helder, whether backup emergency plans exist in all hospitals, and whether the OVV investigation covers this. The minister answered that hospitals are themselves responsible for emergency scenarios, that the Noordwest group has one in place, that the IGJ inspects continuity, and that OVV findings expected in Q3 will determine further action.
I am not aware of which hospitals do or do not have emergency scenarios for IT outages.
Het is mij niet bekend welke ziekenhuizen wel of geen noodscenario’s hebben voor ICT-storingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Nijmeegse huisarts Hanneke: zorg te duur voor minima, levensgevaarlijk’

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that people with low incomes skip necessary care, such as check-ups and physiotherapy, because of the deductible and limited basic package, and asked for a response to calls for more income-dependent care. The minister acknowledges the problem is undesirable, points to existing compensation measures (zorgtoeslag, exemptions, gemeentepolissen, information campaigns) and says the Zvw is already partly income-dependent, without committing to new measures.
It is undesirable if people avoid necessary care because of the deductible.
Het is ongewenst als mensen vanwege het eigen risico noodzakelijke zorg mijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het artikel ‘ €369.344 euro voor een rapport van honderd pagina’s dat in een la ligt’

An SP MP asks the Health Minister about a Follow the Money report on a one-year contract for former Espria executive Meerdink via a foundation set up by Espria's supervisory board, questioning the payment from collective funds, the report's quality and the sessions held. The minister answers that the matter is for Espria's board and internal supervisor, that he has not seen the report or the seven-page note, and that no government officials attended the sessions.
However, it is not for me to judge in individual cases the amount an institution has spent on a study.
Het is echter niet aan mij om in individuele gevallen te oordelen over het bedrag dat een instelling heeft uitgegeven aan een onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over assistentiehonden

An SP MP asked the health minister about insurer CZ requiring assistance dogs to be owned by the training school, dog breed rules, and problems when insured people switch insurers. The minister replied that insurers decide how to contract care, that school ownership aids quality and complaints, that CZ dropped the breed requirement, and that insurers cooperate to ensure continuity of care.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de presentatie van het RIVM over het Rijksvaccinatieprogramma van de toekomst

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a RIVM presentation on the future National Vaccination Programme, including whether parents can refuse consent for sharing vaccination data with RIVM and whether strict GDPR application would reduce insight into vaccination coverage. The State Secretary confirmed that consent is required, that data is needed to calculate coverage, and that the government will explain the value of central registration and monitor refusal rates.
RIVM will monitor what proportion of parents do not consent to sharing vaccination data.
Het RIVM zal monitoren welk deel van de ouders geen toestemming geeft voor het delen van de vaccinatiegegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Dit zijn de beste ziekenhuizen van Nederland, ziekenhuis top 100'

An SP MP asked the minister to explain the 36 indicators behind a newspaper ranking of the best hospitals, including how they were selected, whether they measure care quality representatively, and whether complication scores ignore patient complexity. The minister replied that the AD, not the ministry or IGJ, chose and weighted the indicators, that the ministry cannot judge whether the ranking represents care quality or explain the scoring method, and that he sees no evidence hospitals select patients to improve their ranking.
I want to emphasise that the selection of factors and their weighting were carried out by the AD and not by the ministry or the IGJ.
Ik wil benadrukken dat de selectie van factoren en de weging ervan door het AD heeft plaatsgevonden en niet door het ministerie of de IGJ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over jarenlange misstanden bij Herstelcentrum C&S

MP Hijink (SP) asked the health minister how she judged years of abuse, neglect, coercion and poor care at Herstelcentrum C&S, why the inspectorates and municipal supervisors missed it until 2016, why clients were housed in old caravans and forced to sign pgb declarations, and what lessons and legislation (Wet toetreding zorgaanbieders) would prevent recurrence. Minister De Jonge condemned the abuses, said the inspectorates received no signals before 2016, announced a municipal evaluation due early 2019 and an agreed framework for pgb-proficiency and entry controls under Wmo 2015.

I will closely follow this evaluation, planned for early 2019, and in consultation with GGD Gelderland Zuid, VNG and IGJ examine which lessons from this case can be translated into the national framework of agreements

Ik zal deze evaluatie, die voor het begin van 2019 staat gepland, intensief volgen en in overleg met de GGD Gelderland Zuid, VNG en IGJ bekijken welke lessen uit deze casus kunnen worden door vertaald naar het landelijke afsprakenkader
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Is digitale overdracht van zorgdata bij failliete ziekenhuizen wel gegarandeerd? Neen!’

An SP MP asked the health minister how patient data from bankrupt hospitals is transferred, who owns and controls the systems and data, and how the Slotervaart discharge letters were handled. The minister answered that medical records must remain available, that the curator and the treating provider bear responsibility, that IGJ and NZa are supervising the transfer, and that open standards are being developed.
It is the responsibility of the care provider to transfer the records carefully in such cases.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de hulpverlener om in die gevallen de dossiers zorgvuldig over te dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over structurele problemen bij het CAK

MPs Van Nispen and Hijink (SP) asked the Minister of Health about a 93-year-old woman who received a 27,000 euro bill from CAK due to an administrative error, whether the minister would plead for debt forgiveness, and about CAK's practices, website information and communication. The minister answered that CAK will contact the woman to find a solution, that naheffing periods will be shortened to twelve months and CAK given more room for tailored solutions, that CAK must set contributions immediately after receiving data, that website improvements are ongoing, and that CAK will be asked to communicate personally with clients.

In addition, I want to examine together with CAK how, in cases like this where a client suffers such serious harm due to an error on CAK's side, the period for the back-charge can be considerably shortened.

Daarnaast wil ik samen met het CAK bekijken hoe in dit soort gevallen, waarbij een cliënt zo erg nadeel ondervindt door een fout aan de kant van het CAK, de termijn voor de naheffing aanzienlijk verkort kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over zorgondernemer, de heer Winter

SP MPs asked the health minister about the bankruptcies of hospitals run by entrepreneur Loek Winter, including calls for NZa investigation of financial constructions, conflicts of interest, WNT compliance and property profits. The minister answered that curators will investigate, that the IGJ and NZa will be asked to examine financial constructions with a letter promised by end of November, and that other questions await separate studies or are left to the curator.
Yes, as promised I will ask the IGJ and the NZa to investigate the financial constructions at the hospitals.
Ja, zoals toegezegd zal ik de IGJ en de NZa vragen om onderzoek te doen naar de financiële constructies bij de ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat ziekenhuispersoneel inschrijft op obligaties van het Bernhoven ziekenhuis

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about hospital staff buying bonds issued by Bernhoven hospital, including whether hospitals should be financed this way, the risks, the 4% interest paid out of care, and whether the ban on profit distribution should be lifted. The minister replied that financing hospitals is not the government's role, that staff participation is voluntary and unobjectionable, and that a study on profit distribution will be sent to parliament in early 2019.
I do not have the precise figures that are requested.
Ik beschik niet over de precieze cijfers waarnaar gevraagd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de kosten voor bijzondere tandheelkunde vaak niet vergoed worden door de zorgverzekeraar

MP Hijink (SP) asked the minister about a Radar report that dental care costs after cancer treatment are often not reimbursed by health insurers, and about NFK research showing few patients received reimbursement. The minister disputes the 6% figure (75% received full or partial reimbursement), explains insurers apply the same assessment rules via adviserend tandarts guidelines, notes the Zorginstituut sent letters to professional groups, and rejects restoring adult dental care to the basic package due to cost.
Following the signals from the NFK and the Radar broadcast, the Zorginstituut Nederland immediately sent a letter to all parties involved.
Naar aanleiding van de signalen van het NFK en de Radar uitzending heeft het Zorginstituut Nederland direct een brief gestuurd aan alle betrokken partijen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over informatiereizen in de zorg

An SP MP asked why the ministry commissioned a handbook on 'information journeys' in healthcare using personas, questioning whether it insults care workers and why it uses jargon like 'klant'. The minister answered that it aims to keep information provision patient-centred, that the wording is not objectionable, and that the handbook cost EUR 7,529.
Het realiseren van de handreiking heeft € 7.529 euro gekost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht Drugshandel en pooiers jongere niet veilig in jeugdzorg-instelling Heldring

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that youths in the Heldring youth care institution were unsafe due to drug dealing and pimps, and whether the Inspectorate (IGJ) would investigate, along with staffing, loverboy risks and the inspectorate's earlier role. The minister said the signals are taken seriously, that the institution is commissioning an independent safety analysis under IGJ supervision, and that the IGJ will decide on further steps afterward.
The inspectorate and the Heldring foundation jointly agreed that the Heldring foundation will have an in-depth analysis of the safety situation carried out.
De inspectie en de Heldringstichting hebben gezamenlijk afgesproken dat de Heldringstichting een diepgravende analyse van de veiligheidssituatie laat uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de schijn van belangenverstrengeling met de totstandkoming van de Wmo 2015

An SP MP asked the health minister about the appearance of conflict of interest after a VVD senator's firm, Bureau Duthler Associates, advised the ministry on a privacy impact assessment for the Wmo 2015 bill, and asked for the advice and its effect on the bill. The minister answered that the firm was hired for specialist privacy input in 2013, that the advice was published with the bill in January 2014 and partly adopted, and that assessing conflict of interest is primarily the senators' own responsibility.
I consider it primarily a matter for the senators themselves to weigh whether involvement in an assignment can lead to a conflict of interest.
Ik vind het primair een zaak van senatoren zelf om een afweging te maken of betrokkenheid bij een opdracht kan leiden tot belangenverstrengeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over het beleid van pappen en nathouden van de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd bij inspecties in thuiszorginstellingen

SP MPs Van Gerven and Hijink asked the Health Minister whether the Inspectorate's practice of 'papping en nathouden' (giving new home-care providers repeated chances to correct failings) is acceptable after a Consumentenbond study, and whether structural causes such as staff shortages lie behind the failings. The minister replied that the Inspectorate works with providers' capacity to improve, follows up with re-inspections, escalates when needed, that staff shortages are a sector-wide issue addressed by an action programme, and that the Inspectorate will increase oversight of home care and a notification duty for new providers is being legislated.
Therefore the IGJ will, this year and in the coming years too, exercise more supervision over home care.
Daarom gaat de IGJ nog dit jaar – en ook komende jaren – meer toezicht houden op de thuiszorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Rechtbank geeft Nijmegen tik op vingers; zorgfraude niet aangetoond'

An MP asked the health minister about a court ruling that the municipality of Nijmegen had not proven care fraud at a care provider, and about municipal control over personal budgets (pgb). The minister left the court case to the judge, said municipalities can check budget holders and that a policy review of the pgb is underway, and gave figures on pgb fraude.
I leave the assessment of the case to the judge.
Ik laat het beoordelen van de zaak aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht 'Duizenden minima dreigen voordelige zorgverzekering kwijt te raken'

SP MPs asked the minister about Menzis ending collective health insurance contracts for low-income residents in about 30 municipalities, affecting roughly 41,000 insured. The minister replied that municipalities and insurers are primarily responsible, that contracts are extended to 2020 in most municipalities, and that insured people remain covered and can use other arrangements.
Primarily it is the responsibility of municipalities and insurers themselves to shape cooperation for specific target groups.
Het is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten en verzekeraars zelf om samenwerking voor specifieke doelgroepen vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over Rotterdamse wijkteams die verdrinken in regels en controles, waardoor mensen lang moeten wachten op zorg en ondersteuning

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that Rotterdam neighbourhood teams are overwhelmed by municipal rules and controls, causing long waits for care, and whether a 30-page intake form is acceptable. The Minister declined to judge the Rotterdam Court of Audit findings, leaving the assessment to the Rotterdam council and executive, and pointed to national programmes on reducing administrative burden and a planned consultation with field parties in 2018-2019.
The vast majority of municipalities choose to use neighbourhood teams in implementing the Youth Act and the Wmo 2015.
Het overgrote deel van de gemeenten kiest ervoor bij de uitvoering van de Jeugdwet en de Wmo 2015 gebruik te maken van wijkteams.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over Tzorg dat gedurende de zomerperiode het aantal uren huishoudelijke verzorging halveert

SP MPs asked the Minister of Health whether it is acceptable that Tzorg halved home-help hours in the summer period in Breda, whether other providers did the same, and whether municipalities should reclaim unpaid funds. The minister answered that reducing support unilaterally is not allowed, that municipalities bear responsibility under the Wmo 2015, that he sees no reason for national investigation, and that the matter is for municipalities and the municipal council to oversee.
It is primarily for the municipal council to supervise the municipal executive on the adequate implementation of the law and municipal policy.
Het is primair aan de gemeenteraad om het college van burgemeester en wethouders te controleren op de adequate uitvoering van de wet en het gemeentelijk beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de doorstart van thuiszorgorganisatie Vérian

An SP MP asks the health minister how to judge the Vérian home-care bankruptcy and restart via a BV, the staff terms, gemeente responsibilities, union tactics and bankruptcy law. The minister answers that the curator will report, that municipalities bear continuity duties under the Wmo 2015, that a law-review track on transfers in bankruptcy is underway, and declines to judge individual conduct.
It is among the statutory tasks of the trustee to investigate the course of events surrounding a bankruptcy and to report on it.
Het behoort tot de wettelijke taken van de curator om de gang van zaken rond een faillissement te onderzoeken en hierover te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over het bericht 'Te weinig personeel bij zorgcentra van Liante'

SP MPs asked the Health Minister whether Zorggroep Liante asking relatives of nursing home residents to fill staffing gaps is acceptable, who is liable if something goes wrong, and how to prevent such shortages in future summers. The Minister replied that relatives would only do non-care support tasks during temporary overload, that the care organisation remains fully responsible under the Wkkgz, and listed sector programmes to address the labour shortage, though he did not confirm the shortage was larger than before.
The care institution is always ultimately responsible for the stay of and care for the residents living in the care institution.
De zorginstelling is altijd eindverantwoordelijk voor het verblijf van en de zorg voor de bewoners die in de zorginstelling verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de opleiding sportgeneeskunde

MP Hijink asked the minister why the SBOS, the training foundation for sports physicians, got into financial trouble, why its per-place funding is a third lower than for other specialties, and whether the ministry handled the financial problems properly. The minister denied any broken ministry commitments, defended the cost-covering funding as in line with EU state-aid rules, said the NZa will study training costs in 2019, and reported that the threatened bankruptcy was averted by a loan from SBOH with conditions attached.
The Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) plans to conduct research into the costs of training in medical specialist care in 2019.
De Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit is van plan in 2019 onderzoek te doen naar de kosten van opleidingen in de medisch specialistische zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Jeugdzorg Zuid-Holland Zuid komt opnieuw miljoenen tekort’

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether Zuid-Holland Zuid municipalities, which face renewed youth care deficits, qualify for the extra fund for deficit municipalities, and why, and how the criteria were set. The minister answered that the criteria were drawn up by the VNG and approved by municipalities, that applications run until 15 September 2018 with decisions expected in November, and that no municipality has yet received compensation.
The criteria for distributing the provision for deficit municipalities (renamed by the VNG as the Fund for Deficit Municipalities) were drawn up by the VNG in consultation with municipalities.
De criteria voor de verdeling van de voorziening voor tekortgemeenten (door de VNG omgedoopt tot Fonds Tekortgemeenten) zijn door de VNG, in samenspraak met gemeenten, opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘ZGT hangt aan het infuus bij de bank

Two SP MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about ZiekenhuisGroep Twente's financial trouble, insurers' 20 million euro reclaim, the Supervisory Board approving accounts the auditor did not fully endorse, and whether accountability or further investigation is warranted. The Minister answered that the hospital bears responsibility for its finances, insurers' claims reflect agreed prepayment arrangements, the Supervisory Board assessed the matter and found no further steps needed, and he sees no reason for a further investigation.
I do not have an overview of the hospitals that exceeded their agreed budget or turnover ceilings in 2017 and as a result must repay amounts to health insurers.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de ziekenhuizen die over 2017 hun afgesproken budget- of omzetplafonds hebben overschreden en als gevolg hiervan een bedrag moeten terugbetalen aan de zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de privatisering van het patiëntencontact door bedrijven die geld verdienen aan het informeren van kankerpatiënten

An SP MP asked the Minister whether paid private services that advise cancer patients before oncologist consultations, and the resulting privatisation of patient contact, are acceptable and whether legal steps could stop them. The Minister replied that information from one's own care provider is part of regular care, that patients may freely buy extra advice, that no legal change is planned, and that the government will support shared decision-making through the 'Uitkomstgerichte Zorg 2018–2022' programme.
I see no reason to amend a law to restrict patients in this regard.
Ik zie geen aanleiding een wet aan te passen om patiënten hierin te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Vaak uitzondering gevraagd op maximering salaris’

MP Hijink asks the health minister about reports that care executives often seek exceptions to the WNT pay cap, whether the ministry will share the refusal data and the criteria used, and whether this is morally acceptable. The minister confirms most requests come from the care sector, notes that a request may only seek a different pay class, says the 2018 requests were all rejected, but declines to release a list of refused organisations on privacy grounds and refers to the existing Staatscourant publication of granted exceptions.
Given the above considerations, I will not provide this overview to your House.
Gegeven de bovenstaande overwegingen zal ik dit overzicht niet aan uw Kamer verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over parkeerregels- en kosten voor mensen met een beperking

An SP MP asked the minister whether national rules or guidelines should harmonise differing municipal parking rules and fees for people with disabilities, whether public transport access justifies lower costs, and about the disability parking card (GPK) conditions, renewal fees and medical assessment costs. The minister replied that parking policy is decentralised to municipalities, that the VNG and GNMI will discuss the issues, that the UN disability convention does not require uniform rules, and that renewal fees are justified as a government service.
The UN convention does not require that parking tariffs, parking rules and the use of a GPK be regulated uniformly within a State.
Het VN-verdrag eist niet dat parkeertarieven, parkeerregels en het gebruik van een GPK in een Staat uniform geregeld is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink, Bergkamp en Ellemeet over de stageomstandigheden van studenten verpleegkundige en verzorging

MPs Hijink, Bergkamp and Ellemeet asked the minister about NU'91 survey findings on care students' internships: underpaid allowances, high workload, weak supervision, risky tasks beyond their competence, and interns filling staff shortages. The minister answered that CAO agreements should be respected but allowances need not meet minimum wage, that schools and care providers share responsibility for supervision, that interns should not fill staff shortages, and that he will bring the report to the attention of stakeholders.
I will bring it to attention.
Ik zal het onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het afschaffen van het vrijwillig eigen risico

MP Hijink (SP) asked whether abolishing the voluntary deductible (vrijwillig eigen risico) would allow the mandatory deductible to be lowered, and whether the voluntary deductible undermines solidarity. The minister rejected the claim that abolition would free budget for a lower mandatory deductible, rejected the solidarity concern citing CPB research, and declined to propose abolition.
At this moment I see no reason to abolish the voluntary deductible.
Ik zie op dit moment geen reden om het vrijwillig eigen risico af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over werknemers van umc’s die gaan actievoeren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether he supports umc staff taking action over stalled collective bargaining, whether he finds the NFU's offers acceptable, and whether he will press employers to avoid eroding collective agreements. The minister answered that collective agreement negotiations are a matter between private parties, that he has no involvement beyond the state's labour cost contribution, and that he will not intervene.
Collective agreement negotiations are a matter between the private parties in healthcare.
Cao-onderhandelingen zijn een zaak tussen de private partijen in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat zelfs het wijkteam dat mensen moet helpen verdwaalt tussen zorgloketten

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that municipal care-access teams get lost among too many counters, rules and funding streams, and whether this reflects the decentralisations, waiting lists and the Ombudsman's findings. The minister acknowledged the problems for complex cases, denied structural waiting lists citing lack of national data, and promised to inform parliament soon on strengthening independent client support.
I will shortly inform the House of Representatives how I intend to strengthen this function.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer binnenkort informeren hoe ik deze functie wil versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de Franse investeerder Orpea een Nederlands zorgbedrijf met omstreden managementteam koopt

An MP asks the Health Minister about the acquisition of Dagelijks Leven, a Dutch elderly care provider, by French investor Orpea, including the role of its management, government funding, and whether foreign ownership should be curbed. The minister answers that the takeover was cleared by the NZa under competition rules, that no financial problems or Waardigheid en Trots funds were involved, that foreign and domestic owners are treated alike under existing regulation, and that the IGJ monitors governance.
Care institutions are private institutions and are responsible for decisions on the organisation of care provision, governance and ownership relations.
Zorginstellingen zijn private instellingen en zijn verantwoordelijk voor beslissingen omtrent de organisatie van de zorgverlening, het bestuur en de eigendomsrelatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de strijd tegen onderbetalende gemeenten in de thuiszorg

An SP MP asks the health minister whether he accepts a NRC report that many municipalities pay below-cost home-care rates, whether this undermines care workers' wages, and whether the monitoring group should contact unions and care providers. The minister disputes the report's 25-euro threshold, says 13 signals covering 27 municipalities were investigated with a nuanced outcome, and commits to continuing the monitoring group and an evaluation due early 2019.
On the basis of my current understanding, I cannot endorse the conclusion in the NRC article.
Op basis van mijn huidige inzicht kan ik de conclusie in het NRC-artikel niet onderschrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat 1100 thuiszorgmedewerkers vrezen voor hun baan

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health how long he knew of Vérian Care & Clean's financial trouble, whether he would investigate, guarantee workers' wages and client care, and keep Parliament informed. The Minister said the curator is responsible for investigating the bankruptcy, that municipalities bear responsibility for continuity of care under the Wmo, and that workers can claim WW benefits, but he gave no commitment to an own investigation.
It is among the legal tasks of the curator to investigate the course of events surrounding a bankruptcy and to report on it.
Het behoort tot de wettelijke taken van de curator om de gang van zaken rond een faillissement te onderzoeken en hierover te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat er geen extra geld beschikbaar is voor de ambulantisering van de ggz

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether insurers misused a 300 million euro mental health budget surplus, why community mental health care is underfunded, and how oversight of insurers can be improved. The State Secretary denied that funds were transferred to 2018, explained that insurers may lower premiums through efficiency, and announced NZa checks while committing to further talks with stakeholders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Statement Transvisie: Zorg voor transgender kinderen komt veel te laat'

An MP asked the Minister whether waiting times of up to 62 weeks in transgender care, especially for children and adolescents, are acceptable, and what action will be taken to reduce them. The Minister acknowledged the waits are too long, pointed to a quality standard due this year, expert-centre expansion talks, and stated that municipalities and insurers are responsible for their own provision, while the Minister does not hold data on municipal caps.
I do not have this information.
Ik beschik niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Miljoenentekort voor Midden-Groningen: Erg zorgwekkende situatie’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports of municipal youth care budget shortfalls (Midden-Groningen, Noordoost-Brabant) and whether children would be harmed, and what the Rijk would do. The minister said youth care duties remain in force despite shortfalls, that the Rijk and VNG agreed a 200 million euro temporary facility for municipalities facing stacked social-domain deficits, and that talks with affected regions are ongoing.
It is not precisely known how many municipalities experience a shortfall or surplus on their youth care budget.
Er is niet precies bekend hoeveel gemeenten een tekort of een overschot ervaren op hun jeugdhulpbudget.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over misstanden in de Wmo

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health whether municipalities influence Wmo assessment doctors, whether citizens should have to litigate against municipalities, and whether the minister will investigate further and let care providers make eligibility decisions. The minister replies that the legal position of clients under the Wmo 2015 is adequately regulated, that no further investigation is planned, and that bezwaar and beroep remain available.
Based on the information currently available to me, I still have no reason to assume that municipalities are guilty of influencing assessment doctors more than occasionally.

Ik heb op basis van de mij thans ter beschikking staande informatie nog steeds geen aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat gemeenten zich meer dan mogelijk op incidentele basis schuldig maken aan de beïnvloeding van keuringsartsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Zorgondernemers kunnen keer op keer failliet gaan: geen haan die er naar kraait’

SP MPs asked the Minister of Health whether a care entrepreneur who repeatedly went bankrupt could simply found a new care company, and whether the Wtza and inspectorate powers are adequate to address this. The minister said the bankruptcy-related case is under investigation so he will not comment on it, that curators can pursue personal liability and director bans, and that the new notification obligation under the Wtza plus existing inspection and fraud-coordination tools provide sufficient instruments, while noting some enforcement gaps.
I therefore do not consider it appropriate at this stage to pass judgment on this individual case.
Ik vind het daarom niet gepast om in dit stadium uitspraak te doen over deze individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van  het lid Hijink over belangenverstrengeling in de zorg

An SP MP asked the Health Minister whether the ANBO director serving as president-commissaris of commercial care organisation Fundis creates conflicts of interest, and whether the minister supervises such side functions. The minister answered that boards and members of ANBO and Fundis must judge these roles, and that he does not supervise the side functions of interest-group leaders.
I do not supervise the executives of interest organisations and their side functions.
Ik houd geen toezicht op de bestuurders van belangenorganisaties en hun nevenfuncties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars voor miljoenen euro's beleggen in farmaceutische bedrijven

An MP asks the Minister for Medical Care whether health insurers' investments in pharmaceutical companies, and the buffer requirements behind them, are acceptable given their duty to keep care costs down. The Minister replies that insurers set their own investment policy under DNB supervision, that exposure is small, and that he will not force them to stop investing.
The investment policy of health insurers is up to them.
Het beleggingsbeleid van zorgverzekeraars is aan henzelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over bericht 'Medische gegevens in eigen beheer op je computer of telefoon: vanaf volgend jaar is het mogelijk'

An SP MP asked the health minister about a newspaper report on a patient-controlled electronic health record programme (MedMij) run by the Patient Federation, including its scope, funding, privacy safeguards, timing and the role of the Data Protection Authority. The minister answered that MedMij sets a certification framework for existing personal health environments rather than building a new one, that privacy and security rules apply, and that the Data Protection Authority supervises but is not formally involved in the pilot.
It is up to the AP itself to decide which initiatives it actively investigates.
Het is aan de AP zelf om te bepalen naar welke initiatieven zij actief een onderzoek instelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over kwaliteitsregistraties in de zorg

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about hospitals' complaints that quality registrations are too burdensome, including the NVZ's call for a systemic overhaul, the difficulty of cutting indicators, comparison with OECD countries and the cost per hospital of accreditation and registration. The minister said he is in talks with the NVZ and tripartite parties, will send a plan of action to the House before summer that aims to reduce burden and add patient-reported outcome data, and cited a reduction in preoperative radiotherapy as evidence of benefit.
As I have previously promised, I will send my plan of action to the House before the summer, in which I combine both elements.
Ik stuur – zoals ik eerder heb toegezegd – voor de zomer mijn plan van aanpak naar de Tweede Kamer, waarin ik deze beide elementen verenig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Hijink inzake de brandbrief van de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Logopedie en Foniatrie

MPs Kooiman and Hijink (SP) asked the Minister for Medical Care about the NVLF's warning letter that first-line speech therapy tariffs are about 25% below NZa-set levels, threatening access and the insurers' duty of care, and about bargaining power, tariffs and vacancies. The Minister answered that the NZa is investigating the tariff developments and results are expected in early 2019, that insurers must meet their duty of care under NZa supervision, and that he sees no need for separate intervention.
I do not intend to conduct additional research on top of the investigation the NZa has already started.
Ik ben niet voornemens aanvullend onderzoek te gaan op het onderzoek dat de NZa al is begonnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kooiman over het bericht 'Gemeente harkt te veel persoonsgegevens binnen' (Herdruk)

MPs Hijink and Kooiman asked the health minister about reports that municipalities collect too much personal data via self-reliance matrices, and whether privacy oversight and municipal guidance are adequate. The minister acknowledged limited violations in Nijmegen and Zaanstad, said the Dutch data protection authority is responsible for enforcement, and listed support measures for municipalities while declining to undertake new specific activities.
I do not intend to undertake specific activities aimed at ensuring that municipalities using self-reliance matrices handle them properly from a privacy law perspective.
Ik ben niet van plan om specifieke activiteiten te ondernemen die erop zijn gericht dat gemeenten die met zelfredzaamheidmatrices werken, daar vanuit het privacyrecht bezien goed mee omgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat experts stellen dat de aanpak van topsalarissen in zorg symboolpolitiek is

An SP MP asks whether the government's plan to extend the WNT pay cap to subcontractors in healthcare closes loopholes such as director-shareholders taking dividends from BV structures, and whether an anti-abuse clause should be added. The minister replies that dividends fall outside the WNT's employment-based pay norm and under separate WTZi rules enforced by the IGJ, that the Council of State advised against an anti-abuse clause, and that no clause is planned for now.
I see no reason to conduct further investigation myself.
Ik zie geen aanleiding zelf verder onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de wijkverpleegkundigen van Plicare verdwijnen

An SP MP asks the health minister about the closure of Plicare's neighbourhood nursing services in The Hague, including loss of care for vulnerable clients, the reasons for stopping, contacts with Plicare, prevention, and funding. The minister answers that clients will be transferred to other providers, that insurers no longer purchase neighbourhood care separately, that the government will not interfere in care procurement negotiations, and that data on insurer contracting is not available.
I do not have such data at my disposal.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke data.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Hijink over de brandbrief van de KNGF aan zorgverzekeraars

MPs Kooiman and Hijink (SP) asked the Minister for Medical Care about the KNGF's open letter to health insurers complaining of unequal power, stalled negotiations, unprofitable physiotherapy tariffs, rising non-contracted practice and administrative burden. The Minister answered that the Hoofdlijnenakkoord Paramedische Zorg is making progress, that tariffs are a matter for individual negotiations with the NZa planning a study, that the cabinet favours multi-year contracts and will report in April 2018, and that power balances vary by sector and are monitored by the NZa and ACM.
I am not aware of any recent NZa study on physiotherapy tariffs. As for the KPMG study, I do not have it at my disposal.
Mij is geen recent uitgevoerd onderzoek van de NZa naar tarieven binnen de fysiotherapie bekend. Wat betreft het KPMG-onderzoek; dit heb ik niet tot mijn beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat EU-landen elkaar niet voldoende waarschuwen voor omstreden artsen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care why EU states do not adequately warn each other about disciplined doctors, including a German dentist who practised in Nederland after restrictions elsewhere. The minister answered that no figures exist on how many such professionals work in the Netherlands, that Nederland takes over foreign restrictions in principle, and that refusing EU professionals for non-reporting would be unlawful, while promising to raise the warning mechanism with the European Commission.
No figures are available on the number of healthcare professionals from another Member State who received a restriction on their practice there and nonetheless went on to work in the Netherlands.

Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar van het aantal zorgverleners afkomstig uit een andere lidstaat die een bevoegdheidsbeperking in de lidstaat opgelegd hebben gekregen en desondanks in Nederland zijn gaan werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de belangen tussen zorgverzekeraars en kwaliteitsinstituten

An MP asked the health minister about the financial dependence of quality-registration bodies such as DICA on health insurers, the number and cost of accreditation institutes, and whether the registries are independent. The minister answered that DICA is independent with a board of professional associations, that insurers have no say over content, that costs fall under hospitals' own operations, and that no further investigation of other insurer-funded bodies is planned.
Health insurers have no governance involvement in quality registries such as DICA, nor any influence over the content of the registrations.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben geen bestuurlijke betrokkenheid bij kwaliteitsregistraties zoals DICA of invloed op de inhoud van de registraties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Leijten over het aandeel van banken in de financiering van de zorg

MPs Hijink and Leijten (SP) asked the Minister for Medical Care about banks' large lending to care institutions, whether premium funds pay bank interest, and whether banks pressure hospitals toward profitable specialisation. The minister answered that bank debt is normal for investment, the sector's solvency meets the norm, banks' scrutiny is legitimate, no evidence shows banks forcing specialisation, and the government will keep the current system.
It is not known what part of this amount was specifically spent on paying interest to banks on outstanding loans.
Het is niet bekend welk deel van dit bedrag specifiek is besteed aan het betalen van rentes aan banken over uitstaande leningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat een demente vrouw 250 euro moest betalen voor een consult waarbij zij niet betrokken is geweest

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about a report that a woman with dementia was billed 250 euros for a consultation between doctors she was not part of, and how such billing via the deductible is possible. The minister answered that the claim was unlawful, the hospital and insurer Menzis are reversing it, telephone consults between specialists are not a billable basis, and that complaints can go to the NZa, while not knowing how often such cases occur.
I think it is positive that the son in this case critically examined the bill his mother (the patient) received.
Ik vind het positief dat de zoon in deze casus kritisch keek naar de door zijn moeder (de patiënt) ontvangen rekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de resultaten van het kledingconvenant

An SP MP asked the minister about the first annual report of the Dutch garment and textile covenant, including worker benefits, due diligence self-evaluations, market share, government action, and comparisons with binding laws abroad. The minister answered that important steps were taken, that much remains to be done, that the government will monitor progress, and that the covenant policy will be evaluated before deciding on binding measures.
The cabinet has no precise information on that.
Het kabinet heeft daar geen precieze informatie over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de aanstaande sluiting van Siemens Hengelo

The SP MP Hijink asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate how effective his 'quiet diplomacy' is given the planned closure of Siemens Hengelo, why the plant closes despite orders, what public infrastructure investment was made and whether it can be recovered, and whether he will meet workers and inform parliament. The minister answered that talks with Siemens AG and local authorities continue, that the closure is a centralisation decision unrelated to order books, that investments were area-wide and not Siemens-specific, and that he sees no added value in meeting the union at this stage, without committing to new information beyond what he has.
I have little news to share with the union members at this moment and I think the conversation proposed by FNV Metaal therefore has no added value.
Ik heb de vakbondsleden op dit moment weinig nieuws te melden en vind dat het door FNV Metaal voorgestelde gesprek daarom geen toegevoegde waarde heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de eenzijdige opgelegde commissieverhoging door Thuisbezorgd.nl

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about Thuisbezorgd.nl's unilateral commission increase, its market share, and whether its parity clause and alleged abuse of market power should be banned or investigated by the ACM. The State Secretary answered that the commission is a private contractual matter, that the ACM found no reason for further action on the parity clause, that a ban is not warranted for now, and that platforms' abuse of power is for the ACM to judge case by case.
It is for the ACM, as the independent supervisor of the Competition Act, to judge whether in an individual case there is abuse of a dominant position or another infringement of the Competition Act.

Het is aan de ACM om als onafhankelijke toezichthouder op de Mededingingswet te oordelen of in een individuele casus sprake is van misbruik van een machtspositie of een andere overtreding van de Mededingingswet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat een keuringarts is gezwicht onder gemeentelijke druk

An SP MP asked the health minister whether a municipality (Lingewaard) pressured a medical assessor to alter a report to cut care costs, and whether this is common and should change. The minister said the matter is before the administrative and disciplinary courts, that pressure on assessors is not acceptable and cost should not drive decisions, but that no evidence suggests it is more than incidental, so no further investigation is needed.

It is for the administrative judge to assess whether the municipality's decision to refuse the requested tailored care was lawful, and for the disciplinary judge to determine whether the assessing doctor acted correctly.

Het is aan de bestuursrechter om te beoordelen of het door de gemeente genomen besluit tot afwijzing van de aangevraagde maatwerkvoorzieningen rechtmatig is en het is aan de tuchtrechter om vast te stellen of de keuringsarts juist heeft gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de overname van de margarinedivisie van Unilever door KKR

An SP MP asked the Economy minister whether the government would monitor the sale of Unilever's margarine division to KKR, its effects on jobs and R&D, whether KKR's expected strategy of milking the business is an activist-shareholder excess, how stakeholders were considered, and how debt loading would be prevented. The minister said the government is in ongoing talks with Unilever to keep activities and jobs in the Netherlands, respects corporate autonomy and declines to comment on KKR's decision, and pointed to existing and forthcoming interest-deduction limits in corporate tax law.
For substantial decisions the cabinet keeps a close eye on the situation and will also examine the consequences of any adjustment to the strategy.
Het kabinet houdt bij wezenlijke beslissingen de vinger aan de pols en zal daarbij ook bezien welke gevolgen de eventuele aanpassing van de strategie zal hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Nispen over het bericht dat bedrijven ongevraagd klantgegevens delen met Facebook

MPs Hijink and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a Consumentenbond report that companies share customer data with Facebook without consent, asking how many companies, sanctions imposed, and what steps will follow. The minister replied that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is independent and must assess lawfulness, that Facebook provided no figures, that customers can object or withdraw consent, and that no concrete new action is promised.
It is up to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens to assess whether Facebook Custom Audience targeting involves a legitimate interest on which the data processing can be based.
Het is aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens om te beoordelen of bij Facebook Custom Audience targeting sprake is van een gerechtvaardigd belang waarop de gegevensverwerking kan worden gebaseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kuik over het bericht dat Groninger winkeliers duizenden euro’s aan boetes krijgen

MPs Hijink and Kuik asked whether it is desirable that tenant and owner shopkeepers be forced to open on Sunday shopping days under penalty, and about the burden on small shopkeepers and staff. The State Secretary answered that contractual obligations are permissible but penalties should be a last resort, that the Arnhem-Leeuwarden court ruling clarifies limits on unilateral changes to opening hours, and that the courts, not the government, would judge whether a clause or penalty is unreasonable.
There are no figures on the number of cases in which a penalty is actually imposed.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over het aantal gevallen waarin daadwerkelijk een boete wordt opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat maatschappelijke organisaties zich terug trekken uit onderhandelingen over voedingsmiddelenconvenant

MP Hijink asked about NGOs withdrawing from negotiations on the food sector covenant, the choice of trade associations as signatories, transparency, and whether the covenant approach is succeeding. Minister Kaag answered that trade associations sign on behalf of members to bind the whole sector, that monitoring is ongoing, and that after two years it will be assessed whether binding measures are needed.
As stated in the coalition agreement, after two years it will be examined whether binding measures are necessary and, if so, which measures.
Zoals aangegeven in het regeerakkoord, zal na twee jaar worden bezien of het noodzakelijk is om dwingende maatregelen te nemen en zo ja, welke maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Hijink en Karabulut over het bericht ‘Corrupte constructies: Shell in het nauw’

SP MPs asked the minister about a Vrij Nederland report on Shell's purchase of Nigerian oil block OPL 245 via a corrupt intermediary, questioning Shell's conduct, the alternative payment structure, and calling for corporate human rights rules and prosecution. The minister declined substantive comment because the OM and FIOD are investigating, pointed to Dutch integrated anti-corruption policy and the existing binding anti-bribery law, and said prosecution decisions rest with investigators and the prosecutor.
While this investigation is ongoing, no substantive response will be given.
Lopende dit onderzoek zal niet inhoudelijk worden gereageerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Lacin over het bericht dat op station Amsterdam Centraal slimme reclameborden worden ingezet

MPs Hijink and Lacin asked about smart advertising boards at Amsterdam Centraal that reportedly track when and how long people look at them, including how many such boards exist, what data they collect, and whether companies and state holdings must obtain opt-in consent or seek advice from the Dutch data protection authority. The government answered that it cannot confirm whether personal data is processed, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (Dutch DPA) is looking into it and has jurisdiction, that the operator Exterion is itself responsible for legal compliance and has temporarily switched off the cameras, and that it sees no need to require DPA advice beyond what the law prescribes.
We do not know how many of the advertising boards referred to in the report are used by Exterion and other operators in the Netherlands, nor what data and techniques are used for this.

Het is ons niet bekend hoeveel van de in het bericht bedoelde type reclameborden worden gebruikt door Exterion en eventuele andere exploitanten in Nederland, noch welke data en technieken hiervoor worden gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat gemeenten doorgaan met het ontwikkelen van een BRP-systeem

An SP MP asked whether the VNG tried to obtain BRP source code, whether the ministry will withdraw from VNG's work on a municipal alternative, and whether the BRP code will be released under the GPL licence. The State Secretary replied that requests for the code were deferred pending checks, that no components were shared in advance, that the ministry keeps its commitments and provides no funding to VNG, and that the choice of licence is still under study, with GPL one option.
I have informed the VNG by letter about the commitments my predecessor made to the House of Representatives on this file and that I uphold these commitments.
Ik heb de VNG per brief geïnformeerd (zie bijlage) 2 over de toezeggingen die mijn voorganger op dit dossier aan de Tweede Kamer heeft gedaan en dat ik deze toezeggingen gestand houd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat graniet gedolven wordt door kinderhanden

An SP MP asked the minister about a report that granite sold in the Netherlands is quarried by children in India, including how many Dutch firms are involved, what sanctions a proposed child labour due diligence law would impose, and whether the granite sector covenant will include sanctions. The minister confirmed the report, said the government has no figures, raised the issue in EU-India human rights dialogue and with the ILO, said the covenant is still under negotiation, and described fines and prosecution under the proposed law.
The cabinet has no figures on the precise number of Dutch companies involved.
Over het precieze aantal Nederlandse bedrijven dat daarbij betrokken is, heeft het kabinet geen cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Jasper van Dijk over over het bericht dat zelfstandigen door gemeenten van schuldhulp worden uitgesloten

MPs Hijink and Van Dijk asked whether municipalities exclude self-employed people from debt relief and whether this forces them to stop their businesses. The State Secretary answered that such exclusion is not allowed, that individual assessment is required, that the Bbz scheme is an alternative for some, and that she will raise the issue with the VNG.
Municipalities may not apply exclusion grounds within debt relief.
Gemeenten mogen geen uitsluitinggronden in het kader van de schuldhulpverlening hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de recente ontwikkelingen rondom CETA

An SP MP asked the trade minister about Belgium's request for a Court of Justice opinion on the CETA investment court system, its effect on provisional application and ratification, Poland's objections, and fast-track ratification of EU trade deals. The minister answered that the investment court provisions are excluded from provisional application, that the Court request does not require other states' support, that Poland's stance does not directly affect provisional application, and that the government favours broad trade agreements while the EU-Singapore opinion shapes competence.
The cabinet is in favour of broad, deep, sustainable and inclusive trade agreements.
Het kabinet is voorstander van brede, diepgaande, duurzame en inclusieve handelsakkoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Hijink over het bericht dat Fox-IT zeggenschap van de staat afhoudt

MPs Van Raak and Hijink asked whether Fox-IT, now owned by UK-based NCC Group, has met its agreements on protecting state secrets and why it will not write the state's demands into its articles of association. The minister replied that additional conditions under the ABDO security framework are being negotiated constructively and are near completion, and that contractual security requirements and state supervision mitigate risks.
The discussions on this between Defence and Fox IT are proceeding constructively and are in a concluding phase.
De gesprekken hierover tussen Defensie en Fox IT verlopen constructief en bevinden zich in een afrondende fase.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over het bericht dat De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) het beheer van vertrouwelijke data wil uitbesteden

MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the Finance Minister about DNB's plan to outsource management of its confidential data, including accountability, scope, oversight and expertise. The minister answered that DNB remains ultimately responsible, state-secret data stays in-house, the outsourcing is subject to exit clauses and active steering, and the government is building ICT expertise.
DNB remains ultimately responsible for the data it has obtained in the performance of its duties.
DNB blijft uiteindelijk zelf verantwoordelijk voor de data die zij uit hoofde van haar taak heeft verkregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het betalen door data te delen en de verkoop van consumentendata aan bedrijven en de overheid

An SP MP asked the ministers whether consumers should be allowed to obtain products or services free or discounted in exchange for sharing personal and social media data, and whether consumers are adequately informed about data sold to companies or government, including smart appliances. The minister answered that consumers must receive clear, complete information, that personal data processing requires consent under the Wbp and upcoming AVG, that the AP and ACM supervise compliance, and that government access to such data would require a formal legal basis.

If the government wants insight into the same information about the living environment of the home, Article 10(1) of the Constitution requires a statutory provision granting the government such a power.

Wil de overheid inzicht in diezelfde informatie over de leefomgeving van de woning, dan dient krachtens artikel 10, eerste lid, van de Grondwet, een wettelijke bepaling te bestaan die de overheid een dergelijke bevoegdheid toekent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over het bericht “AFM waarschuwt voor cryptocurrencies als bitcoins en ethers”

Two Socialist Party MPs asked the Finance Minister about AFM warnings on cryptocurrencies, including bubble risks, investor information, regulation, money laundering and a possible DNB or virtual euro. The minister answered that the risks are largely borne by holders, that supervisors have warned consumers, that crypto assets fall outside financial supervision apart from anti-money-laundering rules, and that research is ongoing.
I will ask DNB to keep me informed about the development of a virtual euro and to inform the House when there are relevant developments.
Ik zal DNB vragen om mij op de hoogte te houden van de ontwikkeling van een virtuele euro en de Kamer informeren wanneer er relevante ontwikkelingen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over het opdrijven van prijzen van hotelkamers door boekingswebsites

MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the minister whether hotel-booking platforms' 'lowest price' clauses restrict hotels and whether they should be banned, along with commission rises, room vacancy effects and Booking.com's promotion of student room rentals. The minister rejected a ban, stating that platform contracts are private matters, that ACM has already loosened the clauses, and that rental of student rooms is restricted by contract and law rather than by Booking.com's campaign.
I am not aware of the content of such agreements, which are concluded between two private parties.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de inhoud van dergelijke overeenkomsten die tussen twee private partijen worden gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Raak over het bericht dat Google gebruikersgegevens in buitenlandse datacentra moet overhandigen aan de VS

Two SP MPs asked whether personal data held by UWV and other government bodies, including data stored abroad, can be guaranteed to stay out of reach of the US government after reports that Google must hand over user data. The government answered that it cannot give such a guarantee because legal bases such as mutual legal assistance treaties allow transfers to the US, and it does not plan extra measures against foreign storage beyond case-by-case risk assessment.
No, I cannot give that guarantee.
Nee, die garantie kan ik niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Hijink over het optreden van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM)

MPs Van Dijk and Hijink asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the Consumer and Markets Authority (ACM) rarely acts against deception and fraud by firms, including a stalled enforcement request and a debt collector under scrutiny for four years, and whether the ACM should be given more teeth or replaced by a separate consumer authority. The minister answered that the ACM has adequate instruments and fines, that enforcement choices are its own, that the handling of one enforcement request was flawed, and that no new proposals or a separate authority are planned.
I cannot give any information about possible investigations concerning a specific company.
Over mogelijke onderzoeken betreffende een specifiek bedrijf kan ik geen mededeling doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Hijink over het gebruik van spyware in China

MPs Karabulut and Hijink asked whether China forces residents of Xinjiang to install surveillance spyware under threat of prosecution, and whether the government finds this unacceptable and will raise it with Chinese authorities. The Minister confirms reports of the mandatory app, calls the privacy intrusion serious, and says the government will raise it in the next bilateral human rights dialogue with China.
The use of the app to gain access to devices and the obligation imposed by the Chinese government to install it constitute a serious infringement of the privacy of the citizens concerned.
De inzet van de app om toegang te krijgen tot apparaten en de verplichting tot het installeren ervan door de Chinese overheid maakt ernstige inbreuk op de privacy van de betrokken burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Hijink, Ouwehand en Van Raan over het steunen van de fossiele sector dmv exportkredietverzekeringen

MPs from the SP and PvdD asked whether Dutch export credit insurance (ekv) substantially supports the fossil fuel sector, including the reported €7.3 billion Atradius DSB exposure, and whether it should be tightened to align with Paris goals. The State Secretary answered that the ekv is generic and demand-driven with no fossil-specific policy, that it is cost-covering, that about 39% of the portfolio (€6.4 billion) is fossil-related, that oil and gas transactions undergo environmental and social due diligence, and that he will not explicitly phase out support for non-Paris-aligned projects while promoting renewable and climate-related export cover.
There is no policy to support the fossil fuel sector in particular.
Er is geen beleid om de fossiele sector in het bijzonder te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Raak over de aanbesteding van mobiele telefonie

MPs Hijink and Van Raak asked how government data, including phone traffic of civil servants, is stored and protected against foreign access such as under the USA Freedom Act, and what contract conditions apply to the new mobile telephony tender. The minister answered that data location is assessed per case, that EEA-only processing, notification duties and termination rights were included in the new contract, and that the Vodafone-Ziggo joint venture did not trigger termination.
To prevent data being processed or shared by the contractor in breach of Dutch law, requirements have been included in the contract.
Om te voorkomen dat in strijd met Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving gegevens door de opdrachtnemer worden verwerkt of gedeeld, zijn eisen in het contract opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over de slechte aanpak van faillissementsfraude

MPs Van Nispen and Hijink asked the Justice and Finance ministers why so few criminal reports are drawn up for simple bankruptcy fraud, and how enforcement, capacity, cooperation and registry powers could be improved. The Minister denies police neglect, cites the fraud monitor figures, defends the existing measures and cooperation, and promises further information on a study of guarantee schemes for curators.
I do not recognise the picture that the police give too little priority.
Ik herken het beeld, dat de politie te weinig prioriteit geeft, niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Raak over het bericht dat Google gebruikersgegevens in buitenlandse datacentra moet overhandigen aan de VS

Two SP MPs asked the government about reports that Google must hand over user data stored in foreign data centres to the US, and whether Dutch government data and citizens are protected from foreign surveillance. The Minister of the Interior answered that location decisions are left to each responsible body within existing rules, that full protection and an overview of data locations cannot be guaranteed, and that US court ruling and Judicial Redress Act issues apply only in limited ways.

It is not appropriate for the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to have an up-to-date overview of where the data of all ministries, provinces, municipalities and semi-public institutions are stored.

Het is niet aan de orde dat de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties moet beschikken over een actueel overzicht van de locatie waar de data van alle ministeries, provincies, gemeenten en de semipublieke instellingen zijn opgeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Leijten over het bericht “TiSA and the threat to public banks”

Two SP MPs asked the trade and finance ministers about a report claiming the TiSA services agreement threatens public banks and government regulatory room. The minister rejects this, arguing TiSA contains prudential and public-service carve-outs and leaves governments free to regulate.
The cabinet does not share the thrust of the publication.
Het kabinet deelt de strekking van de publicatie niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de overname van uitvaartorganisatie De Facultatieve

An SP MP asked the Economics and Finance Ministers about the acquisition of funeral organisation De Facultatieve, including share rules, valuation, the shared accountant, and member involvement. The government declined to judge the private transaction, pointed to the civil code, accountant independence rules and public company records, and noted Hermans' Senate side-functions.
The cabinet has no involvement in the ownership and business transactions of individual private enterprises and organisations.
Het kabinet heeft geen bemoeienis met het eigenaarschap en de zakelijke transacties van afzonderlijke private ondernemingen en organisaties
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat volgens de rechter een datavrije muziekbundel niet in strijd is met netneutraliteit

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a court ruling that T-Mobile's data-free music bundle does not violate net neutrality, and about the consequences for Dutch law. The minister answered that the ruling makes the categorical ban on zero-rating in the Telecommunications Act unenforceable, that the ACM will not appeal, and that the ban will likely be removed, while the ACM investigates whether T-Mobile's specific offer breaches the EU regulation.
Since the ACM is not appealing, it makes sense to remove the categorical ban on price discrimination from the Telecommunications Act.
Nu de ACM niet in hoger beroep gaat, ligt het in de rede om het categorische verbod op prijsdiscriminatie in de Telecommunicatiewet te schrappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over ‘de ongekend hoge winstuitkeringen van bedrijven’

SP MPs asked the Finance Minister about record corporate dividend payouts, takeover fears, whether the strategic-takeover screening law should be widened, employee involvement in takeovers, ECB bond purchases and investment. The government answered that dividend decisions rest with companies, outlined existing takeover and works-council rules, proposed a telecom-focused control bill under consultation, and deferred tax and public-investment choices to a future cabinet.
The Minister of Finance meant by extending the law the bill on preventing undesirable control in telecommunications that the Minister of Economic Affairs put into consultation in February 2017.

De Minister van Financiën doelde met uitbreiding van de wet op het wetsvoorstel voorkoming ongewenste zeggenschap telecommunicatie dat de Minister van Economische Zaken in februari 2017 in consultatie heeft gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de verkoop van een bedrijfstak door Unilever

An SP MP asked ministers whether the government would respond to Unilever's plan to sell its margarine division, its effect on jobs and R&D, subsidies received, and whether a takeover cooling-off period proposed by Hommen should be supported. The minister said the government is talking with Unilever to keep the activities in the Netherlands, respects the company's own commercial decisions, explained the existing takeover rules supervised by the AFM, and said subsidy recovery is not possible because no traceable commitments were made.
The cabinet is in talks with Unilever to keep the company and its activities in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet is in gesprek met Unilever om het bedrijf en zijn activiteiten voor Nederland te behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Kent over de dreigende overname van AkzoNobel door PPG Industries

MPs Hijink and Van Kent asked whether activist investor Elliott's demand that the AkzoNobel supervisory board chair resign, and reported sharing of price-sensitive information with PPG, is realistic as serving the company's continuity and how the government views this conduct. The minister answered that the matter falls under the Dutch corporate law framework (shareholder meetings, 10% and 3% thresholds, Code response times), declined to confirm the information-sharing allegation because the AFM is responsible and bound by confidentiality, and stated that shareholders may pursue their interests within bounds of reasonableness, with greater responsibility for larger stakes.
Because of the confidentiality obligation resting on the AFM, no statements can be made about this.
Vanwege de op de AFM rustende geheimhoudingsplicht kunnen hierover geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Kent over de dreigende overname van AkzoNobel door PPG Industries

MPs Hijink and Van Kent asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about a possible hostile takeover of AkzoNobel by PPG, the role of the AkzoNobel foundation, competition and job effects, works council protections, and whether the Wet ongewenste zeggenschap telecommunicatie could protect firms of national importance. The minister answered that boards must weigh stakeholder interests, that the priority-share foundation can appoint management in a hostile bid, that competition authorities would review any merger, and that the telecom bill covers only national security and public order, not jobs or headquarters.
