It is not possible to state the consequences of a possible split for employment; this depends heavily on what the parties involved agree.
Het is niet mogelijk om de gevolgen van een eventuele splitsing op de werkgelegenheid te geven, dit is sterk afhankelijk van wat de betrokken partijen afspreken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Laçin over de ICT-storing in het systeem van Amadeus waardoor overal ter wereld reserveringssystemen voor de luchtvaart uitvielen

MPs Hijink and Laçin asked about a worldwide Amadeus reservation system outage, its cause, possible data exposure, economic damage and cybersecurity safeguards. The government answered that a local hardware fault, not a hack, caused a brief outage with no data loss, and pointed to contractual arrangements and the forthcoming NIS directive implementation.
Resolving outages is of course the responsibility of the owner of the systems concerned, such as Amadeus.
Het verhelpen van storingen is uiteraard de verantwoordelijkheid van de eigenaar van desbetreffende systemen, zoals Amadeus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over stijgende winsten en haperende investeringen

Opposition MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers why profits are rising while business investment lags, and whether corporate tax cuts would spur investment. The government answered that lower interest rates and cyclical factors explain tax revenue, that investment levels are not structurally low, and that investment decisions are primarily for firms, leaving further measures to a future cabinet.
It is up to a future cabinet to decide on any measures to further promote business investment.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om te besluiten over eventuele maatregelen om investeringen door het bedrijfsleven verder te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de digitale veiligheid van bedrijven

MP Hijink (SP) asked the ministers whether companies are doing enough on digital security, what powers exist to enforce cybersecurity duties of care and whether self-regulation suffices. The government answers that it will actively promote the Cyber Security Raad handreiking, that enforcement is split between the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, civil courts and the ACM, that no data exist on negligent firms, and that stimulating duties of care is judged more effective than strict enforcement.
There is no insight into the number of companies that knowingly ignore their cybersecurity responsibilities or use exemption clauses.
Er bestaat geen inzicht in het aantal bedrijven dat hun verantwoordelijkheid voor wat betreft cybersecurity bewust negeert of ontsnappingsclausules hanteert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Karabulut over de aandacht die corruptie krijgt in de convenantenaanpak

MPs Hijink and Karabulut asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a reported Shell bribery case in Nigeria, the handling of corruption in the convenant approach, aid and trade policy, and Dutch government support to Shell. The minister declined to comment on the ongoing investigation, described existing anti-corruption policy, OECD guidelines and aid programmes, and said the energy sector convenant had not yet started.
While the Public Prosecution Service investigation is ongoing, no substantive response can be given.
Lopende het onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie kan niet inhoudelijk worden gereageerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de verkoop van browsergegevens

An SP MP asked ministers whether the US Congress's repeal of FCC broadband privacy rules, allowing internet providers to sell browsing data without consent, affects Dutch and European users, and what the EU framework (GDPR, ePrivacy) and EU action can do to prevent resale of European browsing data. The minister declined to judge the US decision, said the effects on Europeans are hard to predict, pointed to EU rules (GDPR from May 2018, ePrivacy under revision) as adequate safeguards, and said the Commission, not ministers, initiates legislation and a similar EU proposal is unlikely.
It is up to the European Commission and not to ministers to draft and submit proposals to amend the regulations.
Het is aan de Europese Commissie en niet aan ministers om voorstellen voor wijziging van de regelgeving op te stellen en in te dienen.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Geurts ter vervanging van nr. 11 over dat tijdelijke verhuur mogelijk blijft voor aangewezen categorieën personen
Allows temporary leases without rent protection for designated groups and makes the general administrative order on these categories subject to a heavy pre-consultation procedure in both Houses.
The draft general administrative order to be adopted under paragraph 2 is submitted to both Houses of the States General.
Het ontwerp van een krachtens lid 2 vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt aan beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal overgelegd.

Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Geurts en Peter de Groot ter vervanging van nr. 21 over de uitbreiding van de diplomatenclausule voor de mogelijkheid om een woning door een bloed- of aanverwant te l
Extends the diplomatenclausule so private landlords of a single home can end a fixed-term lease for a child or parent, with court review and damages if the intent was false.
It is for the court to test this.
Het is aan de rechter om dit te toetsen.
Amendement van de leden Peter de Groot en Geurts over de uitbreiding van de diplomatenclausule voor de mogelijkheid tot verkoop
Extends the diplomat clause so natural-person landlords with at most one rented home can end a fixed-term lease when they intend to sell, with damages if intent was false.
With this amendment the so-called diplomat clause is extended.
Met dit amendement wordt de zogenoemde «diplomatenclausule» uitgebreid.
Amendement van de leden Geurts en Peter de Groot over de uitbreiding van de diplomatenclausule voor de mogelijkheid om een woning door een bloed- of aanverwant te laten betrekken
Extends the diplomatenclausule so a private individual landlord may terminate a lease to house a child or in-law, enforced through court proceedings with a damages rule.
With this amendment the so-called diplomatenclausule is extended.
Met dit amendement wordt de zogenoemde «diplomatenclausule» uitgebreid
Amendement van het lid Geurts over dat tijdelijke verhuur mogelijk blijft voor aangewezen categorieën personen
Keeps open temporary rental without the usual tenancy protection for designated categories of tenants and extends this option to private landlords, amending the Civil Code and related laws.
temporary letting without rental protection, as in article 22a RTIV, remains possible for categories of persons already designated for housing associations
tijdelijke verhuur zonder huurbescherming zoals opgenomen in artikel 22a RTIV mogelijk blijft voor de reeds nu voor toegelaten instellingen aangewezen categorieën personen
Amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. over een evaluatie binnen twee jaar
Requires the minister to send Parliament a report within two years of the law taking effect on its effectiveness and effects, especially rent affordability and housing corporations' finances.
Our Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning sends the States General a report within two years of this law taking effect
Onze Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening zendt binnen twee jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag
Amendement van het lid Geurts over woningcorporaties buiten de reikwijdte doen vallen
Deletes article 20 so housing corporations fall outside the Good Landlordship Act, since they are already supervised by the Autoriteit Woningcorporaties.
The submitter believes the corporations should fall outside the scope of the Good Landlordship Act because housing corporations are already supervised by the Autoriteit Woningcorporaties

MPs from VVD and CDA asked the minister why energy-efficiency upgrades in shared-ownership apartment buildings stall when homeowners' associations (VvE) do not approve them, and what could be done. The minister answered all eleven questions, citing a VvE acceleration agenda with lower decision thresholds, support tools, subsidies, and possible future legislation, while rejecting a rule giving VvEs unconditional competence over sustainability.
I do not intend to prepare legislation to that effect.
Ik ben niet voornemens wetgeving met die strekking te gaan voorbereiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Geurts over het bericht 'Nederlands beste boerengrond – in Flevoland – maakt plaats voor woningen en natuur: ‘Maar bos kweken werkt hier niet’'

MPs Boswijk and Geurts asked about a newspaper report that the most fertile farmland in Flevoland is being converted to housing and nature, and about how such land is protected. The government replied that a 'right function in the right place' principle applies, that a framework for land-use changes on farmland is being developed within the National Programme Rural Area, and that provinces and municipalities hold the decisive powers.
The national government has a broad coordinating role to ensure all spatial tasks find a place and to prevent agriculture from being the last resort in the spatial debate.
Het Rijk heeft een brede regiefunctie om ervoor te zorgen dat alle ruimtelijke opgaven een plek krijgen en om te voorkomen dat landbouw het sluitstuk is in de discussie rondom ruimte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht 'Deskundige wil extra controles van oude tunnels na problemen in Friesland'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how Rijkswaterstaat will inspect old immersed tunnels after the Prinses Margriet tunnel incident in Friesland, including timelines, the scope of invasive inspection, and interim measures such as sensors. The minister replied that the cause is still under investigation, so no timeline, scope or structural measures can yet be committed to, though sensor options are being explored.
Once more is known about this, Rijkswaterstaat can determine whether and how tunnel approaches can be monitored.
Zodra hier meer bekend over is, kan Rijkswaterstaat bepalen of en hoe tunneltoeritten gemonitord kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht dat nieuwe daglichteisen de bouw onbetaalbaar maken

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about reports that new daylight requirements based on NEN-EN 17037 make construction unaffordable, questioning the method's cost, complexity and conflict with building-regulation principles. The minister answered that the change is not yet in force, that cost studies show no added cost, that the method will be simplified through fixed parameters in the Omgevingsregeling, and that enforcement concerns do not arise.
These requirements have not yet entered into force. The moment of entry into force is still to be determined by me.
Deze eisen zijn nog niet werking getreden. Het moment van inwerkingtreding wordt door mij nog nader bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner, Van der Molen en Geurts over het bericht ‘Kritiek op (on)toegankelijkheid Langeveldgebouw voor mensen met functiebeperking’

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers about reports that the Erasmus University Langeveld building is inaccessible for people with various disabilities, and about the diversity of accessibility standards. The minister acknowledged the problem, noted the university chose the stricter NEN-ISO 21542 standard, said formal inspection is due early next year, and described a forthcoming national NEN accessibility norm expected end 2023.
I have given NEN the assignment to do so.
Ik heb daartoe opdracht gegeven aan NEN.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van der Molen over het bericht dat het leegstaande Leeuwarder belastingkantoor alleen kan worden ontwikkeld met steun van het Rijk

CDA MPs asked the housing minister about the vacant former Tax Office building in Leeuwarden, owned by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, and what obstacles block its reuse and whether the agency will speed up a concrete plan. The minister answered that technical and heritage obstacles affect feasibility, that the municipality and agency aim for a reuse approach by Q1 2023, and that the agency is accelerating temporary reuse of vacant buildings for asylum and status-holder housing.
The aim is for an approach to the reuse to be ready in the first quarter of 2023, based on a joint feasibility study.
Inzet is in het eerste kwartaal van 2023, op basis van een gezamenlijk haalbaarheidsonderzoek een aanpak voor de herbestemming gereed te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van der Molen en Geurts over het bericht 'Nieuwe dreun voor boeren: burgers die last hebben van stank hebben recht op schadevergoeding'

CDA MPs asked ministers about a Hague court ruling holding the State liable to residents exposed to excessive odour from livestock farms, and its effects on farms, permits, and costs. The government replied that the ruling is still being studied, promised a letter before the 10 November debate, and gave no cost estimate.
At this moment the ruling is being studied.
Op dit moment wordt de uitspraak bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de berichtgeving dat de woningbouw in gevaar komt door te weinig grind en zand

An MP asked whether a sand and gravel shortage threatens housing construction because permits are not renewed or granted, and about national oversight of extraction permits. The minister acknowledged the importance of raw materials, said a national monitoring system is being set up, and noted that national steering was abandoned in 2003 and the role lies with provinces and the market.
To regain a national overview, a new national monitoring system is currently being developed.
Om het landelijk overzicht opnieuw te verkrijgen wordt momenteel gewerkt aan het opzetten van een nieuw landelijk monitoringssysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Geurts over het bericht 'Hallo, wij hebben 125 mille studieschuld, hoeveel hypotheek krijgen we?'

Two CDA MPs asked whether student debt under the loan system, which reduces mortgage capacity, is fair, whether students were aware it counts, and whether municipalities could guarantee student loans. The minister acknowledged students were not always aware, defended including student debt under the consumer-protection rules, said guarantees add little, and saw no clear state role.
I find it important that the student debt is still taken into account.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de studieschuld wel wordt meegenomen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Geurts over het artikel 'Huisarts mist ruimte voor uitbreiding'

CDA MPs asked the Ministers of Health and of Housing about the LHV survey showing generalpractice premises shortages, whether municipalities share responsibility, and related questions on costs, inventories and acute care notification rules. The Minister acknowledged the problem, said municipalities share responsibility for adequate premises through land-use planning, declined a separate regional inventory, and pointed to digitalisation and coalition measures.
I will therefore not carry out an additional inventory.
Ik zal daarom geen aanvullende inventarisatie uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Geurts over de export van vervuilende brandstoffen naar Afrika

CDA MPs asked the state secretary about the export of high-sulphur, polluting fuels from the Netherlands to West Africa, the ILT's voluntary talks with refineries, whether the approach reduces emissions, and the legal basis for enforcement. The government answered that the ILT is enforcing the environmental duty of care on Dutch fuel exporters, pursuing international fuel standards via UNEP and ECOWAS, and considering regulatory changes, while rejecting a separate external study.
The ILT is authorised under article 18.2b of the Environmental Management Act and holds these companies to their statutory duty of care.
De ILT is hiertoe bevoegd op basis van artikel 18.2b uit de Wet milieubeheer en spreekt deze bedrijven aan op het naleven van hun wettelijke zorgplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over ‘de beruchte bocht bij de afrit A1 richting snelweg A30 bij Barneveld’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the causes of frequent accidents at a sharp bend near Barneveld, what measures have been taken or considered, and the timeline for reconstruction. The minister reported accident patterns, existing signage measures, a voorkeursalternatief already adopted, and that further willingness to talk with stakeholders exists while large-scale measures are not planned pending reconstruction.
There are no measuring loops in the bend in question. The speed at which accidents occurred therefore cannot be stated exactly.
In de bewuste bocht liggen geen meetlussen. De snelheid waarbij ongelukken plaatsvonden kan daarom niet exact worden aangegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de gevolgen van de Hoge Raad uitspraak “overheid moet gelijke kansen bieden bij uitgifte grond”

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Housing about the consequences of a Supreme Court ruling requiring fair selection when municipalities sell land, and about guidance for municipalities and the housing targets. The Minister answered that the ruling may cause delays, that a transparent selection procedure with objective criteria is now required unless there is only one serious bidder, that legal advice and a factsheet were issued, and that the Reiswijzer Gebiedsontwikkeling will be revised with VNG and Neprom.

The Supreme Court ruling of 26 November 2021 may lead to delays in housing plans where the government supplies the land and no selection procedure meeting the ruling's requirements has been conducted.

Het arrest van de Hoge Raad van 26 november 2021 zal bij woningbouwplannen waar de overheid de grond levert en er geen selectieprocedure is gevoerd die voldoet aan de eisen die het arrest stelt, tot vertraging kunnen leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de vuurtoren 'Lange Jaap' in Den Helder die dreigt in te storten

MP Geurts (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Lange Jaap lighthouse in Den Helder, which risks collapse, and the causes, repair plans, maintenance history, inspections and why earlier consultant advice was not followed. The minister replied that corrosion caused the cracks, that most repair scenarios are infeasible, that short-term shoring is the priority, and that an external review of the process over past years, including the failure to act on earlier advice, will be commissioned and reported to parliament.

To clarify these gaps, identify possible external signals and draw lessons from what happened, I have asked the Secretary-General of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management to commission an external investigation of the process followed in recent years.

Om deze hiaten op te helderen, mogelijke externe signalen te achterhalen en om lessen te trekken uit de gang van zaken, heb ik de Secretaris-Generaal van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat gevraagd om een extern onderzoek uit te laten voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Geurts over collectieve warmtesystemen in de gebouwde omgeving

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary about heat networks: the forfaitair efficiency assumption in energy labels, the supply temperature for district heating, the size of heat districts, and local government capacity to set them. The State Secretary defended the forfaitair method and the energy label design, argued that the draft law's criteria protect optimisation and innovation, noted the Expertise Centrum Warmte and ongoing talks with VNG and IPO for support, and rejected the suggested conflict of interests.
Municipalities have by far the most knowledge of the specific characteristics of the local situation.
Gemeenten hebben bij uitstek kennis van de specifieke kenmerken van de lokale situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht dat de waanzin op de woningmarkt overslaat op de huursector

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of the Interior whether bidding above the asking price for rental homes is becoming common and whether rules or measures should curb it. The Minister said no figures are available, that the government has no role in agreed rents, and that she is working on rent-regulation trials and increasing supply rather than banning bidding, which falls outside the Good Landlordship bill.
A possible ban on renting out by bidding falls outside the scope of the Good Landlordship bill.
Een mogelijk verbod op verhuren per opbod valt buiten de reikwijdte van het wetsvoorstel goed verhuurderschap.
Antwoord op vragen de vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Geurts over de export van giftige benzine

MPs Amhaouch and Geurts asked the government about the export of polluting, carcinogenic petrol from the Netherlands to poorer countries, including whether companies could be stopped and which countries received it. The State Secretary answered that the ILT has told companies the exports breach the Environmental Management Act, demanded measures by 1 September with a penalty order possible, named West African destination countries where traceable, and described diplomatic and UNEP efforts on fuel standards.
Companies were asked by the ILT to state by 1 September at the latest which measures they have taken and/or will take to fulfil their duty of care.
Bedrijven zijn door de ILT verzocht om uiterlijk per 1 september aan te geven welke maatregelen zij hebben genomen en/of zullen nemen om invulling te geven aan hun zorgplicht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Geurts over het NOS bericht ‘Intern onderzoek Rijkswaterstaat: files sluiting Haringvlietbrug veel langer dan gedacht’ en de bijbehorende kamerbrieven ‘Extra reistijd Har

MPs De Groot and Geurts asked why the Haringvlietbrug closure causes longer delays than expected, what measures will reduce them, and why the two-lane variant and the bridge repair are not faster. The minister explains that the delay estimate was revised upward, that traffic management and enforcement were arranged quickly, and that the bridge replacement is already accelerated, while acknowledging no quick fix for the clamps exists yet.
Rijkswaterstaat aims to involve the region and stakeholders in a timely manner, depending on the nature of the works, the nuisance and urgency.
Rijkswaterstaat zet erop in om de regio en belanghebbenden al naar gelang de aard van de werkzaamheden, de hinder en urgentie steeds en tijdig te betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Bontenbal over mogelijke extra kosten bij snelladers voor automobilisten

MPs Geurts and Bontenbal asked whether drivers at DC fast chargers receive less energy than they pay for, and whether a legal framework is needed for metering. The State Secretary replied that energy loss is priced in, consumer rules already apply, and she will push for harmonised EU metrology rules and consider national rules once international standards exist.
I suggest the next cabinet consider, once there is international agreement on the requirements, whether it is possible and desirable to anchor them in national regulation in advance.

Ik geef het volgende kabinet in overweging om, zodra er internationale overeenstemming is over de te stellen eisen, te bezien of het mogelijk en wenselijk is deze alvast in nationale regelgeving te verankeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Geurts over de mentale gezondheid van agrarische ondernemers

MPs Boswijk and Geurts asked the Minister of Agriculture about rising suicide rates among farmers and the gap between farmers and regular mental health care, and what more should be done. The Minister acknowledged the problem, described subsidised projects and sector initiatives to bridge the gap, said a structural follow-up approach and a central referral desk were being prepared, and promised to inform the House once the approach is set.
Once the structural follow-up approach is known and established, I will inform the House of Representatives.
Zodra de structurele vervolgaanpak bekend is en vastgesteld, zal ik de Tweede Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het alarm rond het beheer en onderhoud van wegen

Deputy Geurts (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about alarm reports that funding for road and waterway maintenance had run out, putting jobs at risk, and about deferred maintenance on bridges and provincial and municipal budget cuts. The minister denied that funds for new orders had run out or that work had been stopped, said maintenance budgets for 2021 to 2023 are higher, acknowledged a growing maintenance backlog with budget moved forward, and left municipal and provincial decisions to those authorities.
No, the money for new orders has not run out.
Nee, het geld voor nieuwe opdrachten is niet op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Varen door de Bruse sluizen vraagt planning: al vijf maanden beperkingen door kapotte brug’

MPs Geurts and Van den Berg asked the minister about the months-long closure of the Grevelingen bascule bridge near Bruinisse, its causes, traffic delays, maintenance backlog and the reopening date. The minister answered in detail, confirming the bridge reopened on 13 May 2021, explaining that technical control-system faults caused the delay and that the budget came from existing maintenance funds.
During testing in 2020 we established that faults could occur simultaneously in two components that act as each other's back-up.
Bij testen in 2020 hebben we vastgesteld dat het mogelijk is dat er tegelijk storingen kunnen optreden in twee onderdelen die als elkaars «back up» functioneren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over achterstallig onderhoud aan sluizen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Sint-Andries lock being out of service, its deferred maintenance, and whether preventive inspections are needed. The minister confirmed the closure and component replacement, acknowledged elevated risk of future unplanned closures, and agreed preventive maintenance is necessary, while not committing to specific new measures.
Wear of (parts of) the lock has progressed faster in recent years than expected, creating a real risk that components of the Sint-Andries lock will break down.
Slijtage van (onderdelen van) de sluis is de afgelopen jaren sneller gegaan dan verwacht en hierdoor ontstaat er een reëel risico op het defect raken van onderdelen van de sluis St. Andries.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Geurts over natuur die zich goed ontwikkelt ondanks stikstofdepositie en de definitie van het begrip project bij vergunningsverzoeken

Two CDA MPs asked whether hydrological restoration at Korenburgerveen means nitrogen effects are being offset, and how the legal concept of 'project' under nature permits should be defined and applied. The Minister acknowledged partial improvement from water-management measures but said nitrogen effects remain, that projects must be assessed on significant effects for Natura 2000 areas, and that permits must cover all inseparable parts of an activity.
No, the answer to question 6 shows that the delimitation depends on whether the activity in question may have significant effects on a Natura 2000 area.
Nee, uit het antwoord op vraag 6 blijkt dat de afbakening afhangt van de vraag of de betrokken activiteit significante gevolgen kan hebben voor een Natura 2000-gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de rechterlijke uitspraak over het verlenen van een Wnb vergunning ten behoeve van het wijzigen van een melkveehouderij

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a court ruling that found the emission factors in the Rav insufficiently substantiated for a Wnb permit to convert a dairy farm, and about the consequences for nitrogen calculations. The Minister answers that the ruling concerned the certainty required for Natura 2000 assessment rather than the Rav factors in general, that an appeal is being prepared, that no immediate changes to the nitrogen approach are foreseen, and that a CBS/CDM study on practical use of techniques will be available in late 2021.
I therefore do not recognise the claim that the emission factors in the Rav are insufficiently scientifically substantiated.
Ik herken mij derhalve niet in de stelling dat de emissiefactoren in de Regeling ammoniak en veehouderij (Rav) niet voldoende wetenschappelijk onderbouwd zouden zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Gijs van Dijk over het krantenbericht van het Eindhovens Dagblad dat een aquaduct bij Oirschot ruim 100 miljoen euro goedkoper is dan Rijkswaterstaat eerder voorrekende

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a report by IPV Delft, commissioned by the municipality of Oirschot, claiming an aqueduct alternative to the A58 viaduct would cost about 100 million euros less than Rijkswaterstaat estimated. The minister answered that the compared figures were wrong, explained the differing assumptions on engineering costs, risk reserves and VAT, and declined to reopen the decision or enter new talks.
No new facts have come to light in the studies that give me reason to enter into discussion with the regional administrators about this or to reconsider my earlier decision.

Er zijn uit de onderzoeken geen nieuwe feiten op tafel gekomen die voor mij aanleiding zijn om hierover het gesprek met de regionale bestuurders aan te gaan en tot heroverweging van mijn eerdere besluit te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht over de ‘coronaboete’ die leveranciers van de Albert Heijn boven het hoofd dreigt te hangen

An MP asked the agriculture minister about reports that Albert Heijn threatens suppliers with penalties of up to 80% of order value when COVID prevents full delivery, and whether this falls under the unfair trading practices law. The minister said Albert Heijn reports imposing no such fines, called the practice morally unacceptable, and stated that the new law (planned in force 1 November 2021) will be enforced by the ACM with a dispute committee, while declining to judge the individual case.
As Minister, it is not for me to assess an individual case in light of the Unfair Trading Practices Act for the agricultural and food supply chain.
Het is als Minister niet aan mij om een individuele casus te beoordelen in het licht van de Wet oneerlijke handelspraktijken landbouw- en voedselvoorzieningsketen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht ‘Premie verzekering omhoog door drempeltjes’

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Agriculture whether mandatory drempels (small dams) in ridge cultivation on clay soils will cause more water damage, raise weather insurance premiums, and whether the measure will be reconsidered. The Minister replies that the drempelplicht has not entered into force after a parliamentary majority asked for its removal, that extreme-weather exceptions were foreseen, and that she sees no basis for compensation but will not proceed with the measure.
On 3 February I informed your House that I am heeding the request of a majority of your House to scrap this measure, by not letting it enter into force.
Op 3 februari jl. heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd dat ik gehoor geef aan het verzoek van een meerderheid van uw Kamer om deze maatregel te schrappen, door deze niet in werking te laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht 'Zoekgebieden, phishing en AERIUS' van de heer Hanekamp

An MP asked the minister about a blog critiquing the AERIUS nitrogen calculator, search areas and the buyout calculator's 'maatgevende hexagonen', and the lack of cost-benefit analysis. The minister rejected the criticisms, explained that search areas and key hexagons are methodological tools, and pointed to ongoing research, transparency measures and planned work on reducing the calculation precision.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht 'Vergunningverlening ligt opnieuw stil'

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a Council of State ruling that intern salderen (netting within a farm) requires no permit, and whether future AERIUS model updates could make currently permit-free farm developments subject to permits, creating uncertainty for farmers. The Minister acknowledges the uncertainty, explains that AERIUS updates change calculation results, says that permits can no longer be granted for intern salderen and that provinces are mapping consequences, and promises to inform parliament before summer.
I can imagine that the ruling leads to uncertainty. Together with the provinces, I am mapping the scope and consequences for nitrogen policy of the ruling.
Ik kan mij voorstellen dat de uitspraak tot onzekerheid leidt. Samen met provincies breng ik de scope en consequenties voor het stikstofbeleid van de uitspraak in kaart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Geurts over de berichten 'Polders tijdelijk onder water om Zeeland veilig te houden' en 'Ontpolderen is niet dé oplossing'

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports proposing temporarily flooding polders in Zeeland to protect the region, including who funded the NIOZ study, farmland loss, compensation for farmers, and whether the government will implement the plan. The minister replied that the concept was commissioned and financed by WNF, that it is only one option to be explored within a long-term sea-level rise knowledge programme, and that no decision to implement it has been taken.
For now, this concept of 'double dikes', as one of several concepts and plans, will be included in the Sea Level Rise Knowledge Programme.
Voorlopig wordt dit concept van «dubbele dijken», als één van de concepten en plannen, meegenomen binnen het Kennisprogramma Zeespiegelstijging.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Geurts, Bisschop, Madlener en Van Haga over het schrappen van artikel 8b uit het Besluit gebruik meststoffen ter uitvoering van het zesde actieprogramma Nitraatrichtlijn

MPs from VVD, CDA, SGP, PVV and FvD asked whether the minister would drop article 8b of the manure decree (requiring drempels between potato ridges on clay and loess soils), citing hindrance to integrated cultivation and conflicting research findings. The minister answered that the article cannot be amended after publication, so it will be excluded from entry into force by royal decree, while stating that nutrient runoff measures remain important for the seventh action programme.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma, Geurts en Von Martels over de kosten van kentekens van trekkers

MPs Postma, Geurts and Von Martels (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the RDW plans to charge far more than the promised maximum of €61 per new agricultural vehicle for identification and registration, and whether the RDW will be instructed to cap costs and introduce accelerated registration. The Minister acknowledges the sector's surprise, explains the cost structure, and proposes a transition period until 1 July 2021 with conversion-method registration and work toward accelerated registration, but does not commit to instructing the RDW on a €61 cap.
I have therefore entered into discussions with the RDW and the sector to reach an appropriate and swift solution in light of the law's entry into force on 1 January 2021.
Ik ben daarom samen met de RDW en de sector in gesprek gegaan om te komen tot een passende en snelle oplossing in het licht van de inwerkingtreding van de wet per 1 januari 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Lodders en Geurts over het deskundigenverslag deskundigengroep dierziekten HPAI evaluatie van 13 november 2020 ‘eendenbedrijf besmet’

MPs Lodders and Geurts asked the Minister of Agriculture about the expert report on avian influenza (HPAI) after a duck farm infection, covering spread, monitoring, ventilation routes, pest control, salmonella checks and export of meat from protection zones. The Minister answered most questions in substance, pointing to ongoing research and biosecurity measures, while declining to commit to raising meat export rules with the European Commission.
I therefore cannot now commit to putting this topic on the European agenda.
Ik kan daarom nu niet toezeggen dat ik dit onderwerp Europees zal agenderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Amhaouch en Postma over het bericht 'Onbegrip bij provincie over weigering Rijk om informatie voor stikstofaanpak te delen'

CDA MPs asked the agriculture minister why the national government refuses to share nitrogen-related farm data with provinces on privacy grounds, and whether this delays regional nitrogen plans, and asked about a study focusing on peak-polluting farms. The minister answered that privacy-sensitive data is not essential, that provinces already hold much of the information, that work on an alternative data-access solution is ongoing, and that the study reflects only one part of the broader approach.
I am working with RVO and BIJ12 (on behalf of the provinces) on an alternative solution to make the last part of the relevant information accessible to the provinces.
Ik werk samen met RVO en BIJ12 (namens de provincies) aan een alternatieve oplossing om het laatste deel van de relevante informatie toegankelijk te maken voor de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Geurts over kinderboerderijen, boerencampings en zorgboerderijen die Q-koortsregels schenden

MPs Van den Berg and Geurts asked how the government responds to reports that dozens of petting farms and farm campsites broke Q-fever rules, and how the NVWA inspects and follows up on such violations. The minister replied that compliance is checked at about 10% of such farms with 43-55% compliance over four years, that re-inspections are carried out only where needed, and that farms must document vaccination before allowing visitors again.
The NVWA has started an intensive communication campaign this year to point these businesses to the importance of complying with the rules.
De NVWA is dit jaar een intensief communicatietraject gestart om deze bedrijven te wijzen op het belang van naleving van de regels die zijn gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht ‘Column: Democratische vraagtekens over bijplussen stikstofnatuur’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a report claiming nitrogen-sensitive nature was mapped in AERIUS on privately owned land without a public administrative procedure, asking who decides these locations, whether landowners can object, and whether specific locations were changed. The Minister replied that the maps only reflect the factual presence of protected habitats based on objective data, that objection is possible via existing procedures, and that nature organisations cannot update the map themselves, while stating the mapping is not a legal designation and answering the location-specific questions only partly.
It is therefore not a legal or policy decision, but a representation of the factual situation.
Het is dus geen juridische of beleidsmatige beslissing, maar een weergave van de feitelijke situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht “Wat overblijft van de I&R-affaire”

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about a report on the I&R cattle registration affair, including the 2018 blocking of thousands of dairy farms, the length of handling, financial damages and improvements to prevent recurrence. The minister acknowledges the Court's new interpretation implies the blockades should have been decided differently, reports about 130 damage claims with 30 settled, and promises to implement the ruling and apply lessons to future rules.
I must therefore acknowledge that, with the information available now, this situation should have been handled differently.
Ik moet dan ook erkennen dat er, met de informatie van nu, in deze situatie anders gehandeld had moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Geurts en Van der Staaij over de situatie in Zuid-Afrika

MPs Van Helvert, Geurts and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister about attacks on white farmers, land expropriation without compensation in South Africa's Expropriation Bill, and Brexit implications for trade. The minister said the government has raised land reform concerns bilaterally and in the EU and OECD, that the bill sets limited no-compensation scenarios subject to court or arbitrator review, and that Dutch influence is limited to continued dialogue.
The new bill, the Expropriation Bill, provides for this.
Het nieuwe wetsvoorstel, de «Expropriation Bill», voorziet daarin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Geurts over het bericht 'EU-hof zet streep door subsidie grondaankoop natuur'

MPs Von Martels and Geurts (CDA) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a CJEU ruling that ended state-aid subsidies for land purchases by nature organisations and whether the state faces interest claims. The minister answered that the ruling does not judge whether nature organisations may run economic activities, that the state still considers the subsidies compatible state aid, and that any interest claim depends on a new Commission decision.
The European Court's ruling contains no substantive judgment on whether nature organisations are permitted to carry out economic activities on land intended for nature management.
De uitspraak van het Europese Hof bevat geen inhoudelijk oordeel of het natuurorganisaties is toegestaan economische activiteiten te verrichten op gronden die zijn bestemd voor natuurbeheer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over NEMA (National Emission Model for Agriculture) en AERIUS Calculator

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers how they will ease the ecology-economy tension in nitrogen policy, whether the AERIUS Calculator's methods (SRM-2 for roads with a 5 km cut-off versus OPS for other sources) are defensible, and about monitoring, permit numbers and building-phase exemptions. The minister replied that the calculator remains the best available tool, that the government is studying a scientifically based distance or deposition threshold with RIVM, that the meter network will be expanded, and that exact permit and housing figures are not centrally recorded or depend on future emissions.
I consider it important that competent authorities base their permit decisions on the best available method, and that is the AERIUS Calculator.
Ik vind het van belang dat bevoegde gezagen bij hun vergunningverlening uitgaan van de best beschikbare methode en dat is AERIUS Calculator.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Geurts over het bericht 'LTO: inbreng sector niet meegenomen in afspoelingsmaatregelen'

Two MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture whether the farm sector was excluded from designing measures to prevent runoff from arable fields, and why the measures are so detailed. The minister replied that LTO was consulted, that the draft decree was adjusted after consultation (including adding options and a 3-metre buffer zone), that the scientific reports will be shared, and that the regulatory burden is estimated at about €249,428.
The input from LTO and other organisations and individual farmers has led to adjustments in the draft decree.
De inbreng van LTO en van andere organisaties en individuele landbouwers, heeft geleid tot aanpassingen in het ontwerpbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Agnes Mulder over het artikel Weilanden vol glas van zonnepanelen na hevige brand: nieuw probleem voor milieudiensten

MPs Geurts and Agnes Mulder asked the government whether glass shards and debris from solar panels released in fires that settle on surrounding land are a known problem, what the health risks are, and whether a national protocol and insurance-sector discussion are planned. The minister answered that RIVM will run fire experiments, IFV will consider a protocol, the farmer bears responsibility for food safety, and the insurance issue is separate, promising further steps after the research.
In consultation with the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management, I will, on the basis of the RIVM research, examine whether follow-up steps are necessary.
Ik zal, in overleg met de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat, aan de hand van de onderzoeken van het RIVM bezien of er eventueel vervolgstappen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Harbers en Geurts over het bericht 'Boeren weten raad met Stikstof'

MPs Harbers and Geurts asked the minister whether a farmer-led nitrogen plan that could cut ammonia emissions while freeing space for development is realistic, including financing innovation through leasing nitrogen space and integrating it into provincial policy. The minister responded positively, offering to help the initiators by calculating the measures, exploring legal safeguarding, and discussing a pilot with provinces, while noting that the plan still needs elaboration and that demand for leased space is uncertain.
I am willing to help the initiators, for example by having the proposed emission reduction measures calculated or by examining whether these measures can be legally secured.

Ik ben bereid om de initiatiefnemers daarbij te helpen, bijvoorbeeld door de voorgestelde emissiereductiemaatregelen door te laten rekenen of te onderzoeken of deze maatregelen juridisch geborgd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Harbers en Geurts over het bericht 'Agrifacts en Stikstofclaim blazen gesprek met LNV over voermaatregel af'

MPs Harbers and Geurts asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why the ministry set conditions on the communication after a planned technical briefing with the Agrifacts and Stikstofclaim foundations on feed-measure norms, and why the ministry set those conditions. The minister explained that the ministry proposed a joint-approved report as the only basis for external communication to avoid conflicting interpretations, that the foundations declined and cancelled the meeting, and that a supplementary note on the norms was sent to parliament.

The conversation is not intended to address the accuracy of the input data used from Statistics Netherlands (CBS) and Wageningen Economic Research (WEcR) and their calculations and calculation methods.

Het gesprek is niet bedoeld om de juistheid van de gebruikte invoergegevens van het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) en Wageningen Economic Research (WEcR) en de berekeningen en rekenmethodiek daarvan aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Harbers over het kort geding met betrekking tot onderbouwing ministeriële voernormen

MPs Geurts and Harbers asked the minister why the methodology behind the feed-norm measure for dairy farms could not be reconstructed in the summary proceedings, and whether the ministry's data and calculations were accessible. The minister replied that the underlying CBS data, a WEcR note and the CDM advice were all published, promised a meeting with the foundations on 12 August and a letter after the PBL assessment.
I intend to publish a report of the meeting on www.rijksoverheid.nl and am of course willing to inform the House of the outcomes.
Ik ben voornemens een verslag van het gesprek op www.rijksoverheid.nl te plaatsen en ben uiteraard bereid om uw Kamer te informeren over de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over waterplantenproblematiek op de Randmeren en Zuidelijk IJsselmeergebied

An MP asked the ministers whether Rijkswaterstaat bears responsibility, given past water management measures that promoted aquatic plant growth, for plant overgrowth obstructing recreational boating and swimming on the Randmeren and southern IJsselmeer beyond the fairway, and about the basis for the 10% mowing limit and the cooperation process. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat is responsible only for the fairways of national waterways and designated recreational channels, that responsibility elsewhere lies with regional authorities and the recreation sector, and that a working group and pilots are being run.

On that basis, Rijkswaterstaat is responsible for reducing nuisance from aquatic plants only insofar as it concerns the fairway of the national waterways and certain fairways designated for recreational boating.

Op basis daarvan is Rijkswaterstaat verantwoordelijk voor het verminderen van overlast door waterplanten voor zover het de vaargeul van de rijksvaarwegen en bepaalde voor de recreatietoervaart aangewezen vaargeulen betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Geurts over het bericht dat het draagvlak voor het keurmerk 'On the way to PlanetProof' afbrokkelt

Two CDA MPs asked the agriculture minister about reports that farmers see little added value in the PlanetProof sustainability label and bear extra costs without a price premium. The minister acknowledged the criticism, gave illustrative cost figures, said a farm ownership agenda and ACM monitoring of prices are underway, but did not commit to new rules.
For that reason, and because of the importance I attach to it, I am working on drafting an agricultural entrepreneurship agenda.
Daarom, én vanwege het belang dat ik eraan hecht, ben ik bezig met het opstellen van een agrarische ondernemerschapsagenda.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Geurts, Baudet en Moorlag over de tariefverhogingen van Rendac

MPs Bisschop, Geurts, Baudet and Moorlag asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about Rendac's 2020 carcass-collection tariff increases, the lack of transparency in tariff calculations, and the status of the destruction-market review. The minister defended the tariffs as cost-based, said the ADR and the external auditor check compliance, and withheld Rendac's confidential figures from the Chamber while promising renegotiated agreements with Rendac.
The confidential business information obtained cannot be shared with third parties.
De verkregen bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie kan ik niet delen met derden.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Geurts en Lodders over de voortzetting van de activiteiten van Stichting Veldleeuwerik

MPs Geurts and Lodders asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the uncertain future of Stichting Veldleeuwerik's farmer study groups and how the sustainability practice network would be continued. The minister replied by referring to attached findings and a kwartiermaker appointment, pledging support for existing groups with BO Akkerbouw while the new practice network is set up.
I attach great importance to supporting the current entrepreneur groups of the former Veldleeuwerik network.
Ik hecht er groot belang aan om de huidige ondernemersgroepen van het voormalige Veldleeuwerik netwerk te steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van den Berg over het verlies van het strand bij Zoutelande

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about coastal erosion at Zoutelande after storm Ciara, including whether the periodic sand nourishment approach is adequate, whether the nourishment was delayed by the nitrogen (PAS) ruling, and whether the Spoedwet stikstof could help. The minister answered that the programmatic approach is adequate and climate-resilient, that an accelerated nourishment at Dishoek is being prepared for the 2020 storm season, and that the Spoedwet does not address this situation.
Along the coast of Walcheren, particularly near Dishoek, there was such coastal retreat that an accelerated sand nourishment before the start of the 2020/2021 storm season is necessary.
Langs de kust van Walcheren, met name nabij Dishoek, was sprake van dusdanige kustafslag dat een versnelde zandsuppletie voor aanvang van het stormseizoen 2020/2021 noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Dik-Faber over opkoop van diverse veehouderijen in andere provincies door de provincie Noord-Brabant

MPs Geurts and Dik-Faber asked the minister about Noord-Brabant buying out livestock farms in other provinces to use external nitrogen offsetting for Logistiek Park Moerdijk, and about scattered nitrogen effects from shipping and offsetting rules. The minister replied that the province acted within its policy rules but acknowledged poor coordination with other provinces, and promised agreements with provinces on notification, monitoring and management measures.
Given the limited coordination with other provinces over this buyout, this did not go well and caused much unrest, for which the province has offered apologies.
Gezien de beperkte afstemming met de andere provincies over deze opkoop, is dit hier niet goed verlopen en heeft dit veel onrust veroorzaakt waarvoor de provincie excuses heeft aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Geurts en Von Martels over schade aan mestkelders, ventilatiekanalen en funderingen veroorzaakt door mijnbouwactiviteiten in Groningen

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers whether agricultural damage to manure cellars, ventilation shafts and foundations from Groningen gas extraction had been wrongly excluded from reinforcement and damage handling by NAM, CVW and the TCMG, and how farmers are heard and supported. The government answered that the TCMG handles new damage claims, uses civil liability law with the statutory presumption of causation, is consulting an expert panel on manure cellar damage due around June 2020, and is working with the Province on a programmatic approach for farmers.
The panel's advice is expected to be ready around mid-June 2020.
Naar verwachting is het advies van het panel medio juni 2020 gereed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de wijziging van de salmonellabestrijding bij pluimvee

An MP from the CDA asked why Dutch poultry flocks are slaughtered early after a first positive salmonella test even when a second opinion finds no infection, and what the government is doing about EU rules. The minister agreed early slaughter is undesirable, explained that EU rules do not allow routine retesting, and said WUR research is underway to strengthen the case with the Commission.

At the end of 2019 the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality asked Wageningen University and Research (WUR) to compare the different control approaches and produce a scientifically grounded evaluation.

Het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit heeft eind 2019 aan Wageningen University and Research (WUR) gevraagd om de verschillende bestrijdingsaanpakken te vergelijken en een wetenschappelijk onderbouwde evaluatie te maken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van Toorenburg over legionella in afvalwaterzuiveringsinstallaties

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about legionella at 81 wastewater treatment plants in Noord-Brabant, including who enforces, what has been done, whether the risk locations can be published, and whether companies protect workers. The minister answered that enforcement lies with municipalities and provinces via environmental services, that companies are expected to act, and that publication is the competent authorities' decision, with a model-letter process under way.

Whether enforcement actually takes place when companies do not voluntarily take measures is not known, because Omgevingsdienst NL has no view of the actions each individual environmental service has taken.

Of daadwerkelijk sprake is van handhaving indien bedrijven niet vrijwillig overgaan tot het nemen van maatregelen is niet bekend, omdat Omgevingsdienst NL geen zicht heeft op de acties die elke individuele omgevingsdienst heeft genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht in ‘Nieuwe Oogst’ dat leeftijd stal obstakel is in de regeling voor warme sanering

MP Geurts (CDA) asked the Minister of Agriculture whether the five-year production requirement in the pig-farm sanitation subsidy applies to the age of the location or to individual buildings, and whether RVO's stricter reading was correct. The Minister answered that the requirement applies to the whole production capacity, that younger stables can count if continuously used for pigs, and that RVO has since adopted this more flexible reading, while demolition of the whole location remains required.
RVO.nl had indeed previously communicated the five-year requirement such that a stable younger than five years did not count in calculating the subsidy amount, in consultation with the department.

Eerder communiceerde RVO.nl inderdaad de vijf-jaar-eis zo dat een stal van jonger dan vijf jaar niet meetelde bij de berekening van de hoogte van het subsidiebedrag, dit in overleg met het departement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de veiligheid van en toezicht op indoor kartbanen

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about safety regulation and oversight of indoor go-kart tracks, including hospital admissions, applicable rules, liability and whether a regime is needed. The minister answered that indoor tracks outside amusement parks fall outside the WAS and no rijksoverheid supervision applies beyond the kart machines, and committed to bringing indoor tracks under the WAS and consulting the KNAF, municipalities and inspection bodies.
I want to bring indoor go-kart tracks under the WAS.
Ik wil indoor kartbanen onder het WAS brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Von Martels, Lodders en Bisschop over het artikel 'Grote onvrede over aanpak pootgoedfraude'

MPs from CDA, VVD and SGP asked the minister about NVWA and NAK handling of seed potato fraud (valse NAK-labels), the enforcement tools of the plant inspection services, and cooperation between the agencies. The minister answered that the NVWA acted within its powers, that a criminal investigation is ongoing, that the inspection services' fines powers are limited under current law, and that an evaluation of enforcement instruments is planned by 2021.
I will evaluate the use of the enforcement instruments currently included in this legislation and will also involve the plant inspection services and the sector.
Ik zal de inzet van de nu in deze regelgeving opgenomen handhavingsinstrumenten evalueren en daarbij ook de plantaardige keuringsdiensten en de sector betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Geurts over het bericht ‘Duizenden veehouders nog in ongewis over fosfaatrechten’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about thousands of livestock farmers still uncertain about phosphate rights, including delays in objection procedures, whether a re-assessment will pause pending objections, and the status of hardship-case applications. The Minister answered that objections are being handled as quickly as possible but carefully, that a re-assessment is expected by autumn 2019, that procedural agreements exist with some farmers, and that seven hardship cases still await data, while mostly referring back to earlier answers without firm dates.
The CBb issued rulings on 16 April 2019 and 25 June 2019 on the definition of dairy cattle in the Meststoffenwet.
Het CBb heeft op 16 april 2019 en 25 juni 2019 uitspraken gedaan over de definitie van melkvee in de Meststoffenwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Geurts over de eerdere beantwoording over het zogeheten gelijkberechtigingsdossier

MPs Von Martels and Geurts (CDA) asked the government to respond to the Vereniging Gelijkberechtiging Grondbezitters' claims about state aid to nature organisations (TBOs), including whether the General Court annulment, the interest claim under the CELF ruling, and settlement options were handled correctly. The state secretary defended the earlier position, said the state intervened in support of Natuurmonumenten, argued the Commission's approval may well be reconfirmed, and declined to pursue interest recovery or concrete settlement proposals pending the court procedures.
It is for the European Commission to take a new decision, should it decide to open the formal investigation procedure.
Het is aan de Europese Commissie om een nieuw besluit te nemen, mocht zij besluiten tot het openen van de formele onderzoeksprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg en Geurts over de Nederlandse voorbereiding op een harde Brexit

CDA MPs asked the government about the Dutch preparations for a hard Brexit on 31 October 2019, covering customs staffing and enforcement choices, medicine and medical device shortages, live animal inspection posts and NVWA capacity. The government answered that staffing targets were met, customs and NVWA preparations continue, and that shortages and disruptions cannot be fully ruled out.
The Tweede Kamer was informed about these choices in the cabinet letter dated 18 January 2019.
Over deze keuzes is de Tweede Kamer geïnformeerd in de brief van het kabinet d.d. 18 januari 2019
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Von Martels over het handelen van de NVWA met ondeugdelijk pootgoed en opvolging van meldingen door keuringsdiensten

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture how the NVWA handled fraudulent seed potatoes and follow-up on reports from inspection bodies, including cross-border aspects with Belgium. The minister answered that an NVWA investigation is ongoing, that fields were partly ordered destroyed-free but subject to phytosanitary inspection, and that existing enforcement powers are sufficient, while committing to talks with inspection services.

I cannot provide further information at this stage, except to note that both the Dutch General Inspection Service for seed and seed potatoes (NAK) and the Belgian Federal Agency for the Safety of the Food Chain (FAVV) are involved by the NVWA in this matter.

Ik kan hierover in dit stadium geen nadere informatie verstrekken, met uitzondering van de mededeling dat zowel de Nederlandse Algemene Keuringsdienst voor zaaizaad en pootgoed van landbouwgewassen (NAK) als het Belgische Federaal Agentschap voor de Veiligheid van de Voedselketen (FAVV) hierbij door de NVWA betrokken worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Geurts over de vernietiging van Hollandse uien in Hongarije

MPs Amhaouch and Geurts asked the government about Hungarian authorities destroying a Dutch onion consignment that lacked origin labelling, and whether this was lawful and avoidable. The minister answered that the missing label breached rules, that the consignment was sent to biogas digestion after a spot check, that Hungarian law permits such measures, and that talks with Hungary will be held to prevent recurrence.
I will discuss with the relevant Hungarian authorities whether agreements are possible to prevent this in the future.
Ik zal met de betreffende Hongaarse autoriteiten bespreken of afspraken mogelijk zijn om dit in de toekomst te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Geurts en Slootweg over de aanpak van knooppunt Hoevelaken

MPs of the CDA ask the minister about the stalled redevelopment of the Hoevelaken junction after the contract with BAM and Van Oord was reportedly terminated, including the delay to construction, traffic costs and possible coordination with the A1/A30 Barneveld project. The minister confirms the planned start of 2021 is now delayed to after the route decision (expected 2020), promises to inform the Chamber on re-tendering later, and gives partial answers on other points.
I will inform you at a later moment about how the realisation will be re-tendered.
Ik zal u op een later moment informeren over de wijze waarop de realisatie opnieuw wordt aanbesteed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘windmolens medeoorzaak insectensterfte’

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about reports that wind turbines contribute to insect deaths, citing a German DLR study, and asked about insect considerations in permitting and monitoring of renewable energy. The minister said the German estimate is small relative to total insect numbers according to Dutch experts, that insects are not considered in wind permitting under the Nature Conservation Act, and that the effects of solar parks and renewable energy on insects will be explored.
In permitting wind farms under the Nature Conservation Act, insects are not taken into account.
In de vergunningverlening voor windmolenparken op grond van de Wet natuurbescherming wordt geen rekening gehouden met insecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en De Groot over kleine en middelgrote slachthuizen in Noord-Nederland

MPs Geurts (CDA) and De Groot (D66) asked the minister about small and medium slaughterhouses in the north of the Netherlands, including the handling of about 30,000 kg of condemned meat and an independent investigation into NVWA oversight. The minister answered that the 30,000 kg concerned 31 cattle in 2017, all of which were traced to Rendac for destruction, with only administrative irregularities found, and that an independent external inquiry and an internal audit of NVWA oversight are ongoing.
As I also indicated during the NVWA General Consultation of 23 April, the NVWA investigated the 30,000 kilograms.
Zoals ik ook tijdens het Algemeen Overleg NVWA van 23 april jl. heb aangegeven, heeft de NVWA onderzoek gedaan naar de 30.000 kilo.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving (PBL) “rommelt met de cijfers en de impact van het eten van vlees op het klimaat overdrijft”

MPs Geurts and Agnes Mulder asked about reports that the PBL overstated the climate impact of meat eating, following objections from Stichting Agri Facts, and whether the Chambers were informed of shortcomings. The minister confirmed the PBL corrected a web publication wording, rejected the claim of shortcomings and said no changes to the Klimaatakkoord calculations are needed.
Based on the objections raised by Stichting Agri Facts and the PBL's response, I have not been able to identify any shortcomings and therefore do not endorse the Foundation's claim.

Op grond van de door de Stichting Agri Facts aangedragen bezwaren en de reactie van het PBL daarop heb ik geen tekortkomingen kunnen constateren en onderschrijf ik de stelling van de Stichting dus niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over Brexit, veterinaire keurpunten en levende dieren

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked the government about Brexit no-deal preparedness, the lack of veterinary inspection posts on the north bank of the Nieuwe Waterweg, and the handling of live animals and products. Minister Schouten answered that NVWA preparations are on track but disruptions are not excluded, that inspection post applications are pending with the European Commission, and that temporary alternatives such as transport to southern inspection posts are being explored.
I am awaiting the definitive response of the European Commission.
Ik ben in afwachting van de definitieve reactie van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Geurts over het bericht ‘Mestoverschot berekend met verouderde cijfers’

MPs Lodders and Geurts asked whether Dutch manure policy relies on outdated excretion standards that disadvantage dairy farmers, and why they have not been updated. The minister answered that the forfaits were deliberately not revised for now to avoid exceeding the sectoral phosphate and nitrogen ceilings, with a CDM advisory opinion awaited before a decision for 1 January 2020.
As also reported earlier in the General Consultation of 13 December, I have therefore chosen not to revise the forfaits for the time being.
Zoals ook eerder gemeld in het Algemeen Overleg van 13 december jl., heb ik er daarom voor gekozen de forfaits vooralsnog niet te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en De Groot over het bericht ‘vier jaar geëist tegen vleesfraudeur Willy Selten’

MPs Geurts and De Groot asked the Minister of Agriculture about a prosecution request in a meat-fraud case, the status of Taskforce Voedselvertrouwen action plan items on meat chain quality systems, slaughter of cows, supervision of fattening farms and preventing non-slaughter-worthy cows entering consumption. The Minister answered most questions with reference to ongoing work, promised a further report before the summer recess, and stated that the NVWA checks risk-based but does not register fattening farms separately.
I will also include this topic in the independent external investigation about which I informed you in my letter on slaughterhouses in Northern Netherlands
Dit onderwerp zal ik ook betrekken bij het onafhankelijke externe onderzoek waarover ik u heb geïnformeerd in mijn brief over slachthuizen in Noord-Nederland

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Omtzigt, Lodders, Bisschop en Van Rooijen over een keurpunt voor levend vee voor de Brexit en de extra capaciteit bij de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA)

MPs asked whether the minister had led a public-private effort to set up live-animal inspection posts at Dutch seaports before a no-deal Brexit, and about NVWA staffing and preparedness. The minister replied that applications were sent to the European Commission before the 15 February deadline, that exact locations are confidential, that the NVWA has hired 100 of 143 needed staff, and that service levels may have to be adjusted for about a year.
I cannot go into the precise numbers and locations because of the confidentiality of this information.
Op de precieze aantallen en locaties kan ik niet in gaan in verband met de vertrouwelijkheid van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Geurts over gevolgen van het gebrek aan netcapaciteit voor duurzame energieprojecten in Drenthe, Groningen en Overijssel

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about consequences of grid capacity shortages in Drenthe, Groningen and Overijssel for solar projects holding SDE+ subsidies that cannot connect to the grid, and whether realisation deadlines can be suspended. The minister replied that RVO can grant one year's extension case by case, that grid investment and location checks via Regional Energy Strategies are being pursued, and that talks with grid operators and ACM are ongoing.
RVO.nl has the option to grant one year's postponement of the realisation deadline from the subsidy's start date.
RVO.nl heeft de mogelijkheid om één jaar uitstel van de realisatietermijn te verlenen op de ingangsdatum van de subsidie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het zogeheten gelijkberechtigingsdossier

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the state aid case concerning nature organisations (TBOs) after the General Court found the Commission should have opened a formal investigation on a complaint by VGG. The minister answered that repayment is uncertain, explained the standstill and interest questions, and said she would consider engaging an independent facilitator for a settlement.
What amount of money this would involve is unknown.
Om welk geldbedrag het hier zou gaan is onbekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Von Martels over de bestrijding van de Japanse duizendknoop

CDA MPs asked about the spread of Asian knotweed, its damage costs, EU and national listing as an invasive species, and support for a national protocol. The minister said damage costs are not tracked, control is difficult with no single effective method, she supports a protocol and will approach parties, but declined EU listing and national designation under article 3.19 of the Nature Conservation Act.
No data are kept by the managers on the damage caused by Asian knotweed and the associated costs for residents, businesses and governments.
Er worden door de beheerders geen gegevens bijgehouden over de schade door Aziatische duizendknopen en daarmee gepaard gaande kosten voor inwoners, bedrijven en overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over het op tijd inrichten van een keurpunt voor levende dieren voor export naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk in verband met een eventuele harde Brexit

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked whether a border inspection post for live animals imported from the UK is needed in a no-deal Brexit, whether one will be ready by 29 March 2019, and whether the government will work with business to set one up. The minister answered that no approved sea-port inspection post exists in the Netherlands or along the West European coast, that business is responsible for building one and has not yet applied, and that the government will support a solution if business takes the lead.
I am willing to work with the NVWA to facilitate business in realising a solution, if business takes the initiative to do so.
Ik ben bereid om samen met de NVWA het bedrijfsleven te faciliteren bij het realiseren van een oplossing, als het bedrijfsleven daar het initiatief daarvoor neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Geurts over het bericht ‘Geld kan soms toch groeien op lapjes landbouwgrond’

MPs Ronnes and Geurts asked the Finance Minister whether land speculation schemes escape AFM financial supervision because the land is formally leased out, and where misled investors can turn. The minister confirmed the practices, explained that formal contract arrangements do not settle whether a land investment is a financial product since the substance of management is assessed, pointed investors to the ACM and civil remedies, and said a bill strengthening investor protection is being prepared for 2019.
I am currently preparing a bill that will strengthen the protection of investors in investment objects.
Momenteel bereid ik een wetsvoorstel voor waarmee de bescherming van beleggers in beleggingsobjecten wordt versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Geurts over het lozen van giftige gassen door tankers in Gelderland

CDA MPs Von Martels and Geurts asked the government about tankers venting toxic gases in Gelderland, whether venting is legal, when it will be banned nationwide, and how enforcement is organised. The minister replied that venting by inland vessels is still permitted except for benzine, that a ban under the Scheepsafvalstoffenverdrag is being implemented around 2020, and that enforcement of provincial rules lies with the provinces, while promising to proceed with the ban.
Work is proceeding briskly on preparing the entry into force of the national venting ban, which is foreseen for 2020.
Er wordt voortvarend doorgewerkt aan de verdere voorbereiding van de inwerkingtreding van het nationale ontgassingsverbod, die voorzien is in 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Amhaouch over toename import in de EU van legbatterijeieren

Two MPs from the CDA asked the ministers how much egg and egg-product imports into the EU have risen, whether imported eggs meet EU animal welfare standards, and what is being done about Ukraine's laying-hen housing and chicken fillet imports. The minister replied that imports must meet EU health and labelling rules but not EU production standards, that trade agreements contain limited welfare provisions, and that Ukraine has a phased implementation plan through 2021 which the Netherlands will keep pressing.
Products imported into the EU generally do not have to meet EU production requirements, such as housing systems and animal welfare standards, unless agreements have been made with third countries.

Door de EU geïmporteerde producten hoeven in het algemeen niet te voldoen aan productie-eisen van de EU, als houderijsystemen en dierenwelzijnsstandaarden, tenzij er met derde landen afspraken over zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Asscher, Geurts en Slootweg over de voorbereiding van Nederland op een keiharde Brexit

MPs Omtzigt, Asscher, Geurts and Slootweg asked the government how prepared the Netherlands is for a no-deal Brexit, including whether the added customs, NVWA and justice capacity will be operational by 29 March 2019 and what risks remain. The government answered that NVWA and customs will only partly be staffed by that date, with temporary service reductions expected, and that departments are taking mitigating measures with the Foreign Affairs minister coordinating.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Geurts over het verbod op het gebruik van de sleepvoet

MPs Lodders and Geurts asked the Minister of Agriculture why the planned ban on slurry-shoe (sleepvoet) manure application on grassland on clay and peat soils was not reconsidered, and about alternatives, their effects, verification and responsibility. The Minister maintained the ban from 1 January 2019 as agreed under the PAS nitrogen programme, described approved alternatives, and set out the verification and responsibility arrangements.
For these alternatives, my ministry is now working on elaborating the regulations so that they can be applied in 2019.
Voor deze alternatieven werkt mijn ministerie nu aan de uitwerking van de regelgeving zodat deze kunnen worden toegepast in 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Lodders over het bericht ‘Boeren vrezen wilde zwijnen na besmetting’

MPs Geurts and Lodders asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about African swine fever risks from wild boar, including whether the national government should take over management from the provinces, testing of hunted wild boar, transport and waste controls, and vaccines. The minister answered that consultation with provinces and stakeholders is ongoing, that provinces remain legally responsible for wild boar population management, that the national government can only intervene through substitution in case of neglect, and that existing monitoring and biosecurity measures are considered sufficient for now.
Given this decentralisation of powers, the national government can only intervene in case of neglect of duty by a provincial administration through substitution.
Het Rijk kan, gegeven deze decentralisatie van bevoegdheden, alleen ingrijpen als sprake is van taakverwaarlozing door het bestuur van een provincie door middel van in de plaatstreding
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht 'Hogan belooft versoepeling EU-regels wegens droogte'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture about the Commissioner Hogan report on relaxing EU rules because of the drought, and about what the government would do for farmers. The Minister answered that the government has requested a derogation on catch-crop rules, is pursuing a bank guarantee route via RVO.nl, and points to the broad weather insurance, but declines to commit to new structural drought measures beyond existing instruments.
The Netherlands immediately afterwards submitted a derogation request regarding the greening requirements for catch crops, in line with the sector's (LTO's) request.
Nederland heeft direct daarna een derogatieverzoek ingediend ten aanzien van de vergroeningseisen met betrekking tot vanggewassen, conform het verzoek van de sector (LTO).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over de netto opbrengst van pachtgronden
