MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance how lease returns on farmland compare with the box 3 wealth tax assumed yield of 5.39%, whether the regulated rent norms can leave net lease income below the tax, and whether the government will change the box 3 system. The government answered that regulated lease prices cap only direct rental income, that box 3 is a forfaitary system averaging returns across wealth levels, that some individual landlords may face a higher tax burden than their lease income, and that a letter on actual-return box 3 is in preparation, while declining to give a regional breakdown of average net returns and of lease-type-specific yields.

Because the returns on savings and investments are adjusted annually on the basis of the most recent available data, the wealth yield tax system from 2017 onward better matches the average actual return.

Doordat de rendementen op spaargeld en beleggingen jaarlijks worden aangepast aan de hand van de meest actueel beschikbare gegevens sluit het stelsel van de vermogensrendementsheffing vanaf 2017 beter aan bij het gemiddelde werkelijke rendement.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Geurts en Ronnes over aansluiting en planning van duurzame energie projecten met betrekking tot elektriciteitsnetwerken en beschermen natuur, landschap en vruchtbare landbouw

MPs from the CDA asked the Economic Affairs minister about grid connection delays for renewable energy projects, the statutory connection deadlines and sanctions, planning coordination with regional governments, and protecting nature, landscape and farmland from solar parks. The minister answered that the 18-week deadline is increasingly exceeded for some connections, that no sanctions have been imposed to date, and that regional energy strategies and the national environment vision will address spatial coordination.
For connections to the low and medium voltage grid there is no uniform recording of exceedances of the deadlines.
Voor aansluitingen op het laagspannings- en middenspanningsnet is er geen uniforme vastlegging van overschrijdingen van de termijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van den Berg over late betalingen door en marktmacht van Nederlandse supermarkten

MPs Geurts and Van den Berg asked the government about late payments by Dutch supermarkets to suppliers, bank-financed payment schemes, and whether rising market power and concentration threaten competition. The State Secretary answered that existing payment-term rules apply to supermarkets, a Commission proposal on unfair trading practices is being assessed, a ban on assignment clauses is planned, and that the ACM already polices abuse of dominance case by case, while declining to speculate on causes or commission a broad market-power study.
It is not for me to speculate on the underlying reason for supermarkets' conduct.
Het is niet aan mij om te speculeren over wat de achterliggende reden van het handelen van supermarkten is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Von Martels en Van der Molen over oesterbanken voor de haven van Terschelling

Three CDA MPs asked the ministers about Japanese oyster banks affecting currents and access to the Terschelling harbour, dredging and ferry berths, a possible sailing ban near seal sandbanks, and the addition of the grey seal to Wadden dune habitat designations. The minister confirmed monitoring of the oyster banks with results expected end of the year, said the banks lie outside the ferry channel and do not affect access, confirmed planned maintenance of ferry infrastructure from 2019, and explained the limited scope of the grey seal designation.
These oyster banks are scheduled to be re-measured by Wageningen Marine Research this spring.
Deze oesterbanken worden volgens de planning dit voorjaar opnieuw ingemeten door Wageningen Marine Research.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van den Berg over oogstramingen CBS

MPs Geurts and Van den Berg asked why provisional onion and potato harvest estimates by CBS were sometimes revised down, whether provisional figures distort prices, and whether publication could be limited to final figures. The minister disputed the premise that revisions were mainly downward, said CBS publication is a legal duty and serves transparency, and noted there is no EU obligation to publish provisional estimates.
The claim that final estimates generally came out lower in the period 2010–2017 is therefore not correct.
Het gestelde dat de definitieve ramingen over het algemeen lager uitvielen in de periode 2010 – 2017 is dus niet juist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Geurts over de discriminatie van, onteigeningen van en moordpartijen op blanke boeren in Zuid-Afrika

CDA MPs Van Helvert and Geurts asked the Foreign Minister about reports of discrimination, land expropriation and murders of white farmers in South Africa, and whether the government takes South Africa's security responsibility seriously. The minister answered that violence is a broad problem, that the government sees no reason to doubt South Africa's responsibility, and that the proposed constitutional change on expropriation without compensation is a domestic process being monitored through diplomatic contacts.
The cabinet continues to urge South Africa to keep the farming community well informed about developments and to communicate clearly and unambiguously about the conditions and consequences.
Het kabinet blijft Zuid-Afrika oproepen de boerengemeenschap goed op de hoogte te houden van de ontwikkelingen en eenduidig en helder te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van den Berg over het bericht dat cijfers CBS ervoor zorgen dat de prijs van uien laag blijft

MPs Geurts and Van den Berg asked whether CBS onion harvest estimates, repeatedly revised, depress onion prices and whether mandatory CBS survey participation is enforced with fines. The minister answered that CBS figures inform market prices without determining them, provided five years of revision data, and that no fines apply for 2016 and 2017 under a letter of intent.
The CBS does not have data on the onion prices that growers receive.
Het CBS beschikt niet over uienprijzen die de telers ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Slootweg over het bericht 'Boer kan fipronil-mest niet kwijt'

MPs Geurts and Slootweg asked why farmers forced to burn fipronil-contaminated manure at an incineration plant must pay waste tax while the Moerdijk plant is exempt, and whether the levy should be waived. The minister confirmed the tax applies by law, rejected a temporary exemption given greening policy in the coalition agreement, and pointed to a protocol and other processing options.
Amending the Wbm to include an exemption or zero rate in the waste tax for incidental cases is not appropriate.
Een aanpassing van de Wbm om in de ASB voor incidentele gevallen een vrijstelling of nihiltarief op te nemen ligt niet in de rede.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Geurts en Omtzigt over de economische consequenties van de Brexit voor Nederland

CDA MPs asked the government about the economic consequences of Brexit for the Netherlands, focusing on a customs impact memo, customs staffing needs (500-800 extra staff), IT readiness and the timing of recruitment. The government answered that the Douane and NVWA are recruiting within existing frameworks, that analyses for internal deliberation will not be shared, and that preparations continue ahead of March 2019.
The analyses requested by your House were, however, prepared for internal deliberation and it is undesirable that they become the subject of political debate.
De door uw Kamer gevraagde analyses zijn echter opgesteld voor intern beraad en het is onwenselijk dat zij onderwerp zijn van politiek debat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Geurts, Omtzigt, Von Martels en Slootweg over transparantie regionaal BO van 18 december 2017 en Alderstafel Lelystad Airport

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about transparency of the regional administrative consultation of 18 December 2017, whether minutes and agenda would be public, the remaining steps before the environmental impact report, and the evaluation of the Schiphol advisory council. The Minister confirmed the importance of transparency but declined to publish the minutes of the 18 December consultation for now, citing confidential input from provincial officials, and promised further consultation and a letter to parliament in early February.
Therefore I will not yet make the minutes of the administrative consultation of 18 December 2017 public at this time.
Derhalve zal ik het verslag van het bestuurlijk overleg van 18 december 2017 op dit moment nog niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Dik-Faber over de fipronilschade van pluimveehouders

MPs Geurts and Dik-Faber asked the minister about the European Commission's approval of Belgian compensation for fipronil-contaminated poultry farmers, whether this creates an unequal playing field, and what support is available. The minister answered that the Commission deems the crisis to fall under compensable exceptional events for Belgium only, that compensation is not due for damage caused by private parties and that the Dutch position is unchanged, while listing Dutch support measures and noting the Commission found no distortion of competition.
Government compensation is not at issue if damage was caused by the actions of private parties.
Compensatie door de overheid is niet aan de orde als schade is veroorzaakt door het handelen van private partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Geurts en Omtzigt over de economische consequenties van de Brexit voor Nederland

Three CDA MPs asked the government about the economic consequences of a hard Brexit for the Netherlands, including the KPMG report on non-tariff trade barriers, planned actions, customs and inspection capacity, and information provision to businesses. The government answered that it is intensifying business information, hiring extra customs and NVWA staff, and that the cost of a hard Brexit is estimated at about 1.2% of GDP, while stressing that the EU-UK arrangements are still under negotiation.
The precise effect on employment is difficult to estimate, because trade can also shift to other countries and new jobs can therefore also arise.
Het precieze effect op de werkgelegenheid is moeilijk in te schatten, omdat handel zich ook kan verplaatsten naar andere landen en er dus ook weer nieuwe banen kunnen ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht 'De overheid is de regie kwijt in het bestrijden van overlast van ratten'

An MP from the CDA asked ministers about reports that government has lost control of rat control, including the health risks, the RIVM rat monitoring, WHO advice, the status of an initiative group, the effectiveness of integrated pest management and public information for households. The ministers answered that three ministries share responsibility, that no national plague or clear rise in rat-related disease is visible, that existing legal frameworks cover prevention, and that monitoring, a planned effectiveness study and consumer information are under way.
Three ministries jointly lead the control of rat nuisance.
Er zijn drie ministeries die gezamenlijk regie voeren op het bestrijden van overlast van ratten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Geurts en Dijkgraaf over het bericht van het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek over het Living Planet Report

MPs Bruins, Geurts and Dijkgraaf asked about a CBS Living Planet Report claim that bottom trawling is a major cause of decline in North Sea benthic fauna, which Wageningen Marine Research said could not be concluded from its data, and about CBS's paid work for interest groups. The minister confirms the data sources, says CBS corrected the claim to attribute the finding to Wageningen research, and states that CBS's paid-work terms preserve its independence, while declining to go further on rectification or apology.
CBS concluded that its original report of 30 October required adjustments on some points and published a revised version on 3 November.
Het CBS is tot de conclusie gekomen dat het oorspronkelijke bericht van 30 oktober jl. op enkele punten aanpassing behoefde en heeft op 3 november jl. een aangepaste versie gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Geurts over het bericht ‘NVWA gebruikt satellietdata bij controles vanggewas’

The CDA MPs asked whether satellite data used by the NVWA to check cover crops could also detect illegal cannabis plantations hidden among farmers' crops, and whether research or cooperation with the police is possible. The minister answered that a police experiment in 2016 found under 10% of satellite-flagged cases were actually cannabis, so the approach is not yet effective, though it may be reconsidered, and the ministry is examining how satellite technology can help police.
The experiment showed that fewer than 10% of the cases flagged by satellite images actually involved cannabis.
Uit het experiment is gebleken dat minder dan 10% van de door satellietbeelden aangeduide gevallen daadwerkelijk cannabis betroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, De Groot, Geurts en Lodders over gegevensverstrekking aan Brancheorganisatie Akkerbouw voor het programma Onderzoek en Innovatie

MPs asked whether the minister should give the agricultural sector body BO Akkerbouw the names, addresses and acreage data of non-member farms, given data-protection limits and administrative burden, for a mandatory research levy. The minister declined direct transfer of the data, offering instead KvK data transfers and an opt-in consent route via RVO.nl, arguing this is proportionate and workable under the Wbp.
This means that providing the acreage data, without the farms having given consent, does not meet the requirements of proportionality and subsidiarity.
Dit maakt dat het verstrekken van de areaalgegevens, zonder dat de akkerbouwbedrijven daar toestemming voor gegeven hebben, niet voldoet aan de eisen van proportionaliteit en subsidiariteit
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Geurts over het landelijk asbestvolgsysteem en de programmatische aanpak asbestdaken

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary about recurring faults, slowness and usability problems with the national asbestos tracking system LAVS, and about rules that prevent combining indoor and outdoor asbestos removal on agricultural buildings. The government answers that problems are normal during ICT development, that capacity and user meetings are being improved, and that combined indoor-outdoor removal is not prohibited, with a handbook under review.
In consultation with users, problems are discussed and addressed as quickly as possible.
In overleg met de gebruikers worden problemen besproken en zo snel mogelijk geadresseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Geurts, Dik-Faber en De Groot over fipronil in eieren

MPs Lodders, Geurts, Dik-Faber and De Groot asked the ministers about the fipronil egg crisis, including a toxicologist's claim that the Dutch limit is too strict, the RASFF notification process, when the Netherlands knew of contamination, and differing risk approaches across member states. The government defended the EU residue limit, explained the RASFF process and the ARfD and ADI tests used, admitted a date error, and said it would examine the differences in approach.
For the answer to this question I refer you to our letter of 10 August.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik u naar onze brief van 10 augustus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van Toorenburg over drugsdumpingen en waterkwaliteit

MPs Geurts and Van Toorenburg asked the ministers about rising illegal drug waste dumping and its effects on water quality, enforcement in rural areas and registration. The state secretary confirmed rising recorded dumpings, said they affect wastewater treatment and surface water only occasionally, and described existing cooperation, saying further enforcement measures are sufficient and registration is being improved.
I acknowledge the importance of good registration, both for obtaining a complete picture and for tracing the perpetrators.
Ik erken het belang van goede registratie, zowel ten behoeve van het verkrijgen van een volledig beeld als ten behoeve van het opsporen van de daders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het teruggeven van het geld aan het bedrijfsleven uit de reserves van de product- en bedrijfschappen

An MP asked the government about reserves of the former product and trade boards and how leftover funds will be used, and asked for an overview of reserves, social plan spending, the liquidator's costs and timing. The government answered that reserves are published per board, that the liquidation runs to 2018 or later with leftover funds to be used for a general purpose benefiting the sector, and gave staffing and cost figures.

As I indicated to the House, I intend to decide on what can best be done with the money once it is clear whether any money remains and, if so, how much, and it is my intention to inform the House of that.

Zoals ik in de Kamer heb aangegeven ben ik van plan om op het moment dat duidelijk is of er geld over is en, zo ja, hoeveel een besluit te nemen over wat er zo goed mogelijk met dat geld kan worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Geurts over voedsel- en landbouwbeleid voor Caraïbisch Nederland

Two CDA MPs asked about food and agriculture policy for the Caribbean Netherlands, given trade deficits and high food prices, and whether UPG status could help. The government answered that agriculture is primarily the islands' own responsibility, supported by a modest EUR 150,000 per year fund, and that UPG status would bring limited benefits and substantial burdens.
It is therefore primarily up to the islands themselves to give substance to this.
Het is daarmee primair aan de eilanden zelf om hier invulling aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Amhaouch over het opleiden van asbestsaneerders en het plan van aanpak asbestsanering

MPs Geurts and Amhaouch (CDA) asked whether there are enough certified asbestos removers to clear all asbestos roofs by 2024, how many roofs remain, how many certified workers exist and how many were trained, and whether asbestos awareness should be built into basic construction training. The State Secretary answers that the 2024 deadline is feasible if work is spread over years, that about 100 million m2 of asbestos roof remains, that certified worker numbers rose sharply since 2013, and that asbestos is not a standard part of vocational construction curricula but schools can choose to address it, with no additional funding planned.
It is unknown in what percentage of all rental homes and public buildings asbestos-containing applications are still present.
Het is onbekend in hoeveel procent van alle huurwoningen en openbare gebouwen nog asbesthoudende toepassingen aanwezig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het fosfaatreductieplan 2017

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the 2017 phosphate reduction plan, including its effects on dairy farms started after 2 July 2015, the differing reference dates for dairy and non-dairy farms, the timing of RVO's reference determination, and bank forbearance. The State Secretary answered in detail, saying the scheme will be limited to dairy farms, that reference determination may take longer, and that the scheme will not be postponed.
Your House will be informed separately about this in the short term.
Uw Kamer wordt hier op korte termijn separaat over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over onduidelijke totstandkoming prijzen voor drinkwater

MP Geurts (CDA) asked why drinking water tariff-setting remains opaque despite repeated ILT and ACM criticism and promised improvements, and what will change. The minister acknowledges the lack of transparency in cost separation and tariff justification, says ILT's enforcement continues via a 2018 instruction, and promises the Drinkwaterwet evaluation (summer 2017) will address tariffs and ACM's position.
The formation of the tariffs must be transparent.
De totstandkoming van de tarieven dient transparant te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Dik-Faber, Remco Dijkstra, Ouwehand, Cegerek, Van Veldhoven, Van Tongeren en Geurts over het bericht dat chemiebedrijven de veiligheidsregels schenden

MPs asked the state secretary how to respond to reports that more than half of Dutch major-risk chemical firms repeatedly violated safety rules, including risks to workers and residents in Zaltbommel and how inspections and enforcement work. The state secretary replied that violations fell from 850 to 615 in 2015, that most are light offences, that inspectors act immediately on serious ones, that Zaltbommel is being handled through a planning and permit process, and that repeat offenders face escalated sanctions.
As previously promised, I will send the State of Safety of Major Risk Companies report for 2016 to your House before the summer, including an analysis of regional differences in compliance rates.
Zoals eerder toegezegd, zal ik de Staat van de Veiligheid Majeure Risicobedrijven over 2016 voor de zomer naar uw Kamer sturen inclusief een analyse van regionale verschillen in naleefpercentages.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Pieter Heerma en Agnes Mulder over de berichten “Bod Unilever van baan” en “De drie meedogenloze saneerders uit Brazilië”

Three CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and the Prime Minister about a reported takeover bid for Unilever by 3G Capital, including effects on Dutch jobs, R&D, food security, sustainability, and whether Dutch takeover protection could block it. The minister answered most questions on substance, noting the bid is off the table, the Netherlands' Corporate Governance Code applies, and the planned telecom-only takeover law does not cover this sector, with no commitment to block a future bid.
As long as the acquiring party would maintain a statutory Dutch-based listed company, that listed company falls under the scope of the Dutch Corporate Governance Code.

Zolang de overnemende partij een statutair in Nederland gevestigde vennootschap met beursnotering zou handhaven, valt die beursvennootschap onder de reikwijdte van de Nederlandse Corporate Governance Code.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Geurts en Ronnes over schadevergoeding door de kapotte stuw bij Grave

Three CDA MPs asked the minister whether the state bears responsibility, through the lack of a calamity plan and slow repairs, for damages from the broken Grave weir, and whether the damage should be compensated. The minister answered that the damage was caused by the ship collision rather than a government act, so no nadeelcompensatie applies; the investigation is ongoing and the shipowner's liability-limitation request is pending in court.
However, this damage is not the result of a government decision or action, but the direct consequence of the collision.
Deze schade is echter niet het gevolg van een besluit of handeling van de overheid, maar het directe gevolg van de aanvaring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het mogelijke einde van de toelating van een actieve stof die onmisbaar is voor de bewaring en export van uien

An MP asked whether the Dutch government is aware that the EU may not renew approval of maleic hydrazide, a substance vital for onion storage and export, and what it will do to keep it available. The state secretary confirmed awareness of the sector's dependence, said the substance is under periodic EU re-assessment and that he will not anticipate the outcome, and referred back to that answer on the remaining questions.
Since the European re-assessment process is still ongoing, I do not wish to anticipate its outcome.
Aangezien het proces van de Europese herbeoordeling nog loopt, wil ik niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomst daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Geurts en Ronnes over de stuw bij Grave

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the damaged weir at Grave, its causes, impacts on inland shipping, residents of houseboats, dikes and other businesses, and why municipalities in Gelderland were informed later than those in Brabant. The minister answered that the cause cannot yet be determined pending a police investigation, described temporary and permanent repair measures, said the damage is not fully quantified, and promised an independent evaluation of the incident expected in spring 2017.
I cannot assess that at present. An independent evaluation will be carried out into the incident with the ship at the Grave weir.
Ik kan dat momenteel niet beoordelen. Er zal een onafhankelijke evaluatie worden uitgevoerd naar het incident met het schip bij de stuw Grave.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over opbrengstafhankelijke gebruiksnormen voor de akkerbouw

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the European Commission's objections to yield-dependent manure use norms for arable farming have not been resolved after roughly two and a half years, and what will be done to allow equivalent measures in 2017. The State Secretary replied that the Commission was only substantively informed in October 2015, that it raised concerns about environmental effects and issued a detailed opinion in October 2016, and that the government will try to address those concerns and possibly adjust the measures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de derde beoordeling voor het mogen houden van zoogdieren in drie jaar door dit kabinet

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the positive list for mammal keeping has been re-assessed three times in three years, what problems it solves, and why the criteria and method changed. The State Secretary answers that the criteria are unchanged, the method was only clarified on the legal framework, the Landsadvocaat found the framework legally correct, and stakeholders have been involved since 2014.
The criteria for designating animal species or animal categories on the positive list are set out in article 1.4 of the Besluit houders van dieren.
De criteria voor aanwijzing van diersoorten of diercategorieën op de positieflijst staan vermeld in art. 1.4 Besluit houders van dieren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Geurts over het mislopen van miljoenen euro’s aan GMO-subsidie voor telersverenigingen vanwege onduidelijkheid en te late bekendmaking door de Nederlandse overheid

MPs Dik-Faber and Geurts asked why only one Dutch grower association submitted an operational plan for EU fruit and vegetable GMO subsidies, and why the national strategy was published late. The Secretary of State acknowledged the shortfall, explained the strategy was agreed with the sector in April and the rules published in July, and pointed to a new expertise centre and ongoing consultation as remedies.
I agree that it is regrettable that more producer organisations have not submitted operational programmes for 2017.
Ik ben het met u eens dat het spijtig is dat niet meer producentenorganisaties operationele programma's voor 2017 hebben ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Geurts over de aansluiting A30/A1

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about regional co-financing for the A30/A1 junction, after local authorities and the province offered funds. The minister confirms awareness of the offers, says she is willing to agree co-financing but only if there is a national bottleneck, and will wait for the 2017 NMCA results before talking with the region.
I am willing to make agreements with the region on co-financing the reconstruction of the A1/A30 junction.
Ik ben bereid met de regio afspraken te maken over cofinanciering bij de reconstructie van de aansluiting A1/A30.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Geurts over het tegenhouden van het energiebesparingssysteem glastuinbouw door het Ministerie van Economische Zaken

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the ministry is not declaring the greenhouse horticulture energy-saving scheme (EBG) generally binding despite broad sector support and the government's own plans for sustainability initiatives. The minister answered that the request is still under assessment against applicable frameworks, that he supports the scheme's energy-saving goal, and that a separate planned bill on sustainability agreements has different conditions, promising to inform parliament as soon as possible.
The State Secretary and I will inform your House as soon as possible about the assessment of the request.
De Staatssecretaris en ik zullen uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk over de beoordeling van het verzoek informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Dijkgraaf over niet uitbetalen betalingsrechten en behandeling bezwaren

MPs Geurts and Dijkgraaf asked about thousands of unresolved objections to 2015 payment-right decisions by the agricultural agency RVO, including the share upheld, extended deadlines, and the timing of 2016 payments. The state secretary answered that about 1,400 objections had been upheld in part or in full (about 0.14% of payments), that remaining cases will be settled by 1 April 2017, and that a 2016 payment schedule was sent separately.
Before 1 April 2017, all objections are expected to have been processed.
Voor 1 april 2017 zullen alle bezwaren naar verwachting zijn afgehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Dijkgraaf en Geurts over het persbericht ‘Innovatieve schimmel alternatief voor landbouwgif’

Three MPs asked why the Ministry of Economic Affairs press release on a fungus-based alternative used the term 'landbouwgif' rather than the statutory 'gewasbeschermingsmiddelen', and whether this framing harms agriculture. The Secretary of State acknowledged the term was chosen for a general audience, said the pilots for low-risk alternatives are still in the start-up phase, and stressed the importance of an adequate effective pesticide package.
The word landbouwgif was used as a synonym for the high-risk plant protection products.
Het woord landbouwgif is als synoniem gebruikt voor de risicovolle gewasbeschermingsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf, Geurts en Lodders over het bericht dat fabrikanten woest zijn over eenzijdige aanpassing van emissies innovatieve stalvloeren

MPs Dijkgraaf, Geurts and Lodders asked why the government adjusted emission measurements for innovative low-emission stable floors, whether Wageningen University's overlapping roles are independent, why the Aeromix system received no provisional emission factor, and about the professionalisation of the advisory committee TacRav. The State Secretary answered that a expert panel is reviewing the measurements, a third party will advise by November, definitive factors are expected early 2017, and the TacRav professionalisation will be audited.
I want to have the advice at my disposal in November, so that after consultation with those involved I can definitively set the emission factors in early 2017.
Het advies wil ik in november tot mijn beschikking hebben, zodat ik na overleg met betrokkenen begin 2017 de emissiefactoren definitief kan vaststellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het afbreken door de overheid van vertrouwen en bereidwilligheid bij vissers om deel te nemen aan innovatieve projecten

MP Geurts asks whether clawbacks and reduced payments on innovative fisheries projects under the European Fisheries Fund, including retroactive application of 2015 rules, are eroding trust and innovation in the sector. The State Secretary answers that clawbacks follow strict application of EU rules after audit findings, that they are reserved for cases where beneficiaries should have known costs were ineligible, that objection and appeal remain open, and that a new innovation scheme is being explored.
As indicated, subsidies are only reclaimed from beneficiaries if the beneficiary could or should have known that the declared costs were not eligible under applicable laws and regulations.

Zoals aangegeven, worden de subsidies bij de begunstigden alleen teruggevorderd als de begunstigde kon of had behoren te weten dat de opgevoerde kosten op grond van de geldende wet- en regelgeving niet subsidiabel waren.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Geurts over de vrijstelling van mestverwerking voor biologische bedrijven

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether manure transfer from organic dairy farms to organic arable farms counts as manure processing under the grassland-dependency rules, and what proof organic dairy farmers must provide for the exemption. The State Secretary confirmed that organic production is treated as manure processing, that four organic dairy farms applied for the exemption, and that financial commitments causing a disproportionate cost must be shown, while organic certification alone is not such a commitment.
Organic certification does have financial aspects, but organic certification in itself is not a financial obligation that by definition leads to a disproportionate financial burden.

Biologische certificering heeft weliswaar ook financiële aspecten, maar biologische certificering op zich is geen financiële verplichting die per definitie leidt tot een disproportionele financiële last.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Dijkgraaf, Visser, Geurts, Graus, Bruins, Van Klaveren en Van Vliet over het bericht dat een groot deel van de Noordzee nauwelijks bevist wordt

MPs asked the minister whether the finding that nearly 40% of the North Sea is barely fished changes the government's commitment to closing 10% of Dutch waters to bottom-trawling and the proposed extra closures on the Friese Front and Centrale Oestergronden. The minister answered that the study does not address protected ecological areas, which is the focus of the Dutch ambition, that the proposal remains a valid implementation of the 10-15% goal, and that she will inform parliament on how the Bisschop motion is executed, but could not answer before the committee meeting.
Soon I will, on behalf of the State Secretary for Economic Affairs as well, inform your House how I have executed the Bisschop motion.
Binnenkort zal ik, mede namens de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, uw Kamer informeren hoe ik de motie Bisschop heb uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de voorgenomen sancties door het CBS en het bericht «Verplichte deelname aan CBS-telling Varkensstapel van de zotte»

An MP from the CDA asked the government about mandatory CBS agricultural surveys with fines, the added administrative burden, the low response rates and the lack of prior communication. The ministers answered that the obligation follows from a 2015 AMvB consultation, that the CBS director-general decides independently on fines, and that a meeting with LTO is planned for 19 September.
The director-general of the CBS, as an independent administrative body, is independent in his choice whether or not to enforce a fine.
De directeur-generaal van het CBS is als zelfstandig bestuursorgaan onafhankelijk in zijn keuze om een boete wel of niet tot uitvoering te brengen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Lodders, Graus, Dik-Faber, Dijkgraaf,  Van Klaveren en Houwers over het bericht van Cumela om voor 24 augustus 2016 duidelijkheid te geven over het verzoek van Cumela voor uitstel

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs to clarify before 24 August 2016 whether he would postpone the manure spreading ban, as requested by the trade association Cumela. The State Secretary answered that he had asked the Technical Committee Soil for advice on a possible exemption under the Soil Protection Act, expected to decide within the week and communicate it promptly.
I expect this advice to be received shortly and will then decide on an exemption.
Ik verwacht dit advies op korte termijn te ontvangen en zal daarna besluiten over een vrijstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het onderwerp geen compensatie dubbele heffingen voor pluimveehouders voor het Diergezondheidsfonds door de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland

An MP from the CDA asks why poultry farmers with multi-year animals were charged twice for the Animal Health Fund levy in 2014 and 2015 and whether they will be compensated. The State Secretary acknowledges about 1,800 farms were disadvantaged, commits to refunding the double charge against the final 2015 assessment, and explains the calculation rules.
Therefore I will compensate the poultry farmers concerned.
Daarom zal ik de betrokken pluimveehouders tegemoet komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van Toorenburg over de gesubsidieerde milieurechtsbijstand

Two CDA MPs asked why legal-aid policy charges legal persons in environmental cases only 25% of the highest contribution, whether this rule was evaluated, and whether members' private wealth is considered. The minister explained the 2008 rule was meant to prevent exclusion of environmental groups, said no evaluation occurred and that the Raad voor rechtsbijstand will review it, provided usage figures, and held that members' private means are not relevant to the legal person's means test.
I will ask the Legal Aid Board to examine whether this measure, given its original objective, should be maintained.
Ik zal de raad voor rechtsbijstand verzoeken te onderzoeken of deze maatregel, gelet op de oorspronkelijke doelstelling daarvan, moet worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch en Geurts over ontheffing lengte samenstel van landbouwtrekkers en aanhangwagen(s)

MPs from the CDA asked why the RDW cannot grant exemptions for tractor-trailer combinations longer than 18.75 metres, whether enforcement is underway, and whether the RDW's mandate should be widened. The minister confirmed the 18.75 m limit (aligned with EU Directive 96/53/EG), said there is no national enforcement campaign though regional checks occurred, and declined to widen the RDW's mandate because exemptions fall to provincial or municipal road authorities.
The authority to grant an incidental exemption, for example for an indivisible load, lies with the provincial or municipal road authority.
De bevoegdheid om een incidentele ontheffing verlenen, bijvoorbeeld als het gaat om een ondeelbare lading, ligt bij de provinciale of gemeentelijke wegbeheerder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Geurts over de Nationale Reddingvloot

MPs Van Toorenburg and Geurts (CDA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that Reddingsbrigade Nederland's rescue fleet may be dismantled over unresolved funding after 2016. The minister answered that safety regions are responsible for water rescue capacity, that a one-off 2016 contribution was given, and that he urged the Veiligheidsberaad to reach structural arrangements before end of May.
It is the responsibility of the safety regions to provide sufficient rescue capacity during crises and disasters on and around water.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de veiligheidsregio’s om te voorzien in voldoende hulpverleningscapaciteit bij crises en rampen op en rond het water.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Geurts en Koser Kaya over het rapport van de Raad voor Regionaal Veevoer over de kansen en knelpunten voor eiwitrijke veevoergrondstoffen

MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the Raad voor Regionaal Veevoer report on increasing regionally grown protein feed and whether he would adopt its recommendations and a protein vision. The State Secretary agreed that regional protein production has potential, committed to exploring public-private initiatives, topsector focus and raising EU-level barriers, but said direct state steering of cultivation is not the preferred route and the transition will proceed more slowly than the report envisages.
I agree that regional cultivation and sale of protein crops can contribute more to improving the regional cycle.
Ik onderschrijf dat met de productie van regionale teelt en afzet van eiwitgewassen meer kan worden bijgedragen aan het verbeteren van de regionale kringloop
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het uitvoeren van equivalente maatregelen in het kader van het vijfde actieprogramma Nitraatrichtlijn

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the equivalent measures under the fifth Nitrates Directive action programme were not yet implemented for arable farming, and about the timing of the WUR study, the European Commission's response, and whether a regulation would be ready for the 2016 growing season. The State Secretary answered that the regulatory amendments are being prepared and expected to take about 6 to 9 months, that the Commission raised concerns but requires no formal approval, and that soil-improvers cannot be included due to lack of environmental evidence.
The procedures to anchor these measures in regulation will be started soon.
De procedures om deze maatregelen in regelgeving te verankeren zullen spoedig gestart worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Agnes Mulder over hernieuwbare energie in Noordwest-Europa en regelgeving voor de visserijsector

Two MPs from the CDA asked the government to respond to a European Parliament manifesto on North Sea renewable energy and to address fishing-sector rules around offshore wind farms, including transit for vessels over 24 metres. The minister agreed to strengthen North Sea cooperation, to broaden its scope to include fisheries, and to review transit rules after a two-year trial period from 2017.

Yes. It is important that the scope of North Sea cooperation on renewable energy is broadened, integrating among other things maritime spatial planning, including the fisheries and environmental dimensions.

Ja. Het is belangrijk dat de reikwijdte van de Noordzeesamenwerking rondom hernieuwbare energie wordt verbreed, waarbij onder andere maritieme ruimtelijke ordening, inclusief de visserij- en milieudimensie, integraal wordt meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Dijkgraaf en Geurts over de controle op de aanlandplicht

MPs Visser, Dijkgraaf and Geurts asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a confrontation between Dutch North Sea fishers and German inspectors over the landing obligation and reported widespread ignorance among inspectors. The State Secretary replied that German protocols matched EU rules, that Germany acted quickly, and that harmonisation of enforcement across North Sea states is ongoing but slow.
I have asked the other North Sea member states to share their inspection instructions more widely with one another.
Ik heb de andere lidstaten rondom de Noordzee verzocht om de controle-instructies breder met elkaar te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over ‘de manipulatie van de natuurstatistieken van het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving’

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretaries whether the PBL's biodiversity indicator (MSA) and its graph presentation give a skewed picture of Dutch nature, and whether investments in nature can be measured per euro. The government defended the MSA as an international instrument used for long-term and cross-regional comparison, pointed to the PBL's independent supervisory committee, and referred to existing technical documentation and evaluations, without committing to new action.
In addition, an advisory committee of the PBL made up of independent members is responsible for supervising the scientific quality and social relevance of the planning agency's work.

Daarnaast is een uit onafhankelijke leden bestaande Begeleidingscommissie van het PBL verantwoordelijk voor toezicht op de wetenschappelijke kwaliteit en de maatschappelijke relevantie van het werk van het planbureau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Geurts over de heffing van btw op subsidies voor rietlandbeheerders in de Weerribben en Wieden

Two MPs asked whether the government will help secure a VAT-free subsidy arrangement for reed-land managers in the Weerribben and Wieden after a tax inspector ruled them VAT-liable. The Secretary of State confirmed the ruling, said the arrangement cannot avoid VAT under EU rules as proposed, and pointed to alternative structures (a collective or a combined entity) and possible amendment of the provincial subsidy scheme while giving no firm commitment to a specific fix.

Within the framework of laws and regulations there is willingness to look, on a proposal from the parties involved, at a sector proposal for reed-land management under which no VAT is levied on the reed-land managers.

Binnen het kader van wet- en regelgeving bestaat de bereidheid om op voorstel van betrokken partijen te kijken naar een voorstel van de sector om te komen tot rietlandbeheer waarbij geen heffing van btw plaatsvindt bij de rietlandbeheerders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts inzake het vergoeden van telers bij plantenziekten naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Onderzoek bruinrot rozen uitgebreid’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the NVWA's handling of brown rot (Ralstonia solanacearum) in rose cultivation, including the slow pace toward eradication orders, whether growers should be compensated for costly destruction of plants, and the need for a plant health scheme. The State Secretary explained the NVWA's investigation steps and timelines, stated that compensation under Article 4 of the Plantenziektenwet is only granted in exceptional cases which do not apply here, and said he is intensively negotiating a plant health convenant and possible risk-coverage fund with the sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het overdragen van de melkveefosfaatreferentie aan opvolgers in de eerste, tweede of derde graad en wijzigen van de rechtsvorm van de onderneming

MP Geurts (CDA) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the dairy phosphate reference should remain transferable to heirs in the first to third degree of kinship even when the farm's legal form changes, and whether transfer to third parties could be broadened. The State Secretary answered that transfer within kinship is permitted, including via a partnership, but that the reference is lost on transfer to non-relatives or a legal entity, and declined to broaden transferability because of the policy aim and state aid concerns.
No, for the reasons given in the answers to the previous questions, in particular the answer to question 4.
Nee, vanwege de redenen zoals deze in de antwoorden op de voorgaande vragen en dan met name in het antwoord op vraag 4 zijn gegeven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Helvert en Geurts over de decharge die de aandeelhouder van de NS verleende op 4 maart 2015 tijdens de ALV, ondanks het feit dat toen al duidelijk was dat NS in 2014 de Spoorw

MPs Omtzigt, Van Helvert and Geurts asked why the shareholder granted discharge to NS management on 4 March 2015 although an ACM finding of a Railway Act breach was already foreseeable, and about the handling of the Veolia tender case, remuneration reports and bonuses. The minister answers that ministries were informed step by step, that NS did not yet know the ACM decision date on 4 March, that discharge covers only facts known at that time, and that remuneration information is publicly available in the annual reports.

Moreover, the shareholder grants discharge to the directors only for what the shareholder knew at that moment, and it does not amount to approval of the conduct for which the legal entity remains responsible.

Overigens geeft de aandeelhouder alleen decharge aan de bestuurders voor wat de aandeelhouder op dat moment (moment decharge) bekend is en betreft het hier geen goedkeuring van de gedragingen waarvoor de rechtspersoon verantwoordelijk is en blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Geurts over een juridische analyse van de visie van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) op de Kip van Morgen

MPs Dijkgraaf and Geurts asked whether an informal ACM view on the Kip van Morgen chicken-welfare agreement should meet motivation duties, whether public interests like sustainability and animal welfare are weighed, and how competition rules and the Wouters doctrine apply. The minister answered that the ACM must motivate informal views but at a lower bar, that public interests are considered, and promised a revised sustainability policy rule by year end and follow-up with the European Commission.
An informal view is a provisional judgment and does not bind the ACM or the undertakings involved.
Een informele zienswijze is een voorlopig oordeel en bindt de ACM en de betrokken ondernemingen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de wijziging van het Besluit gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en biociden betreffende gewasbescherming buiten de landbouw

The MP Geurts (CDA) asked the minister why a ministry official suggested the ban on pesticide use on paved areas outside agriculture would take effect in 2016 before the Chamber had discussed the draft decree, and how this fits with earlier promises not to take irreversible steps. The state secretary answered that no irreversible steps had been taken, that the official was only communicating expected timing, and that the Raad van State advice is expected in early 2016.
For the proper implementation of regulations it is important to be transparent and provide information during the drafting phase.
In het kader van de goede uitvoering van regelgeving is het belangrijk in de totstandkomingsfase daarvan transparant te zijn en voorlichting te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de wijziging van de gebiedsanalyse van Achter de Voort, Agelerbroek en Voltherbroek

An MP asked why the Achter de Voort, Agelerbroek and Voltherbroek area analysis was amended to add 46.2 hectares of pine forest in the buffer zone without prior consultation with the province and municipality. The State Secretary explained the amendment as a precautionary nitrogen measure, acknowledged the consultation shortfall, and said the pine planting was dropped in favour of a smaller broadleaf-based measure.
The ecological assessment could no longer be fully justified with the current restoration measures, so additional restoration measures were deemed necessary under the precautionary principle.
Het ecologisch oordeel was hierbij niet meer volledig te onderbouwen met de huidige herstelmaatregelen, waardoor vanuit het voorzorgbeginsel aanvullende herstelmaatregelen nodig worden geacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het bericht «Voormalig NS-topman Huges spant kort geding aan om vergoeding»

Three CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister about reports that former NS chief Huges sued for a large severance payment, whether his 2014 variable pay was reclaimed, and how NS governance and disclosure of the settlement work. The minister answered that the matter was settled out of court, the variable pay was repaid as part of the settlement, the shareholder discharge was granted, and the settlement will appear in the 2015 annual report, with the settlement document made available for confidential inspection.
I have made the settlement agreement itself available for confidential inspection.
De vaststellingsovereenkomst zelf heb ik ter vertrouwelijke inzage gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Lodders en Dijkgraaf over het openbaar maken van meetdata ammoniak door Wageningen Universiteit

MPs Geurts, Lodders and Dijkgraaf asked the state secretary whether Wageningen University should publish its ammonia measurement data and calculation methods behind manure emission factors, citing an international review's call for free data availability. The state secretary said the research was published and reviewed, that Wageningen UR is willing to share underlying data and show calculations to critics, and that older data from the 1990s no longer exists under the five-year retention rule, and declined to request further disclosure.

Since 1 January 2005 it has been customary to retain research data for 5 years, in accordance with the rules of the Dutch Code of Conduct for Research Integrity of the Association of Universities (VSNU).

Het is sinds 1 januari 2005 gebruikelijk om onderzoeksgegevens 5 jaar te bewaren, conform de hiervoor geldende regels vanuit de Nederlandse Gedragscode Wetenschapsbeoefening van de Vereniging van Universiteiten (VSNU).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over fors hogere pachtprijzen door verpachten van grond door het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Housing and Government Services and the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about sharply higher lease prices when the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf auctions farmland, the transfer of payment rights, sustainable land management, and bank guarantees. The minister answered that higher prices reflect scarcity, that a mandatory building plan and soil checks secure sustainable use, and that the outgoing tenants held liberalised leases that end, but gave limited detail on some points.
For land leased out in liberalised tenancy through public tender or auction, a building plan is prescribed.
Voor de grond die in geliberaliseerde pacht wordt uitgegeven door middel van een openbare inschrijving of een veiling per opbod wordt een bouwplan voorgeschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts inzake het gelijkberechtingingsdossier

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the equal-treatment dispute over nature management, including state aid law, the Marker Wadden project awarded to Natuurmonumenten without an open tender, and how such projects are allocated. The State Secretary replies that the current policy is compatible with state aid rules, that the European Commission has not yet ruled on the complaint, that the Marker Wadden tender was properly published, and that equal treatment is the agreed starting point with the provinces.
To give potentially interested cooperation partners the opportunity to participate, a public call was published in the Staatscourant on 17 September 2013.
Om potentieel geïnteresseerde samenwerkingspartners in de gelegenheid te stellen om deel te nemen, is op 17 september 2013 een openbare uitvraag gedaan in de Staatscourant
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Oskam over de toename van voedselfraude binnen het Europese voedselsysteem

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about the rise in food fraud in the EU, citing a 2015 Europol/OHIM report, and asked about EU coordination, training, labelling and non-EU organic certification fraud. The government answered that food fraud is hard to measure, that the NVWA, the Food Fraud Network and training initiatives are underway, and that importers and private certifiers bear primary responsibility.
Food is one of the many product categories that were assessed.
Voedsel is één van de vele productcategorieën die zijn beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het dumpen van grote zwerfkeien door Greenpeace op de Klaverbank

An MP asked whether the government would suspend its cooperation with Greenpeace after the NGO dumped large boulders on the Klaverbank, whether dumping should require a permit, and how Greenpeace could be held liable for damage to fishing. The Staatssecretaris answered that cooperation remains open, that the protest was disapproved of as risky and counterproductive, that the Raad van State ruled the earlier 2011 stones were not waste, that the Kustwacht monitored the action, and that any liability claim would be for fishers to pursue.
It will be assessed to what extent international law of the sea offers possibilities to make a provision for this in national regulation in the short term.
Beoordeeld zal worden in hoeverre er onder het internationale zeerecht mogelijkheden zijn om op korte termijn in de nationale regelgeving hiervoor een voorziening te treffen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het niet meer mogen afschrijven van productie- en ammoniakrechten

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Economic Affairs about the Tax Authority's decision to stop depreciation of production and ammonia rights, and whether this was agreed with the agricultural sector. The government answered that depreciation of production rights is allowed because their temporariness is demonstrable, that ammonia rights may be written off in 2014 and 2015 given the PAS, and that the Landelijke Landbouwnormen 2014 will be corrected.
The Landelijke Landbouwnormen 2014 will be adjusted on the point of production rights and ammonia rights.
De Landelijke Landbouwnormen 2014 zullen op het punt van de productierechten en ammoniakrechten aangepast worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het niet meer mogen afschrijven van productie- en ammoniakrechten

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Economic Affairs whether they knew of reports that the tax authority would correct depreciation of production and ammonia rights, and whether they would refrain from corrections and fines until consultation with accountants and the agricultural sector was completed. The State Secretary answered that he had decided to allow the depreciation and referred to earlier answers.
I have decided to allow the depreciation.
Ik heb besloten de afschrijving toe te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over uitspraken van de Eurocommissaris voor Betere Regelgeving over de Nederlandse implementatie van het Europese natuurbeleid

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary whether the government shares the EU Better Regulation Commissioner's view that Dutch implementation of EU nature directives causes many problems, and whether it will inventory these with the provinces and address them. The State Secretary acknowledged the Commissioner's remarks, said Dutch implementation is largely shaped by EU requirements but that national law can be improved (pointing to a pending nature protection bill), and said the economic and social factors are taken into account in management plans, while no firm new commitment beyond inventorying knowledge gaps was made.
Yes, the weighing takes place within the development of the management plan for the designated Natura 2000 area.
Ja, de afweging vindt plaats in het kader van de ontwikkeling van het beheerplan voor het aangewezen Natura 2000 gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over landschapselementen als invulling van de vergroening

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether landscape elements such as hedgerows and tree rows, including those under former agri-environment agreements, can count toward the ecological focus area of the EU greening requirement, and raised concerns about administrative burden and monitoring. The State Secretary answered that landscape elements are only partly eligible (field margins in the general list, managed elements within approved equivalent packages), that double financing must be avoided, and that a study on a growth model for landscape elements is underway.

In line with the adopted Jacobi, Dik-Faber motion, I am currently having a study carried out with Landschapsbeheer Nederland into the possibilities for a growth model for landscape elements as ecological focus area.

In lijn met de aangenomen motie Jacobi, Dik-Faber, Kamerstuk 28 625, nr. 214 van uw Kamer, laat ik thans in samenwerking met Landschapsbeheer Nederland een studie uitvoeren naar de mogelijkheden voor een groeimodel voor landschapselementen als ecologisch aandachtsgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts met betrekking tot “het onmogelijk maken van private kwaliteitssystemen”

An MP asks the government whether private quality systems in the pig and veal sectors, which fund mandatory self-checks on banned substances, can survive the abolition of the productschappen, and what consequences non-participation would have. The State Secretary answers that the sector is responsible for financing its own systems, that the regulation change takes effect 1 July 2015, that NVWA will supervise self-checks and may apply differentiated supervision, and that AVV cannot cover control costs.
As a result, it is now explicitly stated that not only processors of primary products, such as slaughterhouses, must carry out self-checks, but also livestock farmers.
Hierdoor wordt nu expliciet aangegeven dat niet alleen de verwerkers van primaire producten, zoals slachterijen, zelfcontrole moeten uitvoeren, maar ook de veehouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de Gemeenschappelijke Marktordening subsidies

MPs Geurts asked whether the government would uphold the former state secretary's position that corrections to fruit and vegetable CMO programmes (2006-2008) were the Dutch state's cost and not recoverable from beneficiaries, and about legal uncertainty, litigation, support for producer organisations and recovery practices in other member states. The state secretary answered that the 2014 CJEU ruling made the Commission's EUR 22.7 million correction final, that Dutch law requires recovery from beneficiaries in principle, that she has pressed the Commission on audit uncertainty, and that she has no insight into other member states' recovery practices.
I have no insight into the recovery practice of other member states following financial corrections imposed by the European Commission.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de terugvorderingspraktijk van andere lidstaten naar aanleiding van opgelegde financiële correcties van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Aukje de Vries, Geurts en De Rouwe over de toename, omvang en gevolgen van muizenschade in Friesland

MPs asked the state secretary about the growth and damage of mouse plagues in Friesland, the ban on ploughing grassland, the risk to dykes, and possible derogations from the Nitrates Directive action programme. The state secretary referred to earlier letters on most questions, said the ploughing ban rests on both environmental and agronomic considerations, and noted that nitrate levels in the affected area are well below the norm.
For the answer to these questions I refer you to my letter of 27 January 2015
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik u naar mijn brief van 27 januari 2015

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Geurts, Van Meenen en Schouten over de uitspraak van het Hof Arnhem-Leeuwarden, die de Belastingdienst in het ongelijk stelde en bepaalde dat deelkwalificaties wel in aanmerking k

MPs Omtzigt, Geurts, Van Meenen and Schouten asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Education about a Court of Appeal ruling that part-qualifications qualify for the education wage-tax reduction, including whether the Tax Service's corrections will be suspended, how firms are compensated, and whether bankruptcies or dropouts resulted. The government answered that it will file a cassation appeal before 29 January 2015, that corrections can be held pending the Supreme Court ruling on objection request, that refunds follow any Supreme Court outcome, and that it has no data on affected firms, students or bankruptcies.
I intend to file a cassation appeal against this ruling.
Ik ben voornemens om tegen deze uitspraak in cassatie te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht “melkvee heeft geen negatief effect op natuur”

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a V-focus article claiming dairy cattle have no negative effect on nature, and about a report on land-use interweaving in Noordoost-Twente. The State Secretary largely rejected the article's conclusions, stated that nature remains harmed by nitrogen deposition, and declined further studies and early answers while noting the EU Habitats Directive evaluation timetable.
Government policy aims to further build on this recovery while also giving agriculture (and other economic sectors) room, among other things through the Programmatic Approach to Nitrogen.

Het regeringsbeleid is erop gericht om dit herstel verder uit te bouwen én ook de landbouw (en andere economische sectoren) ruimte te geven, onder andere door middel van de Programmatische Aanpak Stikstof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over het bericht dat WVA wordt teruggevorderd bij transportbedrijven

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked why the Belastingdienst is reclaiming the education wage-tax discount (AV Onderwijs) from transport firms, and how education quality and eligibility are checked. The minister answered that about 36 firms face recovery for €3.5 million, that the Belastingdienst verifies WVA conditions while the Inspectie judges education quality, and that recovery cannot be repaired retroactively.
At 36 companies the AV onderwijs has been reclaimed, for a total amount of about €3.5 million.
Bij 36 bedrijven heeft terugvordering van de AV onderwijs plaatsgevonden, voor een totaalbedrag van circa € 3,5 miljoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over cross compliance en natuurbeschermingswetvergunning

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about farmers in Limburg facing cuts to income support under cross compliance for lacking a Natura 2000 permit, whether such permits are required for all agricultural activities, whether the rule changes from 2015, whether the Programmatic Approach to Nitrogen (PAS) will solve the problem and when it will be sent to parliament, and how cuts can be avoided. The State Secretary answered that permit possession remains a cross compliance condition, listed the specific rule changes for 2015, explained that the PAS offers a framework for permitting, and said farmers can avoid cuts by applying for a permit and that no cut applies where the authority fails to decide within statutory deadlines.
A farmer can avoid a cut by submitting a complete application with all required data for a nature protection permit.
Een landbouwer kan een korting voorkomen door alsnog een volledige aanvraag met alle benodigde gegevens voor een natuurbeschermingsvergunning te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de noodsituatie van kippenboeren

CDA MP Geurts asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the financial crisis facing Dutch egg farmers, the causes of oversupply, imports of eggs from outside the EU, the enforcement of the EU battery cage ban, and whether animal welfare standards can be applied to imports under WTO and trade-agreement rules. The State Secretary answered that the market must correct itself, gave import figures, and said animal welfare cannot currently be required of third-country imports under WTO rules, with trade deals not expected to lower EU standards.
The cabinet considers further improving animal welfare important and actively contributes to adjustments of EU animal welfare policy and regulation.
Het kabinet vindt het verder verbeteren van dierenwelzijn belangrijk en denkt actief mee bij aanpassingen van het Europese dierenwelzijnsbeleid en Europese dierenwelzijnsregelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Toorenburg, Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over het bericht dat ontbreken GSM dekking levens kan kosten

MPs from the CDA asked the government about a reported death in Lattrop where AED alerts did not arrive, whether mobile coverage gaps endanger lives, and whether providers meet licence coverage obligations. The Minister replied that the network functioned properly, that 100% coverage is not achievable, that alternative emergency routes are advised, and that no coverage requirements exist in current frequency licences, with a ministry study on mobile coverage and 112 announced.
I do not have such information available.
Dergelijke informatie heb ik niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Hijum en Omtzigt over de vergoeding voor rietlandbeheer

MPs Geurts, Van Hijum and Omtzigt asked why subsidies paid by provinces to nature managers are exempt from VAT while payments from nature managers to reed cutters are subject to VAT, and asked about the basis for a possible exemption. The State Secretary explained the VAT treatment under EU case law, that the subsidy scheme is taxable only where the payment is consumed, and that stakeholders and government are exploring a restructured single-entity arrangement.

Representatives of private reed managers, Staatsbosbeheer, Natuurmonumenten, the province of Overijssel and the Ministry of Economic Affairs are examining whether the relationship between reed managers and land owners can be changed and formalised so that there is a single entity.

Vertegenwoordigers van de particuliere rietlandbeheerders, Staatsbosbeheer, Natuurmonumenten, de provincie Overijssel en het Ministerie van Economische Zaken onderzoeken of de relatie tussen rietlandbeheerders en terreineigenaren zodanig gewijzigd en geformaliseerd kan worden, dat sprake is van één entiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht dat het mestbeleid een koude douche voor boeren is

An MP from the CDA asked the government about a press report that manure policy is a cold shower for farmers, questioning whether the cabinet ignores business input, why LTO's proposals on the fifth Nitrates Action Programme were not adopted, the status of equivalent-measures and phosphate-chain agreements, and whether negotiation documents with the European Commission on the derogation will be shared. The State Secretary largely defended the process, refused to release negotiation documents and departmental involvement details, and acknowledged that communication on the phosphate-fertiliser ban could have been better, without offering an apology.
I will not make available any documents relating to the course of the negotiations with the European Commission.
Ik zal geen documenten ter beschikking stellen die betrekking hebben op het verloop van de onderhandeling met de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf, Lodders en Geurts over het rapport van Watermaatschappij Limburg over mogelijke overschatting van nitraatgehaltes in lössgrond

Three MPs asked the State Secretary about a Watermaatschappij Limburg report suggesting nitrate levels in loess soil may be overestimated by about 30% compared with RIVM's method, and whether this affects loess-soil use standards and EU reporting. The State Secretary answered that the report rests on a very small dataset, that the nationwide monitoring network (LMM) and model calculations still show concentrations above the 50 mg/l target, that WML and RIVM will discuss the methodology, and that a pilot with equivalent measures in loess areas is viewed positively.
RIVM and WML will soon enter into discussion about the methodology of nitrate measurements.
RIVM en WML gaan op korte termijn in gesprek over de methodiek van nitraatmetingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Agnes Mulder en Geurts over de olielekkage uit opslag in lege zoutmijnen in het natuurgebied Amtsvenn (bij Enschede) en de geplande extra opslag van diesel in lege zoutmijnen onde

MPs Omtzigt, Mulder and Geurts asked about an oil leak from strategic oil storage in salt caverns at Amtsvenn in Germany and about planned diesel storage in salt caverns under Enschede, including risks to the Netherlands and whether operations should wait. The minister replied that the leak likely lies in a borehole casing, that Dutch risks are considered low, that the Enschede design differs and is monitored, that the regulator SodM can intervene, and that AkzoNobel may proceed with preparatory work but has said it will not store diesel until the German cause is clear.
If at any point I see a need to intervene, I can, under article 50 of the Mining Act, prescribe measures in cases of serious harm to safety or the environment or ground movement.

Indien ik op enig moment noodzaak zie tot ingrijpen, kan ik op grond van artikel 50 van de Mijnbouwwet, in gevallen van ernstige aantasting van de bescherming van de veiligheid, het milieu of in gevallen van beweging van de aardbodem, maatregelen voorschrijven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Hijum en Omtzigt over de zorgen die leven bij de Vereniging Natuurmonumenten over de beheersvergoedingen in het kader van het rietlandbeheer in Nationaal Park de Weerribben-Wie

CDA MPs asked whether the subsidy levels for reed-land management in the Weerribben-Wieden park are adequate, and whether the 2014 income-tax changes and 6% VAT rate undermine the SNL standard-cost system. The State Secretary says provinces set compensation at 75% of norm costs under the Natuurpact, that VAT is due on paid management outsourcing, that no relevant tax changes occurred, and that a reduced VAT rate is not possible under EU rules, while committing to no concrete action.

On the basis of the information known to me, I cannot assess whether and to what extent the management compensation provided to reed cutters is insufficient to achieve the desired nature quality through the summer mowing regime.

Op basis van de mij bekende gegevens kan ik niet beoordelen of en in hoeverre de verstrekte beheersvergoedingen die in het kader van het rietlandbeheer aan riettelers verstrekt worden ontoereikend zijn om de gewenste natuurkwaliteit via het regime van zomermaaibeheer te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Toorenburg, Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt Justitie over gsm-ontvangst in Nederland

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about poor mobile coverage in border municipalities and whether 112 emergency calls could fail, including how many complaints and cases occurred and what action was taken. The minister answered that 100% mobile coverage is not achievable, that no registration of failed emergency calls exists, that EZ is studying coverage reach, and that citizens are advised to use a landline in emergencies.
It is not registered in how many cases an acute emergency call was not possible because no mobile coverage was available.
Er wordt niet geregistreerd in hoeveel gevallen een acute noodoproep niet mogelijk was, omdat er geen mobiele dekking voorhanden was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Geurts over het bericht ‘Hoe een Amerikaanse zakenman miljoenen verdiende aan het failliete Aldel’

MPs Mulder and Geurts asked the Economics Minister to reflect on press reports that US businessman Klesch profited from the bankrupt Aldel, including dividends, management fees, pledges over assets and a possible 14 million euro gain, and on state and provincial support given to Aldel. The minister said curators' final report is awaited before the figures can be confirmed, listed the support given (including a provincial bridging loan with conditions) and said the provincial loan was secured on expected ETS compensation, while no pre-verification of the pledges was known at the time.
Curators are currently investigating Aldel. The date for delivery of the curators' final report is not yet known.
Momenteel doen curatoren onderzoek naar Aldel. De datum van oplevering van het eindverslag van de curatoren is nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over slechte prijzen voor Noordzeevis

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why North Sea fish prices (sole and plaice) remain low, whether fish prices can be included in the food price monitor, and how producer organisations and the ACM could enable better pricing and sales. The State Secretary answered that prices result from market supply and demand with no signs of insufficient competition, that the food price monitor excludes fish for cost reasons, that the existing EU framework already allows producer agreements, and that a revolving fund for fishing investment is planned for summer 2014.
I have no signals that there is insufficient market competition in the fish chain.
Ik heb geen signalen dat in de visketen onvoldoende marktwerking is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Bruins Slot over de dreigende sluiting van ruiter- en mountainbikepaden beheerd door Staatsbosbeheer

MPs Geurts and Bruins Slot asked whether the government shares fears that horse-riding and mountain-bike paths managed by Staatsbosbeheer will decline, and how it oversees path maintenance and possible user fees. The state secretary replied that no closures are planned, that the government does not supervise path maintenance, that it steers Staatsbosbeheer only at a general level, and that it leaves the matter to talks between the agency and sports federations.
The cabinet does not supervise this.
Het kabinet houdt hier geen toezicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en van Toorenburg over de GSM-ontvangst enquête van het CDA Zaltbommel

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Economic Affairs about poor mobile reception in the municipality of Zaltbommel, including whether residents can miss emergency alerts, whether 112 and AED access are endangered, whether emergency services are hindered, and whether the minister will meet the parties involved. The minister answered that alerts can be received through other channels, that 112 calls are adequately handled, that AED alternatives exist, and that a meeting is unnecessary because 4G rollout is expected to improve coverage, with an update promised later in the year.
I do not consider a meeting necessary.
Ik acht een gesprek niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en De Rouwe over het bericht heksenjacht bij erkende oormerkweigeraars

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that the NVWA blocked farms of conscientious objectors who refuse ear tags for cattle and removed animals, calling it a witch-hunt. The State Secretary answered that the protocol was terminated after repeated non-compliance, that blocking follows EU and national identification rules, that one farm also faced welfare neglect, and that the NVWA will re-check participants in Q4 2014.
The reason for the termination is that the conscientious objectors did not meet the conditions of the aforementioned protocol.
De reden voor de opzegging is dat de gewetensbezwaarden niet hebben voldaan aan de voorwaarden van het eerder genoemde protocol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Bisschop en Geurts over het bericht van een werkbezoek aan de gemeente Barneveld op 16 januari 2014

Three MPs asked the state secretary whether a rail terminal in Barneveld would reduce road freight and whether the ministry would help assess its feasibility, and about multimodal terminals generally. The state secretary answered that such initiatives are primarily a market responsibility, that ProRail will review any concrete proposal against existing policy, and that the national terminal network is considered sufficient until 2020, with selective strengthening on key corridors also under study.
For new market initiatives for rail terminals, ProRail will examine whether such projects meet the policy starting points set out in the policy framework.
Bij nieuwe marktinitiatieven voor railterminals zal ProRail bekijken of dergelijke projecten voldoen aan de beleidsuitgangspunten, zoals die verwoord staan in het beleidskader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over verhogingen lasten veehouderij
