The CDA MP Geurts asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the takeover of VION Ingredients by Darling International, government involvement, and sharp increases in carcass disposal tariffs for livestock farmers in 2014. The State Secretary answered that tariffs can only change with actual costs or revenues under the Besluit dierlijke producten, referred to her letter of 5 February 2014 for details, and stated that the government would further examine standard weights in the coming year.
In consultation with all parties it was decided to examine this carefully in the coming year as part of setting the tariffs.
In overleg met alle partijen is besloten hier het komende jaar nog zorgvuldig naar te kijken in het kader van de totstandkoming van de tarieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het gebruik van CO2 voor faunabeheer

An MP asked the state secretary whether CO2 gassing of geese should be allowed for population control and whether a temporary exemption could be granted, given crop damage and the stalled goose agreement. The government agreed CO2 is the most acceptable method but refused a temporary exemption because crop and nature damage does not meet the Biocides Regulation's health or environment threshold, and said the EU approval timeline cannot be influenced.
Combating geese because of nuisance to fields, meadows and nature does not fall under this definition and therefore does not qualify for an exemption.
Het bestrijden van ganzen vanwege overlast voor akkers, velden en natuur valt niet onder deze definitie en komt derhalve niet in aanmerking voor een vrijstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de essentaksterfte van 24 oktober 2013

Member Geurts (CDA) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about ash dieback (essentaksterfte), its threat to Dutch trees and landscape, and whether the government would fund or support research after the Productschap Tuinbouw stopped financing it. The State Secretary answered that only removing affected trees is currently possible, that the sector and tree growers should take the lead, that international research is supported, and that the nursery sector is expected to finance the research itself.
I am aware of ash dieback and recognise that the ash is an important tree species in our country for urban green, forest, nature and landscape.
Ik ben bekend met de essentaksterfte en besef dat de es een belangrijke boomsoort is in ons land voor het stedelijk groen, bos, natuur en landschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Geurts over vergunning blijft struikelblok mestverwerking

Two MPs asked whether the failure of permit granting for manure processing plants should affect the manure rights system and whether the government would evaluate or abolish it. The State Secretary said a national working group on speeding permits with the provinces and municipalities has been set up, a complaints point opened, and she will not abolish manure rights but will evaluate the Meststoffenwet annually.
I intend to evaluate the Meststoffenwet annually after its introduction on the objectives achieved.
Ik heb het voornemen om de meststoffenwet na invoering jaarlijks te evalueren op de behaalde doelstellingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over over het vijfde actieprogramma Nitraatrichtlijn

An MP asked why the government drops the 95 percent margin on manure excretion factors and what this means for Dutch farmers under the Nitrates Directive action programme. The Secretary of State answered that the margin understated manure production, so the factor moves to 100 percent from 1 January 2014, with updated standard values likely from 2015 and no retroactive effect.
I am not aware of any other member state that applies less than 100 percent.
Mij is niet bekend dat enige andere lidstaat minder dan 100 procent inrekent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Geurts en Dijkgraaf over de Nederlandse inzet inzake het vijfde actieprogramma Nitraatrichtlijn

Dutch MPs from VVD, CDA and SGP asked the state secretaries about the Dutch negotiating position on the fifth Nitrates Directive action programme, including the 50 mg nitrate standard, phosphate norms, the derogation and the lack of sector support. The government answered that the 50 mg standard is a binding target Netherlands committed to, that equivalent measures are being developed with LTO, and that it will press the Commission on monitoring results and the derogation.

I am in consultation with LTO on a number of these measures, with a view to having the required justification and assurance in place before the nitrogen use standards for leaching-sensitive crops in the southern sand and loess region are lowered on 1 January 2015.

Ik ben met LTO in overleg over een aantal van deze maatregelen met het oog op het beschikbaar hebben van de vereiste onderbouwing en borging voordat op 1 januari 2015 de stikstofgebruiksnormen voor uitspoelingsgevoelige gewassen in het zuidelijke zand- en lössgebied worden verlaagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Geurts over het bericht van de aangifte tegen Odfjell wegens het verzwijgen van een groot Methanol-incident

Opposition MPs Omtzigt and Geurts asked the government about reports that Odfjell concealed a major methanol incident in 2009, including whether it was reported, whether confidential dossiers can be made public, and whether management can be trusted. The state secretary said the incident should have been reported to the DCMR, that a criminal complaint has led to a prosecutor's assessment, that the dossier was released after a balancing test, and that Odfjell is under heightened supervision.

The public prosecution service informed the Minister of Security and Justice that it is currently considering whether, in view of this complaint, there is reason to launch a criminal investigation against Odfjell.

Het openbaar ministerie heeft de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie meegedeeld dat het momenteel beziet of er, gezien deze aangifte, aanleiding bestaat een daarop gericht strafrechtelijk onderzoek in te stellen tegen Odfjell.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht ‘Wachten op vergunning anti-hagelkanon’

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary why municipalities such as Borssele still face difficulties permitting anti-hail cannons despite the 2013 Bor amendment, and whether guidance or an exemption for occasional use would be issued. The state secretary replied that the amendment met the earlier commitment by placing permitting with local authorities, that the 2011 guidance and a May 2013 letter support municipalities, and that no general exemption or rule is appropriate given local noise concerns.
In my view there is therefore no discrepancy between the commitment I made to regulate the use of the anti-hail cannon and its concrete implementation.
Naar mijn mening is er dan ook geen sprake van discrepantie tussen de door mij gedane toezegging voor het regelen van het gebruik van het anti-hagelkanon
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht: ‘kippen- en varkensstallen meest duurzaam’

An MP from the CDA asked why sustainable barns lag in dairy farming, whether open and grazing systems should count in the monitor, and how the sustainable barn investment scheme and budget cuts affect progress. The state secretary answered that the monitor covers only certified or subsidised integrally sustainable barns, that the scheme is oversubscribed, and that a sector stimulus package and an all-sustainable-new-build requirement from 2015 are planned.
For the 2014 monitor, it will be examined whether new developments in integrally sustainable barns and housing systems can be included.
Ten behoeve van de monitor 2014 wordt nagegaan of nieuwe ontwikkelingen op het terrein van integraal duurzame stallen en houderijsystemen kunnen worden opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Rog en Geurts over de inhoud van het examen Nederlands voor havo

MPs Rog and Geurts asked why an opinion piece by professor Roos Vonk, reprimanded for improper conduct and linked to fabricated research, was used in the havo Dutch exam, and whether a note or the College voor Examens should have been consulted. The state secretary replied that the text was chosen for reading and argumentation skills, that it is an opinion piece without cited research, that no source note is required for opinion texts, and that he sees no need to discuss the choice with the College voor Examens.
The piece contains the personal opinion of Ms Vonk on a publicly known theme, but no references to research by Ms Vonk or Mr Stapel.

Het Centraal Eindexamen Nederlands ... Het stuk bevat de persoonlijke mening van mevrouw Vonk op een maatschappelijk bekend thema, maar geen verwijzingen naar onderzoek van mevrouw Vonk of de heer Stapel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Geurts over het bericht “Signaal onderwijsminister onjuist”

MPs Rog and Geurts (CDA) asked the Minister of Education whether her figures on unemployment among graduates of the animal care vocational programme were accurate, and whether her portrayal misrepresented career prospects after the course. The minister defended her use of ROA data, acknowledged the CBS pilot and planned improvements, and said she would look forward to more reliable CBS figures on labour-market position.
I did not want to use these CBS data, because the CBS establishes the labour-market position fairly shortly after graduation and only on an annual basis.
Ik heb deze gegevens van het CBS niet willen gebruiken, omdat het CBS vrij kort na diplomering en alleen op jaarbasis de arbeidsmarktpositie vaststelt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over "harde eisen van de arbeidsinspectie aan Odfjell na ernstige overtredingen" (De bijlage is ter vertrouwelijke inzage gelegd, alleen voor de leden, bij het Centraal I

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked whether the Labour Inspectorate's 2007 letter with eleven hard demands to Odfjell was complied with, and asked for the full file and all inspectorate letters to Odfjell over ten years to be made public. Minister Asscher confirmed the letter, listed the inspection visits and which violations were resolved, noted that the ATEX violation led to a criminal report and court ruling, and made the file and letters available only for confidential inspection by MPs due to the company's commercial interests.
Given Odfjell's commercial interests, I make this data available to your House only for confidential inspection.
Gelet op het bedrijfsbelang van Odfjell stel ik u deze gegevens vertrouwelijk, alleen ter inzage aan uw Kamer, ter beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht «EU will anbau von obst und gemuese gaerten verbieten»

An MP asked the state secretary whether EU plant-health and seed proposals would regulate small-scale growing such as urban farming, allotments and heirloom seeds. The state secretary answered that the Commission's proposals do not appear to require registration for hobby seed trade and that exemptions for small growers are welcome, and promised a BNC-fiche within six weeks.
In line with the agreement with the House of Representatives, the cabinet will send its position on these proposals via a so-called BNC-fiche as soon as possible, and at the latest within 6 weeks.
Conform afspraak met de Tweede Kamer zal het kabinet zo snel mogelijk, maar uiterlijk binnen 6 weken middels een zogenaamd BNC-fiche zijn standpunt over deze voorstellen toezenden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht “Toezicht overheid op MKZ-lab faalde jarenlang”

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the government would publish the EU Food and Veterinary Office inspection report on foot-and-mouth disease laboratories in Lelystad and Wageningen, and what it thought of its findings. The State Secretary answered that the report was released under a Wob request, that the only other inspection was a 2007 and 2009 national review, and that the recommendations were adopted in an action plan and the lab's safety reports were attached.
In consultation with the European Commission, I provided the report last month in the context of a Wob procedure.
In overleg met de Europese Commissie heb ik het rapport afgelopen maand verstrekt in het kader van een Wob-procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Bruins Slot over het bericht “Uitstoot van ammonia bij BASF De Meern”

MPs Geurts and Bruins Slot asked whether BASF De Meern was shut down over safety concerns after an ammonia and nitrogen oxide emission, and requested inspection histories, violations, sanctions and emission data. The government answered that the municipality halted the plant temporarily by administrative coercion, that the Inspectorate SZW found no worker safety risk, and listed past exceedances and inspection results, while noting that the ILT does not supervise the BRZO and that the answers needed more time.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht “Boetes monsterhoeveelheden; reacties fabrikanten en CUMELA”

An MP asks the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about reports of fines for insufficient manure sample volumes, whether problems with sampling equipment were known at approval, whether research reports will be shared, and about weighing and specific gravity rules at laboratories. The State Secretary answers that a 1999 field test flagged low fill levels with thick manure, that later studies found no such problems, that responsibility lies with the intermediary, and that the relevant norms and enforcement basis are described, while sharing the reports is not explicitly committed.
This research is public and can be found on the Wageningen-UR website.
Dit onderzoek is openbaar en terug te vinden op de website van Wageningen-UR.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Geurts over de gevolgen van de overname van Deutsche Bank voor diverse klantengroepen

MPs Van Hijum and Geurts asked the finance minister whether clients harmed by Deutsche Bank's takeover of an ABN Amro unit, required by the European Commission, should be protected, whether unilateral changes to financing terms are allowed, and what government role exists. The minister replied that material terms stayed the same, that Deutsche Bank says it will seek solutions per client, that strategy changes are a private business decision not for government to override, and that courts remain available.
I therefore see no role for the government in this.
Ik zie nu dan ook geen rol voor de overheid hierbij.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Geurts over de NMa opinie "Versterking landbouw vraagt om innovatie, niet om minder concurrentie"

An MP asked the ministers about an NMa opinion arguing that strengthening agriculture requires innovation rather than less competition, and whether the NMa's language about MEPs and national politicians undermines its independence. The minister answered that the NMa's opinion is within its independent role, that the government supports producer organisations under the CAP reform while keeping competition rules, and that the NMa will supervise compliance with competition rules.
The NMa, from its economic expertise, states how it views the CAP reforms and the role competition should play in them.
De NMa geeft vanuit haar economische expertise aan hoe zij aankijkt tegen de hervormingen in het GLB en de rol die mededinging daar in zou moeten nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Geurts over de gevolgen van stopzetten (agrarische) financiering door Deutsche Bank

MPs Van Hijum and Geurts (CDA) asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the consequences of Deutsche Bank ending agricultural lending, including possible unfair terms for clients moved from ABN AMRO, complaints received, and support for farmers' financing. The government answered that the decision is a private business choice, that the EC remedy set no lending-terms commitments, that AFM cannot disclose investigations, and that existing agricultural support measures are in place.
However, the AFM cannot make any statements about possible investigations into individual institutions.
Over mogelijke onderzoeken naar individuele instellingen kan de AFM echter geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht dat emissiearme vloeren van de RAV-lijst verdwijnen

An MP asked about reports that low-emission cattle floors risk being removed from the RAV list and whether this affects the PAS, and about privatising RAV assessment. The minister says the floors will be dropped in 2014 unless measured, that PAS targets should still be met, and that metering subsidies and emission-factor updates are being pursued.
Early this year I will inform manufacturers of the consequences of not measuring their system.
Begin dit jaar zal ik fabrikanten wijzen op de gevolgen van het niet bemeten van hun systeem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over de rapporten over de BRZO-rapportage van Odfjell van oktober 2012

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked the state secretary about the October 2012 BRZO inspection reports on Odfjell, fines imposed on Seveso firms, incident reports, safety after the reorganisation, pipe-thickness checks and whistleblower channels. The secretary released the inspection report, which found violations enforced against but not dangerous enough to stop operations, and described the monitoring, enforcement and whistleblower arrangements, promising a monitoring report by mid-2013.
The inspection report for inspection days 1, 9, 10, 11, 16 and 17 October 2012 was released on 8 February 2013.
Het inspectierapport van inspectiedagen 1, 9, 10, 11, 16 en 17 oktober 2012 is op 8 februari 2013 vrijgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Geurts over het artikel «Achterhoek is spoorproblemen spuugzat»

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary about recurring rail disruptions on the Arnhem-Winterswijk line since 2010, whether ProRail and operators implemented promised measures, punctuality and passenger compensation, and how remaining problems will be solved. The state secretary acknowledged poor performance, attributed the December 2012 failures to start-up problems of new operators, reported most measures implemented and punctuality recovering, and said operators would compensate passengers and a team is monitoring performance.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat jongeren onder 18 jaar nog steeds tot zonnebankstudio’s worden toegelaten

MPs Bruins Slot and Geurts asked the health and economic affairs ministers about reports that studios still admit under-18s to sunbeds, with many non-member studios breaking the age rule. Minister Schippers acknowledged non-compliance (about 80% overall compliance, higher among SVZ members), defended existing Warenwet rules and NVWA enforcement, and declined for now to criminalise minors or introduce an age-check obligation.
For now, the current legislation, aimed at sunbed providers, is sufficient.
Vooralsnog is de huidige wetgeving, gericht op de aanbieders van zonnebanken, afdoende.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Geurts en Lodders inzake introductiemoment groepshuisvesting drachtige zeugen

MPs Geurts and Lodders asked the minister why the 4-day group housing requirement for pregnant sows is kept, whether it harms animal welfare, the environment and farmers' competitiveness, and whether it should be relaxed. The minister answered that research and agreements with sector parties justify keeping the requirement, that farmers with management problems will be supported through a good-practice guide, and that no relaxation is planned.
I therefore see no other reason than to maintain the introduction of pregnant sows into the group four days after mating and to accelerate the drafting of a guide of good practices.
Ik zie dan ook geen andere reden dan vast te houden aan de introductie van drachtige zeugen na vier dagen na dekken in de groep en het versneld opstellen van een gids van goede praktijken

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Geurts naar aanleiding van het artikel ‘De meerwaarde van dynamisch rekenen aan emissies’ d.d. 31 oktober 2012 van Verkeersadviesbureau Goudappel Coffeng en de Universiteit Twe

Two CDA MPs asked the minister whether static traffic models ignore congestion and whether dynamic models should be used to re-examine air quality and noise at knooppunten like the A10 and A13 and to modernise the models. The minister rejected both, saying static models give reliable forecasts for air and noise policy while dynamic models suit detailed design and traffic management.
No. Static models provide good forecasts of future traffic volumes and the associated effects.
Nee. Statische modellen leveren goede prognoses van de verkeersomvang in de toekomst en de bijbehorende effecten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Geurts over het bericht dat Vlaanderen binnenkort de arbitrageprocedure over de ontpoldering van de Hedwigepolder wil starten

Two MPs asked the state secretary about Flanders starting arbitration over the Hedwige polder de-polderisation, the expected timeline, whether the government will reuse its earlier alternative plan, and whether positive dredging results could prevent de-polderisation. The state secretary answered that the arbitration timeline runs from 22 May 2012, that the earlier alternative was not accepted by the Commission, that a demissionary cabinet leaves the decision to its successor, and that the dredging results are preliminary.
The current demissionary cabinet is not taking any action on this matter and has left the decision to the next cabinet.
Het huidige demissionaire kabinet neemt geen actie in dezen en heeft besluitvorming aan het volgende kabinet overgelaten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Geurts over het artikel “vegabal inzet strijd vleessector”

An MP from the CDA asked the government whether the food safety authority NVWA deprioritises enforcement against misleading names such as 'chicken skewer' made of soy, and whether it could intervene more. The ministers answered that enforcement is risk-based, that names are assessed case by case for misleading content, and that the NVWA asked the producer to adjust its labelling.
The NVWA sets priorities in the cases it addresses within the capacity available to it for supervision.
De NVWA stelt prioriteiten in de zaken die ze aanpakt binnen de capaciteit die zij voor het toezicht beschikbaar heeft.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Geurts en De Rouwe over meetresultaten luchtkwaliteit A13

CDA MPs asked the minister whether Rijkswaterstaat used incorrect traffic data in noise and air quality studies for the A13 near Overschie, and whether it would be sent to parliament and corrected. The minister admitted a wrong table in the noise report's annex 1b (calculations used correct figures), sent the data, said the air study used correct figures, and said the error was raised in the pending objection procedure with no consequences for the speed increase.
A check by Rijkswaterstaat showed that the noise report contained, unfortunately, a table with incorrect data in annex 1b.
Een toets hierop door Rijkswaterstaat heeft laten zien dat er in het rapport van het geluidonderzoek helaas in bijlage 1b een tabel met verkeerde gegevens opgenomen is.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Omtzigt c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 18 inzake aanpassing van de bestuurssamenstelling bij bedrijfstakpensioenfondsen
Changes board composition and member selection rules at industry-wide pension funds, giving pensioners and works councils more say and a supervisory board.
The industry-wide pension fund follows the wish of the majority of responding pensioners regarding appointing a pensioner to the board.
Het bedrijfstakpensioenfonds volgt met betrekking tot opname van een pensioengerechtigde in het bestuur de wens van de meerderheid van de responderende pensioengerechtigden
Motie Omtzigt c.s. over modernisering van de governance van pensioenfondsen

Asks the government to draft a pre-draft bill modernising pension fund governance, with a legal right for pensioners to sit on fund boards and expertise and independence requirements, and to submit it to the Raad van State.
requests the government to submit this pre-draft after consultation with relevant parties to the Raad van State
verzoekt de regering voorts dit voorontwerp na overleg met betrokken partijen voor te leggen aan de Raad van State
Amendement van het lid Omtzigt c.s. inzake aanpassing bestuurssamenstelling en governance bij bedrijfstakpensioenfondsen
Changes board composition and governance rules for industry-wide pension funds, giving pensioner representatives a defined share of board seats and a participation council option.
Before article I, part A, a part is inserted, reading: aA Article 33, first paragraph, is amended as follows
Voor artikel I, onderdeel A, wordt een onderdeel ingevoegd, luidende: aA Artikel 33, eerste lid, wordt als volgt gewijzigd
Amendement van de leden Omtzigt en Linhard over het voorschrift dat het gehele vermogen moet worden ingebracht ingeval van samenvoeging

qa: Vragen van de leden Linhard en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de financiële risico’s van het Wieringerrandmeer (ingezonden 11 juni 2010).

MPs Linhard and Vermeij asked the minister whether the province of Noord-Holland's financial risks on the Wieringerrandmeer project (about 100 million euro, including a 30 million euro aqueduct) could fall on the national budget and whether the central government had approved them. The minister answered that the project is a provincial matter, the state does not participate or contribute, no agreement on aqueduct costs exists, and the province's risks are limited to invested equity, with approval a provincial responsibility.
Approval of this project is, however, a provincial responsibility. Provincial States are ultimately responsible.
Goedkeuring van dit project is echter een provinciale verantwoordelijkheid. Provinciale Staten zijn uiteindelijk eindverantwoordelijk.

Vragen van de leden Vermeij en Linhard (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de plannen voor de vestiging van een Landal-Greenpark bij Fort benoorden Spaarndam (ing

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister whether holiday homes (Landal-Greenpark) could be built near Fort benoorden Spaarndam within the World Heritage Stelling van Amsterdam and its buffer zone without harming heritage and nature values, and whether the national advisor and Parliament could review the plans. The minister answered that such building is only possible if World Heritage obligations are met, that the current plan would substantially alter the fort's open firing field, that the province as site holder bears responsibility for assessment, and that the national advisor could be involved on a provincial request.

It is up to the province, as site holder of the World Heritage site and as co-initiator, to demonstrate that the plan sufficiently safeguards, and at least does not harm, the Outstanding Universal Value of the area.

Het is aan de provincie, als siteholde r van het werelderfgoed en als mede-initiatiefnemer, om aan te tonen dat met het plan het behoud van de Outstanding Universal Value van het gebied voldoende wordt gewaarborgd, in elk geval niet wordt aangetast.

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Boulakjar ter vervanging van nr. 15 over het verruimen van de advies- en beslistermijn
Extends advice periods for provinces, municipalities and water boards from six to eight weeks on permit applications, and extends the related ministerial decision deadlines by two weeks.
For a careful handling of the permit application it is necessary that provinces, municipalities and water boards get eight weeks instead of six to issue their advice.
Voor een zorgvuldige behandeling van de vergunningsaanvraag is het noodzakelijk dat provincies, gemeenten en waterschappen acht weken in plaats van zes weken krijgen om hun advies uit te brengen.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Boulakjar ter vervanging van nr. 14 over informeren Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat bij afwijken van advies provincies

Amends the groundwater provisions so that the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management must be informed when the economic affairs minister intends to deviate from provincial advice on groundwater for drinking water supply.
If Our Minister intends to deviate from the advice of the provincial executive with a view to managing groundwater
Indien Onze Minister voornemens is af te wijken van het advies van gedeputeerde staten van de provincie met het oog op het beheer van grondwater
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over ervoor zorgdragen dat wél duurzame warmteprojecten worden beschikt in de SDE++-ronde van 2022
Asks the government to ensure that sustainable heat projects are awarded subsidies in the 2022 SDE++ round, with an extra autumn round if needed.
requests the government to prevent 2022 from becoming a lost year for sustainable heat projects
verzoekt de regering te voorkomen dat 2022 een verloren jaar wordt voor duurzame warmteprojecten
Motie van het lid Kröger c.s. over de haalbaarheid van lithiumwinning bij diepe geothermie onderzoeken
Asks the government to study the feasibility of lithium extraction from geothermal water in the Netherlands, including ecological, economic and legal aspects.
requests the government to study the feasibility of lithium extraction from deep geothermal in the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering de haalbaarheid van lithiumwinning bij diepe geothermie in Nederland te onderzoeken
Motie van de leden Boulakjar en Grinwis over de geothermiesector steunen bij het ontwikkelen van industriestandaarden, convenanten en procesafspraken
Asks the government to encourage and support the geothermal sector in developing industry standards, covenants and process agreements.
requests the government to call on the sector to go further with developing industry standards, covenants and process agreements
verzoekt de regering om de sector op te roepen verder te gaan op de ingeslagen weg met het ontwikkelen van industriestandaarden, convenanten en procesafspraken
Motie van het lid Boulakjar c.s. over geen nieuwe vergunningen voor gaswinning onder de Waddenzee
Asks the government not to grant new permits for gas extraction under the Wadden Sea.
requests the government not to issue new permits for gas extraction under the Wadden Sea
verzoekt de regering geen nieuwe vergunning af te geven voor gaswinning onder de Waddenzee
Motie van het lid Boulakjar c.s. over de lessen uit de Mechelse methode meenemen in het nieuwe programma leefbaarheid en veiligheid
Asks the Minister to take lessons from the Belgian Mechelen approach into the new national liveability and safety programme.
requests the Minister to take the lessons from the Mechelen method into the new programme
verzoekt de Minister de geleerde lessen vanuit de Mechelse methode mee te nemen in het nieuwe programma
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over een aangepast en opgeschaald nationaal isolatieprogramma
Motion asking the government to present an enlarged national insulation programme before the summer recess, focused first on regions with the most energy poverty.
requests the government to come well before the summer recess with an adjusted and scaled-up national insulation programme
verzoekt de regering om ruim voor het zomerreces met een aangepast en opgeschaald nationaal isolatieprogramma te komen
Amendement van de leden Grinwis en Boulakjar over overgangsrecht voor houders van een opsporingsvergunning
Adds transitional rules so holders of an exploration permit for geothermal energy may keep drilling while a startvergunning application is pending.
The prohibition on exploring for geothermal energy without a start permit does not apply to the holder of an exploration permit while the application for a start permit is pending
Het verbod om aardwarmte op te sporen zonder startvergunning aardwarmte, bedoeld in artikel 24b, geldt niet voor de houder van een opsporingsvergunning
Amendement van het lid Boulakjar over afstemming met de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat bij afwijken van advies provincies
Requires the minister to consult the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management before departing from provincial advice on groundwater management for drinking water.
the minister shall coordinate this with the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management
stemt Onze Minister dit af met Onze Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat
Amendement van het lid Boulakjar over het verruimen van de adviestermijn
Extends the advice period for provinces, municipalities and water boards on permit applications from six to eight weeks.
For a careful handling of the permit application it is necessary that provinces, municipalities and water boards receive eight weeks instead of six weeks to issue their advice.
Voor een zorgvuldige behandeling van de vergunningsaanvraag is het noodzakelijk dat provincies, gemeenten en waterschappen acht weken in plaats van zes weken krijgen om hun advies uit te brengen.
Motie van de leden Boulakjar en Grinwis over het in kaart brengen van de effecten van opbieden in de huurmarkt
Asks the government to map the effects of bidding systems in the rental market and to hinder their use if a price-raising effect is found, e.g. via the Good Landlordship Act.
requests the government to map the effects of bidding on the rental market
verzoekt de regering om de effecten van het opbieden op de huurmarkt in kaart te brengen
Motie van de leden Boulakjar en Geurts over een onderzoek naar uitbreiding van het takenpakket van de Huurcommissie
Asks the government to investigate extending the Huurcommissie's tasks to tenants in the free rental sector and inform the House before summer.
requests the government to investigate extending the Huurcommissie's tasks to the free sector and to inform the House about this before summer
verzoekt de regering om uitbreiding van het takenpakket van de Huurcommissie naar de vrije sector te onderzoeken, en de Kamer hierover voor de zomer te informeren
Motie van het lid Koerhuis c.s. over de voor grootschalige woningbouwgebieden beschikbaar gestelde 500 miljoen euro ook ter beschikking stellen voor Amersfoort
Asks the government to make the 500 million euro for large-scale housing areas also available to Amersfoort.
requests the government to also make the 500 million euro available for Amersfoort
verzoekt de regering om de 500 miljoen euro ook ter beschikking te stellen voor Amersfoort
Motie van het lid Boulakjar c.s. over het inzetten van grond en bezit van het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf ten behoeve van snelle woningbouw
Asks the government to remove obstacles for the Government Property Agency to use its land and buildings for fast housing construction and to inform the House before summer.
Requests the government to remove obstacles for the Government Property Agency to deploy its property and land for fast housing construction.
verzoekt de regering om knelpunten voor het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf om zijn bezit en gronden in te zetten ten behoeve van snelle woningbouw weg te nemen
Motie van de leden Boulakjar en Belhaj over afdwingbare regels in de aanpak van discriminatie bij woningverhuur
Asks the government to make enforceable rules against discrimination in rental housing and anchor them in the Wet goed verhuurderschap.
requests the government to make enforceable rules in tackling discrimination in rental housing
verzoekt de regering afdwingbare regels te maken in de aanpak van discriminatie bij woningverhuur
Motie van de leden Koerhuis en Boulakjar over het laten aansluiten van transformaties bij het nieuwe programma versnellen woningbouw
Asks the government to link conversions of buildings into housing to the new programme for accelerating housing construction.
requests the government to have transformations align with the new programme to accelerate housing construction
verzoekt de regering om transformaties te laten aansluiten in het nieuwe programma versnellen woningbouw
Motie van de leden Grinwis en Boulakjar over verhuurders en huurders beter informeren over reële servicekosten
Asks the government to better inform landlords and tenants about real service costs and remedies for excessive charges, and to review rules on social rental by non-profit housing providers.
requests the government to better inform landlords and tenants about what real service costs are
verzoekt de regering verhuurders en huurders beter te informeren over wat reële servicekosten zijn
Motie van het lid Peter de Groot c.s. over onderzoek naar realisatie van de Noordtak van de Betuweroute
Asks the government to study the social and economic value of the Noordtak of the Betuweroute and how it could be realised, reporting to parliament in Q1 2022.
requests the government to examine the societal and economic added value of the so-called Noordtak of the Betuweroute
verzoekt de regering de maatschappelijke en economische meerwaarde van de zogenaamde Noordtak van de Betuweroute te onderzoeken
Motie van de leden Boulakjar en De Hoop over analyseren welke instrumenten kunnen worden ingezet om de modaliteitsshift verder uit te breiden voor het openbaar vervoer
Asks the government to analyse which instruments could expand modal shift to public transport without drawing pedestrians and cyclists onto it.
requests the government to analyse which instruments could be deployed to further expand the modal shift
verzoekt de regering te analyseren welke instrumenten ingezet kunnen worden om de modaliteitsshift verder uit te breiden
Motie van het lid Boulakjar over het wegnemen van drempels voor toetreding van nachttreinvervoerders
Asks the government to identify barriers to entry for new night train operators and how capacity access and equal treatment with domestic rail could remove them.
requests the government to further identify risks for entry of (new) night train operators
verzoekt de regering om risico's voor toetreding van (nieuwe) nachttreinvervoerders verder te identificeren
Motie van de leden Amhaouch en Boulakjar over een onderzoek naar het structurele personeelstekort bij ProRail
Asks the government to work with ProRail and NS to limit train cancellations and to send Parliament an independent investigation into the structural staff shortage at ProRail.
requests the government to send Parliament as soon as possible an independent investigation into the structural problem of the staff shortage at ProRail
verzoekt de regering een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar het structurele probleem rond het personeelstekort bij ProRail zo spoedig mogelijk naar de Kamer te sturen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het bericht ‘Zonnepanelen zonder investering duurder dan gedacht’

MPs Boulakjar asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a Radar broadcast showing misleading sales of leased solar panels with high-interest loans, and what the government would do about it and about the planned phase-out of net metering. The minister said consumer misleading rules apply, that enforcement is for ACM and AFM or the courts, pointed to Warmtefonds promotion and a forthcoming sector code, and described the net-metering phase-out.

Whether misleading occurs in specific cases is for the supervisory authority Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) and, where credit under the Wft is concerned, the Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM), or the courts.

Of er in specifieke gevallen sprake is van misleiding is aan de toezichthouder Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) en, waar het gaat om krediet in de zin van de Wet op het financieel toezicht (Wft), de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM), of aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boulakjar over de Unesco brief over de voorgenomen gaswinning

D66 MPs Tjeerd de Groot and Boulakjar asked the ministers whether UNESCO's concerns about the planned Ternaard gas extraction under the Wadden Sea justify refusing the nature permit, how cumulative effects and the World Heritage Outstanding Universal Value will be assessed, and whether the NAM's notice of default and the Mining Act grounds for refusal apply. The government answered that the permit decision cannot be prejudged, that Natura 2000 and World Heritage tests apply, that it will report to UNESCO by 1 February 2024 and assess cumulative effects, but declined to guarantee no leakage or to commit to refusing the permit.
The Minister for Nature and Nitrogen cannot anticipate a formal decision on the permit application at this stage.
De Minister voor Natuur en Stikstof kan nu niet vooruit lopen op een formeel besluit op de vergunningaanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het bericht ‘Kabinet blijft onvermurwbaar: geen broodnodige studentenhuizen of woningen onder aanvliegroute Schiphol’

Opposition MP Boulakjar (D66) asked ministers why the government blocks student and other housing at Kronenburg under the Schiphol flight path, despite the regional housing shortage, and why an advisor's options were not adopted. The minister answers that noise and safety rules under the LIB restrict housing there, that a 438-home first phase or short-stay units could be explored with Amstelveen, and that no quick route to building is available.
The national government asked in an official-level meeting with the municipality of Amstelveen to examine whether housing plans for Kronenburg could be made that address this complex problem.
Het Rijk heeft hierop in een ambtelijk gesprek met de gemeente Amstelveen gevraagd om te kijken of er woningbouwplannen voor Kronenburg zijn te maken die recht doen aan deze complexe problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boulakjar en Boucke over het artikel 'Lenen voor zonnepanelen levert vaak gratis geld op: 'Jammer dat mensen dit niet weten''

MPs Boulakjar and Boucke asked the Minister for Housing about homeowners' limited awareness of subsidies and green loans for home insulation and solar panels, following a news report. The minister replied that the government is improving information via Verbeterjehuis.nl, mortgage advice rules and municipal programmes, without a detailed timeline for every measure.
The intention is to take the energy label of the home into account in mortgage lending norms from 1 January 2024.
Het voornemen is om bij de leennormen voor de hypotheek vanaf 1 januari 2024 rekening te houden met het energielabel van de woning
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over Microsoft datacentrum zonder bouw- en stikstofvergunningen

An MP asked the Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning how Microsoft could continue building a data centre without building and nitrogen permits, and what the roles of the state, province and municipality are. The Minister answered that the province of Noord-Holland, via regional environmental services, granted an environmental permit on 19 April 2023 (not yet irrevocable) after provisional tolerance decisions allowed construction to start, and that an independent study of nature permit enforcement will be conducted.
The competent authority for permit granting, supervision and enforcement is the province of Noord-Holland.
Het bevoegd gezag voor vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving is provincie Noord-Holland.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot, Boulakjar en Van Ginneken over de Kaderrichtlijn Water (hierna: KRW) en het rapport ‘Een KRW-risicoanalyse voor de vergunningverlening voor de bouw- en infrasector’

MPs from D66 asked the government whether the Water Framework Directive (KRW) targets will be met, and about the construction-sector risk analysis claiming large losses if permits are restricted by missed targets. The minister answered that no guarantee can be given, disputes the report's conclusions and scale of risk, and says the government will consult the European Commission on possible exceptions.
However, guarantees that all KRW targets will be met cannot be given.
Garanties dat alle KRW-doelen gehaald worden kunnen echter niet gegeven worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over de rol van notarissen bij dubieuze grondhandel

MPs Boulakjar asked the ministers about notaries' role in dubious land speculation, including duty of care, use of powers of attorney, disciplinary rulings, and ACM/AFM oversight. Minister De Jonge answered that the notarial disciplinary judge assesses duty of care case by case, that the existing framework is sufficient without legal change, and that regulators receive few reports but will act in individual cases.
The assessment of the role of notaries and the associated duty of care in light of land trading is reserved for the notarial disciplinary judge.
De beoordeling van de rol van notarissen en de daarbij behorende zorgplicht in het licht van grondhandel is voorbehouden aan de notariële tuchtrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het bericht ‘Raad van State zet streep door nieuwe woonwijk bij Schiphol’

An MP asked the housing minister about a Council of State ruling that blocked a 700-home neighbourhood near Schiphol after KLM appealed over aircraft noise, and whether state-owned KLM's litigation endangers the 900,000-homes target. The minister confirmed the ruling, said the noise issue falls under noise law not aviation caps, and argued the national housing target is not directly jeopardised because provincial planning capacity exceeds the quota.
That means the societal task of building 900,000 homes is not directly endangered if a project falls through or is delayed.
Dat betekent dat de maatschappelijke opgave van het bouwen van 900.000 woningen niet direct in gevaar komt als een project uitvalt of vertraging oploopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boulakjar en Wuite over de Nationale aanpak Klimaatadaptatie gebouwde omgeving fase 1

MPs Boulakjar and Wuite asked why the national climate adaptation approach for the built environment (phase 1) excludes the Caribbean Netherlands and its public bodies, and when a spatial development agenda for the islands will be sent to parliament. The minister answers that the strategy covers European Netherlands only, that the island bodies bear primary responsibility with national support, and that the spatial agenda will reach parliament in January 2023 and a programme after summer 2023.
That is why it was chosen to have the National Climate Adaptation Approach for the built environment also cover European Netherlands.
Daarom is er voor gekozen ook de Nationale aanpak Klimaatadaptatie gebouwde omgeving betrekking te laten hebben op Europees Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Boulakjar en Kat over het bericht 'BKR wil hypotheken registreren en gegevens delen met belwinkels en postorderbedrijven'

MPs from D66 asked the Finance Minister, on behalf of other ministers, about BKR's plan to register mortgages and share data with phone-shop and mail-order firms, including its legal basis, public oversight, proportionality and privacy. The minister answered that no positive mortgage registration is planned for now, that a bill will be consulted on in early 2023 to give credit registration a statutory basis and ministerial powers, and that the government is in talks with BKR.
In the bill, credit registration becomes a statutory task, with corresponding powers for the Minister of Finance.
In het wetsvoorstel wordt kredietregistratie een wettelijke taak, met overeenkomstige bevoegdheden voor de Minister van Financiën.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boulakjar over het protest op 26 november tegen de gaswinning in de Waddenzee

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the 26 November 2022 protest against gas extraction under the Wadden Sea near Ternaard, and whether he would urge Shell (NAM) to withdraw its permit application. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, said no new Wadden Sea extraction permits will be issued and that the Ternaard procedure is the last one, but postponed any talks with NAM until the outcome of a supplementary nitrogen assessment ordered after the Porthos ruling.
At this moment I first want to await those outcomes before I can take a next step in the decision-making on the Ternaard project together with the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen
Op dit moment wil ik eerst die uitkomsten afwachten, voordat ik samen met de Minister voor Natuur en Stikstof een volgende stap kan zetten in de besluitvorming over het project Ternaard
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Boulakjar over de gevolgen van de Porthos uitspraak van de Raad van State voor de vergunningaanvraag voor gaswinning bij Ternaard

Two D66 MPs asked how the Council of State's Porthos ruling affects the permit process for gas extraction near Ternaard and when a decision can be made. The minister answered that construction-phase nitrogen deposition must now be assessed, that the NAM has until Q1 2023 to supplement its application, and that she cannot yet give a completion date.
At this moment I cannot yet indicate when the decision-making can be concluded exactly.
Op dit moment kan ik nog niet aangeven wanneer de besluitvorming precies kan worden afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Boulakjar over het IMG die de wachttijd voor schadeafhandeling laat oplopen naar 21 maanden

MPs Beckerman and Boulakjar asked why Groningen mining-damage claimants now face waits of up to 21 months, with extended decision periods, and what the government will do. The Secretary of State acknowledges the wait is unacceptable, says IMG operates independently without consulting the ministry on procedures, and commits to monitoring and steering IMG toward faster handling of complex files.
The IMG does not keep separate records of how many letters extending decision periods it has sent.
Het IMG houdt niet separaat bij in hoeveel gevallen zij een brief met een verlenging van beslistermijnen hebben verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het bericht ‘Je starterswoning is opeens 35 mille duurder’

An MP asked the housing minister about reports that timber prefab starter homes were 35,000 euros more expensive because they fell outside NHG and SVn starter loan coverage, and whether this stalls projects. The minister answered that these homes can be financed with NHG and the starter loan given a guarantee certificate, that startups may struggle with solvency requirements so he asked insurers to look into it, and that he sees no evidence of stalled projects and no need for regulatory change.
That is why I have asked the completion insurers whether they can look at how innovative startups building can be helped to obtain a certificate nonetheless.
Daarom heb ik de afbouwverzekeraars gevraagd of zij kunnen kijken naar hoe startups die innovatief bouwen geholpen kunnen worden om toch een certificaat te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het artikel in NH Nieuws ‘Amsterdamse studentenvakbond eist meer aandacht voor veiligheid na verwoestende brand’

An MP asked the housing minister about a series of student-housing fires in Amsterdam, whether other student cities are affected, how safe student housing can be guaranteed, and what measures and facade fire-safety testing are needed. The minister answered that the three Amsterdam fires are not comparable and no similar problems are known elsewhere, and pointed to the national student housing action plan, fire-safety measures, and planned building-code amendments due for consultation and parliamentary submission in 2023.
I am working on tightening the fire-safety requirements for facades in the Bbl.
Ik werk aan een aanscherping voor de brandveiligheidseisen voor gevels in het Bbl.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Boucke en Boulakjar over het bericht 'Den Haag vindt na Gazprom geen gasleverancier, gemeente wil ontheffing'

MPs Boucke and Bloulakjar asked the energy minister about reports that municipalities must sign costly new gas contracts after Gazprom's Dutch-German arm was sanctioned, and whether exemptions and cost burdens are justified. The minister explains that the SEFE contracts fell under sanctions until Germany nationalised SEFE GmbH on 11 November 2022, that exemptions have been granted, that municipalities face extra costs of a few tons to a few million euros, and that the government will compensate those costs.
The cabinet cannot go into the details of the tender conducted by the municipality of The Hague. That is for the municipality of The Hague itself.
Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op de details van de gedane aanbesteding van de gemeente Den Haag. Dat is aan de gemeente Den Haag zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boulakjar over de brief van 372 wetenschappers met zorgen over de mijnbouw in de Waddenzee

MPs Tjeerd de Groot and Boulakjar asked the ministers how concerns from 372 scientists about gas extraction under the Wadden Sea would be weighed in the Ternaard permit decision and whether the permit is legally sound. The minister answered that the concerns are taken into account, that a permit must be based on an appropriate assessment showing no harm to Natura 2000 sites, and that the decision is delayed because nitrogen effects of the construction phase must be reassessed after a Council of State ruling, with no firm timeline given.
I cannot currently state concretely when the decision-making will be concluded.
Ik kan op dit moment niet concreet aangeven wanneer de besluitvorming zal worden afgerond.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Sjoerdsma, Boulakjar en Boucke over het bericht dat beide Nord Stream pijpleidingen vlak na elkaar zijn stuk gegaan en dat seismologische bureaus van Denemarken en Zweden hevig

MPs from D66 asked whether the Nord Stream pipeline explosions were sabotage, whether Russia could invoke force majeure, whether the Netherlands would push the EU to phase out Russian gas, and how Dutch offshore pipelines and infrastructure would be protected. The government answered that sabotage is almost certain but attribution is not yet possible, outlined EU gas-reduction measures and infrastructure protection plans, and promised a separate letter on North Sea protection.
It is almost certain that this was a sabotage action.
Het staat vrijwel zeker vast dat het hier een sabotageactie betrof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het bericht 'Vijfde keer uitstel Omgevingswet dreigt na negatief ICT-advies'

An MP asked the Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning about a report that a negative ICT review of the Digital Environment Act system (DSO) could force a fifth postponement of the Act. The minister confirmed awareness, said the final advisory opinion was received and would be addressed in a forthcoming progress letter, and explained which DSO components are essential for entry into force while describing the rest as continuing development.

In the progress letter on implementation of the Environment Act that I sent to your House and the Senate on 14 October, I will address the conclusions of the adopted advice of the Advisory Board in substance.

In de voortgangsbrief implementatie Omgevingswet die ik op 14 oktober naar uw Kamer en de Eerste Kamer heb gestuurd, ga ik inhoudelijk in op de conclusies van het vastgestelde advies van het Adviescollege.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boulakjar en Beckerman over het bericht ‘Onveilige situaties voor 2 op de 5 jonge huurders door wooncrisis: 'Mijn huisbaas weet dat ik nergens anders heen kan'’

Two MPs asked the housing minister about reports that young tenants face unsafe situations and exploitation by landlords amid the housing crisis, and about interim protections before the Goed Verhuurderschap bill takes effect. The minister said the bill will give municipalities enforcement tools and a reporting point, declined a national reporting point and national tenant teams for now, and promised to examine expanding the Huurcommissie's remit and regulating mid-rent housing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het bericht 'Shell en ExxonMobil zetten NAM in de verkoop'

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the planned sale of NAM's small fields by Shell and ExxonMobil affects Groningen earthquake damage compensation and the reinforcement operation, and what the sale means for NAM's activities. The State Secretary answered that transfers to regional subsidiaries require ministerial consent under the Mining Act, that the Groningen field and storage sites stay within NAM BV, and that the sale therefore does not change how Groningen costs are charged to NAM.
For the transfer of an interest in a field, prior consent from the State Secretary for Mining is required under the Mining Act.
Voor de overdracht van een belang in een veld is op grond van de Mijnbouwwet voorafgaande toestemming van de Staatssecretaris van Mijnbouw vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boulakjar en Van der Laan over het bericht ‘Blijf weg als je geen kamer hebt’

MPs Boulakjar and Van der Laan asked whether universities advising international and Dutch students without housing to stay away, and how the government ensures sufficient student housing. The ministers acknowledged the advice, pointed to shared responsibility with municipalities and housing providers, and referred to a national action plan, forthcoming legal steering instruments and the Kronenburg short-stay question under study.
Question 1: Is the Minister aware that the Vrije Universiteit and the University of Amsterdam urge international students not to come to the Netherlands if they have no housing?
Vraag 1 Is de Minister ervan op de hoogte dat de Vrije Universiteit en de Universiteit van Amsterdam internationale studenten oproepen om niet naar Nederland te komen als zij geen huisvesting hebben?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Boulakjar over het bericht 'Rusland knijpt ook gaskraan naar Duitsland af, olieprijs naar 125 dollar per vat'

MPs Boucke and Boulakjar asked whether Gazprom's reduced gas deliveries to Germany via Nord Stream 1 were political, how long the reduction would last, and what it meant for Dutch gas storage and LNG supply after the Freeport explosion. The minister confirmed the reduction, said the July maintenance was planned, noted that Germany's supply security was not yet affected and that Dutch storage filling was proceeding, and declined to disclose confidential commercial contracts while pointing to the fully contracted Eemshaven LNG terminal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke, Boulakjar en Podt over het bericht ‘Vluchteling mag wel in herrie’

MPs Boucke, Boulakjar and Podt asked why student housing is blocked near Schiphol under the LIB noise rules while refugee housing at Kronenburg is allowed, and about the duration, permit (vvgb) and planned LIB revisions. The minister replied that temporary stays up to six months are exempt from LIB rules, longer stays need a vvgb which the ILT is assessing, and a LIB revision decision is targeted for year-end.
The ILT will assess whether a vvgb can be issued.
De ILT zal beoordelen of een vvgb kan worden afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Boulakjar over de situatie rondom de Regeling Huisvesting Aandachtsgroepen

Two D66 MPs asked the housing minister why funds under the Regeling huisvesting aandachtsgroepen remained unspent, whether legal deadlines and start-date rules hinder realisation, and what the Ukraine crisis changes for municipalities. The minister answered that nearly all applications were granted, that a mid-term evaluation and 2021 accountability are pending, that deadlines are meant to ensure timely delivery, and that no formal signals of spending problems or financial strain have been received.
At the end of June I will share the outcomes of an interim evaluation of this scheme with you by letter.
Eind juni zal ik per brief de uitkomsten van een tussenevaluatie op deze regeling met u delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar en Romke de Jong over btw op zonnepanelen

MPs Boulakjar and Romke de Jong asked whether the planned zero VAT rate on solar panels should extend beyond homeowners to postcode-rose members, public and community buildings, and tenants. The state secretary answered that the zero rate covers panels on or near homes including for landlords and housing corporations, but not on public buildings (still under study) and not for rental of panels.
Further research must determine whether it is possible and desirable to facilitate solar panels on public and other buildings, and if so, whether a zero VAT rate is a sensible policy route for that.

Verder onderzoek moet plaatsvinden of het mogelijk en wenselijk is zonnepanelen op openbare en andere gebouwen te faciliteren, en zo ja, of een btw-nultarief daarvoor beleidsmatig een verstandige route is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het bericht in het Financieele Dagblad ‘Aedes wil landelijke toets voor fabriekswoningen’

An MP asked the minister whether a national approval framework for prefabricated homes is needed, since municipalities currently assess each factory-built home separately against the Bouwbesluit, causing delays. The minister agreed the issue is real, said the Wkb (quality assurance) due on 1 January 2023 will allow one-off national approval of standard designs, and said pilot projects are under way.
With the introduction of the Wkb quality assurance act for construction, national approval of factory-built homes as Aedes proposes will already be largely possible.
Met de komst van de Wet kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen (Wkb) wordt het landelijk goedkeuren van fabriekswoningen zoals Aedes voorstelt al grotendeels mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over huurdersvoordracht

An MP asked the housing minister whether he would act against existing tenants demanding key money from new tenants via tenant referral, and whether he would ban the practice or add a ban to the good landlordship bill. The minister agreed the practice is undesirable, but saw no basis for a ban or large-scale investigation, pointing instead to a broader rights programme and continued dialogue with the sector body.
I have no insight into the number of cases in which tenants demand key money.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de aantallen waarin het vragen van sleutelgeld door huurders voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Boulakjar over risico’s op zinkgaten en milieuschade in Twente

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the risk that a salt cavern under the Twence waste dump near Enschede has collapsed, possibly causing a sinkhole and soil or groundwater contamination, and about the unclear division of responsibilities between Nobian, Twence, SodM and local authorities. The State Secretary answered that the cavern has collapsed, that three scenarios are being investigated with results expected in May 2022 for SodM to assess, and that responsibilities are clear and supervisors coordinate.
SodM has asked Nobian to determine which of the three scenarios mentioned above applies.
SodM heeft Nobian gevraagd om vast stellen welke van de drie hierboven genoemde scenario’s van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boulakjar en Boucke over maatwerkafspraken voor woningbouw

MPs Boulakjar and Boucke asked about maintenance-style exceptions (maatwerk) allowing housing near Schiphol under the airport zoning decree (LIB), the student housing at Kronenburg, and whether a revised LIB should follow the new noise and enforcement rules. The minister answered that only a limited number of exemptions have been granted, that a revised LIB will follow the pending LVB change and could free some land for housing, and that talks with the regional authority are ongoing.
In the LIB 4 area the noise exposure is such that caution must be exercised when adding housing.
In het LIB 4 gebied is de geluidbelasting dusdanig dat er terughoudend moet worden omgegaan met het toevoegen van woningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Boulakjar over de kamerverhuurvrijstelling

MPs Romke de Jong and Boulakjar asked whether the room-rental tax exemption (kamerverhuurvrijstelling) should be raised to better use the housing stock, and about its rationale, budget and tax effects. The government answered that better use of existing housing can help, referred to the National Housing and Construction Agenda, explained the exemption's conditions and rationale, and argued that raising it would have negligible effects on the housing shortage and could push up rents.
Because the exempt amount per month is already higher than the average cost of a room with shared facilities, I consider the chosen level of the room-rental exemption defensible
Omdat het vrijgestelde bedrag per maand reeds hoger is dan de gemiddelde kostprijs voor een kamer met gedeelde voorzieningen vind ik de gekozen hoogte van de kamerverhuurvrijstelling verdedigbaar
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het artikel 'Gasmarkt toont nu weinig vrees, maar komende winter kan weer spannend worden'

An MP asked the government about gas storage filling, Russian ownership links (Gazprom's stake in Bergermeer), LNG alternatives and the price impact on households ahead of winter 2022. The minister answered that mandatory storage levels are planned, that Bergermeer is operated by TAQA with Gazprom holding certain control rights, and that LNG import capacity is limited, while many answers refer to a separate letter.
Yes, the coalition agreement already announces that the cabinet wants to introduce mandatory filling percentages for gas storage.
Ja, in het coalitieakkoord staat dan ook al aangekondigd dat het kabinet wil komen tot verplichte vullingspercentages voor de gasopslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Boulakjar over het Strategisch Vastgoedplan

MPs Hammelburg and Boulakjar asked the State Secretary for Defence how many of Defence's buildings are urban or rural, which are suitable for housing or greening, which lie in large cities, and which 35-40% of the property portfolio will be divested. The State Secretary answered that Defence does not define urban or rural, that suitability for housing is for regional authorities to judge, that no decision on divestment has been taken, and that the contours of the internal review will be shared in April.
No decision has yet been taken on which buildings or sites Defence wants to leave.
Er is nog geen besluit genomen over welke gebouwen of terreinen Defensie wil verlaten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boulakjar over de berichten '3000 lege vliegtuigen in België de lucht in om landingsrechten te behouden' en 'Knotsgekke drempels in Europese lidstaten bemoeilijken treinreis

Two D66 MPs asked about reports of empty flights run to preserve airport slot rights during the pandemic and about rail cross-border obstacles, and asked how many empty flights were operated, whether the slot waiver would be extended, and what was being done on international rail. The minister replied that no empty flights were needed at Dutch slot-coordinated airports, that the EU slot relief rules are expected to continue for summer 2022 with a request for clarity beyond, and outlined ongoing EU and national rail initiatives without committing to a new legal change.
The ministry has no access to load factors per airline or per flight movement.
Het ministerie heeft geen inzage in de bezettingsgraden per luchtvaartmaatschappij en of per vliegtuigbeweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van Meenen en Boulakjar over coronamaatregelen in het funderend onderwijs

Three D66 MPs asked the education minister why the government departs from OMT advice on school COVID measures, including testing, the Christmas holiday timing, masks, CO2 meters and air purifiers. The minister confirmed the departures, explained the reasons and pointed to ventilation funding and existing measures, without committing to new national devices.
Naturally the epidemiological situation is monitored and the Cabinet takes the decisions that are necessary.
Vanzelfsprekend is de epidemiologische situatie gemonitord en neemt het Kabinet besluiten die nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het weren van buitenlanders in een huurwoning

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about an online rental ad excluding foreigners under an 'anti-migrant policy', and what can be done to stop such discrimination. The minister agreed discrimination is unacceptable, pointed to planned landlord rules in the Goed Verhuurderschap bill, and announced a pilot on a reporting duty with Utrecht by summer 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het bericht ‘Oostenrijk lanceert ‘Klimaticket’: voor 3 euro per dag onbeperkt met het ov door het land’

The MP Boulakjar (D66) asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about Austria's 'Klimaticket' for unlimited public transport at 3 euro per day, and whether a similar system, family tickets, cross-operator annual passes and a pilot could work in the Netherlands. The secretary answered that a comparable national scheme would cost roughly 4,000 euro per person, that earlier experiments showed no measurable effect on congestion, and that an analysis of price instruments will be delivered to parliament in the second half of 2022.

As I indicated during the budget debate of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management on 4 November, in response to the motion by MPs Boulakjar and De Hoop, I will commission an analysis of which price instruments can be used to further expand the mobility shift.

Zoals ik tijdens de begrotingsbehandeling van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat op 4 november jl. heb aangegeven, in reactie op de motie van de leden Boulakjar en De Hoop, zal ik een analyse laten maken van welke (prijs)instrumenten ingezet kunnen worden om de mobiliteitsshift verder uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het bericht «Grote treinstoring kwam door kapotte backup-server» en het bericht «ProRail onderzoekt oorzaak telefoniestoring»

MPs Boulakjar asked the state secretary how the 16 September 2021 nationwide rail outage relates to his earlier statement that the 31 May incident was a one-off, why the backup failed, and what has been done to make the telephony system robust. The state secretary answered that both outages had different causes but similar effects, that ProRail and the provider are investigating and will report in the annual impact report, that fixes were implemented after 31 May, and that backup checks and switchover times are being reviewed.
I have asked ProRail to report on this in the annual report on high-impact disruptions, which is part of the regular annual accountability reports that I always send to your House in spring.

Ik heb ProRail gevraagd hierover te rapporteren in de jaarlijkse rapportage impactvolle verstoringen, die onderdeel is van de reguliere jaarverantwoordingen, die ik uw Kamer altijd in het voorjaar doe toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boulakjar en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Doelstellingen flexwoningen lang niet gehaald

MPs Boulakjar and Koerhuis asked the minister whether municipalities and housing corporations are missing flexible housing targets, what obstacles exist (locations, business case, image) and what is being done. The minister answered that it is too early to conclude targets will be missed, outlined support measures and funding, and said most woondeals already include flexible housing targets.
I therefore think it is too early to conclude that the target for placing flexible housing will not be met.
Ik vind het daarom te vroeg om te concluderen dat de doelstelling voor het plaatsen van flexwoningen niet wordt behaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Boulakjar over het bericht 'Zembla: spoorwerkers worden al ruim 10 jaar blootgesteld aan gevaarlijk kwartsstof'

D66 MPs asked the government about reports that railway workers were exposed to carcinogenic quartz dust for over a decade, whether ProRail ignored advice to change ballast stone, whether ProRail should have reported its studies to the Labour Inspectorate, and related questions on enforcement and ProRail's status. The ministers said ProRail has commissioned studies, is following TNO advice to exclude three stone types temporarily, shared the studies with the inspectorate, and that the inspectorate enforces violations without size distinction.
The Ministry of IenW has received ProRail's research reports.
Het Ministerie van IenW heeft de onderzoeksrapporten van ProRail ontvangen.

m: Motie van het lid Faber-van de Klashorst over het verbieden van de Islamitische Stichting Nederland
Asks the Minister to ban the Islamitische Stichting Nederland because of alleged Turkish influence on the rule of law.
requests the Minister to ban the Islamic Foundation Netherlands
verzoekt de Minister de Islamitische Stichting Nederland te verbieden
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel 'Ook de EU heft economische sancties tegen Syrië op' en het artikel 'Kabinet houdt rapport geheim dat terugkeer van tienduizenden Syriërs kan betekenen'

An MP asks whether Syria readmission talks are underway, whether the new Syria country report allows refusing asylum claims and reassessing granted statuses, and whether ambtsberichten and IND working instructions should be less public. The ministers answer that returns proceed via assisted voluntary return, forced return talks are being prepared, individual assessments continue under the existing country policy, and status revocation is not yet justified.
At this moment it cannot yet be concluded in general terms that the positive changes in the current security and human rights situation in Syria are sufficiently far-reaching and non-temporary.

Op dit moment kan nog niet in algemene zin geconcludeerd worden dat de positieve wijzigingen in de huidige veiligheids- en mensenrechtensituatie in Syrië voldoende ingrijpend en niet-voorbijgaand zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over ‘de groeiende afhankelijkheid van Amerikaanse techgiganten’

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked the government about dependence on US tech giants for public cloud services, including whether ministries, DJI, IND and CJIB will reconsider migrations and whether data could be exposed under US law. The state secretary answers that existing cloud policy requires weighing risks, that migrations are being reconsidered under a temporary cloud policy line, and that dependence on US providers will largely persist for now while the cloud policy is revised.
The cabinet agrees with the submitters that careful considerations regarding cloud migrations are of great importance.
Het kabinet is het met de indieners eens dat zorgvuldige afwegingen bij cloudmigraties van groot belang zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over ‘een integrale audit van ideologisch gedreven overheidsuitgaven en mogelijke systeemfraude in de overheidsadministratie’ aan

An FvD MP asked for a full audit of ideologically motivated government spending, including subsidies to organisations that have sued the state, checks on ghost employees and unused payment cards, and a DOGE-style taskforce. The government declined to create a list of litigating organisations or a taskforce, citing existing audit bodies (ADR, Algemene Rekenkamer) and disproportionate cost, while providing partial data on payroll ages and payment cards.
The Internal Audit Service of the State (ADR) and the Netherlands Court of Audit (AR) are both independent auditors that oversee lawful and efficient use of public funds.
De Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) en de Algemene Rekenkamer (AR) zijn beide onafhankelijke controleurs die toezien op rechtmatig en doelmatig gebruik van overheidsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Pentagon gaat duizenden transgender militairen ontslaan’

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked the government how it views the US Pentagon's plan to discharge transgender military personnel, whether it will condemn this, and whether it will offer asylum or other protection. The minister answered that Dutch defence values diversity, expressed concern, declined to condemn the US decision citing sovereignty, and said there is no basis for a special asylum scheme for transgender Americans, with each asylum claim judged individually.
All countries enjoy sovereignty and make decisions based on their own specific national priorities.
Alle landen genieten soevereiniteit en zij nemen beslissingen op grond van hun eigen specifieke nationale prioriteiten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Vondeling over het bericht dat Denemarken en Italië steun zoeken om de bevoegdheden van het Europese Hof van de Rechten van de Mensen op het gebied van asiel en immigratie te be

PVV MPs Wilders and Vondeling asked whether the government would co-sign a letter by Denmark and Italy seeking to limit the European Court of Human Rights' reach on asylum and immigration, and whether it had been approached to support it. The government answered that it supports the letter's general call for a dialogue on expelling convicted foreigners but will not co-sign because the call to debate the Court's interpretation of the ECHR touches judicial independence, and that it will pursue this via other channels.
The Netherlands does not want to give the impression that it wishes to sit in the judge's seat and therefore cannot support that part of the call.
Nederland wil niet de indruk wekken op de stoel van de rechter te willen zitten en kan daarom dat deel van de oproep niet steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Wrijving in kabinet over migratiebeleid: Faber wil handtekening Schoof onder kritische brief'

An MP asked the Prime Minister and ministers about a reported cabinet dispute over a letter by Denmark and Italy criticising European Court of Human Rights interpretation of migration removal rules, including the timeline, reasons for not co-signing, and whether criticism of the ECtHR undermines the rule of law. The government answered that it supports dialogue on removing convicted foreigners but declined to co-sign the part questioning ECtHR interpretation, citing judicial independence, and said it would pursue other routes.
The Netherlands does not want to give the impression of wanting to sit in the judge's seat and therefore cannot support that part of the call.
Nederland wil niet de indruk wekken op de stoel van de rechter te willen zitten en kan daarom dat deel van de oproep niet steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Van Nispen over de berichten dat KaFra Housing winst maakt op de huisvesting voor asielzoekers

Two SP MPs asked whether it is acceptable that KaFra Housing, a commercial provider, houses asylum seekers in former worker accommodation and profits from public funds, and whether the state should investigate such arrangements. The minister replied that COA renting commercial locations is not unusual, that emergency shelter is costlier and is being phased out, that the locations meet quality standards, and that no further investigation is deemed necessary.
I do not recognise the picture painted that asylum seekers are being housed in poor living conditions at these locations.
Ik herken niet het beeld dat geschetst wordt dat er asielzoekers met slechte woonomstandigheden op deze locaties worden opgevangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Faber-van de Klashorst, Vlottes, Boon en Markuszower over de 'Stichting Plant een Olijfboom'
