PVV MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about the Stichting Plant een Olijfboom, whose staff allegedly praised the 7 October attack, questioning its ANBI charity status, missing financial reporting, possible funding of Hamas, and calls for an FIOD investigation or a ban. The minister condemned such statements but said the ANBI public-benefit test is neutral and non-prosecutable conduct is no ground for revocation, that financial publication gaps are usually remedied, that tax secrecy prevents comment on the individual organisation, and that dissolution/banning under Article 2:20 BW is for the Public Prosecution Service and the court.
The Tax Authority is bound by the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act and therefore cannot provide further information about individual institutions.
De Belastingdienst is gehouden aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen en kan daarom geen nadere informatie verstrekken over individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Faber-van de Klashorst en Van Meetelen over de rellen en racistische leuzen gericht naar kermisexploitanten in Emmeloord

MPs Van Meetelen and Faber-van de Klashorst asked about riots, vandalism and racist chants aimed at fairground operators in Emmeloord, including whether closing hours and costs should fall on the operators, and what prosecution follows. The Minister says municipalities are equipped to handle such disorder, leaves the local measures and prosecution to the mayor and Openbaar Ministerie, and notes that victims can pursue civil claims or request partial restitution of the pitch fee.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide how it follows up on this.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te bepalen hoe zij hier opvolging aan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aardema en Faber-van de Klashorst  over het politieoptreden bij de Pro Palestina demonstratie in Amsterdam van week 19

MPs Aardema and Faber-van de Klashorst asked the Minister of Justice and Security why police did not intervene promptly at the Pro-Palestine demonstration in Amsterdam in week 19, covering masked protesters, violence, the length of the occupation, arrests, costs, intelligence investigation and funding. The minister answered most questions by referring to the Amsterdam mayor's letter to the municipal council, stating that the public order responsibility lies with local authorities, and gave substantive answers only on intelligence limits and on the Wtmo transparency bill.
Responsibility for facilitating and protecting the right to demonstrate rests with local authorities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het faciliteren en beschermen van het demonstratierecht is belegd bij het lokale gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Faber-van de Klashorst over de geweldsexplosie in detentiecentrum Rotterdam

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why the government did not actively inform parliament about a violent uprising by foreign nationals at Detentiecentrum Rotterdam, injuring seven staff, and about aftercare, prosecution, detention regime and deportation status. The minister answered that the incident was listed in the monthly DJI incident list, that one foreign national was reported to police, that information on injuries and individual cases was withheld on privacy grounds, and that the public prosecution service decides on prosecution.
Whether the House of Representatives is additionally actively informed about an incident is a consideration made per incident.
Of de Tweede Kamer daarnaast nog actief over een incident wordt geïnformeerd is een afweging die per incident gemaakt wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Faber-van de Klashorst over heenzenden jeugdige criminelen na mishandelen conducteur

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether two 13- and 14-year-olds who assaulted a conductor and were released had prior police contacts, convictions, what supervision they received, and what measures apply to their parents. The minister declined to give details on the case and the youths' records for investigative and privacy reasons, but explained the legal framework for involving parents and the grounds for parental authority measures.
I cannot, while the investigation is ongoing, make any statements about a criminal case.
Ik kan, lopende het onderzoek, geen uitspraken doen over een strafzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Faber-van der Klashorst over de strafeis van het OM tegen de verdachten van de mishandeling van een NS-conducteur op het station in Schagen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about the six-month prosecution demand (three suspended) against two Eritrean men who attacked a railway conductor in Schagen, and whether the prosecution guideline allowing such low demands should be reviewed by WODC. The minister called the attack unacceptable, explained how prosecution guidelines work and why she sees no reason for the requested study, though a WODC study on sentencing for crimes against public-task workers is underway with results expected before summer 2024.
The numerical overview of prosecution demands and sentences imposed by judges, requested during the budget debate, unfortunately cannot be provided.
Het tijdens de begrotingsbehandeling gevraagde cijfermatig overzicht van de door het OM geëiste straffen en de door de rechter opgelegde straffen kan ik helaas niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Faber-Van de Klashorst over onvoldoende toezicht door reclassering op personen die als opgelegde maatregel een enkelband dragen

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection why probation supervision of juveniles wearing ankle monitors is insufficient and what the government will do about it. The minister replies that electronic monitoring is not meant to prevent recidivism, describes the 24/7 alert and follow-up arrangements, and says the shortfall stems from workload and capacity in local-government-funded youth probation, with the government mainly offering funding programmes and talks with VNG and VWS.

That is why, through the Preventie met Gezag programme, 27 municipalities are being funded to deploy the intensive youth probation approach called Straatkracht, within which youth probation has more time.

Daarom worden vanuit het programma Preventie met Gezag 27 gemeenten gefinancierd die de intensieve jeugdreclasseringsaanpak, genaamd Straatkracht, inzetten waarbinnen de jeugdreclassering meer tijd heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Faber-van der Klashorst over XR en Greta Thunberg

An MP of the PVV asked the Minister of Justice about Extinction Rebellion road blockades in The Hague involving Greta Thunberg, whether the Public Prosecution Service was right that a road blockade cannot lead to pre-trial detention, and whether the OM's knowledge is adequate. The Minister declined to comment on individual cases, explained that the Wom offence is only an infringement so pre-trial detention is not possible, that article 162 Sr is a crime requiring danger to traffic and assessed case by case by the OM, and said she has no concern about OM knowledge.
As Minister of Justice and Security, it is not appropriate for me to comment on individual cases.
Het past mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid niet om in te gaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Faber-van de Klashorst en Aardema over pro-Palestina demonstratie plaats in Amsterdam

MPs Faber-van de Klashorst and Aardema asked whether the government would prosecute or act against a GroenLinks politician who displayed the slogan 'viva viva INTIFADA' at a pro-Palestinian demonstration in Amsterdam. The Minister said the slogan is condemnable, that prosecution is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, that police did not notice it during the event, and that no complaint or criminal investigation has been started.

Assessing whether a criminal offence may have occurred in an individual case is primarily the responsibility of the Public Prosecution Service and, if the case is brought before the court, ultimately reserved for the judge.

De beoordeling of er mogelijk sprake is van een strafbaar feit in een individueel geval is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van het Openbaar Ministerie en – mits de zaak wordt aangebracht bij de rechtbank – uiteindelijk is die beoordeling voorbehouden aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Faber- Van de Klashorst en Deen over de berichtgeving ‘Aboutaleb wil minder communicatie over geweldsexplosie Rotterdam'

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the Rotterdam mayor, by reducing active communication about violent incidents, endangers citizens' safety and fails in his duty, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister replied that communication is a matter for local authorities and the municipal council, that the minister will not interfere in local decision-making, but that the topic is discussed regularly with partners and action will be taken if warranted.
The Rotterdam municipal council is therefore the appropriate place for the debate on communication about incidents involving explosives.
De gemeenteraad van Rotterdam is derhalve de aangewezen plek voor het debat over communicatie over incidenten met explosieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Faber-van de Klashorst en Vondeling over een moeder die voor gerechtigheid vecht na de dood van haar zoon

MPs Vondeling and Faber-van de Klashorst asked about the case of a 22-year-old killed by a driver who was speeding and under the influence, including why he was released from pre-trial detention, why the hearing took 14 months, whether sentences are too low, and whether friends of victims should get speaking rights in court. The Minister declined to comment on the pending case, pointed to 2020 tougher traffic-offence laws, ongoing reforms on driving bans and drink-driving, and said speaking rights for close friends will be considered in the new Code of Criminal Procedure.
No statements will be made about the present case, as it is still before the judge, and any investigation results are subject to the judge's assessment.
Over de onderhavige zaak worden geen mededelingen gedaan, nu deze nog onder de rechter is, en eventuele onderzoeksresultaten aan het oordeel van de rechter onderworpen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema, Claassen, Faber-van de Klashorst en Aardema over het toenemend geweld tegen zorgverleners

PVV MPs asked the health and justice ministers about rising violence against care workers, including reporting of assaults, sentencing, protective equipment costs, a ban on community sentences, mandatory anti-aggression courses and refusing treatment of violent patients. The minister answered at length, citing ongoing consultations, regional meetings and a pending sentencing study, while declining to give several figures or a cost overview.
No, I do not have an overview of this at my disposal.
Nee, ik heb hier geen overzicht van tot mijn beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Blaauw en Faber-van de Klashorst over het bericht ‘Ramen Universiteitsbibliotheek vernield en beklad met pro-Palestinaleuzen’

PVV MPs Blaauw and Faber-van de Klashorst asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether he would condemn the vandalism and pro-Palestinian slogans at the Groningen university library and engage the university board. The minister condemned the vandalism as a crime, noted the university has already filed a police report and issued a statement, and said he sees no reason for a separate meeting with the board, while promising ongoing talks with the sector.
I currently see no reason to enter into talks with the Executive Board of the RUG about these events.
Ik zie momenteel geen aanleiding om samen met het College van Bestuur van de RUG in gesprek te gaan over deze gebeurtenissen.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat tientallen asielkinderen veel te laat zorg krijgen die zij nodig hebben

An SP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about a report that dozens of asylum children received necessary care too late and about shelter conditions, care access, relocations and proposed multidisciplinary teams. The minister said the underlying study is unknown to the department and COA, that care runs through regular GP and healthcare channels, that relocations are minimised under a care-continuity protocol, and declined to create separate arrangements or funding.
COA also has no access to the medical records, does not know which persons are involved, nor when they were referred or will be referred to necessary follow-up care.
Het COA heeft ook geen toegang tot de medische gegevens, weet niet om welke personen het gaat en wanneer zij verwezen zijn of worden naar benodigde vervolgzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Veltman over het bericht ‘Arriva: 92 procent van boetes voor zwartrijden van en naar azc Ter Apel niet betaald’

VVD MPs Veltman and Rajkowski asked the state secretary and the asylum minister about reports that 92 percent of fare-evasion fines near the Ter Apel asylum centre went unpaid, and whether identity checks, reentry bans and fine collection could be improved. The state secretary acknowledges the problem, describes identity-check procedures and fine processes, and says talks with carriers and COA are ongoing with the asylum minister committed to examining how fines can be recovered, though a concrete pilot was not committed to.
Fare evasion and not paying the fine undermine the system and contribute to the deterioration of public transport.
Zwartrijden en het niet betalen van de boete ondermijnen het systeem en dragen bij aan een verloedering van het openbaar vervoer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de Spreidingswet, de contourennota tot intrekking hiervan en haar uitspraken over dwang

An MP asked whether the Spreidingswet stays fully in force until its planned repeal after 1 February 2026, and whether the minister's announced abstention from coercion on asylum reception means municipalities need not deliver the allocated places. The minister answers that the law remains binding and enforced via the interventieladder, that no fixed timeline applies, and that repeal is being prepared, but she repeatedly declines to confirm the stated absence of coercion.
Municipalities are bound by their statutory duty for as long as the law is in force.
Gemeenten zijn gehouden aan hun wettelijke taak zolang de wet van kracht is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Veltman over de berichten ‘Perroncontroles 'overlasttrein' Zwolle - Emmen komen niet terug’ en ‘Staatssecretaris: snel oplossing voor mogelijk overslaan treinstation Maarheeze

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that perron checks on the Zwolle-Emmen line had stopped and that Maarheeze station might be skipped, and about safety, identification and enforcement against nuisance by asylum seekers on public transport. The minister answered that safety is a shared responsibility, that operators have replaced perron checks with on-board staff, that identification of offenders is limited because operators lack access to the basic register of foreigners, and that a structural solution for Maarheeze is still being negotiated.
The collection rate is commercially confidential information and cannot be shared for either company.
Het inningspercentage is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en kan voor beide bedrijven niet worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Van Nispen, Piri en Bruyning over kinderen in de noodopvang

MPs from D66, SP, GroenLinks-PvdA and Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about children housed in emergency reception locations, including overcrowding, unsuitable sites, municipal population conditions, schooling delays, repeated relocations and access to youth care. The minister answered all 18 questions in substance, acknowledged shortcomings, and pointed to a COA inventory study due in summer 2025 and steps on schooling and relocation.
COA does not keep track of whether a minor asylum seeker is enrolled in a school or regularly attends it.
Het COA houdt niet bij of een minderjarige asielzoeker staat ingeschreven op een school en of het kind de school geregeld bezoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het bericht 'COA worstelt met hoge kamerprijzen voor opvang in hotels'

An MP asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration about reports that COA pays up to €290 per night for hotel asylum rooms, why prices are not market-level, how expiring contracts will be priced, how the motion to end commercial emergency reception will be implemented, whether residents must cook for themselves, and when emergency reception can end. The minister acknowledges high prices, explains COA's price steering and contract shortening, describes phasing out emergency locations as capacity allows, and gives a partial answer with a list annexed, while declining to forecast a closing date.
COA also aims to transfer expensive and temporary reception contracts as much as possible to cheaper, long-term ones within the financial framework.
Het COA zet er bovendien op in om dure en tijdelijke opvangovereenkomsten zoveel mogelijk over te zetten naar goedkopere en langjarige binnen de financiële kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het nieuws dat uitvoeringsorganisaties geen vertrouwen hebben in de uitvoering van het escalatiemodel voor overlastgevende asielzoekers per 1 juni

An SP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration why implementing the escalation model for nuisance-causing asylum seekers from 1 June in Ter Apel was going ahead despite concerns from the municipality, police, IND and COA about capacity, enforcement, legal framework and staff safety. The Minister answered that the pbl (procesbeschikbaarheidslocatie) started on 1 June as the motion required, that the legal preconditions were realised, that enforcement will come from cooperation in the chain and the local tripartite, and that a follow-up meeting is planned, but largely referred back to an earlier letter of 30 May without substantive detail.
The Ministry of Asylum and Migration will continue discussions with the partners in the migration chain and the local tripartite on this.
Het Ministerie van Asiel en Migratie gaat daarover samen met de partners uit de migratieketen verder in gesprek met de lokale driehoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Van Nispen over de scheve verdeling in structurele asielopvangplekken tussen rijke en arme gemeenten

MPs Dijk and Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration why poorer municipalities host about five times more structural asylum reception than richer ones, questioning the Zutphen plan and the lack of contributions from wealthy municipalities. Minister Keijzer replied that the Dispersal Act requires each municipality to meet its allocated quota, that the Zutphen plan was dropped by the council, that the ministry will engage municipalities that fall short through interbestuurlijk toezicht, and that she agrees expensive emergency forms should be phased out.
The Ministry of Asylum and Migration will engage with municipalities that have not yet met their quota. Interadministrative supervision will be exercised over municipalities that do not comply.
Het Ministerie van Asiel en Migratie treedt in gesprek met gemeenten die hun opgave nog niet hebben gerealiseerd. Op gemeenten die hier niet aan voldoen wordt interbestuurlijk toezicht uitgeoefend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de Zembla uitzending 'Gevlucht en verwaarloosd'

MP Podt (D66) asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration, after a Zembla broadcast, about overload at Nidos guardianship, unsafe conditions in unaccompanied minors' shelters, foster-type family placements and oversight of host families. The Minister answered that workload concerns were raised and monitored, that smaller-scale care is the aim but emergency locations are used due to capacity pressure, that a Nidos internal review and an IGJ inspection are ongoing, and that the IND hearing practice and a broader improvement plan will be considered.
I will ensure that appropriate follow-up is given to the outcomes.
Ik zal erop toezien dat passend vervolg wordt gegeven aan de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Van moord verdachte Amerikaanse zat wekenlang ongezien in Ter Apel'

An MP asked the minister how a US woman wanted for murder could register for asylum in Ter Apel under her real name and stay unnoticed for weeks, and what checks exist for international alerts. The government declined to discuss the individual case, explained that SIS alerts are checked at intake, and said no structural change is needed beyond adding European databases under the Migration Pact.
I cannot make statements about ongoing criminal proceedings.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke procedures kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over de advertentie van ambtenaren van het ministerie van Asiel en Migratie

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration how she views an advertisement in Trouw by ministry civil servants distancing themselves from the minister, whether it conflicts with civil servants' loyalty duties under the Ambtenarenwet, and what steps she will take. The minister answered that civil servants must respect the Ambtenarenwet and Gedragscode Integriteit Rijk, that the ad's message is in line with cabinet policy, and declined to take further action or raise the issue in cabinet.
Civil servants must abide by the Ambtenarenwet.
Ambtenaren dienen zich te houden aan de Ambtenarenwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het bericht ‘Onrust in Fries dorpje om jonge AZC’ers die meisjes belagen: Nog een vinger naar mijn dochter en ik ga los’

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration how to stop unaccompanied minor asylum seekers at a Frisian reception centre from harassing girls, whether supervision or area bans could be imposed, and why COA told a victim not to go to the police. The Minister said coordination with police, COA and the municipality will continue, that intensive supervision and transfer to specialised care exist, that area bans are for the mayor, and that reporting crimes remains policy.
As you know, individual cases cannot be addressed.
Zoals u bekend, kan niet worden ingegaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht 'Nederland zet voor het eerst 'gewortelde' kinderen uit sinds einde pardonregeling'

The ChristenUnie MP Ceder asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration about reports that children rooted in the Netherlands were deported for the first time since the end of the children's pardon, questioning the safety of Nigeria, the deportation of a mother with three children, child welfare and the effects of lengthy procedures. The Minister declines to comment on individual cases, states that the best interests of the child are weighed under article 8 ECHR and article 3 CRC, and says that rootedness is not a separate criterion and is not systematically recorded.
We cannot go into individual cases.
Wij kunnen niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Nispen en Beckerman over de sloop van de woonwijk Mrija voor 1000 Oekraïners in Vlaardingen

MPs De Nispen and Beckerman (SP) asked ministers about plans to demolish the Mrija housing estate housing about 1,000 Ukrainians in Vlaardingen for a new wastewater treatment plant, questioning responsibility, the waste of recently built homes, and alternatives. The Minister of Asylum and Migration answered that the wastewater plant is a Delfland water board responsibility, the municipality is responsible for follow-up choices, the Rijk supports relocation and subsidises housing business cases, and she invites the municipality to submit business cases to the NOO.
The Rijk has no direct involvement in carrying out that obligation.
Het Rijk heeft met de uitvoering van die verplichting geen directe betrokkenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Westerveld over het bericht 'Transgender teenager is sixth Russian LGBTQ asylum seeker to die in Dutch detention in three years'

MPs Piri and Westerveld asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about the death of a transgender Russian asylum seeker in Dutch detention, the safety of LGBTQ asylum seekers, and reporting of incidents. The minister said an evaluation by COA, Nidos and the inspectorates must be awaited before conclusions, that no criminal indications were found, and that data on incidents is not registered for privacy reasons, while outlining existing protection measures.
At this stage it is not appropriate to draw such a conclusion.
Het past in dit stadium niet om een dergelijke conclusie te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het beoordelen en terugsturen van christelijke vluchtelingen

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration how returning Christian refugees to Nigeria, given severe Christian persecution there, is assessed, how IND staff gain and verify country information, and whether IND expertise on conversion claims should be strengthened with external experts. The Minister answered that Christians are not treated as a risk group, each case is individually assessed against current country information, IND staff are trained and consult conversion coordinators, and sees no concrete need to further strengthen expertise.
In current policy, Christians are not designated as a group or profile facing an elevated risk.
In het huidige beleid worden christenen niet als groep of profiel aangemerkt waarvoor een verhoogd risico geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht dat een medisch noodzakelijk operatie is geweigerd bij een asielzoeker

An MP asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration about reports that a medically necessary operation was refused for a 33-year-old asylum seeker, and whether COA can refuse such care to those without residence status. The minister answered that COA does not decide on care, that asylum seekers receive essentially the basic insurance package under EU reception rules, and that treatment timing is left to the treating doctor, while not confirming the specific case.
That is not correct. COA is not the body that determines which care is provided.
Dit klopt niet. Het COA is niet de instantie die bepaalt welke zorg verleend wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boomsma en Omtzigt over het bericht “Tienduizenden arbeidsmigranten van buiten de EU zonder papieren in Nederland”

MPs Boomsma and Omtzigt asked about reports that tens of thousands of non-EU labour migrants lack papers and obtain a BSN via RNI registration without residence checks. The government (State Secretary Van Marum) acknowledges the misuse is undesirable, says measures are being prepared with the Minister of SZW for September, but rejects requiring residence status for BSN issuance and refuses automatic BSN suspension, citing feasibility and impact on chains.
As promised in answer to question 2, I am working with the Minister of SZW on measures.
Zoals bij vraag 2 toegezegd, werk ik samen met de Minister van SZW aan maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht dat gemeenten een link zien tussen het kabinetsbeleid en dat azc-protesten

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether the government sees a link between its asylum policy and violent protests against asylum centres, and what it will do to support municipalities facing intimidation. The minister said the government condemns intimidation and violence, denies any link to its policy, notes that the government works with municipalities, and states it cannot quantify protest incidents.
No figures are kept on the exact number of protests of this kind or any incidents arising from them.
Over de exacte hoeveelheid protesten van deze aard en eventuele incidenten daarbij worden geen cijfers bijgehouden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Tseggai over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie over het feit dat het Nederlands sanctiebeleid bij niet tijdig halen van het inburgeringsexamen in strijd is met het Eur

MPs Piri and Tseggai asked about the CJEU ruling that Dutch sanctions for failing the civic integration exam in time conflict with EU law, and how many statushouders were fined or had loans reclaimed. The government answered that it awaits the Council of State ruling, has paused fines and loan recovery since March 2023, and reported about 4,025 fined and about 2,100 required to repay loans under the Wi2013.
Pending the Division's ruling, my predecessor felt compelled not to take irreversible decisions in implementation.
In afwachting van de uitspraak van de Afdeling zag mijn ambtsvoorganger zich genoodzaakt in de uitvoering geen onomkeerbare besluiten te nemen.
Antwoord op van het lid Vondeling over de aanstelling van een oud GL-raadslid in Amsterdam en de directeur van Oxfam International als secretaris directeur van de Adviesraad Migratie

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether the appointment of Evelien van Roemburg, a former GroenLinks councillor and Oxfam International director, as secretary-director of the Adviesraad Migratie was appropriate given her public statements, and whether it would be reversed. The minister confirmed the appointment, stated the advisory council is independent, and said the selection followed a standard civil-service procedure, declining to reverse it.
This appointment concerns a civil-service appointment.
Deze aanstelling betreft een ambtelijke benoeming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Iraanse (43) ontvluchtte doodstraf maar zit nu gevangen op Schiphol: 'Word elke nacht veel wakker''

An MP asks the Minister for Asylum and Migration about an Iranian woman detained at Schiphol after fleeing a possible death sentence for clothing violations, including whether asylum seekers in border detention have access to care and whether detention beyond four weeks is humane. The minister answers that individual cases are assessed on their merits, that medical care is available with referral to external specialists, and that border detention beyond four weeks is proportionate and continually reviewed, while declining to comment on individual cases.
I do not think it appropriate to express such qualifications about an individual case while it is still being handled by the IND.
Ik vind het niet passen om me in dergelijke kwalificaties te uiten over een individuele casus terwijl deze nog in behandeling is door de IND.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de uitbuiting van Indonesische verpleegkundigen en hun zaak tegen een Hogeschool

MP Van Nispen asked ministers about the exploitation of Indonesian nursing students under a work-study scheme run by a university of applied sciences, including a settlement gag clause, IND concerns, the revocation procedure and whether exploiters profited. The government answered that the settlement is private and outside its competence, that the IND recognised the institution after a revised programme, that a Labour Inspectorate fine investigation is ongoing with results to be published, and that it will review legal vulnerabilities.
The cabinet will examine vulnerabilities in the current laws and regulations and determine which follow-up steps are desirable.
Het kabinet zal kwetsbaarheden in de huidige wet- en regelgeving bezien en nagaan welke vervolgstappen gewenst zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel 'Burgemeester weigert Eritrese bijeenkomst in Rijswijk uit vrees voor rellen'

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked ministers about the Rijswijk mayor refusing an Eritrean gathering over fear of riots, and about measures, prosecutions, residence permit revocations, and damages following the February 2024 Hague riots. The government answered that local authorities bear primary responsibility, supported by national knowledge and advice networks; that 34 convictions and one acquittal have occurred with damages largely awarded but not yet final; and that it declined to give case-level or IND figures on several points.
Responsibility for taking measures to prevent and deal with unrest lies primarily with local authorities; the national government supports them with knowledge and advice.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het nemen van maatregelen voor het voorkomen en omgaan met onrust ligt in de eerste plaats bij het lokaal gezag; het rijk ondersteunt met kennis en advies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Asielzoekers die overlast geven of crimineel zijn komen op speciale lijst, maar aanvraag loopt door: teller staat op ruim 1.180'

An MP asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration about reports that asylum seekers causing nuisance or crime are placed on a Top-X list, and about incident registration, reporting to the IND, prosecution, revocation of residence permits and legal aid fees. The minister answered that COA registers incidents and encourages reporting, that not all incidents are shared with the IND, that the number of residence permits revoked or refused on public order grounds rose, and that there is no 'perverse business model' in asylum legal aid.
The number of reports against asylum seekers cannot be traced from the police system in that way.
Het aantal aangiften tegen asielzoekers valt op die manier niet uit het politiesysteem te herleiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Vos over het sturen van uitkeringen en inkomsten door statushouders en migranten naar hun land van herkomst

An MP asked whether benefits paid to refugees and migrants (notably Eritreans) are sent abroad, whether this should be restricted, and about counter-terrorism financing. The government said it does not track how benefit recipients spend money, that discrimination by origin is prohibited so benefits cannot be cut for these groups, and it described existing controls and the end of the remigration scheme.
The Ministry of SZW does not keep an overview of how recipients spend benefits.
Het Ministerie van SZW houdt geen overzicht bij van de besteding van uitkeringen door ontvangers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Groot deel asielzoekers die eigenlijk naar ander EU-land moeten om procedure af te wachten, doen dat niet'

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration why most asylum seekers subject to Dublin transfers do not leave for the responsible EU state, why other member states accept so few transfers, and how courts' blocking of transfers fits EU mutual trust. The Minister answers that transfers depend on several factors, outlines legal reforms and EU Pact measures, and commits to further steps on Dublin enforcement and ending irregular stays.
In response, on 15 May I submitted a bill to the Council of State for advice that provides that the six-month transfer period only begins after the (appeal) procedure has ended.

Als antwoord hierop heb ik op 15 mei jl. een wetsvoorstel ter advisering voorgelegd aan de Raad van State dat regelt dat de overdrachtstermijn van zes maanden pas aanvangt na afloop van de (hoger)beroepsprocedure.
Uitstel beantwoording vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het bericht ‘Onrust in Fries dorpje om jonge AZC’ers die meisjes belagen: Nog een vinger naar mijn dochter en ik ga los’

An MP from BBB asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration how she views reports of unaccompanied minor asylum seekers harassing girls near an asylum centre in Sint Annaparochie, what can be done about it, whether supervision and area bans are possible, and why the COA reportedly asked an assault victim not to go to the police. The minister's reply is only a notice that the answers will be delayed because not all necessary information has yet been received.
because not all necessary information has yet been received. I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen. Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid White over het (tijdelijk) stoppen vanuit de Verenigde Staten met financiering op de CAS-eilanden

MP White asked the government about the impact on Curaçao, Aruba and Sint Maarten of the US aid freeze (USAID), including effects on civil society, healthcare, education, legal aid for migrants, and Dutch responsibility and support. The government answered that the Caribbean countries are primarily responsible for compensating lost funding, that the Kingdom bears no direct responsibility, and that the Netherlands can only play a facilitating role such as helping with EU fund applications.
It is not for the Dutch cabinet to give insight into these specific funding flows or to investigate the possible impact.
Het is niet aan het Nederlandse kabinet inzage te geven in deze specifieke financieringsstromen of onderzoek te doen naar de mogelijke impact.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht dat de Spreidingswet mogelijk toch dit jaar wordt ingetrokken

An MP asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether her public statement that she will do everything to withdraw the Dispersal Act (Spreidingswet) this year is consistent with her ministry's outline note saying withdrawal will only happen in 2026, and what concrete steps she is taking. The minister confirms the post, says the consultation on the outline note is the first step and the bill will be refined from consultation input, and says commitments to municipalities for the first cycle will be honoured.
I am doing everything I can to get the legislative process for withdrawing the Dispersal Act moving as quickly as possible.
Ik doe er alles aan om het wetgevingstraject voor de intrekking van de spreidingswet zo snel mogelijk te laten verlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vondeling over het bericht ‘Onlogische, lange en onnodige ritten: misbruik taxivervoer asielzoekers blootgelegd´

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about reported misuse of taxi transport for asylum seekers, including how much was spent, why COA books taxis without control, and whether rides will be curbed. The minister reported high taxi and medical transport volumes and costs, said COA will limit non-medical taxi rides from 1 June, and referred to planned tightening on fraud-linked withdrawal of asylum permits.
COA indicates that it cannot share the current costs of this, due to commercially confidential information.
COA geeft aan dat het de huidige kosten hiervan, vanwege bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie, niet kan delen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Rajkowski, Diederik van Dijk en Boomsma over het bericht ‘Onlogische, lange en onnodige ritten: misbruik taxivervoer asielzoekers blootgelegd’

Three MPs asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about reports of misuse of taxi transport for asylum seekers, including a rejected Woo request, the costs and number of medically indicated taxi rides, verification of medical appointments, suspected 'ghost rides' and whether the rules should be tightened. The minister answered in detail on numbers, indication criteria and controls, stated that further investigation is underway, and announced stricter rules for non-medical taxi rides from 1 June.
COA refused the document on the ground that it contains competitive and commercially sensitive information provided to COA in confidence.
Het COA heeft het betreffende document geweigerd op de grond dat het concurrentie- en bedrijfsgevoelige informatie bevat die vertrouwelijk aan het COA ter beschikking zijn gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Piri, Rajkowski, Van Nispen, Boomsma en Van Zanten over het preventiefonds en schaderegelingen voor ondernemers in Ter Apel

MPs asked whether the 800,000 euro preventive fund for Ter Apel is nearly exhausted, how remaining costs will be financed, whether damage settlement will be broadened by this summer, and whether a single counter for damage claims and preventive funds can be set up. The minister said the funds were paid to Westerwolde municipality, that the damage scheme will be widened case by case, and that a single counter is being explored with a decentralised grant to be decided by the municipality.
As promised to the House and stated in the letter of 11 March 2025, the damage scheme will be broadened.
Zoals aan de Kamer toegezegd en benoemd in de Kamerbrief op 11 maart 2025, zal de schaderegeling verruimd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de antwoorden op vragen over 'asielopvang in hotels'

An MP asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether the Vlaardingen municipality is right that earlier answers did not cover short stays in hotels, and whether municipalities can refuse asylum reception beyond public order grounds, and asks if the democratically rejected council proposal to house 100 asylum seekers should be respected. The minister answers that short stays are permitted under current permits, that municipalities must cooperate via the provincial table and the Wet gemeentelijke taak, and that reception is in principle realised only in agreement with local government, without committing to new action.
From an administrative standpoint, the COA always strives to realise reception in good consultation with the municipality.
Vanuit bestuurlijk oogpunt geldt dat het COA er altijd naar streeft om in goed overleg met de gemeente opvang te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Nispen over de zorgwekkende uitkomsten van de inspectie Gezondheid en Jeugd over de situatie van kinderen in de opvang.

An SP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration how the government responds to the Inspectorate's findings that children and other vulnerable asylum seekers face serious health and development risks in reception, and what will be done. The minister acknowledges shortcomings and responsibility, points to improvements and to planned measures (continuity-of-care guideline, mental health access, maternity care), but says reception capacity shortages limit placement of children in suitable locations, and promises further information before the May recess.
Yes, together with the COA I am taking up these recommendations.
Ja, samen met het COA pak ik deze aanbevelingen op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de verdeelbesluiten Spreidingswet

An MP asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration about dispersal decisions under the Spreidingswet, including municipalities receiving quotas that differ from provincial proposals, objections filed, and cases like Nijkerk and Brummen. The minister explains the criteria used for kansrijke initiatives, confirms 33 municipalities and one province objected, declines to discuss individual cases, and commits to talks with municipalities willing to do more and to reviewing financing of regular reception places.
Given the ongoing discussions and procedures, I cannot, as you know, go into individual cases at this time.
Gezien de lopende gesprekken en procedures kan ik zoals u weet op dit moment niet ingaan op individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vondeling en Emiel van Dijk over Ayoub Y. die in 2020 de 18-jarige Rik van de Rakt doodstak.

PVV MPs asked why Ayoub M., who stabbed 18-year-old Rik van de Rakt while holding a temporary residence permit, was not stripped of his permit, why he may soon qualify for tbs leave, and whether he will be deported. The ministers said they do not discuss individual cases, described the tbs leave assessment procedure in general terms, and pointed to their general policy letter on revoking asylum permits.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Minister Faber negeerde eigen inspectie bij vorming asielwet’

The MPs Piri asked why the minister did not involve the Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid in drafting the Asylum Emergency Measures Act and the two-status system bill, despite the inspection guidelines, and whether this breaches the draft Framework Act on state inspectorates. The minister answered that consultation was limited to directly affected organisations for speed, that the inspectorate is not directly affected, that the guidelines allow this, and that she will not request an implementation check afterwards.
I will not ask the Inspectorate after all for an implementation check.
Ik zal de Inspectie niet alsnog om een uitvoeringstoets vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wijnen-Nas en Zanten over de column ‘Afgeslacht om die achterlijke reden: Eer’

MPs Van Zanten and Wijnen-Nas asked the government about a Telegraaf column on honour killings and what it would do about the attitudes behind them and whether citizenship could be revoked for honour-motivated crimes. The state secretary condemned the worldview, described prevention and repression measures, and said revoking Dutch nationality is only possible within European Convention limits, with the government studying whether other serious crimes could be added.
Revoking Dutch nationality is only possible for persons who hold another nationality besides Dutch.
Intrekking van de Nederlandse nationaliteit is alleen mogelijk bij personen die naast de Nederlandse nog een andere nationaliteit hebben.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koops, Omtzigt en Six Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Gewijzigd beleid van het Openbaar Ministerie rondom strafbeschikkingen, waardoor bijvoorbeeld veelplegers en asielzoekers standaard een str

Three MPs asked the Justice and Asylum ministers about the Public Prosecution Service's expanded use of penalty orders (strafbeschikkingen), which could mean repeat offenders and asylum seekers receive fines or community service instead of prison and no longer go before a judge. The minister answers that the OM acts independently, that the expansion aims to shorten case times and cover offences up to six years, that cases can still be referred to court, and that the data requested is not registered or is forthcoming later.
The OM will clarify the passage in the instruction at the next amendment or following instruction on this point.
Het OM zal de passage in de instructie bij een eerstvolgende wijziging of volgende instructie op dit punt verhelderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Rajkowski over de capaciteit vreemdelingendetentie

Two VVD MPs asked how the government would create 50 to 100 extra immigration detention places, where they would be located, and whether this reduces prison capacity. The minister answers that 90 places will be created at Justitieel Complex Schiphol in phases (August and November 2025) and that staffing shortages may force some prison capacity offline.
We have decided to realise 90 places for immigration detention at Justitieel Complex Schiphol from 1 August 2025.
We hebben besloten om per 1 augustus 2025 90 plekken voor vreemdelingenbewaring te realiseren op het Justitieel Complex Schiphol (hierna: JCS).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meijeren over het Israëlische plan om inwoners van Gaza te laten emigreren naar o.a. Westerse landen

MP Van Meijeren (FVD) asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about an Israeli plan to relocate Gazans to Western countries, including whether the Netherlands must admit Gazan asylum seekers and how to prevent their arrival. The minister declined to address the speculative plan, restated the preference for regional reception, said asylum applications are assessed individually, and noted that Gazans would generally not face the UNRWA exclusion clause.
I will not go into the consequences of a speculative plan.
Ik ga niet in op de gevolgen van een speculatief plan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de meest recente cijfers over de asielinstroom en asielketen

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration for the latest asylum inflow figures, EU comparisons, IND processing times, return rates, COA occupancy by status holders, and the effect of the fall of the Assad regime on Syrian inflow. The minister provides the figures, acknowledges the IND backlog and long waiting times, notes return numbers rose modestly, and promises the Raad van State advice will be addressed with the bills soon.
It is still too early to make statements about the effect of the fall of the Assad regime on Syrian asylum inflow to the Netherlands.
Het is nog te vroeg om uitspraken te doen over het effect van de val van het regime van Assad op de Syrische asielinstroom in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boomsma over de bezuiniging op Vluchtelingenwerk

MP Boomsma asked why the minister cut the subsidy to Vluchtelingenwerk, whether parliament was consulted, and what the consequences for the asylum chain and handover of tasks would be. The minister answered that the full available budget of about 13 million euro was granted without parliamentary approval being needed, that the organisation was informed in May and December 2024, and that the consequences and handover of tasks are still under discussion with ministries and agencies, with a promise to inform parliament as soon as possible.
Awarding a subsidy within the available financial framework does not require explicit approval from the House.
Het toekennen van een subsidie binnen de beschikbare financiële kaders vergt geen expliciete goedkeuring van de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de stand van zaken van de Top X-lijst

Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration about the Top X list of criminal and nuisance-causing asylum residents, including whether they should be denied residence permits, numbers by province and nationality, detention and restriction status, and deportations and permits granted since a motion. The Minister answered that residence permits can be refused or withdrawn only under strict case law, gave the January 2025 list figures, and could not supply the deportation and permit figures due to lack of systematic records.
Because the requested figures are not systematically recorded in that way, and given the answering deadline, it has not been possible to generate the figures requested in questions 8 and 9.
Omdat de gevraagde cijfers op die manier niet systematisch worden bijgehouden, en gegeven de beantwoordingstermijn, is het niet mogelijk gebleken de in vragen 8 en 9 gevraagde cijfers te genereren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Plotse daling van aantal kenniswerkers, iets minder nieuwe aanvragen voor asiel’ en ‘Wachtende asielzoekers ontvangen astronomisch bedrag aan dwangsommen: ‘Schaf

An MP asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration about the sharp rise in penalty payments (dwangsommen) paid by the IND to asylum seekers, the cost of court proceedings, and whether these payments should be abolished. The minister explains rising backlogs and more default notices, says the IND cannot prioritise cases by penalty notices, confirms asylum seekers must in principle contribute to reception costs, and states the government aims to abolish judicial penalty payments in migration cases.
The judicial penalty payment in fact does not function as an effective legal remedy because it does not lead to what the applicant is actually seeking: a decision in the short term.
De rechterlijk dwangsom functioneert feitelijk niet als effectief rechtsmiddel doordat het niet leidt tot dat waar het de rechtzoekende om gaat: een beslissing op korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Sneller over het bericht 'Openbare agenda’s van bewindslieden geven te weinig inzicht in hun lobbywerk'

D66 MPs Podt and Sneller asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration why his public agenda omitted or delayed entries, whether he had met burgomasters and key migration bodies. The minister answered that the agenda is generally accurate, that omissions were corrected, and listed meetings held with the Adviesraad Migratie, IOM, Nidos, UNHCR and the Inspectie, while admitting no contact with Vluchtingenwerk Nederland and Inspectie Jeugd & Gezin.
There were some omissions in the agenda, which have already been corrected.
Er was sprake van enkele omissies in de agenda, die zijn reeds hersteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over diverse cijfers omtrent asiel

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration about asylum application numbers, outflow from COA reception, the growing share of status holders in reception, plans and costs for transitional housing locations, and reducing emergency reception costs. The Minister answered with figures and projections, committed to informing the House on transitional locations in February, and said the government will prioritise faster outflow of status holders, though several cost and timing questions were left open.
I am aware of this article.
Ik ben bekend met dit artikel.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Piri over het mogelijk ontstaan van een financieel gat voor statushouder

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether a financial gap threatens status holders now that COA no longer applies for their benefit allowances, and what support municipalities will receive. The minister replied that status holders remain responsible for their own allowance applications, that the COA's support service ended on 1 January 2025, and that alternative help exists, while acknowledging no national figures on resulting arrears are available.
No national figures are available on the number of status holders who build up payment arrears due to delays in obtaining allowances.
Er zijn geen landelijke cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal statushouders dat betalingsachterstanden oploopt door vertraging bij het verkrijgen van toeslagen.
Uitstel beantwoording vragen van de leden Ellian en Rajkowski over de capaciteit vreemdelingendetentie

MPs Ellian and Rajkowski (VVD) asked how the government will create 50 to 100 extra places for immigration detention, which locations are involved, whether this reduces prison capacity, and how this relates to asylum measures. The government announced a delay in answering because not all required information has yet been received, and said it will answer as soon as possible.
since not all required information has yet been received
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Vroonhoven en Boomsma over hulp bij toeslagen voor statushouders

Two MPs asked how responsibility for helping asylum status holders apply for benefit allowances passed from COA to municipalities, whether the process was careful, and who now supports them. The minister says COA stopped its service on 1 January 2025 after system changes at the Dienst Toeslagen, that the government is cooperating with VNG and Divosa on handouts and platforms, and that statushouders remain responsible for their own allowances, with some answers and letters promised but the answers were not given within the requested week.
Yes, the text has meanwhile been adjusted on the website for COA residents.
Ja, de tekst is inmiddels aangepast op de website voor bewoners van het COA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat een broker miljoenen aan belastinggeld verdiende door de financiering van asielbedden in hotels

An SP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about reports that broker LCHD earned tens of millions in taxpayer money by financing asylum hotel beds, and why intermediaries were used despite a COA agreement to avoid them. The minister declined to comment on the case pending FIOD and OM investigations, said LCHD's services ended, acknowledged high costs, and stated that new hotel contracts are now largely concluded without external intermediaries while leaving room for external expertise.

As indicated in answering the questions of 1 July 2024, pending the outcomes of the investigations by the Public Prosecution Service and the Fiscal Intelligence and Investigation Service, I will make no further statements about this case.

Antwoord 2 en 4 Zoals aangegeven bij de beantwoording van de vragen van 1 juli 2024 3 zal ik vooruitlopend op de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie en de Fiscale Inlichtingen- en Opsporingsdienst geen verdere uitspraken doen over deze zaak.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Michon- Derkzen, Becker en Rajkowski over de komst van omstreden predikers naar de Ramadan Expo in de Jaarbeurs

MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Asylum ministers how to keep three controversial preachers with past antisemitic, homophobic and extremist statements from speaking at the Ramadan Expo in Utrecht, and what could be done about the organisers and the venue. The Minister said the three were barred via SIS signalling, that a court suspended this until a decision on objection, that the municipality holds the power over public order and any prohibition, and that prosecution remains possible if speech is criminal.

On 20 February 2025 the interim relief judge suspended these decisions until six weeks after the decision on the objection, with the result that the alerts in the Schengen Information System were removed and the persons can travel to the Netherlands.

Op 20 februari 2025 heeft de voorzieningenrechter deze besluiten geschorst tot zes weken na bekendmaking van de beslissing op bezwaar, met als gevolg dat de signaleringen in het Schengeninformatiesysteem verwijderd zijn en personen Nederland in kunnen reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over adviezen van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State naar de media zijn gelekt

An MP asked the Asylum and Migration Minister whether leaks of Raad van State advisory opinions to the media were unusual, whether only the ministry received the opinions, and whether the leak would be reported to the police. The minister said the leaked content was unusual and undesirable but declined to qualify it as criminal, said no criminal complaint would be filed for lack of grounds, and noted the opinions were later published by the Raad van State on schedule.
I consider it undesirable when statements are made about Raad van State advisory opinions before they are made public by the Raad van State.
Ik vind het onwenselijk wanneer mededelingen worden gedaan over adviezen van de Raad van State, voordat deze openbaar zijn gemaakt door de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dral en Rajkowski over het artikel ‘Mensensmokkel via zee goudmijn’

MPs Dral and Rajkowski asked the government about reports that criminal networks use the Netherlands as a hub for preparing people-smuggling crossings to the UK, including monitoring of networks, reporting by the maritime sector, social media recruitment and protection of unaccompanied minor Vietnamese girls. Minister Van Weel answered that preparatory acts occur in the Netherlands, that international cooperation (Europol OTF Wave, Calais Group) is ongoing, that reports are not centrally recorded so no comparative figures exist, and that current protection measures for unaccompanied minors are considered sufficient.
However, figures on these reports are not centrally recorded and therefore cannot be compared with previous years.
Cijfers over deze meldingen worden echter niet centraal bijgehouden, en zijn dus ook niet te vergelijken met voorgaande jaren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rajkowski en Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Helft van het aantal asielopvangplekken in 2026 bezet door statushouders'

MPs Rajkowski and De Groot (VVD) asked about projected statushouder occupancy of asylum reception places, rising family reunification, and housing for status holders after the taakstelling is abolished. The Minister of Asylum and Migration answered that the government is pursuing stricter family reunification rules, expects a two-status system to reduce reunification, and will bring forward measures and temporary housing plans with local authorities, without giving a firm timeline for permanent solutions.
The cabinet has included in its Coalition Agreement and Government Programme that family reunification will be further restricted.
Het kabinet heeft in haar Hoofdlijnenakkoord en in het Regeerprogramma opgenomen dat nareis verder wordt beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Zanten over Samidoun

An MP asked whether the government would ban a Samidoun teach-in at the University of Amsterdam, after Samidoun's Europe coordinator had earlier been barred, and what the status is of a motion to list Samidoun on the Dutch terrorist sanctions list. The minister replied that universities decide on events under academic freedom, that the UvA says the event was not officially registered and Samidoun is not welcome, and that no sufficient grounds currently exist for a court ban or sanctions listing, with a broader EU inventory and possible further measures to be reported in spring.

The conversation that has since taken place confirmed that the Public Prosecution Service currently has no information that could contribute to a request for a court ban or listing on the sanctions list.

Het gesprek dat inmiddels heeft plaatsgevonden heeft bevestigd dat het Openbaar Ministerie op dit moment geen informatie heeft die kan bijdragen aan een verzoek om verbodenverklaring bij de rechter of plaatsing op de sanctielijst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Klap voor ministers: omstreden buitenlandse predikers mogen toch Nederland in van rechter’

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked ministers how they would prevent three controversial foreign preachers from entering the Netherlands, whether landing rights could be revoked as in 2017, and what would be done if they had already landed. The ministers answered that a court had suspended the entry ban, so the preachers may enter if they meet entry conditions, that existing law offers no further grounds to refuse them, that landing rights cannot be revoked for migration reasons, and that local authorities are responsible for public order at the event.

On 20 February 2025 the interim relief judge suspended the decision to bar the three speakers from the Netherlands through an alert in the Schengen Information System, until six weeks after the decision on objection is announced.

Op 20 februari 2025 heeft de voorzieningenrechter het besluit om de drie sprekers uit Nederland te weren door signalering in het Schengeninformatiesysteem, geschorst tot zes weken na bekendmaking van de beslissing op bezwaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het tegen betaling laten vertrekken van criminele asielzoekers

MPs Van Nispen asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration about reports that the Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek paid cash and goods to criminal former asylum seekers to leave the country, and whether this rewards crime. The Minister confirmed that about 900 cases used case-specific support, roughly 2% exceeding regular amounts, with a few high payments, and said such support is an exceptional last resort while pledging to reduce its need.
As you know, I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals u bekend kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Syriërs krijgen 900 euro contant bij terugkeer'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration why voluntary return to Syria was being encouraged without a new country report, why the Chamber was not informed of the financial decision, and about the wording of a return promotion and an online post. The minister answered that there is no new policy, that the €900 is part of existing return support rounded up from €815, and that no forced return is currently happening.
Er is geen sprake van nieuw beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boomsma over het artikel 'Deze man nooit je opvang binnenlaten’. Hoe één asielzoeker een heel overheidsapparaat op stang kon jagen'

The MP Boomsma asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration how a single asylum seeker could tie up government agencies, including questions on identity fraud, refusal to cooperate with language tests, placement at a shelter, unlawful detention compensation and payments to returnees with criminal records. The Minister answers that the case is not representative, outlines the return policy and maatwerk instruments, gives figures on maatwerk use (about 900 cases, around 2% above standard support), and says the individual case cannot be discussed while planned legislative measures to strengthen returns are underway.
As you know, I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals u bekend kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de uitzichtloze situatie voor de stateloze Igor en Galina die al 17 jaar in Nederland wonen

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration why stateless Igor and Galina, long resident in the Netherlands, have still not received a residence permit after a 2024 Council of State ruling, and what will be done to resolve their case. The Minister confirmed the ruling only found insufficient reasoning and ordered a new decision, that a new decision has now been taken, and declined to discuss the individual case or to quantify similar cases.
However, I will not go into this individual case, in accordance with the agreements on this with your House.
Ik ga echter niet in op dit individuele geval, conform de afspraken hierover met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Eén man, 25 baby’s: ‘verblijfskinderen’ zijn een nieuwe manier om asiel te krijgen'

An MP asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration about reports of men recognising many children to obtain residence permits, including IND fraud-signal figures, EU comparisons, nationalities, financial effects, municipal patterns and enforcement capacity. The minister gives figures and explains the legal framework, but declines to share an internal IND report and defers the new approach to schijnerkenningen.

Are you willing to share the IND report referring to a network of 'sham fathers'? If not, why not? Answer 16: No, because this IND report concerns the elaboration of an individual case and contains confidential personal data.

Bent u bereid het IND-rapport waarin wordt verwezen naar een netwerk van «schijnvaders» te delen? Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 16 Nee, omdat dit IND-rapport de uitwerking van een individuele casus betreft en het rapport vertrouwelijke persoonsgegevens bevat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Eén man, 25 baby’s:‘schijnkinderen’zijn een nieuwe manier om verblijfspapieren te krijgen’

An SGP MP asked the Asylum and Migration minister about reports of 'sham fatherhood' recognitions used to obtain residence permits, including what action is taken and whether recognition should be criminalised. The minister called the signals serious, outlined existing legal tools (refusal by civil registrars, court annulment, prosecution), and said a new approach is being developed, while declining to share a confidential IND report.

That is why an approach to the problem of sham recognitions in Chavez residence applications is currently being developed together with the IND, the Public Prosecution Service, the Dutch Association for Civil Affairs and the Ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice and Security.

Daarom wordt er op dit moment, in samenwerking met de IND, het Openbaar Ministerie (OM), de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Burgerzaken en de Ministeries van Buitenlandse Zaken en Justitie en Veiligheid gewerkt aan een aanpak voor de problematiek rondom schijnerkenningen bij Chavez-verblijfsaanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van den Burg, Teunissen, Ceder, Boswijk, Van der Lee en Kahraman over de acuut dreigende uitzetting van Oeigoeren in Thailand

Seven MPs asked the ministers about the imminent deportation of 48 Uyghurs held in Thailand to China and what the Netherlands was doing to prevent it. The Foreign Minister answered that the Netherlands has urged Thailand, bilaterally and within the EU, to respect non-refoulement and not deport the group, and is monitoring third-country resettlement options.
The Netherlands has made the urgent appeal to the Thai authorities, orally and in writing, both bilaterally and within the EU, not to extradite the 48 Uyghurs.

Nederland heeft op verschillende manieren, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk en zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband de dringende oproep aan de Thaise autoriteiten gedaan om de 48 Oeigoeren niet uit te leveren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski, Aartsen en Becker over het bericht 'Duizenden asielzoekers krijgen werkvergunning nu regels soepeler zijn'

VVD MPs asked the ministers about a report that thousands of asylum seekers receive work permits since the 24-week rule was lifted, including refusal rates, processing times, and whether asylum seekers from safe countries or with low chances of asylum can work. The minister answered that the rule change largely explains the rise, about 11% of 2024 applications were refused and 25-30% withdrawn or refused, processing has been partly delayed, only under 1% of permits went to safe-country nationals, and restricting such groups awaits implementation of the EU reception directive by June 2026.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het bericht 'Tieners veroordeeld voor groepsverkrachting dakloze vrouw in Helmond

MP Van Zanten asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether a group rape by teenagers of a homeless woman in Helmond should lead to withdrawal of asylum permits, how the motion on refusing or revoking permits after prison sentences will be implemented, which sentence length applies, and on what timeline. The minister answers that serious offences should in principle lead to refusal or revocation, that the minimum sentence threshold is dropped in favour of case-by-case assessment (while the sliding scale of Article 3.86 remains for non-extension or revocation), and that the policy circular was amended and published on 30 January 2025.
I am of the view that if there is a (particularly) serious offence, this should in principle lead to rejection of the asylum application or revocation of the permit.
Ik ben van mening dat als er sprake is van een (bijzonder) ernstig misdrijf, dit in beginsel zou moeten leiden tot afwijzing van de asielaanvraag of intrekking van de vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pirir over het bericht 'Gemeenten en minister oneens over wat sobere opvang voor statushouders is: 'Faber vindt één persoon per slaapkamer niet sober genoeg''

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether she told the municipality of Apeldoorn that single-occupancy rooms with shared facilities are not sober enough for transit locations for recognised refugees, and what objective standards apply. The minister denied saying this, said no decision has been made, that rules and a funding scheme are still being drafted with municipalities, and that no proposed transit locations have been rejected.
To support municipalities, a funding scheme is being drawn up under which the national government will contribute towards setting up a transit location.
Om gemeenten te ondersteunen wordt een bekostigingsregeling gemaakt, waar vanuit het Rijk een bijdrage wordt geleverd om een doorstroomlocatie in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het beperken van inspraak van maatschappelijke organisaties bij nieuwe wetten

The MP asks why the government gave advisory bodies only a one-week consultation on a bill introducing a two-status asylum system and stricter family reunification rules, and why it treated confidentiality and an accelerated procedure as justified. The minister answers that urgency to relieve the asylum chain justified a shortened consultation, that the ministry will still take later advice into account, and that the 'confidential' marking was an error since consultations are not confidential.
For that reason, a limited consultation period of one week was chosen.
Om die reden is gekozen voor een beperkte consultatieperiode van één week.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri , Ceder, Koekkoek en Podt over het bericht 'Faber beperkt inspraak van adviesorganen bij overhaaste wetgeving’

MPs asked why the Minister for Asylum and Migration shortened the consultation period for two asylum bills (two-status system and tighter family reunification) and why the emergency asylum bill was not sent to the Dutch Bar Association, and how this fits Dutch legislative drafting guidelines. The minister answered that urgency justified the accelerated process, that consultation was only with directly affected bodies such as the IND, the Council for the Judiciary and the Raad van State division, that the 'confidential' marking was an error, that no shortened consultation is planned for other migration bills, and that IND concerns about implementation will be taken into account.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht dat er grote zorgen zijn bij hoge rechtsorganen over asielwetten

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration about reported serious concerns at the Council for the Judiciary and other high judicial bodies over the two-status asylum system and the emergency asylum law, including workload, costs for the IND and courts, and the short consultation period. The minister acknowledged the concerns, gave cost estimates for the IND, said the courts' costs would be assessed later, and said advice received later would still be taken into account.
As I stated in the committee debate of 19 December 2024, I will still take into account advice received at a later stage in the legislative process.
Zoals ik aangaf in het commissiedebat op 19 december 2024, zal ik adviezen die op een later moment nog worden ontvangen alsnog betrekken in het wetgevingsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked all ministries about spending, design, training, quotas, success metrics, external consultants and the government's view of 'woke' policy on diversity and inclusion in the civil service. The government answered that diversity and inclusion policy aims at a representative civil service, sets numerical ambitions for gender and cultural diversity, and says no artworks were removed and no quota beyond the statutory banenafspraak applies.
For an overview of the money earmarked for diversity and inclusion policy per ministry for the coming year, as far as now known, I refer to the annexes.
Voor een overzicht van het geld dat het komende jaar geoormerkt is voor diversiteit en inclusiebeleid per ministerie, voor zover nu bekend, verwijs ik naar de bijlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Boomsma en Diederik van Dijk over het bericht 'Asielzoekers met bekeringsverhaal krijgen minder vaak een verblijfsvergunning, zien advocaten'

MPs Ceder, Boomsma and Diederik van Dijk asked whether asylum claims based on conversion are now assessed more strictly after a 1 July 2024 change in the credibility framework, and how IND staff are trained and supported on Christianity and conversion. The minister denies that conversion claims are assessed more strictly, says documents now play a more prominent role, and refuses to provide statistics on conversion-based grant and refusal rates, citing lack of aggregated data.
The IND does not have this information because it does not record at an aggregated level what the asylum motive is for cases that are granted or refused.
De IND beschikt niet over deze informatie omdat niet op geaggregeerd niveau wordt bijgehouden wat het asielmotief is van zaken die worden ingewilligd en afgewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over frauderende tussenpersonen bij de opvang van asielzoeker in hotelkamers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about alleged fraud by a broker (LCHD) that COA cannot end due to contract terms, whether budget cuts caused the reliance on intermediaries, and how such brokers can be excluded in future. The Minister declined to comment on the case pending OM and FIOD investigations, stated COA now works largely without external intermediaries, pointed to multi-year budget allocations, and said COA ended cooperation with LCHD from 1 January 2025.

As indicated in the answers to the questions of 1 July 2024, I will not make further statements about this case in anticipation of the outcome of the investigation by the Public Prosecution Service and the Fiscal Intelligence and Investigation Service.

Zoals aangegeven bij de beantwoording van de vragen van 1 juli 2024 zal ik vooruitlopend op de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie en de Fiscale Inlichtingen en Opsporingsdienst geen verdere uitspraken doen over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Kinderrechtencollectief: 65% meer kinderen in noodopvang is onacceptabel'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about reports that children in emergency asylum shelters face poor conditions, including the Minister's earlier claim that shelters met legal standards, and about the rise in children in emergency shelters, school access, and implementing a motion on limiting forced relocations. The Minister acknowledged the reports, said the government is aware of the earlier inspection and ombudsman reports, admitted that current pressure makes it impossible to meet the standard of keeping children out of emergency shelters, and outlined measures such as child contact persons and school support, while stating it is not yet possible to say when the relocation limit will be achieved.
The starting point is that children do not stay in emergency shelter locations, but given the current pressure on reception capacity it is currently not feasible to meet this.
Het uitgangspunt is dat kinderen niet in noodopvanglocaties verblijven, maar met de huidige druk op de opvangcapaciteit is het momenteel niet haalbaar om hieraan te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over zakelijke en financiële belangen

MP Dijk asked ministers and state secretaries about their financial and business interests, whether these could influence cabinet decisions, and whether such interests should be made public, including holdings under 25,000 euro. The government confirmed that some ministers have such interests, said a procedure was followed to prevent conflicts of interest, and refused to disclose the information, promising only to review the framework before the next formation.
Referring to the answers to questions 1 through 7, I will not provide this information.
Onder verwijzing naar de antwoorden op vragen 1 t/m 7 zal ik deze informatie niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over financiële en zakelijke belangen

An SP MP asked several ministers and state secretaries whether their financial and business interests, including stakes in Dutch and American companies, could affect cabinet decisions and whether such interests should be disclosed. The state secretary confirmed the interests exist, said the procedure to prevent conflicts was followed and the framework will be reviewed before the next formation, but refused to disclose the details of the interests.
Referring to the answers to questions 1 through 7, I will not provide this information.
Onder verwijzing naar de antwoorden op vragen 1 t/m 7 zal ik deze informatie niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over financiële en zakelijke belangen

An SP MP asked several ministers and state secretaries whether their financial and business interests, reported in the formateur's final report, could affect cabinet decisions, and whether such interests should be disclosed.
