State Secretary Szabó confirmed the interests, said the appointment procedure ensured no objective risk of conflict of interest, and declined to share details of the interests, while saying the existing framework will be reviewed before the next formation.
Referring to the answers to questions 1 through 7, I will not provide this information.
Onder verwijzing naar de antwoorden op vragen 1 t/m 7 zal ik deze informatie niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over financiële en zakelijke belangen

An SP MP asked several ministers and state secretaries about their financial and business interests, whether these could influence cabinet decisions, and whether such information should be public. The Minister for Housing answered that the procedure was followed carefully, that the framework for conflicts of interest will be reviewed before the next formation, and declined to disclose the interests requested.
Referring to the answers to questions 1 through 7, I will not provide this information.
Onder verwijzing naar de antwoorden op vragen 1 t/m 7 zal ik deze informatie niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over financiële en zakelijke belangen

An MP asked ministers and state secretaries about their financial and business interests, including whether their holdings are below 25,000 euro, whether these could influence cabinet decisions, and whether they would disclose them. The state secretary confirmed the interests, said a formation procedure safeguarded against conflicts of interest, and declined to share details of the holdings, pointing to the earlier answers.
Referring to the answers to questions 1 through 7, I will not provide this information.
Onder verwijzing naar de antwoorden op vragen 1 t/m 7 zal ik deze informatie niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Piri over zorg voor zwangere vrouwen en baby’s in aanmeldcentrum en AZC’s

MPs Slagt-Tichelman and Piri asked the ministers about maternity care for pregnant asylum seekers in reception centres, citing the EGALITE report on higher stillbirth and birth complications, and asked about relocations, interpreters, hygiene, privacy and the status of the Ketenrichtlijn. The minister acknowledges the problems, points to the Musselkanaal wing, the strain on reception capacity and planned action (raising the guideline with professional bodies, reviewing the EGALITE recommendations), but declines to change birth registration rules and does not commit to new binding standards.
I will therefore ask the professional organisations in maternity care to bring the chain guideline again to the attention of their members.
Ik zal de beroepsorganisaties in de geboortezorg daarom verzoeken om de ketenrichtlijn opnieuw onder de aandacht te brengen bij hun achterban.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over het bericht 'Geboortezorg voor asielzoekers van 'onacceptabel' niveau, concluderen onderzoekers'

MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the ministers about a report finding worse birth outcomes (higher perinatal mortality and low birth weight) among asylum seekers, and about transport, transfers and medical handover for pregnant women in reception. The government acknowledges the disparities and the problems with emergency shelter, points to existing arrangements such as Musselkanaal and taxi transport, and promises further study of the report's recommendations without committing to new funding.
If so, do you consider this cause for serious concern and can you provide the House with a comprehensive response?
Zo ja, vindt u dit reden tot grote zorg en kunt u de Kamer van een uitgebreide reactie voorzien?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Kent over het nieuws dat arbeidsmigranten worden uitgebuit door werkgevers die de noodopvang voor asielzoekers verzorgen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Kent asked about reports that migrant workers were exploited by private firms running emergency asylum accommodation on cruise ships, including unpaid long shifts and dismissal without housing, and about tax avoidance and why asylum seekers do not do the work. The minister called the conditions unacceptable and said investigation is needed, that emergency sites require specialist staff and fast setup, that COA checks contractors via Bibob and CSR rules, and that COA is reviewing contracts and activating residents more, while not committing to contract-wide sanctions.
It is my ambition to limit this expensive and suboptimal form of accommodation to a minimum as quickly as possible.
Het is mijn ambitie om deze dure en suboptimale vorm van opvang zo snel mogelijk tot een minimum te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over "staatscommissie demografie"

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers about the government's position on the State Commission's demography report, including which scenario policy follows and whether the programmatic governance approach and a four-yearly demography report will be adopted. The minister answers that the cabinet endorses steering toward moderate population growth, plans an annual monitor and knowledge infrastructure, and will report on the governance exploration in spring 2025, but declines to answer the questions in time for the debate.

Following the caretaker cabinet's commitment in its letter of 24 May 2024, in November 2024 an assignment was given to ABDTOPConsult for an exploration of how to achieve a cross-domain, multi-year programmatic approach within the central government.
Naar aanleiding van de toezegging van het demissionaire kabinet in de Kamerbrief van 24 mei 2024 is in november 2024 een opdracht verstrekt aan ABDTOPConsult voor een verkenning
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over doorstroomlocaties

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration how many transit locations will be needed for refugees who cannot move into housing in 2025-2027, what they will look like, and who will pay for them. The minister answered that the number depends on location sizes, that details, financing and responsibility are still being worked out with local governments, and that new funding decisions will follow the budget cycle.
The exact number of transit locations depends on the size of the locations brought into use and is difficult to specify in advance.
Het precieze aantal doorstroomlocaties hangt af van de grootte van de locaties die in gebruik worden genomen en is op voorhand moeilijk te preciseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over asielopvang in hotels

MP Eerdmans asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether hotels can be used for asylum reception against a municipality's will, what legal role COA and municipalities have, and how the Vlaardingen Campanile case fits with the Tubbergen precedent. The minister answered that municipal consent is not legally required for hotel placement but COA aims to agree with municipalities, that the Vlaardingen case is different from Tubbergen, and that no ruimtelijke ordening instrument has been threatened there.
Permission from the municipal government is not legally required from a legal standpoint, but COA always strives to realize this in consultation with the municipal government.
Toestemming van het gemeentebestuur is hiervoor vanuit juridisch oogpunt niet vereist, maar het COA streeft er altijd naar om dit in afstemming met het gemeentebestuur te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Boomsma over het bericht 'Onverantwoord veel' asielzoekers vast in aanmeldcentrum Schiphol'

MPs Rajkowski and Boomsma asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration about the rising number of asylum claims at Schiphol and what measures will be taken. The minister confirmed a surge from mid-October 2024 among transit passengers from Chad, Senegal, Mauritania and Central African Republic, introduced a transit visa requirement on 25 November 2024 and said monitoring and airline contacts continue.
Since 25 November 2024, a airport transit visa requirement has therefore been introduced for travellers with Chadian, Senegalese, Mauritanian and Central African nationality.
Sinds 25 november 2024 is daarom een luchthaventransitvisumplicht ingesteld voor reizigers met de Tsjadische, Senegalese, Mauritaanse en Centraal-Afrikaanse nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de zorgen bij de UNHCR betreffende het kleinere aantal vluchtelingen dat Nederland gaat opvangen

An SP MP asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration about UNHCR concerns over the reduced Dutch resettlement quota of 200 refugees instead of 500, its proportionality, the lack of a permanent residence permit for resettled refugees, and whether a special status is planned. The minister answers that the cabinet's October decisions stand, that the quota reduction applies 'until further notice', that resettled refugees receive the same temporary asylum permit as other status holders, and that no exception is currently foreseen.
'Until further notice' means until the current (or a successor) cabinet considers that other action is needed.
Tot nader order betekent totdat het huidige (of een opvolgend) kabinet meent dat andere inzet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het van het lid Bamenga over de plannen voor (intensievere) controles aan de landsgrenzen

An MP asked the ministers about intensified border controls, whether checks occur without individual suspicion, what safeguards prevent ethnic profiling, and related use of number plates and sensors. The government answered that the Marechaussee is bound by non-discrimination rules, no longer uses ethnicity in selection, complaints go to the KMar, Inspectie JenV and the Nationale ombudsman, and that controls are risk- and information-driven rather than random.
The Inspectorate of Justice and Security supervises the conduct of the KMar.
De Inspectie van Justitie en Veiligheid houdt toezicht op het handelen van de KMar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Piri en Podt over de (beveiligde) opvang van COA-bewoners en ongedocumenteerden met ernstige psychische problemen

MPs asked the government why it appeared to downplay concerns that the Veldzicht centre would stop accepting COA residents and undocumented migrants with severe psychiatric problems, and where such people could be placed safely. The minister answered that no decisions had yet been taken, that beds for the group remain available with case-by-case assessment, that responsibility is shared across ministers, and that the group will not be left on the street, while deferring full answers until a decision on the cooperation agreement was taken.
Discussions are taking place between the parties involved to ensure it is clear under which criteria and conditions this group can be placed in the reserved beds at Veldzicht.
Er vinden gesprekken plaats tussen betrokken partijen om te borgen dat duidelijk is onder welke criteria en randvoorwaarden deze groep op de gereserveerde bedden in Veldzicht geplaatst kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Van Nispen over Veldzicht en de uitvoering van de motie-Van Nispen c.s. (Kamerstuk 24 587, nr. 995)

Two MPs asked whether the government will ensure that vulnerable undocumented migrants and COA residents with serious mental health problems, covered by a motion, do not end up on the street, after two people were refused access to Veldzicht. The minister confirmed the target group, said one refused person was ordered admitted by a court, and said that cases are assessed individually and cooperation arrangements remain in place, without giving a firm guarantee on all points.

As indicated in the letter to Parliament 'Samenwerkingsconvenant COA en Veldzicht' (reference 544779), you can assume that the current population staying in Veldzicht without a suitable alternative in mental health care will not simply be put on the street.

Zoals aangegeven in de Kamerbrief «Samenwerkingsconvenant COA en Veldzicht» (referentie 544779), kunt u ervan uitgaan dat de huidige populatie die in Veldzicht verblijft zonder passend alternatief in de GGZ niet zomaar op straat wordt gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Podt over het bericht ‘Ministeries laten gevaarlijke man op straat zwerven, ondanks waarschuwingen’

MPs Van Nispen and Podt asked the Asylum and Migration Minister, on behalf of the Justice Secretary, why a dangerous undocumented man with a violent past was left on the street despite warnings, why he was refused by the Veldzicht clinic, and how this squares with earlier promises and a motion. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, said he will be admitted to Veldzicht following a court ruling, defended clinic admission decisions as medical, and said the government shares responsibility while promising to clarify admission conditions with partners.
We do not go into individual situations.
Wij gaan niet in op individuele situaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman, Omtzigt, Ceder over de opmars van de HTS in Syrië

MPs Kahraman, Omtzigt and Ceder asked the ministers about HTS's rise in Syria, including foreign support, its terrorist listing, contacts, minority rights, sanctions, humanitarian aid and paths to peace. The minister answered that the government lacks information on who backs HTS, HTS is treated as terrorist via the UN/EU listing, no contacts exist, and many questions are deferred to the upcoming debate or ongoing EU reviews.
The cabinet does not have independent information with which these reports can be confirmed or denied.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie waarmee deze berichten bevestigd of ontkend kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Van der Werf over de gevolgen voor veiligheid van de aangekondigde grenscontroles

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Migration, Defence and Justice how border controls would affect security, given KMar staff shortages, whether extra funding helps, and whether border municipalities were consulted. The government answered that controls run within existing KMar capacity, that funding is being worked out, that there was consultation with border regions, and that impacts on the economy will be kept to a minimum.
The internal border checks will be carried out on the basis of the KMar's existing capacity.
De uitvoering van de binnengrenscontroles zullen plaatsvinden op basis van de bestaande capaciteit van de KMar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Chakor over de zorgen van gemeenten over de grenscontroles

MPs Chakor asked how the government involved municipalities in planning border controls and whether it would address the burden on cross-border residents and businesses. The Minister replied that officials had contact with local authorities, a administrative meeting was held with commissioners and border mayors, and measures such as risk-based, non-systematic checks and no speed restrictions unless strictly necessary were announced.
Both before and after 11 November, there has been official contact with subnational authorities.
Zowel voor 11 november jl. als daarna is ambtelijk contact geweest met medeoverheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over de voortgang van het implementatieplan voor het EU Migratiepact

MP Podt (D66) asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration about the progress of the national implementation plan for the EU Migration Pact, including missed deadlines, timing, budget realism and the EES implementation. Minister Faber answered that the final plan was sent to the Commission on 6 December with a copy to parliament, that the budget implications will be considered in the spring memorandum, and that the EES start is being phased by the Commission.
The final plan was sent to the Commission on 6 December.
Het definitieve plan is op 6 december jl. aan de Commissie gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Kamminga over het bericht 'Kabinet wil uitgeprocedeerde Afrikaanse asielzoekers naar Oeganda sturen'

MPs Rajkowski and Kamminga asked the government about reports that the cabinet wants to send rejected African asylum seekers to Uganda, and about migration deals with third countries, Uganda's anti-LGBTI law, and plans for return hubs. The minister confirmed that partnerships with third countries are a key element, said talks with Uganda are at an early exploratory stage, and declined to give figures, costs, timelines or a timeframe for answering.
The talks with Uganda are at an initial stage.
De gesprekken met Oeganda bevinden zich in een beginstadium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘COA verwacht komende dagen voldoende opvangplekken te hebben in Ter Apel’

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about overcrowding at the Ter Apel asylum reception centre, including causes, forecasting, contacts with the mayor and municipalities, and reliance on emergency shelters. The minister answered that reception capacity is full, cited the mix of inflow, status-holder outflow and available places as causes, and said talks with municipalities continue, while declining to list municipalities offering places.
In order not to disrupt the ongoing talks with municipalities, I am not including an overview listing which municipalities are in talks.
Om de lopende gesprekken met gemeenten niet te doorkruisen, neem ik geen overzicht op waarin is vermeld met welke gemeenten gesprekken lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Michon-Derkzen over winkelverboden aan criminele overlastgevende asielzoekers

Two VVD MPs asked about shop bans against criminal nuisance-causing asylum seekers: how many were imposed since 2020, whether shopkeepers must serve them personally and translate them, and how reporting of theft and violations can be encouraged. The minister reported rising numbers of individual and collective shop bans, explained that shop bans must be served in person with no legal translation requirement but must be understandable to the suspect, and pointed to police and CCV measures and the existing toolbox.
There is no statutory provision requiring that a shop ban be issued in the native language of the person concerned.
Er bestaat geen wettelijke bepaling die verplicht tot het uitreiken van een winkelverbod in de (moeder)taal van de betrokkene/verdachte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht aangaande de aanstelling van een woordvoerder op het ministerie van Asiel en Migratie

An MP asked the ministers whether Minister Faber (Asylum and Migration) refused to appoint a former spokesperson of the Amsterdam mayor, how spokesperson appointments work, and why the appointment was withdrawn. The government answered the procedure questions in general terms but declined to comment on the individual case, and gave no figures on refused appointments.
I do not make statements about individual case matters.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen inzake het werken met ambtenaren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether she blocked the appointment of an interim spokesperson with a past link to Mayor Halsema, whether this was linked to Wilders' demand for Halsema's resignation, and what signal this sends to civil servants. The minister declined to comment on the individual case in nearly every answer, stating only that advisers work independently and the minister bears political responsibility.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Sneller over het bericht “Vrees voor grote chaos door grenscontroles: ellenlange files en klap voor Nederlandse economie”

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Asylum and Migration about fears that border controls would cause traffic chaos and harm the Dutch economy, including impacts on border regions and whether an impact analysis would be made. The government answered that controls will be risk-based rather than systematic, no crossing points will be designated, no speed-limiting measures are planned unless strictly necessary, controls will be coordinated with Germany, and no significant extra costs are expected, but it declined to commit to a formal impact analysis.
The cabinet therefore expects that no significant additional costs will arise from the reintroduction of internal border controls.
Het kabinet verwacht daarom dat er geen significante extra kosten zullen ontstaan vanwege de herinvoering van binnengrenstoezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Duitsland gaat paspoorten controleren bij alle landsgrenzen'

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about Germany's reinstated internal border checks, including whether they would apply at the Dutch border, what consultation took place, and whether the Netherlands would follow suit. The minister confirmed notification from Germany, ongoing operational contact, and said the Netherlands will introduce temporary, non-systematic internal border checks from 9 December 2024 to 8 June 2025 while limiting economic impact.
I informed the House on 11 November of the cabinet's decision to temporarily reintroduce internal border supervision between 9 December 2024 and 8 June 2025.
Ik heb de Kamer op 11 november jl. geïnformeerd over het besluit van het kabinet om tussen 9 december 2024 en 8 juni 2025 het binnengrenstoezicht tijdelijk her in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over de invoering van interne grenscontroles in Nederland

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked the government about the reintroduction of internal border controls, including costs, justification under EU rules, personnel impact on the Royal Marechaussee, and whether controls will facilitate people smuggling. The minister answered that controls will be risk-based and non-systematic, that no significant extra costs are expected, that irregular migration and secondary flows justify the measure, and that controls are temporary and not expected to increase smuggling.
The cabinet is taking all possible measures to prevent further disruption of the migration system, because this could lead to distressing situations and a greater threat to public order.
Het kabinet neemt alle mogelijke maatregelen om verdere verstoring van het migratiesysteem te voorkomen, omdat dit kan leiden tot schrijnende situaties en een grotere dreiging voor de openbare orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de opvanglocatie in de Expohal in Assen

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration whether asylum seekers staying beyond the agreed 20 days in the Expohal in Assen, including children and unaccompanied minors, is compatible with the planned reduction of asylum reception and with the agreements between Assen and COA. The minister answered that 90 of 473 residents exceeded the 20-day norm, that noodopvang is used due to shortage of regular places, and that COA is working to move children out and improve conditions, but gave no concrete binding guarantee on compliance with the agreement.
The stay in emergency reception locations must be as short as possible, therefore I am focusing on reducing pressure on the asylum system through measures that limit inflow.
Het verblijf op noodopvanglocaties dient zo kort mogelijk te zijn daarom zet ik met instroombeperkende maatregelen in op het verlichten van de druk op het asielsysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de gevolgen van de recente uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie op het asielbeleid

Baudet (FVD) asked whether the October 2024 CJEU ruling on Afghan women as a particular social group would lower the threshold for refugee status and raise asylum applications, and how Dutch asylum policy and individual assessment would be safeguarded. The minister answered that the ruling largely matches existing Dutch country policy, that no increase in applications is expected, that individual assessment remains, and that no new measures are needed.
The recent ruling of the Court of Justice of the European Union does not stand in the way of this individual assessment either.
Het recente arrest van het Europese Hof van Justitie staat deze individuele beoordeling ook niet in de weg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Van Nispen over het bericht 'GGD-arts slaat alarm: 'Asielkinderen opvang Assen zijn ondervoed en bang'

MPs Piri and Van Nispen asked whether children should no longer be housed in the Expo Hal emergency shelter in Assen, how long residents stay and how often the 20-day limit is exceeded, and how the child-appropriate housing motion will be implemented. The Minister answers that emergency shelter is still needed to prevent people sleeping on the street, that the COA is working to move children to regular shelters, that residents stay on average 15 days with 90 of 473 exceeding 20 days, and that no firm end date can be given.
Given that I depend on other parties to realise shelter, I cannot give a timeframe for when the use of emergency shelter locations will no longer be needed.
Gelet op het feit dat ik voor het realiseren van opvang afhankelijk ben van andere partijen kan ik geen termijn geven waarop de inzet van noodopvanglocaties niet meer nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht dat gemeenten volgend jaar minder geld krijgen voor de opvang van Oekraïners

Piri (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked whether the government's planned cut of about 30% in the per-day reimbursement for municipal Ukrainian refugee shelter would stop municipalities creating enough places, and how this fits the target of 125,000 places. The minister answered that the rates are recalibrated to a cost study, that the exception allowing actual costs to be claimed remains, and that municipalities will not be financially disadvantaged, while many questions were answered only by restating policy or referring to the cost-study outcome.
The starting point here is that municipalities do not suffer any financial disadvantage from the reception task for displaced persons from Ukraine.
Het uitgangspunt hierbij is dat gemeenten geen financieel nadeel ondervinden van de opvangtaak voor ontheemden uit Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het rapport 'Bouwstenen voor het asielbeleid en het asielstelsel'

The MP asks how the government's report 'Bouwstenen voor het asielbeleid' was weighed in the coalition agreement and budget memorandum, and for a per-recommendation account. The minister says the report was one input among others, that recommendations are implemented only where included in the regeerprogramma, and that no overview per recommendation exists or can be produced in the time available.
There is no overview indicating per recommendation whether and to what extent the recommendations have been included in the coalition agreement or the subsequent government programme.
Er bestaat geen overzicht waarin per aanbeveling is aangegeven of en in welke mate de aanbevelingen een plaats hebben gekregen in het hoofdlijnenakkoord of het daarop gevolgde regeerprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat 18.000 asielzoekers niet kunnen werken omdat de wachtlijsten voor een bsn torenhoog zijn

MP Van Nispen asked why the backlog for citizen service numbers (BSN) for asylum seekers has risen to about 18,000, who is responsible for registration, and when the backlog will be cleared. The State Secretary answered that capacity at the few designated registration offices is insufficient, that several municipalities will be funded to register 16,500 people by May 2025, and that responsibilities are split among ministries, municipalities and agencies.

The Ministry of the Interior, with a contribution from the Ministry of Asylum and Migration, will this year provide specific grants to Amsterdam and Gilze en Rijen to carry out 16,500 BRP registrations between November 2024 and May 2025.

Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties verstrekt nog dit jaar, met een bijdrage van het Ministerie van Asiel en Migratie, specifieke uitkeringen aan de gemeente Amsterdam en de gemeente Gilze en Rijen om in de periode van november 2024 tot mei 2025 16.500 inschrijvingen in de BRP te gaan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over humanitaire consequenties detentie reddingsschip van Artsen zonder Grenzen Geo Barents door Italië

MP Koekkoek (Volt) asked the ministers about the humanitarian consequences of Italy's detention of the Geo Barents rescue ship and the Libyan coast guard's conduct. The government replied that Italy's detention is a domestic legal matter for Italian courts and the European Commission, that the EU supports the Libyan coast guard with monitoring and training, and that a complaint filed with the Commission in July 2023 is still pending.
This concerns an assessment by the Italian authorities based on Italian laws and regulations.
Het gaat hier om een afweging van de Italiaanse autoriteiten op basis van Italiaanse wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boomsma over het niet kunnen innen van de eigen bijdrage van werkende Oekraïense ontheemden die worden opgevangen door gemeenten

Boomsma asked why the amended RooO gives municipalities access only to parts a to c of article 33(2) SUWI data, not part d needed to collect the own contribution from working Ukrainian displaced persons, and whether the law must change quickly. The minister says a legal basis extending the data sharing to part d will be added via the pending omnibus bill, with municipalities required to fully implement from 1 January 2025.
It has since become apparent that this legal basis should be extended to include the data under article 33(2)(d) of the SUWI Act.
Inmiddels is gebleken dat deze grondslag zou moeten worden uitgebreid met de gegevens onder artikel 33, tweede lid, onder d, van de wet SUWI.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Van Nispen en Ceder over het artikel 'The brutal truth behind Italy’s migrant reduction: beatings and rape by EU-funded forces in Tunisia'

MPs Koekkoek, Van Nispen and Ceder asked the government about a Guardian report on abuses by Tunisian coast guard forces funded through EU migration cooperation, including rape, beatings, EU financing, and EU monitoring. The government answered that it has raised concerns with the European Commission, that EU funds must not contribute to human rights violations, that it has no independently verified evidence of several alleged abuses, and that it will keep raising human rights in bilateral and EU contacts.
The Netherlands has conveyed these concerns to the European Commission.
Nederland heeft deze zorgen bij de Europese Commissie kenbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Boswijk over de rechtszaak van Nederland tegen Afghanistan

MPs Piri and Boswijk asked for the written claim Netherlands, Australia, Canada and Germany filed against Afghanistan over violations of the Women's Convention, asked whether it affects asylum procedures for Afghan women, and asked about grant rates and the risks of tightened IND assessment criteria. The minister said the claim is at the negotiation stage and the strategy is confidential, that there is no legal link to asylum decisions which rest on the Afghanistan country report and individual assessment, and gave grant-rate figures (about 95% overall, 75% since July 2024 on small numbers).
The progress and strategy of the negotiations is confidential in the interest of the process.
De voortgang en strategie van de onderhandelingen is in het belang van het proces vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boomsma over het bericht GGD-arts slaat alarm: Asielkinderenopvang Assen zijn ondervoed en bang

The MP Boomsma asked whether the minister had read a news report that a GGD doctor raised alarm about malnourished children and fear in the Assen asylum reception, and asked for the GGD letter, a point-by-point response, confirmation of underweight children, an assessment of reception quality for families, and necessary measures. The minister acknowledged a ministry processing delay with apologies and referred the MP to an earlier letter of 4 November answering the same situation, without answering the questions directly in this document.
For answering the questions, I kindly refer you to my letter of 4 November.
Voor de beantwoording van de vragen verwijs ik u graag naar mijn brief van 4 november jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Podt over het kidnappen van Turkse burgers in Kenia

MPs Paternotte and Podt asked about the abduction of seven Turkish refugees in Nairobi, risks of refoulement and political punishment in Turkey, transnational repression of Gülen movement members, and whether a new country report on Turkey would be requested. The minister condemned the refoulement, said the ambassador raised it with Kenya, noted Gülen-linked profiles are treated as a risk profile in asylum policy, and committed to a new Algemeen Ambtsbericht Turkije by end of February 2025.
I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en van Nispen over het nieuws dat veel kinderen in erbarmelijke omstandigheden wonen in de asielnoodopvang in Nederland

MPs Dijk and van Nispen asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about the rising number of children living in harsh conditions in emergency asylum shelters, and whether this breaches children's rights, harms education and health care, and what steps will be taken. The minister acknowledges the pressure on reception capacity, admits emergency sites are poorly suited to children, and describes existing measures and ongoing talks, but gives no firm timeline for ending child placements in emergency shelters.
With the current pressure on reception capacity, however, it cannot be said by when children will no longer be housed in emergency shelters.
Met de huidige druk op de opvangcapaciteit is echter niet te zeggen op welke termijn het niet meer voor zal komen dat kinderen op noodopvanglocaties verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Komst vluchtelingen Weteringsingel zorgt voor grote onrust bij inwoners'

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about a plan to open a second reception location for 80 unaccompanied minors in Papendrecht, its consistency with the government's large-scale reception policy, the lack of consultation with residents and councillors, and how municipal councils can be prevented from being sidelined by COA agreements. The Minister answered that small-scale locations for unaccompanied minors are normal, that large-scale reception is the general policy with small sites still needed, that the municipality is responsible for consultation and the decision process, and that COA-municipality agreements may include safety arrangements.
The decision-making process is a matter for the municipality.
Het proces van besluitvorming is aan de gemeente.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America, Becker, Michon-Derkzen en Ellian over het bericht 'Omstreden Samidoun-kopstuk Mohammed Khatib komt naar Radboud Universiteit Nijmegen: ’Extremistische haatprediker’'

MPs from the VVD asked ministers whether they would refuse or flag a visa for Mohammed Khatib of Samidoun, whether universities should host such speakers, and what the government will do about foreign influence and the organisation's banning. The ministers answered that Khatib has been flagged in the national alert system and refused entry, that the Radboud University cancelled the lecture, that the government is supporting an EU listing of Samidoun and talking with Germany and the public prosecutor, and that a national antisemitism strategy will follow in autumn.
These conclusions led the Minister for Asylum and Migration, in consultation with the Minister of Justice and Security, to flag the person in E&S.
Deze conclusies hebben ertoe geleid dat de Minister van Asiel en Migratie, in samenspraak met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, betrokkene heeft gesignaleerd in E&S.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de rol van de Landsadvocaat in de besluitvorming omtrent het uitroepen van een asielcrisis en de plannen voor een noodwet op het gebied van Asiel

An SP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration when the Landsadvocaat (state's legal advisor) became involved in the planned asylum crisis declaration and emergency law, and why the consultation was informal and undocumented. The minister answered that informal contacts began end of August, that the process stopped after two meetings once all legal angles were covered, that no minutes exist, and that decisions and their justification will be accounted for to parliament as usual.
No minutes were made of the conversations with the Landsadvocaat.
Er is geen verslag gemaakt van de gesprekken met de Landsadvocaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Asielzoekers veroorzaken overlast in Grave: 'Mensen durven straat niet op'’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration about reported nuisance by asylum seekers in Grave, including whether it stemmed from a transfer from Budel, which asylum groups were involved, and whether overlast-causing asylum seekers could be moved to stricter locations such as a PBL. The minister answered that police recorded a rise in reports linked to two separate incidents, that two residents were arrested and personal details withheld for privacy, and outlined a tougher policy package including a faster process-availability approach and stricter supervision, while noting local authorities hold public-order responsibility.
For privacy reasons I cannot go further into the information you requested about these persons.
Om privacyredenen kan ik verder niet ingaan op de door u gevraagde informatie over deze personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over enkele gedane uitspraken en de ministeriële verantwoordelijkheid

MP Podt asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration what she meant by saying COA had been informed and had months to prepare, how this squares with ministerial responsibility for COA, and whether publicly blaming COA is appropriate. The Minister replied that she sought to meet the Ter Apel agreement by asking COA to place one or two extra asylum seekers per location, that she stands by her staff and agencies, that she will keep parliament informed, and that internal documents should stay internal, without committing to stop such statements.
It is my responsibility as Minister to transparently inform your House in response to questions the House has asked.
Het is mijn verantwoordelijkheid als Minister om uw Kamer transparant te informeren naar aanleiding van vragen die de Kamer heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Ministerie en IND: uitzetting van Mikael en moeder naar Armenië onvermijdelijk’

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about a news report that the removal of a boy and his mother to Armenia was unavoidable, and about the rules on repeated asylum applications, the closed Kinderpardon arrangement, the discretionary power of the IND director-general, and humane return of families. The minister answered at length, describing the procedures, the 2019 arrangement statistics, the limited discretionary power since May 2019, and the safeguards for families with children, without committing to a new action.
An asylum application is always assessed individually and is never a political decision, but follows from an objective weighing of the risks on return.
Een asielaanvraag wordt altijd individueel beoordeeld en is nooit een politieke beslissing, maar volgt uit een objectieve weging van de risico's bij terugkeer.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Eerdmans over de instroom en terugkeer van alleenstaande minderjarige vreemdelingen

An MP asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration about the inflow of unaccompanied minors, their acceptance rates, absconding, family reunification, the EU migration pact's exemption from border procedures, and whether adequate reception in origin countries (as in Angola) could enable returns. The minister answers with statistics, acknowledges concerns about sending minors ahead, notes the EU rules apply from 2026, and commits to further research and to pursuing reception partnerships in origin countries.
I find this practice highly undesirable.
Deze praktijk vind ik zeer onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de uitspraken van de minister over de zaak ‘Mikael’ en het ingenomen standpunt

An MP asks the Minister for Asylum and Migration about her statements on the case of the Armenian child Mikael, whether she still has legal powers to intervene, and why the three-year-and-three-month residence rule was applied inconsistently. The Minister confirms she retains formal powers but says the discretionary power for hardship cases was limited to first procedures in 2019, declines to discuss individual cases, and states that children's interests are weighed under Article 8 ECHR.
As is known, I do not go into individual cases.
Zoals bekend ga ik niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Jetten, Dijk, Ouwehand, Bikker, Dassen en Van Baarle over de uitzetting van de elfjarige Mikael

MPs asked the government whether it could grant a residence permit to eleven-year-old Mikael and his mother despite a Council of State ruling, and why the child-amnesty rules required being 'in beeld' with the immigration chain. The minister answered that residence permits require a statutory basis, that the discretionary power was replaced in 2019 and is limited to harsh circumstances in the first application, and that the government will not take measures to prevent harsh outcomes in individual cases.
The cabinet does not intend to take these measures.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens om deze maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het aankondigen van een optout bij de Europese Commissie

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration why the government is announcing an opt-out from EU asylum and migration rules to the European Commission when treaty change is not on the table, and what signal this sends about compliance. The minister replied that the letter signals Dutch intent to make its own migration rules at future treaty change, that the government will comply with current EU asylum law while an opt-out is absent, and that enforcement is for the Commission to decide.
As long as the Netherlands has no opt-out, the European asylum and migration rules apply to the Netherlands, and the cabinet will implement and comply with them.
Zo lang Nederland geen opt-out heeft, is de Europese asiel- en migratieregelgeving op Nederland van toepassing, en zal het kabinet dit uitvoeren en naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Podt over het proefballonnetje van de minister

MPs Piri and Podt asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration whether the cabinet had decided to cut asylum residence permits from five to two years, and why she floated this in the media before a formal decision. The minister answered that no decision has yet been taken, that she wants two years for subsidiary protection holders based on her Denmark visit, and that the measure will be elaborated with other duration options.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over haar tweede proefballonnetje van de week

An MP asks the Minister for Asylum and Migration about a reported plan to have provinces take turns housing asylum seekers from Ter Apel, questioning whether it is in the coalition agreement, whether it was agreed in cabinet, its finances and why the Spreidingswet is not implemented. The minister says no such system has been decided, that emergency measures are being explored and will be implemented once worked out, and that she still intends to repeal the Spreidingswet while abiding by it for now.
No, everything is aimed at ensuring that everyone who applies for asylum in the Netherlands is provided with a bed; despite all efforts, the reception situation remains critical.
Nee, alles is erop gericht om te zorgen dat iedereen die in Nederland asiel aanvraagt, voorzien wordt van een bed, ondanks alle inspanningen blijft de opvangsituatie kritiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bamenga over de zorgwekkende humanitaire situatie in Zuid-Soedan

MPs Boswijk and Bamenga asked about the humanitarian crisis in South Sudan, donor conferences, resettlement of Sudanese refugees and Dutch contributions to peace efforts and budget cuts. The minister answered that Netherlands is a major humanitarian donor, that a separate donor conference is unlikely to yield substantial extra funds, that resettlement resumes under country-based policy, and that budget effects were already reported in the draft budget.
You were informed about the effects of the cuts from the Coalition Agreement in 2025 in the draft budget 2025.
Over de effecten van de bezuinigingen uit het Hoofdlijnenakkoord in 2025 bent u bij de ontwerpbegroting 2025 geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk en Ceder over de interne communicatie en adviezen met betrekking tot de overbrenging van Afghaanse bewakers.

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Asylum and Migration to send all internal communication and advice on the decision not to transfer Afghan guards to the Netherlands. The ministers respond that they partially meet the request by providing the official advice drafted since the new cabinet took office.
We partially meet your request by providing the official advice drafted since the new cabinet took office regarding the transfer of Afghan guards.

Wij komen gedeeltelijk tegemoet aan uw verzoek door de ambtelijke adviezen te verstrekken die zijn opgesteld sinds het aantreden van het nieuwe kabinet met betrekking tot de overbrenging van Afghaanse bewakers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontebal over het bericht ‘Starmer begint zijn ‘reset’ met EU, Brexiteers vrezen dat hij het VK er weer ‘in rommelt’

An MP from the CDA asked the government whether it would take similar initiatives to intensify bilateral cooperation with the United Kingdom after Starmer's planned bilateral treaty with Germany and France, and whether it would invite Starmer to visit. The government welcomed renewed UK engagement with the EU, listed existing bilateral frameworks and defence and science cooperation, and said it was open to intensifying relations without announcing new concrete initiatives.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Gemeenten met azc’s moeten van minister Faber nog vóór 1 september extra plekken vrijmaken’

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked whether COA was ordered to place one or two extra asylum seekers in every reception location before 1 September without consulting municipalities, and whether this overrides local agreements and amounts to coercion. Minister Faber answered that COA was asked to place 1 to 2 extra asylum seekers per location as a last-resort measure to relieve Ter Apel, that municipalities could report non-cooperation and a solution would be sought, and that she values keeping agreements while denying any coercion.
Therefore, no consultation with municipalities or the VNG took place prior to this measure.
Derhalve heeft voorafgaand aan deze maatregel geen overleg plaatsgevonden met gemeenten of de VNG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Gemeenten met azc’s moeten van minister Faber nog vóór 1 september extra plekken vrijmaken’

An MP asked whether the minister consulted municipalities before ordering extra asylum placements to relieve Ter Apel, how this fits with COA agreements, and what happens if municipalities refuse. The minister answered that COA has legal authority to place asylum seekers and that no prior consultation with municipalities took place, though municipalities could object and alternatives were sought, and that Ter Apel occupancy has since risen again so further measures and new locations are needed.
Therefore, no consultation with municipalities took place prior to this measure.
Derhalve heeft voorafgaand aan deze maatregel geen overleg plaatsgevonden met gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht ‘Minister Faber schittert door afwezigheid in eigen ‘asielcrisis’: ‘Ik ken geen burgemeester die door haar gebeld is’

MP Podt asked how many mayors Minister Faber had personally phoned to secure asylum reception places, following a newspaper report that she knew of none. The minister answered that the COA is the first point of contact with municipalities, that she will raise the reception situation at the Landelijke Regietafel and with the Commissarissen van de Koning, and that she will contact a municipality herself if necessary, without giving a number.
I myself will speak on Thursday 26 September at the Landelijke Regietafel with representatives of, among others, the Vereniging Nederlandse Gemeenten
Zelf spreek ik op donderdag 26 september aanstaande tijdens de Landelijke Regietafel met vertegenwoordigers van onder meer de Vereniging Nederlandse Gemeenten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over diverse onderwerpen naar aanleiding van het werkbezoek aan Curacao en Bonaire

Michon-Derkzen and other MPs asked the government about justice-chain staffing shortages, prison problems, police equipment, the Curaçao port, the youth crime prevention, gambling regulation, the Istanbul Convention, legal aid, and related Caribbean Netherlands matters after a study visit. The minister's answers mostly state that these are autonomous responsibilities of the Caribbean countries, describe existing Dutch support, and promise further reports on several items.
The JVO is a closed consultation between the four autonomous countries of the Kingdom.
Het JVO is een besloten overleg tussen de vier autonome landen van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het toewijzen van sociale huurwoningen aan statushouders

An MP from the CDA asks the ministers whether municipalities must house refugee status holders, whether priority allocation of social housing to them is being abolished, and what the consequences of banning such priority would be for asylum flow, dispersal and costs. The government confirms the statutory housing quota and gives the half-year figures, but says the share of social housing allocated to status holders is not tracked nationally, and defers the substance of the priority ban and its consequences until the coalition programme is further elaborated.
Currently it is not possible to provide insight into the percentage of social rental homes allocated to status holders over the past five years, because this is not tracked nationally.
Momenteel is het niet mogelijk om inzicht te bieden in het percentage sociale huurwoningen dat de afgelopen vijf jaar is toegewezen aan statushouders, omdat dit niet landelijk wordt bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Burg, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht “Rusland zet onafhankelijke krant The Moscow Times op zwarte lijst”

MPs from several parties asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Asylum and Migration about Russia placing the independent Moscow Times on a blacklist and the risks to Russian journalists working for it. The minister confirmed awareness of the report and said that emergency visas are possible in exceptional cases within existing policy frameworks, reaffirming support for press freedom.
This entails that within existing policy frameworks, and carefully tested against the Visa Code, visas can in exceptional cases be issued where there are compelling or humanitarian reasons.

Daar hoort bij dat binnen de bestaande beleidskaders, en daarbij zorgvuldig getoetst aan de Visumcode, het in uitzonderlijke gevallen mogelijk is visa te verstrekken als daar zwaarwegende of humanitaire redenen voor zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het verzet tegen de komst van een asielzoekerscentrum in de gemeente Nijkerk

An MP asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration whether she advised a Nijkerk municipal councillor on questions about a proposed asylum centre, and how such advice fits her responsibilities. The minister denied ongoing contact since taking office, said councillors vote without binding instructions, and said she only discusses her own policy field in her official capacity with local officials.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Boodschap aan Oekraïense vluchtelingen: zoek zelf verblijfplaats, eventueel in ander land’

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about a flyer telling Ukrainian displaced persons to find their own shelter, possibly in another country, after the Jaarbeurs hub closed, and how this fits Dutch protection obligations. The minister answered that the number of recipients and of those who found shelter is unknown, that shelter capacity is nearly full, and that the flyer's wording was too simplistic and has been clarified, while stating that displaced persons meeting the Temporary Protection Directive keep their right to protection in the Netherlands.
I do not know how many displaced persons received the letter from the Veiligheidsregio Utrecht, nor how many of them ultimately secured a sleeping place.
Mij is niet bekend hoeveel ontheemden de brief van de Veiligheidsregio Utrecht hebben ontvangen, noch hoeveel ontheemden hiervan alsnog een slaapplek hebben bemachtigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Bikker over arbeidsuitbuiting

MPs Ceder and Bikker asked ministers about the enforcement of labour exploitation, including prosecution figures, UWV's failure to revoke work permits in the Cornwall case, information sharing between ministries, housing tied to employment, inspectorate capacity and the scope of the criminal definition. The minister answered with figures on prosecutions, the legal limits on revoking permits, the new trafficking bill and the expansion of inspection capacity, while saying some earlier recommendations were not adopted.
On 25 April, the bill on modernising and extending the criminalisation of human trafficking was therefore submitted to the House of Representatives.
Op 25 april jl. is daarom het wetsvoorstel modernisering en uitbreiding strafbaarstelling mensenhandel bij de Tweede Kamer ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht «Burgemeesters Apeldoorn en Epe lopen tegen grenzen aan: zelfs criminele Oekraïner eruit zetten mag niet»

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration how municipalities can remove or sanction nuisance-causing Ukrainian displaced persons, given that expulsion from shelter is legally constrained, and whether high-security supervision locations (htl) could be used. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to existing tools and psychosocial support, says htl placement is legally and practically complex and the situation is still being evaluated, and promises answers to the remaining questions before the debate.
At present I am exploring the extent to which municipalities have implemented the new measures and what the effects of these are.
Op dit moment verken ik in hoeverre gemeenten de nieuwe maatregelen hebben geïmplementeerd en wat de effecten hiervan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vondeling over het bericht dat Oekraïners nog steeds niet hoeven mee te betalen aan hun opvang

An MP asked why almost no municipality collects the own contribution Ukrainian refugees owe for their reception, and whether the government will ensure collection by 1 January 2025 and raise the contribution. The minister answered that municipalities were given until 1 January 2025 to implement the contribution, that the Rijk supports them and covers collection costs, and that the contribution will be reassessed after a cost study.
That is why agreements were made with municipalities that they will have until 1 January 2025 at the latest to do this.
Daarom is met gemeenten afgesproken dat zij hiervoor tot uiterlijk 1 januari 2025 de tijd krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over de problematiek rond het innen van de eigen bijdragen van Oekraïense ontheemden met een baan en eigen inkomsten

An MP asks the government about municipalities struggling to collect own contributions from working Ukrainian displaced persons, retroactive charges, the tax exemption for motor vehicle tax and BPM, housing, and security in Ukraine. The minister answers that the government supports municipalities with a guide and reimbursed costs, allows retroactive charges not before 1 July 2024 but advises restraint, and says the vehicle exemption expires on 4 March 2025 without committing to further changes.
We have advised municipalities to exercise restraint, so as not to confront displaced persons at a later time with an accumulated arrears.
Wij hebben gemeenten geadviseerd terughoudendheid te betrachten, om ontheemden niet op een later moment met een opgebouwde achterstand te confronteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boomsma en Omtzigt over het innen van een eigen bijdrage van werkende Oekraïense ontheemden die opgevangen worden door gemeentes

MPs Boomsma and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about municipalities charging a contribution from working Ukrainian displaced persons in municipal shelter, the feasibility of this for municipalities, Suwinet data access, and related costs. The minister confirmed that municipalities must collect the contribution from all displaced persons with income after six months, noted that Suwinet access for income verification is still being examined, and gave cost and contribution figures.

However, the implementation assessment by UWV and consultation with the VNG concluded that the ground in the Temporary Act does not make all data available to municipalities that are needed to fully verify net income.

Uit de uitvoeringstoets van het UWV en in afstemming met de VNG is evenwel geconcludeerd dat met de grond in de Tijdelijke Wet niet alle gegevens beschikbaar komen voor gemeenten die gewenst zijn om het netto inkomen volledig te kunnen verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het corruptieschandaal rond de asielopvang in Van der Valk-hotels

An MP asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration how fraud in asylum hotel contracts is being prevented, whether the LCHD intermediary's role in other hotel chains will be examined, and whether criminal complaints or sanctions will follow after the Van der Valk corruption affair. The Minister says COA is reviewing contracts and procedures, is working to phase out expensive emergency hotel reception, confirms LCHD also worked with other chains, and states that the OM and FIOD are conducting a criminal investigation with no additional steps taken for now.
The OM and FIOD are currently conducting a criminal investigation. I am closely monitoring this investigation
Het OM en FIOD voeren momenteel een strafrechtelijk onderzoek uit. Ik houd dit onderzoek nauwlettend in de gaten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over verschillende nieuwsberichten met betrekking tot Europese grensbewaking

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about news reports on Polish border guards being allowed to shoot irregular migrants, the exclusion of journalists from the Polish buffer zone, and Greek coast guard abuses. The minister said the Netherlands expects compliance with international and EU law, leaves assessment of the Polish measures to Polish and European courts, and points to an independent Greek investigation and existing EU monitoring.
It is up to the national judge to assess whether this condition is met in a concrete situation.
Het is aan de nationale rechter om te beoordelen of in een concrete situatie aan deze voorwaarde wordt voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Ceder over de detentie en uitzetting van de familie Babayants

Two MPs (Piri and Ceder) asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about the detention and planned deportation to Uzbekistan of the Babayants family, who have lived in the Netherlands for about ten years, including children born there, and whether this is consistent with children's rights and the best interests of the child. The Minister declined to discuss the individual case, said the best interests of the child are considered but not decisive, defended detention of families as a last resort in a family facility, and saw no reason to revise the policy.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Podt over het bericht 'Hoger onderwijs onbereikbaar: Oekraïense studenten struikelen over collegegeld'

Two D66 MPs asked whether Ukrainian displaced students can access higher education on equal terms with EU/EEA students, given high institutional tuition fees up to 15,000 euro, and about student finance eligibility. The minister answered that Ukrainians are not automatically entitled to statutory tuition, that changing this would require legislation with wide policy consequences, that the cabinet will meet universities and hogescholen and urges them to lower institutional tuition for other displaced Ukrainians, and that student finance for Ukrainians is not extended because Ukraine is outside the EEA.
The cabinet regularly speaks with universities and universities of applied sciences about Ukrainian displaced persons.
Het kabinet spreekt regelmatig met de universiteiten en hogescholen over de Oekraïense ontheemden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht: ‘Oekraïense vluchtelingen worden dagen in de cel gehouden bij aankomst per vliegtuig’

An MP asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration about reports that Ukrainian displaced persons arriving by plane at Schiphol are held in cells, questioning the legal basis and proportionality of applying the border procedure to them. The minister defended the practice as existing law applied to those seeking long stays, noted only ten Ukrainians completed the procedure since January 2024, and declined to publish rejection figures citing privacy rules.
Because of the low numbers of foreign nationals with Ukrainian nationality, these figures are not made public under the GDPR and traceability considerations.
Vanwege de lage aantallen vreemdelingen met de Oekraïense nationaliteit worden deze aantallen in het kader van de AVG en herleidbaarheid niet openbaar gemaakt.

m: Amendement van de leden Koşer Kaya en Blok over het mogelijk maken van vertegenwoordiging in het bestuur voor meer dan één onderneming of groep

Amendment letting one pension fund's board seat multiple employers or groups, with representation for each, and allowing one representative to cover several bodies; mainly governance of pension funds, not the executive.
This amendment aims to regulate the board composition of the multi-opf as far as possible in the same way as the board composition of company pension funds.
Dit amendement heeft tot doel de bestuurssamenstelling van de multi-opf zoveel mogelijk op gelijke wijze te regelen als de bestuurssamenstelling van ondernemingspensioenfondsen.
Motie Blok en Koşer Kaya over organisaties van zzp'ers in de SER
Asks the government to act on the prime minister's call for self-employed workers to have a place in the Social-Economic Council by giving their organisations a seat.
requests the government to turn the prime minister's plea into deeds and give organisations of self-employed workers a place in the Social-Economic Council
verzoekt de regering het pleidooi van de minister president om te zetten in daden en organisaties van zzp'ers een plaats te geven in de Sociaal-Economische Raad
Motie Blok over voorkomen dat werkgevers mensen moeten ontslaan door in de cao opgenomen loonsverhogingen
Asks the government to create a temporary scheme letting employers skip collectively agreed wage increases if they can show this preserves jobs.
requests the government to make a temporary arrangement so that an employer is not obliged to follow the collective wage increase
verzoekt de regering een tijdelijke regeling te treffen waarmee een werkgever niet verplicht is de cao-loonsverhoging te volgen
Motie Blok over stopzetten van de export van kinderbijslag naar niet-EU-landen
Asks the government to stop exporting child benefit and other child schemes to non-EU countries by amending or terminating bilateral treaties.
requests the government to stop the export of child benefit and other child schemes to non-EU countries
verzoekt de regering de export van kinderbijslag en andere kinderregelingen naar niet-EU-landen stop te zetten
Motie Blok over opheffen van het Spaarfonds AOW
Asks the government to abolish the AOW Savings Fund and to inform the Chamber periodically about the sustainability of public finances given ageing.
requests the government to abolish the AOW Savings Fund and to periodically inform the Chamber about the extent to which public finances are sustainable
verzoekt de regering om het Spaarfonds AOW op te heffen en de Kamer periodiek te informeren over de mate waarin de overheidsfinanciën houdbaar zijn
Motie Blok over aanwijzen van een eigen medewerker als jobcoach
Asks the government to allow employers with many disabled young workers to designate their own employee as jobcoach.
requests the government to give employers who employ multiple Wajong workers the option to designate an own employee as jobcoach
verzoekt de regering werkgevers die meerdere Wajong’ers in dienst hebben, de mogelijkheid te bieden, een eigen medewerker als jobcoach aan te wijzen
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Blok ter vervanging van nr. 13 over terugwerkende kracht van enige bepalingen tot wijziging van de Pensioenwet
Makes retroactive certain Pension Act amendments restoring the partner's option to choose a different pension scheme, with retroactive effect to 2007 and 2008.
to restore the unintended lapsed option for the partner of the (former) participant to shop for a pension scheme
om de door de invoering van de Pensioenwet resp. de Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling onbedoeld vervallen mogelijkheid tot shoppen voor de partner van de (gewezen) deelnemer te herstellen
Amendement van het lid Blok over toevoegen terugwerkende kracht
Amends the pension-shopping provision for partners so that the change applies retroactively from 1 January 2008.
provided that article XIX, parts E through H, have retroactive effect to 1 January 2008
met dien verstande dat artikel XIX, onderdelen E tot en met H, terugwerkt tot en met 1 januari 2008
Motie Van Hijum en Blok over mogelijke gevolgen voor de sociale zekerheid van immigratie uit Oost-Europa en landen buiten de EU
Asks the government to explore migrants' access to and use of the social security system, and whether and how to limit it, reporting to the House by 1 July 2009.
requests the government to carry out an exploration of migrants' access to and reliance on the social welfare system
verzoekt de regering om een verkenning uit te voeren naar de toegang tot en het beroep van migranten op het sociale stelsel
Motie Blok over uitvoeren van de WGA conform het coalitieakkoord
Asks the government to quickly present concrete proposals to carry out the coalition agreement's commitment to fully privatise the WGA disability scheme.
requests the government to come quickly with concrete proposals to carry out its own coalition agreement on this point
verzoekt de regering op korte termijn met concrete voorstellen te komen om haar eigen coalitieakkoord op dit punt uit te voeren
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het toekennen van het recht om het predicaat ‘Koninklijk’ te voeren aan ondernemingen

MP Simons asked whether royal predicate ('Koninklijk') status can be withdrawn from companies that no longer meet the conditions or have harmed their reputation, citing examples of fraud, corruption and environmental damage, and whether a formal appeal procedure exists. The Minister of Economic Affairs answered that the predicate can be revoked via a careful process involving the mayor, the commissioner of the King and ministry advice, that individual cases cannot be discussed, and that no separate appeal procedure is planned.
I cannot go into individual companies.
Op individuele bedrijven kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Erkens over het bericht 'Facebook vs. Zeewolde: hoe lokale politici moeten beslissen over een landelijke kwestie'

MPs Rajkowski and Erkens asked about the planned large Meta data centre in Zeewolde, its impact on grid capacity, energy use, heat reuse, national coordination and the conditions attached to the sale of state land. The minister answered that national spatial policy prefers hyperscale centres at the country's edges, set conditions for the land sale, and committed to tighten national steering and admission criteria in a joint letter this spring.
In line with the coalition agreement, this cabinet will tighten national steering and the admission criteria for (hyperscale) data centres.
In lijn met het coalitieakkoord zal dit kabinet de landelijke regie en de toelatingscriteria ten aanzien van (hyperscale) datacenters aanscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Het Rijk regelde onder druk van Facebook voorrang op het stroomnet'

MP Leijten (SP) asked ministers whether the government arranged priority grid access for Facebook/Meta's Zeewolde data centre, questioned the secrecy and possible blackmail by the company, and asked for timelines of contacts and a pause on the decision. The minister denies any priority was granted, says the connection follows the legal framework, and gives a detailed contact timeline while declining to disclose tax rulings and refusing to pause the spatial process.
The cabinet cannot make statements about the tax position of individual taxpayers due to the statutory tax confidentiality obligation (Article 67 AWR).
Het kabinet kan geen mededelingen doen over de fiscale positie van individuele belastingplichtigen vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht (artikel 67 AWR).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de rode loper voor datacenters

An MP asked ministers about the government's past active acquisition of hyperscale data centres, claimed industry lobbying, water and electricity use, grid congestion, and the Microsoft permit. The reply defends the former acquisition policy as now discontinued, says data centres bring limited direct jobs, notes grid scarcity is not solely caused by data centres, and promises a joint letter with stricter national criteria for data centres in spring.
In line with the coalition agreement, this cabinet will tighten national steering and the admission criteria for (hyperscale) data centres.
In lijn met het coalitieakkoord zal dit kabinet de landelijke regie en de toelatingscriteria ten aanzien van (hyperscale) datacenters aanscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Nijboer, Thijssen en Kröger over de rode loper voor datacenter Zeewolde

MPs asked whether ministries actively courted Facebook/Meta for a Zeewolde data centre, gave it priority on the high-voltage grid, and whether the data centre's energy, heat and diesel backup impacts were addressed. The ministers answered that NFIA was approached by Meta, that the connection was legally permissible without priority, and that many questions on energy, heat and jobs are left to the municipality or are unknown, while promising a national data centre strategy later.
There is no question of "priority" for Meta's connection to the high-voltage grid.
Er is geen sprake van «voorrang» voor aansluiting van Meta op het hoogspanningsnet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over de plannen voor het hyperscale datacenter van Facebookmoederbedrijf Meta in Zeewolde en andere datacenters

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch (PvdD) asked about Meta's hyperscale data centre plans in Zeewolde, the sale of state land, energy and water use, and grid tariffs. The minister answered that the state conditions the land sale on energy and water standards, and that the government will tighten national steering and licensing criteria for hyperscale data centres.
The cabinet will tighten the choices in the NOVI regarding data centres.
Het kabinet zal de keuzes in de NOVI over datacenters aanscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Boucke over het artikel 'Anode Energie vraagt faillissement aan vanwege energieprijzen'

MPs Erkens and Boucke asked about the bankruptcy of Anode Energie and other energy suppliers, consumer losses, supplier protection, licensing by the ACM, and possible stress tests. The minister said about 160,000 customers were affected, outlined a study into stricter financial requirements and consumer protection, and announced Energiewet changes such as VOG screening and Bibob checks.

At this moment I am conducting a study into whether it is desirable and possible to set further requirements for the legal framework and, if so, which requirements best achieve the aim and are workable for both energy suppliers and the ACM.

Op dit moment doe ik een onderzoek naar de vraag of het wenselijk en mogelijk is om nadere eisen te stellen aan het wettelijke kader en zo ja, welke eisen het doel het beste bereiken en goed uitvoerbaar zijn voor zowel energieleveranciers als de ACM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over een opmerkelijke ommekeer van de Autoriteit Consument & Markt

An MP asked the ministers why the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) reversed its draft guidance so that network operators may no longer own electrolysers, and whether this hinders the energy transition. The ministers answer that the ACM is entitled to interpret the law, that the legal framework on network operators and electrolysis is unclear, and that they will clarify it through consultation and a future Energy Act, while the existing Gasunie hydrogen storage pilot is unaffected.

Based on the ACM's guidance on network companies and alternative energy carriers, I find that the current statutory provisions on the scope of network companies in relation to electrolysis are not sufficiently clear and are open to interpretation.

Mede op basis van de «Leidraad netwerkbedrijven en alternatieve energiedragers» van de ACM constateer ik dat de huidige wettelijke bepalingen rondom de ruimte van netwerkbedrijven in relatie tot elektrolyse niet voldoende helder zijn en openstaan voor interpretatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over mogelijke impact van Europese ESG-standaarden op de defensie- en veiligheidssector

CDA MPs asked the government about the EU EcoLabel draft criteria for financial products, which would exclude firms earning over 5% of revenue from conventional weapons or military products used in combat, and how this affects Dutch defence firms' access to financial services. The state secretary said the criteria are voluntary for banks, that the government will raise the risk of blanket sector exclusion within the EU and talk with the defence sector and the banking association, but gave no commitment to change the criteria.
The current revenue share from trade or production of weapons and/or military products for combat of individual Dutch companies is not known.
Het huidige omzetaandeel van de handel of productie van wapens en/of militaire producten voor « combat » van individuele Nederlandse bedrijven is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over het bericht 'Stop op boorvergunningen moet einde tijdperk olie en gas inluiden'

MPs Bromet and Kröger asked whether the government will coordinate with Germany and Denmark on Wadden Sea World Heritage management, the UNESCO letter, and a joint halt to fossil extraction there. The minister said the trilateral conference is planned for late 2022, the UNESCO reply was coordinated with partners, and she is willing to explore extending the coalition's no-new-licences ambition to the trilateral Wadden Sea.

I am willing to explore together with Germany and Denmark whether the coalition agreement's ambition to issue no new gas extraction licences under the Wadden Sea after the Ternaard procedure is completed can also apply to the trilateral Wadden Sea.

Ik ben bereid om samen met Duitsland en Denemarken te verkennen of de ambitie uit het coalitieakkoord 2 om na afronding van de procedure voor Ternaard geen nieuwe vergunningen voor gaswinning onder de Waddenzee af te geven ook kan gelden voor de trilaterale Waddenzee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het WK voetbal in Qatar

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about implementing a parliamentary motion to avoid official government representation at the 2022 Qatar World Cup over labour abuses, the labour conditions, the 6,500 worker deaths, compensation for victims, and why trade promotion with Qatar continues. The ministers answered that qualification is not yet settled, outlined Qatari labour reforms and continued dialogue, and said a digital trade mission was postponed while Dutch firms can still get support.

Following the worrying reports about migrant workers building football stadiums in Qatar, the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development decided to postpone the digital trade mission to Qatar, which was planned from 22 March to 1 April 2021.

Naar aanleiding van de zorgelijke berichten over arbeidsmigranten bij de bouw van voetbalstadions in Qatar heeft de Minister voor BHOS besloten om de digitale handelsmissie naar Qatar, die gepland stond van 22 maart tot en met 1 april 2021, uit te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Ellian over stemmen door Nederlanders in het buitenland

Two VVD MPs asked why only about 9-10% of the estimated one million Dutch citizens abroad registered to vote, why only 63,549 of 92,772 registered voters cast a ballot, and why proxy voting and invalid votes were so low or high, and whether surveys or evaluations would be run. The minister answered that registration barriers are mostly lack of reliable postal addresses and disengagement, that an online survey of 30 expat associations is ongoing, that a survey of registered voters will be conducted, and that the full evaluation will be sent before the summer recess.
I am willing to conduct a survey among all voters included in the permanent registration and ask them whether they voted in the last House of Representatives election and, if not, why not.

Ik ben bereid een enquête te houden onder alle kiezers die zijn opgenomen in de permanente registratie en aan hen te vragen of zij hebben gestemd bij de afgelopen Tweede Kamerverkiezing en zo nee, waarom niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over eerdere antwoorden over burgerdoden in Uruzgan

MP Karabulut asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers, after a Trouw report of a veteran's account of a 2007 incident in Uruzgan with possible civilian deaths, about the internal review, archives, and rules on force use and battle damage assessments. Minister Bijleveld-Schouten answered that the Public Prosecution Service has an ongoing fact-finding inquiry, so further details, witness hearings and the full list of incident reports are withheld for now, while a search of incident reports from 2009–2010 and an updated list will be shared.

To prevent any own investigation by the Ministry of Defence from hindering the Public Prosecution Service's inquiry, I choose to await the completion of this fact-finding inquiry before deciding on an own investigation.
