Om te voorkomen dat een eventueel eigen onderzoek van het Ministerie van Defensie het onderzoek van het OM belemmert, kies ik er voor om de afronding van dit feitenonderzoek af te wachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de executie van ruim tien onbewapende mannen door Ethiopische soldaten

An MP from GroenLinks asked the ministers about the reported execution of more than ten unarmed men by Ethiopian soldiers in Tigray, the G7 and EU condemnation, possible ethnic cleansing and sanctions, humanitarian aid, and gathering evidence for accountability. The minister confirmed awareness, stated Dutch and EU condemnation, backed an independent EHRC/OHCHR investigation with Dutch funding, and said humanitarian contributions totalled about EUR 9.5 million for 2021.
The Netherlands has declared itself willing to contribute financially to the costs of such an investigation.
Nederland heeft zich bereid verklaard financieel bij te dragen aan de kosten van een dergelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Nederlandse zonnepanelen komen van Chinese bedrijven die worden verdacht van dwangarbeid’

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch solar panels are linked to Chinese firms suspected of forced labour in Xinjiang, and what the government would do about it. The government says it lacks data on Xinjiang content in Dutch panels, urges companies to apply due diligence under the OECD Guidelines and UN Guiding Principles, and says it will raise the issue at EU level and engage the sector.
It must be stated at the outset that the cabinet does not have data on the extent to which polysilicon from Xinjiang is processed in the panels used in the Netherlands.
Vooropgesteld staat dat het kabinet niet over gegevens beschikt in hoeverre de in Nederland gebruikte panelen polysilicium uit Xinjiang is verwerkt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Thieme, Baudet, Kuzu, Van de Hul en Knops over het bericht dat de Nederlandse overheid grote steken heeft laten vallen in het verle

MPs from many parties asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the Dutch government failed to assist Mr Singh, a Dutch national imprisoned in the US for 33 years, including over consular visits, a transfer request and the handling of his case. The government rejects the picture of failure, says it cannot intervene in foreign justice, explains that transfer was refused on legal grounds and pledges continued support for parole and review requests.
The ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice and Security do not recognise that picture.
De ministeries van Buitenlandse Zaken en Justitie en Veiligheid herkennen zich niet in dat beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen, Visser, Van Helvert en Van Toorenburg over paspoortcontroles door luchtvaartmaatschappijen

MPs from VVD and CDA asked whether airlines must check passengers' identity on intra-Schengen flights, how responsibilities are divided, and how the EU PNR directive would help detect terrorists. The minister explained that border checks are a KMar task only at external borders, that airlines may but need not perform conformity checks, and that PNR implementation (deadline 25 May 2018) and a feasibility study on mandatory conformity checks are the planned responses.
Figures on how many airlines check the identity of their passengers are not kept.
Cijfers over hoeveel luchtvaartmaatschappijen de identiteit van hun passagiers controleren worden niet bijgehouden.

Vragen van de leden Roemer (SP), Cohen (PvdA), Wilders (PVV), Sap (GroenLinks), Van der Staaij (SGP), Blok (VVD), Slob (ChristenUnie), Thieme (PvdD), Pechtold (D66) en Van Haersma Buma (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van V

MPs from ten parties asked the state secretary of Security and Justice why Germany refused to extradite the fugitive war criminal Klaas-Carel Faber, whether German nationality obtained through a Hitler decree was the reason, and whether the Netherlands would press Germany to enforce the sentence. The minister answered that a Munich court refused extradition because Faber is a German national who did not consent, that German authorities also consider him German without the decree, and that letters were sent to the Bavarian and federal German justice ministers asking that the sentence be enforced in Germany.
By letter of 31 May 2011 I made known to the Minister of Justice of the German state of Bavaria the importance I attach to the law taking its course in this case.
Bij brief van 31 mei 2011 heb ik het belang dat ik eraan hecht dat in deze zaak het recht zijn loop krijgt kenbaar gemaakt aan de Minister van Justitie van de Duitse deelstaat Beieren.
Vragen van het lid Blok (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het groeiend aantal mensen met een arbeidsongeschiktheidsuitkering (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

MP Blok (VVD) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the rising number of people receiving disability benefits (WIA), including inflows, gender and diagnosis breakdowns, the 2010 budget overrun, causes of the trend, and whether the 'hidden unemployment' could be investigated. Minister Donner answered that inflow has risen due to more applications and higher approval rates, that conjunctural effects are not a 'grey area', and that UWV will intensify quality control on medical work-hour restrictions.

Furthermore, following the finding that benefit applicants on average have received more (granted) limitations, the UWV will intensify quality control on the granting of medical work-hour restrictions.

Voorts zal het UWV naar aanleiding van de constatering dat aanvragers van een uitkering gemiddeld meer beperkingen hebben (toegekend) gekregen, de kwaliteitscontrole op de toekenning van medische urenbeperkingen intensiveren.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de verhuizing van DSM naar Maastricht

MP Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the move of DSM's head office from Heerlen to Maastricht, with public subsidies, betrays the Mijnstreek and lacks historical awareness. The minister expressed understanding for regional disappointment, said DSM made its own business decisions and dropped the subsidies, and noted DSM-Firmenich will keep one head office in the region.
However, it remains a decision of DSM itself.
Het blijft echter een besluit van DSM zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht ‘Sociale media niet geschikt voor kinderen, concludeert Consumentenbond’

An MP asked the government about a Consumentenbond finding that social media platforms are unsuitable for children, including personalised advertising to minors and data privacy concerns. The state secretary responded that the AVG already protects children, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is responsible for enforcement, and that the government supports EU-level restrictions on profiling minors while proposing to promote the Dutch Code voor Kinderrechten Online and adjust national rules.
The cabinet wants to protect children more against inappropriate online advertising and child-directed marketing and give children the right not to be tracked and not to receive data profiles.
Het kabinet wil kinderen extra beschermen tegen niet-passende online reclame en kindermarketing en kinderen het recht geven om niet gevolgd te worden en geen dataprofielen te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar NAM

The MP asked about a criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service into NAM's wastewater handling, when it started, whether the Chamber was informed, and about the risks, permits and responsibilities for produced-water injection and transport. The Staatssecretaris answered that the investigation is independent and ongoing, withheld details of its scope and timing, and explained the production-water process, the permit regime and the supervisory roles of SodM and ILT.
The Public Prosecution Service decides whether and when it announces that an investigation has started and what information, such as the nature of the suspicion, it discloses.
Het OM bepaalt of en wanneer het bekend maakt dat het een onderzoek is gestart en welke informatie, zoals de aard van de verdenking, het daarbij bekend maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over de beantwoording van de vragen 'Litouwen adviseert consument geen Xiaomi-telefoons meer te kopen'

MPs Rajkowski asked the ministers about Chinese censorship software on Xiaomi phones, state use of such devices, and whether oversight could detect it. The government answered that Lithuanian and German investigations found the functionality disabled in the EU, pledged to consider amending the Telecommunications Act, and declined an additional independent investigation.

As long as the e-privacy regulation is not yet in force, a complicating factor is that article 11.2a of the Telecommunications Act, which transposes article 5 of the e-privacy directive, is directed only at providers of public electronic communication networks and services and not at third parties such as the phone supplier.

Zolang de e-privacyverordening nog niet van kracht is, is een complicerende factor dat artikel 11.2a van de Telecommunicatiewet waarin artikel 5 van de e-privacyrichtlijn is omgezet, zich alleen richt tot aanbieders van openbare elektronische communicatienetwerken en diensten en dus niet tot derden zoals de leverancier van de telefoon.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over plannen van de NAM met oliewinning in Rotterdam

An SP MP asked the minister about NAM's plan to keep extracting oil from the Rotterdam field until 2050, including subsidence, injection of water, the information evening and climate consistency. The state secretary answered that the updated winning plan is being assessed under current law, that no new extraction is involved, that subsidence is limited to a maximum of 2 cm further, and that restrictive conditions are imposed.
Therefore, in the draft decision I have prescribed a limit on the maximum pressure in the oil reservoir and I do not consent to techniques that lead to cracking in the sealing layer of the oil field.

Daarom heb ik in het ontwerpbesluit een beperking van de maximale druk in het oliereservoir voorgeschreven en stem ik niet in met technieken wanneer die tot scheurvorming in de afsluitende laag van het olieveld leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht 'Rotterdam woest over oliewinning onder de stad: 'Totaal ridicuul''

Green-left MP Kröger asked the minister about plans by NAM to continue oil extraction under Rotterdam, including the permit process, consultation with Rotterdam and Barendrecht, subsidence, new techniques such as hydraulic stimulation, and consistency with climate goals. The state secretary answered that municipal advice was partly adopted, that the draft decision remains open to objections, and that the subsidence and environmental risks are considered minimal, while leaving some questions, such as the total remaining reserves, only loosely answered.
The advice of the municipality of Rotterdam, together with all other advice I requested, has been weighed in the draft decision and has been partly adopted.
Het advies van de gemeente Rotterdam heb ik, samen met alle andere door mij gevraagde adviezen, meegewogen in het ontwerpbesluit en is gedeeltelijk overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het nationaliseren van de kleine NAM-velden

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the minister whether the state should buy the NAM's small gas fields to phase out gas extraction, citing other countries ending new drilling permits, subsidies, damage compensation and the Sebaldeburen and Pieterzijl fracking cases. The state secretary replied that the government wants to keep Dutch small-field gas production as a supply-security and infrastructure asset during the transition, has no plans to buy the fields, and points to the Commission Mijnbouwschade and existing procedures for damage and permit issues.
The cabinet has no plans to buy the gas fields.
Het kabinet heeft geen plannen om de gasvelden te kopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de aanleg van glasvezel in het Westland

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the absence of fibre-optic internet in the Westland rural area, the cause of the withdrawal of Delta Fiber, and possible government intervention. The minister explained that high construction costs due to the area's complexity made fibre unviable, that upgraded coax networks will deliver at least 200 Mbps, and that a study into hard-to-reach areas is underway, with results to be sent to parliament this quarter.
I expect that your House can be informed this quarter about the outcomes of the ongoing research and the next steps.
Ik verwacht dat uw Kamer nog in dit kwartaal kan worden geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten van het lopende onderzoek en de vervolgstappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over ondernemers die als gevolg van zwangerschap in de referentieperiode van de TVL, geen of verminderd aanspraak maken op TVL

MP Aartsen asked whether entrepreneurs who could not claim TVL corona support because pregnancy left them without representative reference-period revenue should be covered by the hardship clause, and whether they should be contacted. The minister answers that RVO's hardship commission cannot make categorical exceptions, but a targeted hardship clause was introduced for TVL Q4 2021 allowing an alternative reference quarter for those on pregnancy/childbirth leave.
Under this article it is not possible to make categorical exceptions to the conditions of the TVL.
Het is op grond van dit artikel niet mogelijk om categorale uitzonderingen op de voorwaarden van de TVL te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het kredietregister

MP Koerhuis asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about SME financing problems, possible solutions, and whether a credit register is desirable, and asked for an overview of OECD countries with credit registers. The minister outlined existing SME financing instruments, said a credit register exploration plan will be started with external research before any decision, and said a full overview of foreign registers could not be produced in the time available.

It has not proved possible to prepare these overviews in this short timeframe and at the same time show how the credit registers in those countries have contributed to improving SMEs' access to finance.

Het is niet goed mogelijk gebleken om deze overzichten in dit korte tijdsbestek op te stellen en daarbij tevens inzichtelijk te maken op welke wijze de kredietregisters in die landen hebben bijgedragen om de toegang van mkb'ers tot financiering te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het beschermen van kleine ondernemers bij zakelijke financiering

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether small business borrowers, who resemble consumers, should be protected in non-bank business lending, given the AFM's finding that the sector lacks effective self-regulation and that the AFM has no supervisory mandate there. The minister acknowledges the vulnerability, is studying whether legal protection is needed, and will reassess self-regulation by mid-2022 before considering legislation.
I am currently examining whether it is necessary and desirable that entrepreneurs also be protected by law.
Ik onderzoek op dit moment of het noodzakelijk en wenselijk is dat ook ondernemers bij wet worden beschermd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het feit dat RVO bij het toekennen van TVL kijkt naar groepsverbondenheid waardoor veel ondernemers amper tot geen coronasteun krijgen omdat ze meerdere zaken hebben

MP Aartsen asks why RVO considers group affiliation when granting the TVL fixed-cost subsidy, which leaves many entrepreneurs with several businesses with little or no support, and whether this is fair and can be changed retroactively. The minister answers that EU state-aid rules require treating affiliated companies as one undertaking subject to the aid ceiling, that SME groups can still apply per legal entity, and that large groups file one application per group, while declining to change the rules retroactively.
For that reason, RVO looks at group affiliation when granting TVL.
Om die reden kijkt RVO bij de toekenning van TVL naar groepsverbondenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de berichten 'Wall Street aast op de Nederlandse camping' en 'Steeds meer Nederlandse vakantieparken in bezit van roofinvesteerders'

An MP asked the ministers about reports that holiday parks and campsites in the Netherlands are increasingly acquired by foreign investors, and what government can do about it. The government answered that two motions on the topic were adopted and that it will commission a study on acquisitions, impacts on owners and tenants, nature and spatial planning, with results expected in Q2 2022.
I will have this study carried out together with the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate.
Ik zal dit onderzoek samen met de Minister van Economische Zaken en Klimaat uit laten voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over het Onderzoeksrapport inzake het faillissement van Flexenergie

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the investigation report into the bankruptcy of energy supplier Flexenergie, including why the ACM did not intervene earlier, whether the supplier misused customer prepayments and tax money, whether revoking its licence would have been better, and what has changed in licensing and consumer protection. The minister defended the independent ACM, said it intervened in 2017 after completing its investigation, described the prepayment system, and pointed to planned Energiewet tightening of licence requirements and a study on consumer protection in supplier bankruptcies.
The ACM completed its investigation at the end of 2017 and decided to intervene at Flexenergie.
De ACM heeft haar onderzoek eind 2017 afgerond en besloten om in te grijpen bij Flexenergie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht ‘Afvalwaterinjectie in Twente gaat ondanks motie gewoon door’

An MP asked why the wastewater injection in Twente continues despite a parliamentary motion, and what legal grounds exist to suspend the permits and when research results will be published. The Staatssecretaris answered that no legal basis currently allows suspension, that a re-evaluation is due by 1 July 2022 with a decision afterwards, and that research results on wells ROW-2 and ROW-7 will be made public.
As long as NAM complies with the conditions of the permit, there is no legal basis to halt the activities covered by the permit.
Zolang NAM zich aan de voorschriften in de vergunning houdt, is er geen rechtsgrond om de activiteiten die onder de vergunning vallen stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het rapport Kwetsbaar door software – Lessen naar aanleiding van beveiligingslekken door software van Citrix

MP Kathmann asked the ministers about the Safety Board's report on software vulnerabilities (Citrix) and whether software makers should bear responsibility, invest more, and face liability. The government says it is studying the report, points to existing measures such as the Roadmap for Digitally Secure Hardware and Software and EU certification efforts, and defers liability and quality-requirement questions to the European level, promising a full response before summer.
As stated in the letter to parliament of 16 December 2021, the cabinet will study the report carefully and respond in writing to the OVV within the statutory six-month period.
Zoals aangegeven in de Kamerbrief van 16 december 2021 zal het kabinet het rapport zorgvuldig bestuderen en binnen de wettelijke reactietermijn van zes maanden schriftelijk richting de OVV reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het ruimte geven aan jaarmarkten en braderieën

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the COVID-19 ban on annual markets and street fairs, their risk compared with weekly markets, and whether an exemption for stallholders could be considered. The minister acknowledged the hardship, pointed to aid packages and falling bankruptcies, and refused a special exemption, arguing that fairs bring extra travel and contacts unlike necessity-focused weekly markets.
The cabinet is not considering an exception such as the one Mr Eerdmans asks for.
Het kabinet kijkt daarbij niet naar een uitzondering zoals het lid Eerdmans vraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Erkens over het artikel 'Waar blijft de toegezegde ruimhartige compensatie?'

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Erkens (VVD) asked the ministers about news reports that promised generous flood compensation had not yet arrived, and about payout pace, the definition of generosity, affected areas in Brabant, and talks on turnover loss. The minister replies that payouts of 7.26 million euros had reached 296 recipients by 11 January 2022, that a one-off turnover loss scheme and a crop-plan compensation scheme are being prepared, and that the Dutch government's existing flood-relief measures apply.
It indicated, among other things, that the cabinet will publish a one-off turnover loss scheme for affected entrepreneurs in Limburg in early 2022.
Daarin is onder andere aangegeven dat het kabinet begin 2022 een eenmalige omzetdervingsregeling zal publiceren voor getroffen ondernemers in Limburg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the government dozens of factual questions about the 2021 coalition agreement's climate, energy, and biomass plans, including Ternaard gas drilling, CCS, nuclear, and the Westerschelde tunnel toll. The minister answered only a handful on substance and deferred most questions to later cabinet decisions.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over de aankoop van 11,6 miljoen mondkapjes bij DSM als compensatie voor het niet afgeven van een garantie aan DSM

An MP asked the Health and Economic Affairs ministers why 11.6 million FFP2 masks were ordered from the DSM-VDL joint venture without competitive tendering, and whether this was justified by urgency, given large existing stocks and a withdrawn DSM guarantee. The government answered that urgency from expected demand justified direct award, denied that a commercial disagreement was the reason, declined to disclose the price as commercially confidential, and said there is currently no formal state involvement in domestic mask production.
A price was paid to Dutch PPE Solutions that was market-conform at the time. The amount is commercially confidential information.
Er is een prijs betaald aan Dutch PPE Solutions die destijds marktconform was. De hoogte daarvan is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Zeer nauwe verbintenis Roland Berger en Tata

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about press reports of close ties between consultancy Roland Berger and Tata Steel, questioning the independence of a study on green steel production. The minister answered that the past Tata/Roland Berger alliance concerned Indian advisory work, ended around 2012, was not linked to Tata Steel Netherlands, and that the scenarios studied have been published.
Both FNV and the group Zeester (former Tata Steel directors) have designated Roland Berger as a competent organisation to investigate the sustainability options for Tata Steel.
Zowel FNV, alsook de groep Zeester (oud-directeuren van Tata Steel) hebben Roland Berger aangewezen als een competente organisatie om de verduurzamingsmogelijkheden voor Tata Steel te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de fors hogere elektriciteits- en gasprijzen

The CDA MP Bontenbal asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about sharply higher electricity and gas prices, including whether this amounts to a European energy crisis, its causes, and how households and firms are affected. The government answered that prices reflect tight global supply and demand, that gas storage is adequate for protected users and monitored, that support measures and a ministerial taskforce are in place, and that the next government will address storage obligations.

I will also ask TenneT in good time next year to assess whether security of supply is sufficiently in order for the coming winter as well, or whether additional measures are needed that can then be developed.

Ook zal ik TenneT tijdig in het komende jaar vragen om te beoordelen of leveringszekerheid ook in de volgende winter voldoende op orde is, dan wel dat aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn die dan kunnen worden uitgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de afhandeling van de schade van de wateroverlast in Limburg en Noord-Brabant van juli 2021

An MP asked the government about the slow handling of flood damage claims in Limburg and Noord-Brabant after July 2021, including delays, strict procedures, insurance exclusions and unclear rules for farmers. The minister said payments had started, defended the procedure and the 13-week and 4-6 week timelines, refused to extend the deadline or make advance payments, and declined to intervene in private insurance policies.
I consider it of great importance that those affected are helped adequately and as quickly as possible.
Ik acht het van groot belang dat gedupeerden adequaat en zo snel mogelijk worden geholpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Kathmann over het bericht dat 5G zorgt voor een toename in het energieverbruik van telecommunicatie

MPs Thijssen and Kathmann asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the energy use of 5G networks was studied beforehand, why 5G masts are not yet used efficiently, and whether the government should accelerate greening of the telecom sector. The minister answered that energy efficiency has been an ongoing concern, that industry has strong incentives to reduce consumption, and that the government sees no need for a specific state role, pointing to EU-level cooperation instead.
I am of the view that the telecommunications sector is making considerable efforts to deliver its services as energy-consciously as possible.
Ik ben van mening dat de telecommunicatiesector zich aanzienlijk inspant om zijn diensten zo energiebewust als mogelijk te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over faillissementen van energiebedrijven

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked about the bankruptcy of energy supplier Welkom Energie, its consumers' losses and whether consumers can be protected or compensated. The State Secretary answered that consumers are unsecured creditors, that compensation is impractical so general tax cuts were chosen, and that stricter supplier requirements and further research on protecting consumers are planned.
Due to the commercial confidentiality of data, the ACM cannot provide information on whether more energy suppliers are in acute financial trouble.
De ACM kan vanwege de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid van gegevens geen informatie verstrekken of er meer energieleveranciers in acute financiële problemen verkeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de gang van zaken rond het faillissement van Welkom Energie, de grote gevolgen voor klanten en de rol van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt bij de afwikkeling

Omtzigt asks the minister about the Welkom Energie bankruptcy, the high costs and forced move to Eneco for customers, the ACM's role in supervision and the takeover, and whether customers can recover credit. The state secretary answers that the bankruptcy follows standard insolvency law, that compensation is generic rather than individual, that ACM's supervision was adequate and not involved in the takeover beyond merger review, and that a study on financial requirements for suppliers and consumer protection in bankruptcy will be commissioned.
Following market developments, I am in discussion with ACM and suppliers to examine whether the legal framework for ACM supervision is robust enough.
Naar aanleiding van de ontwikkelingen op de markt ben ik in gesprek met ACM en leveranciers om te kijken of het wettelijk kader voor toezicht van ACM robuust genoeg is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van het lid Erkens over het bericht ‘Ook energieleverancier Enstroga valt om door hoge gasprijs’

An MP asked the government about energy supplier bankruptcies (Enstroga and others) caused by high gas prices, the protection of affected customers, the fairness of contracts and tariffs, and support for vulnerable households. The State Secretary answered that customers are redistributed under legal supply-security rules, that a generic energy tax cut and municipal support funds are being provided, and that ACM monitors tariff reasonableness, while individual compensation is deemed impractical.
Consumers are protected to ensure that they do not end up without gas or electricity.
Consumenten worden beschermd om ervoor te zorgen dat ze niet zonder gas of elektriciteit komen te zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Thijssen over energieleverancier Enstroga dat omvalt door de hoge gasprijs

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Thijssen asked whether the government will help households and businesses left without a supplier after Enstroga's bankruptcy, whether a sector guarantee fund and sector screening are possible, and how other suppliers at risk will be protected. The state secretary answered that a general tax cut and a municipal support scheme provide relief, that individual compensation is impractical, that a guarantee fund has drawbacks, and that the ACM is independent so no screening can be ordered, while a stricter legal framework and an external study on consumer protection will follow.
Because of commercial confidentiality of data, the ACM cannot provide information on whether more energy suppliers are in acute financial trouble.
De ACM kan vanwege de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid van gegevens geen informatie verstrekken of er meer energieleveranciers in de acute financiële problemen verkeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht 'Van Oord bestelt megaschip voor bouw windmolens'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why Van Oord ordered a green mega-ship for wind farm construction from China rather than Dutch or EU yards, and whether public money, reshoring and strategic autonomy are affected. The minister answered that the company chose on its own commercial grounds, that the state provides no financing, and that industrial policy and innovation subsidies aim to keep knowledge and value in the Netherlands, while declining to go into company motives.
It is not for me to go into the specific reasons and motives behind the investment decisions of an individual company such as Van Oord.
Het is niet aan mij om in te gaan op de specifieke beweegredenen en motieven bij investeringsbeslissingen van een individueel bedrijf als Van Oord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Strien en Klink over het bericht 'Shell verhuist hoofdkantoor naar Engeland en wordt op papier volledig Brits'

Two VVD MPs asked the Economic Affairs and Foreign Trade ministers about Shell and Unilever moving their headquarters abroad, and the consequences for investment climate, employment, and Dutch international standing. Minister Blok answered that the government regrets Shell's plan, which moves about ten top jobs to London, is in talks with the company, and that Dutch investment climate remains good, citing confidentiality on the content of talks.
Given commercial confidentiality, it is not for me to go into detail about the content of these conversations.
Het is gezien de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid niet aan mij om in detail te treden over de inhoud van deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Gündoğan over het artikel ‘Clash Hoekstra en Wiebes over plan Europees noodfonds’

Two MPs from Volt asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance about a reported clash over how the Netherlands should prepare its Recovery and Resilience Plan, including contacts with the European Commission, the factors behind the chosen package of plans, and parliamentary and regional involvement. The acting Finance Minister answered that the matter is being coordinated by the Finance Ministry and that the timing and content of plans will be decided with the next cabinet, with limited concrete commitments on parliamentary involvement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over de afgegeven opsporingsvergunningen voor aardwarmte in (huidige en toekomstige) drinkwatergebieden

MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked why geothermal exploration licences were granted in current and future drinking water areas despite warnings from the Court of Audit and the State Supervision of Mines, and what safeguards exist. The Minister replied that a bill amending the Mining Act is pending, that licences are market-ordering concessions with no drilling rights until an environmental permit is granted, that provinces normally exclude mining in protected drinking water zones, and that no specific restrictions were attached to the licences.
The Court of Audit investigation took place in mid-2019.
Het onderzoek van de Algemene Rekenkamer (AR) heeft medio 2019 plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Bromet en Thijssen over de brief van UNESCO inzake de voorgenomen gaswinning onder de Waddenzee

Three MPs asked whether UNESCO had sent a letter on protecting the Wadden Sea and possible gas extraction beneath it, and whether it could be shared with a cabinet appraisal. The State Secretary confirmed UNESCO letters of 7 May and 30 November 2021, said the Ternaard gas production is assessed under UNESCO principles with a decision expected in March 2022, and that the cabinet plans to reply to UNESCO in January 2022.
The cabinet intends to send a letter to UNESCO with a response in January 2022.
Het kabinet is voornemens om in januari 2022 een brief te sturen aan UNESCO met een reactie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de afhandeling van schade door de voormalige steenkoolwinning

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about SodM's criticism of how mining damage from former coal mining in Limburg is handled, and about the government's responsibility for aftercare. The minister answered that a structural arrangement with the region is being built, that the government aims to take the lead via the Commissie Mijnbouwschade and a public fund for time-barred damage, and that a project group will report in April 2022 while further steps depend on a new cabinet.

For damage caused by former coal mining, I am taking the lead, as stated in earlier letters, in that I am working on an independent, low-threshold, extrajudicial settlement by placing it, in line with the national approach to mining damage, with the Commissie Mijnbouwschade.

9 Voor de schade als gevolg van de voormalige steenkolenwinning neem ik, zoals in eerdere brieven 10 aangegeven, regie in de zin dat ik werk aan een onafhankelijke, laagdrempelige en buitengerechtelijke afhandeling door deze, in lijn met de landelijke aanpak voor afhandeling van mijnbouwschade, onder te brengen bij de Commissie Mijnbouwschade.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Vestering over interne analyses en afwegingen aangaande de gaswinning Ternaard en de aanleg van een elektrische stroomkabel onder de Wadden

MPs Van Raan and Vestering asked about internal legal assessments, public consultation, and the Ternaard gas extraction and Wadden cable routing. The minister answered that the internal legal review underlying the draft decisions was shared, that the Landsadvocaat was not consulted beforehand to avoid exposing litigation strategy, and that the cable landing decision is being pursued jointly with other projects.

The government, like any other litigating party, must be able to speak freely with the lawyer representing it in (future) court proceedings, without the risk that advice given in that context becomes public.

De overheid moet, net als elke andere procespartij, vrijelijk kunnen spreken met de advocaat die haar vertegenwoordigt in (toekomstige) rechterlijke procedures, zonder het risico dat adviezen die in dat verband worden gegeven openbaar worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over “de zware gasbeving in Garrelsweer’’

MP Beckerman (SP) asks the ministers about the Garrelsweer gas-quake, the overrun of the seismic density threshold, schade-afhandeling delays at the IMG, the slow reinforcement operation and the Ombudsman's criticism. Minister Blok answers at length, largely defending the current approach, acknowledging delays and promising a further letter on seismic analyses and a law closing the Groningen field.
As SodM indicates, on 8 November, due to the magnitude 1.7 earthquake near Westeremden, one of the monitoring parameters, the earthquake density near Zeerijp, reached its highest level.

Zoals SodM aangeeft heeft op 8 november jl., door de aardbeving met magnitude 1,7 bij Westeremden, één van de monitoringsparameters, namelijk de aardbevingsdichtheid, nabij Zeerijp het hoogste niveau bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over “de Mijnbouwregeling”

An MP asked whether the 2019 Mining Regulation sets maximum earthquake levels that trigger ministerial intervention in the Groningen gas production plan, and questioned the regulation's value if no consequences follow from exceeding its norms. The minister replied that the regulation only sets monitoring parameters and reporting duties for NAM, not binding maxima, that the minister intervenes on the basis of the Mining Act and SodM advice, and that SodM sees no further short-term measures available.
The purpose of the monitoring is to keep track of the development of seismicity.
Het doel van de monitoring is om de ontwikkeling van seismiciteit in de gaten te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het toepassen van een milieueffectrapportage voorafgaand aan het vaststellen van de besluitvorming rondom de Regionale Energie Strategieën

An MP asked whether environmental impact assessment under the SEA Directive is required before Regional Energy Strategies (RES) are finalised, and how the government squares wind-park permits and the Aarhus Convention with recent Council of State and CJEU rulings. The State Secretary answered that the SEA Directive does not require a plan-MER for norms set in permits or zoning plans, that existing permits need not be withdrawn, that an already-in-progress RES is not a SEA-type plan so a plan-MER is voluntary, and that participation meets Aarhus, while promising a working group report by year-end.
An already-in-progress RES is not a "plan or programme" within the meaning of the SEA Directive, because a RES is not a plan or programme prescribed by legislative or administrative provisions.

Een al in besluitvorming zijnde RES is geen «plan of programma» in de zin van de SMB-richtlijn, omdat een RES geen plan of programma is dat door wettelijke of bestuursrechtelijke bepalingen is voorgeschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het artikel ‘Injectie van afvalwater in Rossum wordt over twee weken hervat’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the inspection history and continued use of water injection well Rossum 7 in Twente, including whether its cement casing was checked and whether economic interests influenced keeping it in use. The minister answered that NAM inspected the well in November 2021, that SodM supervises the tests and decides when injection may resume, and that SodM alone decides on closures for safety and environmental reasons.
SodM is authorised to close a well if there are safety or environmental reasons to do so.
SodM is bevoegd om een put te sluiten als er met betrekking tot veiligheid en of het milieu daartoe redenen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de bescherming van de privacy en het gebruik van een front-facing camera op de zelfscanner van de Albert Heijn

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether Albert Heijn's handheld self-scanners with a front-facing camera enable facial recognition of customers, and what the government will do to prevent supermarkets from using it. The minister replied that the camera is switched off, that the manufacturer lists facial recognition as a possible use, that GDPR allows biometric processing only with explicit consent or for overriding public interest, that a bill clarifying this in the UAVG is planned, and that the AP's guidance is considered sufficient.
The statutory text will explicitly state that the exception in Article 29 may only be applied where necessary for an overriding public interest.
In de wettekst wordt expliciet opgenomen dat de uitzonderingsgrond van artikel 29 alleen kan worden toegepast wanneer dat nodig is voor een zwaarwegend algemeen belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Erkens over het bericht 'Gerberakweker Simon stopt acuut vanwege torenhoge gasprijs: ‘Het is niet meer te betalen’'

Two VVD MPs asked the government about a flower grower stopping production due to high gas prices and what support glasshouse growers could get. The minister said problems are limited to a small number of firms, prices are expected to fall, a tax cut for 2022 is proposed, and no additional compensation is planned for now.
Additional measures are not currently on the table, since high prices are not expected to persist for long.
Aanvullende maatregelen zijn op dit moment niet aan de orde, aangezien het niet de verwachting is dat de huidige hoge prijzen langdurig aanhouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Thijssen en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Energiebedrijf loost klanten vanwege hoge gasprijs'

MPs asked whether an energy company unilaterally terminating contracts because of high gas prices is lawful, what protection consumers have, and what the government will do. The Minister answers that such unilateral termination is not allowed, points consumers to the ACM, complaints committee and courts, reports an ACM order-with-penalty against one supplier, and announces tax relief and extra funding for vulnerable households.
Unilaterally changing the agreed terms is not permitted, unless the parties have explicitly agreed to it.
Het eenzijdig wijzigen van de gemaakte afspraken is niet toegestaan, tenzij partijen dit expliciet zijn overeengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de bevindingen van Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) over zoutcavernes

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about SodM's findings on salt caverns operated by Nobian Salt in Twente, including unreported deviations from mining plans, merged caverns, and liability after ownership changes. The Minister answered that no general reporting duty applied, that SodM already supervises the stability risks and has agreed to stabilise risky caverns and check others, and that the current operator is liable.
There is no general reporting obligation for companies when they deviate from a mining plan.
Er bestaat geen algemene meldingsplicht voor bedrijven bij afwijking van een winningsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de voorgenomen structuurwijziging van de Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij (NAM)

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about NAM's planned restructuring, including selling its small gas fields, effects on Groningen compensation and guarantees, supply security, jobs and union involvement. The Minister answers that the restructuring is an internal company matter needing no approval, that the Groningen field and storage obligations remain with NAM backed by Shell and ExxonMobil guarantees, and that any transfer of licences requires his consent under the Mining Act.
The structure of NAM is an internal business matter of NAM; my approval was not requested for it, and it is not necessary either.
De structuur van de NAM is een interne bedrijfsaangelegenheid van de NAM, mijn goedkeuring is daarvoor niet gevraagd, en ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘NAM wil alle olie- en gasproductie in Nederland verkopen’

MP Bromet asks how much influence the government has over the sale of NAM's oil and gas fields, whether buyers with poor reputations could be blocked, the consequences for Groningen compensation and remediation, and whether the state could be left with unpaid decommissioning costs. The minister answers that ministerial consent is required for licence transfers, that buyers are vetted on technical and financial capacity, that the Groningen field stays with NAM, and that financial security under the Decommissioning Security Agreement covers the state's risk, while avoiding a firm commitment on some points.
Under the Mining Act, my consent is required for this transfer.
Op grond van de Mijnbouwwet is mijn toestemming vereist voor deze overdracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over additionele middelen voor ontwikkelings- en investeringsmaatschappijen

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about recent additional capital for regional development companies (ROMs) and why the €150 million was split by regional GDP. The minister confirmed the top-up, explained the GDP-based allocation agreed with regional partners, and said use of the funds is monitored and reported at each ROM's shareholders' meeting.
These funds are intended solely for investments (equity) in and/or provision of debt to start-ups, scale-ups and the manufacturing industry without a banking relationship.
Deze middelen zijn enkel bedoeld voor investeringen (eigen vermogen) in en/of verstrekken van vreemd vermogen aan start-ups, scale-ups en de maakindustrie zonder bancaire relatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de berichtgeving over verzakte huizen aan het Stieltjeskanaal

An SP MP asked the minister about reports of homes sinking near the Stieltjeskanaal, where residents did not know where to turn for compensation, whether mining damage was recorded, how evidence of cause could be shown, and what would be done for those affected. The minister answered that liability depends on the cause, pointed to the Commissie Mijnbouwschade, municipal and national support channels, and a Fugro study in Emmen attributing the damage mainly to peat oxidation and subsidence rather than gas extraction, while promising no new concrete measures beyond existing programmes.
To determine who is liable for foundation damage, it is necessary to know the cause of the damage that has occurred.
Om te bepalen wie aansprakelijk is voor funderingsschade is het noodzakelijk de oorzaak van de ontstane schade te kennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over “het bericht dat vergelijkbare bevingsschades ongelijk beoordeeld worden”

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that comparable earthquake damage claims in Groningen are assessed inconsistently, and about the Wet Bewijsvermoeden Groningen, the IMG's assessment framework, the handling of secondary costs, and the Ombudsman's report. The minister acknowledges variation in assessments, defends the IMG's independence and the new framework, and largely declines to go beyond deferring to the IMG or the courts, while promising a separate letter on the Ombudsman's report.
The IMG is independent and itself determines, within the legal framework, its working method for handling damage.
Het IMG is onafhankelijk en bepaalt zelf binnen het wettelijk kader de werkwijze voor de afhandeling van schade.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over de berichten ‘Bedrijfsleven start eigen alarmsysteem tegen hackers: ‘overheid te traag’ & ‘Informatie over op handen zijnde hacks wordt grotendeels weggegooid’

MPs Amhaouch and Palland asked whether the government is aware of reports that business is setting up its own hack-alert system because government is too slow, and asked about the Digital Trust Center, the NCSC's legal limits, and evaluation of these bodies. The minister says the private initiative is positive, defends the DTC and NCSC, and points to a draft amendment to the Wbni and pilots while promising to report on DTC results in early 2022.
It is a positive development that private initiatives in the field of cybersecurity, such as the "alarm system", are emerging.
Het is een positieve ontwikkeling dat private initiatieven op het gebied van cybersecurity, zoals het «alarmsysteem», zich ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Problemen met kwetsbare 112-meldkamers na zes jaar nog niet opgelost’

MPs Palland and Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the ministers about reports that vulnerable 112 emergency control rooms remain unresolved after six years, including staffing, responsibility fragmentation, ICT investigation and implementation of inspection recommendations. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the concerns are shared and a multi-year transition is underway, but largely defended the existing governance split, promised a WODC evaluation in 2022, periodic updates and a mobile coverage map by spring 2022.
I therefore do not share the supervisors' view on this point.
Ik deel het standpunt van de toezichthouders op dit punt dan ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de besteding van door de ACM opgelegde boetes

MP Eerdmans asks the minister how fines imposed by the ACM on Samsung for inflating online TV prices are spent, and whether consumers should be compensated directly. The minister confirms consumers were harmed, says fine revenue is a regular part of the EZK budget without earmarking, and points to civil damages claims and WAMCA collective actions as the compensation route.
These revenues thus form a regular part of the EZK budget; therefore no specific spending can be pointed to.
Deze ontvangsten vormen daarmee een regulier onderdeel van de EZK-begroting; daarom is er geen specifieke besteding aan te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over de storing bij Facebook en Instagram op 4 oktober 2021

MPs asked about the impact of the 4 October 2021 Facebook and Instagram outage on Dutch government operations, citizens, and future resilience, as well as EU regulation and internet routing standards. The minister replied that government operations were largely unaffected because these apps are restricted to informal use, that the outage was caused by a human error at Facebook, and that existing EU and national measures (Telecommunications Act duties, NIB2 negotiations, DMA) are being pursued.
There are currently no known signals of such messages directed at the cabinet.
Er zijn op dit moment geen signalen bekend over dergelijke aan het kabinet gerichte berichten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over het bericht 'Ziekenhuis OZG door deal met PowerField in de armen van commercie geduwd en het unieke Oldambtster landschap wordt vermarkt: 'Onoorbaar en amoreel''

Two SP MPs asked whether a deal in which a solar park developer offers EUR 20 million to a Groningen hospital, conditional on a solar park being built, amounts to commercialising care and the landscape. The government answered that spatial development is bound by existing law and policy, that the hospital is not dependent on the donation, that no care funds are involved, and that local authorities make the public interest assessment.
Moreover, I point out that there is no legal obligation to return proceeds to the surrounding area.
Overigens wijs ik erop dat er geen sprake is van een wettelijke verplichting om opbrengsten terug te laten stromen naar de omgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kathmann over het bericht dat de digitale veiligheid onvoldoende is

An MP asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers whether they accepted findings that cybersecurity at hazardous-substance companies (Brzo) in Zuid-Holland is inadequate and what they would do. The ministers accepted that more attention to cybersecurity is needed, described shared responsibilities of companies, provinces and national departments, and listed existing measures such as NCSC support, Wbni designation and Digital Trust Center tools.
That is why it is important that companies get to work on this.
Daarom is het van belang dat bedrijven hier mee aan de slag gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de vervuilende afscheidsvlucht van de KDC-10

An MP asked the Defence Minister why a 550 km farewell flight with an old KDC-10 tanker, emitting about 50,540 kg CO2, was justified given climate ambitions and its cost. The minister replied that the flight was a fitting farewell to a plane that transported veterans and supported missions, that it cost about 7,042 euro within the regular budget, and that the non-CO2 effects were insignificant due to low altitude.
The flight was a fitting farewell to the transport aircraft that since 1995 have carried tens of thousands of veterans to various mission and deployment areas and flown them home again.

De vlucht was een passend afscheid van de transporttoestellen die sinds 1995 tienduizenden veteranen naar verschillende missie- en inzetgebieden hebben gebracht en vervolgens weer naar huis hebben gevlogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het in Singaporese handen vallen van de High Tech Campus Eindhoven

MP Nijboer asks whether the sale of the High Tech Campus Eindhoven to a US asset manager with Singaporean state fund GIC behind it threatens Dutch knowledge infrastructure and national interests. The minister replies that the transaction is a private real estate deal outside existing investment screening rules, that no national security risk is identified, and that the government is examining whether additional safeguards are needed.

Regarding information security and national security risks from direct access to sites where sensitive technology is used or developed, my ministry is exploring whether additional measures are necessary.

Over de informatiebeveiliging en risico's voor de nationale veiligheid bij directe toegang tot de locaties waar sensitieve technologie gebruikt of ontwikkeld wordt, verkent mijn ministerie of aanvullende maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Kops over de gastekorten en het bericht dat het Russische Gazprom minder gas levert

PVV MPs De Roon and Kops asked the government about gas shortages, reduced Gazprom deliveries, nuclear energy and mandatory gas storage reserves. The State Secretary answered that Dutch-specific gas imports cannot be isolated, that high prices reflect supply and demand factors, that nuclear energy is not excluded, and that storage obligations are not currently necessary.
It is only possible to measure European gas imports from Russia.
Het is enkel mogelijk om de Europese gasimport vanuit Rusland te meten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Leijten over de investering in groen staal door ArcelorMittal en de overheden in België

MPs Bontenbal and Leijten asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about ArcelorMittal's green steel investment in Ghent with Flemish government support, and how it compares with Tata Steel IJmuiden's decarbonisation plans, including state participation, state aid rules, SSAB's withdrawn takeover interest. The minister answered that the plans are broadly similar, that the Dutch state is only examining possible support for Tata Steel without any financial commitment yet, and that a progress letter will follow before year end.
You will be informed about the state of affairs by letter to the House before the end of the year.
Over de stand van zaken wordt u voor het einde van het jaar middels een kamerbrief geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de problematiek in de metaalsector als gevolg van de hoge elektriciteitsprijzen

An MP asked the ministers about the metal sector's distress from high electricity prices, including the emission factor used for indirect cost compensation, carbon leakage risk for individual firms, and firm failures and job losses. The minister acknowledged the high energy prices, said cost management is primarily the firm's own task, explained that the compensation scheme is generic and cannot be adjusted for individual firms, and said only one firm (about 325 jobs) has signalled acute risk of closure, with steps assessed under the existing state-aid framework.
So far I am aware of one company that itself indicated its continued existence would be in acute danger.
Vooralsnog is mij één bedrijf bekend dat zelf heeft aangegeven dat het voortbestaan in acuut gevaar zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het loten door SNN voor het verlenen van subsidie

MP Beckerman asked whether the lottery used by SNN to order applications for the Groningen earthquake-area home improvement subsidy is acceptable and whether everyone entitled will receive it. The minister explained that lotteries are a standard way to order same-day applications, but to avoid one, sufficient budget will be made available this year for complete applications received on the cap day, with decisions by 18 November 2021, and budgets for 2022 and 2023 will be merged.
Therefore I will ensure that sufficient budget becomes available this year for those who submitted a complete application on the day the subsidy ceiling is exceeded.
Daarom zal ik ervoor zorgdragen dat er voor degenen die een volledige aanvraag hebben gedaan op de dag van overschrijding van het subsidieplafond dit jaar al voldoende budget beschikbaar komt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'High Tech Campus niet naar Amerikanen, maar in handen van Singaporese staat'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the sale of the High Tech Campus Eindhoven to a consortium led by Singapore's GIC, probing motives, legality, national security, and whether government can regain control. The minister answered that the sale was a lawful private market transaction cleared by the ACM, with no national security risks found, that it cannot be reversed, and that the proposed investment screening law would not apply.
It is not for the Dutch government to address the commercial motives underlying the investment.
Het is niet aan de Nederlandse overheid om in te gaan op welke commerciële motieven ten grondslag liggen aan de investering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over misleidende praktijken van Multi-level Marketing (MLM)-bedrijven

An MP asked the government about misleading practices of multi-level marketing companies, including unrealistic income promises, medical claims, possible pyramid schemes, bogus self-employment and lack of transparency. The minister answered that MLM is a lawful sales method subject to consumer protection rules enforced by the ACM and NVWA, that existing law suffices and no amendment of the gambling law or new disclosure duties are planned.
I currently see no reason for additional information obligations.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding voor aanvullende informatieverplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over de stijgende energieprijzen

MPs Erkens and Bontenbal asked the state secretary about rising gas and electricity prices, their scenarios, impact on sectors and households, flexible contracts, measures in other countries, and the role of nuclear energy. The state secretary answered on substance but deferred a promised letter on household purchasing-power effects and possible measures to the budget debate, and noted a planned tax-reduction measure under motion Hermans.
The cabinet will come back to this before the budget debate and the third round of the General Financial Deliberations.
Het kabinet zal hier voorafgaand aan de begrotingsbehandeling en de derde termijn van de Algemene Financiële Beschouwingen op terugkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Gijs van Dijk over de aanbesteding van fotografieopdrachten

MPs Sneller and Van Dijk asked the government about the tendering of photography contracts, including the administrative burden on photographers, a bureau-based model, tariffs, market power and legal grounds for the new approach. Prime Minister Rutte answered that the new framework will be published around late October/early November, that the hourly rate will be about 109 euros versus 117 now, and that the earlier multi-supplier framework was dropped partly for legal reasons.
The hourly rate in the new framework agreement will in all likelihood be 109 euros, for every hour a photographer takes photos on location.
Het uurtarief in de nieuwe raamovereenkomst zal naar alle waarschijnlijkheid € 109 bedragen, voor elk uur dat een fotograaf op locatie foto’s neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boucke over het bericht 'Milieuorganisaties vrezen dat nieuwe gasboringen oesterbank bij ‘Schier’ vernielen'

MPs De Groot and Boucke asked whether planned gas drilling north of Schier could damage an oyster restoration project and how this fits the North Sea Agreement and Natura 2000 rules. The minister answers that extensive assessments found no significant harm, that permits contain safeguards, and that definitive decision-making follows after objections are processed.
The concerns of the environmental organisations were raised in consultation responses. The consultation responses and advice will be taken into account in the definitive decision-making.
De zorgen van de milieuorganisaties zijn naar voren gebracht in inspraakreacties. De inspraakreacties en adviezen worden meegenomen bij de definitieve besluitvorming.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over “het delen van de eigen juridische analyse van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat waaruit blijkt dat er geen ruimte is om de vergunningsaanvraag van de Nederlands

MP Van Raan asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the ministry's internal legal analysis, which reportedly found no room under existing law to refuse the NAM gas permit under the Wadden Sea, would be shared with parliament. The minister confirmed the analysis was sent to parliament on 27 September 2021 and said the final decision would not come before March 2022 and that courts ultimately decide on the interpretation of the Mining Act.
Yes, I have shared this legal analysis with your House in my letter on the permit granting for gas extraction at Ternaard of 27 September 2021.
Ja, deze juridische analyse heb ik met uw Kamer gedeeld in mijn brief met betrekking tot de vergunningverlening gaswinning Ternaard van 27 september 2021
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Raan over de dood van een lammergier na botsing met een Nederlandse windmolen

MPs Vestering and Van Raan asked ministers about the death of a lammergier after a collision with a Dutch wind turbine, detection systems, protected-area permits, cumulative effects and subsidies for biodiversity. The ministers answered largely in general terms, saying permits are the responsibility of provinces, that a black-blade pilot is under way, and that a cumulative study and subsidy review are being considered.
Provinces are the competent authority for granting exemptions or waivers for species and permits for Natura 2000.
Provincies zijn bevoegd gezag voor het verlenen van ontheffingen of vrijstellingen voor soorten en vergunningen voor Natura 2000.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over aandacht voor de eiwittransitie op internationale conferenties

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether plant-based menus should be the default at international climate conferences such as COP26, and how Dutch meat and dairy exports and feed imports would be raised there. The government said it would raise protein transition and sustainable catering with the UK host and pursue sustainable agriculture and deforestation-free supply chains, without committing to a default vegetarian menu.
The cabinet will raise the importance of a healthy and sustainable offer in preparatory talks for COP26 with the United Kingdom.
Het kabinet zal het belang van een gezond en duurzaam aanbod in voorbereidende gesprekken op COP26 bij het Verenigd Koninkrijk onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Erkens over het artikel 'Nederland blijft achter met gasboringen op zee, bedrijven willen aan de slag'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister why exploration drilling for gas in the Dutch North Sea is lagging, whether domestic gas is preferable to imports, and how the tax investment deduction and supply security affect the outlook. The minister replied that two exploration wells were drilled in 2020, that the shortfall is too early to call structural, that domestic gas is preferable to imports while it is still needed, and that a round table and EU risk assessments will follow.

I am closely monitoring the current developments and am therefore organising a round table discussion with experts from the gas sector in the short term to discuss the developments and their possible consequences.

Ik houd de huidige ontwikkelingen scherp in de gaten en organiseer dan ook op korte termijn een ronde tafel overleg met deskundigen uit de gassector om de ontwikkelingen en de mogelijke gevolgen daarvan te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Dubieuze investeringen van Nederlandse pensioenuitvoerders in Myanmar’

Two D66 MPs asked whether Dutch pension funds investing in companies linked to Myanmar's military should be curbed and whether participants should have more say over investments. The minister said the government advises firms and pension funds not to deal with military-controlled entities, relies on the IMVB covenant and engagement, and points to existing participant voice through boards and accountability bodies.
The cabinet is willing to specifically point pension funds, within this framework, to the lasting importance of the cited cabinet advice and its elaboration.
Het kabinet is bereid om de pensioenfondsen binnen dit verband ook specifiek te wijzen op het blijvende belang van het genoemde kabinetsadvies en de uitwerking er van.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch, en Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Coronacrisis kost overheid tot dusver al 76,2 miljard euro' en het bericht 'Een vijfde van de coronasteun ging naar bedrijven met omze

CDA MPs asked the Ministers of Finance, Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about reports that a fifth of corona support went to firms with year-on-year revenue growth, asking how much support was paid, how much was repaid, and whether firms would be asked to voluntarily repay. The government answered that support was not conditioned on annual revenue loss, estimated the share going to growing firms from partial data (TVL about 9%, NOW about 16% per ESB researchers), reported repayment figures, and committed to informing parliament and to a moral appeal to firms to repay.
Having an annual revenue decline was not a condition for using the generic support measures such as the TVL and NOW schemes.
Het hebben van een omzetdaling op jaarbasis is geen voorwaarde geweest om gebruik te maken van de generieke steunmaatregelen zoals de TVL en de NOW-regeling.
Antwoord van de leden Kathmann, Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over kleinschalige evenementen die niet door kunnen gaan wegens corona

MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why restaurants with a terrace permit may not organise small events under the COVID-19 rules, and about the economic harm and possible support. The Minister confirmed the rule (article 4.4 of the Trm) is tied to the epidemiological situation, acknowledged the business impact, said the loss of revenue from events is unclear, and pointed to the TVL support scheme and a planned supplementary scheme for night-time hospitality.
For entrepreneurs in sectors including hospitality who lose more than 30% of their income due to the corona measures, the TVL scheme is open among others.
Voor ondernemers uit onder andere de horeca die meer dan 30% van hun inkomsten missen door de coronamaatregelen staat onder meer de TVL regeling open.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Boucke over het bericht dat greenwashing bedrijven dreigt door de lage prijs voor CO2-compensatie

Two MPs from D66 asked the government about reports that cheap old carbon offset credits make greenwashing likely, and whether the voluntary offset market needs independent oversight. The State Secretary acknowledged surplus old credits and average prices below real abatement costs, but said the government does not regulate the voluntary market, referring consumer misleading-claims issues to the ACM and committing only to a letter to the European Commission.
Current average prices are not made public.
De actuele gemiddelde prijzen worden niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Teunissen over turf-vrije potgrond

MPs Vestering and Teunissen asked the government about peat extraction for potting soil, its CO2 and biodiversity impacts, import volumes, and bans in other countries. Minister Schouten answered that peat extraction harms peatlands, that RPP certification aims for 100% certified peat by 2025, that England alone plans a sales ban, and that the minister will work toward fully peat-free potting soil for private consumers and study phase-out in the professional sector, reporting before the budget debate.
Yes, I have been called upon by your House through a motion to work toward fully peat-free potting soil for private consumers
Ja, ik ben door uw Kamer per motie opgeroepen toe te werken naar volledig turfvrije potgrond voor particulieren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Piri en Jasper van Dijk over het Follow the Money artikel over Nordstream 2 en de Werkgroep Energie

MPs Van der Lee, Piri and Jasper van Dijk asked the government about a Follow the Money report on the Dutch-Russian Energy Working Group, its restart, possible agreements linked to Nord Stream 2, and the protocol and sanctions implications. The minister replies that the working group made no agreements on specific projects such as Nord Stream 2, that the 2018 protocol has no formal status, and that the government keeps a neutral position on Nord Stream 2 as a commercial project.
There was (and is) no question of agreements on specific energy projects, such as Nord Stream 2.
Er was (en is) geen sprake van afspraken over specifieke energieprojecten, zoals Nord Stream 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een online informatiebijeenkomst over de mogelijke samenwerking tussen Elbit en Nederlandse bedrijven

An SP MP asked the ministers whether they knew of a planned online information meeting on cooperation between Israeli arms maker Elbit and Dutch firms, and whether the government would halt it given Palestinian civilian deaths and possible complicity in violations. The minister replied that the government saw no reason to suspend the meeting, and that any future exports would be subject to Dutch export controls that refuse licences where there is a clear risk of serious human rights violations.
The cabinet saw no reason to suspend this information meeting.
Het kabinet zag geen reden om deze informatiebijeenkomst op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over gaswinning onder de Waddenzee

MPs Thijssen and Bromet asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about gas extraction under the Wadden Sea, including subsidence, the role of regional authorities, climate consistency with the Paris Agreement, and financial benefits. The Minister answered that subsidence is managed under a 'hand on the tap' principle with monitoring and independent audit, that regional advice is weighed within legal limits, that extraction is climate-neutral compared to imports, and that no additional study is needed.
On the basis of an integral weighing of the advice and the studies carried out, I conclude that there are no grounds to refuse (partially) the approval of the extraction plan.

Op basis van een integrale afweging van de adviezen en de onderzoeken die zijn gedaan, kom ik tot de conclusie dat er geen gronden zijn om de instemming met het winningsplan (gedeeltelijk) te weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over “prullemanderen stikstofregels”

Rep. Van Haga asks the ministers about reports that shrinking the livestock sector would cost billions and jobs, and whether nitrogen rules are self-imposed and harm regional investment and the economy. The government replies that the nitrogen measures follow binding EU habitat law and Council of State rulings, that economic losses from shrinking sectors must be weighed against losses from inaction, and that it is working with regions on investment obstacles and a vestigingsklimaat (investment climate) agenda.

It therefore does not concern 'self-imposed nitrogen rules', but compliance with laws and regulations and following court rulings, as may be expected of a government within a state governed by the rule of law.

Het betreft derhalve geen «zelf opgelegde stikstofregels», maar het voldoen aan wet- en regelgeving en het volgen van rechtelijke uitspraken, zoals van een overheid binnen een rechtstaat verwacht mag worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Onzekerheid voor getroffen Limburgse ondernemers, 'meer omzetverlies dan waterschade''

CDA MPs asked for an update on flood damage in Limburg and Brabant, including economic losses from revenue loss, the state of compensation, the EU Solidarity Fund, local helplines and the coordinating minister. Minister Grapperhaus answered that economic loss is still poorly understood, that the Wts compensation scheme entered into force on 9 September 2021 with 1,135 reports so far, that a decision on the EU Solidarity Fund will follow by end of September, and that the Justice Minister coordinates the response while other ministers handle their own areas.
The cabinet is in discussion with the region and entrepreneurs' representatives to get a better picture of the economic damage.
Het kabinet is in gesprek met de regio en ondernemersvertegenwoordigers om een beter beeld van de economische schade te krijgen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over afvalwaterberging van de Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij (NAM) in de gemeente Dinkelland, mede n.a.v. recente problemen geconstateerd in de opslaglocaties in Rossum, gem

Rep. Van der Plas (BBB) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether NAM remains owner and liable for produced water injected into depleted gas fields in Twente, whether it will be recovered, who is liable for damage, whether emergency plans and baselines exist, and whether continuing is responsible given slow damage compensation. The minister answered that NAM remains owner and liable, that the injection is evaluated every six years and an earlier re-evaluation is planned, that no baseline measurements were taken but monitoring is in place, and that licensing followed the legal process.
NAM is liable for any damage arising from storing produced water in depleted gas fields.
NAM is aansprakelijk voor eventuele schade van het bergen van productiewater in uitgeproduceerde gasvelden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over een datalek bij de Kamer van Koophandel

MP Leijten asked the minister how a former lawyer could still access personal data of foundation directors at the Chamber of Commerce, why this lasted months, and whether affected persons could be named, and called for better protection of personal data. The state secretary answered that the former lawyer was reported and that the KVK is tightening authorisation checks and consulting on a data vision, but declined to name the lawyer or the foundations or the number of MPs affected, citing privacy and security.
No, it is not possible to disclose the name of the former lawyer, for reasons of privacy and the safety of the former lawyer himself.
Nee, het is niet mogelijk om de naam van de voormalige advocaat bekend te maken. Dit vanwege privacy en de veiligheid van voormalige advocaat zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over dat er negen jaar na de aardbeving bij Huizinge een chronische ramp gaande is in Groningen

An MP asks whether the Groningen earthquake reconstruction is delivering on its promises, given delays, unequal treatment of victims, and unresolved cases; the minister defends progress (more homes in works, a reconstruction target of 2028) but acknowledges delays, a missed 1 July deadline, and that some cases remain unclear. The government answers most questions on substance, promises letters and an intervention team, and withholds nothing material.
The previously communicated date of 1 July 2021 for the reinforcement advice to these residents was unfortunately not met.
De eerder gecommuniceerde datum van 1 juli 2021 voor het versterkingsadvies aan deze bewoners is helaas niet gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Simons en Van Ginneken over een lek van privéadressen van volksvertegenwoordigers en politieke en maatschappelijke organisaties door de Kamer van Koophandel

MPs Simons and Van Ginneken asked ministers about a leak of private home addresses of MPs and political and civil-society organisations via the Chamber of Commerce, in which a former lawyer had unlawfully retrieved about 1,785 addresses. The government answered that the lawyer's authorisation was revoked, a criminal complaint filed, the police investigate, and that authorisations are being audited and address protections expanded.
Following the unauthorised retrieval, the Chamber of Commerce filed a criminal complaint against the lawyer.
De KVK heeft naar aanleiding van de onbevoegde opvraging aangifte gedaan tegen de advocaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over de subsidie Verduurzaming en Verbetering voor gedupeerden in Groningen, die binnen 5 dagen op is

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked why the 2021 budget for the Groningen home-improvement subsidy ran out within five days and whether all eligible owners can be reached, including the number of eligible homes and the regimes in place. The ministers answer that the subsidy is phased over three years by design, that no legal entitlement exists, and that they will raise the ceiling via a Staatscourant amendment if needed, though they do not commit to extra funding now.
This year €75 million was available, for which more than 8,100 owners submitted an application.
Dit jaar was € 75 mln. beschikbaar, waar door meer dan 8.100 eigenaren een aanvraag hebben ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'GGD-directeur laat naam Tata Steel uit longkankerrapport schrappen'

SP MP Leijten asked ministers about reports that a GGD director had removed Tata Steel's name from a lung cancer report in Beverwijk, and whether trust in authorities has been damaged.
