The government answered that an independent investigation found the director acted with integrity, cited the Schone Lucht Akkoord and a ministerial working group on Tata Steel, and pointed to Tata Steel's own Roadmap Plus, while committing to a nulmeting and possible further measures.
The investigation report, carried out by researcher and former Hague ombudsman Peter Heskes, concluded that the director and his staff acted with complete integrity.

In het onderzoeksrapport, dat door onderzoeker en voormalig ombudsman van Den Haag Peter Heskes is uitgevoerd, is geconcludeerd dat er volstrekt integer is gehandeld door de directeur en zijn medewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Portugal, België en Luxemburg ontvangen eerste geld EU-herstelfonds'

An MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the EU Recovery and Resilience Facility, including the status of the Dutch recovery plan, stakeholder consultation, deadlines and competitiveness effects. Minister Blok answered that the plan will be drafted after the new cabinet decides its content, that consultation with stakeholders will follow, and that the Netherlands still has time to submit before summer 2022.
That is why it was chosen to let the new cabinet decide on the content of the plan.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen om het nieuwe kabinet een besluit te laten nemen over de invulling van het plan.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Sneller, Wuite, Romke de Jong en Van Weyenberg over de aanbesteding van fotografieopdrachten

D66 MPs asked whether the Ministry of General Affairs' tender for photography services, which bundles assignments with a large image bank, would exclude freelancers and SMEs and create a monopsony. The Prime Minister's answer says the tender is in preparation, that a pool of photographers will be selected via a single agency, that the image-bank and commissioned photography will be split into separate tenders, and that the approach honours the 2017 Vos/Mulder motion.
The Ministry of General Affairs has decided, after further consideration, that the commissioned photography and image-bank photography, initially bundled, will be decoupled in this tender.
Het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken heeft op basis van nadere afwegingen besloten dat de van aanvang gebundeld ingezette opdracht- en beeldbankfotografie in deze aanbesteding worden losgekoppeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Aartsen over "het rapport van de Nationale Ombudsman over ondernemers die in de knel komen als gevolg van corona"

MPs Romke de Jong and Aartsen asked the ministers about the Ombudsman's report on entrepreneurs in financial difficulty due to COVID support schemes, including TONK, SBI-code problems, debt relief and repayment. The State Secretary says the knelpunten are acknowledged, describes fixes (TONK budget doubled, SBI-code adjustments, second reference period, flexible repayment terms) and commits to assisting the Ombudsman.
I am always willing to assist the National Ombudsman in his investigation at his request.
Ik ben altijd bereid om de Nationale ombudsman op zijn verzoek bij te staan in zijn onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over de fotografie-aanbesteding Rijksoverheid

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked about the upcoming central government photography tender, its status, and whether it would keep freelance photographers' rates from being pressured and give them a fairer chance to compete, as the Vos/Mulder motion requested. The Prime Minister answered that the tender is in preparation with a pre-announcement published, that a single agency will select a pool of photographers under a framework with fixed hourly rates, and that the design is intended to respect the motion's intent.
In my judgement, the new design does justice to the spirit of the Vos/Mulder motion.
Met de nieuwe opzet wordt naar mijn oordeel recht gedaan aan de geest van de motie Vos/Mulder.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de zoutwinning en lekkages bij Nedmag

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the 2018 brine leak and the approval of Nedmag's salt mining through 2045, including its risks to groundwater, subsidence, damage compensation and whether lessons from Groningen gas extraction apply. The minister replied that the leak was not foreseeable, that the approval set cavern volume and pressure limits and found groundwater risks negligible, and that an independent damage commission and a guarantee fund now cover claims, while rejecting a separate fund and a statutory burden-of-proof reversal outside Groningen.
From 1 November 2021 people with damage can report to the Mining Damage Committee, which will assess the damage.
Vanaf 1 november 2021 kunnen mensen met schade zich melden bij de Commissie Mijnbouwschade die de schade zal beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Bromet over het rapport 'Bescherming drinkwater bij het boren naar aardwarmte; Stille wateren in diepe gronden'

Two Green Left MPs asked the ministers about an Algemene Rekenkamer report finding drinking water sources inadequately protected against geothermal drilling, and whether rules, regional consultation, monitoring and subsidies should be strengthened. The state secretary answered that the Tijdelijk Beleidskader and the forthcoming Mijnbouwwet amendment already strengthen oversight, consultation of provinces and water boards is adequate, extra monitoring will be explored with SodM, and subsidy adjustments are being studied.
The advisory right of the decentralised governments is laid down in the Mining Act.
Het adviesrecht van de decentrale overheden is vastgelegd in de Mijnbouwwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over 'RIVM houdt rapport over gezondheid rond Tata Steel nog lang onder de pet.'

MP Leijten asked why the RIVM health report on Tata Steel is not yet public, whether the timing was deliberate, whether it can be shared before the 9 September debate, and which ministries received drafts. The government replied that the provincial and IJmond municipal clients, together with RIVM, decided to publish mid-September, that the minister is not the client and cannot commit to sharing it earlier, and that only the GGD Kennemerland received a draft.
I am not the client. The province of Noord-Holland and the IJmond municipalities are the clients.
Ik ben geen opdrachtgever. De provincie Noord-Holland en de IJmondgemeenten zijn opdrachtgever.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over ontwikkelingen met betrekking tot de Regionale Energie Strategie (RES)

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about whether the 35 TWh onshore renewable target for 2030 is at risk, whether subsidies and offshore expansion should be halted, offshore costs, data centre demand, health effects of wind turbines, and nuclear energy. The government answered that the 35 TWh target appears within reach, that subsidies will be phased out once it is secured, that further studies on offshore wind health and ecological effects are underway, and that nuclear and cost questions will be addressed in later studies.
For part of it, the information on the costs that wind park developers incur is commercially confidential.
Voor een deel is de informatie over de kosten die windparkontwikkelaars maken bedrijfsvertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij (NAM) en de afvalwaterinjecties

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister about NAM's wastewater injection in Twente, including RTV-Oost reports that NAM helps draft ministerial answers, the integrity of wells ROW-2, ROW-5, ROW-7 and SCH-447, and protection of the Natura 2000 area Voltherbroek. The minister rejected the call for more own information gathering, stated that SodM already imposed enhanced supervision and ordered injection in ROW-7 stopped pending investigation, and committed to further monitoring and an assessment of NAM's SCH-447 investigation.
That is why my answers to parliamentary questions about specific situations are regularly submitted to the parties the questions concern.
Daarom worden mijn antwoorden op Kamervragen over specifieke situaties regelmatig voorgelegd aan de partijen waarover de Kamervragen gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over extra steun voor afgelaste festivals en evenementen

Opposition MPs from the PvdA asked the government about financial support for festivals and events cancelled during COVID-19, including gaps in the guarantee scheme, NOW and TVL, and eligibility for non-EU artists. The state secretary answered that support was being extended and a supplementary allowance introduced, but gave no overview of losses and deferred some questions.
There is no overview of the precise losses you ask about.
Er is geen overzicht over de precieze verliezen waar u naar vraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over ook extra steun voor toeleveranciers van festivals en evenementen

An MP asked whether suppliers to cancelled festivals, who lack contracts for the guarantee scheme and have hit the TVL subsidy ceiling, can be helped with a higher ceiling or other measures. The State Secretary answered that the TVL ceiling is tied to the EU state aid limit of 1.8 million euro and cannot be raised, and that no additional measures are currently on the table beyond the broadened guarantee scheme.
Raising the TVL subsidy ceiling is not possible due to its dependence on the European state aid limit.
Een verhoging van het subsidieplafond voor de TVL is vanwege de afhankelijkheid van de Europese staatssteungrens niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Bromet over het bericht 'Nog slag te slaan: helft Nederlandse kantoren voldoet niet aan juiste energielabel'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about a report finding half of Dutch offices fail the required energy label and about enforcement of the label C obligation for offices by 2023. The minister replied that RVO monitoring matches the Colliers figures, that owners were informed via letters and intermediaries, that government buildings are to be upgraded through portfolio routemaps, and that municipalities, as the competent authority, decide on sanctions.
The competent authority is the municipality. The municipality ultimately determines which sanction is appropriate.
Het bevoegd gezag is de gemeente. De gemeente bepaalt uiteindelijk welke sanctie passend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Jules de Kom: “Eerherstel opa Anton de Kom begint met intrekken vervolging”

Rep. Belhaj asked why Anton de Kom, dead for 76 years, has not been formally exonerated and whether the government will act on the Van Ojik motion calling for a gesture of recognition. The government answers that criminal liability lapsed at his death, that recognition has been given in various ways, and that a gesture of rehabilitation is being developed with the family under the motion.
This will be worked on, partly within the framework of implementing the motion, in consultation with the family.
Daar zal, mede in het kader van de uitvoering van de motie, aan worden gewerkt in samenspraak met de familie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de uitspraak van de rechter in de zaak tussen Milieudefensie en Shell

An MP asked the ministers about the consequences of the court ruling in Milieudefensie v. Shell, including its implications for other companies and for Dutch climate policy. The ministers answered that the reduction obligation applies only to Shell, that effects are still being analysed with a report to parliament after the summer, and that the case does not judge government climate policy.
An analysis is currently being carried out, on which your House will be informed after the summer.
Er wordt nu een analyse uitgevoerd, waarover uw Kamer na de zomer wordt geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Bontenbal over mogelijke extra kosten bij snelladers voor automobilisten

MPs Geurts and Bontenbal asked whether drivers at DC fast chargers receive less energy than they pay for, and whether a legal framework is needed for metering. The State Secretary replied that energy loss is priced in, consumer rules already apply, and she will push for harmonised EU metrology rules and consider national rules once international standards exist.
I suggest the next cabinet consider, once there is international agreement on the requirements, whether it is possible and desirable to anchor them in national regulation in advance.

Ik geef het volgende kabinet in overweging om, zodra er internationale overeenstemming is over de te stellen eisen, te bezien of het mogelijk en wenselijk is deze alvast in nationale regelgeving te verankeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de dominante marktpositie van Vlaamse mediabedrijven

An MP asked the government about the market dominance of Flemish media groups DPG and Mediahuis in Dutch newspapers, alleged Belgian state aid (zero VAT rate, bpost delivery) and whether this distorts competition and political influence. The government answered that the Belgian measures were cleared by the European Commission, that the ACM approved the Mediahuis-NDC merger with sufficient remaining competition, that editorial independence is safeguarded, and that no sector-specific protective measures are planned.

In the context of this takeover, Mediahuis committed to continue delivering morning newspapers for other publishers without their own distribution network, on reasonable terms comparable to its own papers.
Mediahuis heeft in het kader van deze overname toegezegd de bezorging van ochtendbladen van andere dagbladuitgevers zonder eigen distributienetwerk te (blijven) uitvoeren tegen redelijke voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over eerdere antwoorden over burgerdoden in Uruzgan

The SP MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers many questions about the use of force and civilian casualties during the June 2007 defence of Chora, Afghanistan, including rules of engagement, artillery accuracy, civilian warnings and investigations. The government answered that the Dutch troops acted lawfully under humanitarian law and self-defence, withheld some operational details and classified logs citing NATO rules and the ongoing court case, and rejected calls for an independent inquiry.
To avoid disrupting the legal proceedings, no statements can be made about certain details of the deployment in question while the matter is before the court.
Om de rechtsgang niet te verstoren, kunnen zo lang deze kwestie onder de rechter is geen uitspraken worden gedaan over enkele details van de inzet in kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de stijgende energielasten naar aanleiding van het artikel ‘Rekening energie door dak – Nota kan oplopen tot +200’ in de Telegraaf

An MP from the PVV asks the minister why energy bills keep rising, questioning the CO2 price, climate levies and the EU ETS, and whether climate policy is affordable. The state secretary answers that the government controls only energy taxes, which were unchanged, that market supply tariffs are rising for market reasons, and that the government defends the ETS and affordability while weighing household income in budget decisions.
The cabinet only has direct influence over energy taxes.
Het kabinet heeft alleen directe invloed op de belastingen op energie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Schade na brand Noardburgum groot, nog veel onduidelijk over zonnepaneeldeeltjes’

An MP from BBB asks the minister about the lack of a protocol for cleaning up solar panel debris after a fire in Noardburgum, insurance coverage of clean-up costs, and government support for affected businesses. The state secretary answers that research by IFV and RIVM is ongoing, that a panel protocol is one option pending results, that insurance coverage varies by policy, and that financing is primarily an insurer liability matter, with a promise to inform parliament after the summer.
If the ongoing research shows that an additional protocol for cleaning up deposits from solar panel fires is needed, I will consider what follow-up steps may be necessary.

Indien uit de lopende onderzoeken blijkt dat een aanvullend protocol voor het opruimen van de depositie bij branden met zonnepanelen nodig is, zal ik bezien welke eventueel vervolgstappen hiervoor nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het opruimen van de bij de grote brand in Noardburgum vrijgekomen scherven van zonnepanelen

MP Agnes Mulder asked the minister about clean-up of solar panel fragments scattered after a large fire in Noardburgum, including who pays the costs, whether cleanup methods are standardised, and the status of several research projects. The state secretary answered that insurers are primarily responsible for clean-up costs under the polluter-pays rule, that research by RIVM, IFV and TKI Urban Energy is ongoing with results expected later, and that a possible protocol will be considered after the studies conclude.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het essay van Pieter Hasekamp (CPB) in het FD over het in de ban doen van bitcoin

MP Alkaya asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about a CPB director's essay calling for a ban on bitcoin, including whether it is appropriate, whether a national ban is feasible, and whether bitcoin is poor money. Minister Hoekstra answered that the CPB is independent and may publish opinions, that a national ban would be ineffective and only EU-level action could work, and that crypto's volatility, energy use, and money-laundering risks justify MiCA regulation rather than a ban.
The CPB is independent as a planning bureau in terms of content.
Het CPB is als planbureau inhoudelijk onafhankelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de berichten ‘Rechtspraak nodig over blinde vlekken 112-bereikbaarheid’ en ‘Conclusies onderzoek mobiel bereik niet meer bruikbaar’

An MP asked the minister about news reports on blind spots in 112 emergency call reachability and the liability if citizens cannot reach 112 due to poor coverage, and about what government does toward full coverage. The state secretary pointed to broadband and mobile coverage maps, a forthcoming coverage map and consultation, liability as a matter for the parties and civil courts, and existing measures such as 112 calling via any network and WiFi calling.

Because it is in the first instance a matter for the parties involved, and in the second instance for the civil court, it is neither possible nor desirable for me to answer this hypothetical question concretely.

Omdat het in eerste instantie aan betrokken partijen is, en in tweede instantie aan de civiele rechter, is het voor mij niet mogelijk noch wenselijk om deze hypothetische vraag concreet te beantwoorden.
Antwoord  op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de Duitse Klimaatwet deels ongrondwettelijk is

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers how the German Constitutional Court ruling on the Climate Act relates to the Dutch Climate Act and whether Dutch climate policy protects the right to a future for present and future generations. The state secretary answered that the German ruling cannot be translated directly to Dutch law, that Dutch policy aims at emission reductions in line with the Paris Agreement, and that the Climate Act will be adjusted to EU targets.
This link between human rights and climate applies in particular to those who will most come to face the consequences of climate change, such as children and future generations.
Dit verband tussen mensenrechten en klimaat geldt in het bijzonder voor degenen die het meest met de gevolgen van klimaatverandering te maken gaan krijgen, zoals kinderen en toekomstige generaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het lozen van verontreinigd water boven Schiermonnikoog

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about discharge of contaminated produced water and drill cuttings into the North Sea about 20 km from Schiermonnikoog, including environmental effects, methanol use, reinjection options, and calls to align with stricter German rules. The minister answered that SodM's advice led to a condition requiring evaluation of discharged water after three years, that the EIA found limited effects, and that he saw no need to refuse the permits or adopt German standards.
I adopted SodM's advice by including these conditions as a requirement in the environmental permit for the platform.
Het advies van SodM heb ik overgenomen door deze voorwaarden op te nemen als voorschrift bij de omgevingsvergunning voor het platform.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht 'NAM pompt Vries-0 leeg voor afronding goedkeuringsprocedure'

MP Bromet asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether NAM extracted gas from the Vries-10 well before approval of its mining plan, whether SodM should have enforced, and whether NAM and the ministry were open with residents and municipalities. The minister denied that gas was extracted without approval, said extraction fell within the 2011 plan's remaining production capacity, that SodM rejected the enforcement request, and that residents and regional authorities were consulted and informed in the later procedure.
I have no indications that NAM or staff of my ministry were not open or honest in communications about the Vries-10 well.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat NAM of medewerkers van mijn ministerie niet open of eerlijk zouden zijn geweest in de communicatie rondom de put Vries-10.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de Libische kustwacht migranten op verzoek van Frontex onderschept

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the ministers whether Frontex permits or orchestrates Libyan coast guard interceptions and returns of migrants in breach of international law, and about reported pushbacks and Frontex's response. The government answered that it follows the reports closely, that Frontex has explained its cooperation with the Libyan coast guard within SAR obligations, that internal and external investigations (Management Board, European Ombudsman, Parliament, OLAF) are ongoing, and that it will push for normalised disembarkation and safe ports.
In addition, the final report of the working group can be found on the Frontex website, and the Management Board has published conclusions following this report.
10 Daarnaast is het finale rapport van de werkgroep te vinden op de website van Frontex 11 en heeft de Management Board naar aanleiding van dit rapport conclusies gepubliceerd 12 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een Surinaams verzoek om hulp in de strijd tegen het coronavirus

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about Suriname's request for COVID-19 help and why the Netherlands had not yet replied. The minister answered that oxygen containers and protective equipment were sent, 90,000 AstraZeneca doses were dispatched, and vaccine deliveries were promised from week 25 subject to supply.
On 9 June, the government sent 90,000 doses of AstraZeneca plus needles and syringes to Suriname.
Op 9 juni jl. heeft de regering 90.000 doses AstraZeneca plus naalden en spuiten naar Suriname gestuurd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Hammelburg, Boucke, Sjoerdsma en Ceder over het aanbod van het Diaspora Medisch Team Nederland om steun aan het vaccinatieprogramma in Suriname te faciliteren

MPs from D66 and ChristenUnie asked the health and foreign affairs ministers about the Diaspora Medical Team's offer to support Suriname's vaccination programme, whether the minister had contacted Suriname's health minister, and whether vaccines would be supplied. The minister replied that talks with Suriname's health minister had taken place, that 90,000 AstraZeneca doses were sent with further deliveries promised from week 25, and that a coordinator was deployed to match Surinamese needs with Dutch medical staff offers.
Furthermore, the Netherlands has committed that from week 25, provided deliveries allow it, vaccines will be supplied to Suriname.
Verder heeft Nederland toegezegd dat er vanaf week 25, mits de leveringen het toelaten, vaccins worden geleverd aan Suriname.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het wereldwijde chiptekort en de noodzaak van een sterke, onafhankelijke Europese halfgeleiderindustrie

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the global chip shortage, its economic impact in the Netherlands, its causes, and the need for a strong, independent European semiconductor industry, including reshoring. The minister answered that the shortage's Dutch impact is mainly limited to automotive suppliers such as VDL Nedcar, that Europe must solve it jointly through IPCEI, industry alliance and R&D programmes, and that a reshoring action plan will be left to a successor cabinet.
Because of the confidential nature of these talks, we cannot go into their content in more detail.
Omwille van de vertrouwelijke aard van deze gesprekken kunnen wij niet nader ingaan op de inhoud hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over het zesde rapport van UNITAD

An MP asked the foreign minister about the sixth UNITAD report, which points to clear evidence of ISIS genocide against the Yezidis, and about prosecution of ISIS fighters in Iraq and Syria. The minister answered that the government regards ISIS as having 'most likely' committed genocide, notes that Iraq's pending law does not yet meet international standards, and says Netherlands continues diplomatic efforts and support for UNITAD despite the absence of a Security Council mandate.
The cabinet therefore states, partly on the basis of detailed information in reports such as UNITAD's sixth report, that ISIS most likely committed genocide against the Yezidis.

Het kabinet stelt daarom – mede op basis van uitgebreide en gedetailleerde informatie in rapporten zoals het zesde rapport van UNITAD – dat ISIS «hoogstwaarschijnlijk» genocide heeft gepleegd jegens de Yezidi's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Rusland en China twijfel zaaien over Europese vaccins

MPs Paternotte and Sjoerdsma asked whether Russia and China are spreading doubt about European vaccines, whether the government will push back against such disinformation in the EU and bilaterally, and about the quality and regulatory status of Sinopharm, Sinovac and Sputnik V vaccines. The minister acknowledges the disinformation is condemnable but judges its impact small, describes EU and Dutch counter-disinformation efforts and the Chinese and Russian contacts, and says Sputnik V's EMA review is still ongoing with no date for a formal application.

At the same time, the cabinet has confidence in the pluriform Dutch and European media landscape, in which the free press assesses this kind of reporting on its merits and the impact of this kind of disinformation is so far small.

Tegelijkertijd heeft het kabinet vertrouwen in het pluriforme Nederlandse en Europese medialandschap, waarin de vrije pers dit soort berichtgeving op z’n merites beoordeelt en de impact van dit soort desinformatie vooralsnog klein is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Piri, Van der Staaij en Jasper van Dijk over de dreigende executie van een Egyptische monnik

MPs from four parties asked the Foreign Minister whether she knew of Amnesty's appeal on the death sentence of Egyptian monk Wael Tawadros, whether torture-based confession and unfair trial could be confirmed, and whether she would press Egypt and the EU to stop the execution. The minister answered that she could not independently verify the allegations, noted rising executions in Egypt, and reported that Tawadros had already been executed on 9 May 2021, with Dutch and EU concern conveyed to Egyptian authorities at senior official level.
I therefore do not have independent information that confirms or refutes these reports, and can therefore give no further judgment on them.
Ik beschik derhalve niet over eigenstandige informatie die deze berichtgeving bevestigt dan wel ontkracht, en kan daar dan ook geen verder oordeel over geven.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over uitleveringen en uitzettingen aan Rwanda

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about extraditions and expulsions to Rwanda, citing a critical Nederlands Juristenblad article on the country's human rights and fair-trial situation. The government replied that it sees no reason to change policy, points to ICJ monitoring of the 2016 extraditees' trials and to the lack of found due-process violations, and says it shares some NGO concerns while engaging Rwanda on them.
The cabinet sees no reason in this article to adopt different policy regarding extradition to Rwanda.
Het kabinet ziet in dit artikel geen reden om tot een ander beleid met betrekking tot uitlevering naar Rwanda te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Sjoerdsma over het onder de radar verdwijnen van Syriëgangers

Two MPs from D66 asked the ministers of Justice and Foreign Affairs about Dutch Syria travellers who may have escaped Syrian camps unnoticed, including questions on numbers, monitoring, consular contact and repatriation. The government largely refused to discuss individual cases, gave aggregate figures from public AIVD data, and described existing measures and cooperation with Turkey and other European states without committing to new concrete steps.
The cabinet does not comment on individual cases.
Het kabinet gaat niet in op individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het verlenen van een wapenexportvergunning voor Brazilië

The SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked whether a Dutch arms export licence for radar and C3 systems to the Brazilian navy (Thales, Tamandaré-class ships) was granted despite Brazil's Covid-19 crisis, human rights concerns and political turmoil in the military. Minister Kaag declined to give details on commercially confidential matters, said the licence was checked against the EU criteria with extra attention to human rights and regional stability, and saw no reason to reconsider it.
No statements can be made about the details of the application. That concerns commercially confidential information.
Er kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan over de details van de aanvraag. Dat betreft bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het bericht dat Duitsland haar broeikasgasreductiedoelen gaat aanscherpen

Two MPs (Teunissen and Van Raan, PvdD) asked the government about Germany's tightened 2030, 2040 and 2045 greenhouse gas targets, which follow a Constitutional Court ruling on Germany's climate law. The State Secretary answered that the targets are binding and cover all greenhouse gases, that Germany responded to the court ruling, and that the Netherlands will leave its own ambition for 2030 and 2050 to a next cabinet while welcoming the EU's higher target.
The Netherlands has in recent years repeatedly worked for ambitious European climate policy, including through the European Climate Ambition group.
Nederland heeft zich de afgelopen jaren veelvuldig ingezet voor ambitieus Europees klimaatbeleid, onder meer via de Europese klimaatkopgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het misbruik van ‘grijze paspoorten’ door de Turkse AK-partij

An MP asked the government whether it is aware that municipal officials linked to Turkey's ruling AK party allegedly sold grey service passports used for irregular travel to Germany, whether this facilitates people smuggling, and whether any such travellers have reached the Netherlands. The government answered that it is concerned, that Turkey has suspended service passports for non-officials on project travel, that Dutch border checks and Europol cooperation address smuggling risks, and that it is not known whether anyone obtained a passport through corruption and travelled to the Netherlands.
Reports that official documents are being misused to facilitate irregular migration towards the EU are worrying and must be thoroughly investigated.
Berichten dat officiële documenten oneigenlijk worden gebruikt om irreguliere migratie richting de EU te faciliteren zijn zorgelijk en dienen grondig te worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Paternotte, Hagen, Boucke, Grinwis en Ceder over niet-EU-familieleden van expats, die geen toegang hebben tot Nederland

MPs from D66 and ChristenUnie asked whether non-EU family members of expats and residents are barred from entering the Netherlands under the EU entry ban and Dutch flight bans, whether this breaches Article 8 ECHR, and whether exceptions can be made for Suriname and other regions. The government answered that family of Dutch residents with residence permits are exempt, that individual exceptions exist for urgent family reasons, that the flight bans were lifted on 1 June 2021, and that generic exceptions for first- and second-degree relatives were not desirable.
The cabinet notes that the right to private and family life in Article 8 ECHR does not constitute an absolute right of access to the Netherlands.
Daarbij merkt het kabinet op dat het in artikel 8 EVRM opgenomen recht op privé en familieleven geen absoluut recht tot toegang tot Nederland behelst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat vicepremier Dritan Abazovic wordt bedreigd door een drugsbende

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about threats against Montenegro's deputy prime minister from a drug gang, whether contact had been made with Montenegro, what the EU does on corruption and funding, and whether Dutch and EU attention would be raised at accession talks. The minister condemned the threats, pointed to Dutch rule-of-law support projects and EU IPA funding, said Montenegro had announced extra protection measures, and said Nederland raises rule-of-law and anti-corruption issues in EU enlargement meetings.
Additional action by the Netherlands is therefore not necessary at this moment.
Aanvullende actie door Nederland is op dit moment dan ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over deportatie van Syrische vluchtelingen door Denemarken

An MP asked the State Secretary and Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would challenge Denmark's decision not to renew or to revoke residence permits of about 380 Syrian refugees and whether the Netherlands would offer them asylum. The government answered that it saw no reason to intervene, citing Denmark's sovereign asylum competence, the mutual trust principle, and the appeal and ECtHR remedies available, and declined to offer asylum to those affected.
Within the normative frameworks of these treaties, member states have room to make their own policy assessment, based on the country information available to them.
Binnen de normatieve kaders van deze verdragen hebben lidstaten de ruimte om een eigen beleidsafweging te maken, aan de hand van de hun beschikbare landeninformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht ‘Militairen verontwaardigd over achterlaten Afghaanse tolken’

MP Piri asks the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that soldiers are outraged at leaving Afghan interpreters behind, and about the number, timing, and process for bringing interpreters to the Netherlands. The minister answers that vetting of identity and Dutch service is required, that 68 interpreter households have been brought over, and that the process is ongoing with no fixed end date, while numbers are shared confidentially with parliament rather than publicly.
The cabinet has agreed to inform your House in detail about the process and the numbers in a confidential technical briefing.
Het kabinet heeft ingestemd om uw Kamer in een vertrouwelijke technische briefing in detail te informeren over het proces en de aantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over “politiegeweld tegen demonstranten in Colombia”

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about alleged excessive police violence against protesters in Colombia, harassment of human rights activists, internet and electricity shutdowns, and whether the Netherlands would press Colombia to stop the violence. The minister condemned excessive force, backed EU and UN statements, said internet cutoffs were unconfirmed, and described diplomatic engagement and monitoring of Colombian investigations without committing to new measures.

The cabinet shares the concerns expressed by the United Nations. It is important that violence against demonstrators is investigated and that those responsible for human rights violations are punished.

Het kabinet deelt de zorgen die door de Verenigde Naties zijn geuit. Het is van belang dat het geweld tegen demonstranten wordt onderzocht en dat verantwoordelijken voor schendingen van mensenrechten worden bestraft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over een verklaring van de Amerikaanse minister van buitenlandse zaken

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government views a US statement on Taiwan's participation in the WHO assembly, and whether a similar Dutch statement would be published. The minister said the Netherlands supports meaningful Taiwanese participation in WHO-related matters and that prior statements are already public.
These answers as well as earlier written and oral statements of the same tenor by the cabinet to your House are already public.
Deze antwoorden alsook eerdere schriftelijke en mondelinge uitlatingen van gelijke strekking van het kabinet aan uw Kamer zijn reeds openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het rapport van Human Rights Watch aangaande misdaden tegen de menselijkheid door Israël

MP Simons asked the Foreign Minister how the government responds to the Human Rights Watch report accusing Israel of apartheid and persecution as crimes against humanity, including Israel's dual legal system in the occupied territories, the Netherlands' discouragement policy on business in settlements, arms and Elbit contracts, and the EU Association Agreement. The minister acknowledged concern about the violations documented but declined to adopt the term apartheid, rejected several HRW recommendations (new VN inquiry, sanctions, a special envoy, a legal ban on trade with occupied territories, exclusion of firms on the UN database from procurement), while noting existing measures such as restrictive arms export policy and ongoing dialogue with Israël.
The cabinet is however reticent about using qualifications such as "apartheid".
Het kabinet is echter terughoudend met het gebruik van kwalificaties als «apartheid».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Meer beschietingen op Israël en Palestijnse gebieden: doden in Gaza’

MPs Piri and Van der Lee asked the Foreign Minister how the government responds to escalating violence in Israel and Gaza, the threatened eviction of Palestinian families in East Jerusalem, and whether Israel's conduct will be condemned and what further measures will be taken. The minister answered that the government is deeply concerned, has urged de-escalation and restraint by all parties, opposes settlement expansion and the evictions as contrary to international law, and points to earlier Kamerbrieven and the EU discussion for details.
The cabinet remains, like the EU, very critical of Israeli settlement expansion in the West Bank and East Jerusalem.
Het kabinet is en blijft, net als de EU, zeer kritisch ten aanzien van Israëlische nederzettingenuitbreidingen op de Westelijke Jordaanoever en in Oost-Jeruzalem
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de escalatie van geweld in Palestina en Israël

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about escalating violence in Israel and Palestine, Israeli evictions in East Jerusalem, the motion on sanctions over annexation, EU association agreement suspension, and the HRW report calling Israel's policy apartheid. The minister answered that the Netherlands urges de-escalation, opposes unilateral actions like evictions, supports continued dialogue and monitoring of annexation, rejects suspending the association agreement, is cautious about the term apartheid, and will respond carefully to the HRW report.
The cabinet is reticent about using characterisations such as "apartheid".
Het kabinet is terughoudend met het gebruiken van kwalificaties zoals «apartheid».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht ‘Morocco: Release Omar Radi and Guarantee Fair Trial Proceedings’

An MP from the Labour party asked the Foreign Minister about the detention of Moroccan journalist Omar Radi, his hunger strike, the lack of new information on the case, and whether the Netherlands would press Morocco for a fair trial. The minister confirmed awareness of the calls and the hunger strike (reportedly ended 30 April), said there was no new unequivocal information, and stated that a fair trial is for the Moroccan authorities to guarantee while the Netherlands monitors the case and raises press freedom bilaterally or in the EU.
It is for the Moroccan authorities to guarantee a fair legal process.
Het is aan de Marokkaanse autoriteiten om een eerlijke rechtsgang te garanderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het bericht dat Iran is verkozen tot lid van een VN-vrouwenrechtencommissie

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked why Iran was elected to a UN women's rights commission, whether the Netherlands voted against it, and whether it would protest and stop funding the body. Minister Blok confirmed the election, said the secret vote cannot be disclosed, expressed concern about Iran's women's rights record, and declined to protest or change funding, noting indirect Dutch funding via UN Women.
The Netherlands does not publicly state its voting behaviour in secret ballots, because countries must be able to rely on the confidentiality of their vote.
Nederland doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over stemgedrag bij geheime stemmingen, omdat landen moeten kunnen rekenen op de vertrouwelijkheid van de door hun uitgebrachte stem
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht dat Iran is verkozen als lid van de Commissie voor Vrouwenrechten van de Economische en Sociale Raad van de Verenigde Naties

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Iran's election to the UN ECOSOC Commission on the Status of Women, questioning its suitability given women's unequal position in Iran, the secrecy of the vote, and how the Netherlands voted. The minister acknowledged Dutch concerns about Iran's women's rights record, noted the vote was secret so individual positions are unknown, and declined to publicly disclose how the Netherlands voted, referring to a confidential annex.
The Netherlands does not make public statements about voting behaviour in secret ballots, because countries must be able to rely on the confidentiality of their vote.
Nederland doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over stemgedrag bij geheime stemmingen, omdat landen moeten kunnen rekenen op de vertrouwelijkheid van hun uitgebrachte stem
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de mededeling dat Iran voor een volle termijn van vier jaar is verkozen tot lid van de VN-Vrouwencommissie

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands voted on Iran's candidacy for the UN Commission on the Status of Women, on what grounds, and how the decision was prepared, including whether the JCPOA played a role. The minister declined to disclose the vote publicly, referring to secret ballot confidentiality and a confidential annex, and denied that the JCPOA or EU coordination influenced the position.
The Netherlands does not make public statements about voting behaviour in secret ballots, because countries must be able to rely on the confidentiality of the vote they cast.
Nederland doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over stemgedrag bij geheime stemmingen, omdat landen moeten kunnen rekenen op de vertrouwelijkheid van de door hun uitgebrachte stem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte  over het bericht dat Azerbeidzjan kritische politieke opponenten in het buitenland laat deporteren om ze vervolgens in gevangenschap te nemen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Azerbaijan has had critical opponents deported from abroad and imprisoned, specifically the case of Elvin Isayev, and whether the government would raise it with Azerbaijan's ambassador. The minister answered that the government follows the case closely but cannot independently verify the reports, notes the conviction is not final and under appeal, and says human rights are raised bilaterally and in EU and Council of Europe channels, including a planned case discussion in the EU-Azerbaijan dialogue.
The Dutch government closely follows the situation of Mr Isayev. I cannot independently verify the media reports on this.
De Nederlandse regering volgt de situatie van de heer Isayev nauwgezet. De mediaberichtgeving hierover kan ik niet op eigenstandige wijze verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de vervolging van de Syrisch-Orthodoxe monnik Aho in Turkije

Member Kerseboom asked the Foreign Minister about the prosecution of a Syriac Orthodox monk in Turkey and what the government would do to improve the position of Christians in Turkey and the Middle East. The minister confirmed awareness of the case, said the embassy is monitoring it and that Netherlands raises rule of law generally, and referred to EU reporting and existing human rights and religious freedom projects, without committing to a specific intervention.
The Dutch embassy, like several other like-minded countries, follows developments in this case closely.
De Nederlandse ambassade volgt net als enkele andere gelijkgestemde landen de ontwikkelingen in deze kwestie op de voet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Van der Staaij, Jasper van Dijk en Agnes Mulder over de veroordeling van een monnik in Turkije voor het geven van brood aan Koerdische bezoekers, in aanvulling op vragen van het li

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about the conviction of a monk in Turkey for giving food to Kurdish visitors, the situation of Christian minorities, and whether EU-Turkey rapprochement and pre-accession aid should continue. The government answered that the Dutch embassy follows the case, that concerns about rule of law and religious freedom in Turkey are raised consistently, and that it has pressed for suspending pre-accession aid, though no Council support exists.
The Netherlands has serious concerns about human rights and the rule of law in Turkey and consistently raises these concerns.
Nederland heeft grote zorgen over de mensenrechten en de rechtsstaat in Turkije en stelt deze zorgen consequent aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Afghaanse tolken in levensgevaar komen als de coalitietroepen van de resolute support missie vertrekken uit Afghanistan

Two D66 MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about risks to Afghan interpreters who worked for Dutch forces as coalition troops leave Afghanistan, and about implementation of the Belhaj motion on relocating them. The government answered that over 60 interpreters with families have already come to the Netherlands, that the Afghan authorities are responsible for citizens' safety, and that interpreters meeting the conditions will be processed for asylum, with no specific numbers at risk disclosed.
On the numbers of interpreters who may be at risk, names and dates, we make no statements in the security interest of the interpreters.
Over aantallen tolken die mogelijk risico lopen, namen en data doen we uit veiligheidsbelang van de tolken geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over (deels) opgeven Nederlands veto met betrekking tot het buitenlandbeleid van de EU

An MP from FvD asked the Foreign Minister about a Dutch-Spanish non-paper on EU open strategic autonomy that proposes extending qualified majority voting, and whether this amounts to giving up Dutch sovereignty and requires a referendum. The minister replied that the non-paper has no formal status, that QMV would be explored only in limited foreign policy areas such as human rights declarations and sanctions, and that no referendum or sovereignty-related study is planned.
The cabinet does not aim to switch from unanimity to QMV in other policy areas as well.
Het kabinet zet er niet op in ook op andere beleidsterreinen over te stappen van unanimiteitsbesluitvorming naar QMV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Piri, Van der Lee en Amhaouch over het bericht 'EU efforts to observe the Palestinian election fall flat'

MPs Sjoerdsma, Piri, Van der Lee and Amhaouch asked the Foreign Minister about reports that EU efforts to observe the Palestinian elections had stalled, including whether the EU could still observe and support the vote, Israel's reasons for not admitting EU staff, and alternative partners. The minister replied that President Abbas postponed the elections without a new date, that the EU has urged a new date and called on Israel to facilitate elections, and that the EU will renew its observation effort once a date is set.
Once a new date for the elections is set, the EU will again work towards organising an observation mission.
Wanneer een nieuwe datum voor de verkiezingen is vastgesteld, zal de EU opnieuw inzetten op de organisatie van een waarnemingsmissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over de arrestatie van zeven personen op de Molukken

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the government will inquire with the Indonesian ambassador about the arrest of seven Moluccan activists and whether it will act if Article 2 of the ICCPR has been violated. The minister answered that the Dutch embassy will monitor the case, that the Netherlands does not interfere in other countries' legal processes, and that human rights concerns are raised generally in bilateral and EU contacts.
The normal Indonesian legal process appears to be followed and the Netherlands in principle does not interfere in the legal processes of other countries.
De normale Indonesische rechtsgang lijkt te worden gevolgd en Nederland mengt zich in beginsel niet in de rechtsgang van andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de Italiaanse maffia vat probeert te krijgen op de miljarden uit het Corona Herstelfonds

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that the Italian mafia is targeting EU Recovery Fund money, and about oversight of the fund. The minister said the RRF has built-in control, audit and suspension mechanisms that the Commission assesses, that Italy is responsible for controls in the first instance, and that the Netherlands will not submit its plan before 30 April 2021 but a later date has no effect on its allocation.
It is necessary that fraud is prevented in all member states. The agreements made on the functioning of the RRF provide guarantees for this.
Het is noodzakelijk dat fraude wordt voorkomen in alle lidstaten. De gemaakte afspraken over de werking van de RRF bieden hier waarborgen voor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Beertema en Fritsma over het bericht dat tientallen Chinese onderzoekers in Delft banden hadden met het Chinese leger

PVV MPs asked whether dozens of Chinese researchers at TU Delft had ties to the Chinese military, whether knowledge flowed to the PLA, whether intelligence services screen Chinese researchers, and whether universities should stop cooperating with the 'Seven Sons' universities. The government answered that the TU Delft figures are limited and that an inventory and binding risk-assessment framework on knowledge security is underway, while it declined to provide nationality data, a blacklist, or confirmation of specific knowledge transfer.

The cabinet is working on a country-neutral package of measures that together offers a course of action for both knowledge institutions and central government to counter undesirable knowledge transfer.

Het kabinet werkt aan een landenneutraal pakket maatregelen dat samengenomen een handelingsperspectief biedt aan zowel de kennisinstellingen als de rijksoverheid om ongewenste kennisoverdracht tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over ontmijningsprojecten in Nagorno-Karabach

An MP asked why the Netherlands refuses to fund HALO Trust demining in Nagorno-Karabakh despite funding it elsewhere, and why it stopped funding in 2009. The minister answers that access and political conditions are lacking, that the Netherlands is exploring a regional demining fund, and that funding was ended in 2007-2009 for priority reasons and because Armenia and Azerbaijan are not parties to the Ottawa Convention.
The Netherlands is exploring with international partners the possibilities for a contribution to a possible regional demining fund.
Nederland onderzoekt samen met internationale partners de mogelijkheden voor een bijdrage aan een eventueel regionaal fonds voor ontmijning
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over één mondiaal minimumtarief voor winstbelasting

MPs Van Dijk and Alkaya asked whether the US push for a global minimum corporate tax, the Yellen proposal, is a good tool against a race to the bottom, and what the government will do to avoid Dutch tax-haven reputation. The state secretary answered that Nederland supports the OECD Inclusive Framework Pillar 2 minimum tax and an agreement by mid-2021, distinguished it from the EU CCCTB, and pointed to existing anti-avoidance measures and commitment to promote the plan internationally.
The Netherlands will continue to work to reach agreements in the OECD Inclusive Framework by mid-2021.
Nederland zal zich ervoor blijven inzetten om halverwege 2021 tot afspraken te komen in het Inclusive Framework van de OESO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het verwerpelijke Nederlandse stemgedrag in de VN-Mensenrechtenraad

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked why the Netherlands voted alongside states like China and Pakistan on an anti-Israel resolution in the UN Human Rights Council, why it keeps cooperating despite Israel's many condemnations, and whether it will leave the Council. The minister answered that the Netherlands seeks to reduce disproportionate focus on Israel through negotiation with the Palestinians while still criticizing serious rights violations, and that it will remain a Council member to engage with states holding different views.
The Dutch approach remains aimed at countering disproportionate attention to one country within the UN, in line with the motion by MP Van der Staaij.
De Nederlandse inzet blijft erop gericht om disproportionele aandacht voor één land binnen de VN tegen te gaan, conform motie van het lid Van der Staaij
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over de rechtszaak bij het Internationaal Gerechtshof tegen Myanmar over mogelijke genocide tegen de Rohingya

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Nederland's role in the ICJ genocide case against Myanmar and whether the Netherlands should start its own case, request disclosure of filings, or ensure the Rohingya are heard. The minister declines to start a separate case, declines to request disclosure, notes the Rohingya have no standing under the rules, and says no withdrawal by Gambia is indicated.
I am therefore not willing to consider this step without a request to that effect from Gambia, because that would not be in the interest of the progress of the case.
Ik ben dan ook niet bereid deze stap te overwegen zonder verzoek daartoe van Gambia, want dat zou niet in het belang zijn van de voortgang van de zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het stemgedrag van Nederland in de VN-Mensenrechtenraad

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands again voted for UN Human Rights Council resolutions targeting Israel, how this fits the goal of ending the Israel-specific agenda item, how credible the item is, and whether the Netherlands will vote against or abstain on all such resolutions. The minister replied that negotiations with the Palestinian Authority reduced Item 7 resolutions and produced a more balanced merged text, that the Netherlands voted for the settlements and self-determination resolutions in line with its policy, and that voting against or abstaining would not advance the goal and would not change outcomes given broad support.
No. As explained in the answer to questions 1 and 2, a vote against or abstention would not be consistent with the principles of Dutch and European Middle East Peace Process policy.
Nee. Zoals toegelicht in het antwoord op vraag 1 en 2 zou een tegenstem of onthouding niet in overeenstemming zijn met de uitgangspunten van het Nederlandse en Europese MOVP-beleid
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over Chinese surveillanceapparatuur

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Huawei tested facial recognition software targeting Uyghurs, whether this breaches international human rights law, whether Dutch and EU bodies use Hikvision surveillance equipment, and whether the government will act against Chinese firms and push for tougher EU measures. The minister answered that the government cannot confirm the reports, that ethnically targeted facial recognition would likely breach non-discrimination treaties, that it will raise concerns with Huawei and China but rejects calls for a blacklist or a dedicated investigation, and that it has no overview of surveillance equipment used by public or private bodies.
There is no complete overview of the surveillance equipment used across all government institutions.
Er bestaat geen compleet overzicht van de gebruikte surveillanceapparatuur binnen alle overheidsinstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld van de leden Van den Hul, Van Ojik en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over de stelselmatige verkrachting van Oeigoerse vrouwen in Chinese kampen

MPs Van den Hul, Van Ojik and Van den Nieuwenhuijzen asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about reported systematic rape and torture of Uyghur women in Chinese camps, what action the government would take, whether it would press China on human rights and sanctions, and what it was doing about Dutch companies profiting from Uyghur forced labour. The ministers answered that they condemn these abuses, raised them with the Chinese ambassador and in joint EU and UN statements, supported independent UN investigation and EU sanctions, held talks with business and organised a sector session on due diligence, while stating the government has no overview of companies linked to Xinjiang supply chains.
The cabinet has no overview of companies that are linked to the situation in Xinjiang through their supply chain.
Het kabinet heeft geen overzicht van bedrijven die via hun toeleveringsketen zijn gelinkt aan de situatie in Xinjiang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de demonstraties in Myanmar uit de hand lopen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about violent repression of protests in Myanmar, EU sanctions timing, humanitarian aid, protection of activists, Indonesia's role, Rohingya minorities and UN Security Council action. The minister answered most questions in substance, confirming EU sanctions on eleven military figures, humanitarian funding channels and Dutch diplomatic engagement, while giving general policy statements on some points.
The Netherlands also maintains bilateral contact with the United States and other like-minded countries about measures taken in response to the military coup, including sanctions.
Nederland onderhoudt ook bilateraal contact met de Verenigde Staten en andere gelijkgezinde landen over maatregelen die worden genomen naar aanleiding van de militaire coup, waaronder sancties.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de klacht tegen Nederland die de Nederlandse Vereniging Omwonenden Windturbines op 9 november 2015 heeft ingediend bij het Compliance Committee van het Verdrag van Aarhus va

MP Van Gerven asks why the Aarhus Compliance Committee has still not decided, nearly five and a half years after a complaint against the Netherlands over public participation, and what the consequences of a ruling would be for citizen consultation rules in the AWB and Omgevingswet. The government says it cannot explain the delay since the committee controls its own working methods, declines to assess possible consequences before a decision, denies legal uncertainty, and sees no means to press the committee to speed up.
Unfortunately it is not possible to inform you of the reason for the absence of a decision, since the Aarhus Compliance Committee is responsible for its own work organisation and methods.
Het is helaas niet mogelijk om u te informeren over de reden van het uitblijven van een beslissing, aangezien het Aarhus nalevingscomité over zijn eigen werkindeling en -methoden gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht Medisch Dossier Surinaamse activist Doedel opgedoken: hoop op eerherstel

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether the government will examine the newly found medical file of Surinamese activist Doedel, support the family's access request, investigate Dutch archives and pursue rehabilitation. The minister answers that a Surinamese commission will study the file first, the embassy will follow the process, and Dutch involvement and rehabilitation will be considered only if Suriname requests it or the commission's findings warrant it.
If Suriname indicates it wants Dutch involvement in the investigation, for example to locate certain archival documents, the cabinet is of course willing to examine what the possibilities are.

Als Suriname aangeeft Nederlandse betrokkenheid te willen bij het onderzoek, bijvoorbeeld om bepaalde archiefstukken te achterhalen, is het kabinet uiteraard bereid te kijken wat de mogelijkheden daartoe zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de Marokkaanse journalist Maati Monjib al sinds 29 december in voorarrest zit onder discutabele beschuldigingen en inmiddels in hongerstaking is

The MP asks the Foreign Minister about the detention of Moroccan journalist Maati Monjib and his hunger strike, including whether the Netherlands will raise the case in the Media Freedom Coalition. The minister answers that Monjib is now conditionally released pending a verdict, that Morocco must ensure fair proceedings, that the Netherlands has no independent information on the money-laundering charge, and that the case is being followed within EU and international channels.
It is up to the responsible Moroccan authorities to carefully investigate the charges against Maati Monjib and to pass judgment on them.
Het is aan de verantwoordelijke Marokkaanse autoriteiten om zorgvuldig onderzoek te doen wat betreft de aanklachten tegen Maati Monjib en hier een oordeel over te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over recente ontwikkelingen in Polen

An MP asks the ministers about recent concerns over judicial independence and media freedom in Poland, the effectiveness of Article 7 procedures, the Rule of Law report, infringement actions, Article 259 TFEU, and the Rule of Law budget conditionality regulation. The government answers that it shares the concerns, will keep monitoring, supports the infringement actions and civil society, and that Article 259 is not yet relevant while the Commission is acting.
The government is concerned about the erosion of the rule of law in Poland and continuously follows developments regarding the judiciary and media freedom.
Het kabinet is bezorgd is over de erosie van de rechtsstaat in Polen en volgt in dat kader voortdurend de ontwikkelingen rondom de rechterlijke macht en vrijheid van media.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een door Israël ingetrokken reisvergunning voor een Palestijnse minister na een bezoek aan Den Haag

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel revoked a travel permit for the Palestinian foreign minister after his visit to The Hague and whether this was retaliation, asking the government to press Israel for free travel for ministers. The minister denied any revocation, confirmed the delegation was refused smooth passage and questioned about the ICC visit, and said the Netherlands had raised the matter with Israel and would continue to monitor the situation.
In contacts with Israeli authorities, clarification has been requested about what happened.
In contacten met Israëlische autoriteiten is om opheldering gevraagd over de gang van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat Erdogan volgens uitgelekt vertrouwelijk NCTV-rapport een grote rol speelt bij de opkomst van het salafisme in Nederland

MP Van Kooten-Arissen asked about reports of a leaked confidential NCTV draft analysis on Erdogan's role in the rise of salafism in the Netherlands, and on government conduct toward Turkey, Milli Görüş, Diyanet and the Utrecht tram attacker's associates. The government answered that it cannot discuss the content of the unfinished, confidential draft, which is not policy, that a definitive analysis will follow before summer 2021, and that existing policy and positions remain unchanged.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Geheime ‘Turkije analyse’ NCTV lekt uit: grote rol Erdogan bij opkomst salafisme in Nederland'

MPs Becker and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked the government about a leaked confidential NCTV analysis linking Erdogan to the rise of salafism in the Netherlands, and about follow-up on related motions. The Minister declined to discuss the draft analysis's contents, referred to existing policy and a forthcoming final analysis, and answered the remaining questions largely by pointing to ongoing work and existing frameworks.
At this moment I cannot address the questions posed by your House about the content of the draft analysis.
Ik kan op dit moment niet ingaan op door uw Kamer gestelde vragen over de inhoud van de conceptanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over ondermijning van de democratie in Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about threats to Turkey's democracy, including a possible ban on the pro-Kurdish HDP party and stripping MPs of immunity, and what the government would do about it. The minister replied that concerns are raised bilaterally and multilaterally, that the EU and Netherlands issued statements, and that the government favours suspending EU IPA funds while human rights do not improve.
Concerns about the situation regarding elected representatives are regularly raised both bilaterally and multilaterally.
De zorgen over de situatie m.b.t. gekozen volksvertegenwoordigers worden regelmatig zowel bilateraal als multilateraal aan de orde gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Graaf, Van der Staaij en Van Helvert over het rapport 'Same Faith, Different Persecution' van Open Doors

MPs from four Christian parties asked the government about an Open Doors report on gender-specific religious persecution of women and girls, and what came of earlier commitments to raise it with UN envoys. The minister said the Special Envoy's talks with UN officials led to closer cooperation on religion and gender, that the government recognises the problem, and that it will be addressed through existing human rights channels and funding without committing to new concrete measures.
The cabinet recognises that women and girls from religious minorities are subjected to forced marriage and human trafficking.
Het kabinet herkent dat vrouwen en meisjes uit religieuze minderheden onderworpen worden aan gedwongen huwelijken en mensenhandel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de massaprotesten tegen nieuwe landbouwwetten van de Indiase premier Narendra Modi

An MP from DENK asked the government about mass protests in India against new agricultural laws, including internet shutdowns, the use of force, concerns about farmers' incomes and human rights, and calls for Dutch diplomatic action. The ministers answered that the laws are an internal Indian matter, that the government welcomes dialogue and the suspension of the laws, and that it will raise civil society and responsible business conduct through existing channels.
Parliamentary approval of the laws is an internal Indian matter.
Daarbij is de parlementaire goedkeuring van de wetten een interne Indiase aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de bevindingen van het Panel of Experts on Yemen dat Nederlandse wapenexportvergunningen zijn misbruikt

Karabulut (SP) asked whether Dutch components found in intercepted Iranian air-defence missiles bound for Yemen reflect misuse of Dutch export licences, what the government shared with the UN Panel of Experts, and what it will do to prevent recurrence. The government confirmed the components were of Dutch origin, said the firms acted in good faith as targets of covert procurement, stated licences were conditioned on no re-export, and promised tightened company practices, EU information sharing and an export-control proposal, while declining to name other firms.
We cannot make any statements about this in public.
Wij kunnen hierover in de openbaarheid geen uitspraken doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de virtuele handelsmissie India, de omstreden landbouwwetten, de repressie van de maatschappelijke protesten en mogelijke gevolgen voor Nederlandse bedrijven

MP Voordewind asked whether the February 2021 virtual Dutch trade mission to India discussed Indian farm laws, farmer protests, forced and child labour, Dalit discrimination, journalists' prosecution and internet shutdowns, and the state of EU-India trade talks. The ministers replied that no talks with the Indian government took place during the mission, that CSR was stressed to participants, and that human rights concerns are raised regularly bilaterally and in the EU, with trade negotiations on hold since 2013.
During the virtual trade mission, no talks took place with the Indian government.
Tijdens de virtuele handelsmissie hebben geen gesprekken met de Indiase regering plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Belhaj over het bericht 'Situation Report EEPA HORN No. 50' van 9 januari en 'Situation Report HORN No. 81' van 11 februari

MPs Sjoerdsma and Belhaj asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about reports on the Tigray conflict, including the killing of an aid worker, destruction of refugee camps, alleged Eritrean involvement and massacres, plus the response of the government, EU and UN. The minister answered in substance, noting Ethiopia's commitments to humanitarian access and independent investigation, Dutch calls for Eritrean withdrawal, and that details on some incidents could not be verified or discussed for confidentiality reasons.
On the use of this regime in specific situations I cannot make public statements for reasons of confidentiality.
Over de inzet van dit regime in specifieke situaties kan ik omwille van de vertrouwelijkheid geen openbare uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de situatie in Tigray

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about the situation in Tigray, including reported mass killings, sexual violence, famine risk, the fate of Eritrean refugees, humanitarian access, UN peacekeeping and evidence preservation. The minister answered in detail, describing ongoing conflict, EHRC and OHCHR investigations, Dutch diplomatic initiatives, and the Ethiopian government's commitments on access, while declining to commit to a UN mission for now.
Given the limited access for humanitarian organisations and journalists, and the ongoing fighting in the region, it is not possible to give an exact picture of the fate of these refugees.
Gezien de beperkte toegang voor humanitaire organisaties en journalisten, en de voortdurende strijd in de regio is het niet mogelijk een exact beeld te geven van het lot van deze vluchtelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Helvert over de ongeregeldheden bij Marokkaanse consulaten

An MP from the CDA asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about protests and intimidation at Moroccan consulates in the Netherlands, including the desecration of the Moroccan flag in Utrecht. The ministers condemned the incidents, said police and the Public Prosecution Service act on criminal offences, and described contacts and extra security alertness, while stating that demonstrations are a local matter for mayors.
As your House knows, we cannot make statements about the nature of the measures.
Over de aard van de maatregelen kunnen wij, zoals uw Kamer weet, geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Helvert over het bericht dat studenten in Nederland China vrezen

MPs Van der Molen and Van Helvert asked whether the Groningen Confucius Institute chair contract, which bars damaging China's image, threatens academic freedom, and what measures the government will take. The minister said the RUG must safeguard academic freedom, the Inspectorate may investigate, the chair agreement will lapse this year, and further measures are under review.
The Inspectorate of Education can itself decide, based on signals including media reports, to launch an investigation.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs kan zelf op basis van signalen, waaronder berichten in de media, besluiten een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van den Hul en Van Ojik over de sloop van een Palestijns dorp

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government reacts to Israel's repeated demolition of the Palestinian village Humsah al-Fawqa, which left over seventy people homeless, and whether the government will push for firm EU measures against continued demolitions. The minister says the Netherlands and the EU are very concerned, have called on Israel to stop demolitions, visited the village with other European representatives, and will pursue a joint European response such as demarches and diplomatic visits, without committing to sanctions.
The Netherlands is actively working toward a joint European response to the demolition of Palestinian buildings.
Nederland zet zich actief in voor een gezamenlijke Europese reactie ten aanzien van sloop van Palestijnse gebouwen.
Antwoord op van het lid Koopmans over nieuwe technologie en wapenbeheersing

Rep. Koopmans (VVD) asked the Foreign Minister to confirm the government's ambition under the 2019 Koopmans motion to lead on a binding treaty on new weapons technologies, and what concrete steps were taken since October 2020 and planned for this year. The minister answered that the Netherlands will act as a driver of international rules, outlining EU, NATO, space, drone, autonomous weapons and biosecurity initiatives and a planned 2021 conference, while no initiative has been fixed yet.
The Cabinet intends to organise an international conference in 2021 on the responsible use of new technologies and to launch an initiative towards arms control.

Het Kabinet is voornemens in 2021 een internationale conferentie te organiseren over het verantwoord gebruik van nieuwe technologieën en daarbij een initiatief te lanceren om te komen tot wapenbeheersing
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het wettelijk verbod op abortus in Polen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the Polish near-total abortion ban and the prosecution of activist Marta Lempart, and whether the Netherlands would raise these with Poland and push for EU action. The minister said the government is concerned, but that ECHR/ICCPR assessment belongs to the courts or UN committee, that health care is a member-state competence, and that the Netherlands raises women's rights in EU and bilateral contacts.
It is not for the cabinet, however, to assess whether in this case there is a violation of, for example, the right to freedom of expression or the right to demonstrate under the ECHR or the ICCPR.

Het is echter niet aan het kabinet om te beoordelen of er in dit geval sprake is van een schending van bijvoorbeeld het recht op vrijheid van meningsuiting dan wel van het recht om te demonstreren onder het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens (EVRM) of het Internationaal Verdrag inzake burgerrechten en politieke rechten (IVBPR).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het nieuws dat de laatste onafhankelijke radiozender van Hongarije door premier Orban is weggewerkt

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the loss of broadcasting licence by Hungary's last independent radio station Klubrádió was a purely political move by Orbán, and what the Netherlands and the EU would do about media freedom there. The minister replied that media pluralism in Hungary is under pressure, that the Commission asked Hungary to keep the station on air and publicly voiced concern, and that the Netherlands raises press freedom bilaterally, in the EU rule-of-law dialogue and at the Article 7 procedure.
The Netherlands regularly raises the importance of press freedom and media pluralism in European and bilateral contexts.
Er wordt in Europees en bilateraal verband door Nederland regelmatig aandacht gevraagd voor het belang van persvrijheid en mediapluriformiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Sjoerdsma over ‘De quota worden duur betaald‘

D66 MPs asked whether PM Rutte threatened the EU-Faroe trade relationship in 2017 to block a Faroese fisheries law affecting Dutch quota holdings, and questioned the government's intervention and the role of an honorary consul with fishing interests. The government denied an explicit threat, said it raised concerns via bilateral contacts and the EU, declined to publish conversation reports, and defended the honorary consul's appointment as serving Dutch economic interests.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de beslissing van de Pre-Trial Chamber van het Internationaal Strafhof dat het Internationaal Strafhof bevoegd is om misdaden te onderzoeken in de Gazastrook, op de Westelij

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the ICC Pre-Trial Chamber ruling that the Court has jurisdiction over Gaza, the West Bank and East Jerusalem, including the dissent of the presiding judge and Canadian and German criticism. The minister replied that the Court is independent, the ruling concerns only territorial jurisdiction and not statehood or borders, and the Netherlands will not comment on the substance or on other states' positions.
The International Criminal Court is independent. The cabinet has confidence in the professionalism of the Court and the prosecutor.
Het Internationaal Strafhof is onafhankelijk. Het kabinet heeft vertrouwen in de professionaliteit van het Hof en de aanklager.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de ontwikkelingen in Belarus

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of a planned camp for political prisoners in Belarus, whether the information had been shared with European and UN bodies, and what the government would do about the human rights situation. The minister said he could not confirm the report but remains deeply concerned, cited EU sanctions and an OSCE fact-finding mission, and committed to keep the issue on multilateral agendas.
I cannot confirm the content of the report. I am and remain very concerned about the human rights situation in Belarus.
