Ik kan de inhoud van het bericht niet bevestigen. Ik ben en blijf zeer bezorgd over de mensenrechtensituatie in Belarus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de toegang van journalisten tot China

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why journalists with Chinese residence permits are still barred from re-entering China after travel abroad, and how many Dutch and European correspondents are affected. The minister said the cabinet regrets the restrictions, has repeatedly asked Chinese authorities to lift them, and that the Dutch correspondent has now been allowed back, while exact numbers are unknown and further efforts will continue.
Exact numbers are not known to me.
Exacte aantallen zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over gestopte grenscontroles in Noord-Ierland en het EU-only gehalte van het akkoord met het Verenigd Koninkrijk

An MP (Leijten, SP) asked the Foreign Minister about halted border controls in Northern Ireland and whether the EU-UK trade agreement is EU-only, including why the Netherlands handled it differently from other member states and what concrete steps will keep parliament informed. The minister answered that the Northern Ireland Protocol is binding, that the trade agreement is EU-only per the Council decision, that no procedural changes are planned beyond regular briefings, and that parliament will be kept informed through letters and Council agendas.
Your House received a letter on 15 February with an account of the experiences in the first period after the transition period ended.
Uw Kamer heeft op 15 februari jl. een brief ontvangen met daarin een uiteenzetting van de ervaringen van de eerste periode na het aflopen van de overgangsperiode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over UNRWA-studiematerialen

Parliamentarian Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the Foreign Affairs and Development ministers about IMPACT-SE findings that UNRWA home-schooling materials contained incitement to violence and denial of Israel and Jewish history, and whether the government would reconsider its UNRWA funding and raise the issue with UNRWA and the Palestinian Authority. The minister answered that UNRWA removed the material and is conducting an internal review, that the government raised the matter with UNRWA and the PA, and that the government does not intend to revise its UNRWA funding.

In that light, taking into account the corrective measures UNRWA has taken and in the interest of the overall continuity of UNRWA's services, the cabinet does not intend to revise Dutch funding of UNRWA.

In dat licht, rekening houdend met de corrigerende maatregelen die UNRWA heeft genomen en in het belang van de gehele continuïteit van UNRWA’s dienstverlening, is het kabinet niet voornemens de Nederlandse financiering van UNRWA te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de precaire situatie in Noord-Irak

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish military operations in northern Iraq since June 2020, their effect on minorities, and what Dutch diplomacy can do to protect them. The minister described the Turkish operations, said there were no current signs of a new offensive, and answered most questions by pointing to Iraqi responsibility and continued bilateral dialogue without committing to new concrete steps.
The cabinet does not wish to speculate about a possible future Turkish operation.
Het kabinet wil niet speculeren over een eventuele toekomstige Turkse operatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht 'Human Rights Council: Countries Should Take Bold Action on Egypt'

The MP asks whether the minister will support creating a monitoring and reporting mechanism on Egypt's human rights situation at the 46th Human Rights Council session, and whether the minister will answer before that session. The minister says the situation is deeply worrying and prefers building a broad coalition for a strong, influential action over a monitoring mechanism, and notes the session runs 22 February to 23 March 2021 and the answers were sent as soon as possible.

The minister prefers, at the 46th session of the Human Rights Council, instead of a monitoring and reporting mechanism, to pursue as broad a coalition as possible for as strong an action as possible, not only declaratory but also influential.

Het heeft mijn voorkeur om tijdens de 46 e zitting van de Mensenrechtenraad, in plaats van op een monitorings – en rapportagemechanisme, in te zetten op een zo breed mogelijke coalitie voor een zo stevig mogelijke, niet alleen verklarende, maar ook beïnvloedende, actie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over hulp aan Kroatië na aardbeving

MP Van Helvert asked the Foreign Minister about the earthquakes in Croatia, the ongoing hardship of displaced families, and Dutch aid offers. The minister replied that Croatia declined Dutch in-kind and engineering support, that Croatia is eligible for EU Solidarity Fund aid, and that the Netherlands stands ready should needs arise.
In a letter to my counterpart I indicated that the Netherlands stands ready to consider new options should Croatia develop further humanitarian needs in the future.
In een brief aan mijn ambtgenoot heb ik aangegeven dat Nederland klaarstaat om nieuwe mogelijkheden te bezien, mocht er in de toekomst nog een Kroatische hulpbehoefte ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over een oud-ambassadeur van Soedan die in verband is gebracht met een ernstig terreurplan

MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about a former Sudanese ambassador linked to a terror plot, including how he was screened, why he received a royal honour, and whether he can be barred from the Netherlands. The minister answered that agrément procedures are confidential and individual cases cannot be discussed, that the honour cannot be revoked as no prison sentence was imposed, and that no national sanctions listing applies.
To conduct such discussions effectively, it is important that countries can rely on these discussions being held in confidence between the two countries and not becoming public.

Om dergelijke discussies effectief te kunnen voeren, is het belangrijk dat landen er van op aan kunnen dat deze discussie in vertrouwen tussen beide landen gevoerd wordt en niet in de openbaarheid komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Kuiken en Voordewind over het bericht 'Wat er met Ali, Samoal, Ibrahim gebeurde na hun uitzetting naar Soedan'

MPs Van den Hul, Kuiken and Voordewind asked whether the government monitors asylum seekers deported to Sudan, whether the NISS mistreats returnees, and why deportations continued despite reports of torture. The State Secretary answered that post-return monitoring is not part of Dutch return policy, that no concrete evidence of irregularities linked to deportations was received, and that Sudan is considered safe enough for returns.
Monitoring does not form part of the Dutch return policy.
Monitoring geen deel uitmaakt van het Nederlandse terugkeerbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld van de leden Groothuizen, Van Dam en Buitenweg over de rechtsstaat in Polen en de gevolgen voor Nederland

MPs Groothuizen, Van Dam and Buitenweg asked the government about media pluralism and press freedom in Poland, press lawsuits, EU tools, Polish asylum claims under the Aznar protocol, free movement, and detained Polish suspects after extradition suspensions. The government answered at length, largely describing EU monitoring frameworks, noting the limits of EU instruments, declining to provide asylum-motive statistics, and reporting that no one is held in Dutch detention solely due to the suspension.
The cabinet is not aware that Polish citizens are currently experiencing problems exercising their right to free movement in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet is er niet mee bekend dat Poolse burgers momenteel problemen ondervinden bij het uitoefenen van hun recht op vrij verkeer in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over derubricering bilaterale verdragen van Nederland en de VS over plaatsing van kernwapens in Nederland

An MP asked why the government did not itself release nineteen documents on US nuclear weapons in the Netherlands, whether further declassification is planned, and why MoUs on nuclear weapons remain secret. The ministers answered that security and alliance obligations prevent disclosure of locations, numbers and bilateral arrangements, while some older treaties were declassified where NATO agreed.
On grounds of state security, no statements can be made about secret treaties between the Netherlands and other countries.
Op grond van overwegingen van staatsveiligheid kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over geheime verdragen tussen Nederland en andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over schade die de Palestijnse NGO UAWC lijdt door opschorting van Nederlandse financiering

An MP asked the ministers about harm suffered by the Palestinian NGO UAWC after Dutch funding was suspended pending an investigation into alleged PFLP links. The government confirmed about USD 1.08 million in payments were withheld, said it will take no steps to ensure UAWC's continuity until the external investigation concludes, and answered the remaining questions largely by restating policy on Area C and Israeli settlement activity.
Pending the external investigation into UAWC, the cabinet will not take any steps to guarantee UAWC's continuity.
Het kabinet zal hangende het externe onderzoek naar UAWC geen stappen zetten om de continuïteit van UAWC te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse regering stelt dat de Chinese regering zich schuldig maakt aan genocide op de Oeigoeren

MPs Van Ojik and Van den Nieuwenhuijzen asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares the US claim that China commits genocide against the Uyghurs and whether the Netherlands will launch an official investigation, grant access to Xinjiang, or act jointly with the US. The minister answered that the Netherlands is concerned about abuses but, following the government's recognition criteria (international court rulings, consistent scientific findings, UN determinations), does not currently find genocide established, and will raise the matter in EU context while requesting access for observers.

Leading for the Dutch government in recognizing genocides are rulings of international courts or tribunals, unambiguous conclusions from scientific research, and determinations by the UN, as set out in the coalition agreement.

Leidend voor de Nederlandse regering bij de erkenning van genocides zijn uitspraken van internationale gerechts- of strafhoven, eenduidige conclusies volgend uit wetenschappelijk onderzoek en vaststellingen door de VN leidend
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een opgepakte journalist in Marokko en gedetineerde Rif-activisten

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he agrees with Amnesty International that journalist Maati Monjib should be released, whether he will press Morocco for release, and whether detained Rif activists were unnecessarily dispersed across prisons. The minister said embassies monitor such cases and raise press freedom with Morocco where opportune, that Morocco is responsible for prison matters, and that the Moroccan authorities are sufficiently aware of the Dutch position.
It is up to the Moroccan authorities to ensure a careful legal process.
Het is aan de Marokkaanse autoriteiten om een zorgvuldige rechtsgang te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht 'Egypte: doden in gevangenissen na marteling en slechte medische zorg'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty International's report on deaths in Egyptian prisons due to torture and poor medical care, including whether torture was involved, whether Europe would press Egypt to release vulnerable detainees, and whether all detainees should get COVID-19 vaccination. The minister acknowledged serious concerns, said Netherlands raised human rights and detention issues bilaterally and multilaterally, and noted it had urged Egypt to release vulnerable prisoners during the pandemic.
The Netherlands has raised this with the Egyptian authorities.
Nederland heeft dit bij de Egyptische autoriteiten onder de aandacht gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat er al negen maanden vijf Nederlanders vast zitten in een gevangenis in Venezuela

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about five fishermen (four Dutch nationals, one Venezuelan resident of Curaçao) held in Venezuela since March 2020 without trial, and what the government was doing to secure their release. The minister confirmed the detention, said the case is pending pretrial with no substantive hearing yet, described consular assistance and diplomatic requests for a fair trial, and said the embassy cannot extract citizens from foreign detention.
The Kingdom of the Netherlands cannot directly interfere with a foreign legal process.
Het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden kan zich niet rechtstreeks bemoeien met een buitenlandse rechtsgang.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik, Van den Hul, Sjoerdsma en Karabulut over het ter dood veroordeelde Pakistaanse echtpaar Shafqat Emmanuel en Shagufta Kausar

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the death sentence for blasphemy imposed on the Pakistani couple Shafqat Emmanuel and Shagufta Kausar, the repeated postponements of their appeal, and what the government would do through diplomacy, EU channels and asylum support. The minister condemned the death sentence, said the Netherlands and the EU raised concerns with Pakistani authorities without intervening in the court process, and declined to commit to attending the trial or to pre-judging any asylum request.
The Netherlands and the EU do not intervene in the legal proceedings in other countries.
Nederland en de EU interveniëren niet in de rechtsgang in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht 'Apartheid is in Israël al realiteit'

MP Van den Hul asked the Foreign Minister about claims that Israel practises apartheid, including parallel legal systems, discrimination against Arab citizens, the temporariness of the occupation, Israel's ban on NGOs labelling it apartheid in schools, contact with B'Tselem, and steps toward a two-state solution. The minister answered in general terms, restating Dutch and EU positions on occupation law, concern about inequality, and the two-state solution without committing to new concrete action.
The Netherlands has always had good relations with B'Tselem.
Nederland heeft altijd goede relaties gehad met B'Tselem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Verhoeven, Van Helvert en Van der Molen over het bericht dat er tientallen communistische partijcomités binnen Nederlandse bedrijven in China bestaan

MPs from D66 and CDA asked the government whether it knew of Chinese Communist Party committees in Dutch companies in China, what economic or strategic effects this has, whether the government has agreements with these firms, and whether intellectual property is being stolen. The minister answers that the government is aware of such committees and offers general advice to firms, cites an EU Chamber survey suggesting limited influence, says precise numbers of party-linked board members are not held, and declines to comment on intelligence investigations.
The cabinet does not publicly comment on specific investigations by the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Over specifieke onderzoeken van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Van Helvert over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2021 van Open Doors

Three MPs (Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Van Helvert) asked the foreign minister about the Open Doors 2021 Christian persecution ranking, covering FoRB envoy vacancy, persecution in Nigeria, China, India and Turkey, COVID aid, and export controls. The minister answered at length, mostly restating policy and concerns, while declining to commit to specific new initiatives beyond existing diplomacy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van der Lee over het bericht dat het Noorse verzekeringsbedrijf ‘DNV GL’ de certificatie voor Nord Stream 2 intrekt

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about DNV GL withdrawing certifications for Nord Stream 2, the consequences for completion, the status of the court and arbitration cases, and enforcement of the EU gas directive. The government answered that alternative routes are unknown, that it opposes US sanctions but will not anticipate their effects, that the cases are pending and the gas directive is currently applied strictly, and that it will not comment on matters before courts.
It is not appropriate for the cabinet to respond to matters that are before the courts.
Het past het kabinet niet om te reageren op zaken die onder de rechter zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over een veroordeelde terrorist die werkzaam is bij de Israëlische organisatie Shurat Hadin

An MP asked the ministers whether the government was concerned about a convicted terrorist working at Shurat Hadin, a conference appearance by its director, and whether NGO Monitor's conference framing was acceptable. The minister said the government had noted the reports, that freedom of expression applies to organisations like NGO Monitor within legal limits, and that the questions would be answered separately.
Freedom of expression applies in full, to everyone and without regard to persons, within the limits of the law.
De vrijheid van meningsuiting geldt onverkort, voor iedereen en zonder aanzien des persoons binnen de grenzen van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over reizen tijdens de coronacrisis

Two D66 MPs asked ministers why travel advice for Curaçao and other Caribbean and Canary Island destinations seemed inconsistent with the Prime Minister's call not to travel abroad, and why airlines were promoting trips. The ministers answered that a worldwide orange travel advice now applies, that airlines and tour operators agreed to limit package holidays and add PCR and rapid testing requirements, and that testing of arriving travellers is being assessed for capacity.
On 15 December 2020 the travel advice was adjusted worldwide to orange.
Op 15 december 2020 is het reisadvies wereldwijd aangepast naar oranje.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht 'Eerst Assads strijder, nu asiel in Nederland'

MP Kuzu asked the Foreign and Justice ministers whether they knew of Assad-regime sympathisers and alleged war criminals in the Netherlands who received asylum, and what would be done about it, including the disappearance of a Syrian whistleblower. The State Secretary replied that 1F exclusion is applied through individual assessment, that criminal investigations depend on concrete suspicion and realistic prospects, that Syrian refugees are protected like any other resident, and declined to discuss individual cases.
I cannot go into these individual cases or persons.
Ik kan niet ingaan op deze individuele zaken of personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Vluchtelingen die in Nederland aankwamen, waren al statushouders in Griekenland’

MPs Kuiken, Ploumen and Van den Hul asked whether only 50 of the promised 100 children and vulnerable people had arrived from Greece, whether recent arrivals already held Greek status, whether the government would meet the Moria deal, and whether it would reverse returns and act on conditions on Lesbos. The government answered that it will not make an additional relocation offer, that status holders in the Netherlands are returned to Greece as lawful under EU rules, and that conditions at Mavrovouni are better than at Moria though still needing structural improvement.
The cabinet does not intend to make an additional relocation offer.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens om een additioneel herplaatsingsaanbod te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bloedbad van Sivas in Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands had prosecuted anyone over the 1993 Sivas massacre that killed Dutch citizen Carina Thuijs, whether the embassy would attend the ongoing trial and join it, and whether the government would contact Germany about nine convicted suspects reportedly residing there. The minister answered that the embassy attended the 20 January 2021 hearing and monitors such cases, but sees no reason to join the Turkish proceedings or to pursue Germany further.
There are however no indications that the Turkish judge has interpreted or applied international law incorrectly.
Er zijn echter geen aanwijzingen dat door de Turkse rechter het internationaal recht op onjuiste wijze geïnterpreteerd of toegepast is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het statement van de EU dat meer dan 800 Palestijnen het risico lopen gedwongen te worden uitgezet in Oost-Jeruzalem

MP Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister whether he knows of the EU statement that over 800 Palestinians risk forced eviction in East Jerusalem, whether this violates international humanitarian and human rights law, and what steps the government will take to protect these families and press Israel. The minister confirmed awareness, stated that forced transfer is prohibited under occupation law, and said the Netherlands and EU repeatedly urge Israel to refrain, including through diplomatic visits and funding legal aid, without committing to new concrete steps.
The cabinet calls on Israel to strictly comply with these obligations.
Het kabinet roept Israël op tot strikte naleving van deze verplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over journalist Julian Assange

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government reacts to the UK ruling blocking Julian Assange's extradition to the US and whether it would press for his release and against a US appeal. The minister said the Dutch government trusts the independence of British courts, that extradition is a matter for the UK government, and that the Netherlands has no means to support Assange.
The case is still before the courts. Even if the British court on appeal considers extradition in principle lawful, it is for the British government to decide.
De zaak is nog onder de rechter. Ook indien de Britse rechter in hoger beroep uitlevering in beginsel rechtmatig acht, is het aan de Britse regering hierover te beslissen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de uitvoering van de motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over het organiseren van een wereldconferentie van democratieën in Den Haag

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister how the motion to host a world conference of democracies in The Hague is being implemented, including whether contact has been made with the incoming Biden administration. The minister supports the planned Summit for Democracy, agrees The Hague is a suitable location, and says no policy contact was possible before the inauguration but contact will be sought afterwards.
After the inauguration, contact will be sought with the administration, including via the Dutch embassy, to learn more about this initiative.
Na de inauguratie zal er contact gezocht worden met de administratie, o.a. via de Nederlandse ambassade, om meer te weten te komen over dit initiatief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Karabulut over de uitzending van Zembla over de betrokkenheid van Shell-medewerkers bij het creëren van olielekkages in de Nigerdelta

MPs Alkaya and Karabulut asked the ministers about a Zembla broadcast alleging Shell staff paid youths to cause oil spills in the Niger Delta, whether the Dutch government knew, and related issues. The government answered that the allegations are a matter for Nigerian prosecutors, that the former ambassador was informed in 2018 but the matter was not passed on, and that no external inquiry is needed, while citing Shell's $900 million clean-up commitment.
An external inquiry into the relationship between the Dutch embassy and Shell would, in our view, produce no new relevant information and is therefore not desirable.
Een extern onderzoek naar de relatie tussen de Nederlandse ambassade en Shell zal naar onze mening geen nieuwe relevante informatie opleveren en is om die reden niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over burgerdoden in Uruzgan

MP Karabulut asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs about a reported 2007 incident in the Chora valley in Uruzgan where a Dutch veteran said civilians may have been killed, including questions on reports, rules of engagement, a complaints channel and civilian casualty counts. The Minister of Defence said the archives had not yet matched the described incident, a veteran interview had been held, a new archive search and consultation with the Public Prosecution Service were under way, and that a fact-finding inquiry by the OM had been started.
On the basis of this, I will, after consultation with the Public Prosecution Service, decide whether or not to launch an investigation.
Op basis hiervan zal ik, na overleg met het OM, besluiten al dan niet een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Karabulut, Ploumen, Van Raan, Van Ojik, Van Helvert en Van der Staaij over de mensenrechtensituatie in West-Papua

MPs from seven parties asked the Foreign Minister about arms exports to Indonesia, the Community Policing Programme, human rights in West Papua, journalist access, the murder of Yeremia Zanambani, and environmental damage by companies. The minister answered that arms licences are assessed case by case including the Papua situation, the Dutch programme ended in 2019 with local continuation, and human rights concerns are raised bilaterally, though no full overview of documented violations or environmental damage is held.
However, I do not have a complete overview of all documented damage to the environment, living environment and climate in Papua.
Ik beschik echter niet over een totaaloverzicht van alle gedocumenteerde schade aan milieu, leefomgeving en klimaat in Papua.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Leger Ethiopië neemt hoofdstad van Tigray in'

MPs Belhaj and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister about the armed conflict in Tigray, Ethiopia, including casualty figures, alleged civilian massacres, humanitarian needs, refugee flows to Sudan, international calls for a ceasefire, and Dutch response. The minister answered that information is unreliable due to restricted access, condemned the reported violence, called for a ceasefire and access for aid workers and journalists, and described Dutch humanitarian funding.
Because humanitarian workers, media and observers lack access to the area, the cabinet does not have reliable, independent information on casualties.
Vanwege het gebrek aan toegang voor humanitaire hulpverleners, media en waarnemers tot het gebied beschikt het kabinet niet over betrouwbare, onafhankelijke informatie over slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Paternotte over het bericht 'Belgen krabbelen terug: eis negatieve test alleen voor wie langer dan 48 uur in België blijft'

MPs Schonis and Paternotte (D66) asked ministers about Belgium's COVID-19 negative-test requirement for travellers staying over 48 hours, its consultation with the Netherlands and border municipalities, and whether the Netherlands could impose a similar test requirement. The minister answered that consultation with Belgian and Dutch authorities took place, that the 48-hour rule benefits cross-border workers, that the Netherlands extended negative-test requirements to certain high-risk arrivals from 29 December, and that extending it to car traffic would require legislative change.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over Ahrar-al-Sham

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister whether Ahrar al-Sham is a terrorist organisation, whether it benefited from Dutch non-lethal assistance, and whether it poses a threat in the Netherlands, among related questions. The minister answered that intelligence services do not see the group as a direct national security threat, that no non-lethal assistance reached it, and that it does not meet the conditions for national listing, while declining to comment publicly on other armed groups.
The cabinet does not make public statements about moderate armed groups that have or have not received NLA.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over gematigde gewapende groepen die al-dan-niet NLA hebben ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Roon over de Nederlandse positie ten aanzien van terreurorganisatie Ahrar al-Sham

An MP asks the foreign and development ministers whether Ahrar al-Sham should be treated as a terrorist organisation, whether it should be placed on the national terrorism list, whether former members should be prosecuted and residence permits revoked, and whether Non-Lethal Assistance funds reached the group. The government replies that the ministry relies on UN/EU lists and intelligence assessments, that the group is not considered a direct national security threat, that no NLA reached it, and that the national sanctions list lacks Dutch links so no listing is made.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has had no contact with the Syrian arrested recently in Rijssen.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft geen contact gehad met de onlangs in Rijssen gearresteerde Syriër.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht dat de Verenigde Naties datacentra in China gaat neerzetten

An MP from the CDA asks the Foreign Minister whether UN data centres in China, a systemic rival, risk giving China broad knowledge of global activity and whether the Netherlands should object or refuse to share data. The minister answers that the centres involve technical cooperation using freely available or no Dutch personal data, that the government sees no grounds to block them and will monitor developments.
The cabinet of course continues to closely monitor the developments.
Het kabinet blijft de ontwikkelingen uiteraard nauwgezet volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over Nederlands subsidiegeld aan voormalig Syrische kopstuk

MP Van Helvert asks whether Dutch subsidy money flowed via the European Institute of Peace to a former Ahrar al-Sham figure, Labib al-Nahhas, and questions the government's refusal to list Ahrar al-Sham as terrorist. The ministers answer that Al-Nahhas withdrew from the project, that the ministry was not informed beforehand, and that Ahrar al-Sham is not on the national sanctions list because there are no Dutch links, promising only to examine screening procedures.
Information about the salary of Mr. Labib al-Nahhas is confidential personnel information and cannot be shared.
Informatie over het salaris van Dhr. Labib al-Nahhas is personeelsvertrouwlijk en kan niet worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de toekenning van de legion d’honneur aan President Sisi

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he still considers human rights and press freedom under pressure in Egypt, and whether it is appropriate to honour President Sisi with France's Legion d'honneur, and asked whether he would contact France. The minister answers that the human rights situation has worsened, describes arrests, detention, and restrictions on journalists and civil society, and says France decides on honours and that the award is standard protocol for state visits.
It is up to France to decide in which cases it grants honours, including during state visits.
Het is aan Frankrijk om te bepalen in welke gevallen zij overgaan tot het toekennen van onderscheidingen bij onder meer staatsbezoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over miskenning door Nederlandse regering van de Joodse relatie met de Tempelberg te Jerusalem

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked why the Netherlands voted for UN resolution A/RES/75/98, which refers to the Temple Mount only as Haram al-Sharif, and whether it would apologise to Israel. Minister Blok defended the vote as a judgement on the resolution's overall content, said the Netherlands tried to have the Temple Mount name removed, and refused to apologise.
The Netherlands assesses each resolution on its total content and merits.
Nederland beoordeelt iedere resolutie op zijn totale inhoud en merites.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Graaf, Bosman, Bouali, Leijten, Asscher en Van Ojik over het juridische advies van de commissie over de Brexit-deal.

Six MPs and a Green MP asked the ministers whether the Council's Legal Service had put its advice on the Brexit deal in writing, and requested all internal and external legal advice on the deal, plus options for a smooth transition if the deal is mixed. The minister replied that the Legal Service confirmed its view only orally, that the conclusions will be written into the Council decision and a Commission statement, that the EU-only route is a political choice not binding on future deals, and that interim application of mixed parts is not possible, while the legal analysis and a confidential annex were shared with the Chamber.
There are no written opinions from the Council's Legal Service (JDR) on these questions; the JDR confirmed both points orally.
Er zijn over deze vraagstukken geen schriftelijke adviezen van de Juridische Dienst van de Raad (JDR) verschenen; de JDR heeft beide punten mondeling bevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de onderhandelingen over het toekomstig partnerschap tussen de Europese Unie en het Verenigd Koninkrijk

An MP asks the government about the state of the Brexit trade deal, whether it is mixed competence requiring national ratification, and how much time parliament and businesses have to study it. The minister answers that the deal was reached on 24 December 2020 and published, refers to letters for substantive assessment, says the deal is an EU-only competence with no legal need for a mixed agreement, and states the government prefers the deal over no-deal despite the short timeline.
For a substantive assessment, the cabinet refers to the letter sent to your House simultaneously with the answers to these questions.
Voor een inhoudelijke appreciatie verwijst het kabinet naar de brief die gelijktijdig met de beantwoording op deze vragen naar uw Kamer is verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de aanslag op de Iraanse atoomgeleerde

An SP MP asks the foreign minister about the killing of Iranian nuclear scientist Fakhrizadeh: whether a satellite was used, whether a non-state actor could do it, how to characterise it, whether it is a casus belli, and what steps are planned against such practices. The minister says the government has no verified information on the circumstances, calls for de-escalation alongside E3 and the EU, and states that assessing a casus belli is not for the cabinet.
The cabinet has no information about the actual circumstances.
Het kabinet heeft geen informatie over de feitelijke toedracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Kröger, Bruins, Remco Dijkstra, Amhaouch, Gijs van Dijk, Van Brenk, Laçin, Stoffer, Krol, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over een overvol Schiphol

Opposition MPs asked the government about overcrowding and queues at Schiphol, adherence to COVID-19 distancing rules, travel advice, the Brexit and testing effects on arrivals, and whether flight bans or test facilities would be used. The ministers answered that Schiphol is required to prevent queues and enforce rules, that a flight ban is currently undesirable, and that testing and an air corridor pilot are being developed, with several questions combined.
We asked Schiphol for clarification and said they must take action to ensure the measures are complied with.
Wij hebben Schiphol om opheldering gevraagd en gezegd dat zij actie moeten ondernemen om te zorgen dat de maatregelen worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Ploumen en Karabulut over het bericht 'Egypt arrested its leaders, but a leading human rights group remains defiant'

Four MPs asked the foreign minister about the arrest of three senior staff of the Egyptian Initiative for Personal Rights, shortly after Western ambassadors including the Dutch one had visited the group, and about whether the Netherlands would raise concerns. The minister confirmed the arrests and their charges, said the three were released on 3 December while charges remain, and stated that the Netherlands has raised concerns with Egyptian authorities through diplomatic channels.
Both in Cairo and in The Hague, the Netherlands has engaged with the Egyptian authorities at various levels to convey our concerns and ask for clarification.
Zowel in Cairo en in Den Haag is Nederland op verschillende niveaus in gesprek gegaan met de Egyptische autoriteiten om onze zorgen over te brengen en opheldering te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Van Wijngaarden over het artikel ‘The GRU's MH17 Disinformation Operations Part 1: The Bonanza Media Project’

MPs Koopmans and Van Wijngaarden asked the ministers about a Bellingcat article on GRU disinformation operations linked to MH17, including legal options, a possible espionage offence, and mandatory registration of foreign influence agents. The government called such foreign interference undesirable, said it is preparing a new espionage offence, and considered mandatory registration not clearly effective or proportionate, favouring awareness-raising instead.
The cabinet has established that an additional criminal offence is desirable and will examine how to give it shape and then start a legislative process.
Het kabinet heeft vastgesteld dat een aanvullende strafbaarstelling wenselijk is en zal onderzoeken op welke wijze daaraan vorm kan worden gegeven en vervolgens een wetstraject opstarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Australische militairen 39 burgers en gevangenen executeerden in Afghanistan

Two D66 MPs asked whether the ministers knew of reports that Australian soldiers executed 39 civilians and prisoners in Afghanistan, what the Dutch government knew and when, whether Dutch soldiers worked closely with Australian forces, and whether any war crimes investigation was conducted. The minister answered that the Australian inquiry shared no information beforehand, that Dutch soldiers were interviewed only in confidential interviews in 2018, that Dutch-Australian cooperation existed within Task Force Uruzgan, and that the Netherlands conducted no investigation into possible Australian war crimes.
The record of these confidential interviews was not made available to the cabinet or to the interviewed soldiers by the Australian inquiry commission.
Het verslag van deze vertrouwelijke interviews is niet door de Australische onderzoekscommissie aan het kabinet of aan de geïnterviewde militairen ter beschikking gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'Executie van Djalali uit Iran mogelijk nabij'

MP Ploumen asks the Foreign Minister about reports that Iran may soon execute Ahmadreza Djalali, whether Iran's senior officials have been asked about the case, and what diplomatic steps the Netherlands will take against the death penalty. The minister says the Netherlands is monitoring the case, has raised concerns with Iran repeatedly including in 2020, and will apply diplomatic pressure and coordinate with Sweden and EU partners, including on the EU Iran sanctions review.
The Netherlands is closely monitoring the situation.
Nederland houdt de situatie nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de Australische excessen in Afghanistan en de reactie hierop

An SP MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about Australian special forces killing 39 civilians and detainees in Afghanistan, including in Uruzgan where the Netherlands was active, and how the Netherlands responded. The Defence Minister answered that no Dutch involvement has been found so far, that Defence is conducting an internal inventory of joint operations and Australian recommendations, and described the Dutch-Australian coordination and separate command lines in 2006-2010.
If there is cause to do so, the cabinet will inform the House as soon as possible of the findings of the inventory.
Indien hier aanleiding toe is, stelt het kabinet de Kamer zo snel mogelijk op de hoogte van de bevindingen van de inventarisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over de reactie van de Europese Ombudsman op de gunning van een onderzoeksopdracht aan BlackRock door de Europese Commissie

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked the Finance Minister how he views the European Ombudsman's finding of serious shortcomings in controlling conflicts of interest around BlackRock's award of a sustainable finance advisory contract by the European Commission. The minister replied that the Ombudsman found no maladministration, that the Commission should strengthen its procurement framework, and that he will encourage the Commission to act and inform the House.
I will encourage the European Commission in the relevant bodies to take this up promptly and ask how it intends to take forward the Ombudsman's recommendations.
Ik zal de Europese Commissie in de relevante gremia aanmoedigen dit voortvarend op te pakken en vragen hoe zij voornemens is de aanbevelingen van de Ombudsman verder te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'US signs anti-abortion declaration with group of largely authoritarian governments'

The MP asks whether the government will react to the US-led Geneva Consensus Declaration, signed by about 30 mostly authoritarian states, which she says restricts women's access to safe abortion, and whether it will contact the US or raise the issue at the UPR. The government says it shares concern about the declaration, will keep raising SRGR at bilateral and multilateral fora, and recommended at the US UPR that the Helms Amendment and the expanded Mexico City Policy be suspended.

In bilateral talks with the US government and in international fora and negotiations, the Netherlands will continue to raise concerns about the US international SRGR approach, including this declaration.

Nederland zal in bilaterale gesprekken met de Amerikaanse overheid en in internationale fora en onderhandelingen zorgen over de Amerikaanse internationale SRGR-inzet, waaronder deze verklaring, aan de orde blijven stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de dreigende vrijlating van de moordenaar van Daniel Pearl en straffeloosheid van de imam die een fatwa over Geert Wilders uitsprak

The MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether he would press Pakistan to prevent the release of a suspect in the murder of journalist Daniel Pearl and to act against the imam who issued a fatwa against Geert Wilders. The minister replied that the case is before Pakistani courts and the Netherlands does not intervene in foreign legal proceedings, that the imam has died so prosecution is no longer possible, and that the Public Prosecution Service is investigating other threats while withholding details of that investigation.
The Netherlands does not intervene in legal proceedings in other countries.
Nederland intervenieert niet in de rechtsgang in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Dam over de verkoop van paspoorten

Two MPs from the CDA asked the government about golden passport schemes, including whether Curaçao's investor residence scheme meets European Commission requirements, how many people used it, an overview of such schemes in the Kingdom, and how many people in the Netherlands hold passports bought via Malta, Cyprus or Bulgaria. The government answered that Curaçao's scheme falls outside the Commission's requirements, that citizenship is a Kingdom matter, that Curaçao must account for participant numbers itself, and that the Netherlands has no investment-based citizenship scheme, while noting it does not know how EU citizens resident in the Netherlands obtained their nationality.
It is up to the Curaçao government to account for that.
Het is aan de Curaçaose regering om daarover verantwoording af te leggen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de geheime Europese Uniemissie (EU) naar Venezuela en het bericht dat de EU Ambassadeur in Venezuela een propagandarapport in ontvangst heeft genomen uit handen van dhr. Ta

Van Helvert (CDA) asks the Foreign Minister whether the EU ambassador in Venezuela erred by receiving a propaganda report on human rights from Tarek William Saab, whether Dutch ambassadors may meet sanctioned persons, and whether the EU will condemn the report. Minister Blok answers that the ambassador did not know in advance of the handover, the Netherlands does not recognise Maduro, the report was not endorsed, and the EU's sanctions and human rights statements stand, while declining to ask the High Representative to act.
The EU ambassador in Venezuela has contact with all relevant actors to contribute to a solution to the political crisis, including representatives of the Maduro regime.
De EU-ambassadeur in Venezuela heeft contact met alle relevante actoren om bij te dragen aan een oplossing voor de politieke crisis, waaronder vertegenwoordigers van het Maduro-bewind.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ploumen en Van Ojik over het Nederlandse kernwapenbeleid

Three MPs asked the foreign and defence ministers about NATO's decision to publicise the nuclear dimension of exercise Steadfast Noon, transparency on Dutch nuclear policy, the Secretary-General's visit to Volkel, and whether nuclear sharing breaches the Non-Proliferation Treaty. The ministers answered that transparency is being increased within alliance limits, that exercise details and US nuclear locations remain classified, and that nuclear sharing arrangements predate and are consistent with the NPT.
As your House is aware, no statements can be made on the numbers and locations of American nuclear weapons present in Europe, due to alliance and legally binding agreements.

Zoals uw Kamer bekend, kunnen over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een verzoek aan de Nederlandse ambassade in Turkije aangaande het bloedbad van Sivas

Karabulut (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about the 1993 Sivas massacre, ongoing trials of suspects, a request to the Dutch embassy in Ankara to pass a letter to the King, and whether fugitive convicts in Germany could be pursued internationally. The minister replied that the embassy follows the trial, that a petition was not handed over because the group did not leave it, and that the cabinet sees no reason to take steps toward Germany.
In these conversations no request was made to the Netherlands to join a legal case.
Bij deze gesprekken is geen verzoek aan Nederland gedaan om zich bij een rechtszaak te voegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over langeafstandsrelaties in tijden van corona

An SP MP asked the Justice, and Foreign Affairs ministers about the rules and practical obstacles for long-distance partners seeking to meet during COVID-19, including visa problems. The government described the temporary long-distance partner scheme, acknowledged difficulties abroad due to consular scaling-down and local restrictions, and said it is working with EU partners on exceptional visa facilitation.
I am aware of this problem and can imagine it has been very difficult for the affected couples that they could not be reunited as quickly as desired.
Ik ben bekend met dit probleem en kan me voorstellen dat het voor de getroffen koppels erg moeilijk is geweest dat zij niet zo snel herenigd konden worden als gewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de uitspraak van Merkel dat "een compromis van alle kanten nodig is" over het rechtsstaatmechanisme ter bescherming van de rechtsstaat in de EU-begroting

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would resist any weakening of the agreed EU rule-of-law budget mechanism after Merkel called for compromise. The minister replied that the agreed outcome with the European Parliament is the Dutch lower limit, that the Netherlands will keep pressing this, and that it is for the German presidency, not the Netherlands, to set options.
The cabinet will continue to work at all levels to preserve the negotiated outcome and to ensure that no harm is done to the conclusions of the European Council of 17-21 July.

Het kabinet zal zich op alle niveaus blijven inzetten voor behoud van het bereikte onderhandelingsresultaat en er op blijven toezien dat geen afbreuk wordt gedaan aan de conclusies van de Europese Raad van 17-21 juli jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over de bijeenkomst van de G20 georganiseerd door Saoedi-Arabië

MPs asked whether the Dutch UN envoy would attend the G20 meeting hosted by Saudi Arabia, and about the detention of Saudi women's rights activists and what the government has done about it. The minister answered that the Netherlands did not attend the G20 summit or side events, raised the activists' detention through several channels, and expressed concern about their treatment without committing to new concrete action.
The Netherlands did not take part in the G20 summit held virtually on 21 and 22 November.
Nederland nam niet deel aan de G20-top die op 21 en 22 november jl. virtueel plaatsvond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Koopmans en Aartsen over 'Spanje wil tweede instorting toerisme voorkomen'

MPs Dijkstra, Koopmans and Aartsen (VVD) asked whether safe travel corridors and rapid testing could revive tourism, following reports on Spain's Semana Santa operation, and how the EU and other parties could set criteria. The minister said the current COVID situation rules out reopening tourism now, promised to make necessary travel safer via negative test certificates and a possible shorter quarantine, and said a possible Schiphol–Atlanta corridor is being explored.
Therefore, at this moment there is no question of restarting tourism.
Daarom is op dit moment geen sprake van het weer op gang helpen van toerisme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de huidige stand van zaken met betrekking tot de Hirak-activisten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the status of Hirak activists in Morocco, including European coordination, detention conditions, prison visits, contact with the CNDH, and the effect of COVID-19 on rights. The minister replied that the embassy coordinates with European colleagues, does not track Hirak detainees since they lack Dutch nationality, has no independent information on their health, leaves prison oversight to Moroccan authorities apart from attending court hearings, has good contact with the CNDH, and noted the COVID emergency measures restricting movement and assembly.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not keep track of how many detainees in Morocco are serving sentences for their participation in the Hirak movement, since they are not persons of Dutch nationality.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken houdt niet bij hoeveel gedetineerden in Marokko een straf uitzitten naar aanleiding van hun deelname aan de Hirakbeweging, daar het geen personen met de Nederlandse nationaliteit betreft.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Geluk-Poortvliet en Van Helvert over de Hagia Sophia, die door Turkije tegen de regels van de Organisatie der Verenigde Naties voor Onderwijs, Wetenschap en Cultuur (UNESCO) in, i

Three CDA MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey's conversion of the Hagia Sophia and Chora Museum into mosques, both UNESCO World Heritage sites, breaches UNESCO rules and whether the Netherlands will raise it at the Executive Board. The minister confirmed awareness of the conversions and covered frescoes, said the matter is for the World Heritage Committee to judge under the Outstanding Universal Value standard, and noted the Executive Board meeting was postponed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali, Sjoerdsma, Van den Hul en Van den Niewenhuijzen over het bericht dat Palestijnse kinderen worden mishandeld en vernederd in Israëlische gevangenissen

MPs from D66, PvdA and GroenLinks asked the ministers whether they knew of Save the Children reports of mistreatment of Palestinian children in Israeli detention, and what the government would do about military trial of minors. The minister acknowledged the reports, condemned the practices, said Nederland has raised the issue with Israeli authorities and will keep doing so, and mentioned support for NGO projects.
The Netherlands will continue to voice its concerns to the Israeli government.
Nederland zal haar zorgen blijven uitspreken naar de Israëlische regering.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de brief van de Griekse Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken aan de EU-Hoge Vertegenwoordiger Borrell over de kwestie van de Turkse gasboringen in Griekse wateren

An MP asks whether Greece's foreign minister invoked EU Treaty article 42.7 in a letter to Borrell, and about renewed Turkish seismic survey activity in disputed Greek waters with naval escort. The minister confirms awareness of the letter, describes the stalled Greece-Turkey dialogue and the Oruc Reis deployments, and says the Netherlands will consider any Greek request under article 42.7 within EU consultations.
The cabinet has taken note of the letter of 19 October from the Greek Minister of Foreign Affairs to the High Representative of the EU.
Het kabinet heeft kennisgenomen van de brief van 19 oktober jl. van de Griekse Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken aan de Hoge Vertegenwoordiger van de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het beoogd VN-datacentrum in China.

MP Van Helvert (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister whether the UN plans a geospatial and big-data centre in China, how the government assesses the reports, who funds it, and whether the UN was contacted. Minister Blok confirmed UN preparations for a Global Geospatial Knowledge and Innovation Centre in Deqing and a regional hub in Hangzhou, said the government supports careful data use but sees risks in concentrating global data flows in one country and wants clear, verifiable data agreements, and described the intergovernmental governance of the initiative.
For this reason, the cabinet considers it important that clear and verifiable agreements come about regarding the availability, integrity and confidentiality of data.
Daarom acht het kabinet het van belang dat er duidelijke en controleerbare afspraken komen over de beschikbaarheid, integriteit en vertrouwelijkheid van gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van den Hul over een ten onrechte ontslagen klokkenluider op de ambassade in Nigeria

MPs Karabulut and Van den Hul asked about a whistleblower at the Abuja embassy whom a court found was wrongly dismissed, and about alleged leaking of confidential information to Shell and whether the ambassador was dismissed. The minister acknowledged the ruling, said lessons will be drawn and that the complainant's dismissal was not properly handled, but declined to give details of the investigation citing personnel confidentiality, and said no new embassy guidelines are needed.
Unfortunately, BZ did not succeed in convincing the judge that the employee's dismissal was not the result of the integrity report they had made.
Helaas is BZ er niet in geslaagd de rechter ervan te overtuigen dat het ontslag van de medewerker niet het gevolg was van de integriteitsmelding die zij had gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij en Karabulut over Nagorno-Karabach

MPs from ChristenUnie, CDA, SGP and SP asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's alleged deployment of Syrian fighters in the Nagorno-Karabakh conflict, Azerbaijan's ceasefire violations, possible sanctions, arms embargoes, war crimes allegations and recognition of Karabakh's independence. The minister answered that the government now knows of Turkish involvement, condemned the use of Syrian fighters, said no sanctions are currently under consideration, reaffirmed the OSCE arms embargo with no Dutch exports, and rejected recognition of independence.
Sanctions are not on the agenda at this moment.
Sancties zijn op dit moment niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over een medewerker van de Eritrese ambassade die onder dwang geld inzamelde bij zijn landgenoten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the expulsion-type declaration against an Eritrean embassy employee who allegedly extorted money from compatriots was enforced, whether he posed as a consul, why he was not removed, and whether victims were reimbursed. The minister replied that Eritrea was asked to end the contract and confirmed it, that he was not registered as diplomatic staff, that he holds Dutch nationality so cannot be removed, and that victims were called to file reports for police and prosecutors to investigate.
To establish whether there was indeed coercion and intimidation in the fundraising and what amounts are involved, victims have been called upon to file a report.

Om vast te stellen of er bij de geldinzamelingen inderdaad sprake is geweest van dwang en intimidatie en om vast te kunnen stellen om wat voor bedragen het gaat, zijn slachtoffers opgeroepen om aangifte te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Kuiken over het legaal naar Nederland reizen van partners van Nederlanders of EU-onderdanen

MPs Sjoerdsma and Kuiken asked why partners of Dutch or EU citizens cannot travel to the Netherlands when embassies are closed, and urged measures such as cooperation with other EU embassies and digital or border-issued permits. Minister Blok replied that consular services are largely being restored, that the long-distance lovers scheme stays limited to Dutch and EU citizens, and that alternative issuance methods are incompatible with the MVV requirement.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has no insight into figures on the number of partners of Dutch nationals or EU citizens who currently cannot travel.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft geen inzicht in cijfers van het aantal partners van Nederlanders of EU-onderdanen dat op dit moment niet kan reizen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een regeling voor kinderen van standrechtelijk geëxecuteerden in Indonesië

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that only three children of Indonesians executed by summary execution qualify under the new compensation scheme, and whether conditions could be loosened for all children and widows. The minister replied that anyone may apply, individual claims will be assessed against the scheme's requirements under the 'reasonable term' case law, and declined to broaden the conditions.
Anyone who believes they are entitled to the compensation offered under the scheme may submit an application.
Iedereen die meent recht te hebben op de schadevergoeding die in de regeling wordt aangeboden kan een aanvraag indienen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Kuiken, Van Ojik, De Roon, Karabulut en Voordewind over het Nederlandse meisje Insiya, dat ontvoerd is naar India en de pogingen die de Nederlandse regering onderneem

Six MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice why the Dutch child Insiya, abducted to India by her father, has not been returned, what steps have been taken, and whether ministers will personally intervene. The government answered that Dutch court rulings are not automatically binding in India, that it keeps raising the case bilaterally and at high level, and that it has contact persons for the mother, but that return depends on Indian legal procedures and it will not detail enforcement steps against the father.
The Netherlands will keep drawing India's attention to the rulings of the Dutch court and will closely follow the proceedings in India.
Nederland zal de uitspraken van de Nederlandse rechter bij India onder de aandacht blijven brengen en zal uitspraak in de procedures in India nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Geurts en Van der Staaij over de situatie in Zuid-Afrika

MPs Van Helvert, Geurts and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister about attacks on white farmers, land expropriation without compensation in South Africa's Expropriation Bill, and Brexit implications for trade. The minister said the government has raised land reform concerns bilaterally and in the EU and OECD, that the bill sets limited no-compensation scenarios subject to court or arbitrator review, and that Dutch influence is limited to continued dialogue.
The new bill, the Expropriation Bill, provides for this.
Het nieuwe wetsvoorstel, de «Expropriation Bill», voorziet daarin.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Fritsma en Markuszower over de beroerde informatievoorziening aan de Tweede Kamer inzake de inspectie van een koopvaardijschip door marineschip de Zr. Ms. De Ruyter

PVV MPs asked the Justice, Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers why information on the Dutch navy's boarding of a merchant ship (Zr. Ms. De Ruyter) was withheld, and asked about the legal basis, the cargo, sanctions and links to Operation Irini. Minister Grapperhaus refused details citing an ongoing criminal investigation, cited the Criminal Code as legal basis, denied any link to Irini, and promised to inform parliament once possible.
As is customary, your House will be informed as soon as the still ongoing criminal investigation allows for this.
Zoals te doen gebruikelijk zal uw Kamer worden geïnformeerd zodra daar gezien het thans nog lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek de mogelijkheid toe bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de groei van illegale Israëlische nederzettingen op Palestijns gebied

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the government condemns Israeli settlement expansion in occupied Palestinian territory, whether it will pursue sanctions, and whether it will recognise Palestine. The minister confirmed the approval of 5,000 new settlement homes, called settlements contrary to international law, said the Netherlands joined a demarche urging Israel to halt construction, rejected sanctions, and said recognition depends on a peace agreement.

On 13 October 2020, the Netherlands, together with France, Germany, the United Kingdom, Spain, Italy, Sweden, Ireland, Finland and Belgium, urged Israel during a demarche to refrain from building new homes in the occupied territories.

Nederland heeft samen met Frankrijk, Duitsland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, Spanje, Italië, Zweden, Ierland, Finland en België op 13 oktober 2020 tijdens een demarche bij Israël aangedrongen op afzien van de bouw van nieuwe woningen in de bezette gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de Israëlische opdracht tot sloop van een basisschool in bezet Palestijns gebied

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about an Israeli demolition order for a primary school in Ras al-Tin in occupied Palestinian territory, its EU co-funding, whether the Netherlands would protest, and consequences if demolition proceeds. The minister confirmed the announced demolition and the donor funding, said the Netherlands joined a joint demarche urging Israel to stop demolitions, and said it will stay in contact with donors on further steps since demolition had not yet occurred.
The Netherlands will remain in contact with the school's donors about further steps that could be taken to prevent demolition or respond to its execution.
Nederland zal met de donoren van de school in contact blijven over welke verdere stappen gezet kunnen worden om sloop te voorkomen of te reageren op uitvoering van de slooporder.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de geheime Europese Uniemissie (EU) naar Venezuela en het bericht dat de EU Ambassadeur in Venezuela een propagandarapport in ontvangst heeft genomen uit handen

Two CDA MPs asked the Foreign Minister about an EU delegation's late-September 2020 visit to Venezuela and the EU ambassador's receipt of a pro-government propaganda report from Tarek William Saab, a sanctioned official. The minister answered all 18 questions, denying that the mission or the report legitimised the Maduro government, stating that a mission cannot be held to conditions it has not set, and promising to keep the dialogue and human rights pressure going.
No. Both during and after the EU mission it was conveyed that Venezuela does not meet the conditions for holding free and fair elections.
Nee. Zowel tijdens als na de EU-missie is uitgedragen dat Venezuela niet voldoet aan de voorwaarden voor het houden van vrije en eerlijke verkiezingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt en Voordewind over de inzet van Syrische rebellen door Turkije in de oorlog om Nagorno-Karabach

MPs Van Helvert, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkey deployed Syrian rebel fighters to support Azerbaijan in the Nagorno-Karabakh war, whether Dutch-supplied non-lethal assistance reached such groups, and what the government would do about it. The minister confirmed Turkish military involvement and condemned external interference, called for an OSCE investigation and EU statements, but declined to say whether Dutch-supported groups were involved, citing traceability, and said recovery of supplied equipment was no longer possible after monitoring ended.
Because of the traceability to the moderate armed groups supported by the Netherlands, publicly it cannot be addressed whether previously Dutch-supported moderate armed groups were involved.

In verband met herleidbaarheid naar de door Nederland gesteunde gematigde gewapende groepen, kan er in het openbaar niet worden ingegaan op eventuele betrokkenheid van voorheen door Nederland gesteunde gematigde gewapende groepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Baudet over het opgelaaide conflict in Nagorno-Karabach

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the Nagorno-Karabakh escalation, including Turkish involvement, Syrian fighters, Turkish President Erdogan's rhetoric and possible sanctions. The minister declined to attribute responsibility yet, called for de-escalation via the OSCE Minsk Group, said Turkey's military involvement was very likely and that Syrian fighters were confirmed, and ruled out sanctions for now.
At this moment the cabinet makes no statements on attribution; the facts must first be established.
Op dit moment doet het kabinet geen uitspraken over attributie, daarvoor moeten de feiten eerst vaststaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht 'Amnesty legt activiteiten in India voorlopig stil na blokkade bankrekeningen'

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the ministers about the Indian freezing of Amnesty International's bank accounts, which forced the organisation to halt activities, and whether the government shares concern about shrinking civil society space and about the Indian government's actions against human rights groups. The minister acknowledged concern about the pressure on human rights organisations, said the Indian investigation concerns foreign funding rules, declined to pre-judge its outcome, and said the Netherlands raised the matter with Indian and EU counterparts.
The Netherlands raised the matter together with EU partners with various Indian interlocutors in New Delhi and Brussels.
Nederland heeft de kwestie gezamenlijk met EU-partners aan de orde gesteld bij diverse Indiase gesprekspartners in New Delhi en Brussel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Koerden gaan Syrische vrouwen en kinderen vrijlaten uit Al Hol kamp'

MPs Koopmans and Yesilgoz-Zegerius asked about reports that Kurdish authorities would release Syrian women and children from Al Hol camp, and about the handling of Dutch jihadist returnees, including local prosecution, citizenship revocation, and repatriation. The ministers answered that about 40 Dutch fighters remain in Syria, outlined prosecution options in the region and in the Netherlands, and committed to informing parliament before any repatriation decisions.
The cabinet will involve the House in advance, in line with the motion, if there are plans to bring back Syria fighters or their wives or children.
Het kabinet zal de de Kamer conform de motie vooraf betrekken als er voornemens zijn ten aanzien van terughalen van Syriëgangers, hun vrouwen of kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Amsterdamse universiteiten werken samen met omstreden techgigant Huawei’.

MPs asked why Huawei is partly excluded from critical 5G infrastructure in the Netherlands but not from university research cooperation with UvA and VU, and what framework governs cooperation with foreign-state-influenced companies. The government replied that universities are autonomous under the WHW and that the cooperation falls outside vital infrastructure, that authorities advised universities on risks, and that an investment screening and export-control framework is being developed, without committing to new binding rules on university cooperation.

Under their autonomy pursuant to the WHW, the universities themselves are responsible for deciding whether or not to enter a particular (international) research cooperation, within the frameworks of existing laws and regulations.

De universiteiten zijn vanuit hun autonomie op grond van de WHW zelf verantwoordelijk voor het besluit om – binnen de kaders van bestaande wet- en regelgeving – al dan niet een bepaalde (internationale) onderzoekssamenwerking aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de Nederlandse digitale veiligheid en de ontmoeting met de Chinese minister van Buitenlandse Zaken

An MP asked the government about the Dutch digital security implications of university research cooperation with Huawei and about the PM's and Foreign Minister Blok's meeting with Chinese FM Wang Yi. The government answered that the research is civilian (multilingual search), results are open access, universities are responsible for their own partner choices, and a neutral framework for telecom suppliers applies.

The cabinet will inform the House this autumn in more detail about the state of affairs in the process toward additional measures to counter unwanted knowledge and technology transfer through education and research.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer dit najaar nader informeren over de stand van zaken bij het proces om te komen tot aanvullende maatregelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Beertema over samenwerking tussen Amsterdamse universiteiten en de Chinese onderneming Huawei

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether Amsterdam universities' joint AI search-technology project with Huawei Finland risks handing advanced technology to a dictatorship that uses such tools for repression, and whether the project should be stopped. The government answered that export controls apply to dual-use goods, that AI as a field is too broad to fall under them, that the cooperation is for civilian consumer search and the institutions are autonomous, so the cabinet has no formal role in approving or blocking such agreements, while a broader review of knowledge security is ongoing.
The cabinet has no formal role in approving or disapproving cooperation agreements of institutions.
Het kabinet heeft geen formele rol in het goed- of afkeuren van samenwerkingsovereenkomsten van instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Weverling over het artikel ‘Behind China’s Decade of European Deals, State Investors Evade Notice’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about reports that Chinese state investors evade notice in European deals, including in the Netherlands. The ministers acknowledge close Chinese state involvement and state risks to national security, outlining a planned investment screening law (Toetsing Economie en Veiligheid) and EU FDI screening regulation, but give no concrete findings on specific Chinese investments.
The cabinet is currently working on establishing a system of investment screening.
Het kabinet werkt op dit moment aan de totstandkoming van een stelsel van investeringstoetsing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Hiddema over de herijking van de relatie met Suriname

Two FvD MPs asked the foreign minister about the reset of relations with Suriname: current stance on the new government, conditions on aid, financial support and IMF/IDB debt talks, business opportunities, COVID aid and medical staff, diaspora role, and institution-building. The government answered in general terms, pointing to a prior letter, stating that aid carries risk-based conditionality and that Nederland may withhold aid, declining any precedent for a state guarantee, and committing to a business forum and a second aid package still being defined.
With every form of aid the Netherlands provides, risks are weighed, donor conditionalities are set and mitigating measures are taken where there is reason to do so.
Bij iedere vorm van hulp die Nederland levert worden risico’s meegewogen en donorconditionaliteiten gesteld alsook eventuele mitigerende maatregelen genomen indien daartoe aanleiding bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Westerveld over het sluiten van de NESO-kantoren

MPs Westerveld and Van den Hul asked why the Netherlands Education Support Offices (NESO) are being closed, whether an evaluation was done, what funds are freed, how many students use the offices, and how the closures and staff were handled. The minister answers that the offices are Nuffic branches without diplomatic status, that the decision reflects changed policy and financial governance rather than dissatisfaction, that student information services continue, and that freed funds are redirected to knowledge diplomacy, with a new strategy to be presented later.
It is therefore difficult to deploy the NESO offices for the more strategic purposes, which the changing geopolitical relations and heightened attention to knowledge security call for.
Het is daarom lastig om de NESO-kantoren voor de meer strategische doeleinden in te zetten, waar de veranderende geopolitieke verhoudingen en de verscherpte aandacht voor kennisveiligheid om vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Van Wijngaarden over de nieuwe veiligheidswet die de autoriteiten in Beijing opgelegd hebben aan Hong Kong

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice about the Beijing-imposed national security law for Hong Kong, its effects on freedoms and judicial independence, and whether the extradition treaty with Hong Kong should be reconsidered. The government condemned the law's effects on autonomy and rule of law, and announced it would suspend the extradition treaty with Hong Kong as part of coordinated EU action.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de Nederlandse stilte ten aanzien van het historische vredesakkoord in het Midden-Oosten

An MP from FvD asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands was silent on the Israel-UAE-Bahrain peace accords, whether they are historic, why no Dutch representative attended the Washington ceremony, and why a Dutch minister visited Iran. The minister welcomed the accords as historic and reported EU statements, explained US-led diplomacy, and said the Netherlands was not invited at ministerial level, defending dialogue with Iran.
The United States determined the invitation policy, whereby a cross-section of EU member states was invited, of which only Hungary at ministerial level.
De Verenigde Staten bepaalden het uitnodigingsbeleid, waarbij een dwarsdoorsnede van de EU-lidstaten was uitgenodigd, waarvan alleen Hongarije op ministerieel niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Vluchtelingen vast in oorlogsgebied door sluiting ambassades’

MPs Sjoerdsma and Groothuizen asked whether ambassador closures due to COVID-19 leave about 1,500 refugee family members stranded in war zones and what the government will do. The minister answered that no exact figures exist, that about 90% of relevant posts have resumed visa services, that the government has eased rules and reissue arrangements, but that it cannot control the safety of people in conflict areas and cannot say when the remaining closed posts will reopen.

There is no insight into the exact number of refugee families (family reunification followers) who cannot come to the Netherlands for family reunification due to restricted consular services of an embassy or consulate-general.

Er is geen inzicht in het exacte aantal vluchtelingengezinnen (nareizigers) dat niet naar Nederland kan komen voor gezinshereniging door beperktere consulaire dienstverlening van een ambassade of consulaat-generaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van der Molen en Van den Berg over het bericht dat China wereldwijd 2,4 miljoen sleutelfiguren volgt

CDA MPs asked the ministers about reports that China's Zhenhua Data tracks 2.4 million key figures worldwide, including whether Dutch people are in the database and whether the government will act. The government confirmed it was informed, said Dutch persons with special roles in the democratic order were notified, saw no indications of Chinese security service orders or a link to a social credit system, and pointed to existing resilience measures and telecom security rules.
I have been informed about the database.
Ik ben geïnformeerd over de databank.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Asscher, Van Otterloo, Van Ojik en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht dat het Verenigd Koninkrijk met nieuwe wetgeving afspraken uit het uittredingsakkoord niet na dreigt te komen

Five MPs asked the government about the UK's planned Internal Market Bill, which would breach parts of the Withdrawal Agreement, and its risks for citizens' rights and Dutch nationals in the UK. The State Secretary answered that the government shares concerns, monitors citizens' rights implementation with the Commission, sees no current signs of further UK legislation undermining citizens' rights, and will consider information measures for Dutch nationals in the UK.

The government therefore monitors, together with the European Commission and in several ways, whether these rights are being honoured, including via the Joint Committee and the Dutch embassy in the UK.
Het kabinet monitort daarom samen met de Europese Commissie op verschillende manieren of deze rechten worden nagekomen, onder meer via het Gemengd Comité en via de Nederlandse ambassade in het VK.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Wilders en Van Weerdenburg over ‘nog meer Nederlands hulpgeld voor Palestijnse terroristen’

MPs De Roon, Wilders and Van Weerdenburg (PVV) asked why Dutch aid money goes to Palestinian NGO Al-Mezan, alleged to have ties with PFLP and Hamas, and demanded vetting of all Palestinian aid recipients and suspension of aid.
