The government denied evidence of links, said it will await an external investigation into UAWC, promised to remove posts from individual staff, and refused to halt aid or close the Ramallah mission.
The cabinet does not provide support to organisations that have ties with terrorist organisations and checks whether the Dutch contribution to these organisations is spent on the agreed objectives.

Het kabinet geeft geen steun aan organisaties die banden hebben met terroristische organisaties en controleert of de Nederlandse bijdrage aan deze organisaties wordt besteed aan de afgesproken doelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over berichten dat NAVO-lid Turkije moslimextremisten uit Syrië naar Azerbeidzjan stuurt en ook aan de strijd deelneemt

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether Turkey is sending Islamist fighters from Syria to Azerbaijan, whether Turkey is directly fighting, whether the government will press Turkey to stop, what measures will protect Armenians, and whether Turkey should be removed from NATO. The minister replied that the government has no independent information confirming the transfers or Turkish combat involvement, which both countries deny, urged de-escalation and dialogue, and said expulsion from NATO is neither in the Dutch nor the alliance's interest and is not provided for by the treaty.
The cabinet has no independent information that Turkey has transferred foreign fighters to Azerbaijan.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie dat Turkije buitenlandse strijders naar Azerbeidzjan heeft overgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over Turkse paspoorten voor Hamas-terroristen

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey issues passports to Hamas members, whether this threatens Israel, Europe and NATO, and whether visa liberalisation for Turks is still conceivable. The minister could not confirm the press reports, said the Netherlands has no information on Turkish support for listed organisations, and said the Dutch concerns would be raised in bilateral contacts with Turkey.
The Dutch concerns and questions about this reporting will be raised in bilateral contacts with Turkey.
De Nederlandse zorgen en vragen over deze berichtgeving zullen in bilaterale contacten met Turkije worden opgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een Nederlandse journalist die Turkije niet in mag

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch-Palestinian journalist Sakir Khader was barred from Turkey as a security risk under anti-terrorism law, what information Turkey based this on, and whether the government would raise press freedom concerns with Turkey. The minister confirmed the refusal, said the basis is not yet known and Nederland has requested information, and stated the government regularly raises press freedom concerns with Turkey bilaterally and via the EU.
The Netherlands has made inquiries and is awaiting information from Turkey. Your House will be informed further about this.
Nederland heeft hier navraag naar gedaan en is in afwachting van informatie van Turkije. Uw Kamer zal hierover nader worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de Visumplicht tussen de Schengenzone en Suriname

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the Schengen visa requirement for travel to and from Suriname has exceptions, how many visa applications are filed and approved, and what steps would lead toward visa liberalisation. The minister answered that the requirement applies with limited exceptions, that visa approval rates are around 90 to 95 percent, that the EU Commission holds exclusive competence over visa liberalisation, and that Suriname must first request a study and improve readmission cooperation and biometric passports.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not have figures on visa applications submitted by Dutch travellers for Suriname.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken beschikt niet over cijfers van visumaanvragen die door Nederlandse reizigers voor Suriname worden ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Amerikaanse sancties tegen het Internationaal Strafhof

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the US sanctioned ICC staff including the chief prosecutor, what measures apply, and what follow-up steps the government would take. The minister confirmed economic sanctions and visa restrictions, described diplomatic protests and EU/multilateral letters, and outlined ongoing contacts with the Court, banks and EU partners, including raising the sanctions with the Commission for the anti-boycott regulation.
The Cabinet is further in discussion with the European Commission about adding the sanctions to the EU's Anti-Boycott Regulation.
Het Kabinet is verder met de Europese Commissie in gesprek over het toevoegen van de sancties aan de Antiboycotverordening van de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over het bericht 'Kopzorgen KNVB om duel Jong Oranje in Belarus: Veiligheid boven alles'

Two MPs asked whether the Netherlands should intervene over Jong Oranje playing in Belarus amid health and political risks, and whether UEFA should cancel the match. The government said the football decisions and quarantine exemption are for the KNVB and UEFA, that it advised on local health and safety but did not contact UEFA, and that it actively raises human rights concerns through multilateral bodies.
The cabinet is of the view that it is not for the government but for UEFA and affiliated federations themselves to decide whether it is desirable to play football in a country like Belarus.
Het kabinet is van mening dat het niet aan de overheid, maar aan de UEFA en aangesloten bonden zelf is om te bepalen of het wenselijk is in een land als Wit-Rusland te voetballen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘VS zet hoofdaanklager Internationaal Strafhof op zwarte lijst’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about US sanctions placing the ICC chief prosecutor and Court staff on a blacklist, and what the Netherlands has done bilaterally and in the EU to prevent or respond to them. The minister answered that the government repeatedly urged the US not to escalate, is pursuing EU options such as the Anti-Boycott Regulation, and is working with banks to limit the impact on the Court, while stressing the Court must keep functioning.
Over recent months close contact has been maintained with the Court, various banks and our European partners.
Afgelopen maanden is nauw contact onderhouden met het Strafhof, verschillende banken en onze Europese partners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het sluiten van de COVID-19 kliniek op Lesbos

An MP asked the Dutch government whether a COVID-19 clinic run by MSF on Lesbos was closed by Greek authorities while Dutch officials were arranging a replacement hospital container, and what Dutch funds were spent. The government answered that the container was donated at Greek request in April, the choice of location was Greek responsibility, there is no causal link to the MSF closure, and the container was damaged in the Moria fires and is currently out of use.

The cabinet therefore has no indications to suppose that there is a causal link between the acceptance of the donation of the hospital container in April by the national authorities and the closure of the MSF clinic in July by the local authorities.

Het kabinet heeft dan ook geen aanwijzingen om te veronderstellen dat er een causaal verband bestaat tussen het aanvaarden van de schenking van de hospitainer in april jl. door de nationale autoriteiten en de sluiting van de kliniek van MSF in juli jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de financiering van Grieks wanbeleid op Lesbos

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister and the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the Netherlands financed mismanagement on Lesbos, including a hospital container donated for a COVID-19 clinic that coincided with the closure of an MSF clinic, and the links with MotG and a Greek youth-care project. The minister denied any causal link between the donation and the MSF closure, said the location was a Greek decision, and described the Dutch-funded reception places for unaccompanied minors and the offer to take 50 minors and 50 families.

We have taken note of the article 'Hallucinant, Netherlands finances Greek mismanagement on Lesbos', but we do not endorse the claimed connection between the donation of the hospital container and the closure of the Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) clinic.

Wij hebben kennisgenomen van het artikel «Hallucinant, Nederland financiert Grieks wanbeleid op Lesbos», maar onderschrijven de gestelde samenhang tussen het schenken van de hospitainer en het sluiten van de kliniek van Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht 'Protestmars bij grens met Saint Martin'

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for the Interior and the Foreign Minister about French border controls between Sint Maarten and Saint Martin, including their reasons, the government's view, and efforts to coordinate COVID-19 policy. The minister answered that the French controls were introduced for COVID-19 reasons, that the Netherlands respects them but considers them undesirable long term, that they were lifted on 15 September, and that health-sector coordination with the island is ongoing.
The Netherlands respects the French decision to introduce these controls, but considers such a situation undesirable in the long term.
Nederland respecteert het Franse besluit tot invoering van deze controles, maar acht een dergelijke situatie op lange termijn niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over dreigementen van de EU aan het adres van Servië en Kosovo vanwege plannen ambassades te openen in Jeruzalem

An MP asked whether EU warnings to Serbia and Kosovo over plans to open embassies in Jerusalem amount to coercion, and whether the Dutch embassy should move to Jerusalem. The minister rejected the characterization of threats or blackmail, said accession candidates voluntarily align with EU foreign policy, and reaffirmed the Dutch position of keeping its embassy in Tel Aviv.
The cabinet's position on relocating the Dutch embassy is unchanged.
Het standpunt van het kabinet over een verhuizing van de Nederlandse ambassade is onveranderd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de mogelijke rechtsbasis van sancties tegen Wit-Rusland

Omtzigt asked whether the Sanctiewet 1977 allows sanctions against Belarus via an intergovernmental agreement among EU states, and how broadly 'internationale afspraken' is defined. Minister Blok confirmed the statutory text, said such an agreement could provide the basis but would take considerable time and conflict with ongoing EU Council negotiations, and described 'internationale afspraken' as a broad concept.
An intergovernmental agreement could be a sufficient legal basis to adopt a general administrative order with sanctions against Belarus or individuals from Belarus.
Een intergouvernementele afspraak zou voldoende rechtsbasis kunnen zijn om een algemene maatregel van bestuur vast te stellen met sancties tegen Wit-Rusland of individuen uit Wit-Rusland.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het Nederlandse meisje Insiya Hemani, dat ontvoerd is naar India en de pogingen die de Nederlandse regering onderneemt om haar terug te krijgen in Nederland

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the government about the 2016 abduction of Dutch toddler Insiya Hemani to India, the enforcement of Dutch court rulings on her return, and what is being done to bring her back. The ministers confirmed awareness of the case and court rulings, said the Indian authorities are being pressed via diplomatic notes but that enforcement in India cannot be compelled by the Netherlands and that India's child-custody and immigration matters are for Indian law.
In this case, Dutch court rulings are being presented to the Indian authorities through diplomatic channels so that they can take note of them.
Nederlandse gerechtelijke uitspraken worden in deze zaak langs diplomatieke weg aangeboden aan de Indiase autoriteiten om daar kennis van te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over de ontvoering van Insiya naar India

Two PvdA MPs asked the Ministers of Legal Protection and Foreign Affairs why Insiya, abducted to India, has not been returned to her mother despite court rulings, what steps the Netherlands has taken, and whether the minister has raised the case with India. The minister agreed the situation is unsatisfactory, said Dutch court rulings cannot be enforced in India and the case is raised diplomatically, and declined to detail pending Indian proceedings without parties' consent.
I can and may only inform you about proceedings pending between parties in India with the consent of the parties involved.
Over in India aanhangige procedures tussen partijen kan en mag ik u alleen met toestemming van betrokken partijen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Nijboer over vermogen van het Wit-Russische regime bij Nederlandse brievenbusfirma’s

MPs Ploumen and Nijboer asked whether the Belarusian Lukashenko regime holds assets in Dutch letterbox companies, whether such assets should be frozen and how to prevent them. The minister answered that the government is unaware of such assets, that individual cases cannot be commented on absent sanctions, and that EU sanctions, client due diligence and tighter trust office rules are the instruments, while national unilateral measures are not possible under current law.
I cannot make statements about individual cases as long as no sanctions apply to those persons or regimes.
Over individuele gevallen kan ik geen uitspraken doen, zolang er geen sprake is van sancties die van toepassing zijn op die personen of regimes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat er vreselijke dingen zijn gebeurd met het testen van vaccins in Afrika

MP Kuzu asked the ministers whether clinical vaccine trials in developing countries, including Africa, are supervised to protect participants' rights, whether abuses are known, and whether pharmaceutical firms exploit weaker rules there. Minister De Jonge answered that all trials supporting EU registration must meet EU Good Clinical Practice standards wherever they are conducted, that EMA verifies compliance through inspections, that no current abuses are known, and that compensation rules and capacity-building efforts exist.
Clinical studies supporting EU drug registration, wherever in the world they are conducted, must comply with all Good Clinical Practice (GCP) regulations.
Klinische onderzoeken ten behoeve van de registratie van geneesmiddelen in de EU, waar ook ter wereld uitgevoerd, moeten voldoen aan alle regelgeving op het gebied van Good Clinical Practice (GCP)
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Wilders, Markuszower en Graus over heksenjacht door NVWA

MPs De Roon, Wilders, Markuszower and Graus asked whether the government instructed the NVWA to target the Israel Producten Centrum over labelling of wine from Judea and Samaria, and why Israel is treated differently from other countries. Minister Blok answered that the NVWA acts on complaints under EU origin-labelling rules applied equally to all countries, and that a binding CJEU ruling requires settlement-origin labelling.
No. Following a complaint received, the Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (NVWA) carried out an inspection in April 2019.
Nee. Naar aanleiding van een binnengekomen klacht heeft de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA) in april 2019 een inspectie uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de bedreiging van Nobelprijswinnaar Denis Mukwege

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about renewed death threats against Nobel laureate Denis Mukwege and the reduced UN MONUSCO protection for him and his hospital, and what the Netherlands would do. The minister answered that MONUSCO will keep contributing via training Congolese police, an early alert system, a safe room and joint patrols, that the Netherlands is pressing the UN and Congolese authorities, and that Dutch staff are exploring a new security contribution with Mukwege's team.
The Netherlands has urged the UN to provide adequate protection for Dr. Mukwege.
Nederland heeft bij de VN aangedrongen op adequate bescherming voor dr. Mukwege.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik, Karabulut, Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Raan over de beveiliging van Nobelprijswinnaar dr. Denis Mukwege

MPs asked whether MONUSCO protection of Nobel laureate Denis Mukwege and the Panzi hospital is sufficient, whether Nederland will play a role in his security, and whether he should be protected. The minister answered that Nederland pressed the UN for adequate protection, MONUSCO assigned Nepalese troops to the compound and committed to continued protection, and Nederland is exploring a new contribution to security without a formal request from Mukwege.
For this reason, the Netherlands has in recent weeks pressed the UN for adequate protection for Dr. Mukwege.
Nederland heeft daarom de afgelopen weken bij de VN aangedrongen op adequate bescherming voor dr. Mukwege.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over het bericht 'China krijgt voor het eerst militair voet aan de grond in Europa'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that China gained a first military foothold in Europe through cooperation with Serbia, and about consequences for the balance of power and Serbia's NATO partnership. The minister answered that he cannot confirm the reports, sees no clear effect on European security, and sees no direct Dutch role while monitoring Chinese military ambitions.
Because I have no information of my own about the systems the cited article says were acquired, and no information beyond that article, I see no direct role for the Netherlands at this time.

Omdat ik geen eigen informatie heb over de systemen die volgens het aangehaalde artikel zouden zijn aangeschaft en ik ook geen andere informatie tot mijn beschikking heb dan het betreffende artikel, zie ik op dit moment geen directe rol voor Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over de impact van coronabeperkingen op visumverlening aan buitenlandse geliefden van Nederlanders

MPs asked the government about the impact of COVID-19 restrictions on visa processing for foreign partners of Dutch nationals, including closed embassies, cancelled civic integration exams abroad, and whether alternative routes such as online exams or post-arrival testing are possible. The minister answered that most posts now offer the basic integration exam, that online testing is ruled out to prevent fraud, that post-arrival testing is incompatible with the MVV process, and that the government will keep working with posts and EU partners but cannot quantify affected families.
There is no insight into figures on the number of Dutch nationals currently forced to live apart because their partner cannot take the basic civic integration exam abroad.
Er is geen inzicht in cijfers van het aantal Nederlandse staatsburgers dat op dit moment gescheiden moet leven vanwege het niet kunnen afleggen van een basisexamen inburgering buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de adoptie van een ernstig ziek meisje uit Malawi

An SP MP asked the Dutch ministers why a seriously ill Malawian girl adopted by a Dutch mother could not be insured in the Netherlands, why the passport decision took so long, and whether the adoption could be recognised quickly. The minister answered that insurance is tied to residence in the Netherlands, that the adoption was a local one under Malawian law, that a visa for medical treatment was issued, and that a reconsideration of the objection will take place as soon as possible.
Within the objection procedure, a reconsideration of the rejection will take place as soon as possible.
In het kader van de bezwaarschriftprocedure zal zo spoedig mogelijk een heroverweging van de afwijzing plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Bouali, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Israël martelde verdachte Palestijnen van een NGO gesteund door Nederland'

MPs asked whether the Israeli detention and alleged torture of two former staff of the Palestinian NGO UAWC, which the Netherlands supports, breaches international law, and about military trial, access to counsel and administrative detention. The ministers say the Netherlands is concerned, has raised torture and fair-trial rights with Israel and the EU, notes an Israeli Justice Ministry inquiry without published results, and will keep monitoring the case.
The Netherlands will continue to follow the progress.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de (kritieke) situatie van twee mensenrechtenadvocaten in Turkije

Ploumen asks the Foreign Minister about the critical situation of two Turkish human rights lawyers, Ebru Timtik and Aytaç Ünsal, convicted in an unfair trial and on hunger strike, and what the government will do about it. Minister Blok says the Netherlands regularly raises rule-of-law concerns with Turkey, backs the EU statement, and reports that Timtik died and Ünsal was provisionally released.
The Netherlands regularly raises these concerns at all levels, in clear terms, both multilaterally and in bilateral contacts with Turkey.
Nederland stelt deze zorgen regelmatig en op alle niveaus in duidelijke bewoordingen aan de orde, zowel multilateraal als in bilaterale contacten met Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het oppakken van een Palestijnse activist door Israël

The SP MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of Palestinian BDS leader Mahmoud Nawajaa by Israel, his incommunicado detention, whether the arrest was political, the number of Palestinian security detainees, and whether the government would raise concerns with Israel. The minister answered that Nawajaa was arrested on 30 July 2020, held without access to counsel for a week, and released on 17 August without charge; the motives are unknown, the Netherlands raises concerns about pressure on civil society with Israel, but no concrete new step is announced.
The reasons for the arrest and release are unknown to the cabinet.
De redenen voor arrestatie en vrijlating zijn het kabinet onbekend.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over Canadese wetgeving die het openbaar maken van misstanden in de dierindustrie strafbaar stelt (Bill 156) en over de dood van de Canadese dierenrechtenactiviste Regan Russell

An MP asked the Dutch ministers about Ontario's Bill 156, which criminalises exposing animal abuse in farming, and about the death of activist Regan Russell, along with Canadian animal welfare commitments under CETA. The government says Bill 156 is not a response to the abuse cases, that protest rights are not affected, that the Russell death was investigated with a careless-driving charge, and that it will keep the Russell investigation under watch and raise animal welfare within CETA dialogue.
The cabinet cannot confirm that the Canadian province of Ontario adopted Bill 156 in response to the aforementioned cases.
Het kabinet kan niet bevestigen dat de Canadese Provincie Ontario Bill 156 heeft aangenomen in reactie op de eerder genoemde zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over de naamswijziging van het Confucius instituut en het samenwerkingscontract Stichting Confucius Instituut Groningen

CDA MPs asked whether the renaming of the Confucius Institute headquarters signals stronger Chinese state control, and whether Dutch Confucius contracts, including that of Groningen, should be made more transparent and reviewed. The minister answered that the renaming appears to be a response to backlash and creates distance from Hanban, that Dutch institutions are autonomous and their contracts non-confidential by default, and that no extra measures are needed now, with a fuller update promised this autumn.
As indicated in the cover letter to this report, I will further inform your House this autumn about the position of the Netherlands vis-à-vis China in the field of education and science.
Zoals aangegeven in de aanbiedingsbrief bij dit rapport, zal ik uw Kamer dit najaar verder informeren over de positie van Nederland ten opzichte van China op het terrein van onderwijs en wetenschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over het actief ontmoedigen van onnodige reizen naar risicogebieden

Green MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked the government how it will discourage unnecessary travel to COVID-19 risk areas, including ticket advertising and the Schiphol test lane's capacity. The ministers answered that travellers bear responsibility for their choices, orange advice is in place, a Schiphol testing study is under way with results expected mid-September, and airlines were urged to stop promoting travel to orange areas.
It is the responsibility of the traveller themselves to weigh whether a trip is necessary or not.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de reiziger zelf om de afweging te maken of een reis noodzakelijk is of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Koopmans en Middendorp over het bericht dat honderden Chinezen hun valse identiteit ‘herstelden’ bij gemeenten

MPs from the VVD asked the government about reports that hundreds of Chinese nationals 'restored' false identities through municipalities, covering detection, document verification, nationality consequences, limitation periods and sanctions. The State Secretary answered at length, describing existing procedures and safeguards, rejecting several proposed legal changes, and committing only to approach Chinese authorities if useful.
It is not possible to answer this question using data from the BRP.
Het is niet mogelijk om met behulp van gegevens uit de BRP deze vraag te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht 'Ngo’s: hele modewereld betrokken bij dwangarbeid Oeigoeren'

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the ministers about reports that the fashion industry is linked to forced labour of Uyghurs in China, including what concrete steps were taken, whether companies should be mapped, and whether further international reactions would follow. The ministers answered that the Netherlands raises Xinjiang human rights bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN Human Rights Council, that companies bear primary due diligence responsibility, that no overview of linked companies exists, and that further raising of the issue is planned.
The cabinet has no overview of companies that are linked through their supply chain to the situation in Xinjiang.
Het kabinet heeft geen overzicht van bedrijven die via hun toeleveringsketen zijn gelinkt aan de situatie in Xinjiang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht 'Diplomaten uit de bocht'

An SP MP asked the Foreign Affairs and Justice ministers about diplomats involved in traffic offences and other crimes who escape prosecution due to immunity, including whether immunity was lifted, how traffic checks and compensation work, and why countries of origin are not published. The minister replied that traffic violations fell by 51.8%, immunity was lifted only four times with prosecution pursued where possible, and naming countries would not be appropriate at present.
The number of other criminal offences committed by diplomats (i.e. embassy, consulate and international organisation staff with some form of immunity) is low relative to the size of the population.

Het aantal overige strafbare feiten, begaan door diplomaten (i.c. medewerkers van ambassades, consulaten en internationale organisaties die over een vorm van immuniteit beschikken) is laag, afgezet tegen de omvang van de populatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over Nederlanders die nog altijd vastzitten in Marokko

MP Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister why a Dutch family and their newborn remained stuck in Morocco despite reopened borders, and what was being done to help them and other stranded Dutch citizens. The minister answered that Moroccan COVID-19 border closures continue with some exceptions, that the embassy's regular travel document services were suspended from 20 March to 12 July, that the ministry does not comment on individual cases, and that repatriation flights and commercial routes are available.
The ministry does not make substantive statements about individual cases.
Het ministerie doet geen inhoudelijke mededelingen over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over in Bahrein geplande executies

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the upheld death sentences of two men in Bahrain, alleged torture-obtained confessions, and the number of people sentenced to death. The minister confirmed the rulings, condemned torture and reiterated Dutch opposition to the death penalty through bilateral, EU and UN channels, committing to continue raising the issue.
According to Bahraini human rights organisations, 18 persons have currently been sentenced to death since 2017.
Volgens Bahreinse mensenrechtenorganisaties zijn er momenteel 18 personen veroordeeld tot de doodstraf sinds 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over uitgevoerde doodvonnissen in Bahrein

MP Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister how many death sentences were carried out in Bahrain since 2017, how often the Netherlands objected bilaterally, what it does on prison conditions and torture, and whether it will push for an EU moratorium. The minister answered that no official figures exist, that concerns are raised in bilateral, multilateral and EU channels, and that the Netherlands and EU have issued statements calling for a moratorium.
According to Bahraini human rights organisations, 18 persons have currently been sentenced to death since 2017.
Volgens Bahreinse mensenrechtenorganisaties zijn er momenteel 18 personen veroordeeld tot de doodstraf sinds 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Bergkamp en Kuiken over gedwongen gescheiden lange-afstandskoppels door corona

MPs from D66 and PvdA asked whether the government would relax the COVID-19 entry ban for long-distance unmarried partners, including a Danish-style exception, and clarified entry rules for EU citizens' non-EU partners and the online information. The minister answered that a temporary scheme for long-distance partners, in force since 27 July 2020, was introduced within health limits, that a marriage certificate is not the only way to prove a relationship, and that he will check the government online information.

In a letter of 16 July 2020 I informed your House that the cabinet, within the health frameworks relating to Covid-19, found a possibility to arrive at a temporary adjusted scheme for partners in long-distance relationships.

Bij brief van 16 juli 2020 heb ik uw Kamer laten weten dat het kabinet, binnen de gezondheidskaders met betrekking tot Covid-19, een mogelijkheid heeft gevonden om te komen tot een tijdelijke aangepaste regeling voor geliefden in een langeafstandsrelatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van Helvert, Van Dam inzake het bericht ‘Activist Zarza neergestoken in Leeuwarden, familie vermoedt politiek motief’

Three CDA MPs asked whether the stabbing of Iranian activist Sadegh Zarza in Leeuwarden had a political motive, whether Iranian academics should face broader screening, and what steps the government had taken regarding Iranian involvement in liquidations in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service leads the investigation and no substantive statements can be made yet, that screening is limited to sensitive technical research areas under sanctions rules, and that no further action is currently planned.
It is up to the Public Prosecution Service to lead the criminal investigation into the offence and any possible motive.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om leiding te geven aan het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar het strafbare feit en het eventuele motief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over gevolgen van het grensconflict met Frankrijk

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister who is responsible for the Oyster Pond border dispute with France, whether France will be held to the 2014 status quo agreement, and whether the restaurant owner can rebuild without risk of arrest. The minister answered that no single party is to blame, that the Netherlands has repeatedly reminded France of the status quo agreement, and that a joint pragmatic solution is being worked on with talks planned for autumn.
The Kingdom is working on a proposal for a joint pragmatic solution to give Cactus Tree NV comfort and facilitate the reconstruction.
Het Koninkrijk werkt hiertoe aan een voorstel voor een gezamenlijke pragmatische oplossing om Cactus Tree NV comfort te bieden en de wederopbouw te faciliteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Roon over toenemende agressie van Hezbollah tegen Israël

Two PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister about rising Hezbollah aggression against Israel, including the EU's failure to list Hezbollah's political wing, the role of UNIFIL, and Dutch support for Israel. The minister answered that the situation is tense but not escalated, that UNIFIL supports de-escalation under resolution 1701, that the Netherlands lists all of Hezbollah as terrorist, and that no Israeli request for aid exists.
The Netherlands has designated Hezbollah in its entirety as a terrorist organisation since 2004, making no distinction between the political and military wings of the organisation.
Nederland bestempelt Hezbollah sinds 2004 in zijn geheel als terroristische organisatie, waarbij geen onderscheid wordt gemaakt tussen de politieke en militaire tak van de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over illegale wapenleveranties Iran en het instellen van sancties

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands was informed of an intercepted Iranian weapons shipment to the Houthis, why it keeps dialogue with Iran, and whether it will impose unilateral sanctions and push for extension of the UN arms embargo. The minister answers that the Netherlands was not separately informed, rejects unilateral sanctions in favour of EU/UN action, and says it supports seeking a broad solution on the arms embargo while noting the EU autonomous embargo remains in force.
The Netherlands sees no added value in imposing unilateral sanctions.
Nederland ziet geen meerwaarde in het instellen van unilaterale sancties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht dat Polen zich wil terugtrekken uit het verdrag dat geweld tegen vrouwen bestrijdt

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether they share concern over Poland's reported plan to withdraw from the Istanbul Convention on violence against women, whether they will contact Polish counterparts, and whether they will support Polish civil society groups. The government answered that it shares the concern, that no withdrawal decision yet exists in Poland, that a joint démarche was made on 7 August, that the Netherlands will not withdraw, and that support for Polish organisations will be considered if warranted.

The cabinet will continue to follow the matter and, after the ruling of the Polish Constitutional Court and a possible decision by the Polish government, will assess whether and what further action is appropriate and most effective.

Het kabinet blijft de zaak volgen en zal na de uitspraak van het Pools Constitutioneel Hof en een mogelijk besluit van de Poolse regering bezien of en welke verdere actie opportuun is en het meest effectief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het oppakken van een journalist in Marokko

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of critical journalist Omar Radi in Morocco on charges of rape and threats to state security, including whether the case involves Dutch espionage, and whether the Netherlands will press for a fair trial and monitoring. The minister answered that Dutch embassies follow press freedom and fair trial developments, that the Netherlands has no indication Radi's case refers to the Netherlands, and that the Moroccan authorities must investigate the charges, while declining to confirm or refute Amnesty's spyware findings.
I do not have independent information that confirms or refutes this reporting, and therefore cannot give a judgment on it.
Ik beschik niet over eigenstandige informatie die deze berichtgeving bevestigt dan wel ontkracht, en kan daar dan ook geen oordeel over geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Kuik over de arrestatie en gevangenneming van mensenrechtenverdedigers in Niger

MPs Van Helvert and Kuik asked the ministers about the detention of human rights defenders in Niger, including two trade union leaders, and whether Dutch aid to youth employment programmes is hindered as a result. The ministers said they raised the case with Nigerien authorities through several diplomatic channels, will keep following it while respecting judicial independence, and that the detentions are hindering one part of the programme but the Dutch youth employment efforts continue.
The Netherlands will continue to follow this matter closely, with respect for the independent judicial process in Niger.
Nederland blijft deze kwestie nauwlettend volgen, met respect voor de onafhankelijke rechtsgang in Niger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de leefomstandigheden van overlevers van de genocide in Srebrenica

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about living conditions for Srebrenica genocide survivors still housed in collective centres 25 years later. The minister confirmed about 5,000 displaced persons remain in centres, acknowledged poor conditions, and listed past Dutch and EU support including housing projects and an ongoing centre-closure programme, committing only to continued pressure on Bosnian authorities.
After years of intensive support, the Netherlands urges the Bosnian authorities to ensure adequate housing and, where desired, return of displaced persons.
Na jarenlang intensieve steun, spoort Nederland de Bosnische autoriteiten aan om te zorgen voor adequate huisvesting en -desgewenst- terugkeer van ontheemden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Popken en Markuszower over een inspectie door het marineschip Zr. Ms. De Ruyter

MPs De Roon, Popken and Markuszower asked whether the frigate De Ruyter carried out a ship inspection over a possible sanctions violation, which vessel and flag were involved, what evidence existed, and with whom findings were shared. The government confirmed the inspection, said details could not be disclosed because a criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service is ongoing and shared findings only with that service, and declined to give operational details of the ship's operations.
As you know, as Minister of Justice and Security I do not make substantive statements about an ongoing criminal investigation.
Zoals bij u bekend doe ik als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid geen inhoudelijke mededelingen over een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de betrokkenheid van door Nederland betaalde UAWC-medewerkers bij de terreurorganisatie PFLP en het feit dat zij verdacht worden van een terreuraanslag, waarbij

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the foreign and development ministers what the government knew about Dutch-funded UAWC staff allegedly linked to the PFLP and a 2019 bombing, and about the funding involved. The ministers answered that the staff were paid partly from Dutch project funds, that payments were suspended, that audits were not yet shared due to data protection, and that an external investigation has been commissioned.
Our intention is to share these documents with you as soon as possible.
Onze intentie is om deze documenten zo spoedig mogelijk met u te delen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de financiering van UAWC met Nederlands belastinggeld en de overeenkomst tussen Nederland en de UAWC nadat bekend geworden was dat twee hooggeplaatste medewerke

Two CDA MPs asked why Dutch funding to UAWC continued after two former staff were suspected of a terrorist bombing, and about the subsidy agreement's reporting and sanction clauses. The ministers answered that funding was suspended, that no irregularities were formally reported under article 6, that UAWC is not listed as terrorist by the EU, UN or Netherlands, and that an external investigation will be commissioned.
The cabinet nonetheless considers it necessary to commission further external research into UAWC in light of the recent developments.
Het kabinet acht het niettemin noodzakelijk nader extern onderzoek naar UAWC te laten doen op grond van de recente ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Markuszower en Wilders over Hezbollah en ammoniumnitraat

Three PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Hezbollah stored ammonium nitrate and about threats by its leader, and whether the Beirut explosion's chemicals belonged to Hezbollah and how to undermine the group internationally. The minister replied that the Beirut blast was an accident involving seized substances, that the Netherlands supports independent international investigation, and that Hezbollah's military wing has been on the EU terrorist list since 2013 while the Dutch push for listing the political wing lacks support.
The Netherlands strongly advocates thorough, independent international investigation into the explosion and is exploring contributing technical expertise to it.
Nederland maakt zich hard voor gedegen, onafhankelijk internationaal onderzoek naar de explosie en onderzoekt de mogelijkheid om hieraan bij te dragen met technische expertise.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Van Helvert en Voordewind over foltering en honger in vrouwenkampen in Noord-Korea na gedwongen terugkeer vanuit China

Three MPs asked the foreign minister about torture, starvation and sexual violence against North Korean women repatriated from China, and the UN's 2020 report on this, asking whether it amounts to crimes against humanity and what Netherlands is doing about it, including whether military intervention could be justified without a Security Council mandate. The minister confirmed awareness of the UN report and agreed that crimes against humanity are occurring, noted diplomatic and UN-level efforts, and stated that human rights violations alone do not provide a legal basis for military intervention without Security Council authorisation.

Human rights violations, even if they may be qualified as crimes against humanity, do not under existing international law constitute a legal basis for military intervention without authorisation from the UN Security Council.

Het plegen van mensenrechtenschendingen, ook wanneer deze kunnen worden gekwalificeerd als misdrijven tegen de menselijkheid, vormen onder het bestaande internationaal recht geen rechtsgrond voor militaire interventie zonder autorisatie van de VN-Veiligheidsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat Turkije het S400-luchtafweersysteem getest heeft op F-35- en F22-toestellen

The ChristenUnie MP Voordewind asked the Ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs whether reports that Turkey tested its S-400 air defence system against F-35 and F-22 aircraft are accurate, how the government views this, and whether it will raise the matter at NATO. The Minister could not confirm the report, stated serious concerns about Turkey's S-400 acquisition raised bilaterally and in NATO, declined to share operational details of the F-35 for security reasons, and saw no reason to raise the issue at the October NATO defence ministers' meeting for now.
Regarding the specific operational capabilities of the F-35, including claims about possible vulnerabilities of the system, I cannot provide your House with further information for security reasons.

Over de specifieke operationele capaciteiten van de F-35 inclusief beweringen over eventuele kwetsbaarheden van het systeem kan ik uw Kamer vanuit veiligheidsoverwegingen geen verdere informatie doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een zoekgeraakte wapenleverantie in Libië in 2017

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers to give a full account of the 2017 disappearance of weapons and communications equipment shipped to Tripoli to protect the Dutch embassy, and why Parliament was not informed. The minister responded with a timeline of the shipment and loss, confidentially briefed Parliament earlier, but withheld the types and quantities of goods on security grounds and gave no further details.
We do not disclose the nature of the goods for security reasons.
Over de aard van de goederen doen we uit veiligheidsoverwegingen geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Van Dam en Geluk-Poortvliet over het bericht ‘Erdogan wil weer bidden in de Hagia Sophia’

CDA MPs asked whether the government finds it unacceptable that Turkey may convert the Hagia Sophia from museum to mosque, what steps it would take, and whether it will lobby UNESCO. The government replied that the building's function is an internal Turkish matter, that the Netherlands with EU partners has urged respect for its symbolic role and free access, and that UNESCO's assessment focuses on preserving universal value rather than the building's function.
The precise function of the Hagia Sophia is an internal matter for Turkey.
De precieze functie van de Hagia Sophia is een interne aangelegenheid van Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over een wetswijziging in Roemenië waarmee het recht om te zijn wie je bent wordt ondermijnd

Two MPs asked the government about a Romanian amendment banning the teaching of gender as a concept separate from biological sex, and how the EU and the Netherlands would respond. The minister said the amendment awaits presidential approval and a Constitutional Court ruling, and listed EU-level and Dutch efforts to support LHBTI rights, without announcing a concrete sanction.
The ongoing legislative process, as well as the public debate about it in Romanian society, are therefore of concern to the cabinet.
Het nog lopende wetstraject, alsmede de maatschappelijke discussie daarover in de Roemeense samenleving, hebben daarom de aandacht van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de afgifte van een vergunning voor export militair materieel naar Egypte

An SP MP asked the government about an export licence for military radar and C3 equipment to Egypt, including its possible use in the Yemen blockade, human rights concerns and Libya tensions. The minister declined to give details on the licence and product for confidentiality reasons, said the licence was assessed under the EU Common Position, and refused to suspend it.
No statements can be made about the details of the application. That concerns commercially confidential information.
Er kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan over de details van de aanvraag. Dat betreft bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Rusland betaalde Afghaanse strijders om Amerikaanse militairen te doden’

MPs Belhaj and Sjoerdsma asked whether the government confirmed reports that Russia paid Afghan fighters to kill US soldiers, whether US intelligence had informed the Netherlands, and whether Dutch troops in Afghanistan were at higher risk. The ministers answered that the government does not publicly comment on cooperation with foreign intelligence services or specific intelligence, that allied services would normally share information affecting each other's soldiers, and that general threat levels are monitored with precautions taken where needed.
As is well known, the cabinet makes no public statements about cooperation with and between foreign intelligence services.
Het kabinet doet, zoals bekend, in het openbaar geen mededelingen over de samenwerking met en tussen buitenlandse inlichtingendiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Tunisia: Two-Year Sentence for Homosexuality’

Two PvdA MPs asked the foreign ministers about a Tunisian court sentence of two years for homosexuality, including whether the Netherlands had raised concerns, condemned forced anal examinations as torture, and what the Tunisian LGBTI equality commission's stalling means for the relationship. The minister answered that the embassy monitors the case, the Netherlands opposes criminalisation and forced anal examinations and raises LGBTI rights in bilateral and multilateral fora, and that progress on the equality commission has been slow, with the Netherlands continuing to press for implementation.

The embassy is in close contact with the NGO supporting the two convicted men with legal advice and will decide in consultation with those involved whether contact with the Tunisian authorities is desirable.

De ambassade staat in nauw contact met de NGO die de twee veroordeelden bijstaat met juridisch advies en zal in samenspraak met betrokkenen besluiten of contact met Tunesische autoriteiten wenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Voordewind over de vuurgevechten en vijandelijkheden aan de Azerbeidzjaans-Armeense grens vanaf 12 juli jl.

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the July 2020 clashes on the Azerbaijan-Armenia border, including whether Armenia's warnings were ignored, what the Netherlands has done to prevent war, and whether it will push for a ceasefire and new talks. The minister answers that the Netherlands monitors the situation through embassies, the OSCE and the EU, backed an EU statement calling for an immediate halt to hostilities, and says the OSCE Minsk Group remains the primary negotiating format.
The cabinet closely monitors developments in the region.
Het kabinet volgt ontwikkelingen in de regio nauwlettend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Weerdenburg over “subsidieverlening aan een Palestijnse organisatie met terreurbanden”

Two PVV MPs asked whether the Netherlands gave about 23 million dollars in subsidies to the Palestinian NGO UAWC, whether its staff were linked to terrorism, why a petition to stop funding was ignored, and whether funding will stop immediately. The ministers confirmed funding of roughly 11.7 million euros plus earlier programmes, said two staff members arrested for an alleged bombing had received overhead salary payments, paused further payments, and ordered an external investigation before deciding on continued cooperation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Amhaouch over het sluiten van het consulaat in Nador

CDA MPs asked why the Netherlands is moving visa application services from Nador to Tanger, and whether the Nador honorary consulate is closing. The minister answered that the honorary consulate stays open and only the external visa service provider's office moves, to speed up and improve visa processing, a decision already final though paused by COVID-19.
The honorary consulate remains open and the current tasks of the consulate do not change.
Het honorair consulaat in Nador blijft geopend en de huidige taken van het consulaat veranderen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, De Roon, Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Van Helvert en Van Ojik over de bombardementen van Turkije in de Iraakse regio Sinjar

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish bombings in the Sinjar region of Iraq, including alleged strikes on a refugee camp, a hospital and Yezidi areas, and whether the Netherlands would seek clarification or condemn them. The minister confirmed awareness, said the camp and hospital were reportedly not directly hit according to local sources, cited PKK presence as the reason for Turkish strikes, and said the Netherlands raised the bombings with EU partners and urges restraint and respect for international humanitarian law.
I have also recently raised the Turkish bombings with my European colleagues at the Foreign Affairs Council on 13 July.
Ook heb ik de Turkse bombardementen recentelijk opgebracht bij mijn Europese collega's tijdens de Raad Buitenlandse zaken op 13 juli jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de sponsoring van het tijdelijke EU-voorzitterschap

MP Leijten asked the Foreign Minister about private sponsorship of the EU presidency, the European Ombudsman's recommendation, and transparency calls for the German presidency. The minister answered that sponsorship is not in principle undesirable, that the Council is considering guidelines in response to the Ombudsman, and that the Netherlands supports transparency efforts, without committing to a leading role.
The cabinet is of the view that sponsorship is in principle not undesirable.
Het kabinet is van mening dat sponsoring in beginsel niet ongewenst is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Roemenië schrapt seksuele voorlichting’

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the Foreign Minister about Romania dropping mandatory sex education under church pressure, its effect on women and LGBTI rights, and whether the government will raise concerns with Romania. The minister replied that the law is under review by the Constitutional Court, that the government monitors such developments closely, and that the embassy works with civil society on women's and LGBTI rights, without committing to a new concrete step toward Romania.
The cabinet appreciates the involvement of the various Romanian actors in this and considers it at this stage up to them to set the course for Romania.
Het kabinet waardeert de betrokkenheid van de diverse Roemeense spelers hierin en acht het in dit stadium aan hen om de koers voor Roemenië te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over verdwijningen, marteling en willekeurige detentie door alle partijen in het conflict in Jemen

The MP Karabulut asks the Foreign Minister about a Mwatana report on enforced disappearance, torture and arbitrary detention by all parties in Yemen, and whether the government will press them to end these practices. The minister confirms the findings are very serious, notes Yemen's treaty obligations and the possibility of war crimes, says the Netherlands raised concerns at the Human Rights Council and will keep pressing bilaterally and multilaterally.
The Netherlands will continue to raise its concerns about human rights violations by all warring parties in Yemen in bilateral and multilateral settings.
Nederland zal zijn zorgen ten aanzien van mensenrechtenschendingen van alle strijdende partijen in Jemen onder de aandacht blijven brengen in bilateraal als multilateraal verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over de situatie in Noord-Mozambique

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about the insurgency in Cabo Delgado, Mozambique, including casualties, displacement, funding sources, Mozambican government conduct, press access and the case of a missing journalist. The minister answered that the situation is serious, that Dutch embassy and EU channels have raised concerns about army abuses and press freedom, and that Nederland supports development programmes and a multi-stakeholder platform, without committing to a new concrete step beyond existing diplomacy.
It is unclear whether he was actually taken away by the army.
Het is onduidelijk of hij daadwerkelijk door het leger is meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'IOM deplores killing 30 trafficked migrants Libya'

An MP from D66 asked the ministers about the killing of 30 trafficked migrants in Libya, whether the incident would be investigated, and how Dutch policy addresses conditions for residents and migrants in Libya. The government condemned the incident, called on Libyan authorities for a thorough investigation in the Human Rights Council, and listed humanitarian funding and efforts to close detention centres.

In addition, the Netherlands expressed horror at the incident in a national statement to the Human Rights Council on 18 June and called on the Libyan authorities to conduct a thorough investigation with the aim of holding the perpetrators accountable.

Daarnaast heeft Nederland in een nationale verklaring in de Mensenrechtenraad op 18 juni jl. afschuw uitgesproken over het incident en de Libische autoriteiten opgeroepen tot een grondig onderzoek met als doel de daders ter verantwoording te brengen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Remco Dijkstra over de berichten ‘Duizenden Nederlandse zeelieden nog langer vast op zee door visa-chaos’ en ‘Gestrande zeelieden vormen een dreiging voor de wereldeconomie’

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Affairs and Infrastructure ministers about reports that thousands of Dutch seafarers were stranded at sea because of visa problems, including the visa policy, EU coordination, visa on arrival at Schiphol, and why non-Dutch-flagged ships are excluded. The government acknowledged the welfare problem, described capacity increases at consulates in Manila, Moscow and Jakarta and the priority given to Dutch-flagged ships, and said it would keep monitoring and raise the issue at IMO, ILO and EU level.
This subject therefore has the full attention of the cabinet and has also been raised by the Netherlands with the IMO, ILO and the EU.
Dit onderwerp heeft dan ook de volle aandacht van het kabinet en is tevens door Nederland geadresseerd bij IMO, ILO en de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht 'Afghaanse migranten op de Iraanse grens gemarteld en in rivier gegooid'

Kuzu (DENK) asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Iranian border guards tortured and drowned Afghan migrants, and whether the government would raise this with Iran in the EU and the UN Human Rights Council. Minister Blok said the government awaits the outcome of a joint Iran-Afghanistan investigation, offered Dutch-funded IOM return and reintegration support and COVID care access for migrants, and said Iran's human rights abuses will remain on the agenda in multilateral fora.
The cabinet is awaiting the outcome of this investigation.
Het kabinet wacht het resultaat van dit onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over de verplichte Marokkaanse nationaliteit

Two SP MPs asked ministers whether they would support Dutch-Moroccans seeking to renounce their compulsory Moroccan nationality, whether consular support and Moroccan consular influence in the Netherlands would be addressed, and whether they would negotiate with Morocco and EU partners. The government sympathised with the wish for choice in nationality, said it would raise the issue with Morocco, which pointed to its existing law, and said it would address undesirable foreign influence under its existing approach, without committing to new concrete steps.
The cabinet has understanding for this wish for freedom of choice.
Het kabinet heeft begrip voor deze wens tot keuzevrijheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Koopmans en Wiersma over het artikel ‘Marokkaanse Nederlanders bevrijd ons van de dubbele nationaliteit’

MPs from the VVD asked the government how it responds to Moroccan-Dutch citizens who want to renounce dual nationality, whether Morocco's diaspora institutions interfere in the Netherlands, and what practical help and EU position apply. The ministers answer that renunciation rights should be respected abroad, that foreign interference is handled under the 2018 unwanted-interference approach, and that the Moroccan and Turkish nationality rules are the responsibility of those states.
There can be no question of undesired influence on the individual lives of Dutch nationals and the choices they make.
Er kan geen sprake zijn van ongewenste beïnvloeding op de individuele levens van Nederlanders en de keuzes die zij maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Alkaya en Van den Hul over het bericht dat Nederlandse ambassadeur in Nigeria informatie lekte naar Shell

MPs asked whether the former Dutch ambassador to Nigeria leaked confidential information about a corruption investigation into Shell, and about the integrity investigation, handling and reasons for replacing him. The ministers refused to disclose the integrity findings and related documents citing privacy and integrity-reporting concerns, rejected the claim that he favoured Shell, and gave a limited account of the Niger Delta cleanup.
The answers to questions 1 through 7 and question 9 will be sent to your House on a confidential basis.
De antwoorden op vraag 1 t/m 7 en vraag 9 zullen uw Kamer vertrouwelijk toegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht ‘Suriname vraagt Nederland om coronahulp’

An MP from DENK asked the Foreign Minister about Suriname's request for Dutch COVID-19 aid, including ICU capacity, ventilators, and support for a Surinamese foundation. The minister answered that Dutch medical supplies had arrived, further deliveries and ten ventilators were planned, and aid is coordinated with the health ministry, though many answers refer back to a single general reply.
Currently the possibilities are being examined to temporarily deploy Dutch medical personnel to assist in Suriname.
Momenteel worden de mogelijkheden onderzocht om tijdelijk Nederlands medisch personeel in Suriname assistentie te laten verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Gemeente verleent vergunning voor Frans Klooster/Walram Site’

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers whether the municipality of Sittard-Geleen's permit for a Confucius Institute annex, and concerns about Chinese influence, warranted stricter policy. The minister answered that the municipality decides autonomously, that government is monitoring Chinese influence via a knowledge network and ongoing research, and that it would discuss arrangements with institutions if the research shows a need.
That is the responsibility and free choice of the municipality.
Dat is de verantwoordelijkheid en de vrije keuze van de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van Ojik en Ploumen over de Nederlandse kernwapentaak en de Duitse kernwapendiscussie

MPs Karabulut, Van Ojik and Ploumen asked the government about Dutch nuclear weapons tasks, past nuclear exercises and consultations, US nuclear weapons in Europe, and German debate on nuclear deterrence. The ministers largely declined to give details on nuclear decision-making, exercises and US weapons arrangements, citing binding alliance agreements and security, while pointing to NATO unanimity and committing to arms-control and de-escalation work.
Regarding agreements and procedures for nuclear decision-making and execution of the nuclear weapons task, no statements can be made on the basis of alliance and legally binding agreements.

Over afspraken en procedures voor nucleaire besluitvorming en uitvoering van de kernwapentaak kunnen, op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken, geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over de dood van George Floyd als gevolg van racistisch politiegeweld

MPs Ploumen, Karabulut and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister about George Floyd's death, press arrests and force against protesters in the US, and whether he raised concerns with his US counterpart. The minister condemned the killing, said the Netherlands expressed concern in a videoconference with Secretary Pompeo, and largely deferred to US institutions to investigate and prosecute.
The cabinet trusts that the American democratic rule of law will investigate the death of George Floyd and that justice will be done.
Het kabinet vertrouwt erop dat de Amerikaanse democratische rechtstaat de dood van George Floyd zal onderzoeken en dat recht zal worden gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over straffeloosheid voor Israëlisch geweld tegen demonstranten in Gaza

An SP MP asks the Foreign Minister whether he still stands by his earlier calls for independent investigation and prosecution of Israeli forces over the 2018 Gaza border killings, including the death of medic Razan al-Najjar, and whether impunity prevails. The minister answers that the government still supports independent investigations, has repeatedly urged Israel's military advocate to proceed, notes the criminal inquiry is ongoing, and commits to continued pressure.
While the investigation is ongoing, the MAG makes no further statements on this case.
Lopende het onderzoek doet het MAG geen verdere uitspraken over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma  over het bericht 'Huiveringwekkende» agressie tegen journalisten in VS'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of police violence and rubber bullets against journalists during US protests over George Floyd's death, and whether the government would raise press freedom with US authorities. The minister condemned the violence, said the incidents should be investigated by US authorities, and reported that the Netherlands raised racism and press freedom concerns in a videoconference with Secretary Pompeo and with the US ambassador.
The cabinet cannot say whether journalists were deliberately shot with rubber bullets.
Het kabinet kan zich niet uitspreken of doelbewust met rubberen kogels op journalisten is geschoten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Ploumen over het optreden van China

MPs Van Ojik and Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about alleged Chinese pressure on an EU COVID-19 disinformation report, Chinese attempts to influence officials, the Hong Kong national security law, and Chinese control of the Paracel and Spratly islands. The minister answered that the EU's High Representative denied any watering down, that the government promotes independent analysis and information-sharing, that it condemns the Hong Kong measures together with the EU and will keep monitoring, and that an EU-wide response to the island control is unlikely to succeed, though it will raise maritime security in the EU.
The cabinet considers it of great importance that all parties refrain from actions that undermine the rule of law and the autonomy of Hong Kong within the People's Republic of China.
Het kabinet acht het van groot belang dat alle partijen zich onthouden van acties die de rechtsstaat en de autonomie van Hongkong binnen de Volksrepubliek China ondermijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over Nederlandse kritiek op vermeende onderdelen van het Israëlische regeerakkoord

Baudet (FvD) asked the ministers about Dutch criticism of the Israeli coalition plans, embassy involvement, the location of diplomats' residences, and funding of Israeli and Palestinian NGOs including Al-Mezan and projects marked confidential. The ministers defended the criticism as consistent with international law, stated they do not withhold funding from organisations merely supporting BDS, and declined to name some confidential projects.
This concerns one of the reconciliation projects through which the cabinet implements the coalition agreement's commitment to improving relations between Israelis and Palestinians.

Dit betreft een van de verzoeningsprojecten waarmee het kabinet uitvoering geeft aan het regeerakkoord om zich in te zetten voor verbetering van de onderlinge relaties tussen Israëliërs en Palestijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk en Kuiken over het optreden van de Griekse grenspolitie en de gewonden en de dood van een migrant

MPs Voordewind, Van Dijk and Kuiken asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Greek border police fired live rounds at migrants near the Turkish border on 4 March, leaving six wounded and one Pakistani man dead, and asked for investigations and clarification. The minister answered that the Netherlands has no independent information to confirm or refute the reports, that Greek authorities deny using live fire, and that the government expects border actions to respect international law, pointing to existing complaint routes rather than committing to new action.
The Netherlands does not have independent information to confirm or refute the precise circumstances of the situation at the Greek-Turkish border in early March and the reports about it.

Nederland beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie om de precieze toedracht van de genoemde situatie begin maart aan de Grieks-Turkse grens en de berichten daaromtrent te bevestigen of te ontkrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Wilders en Markuszower over Iraniërs die dreigen met de vernietiging van historische Joodse graftombes

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he would publicly condemn the arson at the Jewish tomb of Esther and Mordechai in Iran, whether he still considered it adequately protected, and whether he would press Iran to protect it. The minister said the Netherlands regularly raises antisemitism concerns with Iran, that local authorities opened an investigation, and that the Supreme Leader's threatening rhetoric is unacceptable, but gave no commitment beyond continued diplomatic engagement.
The Netherlands regularly raises concerns about antisemitism and anti-Zionism in Iran in talks with the Iranian authorities and will continue to do so.
Nederland brengt met regelmaat zorgen over antisemitisme en antizionisme in Iran over in gesprekken met de Iraanse autoriteiten en zal dit blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Maeijer over mogelijke Chinese spionage bij Europese instellingen via de ambassade van Malta

Two PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the Maltese embassy in Brussels was used by China for espionage against EU institutions, whether China paid for its renovation, and what the Netherlands does to prevent such practices. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports, cited Malta's statement that it paid for the renovation and that furniture was donated by China, and declined to comment on specific cases, stating that the government is alert to state actors' covert influence and runs an integrated approach.
The cabinet makes no public statements on case matters that affect the current knowledge level and modus operandi of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over casuïstiek die het actuele kennisniveau en de modus operandi van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten raken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Roon over een Nederlandse diplomaat als spreker bij de organisatie FEMYSO

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a Dutch diplomat took part in an online event of FEMYSO, the youth wing of the European Muslim Brotherhood, and whether such events are subsidised or occur often. The minister answered that the diplomat participated as a private person, that the organisation used his title without approval and he objected, that the ministry does not subsidise FEMYSO, and that officials are reminded of their conduct obligations.
Participation in the event, however, took place as a private individual.
Deelname van het event gebeurde echter als privépersoon.

Antwoord op van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Molen, Leijten, Verhoeven en Kuiken over het onderzoek naar de nevenfuncties van professor Kochenov van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen (RUG) en zijn rol in de promotie van de ver

MPs asked about the RUG-commissioned investigation into professor Kochenov's secondary activities and his role in promoting the sale of passports on Malta, and whether he continued such advisory work. The minister reported that the report was released, that no passport-related advisory activities were found after September 2019 apart from attending a Henley & Partners congress, and that she cannot guarantee such cases will not recur.
The research report has today been made public by the RUG, and as promised I have sent you a copy of this report.
Het onderzoeksrapport is heden openbaar gemaakt door de RUG, een afschrift van dit rapport heb ik u – conform mijn toezegging – doen toekomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en van Helvert over de mensenrechtensituatie in Eritrea n.a.v. de excommunicatie van patriarch Antonios van de Eritrees-Orthodoxe Tewahedo-Kerk en de gedwongen s

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about human rights in Eritrea, including the detention of Patriarch Antonios and other religious figures, the forced closure of Catholic clinics, and interference by Eritrean authorities in religious life among the diaspora in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises these issues bilaterally and in the UN Human Rights Council, has taken diplomatic steps against interference, but that Eritrea shows little sensitivity to pressure and the available instruments are limited.

The Netherlands consistently speaks out about the worrying human rights situation in Eritrea and calls on the country to respect human rights and cooperate with the Special Rapporteur on the human rights situation in Eritrea.

Nederland spreekt zich voortdurend uit over de zorgwekkende mensenrechtensituatie in Eritrea en roept het land op om de mensenrechten te respecteren en om samen te werken met de Speciaal Rapporteur voor de mensenrechtensituatie in Eritrea.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van der Lee over een mogelijke uitzondering voor Nord Stream 2 op de Gasrichtlijn

MPs Van Ojik and Van der Lee asked the ministers whether Nord Stream 2 could obtain an exemption from the EU Gas Directive, what input the Netherlands gave the German regulator, and how energy dependence and security are being addressed. The minister answered that the Netherlands considers it the German regulator's decision, that Nord Stream 2 may appeal and has pursued other legal routes, and that the government sees no immediate need for extra measures on energy dependence.

In my response to the Bundesnetzagentur, I indicated on behalf of the Minister of Foreign Affairs as well that it is not up to the Netherlands to assess whether EU regulations provide a sufficient basis for granting the derogation Nord Stream 2 requested.

In mijn reactie aan Bundesnetzagentur heb ik mede namens de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken aangegeven dat het niet aan Nederland is om te beoordelen of de EU-regelgeving voldoende basis biedt voor het verlenen van de door Nord Stream 2 gevraagde afwijking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de geldverspilling van de EU aan de promotie van vlees

An SP MP asked the minister why the EU spends about 60 million euros since 2017 promoting European meat, a policy at odds with Dutch consumption guidance, and whether the government would push the Commission to stop such subsidies. The minister replied that the Netherlands opposed the EU promotion regulation, will seek to steer funding toward healthy and sustainable food information, and will keep raising objections at EU level, though it could not block the regulation.
As before, I still do not support EU funding for promotion of a specific product, such as bread or meat.
Zoals destijds ben ik nog steeds geen voorstander van EU-financiering van promotie van een specifiek product, zoals brood of vlees.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht 'Protesten in HongKong laaien weer op na ‘coronastop’: zeker 230 arrestaties'

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about police violence against protesters and journalists in Hong Kong, Chinese interference in Hong Kong's autonomy, and whether the government would act at EU and bilateral level, including support for universal suffrage and an independent inquiry into police conduct. The minister answered that the government is concerned, shares the EU's statement on national security legislation, has raised concerns with Beijing and Hong Kong authorities, and supports universal suffrage and an independent inquiry in EU settings.

The government has repeatedly conveyed its concerns over the past year to both the central government in Beijing and the local government in Hong Kong, and will continue to do so as long as there is reason to.

Het kabinet heeft het afgelopen jaar herhaaldelijk zorgen overgebracht aan zowel de centrale overheid in Peking als de lokale overheid in Hongkong, en zal dat blijven doen zolang daar aanleiding toe is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over het feit dat vermogensbeheerder BlackRock de Europese Commissie gaat voorzien van advies over duurzaamheidsbeleid bij bankenbeleid op Europees niveau

SP MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers why the European Commission chose BlackRock, a major investor in fossil fuel companies, to advise on ESG and sustainability in bank regulation, and whether this is a conflict of interest. Minister Hoekstra answered that the contract was awarded through a transparent public tender with nine bids, that expert input is customary, that the Netherlands as a Council member will co-decide EU legislation, and that he sees no reason to intervene in the procurement.
The European Commission awarded the research assignment through a public tender procedure.
De Europese Commissie heeft de onderzoeksopdracht uitgezet via een openbare aanbestedingsprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht 'China: Free Covid-19 Activists, ‘Citizen Journalists’

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Chinese COVID-19 citizen journalists had disappeared, and about censorship's effect on China's official information. The minister affirmed the importance of independent journalism, said he would raise the issue in the EU-China human rights dialogue, and noted the EU had already called for the release of detained citizen journalists.
No, but the cabinet is willing to raise this issue in the human rights dialogues with China of the Netherlands and the EU.
Nee, maar het kabinet is bereid aandacht te vragen voor deze kwestie in het kader van de mensenrechtendialogen met China van Nederland en de EU.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de rol van de Karel Doorman in de Caribische Zee en de oproep van voormalig VN-chef Egeland om economische sancties tegen diverse landen, waaronder Venezuela op te heffen

An SP MP asked why the Karel Doorman is deployed for maritime border patrol near the Leeward Antilles, whether it joins anti-drug operations against Venezuela, and whether the government will support lifting sanctions on Venezuela during the pandemic. The minister answered that the deployment supports the Caribbean Coast Guard against possible COVID-19-related migration, corrected a press release wrongly suggesting anti-drug patrols, and stated that sanctions should not hinder humanitarian aid while the EU keeps them targeted.
The cited Ministry of Defence news item unfortunately contained an editorial error, which gave the impression that the Karel Doorman could also be deployed for anti-drug patrols.

Het aangehaalde nieuwsbericht van het Ministerie van Defensie bevatte helaas een redactionele fout, waardoor de indruk werd gewekt dat Zr.Ms. Karel Doorman tevens kon worden ingezet voor anti-drugspatrouilles.
