Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de oppositie in Hongarije verder in de verdrukking komt

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Hungary's COVID-19 emergency measures are being used to further restrict the opposition and local governments, and what the Netherlands will do about it. The minister says the Netherlands is concerned about Hungary's authorisation law, has raised it with the Hungarian counterpart and in EU forums, supports conditionality of EU funds on rule of law, and will keep pressing via the Commission and the Article 7 procedure.
The cabinet is following developments in Hungary with concern.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen in Hongarije met zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht ‘Europees Parlement pleit voor een noodfonds voor overzeese gebieden’

An MP asked the ministers whether the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom have applied for, and how they would access, a possible EU emergency fund for overseas territories adopted in a European Parliament resolution. The government replied that no such fund exists yet since the Commission has not acted on the call, but that the Commission has redirected existing funds (about EUR 10 million via RESEMBID and access to the B-envelope), and that the Kingdom is working to facilitate access.
The European Commission has so far not acted on this call.
De Europese Commissie (de Commissie) heeft tot op heden geen gevolg gegeven aan deze oproep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over het terug laten keren van Nederlanders uit Marokko

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Ojik asked how many Dutch nationals remain stranded in Morocco, how many have returned, at what level the government is negotiating with Morocco, why Morocco is not allowing them to return, and whether the King should contact the Moroccan King. The minister answered that over 1000 remain registered, about 1300 have returned via four repatriation flights, and that contacts with Moroccan authorities continue at a level chosen for effectiveness, without addressing the reasons Morocco gives or the royal contact proposal.
The Dutch aim is to organise all necessary repatriation flights in the short term.
Inzet van Nederland is om op korte termijn alle benodigde repatriëringsvluchten te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over repatriëringsdiscriminatie bij Nederlanders vanuit Marokko

Parliamentarian Azarkan asked the Foreign Minister about claims that Dutch repatriation flights from Morocco discriminated against passengers by surname or migration background, and about the number of stranded Dutch citizens. The minister denied discrimination, said the embassy had no role in compiling passenger lists, noted over 1,000 remain registered, and committed to organising further repatriation flights under the Bijzondere Bijstand Buitenland initiative.
The passenger lists of these commercial flights are therefore not in the possession of the government.
De passagierslijsten van deze commerciële vluchten zijn dan ook niet in het bezit van de overheid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Karabulut en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlanders in Marokko in het licht van de pandemie

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how many Dutch citizens remain stranded in Morocco, why Morocco is refusing repatriation, what pressure the government applies, and what the EU and other member states are doing. The minister answered that over 1000 are registered, four special repatriation flights and some ambulance flights have taken place, Morocco cooperates on urgent cases, and the government continues to press for repatriation within EU coordination.
The aim of the Netherlands is to organise all necessary repatriation flights in the short term.
Inzet van Nederland is om op korte termijn alle benodigde repatriëringsvluchten te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘China wil de ‘klus’ in Hongkong afmaken’

MPs Ploumen, Karabulut and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the April 2020 arrests of fifteen pro-democracy figures in Hong Kong, whether it will coordinate with EU partners and contact Beijing, and how it reads the Liaison Office's claim that the Basic Law's Article 22 does not bind it. Minister Blok answered that the government and the EU will closely monitor the cases, will seek clarification if needed, and restated that Hong Kong's autonomy under One Country, Two Systems must be respected, while leaving the Liaison Office interpretation to Hong Kong's own legal debate.
The cabinet, together with the EU, will closely follow the further course of their cases.
Het kabinet zal, mede in EU-verband, het verdere verloop van hun zaken nauwgezet volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het gevolgde en te volgen protocol bij coronarepatriëringsvluchten uit niet-brandhaarden

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked whether a COVID-19 repatriation flight from Kuala Lumpur was overcrowded and whether quarantine or protocol changes were planned for such flights. The minister could not independently confirm the footage, said the flight carried 285 passengers and 13 crew under EASA and RIVM guidance, and stated no new measures were being considered for now.
At this moment the cabinet is not considering new measures, but we are monitoring the situation closely.
Op dit moment overweegt het kabinet geen nieuwe maatregelen, maar we monitoren de situatie nauwlettend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma  over de aangenomen noodwet van de Hongaarse president Orbán

Two D66 MPs asked the Dutch ministers about Hungary's emergency law allowing rule by decree without time limit and criminal penalties for disinformation, and what the Netherlands would do regarding rule of law. The government called the Hungarian law worrying, said it raised rule-of-law concerns, and described raising it with Hungary, in the Foreign Affairs Council, through the Article 7 procedure, conditionality in the EU budget and the annual rule-of-law review.
The cabinet finds the steps taken by the Hungarian government and parliament worrying.
Het kabinet vindt de door de Hongaarse regering en parlement gezette stappen verontrustend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Krol en Van Raan over de zaak van dhr. Singh

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers about the case of Mr Singh (J.S.), a Dutch prisoner in the United States, including whether a transfer request was received, whether Nederland can start a transfer procedure, whether a clemency request was made without his knowledge, and what efforts are made on humanitarian grounds. The government answered that no formal transfer request has been received, that the US was told he does not meet the binding criteria, that it expressed humanitarian support diplomatically, and that the initiative lies primarily with Mr J.S.
As far as the question concerns the specific circumstances of detainee J.S., I must inform you that no statements can be made about this for privacy reasons.
Voor zover de vraag ziet op de specifieke omstandigheden van gedetineerde J.S. moet ik u mededelen dat er in het kader van de privacy hierover geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de lancering van een militaire satelliet door Iran

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Iran's launch of a military satellite violates the nuclear deal and UN resolution 2231, and what the Iranian space programme is for. The minister confirmed the launch from open sources, said the IRGC's programme is not regular civilian space activity, and stated the launch is not a breach of the letter of the JCPOA or resolution 2231 though it runs against its spirit, while expressing concern about Iran's ballistic missile programme.
The cabinet is concerned about Iran's ballistic missile programme and regularly raises these concerns in bilateral and multilateral settings.
Het kabinet maakt zich zorgen over het ballistische raketprogramma van Iran en spreekt met grote regelmaat in bilateraal en multilateraal verband deze zorgen uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Becker en Koopmans over de Europese Afrikastrategie

MPs from the VVD asked the government about the new EU-Africa strategy, its migration section, conditionality linking migration cooperation to returns, the EIB president's remarks on open procurement, Chinese contractors in African infrastructure, and untied aid. The minister's answers largely defend the Commission's approach as balanced and consistent with Dutch policy, while declining to press for the specific linkages the MPs proposed and rejecting a shift away from untied aid.
The cabinet assesses the migration section of the Commission communication on the EU-Africa Strategy as balanced
Het kabinet beoordeelt de paragraaf over migratie in de Commissiemededeling over de EU-Afrika Strategie als gebalanceerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Van Ojik , Van der Lee, Özütok, Van den Berge, Buitenweg en Westerveld over de coronacrisis

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about COVID-19 measures, including drug shortages, ventilator procurement, religious gatherings, Hungary's emergency law and EU funds, tourism in the Wadden area, sex workers' access to support, and charity funding. The government answered most questions substantively, declining to ban religious gatherings in non-public places for lack of legal basis and deferring some matters to EU or regional bodies.
The cabinet emphasises that there is currently no reason to ban religious gatherings of fewer than thirty people.
Het kabinet stelt voorop dat er thans geen aanleiding is voor een verbod op religieuze bijeenkomsten van minder dan dertig personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over politieke gevangenen in Turkije

An MP asks the Foreign Minister why Turkey releases tens of thousands of prisoners during the coronavirus pandemic while political prisoners are excluded, and whether the minister will urge his Turkish counterpart to release them. The minister confirms the release of about 90,000 prisoners with exceptions for anti-terror convicts, says the Netherlands has repeatedly raised freedom of expression and the political prisoner issue with Turkey, but states that reliable figures on political prisoners are not available.
The Netherlands regularly raises the human rights situation in Turkey, including freedom of expression, at all levels and will continue to do so, including in European and international contexts.
Nederland kaart de mensenrechtensituatie in Turkije, waaronder de vrijheid van meningsuiting, regelmatig en op alle niveaus aan en zal dit blijven doen, ook in Europees en internationaal verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Van Helvert en Voordewind over de vernieling van graven van christenen in Turkije

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the desecration of Christian graves in Turkey, whether this reflects a rising trend of pressure on Christians, who spreads hate speech, whether Turkish school books label missionary activity a national threat, and whether Turkey effectively prosecutes grave desecration. The minister answered that Turkish authorities prosecute such acts, that the cemetery is being restored and guarded, that reports show no clear increase in pressure on Christians, and that the Dutch government raises minority concerns with its Turkish counterpart.
I also do that in my conversations with my Turkish counterpart.
Ook ik doe dat in mijn gesprekken met mijn Turkse ambtsgenoot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Popken over de waarnemingen van De Zr. Ms. De Ruyter van het incident in de Golf van Oman

MPs De Roon and Popken asked what the Dutch frigate De Ruyter observed of the reported Iranian seizure of the chemical tanker SC Taipei, whether Iran was involved and whether Iran's provocations should be condemned. The Defence Minister declined to share observations for operational reasons, said no cargo was seized as far as the government knows, and stated the government's commitment to de-escalation through the EMASoH mission.
No statements can be made about the observations of Zr. Ms. De Ruyter for operational reasons.
Over de waarnemingen van De Zr. Ms. De Ruyter kunnen om operationele redenen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het lot van vrouwelijke activisten in Saudi-Arabië

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the detention of Saudi women's rights activists, including a princess and her daughter, and what has been done to raise their case. The minister says the case was raised in general terms during a February 2020 visit and in multilateral fora, that the trials are paused due to COVID-19, and that the embassy will keep raising women's rights.
The Netherlands will continue to raise the improvement of women's rights in Saudi Arabia in both bilateral contacts and in the appropriate multilateral fora, as well as at EU level.
Nederland zal in zowel bilaterale contacten als in de daarvoor geëigende multilaterale fora, alsook in EU-verband, aandacht blijven vragen voor de verbetering van vrouwenrechten in Saoedi-Arabië
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over gesloten ambassades, consulaten en EDV-kantoren

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch citizens with non-Dutch partners or children cannot travel to the Netherlands because closed embassies and outsourced service offices prevent visa or MVV applications, and about help for stranded Dutch students without a Dutch address. The minister answered that family members of Dutch citizens can apply again under the exception policy where local conditions allow, and that the Bijzondere Bijstand Buitenland registration closed on 8 April 2020 while 24-hour contact remains available.

The group you mention of non-Dutch family members of Dutch citizens falls under this, and can therefore again submit a visa application or collect their MVV sticker under the current policy in order to join their Dutch family member in the Netherlands.

De door u genoemde groep van niet-Nederlandse familieleden van Nederlanders valt daar onder, en kan dus onder het huidige beleid weer een visumaanvraag indienen of hun MVV-sticker ophalen om zich bij hun Nederlandse gezinslid in Nederland te voegen.

Antwoord op vragen van leden Buitenweg, Van Dam en Groothuizen over de brief van the European Network of Councils for the Judiciary (ENCJ) aan de voorzitter van de Europese Commissie over recente anti-Europese wetgeving

MPs from CDA, GroenLinks and D66 asked the government about the ENCJ letter on Polish rule-of-law reforms, the Polish 'muzzle law' and the Commission's infringement actions, and whether the Netherlands should start an Article 259 TFEU procedure against Poland. The ministers expressed serious concern, noted the Court of Justice's rulings and the Commission's role, supported rule-of-law conditionality in the EU budget, but argued that a Member State-initiated Article 259 procedure is not the appropriate instrument.
The separation of powers and the independence of the judiciary are essential principles of the democratic rule of law and form the core values of the European Union.
De scheiding der machten en onafhankelijkheid van de rechterlijke macht zijn essentiële beginselen van de democratische rechtsstaat en vormen de kernwaarden van de Europese Unie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Nederlandse militairen in Afghanistan

An SP MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about the withdrawal and rotation of Dutch troops in Afghanistan during the COVID-19 pandemic, including what 'essential' personnel means and whether NATO can help fight the virus there. The minister answered that non-essential staff were temporarily withdrawn, explained the quarantine and remote-advice arrangements, and said NATO is not the primary actor for COVID-19 aid in Afghanistan.
As your House was informed on 24 March (reference 2020D11584), the commander of the Resolute Support mission ordered that personnel not essential to continuing the mission be temporarily withdrawn.
(kenmerk 2020D11584 ) is door de commandant van de Resolute Support missie opdracht gegeven het personeel dat niet essentieel is voor de voortzetting van de missie, tijdelijk terug te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Anne Mulder over de Hongaarse noodwet ter bestrijding van het coronavirus

MPs Van der Graaf and Anne Mulder asked the Foreign Minister whether the Hungarian COVID-19 emergency law, which lifts the 15-day limit on decrees and lets the government decide when the state of danger ends, is compatible with EU rule-of-law standards, and what the EU can do. The minister answers that the law raises serious rule-of-law, democracy and fundamental-rights concerns, that the Netherlands raised it with EU partners and the Hungarian minister, and hopes international pressure will lead Hungary to reconsider, without committing to a specific formal step.
The cabinet hopes that international pressure will lead Hungary to reconsider the authorisation law.
Het kabinet hoopt dat de internationale druk Hongarije zal doen bewegen de autorisatiewetgeving te heroverwegen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, De Roon, Van Ojik, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Raan, Krol, Van der Staaij, Kuzu, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlander

MPs asked how many Dutch nationals remain stranded abroad, why repatriation costs are charged, and whether a 300-euro rate should extend to more countries and hardship cases. The minister replied that about 8,000 registered Dutch nationals still wished assistance, that the registration closed on 8 April, that costs are charged after the fact, that Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories will be considered favourably, and that a coulance regime is not appropriate given personal responsibility and budget impact.
I am willing to look favourably at the request to add Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories to the list for which the 300-euro rate applies.
Ik ben bereid welwillend te kijken naar het verzoek om Jordanië, Israël, Libanon en de Palestijnse Gebieden toe te voegen aan de lijst waarvoor het tarief van 300 euro geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ploumen over in Marokko gestrande reizigers

MPs Karabulut and Ploumen asked why about 3,000 Dutch travellers remained stranded in Morocco, what the government was doing to repatriate them, and whether it would show leniency on extra costs. The minister confirmed the figure, described diplomatic efforts with Morocco and the EU, but refused a cost-leniency scheme, citing personal responsibility and budget constraints while offering payment arrangements.
I have made a pressing appeal to Morocco to make this possible.
Ik heb een klemmend beroep op Marokko gedaan om dit mogelijk te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat het Britse Hof van Beroep heeft geoordeeld dat uitbreidingsplannen voor London Heathrow Airport strijdig zijn met de klimaatdoelstellingen uit het Parijsakkoor

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the government whether aviation can still ignore the Paris Agreement after a UK Court of Appeal ruled Heathrow expansion plans unlawful, and how Dutch airport plans such as Schiphol growth and Lelystad Airport fit with climate goals. The government answers that aviation emissions are addressed through ICAO and national sector agreements, that the UK ruling concerns UK planning law, and that Dutch airport decisions require environmental impact assessments which are still pending, without committing to halt the projects.
The government's aim is to achieve CO2 reductions based on the measures described in my letter on aviation climate policy of 27 March 2019.
Het streven van het kabinet is om CO 2 -reducties te realiseren op basis van de maatregelen die zijn beschreven in mijn brief over het klimaatbeleid voor de luchtvaart van 27 maart 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Koopmans over de gezondheidszorg in Afrikaanse landen om een uitbraak van het coronavirus het hoofd te bieden

Two VVD MPs asked the foreign trade/development and foreign affairs ministers about the capacity of African health systems to handle COVID-19, the economic and political risks, the scope for development budgets, and whether European aid should be coordinated. The ministers answered that health systems are weak and the crisis is severe, that Netherlands has allocated EUR 100 million largely via multilateral organisations, and that a Team Europe coordinated approach is pursued.
The cabinet does not yet have a complete picture of the funds available from other EU member states; the European Commission is working on an overview.
Het kabinet heeft op dit moment nog geen compleet beeld van beschikbare middelen van andere EU-lidstaten; de Europese Commissie werkt aan een overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over wapenimporten uit Turkije

An MP asked whether Turkish military imports cost the Netherlands over 16 million dollars in two months, which systems were bought and whether the government would press allies to stop imports from Turkey given Syria and human rights concerns. The government could not verify the figures, said the Ministry of Defence only bought maintenance and modification services for Stinger launching systems, and refused to ask allies for an import ban, arguing that export controls are the more effective tool.
No independent figures are available on imports of military goods from Turkey in the first two months of 2020.
Er zijn geen onafhankelijke cijfers beschikbaar ten aanzien van de import van militaire goederen uit Turkije in de eerste twee maanden van 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over EU-lidstaten die maatregelen nemen vanwege de coronacrisis die verregaande gevolgen hebben voor de democratie

MP Leijten asked the Foreign Minister about Hungary's COVID-19 emergency law enabling rule by decree, its criticism under international law, and the criminalisation of 'panic-spreading' that could affect journalists, and how the Netherlands would address this with EU partners. Minister Blok replied that the Hungarian parliament had lifted the time limit on decrees, that the Netherlands raised concerns at EU level and bilaterally, and that the Netherlands would press for the rule-of-law implications of emergency measures to be put on the agenda of the EU General Affairs Council.

The cabinet, together with like-minded member states, has worked at European level to produce a statement calling on member states to respect the principles of the rule of law, democracy and fundamental rights when taking exceptional emergency measures.

Het kabinet heeft zich er in Europees verband samen met gelijkgezinde lidstaten voor ingespannen om een verklaring tot stand te brengen waarin lidstaten wordt opgeroepen om bij het nemen van uitzonderlijke noodmaatregelen de beginselen van rechtsstaat, democratie en grondrechten te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over het ‘EU Action Plan on Human Rights and Democracy 2020-2024’

MP Koopmans (VVD) asks the Foreign Minister about the EU Action Plan on Human Rights and Democracy 2020-2024, questioning its priorities, its placement of basic rights and religious freedom, and its links to climate activism and other policy areas. Minister Blok defends the plan as broad and consistent with Dutch policy, agrees religious freedom should feature more prominently, and rejects separating climate and human rights policy while denying EU subsidy of climate activists under the plan.
The cabinet agrees with you that the right not to believe or to change one's faith should be expressed more strongly in the action plan.
Het kabinet is met u van oordeel dat het recht om niet te geloven of van geloof te veranderen sterker tot uiting zou moeten komen in het actieplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het niet kunnen vervolgen van Syriëgangers

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked whether a court's refusal to continue prosecuting a Syria returnee who is not in the Netherlands means serious crimes go unpunished, and whether government policy on repatriation will change. The government answered that the court has postponed its decision to 2 June 2020, that courts judge each case on its circumstances, and that it is studying the effects of the ruling and will inform the House if policy changes.
If the current policy changes, the House will be informed about this.
Indien verandering van het huidige beleid plaatsvindt, zal de Kamer hierover worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over de onveilige situatie voor homo’s en transgenders in Iran

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked whether the government had correctly assessed the safety of gay and transgender people in Iran, and whether it had used relevant reports and a letter from 6Rang in its country report. The State Secretary answered that the country report relies on source-verified information, that a supplementary analysis confirmed the March 2019 assessment and found no essential change, and that there is no reason to revise the policy, with a further update planned for 2021.
The conclusion of the investigation is that the situation as described in the March 2019 country report is confirmed.
De conclusie van het onderzoek is dat de situatie zoals deze beschreven is in het ambtsbericht van maart 2019 bevestigd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Leijten over uitbreiding van de Europese Unie

MPs Bisschop and Leijten asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands agreed to open EU accession talks with Albania and North Macedonia, given Copenhagen criteria, absorption capacity, rule-of-law and corruption concerns, and whether alternatives to membership were considered. The minister answered that the Netherlands agreed, that further progress by Albania is required before a formal intergovernmental conference, that the Commission found North Macedonia had achieved tangible results, and that the government is considering the EU perspective in the revised enlargement methodology.
The Netherlands agreed to the opening of accession negotiations with North Macedonia.
Nederland heeft ingestemd met de opening van de toetredingsonderhandelingen met Noord-Macedonië.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over sancties die de bestrijding van het coronavirus belemmeren

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he supports UN calls to suspend sanctions that hinder COVID-19 response, and whether he will press for lifting sanctions and blockades such as those on Yemen and Gaza. The minister answered that sanctions carry humanitarian exemptions, that no signals of obstruction have been received for specific EU or UN sanctions, and that targeted sanctions will not be eased while Yemen and Gaza access issues are being raised with the relevant parties.
For now the cabinet has received no signals from companies or aid organisations that specific EU or UN sanctions hinder the fight against the coronavirus.
Vooralsnog heeft het kabinet geen signalen van bedrijven of hulporganisaties gekregen dat specifieke EU- of VN-sancties de bestrijding van het coronavirus belemmeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over de uitzending ‘WNL op Zaterdag‘ d.d. 7 maart 2020

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Helvert (CDA) asked whether the government is doing enough to collect testimony from Yazidi women and others who suffered under ISIS, so it can be used as evidence in prosecutions. The government answered that it supports NGOs and UN and IIIM mechanisms that collect evidence, stresses victim choice and careful interviewing, and says it is funding Yazda, UNITAD and other programmes, without committing to a new concrete step.
The Netherlands is concretely committed to actively reaching the Yazidi community through, among other things, the support mentioned above for Yazda, UNITAD and the IIIM.
Nederland zet concreet in op het actief benaderen van de Jezidi-gemeenschap door onder meer bovengenoemde steun aan Yazda, UNITAD en het IIIM.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Helvert en Van den Berg over het Coronafonds van de Europese Commissie en over het Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI)-initiatief van de G20

Three CDA MPs asked the government about the EU coronavirus investment initiative (CRII) allocations per member state, why Poland and Hungary receive large sums while the Netherlands receives very little, and about EU vaccine production and CEPI participation. The ministers answered that the CRII redistributes remaining cohesion funds based mainly on economic prosperity and implementation progress, not on COVID-19 impact, and that the government views CEPI positively and will consider a contribution, with information to follow in the weekly Corona letter.
The size of the available CRII budget per member state is therefore independent of the scale of the COVID-19 crisis in that member state.
De omvang van het beschikbare CRII-budget per lidstaat staat dus los van de omvang van de COVID-19-crisis in de betreffende lidstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Karabulut over toeristen in Nederland die vanwege het Coronavirus niet terug kunnen keren

Two SP MPs asked whether the government would act on reports that tourists in the Netherlands with expiring visas cannot return home due to coronavirus, and how many are affected. The minister said visa extensions can be requested by phone from the IND, which judges each case individually, but could not give exact numbers and does not track these cases.
In addition, the IND does not register the number of people who cannot return due to the coronavirus and who for that reason submit a request to extend a visa.
Daarnaast registreert de IND niet het aantal mensen dat niet kan terugkeren vanwege het Coronavirus en om die reden een verzoek om verlenging van een visum indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Asscher over het bericht 'Turkije zet grenzen open: Syriërs naar Europa'

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security and the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkey would open its borders to Syrians heading for Europe, including Dutch diplomatic action on Idlib, the future of EU-Turkey support, and conditions on the Greek islands. The government answered that it considers this unacceptable, sees no signs of large-scale border crossings, supports enforcing the EU-Turkey Statement, and outlined EU and bilateral aid to Greece and humanitarian funding.
It is highly undesirable that people are used in this way for political purposes.
Het is zeer onwenselijk dat mensen op deze manier worden ingezet voor politieke doeleinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het gebruik van MANPADS in de Syrische provincie Idlib en de risico’s voor de burgerluchtvaart

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Infrastructure whether Turkey or Turkish-backed groups used MANPADS in Idlib, whether Turkey's policy was being raised, and what the risks to civil aviation were. The government said it could not confirm who operated the systems, that the matter was raised diplomatically with Turkey, and that Dutch airlines avoid Syrian airspace so no further investigation was needed.
The cabinet does not make public statements about which groups have or have not received NLA support from the Netherlands.
229 ) doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de groepen die al-dan-niet NLA-steun hebben ontvangen van Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Wijngaarden, Ploumen, Van Ojik, van der Graaf, Van der Staaij, van Nispen over het onderzoek van Levada Centrum onder de Russische bevolking naar de publieke opinie over Ned

MPs asked the government about a Levada Centre survey of Russian public opinion on the Netherlands and MH17, including willingness to pay compensation, access to facts, and whether Russians could follow the trial in Russian. The government said it was aware of the survey, that trial information is available online in English and via the Dutch embassy, and that the judiciary chose to livestream the trial in English; a Russian-language livestream of the first session was made by Current Time and the government is looking into Russian summaries.

Within the limits of the law, the judiciary, partly because of the broad and diverse international involvement, decided to set up a livestream so the MH17 trial can be followed worldwide and in English as well as Dutch.

Binnen de mogelijkheden van de wet heeft de Rechtspraak, mede vanwege de brede en diverse internationale betrokkenheid, besloten om een livestream in te richten waardoor het MH17-proces wereldwijd en naast het Nederlands, ook in het Engels te volgen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Stampvol vluchtelingenkamp Lesbos kansloos bij besmetting coronavirus’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security and the Foreign Minister about COVID-19 risks in Greek migrant camps such as Moria, including protection measures, evacuation, and use of EU funds. The government answered that no migrants in Moria had tested positive yet, described Greek and EU containment measures and financial support, and said evacuation is in principle Greece's responsibility, with EU emergency mechanisms available if requested.
Responsibility for the decision on evacuating migrants from the Greek islands lies in principle with Greece.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de beslissing over een evacuatie van migranten op de Griekse eilanden ligt in beginsel bij Griekenland.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Karabulut over een boek over de missie in Uruzgan, Afghanistan

MPs Karabulut asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about a book by a veteran claiming there were no Taliban in Uruzgan and that Dutch force use was excessive and civilian casualties were high. The government rejects the portrayal, says it cannot reliably count enemy or civilian casualties, and says the international mission helped Afghanistan.
Defence did not keep a registration of the number of enemy combatants killed as a result of Dutch action.
Defensie heeft geen registratie bijgehouden over het aantal gevallen vijandelijke strijders ten gevolge van Nederlands optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Belhaj en Groothuizen over een Nederlandse bijdrage aan een gereactiveerde ‘Sophia-missie’

MPs Sjoerdsma, Belhaj and Groothuizen asked the ministers about the Berlin Libya conference, the EU arms embargo monitoring role, reactivating the Sophia mission, humanitarian and migration effects, and a Dutch contribution. The government welcomed the Berlin outcomes, said EUNAVFOR MED Irini (succeeding Sophia) will implement the UN arms embargo, and said a Dutch contribution of staff officers in Rome is likely while further capacity decisions await military advice.
The cabinet is still considering a possible contribution with other capabilities.
Het kabinet beraadt zich nog op een eventuele bijdrage met andere capaciteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut  en Van Ojik over het staatsbezoek aan Indonesië

MPs Karabulut and Van Ojik asked for the programme of the state visit to Indonesia, whether apologies for the colonial past were on it, and why broad apologies had not been given. The minister answered that the programme was adjusted after a boat accident, listed past apologies and spijtbetuigingen by Dutch officials, and stated the King expressed regret and apologies on 10 March 2020.

On 10 March 2020, during the state visit to Indonesia, the King, following earlier statements by Dutch ministers and ambassadors, expressed regret and apologies for acts of violence by Dutch forces in the years after the proclamation.

Op 10 maart 2020 heeft de Koning tijdens het staatsbezoek aan Indonesië, in navolging van eerdere uitspraken door Nederlandse bewindspersonen en ambassadeurs, spijt en excuses uitgesproken over geweldsontsporingen van Nederlandse zijde in de jaren na de proclamatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol en Asscher over de berichten inzake Nederlanders die vastzitten op het cruiseschip Costa Luminosa

MPs Krol and Asscher asked the Foreign Minister why dozens of Dutch elderly passengers remained aboard the Costa Luminosa when other countries had evacuated theirs, what was being done, and whether consular capacity and information were adequate for Dutch citizens stranded abroad. The minister replied that Dutch passengers disembarked in Savona on 23 March and were flown home, that a convenant 'Bijzondere Bijstand Buitenland' was set up to help stranded travellers, and that consular services were reorganised and information channels were in use.
The ministry has no figures on the total number of Dutch travellers abroad.
Het ministerie heeft geen cijfers over het totale aantal Nederlandse reizigers in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de situatie in Kameroen

An MP asked the government about the humanitarian, security and political situation in Cameroon, including refugee flows, human rights, the February 2020 elections, education, and Dutch and EU support. The ministers answered in detail on the crises, Dutch aid of 2 million euros, EU pressure for dialogue, and Cameroon-related asylum figures.
The Netherlands contributed 2 million euros to the emergency aid programme of the Dutch Relief Alliance in Cameroon.
Nederland heeft 2 miljoen euro bijgedragen aan het noodhulpprogramma van de Dutch Relief Alliance in Kameroen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht dat voormalige IS-strijders mogelijk zullen worden overgebracht naar een (te bouwen) instelling in de Ninevé vlakte

MPs Ploumen, Karabulut and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware of and had responded to reports that former IS fighters might be transferred to a planned facility in the Nineveh Plain, and what role the Netherlands would take. The minister answered that the transfer concerns Iraqi nationals, is primarily Iraq's responsibility, that the Netherlands remains in dialogue with Iraq and partners, and that no official transfer decision appears to have been taken.
The transfer to Iraq referred to in the article concerns only people with Iraqi nationality.
De in het artikel aangehaalde overplaatsing naar Irak betreft alleen mensen met de Iraakse nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie de Donald Duck gebruikt voor Europese indoctrinatie door te sturen op enkel een positief beeld van de EU

MP Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about the European Commission's Donald Duck special on the EU, alleging that the Commission's Dutch representation pressured publisher Sanoma-type content to present only a positive picture, funded with Dutch taxpayer money, and failed to disclose the costs and label it as government communication. The minister answered that the Commission, which controls its own communication and answers to the European Parliament, is responsible, that the Dutch government cannot judge the correspondence, that the cost of the EU special is not known to the cabinet, and that the Dutch Advertising Code complaint is for the Reclame Code Commissie to decide.

Given that communication policy falls within the Commission's prerogatives and it is accountable for this to the European Parliament, it is not for the cabinet to call the Commission to account on this.

Gezien het communicatiebeleid binnen de prerogatieven Commissie valt en zij hierover verantwoording aflegt tegenover het Europees parlement, is het niet aan het kabinet de Europese Commissie hierop aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over ondervertegenwoordiging van Nederlandse ambtenaren in Brussel

The MP asks why Dutch civil servants are underrepresented in EU institutions in Brussels, given the 3.9% target against 1.9% among young officials, and what steps are being taken to reverse the declining trend. The minister answers with figures per institution, notes the expected effect of Brexit and retirements, and describes the current recruitment and support measures, while saying it is too early to judge their effect.
It is still too early to see the effects of the current policy. The cabinet is monitoring the effects and will adjust where necessary.
Het is nog te vroeg om de effecten van het huidige beleid te zien. Het kabinet monitort de effecten ervan en zal waar nodig bijsturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Tienduizenden Oeigoeren slachtoffer van dwangarbeid voor bekende merken‘

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the ministers whether the government would investigate Dutch companies using Uyghur forced labour, press China for access and act in the EU and UN. The ministers say the government is raising Uyghur rights bilaterally and multilaterally, expects firms to conduct due diligence under OECD guidelines without government investigation, and plans a business information session postponed due to coronavirus.
It is the responsibility of these companies to map whether they are linked to companies where Uyghurs are employed. The cabinet does not investigate this.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van deze bedrijven om in kaart te brengen of zij gelinkt zijn aan bedrijven waar Oeigoeren tewerkgesteld worden. Het kabinet doet hier geen onderzoek naar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Karabulut over het bericht dat Oeigoeren worden tewerkgesteld in Westerse bedrijven

MPs Alkaya and Karabulut asked the foreign and trade ministers about reports that Uyghurs are employed under forced-labour conditions in Western company supply chains, and whether Dutch firms are involved. The government confirmed awareness, said it cannot independently verify the ASPI findings, pointed to business information sessions and EU/UN diplomacy, and said firms failing IMVO conditions can be excluded from trade missions.
The cabinet cannot confirm the conclusions of the ASPI report on the basis of its own independent information.
Het kabinet kan de conclusies van het ASPI-rapport niet op basis van eigenstandige informatie bevestigen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Van Helvert en Kuik over seksueel geweld tegen christelijke vrouwen

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and CDA asked the ministers about reported sexual violence against Christian women and the Open Doors gender-specific persecution report, including what Dutch foreign and development policy can do about it. The ministers condemn such persecution, describe existing programmes on women's legal equality, child marriage, religious freedom and a EUR 750,000 contribution to psychological care for persecuted believers, but do not change any institutional check.
Persecution on account of a belief or conviction deviating from the majority is considered unacceptable by the cabinet.
Vervolging wegens een (van de meerderheid afwijkende) geloofs- of levensovertuiging vindt het kabinet onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de situatie dat Oeigoeren in China het slachtoffer zijn geworden van dwangarbeid en andere mensenrechtenschendingen

MP Kuzu asked the foreign minister about reports that around 80,000 Uyghurs were forced to work in factories supplying well-known brands, asking which brands, whether products reached the Dutch market, what sanctions were possible, and what action was planned. The government said it cannot confirm the ASPI report's findings independently, that no EU sanctions basis exists, that it will raise the issue in EU and UN fora, and that it will hold a business information session on human rights and supply-chain risks once the coronavirus situation allows.
The cabinet cannot confirm the conclusions of the ASPI report on the basis of independent information but sees sufficient reason to raise this in EU and UN contexts.
Het kabinet kan de conclusies van het ASPI-rapport niet op basis van eigenstandige informatie bevestigen maar ziet voldoende aanleiding om dit in EU- en VN-verband aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de informatievoorziening aan Nederlanders in het buitenland rond de ontwikkelingen van COVID-19

MP Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister what measures were taken to inform Dutch nationals abroad about COVID-19, to keep consular services running, and to protect the health of diplomatic and local staff. The minister answered that travel advice, the 24/7 contact centre, embassy social media and crisis structures were used, and that staff health measures followed Arbo rules and RIVM guidance.
The Dutch network of embassies and consulates and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs remain on standby 24 hours a day to provide consular assistance as well as possible.
Het Nederlandse netwerk van ambassades en consulaten en het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken blijven 24 uur per dag klaar staan om zo goed mogelijk consulaire bijstand te bieden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Koopmans over het bericht  ‘U.S. can’t continue’ tolerating Russian ‘noncompliance’ on Open Skies, Esper says’

MPs Bosman and Koopmans asked whether Defence Minister Esper's concerns about Russian non-compliance with the Open Skies treaty had been shared with allies and whether the Netherlands shares them and is acting on them. Minister Blok answered that the US concerns were raised bilaterally, in NATO and the OSCE, that the Netherlands shares them, has raised them with Moscow and in the OSCC, and has pressed for compliance and the treaty's value without joining any formal joint pressure beyond NATO questionnaires.
The Netherlands, like the US, is of the view that all parties must comply with the obligations under the treaty.
Nederland is net als de VS van mening dat alle partijen zich aan de verplichtingen onder het verdrag dienen te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sjoerdsma over hulp voor Nederlandse uitwisselingsstudenten, stagiairs en instellingen voor hoger onderwijs met de situatie rond het coronavirus

Two D66 MPs asked the education and foreign affairs ministers how universities and universities of applied sciences help exchange students and interns stranded abroad by COVID-19 travel restrictions, including repatriation, study delay funding and whether countries are expelling students. The minister says institutions are supporting students, gives partial abroad counts and points to existing DUO loan and funding options, and says that contacts with foreign affairs and airlines continue, without new binding commitments.
Because developments keep changing and differ by country, it is difficult to determine at this moment exactly how many students abroad are involved.
Vanwege de steeds veranderende ontwikkelingen die ook nog eens per land verschillen is het lastig om op dit moment precies in kaart te brengen om welke aantallen studenten in het buitenland het gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Bijna een miljoen Syriërs zitten als ratten in de val in Idlib – of is er nog hoop?‘

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the government about the humanitarian crisis in Idlib, Syria, and what it is doing to protect displaced civilians and secure aid access. The minister outlined Dutch humanitarian funding channels, EU and UN diplomacy, and the Turkey-Russia ceasefire arrangements, without committing to new national measures beyond existing funding.
The Netherlands provides humanitarian aid in several ways to alleviate the needs of the refugees in Idlib.
Nederland levert op verschillende manieren humanitaire hulp om de noden van de vluchtelingen in Idlib te lenigen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Koopmans, Karabulut, Voordwind en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘In Saudi Arabia, contacting the EU is a crime,

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government reacts to reports that contacting an EU or Dutch embassy is treated as a crime in Saudi Arabia, and whether EU diplomats may attend trials of women's rights activists. The minister answered that the government regards such contacts as legitimate, has raised the matter repeatedly with Saudi authorities, and that EU diplomats have so far been refused access to hearings despite continued efforts.
It is correct that EU diplomats, including Dutch diplomats, have not been granted access to court hearings since autumn 2018.
Het klopt dat EU-diplomaten, waaronder Nederlandse diplomaten, sinds het najaar van 2018 geen toegang hebben gekregen tot hoorzittingen van rechtszaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over bedrijven met banden met illegale Israëlische nederzettingen in bezet Palestijns gebied

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister whether he agreed it is undesirable that Dutch firms named by the UN human rights council have ties to illegal Israeli settlements, and whether he would press them to sever those ties. The government answered that settlement-related business activity is undesirable, but that companies bear their own responsibility under OECD guidelines and it is up to them to decide their activities, while the non-facilitation policy still applies.
It is then up to Dutch companies themselves to determine which activities they undertake and with which partners they cooperate.
Het is vervolgens aan Nederlandse bedrijven zelf om te bepalen welke activiteiten zij ontplooien en met welke partners zij samenwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over een Eurocommissaris die wordt benaderd door de energielobby waar hij zelf aandelen in bezit

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether an EU Commissioner's shareholdings in an energy company that lobbies the Commission, and similar holdings of the High Representative, are compatible with the Commission's ethics code and whether the Dutch government will act with the Ombudsman. The minister answers that the declarations were reviewed by the European Parliament's JURI committee, that the Commission President and the independent ethics committee oversee compliance, and that the government trusts they act where needed.

The government trusts that the President of the European Commission, assisted by the independent ethics committee, oversees compliance with this code of conduct for the members of the European Commission.

Het kabinet vertrouwt erop dat de voorzitter van de Europese Commissie, bijgestaan door het onafhankelijk ethisch comité, toeziet op naleving van deze gedragscode voor de leden van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Belhaj over de EU Battlegroup

Two MPs asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about the EU Battlegroup: whether the Netherlands leads it with Germany in 2020, why Battlegroups have never been deployed, and whether they could support UN missions. The minister confirmed the Netherlands' contribution and explained that unanimity, operational and financial obstacles have blocked deployment, while committing to explore a Battlegroup role in a UN mission before summer 2020.
I promised the House to inform it about this before summer 2020. I will keep this commitment.
Ik beloofde de Kamer hierover voor de zomer 2020 te informeren. Ik zal deze toezegging gestand doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de aangekondigde plannen van Israël om nederzettingen te bouwen in E1-gebied

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the Foreign Minister about Israel's announced plans to build settlements in the E1 area near East Jerusalem and what the Netherlands and EU would do, including responses to a US Middle East peace plan. Minister Blok answered that the Netherlands and EU oppose settlement expansion as undermining the two-state solution, joined a demarche and urged Israel to refrain, but declined to commit to specific measures, saying further steps would be weighed later.
The cabinet does not wish to anticipate this.
Het kabinet wil hier niet op vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over offensieve inzet van Afghaanse agenten in de periode 2011-2013

An SP MP asks the Prime Minister and the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether the Chamber was misled about offensive deployment of Dutch-trained Afghan police in Kunduz (2011-2013), as a post-mission assessment suggests, and why the final evaluation did not report it. The minister replies that the government had always said it could not fully exclude incidental involvement of Afghan police in operations against the Taliban, that structural offensive use was not seen, and that the Chamber was informed of placement problems in 2012-2013.
The government could not and cannot fully exclude that incidentally Afghan civilian police could have been involved in military operations in Kunduz against the Taliban.
De regering kon en kan echter niet volledig uitsluiten dat incidenteel Afghaanse civiele agenten betrokken konden worden bij militaire operaties in Kunduz tegen de Taliban.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over nieuwe Nederlandse kritiek op het Israëlische woningbouwbeleid

MP Baudet asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands joined EU partners in criticising Israeli housing plans in East Jerusalem and the West Bank, and why Dutch diplomats live in East rather than West Jerusalem. The minister defended the demarche as consistent with the two-state policy and Dutch embassy location in Tel Aviv, while committing to no change in position.
The cabinet does not recognise that picture.
Het kabinet herkent zich niet in dat beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Diks, Bouali en Sjoerdsma over het VN-rapport waarin wordt geconstateerd dat diverse landen het VN-wapenembargo tegen Libië schenden

MPs from GroenLinks and D66 asked the government about a UN Panel of Experts report finding that several states violated the Libya arms embargo, including the possible Dutch role of Van der Kamp Shipsales in a warship sale. The minister said the Netherlands raised enforcement at EU level, is investigating the company without yet deciding on measures, and sees no need for additional rules, while noting the limits of post-export controls.
Further investigation is currently ongoing, so the cabinet cannot now say whether there is cause to take measures against the company.
Nader onderzoek loopt op dit moment, daarom kan het kabinet nu geen uitspraak doen over de vraag of er aanleiding bestaat om maatregelen tegen het bedrijf te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij bewapening Libië

An SP MP asked the government about Dutch involvement in arming Libyan factions, including ships sold by a Dutch intermediary and Damen Shipyards vessels later armed, and about possible prosecution and export permit misuse. The minister declined to comment on prosecutions, denied permit misuse since the unarmed ships needed no permit, and outlined reinforced monitoring of the Libya arms embargo.
The cabinet makes no statements about which cases are or are not investigated criminally.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over de vraag welke zaken al dan niet strafrechtelijk worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over een dialoog tussen de Spaanse en Catalaanse regering

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the Foreign Minister about the state of the Spain-Catalonia conflict and whether Spain's government would start a formal dialogue with Catalonia's regional government. Minister Blok answered that a formal dialogue started on 26 February 2020, that it is welcome, but that it is an internal Spanish matter on which the Netherlands sees no reason to intervene unless both parties request it.
Moreover, it concerns an internal Spanish affair. I see no reason for the Netherlands to get involved, unless both parties explicitly asked us to do so.
Het betreft verder een interne Spaanse aangelegenheid. Ik zie geen aanleiding voor Nederland om zich hierin te mengen, tenzij beide partijen ons daartoe expliciet zouden verzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Sudan’s ousted leader is sentenced to two years for corruption’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the two-year corruption sentence of ousted Sudanese leader Al-Bashir, arguing it does not reflect ICC-charged crimes, and asked whether Sudan would be pressed to extradite him and whether EU sanctions or aid should be conditioned on it. The minister answered that Sudan has pledged cooperation with the ICC and domestic prosecutions are planned, that Netherlands is pressing for extradition and accountability, but that conditioning EU aid on extradition is not desirable and sanctions will be decided later depending on developments.

Depending on the progress and outcomes, the ICC's view on cooperation with Sudan and the place of trial, I will decide in the coming months whether or not to proceed with calling for targeted sanctions at EU level.

Afhankelijk van de voortgang en uitkomsten hiervan, de visie van het ICC t.a.v. de samenwerking met Soedan en plaats van berechting meewegende, zal ik de komende maanden besluiten om wel of niet door te gaan met het in Europees verband op te roepen tot persoonsgerichte sancties
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bezoek van de minister aan Zuid-Afrika

An MP from the CDA asks the Foreign Minister about his February 2020 visit to South Africa, including human rights, the planned expropriation of land without compensation, the cancelled bilateral investment treaty, and the Afrikaans language. The minister answers that he pressed for fair compensation and a clear reform timeline, that no new investment treaty is currently possible, and that language policy is a matter for South Africa with support channelled via the Dutch Language Union.
I used this visit to discuss this broad cooperation agenda with my counterpart.
Ik heb dit bezoek gebruikt om over deze brede samenwerkingsagenda te overleggen met mijn counterpart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de zwarte lijst van de VN met bedrijven die zaken doen in Israël

An MP asked the foreign minister about the UN Human Rights Council's list of companies active in Israeli settlements, whether the government would act to get Dutch firms removed or protect them against BDS, and whether the UN is selective and whether the Netherlands should leave the Council. The ministers answered that the list concerns settlement activity rather than doing business in Israel, that the Netherlands abstained but accepts the database must be implemented with hearing rights, that the UN disproportionately targets Israel, and that they will not withdraw from the Council.
The Netherlands urged the High Commissioner for transparency and for hearing and right of reply for the companies concerned.
Nederland heeft bij de Hoge Commissaris aangedrongen op transparantie en hoor- en wederhoor met de betreffende bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en De Roon over het bericht dat de VN een zwarte lijst gepubliceerd heeft van bedrijven die zakendoen in Israëlische nederzettingen

Three MPs asked the foreign minister whether the UN Human Rights Council's published list of businesses active in Israeli settlements is justified, whether it amounts to political condemnation fuelling BDS, and whether the Netherlands will oppose it. The ministers answered that the list follows a 2016 Council mandate, carries no legal judgment or call for boycott, that the Netherlands discourages economic ties with settlements, and that they will raise concerns with EU partners while pushing to remove the agenda item.
The cabinet consults with European partners on the joint approach to the Middle East peace process and the joint approach in the UN Human Rights Council.
Het kabinet overlegt met de Europese partners over de gezamenlijke inzet in het Midden-Oosten Vredesproces en de gezamenlijke inzet in de VN Mensenrechtenraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van Helvert, Van den Berg en Omtzigt over het coronavirus (COVID-19), dat nu in Gangelt is vastgesteld, direct grenzend aan Limburg

MPs of the CDA asked the ministers about COVID-19 cases in Gangelt near the Dutch border, cross-border coordination, quarantine and airport controls, hospital bed capacity, and travel advice. The minister answered that the GGD Zuid-Limburg coordinates with Germany, that airport controls are not considered appropriate, that at least 250 isolation ICU beds exist, and that travel advice follows RIVM risk assessments.
I will answer these questions as soon as possible.
Ik beantwoord deze vragen zo spoedig mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Groeiend verzet tegen Saudisch vrachtship Bahri Yanbu vol wapens’ en ‘Don't let Saudi arms ship dock in UK, say campaigners’

MPs Bouali and Sjoerdsma asked the ministers whether a Saudi cargo ship carrying arms bound for Yemen would be allowed to dock in EU ports, and whether EU states should refuse it under the Arms Trade Treaty and EU Common Position. The government said it lacks information on transit through other EU ports, would not have granted a Dutch transit licence to this ship, and will keep raising the matter with EU partners.
The cabinet continues to point EU member states on several occasions to the tightened Dutch policy and to call on other countries to adopt comparable measures.
Het kabinet blijft EU-lidstaten bij meerdere gelegenheden wijzen op het aangescherpte Nederlandse beleid en andere landen oproepen vergelijkbare maatregelen te hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het zogeheten 'Istanboel 10'-proces

MPs Ploumen, Karabulut and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister about the 'Istanbul 10' trial of eleven human rights defenders arrested in 2017, including concerns about fair trial and the use of Turkish anti-terror law. The minister answered that the Netherlands cannot judge individual prosecutions, monitors the hearings with EU partners, has raised the rule of law and fair trial with Turkey including in EU and UN settings, and continues to support civil society.
The Netherlands may and cannot, however, interfere in the legal proceedings in another state.
Nederland mag en kan zich echter niet mengen in de rechtsgang in een andere staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht dat Turkije Syrische rebellen inzet in de strijd in Libië

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkey deployed Syrian rebels, including former ISIS and Al Qaeda fighters, to Libya, and about alleged war crimes by Turkish-backed groups, and whether the Netherlands would condemn this and address it in the EU and NATO. The minister answered that it is unclear which groups are involved, that the Netherlands condemns foreign interference and urges full implementation of the Berlin agreements and the arms embargo, and that the Non-lethal assistance programme ended in 2018 so the status of delivered goods is hard to trace.
It is currently unclear which fighters or groups are involved, what their background is, and how or by whom they would have been recruited and deployed.
Het is op dit moment onduidelijk om welke strijders of groepen het gaat, wat hun achtergrond is en op welke wijze of door wie zij geworven en ingezet zouden worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een in Turkije gevangengenomen Nederlandse vrouw

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about a Dutch woman detained in Turkey who is reportedly on hunger strike, including her health, consular assistance, the reasons for her arrest, and fair-trial concerns. The minister declined to discuss the specific case for privacy reasons, described consular assistance in general terms, and only expressed general concern about Turkey's rule of law.
For privacy reasons and in line with the general framework for consular assistance, I cannot go further into the substantive aspects of this single case.
Uit privacy-overwegingen en in lijn met de algemene kaders voor consulaire bijstand kan ik niet verder ingaan op de inhoudelijke aspecten van deze ene zaak.
Antwoord op van de leden Kuik, Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de uitbraak van het coronavirus.

Three CDA MPs asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Affairs about the coronavirus outbreak, including its infectiousness during incubation, passenger tracing from the Westerdam, EU coordination, travel restrictions and travel advice. The minister answered that transmission during incubation plays a very limited role per RIVM, that EU coordination runs through ECDC and the HSC, and that WHO and ECDC advise against trade or travel restrictions.
Based on the scientific knowledge of the RIVM, we assume that the new coronavirus is transmitted through coughing and sneezing.
Op basis van de wetenschappelijke kennis van het RIVM nemen wij aan dat het nieuwe coronavirus wordt overgedragen door hoesten en niezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Iraniërs die dreigen met de vernietiging van historische Joodse graftombes

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of threats by Iranians to destroy the historic Jewish tombs of Esther and Mordechai, how Iranian authorities responded, whether the Basij militia belongs to the IRGC and should be listed in the Netherlands, whether the tombs are still registered as heritage, and whether he would press Iran to protect them. The minister confirmed awareness, said Iranian authorities had not responded as far as known, described the Basij-IRGC links and sanctions listings, confirmed the tombs remain registered heritage, and said national legislation already protects them so no need for further pressure appears to exist.
Since the tombs are already adequately protected through national legislation, there does not appear to be any need for this.
Nu de graftombes reeds adequaat beschermd worden middels nationale wetgeving, lijkt hiertoe geen noodzaak te bestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'Hindu minor girl who was forcefully converted renounces Islam; Pakistani mullahs demand death penalty'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the abduction and forced conversion of a Hindu minor girl in Pakistan and calls for the death penalty against her. The minister said the court annulled the marriage and prosecuted the man, that no evidence shows a clear increase in such cases, and that human rights are raised with Pakistan and the EU, including opposition to the death penalty.
It is positive to note that on 19 February the court in Jacobabad declared the marriage of Mehak Kumari void because she is a minor.
Het is positief te vernemen dat op 19 februari de rechtbank in Jacobabad het huwelijk van Mehak Kumari nietig heeft verklaard, omdat zij minderjarig is.
Antwoord op de eerste drie vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg, Kuik en Van Helvert over het coronavirus (COVID-19), dat nu in Noordrijn-Westfalen is vastgesteld, vlakbij Limburg

CDA MPs asked ministers for an update on new COVID-19 infections near the Dutch border, whether German schools had closed, and what advice applies to Dutch schools, firms and travellers. The Minister of Medical Care answered that contact tracing is ongoing in Germany with no need for extra Dutch measures, that German schools closing is noted, and that Dutch schools and workplaces can stay open.
The situation is being closely monitored and measures will follow if necessary.
De situatie wordt op de voet gevolgd en indien nodig volgen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over geweldpleging tegen een Pakistaanse blogger in Nederland

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister whether the government considers Pakistani state involvement in an assault on a Pakistani blogger in the Netherlands, and what it will do to protect him and summon the Pakistani ambassador. The minister answered that the police and prosecutor are investigating, that he cannot comment on individual cases or the outcome, and that the matter must await the investigation before further steps.
It is for the police and the Public Prosecution Service to investigate this report.
Het is aan de Politie en het Openbaar Ministerie om onderzoek te doen naar deze aangifte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over een VN-database met bedrijven actief in Israëlische nederzettingen

An MP asks the Dutch government about the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights' database of companies active in Israeli settlements, including whether the government supports its publication and related criticism. The government answers that it opposed creating the database but must implement the Human Rights Council's mandate, that companies themselves decide their activities under IMVO/OECD standards, and that it declines to comment on the statements of Israeli ministers and the AJC.
The cabinet sees no reason to assume that the High Commissioner did not act carefully.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om aan te nemen dat de Hoge Commissaris niet zorgvuldig te werk is gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de passagiers op het schip Westerdam

MPs Kuik, Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked about passengers stranded on the cruise ship Westerdam in Cambodia, their information, repatriation, passenger lists, and the RIVM's earlier claim that people are only contagious once symptomatic. The minister answered that most questions were addressed in an earlier letter, that about 30 Dutch nationals have returned, that returnees are monitored by the GGD, and that current RIVM knowledge supports the incubation and transmission figures, while acknowledging the contagiousness statement as based on current evidence.
Answer 2, 3, 4, 5 and 7 These questions I have already answered in the letter to the House of 17 February.
Antwoord 2, 3, 4, 5 en 7 Deze vragen heb ik reeds beantwoord in de Kamerbrief van 17 februari jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Karabulut over een bezoek aan het noorden van Marokko

MPs Marijnissen and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about political prisoners from the Hirak movement in northern Morocco, trials, torture allegations, detention conditions, development aid and migration. The minister said the Netherlands monitored trials, had raised concerns, and would not verify torture claims independently, and that it lacks data on many detainees and cannot take a position on the broader questions asked.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not keep track of how many detainees in Morocco are serving sentences for their participation in the Hirak movement, as they are not persons with Dutch nationality.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken houdt niet bij hoeveel gedetineerden in Marokko een straf uitzitten naar aanleiding van hun deelname aan de Hirak-beweging, daar het geen personen met de Nederlandse nationaliteit betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over het bericht dat de huidige Voorzitter van de Raad van de Europese Unie wordt gesponsord door de gaslobby

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked whether the Croatian EU Council presidency accepting corporate sponsorship, including from oil company INA, is acceptable, and how this relates to the EU Ombudsman's call for strict rules and to the Green Deal. Minister Blok replied that sponsorship is in principle not undesirable, that the Council will respond to the Ombudsman's recommendations by 6 April 2020, and that the Dutch aim is guidelines similar to those of the Dutch 2016 presidency.
The cabinet is of the view that sponsorship is in principle not undesirable.
Het kabinet is van mening dat sponsoring in beginsel niet ongewenst is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Annahita (22) krijgt duizenden reacties nadat ze als enige op vlucht naar VS wordt geweigerd'

MPs Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the ministers about reports that a Dutch woman was refused boarding to the US at Schiphol, whether the US immigration liaison officers have powers on Dutch soil, and about pre-clearance negotiations. The government declined to comment on the individual case, stated that IAP officers only advise airlines and need consent for photographs, and said pre-clearance negotiations are ongoing with Dutch sovereignty and Dutch standards to be respected.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de brief die ministers oproept om van de EU een sterkere geopolitieke speler te maken

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the High Representative's December 2019 letter calling for the EU to become a stronger geopolitical player, and about the stalled Commission proposal for qualified majority voting in parts of the CFSP/CSDP. The minister largely agrees with the aim, says the Netherlands will keep raising QMV and encourages constructive abstention, but states there is no formal proposal on the table and gives no concrete timetable.
I have repeatedly called for a substantive discussion with the other 27 Foreign Ministers.
Ik heb meerdere malen opgeroepen tot een inhoudelijke discussie met de andere 27 Ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over burgerslachtoffers door Nederlands optreden in de strijd tegen Islamitische Staat

MP Karabulut asked the Prime Minister and the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about civilian casualties from the Dutch bombing at Hawija in June 2015, including when officials were informed, whether information was withheld from parliament, and compensation. The government answers that the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister were informed only in general terms about secondary explosions and possible civilian harm without figures, that an ICRC list was not shared with parliament, that the OM investigation documents cannot be made public, and that compensation options and a progress letter are still being studied.
It was standing policy that for operational reasons and domestic security no statements were made about specific cases.
Het was staand beleid dat om operationele redenen en omwille van de binnenlandse veiligheid geen uitspraken werden gedaan over specifieke gevallen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de stand van zaken in de processen tegen de door Nederland uitgeleverde Rwandezen I. en M. en de zaak tegen de moeder van de Rwandese oppositiepolitica Victoire Ingabire

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about the progress of trials in Rwanda against two genocide suspects extradited from the Netherlands, the delay in their trials, and the case concerning the mother of Victoire Ingabire, including the confiscation of her passport. The ministers answered that trials are being monitored by the ICJ, that the High Court trial of one suspect is nearing conclusion while no end date is given for the other, that they see no unreasonable delay, and that they decline to comment on the passport case while defending extradition as responsible.
It is my custom to exercise restraint in my statements on ongoing cases.
Er past mij, zoals gebruikelijk, terughoudendheid in mijn mededelingen over lopende zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ploumen, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het intrekken van perskaarten in Turkije

MPs from SP, PvdA, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkey revoked press cards of journalists from the paper Evrensel, whether this fits a pattern of state repression, and whether the Netherlands will press Turkey on press freedom. The minister answered that the Evrensel revocations were reversed, that Turkey has revoked nearly 3,804 press cards since 2015, and that the Netherlands raises press freedom concerns with Turkey at all levels, including with the Turkish foreign minister and within the EU and Council of Europe.
The Netherlands therefore continuously raises concerns about the lack of press freedom in Turkey with Turkey at all levels.
Nederland brengt daarom in contacten met Turkije voortdurend en op alle niveaus de zorgen over het gebrek aan persvrijheid in Turkije op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Koopmans, Sjoerdsma en Krol over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2020 van Open Doors

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2020 ranking on Christian persecution, including rising violence in Africa, China's church closures and the role of faith-based actors. The minister acknowledged serious concern, described existing programmes and diplomatic efforts, and committed to continued engagement without introducing new measures.

The cabinet shares your great concern about the trend identified by Open Doors of an increasing number of persecutions of Christians on the basis of their religion and the increasing number of attacks on churches and Christian buildings.

Het kabinet deelt uw grote zorg over de door Open Doors gesignaleerde trend van een toenemend aantal vervolgingen van christenen op basis van hun religie en het toenemend aantal aanvallen op kerken en christelijke gebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat Syrische vluchtelingen die christen zijn geweigerd worden in VN-opvangkampen

An ChristenUnie MP asked the ministers whether Syrian Christian refugees are refused entry to UN camps in Jordan and whether separate camps or investigation are needed. The government says it has no information confirming refusals, is in ongoing dialogue with UNHCR on non-discrimination, sees no structural discrimination, and rejects separate camps.
The government has no information that Christian refugees are being refused in the UN refugee camps in Jordan.
Het kabinet heeft geen informatie dat christelijke vluchtelingen geweigerd worden in de VN-vluchtelingenkampen in Jordanië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Maeijer over het bericht dat Griekenland volgend jaar 100.000 migranten verwacht

Two PVV MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how the Netherlands would prevent migrants expected in Greece from reaching Dutch soil, and about Dutch funding to Turkey under the EU-Turkey deal. The government answered that the EU-Turkey statement has reduced irregular flows, that the Dutch contribution is EUR 140 million to Syrian refugees in Turkey, and that border controls follow the Schengen acquis with shared EU responsibility.
This makes the Statement an effective instrument in countering illegal migration.
Dit maakt de Verklaring een effectief instrument in het tegengaan van illegale migratie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van den Berg, Amhaouch en Omtzigt over het feit dat Italië alle vluchten tussen Italië en China heeft opgeschort

Four CDA MPs asked ministers about Italy suspending China flights, Chinese tourists with coronavirus in Italy, KLM suspending China flights, travel advice, EU coordination, quarantine of returnees, and international support for vulnerable countries. The government answered that Dutch procedures match Italy's, that EU health measures remain with member states, that it follows WHO advice against disproportionate restrictions, and that no additional Dutch funding seems necessary now.
Measures regarding health are reserved to the member states.
Maatregelen ten aanzien van de gezondheid zijn voorbehouden aan de lidstaten.
