Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over De veroordeling van de Chinese voorganger Wang Yi

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the criminal convictions of Chinese church leaders Wang Yi and Qin Defu, the implications of China's 2018 religion law, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister confirmed Dutch concern, described an embassy statement and EU-level advocacy, and promised to raise Qin Defu's case through regular dialogues and to pass on concerns about the religion law.
The cabinet is also willing to raise the case of Qin Defu with the Chinese government through the regular dialogues with the Chinese authorities.
Het kabinet is tevens bereid om de zaak van Qin Defu aan te kaarten bij de Chinese overheid via de reguliere dialogen met de Chinese autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Raak over het meewerken van Aruba Airlines aan de uitzetting van dissidenten uit Cuba

An MP asked whether Aruba Airlines helped Cuba deport dissidents, and whether the Dutch government knew and could have approved it. The minister answered that aviation is an Aruban matter, the airline denies knowingly facilitating forced deportation, Aruba's government was not informed beforehand, and the Kingdom countries could adopt rules if they wish.
Aviation is a matter for Aruba.
Luchtvaart is een aangelegenheid van Aruba.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Voordewind over het bijwonen van de herdenking in  Armenië

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister which minister would attend the April 2020 Armenian genocide commemoration in line with a motion, whether he would visit the Tsitsernakaperd monument and lay a wreath, and how he would raise the genocide with Armenia. The minister confirmed he visited Yerevan and laid a wreath, but said the attending minister for April would be announced later.

That is still being discussed. As also mentioned during the 2019 foreign affairs budget debate, the House will be informed in advance of the commemoration about who will attend on behalf of the Netherlands.

Daarover wordt nog gesproken. Zoals ook gemeld tijdens de BZ Begrotingsbehandeling voor 2019, zal de Kamer voorafgaand aan de herdenking worden geïnformeerd wie namens Nederland aanwezig zal zijn bij deze herdenking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Diertens over de betrokkenheid van Aruba Airlines bij het uitzetten van Cubaanse mensenrechtenverdedigers, journalisten en andere activisten

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Aruba Airlines was involved in deporting Cuban activists, whether this will be investigated, and what support or compensation the Kingdom can offer. The minister said aviation is an Aruban matter, that Aruba's government and the airline deny knowing participation, and that the embassy raised the issue with Cuba, which denies the allegations.
Aviation is, under the Charter for the Kingdom of the Netherlands, a matter for the constituent country and not a matter for the Kingdom.
Luchtvaart is op grond van het Statuut voor het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden een landsaangelegenheid en geen aangelegenheid van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over het bericht dat een Chinese geneticus van het Erasmus MC werkt voor de Chinese politie

MPs Van Helvert and Van der Molen asked the government about reports that a Chinese geneticist at Erasmus MC worked for the Chinese police, and what the government had done in response, including contacts with China, funding, screening of Chinese researchers and university awareness. The minister answered that the disputed face-shape research was separate from the Rotterdam height study, was not funded by Erasmus MC or the EU, that the Chinese embassy was warned about misuse of knowledge, and that the cabinet is examining broader knowledge-security measures.

I cannot give detailed statements on what information is or is not known to the intelligence and security services, because this would reveal the current knowledge level, modus operandi and/or sources of the services.

Ik kan geen gedetailleerde uitspraken doen over welke informatie al dan niet bekend is bij de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten omdat dit inzicht geeft in het actuele kennisniveau, de modus operandi en/of bronnen van de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over vermeende “jarenlange misleiding over de oorlog in Afghanistan”

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether leaked US interviews showing repeated deception about the Afghanistan war, corruption, Afghan forces' readiness and progress, and the Dutch communication on it, were a concern. The government acknowledged the complexity and corruption problems, said the interviewees' views are personal, and admitted transparency and communication need improvement, referring to the post-mission review (PMB) Kunduz.
The cabinet underlines the importance of transparency about what does and does not go well in military and other deployments abroad.
Het kabinet onderstreept het belang van transparantie over wat er wel en niet goed gaat bij militaire en andere inzet in het buitenland.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Omtzigt, Van Helvert, Paternotte en Sjoerdsma over het feit dat Nederlandse luchtvaartmaatschappijen tot 8 januari over Irak en Iran bleven vliegen en over de opvolging van aanbe

MPs asked why Dutch airlines kept flying over Iran and Iraq until 8 January 2020, what information was shared, and how the OVV's MH17 conflict-zone recommendations have been implemented. The minister answered that KLM stopped flying there about 1.5 hours after the US FAA ban, that EASA and ICAO advisories were issued and the status of each OVV recommendation was described, while stating that airspace sovereignty and closure duties lie with states and promising further international and national follow-up.
Following the attack on the Iranian general on 2 January, the situation was actively monitored by the Netherlands (Expert Group of the Convenant on sharing threat information for civil aviation).
Naar aanleiding van de aanslag op de Iraanse generaal op 2 jan jl. is de situatie door Nederland (Expertgroep van het Convenant deling dreigingsinformatie burgerluchtvaart) actief gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Emiel van Dijk over het bericht dat de EU-steun aan Marokko nauwelijks effect heeft

MPs Maeijer and Van Dijk asked whether EU aid to Morocco, criticised by the European Court of Auditors as ineffective, could be recovered, how much Dutch money had flowed there, and why funding should continue given Morocco's refusal to take back rejected nationals. The minister answered that the ECA found limited effectiveness but no evidence of misappropriation, gave the aid totals and Dutch share, and said migration cooperation is pursued through EU instruments while the NDICI negotiations are still ongoing.
The report contains no indications of misappropriation.
Het rapport bevat geen aanwijzingen voor malversaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de onderdrukking van Oeigoeren door de Chinese overheid

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister about Chinese state repression of Uyghurs, including intimidation of the Uyghur diaspora in the Netherlands, complaints, intelligence monitoring, detention of relatives in Xinjiang, the China Cables, US-style legislation and sanctions. The minister confirmed rising reports of pressure from China, said the government raises the issue bilaterally and in the EU and UN, declined to confirm individual complaints or intelligence methods, and said Dutch visa sanctions and Chinese-company sanctions are not currently feasible at EU level, while an EU thematic human-rights sanctions regime is being prepared.
The cabinet cannot make statements about the working methods of the intelligence services.
Het kabinet kan geen uitspraken doen over de werkwijze van de inlichtingendiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over de aankoop van Maltese paspoorten door spionnen, fraudeurs, mensenhandelaren en belastingontduikers

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether the government shares concern that Maltese passports sold to investors have gone to suspected criminals and spies, and whether it will press Malta on its vetting. The government said it finds such passport sales undesirable, relies on Malta's due diligence checks, and will pursue dialogue at EU level once the Commission's expected 2020 report is published.
The government shares that concern and considers the so-called sale of passports, whereby a third-country national can also obtain EU citizenship, an undesirable form of naturalisation.
Het kabinet deelt die zorg en acht het zogenoemd verkopen van paspoorten, waardoor een derdelander ook het EU-burgerschap kan verkrijgen, een onwenselijke wijze van naturalisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Omtzigt, Kuiken en Verhoeven over de paspoorthandel van Malta en de betrokkenheid van een professor van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

MPs asked the government about Malta's citizenship-by-investment scheme, the listed buyers of Maltese passports, the AIVD warning, the Rule of Law situation in Malta, and a Groningen professor's links to a passport firm. The minister answered that the Maltese list covers all naturalisations, that the Commission is monitoring such schemes and the government will seek dialogue, that the Prime Minister raised rule-of-law concerns with his Maltese counterpart, and that the university is examining the professor's activities.
The cabinet considers the sale of passports to non-EU citizens who are suspected of crimes to be undesirable.
Het kabinet acht de verkoop van paspoorten aan niet-EU burgers, die onder verdenking staan van misdrijven, ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Markuszower en Wilders over Erdogan die dreigt politieke tegenstanders in Europa te kidnappen of vermoorden

MPs De Roon, Markuszower and Wilders asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers whether Erdogan's reported threats to kidnap or kill political opponents in Europe were known, how many Turkish extradition requests Netherlands received since 2016, and what measures were taken. The government said it knows of reports on repatriation of Turkish nationals from third countries, has no indication of Turkish kidnapping teams active in the Netherlands, and that police and prosecutors are alert and urge victims to file complaints.
The cabinet currently has no indication that Turkish abduction teams are active in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet heeft op dit moment geen aanwijzing dat er in Nederland Turkse ontvoeringsteams actief zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Molen over het onderzoek naar de nevenfuncties van professor Kochenov van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Molen asked about the investigation into Professor Kochenov's outside positions, including advisory work for Malta and links to Henley & Partners and the Investment Migration Council, and the Paradise Papers. The minister answered that an external investigation by the University of Groningen is underway, that the Inspectorate has not yet received results, that the report is expected in Q1 2020, and that the university is responsible for publishing it, with a commitment to forward a published version to parliament.
The dissemination and degree of publicity is the responsibility of the RUG.
De verspreiding en mate van openbaarheid is de verantwoordelijkheid van de RUG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Maeijer over Moldaviërs die naar Nederland worden gesmokkeld

MPs Emiel van Dijk and Maeijer asked about Moldovans being smuggled to the Netherlands, how many have applied for asylum since visa-free travel in 2014, whether medical and reception support should stop, whether visa-free travel causes illegal stay, and whether the emergency brake or visa reintroduction should be used. The government reported asylum and return figures, restricted medical care for the first two months of reception from 1 December 2019, said the emergency brake is not currently appropriate, and promised a letter on the asylum outcomes in Q1 2020.
Parliament will be informed in the first quarter of 2020 about how the asylum applications of the group of Moldovans who arrived from November are being handled.
Over de afhandeling van de asielaanvragen van de groep Moldaviërs die vanaf november zijn ingestroomd wordt uw Kamer in het eerste kwartaal 2020 geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de aankondiging van de premier van Albanië, Edi Rama, dat hij paspoorten gaat verkopen aan rijke mensen van buiten de Europese Unie (die nu recht geven op reizen in het Schenge

Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister and Prime Minister about Albanian PM Rama's announced sale of passports to non-EU wealthy buyers, including tax concessions, and whether visa-free travel for Albanians should be suspended via the emergency brake. Minister Blok answered that the proposal was halted after Commission criticism, that Albania is sovereign over its tax and citizenship rules, that the Commission is monitoring such schemes, and that he sees no grounds to renew the emergency-brake request.
What he literally said in London is not known to the Cabinet.
Wat hij letterlijk in Londen heeft gezegd is het Kabinet niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de OPCW Douma-documenten op Wikileaks

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister whether leaked OPCW Douma documents were authentic, whether the final Douma report was sound, and whether an inquiry into its preparation was warranted. The minister replied that the OPCW has launched an independent investigation into the leaks, that he sees no reason to doubt the report's process or conclusions, and that no separate inquiry is needed.
No. As I indicated above, I find the OPCW's explanation convincing and appreciate the organisation's own handling of this matter.
Nee. Zoals ik hierboven heb aangegeven, vind ik de uitleg van de OPCW overtuigend en apprecieer ik de aanpak van deze kwestie door de organisatie zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van der Staaij over de gebeurtenissen op 1 december in West Papoea

MPs Ploumen and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister about the harsh Indonesian response to 1 December demonstrations in West Papua, including police entering a church and detaining people. The minister said over a hundred people were arrested, most released, that Papua human rights are a standing agenda item in bilateral and EU dialogue, and that the issue will be raised during the March state visit.
The situation in Papua will therefore also be raised during the state visit in March.
De situatie in Papua zal daarom ook tijdens het Staatsbezoek van maart a.s. aan de orde worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over een gepland optreden van de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Israël op een conferentie van NGO Monitor

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the planned participation of the Dutch ambassador to Israel in an NGO Monitor conference, and about the government's stance on NGO Monitor, the Israeli Ministry of Strategic Affairs, BDS and the IHRA antisemitism definition. The minister confirmed the participation, said the government monitors but does not track contacts between the Israeli ministry and Dutch actors, and defended the decision as a way to present Dutch policy to Israeli audiences while distinguishing criticism of Israeli policy from antisemitism.
The cabinet does not monitor possible contacts between the Israeli Ministry of Strategic Affairs and persons or organisations in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet monitort niet eventuele contacten tussen het Israëlische Ministerie van Strategische Zaken en personen of organisaties in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over vernietiging van Europees gefinancierde projecten in Palestina

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel's defence minister threatened to demolish EU-funded projects in occupied Palestinian territory, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The government says the report is based on a closed briefing, cites Israel's obligations under occupation law, and says it demands compensation and seeks to prevent demolitions, without announcing sanctions.
The report is based on a closed briefing for the EU ambassadors by Minister Bennett.
Het bericht is gebaseerd op een besloten briefing voor de EU-ambassadeurs door Minister Bennett.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de Amerikaanse luchtaanval op de internationale luchthaven van de Iraakse hoofdstad Bagdad, waarbij de Iraanse generaal Qassem Soleimani om het leven is gekomen

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about the political consequences of the US strike at Baghdad airport that killed Qassem Soleimani, whether the government condemns it and its legality under international law, and whether the Hormuz naval deployment should be reconsidered. The ministers said Soleimani's militia role justified US concern but called for restraint, supported E3 dispute-settlement steps on the JCPOA, could not assess the US self-defence claim, and kept the EMASOH deployment while promising to inform parliament before departure if developments warrant.
If further developments give cause for this, they will be included in the letter that reaches your House before the Dutch frigate departs.
Indien verdere ontwikkelingen daartoe aanleiding geven, zullen deze worden meegenomen in de brief die uw Kamer toekomt, voor vertrek van het Nederlandse fregat
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over de Zembla-uitzending ‘Doelwit Volkel’

Three MPs asked whether the Netherlands has a veto over US nuclear weapons at Volkel, whether the Dutch pilots must follow a US order, and whether the government will confirm the presence of nuclear weapons. The ministers answered that NATO decisions require unanimity and Dutch consent, but that numbers, locations and procedures cannot be disclosed for security and binding alliance reasons, and that efforts to increase transparency have gained no support.

On the numbers and locations of US nuclear weapons present in Europe, as well as the precise procedures for nuclear decision-making and execution of the nuclear task, no information can be provided, on the basis of alliance and legally binding agreements.

Over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens, alsmede de precieze procedures voor nucleaire besluitvorming en uitvoering van de kernwapentaak kunnen, op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken, geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Nederlands vetorecht in geval van inzet kernwapens

An SP MP asks whether the Netherlands has a veto over US nuclear weapon use, the legal basis for Dutch personnel's role, the 1992 nuclear accident agreement and the B61 modernisation. The ministers answer that NATO decisions require unanimity so Dutch consent is always needed, but refuse details on locations, procedures and the agreement citing security and NATO confidentiality obligations.

Regarding the number and locations of US nuclear weapons present in Europe, as well as the precise procedures for nuclear decision-making and execution of the nuclear task, no information can be provided, based on allied and legally binding agreements.

Over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens, alsmede de precieze procedures voor nucleaire besluitvorming en uitvoering van de kernwapentaak kunnen, op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken, geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht dat de Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid niet welkom is in Marokko om te praten over het terugsturen van uitgeprocedeerde Marokkanen

An MP asked whether the State Secretary for Justice and Security was refused a meeting in Morocco on returning rejected Moroccan asylum seekers, and what reasons Morocco gave. The government denied any refusal, said talks continue at several levels, and that a visit is being planned.
The State Secretary for Justice and Security already stated during the second round of the Justice and Security budget debate on 21 November that she was not refused by Morocco.
De Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid heeft tijdens de tweede termijn van de begrotingsbehandeling Justitie en Veiligheid op 21 november reeds gemeld dat zij niet door Marokko is geweigerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het feit dat de Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid werd geweigerd in Marokko

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the State Secretary for Justice and Security was refused a visit to Morocco, why, and what the government has done about it and about returns of Moroccan nationals. The government answered that the State Secretary was not refused, that a meeting is being planned, that relations are broad but returns have yielded few results, and that talks on returns continue.
In addition, work is underway to plan a meeting for the state secretary to visit her Moroccan counterpart.
Daarnaast wordt gewerkt aan het plannen van een afspraak voor een bezoek van de staatsecretaris aan haar Marokkaanse ambtgenoot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over legale en veilige abortus in Europa

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about access to legal and safe abortion in Europe, including the claimed figure of 15 million women without access, prosecutions in some countries, and whether the government will raise this with other states and the Commission. The minister says he does not recognise the 15 million figure, lists countries with restrictions, and says the Netherlands raises SRHR concerns in regular contacts while avoiding counterproductive steps, without committing to a new initiative.
The figure of 15 million women is not known to me.
Het aantal van 15 miljoen vrouwen is mij niet bekend.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het uitblijven van een gezamenlijke verklaring van de Europese lidstaten aangaande de beleidsverandering van de Verenigde Staten met betrekking tot Israëlische nederzettingen o

MP Ploumen asks the Foreign Minister about the failure of a joint EU statement criticising the US shift on Israeli settlements, reportedly blocked by Hungary, and whether the Netherlands will issue its own statement. The minister replies that Dutch and EU policy is unchanged, that the High Representative already restated the position on behalf of the EU, and that the Netherlands sees no need for a separate statement, without committing to new action.
The cabinet attaches importance to EU unity on the Middle East peace process and compliance with international law.
Het kabinet hecht aan EU-eensgezindheid op het Midden-Oosten Vredesproces en de naleving van internationaal recht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'EU diplomat ordered to leave Malawi after protesting police rape allegations’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that an EU diplomat was ordered to leave Malawi after protesting police rape allegations, and what the Netherlands had done about police violence against women and press freedom in Malawi. The minister replied that EDEO found the reports of expulsion incorrect, that the EU delegation is monitoring the situation and raised violence against women in the November 2019 political dialogue, and that the issue will remain on the agenda.
The Netherlands will continue to follow the dialogue between the EU and Malawi closely, and will ask the EU to keep raising violence against women and freedom of expression in the political dialogue.
Nederland zal de dialoog tussen de EU en Malawi met aandacht blijven volgen, en de EU vragen het geweld tegen vrouwen en de vrijheid van meningsuiting in de politieke dialoog op te blijven brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Diks en Van Ojik over de investeringen van Nederlandse pensioenfondsen in controversiële wapenhandel

MPs Smeulders, Diks and Van Ojik asked the government about a PAX report showing Dutch pension funds invest over 1 billion euros in arms companies supplying Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Egypt, and what the government can do about it. The minister answered that pension investment policy is for funds and supervisors (AFM, DNB), that arms export rules were tightened for Saudi Arabia and the UAE, and that compliance with the IMVB pension covenant is voluntary but monitored.
It is not my task to supervise the investment policy of pension funds. That is for the supervisors, the Authority for the Financial Markets (AFM) and De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).
Het is niet mijn taak om toezicht te houden op het beleggingsbeleid van pensioenfondsen. Dat is aan de toezichthouders Autoriteit Financiële Markt (AFM) en De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Helvert over het bericht 'België houdt grens dicht voor directeur Confucius-instituut'

Two CDA MPs asked whether the government was informed that Chinese professor Xinning Song was barred from Belgium and the Schengen area, and about screening, Chinese intelligence obligations and Confucius Institutes in the Netherlands. The minister replied that Belgium did not actively inform the Netherlands, that no security screening applies to Confucius Institute staff, that Chinese law cannot be ruled out as requiring cooperation with intelligence services, and that knowledge-security measures and a broader study are underway.
When relevant developments arise on this, I will inform the House further.
Bij relevante ontwikkelingen hieromtrent zal ik uw Kamer nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over door CENTCOM erkende burgerslachtoffers in Irak en Syrië

An MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the 1,346 civilian deaths acknowledged by CENTCOM in Iraq and Syria are confirmed, whether they include the Dutch strikes at Hawija and Mosul, and how the figures were verified. The minister answered that CENTCOM counts 1,347 confirmed civilian deaths, that the Hawija deaths were never confirmed and are excluded, and that the Mosul deaths (four) are included as credible.
The most recent monthly report of December 2 estimates that at least 1,347 civilian casualties resulted from actions of the anti-ISIS coalition.
In het meest recente maandelijkse overzicht van december 2 wordt ingeschat dat er ten minste 1.347 burgerslachtoffers te betreuren zijn ten gevolge van acties van de anti-ISIS coalitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht dat Jeugdzorg het kabinet verzoekt twee IS-kinderen uit Syrië terug te halen

Two PvdA MPs asked whether youth care had requested repatriation of two IS-linked children from Syria, how the government responded, and what happens to them and to other Dutch children in Syrian camps. The government confirmed receipt of a letter from a Dutch child protection organisation on 15 October, said it is in close contact with that organisation, but declined to disclose steps taken, citing no diplomatic presence and restraint on individual cases.
Beyond that, the cabinet cannot currently provide information on the steps being taken to implement this request.
Voor het overige geldt dat het kabinet op dit moment geen mededelingen kan doen over de stappen die worden gezet ter uitvoering van dit verzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind en De Roon over een rapport over mensenrechtenschendingen in het noorden van Syrië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government views a Human Rights Watch report on abuses by Turkish-backed Syrian National Army forces in northern Syria, including whether Turkey is responsible and whether former Dutch non-lethal aid reached groups fighting with Turkey and the Syrian Kurds. The minister says Turkey bears responsibility, that Nederland raises this with Turkey, that the groups concerned cannot be named publicly, and that it cannot exclude that Dutch-supplied vehicle parts were used in Operation Peace Spring.
Because the names of the moderate armed groups previously supported by the Netherlands could be traced, this cannot be addressed publicly here.
In verband met herleidbaarheid naar de namen van de gematigde gewapende groepen die voorheen door Nederland gesteund zijn kan hier in het openbaar niet op in worden gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over berichten over marteling van protestleider Zafzafi in Marokko

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of torture of imprisoned Rif protest leader Nasser Zafzafi in Morocco, whether solitary confinement was imposed on prisoners for leaking audio, and whether the government would press for independent investigation and release. The minister said the reports give cause for concern but he has no independent information, that Morocco's own authorities and national human rights council should investigate, and that Morocco is aware of Dutch positions while a cassation appeal is pending.
It is in the first place up to the authorities in Morocco themselves to investigate in response to these reports.
Het is in de eerste plaats aan de autoriteiten in Marokko zelf om onderzoek te doen naar aanleiding van deze berichtgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Popken en Helder over piraterij in de Golf van Mexico

MPs De Roon, Popken and Helder asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Justice and Security about piracy in the Gulf of Mexico, including the reported rise in attacks, any signals of attacks on Dutch-flagged ships, monitoring and cooperation, and whether armed private guards could be allowed on Dutch ships. The government answered that it cannot confirm the attack figures, has received no signals of attacks on Dutch-flagged ships, relies on cooperation with the US and Mexico, and noted that armed guards may become possible under the new Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij in designated High Risk Areas, which the Gulf is not currently.
To date we have not yet received any signals that ships sailing under the Dutch flag were targeted by pirates in the Gulf of Mexico.
Tot op heden hebben wij nog geen signalen ontvangen dat schepen varende onder de Nederlandse vlag doelwit waren van piraten in de Golf van Mexico.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Regenwoudmaffia’ vermoordt en bedreigt inwoners Amazone’

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul ask the ministers how the government responds to reports of violence and threats against Amazon forest defenders by illegal logging networks, and to Bolsonaro's criticism of conservation groups. The ministers say they have raised deforestation and rights concerns with Brazil, note that the legal framework exists but enforcement and political will fall short, and describe trade and sustainability initiatives.
It must be noted that the legal framework to act against criminal organisations exists, but the financial resources and political will to enforce that framework are lacking.
Geconstateerd moet worden dat het wetgevend kader om op te treden tegen criminele organisaties aanwezig is, maar de financiële middelen en de politieke wil om dat kader te handhaven tekort schieten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over een recent vermoorde boswachter in Roemenië

Green-left MP Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister about the murder of a forest ranger in Romania, the second in two months, and about illegal logging, EU law compliance and the ranger's protection. The minister condemned the killings, said the Romanian prosecutor is investigating, noted Romanian forest reforms, and said the EU forest strategy and the Bucharest embassy's NGO cooperation would address the issue.
The Romanian public prosecutor is currently investigating the case.
Het Roemeense OM onderzoekt momenteel de zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Van Aalst over 700 miljoen euro voor schaamteloze EU-propaganda

Two PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares the Commission's view on the DiscoverEU free-travel pilot and the reported 700 million euro EU promotion budget, and whether he will demand that Dutch taxpayer money not be spent on it. The minister said the Netherlands is critical of DiscoverEU in its current form, wants clarity on learning effects, selection and impact before judging, and will press for a financially sustainable MFK with cuts to existing policy.
The cabinet is critical of DiscoverEU in its current form as a pilot programme.
Het kabinet is kritisch over DiscoverEU in de huidige vorm van het pilotprogramma.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Toorenburg over de Nederlander die in Roemenië verdacht wordt van het misbruiken en vermoorden van een meisje en mogelijk andere vergelijkbare misdrijven

MPs Omtzigt and Van Toorenburg asked how Dutch authorities assisted Romania's investigation into a Dutch suspect in the abuse and killing of a girl, whether he had other offences, and why Romania lacked official confirmation of his death and was not alerted through European systems. The ministers answered that Dutch legal assistance was provided, that the suspect's death was officially communicated, that he was not registered in SIS II, SIENA or ECRIS, and that he had served his earlier sentences, though they declined to give details of his past convictions and did not answer the questions within three weeks.
I will not go into the exact convictions or sentences that Johannes V. received earlier.
Ik ga niet in op de exacte veroordelingen dan wel straffen die Johannes V. eerder heeft gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Zeker drie EU-lidstaten gaan Syriëgangers uit eigen lang terughalen’?

An MP from D66 asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether reports that Belgium, Germany and France would repatriate IS detainees from Syria were true, how the government cooperates with allies and the US, and whether Iraq would prosecute European fighters. The minister denied the repatriation reports, described existing measures against returning fighters, and said talks with Iraq continue on prosecution under conditions excluding the death penalty.
No. This reporting turned out to be incorrect.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de Iraakse weigering om IS-strijders uit Syrië te berechten

MP Van Helvert asked the Foreign Minister about Iraq's reluctance to try European IS fighters and the status of a proposed tribunal. The minister answered that Iraq now only wants to prosecute crimes against Iraqi interests, that talks with Iraq and European partners continue, and that evidence-securing mechanisms are supported.
The Netherlands will continue to advocate for trials in the region according to international standards for crimes committed by all parties to the conflict.
Nederland blijft zich sterk maken voor berechting in de regio naar internationale standaarden van misdrijven gepleegd door alle partijen bij het conflict.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een luchtaanval op Mosul, Irak, waarbij vier burgers werden gedood

MPs Karabulut asked about a 2015 Mosul airstrike, attributed to the Netherlands, that killed four civilians, including why it took so long to acknowledge responsibility, why the coalition's investigations and CENTCOM reports are not shared, and whether compensation is available. The minister answered that Dutch involvement was reported to CENTCOM, that the targeting was judged lawful at the time, that CENTCOM reports are US-classified, that secrecy was needed for security reasons until recently, and that a voluntary compensation proposal will be sent to parliament.
The Netherlands therefore cannot unilaterally make these reports public.
Nederland kan deze rapporten dan ook niet eenzijdig openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat de Indiase regering de speciale status van het gebied Kashmir schrapt

MP Kuzu asks the Foreign Minister about India's revocation of Kashmir's special status, including repression, detentions, communications blockades, Hindu settlement rights, human rights and Muharram processions, and whether the Netherlands will act at the UN. The minister answers that the government follows the situation closely, has raised concerns bilaterally and within the EU, sees no evidence of ethnic cleansing, considers itself insufficiently informed to judge legality under international law, and says the questions were answered as well as possible.
The cabinet has insufficient insight into this complex situation to judge whether the Indian government's decision violates international law.
Het kabinet heeft onvoldoende inzicht in deze complexe situatie om een oordeel te kunnen vellen over de vraag of het besluit van de Indiase regering in strijd met het internationaal recht is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat Amerikaanse diplomaten samenwerken met conservatieve staten om seksuele en reproductieve rechten in te perken

Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about reports that the US administration was building a coalition of socially conservative governments to restrict sexual and reproductive rights, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The government answered that it shares concern, is opposing SRGR rollbacks in UN texts and with allies, and will keep raising the issue with US authorities.
The Netherlands will continue to emphasise the importance of SRGR and its concerns on this matter to the appropriate American authorities.
Nederland zal het belang van SRGR en de Nederlandse zorgen terzake blijven benadrukken bij de geëigende Amerikaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van Ojik over Nederlanders die meevechten in de burgeroorlog in Oekraïne

MPs Ploumen and Van Ojik asked the minister about reports that eight Dutch nationals were fighting in the Ukraine conflict on both sides, and about monitoring, return, and measures. The minister answered that the figures could not be confirmed, that the source report gave no substantiation, and that no further details were known, while referring to the integrated approach to extremism and terrorism for radicalised individuals.
Figures on Dutch nationals who would take or would have taken part in the fighting in Ukraine, however, cannot be confirmed.
Cijfers over Nederlanders die deel zouden nemen of deel zouden hebben genomen aan de strijd in Oekraïne, kunnen echter niet worden bevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over beleggingen in wapenproducerende bedrijven die exporteren naar Turkije

Karabulut (SP) asked whether the partial arms-export embargo on Turkey affects the 631 million euro in loans and investments by ING, ABN Amro and Van Lanschot in eleven arms-supplying firms, whether banks should be pressed to divest, and about progress on a thematic framework and talks with banks. Minister Kaag answered that the embargo has no direct effect on banks, that banks decide themselves under the UNGP and OECD guidelines, that a thematic framework is being developed by the insurance-sector convention parties and is not yet finished, and that the government will share it with banks once ready.
Banks and investors make their own assessment of whether to invest in or provide financing to the defence industry.
Banken en investeerders maken hun eigen afweging of zij beleggen in of financiering verlenen aan de defensie-industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Karabulut, Van Oijk en Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Israëlisch hooggerechtshof keurt uitzetting HRW-directeur goed'

MPs from PvdA, SP, GroenLinks and D66 asked how the government responds to the Israeli Supreme Court's approval of the expulsion of Human Rights Watch director Omar Shakir, and whether it fears this chills civil society and human rights defenders. The minister says the government raised concerns with the Israeli ambassador and at senior official level, its embassy monitored the hearings, and the EU urged Israel to reverse the decision.

Because of the government's and the EU's concern about increasing pressure on human rights organisations and defenders in Israel, and specifically this case, the Minister of Foreign Affairs emphatically raised concerns about this threatened expulsion with the Israeli ambassador on 7 November.

Vanwege de bezorgdheid van het kabinet en de EU over de toenemende druk op mensenrechtenorganisaties en -verdedigers in Israël, en specifiek deze zaak, heeft de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken tijdens een kennismakingsgesprek met de Israëlische ambassadeur op 7 november jl. de zorgen over deze dreigende uitzetting nadrukkelijk opgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Diks over het bericht dat de minister van Defensie niet aanwezig was bij de bijeenkomst van NAVO-ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken op 20 november 2019

MPs Van Ojik and Diks asked why the Defence Minister did not attend the NATO foreign ministers' meeting on 20 November 2019, as reported by Trouw. The government answered that the Defence Minister stayed in The Hague to prepare for a possible parliamentary debate on transparency about civilian casualties, and that Netherlands' permanent NATO representative attended instead.

Yes, the Minister of Defence took into account a possible wish of your House to hold a debate in the short term on transparency about civilian casualties, and therefore decided not to travel to Brussels.

Ja, de Minister van Defensie hield rekening met een mogelijke wens van uw Kamer om op korte termijn een debat te voeren over de transparantie over burgerslachtoffers en heeft daarom besloten om niet naar Brussel af te reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Den Boer en Verhoeven over paspoorthandel op Malta

Three D66 MPs asked the government about passport sales in Malta, including whether they enable crime, the role of the Maltese state, AIVD warnings, and Dutch positions in the EU. The government answered that Malta conducts due diligence but this is no guarantee, that it sees such sales as undesirable but that citizenship remains national competence, that it will await an EU Commission process before dialogue, and that the Dutch investor residence scheme will be reviewed for added value.
As indicated in the answer to question 6, it is wise to await the outcome of these Commission initiatives and then engage in dialogue, preferably at EU level, on these schemes.

Zoals in de beantwoording van vraag 6 is aangegeven, is het verstandig om de uitkomst van deze initiatieven van de Commissie af te wachten en op basis daarvan de dialoog – bij voorkeur op EU-niveau – over genoemde regelingen aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over de aanwezigheid van informatie op ministeries over de burgerdoden bij het Nederlandse bombardement op Hawija

MP Diks asked ministers whether ministries had been informed about the outcome of the CENTCOM investigation into civilian deaths at Hawija and whether the Defence Minister misinformed parliament in 2015. The government answers that ministries received only general, non-numerical information in 2015 meetings, the initial CENTCOM report was not shared with other departments, and the 2015 statements to parliament were found to be incorrect.
The initial CENTCOM report as such was never provided to other departments, in line with standing practice.
Het initiële CENTCOM-rapport als zodanig is nooit verstrekt aan andere departementen, conform staande praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de besluitvorming over geheimhouding burgerslachtoffers in Irak in 2015

The MPs asked how and when ministers were informed of civilian casualties in the 2015 Dutch air operation at Hawija, Iraq, whether the matter was discussed in ministerial sub-councils, and whether the Prime Minister was involved in keeping it secret. The Defence Minister answered that ministers were briefed in June 2015 on the basis of the After Action Report, that civilian casualties remain unconfirmed, that no decision to keep the facts secret was ever taken, and that the matter was not specifically discussed in the relevant sub-councils.
No, such a decision has never been taken.
Nee, van een dergelijke beslissing is nooit sprake geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een passage uit het boek Missie F-16 over mogelijke burgerslachtoffers in Irak

An SP MP asks the defence and foreign ministers about a reported Dutch F-16 strike in Iraq at Christmas 2014 that may have hit civilians, and why it was never reported to parliament, and asks whether other unreported strikes exist. The minister answers that analysts doubted civilian harm at the time, it was quickly ruled out, CENTCOM investigated and found none, and that all reported Dutch cases with possible civilian harm have been disclosed to parliament.
The Ministry of Defence therefore saw no reason to launch an investigation into this case.
Het Ministerie van Defensie zag daarom geen aanleiding om een onderzoek in te stellen naar dit geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over dodelijk geweld in het Koerdische kamp al-Hol in Syrië

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice about lethal violence and unrest in the al-Hol camp in Syria, including the presence of Dutch women and children, conditions in the Annex section, risks of radicalisation and escape, and Dutch responsibility. The government answered that it has no control over the camps, cannot confirm Dutch nationals among the victims, raised escape risks with Turkey and NATO, and maintains its policy of not actively retrieving Dutch IS-travellers while pursuing prosecution.
The cabinet has no authority over reception and detention locations in north-east Syria and cannot exert influence over the situation there.
Het kabinet heeft geen zeggenschap over opvang- en detentielocaties in Noordoost-Syrië en kan geen invloed uitoefenen op de situatie daar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Toorenburg en Omtzigt over het intrekken van paspoorten Syriëgangers en beleid Buitenlandse Zaken inzake ‘gematigde’ rebellen

Three CDA MPs asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about passport and citizenship revocations for Syria fighters and the government's stance on 'moderate' rebel groups supported under the Dutch Non-Lethal Assistance programme, including why Ahrar al-Sham is not on Dutch terrorism lists. The ministers answered largely by referring to legal frameworks, declining to comment on individual cases, and explaining that the listing criteria for the national-security list and the national sanctions list were not met.
The cabinet does not make statements about individual cases.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over de situatie in Al-Hol

Two Labour MPs asked the government about security and child welfare in the Al-Hol camp for IS-affiliated women and children, including Dutch nationals, after reports that Kurdish forces were losing control there. The government answered that it received no Kurdish warning, that it cannot give precise figures or child health information because it has no diplomatic presence in northeast Syria, that it is concerned about escape risks from Turkish operations and has raised this with allies, and that it is not changing its policy against actively repatriating children.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over de situatie in Chili

Three MPs asked the Dutch Foreign Minister about the protests in Chile, including excessive police force, deaths and mass arrests, and whether the government had condemned the violence and raised concerns with the Chilean counterpart. The minister condemned violence on all sides, said the government shares UN concerns and awaits the OHCHR investigation and the national human rights institute's review before considering further steps.
The cabinet is awaiting the outcome of the OHCHR investigation before considering possible steps.
Het kabinet wacht de uitkomst van het OHCHR-onderzoek af, alvorens mogelijke stappen te overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher, Ploumen en Van den Hul over de rechten van LHBTI-gemeenschap en persvrijheid in Polen

MPs Asscher, Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the Foreign Minister about anti-LGBTI rhetoric by Poland's ruling PiS party, local 'LGBT-free' declarations, and press freedom in Poland. The minister acknowledged concern about the rhetoric, noted the gap between campaign rhetoric and concrete policy, and described Dutch diplomatic engagement and support for Polish civil society, while saying the press remains diverse and Poland's rule-of-law developments are monitored.

The cabinet follows developments in Poland that could affect this diversity and includes them in concerns Netherlands already actively raises bilaterally, in the EU and multilaterally about the rule of law.
Het kabinet volgt ontwikkelingen in Polen die deze diversiteit kunnen raken en betrekt die bij zorgen die Nederland nu al actief uit in bilateraal, EU- en multilateraal verband over de rechtsstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de Turkse aanval op Koerden in Syrië en de chantagepraktijken van Erdogan

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether Turkey demanded 28 billion euros in a migrant deal, the status of EU-Turkey accession talks, and how to stop EU funds reaching Erdogan after Turkey's military incursion into Syria. The minister said no such request is known, accession talks are effectively frozen, the Netherlands opposes pre-accession aid, and Turkey remains a valued NATO ally.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de veroordeling van Catalaanse politici en protestleiders

MP Leijten asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the convictions of nine Catalan politicians and protest leaders, whether they comply with ECHR freedoms of expression and assembly, and whether the Netherlands will raise the matter with Spain. The minister replied that the case is an internal Spanish matter, that Spain is a strong democratic rule-of-law state bound by the ECHR, and that there is no reason for the Netherlands to intervene.
In my view there is therefore no reason for the Netherlands to get involved in this case.
Naar mijn oordeel is er daarom geen aanleiding voor Nederland om zich in deze zaak te mengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het rapport ‘Briefing on the Situation of Religious Persecution of Christians and Muslims in India’ van Jubilee Campaign

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a Jubilee Campaign report on religious persecution of Christians and Muslims in India, including discriminatory laws, arbitrary detentions, and violence, and whether the government would press India on the report's nine recommendations and support religious freedom initiatives. The minister said the government shares concerns, raises them diplomatically and in EU and multilateral settings, supports Mensenrechtenfonds projects, and that the special envoy for religion will travel to India, but did not commit to specific demands on India's implementation of the recommendations.
In conversations with India, the government emphasises the importance of respect for human rights for everyone.
Het kabinet benadrukt in gesprekken met India het belang van respect voor mensenrechten voor iedereen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Bisschop over het bericht dat de EU honderden miljarden Euro’s niet uitgegeven krijgt

Two MPs (Leijten, Bisschop) asked the Foreign Minister about reports that about 300 billion euro of EU commitments remains unspent, questioning the MFF's goal-driven design, decommitment, audit efficiency findings and administrative costs. The minister answered that the RAL reflects multiannual investment timing, that Nederland seeks a smaller MFF with stricter decommitment and efficiency focus, and that the surplus mechanism returns unspent funds to member states.
To prevent this in 2021–2027, the Netherlands is working for stricter decommitment rules and lower pre-financing percentages.
Om dit in 2021–2027 te voorkomen zet Nederland zich in voor strengere decommitteringsbepalingen en lagere voorfinancieringspercentages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'Over een nieuwe moord op eigenzinnige vrouw in Libië'

MP Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about reports of a new murder of an outspoken woman in Libya, the situation of women there, and whether a sanctions regime for crimes against women should be created. The minister answered that the security situation is worrying, that the Netherlands supports the UN-led political process, and that it has pressed for investigation of the disappearance of Seham Sergiwa and added sexual-violence criteria to existing UN sanctions regimes.
The cabinet notes with concern that enforced disappearances are increasingly taking place in Libya.
Het kabinet constateert met zorg dat er in toenemende mate gedwongen verdwijningen plaatsvinden in Libië
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Russia invites Albania, North Macedonia to join the Eurasian Union’

MPs Asscher and Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Russia invited Albania and North Macedonia to join the Eurasian Economic Union, and about the Dutch response. The minister replied that no formal invitation was known to have been sent, that Dutch contact with EU partners and the two countries continues, and that Nederland supports their EU accession perspective and reform efforts.
To my knowledge, no formal invitation was sent to Albania or North Macedonia to join the Eurasian Economic Union.
Er is bij mijn weten geen formele uitnodiging aan Albanië of Noord-Macedonië gestuurd om lid te worden van de Euraziatische Economische Unie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over de situatie in het kamp Al-Hol in Syrisch Koerdistan

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked about the situation in Al-Hol camp, the repatriation of Dutch IS women and children (including a court order to make efforts for their return) and Iraq's reported demands for payment to prosecute foreign fighters. The government referred to earlier letters, said the detention orders cannot currently be carried out safely, stated it is seeking solutions with Schengen partners including prosecution in the region, and said it is too early to discuss compensation for Iraq.
The examination of the possibility of executing the detention orders issued by the Rotterdam court is ongoing.
Het onderzoek naar de mogelijkheid van de uitvoering van de bevelen gevangenneming van de rechtbank van Rotterdam duurt voort.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Nederlandse hulp aan gevangenen in buitenland berust op willekeur’

Six MPs from CDA, SP, GroenLinks, D66, SGP and ChristenUnie asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about Dutch assistance to Dutch prisoners abroad (the Singh case), including the five-year binding criterion, a WOTS transfer request and the handling of the case. The government answered that it cannot comment on individual cases, that existing criteria apply, that no official US transfer request was ever made, and that it promises no concrete new step.
I cannot make statements about ongoing cases and individual cases.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over lopende zaken en individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over de honderden miljoenen euro's aan lobbyuitgaven van olie- en gasgiganten

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked whether the government accepts a Corporate Europe Observatory finding that oil and gas lobbying spent over 251 million euro to slow EU climate targets, and whether it will hold Shell and others to account and limit their influence on climate policy. The minister said the figures are not known to the government, that the government does not track individual firms' lobbying, that companies may pursue their interests within the rule of law, and that the Klimaatakkoord deliberately involves industry alongside other stakeholders.
All parties are always free to pursue their interests as long as this stays within the bounds of the rule of law.
Het staat alle partijen altijd vrij hun belangen te behartigen zolang dit binnen de grenzen van de rechtstaat past.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een Nederlandse luchtaanval in Irak waarbij tientallen burgerslachtoffers zouden zijn gevallen

An MP from the SP asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs about a Dutch airstrike in Hawija, Iraq in June 2015 that reportedly killed around seventy civilians, asking whether the Chamber was misinformed, whether targeting was careful, whether compensation was paid, whether the OM investigated, and whether other strikes were withheld. The Defence minister answered that the Chamber was informed in 2018 without exact details due to an ongoing operation, that the strike caused unintended collateral damage, that the targeting process was careful, that no victims claimed Dutch compensation, and that the OM found no reason for prosecution, promising a further letter on transparency.
In my letter of 4 November 2019 (reference BS2019018779) on the feasibility of greater transparency about possible civilian casualties from air strikes, I will elaborate on the reasons
In mijn brief van 4 november 2019 (referentie BS2019018779) over de haalbaarheid van meer transparantie over mogelijke burgerslachtoffers bij luchtaanvallen, ga ik nader in op de redenen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over berechting van IS-strijders in Irak

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the Netherlands is negotiating with Iraq on prosecuting ISIS fighters there, on what legal basis, and about a 1.6 million euro commitment, noting Iraqi law lacks genocide and crimes against humanity. The Minister replied that talks are exploratory, with red lines on the death penalty and fair trial standards, that the 1.6 million euro funds Interpol biometric capacity-building rather than prosecution, and that Iraqi law does not criminalise genocide or crimes against humanity.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht ‘Bahrein brengt drie terrorisme-verdachten ter dood’

MP Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister why there is no verifiable data on the number of Bahraini politicians and human rights activists detained since 2011, how often and at what level human rights concerns are raised with Bahrain, and whether the issue was raised at the UN Human Rights Council and in EU working groups. The minister answered that thousands are estimated to be detained but no official figures exist because Bahrain treats them as terrorists, that concerns were raised at high official level in April and August 2019, that the situation is discussed in EU working groups and the informal EU human rights dialogue, and that the Netherlands did not specifically raise Bahrain at the 42nd Human Rights Council session.
However, because the Bahraini authorities regard these prisoners as terrorists or supporters of terrorism, no official figures are available.
Echter, omdat de Bahreinse autoriteiten deze gevangenen als terroristen of als supporters van terrorisme beschouwt, zijn er geen officiële cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Oeganda komt opnieuw met wet voor doodstraf homoseksualiteit’

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the Dutch ministers whether they condemn Ugandan statements and the reported new bill on the death penalty for homosexuality, and what Dutch action is taken. The government condemns the statements, says Uganda's foreign minister assured EU ambassadors no such bill is planned, and describes Dutch LGBTI rights support without committing to new concrete steps.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht 'De Nederlandse ‘precisiebom’ op een wapendepot van IS'

An MP from D66 asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports of a Dutch precision bomb on an IS arms depot near Hawija in June 2015, including the targeting checks, civilian casualties, transparency and compensation. The minister answered that Dutch targeting checks were applied, that the strike caused unintended secondary explosions and roughly 70 casualties, that Dutch involvement is now acknowledged, and that compensation falls to Iraq and no individual claims were made to Defence.
This Hawija case was one of the cases mentioned there.
Dit geval in Hawija betrof een van de daar vermelde gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de militarisering van Europa’s Afrikabeleid

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether European security and military firms shape EU migration policy, whether drone surveillance has replaced rescue ships, and whether the Mali UN mission has worked, among other questions. The government rejected the premise that arms firms drive migration policy, said no causal link was shown between drones and reduced sea rescue, and defended its Mali engagement and restrictive arms export policy.

The picture that European military and security companies, including through the European Organisation for Security, have played a dominant and determining role in shaping European migration policy is not recognised by the cabinet.

Het beeld dat Europese militaire en beveiligingsbedrijven, onder andere via de European Organisation for Security, een dwingende en bepalende rol hebben gespeeld bij het vormgeven van het Europese migratiebeleid wordt door het kabinet niet herkend.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld van het lid Van Helvert (CDA) over de in Amerika opgepakte Nederlandse Youtubers

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether contact had been made with US authorities and the detained Dutch YouTubers, what steps would be taken to bring them home quickly, and for an update. The minister confirmed contact with US police and family and the detainees, said the Netherlands cannot interfere in foreign legal proceedings, and reported that the men were released on bail and returned to the Netherlands.
As you know, the Netherlands cannot interfere in the legal proceedings of another country.
Nederland kan zich zoals u bekend niet mengen in de rechtsgang van een ander land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Toorenburg en Van der Molen over de verkoop van paspoorten op Malta en de nevenfuncties van professor Kochenov van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

Three CDA MPs asked about Malta's passport-sale programme, its national security risks, and the undisclosed outside roles of a Groningen professor in the investment-migration industry. The minister said the programme is a security concern, that the university must investigate the professor's disclosure and conflicts of interest, and that the Inspectorate will advise on the findings.
I have asked the Inspectorate of Education to subsequently assess the findings of the investigation regarding the secondary activities and possible conflicts of interest and to advise me on them.

Ik heb de Inspectie van het onderwijs gevraagd om vervolgens de bevindingen van het onderzoek ten aanzien van de nevenwerkzaamheden en eventuele belangenverstrengeling te beoordelen en mij daarover te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Helvert en Van Ojik over bloedvergieten op Papoea

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about deadly violence in Wamena, Papua, on 23 September 2019, the Indonesian demonstration ban, the end of the Dutch contribution to the Community Policing Programme, and Dutch diplomatic efforts. The minister answered that the causes and casualty breakdown remain unclear, described the programme's results, and said Dutch diplomacy on Papua continues at ministerial and senior official level.
The cabinet closely follows developments in Papua and gives priority to raising these developments as a standing item with the Indonesian authorities.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen in Papua nauwgezet, en geeft er prioriteit aan deze ontwikkelingen als vast onderdeel bij de Indonesische autoriteiten aan te kaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Groothuizen over de moord op de Maltese journaliste Daphne Caruana Galizia

MPs Verhoeven and Groothuizen asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice about the independence of the Maltese public inquiry into journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia's murder, the Rule of Law situation in Malta, and pending libel suits against her. Minister Blok answered that the inquiry is for Malta to organise independently, the Netherlands raises concerns bilaterally, Malta is following the Venice Commission recommendations, and the libel cases are for the Maltese courts to decide.
It is for the inquiry commission to shape the investigation in an independent manner.
Het is aan de onderzoekscommissie om het onderzoek op onafhankelijke wijze vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer, Wilders en Kops (allen PVV) over een nog hogere bijdrage van Nederland aan de Europese meerjarenbegroting

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he agreed with Commissioner-designate Timmermans that rich EU states like the Netherlands should pay more into the EU budget for a climate agenda, and how he would reduce Dutch contributions. The minister answered that the government supports the Green Deal and a Just Transition Fund to be financed within the MFF framework, rejected the claim that the nomination harms the Dutch negotiating position, and committed to pressing for budget savings and possible corrections on contributions.
Once the Commission proposal for the fund has been published, the cabinet will inform your House further.
Zodra het Commissievoorstel voor het fonds is gepubliceerd zal het kabinet uw Kamer nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Van Helvert, Voordewind en Ploumen over de Nieuwsuur-uitzending 'Nederlandse regering heeft morele verplichting West-Papoea te helpen'

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister about a Nieuwsuur broadcast on a Dutch moral obligation toward West Papua, reports of deaths in Papua unrest, and whether the Netherlands would press Indonesia on human rights. The minister answered that at least 32 died in Wamena with casualties on several sides, that the Netherlands raises Papua in dialogue with Indonesia while fully respecting its territorial integrity, and that it sees no reason to revise its earlier position on the Drooglever report.
I see no reason to revise the position set out in the letters to parliament of 22 November 2005 and 29 April 2016.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de lijn in de Kamerbrieven van 22 november 2005, stuk 30 300V, en van 29 april 2016, stuk 2420, te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de veroordeling van een wetenschapper in Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the conviction in Turkey of scientist Bülent Şık for publishing a cancer-risk study, and whether the Netherlands would press for annulment and dispute that the trial was fair. The minister confirmed the facts of the conviction but said the Netherlands does not interfere in other countries' legal proceedings while the case is open, though it raises rule-of-law concerns with Turkey regularly.
The Netherlands does not interfere in the legal proceedings of other countries.
Nederland mengt zich niet in de rechtsgang in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het (mogelijke) gebruik van chemische wapens bij de Turkse inval in Noord Syrië

Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister how the government views reports that Turkey used white phosphorus in its incursion into northern Syria, what it would do if use were confirmed, and whether it had contacted European and NATO partners and what instruments it has. Minister Blok answered that white phosphorus is not prohibited per se under humanitarian law, that no unlawful use can yet be concluded, that the OPCW's investigation is hampered by insecurity, and that if unlawful use is shown he would press for measures in the EU, NATO and the OPCW.
If it is shown that there has indeed been unlawful use of white phosphorus by Turkey, I will consult with my counterparts in EU and NATO contexts and in the OPCW and press for appropriate measures.

Indien wordt aangetoond dat er inderdaad sprake is van niet-geoorloofd gebruik van witte fosfor door Turkije, zal ik in EU-verband, NAVO-verband en in de OPCW in overleg treden met mijn ambtgenoten en aandringen op gepaste maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over inzet door Turkije van fosforbommen en/of -granaten in Noord-Syrië

The MP asked whether Turkish use of white phosphorus munitions in Noord-Syrië civilian areas violates the Geneva Conventions, and whether the government would push for investigation and prosecution. The minister replied that phosphorus munition is not banned per se but must comply with proportionality and civilian-protection rules, that no confirmation of such use against civilians is available, and that the OPCW is the appropriate body and the Netherlands supports it.
At this moment I do not have information confirming that phosphorus munitions have actually been used against the civilian population in northern Syria.
Op dit moment beschik ik niet over informatie die bevestigt dat er daadwerkelijk fosformunitie is gebruikt tegen de burgerbevolking in Noord-Syrië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Karabulut over Marokkaanse journaliste die veroordeeld is vanwege een abortus

MPs Ploumen and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about the conviction of Moroccan journalist Hajar Raissouni for illegal abortion and sex outside marriage, and whether the Netherlands would act for her release and for women's access to safe abortion. The minister said the Netherlands supports sexual and reproductive rights broadly but does not fund specific abortion programmes in Morocco, noted that clemency had been granted to Raissouni, her doctor and her partner, and declined to speculate on motives or raise the case with his Moroccan counterpart.
I therefore see no reason to discuss this with my counterpart.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om hierover in gesprek te treden met mijn ambtsgenoot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Maeijer en Wilders (allen PVV) over een door de Europese Unie gefinancierd Turks rapport over islamofobie

Three PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU funded a Turkish think tank's report on Islamophobia that they say is government propaganda, how much money was involved, and whether Brussels will stop the funding. The minister confirmed the report was partly EU-funded through a civil society dialogue programme selected by Turkey's foreign ministry, said the EU does not endorse its content, and said the Netherlands has pushed to suspend pre-accession aid without sufficient support.
In this specific case, 90% of the total budget of € 126,951.81 for this SETA publication was financed by the CSD.
In dit specifieke geval is 90% van het totaalbudget van € 126,951.81 voor deze publicatie van SETA door CSD gefinancierd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de situatie dat Oeigoeren in Chinese concentratiekampen worden vermoord en hun organen worden verkocht

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Uyghurs in Chinese camps are killed for their organs and whether this amounts to concentration camps and genocide, and what the government is doing. The minister said the government cannot verify the organ-harvesting allegations, does not consider genocide criteria met, and listed diplomatic efforts such as joint statements at the UN and EU, while withholding some embassy details for confidentiality.
The cabinet is not able to verify these allegations on the basis of its own information nor to refute them.
Het kabinet is niet in staat om deze aanklachten op basis van eigen informatie te verifiëren noch te ontkrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over het artikel "De uit zee opgepikte migranten moeten wel ergens van boord kunnen, waarschuwen Nederlandse reders"

MPs Groothuizen and Sjoerdsma asked about reports that rescued migrants struggle to disembark, a hijacked merchant ship, and EU Operation Sophia, and asked for measures on safe ports and safety. The government answered that it has no such figures, supports calls for safe ports and a structural EU disembarkation solution, and noted that Sophia's mandate targets smuggling rather than rescue and was extended unchanged for six months.
The cabinet does not have such figures.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over dergelijke cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het uitvoeren van de motie Van Helvert c.s. inzake het bijeen roepen van de NAVO-raad

Two CDA MPs asked the Foreign Minister why he would not convene the NATO Council under Article 4 over the release of ISIS detainees in northeast Syria after the Turkish invasion, and what the Netherlands was doing to contain the threat. The minister answered that Article 4 is only appropriate if a NATO member is directly threatened, that the issue would be raised at the NATO North Atlantic Council on 15 October and in the anti-ISIS coalition, and that the Netherlands would condemn the Turkish operation and call for its halt.
Invoking Article 4 of the NATO treaty is only opportune if the territorial integrity, political independence or security of one of the NATO member states is directly threatened.
Inroeping van artikel 4 van het NAVO-verdrag is pas opportuun indien de territoriale integriteit, politieke onafhankelijkheid of de veiligheid van een van de NAVO-lidstaten direct wordt bedreigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij een cyberaanval tegen Iran

MP Karabulut asked the ministers whether the Netherlands was involved in the Stuxnet cyberattack on Iran, how decisions were made, whether parliament was informed, and how the operation relates to international law. The minister neither confirmed nor denied Dutch involvement, citing the duty to protect sources and secrecy, and declined to give substantive answers to most questions while stating the IAEA supervised Natanz in 2007.
Given the nature of the AIVD's work and its methods, and because of the statutory duty to protect sources, I cannot respond substantively to alleged Dutch involvement.
Gezien de aard van het werk en de werkwijze van de AIVD en vanwege de wettelijke plicht tot bescherming van bronnen, kan ik niet inhoudelijk reageren op vermeende betrokkenheid van Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over de kilometerslange files bij de grensovergangen van Turkije, Bulgarije, Servië, Hongarije, Griekenland en Kroatië, en de intimidatie die reizigers ervaren

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked about long queues at EU external border crossings, systematic checks of EU citizens, mandatory paid vehicle disinfection in Bulgaria and intimidation of travellers. The minister said the government has no indications that countries withhold capacity, explained the EU framework for checks and disinfection, and noted the embassy raised complaints with Bulgarian authorities.
The Cabinet has no indications that the countries concerned do not deploy the available capacity.
Het Kabinet heeft geen aanwijzingen dat betrokken landen de beschikbare capaciteit niet inzetten.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Sneller, Ploumen, Voordewind, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘Jaar na dood Khashoggi: zaken doen met de kroonprins kan weer’

Six MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Saudi Arabia's incomplete accountability for the killing of Jamal Khashoggi, the crown prince's responsibility, pressure for openness, trade missions, sanctions and attending the G20. The minister answered that the Saudi account remains incomplete, that the Netherlands keeps pressing bilaterally and in UN and EU fora, that no government-led trade missions are planned, and that sanctions lack international consensus while an EU human rights sanctions regime is being pursued.
The cabinet will continue to press for this in bilateral and multilateral contexts.
Het kabinet zal hier in bilateraal en multilateraal verband op blijven aandringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut, Voordewind, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij en Van Ojik over het bezoek van premier Rutte aan Indonesië

MPs from six parties asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about the topics of Rutte's visit to Indonesia, including the military crackdown in Papua, and whether the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights would be invited to Papua. The government answered that human rights and Papua were discussed, that the Netherlands urged a prompt UN visit, and that the visit is now up to the UN and Indonesian authorities to arrange.
The aim of this conversation was to stress that dialogue and restraint are important to reach a lasting solution.
De inzet van dit gesprek was te benadrukken dat dialoog en terughoudendheid belangrijk zijn om tot een duurzame oplossing te komen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Laan-Geselschap over het berechten van Nederlandse Syrië-gangers door de Koerdische autoriteiten in Noord-Syrië

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign and Justice ministers whether they would support local trials of Dutch jihadists by Kurdish authorities in northern Syria, including financial and legal support and detention facilities. The government said it is exploring regional prosecution with international partners but is reluctant to deal with non-state Kurdish authorities, offers only indirect support through UNITAD and IIIM, and will not fund local detention centres.

The cabinet is reluctant to make agreements or cooperate with non-state entities that actually exercise authority over an area where the government in question effectively no longer exercises authority.

Het kabinet is terughoudend met het maken van afspraken of samenwerken met niet-statelijke entiteiten die feitelijk gezag uitoefenen over een gebied waar de betreffende regering effectief geen gezag meer uitoefent.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het terughalen van Duitse kinderen uit Syrië door Duitsland

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the Dutch ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the government knew in advance of Germany's repatriation of children from Syria, how many Dutch children remain in Syrian camps, and why the Netherlands does not repatriate them. The ministers answered that the Netherlands was not informed beforehand, that active repatriation is not government policy except possibly for orphans, that about 85 children with a Dutch link are in SDF camps, and that the government will study the return of orphans.
It is unknown how many Dutch children are currently in Syrian camps.
Het is onbekend hoeveel Nederlandse kinderen zich momenteel in Syrische kampen bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de aanhoudende onlusten in Papua

MP Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about Indonesian military repression of protests in West Papua, including deaths, Dutch responsibility, and support for a new independence referendum. The minister said Indonesia is responsible for security, Dutch embassy monitors the situation, the territorial integrity of Indonesia is respected, and the issue is raised in bilateral dialogue including a visit by the UN High Commissioner.
