It is not for the Dutch government to judge the advisability of a new referendum on independence.
Het is niet aan de Nederlandse regering om te oordelen over de opportuniteit van een nieuw referendum over onafhankelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Brussel trekt 900 miljoen uit voor gevolgen harde Brexit’

An MP asked the government about reports that the European Commission would use the Solidarity Fund and Globalisation Fund to cushion a no-deal Brexit, and whether the Netherlands could claim these funds. The minister supports the Commission proposals, describes eligibility criteria for both funds, and says it is not yet possible to assess whether a Dutch claim will be made.

Nevertheless, I cannot yet estimate whether the Dutch government can submit an application, because it is not yet possible to estimate the scale of the financial and economic damage from a no-deal Brexit.

Desondanks kan ik nu nog niet inschatten of de Nederlandse overheid een aanvraag kan indienen omdat het nu nog niet mogelijk is om in te schatten wat de omvang van de financiële en economische schade ten gevolge van een no deal Brexit is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'Bahrein brengt drie terrorisme-verdachten ter dood'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he had raised with Bahrain the execution of three terrorism suspects, whether he had condemned it, and about the human rights situation and UN action on Bahrain since 2011. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposes the death penalty, that an EU statement condemned the executions, that the human rights situation has worsened according to several sources, and that Bahrain was raised in the UPR, but gave no specific new commitments.
The figures on this are extremely difficult to establish because no verifiable information is available.
De getallen hierover zijn bijzonder moeilijk vast te stellen omdat er geen verifieerbare informatie beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het niet controleren van diplomaten op alcoholgebruik na ongevallen

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers whether diplomats involved in accidents are exempt from alcohol testing while ordinary drivers are tested, and whether this difference should be ended. The minister replied that diplomatic immunity under international law can bar breath tests, that a criminal investigation continues where immunity is later found not to apply, and that since May 2019 the CJIB notifies immune persons of traffic fines via the Foreign Ministry.
Diplomats, and often also staff of international organisations of comparable rank, enjoy immunity from the Dutch courts so that they can function effectively and independently.

Diplomaten, en vaak ook medewerkers van internationale organisaties met een vergelijkbare rang, beschikken in verband met het effectief en onafhankelijk kunnen functioneren over immuniteit voor de Nederlandse rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht ‘VN wil sancties tegen bedrijven uit Myanmar, ook Shell betrokken’

MP Kuzu (DENK) asks the Foreign Minister whether the government will back targeted financial sanctions against Myanmar military-linked conglomerates (MEHL, MEC) and their business partners, including Shell, following a UN fact-finding report, and what Dutch businesses and the government are doing about indirect ties. The ministers answer that the Netherlands supports targeted measures and EU-level review of listings and an arms embargo, but declines broad sanctions, has no overview of Dutch companies' dealings, and only engages Shell in contact.
The cabinet does not keep an overview of the activities or forms of cooperation of Dutch companies with enterprises established in Myanmar.
Het kabinet houdt geen overzicht bij van activiteiten of samenwerkingsvormen van Nederlandse bedrijven met in Myanmar gevestigde ondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over Nederlandse kinderen die vastzitten in Syrische opvangkampen.

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the ministers about Dutch children held in Syrian camps, including how many have trauma, what support they receive, and whether the government will bring them home. The government answered that at least 85 such children are in Kurdish-run camps, that aid agencies decide where help goes, and that it does not actively pursue repatriation of adult travellers and their children, while promising care and a multidisciplinary team for children who return.

Government policy, as confirmed in the Minister of Justice and Security's letter to the House of 21 February 2019, is still that the Netherlands does not help travellers leave unsafe areas in Syria and Iraq.

Het kabinetsbeleid, zoals ook bevestigd in de brief van de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid aan uw Kamer van 21 februari 2019, is nog steeds dat Nederland uitreizigers niet helpt bij het verlaten van onveilig gebied in Syrië en Irak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het onderwerp godsdienstvrijheid in het Algemeen Ambtsbericht over Afghanistan

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister how the Afghan state protects religious minorities and non-believers, how it treats converts, and whether the General Asylum Report (Algemeen Ambtsbericht) on freedom of religion is accurate and should be amended. The minister acknowledged limited legal space and intimidation of minorities but rejected the claim that the report downplays risks, declined to amend the report, and said the Mensenrechtenambassadeur and Special Envoy would engage on religious freedom.
I see no reason to amend the report.
Ik zie geen reden het ambtsbericht aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Polen sleept kritische juristen voor de rechter’

MPs Groothuizen and Verhoeven asked whether the government recognises that Polish prosecutions of critical academics, including professor Wojciech Sadurski, continue despite an earlier answer that a prosecution was withdrawn. The government replied that the earlier answer concerned threatened prosecutions against jurists, that the Sadurski case concerns private and party complaints over a tweet and remains with the Polish courts, and that it will monitor the case and raise rule-of-law concerns in EU and bilateral channels.
It does not befit the Netherlands to actively interfere in cases that are still before the courts and/or to make statements about them.
Het past Nederland niet om zich actief te mengen in zaken die nog onder de rechter zijn en/of daarover uitspraken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over openheid over betrokkenheid van bedrijven bij illegale Israëlische nederzettingen

MP Karabulut asked whether the government would press for publication of the UN database of businesses active in Israeli settlements, given NGO calls for openness and the delay in publication. The minister confirms the 2016 Human Rights Council mandate, says the Netherlands opposed the database but will not press for its publication, leaving implementation to the High Commissioner.
The Netherlands will therefore not press for publication of the database in question.
Nederland zal derhalve niet aandringen op publicatie van de betreffende database.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over onderhandelingen in het kader van de Group of Governmental Experts bij de Conventie voor Conventionele Wapens

MP Koopmans asked the minister how the government follows up on the motion calling for a broad treaty or binding rules on new potential weapons of mass destruction such as drones and killer robots, and what initiatives were taken with partners. The minister answered that the government is reluctant to label new technologies as weapons of mass destruction, stresses that existing international law applies to autonomous weapons, and describes its work in the GGE LAWS on meaningful human control and guiding principles.
The cabinet categorically rejects the development and use of fully autonomous weapons systems in advance.
Het kabinet verwerpt op voorhand de ontwikkeling en het gebruik van volledig autonome wapensystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Israël oogst kritiek met bliksemsloopactie op Palestijns grondgebied’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Israel's demolition of Palestinian buildings in Wadi al Hummus, settlement expansion, the UN report on child casualties, and the status of investigations into the 2018 Gaza protest killings. The minister answered that the Netherlands joined EU and UN condemnations, raised concerns with Israel, and is awaiting the outcome of Israeli investigations to be presented.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik, Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, en Van Raan over een aanval op de democratie in Turkije

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's removal of elected HDP and CHP mayors and appointment of state supervisors, and whether the Netherlands and EU would condemn it and what consequences would follow. The minister answered that the government shares EU and Council of Europe concerns, supports the EU's public statements, raises the issue bilaterally, and backed halting accession talks, though that proposal lacked support and talks have stalled.
The government does not have precise figures.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over precieze aantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de inperking van vrijheden in Brazilië onder president Bolsonaro

Ploumen asks the Foreign Minister about restrictions on cultural, sexual and democratic freedoms in Brazil under Bolsonaro, including the Rio mayor's censorship of a comic showing two kissing men. Minister Blok answers that the Brazilian Supreme Court overturned the ban, that Netherlands raises human rights concerns with Brazilian authorities and in the EU, but gives no concrete new step.
The day after the mayor's decision, the Brazilian Supreme Court declared it unconstitutional, ruling that freedom of expression is an essential part of a democracy.

Daags na het besluit van de burgemeester werd dat onconstitutioneel verklaard door het Braziliaanse Hooggerechtshof, dat oordeelde dat vrijheid van meningsuiting een essentieel onderdeel is van een democratie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘All-points alert out for “most dangerous Portuguese terrorist of them all’

An MP asked whether the government would press Portugal to bar a Dutch-Portuguese dual national who joined ISIS from entering Portugal or Schengen, and whether her Dutch rights had been forfeited. The government declined to comment on individual cases, explained the conditions under which Dutch nationality can be revoked, and said it has no jurisdiction over other states' nationality decisions.
Furthermore, the cabinet does not comment on individual cases.
Verder gaat het kabinet niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Oeigoeren in Europese landen worden onder druk gezet door de Chinese overheid’

Two D66 MPs asked the government whether reports that Uyghurs in Europe, including the Netherlands, are pressured and intimidated by Chinese authorities are true, and what protection, asylum figures, extradition practice and diplomatic action exist. The government confirms that such pressure is reported and calls unwanted foreign interference unacceptable, lists available protective tools and recent diplomatic efforts, but gives no statistics on Uyghur asylum applications (sensitive data) and no concrete new action.
Therefore this data is not registered in a way that makes it possible to generate an answer to this question from the automated information systems of the migration chain.
Daarom worden deze gegevens niet geregistreerd op een manier die het mogelijk maakt om een antwoord op deze vraag te genereren vanuit de geautomatiseerde informatiesystemen van de migratieketen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat Iran vrouwelijke activistes steeds harder straft

Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of reports that Iran is handing down ever harsher sentences to women activists, including 24 years for removing a headscarf, and what he was doing to improve women's rights there. Minister Blok answered that the government raises women's rights and human rights with Iran regularly in bilateral, UN and EU settings, and is very concerned about the sentences, but commits to no new concrete step beyond continued advocacy.
The Netherlands is outspoken about the dire human rights situation in Iran and regularly calls on Iran, in both bilateral and multilateral fora, to improve the situation.
Nederland is uitgesproken over de schrijnende mensenrechtensituatie in Iran en roept Iran met regelmaat en in zowel bilaterale als multilaterale fora op de situatie te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, en Sjoerdsma over het bericht “Oekraïne laat belangrijke MH17 verdachte vrij”

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Dam asked whether an MH17 suspect released by a Ukrainian court could still be held available for the Dutch investigation and what the government had done to prevent his release and transfer in a prisoner exchange. The minister answered that the Ukrainian court released him in an unrelated case, that diplomatic efforts were made at the highest level, and that after the exchange the Public Prosecution Service requested his detention with a view to extradition from Russia.
The Dutch Public Prosecution Service has indicated it wants Mr Tsemach kept available for the investigation into the downing of flight MH17.
Het Nederlandse OM heeft aangegeven de heer Tsemach beschikbaar te willen houden voor het onderzoek naar het neerhalen van vlucht MH17.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over het bericht “Iran gaat nieuwe centrifuges ontwikkelen om uranium te verrijken”

An MP asks the minister about Iran's reported new centrifuges, French plans to compensate Iran to save the nuclear deal, sanctions, and US actions. The minister says the IAEA has no political mandate, Nederland is concerned, supports EU diplomacy and INSTEX, maintains sanctions, and rejects the US maximum-pressure approach.
The Netherlands raises this regularly, bilaterally and multilaterally, most recently on 10 September at the IAEA Board of Governors and on 16 September during the IAEA General Conference.
Nederland kaart dit met regelmaat aan, bilateraal en multilateraal, meest recent op 10 september in de Bestuursraad van het IAEA en op 16 september tijdens de General Conference van het IAEA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het optreden van KMar- en douanemedewerkers op Schiphol, Eindhoven Airport en Rotterdam The Hague Airport

An MP asks ministers about alleged ethnic profiling and discriminatory treatment by Customs and the Royal Netherlands Marechaussee at Schiphol and Eindhoven airports, including an Ombudsman finding on Customs cash checks. The government denies systematic profiling, acknowledges shortcomings in information provision and one inappropriate remark, cites ongoing complaint procedures, and declines a separate investigation while awaiting the Ombudsman's own inquiry.
Yes, Customs acknowledges that at the time of the complaint the provision of information at Eindhoven Airport was insufficient
Ja, de Douane erkent dat ten tijde van de klacht de informatieverstrekking op Eindhoven Airport onvoldoende was
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over een verboden lhbti-manifestatie op de Westoever

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the Foreign Minister whether he agreed that the Palestinian police banning an LGBTI event on the West Bank and calling on citizens to report activists of Al-Qaws was unacceptable, and whether he would raise concerns with the Palestinian Authority. The minister answered that the police statement had been withdrawn, that the Netherlands urges the PA to respect freedoms of expression and assembly and has raised the matter with the PA, including the prime minister, and has expressed support to Al-Qaws.
The Dutch representative in Ramallah immediately raised the matter with the PA, including the prime minister.
De Nederlandse vertegenwoordiger in Ramallah heeft de zaak terstond opgebracht bij de PA, waaronder de premier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Palestinian Authority Bans Activities by Gay Rights Group’

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister about reports that the Palestinian Authority banned activities of an LGBTI rights group and threatened arrests, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister condemned the restrictions as unacceptable, said the Dutch representative in Ramallah had raised the issue directly, and noted ongoing talks with the group about further support.
The cabinet finds this worrying and unacceptable.
Het kabinet vindt dit zorgelijk en niet acceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een grensconflict tussen het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden en de Republiek Frankrijk in Oyster Pond op Sint Maarten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the Oyster Pond border dispute with France on Sint Maarten has lasted since 1996 without negotiations, whether French incursions occurred, whether other territory is claimed, and what support the affected restaurant owner will receive. The minister explained preparatory technical work delayed by Hurricane Irma, described the dispute as concerning one restaurant and marina, and said the Netherlands will raise the issue with France to give the owner assurances.
In my next meeting with the French Minister for Overseas Territories, which will take place in a month, I will again emphasise the importance of this.
In mijn volgende onderhoud met de Franse Minister van Overzeese Gebieden, dat over een maand zal plaatsvinden, zal ik het belang hiervan nogmaals benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de inbeslagname van een vrachtschip door zowel Groot-Brittannië als Iran

MP Karabulut (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about the seizure of the tanker Grace I by Britain and Iran's response, including Panama's deregistration, the legality under UNCLOS, US sanctions pressure, and a possible European maritime mission in the Gulf. The minister answered that the UK's account was not doubted, that Netherlands is studying a possible contribution to maritime security in Hormuz, and that it favours a diplomatic approach to Iran, though many questions were answered only in general terms.
Once the study gives reason to do so, the House will be informed further.
Zodra het onderzoek daartoe aanleiding geeft zal de Kamer nader worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over een bijdrage aan een veiligheidsmechanisme voor Noordoost-Syrië

An MP (D66) asked the Foreign Minister whether the US request underlying a Dutch contribution to a security mechanism for northeast Syria includes asking the Netherlands to repatriate Dutch nationals who fought in Syria. The minister answered yes, and gave the answer quickly.

Is the part of the American request underlying your notification letter of 21 June 2019 about a contribution to a security mechanism for northeast Syria that asks the Netherlands to take back Syria fighters of Dutch nationality?

Is het onderdeel van het Amerikaanse verzoek dat ten grondslag ligt aan uw notificatiebrief d.d. 21 juni 2019 over een bijdrage aan een veiligheidsmechanisme voor Noordoost-Syrië, dat Nederland wordt verzocht Syrië-strijders van Nederlandse nationaliteit terug te halen?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over de ontbossing van het Braziliaanse Amazonegebied

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the ministers whether they share concern over rising Amazon deforestation under Bolsonaro, whether the Netherlands has raised it, and whether Germany's suspension of environmental aid should be matched. The government says it shares the concern, has raised deforestation with Brazil through several channels, will keep doing so, but declines to match Germany's aid suspension and is still deliberating on further steps.
The Netherlands expresses its concern about the increasing deforestation at every suitable opportunity, both when it is in the news and when it is not.
Nederland uit bij alle in aanmerking komende gelegenheden zijn zorgen over de toenemende ontbossing, zowel wanneer dit in het nieuws is, als wanneer dit niet in het nieuws is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Nederlander in buitenland moet op pad voor extra check DigiD’

MPs Verhoeven and Sjoerdsma asked whether DigiD two-step verification is safe and why Dutch citizens abroad must collect an activation code at a counter in person, often far away, and whether this is acceptable. The State Secretary defends two-step verification as safer, explains the face-to-face requirement as necessary for reliable identity checks, and promises to explore improvements such as more counters and NFC-based activation from the second half of 2020.
I recognise and regret that for some Dutch citizens living abroad who want or need a DigiD this causes inconvenience and that they experience it as a problem.
Ik realiseer mij en betreur dat dit voor een deel van de Nederlanders die in het buitenland wonen en een DigiD willen of moeten hebben tot ongemak leidt en dat zij dit als een probleem ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over de baby en peuter van een Nederlandse vader die zich zonder ouders in een kamp in Noord-Syrië bevinden

Two MPs from the PvdA ask about two young children of a Dutch jihadist without parents in a camp in northern Syria, including their health, why they were not brought back, and whether consular help can be requested. The government says it cannot comment on individual cases, denies diplomats visited the camp, distinguishes this case from the French repatriation, and notes consular assistance requires a request from the Dutch national or their representative.
As you know, the cabinet cannot go into individual cases in more detail.
Zoals u weet kan het kabinet hier niet nader ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de sponsoring van EU-voorzitters door bedrijven

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether it is acceptable that Finland's EU Council presidency is sponsored by BMW, given an ongoing Commission cartel investigation, and whether sponsorship by such firms is undesirable. The minister replied that each presidency decides how to handle sponsorship, that the Commission investigation is ongoing, and that the government does not consider sponsorship in principle undesirable, pointing to 2016 Dutch presidency criteria that excluded firms involved in unlawful activities.
Each member state has the responsibility and room to organise its presidency itself.
Elke lidstaat heeft de verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte om het voorzitterschap zelf in te kleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Dagelijks rechten geschonden’ inzake het gevangeniswezen op Sint Maarten

An MP asked the government about reports of daily rights violations in Sint Maarten's prison, including cell confinement, lack of rehabilitation and psychiatric care, and suspects being sent home instead of held in pre-trial detention. The State Secretary answered that prisons are a country matter, cited the minimum two hours outdoor time and limited reclassering capacity, referred the release policy to Sint Maarten authorities, and said the Corallo supervision and 11 transferred containers cells are being monitored.
It is not for me to assess the factual findings presented in the article.
Het is niet aan mij om de in het artikel weergegeven constateringen te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het niet bijhouden van documentatie met lobbygesprekken door voormalig secretaris-generaal van de Europese Commissie de heer Martin Selmayr

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether it is problematic that former Commission Secretary-General Selmayr kept no formal records of lobby meetings, and whether the Commission and the interinstitutional mandatory lobby register should be pushed for more transparency. The minister replies that transparency rules are for the EU institutions themselves, that the Secretary-General falls outside the Commission's disclosure rules, and that the Netherlands prioritises restarting the stalled register negotiations and getting the Council to join.
It is up to the institutions to set internal agreements, and to supervise compliance with them, regarding the recording of interactions with interest representatives.
Het is aan de instellingen om interne afspraken vast te stellen, en toe te zien op de naleving ervan, ten aanzien van verslaglegging van interacties met belangenvertegenwoordigers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Diks en Van Ojik over Venezolaans conflictgoud dat via Curaçao en Aruba wordt verhandeld

Three GroenLinks MPs asked the government about Venezuelan conflict gold being traded via Curaçao and Aruba, and how this fits with Dutch recognition of Guaidó and the gold covenant. The State Secretary answered that Curaçao and Aruba have banned Venezuelan gold trade, that no Venezuelan gold import was declared in Caribbean Netherlands in five years, and that the EU conflict minerals regulation applies from 2021, with the gold covenant and due diligence as the main tools.
Regarding the nature and scale of gold trade on Sint Maarten, despite inquiries with the Sint Maarten government, I currently have no figures available.
Van de aard en omvang van de handel in goud op Sint Maarten zijn mij, ondanks navraag bij de regering van Sint Maarten, op dit moment geen cijfers bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de benarde situatie van Papua’s in Indonesië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the reported deaths from hunger and disease and displacement in Papua, whether Indonesia was being raised, and about the Netherlands' responsibility given its colonial history and the 1969 Act of Free Choice. The minister said the figures are disputed, that Papua is raised regularly in bilateral and EU human rights dialogue, and that the Netherlands respects Indonesia's territorial integrity.
Papua is now part of the Republic of Indonesia and the Dutch government fully respects Indonesia's territorial integrity.
Papua is nu een onderdeel van de Republiek Indonesië en de Nederlandse regering respecteert de territoriale integriteit van Indonesië volledig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Geef burger ook veteranenstatus’

An MP asked whether civilian personnel (diplomats, police, aid workers) deployed alongside soldiers in mission areas should receive veteran status and access to the same care. The government answered that civilians receive recognition via the Herinneringsmedaille and existing care arrangements, but that veteran status under the Veteranenwet is tied to the special legal position of military personnel and is therefore not appropriate for civilians.
On the basis of the Veterans Act and the provisions based on it, granting veteran status to diplomats, police officers and aid workers is therefore not appropriate.
Op basis van de Veteranenwet en de daarop berustende bepalingen is het toekennen van de veteranenstatus aan diplomaten, politieagenten en hulpverleners derhalve niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Diks over de export van cybersurveillance technologie

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked whether Dutch firms should supply emotion-recognition and surveillance technology used by China's Ministry of Public Security, and what controls apply to cybersurveillance exports. The minister says such use is unacceptable, firms must exercise due diligence, export licences are refused where human-rights concerns exist, and the Netherlands keeps pushing for EU-level controls while declining to pre-empt the stalled dual-use regulation revision.
The Netherlands will continue to work to keep the subject on the agenda.
Nederland zal zich ervoor blijven inzetten dat het onderwerp op de agenda blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over branden in Aramese dorpen in Turkije

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether recent fires in Aramean villages in Mardin, Turkey, reflect systematic targeting of Christians, whether Turkish authorities were negligent, and whether the government would raise the matter. The minister answered that the fires damaged surrounding land but did not reach the villages or the Mor Hananyo monastery, that authorities appeared to fight the fires comparably to elsewhere, and that Dutch officials raised the matter at high level.
The Netherlands has raised this issue at a high level with the Turkish Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Bovendien heeft Nederland dit onderwerp op hoog niveau onder de aandacht gebracht bij het Turkse Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Turkije dat IS-veteranen rekruteert, traint en bewapent in Afrin

De Roon (PVV) asked the Foreign Minister whether IS veterans fight for Turkey-backed groups in Afrin, whether Turkey cooperates with them, whether Dutch nationals are on a list of 40 veterans, and whether Dutch NLA support reached such groups, and whether NATO membership should be reconsidered. Minister Blok answered that he has no information on MIT cooperation, that no Dutch nationals are known on the list, that NLA recipients will not be named publicly, and that Turkey remains an essential NATO and anti-ISIS partner, so no investigation or change of position is planned.
The cabinet makes no public statements about which groups did or did not receive NLA support from the Netherlands.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de groepen die al-dan-niet NLA-steun hebben ontvangen van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oijk en Snels over de ‘Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank’

Two MPs asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers how Netherlands has used its shareholding in the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank to push human rights and environmental standards, complaints mechanisms, transparency and oversight. The minister answered that the Netherlands has pushed for these standards and transparency within the bank's board, that the complaints and disclosure rules have gaps the government will raise in the upcoming framework review, and promised to report annually to parliament.

I propose to share a report with the House of Representatives annually after the meeting of the bank's highest governing body, the Board of Governors, to inform the House of the most important developments at the AIIB.
Ik stel voor om jaarlijks na de bijeenkomst van het hoogste bestuursorgaan, de Board of Governors , van de AIIB een verslag met de Tweede Kamer te delen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg en Geurts over de Nederlandse voorbereiding op een harde Brexit

CDA MPs asked the government about the Dutch preparations for a hard Brexit on 31 October 2019, covering customs staffing and enforcement choices, medicine and medical device shortages, live animal inspection posts and NVWA capacity. The government answered that staffing targets were met, customs and NVWA preparations continue, and that shortages and disruptions cannot be fully ruled out.
The Tweede Kamer was informed about these choices in the cabinet letter dated 18 January 2019.
Over deze keuzes is de Tweede Kamer geïnformeerd in de brief van het kabinet d.d. 18 januari 2019
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Ouwehand, Voordewind en Bouali over het bericht ‘de zwarte kant van het voetbal’

Four MPs from SGP, PvdD, ChristenUnie and D66 asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about reported deaths of migrant workers building World Cup facilities in Qatar and what the government is doing about labour abuse there. The ministers answered that every death is one too many, that Qatar has begun reforms with the ILO and that the Netherlands raises the issue bilaterally and multilaterally, while declining to boycott the tournament.
It does not fit Dutch policy to boycott sporting events because of political situations.
Het past niet in het Nederlandse beleid om sportevenementen te boycotten vanwege politieke situaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van den Hul en Diks over het door de Chinese autoriteiten oppakken van activist(en) die zich onder meer inzetten voor hiv-/aidspatiënten

MPs Ploumen, Van den Hul and Diks asked the ministers whether they would seek clarity on the charge against Chinese NGO workers detained for alleged subversion, and how this relates to China's UNAIDS chairmanship. The ministers answered that the embassy follows the case, raises it through the EU and the bilateral human rights dialogue, and that the chair is performing correctly, while concerns about NGO pressure will continue to be raised.
Concerns about individual cases, such as the arrest of Cheng Yuan, Liu Yongze and Xiao Wu, are raised through the bilateral human rights dialogue or in meetings of the UN Human Rights Council.

Zorgen over individuele gevallen, zoals de arrestatie van Cheng Yuan, Liu Yongze en Xiao Wu, worden via de bilaterale mensenrechtendialoog overgebracht of in vergaderingen van de VN-Mensenrechtenraad aan de orde gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de demonstraties in Hong Kong

MP Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister about the Hong Kong protests, Beijing's growing influence, police violence, freedom of expression and whether the government raised concerns with China. Minister Blok condemned violence on all sides, supported an inclusive dialogue and the EU statement, reaffirmed Hong Kong's autonomy under the Basic Law, and said he raised developments with Wang Yi on 19 June, without committing to new steps toward China.
The cabinet fully supports the statement by the High Representative, which was drawn up in consultation with the EU member states.
Het kabinet staat volledig achter de verklaring van de Hoge Vertegenwoordiger, die in samenspraak met de EU-lidstaten tot stand is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat Minister-President Rutte volgende week voor de tweede maal President Trump bezoekt

Ploumen (PvdA) asked whether PM Rutte would raise human rights, climate, Iran, Saudi Arabia, migrant children and abortion rights with President Trump, and why he had not met the Saudi crown prince at the G20. Minister Blok answered that trade, investment, security and Iran were discussed, that the confidential nature of talks prevents detail, and that no bilateral meeting with the crown prince took place.
Due to the confidential nature of these conversations, it is not possible to go into specifically all the topics discussed.
Omwille van het vertrouwelijke karakter van deze gesprekken kan niet specifiek worden ingegaan op alle onderwerpen die besproken zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een vluchtelingenkamp in het noorden van Irak

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkish airstrikes hit the Makhmur refugee camp in northern Iraq and that local authorities imposed movement restrictions, and whether Turkey's actions and the restrictions were lawful and consistent with refugee rights. The minister said Turkey reported strikes in the wider Karacok area without confirming any attack on the camp, that residents retain movement within Ninewa and medical access to Erbil, that the Netherlands is concerned and urges Turkey to respect international law, and that the government lacks sufficient information to judge compliance with the refugee convention.
The cabinet has insufficient information on which to judge whether the conditions in the Makhmur camp can be qualified as contrary to the UN Refugee Convention.
Het kabinet beschikt over onvoldoende informatie op basis waarvan de omstandigheden in kamp Makhmur wel of niet gekwalificeerd kunnen worden als zijnde in strijd met het VN-vluchtelingenverdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over Pakistan

An MP asked whether the government would respond to a reported video showing images of Geert Wilders with 'dead/murdered' text being walked and spat on in Pakistan, and whether it finds this acceptable. The Minister of Foreign Affairs answered that the video dates from August 2018 and that he discussed Pakistan's reactions and the government's concerns about threats with his Pakistani counterpart in 2018.
I held talks in August and September 2018 with my Pakistani counterpart, Foreign Minister Qureshi, about Pakistan's reactions to this and the cabinet's concerns about the threats.

Ik heb in augustus en september 2018 gesprekken gevoerd met mijn Pakistaanse ambtgenoot, Minister Qureshi van Buitenlandse Zaken, over de reacties van Pakistan hierop en de zorgen van het kabinet over de bedreigingen.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld van het lid Ploumen over de opnieuw opgelegde celstraf voor een Chinese internetdissident en de slechte gezondheidszorg in Chinese detentie

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the renewed prison sentence of Chinese internet dissident Huang Qi and poor medical care in Chinese detention, and whether the government would raise these with Chinese authorities. The minister said the government shares the concerns, supports the EU statement, raised Huang Qi's fair trial at the 2018 human rights dialogue, and will raise his situation again at the next dialogue.
A next bilateral human rights dialogue with China offers an opportunity to again raise concerns about Huang Qi's conviction with the Chinese authorities.
Een volgende bilaterale mensenrechtendialoog met China biedt gelegenheid om opnieuw zorgen over de veroordeling van Huang Qi over te brengen aan de Chinese autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat president Macron namens de EU 15 miljard euro aanbiedt aan Iran

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether President Macron offered 15 billion euros on behalf of the EU to Iran, and whether Dutch taxpayers would contribute. The minister answered that Macron offered no EU funds, that only France could offer funds without prior consent, and that the Netherlands currently grants no subsidies to Iran and would judge any future proposals on their merits.
Contrary to the above reporting, President Macron has not pledged any European money to Iran.
In tegenstelling tot bovengenoemde berichtgeving heeft president Macron geen Europees geld toegezegd aan Iran.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Hungary depriving asylum seekers of food- Council  of Europe’

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the ministers whether Hungary's treatment of asylum seekers, reported as food deprivation, also breaches international law such as the Refugee Convention, whether this has been raised in other fora, and whether Hungary has a duty of care and what aid options exist. The government answered that parts of Hungarian asylum policy conflict with international obligations, that the Commission has started infringement procedures and the Article 7 process covers fundamental rights, that it will keep raising concerns bilaterally and in the EU, and that it awaits the outcomes of the infringement procedures before further steps, with no specific aid discussed in the Council of Europe.
The cabinet awaits the outcomes of the infringement procedures before taking any new steps.
Het kabinet wacht de uitkomsten van de inbreukprocedures af alvorens nieuwe stappen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht dat kinderen van Oeigoerse afkomst door de Chinese overheid van hun ouders worden gescheiden en naar internaten worden gestuurd

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister whether reports that Chinese authorities separate Uyghur children from their families and place them in boarding schools are credible, whether this violates the Convention on the Rights of the Child, and whether sanctions or other measures will follow. The minister said the government has no reason to doubt the reports but cannot verify them independently, called forced separation unacceptable, promised to raise it in a bilateral human rights dialogue, and declined sanctions for now while stressing companies' due diligence responsibilities.
Due to the strict security and control in Xinjiang, independent verification of the reports is not feasible in practice.
Vanwege de strikte beveiliging en controle in Xinjiang is onafhankelijke toetsing van de berichtgeving in de praktijk niet haalbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Karabulut over de groeiende angst onder activisten om naar Marokko te gaan

Two MPs (Ploumen, Karabulut) asked whether the government is aware of fear among activists about travelling to Morocco, whether signals of insecurity were received, and whether a complaints point or stronger action is warranted. The minister replied that travel decisions are personal, no signals of increased insecurity were received, consular help is available, and the Rif cities carry a yellow travel advisory with no reason yet for stronger action.
Neither the Ministry of Foreign Affairs nor the embassy has received signals of increased insecurity.
Er zijn noch bij het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken noch bij de ambassade signalen binnen gekomen over toegenomen onveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de in beslagname van een vrachtschip door zowel Groot-Brittannië als Iran

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the UK seizure of an Iranian tanker at Gibraltar and the Iranian seizure of a British tanker, including whether these seizures were lawful under UNCLOS and EU sanctions. The minister relayed the UK position, rejected an independent inquiry, and said Netherlands is studying a possible contribution to maritime security in the Strait of Hormuz.
I see no reason for an independent investigation. I have no reason to question the UK's account.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor een onafhankelijk onderzoek. Ik heb geen reden om de lezing van het VK in twijfel te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over ‘een mogelijke nieuwe illegale militaire interventie door Turkije in het noorden van Syrië’

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey is preparing an illegal military intervention in northern Syria, whether the government shares concerns about it, whether the minister will raise this with Turkish counterparts, and whether sanctions will be pursued in the EU and NATO. The minister answered that Turkey has massed troops at the border but there are no signs of concrete offensive preparations, that talks with the US on a safe zone continue, that legality cannot be judged in advance, and that the Netherlands has raised Syria with Turkey bilaterally without committing to sanctions.
In advance, no judgment can be made on the lawfulness of possible action.
Op voorhand valt geen uitspraak te doen over de rechtmatigheid van mogelijk optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het hoge aantal burgerslachtoffers van explosieve wapens in dichtbevolkte gebieden

The MP Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about the high share of civilian victims of explosive weapons in populated areas, citing a 2019 NGO report and asking about past trends, UN calls and a planned Austrian conference. The minister answered that the Netherlands condemns such harm, relies on IHL, arms control treaties and export controls, funds explosive-remnant clearance, and will raise the issue at the conference.

Yes. The Netherlands will, in line with its existing position described in the answers to questions two, three and four, condemn the large number of civilian victims from the use of explosive weapons in populated areas.

Ja. Nederland zal daar, conform de bestaande inzet zoals omschreven in de beantwoording van vragen twee, drie en vier, het grote aantal burgerslachtoffers als gevolg van het gebruik van explosieve wapens in dichtbevolkte gebieden aan de kaak stellen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over vrouwenrechten in Saoedi-Arabië

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether Saudi reforms truly improve women's rights, given the continued detention of women's rights activists and the male guardianship system. The minister acknowledged limited reforms (passport, civil registration, labour protections) but said implementation is unclear, that the Netherlands raises activists' cases bilaterally and multilaterally, and that closing the Riyadh embassy is not an option.
The Netherlands also raises women's rights and the protection and support of women's rights activists within the EU and in the appropriate multilateral fora.
Nederland stelt de onderwerpen vrouwenrechten en de bescherming en ondersteuning van vrouwenrechtenactivisten tevens aan de orde in EU-verband en in de daarvoor geëigende multilaterale fora.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Helvert over het rapport 'We’re Indians too' van organisatie Open Doors inzake geweld, uitsluiting en geloofsvervolging van christelijke en moslimminderhe

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about an Open Doors report on violence and exclusion of Christian and Muslim minorities in India, including whether the government would raise anti-conversion laws, Dalit classification, and religious freedom with India at bilateral, EU and UN level. The minister answered that the government shares the concerns, raises religious freedom in human rights dialogues and UN forums, and plans to ask the new Special Envoy for freedom of religion to visit India, while declining to speculate on post-election developments.

I also intend to ask the recently appointed Special Envoy for freedom of religion and belief to travel to India to speak with the government and civil society organisations about freedom of religion and belief.

Ook ben ik voornemens om de onlangs aangestelde Speciaal Gezant religie en levensovertuiging te vragen naar India te gaan om daar met overheid en maatschappelijke organisaties te spreken over vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Islamisten én overheid jagen op Pakistaanse feministe’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Pakistani security services and Islamists are pursuing activist Gulalai Ismail, and whether the government will raise her case and human rights concerns with Pakistan and in multilateral fora. The minister said her whereabouts are unclear, that the government raised her case and wider human rights concerns with Pakistan's foreign minister, and that she could qualify for the Shelter Cities programme if she wishes.

In that conversation, the Netherlands raised concerns about the situation of Gulalai Ismail, the suppression of the Pashtun Tahafuzz Movement, detained members of parliament and the situation of human rights defenders.

In dat gesprek werden onder meer door Nederland de zorgen over de situatie van Gulalai Ismail, de onderdrukking van de Pashtun Tahafuzz Movement (PTM), gearresteerde leden van het parlement en de situatie van mensenrechtenverdedigers aangekaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht “NAVO verklapt slechtst bewaarde geheim van Nederland: kernbommen in Volkel”

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a report claiming US nuclear weapons are stored at Volkel and whether NATO's rules on nuclear transparency are breached. The minister replied that the report is not an official NATO document, that NATO rules permit only confirming the presence of US nuclear weapons in Europe without figures or locations, and that the government will keep pushing for more nuclear transparency within NATO.
However, no statements can be made about numbers and specific locations.
Er kunnen evenwel geen mededelingen worden gedaan over aantallen en specifieke locaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de sloop van gebouwen door Israël in gebieden deels onder bestuur van de Palestijnse Autoriteit

MP Karabulut asks the Foreign Minister about Israel's demolition of Palestinian buildings near a barrier in East Jerusalem, some in areas under Palestinian Authority planning control, and whether the Netherlands will condemn it and pursue measures. The minister condemns the demolition, notes the Israeli Supreme Court departs from the ICJ's 2004 advisory opinion, and says the Netherlands has joined EU and UN Security Council statements calling for restraint without ruling out any EU policy instruments.
The cabinet condemns this demolition and is concerned that more buildings will be demolished in this neighbourhood and in other parts of the West Bank.
Het kabinet veroordeelt deze sloop en is bezorgd dat er nog meer gebouwen zullen worden gesloopt in deze buurt en op andere delen van de Westelijke Jordaanoever.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Stoffer, Voordewind, Koopmans, De Roon en Baudet over de uitvoering van de motie-Van der Staaij c.s. over eenzijdige resoluties bij de VN

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands voted for a UN ECOSOC resolution on Palestinian women, how often Israel is condemned in UN bodies compared to other countries, and how the government implemented the Van der Staaij motion against disproportionate UN resolutions targeting Israel. The minister confirmed the Dutch vote, said Israel is condemned far more often than states like Saudi Arabia, and explained that the vote was taken to secure a more balanced text while committing to continue reducing disproportionate attention.
The Netherlands will continue to actively work against disproportionate attention in the UN and for reducing the number of resolutions on Israel and the occupied territories.
Nederland zal zich daarom actief blijven inzetten om disproportionele aandacht tegen te gaan in de VN en voor het verminderen van het aantal resoluties over Israël en de bezette gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de zorgelijke situatie van Aramese christenen in zuidoost Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the situation of Aramean Christians in southeast Turkey, including arson at three sites, and whether Turkish authorities protect minorities and whether the Netherlands will press for an investigation. The minister answered that the embassy has raised the arson with Turkish authorities at high level, that the Turkish authorities are responsible for investigating, and that the Netherlands will keep raising minority rights with Turkey.
It is now for the Turkish authorities to investigate the mentioned fires.
Het is nu aan de Turkse autoriteiten om de genoemde branden te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over “strijdsters voor vrouwenrechten in Afghanistan die steeds verder in het nauw komen”

Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares concern that women's rights activists in Afghanistan are increasingly squeezed, whether the PM raised Afghan peace talks with Trump, and what the government will do about women's rights after US and NATO withdrawal. Minister Blok answered that the situation is concerning, the PM did not discuss Afghanistan, the government raises women's rights with partners, and lists existing programmes and embassy activities.

Yes. In contacts with all international partners, including the United States, the cabinet emphasises that the Afghan peace process must lead to an outcome that protects the human rights of all citizens, including women and minorities.

Ja. Het kabinet benadrukt in contacten met alle internationale partners, waaronder de Verenigde Staten, dat het Afghaanse vredesproces moet leiden tot een uitkomst waarbij de mensenrechten van alle burgers, inclusief vrouwen en minderheden, worden beschermd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Polen sleept kritische juristen voor de rechter’

MPs Verhoeven and Groothuizen asked the ministers about reports that Poland was prosecuting critical academics, the rule-of-law procedure against Poland, and the Commission's rule-of-law communication. The government answered that the threatened prosecution was dropped, that it will voice concern about Poland's rule of law at EU level, and that it will study the Commission's proposals before reporting further.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘WhatsApp Rushes to Fix Security Flaw Exposed in Hacking of Lawyer’s Phone’

An MP asked ministers about a report that WhatsApp rushed to fix a security flaw exposed in the hacking of a lawyer's phone, and about NSO Group's hacking software being used against dissidents and journalists. The minister said vulnerabilities should be reported to vendors, that export controls and screening of suppliers apply, but declined to say which regimes bought NSO software.
I have no insight into the customer base of NSO Group and therefore cannot make statements about NSO Group's sales policy.
Ik heb geen inzicht in het klantenbestand van de NSO Group en kan dus geen uitspraken doen over het verkoopbeleid van de NSO Group.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Honderd Cubanen lopen illegale mars voor homorechten: 'Historisch moment'’

MPs Groothuizen and Bergkamp asked about reports that Cuban police arrested demonstrators at an unauthorised LGBTI rights march, and whether this changes the Dutch policy that LGBTI Cubans can generally return safely, including questions on monitoring, Cuban returnees, asylum statistics and a new country report. The government regrets the arrests and violence, says there is no reason to change policy since discrimination is not systematic enough to amount to persecution, will raise the issue with Cuban authorities, and holds that sufficient reliable information exists so no new thematic country report is needed.
I therefore cannot confirm these reports.
Ik kan berichtgeving hierover dan ook niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de bestorming van de al-Aqsa compound door honderden kolonisten gesteund door Israëlische militairen

Dutch MP Kuzu (DENK) asked the ministers about the storming of the al-Aqsa compound by settlers escorted by Israeli forces, and whether the government condemns it, will act, and supports a UN mission. Minister Blok answered that the Temple Mount status quo is important, that the Netherlands and the EU have repeatedly urged its preservation, but that the Netherlands plays no mediating role and does not support an independent UN monitoring mission.

No. In recent years Israel, the Palestinian Authority and Jordan have shown they are able, sometimes with difficulty and sometimes with external help, to make arrangements about the holy sites in Jerusalem.

Nee. De afgelopen jaren hebben Israël, de Palestijnse Autoriteit en Jordanië aangetoond dat zij in staat zijn, soms met moeite en soms met externe hulp, om afspraken te maken over de heilige plaatsen in Jeruzalem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘Madagascar: Take decisive steps to end torture and killings by security forces’

MPs Ploumen and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty International's call on Madagascar to end impunity for torture and killings by security forces and to address prison conditions. The minister answered that Netherlands supports the call, will raise it via EU political dialogue and the UN Universal Periodic Review, but has no embassy in Madagascar and cannot verify prison conditions or the number of detained minors.
The Netherlands has no embassy or career consulate in Madagascar and therefore cannot draw on its own observations.
Nederland heeft geen ambassade of beroepsconsulaat in Madagaskar en kan derhalve niet uit eigen waarnemingen putten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ploumen, Karabulut, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik en Van der  Staaij over het Nederlandse kind Duncan en de Spaanse kinderbescherming

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the case of a Dutch child with Down syndrome held under Spanish child protection and whether he should be reunited with his mother quickly. The minister said the matter falls to the competent Spanish authority, that the ministry is following the case and has mediated contact, and withheld case details citing data protection.
For reasons of personal data protection, I cannot give your House any details about the individual case.
Omwille van persoonsgegevensbescherming kan ik uw Kamer geen details geven over de individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht ‘VN-rapport: Bewijs dat Saoedische kroonprins achter moord Khashoggi zit’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government responds to a UN special rapporteur's report finding credible evidence that Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman bears responsibility for the murder of journalist Jamal Khashoggi, and asked about contact with the rapporteur, whether the killing is an international crime, and further EU sanctions. The minister replied that the Netherlands and the EU condemn the murder, call on Saudi Arabia to cooperate fully with investigations, engaged with the rapporteur at the Human Rights Council, and will keep pressing bilaterally and multilaterally, but that there is currently no support for UN sanctions and priority is given to an EU human rights sanctions regime.
The cabinet will continue to press this in bilateral and multilateral contexts.
Het kabinet zal hier in bilateraal en multilateraal verband op blijven aandringen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Sneller over het Rapport van de Special Rapporteur on extrajudicial, summary or arbitrary executions: Investigation into the unlawful death of Mr. Jamal Khashoggi

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the UN Special Rapporteur's report finding Khashoggi's killing a premeditated extrajudicial execution attributable to Saudi Arabia, and about recommendations on accountability, press safety, surveillance exports and targeted sanctions. The minister acknowledged the report's seriousness, urged Saudi cooperation and further investigation, said sanctions currently lack the needed broad support, and listed bilateral and multilateral follow-up steps.
For this reason the Netherlands and the EU continue to call on Saudi Arabia to fully cooperate with all investigations and to make all information about the case available.
Nederland en de EU blijven daarom Saoedi-Arabië oproepen om volledige medewerking te verlenen aan alle onderzoeken en om alle informatie over de zaak beschikbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma en Van Nispen over gedetineerdenbegeleiding in het buitenland

MPs from CDA, D66 and SP asked whether Dutch detainees abroad can receive legal aid from the Netherlands, how subsidies for detainee support were distributed, and whether DutchAdvocates refuses or redirects cases and pressures former PrisonLAW clients. The minister replied that legal aid is primarily the detainee's own responsibility with local lawyers, that subsidy was transferred to DutchAdvocates from 2019 with PrisonLAW's agreement, that clients are free to choose their lawyer, and that no misconduct exists.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht dat jonge vrouwen die Saoedi-Arabië ontvluchten om een gedwongen huwelijk en seksueel misbruik te voorkomen

Two PvdA MPs asked the foreign minister and justice state secretary about reports that two young Saudi women fleeing forced marriage were refused boarding in Georgia, whether they would be admitted, and what the government was doing on Saudi women's rights. The minister said the reports could not be confirmed, no visa application was made, asylum for such women runs only through UNHCR resettlement, and that Nederland repeatedly raises women's rights bilaterally and in the EU and UN.
Because of the small numbers, it is not possible for privacy and technical reasons to state what the asylum motives are.
Vanwege de kleine aantallen is het om privacy technische redenen niet mogelijk aan te geven wat de asielmotieven zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de ontmoeting met de Chinese collega Wang Yi waarin de sterke band en het belang van internationale samenwerking besproken werd

Ploumen asked Foreign Minister Blok whether human rights abuses in China were raised during his meeting with Wang Yi, and about facial recognition and the social credit system. Blok answered that he raised freedom of religion, especially in Xinjiang, and met human rights activists, and that the Netherlands raises these issues with China, while he declined to discuss facial recognition and social credit in that meeting, offering to put social credit on the agenda of a future human rights dialogue.
I am willing to put the subject on the agenda of the next bilateral human rights dialogue with China, which may take place this autumn.
Ik ben bereid om het onderwerp te agenderen voor de volgende bilaterale mensenrechtendialoog met China die mogelijk dit najaar zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de samenwerking tussen scheepsbouwer Damen en de Nederlandse staat

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries and Foreign Minister about Atradius export-credit insurance for shipbuilder Damen, alleged fraud and irregularities, and whether the submarine replacement decision should wait for clarity on Damen. The government confirmed 67 policies worth 1.89 billion euro, declined to comment on the ongoing criminal investigation, and said suspicion of fraud is not grounds for exclusion from tender under the Defence procurement law.
Because this case involves an ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot provide further statements on this.
Omdat er in deze casus sprake is van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik daar geen verdere mededelingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de eenzijdige beëindiging van Temporary International Presence in Hebron (TIPH) door de Israëlische overheid

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Israel's decision not to renew the TIPH observer mission in Hebron, including its impact on Palestinians, whether the government condemns it, and the prospects for resumption. The minister said the government regrets the decision, shares EU concern, calls for the mission's resumption, but notes it lacks the confidential TIPH reports and that resumption depends on Israel, the Palestinian Authority and contributing states.
The Netherlands was not one of the countries that supplied observers to TIPH, and therefore did not receive the confidential TIPH reports the media refer to.
Nederland was niet een van de landen die waarnemers leverden voor TIPH, en kreeg daarom ook niet de vertrouwelijke rapporten van TIPH, waarnaar de media verwijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat terrorismeverdachten toch geld kunnen opnemen van bevroren tegoeden

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether frozen funds of suspected Al Qaeda or IS supporters can be withdrawn for basic necessities, whether the UN exemption system and its lack of public deliberation and ex-post control should be revised, and whether the Netherlands voted on such requests while on the Security Council. The minister answers that UN Security Council sanctions committee deliberations are confidential, that exemptions are a national-level responsibility for spending control, and that the rules are public, without committing to reform.
Such an overview unfortunately cannot be shared because of the confidentiality of the deliberations of the UN Sanctions Committee.
Een dergelijk overzicht kan helaas niet worden gedeeld vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van de beraadslagingen van het VN-Sanctiecomité.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over de oprichting van een tribunaal om IS-strijders te vervolgen

MPs asked whether the government had discussed an international tribunal for IS fighters with Sweden, whether it will pursue genocide prosecutions and join a Swedish-invited conference, and whether a prosecutor is assigned. The government confirmed talks with Sweden and UN partners, said it is seeking expert advice on an international tribunal due 8 July 2019, and said the Public Prosecution Service will report on a dedicated prosecutor before the recess.
The Public Prosecution Service is expected to inform the cabinet before the recess whether a special prosecutor specifically for prosecuting ISIS fighters for genocide would add value.

Het OM zal het kabinet naar verwachting voor het reces nog informeren of daarnaast een speciale officier van justitie specifiek voor de vervolging van ISIS-strijders voor genocide van toegevoegde waarde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het terughalen van Nederlandse kinderen uit Syrië

Two PvdA MPs asked whether MIVD staff or Dutch diplomats regularly visit the Al-Roj camp in Syria to prepare repatriation, how often delegations have visited, and whether the Netherlands prepares for returning children and their parents. The ministers declined to comment publicly on intelligence service methods, called the report of biweekly diplomatic visits incorrect, and stated that returnees will be brought back in a controlled manner for prosecution while children are treated as victims and childcare plans are ready.
No public statements are made about the working methods of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Over de werkwijze van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten wordt in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der  Staaij, Koopmans, Voordewind, De Roon en Van Helvert over aanvallen door radicale moslims op christenen in Nigeria

Five MPs asked the foreign minister about the May 2019 killing of Nigerian Christians after a church visit near Jos and whether radical Muslims were responsible. The government confirmed the killings, framed the Middle Belt conflict as mainly driven by resource pressure rather than religion, and promised to raise the issue bilaterally, in the EU and UN, and through the special envoy for freedom of religion.
The conflict is on the agenda during bilateral talks and will also be discussed during Minister Kaag's visit to Nigeria in July.
Het conflict staat op de agenda tijdens bilaterale gesprekken en zal ook tijdens het bezoek van Minister Kaag aan Nigeria in juli worden besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Ploumen, Van den Hul, Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over het bericht ‘IND stuurt yezidi’s terug naar kampen in Noord-Irak, VN ongerust’

MPs asked the State Secretary whether Iraqi Yezidis are being returned to camps in Northern Iraq despite UNHCR concern, and whether Kurdish camps can absorb them. The State Secretary answered that Yezidis from other parts of Iraq who fled to the Kurdistan Region and lived there long-term are no longer treated as having a normal residence there, so the vulnerable minority policy applies, and that the Kurdish shelter situation is not generally inadequate.
I have asked the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to give extra attention to the Yezidis in the upcoming general country report on Iraq, which I expect early next year.
Ik heb het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken gevraagd bij het komende algemeen ambtsbericht over Irak, dat ik begin volgend jaar verwacht, extra aandacht te besteden aan de jezidi’s
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Omtzigt over  het  bericht 'Nederland stuurt Yezidi’s terug naar de tentenkampen en dat is tegen eigen regels zeggen advocaten'

CDA MPs Van Dam and Omtzigt asked whether the Netherlands is returning Yazidis to camps in northern Iraq, whether the policy changed, and how many genocide victims received protection and perpetrators are prosecuted. The State Secretary answered that individual asylum assessments apply, that Yazidis who lived in the Kurdistan Region after fleeing other parts of Iraq are no longer treated as having a normal residence there, and that the Netherlands prosecutes international crimes while leading international evidence mechanisms, though the government does not register asylum grounds by group and gave no case figures.
I have asked the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to pay extra attention to the Yazidis in the upcoming general country report on Iraq, which I expect early next year.
Ik heb het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken gevraagd bij het komende algemeen ambtsbericht over Irak, dat ik begin volgend jaar verwacht, extra aandacht te besteden aan de jezidi's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het wegzenden van Taiwanese waarnemers bij het World Meteorological Congress 2019

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew that two Taiwanese experts were excluded from the WMO World Meteorological Congress after one day, and whether he would ask the WMO for an official explanation. The minister confirmed the reports and explained that the experts had not been invited by the WMO but accredited via a private industry association for a parallel expo, and were refused access once their nationality became known under the WMO's UN-recognised-country passport rule.
Inquiries with the WMO reveal that the two Taiwanese meteorological experts were not invited or accredited by the WMO to attend the World Meteorological Congress as observers.
Navraag bij WMO leert dat de twee Taiwanese meteorologische experts niet door WMO waren uitgenodigd of geaccrediteerd om als waarnemers bij het World Meteorological Congress aanwezig te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over gelekte documenten aangaande smerige politiek in Brazilië

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether leaked documents showing alleged political manipulation of Lula's conviction in Brazil were known, how they were assessed, and what they say about judicial independence. The minister acknowledged the reports and described the parliamentary hearing and Supreme Court proceedings, stating that it is for the Brazilian legal system to reach a judgment.
It is for the Brazilian legal system to reach a legal judgment on the alleged statements of Mr. Sergio Moro.
Het is aan het Braziliaanse rechtssysteem om tot een juridisch oordeel te komen over de al dan niet vermeende uitlatingen van dhr. Sergio Moro.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het bericht dat Nederland met kinderlevens speelt

MP Buitenweg asks whether Dutch children in Kurdish camps without parental care should be repatriated, and what the consequences of revoking a parent's Dutch nationality are for the children. The government answers that about 90 children with a Dutch link are in the camps, that revocation does not affect already-born children's nationality, that it sees no treaty obligation to repatriate, and that it assesses orphan cases case by case without sending people into unsafe areas.
The cabinet continues to assess cases of Dutch orphaned children on a case-by-case basis and to explore the possibilities.
Het kabinet blijft gevallen van Nederlandse weeskinderen van zaak tot zaak beoordelen en de mogelijkheden verkennen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Geurts over de vernietiging van Hollandse uien in Hongarije

MPs Amhaouch and Geurts asked the government about Hungarian authorities destroying a Dutch onion consignment that lacked origin labelling, and whether this was lawful and avoidable. The minister answered that the missing label breached rules, that the consignment was sent to biogas digestion after a spot check, that Hungarian law permits such measures, and that talks with Hungary will be held to prevent recurrence.
I will discuss with the relevant Hungarian authorities whether agreements are possible to prevent this in the future.
Ik zal met de betreffende Hongaarse autoriteiten bespreken of afspraken mogelijk zijn om dit in de toekomst te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht ‘VN annuleert mensenrechtensessies wegens geldgebrek’

Ploumen (PvdA) asks the Foreign Minister about reports that the UN is cancelling human rights sessions due to lack of funds, and about the effects on complaints, country reports and Dutch cases. Minister Blok replies that no treaty body sessions have yet been cancelled, that OHCHR confirmed the 2019 sessions will proceed, that the funding problems stem from a cash-flow shortage, a 2017 budget cut and staffing limits, and that the Netherlands paid its contribution and urges late-paying states to pay.
Together with the other EU member states, the Netherlands consistently urges countries in arrears to meet their payment obligations.
Nederland roept samen met de andere lidstaten van de Europese Unie landen die in gebreke blijven consequent op hun betalingsverplichtingen na te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Ploumen over het bericht dat er nieuw bewijs is van China's missie om de moskeeën in Xinjiang te verwoesten

MPs Kuzu and Ploumen asked the government about reports that China is demolishing mosques and shrines in Xinjiang, whether this violates universal human rights, and what the Netherlands and the EU have done to press China. The ministers answer that the demolitions fit a broader pattern of restricted freedoms in Xinjiang that they consider contrary to international human rights norms, list bilateral, EU and UN initiatives, and say they will keep pressing for meaningful access for UN experts to Xinjiang.
The cabinet continues to call for meaningful access to Xinjiang for UN (human rights) experts, including the High Commissioner for Human Rights.
Het kabinet blijft pleiten voor betekenisvolle toegang tot Xinjiang voor (mensenrechten)experts van de VN, waaronder de Hoge Commissaris voor de Mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat het leger van Myanmar opnieuw mensenrechten schendt

An MP asked the Foreign and Development Ministers about Amnesty International's report on new Myanmar army abuses in Rakhine State, including demands for sanctions, an ICC referral and a arms embargo. The ministers condemned the violence, said Netherlands keeps pressing for ICC referral, sanctions and an investigation mechanism, but noted UN Security Council deadlock blocks action.
On 17 June, Minister Blok again called in the Foreign Affairs Council for additional sanctions against those responsible for the human rights violations.
Minister Blok heeft op 17 juni in de RBZ nogmaals opgeroepen tot aanvullende sancties tegen de verantwoordelijken voor de mensenrechtenschendingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het overlijden van gijzelaar Ewold Horn in de Filipijnen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the death of Dutch hostage Ewold Horn in the Philippines, including whether the government knew of a planned rescue operation, what steps it took, and whether it had dialogue with Abu Sayyaf. The minister said local authorities are responsible for resolution, declined to detail the government's efforts or the planned operation for reasons of confidentiality, and dismissed critics' claims as made without knowledge of the efforts.

To avoid harming the Dutch government's capacity to act in this and future cases, in the interest of relations with third countries and international organisations, and thus for the safety of all Dutch nationals abroad, I will not make further statements about this case or the Dutch government's efforts in it.

Om de slagkracht van de Nederlandse overheid in deze en toekomstige zaken niet te schaden, in het belang van de relaties met derde landen en internationale organisaties en dus voor de veiligheid van alle Nederlanders in het buitenland, doe ik geen nadere mededelingen over deze zaak en de inspanningen van de Nederlandse overheid daarin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Sjoerdsma over lange rijen bij de Roemeense stembureaus in Nederland

Two D66 MPs asked whether too few voting locations were provided for Romanian citizens in the Netherlands, causing long queues and a disturbance at the Hague embassy during the 2019 EP and referendum votes, and whether the government would raise this with Romania. The minister answered that Romanian authorities are responsible, that the Netherlands raised its dissatisfaction with the ambassador and Romanian counterpart, and that Romania promised improvements, so no EU-level agenda item is needed.
The Romanian authorities must in future ensure sufficient capacity, polling stations and staff so that every citizen who wishes to vote can do so.
De Roemeense autoriteiten dienen in het vervolg te zorgen voor voldoende capaciteit, stemlocaties en personeel, zodat iedere burger die dat wil kan stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een gelekt document van de OPCW over een chemische aanval in Syrië

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a leaked internal OPCW document suggesting doubts about the official findings on the 2018 chemical attack in Douma, Syria, and whether it was withheld. The minister confirmed the internal report exists, said the OPCW considered its contents, that independent ballistic analyses supported the official conclusion, and that the Netherlands has no reason to doubt the official report.
It is correct that an internal OPCW report exists on the poison gas attack in Douma on 7 April 2018, with findings that partly deviate from those included in the official OPCW FFM report.

Het klopt dat er een OPCW-intern rapport bestaat over de gifgasaanval in Douma op 7 april 2018 met bevindingen die deels afwijken van de bevindingen die door de Fact Finding Mission (FFM) van de Organisatie voor het Verbod op Chemische Wapens (OPCW) zijn opgenomen in het officiële OPCW-FFM rapport
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht ‘U.S. sanctions Congo election officials, says they obstructed vote’

MP Ploumen asks the government whether it knows of US sanctions on Congolese election officials for obstructing the vote, and about corruption, the effects of EU and US sanctions, network-based sanctioning and criminal money flows in the DRC. Minister Blok answers that the Netherlands is in contact with the US, that EU and US sanctions target individuals obstructing the election, that network-based sanctions were not an EU criterion, and that tracing illicit money flows is being pursued with partners such as The Sentry.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Drost, Voordewind en Segers over de berichten 'Iraans anti-Israëlprotest bereikt ook westerse steden' en 'CIDI: Stop haatdemonstraties Iraans regime in Nederland'

MPs Drost, Voordewind and Segers asked whether calls to destroy Israel and the United States at a demonstration in The Hague were incitement to hatred, whether police should have ended it, whether an interpreter was present, and whether Iran was behind it. The minister answered that the demonstration right allows offensive speech, police found no criminal offences, an interpreter was present, and the cabinet has no concrete indication of Iranian involvement.
The right to demonstrate also includes publicly expressing opinions or statements that may be experienced as annoying, offensive or shocking.
Het demonstratierecht omvat ook het publiekelijk uiten van meningen of uitlatingen die als hinderlijk, aanstootgevend of choquerend kunnen worden ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kuiken en Voordewind over het bericht ‘VVD en CDA zien geen heil in terughalen IS-kinderen’
