MPs Ploumen, Kuiken and Voordewind asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about the situation of Dutch IS women and children held in Syrian camps, their ability to reach Dutch consulates, the Red Cross offer to bring children to Erbil, and calls for an international tribunal. The government answered that it does not actively pursue repatriation of adult jihadist travellers and their children, that conditions in Al-Hol are very poor, and that it is working on options for prosecution with international partners while stating no tribunal has yet been agreed.
The cabinet sees the children in this matter first and foremost as victims.
Het kabinet ziet de kinderen in deze kwestie in de eerste plaats als slachtoffer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Nederlanders in het Verenigd Koninkrijk worden geweerd bij de stembureaus

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch citizens in the UK were turned away from polling stations in the 2019 European elections due to registration problems, and whether this was unacceptable and would be raised with the UK. The minister confirmed the reports, said elections are a UK responsibility, noted the UK Electoral Commission's review, and said the government would raise the concern in upcoming talks with the UK.
Nevertheless, the Dutch government will appropriately draw attention to the concerns of Dutch citizens in the UK regarding their participation in the British European elections.
Desalniettemin zal de Nederlandse regering op gepaste wijze aandacht vragen voor de zorgen van de Nederlandse burgers in het VK
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over geweld tegen demonstranten in Soedan

Karabulut (SP) asked the Foreign Minister whether he knows of the deadly violence against protesters in Sudan, whether he shares calls for targeted sanctions and a handover of power to civilians. Minister Blok confirmed over 100 deaths, said he had voiced concerns and urged a civilian transition, and described EU and African Union steps including a call for sanctions to be considered if violence escalates.
The Netherlands advocates an active supporting role for the EU in the run-up to and during the transition process in Sudan.
Nederland pleit voor een actieve ondersteunende rol van de EU in aanloop naar en tijdens het transitieproces in Soedan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de mogelijke executie van een Saudische tiener

The MP Karabulut asks the Foreign Minister about the possible execution of a Saudi teenager who was arrested as a child for protesting, and whether Saudi Arabia executes people arrested as minors, and asks the government to protest and consider targeted sanctions. The minister answers that the youth was sentenced to 12 years rather than death, the Netherlands and EU have raised concerns and will follow the appeal, there are no official figures on such executions, and sanctions lack the required international political consensus.
The Netherlands will continue to follow the case.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Dissidenten uit Hongkong krijgen voor het eerst asiel in Duitsland’

Two PvdA MPs asked the foreign and justice ministers about Hong Kong's proposed extradition law to China, its risks for Dutch citizens and firms, and German asylum grants to Hong Kong dissidents. The government said it had raised concerns with Hong Kong's leader and the EU, that the law was suspended, and that asylum decisions do not reflect on the rule of law in the country of origin.
The cabinet will closely follow developments and, if necessary, consider what the consequences should be for cooperation with Hong Kong on the surrender of fugitive offenders.

Het kabinet zal de ontwikkelingen nauwgezet blijven volgen en zal zo nodig bezien wat de eventuele gevolgen zouden moeten zijn voor de samenwerking met Hongkong op het gebied van overlevering van voortvluchtige delinquenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘Western firms get tangled in China’s Uighur crackdown’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether forced labour in Xinjiang re-education camps and a surge in yarn production is linked to garments sold in the Netherlands, and what the government will do about supply chains and the textile covenant. The government condemns forced labour, says it cannot confirm or deny that Xinjiang yarn ends up in Dutch clothing, and promises to raise the issue within the covenant and with China, without committing to talks with individual brands.
The government therefore can neither confirm nor deny that yarn from Xinjiang, produced with forced labour, has been processed into clothing sold in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet kan daarom bevestigen noch ontkennen dat garen uit Xinjiang, geproduceerd met gedwongen arbeid, is verwerkt in kleding die in Nederland wordt verkocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Police Can’t  Guarantee Pride Safety Outdoors - Ministry’

Two D66 MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that Georgian police could not guarantee security for the Tbilisi Pride march, and whether the Netherlands would raise concerns and have diplomats join the march. The minister confirmed the concerns were raised with the Georgian foreign minister and that the embassy is in close contact with authorities, and said diplomats would be willing to participate.
The Dutch ambassador in Tbilisi has already conveyed my concerns about the security of the planned Pride march at political level.
De Nederlandse ambassadeur in Tbilisi heeft mijn zorgen rondom de beveiliging van de geplande Pride-optocht inmiddels op politiek niveau overgebracht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Sjoerdsma, Kuiken en Voordewind over het bericht ‘VN: 1.500 migranten in levensgevaar in Libië’

Four MPs asked the government about reports that about 1,500 migrants held in detention centres south of Tripoli were in danger from fighting, and about the evacuation of detainees, reports of forced participation in the conflict, and possible Dutch action. The ministers answered that the Netherlands is following the situation closely, supports UNHCR and IOM evacuations and resettlement via the Emergency Transit Mechanism, is considering additional funding, and says forced use of civilians in fighting would violate international humanitarian law, while the forced-participation reports were not confirmed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Sjoerdsma over Koninklijke onderscheidingen aan buitenlandse staatshoofden

MPs Sneller and Sjoerdsma asked whether royal Dutch honours given to foreign heads of state can be inappropriate when controversy or human rights violations are involved, and whether revocation grounds should be widened. The minister listed nine heads of state honoured in the past five years, said honours are a diplomatic instrument, opposed widening revocation grounds, and was willing to have the standard practice evaluated.
I am of the view that broadening the revocation grounds for honours will not contribute to a better substantive discussion with the country concerned about respecting international law.

Ik ben van mening dat het verruimen van intrekkingsgronden van onderscheidingen niet zal bijdragen aan een betere inhoudelijke discussie met het betrokken land over het respecteren van het internationaal recht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het gebruik van geweld tegen demonstranten in Pakistan

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the use of force against Pashtun activists in North Waziristan, the arrest of MP Ali Wazir, calls for independent investigation, and whether the Netherlands would raise concerns with Pakistan. The minister confirmed the reports (casualty figures disputed), said Pakistani authorities are responsible for investigating, and said the Netherlands raises rule-of-law concerns bilaterally and the EU will raise the Pashtun movement's suppression at a 25 June meeting.
The government is of the view that the Pakistani authorities have the responsibility to investigate the circumstances of the violence.
De regering is van mening dat de Pakistaanse autoriteiten de verantwoordelijkheid hebben de toedracht van het geweld te onderzoeken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Amerikaanse kerncentrales in Saoedi-Arabië, en Urenco?'

MPs Van der Lee and Van Ojik asked whether the US would sell nuclear technology to Saudi Arabia despite the Khashoggi case and Saudi nuclear weapons ambitions, and whether Urenco would supply enriched uranium to Saudi Arabia under the Almelo Treaty. The ministers answered that the US has not confirmed any export, that civil nuclear use is permitted under the NPT, that Urenco supply oversight lies with the Joint Committee whose deliberations are confidential, and that no supply to Saudi Arabia is foreseen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht dat de VS een steeds steviger abortusbeleid voert

Two Labour MPs asked the ministers about reports that the US is tightening anti-abortion funding rules abroad, asking for the government's reaction, diplomatic steps, and ways to offset the effects. The minister said the government regrets the measures, has raised concerns with US officials, and points to continued SRGR funding and several parliamentary amendments being implemented.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht dat natuurorganisaties en inheemse volken Jair Bolsonaro een grote bedreiging vinden voor het Amazoneregenwoud

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister about reports of rising Amazon deforestation under President Bolsonaro, whether Dutch support for land-rights and environmental defenders exists, and whether Dutch companies are involved. The minister acknowledged the concern, said the government raises deforestation with Brazil bilaterally and multilaterally, noted funding channels, and said no Dutch company involvement is known.
Should this be the case, dialogue on this will be sought.
Mocht dit zo zijn, dan zal daarover de dialoog gezocht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de behandeling van het onderwerp godsdienstvrijheid in het Algemeen Ambtsbericht over Afghanistan

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister whether the General Asylum Report on Afghanistan wrongly portrayed religious freedom and the position of Christians, converts and apostates, including omitting parts of the US State Department findings and a Open Doors claim about trials framed as other crimes. The Minister denied intending such a picture, defended the report's treatment of non-Muslims and converts, and declined to amend the text.
I therefore see no reason to amend the said paragraph.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om genoemde paragraaf aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers, Van Helvert en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘RIVM scherpt vaccinatieadvies mazelen aan’

MPs Raemakers, Van Helvert and Sjoerdsma asked about RIVM's measles vaccination advice for infants travelling to high-risk countries and whether the Foreign Ministry should adjust its travel advice accordingly. The minister answered that the advice is updated annually based on WHO data, and that the Foreign Ministry defers health information to the national travel health centre (LCR) by linking to it rather than copying the measles guidance, while examining automatic integration.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is examining whether it is possible to automatically load the LCR information into the BZ Travel App.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken onderzoekt wel of het mogelijk is om de informatie van de LCR automatisch in de BZ Reisapp in te laden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Sjoerdsma over het aanpassen van reisadviezen naar aanleiding van de uitbraak van mazelen in een Haagse kinderopvang

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Affairs Minister why travel advice does not specifically warn of measles risk in Europe and whether it should be updated, as the GGD does. The minister replied that travel advice links directly to the LCR's current health information, which covers measles, and that the ministry is not the health authority and will not copy changing health advice into its advice.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is examining whether it is possible to automatically load the LCR information into the BZ Travel app.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken onderzoekt wel of het mogelijk is om de informatie van de LCR automatisch in de BZ Reisapp in te laden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ploumen over maatregelen tegen Amerikaanse sancties tegen Iran

MPs Karabulut and Ploumen asked whether the EU anti-boycott regulation against US sanctions on Iran is effective and whether the US sanctions are unlawful, and what steps can protect the JCPOA and trade with Iran. The ministers answered that the regulation is in place but unused by Dutch firms, that INSTEX is being developed, that Dutch firms decide independently to cut trade, and that the Netherlands remains committed to the JCPOA.
The cabinet has no figures on the trading activities of individual Dutch companies with Iran.
Het kabinet heeft geen cijfers over de handelsactiviteiten van individuele Nederlandse bedrijven met Iran.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over het bericht dat een Nederlandse strafrechtadvocaat de toegang tot de Verenigde Staten geweigerd wordt

SP MPs asked the government whether it would act after reports that a Dutch criminal lawyer representing terrorism suspects was denied entry to the United States, and how US authorities obtained that information. The minister said advocates must be free to practise, that the US decides its own entry criteria and gave no individual explanation, that the government raised the matter with US authorities and will monitor it, and that the Dutch government shares no information about such lawyers with the US.
Enquiries with the American authorities show that an application for an ESTA or visa is assessed against many different criteria.
Navraag bij de Amerikaanse autoriteiten leert dat een aanvraag voor een ESTA of visum wordt getoetst aan de hand van vele verschillende criteria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over advocaten die de toegang tot de Verenigde Staten wordt geweigerd

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked whether US entry bans against lawyers defending terrorism suspects could deter Dutch lawyers, and whether the minister would consult the US ambassador. The minister agreed lawyers must practise freely, said US entry decisions are sovereign and based on many criteria, and reported that US authorities referred to general policy and would not address individual cases; the government will keep monitoring the situation.
Lawyers must be free in the exercise of their profession, given the important role they play in realising the right of suspects to a fair trial.
Advocaten moeten vrij zijn in de uitoefening van hun beroep, gelet op de belangrijke rol die zij spelen in de verwezenlijking van het recht van verdachten op een eerlijk proces.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over een Brits rapport inzake geloofsvervolging waarin grote zorgen worden geuit over de wereldwijde christenvervolging

MPs from CDA, ChristenUnie and SGP asked the Foreign Minister about a British interim report on Christian persecution that said persecution in some regions approaches the UN definition of genocide, and asked what Dutch action would follow. The minister responded that the Netherlands shares concern, cites its existing human rights commitments, the planned Special Envoy and an international conference in November 2019, and that sanctions and genocide-prevention obligations are available instruments without committing to new specific measures.
The cabinet is committed, and will remain committed, to upholding the Universal Declaration, including article 18.
Nederland zet zich in, en zal zich blijven inzetten, voor naleving van de Universele Verklaring, met inbegrip van artikel 18.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat in 2017 Nederland bijstand verleende aan Nederlandse uitreizigers in Syrië

An MP asked whether Dutch diplomats in 2016-2017 sought to retrieve Dutch jihadist travellers from Syria via the Free Syrian Army and Turkey, and how this squares with earlier answers denying any assistance policy. The minister answers that contacts were limited to verifying identity and location of four cases in non-combat areas at family request, that no retrieval was requested, and that the policy on not assisting travellers inside the combat zone was unchanged, though the answers did not disclose the 2016 internal policy note and the earlier answer's omissions are acknowledged in part.
It is not customary to share internal policy views with the House, such as the Ministry of Foreign Affairs memorandum referred to in the NOS article.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om interne beleidsopvattingen met de Kamer te delen, zoals de nota van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse zaken waaraan het NOS-artikel refereert.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de geheime gesprekken van de Europese Commissie met voormalig premier van het Verenigd Koninkrijk de heer Blair en de heer George Soros over een tweede Brexit-referendum

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reported secret meetings of Commissioner Moscovici with Tony Blair and George Soros on a second Brexit referendum, and about the Commission's non-publication of such meetings and absence of minutes. The minister answered that the Commission decides whom its members meet, that the Brexit mandate is unaffected, that the Commission's publication decision falls within its own exceptions, and that the Commission is responsible for its own transparency, while noting the lobby register proposal was stalled but the Netherlands would push for it in the next legislature.
It is up to the European Commission itself to weigh whom Commissioners do or do not speak with.
Het is aan de Europese Commissie zelf om de afweging te maken met wie Eurocommissarissen wel of niet spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Venezuela belangrijk thema op Koninkrijksoverleg’

An MP asked the government about Aruba's push for a visa requirement for Venezuelans, the Caribbean visa framework, alleged visa fraud by Dominicans and overstay figures. The minister said no common Kingdom position exists yet, that Aruba will first exhaust national measures, and that the government sees no organised visa abuse but will keep monitoring.
Neither the Ministry of Foreign Affairs nor the Aruban authorities have any knowledge of organised abuse of Caribbean visas for Aruba.
Er is bij het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken noch bij de autoriteiten van Aruba iets bekend over georganiseerd misbruik van Caribische visa voor Aruba.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht ‘Vijf jaar na de grote ontvoering door Boko Haram, zijn nog 112 schoolmeisjes niet vrij’

An MP asked why the government has made no concrete proposal to Nigeria to help find the 112 still-missing Chibok schoolgirls, and asked about trauma support, satellite imagery, NGO contacts and gender-violence programmes. The ministers answered that Nigeria has made no request for help, that Dutch psychosocial aid already reaches Boko Haram victims, and that other states are handling satellite sharing and support.
This is a matter between third countries and Nigeria, in which the Netherlands is not involved.
Dit is een zaak tussen derde landen en Nigeria, waar Nederland niet bij betrokken is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'Kritiek op Saoedi’s? Dan dreigt gevaar'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the risk to critical journalists and dissidents from Saudi Arabia, including contacts with Norwegian and US intelligence, EU coordination, and calls for divestment. The minister replied that concerns about Saudi human rights are shared, that intelligence contacts are not discussed publicly, and that the Netherlands opposes boycotts or sanctions while continuing critical dialogue.
The government does not publicly comment on specific contacts between Dutch and foreign intelligence and security services.
De regering gaat in het openbaar niet in op concrete contacten tussen Nederlandse en buitenlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Remco Dijkstra, Koopmans en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht dat Defensie zich nog geen raad weet met steeds kleinere drones

VVD MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs, among others, about the difficulty of countering increasingly small drones, expert recommendations, inter-ministerial coordination, and Defence's counter-drone research and industry cooperation. The ministers replied that research is ongoing with international partners, coordination with the police and Justice and Veiligheid exists, and Nederland is pursuing counter-drone categories in EDIDP, without committing to new checks on the executive.
The cabinet will return on this matter shortly in a letter that will be sent to the House soon.
Het kabinet komt op korte termijn ter zake in een brief die uw kamer spoedig zal toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over de zeehondenjacht in Canada

An MP asked whether the minister knows Canada's commercial seal hunt starts today and whether the government will urge Canada to end it and lobby the Canadian ambassador and subsidies. The minister confirmed the hunt starts, said the Canadian government knows the Dutch position and that EU import of seal products has long been banned, saw no need to contact the ambassador, and stated the commercial hunt is not subsidised by Canada.
I see no need to personally inform the Canadian government or the Canadian ambassador of the Dutch position.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om de Canadese overheid of de Canadese ambassadeur van het Nederlandse standpunt persoonlijk op de hoogte te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van den Hul en Voordewind over het bericht ‘De jezidi’s zijn hun familie en cultuur kwijt’

MPs Ploumen, Van den Hul and Voordewind asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and of Foreign Trade and Development about reports that Yazidi women and children remain missing or enslaved, the role of Yazidi support organisations, Syrian regime action, aid withdrawal from Duhok and psychosocial programmes. The ministers answered that about 3,083 Yazidis were still held or missing as of late 2018, outlined existing Dutch and EU support, and committed to no new concrete steps beyond ongoing programmes and an October 2019 conference.
The Netherlands has no diplomatic relations with the Assad regime and the cabinet has no independent information on regime actions to free possibly enslaved Yazidis.
Nederland onderhoudt geen diplomatieke betrekkingen met het Assad-regime en het kabinet heeft geen eigenstandige informatie over regime-acties om mogelijke tot slaaf gemaakte jezidi’s te bevrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Bowing to U.S. demands, UN waters down resolution on sexual violence in conflict’

Two MPs asked the Dutch ministers about reports that the UN Security Council watered down a resolution on sexual violence in conflict under US veto pressure, including the removal of sexual and reproductive health language and the weakened reference to the ICC. The government said it regrets the US threat, supports reproductive health language and the French position, sees no direct consequences for victim assistance or UNFPA funding, and explained the ICC reference change as a compromise.
The Netherlands explicitly spoke out for sexual and reproductive health and rights during its intervention in the open debate.
Nederland heeft zich tijdens de interventie in het open debat expliciet uitgesproken voor seksuele en reproductieve gezondheid en rechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over de dreigementen van de Iraanse president in relatie tot de nucleaire deal

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the Iranian president's announced steps to reduce commitments under the JCPOA nuclear deal (including enriched uranium stockpile limits) relate to the deal and to preventing an Iranian bomb, and what tools the Netherlands would use. The minister answered that the government is concerned but that no Iranian violation has yet been reported by the IAEA, so the Netherlands and the EU will keep supporting the deal, rejecting Iran's 60-day ultimatum, and noted the Netherlands was informed by the Iranian ambassador and discussed the matter at the Foreign Affairs Council.
The Netherlands is not a party to the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action and was therefore not directly informed of Iran's intentions.
Nederland is geen partij bij het Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action en is daarom ook niet direct op de hoogte gesteld van de Iraanse voornemens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Kuiken en Ploumen over ontvoeren en uithuwelijken van meisjes naar het buitenland

MPs Van den Hul, Kuiken and Ploumen asked the government about abduction and forced marriage of girls abroad, including whether children aged twelve and under are affected, the role of teachers, legal options to block travel, and possible exit bans. The government answered that child marriages are hard to detect, pointed to the meldcode and existing child-protection measures, noted that preparing a forced marriage abroad is already punishable under article 285c Sr, and said further measures are being explored within the 'Geweld hoort nergens thuis' programme.
Child marriages are an invisible and complex problem.
Kindhuwelijken zijn een onzichtbaar en complex probleem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over interne memo’s inzake een corruptieaffaire bij Damen Shipyards

An MP asked the Ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs about internal memos concerning a corruption case at Damen Shipyards, alleged pressure from Damen against publication, and whether pending investigations affect procurement. The government answered that additional memos cannot yet be released pending a court appeal, denied undue pressure, explained that ongoing investigations are not grounds for exclusion under procurement law, and described contacts with Damen on submarine and other projects.
Once there is a final legal judgment, I will share with the House the information that may be released.
Zodra er een juridisch eindoordeel ligt, zal ik de informatie die mag worden vrijgegeven met de Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van Helvert over het statement gemaakt door de (werkgroep Legal Affairs en Human Rights van de) Parlementaire Assemblee van de Raad van Europa

Two CDA MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about a Council of Europe PACE working group statement on prosecutions facing Laura Codruța Kövesi, a candidate for European Public Prosecutor, and whether the government would seek clarification from Romania and condemn it. The minister replied that the government greatly values her anti-corruption work and wants all candidates treated fairly, that it is closely following the case, and that the Romanian courts must first rule on the cases.
However, it is first and foremost for the Romanian judge to rule on the cases brought against Ms Kövesi.
Het is nu echter allereerst aan de Roemeense rechter om zich uit te spreken over de zaken die zijn aangespannen tegen mevrouw Kövesi.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de samenwerking met Armenië

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister and Prime Minister about cooperation with Armenia, including whether an embassy in Yerevan would be opened and when the EU-Armenia partnership agreement bill would reach parliament. The minister answered that opening an embassy is not currently on the agenda due to limited postal network funds, that the bill's explanatory memorandum will go to the Council of State in the first half of the year, and that Armenia is covered by the Georgia embassy.
The explanatory memorandum will be submitted to the Council of State in the first half of this year.
De MvT zal in de eerste helft van dit jaar aan de Raad van State worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over het bericht dat Poetin paspoorten uitdeelt aan inwoners van separatistengebieden in Oost-Oekraïne

An MP asked whether Russia's accelerated issuance of Russian passports to residents of the separatist Donetsk and Luhansk regions affects their legal status, Schengen visa practice, and whether it escalates the conflict. The minister replied that EU guidance on non-recognition of Crimean Russian passports is being applied and discussed with EU partners, and that the move undermines the Minsk process, with the government pursuing a common EU response.

Following this Russian decision, the Netherlands immediately urged the European Commission to examine whether the above guidelines also apply to Russian passports issued to residents in eastern Ukraine.
Naar aanleiding van dit Russische besluit heeft Nederland er terstond bij Europese Commissie op aangedrongen na te gaan of de hierboven genoemde richtsnoeren ook van toepassing zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het doodvonnis voor de Jemenitische bahá’í de heer Hamed bin Haydara

MP Ploumen asks the Foreign Minister whether he knows the death penalty is sought against Yemeni Bahá'í Hamed bin Haydara, whether the government has contacted the Houthi authorities, his lawyer, and the community, and whether it will investigate the treatment of the Bahá'í. The minister confirms awareness, says Nederland raised the case within the EU and has no direct contact with the lawyer or Houthi authorities, and promises to monitor the situation and keep the House informed.
The Netherlands is closely following the situation of the community in Yemen, as part of the broader situation in the country, and will keep the House informed of relevant developments.
Nederland volgt de situatie van de gemeenschap in Jemen op de voet, als onderdeel van de bredere situatie in het land, en zal de Kamer op de hoogte blijven houden van relevante ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gent en Koopmans over het niet tijdig ontvangen van stemdocumenten door Nederlanders in het buitenland

MPs Van Gent and Koopmans asked the ministers why Dutch citizens abroad had not received their voting documents on time for the 2019 European Parliament election, and how many ballots arrived on time. The minister answered that The Hague municipality organises the vote, that most voters received ballots by email, that postal ballots were delayed until 25 April 2019 pending Council of State rulings, and that the government aims to ease voting abroad.
The Ministry of the Interior evaluates every election and, for elections in which Dutch citizens abroad may vote, receives data from The Hague municipality on abroad-voter participation.

Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (BZK) evalueert elke verkiezing en ontvangt daarvoor, als het om verkiezingen gaat waarvoor Nederlanders in het buitenland kunnen stemmen, van de gemeente Den Haag gegevens over de deelname van kiezers in het buitenland aan de betreffende verkiezing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Raak over het bericht dat buitenlandse bedrijven Europese partijen sponsoren

MPs Leijten and Van Raak asked whether buying influence over parties through foreign corporate donations and Dutch shell companies is undesirable, and what the government will do to make European party financing more transparent and block corporate funding. The minister agrees buying influence is undesirable, announces a bill banning non-EU donations to Dutch parties, and says EU-level changes to Regulation 1141/2014 can only come via the scheduled 2021 review.

Given the increased risk of foreign influence, the cabinet will, in addition to the existing transparency rules in the Wfpp, prohibit donations from outside the EU (except from Dutch voters residing abroad) and require full transparency for donations from other EU countries.
Gelet op het toegenomen risico van buitenlandse beïnvloeding zal het kabinet in aanvulling op de bestaande transparantieregels in de Wfpp giften van buiten de EU verbieden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Dochtertje van Nederlandse Syriëganger overleden in vluchtelingenkamp’

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice about reports that a Dutch Syria-returnee's young daughter died in the Al Hol camp, the camp conditions, and whether Dutch women and children would be brought back. The ministers acknowledged the dire humanitarian conditions and the child deaths, but said the Netherlands does not actively repatriate its nationals from Syria, separating children from parents is undesirable and legally complex, and consular assistance is only given if they report to a Dutch mission in the region.
The Netherlands takes no action aimed at or supporting the active repatriation of Dutch travellers to Syria.
Nederland onderneemt geen actie gericht op of ondersteunend aan het actief terughalen van Nederlandse uitreizigers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Laan-Geselschap, Groothuizen en Van Dam over de procedure en de capaciteit bij het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens

MPs asked about budget problems at the Council of Europe and the European Court of Human Rights, the reopening of Dutch criminal cases after a unilateral state acknowledgement of a Convention breach, and extra staff for Dutch cases at the Court. The minister said the Netherlands must meet its payment obligations and wants the Court spared from cuts, that the government will examine whether the reopening rules need amending, and that talks are underway on extra support for the Court's registry.

In view of this, I will examine whether amending the statutory provisions is necessary and desirable to ensure that revision is possible on the basis of a decision by the ECtHR following a unilateral government declaration that the Convention has been breached.

Gelet hierop zal ik bezien of aanpassing van de wettelijke regeling nodig en gewenst is om te verzekeren dat herziening mogelijk is op grond van de beslissing door het EHRM na een eenzijdige verklaring van de regering dat het verdrag is geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg, Diks en Van Ojik over het bericht 'AIVD en MI5 gestopt met samenwerking met Oostenrijkse diensten'

MPs Buitenweg, Diks and Van Ojik asked the government about reports that the AIVD and MI5 stopped cooperating with Austrian intelligence services, including effects on the Club van Bern, CTG, PESCO and the Burum satellite station. The minister declined to comment publicly on the specifics of intelligence cooperation, citing legal risk-weighing procedures, and otherwise answered that bilateral and EU relations with Austria remain good.
The AIVD and MIVD make no public statements about the precise nature of cooperation with intelligence or security services.
De AIVD en MIVD doen in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de precieze invulling van de samenwerking met inlichtingen- of veiligheidsdiensten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Nispen over de hulp aan achterblijvers van vermiste personen in het buitenland

MPs Kuiken and Van Nispen asked whether families of people missing abroad should receive better and more standardised help, including a 24-hour help desk, and whether it is absurd that they are advised to crowdfund searches. The minister answered that the local authorities bear primary responsibility, that the ministry keeps families informed via a contact person, and that a dedicated search fund would undermine local responsibility, so the government will not set one up.
By setting up a search fund and creating the impression that the Dutch government can and wants to take over a case, that responsibility is actually undermined and undesirable effects can arise.

Door het instellen van een fonds voor opsporing en de indruk te wekken dat de Nederlandse overheid een zaak kan en wil overnemen, wordt die verantwoordelijkheid juist ontkracht en kunnen ongewenste effecten ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over doodstraf voor homo’s in Brunei

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked whether the Syariah Penal Code phases 2 and 3 in Brunei, including death by stoning, would take effect and what Dutch and international pressure could prevent this. Minister Blok answered that the Netherlands and the EU raised concerns, issued statements and pressed Brunei, that a moratorium on the death penalty was announced, and that Dutch support for civil society and LGBTI rights continues.
The cabinet has taken note with great concern of Brunei's decision to introduce phases 2 and 3 of the Syariah Penal Code.
Het kabinet heeft met veel zorg kennisgenomen van het besluit van Brunei om fase 2 en 3 van de Syariah Penal Code in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Van Ojik en Diks over het bericht dat Brunei extreme straffen invoert, onder meer de doodstraf voor homoseksuele handelingen

Three GroenLinks MPs asked the foreign and education ministers about Brunei's introduction of harsh Sharia penalties, including the death penalty for same-sex acts, and whether the Netherlands would cut arms trade, summon the ambassador, or take other action. The minister answered that the government strongly opposes the measures, has publicly and diplomatically objected via the EU, the Equal Rights Coalition and the Foreign Affairs Council, and that arms exports are screened for human-rights risk, with no export moratorium deemed necessary at present.
For this reason, the cabinet currently does not consider it necessary to announce a moratorium on the export of strategic goods to Brunei.
Om die reden acht het kabinet het op dit moment niet noodzakelijk om een moratorium af te kondigen op de export van strategische goederen naar Brunei.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Sneller over het bericht dat in Brunei nieuwe shariawetten zijn ingevoerd

Two D66 MPs asked the foreign minister about Brunei's new Sharia penal code, including stoning for same-sex relations, Dutch diplomatic response, and whether the sultan's Dutch royal honour should be revoked. The minister condemned the measures, cited diplomatic efforts and the sultan's announced moratorium and UNCAT ratification, but declined to revoke the honour, stating the law only permits revocation after a one-year prison sentence and that broadening revocation grounds would not help dialogue.
Under the law, a decoration can only be revoked if the decorated person has been sentenced to a final prison term of at least one year.
Volgens de wetgeving kan een onderscheiding alleen worden ingetrokken als de gedecoreerde persoon veroordeeld is tot een onherroepelijke gevangenisstraf van minimaal één jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de bombardementen van Turkije op christenen in Irak

MPs Van Helvert, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the foreign minister about reported Turkish airstrikes forcing Christian villagers in northern Iraq to flee, and about civilian casualties and compliance with international humanitarian law. The minister said the reports could not be verified, attributed the strikes to Turkey's campaign against the PKK, denied any targeting of religious minorities, and called on Turkey to exercise restraint and proportionality.
The cabinet has no precise information about the exact times and precise locations of these bombings.
Het kabinet heeft geen precieze informatie over de exacte tijd en precieze locaties van deze bombardementen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Van Ojik en Karabulut over vervolging van de Palestijnse mensenrechtenverdediger Issa Amro

MPs Van den Hul, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the government about prosecutions of Palestinian human rights defender Issa Amro by Palestinian and Israeli authorities, including criticism of Amnesty and Front Line Defenders reports and whether the EU and the Netherlands support him. The minister answered that the Netherlands shares concern over shrinking civic space, urges both authorities to respect free expression and drop charges covered by that right, and that the EU and member states have attended hearings, with the next hearing set for 22 May.
The EU and the Netherlands both follow the two legal cases against Amro closely, including by attending hearings.
De EU en Nederland volgen beide rechtszaken tegen Amro nauwgezet, onder andere door het bijwonen van hoorzittingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de arrestatie en mogelijke uitlevering van WikiLeaks oprichter Julian Assange

MP Karabulut asks the Foreign Minister why Julian Assange was arrested in the UK, whether a US extradition request is involved, and whether the US charges threaten press freedom, along with related questions on Swedish proceedings, Afghanistan/Iraq disclosures, Amnesty concerns and Dutch advocacy against extradition. The minister answers that the UK arrest followed a failure to surrender to court on a Swedish request, that a provisional US extradition request for computer intrusion has been filed, that Sweden's case may be reopened, and that the Netherlands does not intervene in other states' prosecution policy or the UK legal process.
The Netherlands does not interfere in other countries' considerations regarding prosecution policy.
Nederland mengt zich niet in de overwegingen van andere landen omtrent het vervolgingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Saoedi-Arabië executeert 37 gevangenen om terrorisme’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government responded to Saudi Arabia's execution of 37 prisoners convicted of terrorism, including the use of the 2014 counterterrorism law against activists and critics, and whether sanctions were considered. The minister condemned the executions, said Nederland opposes the death penalty and raised concerns in EU and UN settings, but stated that sanctions lack the required international political consensus and gave no concrete new measures.
Imposing sanctions requires broad international political agreement.
Voor het instellen van sancties is internationaal brede politieke overeenstemming nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Helvert over verschillende reisadviezen

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Helvert asked whether EU member states issue differing travel advice for the same countries, whether a single European travel advice is desirable, and what Netherlands has done to harmonise. The minister agrees a single European advice is desirable and says the main obstacles are national competence, differing formats and procedures, and timing, while describing consular cooperation efforts and promising continued advocacy.
I am willing to keep emphasising the importance of unified travel advice within the EU.
Ik ben bereid het belang van eensgezinde reisadviezen verder te blijven benadrukken binnen de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over foutieve registratie in de Basisregistratie Personen

An SP MP asked why the Landentabel in the Basisregistratie Personen no longer allows the name '(bezet) Palestijns gebied' and why people born there may be registered as born in Israel. The State Secretary replied that the name does not fit the Landentabel's systematics as an administrative/state list, so 'Gazastrook en Westelijke Jordaanoever met inbegrip van Oost-Jeruzalem' will be used, with a change planned for 1 July 2019 and a registration option for affected persons.
An effort is being made to have the change take effect on 1 July 2019.
Er wordt naar gestreefd om de wijziging op 1 juli 2019 in werking te laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht 'Gitarist en oud-student UvA zucht in Egyptische cel'

Two PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the detention of Rami Sidky, a former University of Amsterdam student held in Egypt, including contacts with Egyptian authorities, the grounds for his pre-trial detention and whether the Netherlands will press for his release. The minister answered that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised the case with Egypt and requested the grounds for detention, but declined to demand immediate release, citing Egyptian sovereignty.
Egypt is a sovereign state with its own judiciary in which the Netherlands cannot interfere.
Egypte is een soevereine staat met een eigen rechtspraak waar Nederland zich niet in kan mengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat het Rode Kruis Venezuela mag betreden met hulpgoederen

MPs Bouali and Sjoerdsma asked whether the government knows that the Red Cross received permission from Maduro to deliver emergency aid to Venezuela, and about shortages of medicine and food, the scale of the operation and Dutch funding. Minister Kaag confirmed the crisis and noted that Dutch contributions since 2018 total over EUR 1.6 million, with an additional EUR 2 million, while stressing that aid must be neutral and reach those most in need.
The Netherlands has contributed at various moments over the past year to Red Cross relief efforts in Venezuela and the region.
Nederland heeft het afgelopen jaar op verschillende momenten bijgedragen aan de hulpverlening van het Rode Kruis in Venezuela en de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘It Wasn’t Just Khashoggi: A Saudi Prince’s Brutal Drive to Crush Dissent’

MPs Ploumen, Karabulut and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister about reports of a Saudi intervention team targeting dissidents, Saudi human rights abuses, detention conditions and the arrest of women's rights activists. The minister could not confirm the intervention team, said Dutch concerns are raised bilaterally and multilaterally including a joint UN statement, and noted that embassy access to trials had been refused four times.
I cannot provide any information on the exact content of these contacts with partners.
Over de exacte inhoud van deze contacten met partners kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Van Haga over de miljardendeals van Frankrijk met China

MPs Koopmans and Van Haga asked the government about Italy's and Luxembourg's signing of China's Belt and Road memoranda and whether this undermines a common EU China policy and screening of Chinese investment. The minister answered that member states may maintain bilateral ties, that the EU investment screening regulation enters into force on 19 April, and that member states remain committed to EU-level consensus on China.
EU member states are free to maintain bilateral relations with China, as the Netherlands also does.
Het staat EU-lidstaten vrij bilaterale relaties te onderhouden met China, dat doet Nederland ook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over bemoeienis vanuit Turkije met een slijter in Den Haag

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of Turkish interference with a Hague liquor shop over the name 'Rumi', and what he would do about it. The minister answered that the Netherlands allows freedom of expression and product naming within the law, that the ambassador responded to the Konya mayor's letter, and that the Dutch position was clear enough without further contact with Turkish counterparts.
The cabinet is aware of the reporting concerned.
Het kabinet is bekend met de betreffende berichtgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de wederom gesponsorde Koningsdagborrel van de ambassade in Brussel, ook wel de Permanente Vertegenwoordiging genoemd

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister how sponsors such as Sabic, ING, and Shell were selected for the Koningsdag reception at the Permanent Representation in Brussels, whether a Saudi state-linked sponsor was appropriate after the Khashoggi killing, and why sponsors are not publicly listed. The minister replied that sponsorship follows integrity rules on impartiality and conflict of interest, that sponsor amounts are modest and kept confidential, and that no central register or ban on sponsorship is planned.
Because the companies that made a sponsorship contribution did not expect their individual contribution to be made public, I prefer to treat these contributions confidentially.

Omdat de bedrijven die een sponsorbijdrage hebben gedaan er niet van uitgingen dat hun afzonderlijke bijdrage publiek zou worden gemaakt, geef ik er de voorkeur aan deze bijdragen vertrouwelijk te behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'Vijf jaar na grote ontvoering Boko Haram, zijn nog 112 schoolmeisjes niet vrij’

An MP asked whether the government knows the testimony of escaped Chibok schoolgirls, has contacted Nigeria on the still-missing girls, is willing to help the search, and will raise the case at the UN. The government condemns the abductions, says it has raised the issue with Nigeria since 2014, will assist if Nigeria asks, and will keep drawing attention to the case in UN and EU settings.
The Netherlands will continue to draw attention to these schoolgirls and other Boko Haram victims in the UN for as long as necessary.
Nederland blijft ook in VN-verband, zo lang als nodig is, aandacht vragen voor deze schoolmeisjes en andere slachtoffers van Boko Haram.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de arrestatie van een 9-jarige Palestijn

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the detention of a 9-year-old Palestinian boy at his school by Israeli troops, and about how common such arrests are and whether Israel should be pressed to guarantee safe schools. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises children's rights with Israel bilaterally, multilaterally and through the EU, and that the Dutch embassy leads an EU working group on the issue, without committing to a new concrete step.
The Netherlands plays a leading role in protecting the rights of Palestinian minors in Israeli detention.
Nederland speelt een voortrekkersrol bij de bescherming van de rechten van minderjarige Palestijnen in Israëlische detentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Helvert over het bericht dat de VS Turkije uit F-35 programma dreigen te gooien om Russische raketten

CDA MPs Bruins Slot and Van Helvert asked whether the US halting F-35 equipment deliveries to Turkey over its planned purchase of Russian S-400 air defence systems is accurate, whether Nederland agrees with the US reasoning, and whether Dutch industry could take over Turkish F-35 work. The government confirmed the US decision, shared US concerns, said it has raised them bilaterally and in NATO, and declined to speculate on further steps while Turkey remains a partner.
At this stage it is undesirable to speculate openly about possible follow-up steps in the programme.
Het is onwenselijk om in dit stadium openlijk te speculeren over mogelijke vervolgstappen in het programma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Amerikaanse immigratiedienst bouwde database van journalisten'

The MPs asked whether the Dutch government cooperates with a US immigration agency's reported database of journalists and activists critical of US immigration policy, and whether Dutch and foreign journalists are in it. The minister answered that the Netherlands did not cooperate, no Dutch journalists are known to be on the list, and the government will not intervene in a US internal matter unless press freedom there is at stake.
No cooperation with the Dutch government took place in this.
Hierbij is niet samengewerkt met de Nederlandse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de visumaanvraag van Nigeriaanse weduwen om de rechtszaak tegen Shell bij te wonen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why Nigerian widows suing Shell were refused Schengen visas to attend the Dutch hearing, whether Dutch visa policy had been fully outsourced to France and Belgium, and whether the government would support future applications. The minister said the French consulate refused the files as incomplete (missing documents and a financial guarantee), that the Dutch embassy tried to find a solution, and that he would support a complete future application if the widows are summoned again.
The French consulate-general indicated that the file was incomplete.
Het Frans consulaat-generaal heeft aangegeven dat het dossier incompleet was.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het vervolgen, martelen en vermoorden van lesbiennes, homoseksuelen, biseksuelen, transgenders en mensen met een intersekse-conditie (LHBTI’s) in Tsjetsjenië

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the government what it has done since April 2018 to raise persecution, torture and killings of LGBTI people in Chechnya, including follow-up with Benedek, the Equal Rights Coalition, UN bodies and the question of quiet diplomacy. The minister answered that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised the issue through the OSCE Vienna and Moscow mechanisms, the EU, the Human Rights Council and the Equal Rights Coalition, that violence has not structurally decreased, and that quiet diplomacy has no general criteria but depends on context.
The Netherlands regularly raises the gross human rights violations in Chechnya, including violence against lesbian, gay, bisexual, trans and intersex persons (LGBTI), with Russia in various ways.

Nederland brengt de grove mensenrechtenschendingen in Tsjetsjenië, waaronder het geweld tegen lesbische, homoseksuele, biseksuele, trans en intersekse personen (LHBTI's), op diverse manieren regelmatig onder de aandacht bij Rusland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Voordewind over erkenning van de Golanhoogten als deel van Israël

Three MPs asked whether the Netherlands recognises the Golan Heights as Israeli territory, on what resolutions its position rests, when it would recognise Israeli sovereignty, and whether residents are safer under Israel. The minister answered that the Golan remains Syrian territory under Israeli occupation, based on international law and UN Security Council resolutions 242 and 497, and that the Netherlands will only recognise border changes agreed by both parties.
The Netherlands will only recognise changes to the 1967 border if both parties, in this case Israel and Syria, agree to them.
Nederland zal alleen wijzigingen van de grens van 1967 erkennen als de beide partijen, in dit geval Israël en Syrië, daarover afspraken maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de militaire oefening van Turkije en Rusland op de Zwarte Zee

An MP from the CDA asked the government about a Turkish and Russian naval exercise in the Black Sea and whether it was an alliance-worthy act given NATO tensions with Russia, the S-400 dispute and the Kerch Strait incident. The minister said Turkey held a national exercise, that two Turkish ships made a port visit to Novorossiysk without confirmed joint drills, that the Kabinet is open to raising the matter with Turkey and deepening NATO Black Sea cooperation, but did not condemn Turkey's rapprochement with Russia.
The cabinet is willing to make inquiries with Turkey about this.
Het kabinet is bereid hierover bij Turkije navraag te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van den Hul, Ploumen en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Mensenrechten in Iran gruwelijk geschonden’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the deteriorating human rights situation in Iran, including executions, harsh crackdowns, the morality police and the appointment of Ebrahim Raisi as head of the judiciary. The minister answered that the government shares concerns, raises them multilaterally, bilaterally and through the EU, but does not comment on appointments in other countries.
The cabinet does not concern itself with appointments in other countries.
Het kabinet gaat niet over benoemingen in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ploumen over veroordelingen van activisten in de Rif

MPs Karabulut and Ploumen asked whether the minister would condemn the upheld prison sentences against Rif activists in Morocco, call for their release, and summon the Moroccan ambassador. The minister said the Netherlands has already expressed its view in earlier letters, raised the matter during visits, and sees no purpose in summoning the ambassador, while noting cassation remains possible.
I do not consider it opportune to summon the Moroccan ambassador over this issue.
Ik vind het niet opportuun om de Marokkaanse ambassadeur over deze kwestie te ontbieden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ploumen en Van Ojik over de mogelijke invoering van twee wetten in Guatemala

MPs Karabulut, Ploumen and Van Ojik asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs whether he shares concerns about Guatemalan bills 5377 (amnesty for wartime crimes 1990-1996) and 5257 (stricter rules for NGOs), and what their status is. The minister shares the concerns, reports that the Netherlands raised them bilaterally, in an EU High Representative statement and with donors, and says the bills are pending a third reading with uncertain timing.
Yes, I am aware of the concerns of human rights organisations and UN experts about laws no. 5377 and no. 5257. I indeed share these concerns.
Ja, ik ben bekend met de zorgen van mensenrechtenorganisaties en VN-experts over de wetten nr. 5377 en nr. 5257. Ik deel deze zorgen inderdaad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van den Berg en Van Helvert over het voornemen van Italië om zich aan te sluiten bij het Chinese Belt and Road investeringsprogramma

CDA MPs asked the government about Italy's planned accession to China's Belt and Road Initiative, its effect on EU unity, Dutch firms and EU screening of Chinese investment. The minister answered that Italy's MoU is a non-binding intention, that EU rules remain fully applicable, that the EU investment screening regulation was being finalised, and that the government would address China in a forthcoming note.
At this moment it is not possible to make an estimate of this.
Op dit moment is het niet mogelijk hiervan een inschatting te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Den Boer en Sjoerdsma over een oppositieleider die vastzit in een Tadzjiekse gevangenis

MPs from D66 asked the government about opposition leader Gadojev, detained in Tajikistan after apparently being arrested in Russia, and whether Interpol listings are being misused against political critics. The government replied that Gadojev returned to the Netherlands with consular help via the German embassy, that Interpol's rules forbid political interventions but full guarantees cannot be given, and that human rights are raised regularly in bilateral and multilateral settings.
However, I cannot speculate on the circumstances in individual cases listed on the Interpol list.
Ik kan echter niet speculeren over de toedracht in individuele casussen die op de Interpol-lijst staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Becker over de dreigementen van de Turkse Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken richting Europese toeristen die Turkije zouden verraden

MPs Koopmans and Becker asked the Foreign and Social Affairs ministers whether Turkey's interior minister threatened to detain European tourists who attend certain meetings, and what this means for Dutch citizens criticising Turkey; they also asked about Turkish weekend schools and contacts with the Turkish embassy. The government answered that it does not change its position on free expression within the rule of law, that it knows of no policy change by Turkey, and that it will inform the House on the motion-Becker implementation before summer.
The cabinet will inform the House more fully before this coming summer about the implementation of the Becker et al. motion.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer voor aanstaande zomer nader informeren over de uitvoering van de motie Becker c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht 'It Wasn’t Just Khashoggi: A Saudi Prince’s Brutal Drive to Crush Dissent'

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister how he views reports of a Saudi intervention team allegedly surveilling, detaining and torturing dissidents, whether he has information on secret detention sites, and what concerns he has about pre-trial detention. The minister said the reports cannot be confirmed, that Netherlands shares concern about the human rights situation and has raised it bilaterally and in the UN Human Rights Council, and that the Netherlands has no independent information on secret detention sites.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs cannot confirm the reporting about the existence of the said intervention team.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken kan de berichtgeving over het bestaan van het genoemde interventieteam niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Helvert over de berechting van Syriëgangers

MPs Voordewind and Van Helvert asked why the Ministry of Foreign Affairs classifies some Syrian armed groups as moderate while the public prosecutor treats some as terrorist, and whether the government would align its classifications and share information to prevent lenient sentences. The minister answered that prosecutors make their own assessments, that the ministry relies on EU and UN terrorist listings, that NLA support does not rule out prosecution, and that information will be shared case by case on request.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs will where possible share information with the Public Prosecution Service to promote the course of justice.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken zal waar mogelijk informatie delen met het Openbaar Ministerie om de rechtsgang te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt en Voordewind over de belemmerde vervolging van Syriëgangers

MPs Van Helvert, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked whether Dutch jihadist fighters in Syria could cite Dutch non-lethal assistance (NLA) to armed groups in their defence, and whether the Public Prosecution Service had been informed about which groups received NLA. The minister replied that such use is not known, that information on two specific groups was shared with the prosecutor only for a pending case, and that prosecution decisions are independent of NLA support.
The Public Prosecution Service makes no general statements about fighting groups.
Het Openbaar Ministerie doet geen algemene uitspraken over strijdende groeperingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Ploumen over het bericht dat artiesten niet welkom zijn in Nederland

MPs Asscher and Ploumen asked whether artists refused entry to the Netherlands should be allowed to visit more easily, and whether detention of artists on unclear grounds is acceptable. The minister replied that refusals follow EU Schengen rules, that cultural exchange is valued, and that existing facilitation schemes such as Orange Carpet apply, with each visa application still assessed individually.
A decision to refuse entry and place persons in custody is always a decision surrounded by safeguards and reasoned on the basis of national, international and European legal obligations.

Een besluit om de toegang te weigeren en personen in bewaring te plaatsen is altijd op grond van de (inter)nationale en Europese juridische verplichtingen een met waarborgen omkleed en gemotiveerd besluit.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Ploumen, Karabulut, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over de krimpende bewegingsruimte, democratische vrijheden en veiligheid van mensenrechtenorganisaties en -verdedigers in Israël

MPs from several parties asked the ministers about threats to human rights organisations and defenders in Israel, including an Israeli UN envoy's insult to B'Tselem, a law affecting Breaking the Silence, and the deportation order against Human Rights Watch's Omar Shakir. The government answered that it shares concern about intimidation and shrinking civic space, has protested at the UN and bilaterally, and will keep raising the issues with Israeli and Palestinian authorities together with the EU.

The government, together with the EU, is concerned about the increasing pressure on human rights organisations and defenders in Israel, partly caused by bills that restrict the space of civil society organisations.

Het kabinet is, samen met de EU, bezorgd over de toenemende druk op mensenrechtenorganisaties en -verdedigers in Israël, mede veroorzaakt door wetsvoorstellen die de ruimte van maatschappelijke organisaties beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kooten-Arissen, Van Raan en Van Gerven over het bericht dat EU-voorzitter Roemenië zich laat sponsoren door Coca-Cola

MPs from PvdD and SP asked whether Coca-Cola's sponsorship of the Romanian EU presidency, and similar Dutch presidency sponsorships, create conflicts of interest and undermine the EU's health and sugar policy. The minister answered that sponsorship is a logistical matter for each presidency, that Coca-Cola's sponsorship is separate from EU negotiations on food rules, that no intervention was planned, and that the Dutch sponsorship policy will be considered for the 2029 presidency.
Sponsorships are a way to facilitate an EU presidency logistically.
Sponsorschappen zijn een manier om een EU-voorzitterschap logistiek te faciliteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat christenvervolging in China verviervoudigd is

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that persecution of Christians in China had quadrupled, the closure of churches, state restrictions on religious freedom including of Uyghurs, and Dutch efforts at the UN and EU. The minister confirmed the rise in arrests linked to new religious regulations, said official church closure figures are unknown, described qualifications in China's constitution, reported Dutch support for a UN religious freedom resolution, and described continued EU, UN and bilateral advocacy on China's human rights.
Human rights, including the right to freedom of religion and belief, is one of the priorities of the Netherlands' foreign policy and will therefore also be part of the China strategy.

Mensenrechten, waaronder het recht op vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging, is een van de prioriteiten van het buitenlands beleid van Nederland en zal daarmee dus ook onderdeel zijn van de China-strategie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht dat een door Nederland uitgezette asielzoeker uit Bahrein zonder eerlijk proces is veroordeeld tot levenslang

An MP asked whether the Dutch government would acknowledge that the deportation of a Bahraini asylum seeker, later sentenced to life imprisonment without a fair trial, breached non-refoulement, and what it would do about his case. The state secretary refused to discuss individual case details citing privacy, rejected the non-refoulement claim as not established on the information available at the time, and said it would raise concerns with Bahraini authorities and follow the appeal.
Out of respect for personal privacy, I am not free to make individual facts and circumstances from an asylum file public.
Met het oog op de eerbiediging van de persoonlijke levenssfeer, ben ik niet vrij individuele feiten en omstandigheden uit een asieldossier in de openbaarheid te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de veroordeling van Nasrin Sotoudeh in Iran

MP Karabulut asks the Foreign Minister whether he knows of the sentence of 33 years and 148 lashes given to Iranian lawyer Nasrin Sotoudeh, whether it is condemned as punishment for peaceful activism, and whether he will call for her release with Iranian and EU counterparts. The minister answers that the cabinet is shocked, has publicly voiced concern, supported an EU statement calling for review, and will keep urging Iran to respect her rights while her appeal is pending.
As I also stated during the General Consultation on the Foreign Affairs Council of 14 March, I publicly expressed my concerns about the conviction of Nasrin Sotoudeh.
Zoals ik ook stelde tijdens het Algemeen Overleg over de Raad Buitenlandse Zaken van 14 maart heb ik publiekelijk mijn zorgen uitgesproken over de veroordeling van Nasrin Sotoudeh
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Ojik over een hongerstaking in Turkije

MPs Karabulut and Van Ojik asked about a hunger strike in Turkey by MP Leyla Güven and others, the demands of the strikers, and the number of political prisoners and Dutch efforts for their release. The minister said the situation is critical according to contacts, that the government takes no position on the demands, that it lacks reliable figures on political prisoners, and that it raises rule-of-law and fair-trial concerns with Turkey.
The cabinet does not have reliable figures on the number of political prisoners in Turkey.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over betrouwbare cijfers wat betreft het aantal politieke gevangen in Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Kooten-Arissen over de berichten dat verschillende buitenlandse steden een klimaatnoodtoestand hebben uitgeroepen

MPs Van Raan and Van Kooten-Arissen asked whether the government would explain the effects of cities such as Basel, Vancouver and London declaring a climate emergency on local and national powers, and whether Dutch municipalities and provinces could declare one too. The minister answered that such declarations are symbolic with no transfer or widening of powers, that Dutch law has no rules for them, and that a climate emergency declaration would not affect the forthcoming package of CO2 measures.
In none of the cities does declaring the climate emergency widen or transfer powers of local or national governments.
In geen van de steden worden door het uitroepen van de klimaatnoodtoestand bevoegdheden van de lokale of nationale overheden verruimd of overgeheveld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weerdenburg, De Roon en Markuszower over de financiering van een aanval op onafhankelijke Israëlische rechtspraak

PVV MPs asked whether the Dutch government financed a critical B'Tselem report on Israel's High Court and whether this undermines judicial independence. The minister answered that the EUR 176,000 grant was given under a strategic plan with B'Tselem setting its own research aims and conclusions, that Nederland did not steer the report, and that it does not regard the funding as undermining judicial independence.
There has been no substantive steering by the Netherlands.
Er is geen sprake geweest van inhoudelijke sturing door Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht ‘Egypt: Set Independent Torture Inquiry’

Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister whether he would act on Human Rights Watch reports of systematic torture and enforced disappearances in Egypt, including contact with allies, sanctions, and raising the issue at the UN Human Rights Council. Minister Blok answered that the cabinet is very concerned, raises the issue in EU channels, supports independent investigation and UN rapporteur access, but sees no case for sanctions and will press for an EU statement at the Council.
The cabinet considers extensive and independent investigation, which HRW also calls for, therefore important.
Het kabinet acht uitgebreid en onafhankelijk onderzoek, waartoe HRW ook oproept, daarom belangrijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, De Roon en Van der Staaij over het bericht op de website van de Jerusalem Post waarin staat dat Nederland een kritisch onderzoek naar het Israëlische hooggerechtshof heeft gefi

MPs Voordewind, De Roon and Van der Staaij asked why the Dutch government funded B'Tselem, a critical report on the Israeli Supreme Court, and whether the government shaped its aims or findings. The minister answered that the €176,000 grant was based on B'Tselem's own strategic plan, that the Dutch government did not steer its research goals or conclusions, and that funding critical civil society work fits Dutch support for human rights and the two-state solution.
The Netherlands in no way steered the research objectives or conclusions in advance or during the implementation of the research.
Nederland heeft op geen enkele manier op voorhand, of tijdens de uitvoering van het onderzoek sturing gegeven aan onderzoeksdoelen of conclusies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ploumen over het uitzetten van een journalist door Marokko

MPs Karabulut and Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about the expulsion of a Dutch journalist from Morocco, the reasons given, and whether the government would press Morocco on press freedom and the health of an imprisoned Rif protest leader. The minister answered that the journalist lacked accreditation as Morocco legally allows, that a French journalist was expelled for the same reason in 2018, that press freedom is raised bilaterally, and that the appeals and the ambassador's monitoring continue, while the detainee's health reportedly is relatively good.
I see no reason to do so.
Daar zie ik geen reden toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het loskoppelen van het burgerrechtengedeelte in het Brexit-uittredingsverdrag

Verhoeven (D66) asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister whether the government supports decoupling the Brexit citizens' rights chapter so it applies in all cases, including no deal, and whether dual nationality should be allowed for affected Dutch citizens in the UK. Minister Blok replied that the UK is responsible for protecting citizens' rights in a no-deal scenario, that the government will keep pressing the UK, and that it will not pursue a 'mini-deal' or broader dual nationality, preferring ratification of the withdrawal agreement.
The cabinet maintains that the EU and the European Council on its behalf must keep fully committed to ratification of the withdrawal agreement.
Het kabinet blijft van mening dat de EU en de Europese Raad namens haar zich vol moeten blijven inzetten voor ratificatie van het terugtrekkingsakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een rapport over het geweld vorig jaar aan de grens met Gaza

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister for his reaction to a UN report finding that Israel likely violated international law and committed war crimes in using lethal force against protesters at the Gaza border, and asked whether he would condemn Israel and press it to follow the report's recommendations. The minister's answer was a referral to a separate letter on a motion by another MP, so the questions were not answered on substance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over spanningen tussen Pakistan en India

An MP asked the foreign and trade ministers whether the Netherlands had responded to the India-Pakistan clashes over Kashmir, what would end the conflict, whether Dutch arms exports to both countries should be halted, and whether the tensions justify action on nuclear weapons. The ministers replied that the Netherlands and the EU called for de-escalation, that arms exports are assessed case by case without a moratorium or embargo, and that they would not sign the nuclear weapons ban treaty.
The Netherlands voted against the text of the nuclear weapons ban treaty.
Nederland heeft tegen de tekst van het kernwapenverbodsverdrag gestemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over toeristische bedrijven die verdienen aan illegale nederzettingen in bezet Palestijns gebied

An MP asked the government whether it condemns online booking firms such as Booking.com, Airbnb, Expedia and TripAdvisor for offering accommodation in Israeli settlements in occupied Palestinian territory, and whether it would discourage such trade and ban settlement goods. The ministers answered that companies are responsible for their own human rights due diligence, that the government does not support import bans on settlement goods, and that it discourages economic ties with settlement businesses while Booking.com has agreed to label settlement listings.
The cabinet, in line with the EU, is not in favour of an import ban on goods from settlements or measures leading to a boycott of these goods.
Het kabinet is, in lijn met de EU, geen voorstander van een importverbod van goederen uit nederzettingen of maatregelen die leiden tot een boycot van deze goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over banden tussen BDS en terroristen

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked the government about alleged links between BDS organisations and Palestinian terrorists, whether Dutch subsidies could indirectly fund such organisations, and about an Amnesty campaign urging tourism platforms to boycott Israeli settlement businesses. The government rejected the general claims, said subsidy procedures and sanctions are adequate, maintained its opposition to BDS and its policy of not funding BDS-promoting activities, and referred to the company's own responsibility under international CSR norms.
Funds from both the Netherlands and the EU are only provided once careful selection procedures have been completed.
Fondsen van zowel Nederland als de EU worden pas verstrekt zodra zorgvuldige selectieprocedures zijn doorlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Recordaantal migranten: Griekenland bezwijkt opnieuw onder grote toestroom’

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the government about reports of record migrant arrivals in Greece, the CPT's criticism of camp conditions, and whether Europe should relocate people from the Greek islands. The State Secretary answered that the government urges Greece and the Commission for structural solutions via faster asylum and return procedures, rejects further transfers or relocations as a fix, and sees some improvements in Greek camp conditions.
More transfers to the mainland or new efforts to relocate asylum seekers from Greece do not contribute to that.
Meer transfers naar het vasteland of nieuwe inspanningen om asielzoekers vanuit Griekenland te herplaatsen, dragen daar niet aan bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Van der Staaij over antwoorden op Kamervragen over foutieve registratie in de Basisregistratie Personen

MPs Bisschop and Van der Staaij asked about the Council of State ruling on a disputed birthplace entry in the BRP, the legal basis for including non-recognised territories in the country table, and whether adding 'Gazastrook en Westelijke Jordaanoever' implies de facto recognition of Palestine. The State Secretary answered that the ruling was correctly applied, that exceptions for non-recognised areas are allowed in the country table, and that the change does not alter Dutch policy on Palestinian statehood.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht 'Bendes stropen Oeganda af om vrouwen genitaal te verminken'

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the ministers about reports of female genital mutilation in eastern Uganda, its rising numbers, and the government's response with the Ugandan authorities, UNFPA, Equality Now, Reach and a trade mission. The ministers answered that the government takes the reports seriously, is engaged with Ugandan authorities, UNFPA and NGOs, and will brief trade mission participants on responsible business including eastern Uganda.
