The cabinet takes the reporting, on the practice of genital mutilation as well as the cited numbers of girls and women, very seriously.
Het kabinet neemt de berichtgeving, over de praktijk van genitale verminking maar ook over de genoemde aantallen meisjes en vrouwen, zeer serieus.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Helvert over de veiligheid van de advocaat van de Asia Bibi, de heer Saif ul-Malook, nu hij teruggekeerd is naar Pakistan om haar zaak te verdedigen

MPs asked whether the Minister would nominate lawyer Saif ul-Malook for the Human Rights Tulip, offer him protection when threats recur, confirm the validity of his Schengen visa, and say how the Netherlands could help his safety in Pakistan. The Minister said the Tulip nomination process is independent, declined to pre-empt any new protection request, would not confirm visa validity, and noted Pakistani authorities are responsible for his safety.
The cabinet cannot make statements about the validity of individuals' Schengen visas, partly because it is not authorised to share this personal data.
Het kabinet kan geen uitspraken doen over de geldigheid van het Schengenvisum van individuen, mede omdat het kabinet niet gemachtigd is deze persoonsgegevens te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Koopmans, De Roon, Karabulut, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de uitzetting van Nederlandse journalist Boersma

MPs from nine parties asked the Foreign and Justice ministers whether Turkey expelled Dutch journalist Ans Boersma on the basis of information Dutch authorities shared, and what Dutch government steps followed. The ministers confirm the expulsion, say an information request was made in a Dutch criminal investigation via operational channels without foreign ministry involvement, and decline to give further details citing the ongoing investigation.
Regarding the content of that information request, no further statements can be made because the criminal investigation is still ongoing.
Over de inhoud van dat informatieverzoek kunnen, vanwege het nog lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek, geen nadere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Koopmans over het bericht dat de Egyptische ambassade het Couperushuis in Den Haag in verval laat

MPs Aartsen and Koopmans asked whether foreign embassies in The Hague are letting monumental buildings, including the Egyptian embassy at the Couperushuis, fall into disrepair, and what can be done given diplomatic inviolability. The minister answered that the municipality supervises upkeep, that the ministry escalates via diplomatic channels and recall as a last resort, that the Egyptian embassy has explained its steps and trust in a positive outcome has grown, and that four embassies are still under discussion.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not supervise maintenance, but addresses embassies at the municipality's request.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken houdt geen toezicht op het onderhoud, maar spreekt op verzoek van de gemeente ambassades aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het vertrek van VN-gezant Patrick Cammaert uit Jemen

Three MPs asked the ministers about the early departure of UN envoy Patrick Cammaert from Yemen, the stalled Hodeidah ceasefire and redeployment talks, humanitarian effects and Houthi refusal to negotiate. The ministers confirmed the short mandate was known, reported that the ceasefire largely holds despite delays, outlined humanitarian funding and ongoing contacts with the UN and EU, and gave limited detail on the Crisis Group report and Houthi motives.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de minderjarige Nederlandse jongen Charly die in Spanje gedetineerd is en prisonlaw

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister why Dutch detainees are not actively told about PrisonLAW, whether a minor is held unsafely in Spain, and why Kaderbesluit 829 was raised late, and about the pressure on PrisonLAW and the ministry's contacts with it. The minister answered that PrisonLAW is mentioned in a brochure but not actively offered, that the Spanish facility is judged safe, that KB 829 was raised from September 2018 and formally in December, and declined to give case details or precise contact counts citing privacy and ongoing proceedings.
For reasons of personal data protection and because the legal proceedings are still ongoing, I cannot provide the House with further judicial details about this individual case in this public letter.
Omwille van persoonsgegevensbescherming en omdat de rechtsgang nog loopt, kan ik uw Kamer via deze openbare brief geen nadere justitiële gegevens over deze individuele zaak verschaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het vervolgen, martelen en vermoorden van LHBTI’s in Tsjetsjenië

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the ministers whether they condemn the persecution, torture and killing of LGBTI people in Chechnya, how they will act toward Russia, and what diplomatic steps are taken. The minister answered that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised the issue bilaterally and in the EU, OSCE, Council of Europe and Equal Rights Coalition, and will bring it to the UN Human Rights Council, while keeping some diplomatic steps non-public.
For effective influence, the Netherlands and like-minded countries will also need to use quiet diplomacy, where it is crucial that steps are taken outside the public domain.
Ten behoeve van effectieve beïnvloeding zullen Nederland en gelijkgezinden ook gebruik moeten maken van stille diplomatie, waarbij het cruciaal is dat stappen worden gezet buiten het publieke domein.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het (mogelijke) gebruik van chemische middelen tijdens militaire operatie in West Papoea door het door het Indonesische leger

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about reports of possible chemical weapons use by the Indonesian military in West Papua and whether the Netherlands would seek an independent fact-finding mission. The minister answered that Indonesia denies the reports, that neither local sources nor the OPCW can confirm them, and that he sees no reason yet for an independent investigation, while Nederland continues to press for free access for NGOs and journalists.
In view of the above answer, I currently see no reason to call for an international independent investigation.
Gezien het bovenstaande antwoord zie ik vooralsnog geen aanleiding voor een oproep tot het instellen van een internationaal onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de Nederlandse jongen die in Spanje gedetineerd is

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the detention of Dutch youth Charly T. in Spain, including whether consular procedures were followed, why no trust lawyer was appointed, and whether the ministry pressed Spanish authorities. The minister answered that the ministry uses consular and subsidised legal-advice instruments, is actively following the case without ordering a trust-lawyer review yet, did not steer the family to another legal aid provider, and will continue its efforts.

Because the legal proceedings are still in the initial phase and the public prosecutor, the defence and the judge still have to play their roles to a significant extent, there is currently no reason or scope to use the instrument of examining the proceedings through a trust lawyer.

Omdat de rechtsgang zich nog in de initiële fase bevindt en de Officier van Justitie, de verdediging en de rechter hun rollen in de rechtsgang nog in belangrijke mate moeten vervullen, is er thans geen aanleiding en ruimte voor het inzetten van het instrument van onderzoek naar de gevolgde rechtsgang door een vertrouwensadvocaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de heimelijke zuivering door de Zimbabwaanse overheid

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of disappearances and a crackdown on activists, union leaders and opposition MPs in Zimbabwe, and what the Netherlands would do. The minister answered that the government is concerned, that the embassy monitors the situation, and that the Netherlands has pressed for an EU statement and raised concerns with Zimbabwean officials, without announcing a concrete new domestic-accountability measure.
The cabinet is very concerned about the human rights situation in Zimbabwe, in particular freedom of expression.
Het kabinet maakt zich grote zorgen over de mensenrechtensituatie in Zimbabwe, in het bijzonder de vrijheid van meningsuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het artikel ‘A less political European Commission is needed’

An MP asks the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister how a less political European Commission can have more real authority, why the Spitzenkandidaten process is compared to a coup, whether the European Council bypassing the election outcome violates Article 17(7) TEU, and how the government will act on the views in the minister's Financial Times op-ed. The minister answers that a stronger but objective Commission is needed to enforce agreed rules, that the Spitzenkandidaten procedure is not in the treaty while Article 17(7) requires taking account of the election results, and that the government will set out its position in the State of the Union debate.
Article 17(7) of the EU treaty is clear about the procedure to follow in electing the President of the European Commission.
Artikel 17 (7) van het EU-verdrag is helder over de te volgen procedure bij de verkiezing van de voorzitter van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Sjoerdsma over foutieve registratie in de Basisregistratie Personen

MPs Karabulut and Sjoerdsma asked why a person born in East Jerusalem is registered in the Basisregistratie Personen as born in Israel, and whether the government will change the system. The Staatssecretaris explains that the Landentabel only allows recognised states and territories, that the government will amend the table to add 'Gazastrook en Westelijke Jordaanoever, met inbegrip van Oost-Jeruzalem' for births from 15 May 1948 onward, and admits the earlier 2014 option of 'Onbekend' was a policy choice.

I intend to amend the Landentabel (table 34) and include the designation 'Gazastrook en Westelijke Jordaanoever, met inbegrip van Oost-Jeruzalem' for persons born in those areas from 15 May 1948 onward.

Ik ben voornemens de Landentabel (tabel 34) te wijzigen en de benaming «Gazastrook en Westelijke Jordaanoever, met inbegrip van Oost-Jeruzalem» daarin op te nemen voor personen die vanaf 15 mei 1948 in die gebieden zijn geboren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de staat van de rechtsstaat op Malta

Leijten (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about the rule of law in Malta, including the murder investigation into journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia, the Venice Commission's criticism, attempts to remove Pieter Omtzigt as PACE rapporteur, and the prime minister's concentration of power. Minister Blok answered that the rule of law and the murder case were raised with Malta, that the Venice Commission report will be followed up by Malta, and that the government does not see reason to put the conclusions on the General Affairs Council agenda.
The cabinet therefore sees no reason to put the conclusions on the agenda of the General Affairs Council at this time.
Het kabinet ziet daarom geen reden de conclusies op dit moment op de agenda van de Raad Algemene Zaken te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over Albanië, dat zijn verplichtingen met de EU onder de Stabilisatie- en Associatieovereenkomst (SAA) niet nakomt

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether Albania violated its EU Stabilisation and Association Agreement in awarding the Vlorë airport and Air Albania contracts without open tender, and what the Commission has done about it. The minister answers that the Commission will examine any possible breach within a broader assessment of Albania's public procurement and competition framework, that no breach has been confirmed, and that the case is not on the SAA Council agenda.
The cabinet is not involved in assessing the application of existing rules in individual cases and is therefore not in a position to offer such an example.
Het kabinet is niet betrokken bij de beoordeling van de toepassing van bestaande regels in individuele zaken en is daarom niet in de positie om een dergelijk voorbeeld aan te dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over verstrekking van Nederlandse visa in landen waar geen Nederlands consulaat gevestigd is

An MP asked how the Dutch-Belgian visa representation arrangement in Cameroon works, why individual visa refusal appeals are handled only by the representing state, and how the government ensures effective remedies. The minister answered that appeals lie against the representing state under the Visa Code, that CJEU case El Hassani guarantees effective remedies, and that complaints about Belgian representation in Cameroon have been minimal.
I do not wish to anticipate the outcome of that procedure.
Ik wil niet op de uitkomsten van die procedure vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Groothuizen over gouden paspoorten en visa

MPs Den Boer and Groothuizen asked whether golden passports and golden visas, which let wealthy investors obtain EU residence or citizenship, pose crime and terrorism risks and whether the Netherlands should abolish its investor residence permit. The government acknowledged the risk if screening is inadequate, said Dutch investor permits are strictly checked, and promised an evaluation of the Modern Migration Policy Act in Q2 2019 and participation in EU-level discussion.
Based on this evaluation, it can in due course be assessed whether it is desirable to adjust admission schemes.
Op basis van deze evaluatie kan te zijner tijd worden beoordeeld of het wenselijk is dat toelatingsregelingen worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat het “gouden visa” een bedreiging vormen voor de interne veiligheid van de Europese Unie

An MP asked the government about reports that Spain's golden visa scheme poses money-laundering and EU internal security risks, and whether national citizenship-by-investment schemes should be restricted. The state secretary answered that member states decide on their own visa and nationality rules, that the Netherlands has no scheme selling passports for money, and that the government will await the Commission's proposals while stressing EU anti-money-laundering rules.
The Netherlands has no scheme under which passports are granted to people who bring 'sufficient money' to be admitted to Dutch nationality.
Nederland kent geen regeling waarbij paspoorten worden verstrekt aan mensen die «voldoende geld» meebrengen om toegelaten te worden tot het Nederlanderschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het gebruik van pepperspray in het Turkse consulaat in Rotterdam en het feit dat niemand daarvoor vervolgd wordt

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked why no one was prosecuted after a Turkish consulate staff member used pepperspray in Rotterdam, and about the immunity and diplomatic-prosecution arrangements involved. The minister answered that the person had functional immunity, that Turkey withdrew him, that no prosecution of others was possible because no other offences were known, and described the prosecution working arrangements and the planned notification system.

When requesting a lifting of immunity, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs immediately makes clear to the country concerned that no answer or a refusal to lift immunity will very likely lead to a request for the person's withdrawal.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken maakt bij een eventueel verzoek om opheffing van immuniteit meteen duidelijk aan het land in kwestie dat geen antwoord of een weigering om de immuniteit op te heffen zeer waarschijnlijk zal leiden tot een verzoek om terugtrekking van de betrokkene.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Helvert over de ranglijst christenvervolging 2019 uitgebracht door 'Open Doors'

MPs from the ChristenUnie, SGP and CDA asked the Foreign Minister about the 2019 Open Doors ranking of Christian persecution, its trend, and Dutch responses in Iraq, China, India and Algeria, plus the Asia Bibi case and the planned special envoy for freedom of religion. The minister acknowledged the concern about rising persecution, described ongoing bilateral and EU diplomacy, and said the special envoy would start work as soon as possible.
The Netherlands continues to work for freedom of religion and belief bilaterally and through various multilateral fora and will intensify this effort in the coming years.
Nederland blijft zich zowel bilateraal als via de diverse multilaterale fora inzetten voor de vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging en zal deze inzet in de komende jaren intensiveren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Futselaar over het bericht dat een Oekraïense kippenmiljardair het meest profiteert van het associatieverdrag met Oekraïne

Two SP MPs asked whether the EU-Ukraine association agreement lets Ukrainian poultry imports undercut Dutch producers through lower standards, state aid and EU loans to MHP, and whether the agreement should be evaluated. The ministers answered that imports must meet EU health and safety rules, that the Commission monitors implementation and is closing a tariff loophole, that the state aid cannot yet be judged compatible, and that the Netherlands opposed the EBRD loans.
Periodic evaluation of association agreements is therefore necessary to keep a finger on the pulse and to be able to intervene if needed.
Periodieke evaluatie van associatieakkoorden is daarom nodig om de vinger aan de pols te houden en in te kunnen grijpen als dit nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht dat de rechter de Belgische overheid heeft opgedragen kinderen uit Syrië terug te halen

Two MPs (Ploumen and Kuiken, PvdA) asked the foreign minister about a Brussels court order for Belgium to repatriate six children from Syria, and whether Dutch policy and cooperation with Belgium should change. The minister answered that the Netherlands does not actively pursue repatriation of adult travellers and their minor children, that consular assistance is discretionary, and that the government will keep monitoring developments.
The cabinet does not actively pursue the repatriation of adult travellers and their minor children from Syria.
Het kabinet zet niet actief in op het terughalen van volwassen uitreizigers en hun minderjarige kinderen uit Syrië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over het Oxfam rapport over vluchtelingenopvangkampen in Griekenland

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked about the Oxfam report on Greek refugee camps, including a death from cold, the lack of medical screening of vulnerable people, and contacts with EU partners. The State Secretary answered that Greece remains responsible, that the Netherlands repeatedly raises the issue with Greece and the Commission, and that it will be on the agenda of his next visit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over de veroordeling in Egypte van Amal Fathy

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the government about the conviction in Egypt of women's rights defender Amal Fathy and whether it would press for her release and a presidential pardon. Minister Blok answered that the Netherlands follows the case closely, has raised concerns bilaterally and within EU channels, will keep doing so, and that Fathy can still appeal to the Court of Cassation or seek a pardon, but did not commit to specific further steps beyond consultation with EU partners.
It is not for the ministry to provide information about this.
Het is niet aan het ministerie om hierover informatie te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat Japan zich terugtrekt uit de internationale walvisvaartcommissie

The MP Wassenberg asked the government whether it shares concern about Japan's withdrawal from the International Whaling Commission, what consequences it has for relations and the trade agreement's sustainability chapter, and whether the government will raise the matter with Japan, summon its ambassador, or seek EU pressure or sanctions. The government answered that it regrets the decision, raised it with Prime Minister Abe, notes the sustainability chapter allows annual dialogue, and sees no EU sanctions basis since Japan is acting within its rights.
Japan has also indicated it will only hunt in its own territorial sea and exclusive economic zone, whereby Japan does not violate international agreements.
Japan heeft tevens aangegeven enkel nog in hun eigen Territoriale Zee en Exclusieve Economische Zone te zullen jagen, waarmee Japan geen internationale afspraken schendt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the government, in 21 questions, whether it will respond to and act on the criticisms voiced by climate activist Greta Thunberg at COP24, including on the government's climate policy, economic growth, and ties with Saudi Arabia. The government answers collectively, stating that the questions were answered by reference to the Aanhangsel Handelingen (the answers appended to the parliamentary record) rather than in the document itself.
The written questions from MP Van Raan (PvdD), question number 2018Z24286, have been answered by means of the Appendix to the Handelingen, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1305.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Raan (PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24286 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over aanpassing van het reisadvies voor Marokko na de gruwelijke moord op twee Scandinavische toeristen

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister why the Morocco travel advice had stayed unchanged since April 2018, how many IS fighters returned to Morocco in 2018, and whether the advice would be tightened after two Scandinavian tourists were murdered. The minister answered that the advice was updated on 21 December 2018 to mention the killings and the heightened terrorism threat, with the main cities now rated yellow, and that no reason to change it existed before 17 December; the number of returning fighters is not known.
It is not known how many IS fighters returned from Syria and Iraq to Morocco in 2018.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel IS-strijders in 2018 uit Syrië en Irak naar Marokko zijn teruggekeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt en Voordewind over mogelijke staatsgeheimen die gepubliceerd zijn in WOB-stukken over Non Lethal Assistance aan Syrische ‘rebellen’

MPs Van Helvert, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked whether state secrets were published in FOIA documents on Non Lethal Assistance to Syrian rebel groups, and what the penalties and actions are. The minister admits some names were wrongly left unredacted, says the government will not publicly name supported groups for security and alliance reasons, reports a data-leak investigation, and offers Parliament renewed confidential access to the documents.
The cabinet nevertheless maintains the principle that no public statements are made about groups that received support under the Non Lethal Assistance (NLA) programme.
Het kabinet blijft evenwel bij het uitgangspunt dat er geen openbare uitspraken gedaan worden over groepen die steun ontvingen in het kader van het Non Lethal Assistance (NLA)-programma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de 17-jarige Charly T. die al meer dan 4 maanden in voorarrest in Spanje zit

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about a 17-year-old Dutch national held on remand in Spain for over four months, including consular visits, support, and possible transfer to the Netherlands. The minister answered that the embassy has visited and supports him, has contacted Spanish authorities about alternative measures, and that the Dutch prosecutor is willing to cooperate.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over een naar Bahrein uitgezette man

MPs Van Dijk and Karabulut asked whether a rejected asylum seeker deported to Bahrain was arrested and possibly mistreated, why the IND did not weigh this risk, and whether deportations to Bahrain should be suspended with an independent investigation. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case citing privacy, said the IND assesses each application on its merits and acknowledges worsening human rights, but refused a moratorium or investigation, while promising to monitor developments.
As your House is aware, in connection with the privacy of the person concerned I cannot make statements about individual cases and possible deportations.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend kan ik in verband met de privacy van de betrokken persoon geen uitspraken doen over individuele zaken en eventuele uitzettingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind en Sjoerdsma over de repressie tegen Nicaraguaanse ngo’s

MPs from five parties asked the Dutch foreign and development ministers about Nicaragua's dissolution of NGOs including CENIDH, police raids on NGOs and the Confidencial newsroom, seizure of Dutch-funded assets, and the anti-terror law 977 used against civil society. The ministers confirmed the raids and seizures, said Nederland raised the issue with the Nicaraguan ambassador and within the EU, and shared the concern that civil society is under pressure.
The Netherlands will continue to closely monitor the situation and, where possible, including within the EU, continue to speak out against repression in Nicaragua.
Nederland zal de situatie nauwlettend blijven volgen en waar mogelijk zich, onder meer in EU-verband, blijven uitspreken tegen onderdrukking in Nicaragua.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ploumen en Van Ojik over het bericht dat de visa van 11 onderzoekers van CICIG door Guatemala zijn ingetrokken

MPs Karabulut, Ploumen and Van Ojik asked the minister about Guatemala expelling 11 CICIG investigators and revoking their visas and immunity, and whether the Netherlands would condemn this and support CICIG's mandate. The minister condemned Guatemala's termination of the UN agreement, said the Netherlands backs CICIG and a renewed mandate, and reported EU and G13 statements and diplomatic contacts, while declining to commit to a specific new step beyond existing advocacy.
The international community has sharply condemned the Guatemalan government's termination of the CICIG agreement.
De internationale gemeenschap heeft het opzeggen van het CICIG-akkoord door de Guatemalteekse regering scherp veroordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een publicatie van Instituut Clingendael over het Israëlisch-Palestijns conflict

An MP asks the Foreign Minister to respond to four criticisms in a Clingendael publication on Israel-Palestine policy, and whether the government agrees with its recommendations on supporting civil society and an international conference. The minister largely defends existing Dutch policy, rejects the claim of complicity, sees no need for a new human rights forum, and restates non-recognition of Israeli sovereignty over occupied territories.
The cabinet is not convinced that establishing a separate forum for enforcing human rights in Israel and the Palestinian Territories, as recommended in the publication, has sufficient added value.

Het kabinet is er niet van overtuigd dat de oprichting van een apart forum voor de handhaving van mensenrechten in Israël en de Palestijnse Gebieden – zoals in de publicatie wordt aanbevolen – voldoende toegevoegde waarde heeft.

Vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma (D66), Omtzigt (CDA) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de toekenning van de mensenrechtentulp aan Zeid Ra’ad Al Hussein (ingezonden 3 september 2018).

MPs Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked why the Dutch human rights award was given to outgoing UN High Commissioner Zeid Ra'ad Al Hussein despite whistleblower allegations of cover-ups, whether an independent committee chose him, and whether he should apologise to whistleblowers Emma Reilly and Anders Kompass. The minister answered that a one-off selection was made without an independent committee, that the UN Ethics Office found no direct retaliation link in the Reilly case, that the Kompass panel found no abuse of power, and that the government would not ask for apologies.
No independent committee was involved in the decision-making regarding the award.
Bij de besluitvorming rond de toekenning was geen onafhankelijke commissie betrokken.

Nader antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de toekenning van de speciale editie van de mensenrechtentulp aan de Hoge Commissaris voor de Mensenrechten Zeid Ra'ad Al Hussein en de rol van de commiss

MPs asked the government about the process for awarding the special Human Rights Tulip to UN High Commissioner Zeid Ra'ad Al Hussein, and about his handling of whistleblowers Anders Kompass and Emma Reilly regarding sexual abuse by peacekeepers and the sharing of activists' names with China. The government answered that the award was decided by the minister based on the commissioner's human rights record, that it condemns sexual abuse, and that the UN's independent panel found no abuse of power by the commissioner, while it will monitor pending whistleblower cases.
The cabinet is of the view that in all cases where a whistleblower brings misconduct to light, an independent investigation must take place examining all relevant aspects.

Het kabinet is van mening dat in alle gevallen waarin een klokkenluider misstanden aan het licht brengt, er een onafhankelijk onderzoek moet plaatsvinden waarin alle relevante aspecten worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Bosman over het bericht ‘Rusland: buitenlandse marineschepen niet meer zomaar langs kust Siberië‘

MPs Koopmans and Bosman asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reported Russian plans to require notification before foreign naval ships use the Northern Sea Route, and related Arctic military developments. The government said the scope of the reported measure is unknown, that notification requirements would conflict with innocent passage and freedom of navigation outside Russian internal waters, and that it will send an update on the security part of the Arctic strategy in mid-2019.
Nothing is known about the precise content and scope of the (possibly planned) measure.
Over de precieze inhoud en reikwijdte van de (mogelijk voorgenomen) maatregel is niets bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over een verdubbeling van Iraanse rakettesten, waaronder raketten die Europa kunnen bereiken

MP De Roon asked whether Iran doubled its missile tests, whether the tested missiles can carry weapons of mass destruction and reach Europe, why EU measures have had no effect, and whether the Netherlands will withdraw support for the nuclear deal. Minister Blok answered that the reports are worrying, that Iran's Category 1 missiles could in theory carry WMD and reach parts of Europe given the claimed 2,000 km range, that existing UN and EU measures are in place and the Netherlands raises the issue continuously, and that the Netherlands will not withdraw support for the JCPOA since it is working as intended.
The cabinet is not aware of Iran's intentions, but it is beyond doubt that the ballistic missile programme is a cause for concern.
Het kabinet is niet bekend met de intenties van Iran, maar het staat buiten kijf dat het ballistisch raket programma zorgen baart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Helvert over de ontwikkeling dat Zuid-Afrika in sneltreinvaart aankoerst op landonteigening

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about reports that South Africa is rushing towards land expropriation without compensation, and about the constitutional amendment, Namibia, the EU summit and the risks to Dutch farmers. The minister answered that the government raises concerns bilaterally and in the EU, notes that the constitution already permits such expropriation under review, and says it will wait for South Africa's measures and does not consider an external legal advisor necessary.
It is therefore practically impossible to carry out such an investigation.
Het is daardoor praktisch onmogelijk om een dergelijk onderzoek uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van Ojik en Ploumen over de detentie van anti-slavernij activisten in Mauritanië

MPs Karabulut, Van Ojik and Ploumen asked about the detention of anti-slavery activist Biram Dah Abeid in Mauritania, the conditions and fairness of his trial, and whether the minister would press Mauritania to stop repressing anti-slavery activists. The minister answered that Abeid was arrested in August 2018, released on 31 December 2018, that the Netherlands and the EU have raised concerns with Mauritanian authorities, and that Dutch support for local human rights NGOs continues.
Information on the exact conditions in detention and the course of the trial was limited.
Informatie over de exacte omstandigheden in detentie en verloop van het proces was beperkt beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een gedetineerde mensenrechtenverdediger in Iran

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Arash Sadeghi, a detained human rights defender in Iran whom Amnesty calls a prisoner of conscience, including his reported lack of adequate cancer care and whether the government would press Iran for his release. The minister confirmed awareness, agreed the detention concerns peaceful activity, said Iran has provided no new information, and said the government will raise humane treatment and medical access with Iranian authorities in general terms.

The Netherlands will continue to raise with the Iranian authorities, more broadly, the humane treatment of detainees, the importance of fair and transparent legal proceedings, and the need to provide detainees access to adequate medical care.

Nederland zal de Iraanse autoriteiten in bredere zin blijven aanspreken op de humane behandeling van gedetineerden, het belang van een eerlijke en transparante rechtsgang en de noodzaak tot het verlenen van toegang tot adequate medische zorg aan gedetineerden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Omtzigt en Van den Berg over voorbereidingen om mogelijke medicijntekorten te voorkomen door een harde Brexit

MPs Slootweg, Omtzigt and Van den Berg asked how medicine shortages from a hard Brexit would be prevented, including supply continuity, registration, stockpiling, patient coverage and Dutch doctors' diploma recognition. The minister answered that the CBG is mapping critical medicines dependent on the UK, IGJ exemptions and alternatives are planned, and the rules for approval and healthcare coverage would be adjusted in a no-deal scenario.
To secure the supply reliability of the critical medicines on the list, several steps will be taken.
Om de leveringszekerheid van de kritieke geneesmiddelen op de lijst te borgen, zullen verschillende stappen worden doorlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Karabulut, Ploumen, Van Helvert, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over arrestaties tijdens mensenrechtendemonstraties in West-Papoea

Eight MPs asked the Foreign Minister about mass arrests of protesters at Human Rights Day demonstrations in West Papua, the fairness of their trials, progress on human rights in Indonesia, the Dutch Community Policing Programme, and whether the Netherlands will keep pressing Indonesia on press freedom and violence against Papuans. The minister answered that roughly 132-137 people were detained and released without charge in a context of tension, that all were freed and will not be prosecuted, that human rights concerns remain despite socio-economic progress, and that the Netherlands raises these points bilaterally and within the EU.
All persons arrested have since been released. They will not be prosecuted.
Alle opgepakte personen zijn inmiddels weer vrijgelaten. Zij zullen niet vervolgd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de wapenstilstand en de VN waarnemingsmissie in Jemen

MP De Roon asked whether a UN monitoring mission in Yemen, reportedly led by Dutch general Patrick Cammaert, would include UN troops, and whether the Netherlands would rule out sending military personnel to Yemen. Minister Blok confirmed the leadership report, said details of the mission's composition are not yet known, and said the question of Dutch military deployment does not arise yet, with parliament to be informed under the regular procedure if a contribution is considered.
Should the Netherlands consider a contribution, your House will be informed about this in accordance with the regular procedure.
Mocht Nederland een bijdrage overwegen dan zal uw Kamer hierover conform de reguliere procedure worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Verhoeven over de artikel 7-procedure

Two MPs (Van Ojik and Verhoeven) asked the Foreign Minister whether member states are stalling the Article 7 procedure against Hungary, whether a Council hearing with Hungary should be held, which states block it, and what deadlines and consequences apply. The minister answered that the Council must follow up the EP resolution with hearings, that no fixed deadline exists, that the Netherlands is pushing with like-minded states for an early hearing, and that the Council's deliberations are confidential.
Because the Council's deliberations are confidential, the cabinet cannot publicly provide further explanation of the positions of other member states on the Article 7 procedure against Hungary.

Het kabinet kan vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van de beraadslagingen in de Raad publiekelijk geen verdere toelichting verschaffen over de positionering van de overige lidstaten ten aanzien van de artikel 7-procedure jegens Hongarije.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de bedreiging, onderdrukking en roof van christenen in Irak

MPs from CDA, ChristenUnie and SGP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of militia intimidation of Christians in Iraq, illegal seizure of their homes, the Shia militias' status, and whether Dutch pressure and UN investigation were planned. The minister said the Bartella incident was a wedding celebration rather than religious restriction, acknowledged property seizures, and said the government raises minority rights with Iraqi authorities but sees no reason for a separate UN inquiry.
The cabinet sees no reason to additionally start a UN investigation into the alleged oppression, threats and persecution of vulnerable minorities in Iraq.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden om hiernaast nog een VN onderzoek te starten naar de vermeende onderdrukking, bedreiging en vervolging van kwetsbare minderheden in Irak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de verstrekking van Nederlandse visa in landen waar geen Nederlands consulaat gevestigd is

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how Dutch visas are issued in countries without a Dutch consulate, including the Cameroon arrangement with Belgium, the criteria for financial means and return, and whether decisions can be reviewed. The minister explained the EU Visa Code framework, bilateral representation arrangements (including Belgium deciding independently in Cameroon), the evidence criteria, and that the decision on individual applications cannot be revised through Dutch channels.
The Netherlands has transferred the authority to make final decisions on visa applications in Cameroon to Belgium.
Nederland heeft de bevoegdheid om definitief te beslissen op visumaanvragen in Kameroen overgedragen aan België.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, De Roon, Bosma en Fritsma over het bericht dat het Chinese leger massaal onderzoekers stuurt naar westerse universiteiten

PVV MPs asked whether Chinese military-linked researchers are entering Dutch universities such as TU Delft to develop dual-use technologies, and how immigration screening and a possible ban would work. The government answered that the intelligence services do not comment on their knowledge, that universities bear primary responsibility for screening students, and that a review of the policy framework is ongoing, with no statutory ban beyond the North Korea rule.
The intelligence and security services make no statements about their current level of knowledge.
De inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten doen geen uitspraken over hun actuele kennisniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Karabulut over brievenbusfirma’s van internationale wapenbedrijven in Nederland

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked whether nuclear weapons-linked arms firms should be allowed to settle in the Netherlands for tax reasons, obtain tax rulings, and face extra taxation, and whether the government would act on arms sales to Saudi Arabia. The government answered that it opposes tax-motivated settlement, rejects a special tax or exclusion for arms firms, notes no commercial firm produces nuclear weapons, and stresses its strict export controls.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act I cannot discuss the tax affairs of individual taxpayers.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op fiscale aangelegenheden van individuele belastingplichtigen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Verhoeven, Van der Graaf, Leijten, Van Ojik, Maeijer, Asscher, Van Rooijen, Van Raan, Bisschop, Azarkan en Baudet over de rechtsstatelijke aspecten van de machtigingsbepaling van

MPs from many parties asked the Foreign Affairs and Justice ministers whether article X of the Brexit omnibus bill, which lets ministers issue temporary general rules that can depart from existing law, undermines legislative primacy and rule-of-law safeguards, and whether they would add safeguards by amendment. The ministers reject the criticism, argue the power is a narrow, one-year transitional measure justified by Brexit's unprecedented nature and that the Council of State endorsed it, and say they will consider an amendment based on Chamber feedback.
We will, based on the views of the Chamber and further reactions from society, benevolently consider whether an amendment note is appropriate.
Wij zullen op basis van de zienswijze van de Kamer en verdere reacties uit de samenleving welwillend bezien of een nota van wijziging aangewezen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Koopmans over de intenties van de Turkse ambassade om bij te dragen aan de integratie van de "Turkse gemeenschap" in Nederland

MPs Becker and Koopmans asked the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Social Affairs whether the Turkish ambassador's stated aim of bringing the Turkish community together for integration is acceptable, and whether Turkish diaspora politics should be raised with Turkey. The government answered that integration policy is its own responsibility, that Turkey may maintain voluntary ties with its diaspora within the limits of the rule of law, and that it will raise concerns with Turkey if those limits are exceeded.
The Cabinet sees no role in this for diplomatic representatives of other countries.
Het Kabinet ziet hierin geen rol voor diplomatieke vertegenwoordigers van andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht Saudi Arabia Allegedly Tortured Women’s Rights Activists Before Khashoggi Murder

MPs Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked whether the government knows of reports that Saudi Arabia detained eight women's rights activists for exercising free expression and allegedly tortured them, and what it will do, bilaterally, in the EU and with partners, to condemn this and seek release. The minister replied that the Netherlands raised concerns with the Saudi ambassador, in multilateral fora and through EU channels, promoted a formal EU-Saudi human rights dialogue, and works with the embassy to gather information, while weighing public versus quiet diplomacy case by case.
The Netherlands, together with partners, weighs case by case what degree of public attention is most effective, with the wishes of the persons concerned or their families being decisive.
Nederland maakt samen met partners per geval de afweging welke mate van publieke aandacht het meest effectief is, waarbij de wensen van de betrokkenen zelf, of hun families, leidend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over gevangen gezette vluchtelingenreddingswerkers in Griekenland

An MP asked whether Greek rescue workers Sarah Mardini, Sean Binder and Nassos Karakitsos were detained without legal grounds, whether this is acceptable, and whether the Dutch government would raise concerns with Greek counterparts. The government answered that the four ERCI members were released on bail on 4 December, that it does not intervene in Greek legal proceedings, and that it sees no reason to contact Greek or other European colleagues.
The Netherlands does not intervene in the Greek legal process.
Nederland intervenieert niet in de Griekse rechtsgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over export van 'dual use'-goederen en wapens naar Saudi-Arabië

An MP asks the government about Dutch exports of dual-use goods and weapons to Saudi Arabia, including whether 94 contracts worth 136 million euro are valid and whether the goods could be used in Yemen or for internal repression. The ministers answer that about 88 valid licences exist (133 million euro), that goods are civilian end-use, that military exports are now effectively presumed denied, and they list all licences issued since January 2016.
Following the latest report of the Group of Eminent Experts, the Cabinet decided to further tighten the arms export policy.
Naar aanleiding van het meest recente rapport van de Group of Eminent Experts, heeft het Kabinet besloten het wapenexportbeleid verder aan te scherpen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Gaddafi verdween, maar Damen bleef geliefd in Libië'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether eight Damen Stan Patrol patrol boats exported to Libya in 2013 should be classed as military goods, given mounting points that could carry heavy machine guns. The minister replied that the boats fall outside the EU military list, that the mounts are generic and not designed for 12.7 mm weapons, and that Damen now must consult the ministry before supplying unarmed patrol boats to Libya.
Since Damen is abiding by the agreement, there is no need for this.
Aangezien Damen zich aan de afspraak houdt, bestaat hier geen noodzaak toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over doorvoer van militaire goederen via Schiphol en andere Nederlandse havens

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Trade, Finance and Justice about fines on airlines at Schiphol for illegally transporting strategic goods, prosecution figures, Customs capacity and procedures, and an alleged shipment of Dagaie missile defence parts to Saudi Arabia. The government answered that courts have fined some transporters since 2013 but that OM does not register such cases by sector, that Customs stopped 19 military shipments to Saudi Arabia since 2014 (two illegal exports found), that the current enforcement approach has been policy since 2013, and that carriers are legally obliged to assist Customs.

It is not possible to provide an overview of convictions by sector (such as transport companies) or an overview of the number of investigations per year, because the illegal transit of military goods is not registered as such in the OM's systems.

Het is niet mogelijk een overzicht te geven van veroordelingen per branche (zoals die van vervoersbedrijven) dan wel een overzicht van het aantal onderzoeken per jaar, omdat het illegaal doorvoeren van militaire goederen niet als zodanig wordt geregistreerd in de systemen van het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het stelselmatig martelen van critici door de Palestijnse autoriteiten

An MP asked the government about HRW's findings that Palestinian security services systematically torture critics, and what Dutch and EU responses would be. The minister acknowledged the serious concerns, described diplomatic pressure, support for a national anti-torture mechanism, and continued but conditional donor support.
The Netherlands will closely follow this investigation, jointly with the EU and other donors.
Nederland zal dit onderzoek nauwgezet volgen, gezamenlijk met de EU en andere donoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Trump administration wants to remove 'gender' from UN human rights documents’

MPs Sjoerdsma and Bergkamp asked the government about reports that the Trump administration sought to replace the term 'gender' with 'woman' in UN human rights documents, and the implications for transgender and intersex people's legal protection. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposes these US amendments as weakening gender equality commitments, that hundreds of UN and EU texts with gender language remain in force, and that Dutch protections for trans and intersex persons are not affected.
The Netherlands is working in international fora to ensure that progress made is not reversed and that agreed language is retained.
Nederland zet zich binnen internationale fora ervoor in te zorgen dat de geboekte vooruitgang niet wordt teruggedraaid en agreed language behouden blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken een deal sloot met een van martelingen verdachte Venezolaanse minister

Ploumen (PvdA) asked whether Foreign Minister Blok's signed April 2018 border agreement with Venezuela, signed in Caracas with a vice-president suspected of torture, was appropriate and whether it sent a wrong signal, and asked about Aruba's objections and a Venezuelan consul linked to drug crime. Blok answered that the delegation composition is the receiving country's prerogative, EU sanctions were not yet in force at the meeting, the agreement was signed with the Caribbean partners, and the Aruban premiers were kept informed, and referred to earlier answers for the consul question.
Moreover, individual sanctions measures do not preclude a meeting with persons who appear on the sanctions list.
Overigens staan individuele sanctiemaatregelen een ontmoeting met personen die op de sanctielijst voorkomen niet in de weg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Sjoerdsma over het akkoord met Venezuela

MPs Van Helvert and Sjoerdsma asked whether the Netherlands' border agreement with Venezuela, signed with Vice-President El Aissami despite planned EU sanctions against him, was properly prepared and justified given alleged human rights abuses. The minister answered that the agreement was in the Kingdom's interest, that Venezuela's signatory was Vice-President Soteldo, that the EU sanctions process was separate, and declined to link the agreement to the sanctions or to human rights concerns.
The agreement was in the interest of the Kingdom.
Het akkoord was in het belang van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over de The Hague Youth Declaration on Human Rights in Action van 20 oktober 2018

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about the Hague Youth Declaration on Human Rights in Action adopted at the One Young World Summit, including its relevance to human rights promotion and how the government will publicise it among young people. The minister answered that the government sponsored youth participation, supports youth voice initiatives in the Netherlands, and will promote the declaration in line with existing human rights policy, without committing to a new concrete step.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Helvert over het bericht dat PrisonLaw breekt met Buitenlandse Zaken

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Helvert asked the Foreign Minister about PrisonLaw's decision to end its subsidy relationship, alleged pressure on the organisation over publicity, and consular assistance shortcomings for detainees abroad. The minister denied the portrayal, said the ministry and PrisonLaw are negotiating an orderly early termination, and largely referred to earlier letters while declining to share the internal integrity investigation in detail.
Because of the legal requirements on personal data protection, the investigation and handling of the complaint are confidential.
Vanwege de wettelijke eisen die worden gesteld aan persoonsgegevensbescherming zijn het onderzoek en de afhandeling van de klacht vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Raak over de vluchtelingencrisis op Curaçao

SP MPs asked whether Curaçao requested Dutch help during the Venezuelan migrant crisis, what aid could be given, and whether returning migrants to Venezuela was part of the border-reopening deal. The State Secretary answered that Curaçao requested support, that the Netherlands provided expertise visits and a EUR 132,000 detention contribution pending a proposal, and that returns to Venezuela were not part of the agreement.
This is also not part of the agreement, which was published on the central government website following the Zembla FOI request.
Dit is ook geen onderdeel van het akkoord dat n.a.v. het WOB-verzoek van Zembla is gepubliceerd op de website van de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over VNO en het klimaatbeleid

An MP asked the ministers whether VNO-NCW's opposition to stronger climate policy, including arguments about carbon leakage that resemble a Business Europe lobbying strategy, undermines the Klimaatakkoord, and whether the government sees VNO-NCW as an obstacle. The minister acknowledges VNO-NCW's concerns about competitiveness and carbon leakage as shared points of attention, rejects the characterisation of the Klimaatakkoord as sabotaged, and states that the draft is on track to the 49% target with further elaboration needed.
I note that VNO-NCW calls attention to the international competitiveness of Dutch business and carbon leakage effects of CO2 emissions.
Ik constateer dat VNO-NCW aandacht vraagt voor de internationale concurrentiepositie van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven en weglekeffecten van CO 2 -uitstoot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Van Helvert en Koopmans over de situatie van Asia Bibi nu zij is vrijgesproken van godslastering door het Pakistaanse Hof

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the situation of Asia Bibi after her acquittal by Pakistan's Supreme Court, including efforts to secure her release, safe exit for her and her family, and protection for Christians in Pakistan. The minister answered that a review petition is pending under Pakistani procedure, that the Netherlands is pursuing quiet diplomacy with allies, offered the lawyer and family a place in the Shelter City programme, and will raise minority protection at the Foreign Affairs Council.
To the lawyer of Asia Bibi, as well as his wife and child, the cabinet has offered a place in the Shelter City programme.
Aan de advocaat van Asia Bibi, alsmede zijn echtgenote en kind, heeft het kabinet een plek in het Shelter City-programma aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Leijten over het bericht dat lidstaten EU-miljarden niet op krijgen

MPs Bisschop and Leijten asked the Foreign Minister about reports that member states are not drawing down EU structural funds, with only 16% spent by end-2017 and large sums unspent, and asked about complexity, co-financing, OLAF referrals, unspent budgets, and reforms for the 2021-2027 MFF. The minister confirmed the low spending rate but argued unspent funds are committed to projects, defended national co-financing, declined to disclose OLAF referrals, and said the government favours simplification, a budget cut, and publishing Annual Control Reports.
The cabinet has no insight into the reports the European Court of Auditors made to OLAF regarding suspicious transactions.
Het kabinet heeft geen inzicht in de meldingen die de Europese Rekenkamer aan OLAF heeft gedaan met betrekking tot verdachte transacties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Baudet, De Roon en Voordewind over de Nederlandse instemming met een Palestijns voorzitterschap van de G77

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands voted for a UN resolution granting the Palestinian delegation rights to chair the G77, given the resolution's reference to a "Palestinian State" and the Netherlands not recognising such a state. The minister answered that the rights are temporary and limited to the 2019 chairmanship, that the Netherlands reaffirmed its non-recognition in a vote explanation, and that the Kingdom will keep clarifying its position where needed.
At the same time, the Kingdom reaffirmed its long-standing consistent position on the non-recognition of the "State of Palestine" in a vote explanation.
Tegelijkertijd heeft het Koninkrijk zijn jarenlange consistente positie ten aanzien van de niet-erkenning van de «Staat Palestina» in een stemverklaring herbevestigd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat VNO-NCW is aangesloten bij een machtige lobbygroep die het verhogen van de Europese klimaatambitie actief tegenwerkt

MP Van Raan asked the government about reports that employers' federation VNO-NCW belongs to Business Europe, which lobbies against raising the EU 2030 climate target, and whether this conflicts with the coalition goal of 55% reduction and with the Dutch Climate Agreement talks. The minister acknowledged the notes, said the government works constructively with VNO-NCW, committed to pursuing 55% at EU level with allied member states, and declined to warn negotiators or officials specifically about the lobbying strategy.
Both government representatives in contact with VNO-NCW and the parties at the Industry table are aware of the international context in which industry operates.
Zowel overheidsvertegenwoordigers die in contact staan met VNO-NCW als de partijen aan de Industrietafel zijn zich bewust van de internationale context waarbinnen de industrie opereert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over samenwerking van Israël met antisemitische regeringen en leiders

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he was concerned that Israel increasingly cooperates with governments and leaders who have made antisemitic statements or tolerate antisemitism, and why pro-Israel organisations like CIDI do not object. The minister denies that Netanyahu enthusiastically supports antisemitic leaders, says the Dutch government distinguishes criticism of Israeli policy from antisemitism, and restates that the IHRA definition does not change the legal assessment of statements about Israeli government policy.
The cabinet does not keep an overview of the number of occasions on which this has been raised.
Het kabinet houdt geen overzicht bij van het aantal gelegenheden waarbij dit ter sprake is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de mensenrechtensituatie in Egypte

Karabulut (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about mass unfair trials, torture, death sentences, journalists and minors convicted, and impunity for security forces over the 2013 Rabaa dispersal in Egypt, and whether the Netherlands would press Egypt on this. The minister answered that the government is concerned, monitors the case, opposes the death penalty, raised concerns with Egyptian counterparts, notes no security officers were convicted for the Rabaa dispersal, and that Egypt's 2018 law shields certain officers from prosecution.
The Cabinet considers combating impunity to be of great importance.
Het Kabinet acht het tegengaan van straffeloosheid van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'Khashoggi vermoord op last koningshuis'

Ploumen asked whether the government had verified reports that journalist Khashoggi was killed on orders of the Saudi royal household, whether it had contacted Turkish and European counterparts, and whether a planned trade mission to Saudi Arabia would be postponed. The government answered that it contacted Turkey, that the EU and E3 called on Saudi Arabia to cooperate, and referred to letters of 18 and 30 October 2018 for its full position, without giving a substantive answer on the Saudi trade mission or the consequences for relations.
For a comprehensive cabinet appraisal, I refer the House to the letter on policy towards Saudi Arabia dated 18 October 2018.
Voor een uitgebreide kabinetsappreciatie, verwijs ik uw Kamer naar de Kamerbrief «Beleid ten aanzien van Saoedi-Arabië», dd. 18 oktober 2018

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat mensenrechtenactivist Gulalai Ismail werd gearresteerd door de Pakistaanse FIA (Federal Investigation Authority) toen ze het land herintrad vanuit het Verenig

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about activist Gulalai Ismail's arrest on return to Pakistan, her withheld passport and exit ban, and whether the government would act to restore her rights. The minister confirmed the case, explained that Pakistani authorities opened an investigation and that exit-control rules apply, and said the Netherlands raises human rights defenders' protection bilaterally and in the EU without interfering in Pakistan's judicial process.
The Netherlands bilaterally and within the EU works to protect human rights defenders in Pakistan.
Nederland zet zich bilateraal en in EU verband in voor bescherming van mensenrechtenverdedigers in Pakistan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over handel met illegale Israëlische nederzettingen in bezet Palestijns gebied

Karabulut (SP) asked how large trade with illegal Israeli settlements is, by product and over time, and whether the government would seek clarification from Israel where data is lacking. The government replied that neither it nor the European Commission has figures quantifying such trade, Israel does not keep them, and it points to EU origin rules, customs checks and NVWA labelling enforcement instead.
Neither the cabinet nor the European Commission has figures quantifying trade with illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied Palestinian territory.
Antwoord 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 en 6 Zowel het kabinet als de Europese Commissie 1 beschikken niet over cijfers die de handel met illegale Israëlische nederzettingen in bezet Palestijns gebied kwantificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over wapenleveranties aan Oekraïne

MP Karabulut (SP) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about US lethal weapons deliveries to Ukraine, their compatibility with the Minsk agreements, and Dutch arms export policy and past exports to Ukraine. The ministers answered that the conflict must be solved politically, that Ukraine has a legitimate security need, that exports are assessed case by case against the EU criteria, and listed Dutch export licences and refusals.
Since 2004 the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has published every month a detailed overview of all licences issued for military goods and dual-use goods with military end use.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken publiceert sinds 2004 elke maand een gedetailleerd overzicht van alle afgegeven vergunningen voor militaire goederen en dual-use goederen met militair eindgebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Van Helvert, Koopmans, Voordewind en Kuzu over kerksluitingen in China

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the closure of the Sion church in Beijing, China's repression of religious minorities, and the legal basis of new restrictions on religious groups. The minister confirmed the closure as part of a broader pattern of restrictions, described the legal measures and Article 36 of the Chinese constitution, said past Dutch interventions cannot be shown to have had direct effect, and committed to keep raising the issue within the EU and at the UN General Assembly.
Raising human rights violations remains necessary according to this cabinet, if only to discourage China from continuing those violations.
Het aan de orde stellen van mensenrechtenschendingen blijft volgens dit kabinet noodzakelijk, al is het enkel om China te ontmoedigen met die schendingen door te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over seksueel overschrijdend gedrag bij het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a reprimanded ministry official who remained active in women's rights, the basis for the disciplinary measure, why external organisations hesitated to report, and transparency on sanctions and a cross-government reporting point. The minister confirmed awareness, said six complaints were upheld and a disciplinary measure imposed, acknowledged reporting hesitancy, said transparency is being examined, and said a reporting point for external organisations is being set up as quickly as possible.
That is why I am having it examined how transparency about the follow-up to boundary-crossing behaviour can be increased in the future.
Daarom laat ik onderzoeken hoe de transparantie over de opvolging van grensoverschrijdend gedrag in de toekomst kan worden vergroot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Iran dat met ballistische raketten doelen heeft bestookt in Syrië

The MP De Roon asked whether Iran fired ballistic missiles at targets in Syria, whether the anti-IS coalition was informed, whether air traffic including Dutch F-16s was endangered, the damage, whether the missiles fall under MTCR Category 1, and whether the strike violates UN resolution 2231 and warrants more sanctions. The minister confirmed the strike, said it was not announced and posed no danger to aircraft, said damage is unknown, confirmed MTCR Category 1 status, and said it is legally not a violation of 2231 but inconsistent with Annex B, pointing to existing EU and JCPOA measures rather than new sanctions.
Firing these kinds of missiles is legally not a violation of UN Security Council Resolution 2231 (2015), but is inconsistent with paragraph 3 of Annex B of that resolution.
Het afvuren van dit soort raketten is juridisch gezien geen schending van VNVR-Resolutie 2231 (2015), maar wel inconsistent met paragraaf 3 van Annex B van die resolutie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Berispte ambtenaar blijft actief in vrouwenrechten'

MPs Özütok and Van Ojik asked whether a Foreign Ministry official coordinating a women's rights project, whose complaints of sexual intimidation, financial abuse and bullying were upheld, was moved to an equivalent post still touching women's rights and contact with NGOs. Minister Blok confirmed six complaints were upheld, a disciplinary measure was imposed, the official was moved immediately, and he may continue in ministry work with NGO contact that will be avoided, while outlining reforms to reporting and transparency.
Six of the complaints have been upheld.
Zes van de klachten zijn gegrond verklaard.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de vertrouwensbreuk van organisatie PrisonLaw met het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken en het beëindigen van de subsidierelatie

An MP from the SP asked the Foreign Minister about the breakdown of trust with PrisonLAW, which ended its subsidy relationship, including alleged pressure to retract media statements, the confidentiality of an internal complaint investigation, and how legal aid for detained Dutch nationals abroad will be provided. The minister denied undermining PrisonLAW's independence, described contact as constructive, stated that the investigation is confidential for privacy reasons, and said a temporary solution will be arranged until 31 December 2019 with a new subsidy framework from 2020.
Due to the legal requirements for personal data protection, the investigation and handling of the complaint are confidential.
Vanwege de wettelijke eisen die worden gesteld aan persoonsgegevensbescherming zijn het onderzoek en de afhandeling van de klacht vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de aanval van het Israëlische leger op Palestijnse betogers langs de grens tussen Gaza en Israël

MP Kuzu asked the Foreign Minister about the Israeli military's killing of seven Palestinian protesters at the Gaza-Israel border, including two children, and whether the Netherlands would condemn it, revisit arms exports, and raise it at the UN Human Rights Council. The minister answered that the Netherlands is concerned, urges Israel to respect proportionality and necessity, notes that investigations are not finished, states that export licences are assessed case-by-case against EU criteria, and says concerns are raised in regular talks with Israeli and Palestinian representatives.
The Israeli investigation into the events has not yet been completed.
Het Israëlisch onderzoek naar de gebeurtenissen is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de reactie vanuit de Europese Commissie, Navo en Europese leiders op de uitslag van het referendum in Macedonië

MP Leijten asks whether the Macedonian referendum on the Prespa agreement was an internal name issue or a vote on EU and NATO membership, and whether EU and NATO reactions and Tusk's pre-referendum video were premature or improper interference. The minister replies that the government linked the referendum to future EU and NATO accession, that the vote was consultative so parliament now decides, and that the EU and NATO were simply encouraging participation.
The referendum has thus been linked by the Macedonian government to future EU and NATO accession.
Het referendum is daarmee door de Macedonische regering gekoppeld aan toekomstige EU en NAVO-toetreding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat een Nederlandse consul voor het redden van duizenden Joden een reprimande van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken kreeg

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that consul Jan Zwartendijk was reprimanded by the ministry for helping save thousands of Jews, and whether the minister would apologise to his relatives. The minister said the reprimand, if it occurred, was wholly inappropriate, that apologies are due, and that the secretary-general had written to the family to that effect.
Jan Zwartendijk did not deserve a reprimand such as the one Jan Brokken assumes in his book was given in 1964.
Jan Zwartendijk verdiende geen reprimande zoals die naar de veronderstelling van Jan Brokken in zijn boek heeft plaatsgevonden in 1964.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en De Graaf over berechting Nederlandse terreurverdachten in Suriname

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government knows that two Surinamese-Dutch suspects are being prosecuted in Paramaribo for plotting a terror attack on the US ambassador, whether the Dutch embassy and police follow the trial and will report after each hearing, and whether Dutch roots of the plot are being investigated. The minister confirms awareness, says the embassy follows the case closely, notes one closed-door hearing, declines to send case reports to parliament, and declines to comment on an individual foreign case.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Justice and Security cannot send your House reports on individual foreign court cases.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken en het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid kunnen aan uw Kamer geen rapportages over individuele buitenlandse rechtszaken doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het repressieve optreden van de Venezolaanse autoriteiten tegen jongeren

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares Amnesty's findings that Venezuelan authorities kill young men in poor neighbourhoods under the guise of fighting crime, and whether he will press for an end to disproportionate force and prosecution of abusers. The minister said he lacks sufficient information to confirm all Amnesty findings, but shares concern about rule-of-law erosion and impunity and says the issue is raised bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN Human Rights Council.
However, I do not have sufficient information to confirm all findings from the Amnesty International report.
Ik beschik echter niet over voldoende informatie om alle bevindingen uit het rapport van Amnesty International te bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Turkse internationaal opererende ontvoeringsteams

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Turkish presidential spokesman's remarks on possible global deployment of Turkish abduction teams, what the government will do against such teams in the Netherlands, and whether the Turkish ambassador will be summoned. The minister answered that there are no indications such teams are active in the Netherlands, that police and prosecutors are alert and urge victims to report, and that there is currently no reason to summon the ambassador.
The cabinet currently has no indications that such teams are active in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet heeft op dit moment geen aanwijzingen dat dergelijke teams in Nederland actief zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat het strafhof in Caïro doodstraffen en zware gevangenisstraffen aan demonstranten heeft opgelegd

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Cairo court's death sentences and heavy prison terms for protesters, including doubts about the fairness of the trial and whether the Netherlands would press for reversal. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposes the death penalty, monitored the trial with partners, raised concerns bilaterally and via the EU, and supported an EU statement, while declining to judge the legal process before appeals are exhausted.
As long as appeal options remain, I do not consider it appropriate to make definitive statements about the legal process.
Zolang er nog beroepsmogelijkheden zijn, acht ik het niet opportuun om definitieve uitspraken te doen over de rechtsgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat Iran de Nederlandse ambassadeur op het matje heeft geroepen

The MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about Iran summoning the Dutch ambassador over an attack in Ahwaz, whether the US view of Iran as the top state sponsor of terrorism is shared, and whether the Netherlands should distance itself from EU policy on the Iran nuclear deal. The minister answered that the ambassador conveyed condolences and that claims would be assessed on facts with EU partners, that the Netherlands shares concern about Iran's regional role and pursues pressure plus critical dialogue, and that the nuclear deal remains essential for Dutch security.
The Netherlands is greatly concerned about Iran's role in the region.
Nederland maakt zich grote zorgen over de Iraanse rol in de regio
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een aanslag in Iran

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the deadly 2018 attack in Ahvaz, Iran, was claimed by a group based in Delft, and what the Dutch branch of the Arab Struggle Movement for the Liberation of Ahwaz does and whether the ambassador discussed the matter. The minister answered that IS and an Ahwaz separatist claimed the attack, that the Dutch ASMLA branch disavows it, that he urged Iran to substantiate its accusations, and that the ambassador conveyed condolences and said any assessment would rest on facts and EU consultation.
Minister Blok called on his Iranian counterpart Zarif on 28 September to substantiate accusations against the Netherlands or persons or groups established in the Netherlands with evidence.

Minister Blok heeft zijn Iraanse ambtsgenoot Zarif op 28 september jl. opgeroepen om aantijgingen aan het adres van Nederland of in Nederland gevestigde personen of groepen te onderbouwen met bewijslast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat een Nederlandse docente “door Israël is gearresteerd en gedeporteerd”

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a Dutch lecturer was arrested and deported by Israel, whether she was denied consular help, and whether the government would act, plus whether this links to Israel's BDS entry-ban law. The minister said the government knows of the case only from the person's blog, does not recognise the term deportation, and that the woman never requested consular assistance; the government raised concerns about the earlier entry denials with Israel but said entry policy is Israel's prerogative.
The cabinet knows of this matter only through the blog of the person concerned.
Het kabinet is uitsluitend via het blog van betrokkene bekend met deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over mensenrechtenschendingen in Afrin in Noord-Syrië

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about human rights violations by Turkish-backed groups and Turkish forces in Afrin, Syria, including whether Turkey must stop them and ensure displaced residents can return, and whether Dutch non-lethal aid reached those groups. The minister acknowledged the serious picture, said Turkey bears responsibility and that the Netherlands raises the issue bilaterally and in the EU, NATO and UN, and admitted Dutch-supplied equipment could have been used in the offensive, referring to a confidential letter.
Your House was informed in a confidential letter of 23 January about the situation in Afrin and the Dutch contribution to the NLA programme.
Uw kamer is middels een vertrouwelijke brief op 23 januari jl. (kenmerk: 32 623, nr. 184 ) over de situatie in Afrin en de Nederlandse bijdrage aan het NLA-programma geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Anne Mulder over het bericht 'Romanian PM clashes with Commission over rule of law'

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Romanian PM Dăncilă's criticism of the EU Cooperation and Verification Mechanism on rule of law and the upcoming referendum redefining marriage in the constitution. The minister said the CVM remains necessary until Romania's reforms are irreversible, expressed concern that the referendum could discriminate against LGBTI people, and reported raising Dutch concerns during his visit to Romania.
The CVM makes an important contribution here and should therefore be maintained until the CIE recommendations are sustainable and irreversible.
Het CVM levert hier een belangrijke bijdrage aan en dient derhalve behouden te blijven totdat de CIE-aanbevelingen duurzaam en onomkeerbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht ‘Escalatie President Guatemala weert corruptie-aanklager VN’

MPs asked the ministers about Guatemala's refusal to renew the UN anti-corruption commission CICIG and about the government's response, protection of human rights defenders, and intimidation of NGOs. The ministers said they regret the non-renewal, cite Dutch funding, EU statements and the Shelter City programme, and promised continued monitoring and raising of the issue with Guatemalan authorities.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs will continue to closely monitor the situation and keep raising it with the Guatemalan government.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken zal de situatie nauwlettend blijven volgen en blijven aankaarten bij de Guatemalteekse overheid.
