Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van Rooijen, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Kuzu over de uitvoering van de motie inzake Magnitsky-sancties

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he had formally proposed an EU human rights sanctions regime, how other member states reacted, and why he doubts a national Magnitsky-style regime would be effective, as well as whether he will implement the Omtzigt motion. The minister answered that he proposed an EU global human rights sanctions regime at the Gymnich meeting, that some states were positive and none openly negative, that a formal proposal is deferred until support exists, that a national regime would be ineffective given Schengen, and that he will pursue the EU route and report after a November meeting.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is organising a senior-official meeting in November for EU member states and like-minded countries to further develop the concept of a human rights sanctions regime.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken organiseert in november een hoogambtelijke bijeenkomst voor EU-lidstaten en enkele gelijkgezinde landen om het concept van een mensenrechtensanctieregime verder te ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over de sluiting van Aramese scholen door de Koerdische YPG in Noordoost-Syrië

MPs Omtzigt, Van Helvert and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware that the YPG had closed Christian schools in north-east Syria, how he assessed this, what contacts the government has with the YPG, and what steps it would take on the risk of ethnic cleansing and a ceasefire. Minister Blok answered that the government finds the reports worrying, will raise them informally with the Benelux representation of the PYD/YPG, and that contacts are sporadic; on ceasefire efforts he described support for initiatives in Idlib without committing to new concrete steps.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en De Roon over de uitlatingen van een Nederlandse diplomaat over het opgeven van het veto op het gebied van buitenland beleid

PVV MPs Maeijer and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of a Dutch diplomat's remarks on giving up the EU foreign-policy veto and whether the government would reject any loss of vetoes. Minister Blok confirmed the quotes, said the government favours efficient EU decision-making with a positive attitude, and promised a BNC-fiche on the Commission communication, without clearly ruling out giving up vetoes.
The cabinet will inform the House of Representatives, by means of a BNC-fiche, of its position on the Communication of the European Commission.
Het kabinet zal de Tweede Kamer door middel van een BNC-fiche informeren over zijn standpunt ten aanzien van de Mededeling
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van Ojik over het ‘Verdrag tussen de Regering van het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden en de Regering van Australië inzake olievoorraadovereenkomsten’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether the Netherlands-Australia oil stockholding treaty is efficient given Australian stocks stored in the Netherlands, whether it mainly benefits Dutch oil companies, and what value it has for citizens. The minister answered that stock location does not matter in IEA collective actions, that Australia has long failed its stockholding obligation, and that the treaty lets Australia buy oil tickets from Dutch firms, a usual commercial activity.
The treaty makes it possible for Australia to purchase oil tickets from oil companies established in the Netherlands.
Het verdrag maakt het voor Australië mogelijk om olie-tickets aan te kopen bij in Nederland gevestigde oliebedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie zich mengt in de opleiding Europese Studies

An SP MP asked the ministers whether the European Commission exerts undue influence over European Studies curricula through Jean Monnet funding and the Tuning project, and whether funding and teaching should be transparent and free of content steering. The minister replied that there are no signals from the accreditation body or inspectorate of threats to academic freedom, that Jean Monnet funding is open to critical perspectives, that Tuning is an autonomous higher-education initiative to which the Commission gave only financial and moral support, and that transparency will be promoted within existing privacy law.
The Netherlands favours maximum transparency and accessibility of information, within the existing (privacy) legislation of course.
Nederland is voorstander van maximale transparantie en toegankelijkheid van informatie, uiteraard binnen de bestaande (privacy)wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over het bericht dat de Iraanse regering de Nederlandse ambassadeur heeft ontboden

MP Koopmans asked the Foreign Minister about Iran summoning the Dutch ambassador over claims that the Netherlands harbours Iranian opposition groups, and about the response, human rights and a possible UN resolution. Minister Blok confirmed the summons, said the ASMLA branch in The Hague is not linked to the attack, pledged to raise Dutch concerns with Iran and to keep raising human rights in UN and bilateral fora.
I will convey to Iran that accusations against the Netherlands must be substantiated with evidence.
Ik zal aan Iran overbrengen dat aantijgingen aan het adres van Nederland moeten worden onderbouwd met bewijslast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een aantal gedetineerden in Bahrein

Karabulut (SP) asked the Foreign Minister whether detained activists in Bahrain, including Hassan Mushaima, are denied medical care, whether they are prisoners of conscience who should be released, and whether the government will call for it. The minister said the Netherlands has no independent information, pointed to a Bahraini Ombudsman report saying appropriate care is provided, and said the government raises human rights and fair-trial concerns with Bahraini authorities and in the UN Human Rights Council without committing to demand release.
The Netherlands does not have its own information about this case.
Nederland beschikt niet over eigen informatie over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over militair optreden in Syrië

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister whether he remembers partially publishing internal international-law advice on possible military action in Syria after a Wob request, to list the internal legal advice given on Syria since late 2014, and to publish it or explain why not. The minister confirmed a summary part was released, said advice covered the NLA programme, the mandate for operations over Syria and the response to chemical weapons use, and declined to publish it, citing the need for candid internal advice, though it gave confidential access to decision memoranda on the NLA programme.
The cabinet attaches great importance to civil servants being able to advise impartially and in confidence, and therefore as a rule does not provide internal advice.
Het kabinet hecht er zeer aan dat ambtenaren onbevangen en in vertrouwen kunnen adviseren en verstrekt interne adviezen dan ook in de regel niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat de Nigeriaanse overheid verdrijving van christenen toestaat

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Nigerian government permits the expulsion of Christians in the Middle Belt and whether impunity for violence against them is actively sustained by federal authorities. The minister denied that the federal government expels Christians or encourages violence, acknowledged police and army failure to curb attacks, and listed diplomatic pressure and two new NGO-run programmes as steps taken.
It has not been shown that the federal government would expel Christians from their country or encourage violence.
Het is niet gebleken dat de federale overheid christenen van hun land zou verdrijven of geweld zou aanmoedigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de gevolgen van het inreisverbod van de Verenigde Staten voor werknemers van ASML

The MP Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister how the US travel ban affects ASML and other Dutch employees, whether the government will raise it with US authorities, and whether it was raised in preclearance talks at Schiphol. The minister replied that the US is sovereign over admissions, that the ministry will try to mediate if companies report problems, and that the Dutch preclearance position is conditioned on compatibility with Dutch, European and international law.
The United States, like all other countries, is sovereign in determining who it admits to its territory, subject to its international legal obligations.
De Verenigde Staten zijn, net als alle andere landen, met inachtneming van hun internationaalrechtelijke verplichtingen, soeverein in het bepalen wie zij toelaten tot hun grondgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de Nederlandse steun aan de Syrische rebellen en de vele geheime onderzoeken die daarnaar gedaan worden

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign and Prime Minister about Dutch support to Syrian rebels, the ending of the NLA programme, and the secrecy and multiple reviews surrounding it. Minister Blok answers that the programme ended, that delivery documents are classified for security reasons, that reports will be shared confidentially before the debate, and that some detailed information cannot be disclosed.
Prior to the debate on the NLA programme, the cabinet will send the full research report to the House on a confidential basis.
Voorafgaand aan het debat over het NLA-programma zal kabinet het volledige onderzoeksrapport op vertrouwelijk basis aan uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het rapport van de onafhankelijke, internationale VN Fact Finding Missie over Myanmar

MP Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to the UN fact-finding mission report on Myanmar, which found genocidal intent, crimes against humanity and war crimes, and what steps Netherlands will take on the matter. The minister said the findings are very worrying, that genocide requires a very high evidentiary bar and recognition would ideally follow a UN Security Council resolution or international court ruling, and that Netherlands will push for ICC referral, an evidence-gathering mechanism and EU-led resolutions while noting China's likely veto.

The cabinet is of the view that impunity must always be combated and that the FFM, through this report, further substantiates the strong call that Netherlands previously made for perpetrators to be brought to justice.
Het kabinet is van mening dat straffeloosheid altijd moet worden bestreden en dat de FMM door middel van dit rapport verdere onderbouwing geeft aan de sterke oproep
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Van Ojik en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Waarom help Nederland zijn meisjes niet’

MPs Özütok, Van Ojik and Buitenweg asked the Foreign Affairs and Legal Protection ministers why the Netherlands helps so few women and girls who are victims of forced marriage or abandonment abroad, why the ticket fund is little used, and how Norway compares. The minister's answer describes 38 reports in 2017, the handling of cases, the limited use of the ticket fund, and commits to reporting results of the forced marriage unit soon.
There is no national registration of victims of forced marriage and abandonment.
Er is geen landelijke registratie van slachtoffers van huwelijksdwang en achterlating.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'Kanada fordert Unterstützung von Maas'

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether the pressure Saudi Arabia exerted on the Netherlands in 2017 over a UN Human Rights Council resolution compares to the pressure now on Canada, whether Canada requested support, and whether the Netherlands will publicly back Canada and raise the matter with Germany and the EU. The minister replies that the Saudi-Canada dispute differs in kind, that Canada made no such request, and that the Netherlands has raised concerns about detained activists at EU level via a demarche.
Canada has not made such a request to the Netherlands.
Canada heeft niet een dergelijk verzoek aan Nederland gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ploumen en Van Ojik over de hongerstaking van gedetineerde Rif-activisten in Marokko

MPs Karabulut, Ploumen and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister about the hunger strike of detained Rif activists in Morocco, including Nasser Zefzafi's health, contacts with Moroccan authorities, review of the verdicts and calls for release. The minister confirmed the hunger strike ended after most demands were met, said the embassy is in contact with lawyers but not detainees, and declined to request release or better treatment, citing that verdicts and appeal are still pending.
Regarding the treatment of Mr Zefzafi and other political prisoners, I do not have information that would support a request for better treatment.
Wat betreft de behandeling van de heer Zefzafi en andere politieke gevangenen, beschik ik niet over informatie die een verzoek om betere behandeling zou kunnen ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van den Hul, Ploumen, Van Ojik en Van Raan over het bericht dat de VS alle hulp aan UNRWA stopt

MPs asked the government how it views the US decision to halt all funding to UNRWA, and whether it will press Washington, increase its own contribution, and address the wider political consequences. The government regrets the US decision, says it opposes politicising humanitarian aid, pledges to raise the issue with the US and other donors, and keeps its existing 13 million euro annual contribution while deferring any extra funding to year-end review.
As usual, at the end of the year the cabinet will assess, within existing humanitarian aid agreements, which additional Dutch contributions based on the humanitarian imperative are desirable.

Zoals gebruikelijk beoordeelt het kabinet aan het einde van het jaar binnen de bestaande afspraken over humanitaire hulp welke aanvullende Nederlandse bijdragen op basis van het humanitair imperatief wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over intern volkenrechtelijk advies over de steun aan de rebellen in Syrië

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether internal international-law advice on arms-type aid to Syrian rebels is public, whether the government deliberately avoided external advice, and asked for all such advice to be sent to parliament before a debate. The minister said internal advice is not state secret but falls under personal policy views and is not released by default, and offered confidential inspection of the decision memoranda for the NLA programme.
In this exceptional case, the cabinet is prepared, exceptionally, to give the House confidential access to the decision memoranda on the NLA programme if desired.
In dit bijzondere geval is het kabinet bij uitzondering bereid de Kamer desgewenst vertrouwelijk inzage te geven in de besluitvormingsmemoranda over het NLA-programma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over mogelijke normalisatie van de relatie met Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether normalising relations with Turkey is acceptable given the rule-of-law decline, the proposed law giving the president power over judges, and the detention of opposition figures, and what was done on a motion for release of political prisoners. The minister answered that rule-of-law concerns are raised in EU and Council of Europe settings, that normalisation does not mean agreement on the facts, and described diplomatic steps taken on the Demirtaş and Kiliç cases.
The Netherlands regularly raises concerns about the rule of law and human rights in Turkey, including within the European Union and the Council of Europe.
Nederland stelt de zorgen over de rechtsstaat en mensenrechten in Turkije regelmatig aan de orde, onder andere binnen de Europese Unie en in het kader van de Raad van Europa (RvE).
Antwoord op vragen het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat Maleisische vrouwen stokslagen krijgen omdat zij op vrouwen vallen

Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister how the government views caning of two Malaysian women for a same-sex relationship and what it will do about human rights for LGBTI people in Malaysia. Minister Blok condemned the caning, said the ambassador raised the case with authorities, and outlined ongoing human rights engagement while noting that sharia courts fall under the states.
I will also raise the issue at my next meeting with my counterpart Saifuddin Abdullah.
Ik zal de kwestie bij mijn volgende gesprek met mijn ambtsgenoot Saifuddin Abdullah eveneens aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over het bericht dat Fransen nieuwe jacht op de grutto niet uitsluiten

MPs Van Kooten-Arissen and Van Raan asked whether France's hunting of protected migratory birds such as the curlew and black-tailed godwit harms Dutch populations and whether the Dutch government will protest or block imports. The minister said France has extended a hunting ban on the godwit and curlew (except coastal curlew hunting) until July 2019, will monitor the situation, and will support proposals at the AEWA meeting in December 2018.
The Netherlands is closely monitoring developments in France and the population status of the black-tailed godwit and curlew, as the Netherlands invests heavily in conserving these species.
Nederland volgt de ontwikkelingen in Frankrijk en de stand van de populaties van de grutto en de wulp nauwgezet, aangezien Nederland veel inspanningen doet om deze soorten te behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Weerdenburg over het bericht dat Hamas een militaire opleiding runt met UNRWA geld

Two PVV MPs asked whether UNRWA schools in Gaza are used by Hamas for military training, how much of UNRWA's budget goes to Gaza, and whether the Dutch annual contribution of about 20 million euro should be stopped or not increased. The government said it has no evidence for the training claim, that UNRWA does not cooperate with Hamas summer camps, and that it intends to keep the annual 13 million euro contribution while assessing any additional funding case by case.
The government has no evidence for the claim in the article or the 2015 film referred to in the article.
Het kabinet heeft geen bewijs voor de claim uit het artikel of de film uit 2015 waar in het artikel naar verwezen wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over mensenrechtenschendingen in Saudi-Arabië

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares Amnesty's analysis that Saudi Arabia's detention of women's rights defenders and possible death sentences aim to deter other rights activists, and whether he will press Saudi Arabia on Amnesty's demands. The minister answered that the Netherlands is deeply concerned, opposes the death penalty, raises these concerns via political channels and an EU demarche of 8 August, and will raise activist arrests at the UN Universal Periodic Review in November.
The Netherlands is very concerned about the recent arrests and the broader human rights situation in Saudi Arabia.
Nederland is zeer bezorgd over de recente arrestaties en de bredere mensenrechtensituatie in Saoedi-Arabië.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Ojik, Agnes Mulder, Sjoerdsma en Van der Staaij over de berichten dat tegen vijf Soedische mensenrechtenactivistes de doodstraf is geëist

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that prosecutors sought the death penalty against five Saudi human rights activists, including one woman, and whether the trial is fair and what pressure the Netherlands can exert. The minister answered that the government is deeply concerned, opposes the death penalty, raises concerns with Saudi authorities and through EU channels including a joint demarche, and will raise the issue at the November UPR, but gave limited information on the trial itself.
The cabinet is following developments, including the trial of the female activist mentioned in the reports, closely.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen, waaronder het proces van de in de berichtgeving genoemde vrouwelijke activist, op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een VN-rapport over mogelijke oorlogsmisdaden in Jemen

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about a UN report on possible war crimes by all parties in Yemen, including its recommendations and whether the Netherlands would push for a Security Council resolution and an end to arms supplies. Minister Blok said the findings are worrying, that follow-up falls to the Human Rights Council, and that existing UN arms embargo rules and Dutch export policy apply, without committing to a Security Council resolution.

The Netherlands, in line with its commitment to the House of Representatives, does not export weapons to countries involved in the coalition operation unless it can be ruled out that they will be used in Yemen.

Nederland exporteert, conform toezegging aan de Tweede Kamer, geen wapens naar landen die betrokken zijn bij de operatie van de coalitie, tenzij uitgesloten kan worden dat deze worden ingezet in Jemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over het bericht dat Russische trollen ook actief zijn in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers whether Russian troll activity in the Netherlands is a concern, whether it is criminal, and whether the government will act with platforms and at EU level against foreign influence on public opinion. The government says foreign interference is serious, points to an interdepartmental approach and EU work on online disinformation, and says whether speech is criminal is for the prosecutor to decide, while keeping talks with platforms ongoing.

The cabinet considers unwanted foreign interference very objectionable as it can undermine the political and social system and touches the foundation of the Dutch democratic legal order and open society.

Het kabinet vindt ongewenste buitenlandse inmenging zeer kwalijk aangezien dit het politieke en maatschappelijke systeem kan ondergraven en raakt aan het fundament van de Nederlandse democratische rechtsorde en open samenleving.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat de Europese Unie een plan heeft opgesteld voor infrastructuur tussen Gaza en Judea-Samaria, zonder Israël en de Palestijnse Autoriteit hierbij te betrekken o

The MP asks whether the EU drew up an infrastructure plan linking Gaza and the West Bank without involving Israel or the Palestinian Authority, and what the Netherlands thinks of it. The minister answers that the study supports the Palestinian Ministry of Transport, that coordination with Israel will be needed for concrete projects, and that the government supports opening crossings and the two-state solution.
Since this is an exploratory study that helps the PA shape its own vision, permission was not requested from the Israeli authorities.
Aangezien het gaat om een verkennend onderzoek dat de PA helpt diens eigen visie vorm te geven, is geen toestemming gevraagd van de Israëlische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Helvert over het beëindigen van vluchten naar Teheran door KLM en de gevolgen van Amerikaanse secundaire sancties

MPs Amhaouch and Van Helvert asked whether KLM's halt of Tehran flights and the US secondary sanctions on Iran are related, and what the sanctions mean for Dutch firms. The ministers answered that KLM's decision was commercial, that Dutch firms face reputational, financial and legal risks from extraterritorial US sanctions, and that the Netherlands opposes such extraterritoriality while the EU has adopted countermeasures.
The Dutch government is not involved in internal considerations and motives regarding the business operations of Dutch companies.
De Nederlandse overheid is niet betrokken bij interne overwegingen en beweegredenen t.a.v. bedrijfsvoering van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de verwerving van gevechtsvesten in het kader van het VOSS-project door het Israëlisch concern Elbit

An MP asks the Defence and Foreign Ministers about the procurement of combat vests from Israeli firm Elbit under the VOSS project, including whether a contract option bypassed competition and whether differentiation policy on Israeli settlements should apply. The government answers that using a contract option is standard, the DMP procedure was applied correctly, and Elbit's activities do not contribute to settlements, so there is no reason to revise the relationship.
Defence is using an option within the contract concluded with Elbit under the VOSS project.
Defensie maakt gebruik van een optie binnen de overeenkomst die met Elbit is gesloten in het kader van het project VOSS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over de arrestatie van Bobi Wine

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest and alleged torture of Bobi Wine in Uganda, whether he had contacted his counterpart, and how pressure could be applied for his release. The minister condemned the arrest, described EU joint démarches, consular visits and contacts with Ugandan officials, and said Netherlands would continue to raise human rights concerns with Uganda.
I share the concerns about the human rights situation in Uganda and will continue to raise them with the Ugandan government in a European context.
Ik deel de zorgen over de mensenrechtensituatie in Uganda en blijf die in Europees verband aan de orde stellen bij de Ugandese regering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over twee Nederlanders die om politieke redenen de toegang tot Israël geweigerd is

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about two Dutch women refused entry to Israel at Tel Aviv airport over alleged BDS sympathies, including whether they were denied consular access and what the government would do. The minister confirmed the facts, said the embassy did not have direct contact with the women but followed up with Israeli authorities, and said the government raised concerns while stating that refusing entry is an Israeli prerogative.
However, it remains an Israeli prerogative to deny people entry into the country.
Het blijft echter een Israëlisch prerogatief om mensen de toegang tot het land te onthouden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over door de OVSE waargenomen schendingen van de Minsk-akkoorden door de Russische Federatie

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about OSCE observations of Russian-linked arms supplies to separatists in eastern Ukraine, heavy weapons in prohibited zones, and obstruction of the mission under the Minsk agreements. The minister confirms awareness, says convoys were observed but Russia claims humanitarian aid and not all can be verified, states violations occur almost daily without detailing each, and says the international community repeatedly urges all parties, including Russia, to stop obstructing the OSCE.
Almost daily the OSCE observes and reports on the presence of heavy weapons on both sides of the front line.
Vrijwel dagelijks constateert en rapporteert de OVSE over de aanwezigheid van zware wapens aan beide zijden van de frontlinie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Van Oosten en Van der Graaf over de verklaring (nr. 2) van het bestuur van de Stichting Vliegramp MH17 inzake meldingen en publiciteit over lichamelijke resten op MH17-crashsite

MPs asked whether recent YouTube videos and a foundation statement about bone fragments found at the MH17 crash site show that remains were planted to undermine the JIT investigation, and what action the government has taken. The minister answered that remains may still be found but the claimed location is unlikely, that no reports of new finds came in to official contacts, that the JIT has no concrete evidence of planting, and that Nederland has asked the OVSE and Grieving Nations to press the de facto authorities to hand over remains.
Contact will be made with the journalist with an urgent request to hand over all bone fragments to the authorities.
Er zal contact met de journalist worden opgenomen met het dringende verzoek alle botfragmenten aan de autoriteiten over te dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Lodders over de voornemens omtrent landonteigening in Zuid-Afrika

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about South African plans for land expropriation without compensation, farm attacks, Dutch and European business caution, the ICC withdrawal and asylum applications by South Africans. The minister answered that the government is monitoring developments, expects the parliamentary inquiry report and the post-2019 ICC decision, and will raise concerns at the EU-South Africa summit.
Once this report is published, the government will study the outcomes and share them with the House.
Het kabinet zal, zodra dit verslag is uitgebracht, de uitkomsten bestuderen en met de Kamer delen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de toekenning van de speciale editie van de mensenrechtentulp aan de Hoge Commissaris voor de Mensenrechten Zeid Ra'ad Al Hussein en de rol van de commissaris i

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked how the special Human Rights Tulip was awarded to outgoing UN High Commissioner Zeid Ra'ad Al Hussein, given his role in the treatment of whistleblower Anders Kompass, and whether he should apologise and help child victims of abuse by peacekeepers. The minister explains the award procedure and the decision by the minister, says the independent panel found no abuse of power by the High Commissioner, notes that a UN tribunal case is pending, and declines to request an apology, while pointing to UN and UNICEF measures for victims and whistleblower protection.
The cabinet will strive to answer your questions before the Human Rights Tulip ceremony.
Het kabinet zal streven naar beantwoording van uw vragen voor de uitreiking van de Mensenrechtentulp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt en Voordewind over de toekenning van de mensenrechtentulp aan Zeid Ra’ad Al Hussein

MPs Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked why the Dutch human rights award was given to outgoing UN High Commissioner Zeid Ra'ad Al Hussein despite whistleblower allegations of cover-ups, and whether he would apologise to whistleblowers Reilly and Kompass. The minister answered that the one-off award honoured his record defending human rights defenders, that no independent committee was involved, that the whistleblower cases were handled by UN bodies with proceedings still pending, and that the government will not ask him to apologise.
No independent committee was involved in the decision-making on the award.
Bij de besluitvorming rond de toekenning was geen onafhankelijke commissie betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Leijten over het bericht dat visa en paspoorten te koop zijn voor superrijken

An MP asks the government why wealthy non-EU nationals can buy EU residence permits or passports through investor programmes, and whether this undermines citizenship, transparency and anti-money-laundering safeguards. The government answers that each state sets its own nationality rules, transparency and money-laundering checks are the responsibility of member states and the Commission, and it sees no conflict with international law so no further action is planned.
It is up to the member state concerned to establish whether the national legal conditions for issuing a passport have been met and to prevent criminals possibly being facilitated thereby.

Het is aan het desbetreffende land om vast te stellen of aan de nationale (wettelijke) voorwaarden voor verstrekking van een paspoort is voldaan en om te voorkomen dat daardoor mogelijkerwijs criminelen worden gefaciliteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Roon over de OIC-veroordeling van een cartoonwedstrijd in Nederland

PVV MPs Wilders and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about the OIC's condemnation of a planned Mohammed cartoon contest in the Netherlands, questioning the OIC's standing, the Cairo Declaration's sharia clause, and whether the government would firmly reject OIC interference. Minister Blok answered that freedom of expression applies to all, that the Netherlands is not an OIC member and does not endorse the Cairo Declaration, that courts rather than the cabinet judge legal limits, and that he informed the OIC Secretary-General that the government has no involvement in the contest.
The OIC is free to speak out publicly in this debate.
Het staat de OIC vrij om zich openbaar uit te spreken in dit debat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert, De Roon en Van der Staaij over een rapport over schoolboeken, uitgegeven door de Palestijnse Autoriteit

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government assesses a report finding that Palestinian Authority textbooks delegitimise Israel, glorify violence and lack peace education, and whether the government will press for change and join a British-led review. The ministers agree problematic elements remain, say Dutch and EU pressure on both sides against incitement has had limited results as relations deteriorate, and decline to contribute to the British review because the Netherlands is not a donor in education and lacks specific expertise.
However, the Netherlands is not a donor in the education sector and has no specific expertise on Palestinian education.
Nederland is echter geen donor in de onderwijssector en heeft geen specifieke expertise op het Palestijnse onderwijs.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke en Van der Staaij over de brief van de Hoge Vertegenwoordiger van de EU Federica Mogherini aan de Israëlische minister van Strategische Zaken Gilad Erdan

MPs asked the government about an EU High Representative letter to Israeli minister Erdan and reports that a Palestinian NGO, Ma'an Development Center, employed a man allegedly linked to the PFLP, and whether Dutch funds reached it and whether NGO funding policy should change. The government answered that the man worked on a project basis and not in permanent employment, that it has no independent evidence of the alleged affiliation, that its selection criteria are adequate and it would act if subsidy conditions were breached, and that no policy revision is currently needed.
Revision of the Dutch policy towards NGOs is currently not on the agenda.
Herziening van het Nederlandse beleid ten aanzien van NGO's is op dit moment niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Fritsma over het opheffen van de visumplicht voor Kosovo

PVV MPs Maeijer and Fritsma asked whether the Commission's finding that Kosovo meets visa liberalisation conditions is accepted, whether the government will consent, and why it is nonetheless pursued given past crime and security concerns. The Minister replied that the government will study the Commission report carefully before taking a position, that each country is assessed separately with flanking safeguards, and that visa liberalisation is conditional and monitored after adoption.
The cabinet will study this report carefully before taking a position. Your House will be informed about this.
Het kabinet zal dit rapport nauwgezet bestuderen alvorens een standpunt in te nemen. Uw Kamer zal hierover worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat NRC journalist Koen Greven geen toestemming heeft gekregen om zijn werk te doen in Marokko

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how he assesses Morocco's restrictions on press freedom, including the ban on NRC journalist Koen Greven working in Al Hoceima, and whether he would raise it urgently with Moroccan authorities. The minister said the Dutch ambassador raised the case, Moroccan authorities cited missing accreditation, and the embassy offers journalists guidance and the Netherlands supports press-freedom organisations.
This matter was raised by the Dutch ambassador in Rabat on 20 July with the Moroccan Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Deze kwestie is door de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Rabat op 20 juli jl. opgebracht bij het Marokkaanse Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de klokkenluidersbrief van Roelie Post.

Rep. Omtzigt asked the Foreign and Prime Minister about whistleblower Roelie Post, who sent a letter to the European Parliament president copied to the Dutch Prime Minister during the Dutch EU presidency, and about her dismissal by the European Commission. The government replied that EU whistleblowing guidelines allow external channels as a last resort, that the copy was noted rather than read, and that the dispute is for the Commission and the EU General Court to resolve, so the government takes no mediating role.
The copy of this letter was therefore officially received for information and was not read by the Prime Minister.
Het afschrift van deze brief is daarom ambtelijk aangenomen ter kennisgeving en niet door de Minister-President gelezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het ontslag van klokkenluider Roelie Post bij de Europese Commissie

The SP MP Leijten asked the Foreign Minister how he judges the dismissal of whistleblower Roelie Post by the European Commission for unauthorised absence and disloyalty, the loss of unemployment benefits, the Commission's bill for unauthorised absence, and whether he will intervene with Commission President Juncker. The minister replied that Commission staff are governed by the EU Staff Regulations, that it is for the Commission to resolve the dispute, that the cabinet has no mediating role and no details of the dispute, though it would welcome a mutually acceptable solution, and that the EU General Court is competent in such disputes.
For this reason, a mediating role for the cabinet is not obvious.
Voor het kabinet ligt om deze reden geen bemiddelende rol voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, De Roon en Agema over het beleid van Jeugdbescherming Rijnmond inzake reisadviezen naar Israël

PVV MPs asked whether the Rotterdam youth protection agency JRR gives children under supervision a negative travel advice for Israel, why it differs from Turkey or Morocco, and whether it should allow travel to such areas when accompanied by an adult. The minister answered that the certified institution assesses each trip case by case for every destination, that the ministry's advice is only one factor, and that it will not restrict the institution's power to refuse travel when child development is at risk.
There is no general negative travel advice for any country.
Er is daarbij geen sprake van een algemeen negatief reisadvies voor welk land dan ook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over omkoping van parlementariërs vanuit Azerbeidzjan

An MP asks the foreign minister and prime minister about alleged bribery of parliamentarians by Azerbaijan, including the 'Azerbaijan Laundromat' and the Council of Europe PACE corruption investigation, and asks why the Committee of Ministers and GRECO are not pursuing an independent inquiry. The minister answers that the government is aware of the reports, supports GRECO follow-up, and will monitor developments, but does not commit to pushing for a new independent investigation.
The cabinet welcomes the steps taken so far.
Het kabinet verwelkomt de tot op heden genomen stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het in staatsgezinde handen vallen van een kritische tv-zender in Hongarije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the takeover of Hir-TV in Hungary by pro-government owners, press freedom, the Copenhagen criteria, the Commission's infringement action over the anti-migrant aid law, NGO restrictions, and how the EU and like-minded states should respond. The minister said the government is concerned about shrinking media diversity but does not comment on individual outlets, backed the Venice Commission's criticism of the Soros package, and pointed to ongoing bilateral and EU-level pressure and work on a peer review mechanism.
The cabinet is concerned about the narrowing of media diversity in Hungary, but does not address the position of individual broadcasters.
Het kabinet maakt zich zorgen over de verschraling van de diversiteit aan media in Hongarije, maar gaat niet in op de positie van individuele zenders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Nederlandse projecten in bezet Palestijns gebied die door Israël zijn gesloopt

An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether Israel's demolition of Dutch-funded water projects in occupied Palestinian territory, and its refusal to pay compensation, violates occupation law and what consequences the government will attach. The government condemns the demolitions, says Israel must justify any exception case by case, protested immediately, requested compensation which Israel refused, and favours a joint European response.
The Netherlands remains in discussion with Israel about this issue.
Nederland blijft met Israël in gesprek over deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Anne Mulder en Asscher over de gevolgen van het no deal-scenario voor Nederlandse en EU-burgers in het Verenigd Koninkrijk

MPs Omtzigt, Mulder and Asscher asked the government about the consequences of a no-deal Brexit for Dutch and EU citizens in the UK, including settled status, the need for a helpdesk, and timely information. The government answered that the UK's Settlement Scheme offers no hard guarantees, that a no-deal scenario is being prepared for, that information is provided via IND and the embassy, and that the Chamber will be briefed in September and a closed technical briefing in October.
However, this Statement of Intent offers no hard guarantees.
Dit Statement of Intent biedt echter geen harde garanties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het toelatingsbeleid van Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he knows of EU citizens being refused entry to Turkey on political grounds, how many Dutch nationals have been turned back, whether the government coordinates with other EU states, and whether it will condemn Turkey's practice. The minister said he lacks a full picture of scale or trend, that such cases are handled by foreign authorities, that there is no structural contact with other EU states, and that each country may decide on admission while Dutch citizens may file a complaint.
I do not have a complete picture of the scale, nor of any possible trend.
Ik beschik niet over een volledig beeld van de omvang, noch over een eventuele trend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de oorlog in Jemen

Karabulut (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about recent airstrikes in Yemen with civilian deaths, the death toll, cholera risk, alleged coalition cooperation with Al Qaida, and Dutch initiatives in the UN Security Council including a ceasefire resolution. Minister Blok condemned the attacks in the Security Council, said exact casualty figures are hard to obtain, noted WHO vaccination efforts, said Nederland lacks information on the Al Qaida claim, and declined to launch its own ceasefire initiative so as not to disrupt the UN envoy's process.
The Netherlands does not wish to take its own initiatives that could disrupt this process.
Nederland wil geen eigen initiatieven nemen die dit proces kunnen doorkruisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Arissen over het door Shell georganiseerde festival Generation Discover 2017

Two MPs asked whether Defence and the national police, through paid stands and programme roles at Shell's Generation Discover festival, should withdraw support given Shell's fossil-fuel messaging to children. The Justice minister replied that no state subsidy was given, the stands were rented at market rates, and the government sees the partnerships as technology and cybercrime outreach, with no intention to withdraw.
There is no question of financial state support in the form of, for example, a subsidy.
Er is geen sprake van financiële rijkssteun in de vorm van bijvoorbeeld subsidie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het bericht dat Nederland lokale verkiezingen in Syrisch rebellengebied financierde

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether Dutch funds financed local elections in rebel-held Eastern Ghouta, whether this was covert political interference, and why Parliament was not informed. The minister confirmed a 4,800 euro contribution via the LDSPS programme, defended it as supporting transparent local governance and countering extremist influence, found no evidence of diversion to armed groups, and stated that non-humanitarian support to opposition areas has largely ended.
Through the Local Development and Small Projects Support (LDSPS) programme, the Netherlands supported the elections in Eastern Ghouta with 4,800 euros.
Nederland heeft via het Local Development and Small Projects Support (LDSPS) programma de verkiezingen in Oost-Ghouta met 4800,- euro ondersteund.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de aankoop van olie en gas afkomstig van ISIS door Turkije

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey bought oil and gas from ISIS, whether the government still has no evidence of Turkish tolerance of such smuggling, whether the coalition still aims to destroy ISIS oil infrastructure, whether Dutch F-16s contributed, whether NATO allies undermining the anti-ISIS effort should be raised, and how many persons or companies have been punished for dealing with ISIS. The minister answered that the government has no evidence Turkey tolerates oil smuggling, that Dutch F-16s have not attacked ISIS oil infrastructure, that dealings with ISIS are prohibited under UN and EU sanctions, and that no one has yet been convicted in the Netherlands for such dealings.
The cabinet has no indications that the Turkish state would tolerate oil smuggling from Syria or Iraq.
Er zijn bij het kabinet geen aanwijzingen bekend dat de Turkse staat oliesmokkel vanuit Syrië of Irak zou gedogen.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld van het lid De Roon over de onrust in Nicaragua en het hoge aantal burgerdoden bij anti-regeringsprotesten

MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about the reported high death toll from anti-government protests in Nicaragua, alleged summary executions by police and paramilitaries, and whether the Netherlands would press for UN Security Council action. The minister confirmed awareness of divergent death toll estimates (295 per IACHR, 448 per ANPDH), called the government's conduct of human rights very worrying, and said the Netherlands is supporting an OAS expert mission and suspended a development project for two months, but would wait for ongoing international initiatives before considering raising the matter in the Security Council.
The Netherlands intends to financially support an independent OAS expert mission.
Nederland is voornemens een onafhankelijke expertmissie van de OAS financieel te steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over een tsunami van islamitisch geweld tegen christenen in Nigeria

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether jihadists operate among Fulani herders and whether recent killings of Christians in Nigeria amount to ethnic cleansing or an Islamic agenda. The minister answered that the conflict is mainly driven by socio-economic factors with ethnic-religious elements, that there is no evidence of a religious agenda, and that the government raised the killings with President Buhari during his visit.
There are so far no indications that a premeditated religious agenda lies behind the acts of violence.
Er zijn vooralsnog geen aanwijzingen dat er achter de geweldplegingen een vooropgezette religieuze agenda schuilgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het ‘Report on the Situation of Human Rights in Kashmir’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister about the 2018 OHCHR report on human rights in Kashmir, including whether the Netherlands or the EU had responded, whether an international inquiry should be set up, and whether India and Pakistan should grant access. The minister said the report was regrettable given the lack of access, noted that neither the Netherlands nor the EU took a position on it in the Human Rights Council, and said all parties should cooperate with independent investigations, leaving any heavier inquiry to future findings.
Neither the Netherlands, nor the European Union, nor any of the other EU member states has taken a position on the report.
Nederland, noch de Europese Unie of een van de andere EU-lidstaten, heeft zich uitgesproken over het rapport
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Sjoerdsma en Van Dam over de Amerikaanse steun voor het Joint Investigation Team (JIT) onderzoek naar de daders van MH17

MPs from VVD, CU, D66 and CDA asked the Foreign Minister about reports that the US State Department went silent or softened its MH17 statement after the Trump-Putin summit, and whether MH17 was discussed there. The minister replied that the US fully supports the JIT and the Dutch approach, reaffirmed in the G7 statement of 16 July, while declining to share confidential allied information and calling Russia's criticism unfounded.
As the House is aware, on the basis of alliance agreements no statements can be made about information confidentially shared by allies.
Zoals de Kamer bekend kunnen op basis van bondgenootschappelijke afspraken geen mededelingen worden gedaan over door bondgenoten vertrouwelijk gedeelde informatie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over uitspraken tijdens de bijeenkomst met Nederlandse werknemers van internationale organisaties, bedrijven en ambtenaren op het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken

Rep. Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister whether he stands by remarks made at a closed staff meeting, including claims about genetic predisposition to exclusion and burden sharing in EU asylum policy, and what contacts and damage control followed. The minister regrets the wording, says it was meant to provoke discussion, denies any intent to justify racism, and reports contacts with Caribbean premiers, Suriname and other countries, while declining to speculate on reciprocal cases.
I should not have done that, certainly not in my role as Minister of Foreign Affairs. I regret this.
Dat had ik niet moeten doen, zeker niet in mijn rol als Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken. Dit spijt mij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de weigering van Israël om parlementariërs toe te laten tot Gaza

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel denied her access to Gaza for political reasons, what Israel's policy is on parliamentarians entering Gaza, and whether the government will press Israel to admit them. The minister confirmed she was not granted entry, said Israel rarely allows parliamentarians because it wants to avoid legitimising the de facto authorities, and said the Dutch embassy and Ramallah post have urged Israel to grant access, though entry remains at Israel's discretion.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is aware that you have not been granted permission to enter Gaza through the border crossings with Israel.
Het is het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken bekend dat u geen toestemming is verleend om Gaza in te reizen via de grensovergangen met Israël.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een onbeantwoorde brief over Palestijnse kinderen in Israëlische detentie

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a December 2015 letter from Military Court Watch about the transfer of Palestinian detainees to Israeli prisons, which had gone unanswered, would be answered. The minister said the Dutch embassy facilitated a meeting with the organisation and sent a written reply on 6 August 2018, citing Dutch support for international law and a recommendation made at Israel's UN human rights review.
The embassy provided Military Court Watch with a written reply on 6 August 2018.
De ambassade heeft op 6 augustus 2018 Military Court Watch alsnog schriftelijk van een antwoord voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de president van het Venezolaanse Hooggerechtshof in Nederland was

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the president of Venezuela's Supreme Court, Maikel Moreno, who is on the EU sanctions list, was allowed to attend the 20th anniversary of the Rome Statute in The Hague. The minister confirmed the visit, said Venezuela designated him as its representative, and explained that the ICC requested an exemption and the Zetelverdrag obliged the Netherlands to grant access, while stating that sanctions would be upheld and he could only attend ICC-organised activities.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs explicitly told the Venezuelan authorities that it would enforce the sanctions and that Mr Moreno could only take part in activities organised by the Court.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft in contact met de Venezolaanse autoriteiten uitdrukkelijk aangegeven de sancties te zullen handhaven en dat de heer Moreno alleen kon deelnemen aan activiteiten die door het Strafhof werden georganiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over een explosie in Caïro op 6 augustus 2018

The VVD MP Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister whether the government knew of a 6 August 2018 explosion in central Cairo, whether it occurred opposite the Dutch-supported human rights organisation Karama, and asked to be kept informed given possible terrorism. The minister answered that the minibus explosion injured thirteen bystanders, that it is not for the ministry to disclose Karama's office location, and that Egyptian authorities assume an accident, with the Chamber to be informed of new developments.
It is not for the ministry to provide information about the location of Karama's office.
Het is niet aan het ministerie om informatie te verstrekken over de locatie van het kantoor van Karama.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Voordewind, Diks, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma en Agnes Mulder over de arrestatie van opnieuw twee vrouwenrechtenactivisten in Saoedi-Arabië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of two more Saudi women's rights activists, whether it constitutes an attack on the movement, what joint EU steps were taken, and how the government supports civil society. The minister said the government is concerned, an EU demarche was delivered on 8 August urging clarification of charges and fair treatment, but Saudi space for civil society is limited.

On 8 August the Chargé d'Affaires of the European diplomatic mission, together with the European countries present in Riyadh including the Netherlands, delivered a demarche to the Saudi Foreign Minister.

Op 8 augustus jl. voerde de Tijdelijk Zaakgelastigde van de Europese diplomatieke missie samen met de in Riyad aanwezige Europese landen, waaronder Nederland, een demarche uit bij de Saoedische Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Dam, Ten Broeke en Arno Rutte over terreurvlaggen Hezbollah bij de Tweede Kamer

MPs asked whether Hezbollah flags shown at a June 2018 Quds Day demonstration outside parliament were punishable and why police did not act, and whether the OM enforcement framework or local coordination should change. The minister answers that the flag is punishable under article 131 Sr (incitement) in principle, that no arrest was made for lack of hard investigative indications, and that current frameworks suffice, with each case judged on its own.
Displaying the Hezbollah flag would in principle constitute a punishable offence under article 131 of the Criminal Code, incitement, an offence against public order.
Het tonen van de Hezbollah-vlag zal in beginsel strafbaarheid op grond van artikel 131 Sr, opruiing, opleveren, een misdrijf tegen de openbare orde.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Ojik, Ploumen en Karabulut over de inning Eritrese diasporabelasting nadat de Tijdelijk Zaakgelastigde persona non grata is verklaard

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the dwangmatige inning of Eritrean diaspora tax has changed since the Eritrean chargé was declared persona non grata, whether reports and prosecutions have increased, and whether a central reporting point should be created. The minister answered that no new chargé has been appointed, that there are no indications of change in reports, that a study on banning diaspora tax is underway, and that a special reporting point is not considered necessary.
The cabinet is currently examining the possibilities for a ban on diaspora tax in the Netherlands, in line with the motion by MPs Karabulut and Van Ojik.
Het kabinet onderzoekt momenteel de mogelijkheden met betrekking tot een verbod op diasporabelasting in Nederland, conform de motie van de leden Karabulut en van Ojik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht minister Blok: ‘Suriname is een mislukte staat, door etnische opdeling’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about his remarks calling Suriname a failed state, comments on integration in the Netherlands and Singapore's migration policy, and remarks about migrants being beaten in Warsaw and Prague. The minister acknowledged the remarks, said they were made at a closed meeting to provoke discussion, admitted the claim about beatings was speculative, and reaffirmed the government's EU migration position.
As the published footage shows, I said "They are probably literally being beaten up." I acknowledge that this statement is speculative.
Zoals uit de gepubliceerde beelden blijkt heb ik gezegd «Ze worden waarschijnlijk letterlijk in elkaar geslagen». Ik erken dat die uitspraak speculatief is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht ‘The summon of Feminist and Woman Human Right Defender Mozn Hassan to investigation within the Context of the NGO Foreign Funding Case’ dd 18 juni 2

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked whether the government had raised concerns with Egypt over the summoning and questioning of human rights defender Mozn Hassan in the NGO foreign funding case, and about pressure on civil society. The ministers answered that the case is still under investigation, that concerns were raised bilaterally and at EU level, and that the embassy is monitoring it, without directly intervening in the court process.
The specific case of Mozn Hassan is still before the court, so direct political intervention is not opportune.
De specifieke zaak van Mozn Hassan is nog onder de rechter, waardoor directe politieke interventie niet opportuun is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke en Koopmans over de brief van de Turkse president Erdogan inzake de Turkse verkiezingen

MPs Becker, Ten Broeke and Koopmans asked the government about a letter from Turkish President Erdogan to Turkish voters in the Netherlands before the 2018 Turkish elections, including who supplied the address data, whether the Dutch data protection authority investigated, and whether Turkish election signs on Dutch motorways were justified. The government answered that the letter was not a literal voting instruction but was inappropriate, that address lists can be obtained in Turkey under Turkish law, that the data protection authority acted independently and the GDPR does not apply, and that local authorities handled the signs and no disclaimer will be added.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority is an independent supervisory body that itself determines which investigations it carries out.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder die zelf bepaalt welk onderzoek zij uitvoert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het optreden van veiligheidstroepen in Papua

The MP asks the Foreign Minister about Amnesty International's report on killings by Indonesian security forces in Papua and whether the government will raise impunity, independent investigation and the Dutch-funded community policing programme with Indonesia. The minister acknowledges the report's findings as serious, says human rights in Papua are raised in diplomatic contacts and were discussed during his visit, but does not commit to a new independent investigation or changes to the programme.

The cabinet considers it important that state security personnel exercise their use-of-force mandate within the limits of proportionality, and that the possibility of thorough and independent investigation exists.

In algemene zin vindt het kabinet het belangrijk staatsveiligheidspersoneel zijn geweldsmandaat uitoefent binnen de grenzen van proportionaliteit, en dat de mogelijkheid bestaat tot gedegen en onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de toenemende onzekerheid van eigendom en investeringen in Zuid-Afrika

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about declining property and investment security in South Africa, including the Financial Times reporting, the EFF leader's rhetoric, proposed land expropriation without compensation, BBBEE policy, and the effect on Dutch investors and the bilateral investment treaty. The government answered that it is cautiously optimistic about President Ramaphosa's reforms, that it will monitor expropriation and raise investor concerns in dialogue and at the upcoming EU-South Africa summit, but it gave no concrete commitments beyond continued contact.
The cabinet continues to closely monitor developments, including by maintaining close contacts with the South African authorities through the Embassy in Pretoria.
Het kabinet blijft ontwikkelingen op de voet volgen, onder andere door het onderhouden van nauwe contacten met de Zuid-Afrikaanse autoriteiten door de Ambassade in Pretoria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over inhumaan optreden Franse grenspolitie jegens migrantenkinderen

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the government how it responds to reports of abuse of migrant children by French border police and whether it will raise child protection and EU burden-sharing at EU level. The State Secretary answered that the government monitors EU-acquis compliance, relies on the Commission to assess violations, and points to EU reform negotiations and existing child-specific safeguards, without committing to a new investigation.
The cabinet critically monitors both the implementation and compliance with the EU acquis, without assumptions, and uses bilateral and multilateral channels to raise our concerns where appropriate.

Het kabinet volgt, zonder aannames, zowel de implementatie als naleving van het EU-acquis kritisch, en maakt gebruik van bilaterale en multilaterale kanalen om onze zorgen, waar opportuun, over te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Van Aalst over het bericht dat de EU 15.000 Interrailpassen weggeeft

MPs Maeijer and Van Aalst asked whether the Netherlands supported the EU DiscoverEU free Interrail pass pilot and whether its expansion for 2021-2027 is EU propaganda paid by Dutch taxpayers. Minister Blok answered that DiscoverEU is a European Parliament pilot included in the 2018 EU budget and referred to the BNC-fiche on the proposed Erasmus+ programme for the expansion questions, without giving a cost figure or a position on the propaganda charge.
For the cabinet's appraisal of this proposal, I refer you to the BNC-fiche on Erasmus sent to your House on 10 July.
Voor de kabinetsappreciatie van dit voorstel verwijs ik u graag naar het op 10 juli jl. aan uw Kamer verzonden BNC-fiche over Erasmus
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Van Weerdenburg over meer dan 1 miljard euro voor het Europees solidariteitskorps

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about the EU European Solidarity Corps, its proposed expansion to 350,000 youth and over 1 billion euro, asking which organisations participate, how many Dutch youth joined, what it has cost, and whether the EU should fund it. The minister answered with figures on accredited organisations, registered Dutch participants, the 378 million euro budget under the current MFF, and said the Dutch appraisal of the new proposal will follow via a BNC-fiche.
There is no list available of organisations where young people currently participate or have participated.
Er is geen lijst beschikbaar van organisaties waar jongeren op dit moment aan deelnemen of aan deelgenomen hebben.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en De Roon over het bericht dat het Israëlisch parlement een wet heeft aangenomen om salarisbetalingen aan veroordeelde Palestijnse terroristen te stoppen

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands should support the Israeli, US and Australian measures against salary payments to convicted Palestinian prisoners, and freeze funds to the Palestinian Authority. The minister responded that the government shares concern about payments tied to detention length, opposes unilateral Israeli withholding of PA tax revenues, and continues to press the PA to reform the system without endorsing a funding freeze.
The Netherlands consistently presses for adjustment of the system.
Nederland dringt consequent aan op aanpassing van het systeem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht 'News: Open letter for the release of Human Rights Defenders in Niger'

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the ministers about arrests of human rights defenders in Niger, the closure of a television station, uranium-gate, press freedom and the Dutch embassy opening. The government answered that the EU monitors the court cases, that prisoner welfare projects exist, that it has no direct stake in uranium-gate, and that human rights can be raised in general terms.
The Netherlands and the various EU representations will continue to follow developments in this case closely.
Nederland en de verschillende EU-vertegen woordigingen blijven de ontwikkelingen van deze zaak op de voet volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over Oekraïense spionage gericht tegen Nederlanders die betrokken waren bij MH-17 onderzoek(en)

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether Ukraine spied on Dutch officials involved in the MH17 investigation, how this affected the Joint Investigation Team, and whether it undermined the findings. The government declined to confirm specific evidence publicly, said cooperation within the JIT remains constructive and the evidence is considered reliable, and said the matter was raised with Ukrainian authorities.
The cabinet cannot make any public statements about this.
Hierover kan het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over gezamenlijke productie van S500-raketten door Turkije en Rusland

MPs Ten Broeke and Bosman asked whether Turkey proposed joint production of S-500 missiles with Russia, whether NATO had reacted, and whether Turkey's S-400 purchase would be integrated with NATO systems and operated by Russian personnel. The government said it could not confirm the reports, that neither NATO nor the Netherlands had been formally informed, that arms procurement is a sovereign matter, and that integration of the S-400 with NATO systems is nearly ruled out.
The cabinet therefore cannot confirm these reports and does not wish to speculate about them.
Het kabinet kan deze berichten daarom niet bevestigen en wil hier niet over speculeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘EU’s top watchdog slams Council secrecy’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the European Ombudsman's critical report on the Council's lack of transparency and whether the Council would respond. The minister answers that the Treaties impose no deadline on the Council, that the Council will respond substantively at a hearing, and that Netherlands will push for a broader transparency discussion in the autumn.
Formally, no obligation arises for the Council under the Treaties to respond within a set period to a report of the European Ombudsman.
Formeel vloeit er voor de Raad geen verplichting voort uit de Verdragen om binnen een bepaalde termijn te reageren op een rapport van de Europese Ombudman.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over de niet nagekomen beloftes van de regering van Malta

MPs Van Helvert and Van der Molen asked the Foreign Minister about Malta's Valletta 2018 director's comments on murdered journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia, Leeuwarden's suspension of official exchanges, the stalled murder investigation, and Dutch forensic assistance. The minister answered that the Dutch forensic institute helped Maltese police, that responsibility for the investigation lies with Malta, and that the issue has been raised bilaterally and in the EU and Council of Europe.
The Maltese authorities are responsible for the investigation into the murder of journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia and for tracking down and prosecuting the perpetrators.
De Maltese autoriteiten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het onderzoek naar de moord op journaliste Daphne Caruana Galizia en het opsporen en berechten van de daders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Voordewind over het vertrek van de Verenigde Staten uit de VN-Mensenrechtenraad

MPs Van der Staaij, De Roon and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about the US withdrawal from the UN Human Rights Council over alleged bias against Israel, and whether Dutch membership legitimises unreliable human rights policy. The minister rejects that view, acknowledges shortcomings such as agenda item 7, describes reform efforts and says the Netherlands will keep working in the Council rather than follow the US out.
The cabinet does not want to sideline itself, but rather wants to stay in dialogue within the Human Rights Council, including with the difficult countries.
Het kabinet wil zichzelf niet buiten spel zetten, maar wil juist in gesprek blijven in de Mensenrechtenraad, ook met de moeilijke landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de steun van de Nederlandse regering aan de rebellen in Zuid-Syrië

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about Dutch non-lethal assistance to Syrian rebels in the south, including reports of US withdrawal, other donors, results, and whether support continues. Minister Blok answered that the NLA programme in the south has ended, the north programme was also stopped, and that the government's objectives were stability on the Jordanian and Israeli borders and a foothold for the opposition.
Besides the Netherlands, the US also publicly states that it supported the moderate armed opposition in southern Syria in 2018.
Naast Nederland stelt ook de VS publiekelijk dat het de gematigde gewapende oppositie in Zuid-Syrië in 2018 heeft gesteund.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over een lasterlijk rapport van het Israëlische Ministerie van Strategische Zaken

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about an Israeli ministry report accusing EU-funded NGOs of ties to terrorism, and about related Israeli activities against BDS campaigners and activists. The government answered that the EU does not fund terrorism, that the Netherlands opposes BDS but protects its expression, and that it has no independent information on the alleged surveillance or intelligence activities.
The cabinet has no independent information indicating that such activities are being carried out against Dutch citizens and therefore sees no reason to inquire with the Israeli authorities.

Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie die er op wijst dat er dergelijke activiteiten tegen Nederlandse burgers worden ontplooid en ziet daarom geen aanleiding hier bij de Israëlische autoriteiten over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de agressieve retoriek en manoeuvres van Turkije richting Griekenland en Cyprus

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's aggressive rhetoric and maneuvers toward Greece and Cyprus, including ramming incidents, airspace violations, and maritime disputes over Cypriot gas exploration. The government condemned violations of sovereignty and territorial integrity in general terms, referenced EU Council conclusions, said it lacked facts on specific incidents, and declined to take an active bilateral role, saying the issue should be resolved between the parties.
It is therefore not obvious that the Netherlands should play an active role in this matter at this time.
Het ligt dan ook niet voor de hand dat Nederland in deze kwestie op dit moment een actieve rol speelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het steunprogramma aan de Syrische gewapende oppositie

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the Dutch support programme for the Syrian armed opposition, including the external evaluation, the number of groups supported, vehicle deliveries, end-use and goal achievement. The minister answered most questions with confidentiality and security reasons, declined to share the evaluation or transfer documents, and pointed to an IOB review and an Auditdienst Rijk audit still underway.
Information about this project, as stated in the external evaluation, is state secret.
Informatie over dit project, zoals vermeld in de externe evaluatie zijn staatsgeheim.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over de investeringen in kolencentrales in de Westelijke Balkan

Two SP MPs asked the government about Chinese investment in coal plants in the Western Balkans, whether this shows weak EU accession commitment, how it affects Dutch coal phase-out and EU climate targets, and whether the Netherlands will raise environmental standards with EU partners. The minister answered that accession countries must align with EU law including the ETS, that the EU 40% target stays, that accession is a long process with strict, fair criteria, and that the Netherlands will continue to insist on these conditions including environmental ones.
The cabinet adheres to a strict and fair EU accession policy and consistently emphasises this in European forums.
Het kabinet houdt vast aan een strikt en fair EU-toetredingsbeleid en benadrukt dit steevast in Europees verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Maeijer over ontoegankelijkheid van Amerikaanse nieuwssites door EU regels

PVV MPs asked the government about US news sites blocking EU users because of GDPR rules and what it would do to protect Dutch access to US news. The minister replied that GDPR applies to non-EU firms, that the blocking is a temporary transition problem, that compliant alternatives exist, and that no action is planned.
At this moment I therefore see no reason to take action on this.
Op dit moment zie ik dan ook geen aanleiding om hier actie op te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Maeijer en Wilders over de mededeling dat Nederland een deel van de migranten van het schip 'Lifeline' gaat opvangen

PVV MPs asked whether the government agreed to take in part of the migrants from the Lifeline ship, how many, and why it acted without parliamentary approval, and urged an asylum stop. The State Secretary confirmed Netherlands offered a one-off responsibility for up to 20 asylum seekers from Malta and referred the rest to a separate letter to parliament.
For the considerations on which and the terms under which this gesture is made, I refer you to the cover letter accompanying the annotated agenda.
Voor de overwegingen op grond waarvan en de modaliteiten waaronder deze geste wordt gedaan, verwijs ik u naar de aanbiedingsbrief
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over een geliquideerde man in Almere

MPs Karabulut and Van Dijk asked whether the man liquidated in Almere in 2015 was a Iranian-convicted attacker who had received a residence permit under an alias, whether Iran contacted the Netherlands, and whether the MKO is considered terrorist. The government said no signals of a different identity were known during the asylum procedure, that some indications later emerged in the criminal investigation and were reported to ministers, that no reason was seen to further examine the identification process, and that no Iranian correspondence was found.
In this case no reason is seen to further investigate the identification and registration process.
Er wordt in deze casus geen aanleiding gezien om het I&R-proces verder te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat de Chinese overheid ambtenaren inzet om de Oeigoeren in Xinjiang te controleren en te indoctrineren

Dutch MP Kuzu asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about reports that Chinese officials are staying with Uyghur families in Xinjiang to monitor and indoctrinate them, and about detention of a footballer and re-education camps, asking what the government will do and whether it will support an independent international inquiry. The government says it is seriously concerned about restrictions on religious and cultural freedoms, has raised the issue in the human rights dialogue, EU and UN channels, but declines to pursue an international investigation.
The cabinet does not consider it opportune to push for an international investigation and believes the current course is most appropriate.
Het kabinet acht het niet opportuun om op een internationaal onderzoek aan te sturen en is van mening dat de huidige koers
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'VN: Amerika overtreedt mensenrechten met scheiden migrantengezinnen'

MP Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister whether the US breach of human rights by separating migrant families is a concern, whether allies should be held to human rights standards, and whether the minister would contact US and European counterparts and raise the issue during the Prime Minister's visit. The minister answered that Dutch human rights policy applies to all countries, that concerns were conveyed diplomatically, and that the matter is for the US democratic debate and courts to resolve, without committing to further action.
The concerns that exist in Dutch society have been conveyed to the US through diplomatic channels.
De zorgen die in de Nederlandse samenleving bestaan zijn via diplomatieke weg aan de VS overgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over het scheiden van ouders en kinderen door Amerikaanse grensbewakers aan de grens tussen de VS en Mexico

MPs Voordewind and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister whether US border separation of children from parents is compatible with international treaties and whether he would ask the US ambassador for clarification. The minister expressed concern, said the Refugee Convention does not apply, noted the US is not party to the Children's Rights Convention, and said Dutch concerns were conveyed diplomatically while awaiting the outcome of the US debate and court proceedings.
That is how it should be in a democratic constitutional state. We are awaiting the outcome of the discussion.
Zo hoort dat in een democratische rechtsstaat. De uitkomst van de discussie wachten we af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de stijgende christenvervolging in China onder Xi Jinping

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the detention of Catholic bishop Guo Xijin, new Chinese restrictions on unregistered religious activity, and what the government will do about religious freedom in China.
