The minister said the Netherlands is seriously concerned, raised religious freedom in bilateral and multilateral talks, and will use the UN Universal Periodic Review, but made no commitment on the bishop's appointment, which he called a matter between China and the Vatican.
The cabinet makes no statement on the official appointment and approval of bishops; this is a matter between China and the Vatican.
Over de officiële benoeming en goedkeuring van bisschoppen doet het kabinet geen uitspraken – dit is een kwestie die speelt tussen China en het Vaticaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht 'Waarom het KhAD-WAD ambtsbericht van 29 februari 2000 onjuist en onbetrouwbaar is'

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice about a critique of the 2000 KhAD-WAD country report, which relied on anonymous sources and claimed all Afghan intelligence officers were involved in human rights abuses via rotation, and about the resulting exclusion of asylum seekers under Article 1F. The ministers defended the sources as confidential but credible, said the 2008 UNHCR critique did not refute the report, and rejected calls for a new assessment.
The sources consulted are not anonymous but confidential.
De geraadpleegde bronnen zijn niet anoniem maar vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Dutch Trade and Investment Board (DTIB)

An SP MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Foreign Trade whether the Dutch Trade and Investment Board (DTIB) and its successor the ISB-NL are lobby organisations, who sits on them, whether their composition and minutes are transparent, and what they cost. The minister replied that they are public-private advisory platforms rather than lobby bodies, gave the 2017 membership list, promised to publish future ISB-NL members and agendas subject to business confidentiality, and said a WOB decision was published late.
Account must be taken of business-sensitive information, and it must be ensured that discussions within the ISB-NL can be held as openly as possible.
Daarbij zal wel rekening gehouden moeten worden met bedrijfsgevoelige informatie en moet worden gewaarborgd dat gesprekken binnen de ISB-NL zo open mogelijk gevoerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Baudet, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Becker, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over de sluiting van kerken door de Algerijnse overheid

Eight MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Algeria is closing Protestant churches under its law on non-Islamic religions and whether this breaches religious freedom. The minister confirmed that some churches cannot hold services without the required permits, said freedom of religion is not generally violated, and said he raised the issue with the Algerian foreign minister, who replied that churches have nothing to fear.
Needless to say, I will continue to closely monitor developments in this regard and, if necessary, voice my concerns bilaterally and within the EU.
Het spreekt voor zich dat ik de ontwikkelingen hieromtrent nauwgezet blijf volgen en indien nodig hierover, bilateraal en in EU-verband, mijn zorgen zal uiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het rapport 'The Use of UN Sanctions to Address Conflict-Related Sexual Violence'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a report finding UN sanctions weakly used against conflict-related sexual violence, and whether the government would act on it, including a proposed global thematic sanctions regime. The minister responded that the Netherlands supports using sanctions, notes some progress in the Central African Republic regime, but gives only a general commitment to revisit the thematic regime proposal in September.
I will also take into account the position of like-minded members of the UN Security Council.
Ik zal daarbij ook nader betrekken de positie van gelijkgezinde leden van de VN-veiligheidsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Koopmans over het bericht dat de Turkse president Erdogan campagne wil voeren in het buitenland voor de Turkse presidents- en parlementsverkiezingen in juni

VVD MPs Becker and Koopmans asked whether Erdogan would campaign abroad before the June 2018 Turkish elections, how the Netherlands would prevent such campaign visits, and whether a German-style ban on foreign politicians campaigning could be introduced. The government said Erdogan attended a rally in Sarajevo, that visits by Turkish government members are unwanted, that municipalities decide on other campaign activities, and that it will explore a general line on foreign politicians' campaigning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de situatie in Nicaragua

The SP MP Karabulut asks the Foreign Minister whether he condemns the use of violence and repression against protesters in Nicaragua, whether he will press Nicaragua to implement the Inter-American Commission's recommendations and support an independent investigation, and whether he will call for UN human rights access. The minister condemns the violence, says the Netherlands and EU have urged implementation of the recommendations, and notes Nicaragua has invited the Inter-American Commission, the EU and the UN High Commissioner and asked for an expert mission.
Reports of violence against demonstrators by the police and by armed groups linked to the government are very worrying.
De berichten over geweld jegens demonstranten door de politie en door aan de overheid gelieerde gewapende groeperingen zijn zeer zorgelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Leijten over het bezoek van de Eurocommissaris Cretu in het kader van het cohesiebeleid en de volgende meerjarenbegroting

MP Leijten asked why the Chamber was not informed about the April 2018 meeting between Commissioner Crețu and the Dutch ministers on cohesion policy and the next MFF, whether a meeting report exists, and whether the Chamber will be informed of such meetings in future. The ministers answered that such consultations are routine, that their outcomes flow into the regular EU information channels, and that minutes will not be provided, while stating the cabinet coordinates MFF positions closely.
The cabinet does not consider it expedient or desirable to inform the Chamber of every conversation that ministers have with members of the European Commission.
Het kabinet acht het niet opportuun noch wenselijk om van elk gesprek dat bewindspersonen met leden van de Europese Commissie voeren, de Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Helvert over het bericht dat Israël Nederlandse projecten op de Westelijke Jordaanoever sloopt

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Helvert asked whether Israel demolished Dutch-funded water systems on the West Bank, whether Israel was consulted, and what steps the government took, including on compensation and EU-funded project demolitions. The minister confirms the demolitions, says Nederland was not consulted, protested at official level and sought compensation (refused by Israel), and reports about 326 EU-assisted structures and roughly 38,600 euro of Dutch damage demolished since 2015, while condemning demolitions under occupation law.
The Netherlands and the EU consistently and at various levels make clear objections to the Israeli authorities against demolition of Palestinian property.
Nederland en de EU maken consequent en op verschillende niveaus de bezwaren duidelijk bij de Israëlische autoriteiten tegen sloop van Palestijnse bezittingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de sloop door Israël van door Nederland gefinancierde watersystemen in bezet Palestijns gebied

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister to confirm Israel demolished three Dutch-funded water systems in occupied Palestinian territory, what the consequences were, how Israel was challenged and whether it should face further consequences. The minister confirmed the demolitions (citing lack of permits and a military training zone), said Netherlands and the EU protested and requested compensation which Israel refused, and committed to continued bilateral and EU pressure to stop demolitions.
The Netherlands and the EU consistently make objections clear at various levels to the Israeli authorities against demolition of Palestinian property.
Nederland en de EU maken consequent en op verschillende niveaus de bezwaren duidelijk bij de Israëlische autoriteiten tegen sloop van Palestijnse bezittingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een veroordeelde Tibetaanse activist

Rep. Karabulut (SP) asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares Amnesty's view that the five-year sentence of Tibetan activist Tashi Wangchuk is unjust and whether he will press for his immediate release. The minister agreed the sentence conflicts with China's international obligations, said the Netherlands supports an immediate release and has raised the case with Chinese diplomats and will raise it at the human rights dialogue and in the EU statement at the UN Human Rights Council.
The Netherlands raised the conviction of Tashi Wangchuk in a conversation with the director of the China Tibetology Research Center and diplomats of the Chinese embassy in The Hague.
Nederland heeft de veroordeling van Tashi Wangchuk aan de orde gesteld in een gesprek met de directeur van het China Tibetology Research Center en diplomaten van de Chinese ambassade in Den Haag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het witwasschandaal met EU-geld door de Hongaarse premier Orbán

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about an alleged money-laundering scandal involving EU funds linked to Hungarian PM Orbán, including investigation, OLAF referral, fund suspension and stricter enforcement. The minister replied the cabinet lacks the figures, that the Commission and OLAF are responsible for investigating and recovering funds, and that the Netherlands supports stricter rule-of-law linked conditionality and the EPPO.
The cabinet is not aware of the figures behind this alleged scandal, nor of whether and how much EU money is involved.
Het kabinet is niet op de hoogte van cijfers achter dit mogelijke schandaal en ook niet of en zo ja hoeveel EU-geld hiermee zou zijn gemoeid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke, van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over aanvallen op de Kerem Shalom-grensovergang in Israël

MPs asked whether Gazan demonstrators tried to damage the Kerem Shalom crossing, whether the Dutch-funded scanners and cargo flows were affected, how much freight crossed this year, and whether the government accepts Israel's view that the border protests amount to a state of war. The minister answered that damage occurred on the Palestinian side with minimal effect on trade, gave UN cargo figures for January to April, and rejected the war qualification, stating that Gaza is occupied territory under the law of occupation.
On Friday 4 May Gazan demonstrators caused damage on the Palestinian side of the Kerem Shalom / Karm Abusalem crossing.
Op vrijdag 4 mei hebben Gazaanse demonstranten aan Palestijnse zijde van de Kerem Shalom / Karm Abusalem grensovergang beschadigingen aangebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over steun voor Israëlische tegenaanval

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands was aware of German and British support for Israel's counterstrike after an Iranian attack from Syria, and why the Dutch government had not expressed similar support, asking if it would do so now. The minister confirmed awareness, condemned Iranian threats and the attack at the UN Security Council, and called for calm and de-escalation, without expressing support for the Israeli strike.
The cabinet acknowledges Israel's security concerns and condemns the ongoing Iranian threats against Israel.
Het kabinet erkent de Israëlische veiligheidszorgen en veroordeelt de aanhoudende Iraanse dreigementen tegen Israël.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de resultaten van de topambtenaar van PvdA-huize

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the foreign minister about the results of a 'counter-thinking strategist' (scholar in residence) appointed for one year, including the advice produced and whether other ministries should adopt the role. Minister Blok answered that the scholar advised on various policy themes, commented on draft policy notes and gave lectures, and that the role is useful and worth repeating.
He has given strategic advice on various themes, for example globalisation, populism, European cooperation, support for foreign policy and internal organisation.
Hij heeft strategische adviezen over uiteenlopende thema's gegeven, bijvoorbeeld over globalisering, populisme, Europese samenwerking, draagvlak voor buitenlands beleid en interne organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert en De Roon over het bericht dat EU-subsidies terecht komen bij organisaties die oproepen tot boycot van Israël

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU funds organisations calling for a boycott of Israel (BDS), and whether funds reached Palestinian groups linked to terrorism. The government answered that the EU opposes a boycott, that BDS advocacy is protected speech and not a funding bar, that only one NGO was named in the report (training for youth including Hamas and PFLP members, funded by Norway), and that it sees no reason to ask the Commission to act.
The fact that organisations support the BDS movement is not a criterion for rejecting funding for the cabinet.
Het feit dat organisaties de BDS-beweging ondersteunen, is voor het kabinet geen afwijzingscriterium voor financiering
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Amnesty: duizenden vrouwen en meisjes verkracht door leger Nigeria’

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the Dutch government whether it knew of Amnesty's report on rape of women and girls by Nigerian soldiers in camps, and what it would do, including raising the matter at the UN Security Council and considering a thematic sanctions regime. The government said it is aware of the report, supports women's rights projects in Nigeria, will raise the allegations with the EU and in the EU-Nigeria human rights dialogue, and opposes a global thematic sanctions regime as ineffective.
Following Amnesty International's report, the EU plans to enter into dialogue with key actors in the federal government and security agencies.
Naar aanleiding van het rapport van Amnesty International is de EU van plan een dialoog aan te gaan met belangrijke actoren in de federale regering en veiligheidsagentschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de behandeling van klokkenluider Roelie Post door de Europese Commissie

Two MPs from the SP asked the ministers whether the government would intervene in the case of whistleblower Roelie Post, who alleges retaliation and threats from the European Commission after exposing adoption corruption in Romania. The minister replied that the government considers threats against officials unacceptable, points to EU whistleblower guidelines, states it lacks details of the dispute, and sees no role for itself in mediation, though it would welcome a mutually acceptable solution.
For this reason, the government sees no obvious role for mediation.
Voor het kabinet ligt er om deze reden geen bemiddelende rol voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over nieuwe Amerikaanse sancties tegen leden van de Iraanse Revolutionaire Garde

MP Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister about new US sanctions on five individuals linked to the Iranian Revolutionary Guard, whether they are on EU lists, and whether sanctions for ballistic missile activity are consistent with the JCPOA and UN resolutions. The minister confirmed the US sanctions, said none of the individuals is on an EU list, committed to exploring with E3 partners the best pressure tools against ballistic missile proliferation, and argued that Iran's conduct is inconsistent with resolution 2231 but that resolution 2216 cannot be invoked.
In the coming months I will work with European partners to examine the best combination of pressure instruments against persons involved in developing and spreading ballistic missile technology.

De komende maanden zal ik mij in samenwerking met Europese partners inzetten om te bekijken wat de beste combinatie van drukmiddelen is tegen personen die betrokken zijn bij het ontwikkelen en verspreiden van ballistische rakettechnologie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over de strijd tegen corruptie in Oekraïne

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the installation of wiretapping equipment by Ukraine's anti-corruption bureau NABU in the office of the special anti-corruption prosecutor and about threats to Ukraine's anti-corruption institutions. The minister answered that Nederland raises anti-corruption reform bilaterally and multilaterally, that Ukraine itself must prevent damage to its institutions, and that EU macro-financial aid conditions include a special anti-corruption high court.
I do not have sufficient information to form a judgement on this measure.
Ik beschik niet over voldoende informatie om een oordeel te vellen over deze maatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Ze vermoordde haar man toen hij haar verkrachtte. Nu krijgt Noura (19) de doodstraf’

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of the case of Noura, 19, sentenced to death in Sudan after killing her husband, whether she was a victim of sexual abuse acting in self-defence, and what he would do to stop the execution. The minister confirmed awareness, said the embassy found the facts plausible, that the appeal court must decide, and that the Netherlands made strong representations jointly with the EU, but that annulment was not yet an option while the appeal is pending.
Once it is clear what ruling the appeal court has made, the Cabinet will consider which follow-up steps are necessary and possible.
Nadat duidelijk is geworden welke uitspraak de rechter in hoger beroep heeft gedaan, zal het Kabinet bezien welke vervolgstappen nodig en mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de terdoodveroordeling van een Sudanese vrouw

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of the death sentence against a 19-year-old Sudanese woman who killed her husband in self-defence, whether he shared Amnesty's call for a retrial, and whether he would raise the case with Sudanese counterparts. The minister confirmed awareness, said the appeal is pending, and described diplomatic démarches with the Sudanese ambassador, joint EU and Norwegian/Swiss statements, and monitoring through the embassy, with further steps to be considered after the appeal ruling.
Once it is clear what ruling the appeal court has made, the Cabinet will consider which follow-up steps are necessary and possible.
Nadat duidelijk is geworden welke uitspraak van de rechter in hoger beroep heeft gedaan, zal het Kabinet bezien welke vervolgstappen nodig en mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Özütok en Van den Hul over de verkiezingsprocedure voor leden van het United Nations Committee on the Elimination of Discrimination against Women (CEDAW)

Three MPs asked why the Netherlands did not nominate a candidate for the UN CEDAW committee and whether it would do so in future. The minister replied that suitable candidates were unavailable or did not meet the independence and expertise requirements, and that the government will reconsider a nomination in a future round.
On the basis of the criteria mentioned earlier, the cabinet will again consider nominating a candidate in a next round.
Op basis van eerdergenoemde criteria zal het kabinet een volgende ronde opnieuw overwegen een kandidaat te nomineren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Voordewind, Becker, Diks, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij, Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Prominente Saudische vrouwenrechtenactivisten opgepakt’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the arrests of Saudi women's rights activists were only for campaigning for women's right to drive, and whether the government would raise the matter bilaterally and in the EU and call for their release. The minister said the detainees are suspected of conspiracy with foreign powers and financing hostile actors, that Nederland raised concerns with the Saudi foreign minister and is consulting partners including in the EU, and that it remains concerned about repression of dissent.
The Netherlands will continue to ask for attention to the detention of the activists and press for proper treatment.
Nederland zal aandacht blijven vragen voor de aanhoudingen van de activisten en aandringen op goede behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de arrestatie van tien activisten voor vrouwenrechten in Saoedi-Arabië

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of ten women's rights activists in Saudi Arabia, the lack of lawyer access, sanctions, and whether the government would call for their release. The minister said Saudi reforms are a step forward but the government remains concerned about repression, raised the case with his Saudi counterpart, and will pursue EU and UN raising of the issue.
I am aware of the media reports, but I cannot confirm them.
Ik ken de mediaberichten hierover, maar ik kan deze niet bevestigen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Leijten en Van Rooijen over het feit dat de Raad van de Europese Unie geen enkel antwoord geeft op de aanbevelingen van de Europees Ombudsman over transparantie en geheimhouding e

MPs Omtzigt, Leijten and Van Rooijen asked why the EU Council has not responded to the European Ombudsman's February 2018 recommendations on transparency and secrecy in its working documents, which they argued breaches the EU treaty. The Minister replied that no formal treaty deadline binds the Council, that the Netherlands pressed for a timely reply, and that a substantive Council response is expected in early July 2018.
Formally, no obligation arises from Article 228 TFEU for the Council to send its position to the European Ombudsman within three months.
Antwoord 3 Formeel vloeit er geen verplichting voor de Raad voort uit artikel 228 VWEU om binnen drie maanden een antwoord om de Europese Ombudsman zijn standpunt mede te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Agema en De Roon over de arrestatie van de Britse activist en islamcriticus Tommy Robinson

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would protest to the UK over the arrest and sentencing of Tommy Robinson, citing free speech and his safety in prison, and whether the government accepts that suppressing Islam critics fuels public anger. The minister replied that free speech applies to everyone, that Robinson reportedly breached his earlier parole conditions, and that the government trusts the UK legal process and sees no reason to comment further.
The cabinet has confidence in the legal process in the United Kingdom and sees no reason to comment further on this.
Het kabinet heeft vertrouwen in de rechtsgang in het Verenigd Koninkrijk en ziet geen aanleiding zich hierover nader uit te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Groothuizen over de pushbacks van vluchtelingen door Griekenland

MPs Voordewind and Groothuizen asked whether Greece is pushing refugees back to Turkey without allowing asylum claims, whether this breaches the Refugee Convention, and whether the Netherlands will confront Greece about it. The Secretary of State says the government takes such reports seriously, that Greece denies pushbacks at its borders, and that the Commission is responsible for enforcing EU law, while listing EU and bilateral financial and personnel support to Greece.
Incidentally, it is primarily the responsibility of the European Commission to monitor the application of the EU acquis.
Overigens is het primair aan de Europese Commissie om toe te zien op de toepassing van het EU-acquis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over mensenrechtenschendingen in Ethiopië

An MP from the CDA asked the government about human rights violations in Ethiopia, including repression of protesters, detention and torture, the Maekelawi and Kaliti prisons, Dutch aid and dialogue, and an outdated country report used in asylum decisions. The government acknowledged serious past abuses, noted recent reforms under the new prime minister, described its diplomatic engagement, and said the updated country report would be delayed until summer 2018.
The government regrets that the country report could not be delivered on time.
De regering betreurt het dat het ambtsbericht niet tijdig kon worden aangeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Sjoerdsma en Karabulut over financiering van Nederlandse islamitische instellingen vanuit de Golfstaten

MPs Segers, Sjoerdsma and Karabulut asked the ministers about Gulf state financing of Dutch Islamic institutions, including why the ministry withheld information from RAND researchers and from municipalities, and why Saudi and Kuwaiti information was kept confidential. The minister answered that the ministry fully cooperated with RAND, that the information was shared with other government bodies and municipalities, that the Saudi MoU would not be published at Saudi request, and that the government is exploring legal measures on transparency of funding flows.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs, to the best of its knowledge and belief, provided full cooperation to RAND during the research at the end of 2014 so that it could conduct research in complete freedom.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft naar eer en geweten tijdens de uitvoering van het onderzoek eind 2014 volledige medewerking verleend aan RAND om in alle vrijheid onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de antisemitische uitspraken van president Abbas

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister whether President Abbas's antisemitic remarks were unacceptable, whether the EU would take follow-up action, and what consequences should follow. The minister answered that the government shares the EU's view that parts of the speech are unacceptable, has protested bilaterally and in the UN Security Council, and sees no reason to suspend Dutch support to the Palestinian territories.
The cabinet sees no reason to suspend or end (partly) Dutch support to the Palestinian territories.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om de Nederlandse steun aan de Palestijnse gebieden (gedeeltelijk) op te schorten of te beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de financiering van een broodcampagne door de EU

The SP MP Leijten asked why the EU co-finances a bread promotion campaign, whether the sector cannot fund it itself, and what 'European bread' means. Minister Schouten answered that general promotion is the sector's responsibility, that she opposed EU co-financing and will push for abolishing the scheme in the new CAP negotiations, while noting the sector can apply directly to the Commission.
Furthermore, I will again argue, including in the negotiations on the new CAP, for abolishing the EU promotion scheme for general sales promotion.
Verder zal ik, ook in de onderhandelingen over het nieuwe GLB, opnieuw pleiten voor afschaffing van de EU-promotieregeling voor algemene afzetbevordering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Van Dam en Voordewind over de persconferentie van het JIT over de ramp met MH17

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the JIT press conference on MH17, in particular Russia's failure to share information on the Buk missile's origin and whether Russia breaches UN resolution 2166. The minister agreed that the Buk belonged to the Russian military, that Russia must cooperate fully, and that he raised the matter in the UN Security Council.
In the Security Council I called on Russia to take its responsibility, to engage with Australia and the Netherlands on this, and to cooperate fully as demanded by UN Security Council Resolution 2166.

In de Veiligheidsraad heb ik Rusland opgeroepen zijn verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, met Australië en Nederland daarover in gesprek te gaan en volledig mee te werken zoals wordt geëist door VNVR-resolutie 2166.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de mogelijke strafbaarheid van het vechten voor Turkije in Syrië

Two MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether Turkish dual nationals could be mobilised for the Afrin offensive, whether Dutch citizens fighting for the Free Syrian Army or serving in Turkish forces are criminally liable, and whether the Turkish offensive is lawful. The ministers answered that no general mobilisation orders are known, that fighting in Syria is in principle punishable for Dutch nationals except for state-authorised action against IS, that serving in foreign armed forces is not in itself criminal, and that the government takes no active role in advising those called up; several questions were answered by reference to earlier letters or deferred.
Active participation other than on government orders in the fight against IS in Iraq and Syria is in principle punishable.
Actieve deelname anders dan in opdracht van de overheid aan de strijd tegen IS in Irak en Syrië is in beginsel strafbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over berichten inzake een gifaanval in Douma

MP Becker asked the Foreign Minister about the alleged chemical attack in Douma, the OPCW investigation, UN Security Council steps, Russian vetoes, Syrian chemical weapons stocks, and whether the P5 should give up the veto in mass-atrocity cases. The minister answered that the government considers Syrian responsibility likely, details the OPCW fact-finding and Russian obstruction, and says it supports a voluntary veto restraint code, which it promoted at a Council debate.
The government supports the French-Mexican and other initiatives aimed at voluntary abstention from the veto by permanent members of the UN Security Council in cases of mass atrocities.

Het kabinet steunt het Frans-Mexicaanse en andere initiatieven gericht op het vrijwillig afzien van het gebruik van het veto door de permanente leden van de VN Veiligheidsraad wanneer sprake is van massale wreedheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en De Graaf over een drugsbaron als consul op Aruba

MPs De Roon and De Graaf (PVV) asked whether the Netherlands should accept a consul-general from Venezuela on Aruba with a questionable reputation, citing alleged drug links, and whether the appointment should be reversed. Minister Blok answered that no grounds such as a conviction currently bar the exequatur, that the person is not on the US SDN list, and that he sees no reason to reverse the decision.
I currently see no reason, with reference to the answers to questions 1 and 3, to reverse the decision.
Ik zie, met verwijzing naar de antwoorden op vraag 1 en 3, momenteel geen reden om het besluit terug te draaien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht dat het aantal migranten dat wordt opgesloten in onmenselijke Libische detentiecentra sterk is toegenomen

Green Left MP Van Ojik asked the ministers about reports that the number of migrants detained in Libyan detention centres rose sharply, and whether Dutch support for the Libyan coastguard and alleged Italian direction amounted to unlawful pushbacks. The government replied that Libyan coastguard tasks are lawful, denied Italian direction beyond coordination, and described its efforts to improve conditions and close the centres, noting progress remains slow.
As previously shared with your House, the cabinet is working with the AU, EU and UN to improve the situation in the centres, including promoting access to medical care and food supplies.

Zoals eerder met uw Kamer gedeeld 6 , zet het kabinet zich in om samen met de AU, EU en VN de situatie in de centra te verbeteren, waaronder het bevorderen van de toegang tot medische zorg en voedselvoorziening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Drie mishandelaars Praag veroordeeld en Tsjechië uitgezet’

CDA MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that three Dutch men were convicted in Prague for assault and expelled, including questions on reputational harm, prosecution in the Netherlands, police-officer involvement and compensation for the victim. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the case is individual, the Czech authorities handle it, the Netherlands will not investigate under Article 68 Sr, a Dutch police investigation has started, and compensation is not for the Dutch government.
I do not make statements about the individuals involved.
Over de betrokken individuen doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de VN coördinaten van Syrische ziekenhuizen doorgeeft aan Rusland

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister about reports that UN OCHA shared coordinates of Syrian hospitals with Russia and Syria's narrative and programming in the 2016 Humanitarian Response Plan were adjusted at the regime's request. The minister answered that the deconfliction mechanism is voluntary, offers no guarantees, that Netherlands has no insight into onward sharing by Russia, and that it has urged the UN to share its investigation results quickly.
The Netherlands has no insight into the extent to which, or whether, the Russian government shares information with third parties.
Nederland heeft geen zicht op de mate waarin en of de Russische overheid informatie deelt met derden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een tot de dood veroordeelde man in Iran

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a Kurdish man sentenced to death in Iran after an allegedly unfair trial, possibly involving torture, would be pressed to be spared execution and released. The minister answered that the Netherlands has no independent information on the case, shares Amnesty's concerns, endorsed UN experts' calls for abolition of the death penalty and a fair trial, and pursues ongoing human rights dialogue with Iran.
The Netherlands does not have its own information about the course of Mr Panahi's proceedings.
Nederland beschikt niet over eigen informatie over de procesgang van de heer Panahi.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over een uitspraak van president Erdogan

MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether Erdogan called the US and other NATO allies a 'priority threat', whether the minister would ask Turkey which allies are meant, and whether Turkey fits in NATO. The minister replied that the interview concerned alleged US arms supplies to groups Turkey sees as threats, that it contained no such characterisation of allies, that Turkey and the US are discussing mutual security concerns, and that Turkey's NATO membership is not in question.
The interview referred to in the question contains no statement by President Erdogan that the US and other allies are a 'priority threat'.
Het interview waar de vraag op doelt, bevat geen uitspraak van president Erdogan dat de VS en andere bondgenoten een « priority threat » zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Turkse chantage met gegijzelde Grieken

The MP De Roon asks the Foreign Minister about Erdogan's linking the release of detained Greek soldiers to Greece handing over eight Turks to Turkey, whether this breaches NATO principles, why NATO membership has no consequences, and whether Turkish EU accession talks and visa liberalisation should be cancelled. The minister calls it a bilateral matter, affirms NATO's shared values while noting Turkey's contribution to collective defence, and states the government will keep EU accession talks fully frozen and keep visa benchmarks, but will not block Turkish visa-free travel without firm conditions.
This concerns a bilateral issue between Turkey and Greece.
Dit betreft een bilaterale kwestie tussen Turkije en Griekenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over de open brief van de organisatie NHIB (Nederlanders in het Buitenland)

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about an open letter from NIHB on closing consulates and passport services abroad, including the travel costs, the risk of losing Dutch nationality for those unable to renew, and why ombudsman complaints have not improved service. The minister acknowledges the burden, points to mobile options, Schiphol and other border municipalities, a pilot with a commercial provider in Edinburgh, and modernisation toward digitisation by 2020, but does not commit to specific reversals.
The cabinet has a positive basic attitude towards expanding this service, also in light of the specific wishes from the House
Het kabinet heeft een positieve grondhouding ten aanzien van de uitbreiding van deze dienstverlening, ook in het licht van de specifieke wensen vanuit de Kamer
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Bouali over voortdurende demonstraties in Marokko

MPs Sjoerdsma and Bouali asked the ministers about protests in Morocco, including police violence and arrests in Jerada and the Rif, and whether the government would raise these with Morocco. The ministers answered that violence and arrests had occurred, that the Dutch embassy and ministers have raised freedom of assembly and fair trial concerns with Moroccan authorities, and that Dutch programmes support socio-economic development in the north.
The right to peaceful demonstration is laid down in international human rights treaties and in the Moroccan Constitution.
Het recht op vreedzaam demonstreren is vastgelegd in internationale mensenrechtenverdragen en in de Marokkaanse Grondwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over toenemende inperking van de godsdienstvrijheid in China

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the worsening of religious freedom in China, including tighter rules on unregistered religious groups, the detention of Dr. Wang Bingzhang without trial, and the treatment of Taiwanese activist Li Ming Che. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described Dutch raising of the issue bilaterally and in EU forums, and said the government will keep raising individual cases with China.
The Cabinet raises individual cases both within the EU and bilaterally and will continue to do so.
Het Kabinet kaart zowel in EU-verband als in bilateraal verband individuele gevallen aan en zal dat blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de steun van Nederland ten behoeve van detentie en uitzetting van ongedocumenteerden op Curaçao

An MP asked whether the Netherlands offered Curaçao 100,000 euro for detention of undocumented migrants, what aid was offered, whether it is voluntary, how many migrants await removal, and whether Venezuelan migrants are registered. The government confirmed a voluntary contribution of 132,000 euro for additional detention capacity plus expert support, and gave detention and registration figures from Curaçao and Aruba authorities.
The support mentioned under answer 2 is not an obligation but a voluntary contribution.
De onder antwoord 2 genoemde steun betreft geen verplichting, maar een vrijwillige bijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat Iran stiekem delen van het atoomprogramma zou hebben voortgezet

MPs Becker, Ten Broeke, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked whether Israeli claims that Iran secretly continued parts of its nuclear weapons programme after the JCPOA were new, whether the IAEA and the Dutch government had received the material, and how the Dutch government would keep the JCPOA in place after the US withdrew support. The minister answered that the information offers no new insight, that the IAEA reports Iran is complying, that Nederland urges Israel to share the material with the IAEA, and that Nederland is working with EU partners to preserve the agreement and consider measures on ballistic missiles.
The information presented by Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu does not lead to new insights into the Iranian nuclear programme.
De informatie die de Israëlische minister-president Netanyahu presenteerde leidt niet tot nieuwe inzichten over het Iraanse nucleaire programma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Groothuizen over het bericht “U-bocht in zaak Poch”

MPs Sjoerdsma and Groothuizen asked about Dutch police and prosecution contacts with Argentine judicial authorities in the Poch case, including an unofficial 2008 trip and the role of intermediaries. The minister answered that two working visits took place in 2008 under the Dutch investigation, with knowledge of both states, that no minutes of the talks exist, and that such exploratory contacts are not unusual in complex cases.
I do not have records of these conversations.
Ik beschik niet over verslaglegging van deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het vastzittende onderzoek naar de moord op onderzoeksjournalist Daphne Caruana Galizia op Malta

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the stalled investigation into the murder of Maltese journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia, including Dutch forensic assistance, the rule of law in Malta, and EU action. The minister said the investigation is ongoing, that the Netherlands Forensic Institute assisted Maltese police cooperatively, and that the Commission and Council are monitoring Malta's rule of law without committing to specific Dutch action.
The Cabinet welcomes this involvement and also closely follows developments itself.
Het Kabinet verwelkomt deze betrokkenheid en volgt daarnaast ook zelf de ontwikkelingen op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over 1,3 miljard euro belastinggeld voor de promotie van Europese waarden

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware of reports that the EU plans a 1.3 billion euro fund to promote European values, and whether he would oppose it and block Dutch funding. The minister replied that the Netherlands has an interest in a strong EU whose members uphold shared values, and that the new budget proposal is still under study, with the cabinet's appreciation to follow.
When values are under pressure in member states – for example the independence of the judiciary – this can affect the functioning of the Union
Wanneer in lidstaten die waarden onder druk staan – denk bijvoorbeeld aan de onafhankelijkheid van de rechtspraak – kan dit gevolgen hebben voor het functioneren van de Unie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het uitzetten van twee Russische inlichtingenmedewerkers

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister why the government judges Russia very likely responsible for the Salisbury nerve agent attack, whether Dutch intelligence verified British evidence, and how the expulsion of two Russian intelligence officers relates to other matters. The minister answered that the EU shares the UK's assessment, declined to comment on intelligence received from foreign services, said the expulsions rest on international law and are unrelated to Brexit, and reported that the OPCW has confirmed the UK's findings on the agent.
The cabinet makes no public statements about intelligence that Dutch intelligence and security services receive from foreign services.
Het kabinet doet geen publieke uitspraken over inlichtingen die Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten van buitenlandse diensten ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de handelsmissie naar China

The MP Kuzu asks why the government organised a trade mission to China, how it squares with criticism of human rights and religious freedom, and what is being done on Uyghurs and Tibetans. The Minister answers that the mission aims to strengthen economic ties and that human rights concerns, including Xinjiang and Tibet, were raised bilaterally and will be discussed in a human rights dialogue, but gives little operational detail on the Mensenrechtenfonds projects.
For the safety of project partners, further details cannot be provided.
Omwille van de veiligheid van projectpartners kan niet op nadere details worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de consulaire problemen die Venezolanen in Nederland ondervinden

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Venezuela's refusal to issue or renew passports at its Hague embassy, which affects Venezuelans in the Netherlands, and how the government would address the consequences. The minister confirmed the problem, said Venezuela is responsible for passport issuance, and described temporary IND arrangements that waive the passport requirement for some residence procedures.
The IND offers the following two temporary solutions to Venezuelan citizens in the Netherlands who have difficulty identifying themselves with a valid national passport.
De IND biedt de volgende twee, tijdelijke, oplossingen aan Venezolaanse burgers in Nederland die problemen hebben om zich te identificeren met een geldig nationaal paspoort
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over sponsoring van de Koningsdagborrel op de Nederlandse Permanente Vertegenwoordiging in Brussel

MP Leijten asked the Foreign Minister about corporate sponsorship (ING, Shell, G4S) of the King's Day reception at the Dutch Permanent Representation in Brussels, including whether such sponsorship is usual, whether it risks conflicts of interest, and whether it should end. Minister Blok answered that posts have long used third-party sponsorship under integrity codes, were re-instructed in March 2018, that no central sponsor register exists, and that he sees no reason to change the practice.
No central register of sponsors is kept.
Er wordt geen centraal bestand van sponsoren bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over het bericht dat de EU meebetaalt aan dodelijke grensbewaking in Turkije

MPs Van Dijk and Karabulut asked whether EU funds paid for armoured vehicles used in lethal border guarding in Turkey, how much Dutch money is involved, and whether non-refoulement is breached. The government answered that the IPA-funded surveillance project serves border security, that the vehicles are unarmed and restricted to surveillance by contract, that reports of killings could not be independently verified, and that Turkey's border management is understandable given the refugee burden.
However, there is currently insufficient support for suspension.
Voor opschorting bestaat momenteel echter onvoldoende draagvlak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Van Helvert en Voordewind over het benoemen van een defensieattaché in Iran

MPs from the SGP, PVV, CDA and ChristenUnie asked why the Netherlands plans to station a defence attaché in Tehran, how this relates to Iran's regional ambitions and missile programme, and to possible EU sanctions. The government answers that the posting improves monitoring of military developments and contacts with Iranian authorities, and that a parallel dialogue with Iran does not exclude concern about the missile programme.
Because of the Dutch interests in the region and Iran's role in it, it was chosen to station the new defence attaché in Tehran itself.
Vanwege de Nederlandse belangen in de regio en de rol van Iran daarin is ervoor gekozen de nieuwe defat in Teheran zelf te plaatsen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Dam en Omtzigt over de aangenomen resolutie van de parlementaire assemblee van de Raad van Europa “Prosecuting and punishing the crimes against humanity or even possible g

MPs Van Helvert, Van Dam and Omtzigt asked whether the government will act on a Council of Europe resolution calling ISIS crimes genocide, including whether to appoint a specialised prosecutor and enable handover of evidence. The government confirmed its support for the resolution, described existing investigative cooperation, and promised to study the specialised prosecutor proposal and report back.
I will inform your House of the results of this study.
Over de resultaten van dit onderzoek zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het massaproces en de doodstraf voor een persfotograaf in Egypte

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the death sentence sought against photojournalist Shawkan in a mass trial in Egypt, the detention of rights defenders, and the NGO law. The minister shares concern about the death penalty, unfair trial procedures, and the NGO law, and says the Netherlands raises these issues bilaterally and supports civil society, though implementing rules are not yet published.
I have taken note of the reports and remain deeply concerned about the application of the death penalty in Egypt.
Ik heb kennis genomen van de berichtgeving en maak mij onverminderd zorgen over de toepassing van de doodstraf in Egypte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de door Egypte geëiste doodstraf tegen fotojournalist Shawkan

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the death penalty sought in Egypt against photojournalist Shawkan, whether the trial was fair, and whether EU and Dutch aid to Egypt is appropriate given press repression. The minister agreed the penalty is disproportionate, said the Netherlands monitors the trial with partners and raises concerns in dialogue, and defended continued aid as conditional on monitoring and not contributing to repression.
The Netherlands, together with Germany, has worked to monitor this case within the EU framework.
Nederland heeft zich samen met Duitsland ingezet om deze zaak in EU-verband te monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het Israëlische geweld tegen demonstranten in Gaza

The SP MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemns Israeli lethal force against protesters in Gaza, whether he supports Amnesty's call for an immediate halt and an independent investigation, and how the Netherlands will press for this, including in the UN Security Council. The minister expressed serious concern and called for proportionality and independent, transparent investigations, but declined to condemn Israel's conduct yet, saying the facts must first become clearer.
In the government's view, however, the facts must first become clearer before a condemnation of Israel's conduct is on the table.
Naar mening van het kabinet moeten de feiten echter eerst duidelijker worden, voordat een veroordeling van het Israëlisch optreden aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over demonstrerende Palestijnen die zijn doodgeschoten door het Israëlische leger in Gaza

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Israeli security forces killing Palestinian protesters in Gaza, including whether the government will call for an independent investigation, condemn Israel's refusal to cooperate, and press Israel on its treatment of Palestinians and recognition of a Palestinian state. The minister says the government is concerned about the deaths, supports a transparent independent investigation and urges restraint from all parties, but does not condemn Israel and rejects recognising a Palestinian state now, pointing to a negotiated two-state solution first.
The cabinet endorses the EU statement that this raises questions about the proportionality of the use of force.
Het kabinet onderschrijft de verklaring van de EU, dat dit vragen oproept over de proportionaliteit van het gebruik van geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een in Nederland opgepakte Marokkaanse Rif-activist

An SP MP asked whether a Moroccan Rif activist arrested in Rotterdam should be returned to Morocco given doubts about a fair trial there, and whether the government agrees. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case, said fair-trial concerns must be judged case by case, and noted the former foreign minister raised fair trial with Morocco.
As your House is aware, I in principle do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, ga ik in beginsel niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over verhoging van betalingen aan veroordeelde Palestijnen

An MP asked the government whether it supports Israeli measures withholding tax revenue from the Palestinian Authority over payments to prisoners and whether Dutch aid should be cut similarly. The government answered that it opposes cutting aid, that the revenue transfers are binding under the Paris Protocol, and that it will keep raising the issue bilaterally and in the EU and UN.
The cabinet is not in favour of reducing support to the Palestinian Authority.
Het kabinet is geen voorstander van korten van de steun aan de Palestijnse Autoriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over de euro’s die het raam uitvliegen voor het betalen van het luxeleven van Europarlementariërs

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister about European Parliament members' salaries and allowances, including a €4,342 office-cost allowance without accountability, and whether the Netherlands should push to cut these and even dissolve the Parliament. The minister answered that the European Parliament is responsible for its own transparency, that the Netherlands seeks administrative cost savings in the next EU budget, but rejected abolishing the Parliament for its role in democratic legitimacy.
The European Parliament is itself responsible for transparency and accountability regarding its expenditure.
Het Europees parlement is zelf verantwoordelijke voor transparantie en verantwoording over zijn uitgaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Europees Parlement trakteert zichzelf op miljoenen voor verkiezingen'

An SP MP asks the Foreign Minister about a rise in the European Parliament's budget above two billion euros, extra campaign funding, and communication staff and information offices. The minister answers that the EP sets its own budget within EU financial frameworks, that campaign subsidies are permitted under EU and Dutch rules, and that the EP is primarily responsible for its own spending and controls.

The cabinet leaves it to the members of the European Parliament themselves to assess to what extent they consider it desirable for their tasks to have a communications department and information offices in the member states.

Tegen deze achtergrond acht het kabinet het dan ook aan de leden van het Europees parlement zelf om te beoordelen in hoeverre zij het voor de uitoefening van hun taken wenselijk achten dat er een communicatieafdeling is en dat er informatiekantoren zijn in de lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Becker en Van Helvert over verhoging van het budget voor betalingen aan veroordeelde Palestijnen

MPs Van der Staaij, Becker and Van Helvert asked the government about reports that the Palestinian Authority's 2018 budget raises payments to prisoners and their families by $56 million, and what the Netherlands is doing to change the system. The ministers answered that the increase is about $900,000 compared with 2017, that the Netherlands opposes linking payments to length of detention, and that it keeps raising this bilaterally, multilaterally and within the EU.
The cabinet continues to press on this, including in multilateral settings.
Het kabinet blijft hierop aandringen, ook in multilateraal verband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over ‘The Rohingya children trafficked for sex’.

An MP asked the foreign and development ministers about reports that Rohingya girls in Bangladeshi refugee camps are trafficked into sex work, what protective measures will be taken, and what concrete steps the Netherlands will take on UN calls to protect women in conflict, including a thematic sanctions regime. The ministers said the Netherlands will press Bangladesh, the UN and aid agencies for protection measures and raise the issue at the World Bank meetings, but they judged a global thematic sanctions regime unlikely to succeed and preferred adding sexual violence to country-specific sanctions regimes and using the International Criminal Court.
The Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation will attend a meeting in Washington on 21 April together with UNHCR and Bangladesh.
Zo zal de Minister voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking op 21 april in Washington samen met UNHCR en Bangladesh een bijeenkomst bijwonen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Omtzigt over de uitspraak van het Europees Hof inzake transparantie van de triloogonderhandelingen

MPs Leijten and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to the General Court ruling in De Capitani v Parliament (T-540/15) requiring public disclosure of trilogue four-column documents, and how it will promote transparency. The minister welcomed the ruling, said the Limité marking should be applied as restrictively as possible and that Nederland will press the Council secretariat on this and on proactive publication, but declined to commit to standard publication of the documents.
The Netherlands is working to ensure that this assessment is carried out carefully.
Nederland zet er op in dat deze afweging zorgvuldig gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over ernstige gevolgen van de notificatierichtlijn

The SP MP Leijten asked whether the proposed revision of the EU services notification directive, with its standstill period, threatens democratic processes, burdens municipalities and the Commission, and whether the Netherlands should withdraw from it. The State Secretary answered that the Netherlands opposes an extra three-month standstill (which was dropped from the general approach), that the notification duty already exists and only moderately expands, and that municipalities can still adopt ordinances without prior Commission approval.
During the trilogue negotiations as well, I will continue to work hard on this.
Ook tijdens de onderhandelingen in de trilogen zal ik mij hiervoor in blijven spannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de Nederlandse steun aan het Vrije Syrische Leger

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether Dutch non-lethal support to Free Syrian Army groups had reached groups now fighting alongside Turkey in Afrin, and requested transfer documents and a fuller answer. The government declined to publish transfer documents or group names for security reasons, said support was stopped in northern Syria in March 2018, and referred the specific questions to a confidential letter.
For security reasons the cabinet does not make public information from which it can be inferred which groups Netherlands supports or supported or where they are located.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen maakt het kabinet geen informatie openbaar waaruit kan worden afgeleid welke groepen door Nederland worden of werden gesteund of waar ze zich precies bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Geurts over de discriminatie van, onteigeningen van en moordpartijen op blanke boeren in Zuid-Afrika

CDA MPs Van Helvert and Geurts asked the Foreign Minister about reports of discrimination, land expropriation and murders of white farmers in South Africa, and whether the government takes South Africa's security responsibility seriously. The minister answered that violence is a broad problem, that the government sees no reason to doubt South Africa's responsibility, and that the proposed constitutional change on expropriation without compensation is a domestic process being monitored through diplomatic contacts.
The cabinet continues to urge South Africa to keep the farming community well informed about developments and to communicate clearly and unambiguously about the conditions and consequences.
Het kabinet blijft Zuid-Afrika oproepen de boerengemeenschap goed op de hoogte te houden van de ontwikkelingen en eenduidig en helder te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de pretoetredingssteun van de Europese Unie aan Turkije

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about EU pre-accession aid to Turkey: the funding per year and sector for 2014–2020, spending on prisons, police, justice and press freedom, and whether funds reach the Turkish government directly. The minister answers most questions with figures and programme details, notes the aid was cut and redirected toward civil society and rule of law, and says no projects on police/justice were funded in 2017 while 2018 programming is still in progress.
The Commission is currently still working out the programming for 2018.
De Commissie werkt de programmering voor 2018 momenteel nog uit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over een miljard euro belastinggeld voor Oekraïne

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister why the EU should give another 1 billion euro of taxpayers' money to Ukraine, whether the minister would oppose it at the Council, and how much evidence is needed before the Netherlands leaves the EU. The minister answered that the proposed macro-financial assistance is a loan paid in tranches under conditions in a Memorandum of Understanding, that the Netherlands will press for strict anti-corruption conditions, will not announce opposition in advance, and remains committed to EU membership.
The Netherlands is pressing Ukraine in bilateral talks and in multilateral forums for anti-corruption reforms and will insist on strict conditions on anti-corruption reforms in the MoU.

Nederland dringt in bilaterale gesprekken met Oekraïne en in multilaterale fora aan op anti-corruptiehervormingen en zal aandringen op strenge voorwaarden op het gebied van anti-corruptiehervormingen in het MoU.
Correctie op het antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘EU welcomes Silvio Berlusconi as the man to save Italy from populism’

An MP asks the Foreign Minister why Commission President Juncker publicly received Berlusconi before the Italian election, given a court ban on his holding government office, and whether EU officials overstep their mandate by backing a candidate. The minister answers that Juncker and other EU officials decide whom they meet and what they say, that the Italian court ban applies until an appeal is decided, and that Brexit negotiators can be trusted to honour EU agreements.
It is up to Commission President Juncker and other EU high-level officials to decide whom they meet, and the statements they make are their own responsibility.

Het is aan de voorzitter van de Europese Commissie Juncker en andere EU-hoogwaardigheidsbekleders om te bepalen met wie zij een ontmoeting hebben en de uitspraken die zij doen zijn voor hun eigen rekening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Azmani over het bericht dat Tunesië een nieuwe springplank voor illegale migratie naar Europa wordt

MPs Ten Broeke and Azmani asked the ministers about reports that Tunisia is becoming a new departure route for illegal migration to Europe, including the scale of arrivals, possible undercounting, and cooperation with Tunisia. The government answered that arrivals from Tunisia have risen sharply but remain far below 2011 levels, that Tunisia is cooperating on border control and root causes, and that an integrated approach is needed.
Although this is relatively limited compared with the total number of arrivals in Italy, it is a striking increase compared with 2016.
Hoewel dit op het gehele aantal aankomsten in Italië relatief beperkt is, betreft het een opvallende stijging ten opzichte van 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over "het Manifest Schuldvrij! en incassobureaus die te snel naar de rechter stappen"

An SP MP asked the government about the Schuldvrij! manifesto, the overuse of court debt collection by collection agencies, government fines and surcharges, and the Zweeds-style single-collector model. The Staatssecretaris answered that the government shares the concern and will pursue a broad debt approach, committing to a debt collection register, a 2018 review and an information letter in spring 2018, but largely restated existing policy and deferred several points.
The cabinet will get to work on elaborating the debt collection register announced in the coalition agreement.
Het kabinet gaat aan de slag met de uitwerking van het in het regeerakkoord aangekondigde incassoregister.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over de mogelijkheid tot het opleggen van tbs bij weigerachtige verdachten

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether courts can impose tbs (compulsory psychiatric treatment) on suspects who refuse psychiatric observation, and how refusing or non-cooperating tbs patients are managed. The Minister answered that courts can impose tbs without a pJ-report using other sources, that a legislative regulation on refusing observandi is pending, and that the government is examining further measures and will inform parliament in early 2018.
That is why I am currently examining in full breadth which measures can contribute to a solution, alongside the interventions already taken and being introduced.
Daarom onderzoek ik op dit moment in de volle breedte welke maatregelen aan een oplossing kunnen bijdragen, naast de interventies die al zijn getroffen en worden ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de terugkeer van Nederlanders uit IS-gebied

MP Verhoeven (D66) asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether Dutch authorities help Dutch nationals returning from IS-held territory, how this squares with earlier NCTV statements, and whether such people should be prosecuted in the Netherlands. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the government provides no active extraction, that consular help is available at Dutch missions, that each case is handled individually through criminal, intelligence or administrative routes, and that he agrees returnees should face Dutch justice, though nationality revocation may be used where national security requires it.
Yes, I share the view that travellers to conflict areas who may have committed terrorist acts there must come before a Dutch court and be prosecuted for the possible crimes they have committed.

Ja, ik deel de mening dat uitreizigers naar strijdgebied die mogelijk terroristische daden aldaar hebben gepleegd, in Nederland voor de rechter moeten komen en berecht moeten worden voor de mogelijke misdaden die zij hebben begaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over de berichten inzake de aanhouding van Michael P. uit Zeewolde

MP Markuszower asked the Justice Minister why convicted offender Michael P. was able to leave custody and be placed in a forensic clinic, and about the clinic's closure and the number of similar offenders outside prison. The minister declined to discuss the individual case because of ongoing criminal and inspection investigations, explained the general rules for leave and placement in forensic clinics, and gave a count of 128 transferred detainees.
It is important that the criminal investigation and the inspectorates' investigation can proceed carefully. Therefore I cannot go further into the details about Michael P. and his detention.
Het is belangrijk dat het strafrechtelijk onderzoek en het onderzoek van de Inspecties zorgvuldig kunnen verlopen. Daarom kan ik niet verder ingaan op de details over Michael P. en zijn detentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de rechterlijke uitspraak dat een schuldeiser een rekening niet volledig mag plukken

The MP asks whether creditors may empty bank accounts leaving no living allowance, whether a statutory rule for bank seizure is coming, and what is done about creditor and bailiff practice. The state secretary agrees a legal rule is needed, says a broader revision of seizure law is planned for consultation in 2018, and promises talks with the bailiffs' body and a Ministry of Finance study on a proactive living allowance.
I agree with the National Ombudsman that a statutory rule must come to prevent bank seizure from circumventing the rules on the protected minimum for wages or benefits.

Ik ben het met de Nationale ombudsman eens dat er een wettelijke regeling moet komen om te voorkomen dat de regeling inzake beslagvrije voet bij loon of uitkering door een bankbeslag wordt doorkruist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Geurts over het bericht ‘NVWA gebruikt satellietdata bij controles vanggewas’

The CDA MPs asked whether satellite data used by the NVWA to check cover crops could also detect illegal cannabis plantations hidden among farmers' crops, and whether research or cooperation with the police is possible. The minister answered that a police experiment in 2016 found under 10% of satellite-flagged cases were actually cannabis, so the approach is not yet effective, though it may be reconsidered, and the ministry is examining how satellite technology can help police.
The experiment showed that fewer than 10% of the cases flagged by satellite images actually involved cannabis.
Uit het experiment is gebleken dat minder dan 10% van de door satellietbeelden aangeduide gevallen daadwerkelijk cannabis betroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Groothuizen over het Landelijk Bureau Vermiste Personen

MPs Kuiken and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about staffing shortages, a 'spam box' for urgent missing-person alerts, and the handling of missing-person cases at the Landelijk Bureau Vermiste Personen. The minister denied that alerts were late or sent to a spam box, said the bureau was always reachable and cases were assessed by police officers, and did not track how often urgent cases went unreported to the bureau.
It is not tracked in how many cases no report of an urgent disappearance was made to the LBVP.
Er wordt niet bijgehouden in hoeveel gevallen er geen melding van een urgente vermissing bij het LBVP is gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht inzake kansloze aangiftes bij mensenhandel

SP MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report that a third of human trafficking complaints are dismissed within a month, whether this deters victims, the progress of a motion on combating trafficking, asylum versus trafficking residence procedures, IND's reliance on conviction, and steps to raise victims' willingness to report. The minister explained the new fast-track dismissal procedure piloted with police, prosecutors and IND, said data on residence grants cannot yet be broken down, and promised further consultation with partners and the National Rapporteur.
At present, however, no insight can be given into the number of grants made on the basis of a conviction, a criminal process lasting more than three years, or humanitarian circumstances.

Op dit moment kan echter geen inzicht worden gegeven in het aantal toekenningen dat heeft plaatsgevonden op basis van een veroordeling, een strafrechtelijk proces dat langer dan drie jaar in beslag heeft genomen, of op grond van humanitaire omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over een droneverbod vanwege privacy

An MP asked the Minister whether he knew of a proposed ban on hobby drones over privacy concerns at the Kinderdijk windmills, what privacy complaints and violations exist, how anonymous and miniaturised drones should be judged, what physical and legal means exist against privacy-violating drone flights, whether enforcement occurs, and what short-term measures can protect horizontal privacy. The Minister answered that the existing privacy rules are adequate for now, listed police drone-report figures, pointed to identification chips, geofencing and a future updated privacy handbook, and noted civil and criminal remedies.
This handbook will be updated in the first half of 2018 and adapted to the GDPR.
Deze handleiding zal in de eerste helft van 2018 worden geactualiseerd en aangepast aan de AVG.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuiken en Groothuizen over een gebrek aan capaciteit en kwaliteit bij het Landelijk Bureau Vermiste Personen

MPs Kuiken and Groothuizen asked the Minister about reports of understaffing and lack of expertise at the national police's Landelijk Bureau Vermiste Personen, including late alerts, a spam mailbox for urgent reports, and whether an independent investigation is needed. The Minister answers only by referring to a separate letter on improving missing-persons procedures, without addressing the individual questions.

The written questions from MPs Kuiken (PvdA) and Groothuizen (D66), question number 2017Z08797, have been answered by way of the letter 'Approach to bottlenecks in the missing persons process at the police'.

Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kuiken (PvdA) en Groothuizen (D66), vraagnummer 2017Z08797 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Aanpak knelpunten in het proces vermissingen bij de politie» (Kamerstuk 29 628, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over incassobureaus die de rechtbank misbruiken om hun klanten te intimideren

SP MPs asked the Justice Minister about debt collectors such as Hoist and Direct Pay allegedly misusing the courts to intimidate debtors, including the adequacy of judicial oversight, the resale of debts, and AFM supervision. The minister said individual cases are for judges, promised a debt-collection register, a judicial vision paper due early 2018, and tighter AFM engagement, but declined to commit to banning debt resale.
I cannot go into individual cases that are submitted to the judge.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken die aan de rechter worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Helder en Markuszower over het bericht dat een niet bestaand land lid is geworden van Interpol

PVV MPs asked why the Palestinian Authority could join Interpol, whether the Netherlands supports this, and when aid would be cut given attacks on Israel. The government said the bid had sufficient support in Interpol's General Assembly, the Dutch delegations abstained because the Kingdom does not recognise a State of Palestine, and it sees no reason to revise relations with the Palestinian Authority.
The cabinet therefore sees no reason to revise the relationship with the Palestinian Authority.
Het kabinet ziet daarom geen aanleiding om de relatie met de Palestijnse Autoriteit te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Aboutaleb laat ‘kindercasino’ ongemoeid’

MP Van Toorenburg asked the Justice Minister about reports that Rotterdam's mayor was leaving so-called 'kindercasino' arcade halls with permanent fairground-style gambling machines unregulated, and whether the Gaming Authority had advised on them. The minister replied that the Authority found no deliberate or structural circumvention of the gambling-machine regime, that it had asked venues to carry out risk analyses, and that its supervision was still ongoing with no advice issued yet.
These supervisory activities are still ongoing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat Nederland een centrale rol in een wereldwijd netwerk speelt dat mensen helpt bij het kopen van euthanatica

An SGP MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about reports that the Netherlands plays a central role in a global network helping people buy euthanasia drugs, and about enforcement against facilitators, customs controls and testing labs. Minister Grapperhaus replied that no central Dutch role appears in the article, that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, that there is no tolerance policy and the law is enforced, and that customs conducts risk-based checks while the Inspectorate and prosecutors were unaware of the testing lab.
I repeat that the Public Prosecution Service can never make statements about ongoing cases, but there is confidence in the Public Prosecution Service that it will do what it must do: enforce the law.
Ik herhaal hier dat het Openbaar Ministerie nooit mededelingen kan doen over lopende zaken maar dat er vertrouwen is in het Openbaar Ministerie dat het doet wat het moet doen: de wet handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Vader gedode Sandra uit Enschede vindt het onverteerbaar: dader mag op verlof'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice why a young adult convicted of murder was tried under juvenile criminal law, and how leave arrangements for dangerous detainees can be justified given the risk to society. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, explained the adolescent criminal law and the structured leave system, and said no guarantee against reoffending can be given.
I cannot go into the circumstances of this individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de omstandigheden in deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, van Dijck en Wilders over de berichten 'Stichtingen steunen terreur' en 'Drinkwater uitgedeeld in Syrië, maar waar dan'?

PVV MPs asked how many people have been convicted in the Netherlands since 2012 for financing Islamist terrorism, whether citizens convicted of such financing can have their Dutch nationality revoked and be deported, and whether bank and money-transfer reporting duties should be tightened. The government answered that no separate figures exist because terrorism financing is not split by ideology, that nationality revocation is possible case by case for dual nationals, and that the existing Wwft reporting system needs no stricter rules.
Figures on how many people in the Netherlands have been convicted for financing Islamist terrorism are therefore not known.
Cijfers over hoeveel mensen er in Nederland zijn veroordeeld voor het financieren van islamitisch terrorisme zijn daarom niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Lotsverbondenheid’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the government can guarantee that a convicted child murderer on TBS will not reoffend during unsupervised leave, when he will be released, and for lists of convicted rapists and murderers on leave or release in the next two years. The Minister (Rechtsbescherming) answered that leave follows a multi-step assessment by the clinic and the AVT advisory committee, that risk cannot be fully excluded, that individual timelines cannot be disclosed, and that lists would breach data protection law.
No. Providing these lists would be in breach of the Personal Data Protection Act.
Nee. Het verstrekken van deze lijsten zou in strijd zijn met de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Niet meer geklopt op snelheid!’

An MP asked whether police may stop a car remotely by breaking into its software, given that the Computercriminaliteit III bill does not list stopping a car as an investigative power. The minister confirmed that stopping a car is not a permitted investigative act under the bill, said he would alert the police, and denied that the police have prepared for such intrusions.
Under the bill, it is therefore not permitted to break into a car's computer system in order to stop it.
Volgens het wetsvoorstel is het dus niet toegestaan binnen te dringen in het computersysteem van een auto om deze te stoppen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Jankende jihadbruid hoort bij harde kern'

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Justice Minister about a news report on a jihadi bride and whether she should be barred from ever returning to the Netherlands. Minister Grapperhaus acknowledged that returnees from Syria and Iraq can pose a security risk but declined to comment on the individual case or on whether she should be refused re-entry.
I do not comment on individual cases.
