Over individuele casussen doe ik geen uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Kuiken over de opvang van vluchtelingen in Turkije op basis van de Turkijedeal

MPs Buitenweg and Kuiken asked whether Turkey's treatment of migrants returned from Greece under the EU-Turkey deal, as described in a VU report, meets refugee law obligations, and what follow-up is planned. The government rejects the report's conclusions, says all migrants can apply for asylum in Turkey and that only a small share of non-Syrians have applied, and it will not take new steps beyond existing EU monitoring and support.
The cabinet reaches different conclusions than the Vrije Universiteit study commissioned by VluchtelingenWerk Nederland.
Het kabinet komt tot andere conclusies dan het onderzoek van de Vrije Universiteit dat is opgesteld in opdracht van VluchtelingenWerk Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het artikel ‘Kind gestoken’

Two PVV MPs asked whether an imam convicted in England for child abuse and active at a Rotterdam mosque could be stripped of Dutch nationality, expelled and the mosque closed, and whether all mosques should be closed. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case, stated that Dutch nationality law provides no basis for revocation for common crimes and the European Nationality Convention prevents introducing one, said no data exist on convicted imams, and rejected closing all mosques on freedom of religion grounds.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Dementie vaak niet herkend: opeens was moeder getrouwd en waren zij onterfd'

MP Van Dam (CDA) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report on a dementia patient who remarried and disinherited her children, despite a living will and a dementia diagnosis, and asked how notaries assess testamentary capacity, what medical information they can access, and when a void marriage takes effect. The minister answered that a testament by someone lacking capacity is void, that notaries have the duty to assess capacity themselves with optional VIA-doctor advice and a KNB step plan, that medical confidentiality prevents automatic sharing of diagnoses, and that a marriage annulled in good faith takes effect retroactively only once final.
Medical professional confidentiality prevents a doctor from automatically sharing a dementia diagnosis with a notary.
Het medisch beroepsgeheim staat eraan in de weg dat een arts een diagnose dementie automatisch deelt met een notaris.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de situatie van LHBTI-asielzoekers afkomstig uit Oekraïne

MP Buitenweg asks why the government did not respond to UNHCR's 2017 letter arguing Ukraine is unsafe for LGBTI asylum seekers, and whether practical safety and government protection were weighed in designating Ukraine a safe country of origin. The State Secretary maintains Ukraine's designation, citing multiple public sources and noting that individual asylum claims can still be granted, while promising to revisit safe-country assessments later.
The House of Representatives will also be informed of these reassessments.
Ook van deze herbeoordelingen zal de Tweede Kamer op de hoogte worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Helder en Markuszower over het bericht dat Erdogan Interpol misbruikt om jacht te maken op politieke tegenstanders

MPs De Roon, Helder and Markuszower asked whether Turkey misuses Interpol systems to pursue political opponents, what safeguards exist, and whether Dutch nationals have been affected. The government answered that it shares concern, describes Interpol's safeguards (Constitution article 3, Secretary General review, the CCF complaints commission) and Dutch pre-checks of Red Notices, and says it knows of no cases involving Dutch nationals.
The cabinet is concerned about reports, such as this one, that Turkey uses INTERPOL for arrest requests that violate article 3 of the INTERPOL Constitution.
Het kabinet is bezorgd over berichten, zoals onderhavig rapport, dat INTERPOL door Turkije wordt gebruikt voor arrestatie-verzoeken die een schending vormen van artikel 3 van de INTERPOL Constitutie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven inzake ‘Russische whizzkid wordt rijk door jouw documentjes’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether a website publishing leaked official documents with personal data was obtained illegally, what action would be taken against it, whether Google would be pressed to act, and whether government publications should stop linking to it. The minister answered that legality cannot be assumed, that the data protection authority is the competent supervisor and the Wbp may not apply to a foreign-based site, that delisting via individual requests is the available route, and that the government will raise the linking issue in appropriate channels.

Where there are violations of the Personal Data Protection Act (Wbp), the Dutch Data Protection Authority is the independent supervisor, which has the power to act against violations of the Wbp and itself decides when to do so.

Daar waar sprake is van schendingen van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (Wbp) is de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens de onafhankelijke toezichthouder, die de bevoegdheid heeft om op te treden bij schendingen van de Wbp en zelf bepaalt wanneer zij dat doet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Azarkan over het bericht dat PSV-spelers racistisch zijn bejegend in Venlo

MPs Kuzu and Azarkan asked the government about racist chanting directed at PSV players in Venlo, including what clubs, referees and the KNVB did, whether criminal prosecution is underway, and whether penalties for discriminatory football-related offences should be raised. The Minister said the KNVB disciplinary process is pending, a criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service is ongoing and he will not comment on it, and that prosecutors may raise sentence demands by 50% for football-related discrimination offences.
As is customary, while the criminal investigation is ongoing, I make no statements on the progress of this criminal investigation and the prosecution.
Zoals te doen gebruikelijk doe ik, gaande het strafrechtelijk onderzoek, geen uitspraken over het verloop van dit strafrechtelijk onderzoek en de vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut vervoert lijken voor sectie naar België”

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that the Netherlands Forensic Institute sends bodies to Belgium for autopsies, why two offered Dutch pathologists were not used, and whether autopsies should be done domestically. The minister replied that a Belgian university hospital was chosen for its expertise and capacity, that talks with one pathologist took place, and that the shortage is temporary after a pathologist's death, with trainees fully deployable from mid-2018.
After careful consideration, it was decided to cooperate with the University Hospital in Antwerp.
Na een gedegen afweging is gekozen voor samenwerking met het Universitair Ziekenhuis in Antwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Dam over gerechtelijke secties die noodgedwongen in België worden uitgevoerd

MPs Kuiken and Van Dam asked the Justice Minister about autopsies of suspected crime victims being carried out in Belgium because of a staffing shortage at the Netherlands Forensic Institute after a forensic pathologist died. The minister defended the arrangement as a professional, temporary solution with the Antwerp University Hospital, consistent with prior policy, and declined to say the Chamber should have been informed beforehand.
I assess it as a good solution by the NFI to enter into constructive cooperation with Belgian experts.
Ik beoordeel het als een goede oplossing van het NFI om een constructieve samenwerking met Belgische deskundigen aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen  over het gebrek aan capaciteit bij het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut en het uitbesteden van zaken

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister why the Netherlands Forensic Institute now outsources some autopsies to Belgium, why capacity has run short, and about the institute's improvement programme and future outsourcing plans. The minister attributed the shortage to the sudden death of one of four forensic pathologists amid rising caseloads, said no budget cuts affected forensic pathology, and promised a letter on the improvement programme and a vision on forensic research.

Before the budget debate of the Ministry of Justice and Security at the end of November, you will receive the previously promised letter setting out the status of the improvement programme following the culture study.

Voorafgaand aan de begrotingsbehandeling van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid eind november, ontvangt u de al eerder toegezegde brief met daarin de stand van zaken van het verbeterprogramma naar aanleiding van het cultuuronderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het helpen van slachtoffers van kinderporno

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about research into victims of child pornography, whether a webcrawler could be deployed to remove such material, and whether victims are informed so they can claim compensation. The minister pointed to existing victim-support research, said a webcrawler is being assessed for inclusion in a plan due end 2017, and explained that victims are notified case by case, with the victim's wishes decisive.
Currently it is being examined what the possibilities are for deploying such a webcrawler and to what extent it adds value to existing investigation methods.
Op dit moment wordt bekeken wat de mogelijkheden zijn voor het inzetten van een dergelijke webcrawler en in hoeverre dit toegevoegde waarde heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over rehabilitatie bij onterechte jeugdbeschermingsmaatregelen

The MPs asked whether wrongful private-law child protection decisions can cause serious harm, how many such cases exist, whether the state bears responsibility for rehabilitation and support, and how erroneous information in child protection databases is corrected. The minister declined to give a count because 'wrongful' is undefined and the criminal-law analogy does not hold, stated that appeal and cassation exist and that families are supported when children return, and said an action plan on fact-finding is being drawn up for early 2018 and that incorrect facts will be corrected in the file.
An overview of the number of 'in hindsight wrongful private-law rulings' cannot be given, because it is unclear what the definition of that is.
Een overzicht van het aantal «bij nader inzien onterechte privaatrechtelijke uitspraken» is echter niet te geven, omdat onduidelijk is wat de definitie daarvan is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Van Oosten, Groothuizen en Segers over het bericht ‘Grote strafzaken verhuizen van rechtbank Almelo naar Zwolle’

MPs asked whether the move of multi-judge Functioneel Parket criminal cases from Almelo to Zwolle follows from the Herziening Gerechtelijke Kaart and whether Almelo keeps enough work. The minister confirmed the move follows from 2012 agreements, that Almelo remains a main location, and gave hour figures showing fewer multi-judge hearings in Almelo in 2018.
The shift of multi-judge Functioneel Parket criminal cases to Zwolle from 1 January 2018 flows directly from agreements made in 2012 within the framework of the Judicial Map Revision Act (HGK).

De verschuiving van meervoudige strafzaken van het Functioneel Parket per 1 januari 2018 naar Zwolle, zijnde de vestigingsplaats van het Functioneel Parket in Overijssel, vloeit direct voort uit afspraken die in 2012 het kader van de Wet Herziening Gerechtelijke Kaart (HGK) zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over bedreiging van christenen in Rotterdam

Two MPs (Van der Staaij and Voordewind) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that a converted Christian couple in Rotterdam was threatened by Muslims for evangelising, asking how police and prosecutors respond and whether other cases exist. The minister confirmed that threats are criminal, that the couple has regular contact with police, and that cases can be investigated, but declined to discuss individual casework.
Beyond that, it is not appropriate for me to address individual casework in parliamentary questions.
Voor het overige past het mij niet om in Kamervragen in te gaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Wilders, Fritsma en Maeijer over toegang van terroristen tot het Europees Parlement

PVV MPs asked whether the government knew that Leila Khaled had been received in the European Parliament, whether it finds this absurd, how a convicted hijacker obtained a Schengen visa, and what will prevent recurrence. The minister confirmed awareness, declined to judge the Parliament's invitation decision, explained the SIS refusal mechanism in general terms without discussing the individual case, and stated no action on the invitation policy.
I see no reason to intervene in the assessment made by the European Parliament when inviting Ms Khaled.
Ik zie geen aanleiding te treden in de afweging die door het Europees parlement is gemaakt bij de uitnodiging aan mevrouw Khaled.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over The Hague Security Delta

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about public funding to The Hague Security Delta, its influence on senior officials, and possible improper use of public money. The minister answered that the one-off 500,000 euro start-up subsidy was accounted for and met its conditions, that HSD is a public-private platform with no duty to contact senior officials, and that no improper conduct is apparent.
There are no agreements between HSD and the Ministry of Security and Justice about contacts with senior officials.
Er zijn geen afspraken tussen HSD en het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie over contacten met hoge ambtenaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Buitenweg over Amber Alert en de inzet bij jong volwassenen

MPs Kuiken and Buitenweg asked whether the AMBER Alert system could be extended to life-threatening disappearances of young adults and whether the minister would take steps to do so. The minister answered that current criteria cover only children under 18, that extension has legal, financial and operational consequences, and that a broader review of alerting tools is underway without committing to expansion.
I will ask the police to examine your question and the consequences of your request further in conjunction with the tender.
Ik zal de politie vragen om uw vraag en de gevolgen van uw verzoek nader te onderzoeken in combinatie met de aanbesteding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen inzake de werkelijke vraag vanuit de politie en het openbaar ministerie (OM) naar sporenonderzoek en het budget van het Nationaal Forensisch Instituut (NFI)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a WODC study into the forensic production capacity needed by police and prosecutors, its steering committee composition, whether it will update the PMJ forecasting model, and whether it will establish the real demand for forensic investigation and the related NFI budget. The minister confirmed the study started in August 2017, explained the composition of the steering committee and that stakeholders can contribute via expert sessions, and said the two-phase study will identify demand factors and feed a quantified forecast into the budget discussions.
The results of this will be submitted to the budget discussions of the Ministry of Security and Justice.
De resultaten hiervan worden ingebracht bij de besprekingen van de begroting van Veiligheid en Justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Opnieuw werkstraf kopschopper’

An MP asked the Justice Minister why a violent attacker of NS security staff received a community service sentence despite guidelines allowing higher demands for assaults on public-duty workers, and whether minimum sentences should be introduced. The minister defended community service as effective, said serious violent offences warrant more than a community service sentence, clarified the guideline was a doubling rather than tripling, and rejected minimum sentences as undesirable under the coalition agreement.
No. By letter of 12 February 2013 my predecessor informed the House of the withdrawal of the bill on introducing minimum sentences for recidivism in serious offences.

Bij brief van 12 februari 2013 3 heeft mijn ambtsvoorganger uw Kamer op de hoogte gesteld van de intrekking van het wetsvoorstel omtrent het invoeren van minimumstraffen voor recidive bij zware misdrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Nederland weer een stukje meer Turks: Enschede krijgt joekel van een azaantoetermoskee'

Two PVV MPs asked the government whether it shares their view that Islam should be reduced in the Netherlands and that Turkish state influence via Diyanet and a planned mosque in Enschede should be curbed. The minister answered that islamisation is not occurring, all religions are treated equally, the government will increase transparency of religious institutions, and permit decisions for the mosque are a municipal matter handled after objections were considered.
Granting permits and determining zoning plans is the responsibility of the relevant municipality and therefore a local matter.
Het verlenen van vergunningen, bepalen van de bestemmingsplannen etc. is de verantwoordelijkheid van de desbetreffende gemeente en dus een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de bezetting van een islamitische middelbare school en een moskee

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the occupation of an Islamic secondary school and a mosque by Identitair Verzet, including government funding for protection, the role of the Education State Secretary, and calls to ban the group. The minister condemned the actions, said the group was not linked to violence so a ban was not justified, and rejected claims that government conduct fostered the climate, while leaving prosecution and school oversight to the competent authorities.
The Public Prosecution Service is currently examining whether the actions of Identitair Verzet constitute criminal offences, including calls for violent conduct.
Het Openbaar Ministerie onderzoekt momenteel of met de acties van Identitair Verzet sprake is van strafbare feiten, waaronder het oproepen tot gewelddadig optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Ellemeet over de aanhouding van een NRC-fotograaf

Opposition MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the arrest of an NRC photographer who refused to hand over photos of a fight involving a US soldier violates press freedom and proper handling of journalistic material. The minister confirmed the arrest, said apologies were offered, pointed to existing restraint rules on coercive measures against journalists, and committed to discussing the case within the prosecution service and police training.
The acting chief public prosecutor has offered apologies to both the photographer and the editor-in-chief of NRC.
De waarnemend hoofdofficier van justitie heeft zowel de fotograaf als de hoofdredacteur van de NRC excuses aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Kwint over het bericht dat een NRC-journalist in de cel zat omdat hij weigerde foto’s af te staan

SP MPs asked whether a NRC journalist was jailed for refusing to hand over photos without a judge's authorisation, and what would prevent recurrence. The Minister confirmed the incident, said the prosecution service apologised, acknowledged no judicial review took place contrary to the guidelines on coercive measures against journalists, and said the case will be discussed widely within the prosecution service.

When the Public Prosecution Service wants material held by a journalist, the public prosecutor must submit a request to the investigating judge under Article 105 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to obtain an order to surrender it.

Wanneer het Openbaar Ministerie wil beschikken over materiaal dat onder een journalist berust moet de Officier van Justitie ex artikel 105 Wetboek van Strafvordering, bij de Rechter-Commissaris een vordering indienen om van de Rechter-Commissaris een bevel tot uitlevering te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van Engelshoven en Groothuizen over het in de cel gooien van een Nederlandse journalist

MPs from D66 asked why an NRC photographer was detained and his equipment seized for refusing to hand over photos, and whether this was lawful. The Minister answered that the journalist was wrongly treated as a suspect, the seizure was wrong, the Public Prosecution Service apologised, and the case will be discussed within the OM.
The journalist was wrongly treated as a suspect.
De journalist is ten onrechte als verdachte aangemerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Rouvoet voorzitter platform Divorce Challenge’

An MP asked why a platform chair was appointed to follow up the Divorce Challenge on separation, what the government's role is, and about the Rechtspraak vision document, uniform support offers, and the role of special guardians (bijzondere curatoren). The minister answered that the platform, chaired by André Rouvoet, will report in early 2018, that the government wants a multi-party approach to reduce harm to children, and that the fee issue for special guardians awaits the Van der Meer commission.
Early 2018 Rouvoet will present the results of his Platform.
Begin 2018 zal Rouvoet de resultaten van zijn Platform presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat in Nederland dagelijks 30 terreurexperts uit Europa bijeenkomen

The MP asks whether the AIVD head's claim that 30 European terrorism experts meet daily in the Netherlands is accurate, and about the group's composition, legal basis, information shared and oversight. The minister confirms the statement, explains it refers to a physical platform set up under Dutch chairmanship of the Counter Terrorism Group, describes its operational intelligence sharing, and says oversight is multilateral with national supervisors such as the CTIVD able to review AIVD conduct.
Multilateral oversight by national supervisors of the Platform members applies to the multilateral cooperation.
Bij de multilaterale samenwerking is multilateraal toezicht door nationale toezichthouders van de Platform-leden van toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat het project met de slimme camera’s in de haven van Rotterdam stil ligt

MPs Van Raak and Van Toorenburg asked about reports that the smart camera project in the Rotterdam port had stalled, including whether cameras are being read, a funding deadlock, and a claimed one-fifth interception rate for cocaine. The government replied that a convenant is about to be signed, operational rollout is planned for 2018–2021, it has no basis for the one-fifth figure, and the Haventafel held its first meeting on 5 September.
I am not aware of the basis for the estimate of one fifth.
Het is mij niet bekend waarop de schatting van een vijfde is gebaseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het feit dat er een groei van 122% is geconstateerd in varianten van ransomware

An MP asked the ministers whether the reported 122% growth in ransomware variants would continue, whether Dutch society and economy are sufficiently resilient, and what EU-level steps are being taken on device security certification. The government answered that growth is hard to predict, pointed to extra cybersecurity funding of 26 million euros from 2018, awareness campaigns, and EU proposals on a certification framework that will be discussed further.
The cabinet has therefore reserved additional funds for cybersecurity on Budget Day.
Het kabinet heeft daarom bij Prinsjesdag aanvullende middelen voor cybersecurity gereserveerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Van Engelshoven en Jetten over de berichtgeving dat de nieuwe drugstest voor automobilisten mogelijk problematisch is voor mensen met ADHD medicatie

Three D66 MPs asked whether the new saliva drug test for drivers could wrongly flag people taking ADHD medication containing dexamfetamine, and whether this risks loss of driving licences and discourages necessary medication. The minister confirms the test detects amphetamine including dexamfetamine, says medicinal users rarely show signs prompting testing and can explain their medication to the prosecutor, and announces a broader exemption for medically supervised use of dexamfetamine, morphine and medicinal cannabis to be worked out with pharmacists and implementing bodies, with Parliament to be informed as soon as possible.
They will look at an exception to criminalisation for persons who use these substances on medical prescription and under medical supervision and take part in traffic.
Wij zullen daarbij kijken naar een uitzondering op de strafbaarstelling voor personen die op medisch voorschrift en onder medisch toezicht deze stoffen gebruiken en deelnemen aan het verkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Drugscriminelen mogen geld houden omdat justitie er zooitje van maakte’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a news report that drug criminals could keep their illicit proceeds because the Public Prosecution Service mishandled a confiscation case, and asked how often this happens, the cause, and what measures are planned. The Minister replied that the conclusion is premature since the prosecution has appealed, that frequency is not centrally registered, that asset recovery is a policy priority with continuous review, and that the disagreement concerns the scope of additional financial investigation; no extra measures are considered for this individual case.

The question of whether the court has more often ruled that the Public Prosecution Service is inadmissible in its confiscation claim due to failing to meet an evidentiary order cannot be answered because this is not centrally registered.

De vraag of door de rechtbank vaker is geoordeeld dat het Openbaar Ministerie niet ontvankelijk is in zijn ontnemingsvordering in verband met het niet (kunnen) voldoen aan een bewijsopdracht, kan niet worden beantwoord omdat dit niet centraal wordt geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali, Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over de invloed van salafisten in Nederlandse moskeeën

MPs from D66 asked ministers about Saudi-funded study places at the Islamic University of Medina, salafist takeovers of mosques, violence in mosque power struggles, and whether municipalities monitor foreign funding of religious institutions. The government answered that registration data are incomplete, Saudi scholarships are a voluntary choice not disclosed in Notes Verbales, it lacks data on violent incidents or lecture funding, and it promised a tri-track municipal approach and a further handling framework.
The Public Prosecution Service and the police do not register violent incidents at mosques in the context of the power struggle as referred to in the question.
Het Openbaar Ministerie en de politie registreren niet op gewelddadige incidenten bij moskeeën in het kader van de machtsstrijd zoals in de vraag bedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de berichten 'Gemeente blind' en 'Bilal L. bleek wolf in schaapskleren te zijn'

PVV MPs asked the Social Affairs and Justice ministers how a convicted terror suspect who recruited for jihad came to be hired as a deradicalisation youth worker by Amsterdam, whether the mayor knew, and whether comparable figures are employed and nationality can be revoked. The government answered that Amsterdam is autonomously responsible, the mayor knew of the hiring, Amsterdam will no longer hire people who went through radicalisation, and nationality revocation is only possible under narrow legal grounds which it does not discuss for individual cases.
Amsterdam municipality is responsible for the local approach to jihadism in Amsterdam and its implementation, and shapes this policy autonomously.
Gemeente Amsterdam is verantwoordelijk voor de Amsterdamse lokale aanpak jihadisme en de uitvoering daarvan en geeft autonoom vorm aan dit beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht dat de helft van de gemeenten nauwelijks iets doet tegen radicalisering

An MP asked whether the government is aware that half of municipalities, especially small and medium-sized ones, do little against radicalisation, and how it will embed the national counter-terrorism policy locally. The minister acknowledges uneven municipal activity, points to regional structures, versterkingsgelden, and national training and support (ROR, ESS), and promises to report on use of funds in response to a motion.

Like the VNG, I consider it important that at regional level the problem is mapped, knowledge and expertise are in order, and cooperation structures exist through which signals can come in and be followed up.

Wel vind ik het, evenals de VNG, van belang dat op regionaal niveau de problematiek in kaart is gebracht, kennis en kunde op orde is en samenwerkingsverbanden en structuren bestaan waarbij bijvoorbeeld signalen kunnen binnenkomen en worden opgevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht 'Beschermd door justitie, leven kapot'

The MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the protection system for witnesses may fail to adequately support them, and whether witnesses' dissatisfaction, the need for evaluation, legal assistance, financial and medical support, and information for witnesses are adequate. The Minister largely rejects the need for changes, stating the system works as intended, witnesses can consult a lawyer, and that the government is studying whether to extend legal options for promises to criminal witnesses.
I see no reason for a different approach.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor een andere aanpak.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over het overdragen van sociale media data van gewone Nederlanders aan de Amerikaanse overheid, de Muslimban en de onderhandelingen over de Amerikaanse "preclearance"

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked about US handling of Dutch travellers' social media data, refusals of entry to dual nationals and Dutch citizens, the Muslim travel ban, and preclearance negotiations at Schiphol. The government answered that it is not actively informed when entry is refused, that the EU PNR court opinion does not affect US data exchange, and that preclearance talks continue under Dutch, EU and international law including human rights.
The Dutch government is not actively informed when Dutch nationals are denied entry to the US.
De Nederlandse regering wordt niet actief geïnformeerd indien Nederlanders de toegang tot de VS is ontzegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de verplichte pensioenleeftijd voor rechters

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the mandatory retirement age of 70 for judges is still justified, given rising life expectancy, age discrimination concerns and judicial shortages. The minister defended the age limit as lawful and legitimate for judicial independence and career flow, but agreed to examine whether the limit should be changed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Markuszower over het bericht “Terreurvader Bunschoten vrij met enkelband”

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether an ankle monitor and location ban are sufficient to protect the children of a suspect in a child abuse case, after he was released from preventive custody. The State Secretary answered that the independent judge decided on the release under strict conditions, that sentencing is for the courts, and that the government does not decide on pre-trial detention.
The independent judge, and not the government, decides in the Netherlands whether suspects must await their trial in custody.
De onafhankelijke rechter, en dus niet de regering, beslist in Nederland of verdachten hun berechting in de cel moeten afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de berichtgeving van de samenwerking tussen het Openbaar Ministerie en de Belastingdienst om criminelen in hun portemonnee te raken

Two SP MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about reported weak cooperation between the Public Prosecution Service and the Tax Authority in recovering criminal proceeds, including why confiscation often yields less than claimed, whether tax recovery works after failed criminal recovery, how often offshore concealment occurs, and whether multidisciplinary asset-recovery teams and more investigative capacity are warranted. The minister answered that cooperation already exists and is periodically evaluated, that figures on tax recovery and concealment are not kept, that RIEC structures are preferred over new teams, and that extra funding (5 to 20 million euro a year from 2018, plus 30 million reserved for 2018) has been provided.

The number of cases in which the Tax Authority still recovers money from criminals via tax reassessment after the criminal asset-recovery route has (partly) failed is not tracked and no figures are available.

Het aantal gevallen waarin de Belastingdienst als nog via fiscale navordering en naheffing geld terug haalt bij criminelen als het strafrechtelijke afpaktraject (deels) mislukt, wordt niet bijgehouden en cijfers zijn dan ook niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Keijzer en Van Toorenburg over het bericht “Albanese maffia slaat hier zijn tentakels uit”

MPs Omtzigt, Keijzer and Van Toorenburg asked about reports of Albanian organised crime in the Netherlands, including whether a visa requirement should be reintroduced under EU rules and whether Albania should keep candidate status. The minister answered that Albanian-national suspects rose to about 700 in 2016, that the government will await the Commission's Western Balkans monitor before considering the EU emergency brake, and that the answers were delayed beyond the two-week target.
I will make this report available for confidential inspection by your House until the end of the year.
Deze rapportage leg ik tot het einde van het jaar ter vertrouwelijke inzage in uw Kamer.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over slachtoffers die recht hebben op een schadevergoeding, maar geen aanspraak kunnen maken op de voorschotregeling bij schadevergoedingen en daardoor, wanneer de dader de schad

An MP asked why victims of offences in Book 3 of the Criminal Code (overtredingen) cannot receive a state advance on compensation, unlike victims of violent and sexual offences, and why the CJIB stops collecting after substitute detention. The minister defended the limited scope of the advance scheme on budgetary grounds, said the CJIB is examining wider collection after substitute detention, and declined to extend the scheme to overtredingen.
I still stand by this choice.
Ik sta nog steeds achter deze keuze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de storingen in de tapinstallatie van de politie

MPs Van Nispen asked about reported storms of failures in the police wiretap system, the foreign-owned vendor's limited transparency, and the delayed replacement of the system. The minister confirmed earlier storm counts were unreliable, said a corrected investigation will report by year-end, outlined restricted vendor access rights, and said a new system tender should conclude in early 2018.
The vendor's registration system contains not only reports about the police system but also about other customers.
In het registratiesysteem van de leverancier staan niet alleen meldingen over het systeem van de politie, maar ook van andere klanten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Toorenburg over het inspectieonderzoek naar de stroomstoring van Amsterdam en omstreken van 17 januari 2017

MPs Van den Berg and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked why the 1-1-2 emergency line's intake arrangements date from when mobile phone use was limited, why about 19% of callers got no contact during the January 2017 Amsterdam power outage, and what is being done about mobile reachability, waiting times and standards. The Minister answered that a national intake structure and a renewed technical infrastructure are being introduced, that a cost-benefit analysis on a standard for outage-resilient 1-1-2 access will be sent to parliament in early 2018, and that the Agentschap Telecom has advised several municipalities.
As indicated in the policy response, a thorough cost-benefit analysis will first be carried out to determine what a reasonable standard is.
Zoals aangegeven is in de beleidsreactie, wordt eerst een gedegen kosten en baten analyse uitgevoerd om te kijken wat een redelijke norm is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Engelshoven en Paternotte over het bericht '112 bij ramp? In de wacht' naar aanleiding van het onderzoek naar de stroomstoring in Amsterdam op 17 januari 2017

MPs Van Engelshoven and Paternotte asked about 112 emergency call failures during the January 2017 Amsterdam power outage, prior recommendations, telecom obligations and the lack of a norm for continuous 112 access. The minister answered that most earlier recommendations were implemented, that a risk analysis and new technical infrastructure in 2018 address remaining gaps, and that a norm for uninterrupted access awaits a cost-benefit analysis.
That is therefore the reason why the Ministry of Economic Affairs first wants to have a cost-benefit analysis carried out before moving to a norm for uninterrupted access to 1-1-2.
Dat is dan ook de reden dat het Ministerie van Economische Zaken eerst een kosten en baten analyse wil laten uitvoeren voordat overgaan wordt tot een norm voor onderbroken toegang tot 1-1-2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het EUROPOL-rapport 'From suspicion to action - Converting financial intelligence into greater operational impact'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a Europol report on converting financial intelligence into operational impact, including why Dutch reporting raises its share of suspicious transaction reports, what happened to 6,500 FIU dossiers, and whether a uniform EU reporting system and stronger Europol role are needed. The minister answered that Dutch unusual-transaction reporting is a deliberate design, that the report's figures are misleading, that FIU-NL cooperates closely with investigators, and that EU reforms are underway, without committing to a new system.
In view of the foregoing, I see no reason to switch to a uniform European reporting system.
Ik zie gelet op het voorgaande geen reden om over te stappen naar een uniform Europees rapportagesysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over het advies van de Coöperatie Laatste Wil omtrent een zelfdodingsmiddel

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij ask whether a lethal substance advised by the Coöperatie Laatste Wil for suicide is legal, traceable, safe, and whether the cooperative's advice constitutes criminal assistance in suicide, and whether it should be banned. The ministers answer that they do not know the substance, that criminal liability is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, that a ban under article 2:20 BW faces high legal thresholds, and that the government opposes spreading such information and will rely on suicide prevention policy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van 't Wout en Koopmans over het bericht “Sollicitant niet meer vogelvrij op internet.”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Justice about an Article 29 Working Party opinion on employers screening job applicants' social media profiles, and how it fits with Dutch privacy law and UWV training. The government answered that the opinion does not change existing rules, that the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (and later the AVG) leaves room for a necessary, transparent online check, and that no contradictory signal was given.
If a profile serves a professional purpose, it may more readily be justified than a private profile.
Als er sprake is van een profiel dat een professioneel doeleinde dient, zal daar eerder sprake van kunnen zijn dan als het een privé profiel betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de onbetrouwbaarheid van flitsapparatuur

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether digital speed cameras are unreliable and whether mobile radar problems and manual filtering errors lead to wrongful fines, and asks about the figures involved. The minister denies a general reliability problem, says a single storage fault was isolated and fines annulled, and states no percentages or counts are kept, while noting correction requests and appeal as remedies.
A percentage cannot be given because this is not recorded.
Een percentage is niet te geven omdat dit niet wordt bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over het bericht 'Politiedienst slaat alarm: duizenden buitenlandse terreurtips genegeerd'

MPs Helder and De Graaf asked whether the police international legal assistance centre (LIRC) has thousands of backlogged terrorism-related requests and signals and whether this structural understaffing endangers security. The minister confirmed the backlog figures, said terrorism requests get top priority, and stated 32 vacancies have been filled with the remaining 8 expected by early 2018, with a letter to follow.
Requests related to terrorism receive the highest priority and are handled immediately.
Verzoeken in het kader van terrorisme krijgen de hoogste prioriteit en worden direct opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de intrekking van het Nederlanderschap

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether concrete steps had been taken to revoke Dutch nationality from jihadists under the new article 14(4), and why prosecution might be preferred over administrative revocation. The Minister replied that nationality has been revoked in four cases and a further intention announced in one, that revocation is weighed case by case against criminal enforcement, and that the Public Prosecution Service decides on criminal investigations.
I have revoked Dutch nationality in four cases under article 14, paragraph 4, of the Nationality Act.
Ik heb in vier gevallen het Nederlanderschap ingetrokken op grond van artikel 14, vierde lid, Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap.
Antwoord op van vragen van de leden Van Dam en Knops over het bericht ‘Stop leningen aan politieagenten voor afkopen dienstplicht Turkije’

MPs Van Dam and Knops asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that police officers could borrow up to 6,000 euro interest-free to buy out Turkish military service, and whether this and the similar Defence scheme should be ended, as previously requested in a 2011 motion. The minister answered that 24 police officers used the scheme from 2013 to 2017, that the scheme will be abolished soon because Turkish rules were relaxed in 2016, and that the Defence scheme is under discussion with the public sector unions.
This scheme will therefore be abolished soon.
Deze regeling wordt daarom binnenkort afgeschaft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over het artikel 'Dubieuze gluurcamera gewoon te koop via Amazon'

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a news report on a dubious hidden camera sold via Amazon, and how the spread of such devices threatens horizontal privacy. The minister said existing criminal and data protection law suffices, pointed to ongoing private-sector cooperation on preventive measures, and noted the stricter GDPR fines from May 2018, without committing to new measures.
In my view, current legislation offers sufficient possibilities to counter misuse of such equipment.
Naar mijn mening biedt de huidige wetgeving voldoende mogelijkheden om misbruik van dergelijke apparatuur tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over gebrekkig onderwijs t.a.v. sexting

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked why pupils report little sexting education and how schools' teaching on sexting, sexual diversity and media matches the 'Seks onder je 25ste' findings. The ministers pointed to Inspectorate reports showing schools address sexual education variably, to Mediawijzer.net and curriculum reform, and gave no new concrete commitments beyond ongoing efforts.
The full report 'Seks onder je 25ste' has not yet been made public; that will happen in the autumn.
Het volledige rapport «Seks onder je 25 ste » is nog niet openbaar gemaakt; dat gebeurt in het najaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en De Graaf over een in Brunssum opgepakte Syrische terreurverdachte met een verblijfsvergunning

PVV MPs asked how a Syrian asylum seeker with a residence permit, suspected of terrorism, passed screening, how many asylum seekers are suspected of terrorist links, why migration continues, whether such suspects will be deported, and when borders will close to Muslim-country nationals. The state secretary replied that the suspect was wrongly linked to terrorism, that authorities stay alert but cannot guarantee abuse is impossible, that deportation or residence/nationality measures are considered when a conviction or intelligence report exists, and rejected closing borders.
The Public Prosecution Service does not register by residence status.
Het OM registreert niet op verblijfstatus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de groei van het aantal mensen met problematische schulden

MPs asked the government about the growth in households with problematic debts, including residents of holiday parks, why most are not reached by debt assistance, the difficulty of obtaining a postal address, and whether government creditors impose excessive costs. The government says it is taking steps such as funding debt assistance, reforming enforcement costs and the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet), and promises to improve access but commits to few concrete new measures.
Creditors, both government creditors and private creditors, must behave properly.
Schuldeisers, zowel overheidsschuldeisers als (private) schuldeisers dienen zich behoorlijk te gedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Haatsjeik toch actief in Den Haag'

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Justice whether a convicted Islamic preacher runs an illegal mosque in The Hague, and whether such individuals may act as preachers and should be shut down. The government answered that the leased premises may only be used for commercial activities, that the municipality has ordered the owner to stop the non-conforming use with legal follow-up threatened, and that the Justice minister imposed an area ban on the individual, while freedom of religion precludes 'deislamisation'.
The Hague municipality has meanwhile ordered the owner of the premises on Cilliersstraat to end the non-conforming use.
De gemeente Den Haag heeft de eigenaar van het pand aan de Cilliersstraat inmiddels gesommeerd het strijdige gebruik te beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Tellegen over het bericht 'In je blootje op Dumpert'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about online sharing of intimate images without consent (horizontal privacy violations, sextortion) and whether platforms like Dumpert and Facebook can be compelled to release perpetrators' identities. The Minister noted existing legal tools, the pending computer crime III bill, a voluntary Notice and Take Down code, the Dutch DPA's role, and that identity release from Facebook Ireland requires a legal basis or civil suit.
I therefore cannot provide insight into the scale of sextortion.
Ik kan dus geen inzage geven in de omvang van sekschantage.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de explosieven in woonwijken

An MP asked how hundreds of kilos of WWII explosives could be stored under a permit, what conditions apply, and whether emergency services knew of them. The government answered that a 2012 exemption covered a collection of WWII munition, that no permit existed for phosphorus, artillery or hand grenades, and that emergency services were not told of permit holders as a standing practice.
I cannot say exactly what was found because this is part of the criminal investigation.
Over wat precies is aangetroffen kan ik geen mededelingen doen omdat dit onderdeel is van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat er camera’s hangen in de kleedkamers van fitness keten Fit For Free

MPs Koopmans (VVD) and Bruins Slot (CDA) asked whether cameras in changing rooms of fitness chain Fit For Free, even if switched off, violate privacy, and what oversight exists. The government answered that cameras in changing rooms and toilets go too far, that installed-but-unused cameras involve no personal data processing, that the Dutch Data Protection Authority handled two complaints and the cameras were removed, and that no law change is needed.
Camera surveillance in changing rooms or toilets goes too far because people would be filmed undressed.
Cameratoezicht in kleedkamers of toiletten gaat te ver omdat mensen dan ontkleed in beeld komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Nispen over het niet nakomen van omgangsregelingen naar aanleiding van de uitzending 'Dwaze vaders'

MPs Bergkamp and Van Nispen ask the Minister of Justice about parents not honouring custody/contact arrangements after separation, the prosecution of parental abduction, the handling of mutual accusations in divorces by the Child Protection Board and prosecutors, and whether courts stop contact with one parent (often fathers). The Minister answers that civil enforcement tools exist, a WODC study on non-compliance is commissioned for 2018, criminal prosecution is used as optimum remedium with a prosecution guideline in preparation, and truth-finding is addressed via an action plan.
To gain more insight into the problem, I have, partly following a motion by MPs Bergkamp and Van Nispen, asked the WODC to conduct research into the non-compliance with custody arrangements.

Om meer inzicht in de problematiek te krijgen heb ik, mede naar aanleiding van een motie van de leden Bergkamp (D66) en Van Nispen (SP) 6 , het WODC verzocht om onderzoek te laten doen naar het niet nakomen van omgangsregelingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de informatie beschikbaar bij de Nederlandse overheid en regering over het onveilige luchtruim boven Oost Oekraïne in de eerste helft van 2014, dus vóór het nee

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked what information the Dutch government held about unsafe airspace over eastern Ukraine before MH17 was downed, including an April 2014 NCTV threat-analysis request, the Kiev memorandum, OVSE and ECAC warnings, NOTAMs, Eccairs reports and airline warning arrangements. The government answered that the April 2014 request was a routine terrorism-alert request on Dutch airports, that the relevant warnings concerned Crimea and the Black Sea rather than eastern Ukraine, and it offered some documents for confidential inspection by the House until the 2017 Christmas recess while withholding others from public disclosure.
To give your House a complete picture I will make all the requests mentioned above available for confidential inspection, only to members of your House, until the 2017 Christmas recess.
Om uw Kamer een compleet beeld te geven zal ik alle hierboven genoemde aanvragen ter vertrouwelijke inzage ter beschikking stellen, alleen aan de leden van uw Kamer, tot het kerstreces 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Bevel rechter leidt niet tot snellere hulp jongere’

MPs Peters and Van Toorenburg asked why juveniles ordered by the juvenile judge to undergo therapy face long waiting lists, and whether this reflects judges imposing specific trajectories unaware of municipal contracts. The state secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for youth care availability, that coordination between the Child Protection Board, probation and municipalities should be improved, and that the Midden-Nederland region will hold talks, with the Board reporting back on follow-up.
The Child Protection Board has informed me that in upcoming talks with municipalities where this is a problem, it will discuss the availability of forensic youth care and will keep me informed.
De RvdK heeft mij gemeld in de komende gesprekken met gemeenten waar dit een probleem vormt, de beschikbaarheid van forensische jeugdhulp te bespreken en houdt mij daarvan op de hoogte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'We horen niets meer van OM'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Justice why a gay couple attacked in Arnhem has heard nothing from the prosecution service about their case, and whether violent juvenile offenders should face minimum sentences. The minister answered that the victims were informed several times, the case file was sent to the prosecutor and a hearing is being planned, that minors are treated with restraint on privacy and detention grounds, and that he does not favour minimum sentences.
When it concerns minor suspects, as in the present case, it is standard policy to be restrained in sharing substantive information because of the suspects' privacy interests.

Wanneer het gaat om minderjarige verdachten, zoals in de onderhavige casus, is het standaard beleid om terughoudend te zijn met het delen van inhoudelijke informatie in verband met privacybelangen van de verdachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het MH17 archief

Rep. Omtzigt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the government's MH17 archive, including whether a public index or search function exists, whether sensitive materials such as interview reports, the JIT agreement and diplomatic memos will be preserved and made accessible, and whether the archiving meets the DUTO accessibility criteria. The minister answered that an information overview has been published on the National Archives website at dossier level, that a public item-level index or search function will not be provided for privacy, state interest and ongoing prosecution reasons, and that interview reports, the JIT agreement and diplomatic memos will not be disclosed.
I do not share your assessment of how applicable the information overview is.
Uw oordeel over de mate van toepasbaarheid van het informatieoverzicht deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over ICT bij de Nationale Politie

MP Van Dam asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the Review Board's warning that the police ICT programme would reach only about 45% of its realisation plan by end 2017, creating an imbalance between maintaining the base and renewing ICT, and whether the programme and Review Board should continue after 2017. The Minister acknowledged the warning, said the focus was deliberately on putting the basic systems in order, promised a final report and Review Board report after the programme ends on 31 December 2017, and said the programme would be handed over to the standing organisation with a transition plan advised by the Review Board, which was reinstated and extended to end 2017.
I will send your House a final report after the Attack Programme ends (31 December 2017), as well as the final report of the Review Board.
Ik zal uw Kamer na afloop van het Aanvalsprogramma (31 december 2017) een eindrapportage doen toekomen, evenals het eindverslag van de Review Board.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht 'Nederland tweede op lijst online illegale wapenhandel'

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report that the Netherlands ranks second worldwide in online illegal arms trade, asking about oversight, strategy and criminal law. The state secretary acknowledged the trend, said the report does not allow hard conclusions on location, and pointed to intensified enforcement, specialised police teams and a pending computer-crime bill.
The approach is being intensified through stronger investigative and digital expertise and the setting up of public-private partnerships with postal and parcel services.
De aanpak wordt met de inzet van de versterkte opsporings- en digitale expertise en het opzetten van publiek-private samenwerkingsverbanden met post- en pakketdiensten geïntensiveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het passief kiesrecht

MP Van Raak asked whether politicians convicted of fraud or corruption should be barred from office and why passive voting rights are rarely removed, and whether the law should be tightened. The minister agreed integrity is essential, said vetting is primarily a party responsibility and cited a handreiking for parties, and stated that the parliamentary amendment replacing loss of voting rights with an aggravating circumstance means no legislative change is planned.
Against this background, I see no reason to propose amending the legislation.
Ik zie tegen deze achtergrond geen aanleiding voorstellen te doen tot wijziging van de wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Vaak te laat bij brand'

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Safety and Justice whether fire services often arrive late at emergencies, whether they can fail to deploy due to staff shortages, and whether the government will engage with volunteer firefighter unions. The minister says an Inspectorate study on the quality of fire response, including arrival times and staffing, is expected by year end; responsibility for staffing and arrival-time registration lies with regional safety boards, and a meeting with unions will be held with results reported to parliament.
The Inspectorate of Security and Justice is currently conducting research into the quality of repressive fire brigade care.
De Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie doet op dit moment onderzoek naar de kwaliteit van de repressieve brandweerzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de bestrijding van synthetische drugscriminaliteit

MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a Brabant synthetic drugs sweep stopped early, police and LFO capacity, drug-waste dumping trends in Gelderland and Brabant, and cleanup costs. The minister answered that the sweep was successful, that capacity appears adequate but may need expansion, that dumping counts rose modestly with figures by province, and that the offender should bear cleanup costs, with a cofinancing scheme being implemented.
How investigative capacity is deployed is determined in the local triangle (mayor, public prosecution and police).
Hoe de opsporingscapaciteit wordt ingezet, wordt bepaald in de lokale driehoek (burgemeester, OM en politie).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het doden van beschermde houtsnippen

MP Wassenberg asked about a court ruling on the killing of protected woodcocks at Duivenvoorde estate, whether a game warden with investigative powers took part, and whether such officers should be barred from hunts they supervise. The State Secretary answered that the warden's dual role is justified with strict training and supervision requirements, saw no reason for further restrictions, pointed to existing protection rules, and confirmed the public prosecutor did not appeal.
I see no reason to impose further restrictions on the game warden.
Zie ik geen reden om nadere beperkingen op te leggen aan de jachtopzichter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat de Duitse recherche de zogenaamde Panama Papers heeft gekocht

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether he would contact German authorities to obtain access to the Panama Papers, share the information with Dutch tax and prosecution bodies, and publicly release the data. The State Secretary confirmed the German BKA is willing to share, that talks are ongoing, and that the Tax Administration will report aggregated progress in its half-yearly reports without individual cases, while declining to commit on public release.
As agreed when the Panama Papers appeared in 2016, the Tax Administration's half-yearly reports will inform your House of the progress of processing this information
Zoals afgesproken bij het verschijnen van de Panama Papers in 2016 wordt in de halfjaarsrapportages van de Belastingdienst uw Kamer verslag gedaan van de voortgang
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Popken, Wilders en Graus over het bericht dat de marechaussee onervaren en ongewapenden burgers gaat inzetten op Schiphol

PVV MPs asked whether deploying inexperienced, unarmed reservists at Schiphol border control, as reported, endangers security given the terror threat, and whether more money will be invested in border control. The ministers confirmed the report, said about 200 fully trained ex-marechaussee reservists exist and a single trainee reservist is in a pilot (unarmed, always paired with an armed colleague, to be evaluated), and pointed to €7.5m extra for 2017 and €20m structurally from 2018 for border control.
The starting point is that no compromises are made on security.
Voorop staat dat er geen concessies worden gedaan aan de veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Bosch over de beveiliging door de Marechaussee op Schiphol

An MP asked the Defence and Justice ministers whether untrained or minimally trained reservists were being used for border passport checks at Schiphol, and about the risks and whether this is a pilot. The ministers answered that about 200 fully trained reservists exist, that one reservist in a pilot, unarmed and always paired with an armed colleague, is limited to passport checks, and that a decision will follow evaluation.
After evaluation of the pilot with this one reservist, a decision will be made on whether the Royal Marechaussee continues with this.
Na evaluatie van de pilot met deze ene reservist wordt beslist of de Koninklijke Marechaussee hiermee doorgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Aalst en Helder over het bericht “Twee conducteurs mishandeld door treinreizigers”

PVV MPs asked the state secretary and minister about reports of conductors and police being assaulted on trains, asking why measures have not stopped it, whether travel bans and harsher penalties will be imposed, whether NS security staff will get batons and pepper spray, whether a perpetrator profile and a real-time database of travel bans will be created. The government answered that eight and 23 measures are being implemented or evaluated, that travel-ban evaluation will be shared in autumn, that NS security staff have no need for pepper spray, that a perpetrator profile report was already delivered, and that a database will be considered in the travel-ban evaluation.
These measures are currently being evaluated. You will be informed about this in the autumn.
Deze maatregelen worden momenteel geëvalueerd. Hierover zult u in het najaar worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, De Graaf en Wilders over beschermde identiteit voor teruggekeerde Zweedse jihadisten

MPs De Roon, De Graaf and Wilders asked whether returning Swedish jihadists receive protected identities to aid reintegration, whether they could travel and settle in the EU and Netherlands, and whether Dutch services know of them. The ministers replied that the reports are incorrect, that Sweden only offers privacy-data protection for threatened citizens and not new identities, and that the other questions therefore do not apply.
No, this report is not correct.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Toorenburg over terugkerende jihadisten naar Zweden die een nieuwe identiteit krijgen

MPs Omtzigt and Van Toorenburg asked whether Sweden gives returning jihadists new identities without local authorities knowing where they live, and what risks this poses for the EU. The ministers answered that the reports are inaccurate according to Swedish authorities, that no EU state is known to pursue such a policy, and they described existing EU information-sharing and PNR arrangements.
Enquiries with the Swedish authorities show that this report is incorrect.
Uit navraag bij de Zweedse autoriteiten blijkt dat deze berichtgeving onjuist is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over activiteiten van de Turkse inlichtingendienst in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers whether the Turkish intelligence service operates from The Hague, including compiling kill-lists of Kurdish activists, and what the government will do about it. The ministers declined to comment on the French prosecution and said they cannot publicly discuss investigations into foreign intelligence activity, only that the government takes measures when unauthorised activity is found.
No public statements can be made about investigations into such activities by foreign intelligence and security services.
Over onderzoek naar dergelijke activiteiten van buitenlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de brandweer bijna geen bevelvoerders meer heeft

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the shortage of volunteer firefighters is growing, whether the minister will intervene given that regional safety boards are responsible for staffing, whether talks with the volunteer firefighters' union continue, and whether the safety regime should be revised. The minister answered that two studies are underway with results expected by year end, that regional boards bear responsibility for staffing while the Inspectorate supervises, that he meets the union yearly, and that the Wet veiligheidsregio's will be re-evaluated in 2019.
The boards of the safety regions are responsible for the adequate organisation of fire brigade services.
De besturen van de veiligheidsregio's zijn verantwoordelijk voor een adequate organisatie van de brandweerzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de resolutie van het Europees parlement inzake de bestrijding van antisemitisme

An SGP MP asked the government about the European Parliament's resolution on combating antisemitism, including adopting the IHRA working definition, the BDS movement, separate registration, and a national coordinator. The government answered that it supports the non-binding IHRA definition but sees no added value in a binding one, that antisemitism is already registered separately by police, and that it sees no added value in a national coordinator given existing prevention efforts.
At present the cabinet sees no added value in adopting a legally binding international definition, because definitions have different effects in different legal systems.

Op dit moment ziet het kabinet geen toegevoegde waarde in het aannemen van een juridisch bindende internationale definitie, omdat definities een verschillende doorwerking hebben in verschillende rechtssystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat malware mogelijk energiebedrijven kan platleggen

An MP asked the ministers whether the Industroyer malware, reported by ESET, could disrupt Dutch energy companies given similar equipment and protocols, and what the government role is in protecting vital infrastructure. The government answered that intrusion is a prerequisite, that responsibility lies primarily with companies under Elektriciteitswet and Gaswet with ACM supervision, that the NCSC advises vital providers, and that the NIS directive implementation bill was in consultation.
Government and vital organisations work together in the Netherlands to protect vital infrastructure.
Overheid en vitale organisaties werken in Nederland samen aan de bescherming van de vitale infrastructuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over twijfelachtig recherchewerk brengt brugwachter aan de afgrond

An SP MP asked the Interior and Justice ministers about municipalities and provinces hiring private investigation firms for integrity probes, including a case where private investigators allegedly placed tracking devices on a government employee's car, and whether central government does the same. The minister answered that local authorities decide themselves whether to use private bureaus for reasons of capacity, expertise and independence, that such bureaus must be licensed under the WPBR with conduct rules, that the tracking device practice is only allowed for business-used vehicles within the relevant period, and that central government sometimes outsources such investigations while preferring in-house work.
Municipalities and provinces are themselves responsible for deciding whether or not to use an external private bureau to carry out an integrity investigation.
Gemeenten en provincies zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het besluit al dan niet gebruik te maken van een extern particulier bureau voor de uitvoering van een integriteitsonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders  over het bericht 'Engeland neemt paspoort van 150 Syriëgangers af: 'Britse nationaliteit is geen absoluut recht'

Two PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister about the UK stripping citizenship from around 150 Syria travellers, asking how many Dutch travellers remain abroad, how many hold dual nationality, and whether the Netherlands would do the same. The minister gave the numbers (about 190 still in the conflict zone), said dual-nationality data is not updated in the population register, and explained the Dutch legal grounds for revoking citizenship on national security grounds, noting each case needs an individual assessment and that no decisions under that power had yet been taken.
In general I cannot make statements about the number of travellers with a second nationality.
In zijn algemeenheid kan ik geen uitspraken doen over het aantal uitreizigers met een tweede nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht “Jongeren met een nepwapen uit metro gehaald”

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report of youths removed from the Rotterdam metro carrying a toy gun, and whether the government still opposes a national ban on toy firearms and considers carrying them in public restrictable under the Weapons and Ammunition Act. The state secretary answered that EU toy safety rules permit possession, that carrying is only punishable case by case under the existing limited carrying ban, that a general carrying ban is not warranted, and that police awareness campaigns are preferred.
Given the target group of the product, namely children, it is not reasonable to introduce a general carrying ban on toy weapons.
Gezien de doelgroep van het product, te weten kinderen, ligt het niet in de rede een algemeen draagverbod voor speelgoedwapens in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over uitreisverboden voor Nederlanders in Turkije

An MP asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about a Dutch man arrested in Turkey and banned from leaving for allegedly insulting President Erdogan, about ten Dutch nationals reportedly barred from leaving over Gülen links, resumed extraditions to Turkey, and whether the government will press Turkey to lift the bans and tighten travel advice. The government confirmed one case but withheld details on privacy grounds, stated about ten persons had reported bans, defended case-by-case extradition review with Turkish guarantees, said the embassy has repeatedly raised the bans with Turkish authorities, and noted existing travel advice already warns of these risks.
Due to privacy protection, I cannot provide your House with further information about an individual case through this public letter.
Vanwege privacybescherming kan ik uw Kamer via deze openbare brief geen verdere informatie verstrekken over een individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over de rol van een ondernemingsraad na een doorstart bij faillissement

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked the Justice Minister whether a Supreme Court ruling extends works council advisory rights to bankruptcy sales and going-concern takeovers, and whether it requires advice before a doorstart and helps prevent abusive dismissals. The minister confirmed the ruling applies WOR advisory rights to continuation or doorstart of bankrupt businesses where jobs may be preserved, but not to liquidation by the curator, and said the topic will be addressed in the faillissementsrecht reform programme with a fuller update due in September.
I will inform you further on this subject in mid-September, in the next progress letter on the bankruptcy law renewal programme.
Ik zal u medio september, in de volgende voortgangsbrief van het programma herijking faillissementsrecht, nader over dit onderwerp informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Aalst en Helder over het bericht ‘Milieuactivisten maken voor tienduizenden euro’s schade’

MPs Van Aalst and Helder asked whether police knew in advance of a Code Rood activist break-in at an Amsterdam port business park, why police did not intervene sooner, how few arrests were made, and whether damages can be recovered. Minister Blok answered that the mayor is responsible for police operations, referred specific questions to the local authority, reported 13 arrests, and noted victims can claim damages through criminal or civil routes.
The mayor is responsible for directing the police with regard to public order in his or her municipality.
De burgemeester is verantwoordelijk voor de aansturing van de politie ten aanzien van de openbare orde in zijn of haar gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Radicaal vrijuit door slordigheid Justitie’

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Minister of Justice and Security why a radicalised individual was freed due to a procedural error, and whether preventive detention should be introduced. The minister rejected detention, pointed to the new Temporary Act on administrative counter-terrorism measures, and noted a court had found the measures lawful apart from an unclear map annex.
Furthermore, I will not go into (the measures surrounding) individual cases.
Verder ga ik niet in op (de maatregelen rondom) individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Popken en De Graaf over het bericht dat België radicalen op zee gaat opsporen

MPs Popken and De Graaf asked whether the Netherlands applies maritime border and port controls comparable to Belgium's new hunt for radicalised crew on suspicious ships, and whether Dutch controls should be stepped up. The ministers answered that Dutch sea and port controls are comparable, describing the roles of the Kustwacht, ILT, Douane and Marechaussee, and pointed to extra funding for the Marechaussee.
The organisation of sea and port control in the Netherlands and Belgium is comparable.
De inrichting van de controle van de zee en havens in Nederland en België is vergelijkbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Helder en Wilders over een aanranding door een Somalische asielzoeker in Hoorn

PVV MPs asked why a Somali asylum seeker was arrested only months after a sexual assault in Hoorn despite the victim's early tip, why he kept a residence permit while already a suspect, and whether his permit will be revoked. The state secretary explained the DNA-based arrest timeline, said the permit will be reviewed for withdrawal now that the conviction is final, and rejected calls to close borders.
Now that the judgment in this case has become final, the IND will examine whether the residence permit of the person concerned can be withdrawn.
Nu in deze zaak het vonnis onherroepelijk is geworden, zal de IND onderzoeken of de verblijfsvergunning van de betrokkene kan worden ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de arrestatie van klimaatactivisten

MP Özütok (GroenLinks) asked why Fossil Free Culture activists arrested at the Van Gogh Museum were detained for refusing to identify themselves, whether this conflicts with Raad van State case law, and when a promised practice guide for mayors on demonstrations will be ready. The Minister says four unidentified persons were transferred to immigration police and released after an extended holding period without immigration detention, and that the guide is planned for end of year, with refusal to identify not automatically justifying further Vreemdelingenwet measures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat kinderen van zeven jaar slachtoffer zijn van sekschantage

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that seven-year-old children are victims of sextortion, including whether Dutch figures exist, how children and parents are informed, how perpetrators are traced, and whether a response to a Europol report will be sent. The minister answered that sextortion is not registered as a separate phenomenon so no figures can be given, described existing prevention and police efforts, explained the investigation approach, and saw no reason for a policy response to the Europol report.
Sextortion is not registered as a separate phenomenon in police systems. For that reason I cannot give you the requested figures.
Sextortion wordt niet als apart fenomeen in de politiesystemen geregistreerd. Om die reden kan ik u het gevraagde cijfermatige inzicht niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de doorberekening van kosten van toezicht en tuchtrecht aan deurwaarders en schuldenaren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the costs of supervision and disciplinary law for bailiffs and notaries would be passed on to debtors or clients, and why bailiffs get no compensation. The minister answered that the professional bodies decide how to pass costs to members, that the law does not allow charging debtors, and referred back to the parliamentary debate on several figures.
However, I wish to emphasise that the law provides no basis for charging the costs to debtors.
Wel hecht ik er aan te benadrukken dat de wet geen grondslag biedt voor het doorbelasten van de kosten aan de schuldenaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Klassenfoto tijdens Offerfeest kost school 500 euro'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about a report that a court awarded 500 euros in damages to pupils or parents because children missed a school photo during an Islamic feast, and whether the judge should be suspended and such absences banned. The minister confirmed the ruling, declined to act against an independent judge, and refused to end the leave option, citing the Leerplichtwet's exemption for religious obligations available to all faiths.
It is not for me, as Minister of Justice and Security, to intervene in decisions taken by an independent judge.
Het is niet aan mij, als Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie, om te treden in beslissingen genomen door een onafhankelijke rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Engelshoven over het bericht “Nederland langs de mensenrechtenmeetlat”
