An MP asked the Justice and Home Affairs ministers about reports of ethnic profiling by police, including a new anti-profiling code, a handling framework for proactive checks, and an app feature for recording stops. The minister answered that a draft proactive-control framework was tested and will be finalised later this year, and that the MEOS app will allow recording of stops with pilots expected in autumn 2017.
After adoption, the handling framework will be shared with your House.
Na vaststelling zal het handelingskader met uw Kamer worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de afkoop van het regresrecht waardoor letselschadeslachtoffers gedupeerd raken

MPs Van Nispen (SP) asked whether the buyout of the Wmo regress right via the VNG-Verbond van Verzekeraars convenant harms personal injury victims, who may be sent to municipalities first and face delays. The State Secretary replied that regress is a matter between insurer and municipality, that the victim is not affected, that the Gedragscode Behandeling Letselschade is not breached, and that no talks with stakeholders are planned.
Regress takes place in the relationship between insurer and regress claimant.
Regres speelt zich af in de verhouding tussen verzekeraar en regresnemer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Nispen over de mogelijke uitlevering van Saïd C.

MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked why the Netherlands arrested Saïd C. on a Moroccan extradition request, what guarantees Morocco gave on serving any sentence in the Netherlands and on a fair trial, and whether torture concerns and Dutch prosecution were considered. Minister Blok answered that Morocco agreed to transfer enforcement of any sentence to the Netherlands and to Dutch conversion of the sentence, that the request is now for a court to assess, that the minister declines to comment on the individual case, and that the Netherlands does not normally prosecute itself when another state requests extradition.
As is customary in individual cases, I exercise restraint in my statements about the case.
Er past mij, zoals gebruikelijk in individuele gevallen, terughoudendheid in mijn mededelingen over de zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht “Oplichtersnetwerk roofde ongestoord tientallen miljoenen”

An MP asked the Finance and Justice ministers how a network defrauding private investors through investment schemes could operate undetected for years, what victims can recover, and whether the AFM and prosecution have enough resources. The minister answered that prosecution and AFM action were taken in specific cases (Centurion, Hollandsche Wind), that the AFM's powers over exempt offerings are limited, and that enforcement and prevention are adequate, with planned tightening of the exemption threshold.
I cannot provide information on the number of victims and the amount of damage per individual case.
Ik kan geen mededelingen doen over het aantal gedupeerden en de omvang van de schade per individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over het bericht dat er een camera in een toilet in een café is geplaatst

MP Koopmans (VVD) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a camera in a café toilet is permitted, how such private surveillance is enforced, what affected people can do, and whether rules should change. The minister said cameras in toilets go too far and set out conditions for private camera surveillance, that the Data Protection Authority enforces the rules, and that no change to law or enforcement is planned.
A camera in a changing booth, fitting room or toilet goes too far, because people could be filmed undressed.
Een camera in een pashokje, kleedkamer of toilet gaat te ver, omdat mensen dan ontkleed in beeld kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Raak over capaciteitsgebrek bij sporenonderzoek

MPs Van Nispen and Van Raak asked the Minister of Security and Justice what caused the late start of forensic investigation after a fatal armed robbery, how large the capacity shortage is, how often such delays occur, and what measures will prevent staffing problems from hindering evidence collection in serious cases. The minister replied that the police had forensic officers on scene within an hour, that priority goes to the most serious cases with assistance from other units when needed, and pointed to the ongoing personnel reorganisation and recruitment of specialists.
The police information shows that in this case there was no late start to the forensic investigation.
Uit de informatie van de politie blijkt dat er in deze zaak geen sprake is van te laat starten met het sporenonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de berichtgeving dat matchfixing toeneemt in Nederland

An SP MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about expected growth in matchfixing in the Netherlands and how it is being tackled, including reporting channels, police and prosecution capacity, information sharing, and a proposed dedicated criminal law provision. Minister Blok answered that the rise is linked to the growing online gambling market, that a national platform, reporting channels and the upcoming online gambling law are being used, and that prosecutors see no need for a new statutory article.
The Public Prosecution Service does not make statements about ongoing investigations or what prompted them.
Over lopende onderzoeken en wat de aanleiding voor deze onderzoeken is geweest doet het OM geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over de berichtgeving dat matchfixing toeneemt in Nederland

Member Diertens (D66) asked whether current law is sufficient to combat matchfixing, following KNVB calls for stricter rules, and what has been done with the 2013 report's recommendations. The minister replies that existing legislation offers enough prosecution options, refers to earlier answers for the report's recommendations, which led to a national matchfixing platform and sports-side prevention measures, and defers on the international approach.
In my answer to earlier parliamentary questions on matchfixing I indicated that the current legislation offers sufficient possibilities for prosecution.
In mijn antwoord op eerdere Kamervragen over matchfixing heb ik aangegeven dat de huidige wetgeving voldoende mogelijkheden biedt tot vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van Toorenburg over drugsdumpingen en waterkwaliteit

MPs Geurts and Van Toorenburg asked the ministers about rising illegal drug waste dumping and its effects on water quality, enforcement in rural areas and registration. The state secretary confirmed rising recorded dumpings, said they affect wastewater treatment and surface water only occasionally, and described existing cooperation, saying further enforcement measures are sufficient and registration is being improved.
I acknowledge the importance of good registration, both for obtaining a complete picture and for tracing the perpetrators.
Ik erken het belang van goede registratie, zowel ten behoeve van het verkrijgen van een volledig beeld als ten behoeve van het opsporen van de daders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Oostenrijk hekelt Nederlandse aanpak drugsproducenten'

MPs Van Oosten and Dijkstra asked whether Austria's criticism that the Netherlands does too little against underground drug labs is justified, and about clean-up costs, cofinancing of drug-waste dumping and post-related drug trafficking. The minister rejected the claim of Dutch laxity, said the cooperation with Austria functions well, described the dismantling and cost-recovery arrangements, and reported underspending and an ongoing evaluation of the cofinancing scheme.
It has not become clear to the Dutch authorities which requests Austria is referring to in the reporting.
Het is de Nederlandse autoriteiten niet duidelijk geworden op welke verzoeken Oostenrijk in de berichtgeving duidt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat Brabantse criminelen in buitengebieden vrij spel zouden hebben

An MP asked the ministers whether they agreed with researchers that municipal anti-crime action in rural areas of Brabant rarely leads to concrete steps, and about their proposed solutions. The minister said the WODC study shows growing awareness and institutional anchoring but a fragile, information-poor cycle in smaller municipalities, and announced extra funding for RIEC/LIEC, public-private cooperation and support for political office holders while leaving effectiveness of local measures to local authorities.
The assessment of that is primarily a matter for the local authorities.
De beoordeling daarvan is primair aan de lokale autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over OneCoin en OneLife

An MP asked the Finance and Justice ministers about OneLife and OneCoin, a multi-level marketing scheme suspected of being a pyramid game, and whether authorities are investigating it. The Finance Minister answered that virtual currencies fall outside supervision, that the assessment is for regulators, prosecutors and courts, and declined to give participant numbers or confirm ongoing Dutch investigations.
No statements are made about any ongoing investigations in the Netherlands.
Over eventuele lopende onderzoeken in Nederland worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over de slechte aanpak van faillissementsfraude

MPs Van Nispen and Hijink asked the Justice and Finance ministers why so few criminal reports are drawn up for simple bankruptcy fraud, and how enforcement, capacity, cooperation and registry powers could be improved. The Minister denies police neglect, cites the fraud monitor figures, defends the existing measures and cooperation, and promises further information on a study of guarantee schemes for curators.
I do not recognise the picture that the police give too little priority.
Ik herken het beeld, dat de politie te weinig prioriteit geeft, niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over Oekraïne als drugsroute

Two SP MPs asked about a BBC/RTL documentary alleging drug smuggling through Ukraine and corruption among border guards, and what the EU has done about it. The minister answered that anti-corruption efforts have intensified since the Euromaidan, that the EU supports Ukrainian border reform with several million euros, and that the scale of drug flows cannot be reliably estimated.
This is difficult to estimate: Ukrainian data on intercepted drug shipments mainly concern quantities of drugs entering Ukraine.
Dit is moeilijk in te schatten: Oekraïense data over onderschepte drugszendingen zien immers vooral op hoeveelheden drugs die Oekraïne binnenkomen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de rechterlijke uitspraak waarin staat dat het Openbaar Ministerie strafrechtelijk onderzoek moet doen naar de aardbevingsschade die is veroorzaakt door de gaswinning van

An MP asked ministers whether the Public Prosecution Service should investigate Groningen earthquake damage caused by NAM gas extraction, whether the Landelijk Parket should take the case, and whether the Raad van State hearing should be delayed. The government confirmed it would not appeal the Dijk ruling, declined to direct the prosecutor in an individual case, and said it would not further delay the July 2017 Raad van State hearing.
The Minister of Security and Justice may, under the Judiciary Organisation Act, give general and specific instructions on the performance of the Public Prosecution Service's duties and powers.

De Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie kan volgens de Wet op de Rechterlijke Organisatie algemene en bijzondere aanwijzingen geven betreffende de uitvoering van de taken en bevoegdheden van het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de aanslag met een bestelbus op moskeegangers in Londen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the June 2017 van attack on mosque-goers in London, including the government's response, the threat level for places of worship, consultation with Muslim umbrella organisations, the Handreiking Veilige Moskee, and whether more funding for mosque security would be provided. The minister answered that the threat picture is set out in a separate threat report, that regular consultation takes place, that the rejected motions are not adopted while the Recourt motion is treated as policy support, and that local monitoring and contact continue.
For the current threat level I refer to the Terrorism Threat Picture Netherlands that I sent to the House on 23 June 2017.
Voor het actuele dreigingsniveau verwijs ik naar het Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland dat ik 23 juni 2017 naar de kamer stuurde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat het aantal gevallen van ladingdiefstal explosief stijgt

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether cargo theft is rising sharply, whether foreign gangs are responsible, whether thefts occur while trucks are moving, and how police handle reports and cross-border cooperation. The minister answered that Q1 2017 cases were 46 percent above Q1 2016 but 15 percent below Q4 2016, that the police see some foreign perpetrators but mostly Dutch ones, and described a new reporting desk and European cooperation.
In the second quarter of 2017, no further reports have been received in which there is a suspicion that the cargo was already stolen while driving.
In het tweede kwartaal 2017 zijn geen aangiften meer binnengekomen waarbij het vermoeden bestaat dat de lading al rijdend is gestolen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ´Stampvolle stad feest uitbundig’

MP Van Dam (CDA) asked the Justice Minister about fireworks incidents during the Rotterdam celebrations, including a man losing a hand, dangerous explosions near crowds, the categories and penalties for illegal fireworks, enforcement capacity, cross-border smuggling, and combining answers with a promised letter. The minister confirmed the incidents, stated that incident numbers have not risen compared with other years, described penalties (up to six years for storing or supplying heavy fireworks) and enforcement capacity, and said the cross-border measures are being pursued at EU level, though the combined letter could not be produced.
The Public Prosecution Service publishes annually the number of kilos of seized fireworks on its website.
Het Openbaar Ministerie publiceert jaarlijks het aantal kilo's inbeslaggenomen vuurwerk op zijn website
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Graus over boeren in Limburg die drones gaan gebruiken in de strijd tegen criminelen die in hun maisvelden stiekem hennepplantages onderbrengen

PVV MPs Helder and Graus asked whether police helicopter flights to detect cannabis cultivation in Limburg maize fields were stopped for lack of funds, and how farmers would be protected. The Minister replied that flights were halted because detections had been very few, that helicopters can still be used on concrete indications, and that farmers share responsibility for protecting their property.
Because the number of cannabis plantations detected in this way was very small, it was decided to stop these control flights.
Omdat het aantal wietplantages dat op deze wijze werd opgespoord zeer gering was, is besloten te stoppen met deze controlevluchten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Gouda is een onveilige gemeente’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a press report labelling Gouda an unsafe municipality with high burglary rates, asking about police staffing shortfalls, offender origins, recidivism and measures in the justice chain. The minister confirmed the figures, declined to comment on local staffing as it is a matter for the local tripartite, provided local data and recidivism context, and listed existing measures such as the Top60 approach and burglary prevention campaigns.
I therefore do not comment on this specific case.
Over deze specifieke casus doe ik dan ook geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht forse toename boetes voor kleine snelheidsovertredingen

An MP asked why fines for minor speeding offences rose sharply, whether the cause is new speed cameras or more section controls, and how this affects road safety and police credibility. The minister says many factors influence offence numbers, partly points to the abolition of the 4 km/h threshold on 130 km/h roads and more such roads, defends enforcement of small speeding offences, and reports the progressive fines study was sent to parliament.
It is possible that part of the increase is due to the replacement of the digital poles and section controls and part to the expansion of the number of sections where 130 km/h may be driven.

Het is mogelijk dat een deel van de stijging komt door de vervanging van de digitale palen en trajectcontroles en een deel door de uitbreiding van het aantal trajecten waar 130 km/u mag worden gereden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Öztürk, Azarkan en Kuzu over hoe de vrijheid van meningsuiting, de vrijheid van demonstratie en de vrijheid van vereniging zich verhouden tot de openbare orde

MPs Öztürk, Azarkan and Kuzu asked how freedom of expression, assembly and association relate to public order, including the bans on Eritrean and Turkish-minister-linked events, the Rotterdam police handling, and the expulsion of a Turkish minister. The government defended the mayors' powers under the Wet openbare manifestaties, declined to assess the mayors' conduct against human rights treaties (leaving that to courts), and said it could not judge mayoral decisions that fall to municipal councils.
It is for the court to form a judgement on that, if and insofar as such legal questions are submitted to a court in any procedure.
Het is aan de rechter om zich daarover een oordeel te vormen indien en voor zover aan de rechter in enigerlei procedure dergelijke rechtsvragen worden voorgelegd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Ten Broeke over het bericht 'honderden zeeschepen van de radar'

Two VVD MPs asked the Ministers of Justice and Security and of Foreign Affairs about reports that hundreds of ships enter Dutch waters each month after switching off their GPS/AIS signals, and about controls on such vessels. Minister Blok answered that the Coast Guard monitors the North Sea around the clock, cannot confirm the report's claims, uses risk profiling and information-led intervention, and sees no problems with ship registration.
The Coast Guard does not have the research data on which Windward based its conclusions and therefore cannot confirm such a statement.
De Kustwacht beschikt niet over de onderzoeksgegevens waarop Windward haar conclusies heeft gebaseerd en kan derhalve een dergelijke uitspraak niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat de basisteams van de politie ernstig tekortschieten

The MP Helder asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether a report shows serious shortcomings in police basic teams, including a shortage of detectives that leaves petty crime unaddressed, and how this will be fixed. The Minister replies that the report does not conclude there is a severe detective shortage or harm to crime fighting, notes citizens rate the police 6.9, and refers to a separate fuller response.
In the conclusions of the report I therefore see no basis for the above claim.
In de conclusies van het rapport zie ik dan ook geen grondslag voor bovenstaande stellingname.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Oorlog op zee tegen redders vluchtelingen'

MPs Buitenweg and Van Dijk asked whether the Public Prosecution Service knows of Dutch participation in actions against migrant rescue operations in the Mediterranean and whether such actions could be criminal, and about a Libyan coastguard warning-shot incident. The minister answered that no signals of Dutch involvement were received, that prosecution depends on jurisdiction and the national law of the country where acts occur, and that the government will keep raising maritime coordination and human rights with Libya.
I have not received any signals from the Public Prosecution Service that Dutch nationals may be involved in such activities.
Ik heb geen signalen van het openbaar ministerie (OM) ontvangen dat er mogelijk Nederlanders betrokken zijn bij dergelijke activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over voortvluchtige criminelen die geen belasting hoeven te betalen

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked whether fugitive criminals can avoid paying tax in the Netherlands because of the durable-ties residence test, and whether this makes the Netherlands a tax haven for criminals. State Secretary Wiebes replied that residence is assessed on the circumstances, that the court ruling was specific to its facts, that Dutch rules do not differ from other countries, and that he sees no reason to depart from the residence principle for fugitives.
As stated, to my knowledge Dutch tax legislation does not differ in this respect from tax legislation in other countries.
Zoals gezegd wijkt de belastingwetgeving in Nederland in dit opzicht naar mijn weten niet af van de belastingwetgeving in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de slechte kwaliteit van NFI rapporten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about criticism by Van Koppen that NFI forensic reports have recurring quality problems, including unexamined origin of items, unexplained conclusions, deliberately limited answers and hypotheses outside the expert's field. The Minister acknowledges some shortcomings in the cited case, defends the NFI's scope-limited reporting and quality systems, and promises a fuller response to the Nederlands Juristenblad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Groothuizen en Bouali over het bericht dat verdachte schepen niet worden gecontroleerd

MPs Jetten, Groothuizen and Bouali (D66) asked whether ships that switched off their AIS signal or changed identification before entering Dutch waters are being properly checked, and what the consequences for security and enforcement are. The government answers that AIS gaps have many legitimate causes, that the Kustwacht and Douane use risk profiling and treat AIS switch-offs as a risk indicator, that the numbers from Winward cannot be confirmed, and that modernisation and EU cooperation are underway.
The Coast Guard does not have the investigation data on which Winward based its conclusions and therefore cannot confirm the numbers Winward cites.
De Kustwacht beschikt niet over de onderzoekgegevens waarop Winward haar conclusies heeft gebaseerd en kan derhalve de door Winward genoemde aantallen niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het boetebeleid voor onverzekerde auto’s

An MP asked ministers about fines for uninsured cars, including fines after suspension lapses, the legality of indefinite suspension, and debt collection and imprisonment for those unable to pay. The government said suspension is meant to be temporary, described existing prevention measures and a changed approach to imprisonment-for-debt requests, and promised to report back on the outcomes of consultations.
It is not known what the personal motives are of all owners of suspended vehicles in the Netherlands for whether or not to extend the suspension.
Het is niet bekend wat de persoonlijke motieven zijn van alle eigenaren van geschorste voertuigen in Nederland om de schorsing wel of niet te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Ruim 600 agenten nog niet gescreend’

An MP asked the minister about reports that over 600 police officers, including 65 in the highest-category trust positions, had not yet been screened, and about the rising number of officers suspected of crimes. The minister confirmed some officers still await screening, said the number is lower than reported, stated A-screenings are expected to finish around summer 2017, and gave 2016 figures showing 279 police employees suspected in 791 criminal investigations.
The number of employees concerned is lower than stated in the article.
Het aantal medewerker waar het om gaat is lager dan in het artikel wordt gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Politie te ver doorgeslagen’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the police station of the Twente-West basic unit was moved from Rijssen to Nijverdal, on what criteria, and whether this neglects villages without a station. The minister confirmed the reorganisation follows an agreed 2025 housing plan, cited business cases with response times as criteria, and said the local authorities are jointly responsible, without committing to keep multiple active posts open.
In this specific case, the Twente-West police unit, in close consultation with local authorities, is responsible for the choices made regarding housing.
In dit specifieke geval is de politie-eenheid Twente-West in nauw overleg met het lokaal gezag verantwoordelijk voor de gemaakte keuzes inzake de huisvesting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu, Azarkan en Öztürk over het bericht dat er voor de zoveelste keer wordt gediscrimineerd tijdens de sollicitatieprocedure

MPs Kuzu, Azarkan and Öztürk asked ministers about reported job-application discrimination, the College voor de Rechten van de Mens's ruling against Yacht B.V., how such rulings relate to prosecution, whether the College and OM have enough capacity, and whether government contracts and staffing agency oversight should be tightened. The government calls discrimination unacceptable, says the College's equal-treatment track is separate from criminal law, rejects expanding OM capacity and a licensing system for agencies, and points to a study on procurement exclusion and an added Inspectie SZW budget.
On the question of a licensing system for the temporary staffing sector, I am focusing on improving public-private cooperation within the Stichting Normering Arbeid quality mark.
Ten aanzien van de vraag over een vergunningstelsel voor de uitzendbranche zet ik in op verbetering van de publiekprivate samenwerking in het kader van het keurmerk van de Stichting Normering Arbeid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Engelshoven over het bericht dat het NL-alert systeem nog steeds fouten bevat

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reported NL-Alert faults, including a message sent up to eleven times, low reach growth, and delays in the system's rollout. The Minister acknowledged the duplicate transmissions, said Amsterdam is evaluating them, denied any delay or extra cost, and promised a pilot-based report in spring 2018.

The municipality of Amsterdam is carrying out an evaluation of this deployment of NL-Alert and, in consultation with my ministry, is examining which aspects played a role in sending the same message four times.

De gemeente Amsterdam voert een evaluatie uit van deze inzet van NL-Alert en beziet in overleg met mijn ministerie welke aspecten een rol hebben gespeeld bij het viermaal verzenden van hetzelfde bericht.
Antwoord op een vraag van het lid Beckerman over het geld dat de oud-topman van woningcorporatie Rochdale aan de Staat moet betalen

Beckerman (SP) asked how money ordered by the court to be paid by the former Rochdale housing corporation executive and staff could flow back to the tenants and corporation harmed by their mismanagement. The minister explains the money is a criminal confiscation (ontneming) payable to the State, that victims could claim as injured parties or in civil proceedings, and that Rochdale's civil claim is paused because the former director was declared personally bankrupt.
Persons who have suffered direct harm from a criminal offence can join the criminal proceedings as an injured party to obtain compensation.
Personen die rechtstreeks schade hebben geleden door een strafbaar feit kunnen zich voor het verkrijgen van schadevergoeding als benadeelde partij voegen in het strafproces
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Groothuizen over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad dat vergaand onderzoek in smartphones privacy rechten schendt

MPs Groothuizen and Verhoeven asked how the Supreme Court's 4 April 2017 ruling on smartphone searches affects criminal investigations, whether it differs from the Computer Crime III bill, and whether a prompt statutory regime is needed. The minister answered that prosecutor authorisation is now generally required for searching seized phones, that the bill covers remote access rather than seizure, and that existing provisions suffice in most cases while new Code of Criminal Procedure rules are under consultation.

Following the Supreme Court ruling, from 4 April 2017 the main rule in criminal investigations is that, where the police seize independently, examining a seized smartphone or other electronic data carrier requires the prosecutor's authorisation.

Naar aanleiding van het arrest van de Hoge Raad geldt in strafrechtelijke onderzoeken vanaf 4 april 2017 als hoofdregel dat, indien sprake is van zelfstandig beslag door de opsporingsambtenaar, er voor het doen van onderzoek aan een inbeslaggenomen smartphone of andere elektronische gegevensdrager of geautomatiseerd werk, de toestemming van de officier van justitie voor dat onderzoek vereist is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de stijging van het aantal naaktfoto's en filmpjes van jongeren

MP Kuiken asked the Education and Justice ministers about the rise in sexting among youth, the normalisation of the practice, the lack of education on it, and when new sex-crime legislation would arrive. The government replied that schools must teach sexuality and resilience, that new sexting programmes and a barrier model are being developed, that the panel figures are not recognised, and that a bill is expected for consultation in summer 2017.
It is expected that a bill modernising sex-crime legislation will be ready for consultation in the summer of this year.
Naar verwachting zal een wetsvoorstel tot modernisering van de zedenwetgeving in de zomer van dit jaar gereed zijn voor consultatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Bosch en Tellegen over het aanhouden van een veroordeelde terrorist op de vliegbasis Volkel

MPs Van den Bosch and Tellegen (VVD) asked the Defence and Justice ministers how a convicted terrorist gained access to Volkel air base, whether screening was done, why he was released, and whether access rules will be tightened. The government answered only by referring to an earlier letter (Kamerstuk 34 550-X, nr. 91) answering a related request, without giving substantive answers in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Politie slaat door met positieve discriminatie'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a police vacancy text in Amsterdam that excluded native Dutch applicants and was later amended, and whether diversity policy should be abolished. The minister confirmed the vacancy text was discriminatory, said it was revised after the police judged it violated the duty of care, and defended diversity steering as operationally necessary while not addressing abolition of the policy.
Regarding the vacancy text in question, the police judged that it did not meet the duty of care requirement, after which the vacancy text was amended.
Wat de betreffende vacaturetekst betreft, heeft de politie geoordeeld dat hiermee niet werd voldaan aan de zorgvuldigheidseis, waarna de vacaturetekst is aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over het bericht 'Amsterdamse politie wil hoofddoekje toestaan bij uniform'

MPs Helder and De Graaf asked whether the Amsterdam police was considering allowing headscarves as part of the uniform and how this fits with police neutrality rules and diversity policy. The minister said the police adheres to the lifestyle-neutrality code, that no concrete plan exists, that diversity policy does not override rules, and that he sees no reason to deviate from the code.
There was no concrete proposal or plan regarding this subject.
Er was geen concreet voorstel of plan met betrekking tot dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat het Openbaar Ministerie verdachte transacties bij een trustkantoor onderzoekt

An SP MP asked the Ministers of Finance and Justice about reports that the Public Prosecution Service is investigating suspicious transactions at trust office BK Group, and about sanctions compliance, integrity, supervision capacity and related leaks. The Minister replied that trust offices must freeze assets of sanctioned persons and report to DNB, that a tightened trust-office supervision bill is planned, and that ongoing investigations cannot be commented on.
With the draft bill for a Trust Offices Supervision Act 2018, the aim is to make the regulatory framework for trust offices stricter.
Met het concept wetvoorstel voor een Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018 wordt beoogd het regelgevend kader voor trustkantoren strenger te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het bericht 'Voortvluchtige criminelen ontlopen gevangenisstraf'

An MP asked why criminals can escape prison sentences through execution limitation periods, whether limitation should be interrupted when offenders evade enforcement, and how those who ignore summons to report to prison are treated. The State Secretary defended the current limitation system, noting interruption rules and that most custodial enforcement occurs early in the period, and explained that non-reporting offenders are arrested and placed in a stricter regime.
I therefore consider the current limitation system valid and am currently focusing on improving enforcement of sentences.
Daarmee vind ik dat het stelsel van huidige verjaringstermijnen valide is en zet ik op dit moment in op de verbetering van de tenuitvoerlegging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het meewerken aan illegaal commercieel draagmoederschap uit Cambodja door de Nederlandse ambassade

An SGP MP asked ministers whether the Dutch embassy in Cambodia assisted in bringing a baby from an allegedly illegal commercial surrogacy arrangement to the Netherlands, and raised questions about surrogacy policy, nationality recognition, and possible extradition. The minister answered that the embassy only accepts passport applications under Dutch law, defers the broader policy question on surrogacy to a future cabinet, and says it is for foreign authorities to act on illegal conduct abroad.
A decision on following up the Staatscommissie's recommendations, including those on surrogacy, I gladly leave, in light of this, to a next cabinet.
Een beslissing over de opvolging van de aanbevelingen van de Staatscommissie, waaronder die over draagmoederschap, laat ik mede in dat licht graag aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Jetten over het boetebeleid voor onverzekerde auto’s die buiten gebruik zijn

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about stacking fines for uninsured cars that are no longer used and about the RDW's approach to uninsured vehicles. The minister defended the fines as a deterrent, pointed to preventive measures and a pilot, and said the progressive fine system, including moving enforcement to criminal law, is under review.
It is not recorded whether the vehicles fined for breaching Article 30(2) of the Wam are no longer on the road.
Er wordt niet bijgehouden of de voertuigen waarvoor een boete wordt opgelegd wegens overtreding van artikel 30, tweede lid van de Wam niet meer op de weg komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de zorgelijke ontwikkelingen binnen de rechterlijke macht in Polen

An SP MP asked the government about the erosion of judicial independence in Poland and what further action it would take. The government answered that it monitors developments closely, will keep pursuing multiple channels (EU, Council of Europe, UN, bilateral), and cites mutual trust in judicial decisions and ongoing dialogue with the Commission as its approach.
The cabinet is aware of developments in Poland, follows them closely and with concern.
Het kabinet is op de hoogte van de ontwikkelingen in Polen, volgt die op de voet en met zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het tot staatsgeheim verklaren van de aantekeningen van een officier van justitie in een strafdossier

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the prosecutor's daily notes in the Sharleyne child death case were classified as state secret, and whether such notes are always classified. The minister refers to earlier answers and states that the OM is revising its procedures for autopsy and that a letter on relatives' access to case files will be sent before the summer recess.
For answering questions 1 through 5, I refer to the answers to the questions from MP Helder (PVV), submitted on 21 April 2017.
Voor de beantwoording van de vragen 1 tot en met 5 verwijs ik naar de beantwoording van de vragen van het lid Helder (PVV), ingezonden op 21 april 2017
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ’Wat is er staatsgeheim aan de dood van de 8-jarige Sharleyne?'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about press reports that a public prosecution office classified documents in the Sharleyne death investigation as state secret, and why the father was refused access under the Wob. The minister answered that the refused OM-journaal was an internal quality tool, that the state-secret reference was an error from placing it in a classified ICT environment, and that the father's access rights were not violated.
The OM Noord-Nederland additionally referred to the circumstance that the document would have been classified as a state secret.
Het OM Noord-Nederland heeft daarbij ten overvloede verwezen naar de omstandigheid dat het betreffende document zou zijn gerubriceerd als staatsgeheim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de vraag of de wet iemand verplicht de hypotheekrenteaftrek te gebruiken of niet

Omtzigt (CDA) asks whether the law obliges taxpayers to claim mortgage interest deduction, whether a net tax increase can arise for small mortgages, and how the Hillen rule and the 2013 letter should be read. State Secretary Wiebes answers that the rules are unchanged, that claiming deductions is effectively mandatory for correct returns, and that the 2013 letter's passage was unclear, though the law will be applied as written.
It has come to my attention that the passage in the letter of 11 November 2013 is being read as a standalone choice to claim or not claim interest and costs as deductions.
Antwoord 5 Mij is gebleken dat de passage in de brief van 11 november 2013 5 wordt uitgelegd als een losstaande keuze om rente en kosten al dan niet in aftrek te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Arissen over de vorming van de ‘Stichting Aanmoedigingsfonds van de Koninklijke Facultatieve’

MPs Van Raan and Arissen asked whether a cremation association's transfer of about 17 million euros to a charitable foundation run by the same board was proper, and whether independent investigation, prosecutorial action or a supervisory protocol is warranted. The government declined to assess the facts, saying private associations are outside its remit, pointed to members' civil-law remedies and to the pending bill on governance of legal entities, and refused to instruct the prosecutor.
The cabinet has no involvement in the ownership and business transactions of individual private companies and organisations.
Het kabinet heeft geen bemoeienis met het eigenaarschap en de zakelijke transacties van afzonderlijke private ondernemingen en organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht: 'Stille tocht voor Israël in Rotterdam niet toegestaan'

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked why a silent march supporting Israel in Rotterdam was not permitted while a conference they linked to Hamas was. The minister replied that freedom of assembly is constitutionally protected, a ban requires a concrete risk assessment, and the mayor of Rotterdam is responsible for public order, so he declined to intervene.
I do not intervene in the mayor's powers.
Ik treed niet in de bevoegdheid van de burgemeester.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een cocaïnebaron die zijn enkelband sloopt en vlucht

An MP asks why a convicted cocaine trafficker who fled after removing his ankle monitor was allowed to await trial under electronic monitoring, and whether the monitor should be abolished. The minister acknowledges the frustration, says the suspect is being actively sought, states that the court independently decided to suspend detention, and rejects abolishing the monitor as disproportionate.
Whether or not to suspend pre-trial detention is, however, a decision of the independent judge.
Het wel of niet schorsen van de voorlopige hechtenis is echter een beslissing van de onafhankelijke rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht “cocaïnebaron knipt enkelband door en vlucht”

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that a cocaine trafficker cut his ankle monitor and fled, including when the authorities learned of it, how the tag was defeated, how often tags are removed, and whether suspects of serious crime should be held in custody instead of at home with a tag. The Minister answered that police and prosecutors were notified in November 2016 and that a search was started, that 35 tags out of about 2,700 wearers were deliberately removed since early 2016, that the tag remains an effective instrument, and that the independent judge decided against the prosecution and advisory position, referring to earlier answers and a letter to parliament for the rest.
Because of future investigative interests, I cannot make further statements about specific investigative actions.
Vanwege toekomstige opsporingsbelangen kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over concrete opsporingshandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht ‘Overheid moet oog hebben voor shariarecht’

PVV MPs asked whether the government should resist sharia influence, given a university chair studying good parts of sharia law, and asked who funds it. The minister answered that Dutch public order limits foreign law and that existing private international law rules are sufficient, without naming the chair's funder in detail.
The application of foreign law in the Netherlands and the recognition of legal facts or relationships established abroad always find their limit in Dutch public order.

De toepassing van buitenlands recht in Nederland en de erkenning van in het buitenland tot stand gekomen rechtsfeiten of rechtsverhoudingen vinden echter altijd hun grens in de Nederlandse openbare orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de opstelling van verzekeraars bij letselschade verhardt

An SP MP asks the Justice Minister whether insurers are increasingly rejecting injury claims and stalling settlements, and whether the industry Gedragscode Behandeling Letselschade (GBL) is effective, evaluated, enforceable, and should be made statutory. The minister replies that the code is working: 91% of claims settle within two years, audits were positive, sanctions and complaint routes exist, and he sees no added value in legislating the code, though he will raise a TV investigation with the Letselschaderaad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over het achterblijven van het bestrijden van witwassen

Two SP MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers why the Netherlands lags internationally on combating money-laundering risks, including ING and trust office cases, Panama Papers follow-up, capital controls, UBO and shareholder registers, and Algemene Rekenkamer recommendations. The minister responded at length, largely describing existing supervision, risk-based rules, DNB/AFM enforcement and planned monitors, while disputing the claim that financial institutions take due diligence insufficiently seriously and declining to comment on individual institutions due to confidentiality.
Due to the statutory duty of confidentiality, DNB cannot make further statements about individual institutions under its supervision.
In verband met de wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht kan DNB geen verdere uitspraken doen over individuele instellingen onder haar toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz-Zegerius over de website 'Alt Rechts' (altrechts.com) waar opgeroepen wordt om personen en organisaties op te geven die zich 'volksvijandig' zouden opstellen

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the website Alt Rechts, which listed Jews and 'enemies of the people' and allegedly incited discrimination, and whether complaints and prosecution were possible. The minister confirmed the site was taken offline, that a criminal investigation led by the Oost-Nederland prosecutor's office is underway, that no complaints had been filed, and set out the maximum penalties for discrimination, incitement, defamation and slander.
This will have to become clear from the criminal investigation being carried out under the direction of the Oost-Nederland prosecutor's office.
Dit zal moeten blijken uit het strafrechtelijk onderzoek dat wordt uitgevoerd onder leiding van het parket Oost-Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de onafhankelijkheid van deurwaarders en de verwevenheid met incassobureaus

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of infighting among bailiffs over competition rules and whether bailiff offices partly owned by debt collection agencies, which also receive their assignments from those agencies, breach the independence regulation. The Minister said the regulation applies to all bailiffs and must be enforced, that the KBvG will prepare a new regulation, that the BFT supervises compliance, and that the KBvG is expected to fulfil its enforcement role.
Naturally, an unequal playing field due to incomplete enforcement must be prevented.
Vanzelfsprekend dient een ongelijk speelveld door onvolkomen handhaving te worden voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over verhandelbare spionagesoftware en de persoonlijke levenssfeer

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about privately traded spyware, its use against citizens and companies, oversight of spyshops, and protection of privacy. The minister said private spyware is not illegal in itself, pointed to prevention and awareness efforts and to the GDPR from May 2018, and could not guarantee protection against spyware on smartphones.
Ik kan die zekerheid niet bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Azarkan over de rellen in Rotterdam van 7 mei 2017

MPs Kuzu and Azarkan asked the Justice Minister about the 7 May 2017 Rotterdam riots after Feyenoord's loss, including prosecution, the mayor's enforcement choices compared with other demonstrations, and integration. The minister condemned the rioters, said prosecution is ongoing, and stated that public order enforcement is a matter for the local mayor and council.
Policy on this and its implementation is tailored and a matter for local authorities.
Het beleid ten aanzien hiervan en de uitvoering daarvan is maatwerk en aan het lokale gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat de Koninklijke Marechaussee bij Rotterdam The Hague Airport discrimineert

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Security and Defence about an Ombudsman finding that the Marechaussee at Rotterdam The Hague Airport discriminates, asking whether there are more signals, what is done to prevent ethnic profiling, and whether objective criteria for checks are needed. The government reports ten complaints since 2014, sees no reason for further investigation, states non-discrimination is the starting point and profiles are used with objective indicators, and says the KMar continually reviews its criteria.
These profiles are confidential and are used internally.
Deze profielen zijn vertrouwelijk en worden intern gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over invallen bij thuiskwekers

An SP MP asked the Justice and Health ministers whether reported police raids on home cannabis growers were proportionate, how raid and eviction decisions are made, and whether medical use and personal circumstances such as a child with autism are weighed. The Minister answered that the reported accounts were partly incorrect, that such decisions are local discretionary assessments under the Damocles policy and Article 4:84 Awb, and that no central guideline weighs medical use or personal circumstances.
There is no central guideline for weighing whether and how personal circumstances factor into decisions on police raids and evictions at cannabis plantations.
Er is geen centrale richtlijn voor de weging of en hoe persoonlijke omstandigheden meewegen in besluiten bij invallen en ontruimingen van wietplantages door de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over stroperij met honden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary and Justice Minister about greyhound-based poaching: what happens to seized dogs, penalties for poachers, whether such cases are rising, and whether enforcement capacity in rural areas is adequate. The government answered that seized dogs are usually rehomed at the discretion of the Public Prosecution Service or a judge, that poaching is punishable under nature protection law, that no central registration of poachers exists, and that enforcement capacity is considered sufficient.
No central registration is kept of the number of apprehended poachers.
Er wordt geen centrale registratie bijgehouden van het aantal gepakte stropers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Markuszower en Wilders over misstanden in het Zuiderparkbad

MPs from the PVV asked the ministers about reported assaults, harassment and vandalism at the Zuiderparkbad in The Hague, including the ethnicity of perpetrators, whether they should be punished harshly, what has been done and whether national measures would be taken. The minister answered that the matter is a local responsibility, that the municipality has introduced security measures and a review is underway, and that prosecution is for the public prosecutor to decide.
Enforcing order and rules in swimming pools is a local matter.
De handhaving van de orde en regels in zwembaden is een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een schietincident in Irak in 2004

An MP asked the Justice and Defence ministers whether the Public Prosecution Service decided not to prosecute a Dutch soldier before all evidence on a 2004 Iraq shooting was gathered, whether it withheld statements, and how the minister views the claim that the OM misled the court. The minister declined substantive answers, citing a pending Article 12 Sv complaint procedure, judicial independence, privacy and investigative interests.
A procedure under Article 12 of the Code of Criminal Procedure is currently ongoing on this matter.
Over deze aangelegenheid loopt momenteel een procedure ex artikel 12 Wetboek van strafvordering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Ten Broeke , Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Grashoff en Voordewind over schandalige intimidatiepraktijken en misleiding door Turkije

Six MPs asked the government about reported intimidation of Turkish-Dutch citizens and a Rotterdam CDA councillor by Turkish consular officials, whether the consul misled Dutch authorities, and whether the consul should be expelled. The government answered by referring the MPs to a separate letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 34 824, nr. 195) on the ministerial campaign visits and the events of 11 March 2017, without answering the questions in the reply itself.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat voorlopige hechtenis vaak onvoldoende wordt onderbouwd

Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister of Justice and Security how he would respond to a Human Rights Board study finding that pre-trial detention orders are often poorly reasoned, what safeguards apply under European and international law, whether there is uniform practice on motivation, and what steps will improve reasoning. The Minister replied that the judiciary is implementing professional standards to improve reasoning, that the Dutch practice does not clearly violate European case law, and that a bill on alternatives to pre-trial detention has been submitted for advice.
The study by the Human Rights Board makes clear that decisions to impose pre-trial detention by judges are often still insufficiently reasoned (in writing).
Het onderzoek van het CRM maakt duidelijk dat beslissingen tot het opleggen van voorlopige hechtenis door rechters vaak nog onvoldoende (schriftelijk) worden onderbouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de knelpunten bij het afpakken van crimineel vermogen

An SP MP asked the Justice and Finance ministers about obstacles to confiscating criminal assets, including a financial investigator's alarm, Tax Authority–prosecution cooperation, bank secrecy abroad, notary and lawyer privilege, and slow mutual legal assistance. Minister Blok rejects the picture of a poorly functioning system, points to new cooperation arrangements and planned reports, and promises a letter before summer on cooperation outside Europe.
I do not recognise the picture the report creates that the confiscation of criminal assets is in a poor state in the Netherlands.
Het beeld dat het bericht oproept dat het in Nederland slecht is gesteld met het afpakken van crimineel vermogen herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Fritsma over de berichten 'Cijfers onder de pet' en 'Stempel nationale veiligheid excuus'

PVV MPs asked why police refused to share data on crimes by asylum seekers after a Telegraaf FOIA request, and whether this undermines police and mayors' information. The minister says the police initially interpreted the request narrowly, is re-assessing it with priority, and that information is shared with local authorities though no separate registration of asylum seekers' crimes exists.
In response to the Telegraaf's FOIA request, the police replied that they do not record the residence status of persons when arresting or stopping them.
Op het WOB-verzoek van de Telegraaf heeft de politie geantwoord dat zij bij aanhoudingen en staandehoudingen de verblijfstatus van betrokkenen niet registreert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Van Dam over het bericht ´Politie bood zwijgdeal’

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a Telegraaf report that police offered a 'silence deal' on data about asylum seekers and criminal suspects, and about how many asylum seekers and status holders came into contact with criminal law in 2014-2016. The minister denied any silence deal, said police do not routinely record residence status and that a WOB request is being reassessed, and provided 2015-2016 figures while admitting 2014 figures were not available.
On which analyses and/or monitors are or are not kept in which units, I will inform the House after the WOB request has been processed.
Over de vraag welke analyses en/of monitors in welke eenheden nu wel of niet worden bijgehouden zal ik uw Kamer informeren nadat het wob-verzoek is afgehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het bedonderen van ontevreden huurders in Groningen

MPs asked whether it is acceptable that legal advisers are paid by landlords not to take on tenant cases, and how the government will prevent this and protect tenants' access to the Huurcommissie. The minister said such contracts are disapproved of but depend on the case and are for courts to judge, that the Huurcommissie is accessible without legal aid, and that the number of such contracts is unknown.
In principle, citizens and businesses are free to decide with whom they enter into an agreement, when they do so, and what the content of the agreement is.
Het staat burgers en bedrijven in beginsel vrij om zelf te bepalen met wie zij een overeenkomst aangaan, op welk moment zij dat doen en om te bepalen wat de inhoud van de overeenkomst is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de registratie van levenloos geboren kinderen in de basisregistratie personen (BRP)

MP Bergkamp asked the ministers about progress on ICT changes and legal amendments needed to register stillborn children in the BRP, following a petition and a prior letter. Minister Plasterk answered that a recalibration of Operatie BRP revealed major delays and costs, and he will inform the Chamber after receiving a BIT advisory report and deliberating on the matter.
I can therefore only inform you of the manner and timing of registering stillborn children after that.
Ik kan u derhalve pas daarna informeren over de wijze en het moment van registreren van levenloos geboren kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over gokcriminelen in het betaald voetbal

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about illegal gambling syndicates influencing Dutch professional football, including a press report on a footballer drawn into gambling and the status of the Feniks investigation. The minister answered that the Feniks investigation is complete, no players or officials are suspected of match-fixing in a related case, and the KNVB has taken prevention measures.
The criminal investigation Feniks has been concluded.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek Feniks is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over het bericht dat de politie aangiftes van huwelijkse gevangenschap niet in behandeling neemt

MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked whether the government would look into police refusing to record complaints of forced marriage and polygamy, and how many such complaints exist, and whether the government would act further. The minister declined to comment on the individual case citing the ongoing investigation, said the registration cannot separate forced-marriage complaints, pointed to existing expertise bodies, and saw no concrete reason for additional measures.
This concerns an individual case. Caution is required here, in the interest of the investigation and the protection of the privacy of the person concerned.
Het betreft hier een individuele zaak. Hiermee dient terughoudend te worden omgegaan, in het belang van het onderzoek en bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de betrokkene.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Wapenhandelaar vrijuit na bedreiging burgemeester Gilze en Rijen’

MP Van Toorenburg asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the prosecution of a suspect who threatened a mayor, civil servants and a police officer was dropped, why the victims were not informed in time, and whether the minister will consult the prosecution service. The minister answered that the prosecution service had asked the court to end the case because of the suspect's convictions in other cases, that the court declared the request inadmissible so prosecution will proceed, that the victims were not informed in time and the prosecution service apologised, and that no policy change is needed.
The prosecution service regrets this course of events and has offered its apologies for it.
Het OM betreurt deze gang van zaken en heeft hiervoor zijn excuses aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de vondst van een dood en ernstig verwaarloosd paard in Deurne (Noord-Brabant)

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a dead, severely neglected horse found on a Brabant family's land, whether the family's ongoing animal-keeping is responsible, whether animal health is monitored, whether a standalone keeping ban could help, and why the promised policy letter on it has been delayed. The minister answers that the matter is for the courts, describes the inspection bodies and their enforcement powers without disclosing visit counts, says a keeping ban could help depending on the case, and promises to inform parliament before the summer recess.
I will inform the House before the summer recess.
Ik infomeer uw Kamer voor het zomerreces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de verkoop van lockpick guns

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the online sale of lockpick guns to burglars and how this fits with the government's burglary prevention campaign, and whether the free sale would be stopped. The minister shares concern about misuse, says current law (model APV and criminal preparation offences) already allows sanctions, and notes a planned bill extending the offence of burglary preparation.
Current legislation provides sufficient means to sanction the preparation of a burglary involving this kind of equipment.
Huidige wetgeving biedt voldoende mogelijkheden om de voorbereiding van een woninginbraak, waarbij gebruik gemaakt wordt van dit soort apparatuur, te sanctioneren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de bevoegdheid van de burgemeester om een huis te sluiten

MP Kuiken asked whether a mayor should be able to close a home when its occupation causes public order disturbance, and whether the law should be amended after the Echt-Susteren Bandidos case, where the Council of State ruled the closure unlawful. Minister Blok defended the mayor's efforts, said the closure power under Article 174a Municipal Act is narrow due to fundamental rights and that other measures were available, and declined to propose a legislative change.
From my answers to questions 2 to 5 it follows that I am not considering a legislative amendment following this case.
Uit mijn antwoorden op vraag 2 t/m 5 blijkt dat ik naar aanleiding van deze casus geen wetswijziging overweeg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Swinkels over de kwaliteit van dienstverlening door rechtsbijstandverzekeraars

MPs Swinkels asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the quality of legal aid insurers' services, citing a 2012 WODC report and a TROS-Radar broadcast suggesting problems persist, and whether statutory rules like Germany and France should apply. The minister answered that Kifid now handles complaints about legal aid insurance, that existing financial supervision and self-regulation suffice, and that no change in oversight or statutory quality rules is warranted.
I therefore do not consider it appropriate at present to compare the situation in the Netherlands with the situation in France and Germany.
Ik acht het thans dan ook niet geboden om de situatie in Nederland met de situatie in Frankrijk en Duitsland te vergelijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de verkoop van browsergegevens

An SP MP asked ministers whether the US Congress's repeal of FCC broadband privacy rules, allowing internet providers to sell browsing data without consent, affects Dutch and European users, and what the EU framework (GDPR, ePrivacy) and EU action can do to prevent resale of European browsing data. The minister declined to judge the US decision, said the effects on Europeans are hard to predict, pointed to EU rules (GDPR from May 2018, ePrivacy under revision) as adequate safeguards, and said the Commission, not ministers, initiates legislation and a similar EU proposal is unlikely.
It is up to the European Commission and not to ministers to draft and submit proposals to amend the regulations.
Het is aan de Europese Commissie en niet aan ministers om voorstellen voor wijziging van de regelgeving op te stellen en in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Kent over werknemersbelangen bij flitsfaillissementen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Kent asked how the government will protect employee interests in 'flash bankruptcies' (pre-pack restructurings), in light of an Advocate-General's opinion on the EU Business Transfer Directive and the Estro case. The minister answered that the opinion is non-binding, the CJEU ruling is awaited, the matter will be discussed with social partners in the WCO III preparations, and he will report back in a summer progress letter.

I am certainly willing to keep your House informed and propose that I will update you in the next progress letter on the bankruptcy law recalibration programme, due in the summer, on the state of affairs.

Ik ben zeker bereid uw Kamer op de hoogte te houden en stel voor dat ik u in de eerst volgende voortgangsbrief in het kader van het programma herijking van het faillissementsrecht die in de zomer zal uitkomen, in zal lichten over de stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het aftreden van de directeur van het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about interim findings of a culture investigation at the Netherlands Forensic Institute, the reasons for the director's resignation, why he was asked to stay on with full mandate, the unlawful procurement and the dismissal of procurement staff. The minister answered that the final report is due in May, the director resigned on personal grounds, he retains full mandate, the unlawful spending is itemised, and two staff were declared redundant but not dismissed, with measures taken since.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht magere score voor politie in de buurt

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a news report that residents of South Limburg are the least satisfied with local police, and about drug-related nuisance, the number of neighbourhood officers, and measures to raise satisfaction. The minister confirmed the low regional score, said the cause is not clear from the data, pointed to a target of 97% neighbourhood officer staffing by end 2017, and answered the measures question only in general terms.
However, the results do not show what makes one region score higher than another.
Uit de uitkomsten is echter niet op te maken wat maakt dat de ene regio hoger scoort dan de andere.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koolmees over het bericht dat aankoopmakelaars de woningmarkt in hun greep hebben

An MP asks whether buyer's agents (aankoopmakelaars) hold the housing market in a grip through opaque fees, early knowledge of listings, refusal of buyers without an agent, and percentage-based commissions. The minister acknowledges opacity, calls for transparency, flags an information advantage the ACM is looking at, finds refusing buyers without an agent undesirable but notes no structural exclusion, and says percentage fees are not prohibited but may create a slight incentive.
I have no insight into the extent to which this happens and what it means for the position of the client in the purchase process.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de mate waarin dit gebeurt en wat dit betekent voor de positie van de klant in het koopproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over uitbreiding trajectcontroles naar de Provinciale wegen

Visser (VVD) asked the ministers about extending average-speed (trajectory) controls to provincial roads, including pilot results, selection criteria and the role of parliament. The minister answered that 15-20 N-road locations are being assessed by the OM, police and road managers, that provinces are responsible for road safety and that parliament has no formal role beyond its oversight of national policy.
Beyond its supervisory role over national policy, I see no role for the House here, since road safety on provincial roads is a responsibility of the provinces.
Buiten haar controlerende taak op het rijksbeleid zie ik hier geen rol weggelegd voor de Kamer, aangezien de verkeersveiligheid op provinciale wegen een verantwoordelijkheid van de provincies is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over onvoldoende middelen en capaciteit bij het Expertisebureau Online Kindermisbruik

An SP member asked the Justice and Health ministers about insufficient funding and capacity at the Expertise Bureau Online Child Abuse (EOKM), including police follow-up on Tor reports, proactive search powers, hosting provider takedown, sexting and sextortion support, Stop It Now funding and child sex tourism campaigns. The minister answered that current funding is considered adequate for now, that the police handle reports through a prioritisation process, that the EOKM has no investigative powers, and that other initiatives and funding decisions are being reviewed.
I will await this plan before entering further discussions with the EOKM about its future intentions.
Ik wacht dit plan af alvorens met het EOKM verder in gesprek te gaan over hun toekomstige voornemens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de handelwijze van een oud-rechter en de Raad voor de rechtspraak

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice about a 2006 Raad voor de rechtspraak statement on a former judge's conduct, which a court now says must be rectified, and whether the judge's legal costs should be reimbursed. The Minister declined substantive comment while the case is pending, stating the Raad decides on cost recovery once the ruling is final.
Given the state of the procedure, I refrain from a substantive response.
Gelet op deze stand van de procedure onthoud ik mij van een inhoudelijke reactie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat er steeds meer meldingen en materiaal van kinderporno boven water komen

MP Bergkamp asked the Minister of Security and Justice about rising reports of child pornography online, including the causes of a 60% rise since 2015, whether police and prosecution have enough capacity, the state of international cooperation, and the conviction rate from police reports. The minister answered that reports rose mainly due to growing internet use and better detection, that capacity is under review with results promised in a summer progress report, that international cooperation works satisfactorily, and that the conviction percentage cannot be extracted from police systems.
I will report the outcomes to you in the next progress report on child pornography this summer.
Over de uitkomsten daarvan zal ik u in de eerstvolgende voortgangsrapportage kinderporno van deze zomer berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over bestrijding van machtige internationaal opererende criminele organisaties

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a television report on combating the Italian mafia and whether the Cerca Trova report was released late, and the minister answered that the report was sent to parliament, found mafia activity in drugs and property crime but no corrupting influence on politics or government, and that cooperation with Italy and Europol is being strengthened. The answers are substantive and mostly responsive, with a commitment to set up a support facility and intensified operational cooperation.

I share the view that the Dutch government, in cooperation with European and international partners, must prevent foreign criminal groups, including the Italian mafia, from carrying out their practices in the Netherlands.

Ik deel de mening dat de Nederlandse overheid in samenwerking met Europese en internationale partners moet voorkomen dat buitenlandse misdaadgroepen, waaronder de Italiaanse maffia, hun praktijken in Nederland ontplooien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Futselaar over het bericht dat de politie weer niet op tijd is bij spoedmeldingen

MPs Van Raak and Futselaar asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether, after reports that police again missed response-time targets for urgent calls, the government still stood by its earlier claim that safety in rural areas had improved and whether it would act to restore capacity. Minister Blok answered that response times are broadly stable nationally, that the targets are not yet met in rural areas for structural reasons, that local optimisation is ongoing, and that bureaus are closed only in consultation with local authorities and vehicle capacity is not being cut.
There are sufficient police vehicles available and no savings are being made on them.
Er zijn voldoende politievoertuigen beschikbaar en hier wordt niet op bezuinigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het feit dat voor de zoveelste keer een zelfmoord wordt gepleegd ten gevolge van sexting

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the ministers about a suicide linked to sexting and bullying, asking about school responsibility, investigation, victim support, internet providers, the Dutch Data Protection Authority budget, the Kindertelefoon, and legal action. The state secretary answered that school anti-bullying duties and sexting education exist, that a police investigation is ongoing, and that IP-address identification is increasingly unreliable, while stating that bullying itself is not a crime.
The police are currently investigating this case both online and offline.
De politie is op dit moment zowel online als offline bezig met een onderzoek naar deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Jeugdbendes veroorzaken megaschade”

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a press report on youth gangs causing large damage, whether the promise to remove youth gangs from the streets was kept, whether parents should be held liable, and whether dual-nationality offenders can lose Dutch nationality. The minister answers that the integrated approach has reduced problematic youth groups by 18%, explains parental civil liability by age, and states that the Rijkswet does not allow revoking nationality for ordinary crimes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het aftreden van de directeur van het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the NFI director resigned voluntarily or under ministry pressure, how the decision came about, what role the ongoing culture investigation played, and whether procurement problems threaten material shortages. The minister answered that the director resigned on her own initiative, that interim findings were only presented orally and will not be sent to parliament, and that procurement irregularities are being addressed through reinforced teams and process changes.
There is no written report with interim results.
Er is geen schriftelijke rapportage met tussentijdse resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanstaande Hamas-conferentie in Rotterdam

Two MPs asked the Justice and Home Affairs ministers whether a Palestinian conference in Rotterdam organised by the Palestinian Return Centre, alleged to be linked to Hamas, should be stopped, and whether the mayor should be pressed to cancel it. The minister replied that the conference was not established as Hamas-organised, that no threat or legal breach was indicated, that public order lies with the municipality, and that action would follow if laws were broken.
However, from the information known to us it cannot be concluded that the conference in Rotterdam is organised by Hamas, so there is also no reason to exclude the organisation of the conference.

Uit de bij ons bekende informatie kan echter niet geconcludeerd worden dat de conferentie in Rotterdam georganiseerd wordt door Hamas, waardoor er ook geen reden is om de organisatie van de conferentie te weren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de conferentie georganiseerd door een aan Hamas verbonden organisatie in Rotterdam

An MP asked the ministers whether a Rotterdam conference organised by a Palestinian Return Centre, allegedly linked to Hamas, should be banned, and about its links, funding and ECOSOC status. The government answered that it cannot be concluded from known information that Hamas organises the conference, that funding of terrorism is monitored via FIU-NL, and that banning would require a threat to public order, which is not present.
From the information known to us, it cannot be concluded that the conference in Rotterdam is organised by Hamas.
Uit de bij ons bekende informatie kan niet geconcludeerd worden dat de conferentie in Rotterdam georganiseerd wordt door Hamas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het groot tekort aan rechters

An SP MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about a reported shortage of about 227 judges, citing court presidents' projections of deficits in 2017 and 2018, the difficulty of recruiting qualified candidates, and open vacancies. The Minister answers that the Judiciary reports capacity expansion rather than a shortage, acknowledges training takes time, cites intensified recruitment and about 150 extra posts over three years, and sees no reason for a separate meeting with the Judiciary council.
There is an expansion of capacity that will lead to shorter processing times, better quality for those seeking justice, and lower workload for judges.
Er is sprake van uitbreiding van capaciteit die zal leiden tot kortere doorlooptijden, betere kwaliteit voor de rechtzoekende en lagere werkdruk voor de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Van Laar over de dood van een agent op Bonaire

MPs Recourt and Van Laar asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Interior Affairs about the 2016 shooting death of a police officer on Bonaire, its impact on the force, and whether insurance and employer benefits differ between locally recruited and seconded officers. The Minister acknowledged the death and its effects, confirmed that terms of employment and employer arrangements differ for Caribbean Netherlands civil servants, and said a suitable employer provision for death in service is being examined.
Currently it is being examined how a suitable employer provision in case of death from a service accident can be created for (all) civil servants in the Caribbean part of the Netherlands.

Op dit moment wordt bezien op welke wijze een passende werkgeversvoorziening bij overlijden door een dienstongeval voor (alle) rijksambtenaren in het Caribisch deel van Nederland kan worden gecreëerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over de gang van zaken in de nasleep van de moord op drie vrouwen in Parijs

The MPs Gesthuizen and Van Bommel asked whether Dutch authorities knew that suspect Ömer Güney had died, what information was exchanged with France and Turkey about the Paris murders, whether he was a Turkish infiltrant, and how information misuse can be prevented. The government answered that it did not know of his death until media reports, declined to discuss the information exchange or the French indictment, said it had no information about an infiltrant, and deflected questions on Turkish use of shared information.
I do not make statements about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over subsidieverlening aan organisaties voor slachtoffers van seksueel misbruik in de kerk

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about the resignation of KLOKK's supervisory board, the salary and spending of KLOKK's director, the handling of sub-funding to MCU, and the continuation of grant support. The government replied that the board resigned on its own choice over a disrupted relationship with the executive board, that the director's pay is set by the supervisory board, that remaining improvement points are being followed up, and that the grant will not be renewed after 2017 and disbursement was paused.
