However, it is for the Supervisory Board, in its role as employer of the director, to set the director's employment conditions.
Het is evenwel aan de Raad van Toezicht, in de rol van werkgever van de directeur, om de arbeidsvoorwaarden van de directeur vast te stellen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over een interventie door het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken in een onderzoek naar een smeergeldaffaire waarin het Saoedisch koningshuis betrokken zou zijn

MPs De Roon and Helder asked whether the Foreign Ministry intervened to halt a bribery investigation involving Saudi royals, including cancelling the hearing of a Saudi witness, and whether a criminal investigation may be blocked for diplomatic reasons. The ministers answered that the decision not to send a mutual legal assistance request followed the normal procedure, weighing security risks to the witness rather than diplomatic relations, and declined to launch a separate inquiry.
Contrary to what the questions suggest, relations with the country to be approached are not decisive in weighing whether a legal assistance request is submitted.
Anders dan in de vragen wordt gesuggereerd, zijn verhoudingen met het aan te zoeken land niet van doorslaggevend belang bij de afweging of een rechtshulpverzoek wordt ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Opheldering geëist over dood 14-jarige Luciano”

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the death of a 14-year-old was explained to the parents, whether an autopsy was performed, and whether autopsies should be mandatory for minors. The minister declined to discuss the facts citing family privacy, said the prosecutor is handling the parents' access request and the inspections will brief the mother, and stated autopsy is ordered when suspicion of crime or third-party involvement exists regardless of age.
Regarding the facts, I cannot make any statements in the context of the privacy of the next of kin.
Over de feiten kan ik, in het kader van de privacy van de nabestaanden, geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het artikel ‘Een ongeluk 112 aan de lijn, waar zit je precies?’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why mobile 112 calls do not transmit location data and what changes are needed, and whether an app or SMS-based tool could help. The minister answered that location data is already shown to the 112 centre, that wider location sharing requires infrastructure changes planned for spring 2018, that 14 of 22 regional centres use the VIL location tool, and that no legal obstacle exists.
No data is kept on this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht “veel discriminatie transgenders op werk”

An MP asks the ministers whether reported workplace discrimination against transgender people (40% reported experiencing it) is acceptable and what measures will reduce it, including complaints, prosecution and inspection. The government answers that the survey is not representative but that the group is vulnerable, cites existing action plans, the Inspectorate's antidiscrimination checks of employers, TNN campaigns and the planned repetition of the 2016 campaign, without committing to new legislation beyond the pending Bergkamp bill.
It is indeed worrying that many transgender people face discrimination in the workplace, or do not feel free to be themselves at work.
Het is inderdaad zorgelijk dat veel transgenders te maken hebben met discriminatie op de werkvloer, of niet de ruimte voelen om zichzelf te zijn op het werk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het herkenbaar uitzenden van beelden ten behoeve van de opsporing

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about broadcasting recognisable CCTV images for investigative purposes, after a 68-year-old woman took her own life when such footage spread online. The minister said the criteria are set in the Aanwijzing opsporingsberichtgeving, that footage is removed once a suspect is identified, but that third-party redistribution cannot fully be prevented, and that the criteria are being reviewed with a new instruction expected before summer 2017.
The criteria and conditions for using investigative publicity are already being reviewed as part of the update of the Aanwijzing opsporingsberichtgeving.
De criteria en voorwaarden voor inzet van opsporingsberichtgeving worden op dit moment in het kader van de actualisering van de Aanwijzing opsporingsberichtgeving al opnieuw bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Tongeren over de registratie van geweld tegen vluchtelingen

MPs Voortman and Van Tongeren asked whether figures on violence against refugees and asylum seekers exist, whether police will record the victim's status, and how reporting is encouraged. The Minister answered that police record whether an offence is discriminatory, that the 2015 discrimination figures were sent to parliament, that efforts to raise reporting willingness continue, and rejected the claim that racist violence is structurally under-recognised.
Police officers must record all reports and complaints of discrimination and incidents in which a discriminatory aspect may be present.
Politieagenten dienen alle aangiften en meldingen van discriminatie en van incidenten waarin mogelijk een discriminatoir aspect aanwezig is, te registreren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het aantal alcoholcontroles in het verkeer

An MP asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers why the number of recorded alcohol checks in traffic fell 17.5 percent in 2016, whether registration is mandatory, and whether individual checks are more effective. The Justice minister answered that the decline reflects a shift away from large checkpoints toward individual checks, that recording individual checks is not mandatory, and that alcohol limit violations are always recorded as offences but not separately per check.
Recording individual checks, which also test for alcohol use, is not mandatory, so the number of recorded alcohol checks does not give a complete picture of police deployment.

Het registreren van individuele controles, waarbij ook getest wordt op het gebruik van alcohol, is niet verplicht, waardoor uit het aantal geregistreerde alcoholcontroles geen volledig beeld van de inzet van politie kan worden afgeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over weinig zinvolle taken voor de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether police officers are performing non-core tasks such as cleaning and car maintenance, and whether caretaker work was centralised as a cost-saving measure. The minister answered that the centralised caretaker model is meant to be more efficient, that police officers are not diverted from core tasks in a way that harms them, and that no other signals were known.
With the implementation of the facility plan of the Police Service Centre (PDC), a more efficient and flexible approach to facility maintenance and cleaning has been chosen.
Met het in werking brengen van het inrichtingsplan van het Politiedienstencentrum (PDC) is gekozen voor een efficiëntere en flexibelere aanpak voor facilitair onderhoud en schoonmaak.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Navigators Studentenvereniging Amsterdam op basis van de christelijke identiteit wordt geweerd door een leverancier van pinapparaten

MPs Bruins and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether refusing a card payment terminal to a Christian student association on religious grounds is lawful under the equal treatment act, and how it relates to that act. The minister answered that the equal treatment act generally prohibits religious distinctions in offering services, but whether unlawful discrimination occurred can only be determined through investigation, and the association could file a complaint with the College voor de Rechten van de Mens.
Whether unlawful distinction exists in the case in question can only be established on the basis of investigation.
Of er in het genoemde geval sprake is van verboden onderscheid kan alleen op basis van onderzoek worden vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de door het Europees Parlement aangenomen resolutie over matchfixing

An MP asked whether the Netherlands will criminalise match-fixing as a specific offence following a European Parliament resolution, and whether further research is warranted. The Minister replied that no specific offence is being studied, as current fraud, bribery, money laundering and forgery provisions are considered sufficient.
A specific criminal offence for match-fixing is not being investigated.
Een specifieke strafbaarstelling van matchfixing wordt niet onderzocht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Van Dekken over de berichten ‘Veel sportclubs melden seksueel overschrijdend gedrag niet bij instanties’, ‘Bij elke club kan een verborgen camera in de kleedkamer hangen’ en 'Vertr

MPs Volp and Van Dekken asked the ministers about reports that many sports clubs do not report sexual misconduct, the Vertrouwenspunt Sport of NOC*NSF, and the need for a reporting code, VOG checks, a blacklist and independent research. The minister answered that reporting should be encouraged, that the independent research will inform further measures, that a VOG is voluntary (free) rather than mandatory in sport, and that an independent inquiry will be supported financially.
It is important that it is a high-quality study that makes use of the knowledge and experience gained in recent times from earlier studies in other sectors.

Het is van belang dat het een kwalitatief goed onderzoek is waarbij gebruik wordt gemaakt van de kennis en ervaringen die in de afgelopen tijd zijn opgedaan bij eerdere onderzoeken in andere sectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over een gebrek aan diversiteit bij de politie

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security why police diversity remains insufficient despite long-standing recognition, and about targets, registration of ethnic background, and reports of discrimination against officers with migrant backgrounds. The minister answers that a 25% intake target for officers with a dual cultural background applies from 2018 (with the korpschef aiming for 2017), that ethnicity is not registered but dual background is inferred from voluntary application forms, and that discrimination concerns are acknowledged.
There is no legal basis for registering the ethnicity of incoming, serving and outgoing police employees.
Er is geen wettelijke grondslag voor de registratie van de etniciteit van instromende, zittende en uitstromende medewerkers van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het Nederlandse wapenbeleid

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether Dutch firearms policy is failing, given UK concerns about illegal guns smuggled through the Netherlands and the tougher UK sentencing and enforcement. The minister rejects the claim that policy is failing, points to intensified enforcement and new coordination structures, and says capacity and prioritisation are under continuous review without committing to a specific new step.
I do not agree with the claim that Dutch firearms policy is failing.
Ik ben het niet eens met de stelling dat het Nederlandse wapenbeleid faalt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Bommel over de verdergaande ondermijning van de rechtsstaat en de democratie in Polen

Two SP MPs asked the government about the erosion of rule of law and judicial independence in Poland, EU sanctions under Article 7, judicial cooperation, and Kaczynski's remarks on a two-speed EU and refugees. The government answered that it follows developments closely, pursues dialogue bilaterally and in EU fora, considers Article 7 not currently at issue, and that judicial cooperation continues as no grounds to refuse were found.
Triggering the Article 7 procedure is not currently on the table.
Het in werking stellen van de artikel 7 procedure is vooralsnog niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Overheid eist invloed bij cyberbeveiliger FOXIT’

An MP asked ministers whether the takeover of Fox-IT by NCC Group risks state secrets reaching foreign intelligence, why the government was informed only after the sale, and how dependent it is on private encryption firms. The government answered that existing secrecy law and contractual security requirements, with state supervision, cover the risk, that ministries were informed beforehand, and that alternative Dutch suppliers exist only in limited form.
Before the takeover, the ministries of the Interior and Defence were informed about it.
Voorafgaand aan de overname zijn de ministeries van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en Defensie ter zake ingelicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de slechte bereikbaarheid van de politie

Van Raak (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police phone lines are still poorly reachable and what will be done to improve response times, and whether WhatsApp contact with youth will be explored. The Minister answered that 73 percent of calls were answered within 20 seconds in January 2017, that a taskforce is working on improvements with effects expected in the medium term, and that WhatsApp contact is being studied alongside privacy and reliability concerns.
A Taskforce RSC has been set up to support units.
Er is een Taskforce RSC ingericht om eenheden te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Vermue over een tekort aan rechercheurs in Zeeland

MPs Marcouch and Vermue asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a shortage of detectives in Zeeland, its vulnerability to crime due to logistics and ports, and the loss of the police headquarters. The minister replied that police capacity is allocated with the police authority, that visibility does not depend on headquarters, that synthetic drug problems in Zeeland are limited, and that Zeeland-West-Brabant has 928 FTE investigative capacity.
The allocation of strength within the units is done by the police in agreement with the authority.
De verdeling van de sterkte binnen de eenheden geschiedt door de politie in overeenstemming met het gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat er grote verontwaardiging heerst over de aanhouding van een 12-jarige jongen

Kuzu asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the arrest of a 12-year-old boy in Amsterdam Zuidoost, including racism, disproportionate force, identity-document requests, boa legal knowledge, aftercare, fine remission and apologies. The Minister answered that the matter is a local case for the municipality to respond to, referred to an earlier letter on ethnic profiling and violence, described the youth-suspect working procedure and police training, and said psychological help is assessed case by case.
This concerns an individual local matter on which council questions have also been asked. It is for the local competent authority to respond or act.
Het betreft hier een individuele lokale aangelegenheid waarover ook Raadsvragen zijn gesteld. Het is aan het lokale bevoegd gezag om hierop te reageren c.q. te acteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Jacobi over de hulpverlening op het Schelde-Rijnkanaal

MPs de Vries and Jacobi asked the ministers how rescue duties on the Schelde-Rijnkanaal were reorganised between two safety regions, whether the new rescue vessel meets comparable standards, whether other stakeholders were consulted, and whether shipping will face delays. Minister Blok answered that the safety regions decided on the split, that the new vessel meets at least the same standards, that stakeholders were consulted in working groups, and that shipping delays are not expected, while declining to account for the regional boards' decisions to parliament.
I do not wish to enter into this accountability relationship.
In deze verantwoordingsrelatie wil ik niet treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht ‘Koolmonoxidevergiftiging kinderen door barbecue in ijskoud huis’

An MP asked ministers about a report of children poisoned by carbon monoxide from a barbecue indoors in a cold home after gas and electricity were cut off, and whether disconnection rules for energy debts should change or a basic income would prevent this. The government says disconnection policy protects vulnerable households and winter disconnections are limited, sees no need to change it, and says neither the current system nor a basic income can guarantee bills are paid.
Based on the current policy described above, the cabinet is of the view that the disconnection policy, particularly for vulnerable households, does not need to be changed.
Op basis van bovenstaand omschreven huidig beleid is het kabinet van mening dat het afsluitbeleid, in het bijzonder het afsluitbeleid bij kwetsbare huishoudens, geen aanpassing behoeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over een knokpartij tussen hooligans van Feyenoord en AZ

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked the government about a staged fight between Feyenoord and AZ hooligans, whether crimes were committed, and whether the state tolerates such violence. Minister Blok answered that the public prosecutor has opened an investigation, that such violence is criminal and unacceptable, and that research into hooligan fights is underway with results expected before summer.
The public prosecution services of Alkmaar and Rotterdam have started an investigation.
Het OM Alkmaar en het OM Rotterdam zijn een onderzoek gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het akkoord over verplichte paspoortcontrole voor reizigers van internationale hogesnelheidstreinen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a reported agreement among the Netherlands, Belgium, the UK and France to mandatory passport checks on international high-speed trains, and why parliament was not informed beforehand. The minister denied any binding agreement, said only a joint impact analysis on passenger data from Thalys and Eurostar will be carried out, and deferred most operational questions to that analysis, promising to inform parliament of its outcome.
Your House will be informed of the outcomes of the impact analysis.
Uw Kamer zal geïnformeerd worden over de uitkomsten van de impactanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Oosenbrug over vorderingen rondom mobiel bereik in tunnels

MPs Hoogland and Oosenbrug asked about progress on mobile coverage in tunnels, including how new tunnel standards, tender specifications, provider cooperation and the Ketheltunnel and Blankenburg projects are handled. The minister answers that coverage is being facilitated through updated standards and provider agreements, with providers responsible for funding and installation, and that no Building Decree change is planned.
I will inform your House in the second half of the year about the results of this inventory of mobile accessibility in existing tunnels.
Ik zal uw kamer in de tweede helft van het jaar over de resultaten van deze inventarisatie van mobiele bereikbaarheid in bestaande tunnels informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over Alternatieve Sjöterie Sint Christina Stank Stief Sjaelberg

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a Justis department letter refusing a cannon exemption to a Limburg association after a phone call seemed to suggest approval, and about handling errors and whether the decision should be revised. The minister confirmed the call was only a discussion, that the cannon was self-built without the required license, admitted the handling was unfortunate, but refused to revise the decision pending a possible objection procedure and declined a meeting.
I acknowledge that the course of events is unfortunate.
Ik erken dat de gang van zaken ongelukkig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over een plan voor een recreatieproject in het Veerse Meer

An MP from GroenLinks asks the ministers about a proposed large recreational peninsula in the Veerse Meer, including the municipality's stance, a 50-year ground lease by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, land exchanges, and whether the government will block the plan before the coastal pact. The minister replies that the municipality decides, that the lease is subject to permits by competent authorities, and that the government will not block the plan now but will set rules in the Kustpact and the Barro.
Ahead of the final signing of the Kustpact and applications for permits, I cannot yet give insight into that.
Vooruitlopend op de definitieve ondertekening van het Kustpact en aanvragen voor vergunningen kan ik daar nog geen inzage in geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht “NOS gaat door het stof voor FC Utrecht-supporters”

An MP asked the Justice Minister about anti-Semitic chants at football matches, whether the KNVB guideline is applied, when matches have been stopped, and what a 'gedoogcategorie' in a club protocol means. The minister says there are no signals the guideline is not followed, no match has yet been stopped under the new rule, the KNVB reports no tolerance category exists, and that action should always be taken against discriminatory chants.
I have no signals from the KNVB or the other football and safety partners that the existing guideline is not being complied with.
Ik heb geen signalen van de KNVB of van de andere bij voetbal en veiligheid betrokken partners dat de bestaande richtlijn niet wordt nageleefd.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Fokke (beiden PvdA) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat de politie filmpjes van een arrestatie liet wissen (ingezonden 27 december 2016).

MPs Marcouch and Fokke asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police had its witnesses delete phone footage of a fatal arrest in Maastricht, and on what authority. The minister said a Rijksrecherche investigation is ongoing, that police have no power to order deletion of citizens' footage but may ask bystanders to delete it voluntarily in medical emergencies, and declined to report on complaints or the investigation's findings.
The police have no power to delete footage from citizens.
De politie heeft geen bevoegdheid om beelden van burgers te wissen.

Vragen van het lid Kuzu (Groep Kuzu/Öztürk) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de berichten «Asielzoeker overlijdt na aanhouding in Maastricht» en «Getuigen fatale arrestatie Maastricht moesten beelden wisse

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a death after a police arrest in Maastricht, including whether officers forced witnesses to delete footage, whether a neck hold was proportionate, and whether officers should have been suspended and how many arrestees suffered lasting injury. The minister answered that a Rijksrecherche investigation is ongoing and declined to comment on findings, said disciplinary measures are the chief of police's responsibility, and said the police do not keep a record of arrestee injuries.
The Rijksrecherche (national criminal investigation service) is investigating this incident.
De Rijksrecherche doet onderzoek naar dit incident.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het tekort aan aangepaste woningen en  ouderenwoningen

An SP MP asked the Minister about a shortage of affordable and accessible housing for seniors and people with disabilities, the waiting times for such homes, and whether the removal of accessibility rules in the building code would reduce supply. The Minister replied that housing corporations have ample financial means to lower rents and build more, that waiting times for seniors are one to three years, that local agreements are the main route, and that the existing accessibility requirements are carried over unchanged into the new building regulation.
The annual increase or decrease in the number of adapted and senior housing units in the social rental sector is not tracked.
De jaarlijkse toe- of afname van het aantal aangepaste- en ouderenwoningen in de sociale huursector wordt niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht 'Ook in nieuwe baden nog gevaarlijk rvs' van de Leeuwarder Courant

An MP asked the minister about news that new swimming pools still contain dangerous RVS (stainless steel), whether the Swimfun pool had the Veilig & Schoon quality mark, and how new use of RVS can be prevented. The minister answered that the 2016 inspection obligation requires removal of dangerous RVS, that the private quality mark is not necessary, and that the Bouwbesluit already prohibits new use, so no amendment is needed.
In June 2017 I will inform your House of the findings of this investigation.
In juni 2017 zal ik uw Kamer op de hoogte brengen van de bevindingen van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Voortman en Karabulut over schoonmakers die werken bij het Ministerie van Buitenlandse zaken

MPs asked whether the government will act on cleaners at the Foreign Affairs ministry who may lose jobs after the move to Rijnstraat 8, including whether the government as client will protect their security, alternative work, and a permanent post at the Rijksschoonmaakorganisatie. The minister says the contractor ISS has no legal obligation to take over staff, no specific employment requirements were set, a social plan with partial takeover (9 of 21) was contractually agreed, and the Social Affairs minister is examining priority placement in other government buildings.
I will have the implementation of this plan supervised.
Ik zal toezicht laten houden op de uitvoering van dit plan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Voortman over de energieprestatievergoeding bij zeer energiezuinige woningen met een gasaansluiting

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked why the energy performance allowance (EPV) for very energy-efficient homes now allows gas connections despite the government's plan to phase out gas, and about the consequences for consumers, gas networks and costs. The minister replied that gas-connected homes are allowed for pragmatic reasons backed by housing associations, that the option is temporary (no new EPV gas contracts for renovations starting after 2022), that gas grid phase-outs are handled via local pilot projects with residents, and that no gas pipes need replacing unnecessarily.
I will have the regulation take effect on 1 February 2017.
Ik zal de regeling per 1 februari 2017 in laten gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes, Van der Linde, Albert de Vries en Dijkgraaf over het bericht dat er chaos dreigt door nieuwe zienswijze van de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM)

Four MPs asked the Minister for Housing and Government Service, on behalf of the Finance Minister, about the AFM's new view that mortgages must be tested against the lending norms in force when the binding offer is issued rather than at application, which could cause chaos for applicants. The Minister answered that a transition period until 1 February 2017 was agreed with the sector and the WEW for applications filed before 2017, that the AFM will take this into account in supervision, and that the timing of tests is a matter of clarifying the MCD-based rules.
For mortgage applications submitted before 1 January 2017 where the creditworthiness test for the binding offer takes place by 1 February 2017 at the latest, the 2016 lending norms may be applied.

Voor hypotheekaanvragen die zijn ingediend voor 1 januari 2017 waarbij de kredietwaardigheidstoets ten behoeve van het bindend aanbod uiterlijk 1 februari 2017 plaatsvindt, er met de leennormen van 2016 mag worden gerekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over nieuwe voorrangsregels bij een Amsterdamse woningcorporatie die leiden tot verzet bij huurders

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing why housing corporation De Key changed its statutes to prioritise students and starters without involving tenants, and why the minister approved this despite the municipality's objection. The minister replied that the tenant council was consulted under the Wohv, that the statutes meet the Woningwet requirements, and that municipalities cannot file formal objections but can use performance agreements and allocation ordinances.
Submission of a view by the municipality is not a requirement for the Aw to process a request for a statutory amendment.
Afgifte van zienswijze door de gemeente is geen vereiste voor het in behandeling nemen van een aanvraag statutenwijziging door de Aw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Houwers over het gebruik van WOZ-beschikkingen voor het aanvragen van een hypotheek

An MP asked the Minister for Housing whether banks may be required to accept a public WOZ assessment instead of a taxation report for mortgages, and whether this would increase acceptance of WOZ valuations. The Minister answered that the Mortgage Directive allows WOZ-based valuations up to 90% of value, that lenders may still require a physical appraisal, and that a statutory obligation to rely on WOZ is not desirable.
A requirement to use the WOZ assessment when determining the value of the home is therefore not, in my view, desirable.
Een verplichting om gebruik te maken van de WOZ-beschikking bij het bepalen van de waarde van de woning acht ik daarom niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de ontwikkeling van huurprijzen

An SP MP asks the housing minister to explain a large rent increase for a small Amsterdam (De Pijp) dwelling over 1994-2016, including a year-by-year account, and whether scarcity points introduced in 2011 should be removed from the rent points system instead of being offset against WOZ values. The minister attributes the rise to successive changes in the WWS rent points system, notes that the example would largely not apply to a pre-war dwelling and that the rise is far above the national average, and states that scarcity points were abolished in October 2015 while the maximum rent per point was adjusted to keep average earning capacity.
As indicated in the letter to the House of Representatives of 21 November 2014, the scarcity points were abolished with the amendment of the WWS that took effect on 1 October 2015.

Zoals is aangegeven in de brief aan de Tweede Kamer van 21 november 2014 (Kamerstuk 27 926, nr. 237 ) zijn de schaarstepunten vervallen met de wijziging van het WWS die per 1 oktober 2015 in werking trad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Kerstens over de gemeente Haarlem en Tilburg die op basis van payrolling mensen in dienst nemen

MPs Vermeij and Kerstens asked about municipalities such as Haarlem and Tilburg hiring staff via payrolling for structural work and whether the government will act. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for their own employment policy, that social partners are already examining the issue, and that the central government sees no need for further action; payrolling rose slightly among municipalities and has ended in central government.
Municipalities are themselves competent and responsible, within the framework of general legislation and collective agreements, for their employment conditions policy and business operations.
Gemeenten zijn namelijk zelf bevoegd en verantwoordelijk binnen de kaders van algemene wetgeving en cao's voor hun arbeidsvoorwaardenbeleid en bedrijfsvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Koolmees over het bericht ‘Grote steden voelen niks voor bouwen in groene zones’

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Housing and Infrastructure about a report claiming big cities resist building on green zones, and whether the government should steer housing growth towards urban infill. The minister answered that municipalities and provinces hold the regie over housing, that the Ladder for Sustainable Urbanisation guides the choice between inner-city and edge-of-city building, and that further research and a National Environment Vision are forthcoming.
Municipalities and provinces have the lead role in making spatial considerations in urbanisation and housing construction.
Gemeenten en provincies hebben bij verstedelijking en woningbouw de regie bij het maken van ruimtelijke afwegingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de reis van de Minister naar Azië om beleggers naar de Nederlandse huursector te lokken

An SP MP asks the Minister for Housing why he travelled to Southeast Asia to attract investors into the Dutch rental sector, questioning the choice of region, the goals, the role of housing associations and the costs. The minister answers that the trip aimed at starting long-term contacts rather than concluding deals, that sales of association homes are governed by rules and local decisions, that he will inform parliament before summer, and that private sector bodies paid their own costs.
Yes, I will inform you about that before the summer.
Ja, ik zal u voor de zomer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over terreursteun voor Rotterdamse salafistenschool

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a Qatari charity linked to terrorism financed a Rotterdam salafist school, whether its foundations should be dissolved, and whether salafist schools and foreign funding should be banned. Minister Plasterk answered that the property was bought with Qatari funds but that the organisation is not on Dutch, EU or UN sanctions lists, that dissolution is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service, and that the government will address foreign funding in a letter in November.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether there are facts and circumstances that give cause to file a request with the court for civil prohibition or dissolution under art. 2:20 BW.

Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of er feiten en omstandigheden aanwezig zijn die aanleiding vormen om een verzoek tot civielrechtelijke verbodenverklaring of ontbinding ex art. 2:20 BW bij de rechtbank in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over huurtoeslag voor studenten

An MP asks whether student rent allowance (huurtoeslag) for students in shared-house-number accommodation is at risk because the BAG address register only records self-contained units, and whether tenants will keep their advance payments. The minister answers that entitlement does not change, that specified student complexes will be handled separately, that wrongly granted allowance will not be recovered, and that the Belastingdienst will take up the issues with priority.
As indicated in the answers to the previous questions, the right to rent allowance does not change.
Zoals in de antwoorden op de vragen hiervoor aangegeven wordt, verandert het recht op huurtoeslag niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het artikel ‘Wet Doorstroming Huurmarkt: De huurovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd met een minimale huurtermijn, kan dat nog’

MP Van der Linde asks whether the new temporary rental contracts under the Wet doorstroming huurmarkt could undermine minimum rental terms in open-ended leases, and whether the law should be clarified. The minister denies intending any such effect, says no clarification is necessary, and acknowledges that a minimum rental term is understandable for landlords.
No, with the introduction of the temporary rental contracts for a fixed term I did not intend to undermine the common practice among commercial landlords of applying a minimum contract duration.

Nee, ik heb met de introductie van de tijdelijke huurcontracten voor bepaalde tijd niet beoogd afbreuk te doen aan de gangbare praktijk onder commerciële verhuurders van het hanteren van een minimumcontractsduur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over mogelijke staatssteun aan Lelystad Airport

MP Van Tongeren asks whether discounts for charter and low-cost airlines at Lelystad Airport amount to unlawful state aid, how this fits the Aldersakkoord, and what profit expectations apply to regional airports and Lelystad. The Staatssecretaris rejects the state-aid claim, says discounts are not in themselves unlawful and are left to the operator within competition rules, and gives general profit outlooks while noting some details are not yet known.
Applying discounts as such in principle does not constitute (unlawful) state aid.
Het hanteren van eventuele kortingen als zodanig vormt in beginsel geen (onrechtmatige) staatssteun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koolmees en Verhoeven over het bericht “Renovatie Binnenhof officieel geheim”

MPs Koolmees and Verhoeven asked why the Binnenhof renovation was declared secret, bypassing open tender, and how contractors are selected and costs checked. Minister Blok answered that security risks justified secrecy, pointed to precedents, and said selection criteria and price checks apply despite limited competition.
I decided to deviate from the usual procedures in order to limit risks to the security situation of the Binnenhof complex and its users.
Ik heb besloten af te wijken van de gebruikelijke procedures om risico’s voor de veiligheidssituatie van het Binnenhofcomplex en zijn gebruikers te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht ‘Groot tekort aan woningbouwlocaties’

An MP asks the Minister for Housing about an EIB report finding too few 'hard' housing sites to meet household growth to 2025, including the risk of overplanning, the role of the Ladder for Sustainable Urbanisation and the government's systemic responsibility. The Minister broadly agrees with the EIB on regional shortages, says local authorities hold the primary responsibility, and points to support measures (expert teams, annual talks, simplified Ladder) without committing to mandatory overplanning targets or regional reporting.
I do not have figures on the extent to which plans have been formally adopted by the authorities. That fits the decentralised character of spatial planning policy.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over in hoeverre plannen bestuurlijk zijn vastgesteld. Dat past bij het decentrale karakter van het ruimtelijke ordeningsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brouwer over vooroordelen en loonachterstanden vanwege het spreken met een dialect

An MP asked the government about reports that people speaking a dialect earn 5 to 15 percent less than Standard Dutch speakers, and whether prejudice plays a role. The minister cites a discussion paper finding a link between dialect and hourly wages, says the data cannot separate the causes and points to the existing anti-discrimination labour market policy and progress reports.
The study notes that the underlying data do not allow distinguishing between the different mechanisms that lead to the negative wage effect experienced by male workers.

In het onderzoek wordt opgemerkt dat de aan het onderzoek ten grondslag liggende gegevens niet toe staan om een onderscheid te maken tussen de verschillende mechanismen die leiden tot het negatieve looneffect dat mannelijke werknemers ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes, Rog en Van Helvert over de huisvesting van studenten in hotels

MPs from the CDA asked the minister whether The Student Hotel's rentals to students, often longer than six months, breach tenancy protection, whether the rents are acceptable, and whether such hotel rooms count toward student housing goals. The minister replied that the short-stay exception may apply, that tenants must go to the rent commission or court themselves, that the Rijk has no enforcement role, and that municipalities decide on hotel-based housing.
The central government has no enforcement role on this point.
Het Rijk heeft op dit punt geen handhavende taak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de verhuur van woonruimte aan studenten door “The Student Hotel”

An MP asked the minister whether Student Hotel rentals to students, which resemble regular student housing, fall outside tenant rent and eviction protection as short-term use. The minister answered that courts and the rent commission decide case by case, the state has no enforcement role, and municipalities decide on hotel versus housing permits.
The national government has no enforcement task on this point.
Het rijk heeft op dit punt geen handhavende taak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de openbare gegevens in het kadaster

MP Bashir asked ministers about publicly accessible personal data in the Kadaster after a broadcast showed how easily identity numbers and marriage details could be obtained. The minister defends the openness of the registers for legal certainty, notes that searching by person requires a subscription or written request, and says the government will review the balance with privacy and safety and consult the Dutch Data Protection Authority.

I will therefore consult with the Kadaster to examine whether the current balance between accessibility in the interest of legal certainty on the one hand and protection of personal data, including security aspects, on the other is still appropriate.

Ik zal daarom in overleg met het Kadaster bezien of de huidige balans tussen toegankelijkheid in het belang van de rechtszekerheid enerzijds en bescherming van de persoonsgegevens inclusief veiligheidsaspecten anderzijds nog steeds passend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het door derden onttrekken van gegevens aan het WOZ-waardeloket

Gesthuizen (SP) asked whether third parties are harvesting WOZ property valuation data from the WOZ-waardeloket for commercial purposes, whether this is allowed under Article 40a Wet WOZ, how it is monitored and prevented, and whether access could be restricted via DigiD. Minister Plasterk answered that automated bulk extraction is not permitted, that anti-scraping safeguards and monitoring by the Kadaster are in place, but that full prevention is not feasible without undermining transparency, and that the government will decide on bulk provision after evaluation and a working group is examining further openness.
It is indeed not permitted to extract data from the WOZ-waardeloket in an automated manner.
Het is inderdaad niet toegestaan om op geautomatiseerde wijze gegevens aan het WOZ-waardeloket te onttrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir, Gesthuizen en Jasper van Dijk over jonge statushouders die gaan studeren

MPs Bashir, Gesthuizen and Van Dijk asked the Minister about poor coordination between COA and municipalities that leaves student housing for young refugees underused, and about how the gaps in study guidance and information will be addressed. The Minister replied that municipalities are responsible for housing, that the Rijk has introduced early screening of refugees' education and work background, and that study guidance is a task of the educational institutions, with specialised support from UAF.
Municipalities are responsible for the housing of refugee status holders.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de huisvesting van statushouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Miltenburg over het bericht dat ‘De overheid discrimineert’

An MP asked the ministers whether government and companies discriminate through job application forms that ask for age, sex or marital status, and whether that is unlawful. The minister answered that asking for such information is not per se discriminatory, that the central government's vacancy site does not require those fields and does not ask marital status, and that no research is currently planned.
There is currently no clear reason to start such an investigation.
Er is op dit moment geen duidelijke aanleiding om een dergelijk onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Leijten over het bericht dat er meer mensen onder de brug slapen

MPs Bashir and Leijten asked the government about reports of more people sleeping under a bridge in Rotterdam, rising homelessness, and the causes and policy response. The state secretary answered that causes of homelessness are diverse, that responsibility for shelter capacity lies mainly with municipalities, and listed measures such as housing reforms, a Platform31 experiment and a quality framework, without giving a full account of why earlier policy failed.
Responsibility for shelter capacity and for the flow from shelters into housing therefore lies at these levels (municipal and regional).
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de capaciteit in opvangcentra en de doorstroom vanuit de centra naar huisvesting ligt dan ook op deze niveaus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht "Woonbootbewoners tussen wal en schip"

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van der Linde asked about ING ceasing mortgages for houseboats, leaving only one provider, and whether banks should be able to offer tailored products. The minister says the market is commercially unattractive due to complexity and low volume, sees no regulatory obstacles in financial rules, notes a forthcoming houseboat mooring-tenancy law, and will monitor developments.
I have actively followed developments in recent months and will continue to do so in the coming period.
Ik heb de ontwikkelingen de afgelopen maanden actief gevolgd en zal dit de komende periode ook blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht “Bank straft trouwe klant”

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van der Linde asked whether banks refuse bridging loans to retirees who no longer need a mortgage, and whether regulation causes this, plus solutions and whether NVB claims regulation hinders tailored service to seniors. The minister says no standard bridging loan exists without a mortgage, regulation does not block it, some banks offer it case by case, and a study and a maatwerk platform will examine the practice.
As far as I am aware, no lender offers a bridging loan as a standard product when no mortgage product is attached.
Voor zover mij bekend biedt geen enkele kredietverstrekker standaard de mogelijkheid om een overbruggingskrediet af te sluiten indien er geen hypotheekproduct aan is verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de praktijk van verhuurdersverklaringen

An MP asks the Minister for Housing about rental landlord statements (verhuurdersverklaringen), including their evidentiary basis, duration, refusal of tenants, legal protection and the need for regulation. The Minister answers that the Dutch data protection law sets care requirements, tenants can request correction and add their own views, but sees no need for legislative or other measures.
I therefore see no reason to take legislative or other measures.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding wetgevende of andere maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Vliet over het voornemen tot verhuizing van het Financieel Service Centrum Defensie van Eygelshoven naar Utrecht

An MP asks the Minister for Housing and Government Services about the planned relocation of the Defence Financial Service Centre from Eygelshoven to Utrecht, including job losses, alternative locations and a priority arrangement for staff at the incoming US military facility. The minister answers that the relocation is planned for spring 2017, about 34 civilian staff are offered Utrecht posts, the alternatives were considered but did not meet the goal of concentrating the unit in one location, and the Defence minister is responsible for the operational questions.
For the questions concerning the substantive discussion of the planned relocation, I refer you to the committee debate on Defence real estate on 3 November.
Voor de vragen die betrekking hebben op de inhoudelijke bespreking van de voorgenomen verhuizing verwijs ik u graag naar het AO Vastgoed Defensie op 3 november aanstaande.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Bosman over de aangekondigde sluiting van de Windward Island Bank (WIB) op Saba

MPs Aukje de Vries and Bosman asked whether the Windward Island Bank will close its Saba branch, what the consequences are, and whether the resulting single-bank situation and the stricter BES financial regulation are justified. The minister confirmed the closure, said the remaining bank RBC would hold a de facto monopoly that may be undesirable, attributed the decision mainly to poor financial results rather than regulation, and committed to ongoing consultation with the island government and supervisors to keep ATMs and at least one bank operating.
I am considering, in consultation with the parties involved, whether there are options to keep this ATM operational next year as well.
Ik bezie, in overleg met betrokken partijen, of er mogelijkheden bestaan om deze geldautomaat ook volgend jaar operationeel te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over geheime beïnvloedingsoperaties door Rusland

An MP asked the ministers whether the government knows of covert Russian influence operations, including alleged efforts to influence the US election and Dutch politics, and whether it will investigate or inform parliament. The government replied it has no concrete knowledge of Russian funding or influence of Dutch parties, cannot make public statements on ongoing intelligence activities, and so cannot share details.
The cabinet cannot make public statements about alleged Russian activities aimed at influencing the US presidential elections.
Het kabinet kan geen publieke uitspraken doen over (vermeende) activiteiten van Rusland teneinde de presidentsverkiezingen in de VS te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het aanmerken van woningen met een aardgasaansluiting als nul-op-de-meter woning

MP Albert de Vries asked the Minister for Housing about the planned extension of the energy performance allowance to homes with a gas connection, the consistency with the Stroomversnelling deal, grid costs and the risk of slowing innovation. The minister defends allowing gas-connected near-zero homes provided the gas use is compensated by on-site renewable generation, commits to periodic evaluation and to a consultation on district heat, and dismisses the innovation and grid-cost concerns.

I am willing to also enable an energy performance allowance for very energy-efficient homes that have a gas connection, on the condition that the limited fossil energy still used for heating the home is compensated by renewable energy generation.

Ik ben bereid om ook voor zeer energiezuinige woningen die een aardgasaansluiting hebben een energieprestatievergoeding mogelijk te maken, waarbij voorwaarde is dat de beperkte fossiele energie die nog voor de verwarming van de woning gebruikt wordt, wordt gecompenseerd door duurzame energieopwekking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de onmogelijkheid om in het Caribisch deel van Nederland de Nederlandse televisiezenders te ontvangen

An MP asked why Dutch TV channels were not receivable in Caribbean Netherlands and what the government would do about it. The government answered that the NPO adjusted geo-IP filtering so the islands can access its services, that sports rights are sold by geographic zone, and that commercial broadcasters set their own distribution policy.
For the distribution of media services by commercial broadcasters, this is not a matter for the Dutch government.
Voor de doorgifte van mediadiensten van commerciële omroepen geldt dat dit geen zaak is van de Nederlandse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘’Isla werkt aan concept gaspijp vanuit Venezuela’’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about press reports on a planned gas pipeline from Venezuela to Curaçao, including its costs, public financing, dependence on Venezuela and risks. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, declined to answer the detailed questions by referring to Curaçao's responsibility as a national matter of that country, and stated that the Netherlands should not pay for the pipeline.
The subject at hand concerns a national affair of the country of Curaçao.
Onderhavig onderwerp betreft een landsaangelegenheid van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het inkomen van de topman van Omroep West

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether Omroep West compensated its director for scrapping his performance bonus with a higher fixed pay, and whether the director's withdrawal of a 1,000 euro allowance was driven by publicity. The minister confirmed the arrangement (bonus replaced by a taxable monthly allowance of 8.5% of gross salary), gave total remuneration figures for 2013 to 2015 within the WNT norm, and left the compensation decisions to the supervisory board.
According to media reports, the Supervisory Board of Omroep West made arrangements with the director to stop the performance-related bonus from 1 January 2014.
De Raad van Commissarissen van Omroep West heeft volgens de berichtgeving met de directeur afspraken gemaakt over het per 1 januari 2014 stopzetten van de prestatieafhankelijke bonus
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over de voorspelde toename van intimidatie en bedreiging van politieke bestuurders

The MP asked how threats and intimidation of political office-holders stemming from the fight against organised crime are being addressed, whether the programme has been revised, and why the minister asks parliament for extra funds. The minister answered that local government is central to the approach, that threats are dealt with firmly, that a monitoring study and a WODC study are pending, and that extra funding of 7 to 10 million euros a year plus 14 million for the Public Prosecution Service has been allocated.
I have no information available about the expected threats and intimidation.
Over de te verwachten bedreigingen en intimidaties heb ik geen informatie beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Extra veel Belgische Nederlanders bij buitenlandloket’

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked why the Brussels embassy and Antwerp consulate-general stopped issuing passports and ID cards from November 2015, how many applications and waiting times were involved, and how backlogs would be cleared. The minister answered that the change is part of a modernisation of consular services, that alternatives exist, that waiting times at some Dutch municipalities are comparable, and that capacity is being expanded and an external-provider pilot started.
It is not possible to retrieve figures from the systems on the time between application and actual issue of a travel document.
Het is niet mogelijk om cijfers uit de systemen op te vragen met betrekking tot de tijdsduur tussen de aanvraag en de daadwerkelijke uitreiking van een reisdocument.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en De Caluwé over het artikel ’Disrepair causes Statia court session to move’’

MPs Bosman and De Caluwé asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about reports that a courthouse building on Sint Eustatius was too dilapidated to use, and about responsibility for maintenance, affected hearings, costs and other closed state buildings. The minister acknowledged the problem, explained that ownership was unclear for years, said repair works are ordered and funded, and answered that hearings were moved to other venues while other buildings are not closed.
The Ministry of BZK has also ordered repair works to be carried out, for which funds have also been made available.
Ook heeft het Ministerie van BZK opdracht gegeven om herstelwerkzaamheden te verrichten, waarvoor ook middelen ter beschikking zijn gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over “Wageningse geurval kan malaria uitroeien”

An MP asked the ministers whether a scent-trap method for malaria mosquitoes could be applied in the Caribbean Netherlands to combat chikungunya and Zika, and whether a pilot would be started. The minister answered that such research is important but results do not transfer directly to other settings, and committed to a joint plan with Bonaire, Saba and St. Eustatius, with a pilot only if research supports it.
With these islands it has been agreed that they will jointly work out a plan with the RIVM.
Met deze eilanden is afgesproken dat zij met het RIVM gezamenlijk tot een plan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de gokindustrie op Curaçao

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the master/sub-licence structure of Curaçao's gambling industry lacks a legal basis, whether UTS reports unusual transactions to the FIU, and whether UTS and KPMG's services and tax responsibility raise concerns. The Minister declined to answer on substance, stating these are matters for the autonomous country of Curaçao, and said he would forward the questions to the Curaçao government.
I cannot comment on these questions because they concern a matter for the autonomous country of Curaçao.
Ik kan mij over deze vragen niet uitlaten omdat het vragen zijn die een aangelegenheid van het autonome land Curaçao betreffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Houwers over het jaarlijks betalen om te kunnen reageren op sociale huurwoningen

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about annual registration fees for applying to social rental housing, including their level and purpose. The minister confirmed one-time and yearly fees (typically 0-30 euro and 10-20 euro per year), explaining they cover operating the allocation system and deter inactive applicants.
No information is known about the degree to which the fees cover costs.
Over de mate van kostendekkendheid van de tarieven is geen informatie bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Amhaouch over financiering van de referendum campagne in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt and Amhaouch asked the government about foreign and undisclosed funding of the 2016 Dutch referendum campaign, including donor disclosure rules, GRECO recommendations on foreign donations, and contacts with George Soros's organisations. Minister Plasterk answered that party donations above EUR 4,500 are disclosed, no rules exist on foreign donations or referendum-period disclosure, the government had no direct contact with Soros, and the referendum subsidy audit is still ongoing.
I do not have overviews of organisations or persons who spent more than EUR 4,500 on campaign activities for the referendum of 6 April.
Ik beschik niet over overzichten van instanties of personen die meer dan € 4.500 hebben uitgegeven aan campagneactiviteiten voor het referendum van 6 april jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het artikel ’Aruba en Valero sluiten definitief akkoord voor overname raffinaderij’

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether Aruba's purchase of the Valero refinery is financially sound, whether it resembles Curaçao's 1985 ISLA purchase, what economic gains and costs it brings, and whether it was submitted to the CAft financial supervisor. The Minister answers that it is a national matter, that no business case is known to him, that the CAft will assess the budget and multi-year financial effects later, and that costs must never fall on the Netherlands.

The CAft will, from its legally assigned task, therefore test the financial consequences for the (multi-year) budget of the concluded agreements on the takeover and reopening of the refinery against the norms of the Aruba Financial Supervision Ordinance.

Het CAft zal vanuit haar wettelijk toegewezen taak dan ook de financiële gevolgen voor de (meerjaren) begroting van de gesloten overeenkomsten ten aanzien van de overname en heropening van de raffinaderij toetsen aan de normen van de Landsverordening Aruba financieel toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Kuiken over de vestiging van een asielzoekerscentrum in Maastricht

Two PvdA MPs asked whether the sale and lease of a Maastricht property for an asylum centre, reportedly linked to a suspect owner, showed integrity risks and whether the COA should have checked the buyer's integrity under the Bibob Act. The minister acknowledged factual inaccuracies in the press report, said the government should be restrained in such deals and that integrity checks are warranted, explained that the COA ran a notarial check finding no link to the owner, and noted the COA lacks Bibob powers but a change is being prepared.
The Minister of Justice and Security is currently examining how the Bibob authority for the COA can be realised in the short term by amending the Bibob Decree.
Momenteel beziet de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie hoe de Bibob-bevoegdheid voor het COA, door middel van een aanpassing van het Besluit Bibob, op korte termijn kan worden gerealiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over Turkse steun voor jihadi’s en een Turks verzoek om de inzet van  inlichtingendiensten voor de jacht op opponenten van Erdogan

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether a Turkish request for German intelligence help in hunting Erdogan opponents had reached Dutch services, whether Turkish support for jihadists was known to the AIVD and MIVD, and whether cooperation should end. The government said it cannot discuss concrete contacts with foreign services publicly, outlined its cooperation criteria, and declined to give details on the services' knowledge.
The government cannot publicly discuss concrete contacts between Dutch and foreign intelligence and security services.
De regering kan in het openbaar niet ingaan op concrete contacten tussen Nederlandse en buitenlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht "Woningtekort dreigt door droog koken nieuwbouwmarkt"

An MP asks the ministers whether the shortage of new housing, shown by falling building permits, requires stronger central government action, rising prices, reform of the Ladder for sustainable urbanisation, and easier land acquisition for municipalities. The minister answers that housing supply is primarily a local responsibility, cites existing measures such as tax relief, expert teams and a planned simplification of the Ladder, and rejects restricting zelfrealisatie as a route to faster construction.
Responsibility for the quantitative development of the housing stock and for taking measures on it lies at the local level.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwantitatieve ontwikkeling van de woningvoorraad en het treffen van maatregelen daarop ligt op het lokale niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pechtold inzake activiteiten van de Turkse geheime dienst in Nederland

MP Pechtold asks the government about Turkish intelligence activities in the Netherlands, the AIVD's staffing for Turkish-language analysis, whether the AIVD uses information obtained by Turkish services, the protection of Turkish-Dutch residents against intimidation, and the assessment notes governing intelligence sharing with Turkey. Minister Blok answers that he cannot publicly confirm or deny activities of foreign services or the AIVD's expertise, refers complaints to the police, and states that the assessment notes are continuously reviewed and cannot be discussed individually.
No public statements can be made about activities that foreign intelligence and security services would carry out with the permission of the Dutch government.
Er kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan over activiteiten die buitenlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten met toestemming van de Nederlandse overheid zouden uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de dode dieren bij de brand van een pluimveebedrijf in het Drentse Orvelte

An MP asked about 15,000 chickens killed in a barn fire in Orvelte, including whether fire prevention in existing barns is adequate, whether asbestos roofs should be removed faster, and how many animals died in barn fires in 2015. The Secretary of State says the barns date from the 1970s, municipal inspections found nothing, the cause is under investigation, the fire-prevention action plan will be evaluated in early 2017, and the asbestos-roof removal goal is 2024 with a subsidy scheme and a versnellingsaanpak; he refers to an earlier report for the 2015 animal death figures.
I will take the outcomes of this investigation into account in the barn fire action plan.
Ik zal de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek meenemen in het actieplan stalbranden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het opruimen van oorlogsmunitie in Apeldoorn

An MP asked the ministers whether the ordnance clearance around Apeldoorn is underfunded and whether the remaining explosives pose an unacceptable fire and safety risk. The minister answered that the municipality is responsible for risk assessment and clearance, that the fire service works only on cleared paths, and that clearance of phase 2 is expected to take 8 to 8.5 years.
Responsibility for public order and safety is a local responsibility.
De zorg voor openbare orde en veiligheid is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Albert de Vries over de beloning van directeuren van woningcorporaties boven de wettelijke norm

Two PvdA MPs asked whether housing corporation directors earning above the WNT pay norm, including those not covered by the transitional rules, would be brought under the norm and whether the norm is justified. The minister answered that accountant reports for 2015 will be checked by the Autoriteit woningcorporaties, that transitional rules protect existing contracts, and that the current maxima are considered appropriate.

When checking the 2015 accountant reports of the various corporations, it will be determined whether the top officials mentioned in the article still fall under the transitional rules based on the annual reports approved by the accountant.

Antwoord 2 Bij de controle van de accountantsrapporten over 2015 van de verschillende corporaties zal worden vastgesteld of de in het artikel genoemde topfunctionarissenvallen op grond van de door de account goedgekeurde jaarverslagen nog steeds onder het overgangsrecht vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Kerstens over een inbraak in de database van de gemeente Ede

MPs Oosenbrug and Kerstens asked about a hack of the Ede municipal database exposing residents' data, whether a police report was filed, the Data Protection Authority's role, municipal hack statistics, and whether a central municipal secure portal should be created. The minister confirmed a police report and ongoing investigation, declined to comment on the specific case, reported 147 municipal breach notifications in early 2016, and pointed to existing municipal cooperation and a possible KING proof of concept.
An investigation is currently ongoing. Therefore no statements can be made about this.
Er loopt momenteel een onderzoek. Derhalve kunnen hieromtrent geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over het mogelijk maken om een hypotheek met hoge rente stapsgewijs en boetevrij om te zetten in een hypotheek met een lager rentepercentage

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked whether existing mortgage holders could convert high-rate mortgages stepwise and penalty-free to lower rates, and whether banks may still charge early-repayment fees under the new EU Mortgage Credit Directive. The minister explained that fees must now reflect actual losses for new mortgages, that the AFM is still investigating compliance for existing contracts, and that no standardised stepwise conversion guide will be published.
There is currently no overview available showing how the various mortgage lenders in the Netherlands calculate the early repayment compensation.
Er is op dit moment geen overzicht voorhanden waarin wordt weergegeven op welke wijze de verschillende hypotheekverstrekkers in Nederland de vergoeding bij vervroegde aflossing berekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over het bericht "Binnenlandse zaken paait grote gemeenten"

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes (CDA) asked the Minister of the Interior why he adopted a 33% redistribution step in the municipal fund subcluster VHROSV despite advice from the Rfv and VNG favouring full implementation, and whether he would reconsider or monitor actual costs. The Minister defended the decision as consistent with the VNG's May advice, citing open ends in the research, and said the fundamental review of the municipal fund is underway with cost monitoring feeding into it.

With this decision, which follows the VNG advice from May of this year, I have weighed the research results differently than the Rfv and the motion adopted by a narrow majority at the VNG general members meeting.

Ik ben met dit besluit, dat aansluit bij het VNG advies uit mei van dit jaar, tot een andere weging gekomen van de resultaten van het onderzoek dan de Rfv en de met een nipte meerderheid aangenomen motie op de Algemene ledenvergadering van de VNG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moors en Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Amsterdam gaat huurders financieel bijstaan

MPs Moors and Van der Linde asked the ministers about Amsterdam's plan to financially support tenants through rent reductions funded by the municipality and their view on using poverty funds against costly housing. The government answered that existing rent instruments suffice, that the Amsterdam approach is individual case-based and grounded in local agreements rather than the Participatiewet, and that municipalities and corporations each carry defined responsibilities.

Incidentally, it has come to my attention that Amsterdam does not base this policy on the Participatiewet, but is an elaboration of the cooperation agreements between the tenants' association, the federation of housing corporations and the municipality of Amsterdam.
Overigens is mij gebleken dat Amsterdam het onderhavige beleid niet baseert op de Participatiewet, maar betreft het een Uitwerking van de Samenwerkingsafspraken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het artikel ‘Bouw faalt als keurmeester van zichzelf’

An MP asked the minister about a newspaper report that construction failed as its own inspector in The Hague, and about how the Den Haag pilot relates to other quality-assurance experiments and the pending Kwaliteitsborging bill. The minister answered that residents have no cause for alarm because municipal oversight and warranty guarantees apply, and described the pilots as tests of instruments for the planned new quality-assurance system.
The municipality of The Hague actively ensures it receives the handover files as quickly as possible and that any repairs are carried out adequately.
De gemeente Den Haag ziet er actief op toe dat zij de opleverdossiers zo snel mogelijk ontvangt en dat eventueel herstel adequaat wordt uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over natuurbegraven

An MP asked the government about natural burial sites: how many exist, whether they are concentrated in certain regions because of groundwater levels, their environmental effects, and the rule in the burial decree requiring graves to lie 30 cm above the highest average groundwater level. The minister answered that there is no single definition and about 20 sites exist, that effects on nature are limited with proper management, and that a possible exception to the groundwater rule will be considered in a further review of implementation practice.
No figures are known on the number of burials in nature.
Van het aantal begrafenissen in de natuur zijn geen cijfers bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over onduidelijkheid over hoofdverblijf bij huurwoningen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about unclear rules on what counts as a main residence (hoofdverblijf) in rented homes, after a family was evicted by a housing corporation for living abroad. The minister answered that the case is still before the courts, that the concept is not defined in law but shaped by case law, and that the judge decides, while corporations should clarify their expectations to tenants.
Ultimately it is up to the judge to assess whether there is a main residence or not.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de rechter om te beoordelen of sprake is van hoofdverblijf of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Marcouch over huuropzegging wegens langdurig verblijf in het buitenland

MPs De Vries and Marcouch asked the Minister for Housing about tenancy terminations for long stays abroad, including the term 'housing fraud', the grounds for dissolving leases, the lack of statutory minimum occupancy rules, information for tenants, and risk of arbitrary enforcement. The minister answered that the term has no legal consequence, that landlords set occupancy rules contractually and courts decide case by case, and that no new regulation is needed.
I see no need to introduce further regulation on this point.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om op dit punt met nadere regelgeving te komen.
Antwoord op vragen Van der Linde en Van Vliet over het artikel ‘De Key staat Airbnb toe in sociale huurhuizen’

MPs Van der Linde and Van Vliet asked the Minister for Housing whether he knew of, was consulted about, and would act against a plan by housing corporation De Key to allow Airbnb-style tourist rentals of social rental homes. The minister said he opposes such use, that corporations currently do not permit it, that De Key has dropped the experiment, and that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties could intervene if such a plan proceeded.
If the Aw is of the opinion that statutory provisions are at stake through the conduct of a housing corporation, it can intervene by means of an intervention.
Indien de Aw van oordeel is dat de wettelijke bepalingen in het geding zijn door het handelen van een woningcorporatie, dan kan zij door middel van een interventie ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Gesthuizen over digitale platforms voor verhuur van woningen aan toeristen, zoals Airbnb en Wimdu

Two SP MPs asked the Ministers for Housing and Economic Affairs about short-term tourist rental of homes via platforms like Airbnb, including whether social rental homes may be rented out and whether a notification duty is needed. Minister Blok answered that social housing must not be used for tourist rental, that existing laws (Huisvestingswet, Woningwet, Wro) already give municipalities enough enforcement tools, and that no notification duty is planned for now, while the government is working on a tax-data provision and on local agreements with platforms.
Due to privacy considerations, there is currently no possibility to oblige Airbnb to provide the data of providers or users of its services to the government.
In verband met de privacy is er op dit moment geen mogelijkheid om Airbnb te verplichten de gegevens van aanbieders of gebruikers van hun diensten aan de overheid te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Vliet en Bashir over het bericht dat het Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw de woningwet blokkeert

MPs Van Vliet and Bashir asked whether the Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw is blocking housing corporations from splitting their social (DAEB) and commercial (non-DAEB) activities, and why it requires mortgage power over all property. The minister replied that corporations must submit splitting proposals to the Aw by 1 January 2017, that no proposals had yet been filed, that WSW's collateral demands are meant for financial stress, and that WSW will publish conditions for releasing collateral, with no risk fee charged in 2017.
WSW requests a power of attorney over all collateral because in situations of financial stress the value of the underlying collateral can drop quickly.
Het WSW vraagt volmacht op al het onderpand, omdat in situaties van financiële stress de waarde van het onderliggende onderpand snel terug kan lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Karabulut over huurverlaging bij inkomensdaling

MPs Bashir and Karabulut asked why housing corporations need not reduce rents when tenants' incomes fall, and why the government does not expand rent reductions after income decline. The minister replied that the law already allows tenants with income falling after income-dependent rent increases to request a reduction, that he is not willing to widen this, and that he will survey corporations on how often reductions were granted.
In the committee debate of 25 May 2016 I committed to asking the housing corporations this autumn how often they have lowered the rent at the tenant's request due to income decline.

In het AO Diverse woononderwerpen van 25 mei 2016 heb ik toegezegd dat ik dit najaar bij de woningcorporaties ga navragen hoe vaak zij de huurprijs op voorstel van de huurder wegens inkomensdaling hebben verlaagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over opvallende vastgoeddeals van ING

MPs asked the ministers whether they were involved in, or aware of, questionable real estate deals by ING and how housing corporation Rochdale could lose 35 million euro on the sale of the Frankemaheerd office building to ING. The minister answered that the deals are private transactions outside state pre-approval, that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties found Rochdale acted within the rules, and that the sale price reflected a long, difficult process, while stating ING and Rochdale did not know of an 18 million option.
I note that these are agreements between private parties.
Ik stel vast dat het hier om overeenkomsten gaat tussen private partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de stijging van huren in de vrije sector

The MP asks the Minister about rising rents in the private rental sector, the effect of the Supreme Court ruling on intermediary fees, whether rent regulation is needed, and tenant protection and oversight. The Minister disputes the Pararius rent-rise figures, says the ruling benefits tenants, and commits to discussing rent moderation with commercial landlords and reporting later this year.
I will inform you of the outcome of this consultation later this year.
Ik zal u over het resultaat van dit overleg later dit jaar berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Veldman over vleermuizen die bouwprojecten belemmeren

MPs Van der Linde and Veldman asked about bats (vleermuizen) blocking construction projects and housing for migrants under the Flora and Fauna Act, and whether the upcoming Environment Act could prevent delays. The minister answered that the government commissioned research into the economic effects and will respond, that about 250 exemptions were granted in 2014-2015 without data on stoppages, and that integrated planning, provincial responsibility under the Nature Conservation Act and standardised project approaches can prevent delays.
I have commissioned research into the problem and its economic consequences.
Ik heb onderzoek laten doen naar de problematiek en de economische gevolgen daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over de opvang van statushouders in het voormalige Missiehuis in Driehuis

An MP asked the Minister for Housing and Government Property why the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf demands full costs, maintenance and taxes for the former Missiehuis in Driehuis that Velsen wants to use for refugee housing. The minister answers that the building is offered at cost-covering rent, that gemeenten can use the national subsidy scheme for local arrangements, and that the Rijk makes neither profit nor loss, leaving the decision to Velsen.
The Rijk rents to a municipality at a cost-covering price.
Het Rijk verhuurt tegen een kostendekkende prijs aan een gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over vochtproblemen of schimmel in huis
