An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about mould and damp in homes, citing reports of widespread problems and corporations' claims they lack funds for maintenance. The minister answered that corporations are responsible for their stock, that tenants can turn to the Huurcommissie, courts or municipality, and that no additional national measures are needed.
I therefore see no reason to assign myself a larger role.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden mijzelf een grotere rol toe te dichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van de leden Bashir en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat driekwart van de studenten teveel huur betaalt

MPs Bashir and Van Dijk asked the Minister for Housing about an LSVb survey finding that 74% of students pay too much rent, and about enforcement, local rent-check teams and how the Rent Tribunal's rulings were communicated. The Minister replied that betaalbaarheid is on the platform's agenda and in the monitor, that municipalities decide on rent teams, that Rent Tribunal rulings were published in a public register, and that existing information and rent-check tools suffice, so no additional measures are planned.
I see no need to take additional measures for this target group.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om voor deze doelgroep aanvullende maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Keijzer over verdringing op de woningmarkt door statushouders

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister for Housing about reports that statushouders (refugees with status) take up a third of freed-up social homes, displacing others, and about whether gemeenten can meet their housing quotas. The minister said the Companen figures come from a survey not a study, stressed local tailoring, pointed to existing subsidy and agreement instruments, and promised follow-up on the motion De Vries.
I am of the view that housing policy is best implemented at local level, with as little as possible imposed from above.
Ik ben van mening dat het woningmarktbeleid het best op lokaal niveau kan worden ingevuld waarbij zo min mogelijk van bovenaf moet worden opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Rog over de het bericht dat Amsterdamse studenten te veel huur betalen

MPs Ronnes and Rog asked the minister whether it is true that 88 percent of Amsterdam students pay rent above the statutory point system limit, and what action will be taken. The minister answered that the figure refers to 265 students who checked their rent online, not all Amsterdam students, that tenants can appeal to the rent commission, and that affordability is on the Landelijk Platform Studentenhuisvesting agenda.
Contrary to what the headline of this report suggests, my conclusion is not that nearly 88 percent of Amsterdam students pay more rent than the statutory point system allows.

Anders dan de kop van dit bericht weergeeft is mijn conclusie niet dat bijna 88 procent van de Amsterdamse studenten een hogere huur betaalt dan volgens het wettelijk puntensysteem voor huurprijzen is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over de vorming van woningmarktregio’s

An MP asks the Minister for Housing whether housing associations can effectively veto the housing market regions municipalities prefer by refusing exemptions or splits, and whether the Minister will intervene or change the law. The Minister answers that municipalities propose regions, exemptions are a separate procedure with criteria, the Minister will not steer the regional proposals, and he will not legislate forced splits because that would violate property rights.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over de toename van het tekort aan seniorenwoningen

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about a reported growing shortage of senior housing, the Ipso Facto/ANBO study, why small municipalities already face shortages, and whether the government will help municipalities gather data and include senior housing in performance agreements. The Minister acknowledged the report, argued senior housing is primarily a local matter, questioned a shortage, and said the government will consult the VNG and produce a practical guide for municipalities.
It is up to municipalities to decide how they fill in their housing vision and the performance agreements based on it.
Het is aan gemeenten om te bepalen hoe zij hun woonvisie, en daarop gebaseerde prestatieafspraken in willen vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de berichten over een tekort aan seniorenwoningen

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about reports of a shortage of senior-suitable housing and about ANBO research showing many municipalities lack insight into suitable homes for seniors. The Minister answered that the government sees municipalities, housing corporations and regional partners as responsible, with the national government in a facilitating role, and committed to monitoring Woonvisies and prestatieafspraken and evaluating them before the budget debate.
The national government has a facilitating and supporting role, for example by removing uncertainties in implementation or offering room for experimentation.
Het Rijk heeft een faciliterende en ondersteunende rol, bijvoorbeeld door onduidelijkheden in de uitvoering weg te nemen of experimenteerruimte te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Jan Slagter over zijn verpleeghuis ‘Ben Oude Nijhuis’

MP Leijten asks the State Secretary for Health about a proposed small-scale nursing home for dementia patients with low incomes, whether the government supports it, why housing corporations show no interest in investing, and what the government did in advisory-team consultations on small-scale housing. The State Secretary says he supports such initiatives, which already exist and are funded, declines to judge the specific initiative's plans, points to local responsibility of corporations and municipalities, and reports the consultations covered the advisory team's findings.
Whether in Mr. Slagter's case there were sound plans I cannot and will not assess. That is for the care office, the financier or a housing corporation with which cooperation is sought.

Of in het geval van dhr. Slagter ook sprake was van degelijke plannen kan en wil ik niet beoordelen. Dit is aan het zorgkantoor, de financier of een woningcorporatie waarmee samenwerking wordt gezocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Azmani over het rapport ‘Rotterdamse aanpak statushouders, 2016 – 2020’ van het Rotterdamse college van burgemeester en wethouders

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a Rotterdam report attributing its backlog in housing status holders to problems with IND documents, BSN numbers and file completeness. The government answered that it does not share that conclusion, outlined the registration and information-exchange arrangements and existing support teams, and gave the number of permit holders awaiting housing.
No, I do not share that conclusion.
Nee, die conclusie deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over de sloop van krakkemikkige gebouwen

MP Schouten asks whether demolition of dilapidated buildings can cost a plot its residential zoning without planning compensation, and whether VAT on building land deters demolition compared with transfer tax. The minister replies that demolition does not itself remove zoning, that existing procedural safeguards and planning damage compensation rules are adequate, and that the VAT exemption is fixed by EU directive so the law cannot be changed.
Demolition does not automatically lead to a plot losing its residential zoning.
Sloop leidt er niet toe dat een perceel vanzelf zijn woonbestemming verliest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Smaling over het energiezuinig maken van huurwoningen en het voordeel voor huurders

Two SP MPs asked the Minister for Housing about the Amsterdam audit office's recommendation on energy-saving measures in social rental housing, the gap between expected and actual energy savings, and whether tenants financially benefit from energy renovations and an energy performance fee. The minister said the audit office did not recommend reconsidering specific measures, that municipalities have discretion and tools, declined to give a general figure on tenant costs, and rejected a mandatory rent-cost guarantee.
I cannot state in general terms what the financial advantage or disadvantage is for tenants when their home is made energy-efficient.
Ik kan niet in algemene zin aangeven wat het financiële voor- of nadeel is voor huurders wanneer hun woning energiezuinig wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp, Fokke en Yücel over het mogelijk moeten sluiten van gevangenis De Karelskamp te Almelo

Three PvdA MPs asked whether prison De Karelskamp in Almelo might be closed, what the status of the reported closure plans is, and whether this would cost jobs in a shrinkage region. The Staatssecretaris answered that DJI is drafting a plan in response to falling capacity needs, that no definitive closure decision has been taken, that shrinkage regions are one weighted factor, and that a political decision will follow after new WODC research and a second opinion.
I have instructed the Custodial Institutions Agency (DJI) to develop a plan on how to deal with the declining capacity requirement.
Ik heb de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI) de opdracht gegeven een plan te ontwikkelen hoe om te gaan met de dalende capaciteitsbehoefte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over onterechte huren boven de liberalisatiegrens

An MP asks the minister whether unlawfully liberalised rents above the liberalisation threshold are widespread, whether tenants are adequately informed of their rights and of the rent-check route, and whether a one-off review of liberalised contracts should be introduced. The minister answers that Huurcommissie data show a limited number of disputed cases, that existing information channels and court routes suffice, and that no extra review is needed, while noting a sector-wide reform will limit liberalisation going forward.
I do not have data on possibly unlawfully liberalised rental contracts.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens over mogelijk onterecht geliberaliseerde huurcontracten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Van Dekken over het mogelijk moeten sluiten van gevangenissen

MPs Volp and Van Dekken asked whether eight prisons and three youth institutions would close, whether staff had been informed, and how the government would respect the De Vries motion on regional job losses. The State Secretary answered that a WODC study and second opinion on the forecasting model are underway, DJI has been asked to draft a flexibility plan to be discussed with mayors, and the motion is one criterion in that assessment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het opkrikken van de huurprijs door gesjoemel met de energie-index

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing whether the energy-index used to set rents, and the data behind it, should be disclosed to tenants on request, and why the sample check and 8% margin were considered adequate. The minister opposed a mandatory disclosure duty, pointed tenants to the Huurcommissie for disputes, and said quality assurance lies with the certification system, with an audit already underway.
No, I am not in favour of this obligation.
Nee, ik ben niet voor deze verplichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over onduidelijkheid en onwetendheid bij gemeenten over de nieuwe Woningwet

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about municipalities' unpreparedness and knowledge gaps regarding the new Housing Act (Woningwet), citing BMC and Binnenlands Bestuur research. The Minister replied that information provision, handbooks, congresses and tools have been offered, that municipalities are responsible for their own role and tenant participation, and that a fuller picture of housing visions will follow at end 2016.
The Ministry of BZK facilitates municipalities by making the relevant financial housing-corporation information available in an accessible way.
Het Ministerie van BZK faciliteert gemeenten door de relevante financiële corporatie-informatie overzichtelijk ter beschikking te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over een proefschrift over de wijkaanpak

An SP MP asked the minister for Housing and Central Government Affairs about a TU Delft PhD thesis on housing corporations' role in neighbourhood renewal, probing market-versus-state tensions, consolidation, tenant participation and the role of the WRR advice. The minister replied that the Woningwet 2015 clearly delineates corporations' neighbourhood liveability role, that effects cannot yet be assessed, and that municipalities should lead local neighbourhood policy.
It is too early to make statements about the effects of the Housing Act.
Het is te vroeg om uitspraken te doen over de effecten van de Woningwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over zeer kleine woningcorporaties

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about a Platform 31 report on very small housing associations, their definitions, the role of tenant bodies in the advice given, whether mergers and outsourcing could raise rents, the continued support for these associations, and the landlord levy. The Minister replied that the report reflects strategies of participants rather than advice, that the Woningwet implementation is the associations' own responsibility, that the levy paid by very small associations totals about 10 million euro, and that he will not abolish the levy for them but will address their position in its evaluation.
In the evaluation of the landlord levy I will also pay attention to the position of smaller housing associations.
Bij de evaluatie van de verhuurderheffing zal ik ook aandacht besteden aan de positie van kleinere woningcorporaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht ‘het energielabel misverstand van minister Blok’

MP Albert de Vries asked whether the Commission's withdrawal of an infringement procedure meant the Dutch energy label fully complies with EU rules and that a fine threat is gone, and whether the Commission's letter could be shared. Minister Blok answered that the procedure closed as full transposition of the EPBD, that a second fine-related phase on implementation remains, and that no separate letter on the closure exists.
No letter was provided on the closure of infringement procedure 2012/0388.
Er is geen brief verstrekt over de sluiting van inbreukprocedure 2012/0388.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het energielabel

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Housing about the Energy Agreement target of label B for rental homes by 2020, the progress of the 400 million euro STEP subsidy, and whether corporations should be pre-financed. The minister answered that corporations are primarily accountable for the target, that subsidy is paid after renovation and pre-financing is their own responsibility, and that STEP may be made more attractive in spring 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het energielabel

An MP asks the minister about reports that the European Commission has not yet accepted the Dutch energy label methodology, including remote assessment concerns and the content of the Commission's questions. The minister replies that the transposition is complete, that the current stage is an informal EU pilot with no fine threatened, and that the Commission's questions are answered, but declines to release the correspondence in full.
I cannot provide the European Commission's questions to your House without conditions.
De vragen van de Europese Commissie kan ik niet ongeclausuleerd aan uw Kamer verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat er veel meer daklozen in Nederland zijn

An MP asked whether the government is aware of reports that homelessness in the Netherlands has risen sharply. The State Secretary answered that the CBS figures are based on registrations for shelter and homeless benefit, not street counts, and pointed to measures on social housing access for status holders.
These figures therefore relate to the number of people who claim shelter and a homeless benefit, and not necessarily the number of people who live on the street.
Deze cijfers hebben dus betrekking op het aantal personen dat een beroep doet op opvang en een daklozenuitkering en niet perse het aantal mensen dat op straat verblijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de sloop van goedkope huurwoningen in Rotterdam

An MP asked the Minister whether Rotterdam's plan to demolish about 20,000 cheap rental homes, and the effects on low-income access, was acceptable. The Minister confirmed the figures but said the plans are local matters for the municipality, declined to comment on substance, and gave no concrete action.
It is not my role as Minister to respond substantively to the plans as described in the Rotterdam municipality's housing vision.
Het is niet mijn rol als Minister om inhoudelijk te reageren op de plannen zoals omschreven in de Woonvisie van de gemeente Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het opkrikken van de huurprijs door een hoog energielabel

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about a case where an old rental home received a high energy label that raised the rent, and about how rent-related energy assessments are verified and whether fraud occurs. The minister said the Energy-Index is set by certified advisers, tenants can get the underlying data or appeal to the Huurcommissie, fraud is only a matter for courts, and only a few adjustments occurred in four years.
The judge will rule on the nature of the evidence documents in a court case.
Over de aard van de bewijsstukken in een rechtszaak zal de rechter een uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over het bericht 'Falende topambtenaren snel weer aan topbaan geholpen'

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister for Housing and Civil Service whether senior civil servants who failed are rarely dismissed and instead quickly reappointed, and how this is treated differently from other staff. The minister replied that performance assessment applies to all civil servants, that top officials' 7-year terms and departures reflect various circumstances, and that no forced dismissals occurred at top level in 2011 to date, with 24 top-level departures reported.
The exact circumstances of each individual case are confidential personnel matters.
De exacte toedracht per individuele casus is personeelsvertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Bashir over de voortgang van de aanpak van koopkrotten in Rotterdam Zuid

The SP MP Bashir asked the Minister for Housing about delays in tackling roughly 10,000 privately owned dilapidated homes in Rotterdam-Zuid, the funding gap of about EUR 40 million, and whether tenants and housing corporations should be shielded from paying for it. The Minister acknowledged the delay and disagreement between the municipality and corporations, said the national government is supporting the process, promised to inform parliament before 1 April 2016 on the motion implementation, and confirmed the 10,000-home ambition remains.
Before 1 April 2016 I will inform the House about this.
Vóór 1 april 2016 zal ik uw kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het tekort aan huurwoningen voor statushouders en andere woningzoekenden

The MP Bashir (SP) asked the Minister for Housing about the shortage of rental homes for refugees with residence permits and other housing seekers, including why monthly placements fell and how many are waiting. The Minister answered that municipalities are on track to meet their quota, that the figure of 23,400 is the half-year quota rather than people waiting, and that he sees no need for extra measures such as halting sales or demolition of social housing.
Therefore I see at this moment no reason to take additional measures, such as those proposed in question 9.
Derhalve zie ik op dit moment geen reden om aanvullende maatregelen te treffen, zoals die in vraag 9 worden voorgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Keijzer over de opvang van statushouders

CDA MPs Ronnes and Keijzer asked the Minister for Housing about Brabant municipalities lacking housing for refugees, rising social-housing waiting times, whether municipalities can meet their 2016 placement quotas, and the status of alternative housing under the Bestuursakkoord. Minister Blok answered that waiting-time effects cannot be precisely isolated, that municipalities should be able to meet quotas, and that 325 subsidy applications for about 1,647 places were under review.
I committed to your House on 26 November 2015 to have a study carried out into waiting times for social rental housing.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 26 november 2015 toegezegd een onderzoek te laten uitvoeren naar de wachttijden voor sociale huurwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat statushouders met voorrang een sociale huurwoning krijgen met lagere huur van een woningcorporatie in Amsterdam

An MP asked the minister whether a Amsterdam housing association (not a recognised social landlord) gives refugee status holders priority and lower rents for social housing, and whether this should be stopped. The minister said the association falls outside his responsibility, that landlords set rents within rules, and that the Huisvestingswet urgency rule for permit holders is being removed by a bill to be sent to parliament this spring.
Because this is not a recognised housing association, the allocation system of this association does not fall under my policy responsibility.
Omdat dit geen toegelaten instelling is valt het toewijzingssysteem van deze vereniging niet onder mijn beleidsverantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Koolmees over het bericht dat de pachttermijn van zes jaar voor landbouwgrond te kort is

MPs Koşer Kaya and Koolmees asked about reports that six-year farm lease terms are too short to protect soil fertility in Flevoland and elsewhere, and about lease prices, farm incomes, Rijksvastgoedbedrijf practices and possible lease discounts for sustainable soil management. The State Secretary answered that the government is aware of the soil concerns, describes the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf's soil-quality checks and building plans, provides lease price and income data, and declines to introduce a lease discount while exploring a broader review of the lease system.
I am not prepared to introduce a lease discount.
Ik ben niet bereid een pachtkorting te introduceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht «ING stopt met watervilla hypotheken»

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister about ING ending houseboat mortgages, the market consequences, and how to attract new providers. The minister confirmed ING is the largest player, that Rabobank will remain the only provider, and that the government will consult the Dutch banking association on new entrants.
Consultation will be held with the Dutch Banking Association and it will be asked what ideas they have to ensure more providers of houseboat mortgages can enter the market.

Er zal overleg worden gevoerd met de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken en gevraagd worden welke ideeën zij hebben om ervoor te zorgen dat er meer aanbieders van woonboothypotheken op de markt kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Te hoge hypotheken verstrekt door verwarring over regels’

MPs Van der Linde and Aukje de Vries asked whether lenders wrongly granted NHG mortgages up to 106% LTV based on minimal energy-saving measures, whether homeowners are harmed, and how rules and oversight should respond. The minister confirmed some lenders breached the rules, attributed partial confusion to WEW guidance, said homeowners face no tax loss, and that WEW clarified its norms and the AFM will inventory the problem.
It is correct that a number of institutions granted mortgages with an LTV of 106% without the full additional financing room being spent on energy-saving measures.
Het klopt dat een aantal instellingen hypotheken hebben verstrekt met een LTV van 106% zonder dat de volledige extra financieringsruimte is besteed aan energiebesparende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Albert de Vries over het gevaar van betonblokken

MPs Cegerek and Albert de Vries asked whether concrete blocks containing waste (including lead-containing cathode-ray tube glass and fluorescent tubes) pose risks to people and the environment, how many accidents occurred, and whether stricter controls are needed. The State Secretary answered that cathode-ray tube glass processing is a permitted practice, that the RIVM advises against it, that existing permits are not criminal, that new insights will be shared with the regional authorities and the third national waste plan, and that the only reported accident is with the public prosecutor, so no conclusion on stricter controls can be drawn.

I will present the new insights to the environmental services that are the competent authorities for the producers of concrete blocks and will also include these insights in the upcoming third National Waste Management Plan (LAP3).

Ik zal de nieuwe inzichten voorleggen aan de omgevingsdiensten die bevoegd gezag zijn voor de producenten van betonblokken en deze inzichten tevens opnemen in het komende derde Landelijk Afvalbeheerplan (LAP3).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Fokke over het bericht dat bestuurders in de buurt meetellen bij de planning van asielzoekerscentra

MPs Kuiken and Fokke asked whether officials at the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf were right to check which local administrators live near a possible asylum site, and why. The minister answered that COA, not the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, is responsible for finding locations, that the wording in the email suggests such considerations can and may not matter, and that COA does not use a social map and no sites were rejected on this basis; the answers to earlier questions were referred to.
The wording of the email, as reported in the Algemeen Dagblad, creates the suggestion that the presence of administrators could make a difference. That cannot and may not be the case.
Het taalgebruik uit de e-mail, zoals gemeld in het Algemeen Dagblad, wekt de suggestie dat de aanwezigheid van bestuurders verschil kan maken. Dat kan en mag niet het geval zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat welke bestuurders omwonend zijn wordt meegewogen bij plannen voor asielzoekerscentra

An MP asked the minister whether the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf mapped which local administrators live near the Julianakazerne before COA decided not to request it for asylum reception, whether such stakeholder mapping is standard, and whether COA would now request the site. The minister says the stakeholder analysis covered all parties affected by a zoning change without differentiating by role, that the wording suggesting administrators matter is unacceptable and not reflected in actual conduct, and that the site was ultimately offered to COA and then to the municipality, while COA chose another site after consultation with The Hague.
The wording in the email, as reported in the Algemeen Dagblad, creates the impression that the presence of administrators could make a difference. That cannot and may not be the case.
Het taalgebruik uit de e-mail, zoals gemeld in het Algemeen Dagblad, wekt de suggestie dat de aanwezigheid van bestuurders verschil kan maken. Dat kan en mag niet het geval zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht “Bestuurder in de buurt weegt mee bij locatie AZC”

An MP asked whether a list of 36 residents near the Prinses Julianakazerne, some of them officials, was compiled as part of a site assessment for an asylum centre and whether locations were rejected because administrators lived nearby. The government answered that the list was an inventory linked to a possible change of use, that the presence of administrators is not a relevant factor for the COA, and that no locations were rejected for that reason.
That may not and cannot be the case.
Dat kan en mag niet het geval zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Vliet over hoge vertrekbonussen bij een woningcorporatie

MPs Ronnes and Van Vliet asked the minister about exceptionally high exit payments to supervisory board members at housing corporation Weller, and whether the WNT transitional rules were properly applied. The minister answered that the payments were legal under the pre-WNT reglement and the transitional regime, that he finds them socially insensitive, and that no WNT violation was found so no clawback is planned.
Er is derhalve conform de regelgeving gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de papieren werkelijkheid van passend toewijzen

MP Bashir asks the minister why, in his view, the 95% fit-allocation norm for housing corporations is unworkable and whether the norm should be relaxed or its interaction with the planned rent-harmonisation system addressed. The minister rejects the claim that the norm is unworkable or should be relaxed, argues corporations can meet it through careful allocation and rent setting, and declines to provide sanction and regional compliance figures before the 2017 budget debate, pointing to the 2016 reporting cycle.
Unfortunately it is not possible for me to provide the requested data for the 2017 budget debate.
Het is mij helaas niet mogelijk om de gevraagde gegevens te verstrekken voor de begrotingsbehandeling 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Kerstens inzake de onlangs afgesloten schikking van woningcorporatie Vestia met een oud-bestuurder

MPs Albert de Vries and Kerstens asked the minister how the settlement between Vestia and former CEO Staal was reached and whether it is an acceptable outcome given the damage. The minister acknowledges the damage and the unsatisfying outcome, but argues the settlement is the maximum achievable and that the Vestia board, under supervision, made a reasoned decision; he has no means to undo it and points to existing supervisory principles.
I have no means to undo such civil-law settlements.
Ik heb geen middelen om dergelijke civielrechtelijke schikkingen ongedaan te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de dreigende kaalslag in de huursector in Rotterdam

An SP MP asks the housing minister about Rotterdam's plan to cut 20,000 social rental homes via demolition or renovation pushing rents above the liberalisation limit, and whether the government was consulted. The minister replies that housing policy is a municipal matter, that residents and housing associations have consultation and agreement routes, and that the municipal housing vision is still a draft.
It is not my role to respond substantively to the plans.
Het is niet mijn rol om inhoudelijk op de plannen te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Marcouch over het bericht dat de nieuwe korpschef van de Nationale Politie € 75.000 compensatie voor salarisverlies krijgt

PvdA MPs Kerstens and Marcouch asked about the reported €75,000 compensation for salary loss given to the new national police chief, and why it was paid as a severance under the civil service rules rather than a WNT exception. The ministers answered that it is a discretionary payment under the civil service regulation capped at €75,000 by the WNT, justified by the public interest in filling the post quickly, with any further compensation to be arranged within police employment rules.
In order to remove this obstacle, it was examined whether there was a possibility to compensate.
Ten einde deze belemmering weg te nemen, is bezien of er een mogelijkheid was te compenseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Van Raak over het bericht dat er ruim zes ton is betaald aan een ex-topman van een woningcorporatie

MPs Bashir and Van Raak asked the ministers about reports that a former housing corporation executive received over six hundred thousand euros, and whether this was a sham consultancy arrangement harming tenants. The minister replied that the severance was allowed under a court ruling, that no sham arrangement was found since a real change of board occurred, and that the government will consider WNT extension and tackle such constructions in the evaluation process.

A sham construction exists when a top executive of an organisation falling under the WNT changes function and in name no longer acts as executive but de facto still leads the organisation, in order to obtain a higher salary than allowed.

Van een schijnconstructie is sprake als een topbestuurder van een organisatie die onder de Wet normering topinkomens (WNT) valt, van functie wisselt en in naam niet meer als bestuurder optreedt maar de facto nog steeds leiding geeft aan de organisatie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht: ‘Geen voordeel verzekeraar meer bij NHG-lening’

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister whether Solvency II rules that deny insurers the risk-reducing effect of the NHG mortgage guarantee, and the late communication of this, will raise NHG mortgage rates and distort competition. The minister confirmed the problem, said DNB rightly sees no legal room to recognise NHG under the current standard formula, pledged to work with DNB to fix it in the 2018 review, and argued the effect on rates and competition would be small.

Once the European Commission starts the evaluation of the delegated acts, expected to be completed in 2018, the Ministry of Finance will work together with DNB to resolve this omission in the Solvency II framework recently identified by DNB.

Zodra de Europese Commissie de evaluatie van de gedelegeerde handelingen opstart, waarvan de afronding is voorzien in 2018, zal het Ministerie van Financiën zich gezamenlijk met DNB inzetten om deze onlangs door DNB geconstateerde omissie in het Solvabiliteit II kader op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de vertraging in de behandeling van het wetsvoorstel kwaliteitsborging bouw

An MP asks why the building quality assurance bill has been delayed, whether regulatory burden or market signals are behind it, and what its goals and timetable are. The minister says the delay reflects pending regulatory-burden and cost-benefit studies and stakeholder talks, that the bill covers about 53% of permit-required works in the lowest consequence class (not 80%), and that he still intends to submit it soon.
I still intend to send the bill to your House soon.
Ik heb nog steeds het voornemen om het wetsvoorstel spoedig naar uw Kamer te sturen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over een mogelijke fout in het Besluit huurprijzen woonruimte

An MP asked whether a drafting error caused a discrepancy between the draft and final Besluit huurprijzen woonruimte, and whether amendment is needed. The minister confirmed an administrative error during a redaction change and committed to amending the decree as soon as possible.
There is a difference resulting from an administrative error during an amendment for editorial reasons.
Er is sprake van een verschil als gevolg van een administratieve misslag bij een aanpassing om redactionele redenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de ingebruikname van de Julianakazerne voor de opvang van asielzoekers

An MP asked why the Julianakazerne in The Hague was not requested by the COA for asylum reception, despite a minister's earlier statement that the COA was still considering it, and whether the COA would now request it. The government answered that the COA requests a location only after prior consultation with the municipality, that a formal request was made for the former Ministry of Social Affairs building because The Hague agreed, and that the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf was asked to offer suitable state-owned sites.
The COA only makes a formal request to a municipality for the use of a particular location once consultation has taken place.
Het COA doet pas een formeel verzoek aan een gemeente voor de ingebruikname van een bepaalde locatie als er overleg is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Bashir over het gemak van inbraken bij sociale huurwoningen

MPs Kooiman and Bashir (SP) asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Housing about burglary risks in social rental housing, including the share of doors and windows with weak locks and whether the government will fund better protection. Minister Van der Steur answered that prevention is locally led and primarily the responsibility of residents and landlords, announced a 2 million euro co-financed fund for hotspot neighbourhoods, and said no national data on burglaries in social rental housing are kept.
No national figures are kept on the number of burglaries in social rental housing.
Over het aantal inbraken bij sociale huurwoningen worden landelijk geen cijfers bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert de Vries over bouwkeurmerken in relatie tot aardbevingsbestendigheid

Two MPs asked whether earthquake risk in Groningen is factored into construction certification (KOMO, KIWA) and CE marking, and whether the sector can build earthquake-resistant. The minister answered that certificates cover material strength independent of load type, earthquake resistance is assessed through project-specific structural calculations, and a Groningen-specific regulation (NPR) is planned to be designated in the Bouwbesluit in early 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de risico’s van koolmonoxidevergiftiging door cv-installaties

An MP asks the Minister for Housing about the risks of carbon monoxide poisoning from central heating installations, including the OvV findings, public testing data for CO detectors, a mandatory installer certification scheme, and European appliance standards. The government answers almost every question by saying a cabinet position will follow in spring 2016, while acknowledging that the OvV finding that many incidents occur in young and serviced appliances revises the existing picture.
Currently the Minister of VWS and I are working on a cabinet position that will respond to the report.
Momenteel werken de minster van VWS en ik aan een kabinetsstandpunt waarin een reactie op het rapport wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Van Gerven over het onderschatte gevaar van koolmonoxide

MPs Bashir and Van Gerven asked the ministers about the underestimated carbon monoxide danger identified by the Safety Board, including modern boilers being involved, mandatory inspections, detector testing, and public information. The minister replied that a cabinet position would be sent in spring 2016, acknowledged that modern appliances are involved in many incidents, rejected mandatory inspections for now, and defended existing rules while deferring most concrete measures to the forthcoming cabinet position.
The minister of VWS and I are currently working on a cabinet position that will respond to the report.
Momenteel werken de minster van VWS en ik aan een kabinetsstandpunt waarin een reactie op het rapport wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht ‘Consument weet niet dat hypotheek tussentijds omlaag kan’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Housing whether homeowners are informed that they can lower their mortgage rate once loan-to-value falls, and whether banks should be pushed to inform them proactively. The minister answered that he will consult mortgage lenders on informing consumers and report back in spring 2016, without giving a substantive explanation yet.
I will inform you about this in spring 2016.
Ik zal u hierover in het voorjaar van 2016 informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Karabulut over het bericht dat huurverhogingen leiden tot armoede

MPs Bashir and Karabulut asked whether rent increases cause poverty and whether the government will curb rents and help affected tenants. The minister answered that income drops drive payment problems, that the rent-cap agreement and bill are in progress, refused a rent freeze, and pointed the tenant to rent reduction and housing-allocation options.
No, I am not willing to oblige landlords to freeze rents.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid verhuurders te verplichten de huren te bevriezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over huurbemiddelaars die nog steeds onterechte kosten in rekening brengen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing whether the government and ACM are aware that some rental intermediaries still charge tenants illegal double brokerage fees, what will be done, whether DirectWonen really works only for tenants, how many brokers go bankrupt and restart to avoid refund claims, and whether the minister will meet brokers and trade associations to urge refunds. The minister replied that ACM is aware and will enforce against collective violations, that existing law already prevents such fees and allows bankruptcy curators and director liability to be used, and that talks with trade associations would have little use since offending brokers are often not members.
I do not have figures on the number of brokers that declare bankruptcy or cease their business to continue it in another legal entity.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers van de aantallen bemiddelaars die zich failliet laten verklaren of hun bedrijf staken om het in een andere rechtspersoon voort te zetten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over een aanpassing van de Stimuleringsregeling Energieprestatie Huursector (STEP-regeling)

The SP MP Bashir asks whether Minister Blok will simplify the STEP scheme for energy improvements in rented flats and what the status is of its low uptake in the four largest cities, which the minister had promised to investigate. The minister replies that no specific barriers were found in the big cities, that lower uptake reflects local trade-offs between rent, investment and maintenance, and that he will explore improvements with stakeholders and report in spring 2016.
This consultation has now shown that there are no specific obstacles to using the scheme in those municipalities.
Uit dit overleg is inmiddels gebleken dat er geen specifieke belemmeringen voor gebruik van de regeling in die gemeenten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Vliet over de berichten inzake het megalomane project ‘Maankwartier’ in Heerlen

An MP asks the Minister for Housing about the Maankwartier project in Heerlen, in which housing corporation Weller invested tenant money, raising concerns about vacancy, undisclosed investors, financial risk, and refused Wob requests for progress reports. The Minister answers that Weller acted within the rules at the time, that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties finds its finances sound, and that the progress reports stay confidential, while acknowledging that such hotel and commercial activities are no longer permitted under the new Woningwet.
It is not in the interest of tenants that planned investments be fully public if that could make those investments more expensive or less profitable.
Het is niet in het belang van huurders dat voorgenomen investeringen volledig openbaar zijn als dat er toe kan leiden dat die investeringen daardoor duurder worden of minder opbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het misbruik dat DUO maakt van de Roemernorm

MP Van Raak asked whether DUO's handling of the Roemer norm (capping external staffing at 10% of personnel costs) was a pretext to send temporary agency workers home while keeping expensive top consultants, and how the minister would intervene. The minister denied any such intent, explained that DUO cut 18 external advisers and limited agency rostering for December due to seasonal patterns and leave, and stated that DUO treats agency workers as valued staff.
That is not the case. In enforcing the Roemer norm at DUO, all categories of external staff were examined.
Daarvan is geen sprake. Bij de handhaving van de Roemernorm door DUO is naar alle categorieën externen gekeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir, Jacobi, Albert de Vries, Koolmees, Ronnes en Van der Linde over aankoop van Dekemahiem door Vereniging Doarpskorporaasje Jirnsum

MPs asked the minister whether housing corporation Elkien's plan to demolish 24 affordable homes for elderly and starters in Jirnsum without rebuilding, and the sale to a village cooperative, required an Inspectorate review and a residual valuation, and why the process took so long. The minister answered that local housing policy is for the municipality, that sales to third parties need the regulator's consent at no less than market value, that the residual valuation request was refused, that the earlier rules applied, and that the 12-week decision period was not exceeded.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Oskam over de financiële gevolgen van het voorgenomen besluit van de Raad voor de rechtspraak zeven rechtbanken te ontmantelen en de toekomst of leegstand van deze gebouwen

MPs Van Nispen and Oskam asked about the financial consequences of the Judiciary's plan to dismantle seven courthouses, including ownership, costs, reuse of vacant buildings, and effects on court users and regions. The Minister answered that the Judiciary projects savings of 6 to 15 million euros annually, that the State owns most buildings, and that he declined to ask the Judiciary to assess negative effects in advance because the Minister's oversight is ex post.
For this reason I do not consider it appropriate for me to ask the Judiciary Council in advance to map out all possible negative (financial) consequences of the Judiciary's proposed location policy.
Daarom acht ik het niet passend dat ik de Raad vooraf verzoek allerlei mogelijk negatieve (financiële) gevolgen van het voorgenomen locatiebeleid van de Rechtspraak in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over staatssteun en woningcorporaties

An MP asked whether the European Commission's growing influence over Dutch social housing (via state aid rules, competition rules and the European Semester) is undesirable, and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that the Commission only checks compliance with EU rules, that the Dutch housing law already uses the discretion granted under Protocol 26, and that the government will raise housing and poverty themes during the Dutch EU presidency without a specific intervention.

The European Commission checks whether member states comply with the rules and, when this leads to outcomes undesirable for the member state, enters into discussion to reach agreements that minimise market distortion.

De Europese Commissie toetst of lidstaten aan de regels voldoen en gaat, wanneer dit leidt tot voor de lidstaat ongewenste uitkomsten, in gesprek om te komen tot afspraken om zo veel mogelijk marktverstoring te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de huisuitzetting van studenten ten behoeve van asielzoekers

An MP asked whether students were being evicted from Houthavens container housing to make room for asylum seekers, and why status holders get priority in social housing. The minister denies students are displaced by asylum seekers, says the units were rented on a temporary basis and are being reused, and states the priority rule for status holders will be scrapped.
For that reason, the priority arrangement for residence-entitled persons is being removed from the Housing Act.
Om die reden wordt de voorrangsregeling voor verblijfsgerechtigden uit de Huisvestingswet geschrapt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Albert de Vries over het AFM-onderzoek naar de dienstverlening van hypotheekaanbieders bij betalingsproblemen met hypotheken

MPs Nijboer and Albert de Vries asked about an AFM study finding that mortgage lenders must improve their service to borrowers with payment problems, including which lenders must improve, the safeguarding of borrower interests and fees, and the timing of a follow-up study. The minister answered that most lenders still need improvements, the AFM will monitor progress and decide on follow-up research, and the EU mortgage directive will limit charges to actual damages.
Which lender falls into which category is not disclosed because this is supervisory-confidential information.
Welke aanbieder in welke categorie valt wordt niet bekend gemaakt omdat dit toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de vertrekregelingen van drie functionarissen bij Woonzorg Nederland

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about large exit payments to three executives of housing corporation Woonzorg Nederland, including whether one executive was moved to a lower post to escape the WNT pay cap. The Minister answered that the Autoriteit Woningcorporaties will investigate legality and enforce repayment if the rules were breached, and that the Aedes governance code is a matter for the sector itself.
The Autoriteit Woningcorporaties (Aw) supervises compliance with the WNT by executives and internal supervisors in the housing corporation sector.
De Autoriteit Woningcorporaties (Aw) ziet toe op de naleving van de WNT door bestuurders en interne toezichthouders in de woningcorporatiesector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de consequenties voor de aftrekmogelijkheid van de verhuurderheffing bij uitstel van sloop van woningen in krimpgebieden en Rotterdam-Zuid

Albert de Vries (PvdA) asked whether the minister would allow housing corporations in shrinking regions and Rotterdam-Zuid to postpone planned demolition of social rental homes, used temporarily for refugees, without losing the rental levy deduction. Minister Blok said he sees no reason to change the levy rules now, noting demolition can be notified until end-2017 and completed by end-2020, and that it is too early to conclude further postponement is needed.
However, I see no reason to change the rules on the levy reduction in the rental levy for this purpose now.
Ik zie evenwel hierin geen reden om nu de regels rond de heffingsvermindering in de verhuurderheffing daarvoor aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Van Dekken over het krimpbeleid in Oost-Groningen

Two MPs asked the minister whether the absence of joint population-decline (krimp) policy in East Groningen is a missed opportunity and what support the central government has given the municipalities there. The minister answers that primary responsibility lies with the municipalities and province, that a new integrated implementation plan is being prepared, and that central support has been provided through existing agreements and knowledge-sharing without any financial measures.
First, I would point out that responsibility for population-decline policy in East Groningen lies primarily with the relevant municipalities, in cooperation with the province.
Allereerst wil ik erop wijzen dat de verantwoordelijkheid voor het krimpbeleid in Oost-Groningen primair berust bij de desbetreffende gemeenten, in samenwerking met de provincie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en De Boer over het bericht “Krimpbeleid Oost-Groningen zorgwekkend”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the 2.24 million euro population-decline grant for East Groningen carries conditions, and whether regional rather than Gemeentefonds-based approaches should lead on shrinkage policy. The government answered that the funds are unconditional Gemeentefonds money, favours an integrated cross-municipal approach encouraged by designating one centre municipality per shrinkage region, and says it already works with the province and region on shrinkage policy.
The funds are part of the municipal fund and are therefore not tied to any conditions.
De middelen zijn onderdeel van het gemeentefonds en daarmee niet aan voorwaarden gebonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Van Raak over de extra kosten bij de verbouwing van Huis ten Bosch

MPs Pechtold and Van Raak asked why the renovation of Huis ten Bosch cost almost double the earlier estimate and whether the cost figure would hold. The minister said the higher cost reflects detailed technical research and a higher per-square-metre price, and that the budget of 59 million euros is binding, with the requested documents partly released under the Wob.
For security reasons, among others, part of the information could not be made public.
Om onder meer veiligheidsredenen kon een deel van de informatie niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over fors hogere pachtprijzen door verpachten van grond door het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Housing and Government Services and the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about sharply higher lease prices when the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf auctions farmland, the transfer of payment rights, sustainable land management, and bank guarantees. The minister answered that higher prices reflect scarcity, that a mandatory building plan and soil checks secure sustainable use, and that the outgoing tenants held liberalised leases that end, but gave limited detail on some points.
For land leased out in liberalised tenancy through public tender or auction, a building plan is prescribed.
Voor de grond die in geliberaliseerde pacht wordt uitgegeven door middel van een openbare inschrijving of een veiling per opbod wordt een bouwplan voorgeschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de aanpassingen voor het woningwaarderingsstelsel

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about the 2015 change in the rent-valuation system replacing the 'serviceflatwoning' category with 'zorgwoning', including why conditions were changed, consultation, choice, stigma and rent effects. The minister answered that the change aligns rules with current practice, followed consultation with stakeholders, and does not affect tenant choice or permit rent increases beyond existing legal limits.
Replacing the term 'serviceflatwoning' with 'zorgwoning' does not lead to the possibility of a rent increase.
Het vervangen van het begrip «serviceflatwoning» door het begrip «zorgwoning» leidt niet tot de mogelijkheid van een huurverhoging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en De Caluwé over de meerjarenplannen van de Raad voor de Rechtspraak

Two MPs asked the Justice and Interior ministers how access to justice at reasonable distance is guaranteed under the judiciary's multi-year plans, and about regional employment effects and coordination with other government relocations. The minister answered that the 32 court locations remain legally fixed, that the relocation may shift jobs locally but not reduce total judiciary employment, and that the housing minister will report in autumn on regional employment effects.
The proposed location policy, as described in the proposed multi-year plan, leads to a shift of jobs within a number of courts.
Het voorgenomen locatiebeleid, zoals beschreven in het voorgenomen MJP, leidt tot een verschuiving van arbeidsplaatsen binnen een aantal gerechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Oskam over het bericht dat woningen onbereikbaar worden

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers whether housing is becoming unreachable due to the rise in asylum residence permits, and what the government is doing about it. The minister answered with figures on the housing quota for permit holders, mentioned the Ministerial Commission on Migration and local tools, but gave few concrete commitments.
I further expect that the measures proposed by the Ministerial Commission will offer further additions in this regard.
Ik verwacht daarnaast dat de maatregelen die door de Ministeriële Commissie voorgesteld worden daarop nog aanvullingen zullen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over de voorgenomen subsidiëring van particulier bezit door woningcorporaties in Rotterdam

An MP asked whether Rotterdam housing associations may subsidise private homeowners with 2 million euros, whether the Rijk's 30 million euro contribution could fund it, and whether the Ministry would act. The minister said such subsidy does not fit the core tasks of associations, that the Rijk's funds were not used for it, and that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties has asked the associations for information and will enforce if activities fall outside the legal framework.

The Autoriteit woningcorporaties has asked the Rotterdam associations to report which activities they carry out regarding maintenance of third-party property and under which regulations obligations for these activities were entered into.

De Autoriteit woningcorporaties heeft de Rotterdamse corporaties verzocht te melden welke activiteiten worden verricht ten aanzien van het onderhoud van bezit van derden en onder welke regelgeving verplichtingen voor deze activiteiten zijn aangegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over verzilverd wonen

Ronnes (CDA) asked the Minister for Housing about the government's role in regulating home-equity release products sold to older homeowners, and whether the financial supervisory scope covers them. The minister explained that mortgage-type equity release falls under AFM supervision with a planned information-duty expansion, while sale-and-leaseback is governed by the Civil Code and ACM oversight, and committed to consultation with the sector.
The cabinet intends to apply the provisions in the so-called mortgage directive for regular mortgages also to equity-release mortgages.
Het kabinet is voornemens om de in de in de zogenoemde hypothekenrichtlijn 3 opgenomen voorschriften voor reguliere hypotheken ook toe te passen op opeethypotheken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de toegankelijkheid van de Oranjezaal voor slechtzienden en slechthorenden

An MP asked why the Oranjezaal visit lacks special provisions for visually and hearing-impaired visitors, why sign-language interpreters need their own ticket and guide dogs were initially barred, how comparable museums handle this, and whether separate tours could be organised. The minister replied that companions get free tickets, professional guides and written materials are provided, guide dogs are now allowed, and that the government will lead by example under the UN disability convention.
Following these parliamentary questions, guide dogs are permitted despite the vulnerability of the room and limited physical space.
Naar aanleiding van deze Kamervragen zijn, ondanks de kwetsbaarheid van de zaal in combinatie met de beperkte fysieke ruimte, hulphonden toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht “Huizenbezitters betalen te veel rente voor hun spaarhypotheek"

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van der Linde asked whether banks charging a risk surcharge on savings mortgages despite substantial savings balances overcharge homeowners, whether banks are transparent about this, and whether the AFM has investigated. The minister replied that the effect depends on savings balance and tax rate, that consumer information rules apply, and that the AFM has not studied risk surcharges structurally but has challenged a few providers on signals and will continue to hold providers to account where needed.
The AFM will also hold mortgage providers to account on this in the future, where necessary.
De AFM zal hypotheekverstrekkers hier – waar nodig – ook in de toekomst op aanspreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht ‘Spaarhypotheek onnodig duur’

An MP asked the minister whether a report that savings-mortgage (spaarhypotheek) savings credited against the risk surcharge are needlessly costly is accurate, and whether the government would intervene, have the AFM or DNB act, commission an ACM mortgage-market study, or cap early-repayment penalties as in Belgium. The minister answered that including savings can be disadvantageous depending on savings size and tax rate, that AFM will address providers where needed, that ACM monitors competition and will update its studies in 2016, and that Belgian-style penalty caps are not adopted because they would make banks less willing to offer long fixed-rate periods.
The Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) monitors competition in the mortgage market, including the interest rates mortgage lenders charge.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) monitort de concurrentie op de hypotheekmarkt, waarbij onder andere wordt gekeken naar de rentetarieven die hypotheekverstrekkers hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht «Voormalig Paleis van Justitie in handen omstreden vastgoedman»

An MP asked whether the Bibob screening of the director of developer M7 was properly weighed against his prior prosecution settlement with the Public Prosecution Service, and about the sale of the former Amsterdam courthouse. The minister declined to discuss the Bibob advice details due to confidentiality, stated the sale is completed, and said any further zoning and Bibob decisions rest with the municipality.
I therefore cannot go into the specific content of the Bibob advice.
Ik kan derhalve niet op de specifieke inhoud van het Bibob-advies ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over gekaapte IP-adressen van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken

The MP asks whether the Foreign Ministry's hijacked IP addresses were misused, how the government ensures integrity of its networks, and whether security techniques and shared knowledge are adequate. The minister answers that the hijack lasted November 19-27 2014, misuse cannot be ruled out or fully investigated, no new technical measures were taken, and the network is managed in fragmented but coordinated fashion.
It is unknown whether and to what extent the hijacked IP addresses were actually misused during the period in question.
Het is onbekend of en in hoeverre de gekaapte IP-adressen in de bewuste periode daadwerkelijk zijn misbruikt.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst over een nieuwe bestemming van landgoed en paleis Soestdijk (ingezonden 14 juli 2015).

An MP asks the Minister for Housing and Government Service why the Ronde Tafel advice on reusing Paleis Soestdijk was not assessed by the Rijksbouwmeester, which selection criteria, timeline, expertise and rent arrangements apply, and why the sale procedure differs from precedent. The Minister answers that the Rijksbouwmeester will sit on an independent selection committee, that the procedure follows published criteria and steps with delivery planned for 2017, and that the advertising cost was EUR 50,000 while rent arrangements date from a 1975-era statutory decision.
No, the Rijksbouwmeester has not issued a (counter)advice on the advice of the Ronde Tafel.
Nee, de Rijksbouwmeester heeft geen (contra)advies uitgebracht op het advies van de Ronde Tafel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Fokke over het voorkomen van onevenredig banenverlies in de provincies Friesland, Groningen, Drenthe, Zeeland en Limburg door de reorganisatie van de Belastingdienst

MPs De Vries and Fokke asked whether the Tax Authority reorganisation has been instructed to prevent disproportionate job losses in Friesland, Groningen, Drenthe, Zeeland and Limburg, and whether the De Vries motion will be honoured. The State Secretary answered that a detailed plan follows in autumn, that unions and the works council are consulted but municipalities are not initiated, and that regional employment effects will be reported later by the Minister for Housing and Government Employment, with the De Vries and Groot-Schouten motions taken into account.
I can commit that the De Vries motion will be taken into account in the picture the Minister intends to present to you.
Ik kan toezeggen dat de motie De Vries (Kamerstuk 31 490, nr. 126 ) wordt meegenomen in het beeld dat de Minister u wil schetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de voorgenomen verkoop van sociale huurwoningen van Vivare in Velp, gemeente Rheden

An SP MP asks the Minister for Housing about the planned sale of social rental homes by Vivare in Velp, including objections from the tenants' association, the municipality's reversal to a positive opinion, rent risks under a British investment fund buyer, and conflicts with the local housing vision. The Minister replies that no application has yet been received, that the independent Autoriteit woningcorporaties will assess it, that tenants' objections will be weighed, and that existing rent rules continue to apply.
I have not yet received an application. The housing association must submit an application for approval of the planned sale to the Authority for Housing Associations (Aw).
Ik heb nog geen aanvraag ontvangen. De corporatie moet een aanvraag om goedkeuring voor de voorgenomen verkoop indienen bij de Autoriteit woningcorporaties (Aw).
Vragen van het lid Albert deVries (PvdA) aan de Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst over de verkoop van het Paleis van Justitie in Amsterdam (ingezonden 6 juli 2015).

Albert de Vries (PvdA) asked why the State sold the Amsterdam Paleis van Justitie to M7 Development despite the municipality's preferences, why only two bidders underwent a Bibob integrity screening, and whether the sale could be delayed. Minister Blok answered that the sale followed the agreed bid procedure, the buyer's bid was the most favourable, the Bibob screening was legally required and confidential, and the contract was already legally concluded.
The bids made are commercially confidential, and disclosure could harm the economic interests and privacy of third parties.
Gedane biedingen zijn commercieel vertrouwelijk en openbaarmaking zou de economische belangen en privacy van derden kunnen schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over automatische incasso en huurverhogingen bij huurders van Trudo, Eindhoven

MP Karabulut asked whether housing corporation Trudo may tie a reduced rent increase to automatic direct debit, why not all tenants qualify, and what Trudo's solvency is. The minister confirms the link, says landlords may set varying increases within the legal maximum and attach conditions or counter-performances, says it is up to the corporation whether direct debit saves costs, and reports Trudo's solvency has risen above 20%.
It is primarily up to the housing corporation itself to determine whether this is the case.
Het is primair aan de woningcorporatie zelf om te bepalen of dit het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over rekening houden met fauna bij renovatie van woningen

MP Ouwehand asked whether alternative roosts for protected species were actually realised under the Stroomversnelling renovation exemption, and whether energy renovation of 111,000 homes should be redesigned to disturb fauna less. The Secretary of State said temporary alternatives are provided, overcompensation is expected, consultation with species organisations is ongoing, and that ensuring alternative roosts is the exemption holder's responsibility.
The initiator has not offered permanent alternative roosts in the area because, after an environmental check, it was found that sufficient alternatives exist nearby.

Door de initiatiefnemer zijn geen blijvende alternatieve verblijfplaatsen in de omgeving aangeboden omdat, na uitvoering van een omgevingscheck, is geconstateerd dat er in de omgeving voldoende alternatieven zijn.
Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst over het bericht dat gemeenten niet klaar zijn voor de nieuwe Woningwet (ingezonden 24 juni 2015).

An SP MP asks the housing minister how the government will ensure municipalities, tenant organisations and housing associations are ready for the new Housing Act, covering preparedness, tenant participation, capacity, performance agreements and local housing visions, and requests a progress report before the 2016 budget. The minister's answer, a supplementary reply, mainly corrects a funding figure given earlier for professionalising tenant organisations (EUR 261,000 instead of EUR 225,000) and does not address the other questions.
The amount promised to the Dutch Tenants' Union for professionalising the tenant organisation is EUR 261,000 (in three instalments of EUR 87,000) instead of the EUR 225,000 mentioned.

Het bedrag dat is toegezegd aan de Nederlandse Woonbond met het oog op de professionalisering van de huurdersorganisatie bedraagt € 261.000 (in drie termijn van € 87.000) in plaats van de genoemde € 225.000.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over de renovatiewerkzaamheden van flats in Soest van woningcorporatie Portaal

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about a troubled renovation of flats in Soest by housing corporation Portaal, covering delays, nuisance, temporary housing, asbestos and safety, and forged handover signatures. The minister acknowledged the renovation went badly and that the corporation and municipality took corrective steps, but said the national government has no direct role and the municipality and corporation are responsible.
There is no role here for the supervisor of housing corporations.
Er is in deze geen sprake van een rol voor de toezichthouder op corporaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat gemeenten niet klaar zijn voor de nieuwe Woningwet

The SP's Karabulut asks the housing minister how municipalities can be ready for the new Housing Act given reports that most are unprepared, with few consulting tenants, and about tenant organisation professionalisation, housing vision gaps, and oversight of corporations. The minister responds that implementation is primarily the municipalities' responsibility, supported by ministry guidance, helpdesks, and planned reports, while committing to publish agreements and include findings in the next State of Housing report.
It is up to the parties themselves to shape the cooperation at local level.
Het is aan de partijen zelf om op lokaal niveau vorm te geven aan de samenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Van Dekken over het in vaste dienst nemen van payrollers door DUO

Two MPs asked the ministers whether DUO's decision to end payroll contracts for 19 workers, who will remain employed by Randstad Payroll Solutions, was reasonable and consistent with the Wwz, and how it fits the motion on regional employment. The ministers confirmed the contracts are ended, cited DUO's digitisation and budget cuts, said DUO will help with redeployment, and promised a regional employment overview in the autumn.
Randstad Payroll Solutions will ensure new work for these employees.
Randstad Payroll Solutions zal zorgen voor nieuw werk voor deze medewerkers
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de sociale woningbouw in Den Haag die is ingestort

MP Karabulut asks the minister why social rental construction in The Hague fell sharply, whether the landlord levy prevents corporations from building, and about waiting times, success rates for large families, and safeguards against sales or liberalisation. The minister attributes the decline mainly to local corporations' financial constraints unrelated to the levy, says the levy is not a bar to new construction, and points to municipal housing targets and prestatieafspraken.
It can be said that the landlord levy is not an obstacle for housing corporations to make new construction investments.
Gesteld kan worden dat de verhuurderheffing geen belemmering voor corporaties is om nieuwbouwinvesteringen te plegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Van der Linde en Anne Mulder over bericht “proef flexwerkershypotheek uitgebreid”

VVD MPs asked whether the perspective-statement pilot for flexworkers and self-employed mortgage applicants should be broadened and made permanent, and whether mortgage rules should change. The Minister replied that the pilot falls within existing rules (Tijdelijke regeling hypothecair krediet), that current rules already allow tailored assessments, and that no regulatory change is planned.
The approach taken with the perspective statement falls within the current possibilities of the Temporary Regulation on Mortgage Credit.
De gevolgde werkwijze met de perspectiefverklaring valt binnen de huidige mogelijkheden van de Tijdelijke regeling hypothecair krediet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Albert de Vries over de gevolgen van de reorganisatie bij de Belastingdienst voor de provincies Friesland, Groningen, Drenthe, Zeeland en Limburg

MPs Fokke and Albert de Vries asked whether the Belastingdienst reorganisation would disproportionately hit Friesland, Groningen, Drenthe, Zeeland and Limburg, and how the parliamentary motion on regional fairness would be implemented. The state secretary replied that the effects are not yet clear and that the Minister for Housing and Civil Service will inform the House later, taking the motion into account.
The Minister for Housing and Civil Service will inform you at a later stage about the regional employment effects within central government
De Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst zal u in een later stadium informeren over de regionale werkgelegenheidseffecten bij de rijksoverheid
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over leeftijdsdiscriminatie bij subsidieverstrekking voor zonnepanelen naar aanleiding van het artikel “Te oud voor subsidie” in de Telegraaf

Krol (50PLUS) asked whether a couple from Goor was denied a solar-panel loan purely because of age and whether this constitutes age discrimination. The minister answered that the SVn loan is a consumer credit with an age limit of 75, that lenders may apply credit criteria, and that no age discrimination occurs.
In my view there is no age discrimination, since a lender may apply criteria when granting a loan to ensure repayment of loans to the lender.

Naar mijn mening is er geen sprake van leeftijdsdiscriminatie aangezien een geldverstrekker bij het afgeven van een lening criteria kan hanteren om zekerheid te houden over de terugbetaling van leningen aan de geldverstrekker.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht 'Welvaartsverlies voor verlaging loan-to-value'

An MP asked the housing minister about reports that lowering the loan-to-value limit causes welfare losses, that starters and self-employed face mortgage difficulties, and how many households are underwater. The minister said the government has set a path to phase the LTV limit to 100% by 2018, pointed to banks' information point for flexible workers and restschuld financing, and declined to comment on the Prime Minister's private purchases.
As Minister for Housing and Central Government Real Estate, I do not concern myself with the private affairs of the Prime Minister.
Als Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst ga ik niet over de privé aangelegenheden van de Minister-President.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht 'Leengrens hypotheek moet verder omlaag'

Madlener (PVV) asked the minister whether a further cut in the loan-to-value ratio would hurt the fragile housing market, and how the government views the FSC analysis and banking/homeowner criticism of it. The minister answers that a further LTV cut is not on the table, that the LTV path is already set to phase down to 100% by 2018, and rules out a further cut below 100% this cabinet term.
The cabinet has set out a path for the loan-to-value, under which the maximum loan-to-value will be gradually reduced to 100% by 2018.
Het kabinet heeft een pad voor de loan-to-value uitgestippeld, welke inhoudt dat de maximale loan-to-value stapsgewijs wordt afgebouwd naar 100% in 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Laar over slavernij en kinderarbeid in steengroeves

MPs Voordewind and Van Laar asked about child labour and slavery in South Indian granite quarries, due diligence by Dutch firms, the government's own procurement of granite, and whether municipalities and other public bodies are engaged. Minister Ploumen answers that she will engage sector federations on IMVO agreements, raise the issue during her India visit, pilot and implement evaluation recommendations on international social procurement conditions, and that PIANOo has worked with local authorities on procurement tools.
I am in discussion with the relevant trade organisations about the support the government can offer the sectors to reach IMVO agreements.
Ik ben in gesprek met de desbetreffende brancheorganisaties over de ondersteuning die de overheid kan bieden aan de sectoren om te komen tot IMVO afspraken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de berichten “Gewonden bij brand seniorenflats Wijchen” en “Seniorenflats moeten een stuk veiliger”

An MP from 50PLUS asked the government about fire safety in senior housing complexes after press reports of fires and deaths among elderly residents, and whether building rules, drills, inspections and resident education should be tightened. The minister answered that the government is studying how to better protect elderly residents from fire with stakeholders, with results due in autumn 2015, while stating that drills and inspections are largely a matter for residents, owners and municipalities.
It is up to each municipality individually to intensify inspections at senior housing complexes if desired.
Het is aan iedere gemeente afzonderlijk om controles bij seniorencomplexen desgewenst te intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Omtzigt en Knops over de bouw van een moskee in Gouda

MPs Oskam, Omtzigt and Knops (CDA) asked ministers how the sale of the PWA barracks in Gouda to a large mosque project was handled, including the origin of its funding, the Bibob review, and whether the state would follow the process. The ministers answered that the matter is a local responsibility, that a new local process is under way, and that financing was checked by a forensic accountant and Bibob advice, but that the results are not publicly disclosed and no independent state investigation will be launched.
No, this concerns a local matter.
Nee, dit betreft een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat woningcorporatie Ymere meer koopwoningen dan sociale huurwoningen bouwt

An MP asked the minister whether housing corporation Ymere should be building market-rate owner-occupied homes rather than social rentals, and whether stricter rules are needed. The minister said developing owner-occupied new builds is not a core task of corporations, pointed to the revised Housing Act effective 1 July 2015 that separates core (DAEB) from non-core activities, and gave sector figures on owner-occupied construction.
I do not consider developing new owner-occupied homes to be a core task of a housing corporation.
Het ontwikkelen van nieuwbouwwoningen in het koopsegment reken ik niet tot de kerntaken van een woningcorporatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Monasch over de WNT-staffel voor de sector woningcorporaties

Two MPs asked the government about the WNT pay-cap staffel (salary scale) for housing corporations, including whether talks with Aedes had taken place and whether the staffel would be published by 1 June. The minister answered that the sector bodies had submitted a proposal within the lowered WNT norm and that the Chamber would be informed in June, with formal adoption in November.
For the housing corporations, I expect to be able to give your Chamber and the sector clarity on the staffel for 2016 in June.
