Voor wat betreft de woningcorporaties, zal ik uw Kamer en de sector naar verwachting in juni duidelijkheid kunnen bieden over de staffel voor 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de wens van een woningcorporatie om illegalen te huisvesten

An MP asked the minister whether housing corporation Rochdale should be told that rejected asylum seekers have no right to social housing, and whether priority allocation of social rental homes to admitted asylum seekers should end. The minister answered that the Housing Act only allows Dutch nationals and lawfully resident aliens to obtain housing permits, that Rochdale has said it will only house people with residence permits, and that there are no plans to change the priority rules for permit holders.
There are no plans to amend the Housing Act on this point.
Er zijn geen voornemens de Huisvestingswet hierop aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Koolmees over het bericht ‘Brussel ligt dwars bij nieuw instituut voor hypotheken’

MPs Verhoeven and Koolmees asked the Ministers of Housing and of Finance about reports that Brussels opposes the planned Dutch mortgage institute (NHI), including the state-aid and debt-classification issues, the difference from the existing NHG guarantee, and the added value of the NHI in current market conditions. The minister answered that talks with the European Commission and Eurostat are not concluded, that state-aid and classification outcomes are still open, that the NHI's added value lies mainly in stress periods and transparency, and that no signals of waning investor interest were received.

Naturally, I aim to have sufficient clarity and assurance as soon as possible on whether the preconditions can be met so that the NHI does not lead to state aid and is not classified in the government sector.
Vanzelfsprekend streef ik ernaar zo spoedig mogelijk voldoende duidelijkheid en comfort te hebben of aan de randvoorwaarden kan worden voldaan dat de NHI niet leidt tot staatssteun
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Mohandis over te dure studentenkamers

MPs Monasch and Mohandis asked the minister about student room rents said to be too high, the LSVb findings, possible tougher rules against landlords, how students use rent-review routes, and whether the student housing action plan will ease scarcity. The minister acknowledged the concern, committed to tracking affordability in the monitor, saw no reason to abandon freedom of contract, described the Huurcommissie procedures as accessible, and gave supply figures with a promise of a later update.
From 2015 onward, affordability will be included as a regular indicator in the National Student Housing Monitor to gain better insight into the affordability problem for students.
Vanaf 2015 wordt in de Landelijke Monitor Studentenhuisvesting betaalbaarheid als reguliere meetindicator opgenomen om beter inzicht te krijgen in de betaalbaarheidproblematiek voor studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over misdaadgeld en de werkelijkheid van voordeelsontneming

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a study claiming asset confiscation mainly targets petty offenders, and why reported confiscation figures differ from the study's data. The minister rejected the 'petty offenders' characterisation, explained the scope and data limits, and described the investment and capacity expansion in the enforcement chain.
The picture that mainly smaller cases are confiscated, I consider incomplete in light of the foregoing.
Het beeld dat voornamelijk in de kleinere zaken wordt afgepakt, vind ik gezien het voorgaande onvolledig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Groot over het bericht  ’Amsterdamse verhuurders in de fout met inkomensdata’

MPs Monasch and Groot asked the minister whether Amsterdam landlords wrongly requested income indications for tenants with liberalised leases, and whether such landlords should be denied portal access and rent increases reversed. The minister answered that such requests are unlawful, that the Tax Authority sanctions repeat or deliberate misuse by revoking portal access, and that in 2014 only warning letters were issued, with two landlords now warned.
Landlords who nonetheless include addresses with a liberalised lease in their request file violate both the law and the terms of use of the web portal.
Verhuurders die toch adressen met een geliberaliseerd huurcontract in hun opvraagbestand opnemen, overtreden de wet èn de gebruiksvoorwaarden van het webportaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over ongevallen met voorrangsvoertuigen van de politie, brandweer en ambulance

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about accidents involving emergency vehicles of police, fire and ambulance services, citing reports on accident rates, prevention, traffic-light priority and training. The Minister said a pilot allowing on-road training with sirens was evaluated positively and made permanent, explained differences in accident rates, pointed to prevention work, and stated there was insufficient Dutch data on traffic-light influence.
From 1 April 2015 a permanent exemption has been granted for giving driving instruction on public roads in operating an emergency vehicle with optical and audible signals.
Met ingang van 1 april 2015 is een permanente vrijstelling verleend voor het op de openbare weg geven van rijonderricht in het besturen van een voorrangsvoertuig met optische en geluidssignalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over de verkoop van al het sociale woningbezit van het Wooninvesteringsfonds

An MP asks whether legal objections delaying the sale of Round Hill prevent the Wooninvesteringsfonds from repaying its bank loans, what financing options it has, and why the board pursued a sale rather than refinancing against the wishes of certificate holders. The minister confirms the delay, states that bridge financing runs to 1 July 2015, and says no parties were willing to refinance or inject capital, so sale was the only option.
Sale was therefore at the end of 2014 the only solution to repay the loan by 31 March 2015.
Verkoop was derhalve eind 2014 de enige oplossing om tot aflossing van de lening per 31 maart 2015 te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de rol van de ondernemingsraden bij de beslissing tot het sluiten van politieposten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the role of police works councils in closing police posts under the housing plan, including whether their agreement is needed before the plan is implemented. The minister replied that the plan is a political decision falling under the works council's exemption from advisory rights, that the works council only has advisory rights on personnel consequences, and that the central works council has requested an extension and has not yet advised.
The works council will also be involved in the further decision-making on implementing the housing plan.
De medezeggenschap zal ook betrokken worden bij de nadere besluitvorming in de uitvoering van het huisvestingsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over de rol van advocaten en accountants bij fraudeonderzoeken

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about the differing duties and powers of lawyers and accountants in forensic fraud investigations at companies, including legal privilege, reporting duties and whether the public prosecution's use of settlements serves the public interest. The minister answers that neither profession has specific rules for forensic work, that lawyer privilege is necessary and under review with the Public Prosecution Service and the bar, and that settlements follow case-by-case reasoning, while deferring the independence question to the earlier answer.

In the general consultation with your House on 8 April on the government-wide approach to fraud, I promised to inform you around the summer recess of the outcomes of the talks currently being held with the NOVA, the KNB and the Public Prosecution Service.

In het algemeen overleg met uw Kamer op 8 april jl. over de rijksbrede aanpak van fraude heb ik toegezegd u rond het zomerreces te informeren over de uitkomsten van de gesprekken die momenteel worden gevoerd met de NOVA, de Koninklijke Nederlandse Beroepsorganisatie van Notarissen (KNB) en het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat een stadsparel een yuppengetto wordt

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about a Utrecht housing corporation doubling rents on re-letting, pushing neighbourhoods toward gentrification, and whether the landlord levy creates incentives for liberalisation. The minister replied that rent adjustments and housing stock are local matters governed by municipal performance agreements, declined to intervene, and did not give substance on whether the levy creates perverse incentives.
The desired housing stock in a municipality is a local matter and is usually laid down in performance agreements between the municipality and housing corporations.
De gewenste woningvoorraad in een gemeente is een lokale aangelegenheid en wordt doorgaans in prestatieafspraken tussen de gemeente en corporaties vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht dat een man die is veroordeeld voor het doodrijden van een meisje een opgelegd rijverbod negeert

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a convicted drink-driver who ignored a driving ban after killing a girl, and how repeat offenders can be stopped, including the recidivism rule, the Danish car-seizure model and perceived enforcement risk. The minister answered that the rules and police measures are already in place, that the recidivism scheme is being evaluated with a policy response promised before the summer recess, and that some questions (such as recidivism statistics) will be answered in that evaluation.
I will answer this question in the evaluation of the recidivism scheme for alcohol offenders that I have promised to send to the House.
Het antwoord op deze vraag zal ik geven in het kader van de aan uw Kamer toegezegde evaluatie van de werking van de recidiveregeling voor alcoholovertreders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Gesthuizen over een tekort aan woningen voor statushouders (opnieuw en nu met de nagezonden tabellen)

MPs Karabulut and Gesthuizen asked the government about a shortage of social rental housing for status holders and how municipalities are meant to house them. The Minister replied that no overview exists of municipalities reporting shortages or of housing waiting lists, that the 14-week housing norm is based on a 2012 agreement, and that no budget is available for new solutions such as converting the housing tax.
There is no overview of municipalities that indicate they have too few social rental homes to house asylum seekers with a residence permit (status holders).
Er is geen overzicht van gemeenten die aangeven dat ze te weinig sociale huurwoningen hebben om asielzoekers met een verblijfsvergunning (statushouders) te huisvesten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Bashir en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de overheid de bouwsector genadeloos uiteen speelt

MPs of the SP asked the government about reports that it squeezes the construction sector, including cost overruns on A15 and A2 projects, the risks of a Ballast Nedam bankruptcy, and whether lowest-price awarding and design-build-finance-maintain contracts cause sector losses. The minister answered that cost overrun figures are confidential, that Rijkswaterstaat compensates responsibly-caused extra costs, that EMVI (best value) is the main award criterion, and that the Aanbestedingswet evaluation will be sent to parliament by summer.
Financial information from contractors, insofar as I have it, I cannot make public.
Financiële informatie van opdrachtnemers, voor zover ik hierover beschik, kan ik niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over grote verschillen in inschrijfkosten voor Woningnet

An SP MP asked the Minister of Housing about large differences in registration and renewal fees for regional housing allocation systems such as Woningnet, and whether fees should be uniform. The minister answered that no rules govern cost allocation, that differences reflect local choices, that he prefers regional allocation but sees no need to impose uniform fees, and that the new housing law is not expected to change allocation systems.
In my contacts with Aedes and the Association of Dutch Municipalities I bring the usefulness of regional housing allocation systems to their attention.
Ik breng in mijn contacten met Aedes en de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten het nut van regionale woonruimteverdeelsystemen onder de aandacht.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Bashir over ‘de dubbele petten bij Bijzonder Beheer Rabobank’

An SP MP asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs about alleged 'double hats' at Rabobank's Bijzonder Beheer unit, its subsidiary Bodemgoed buying assets of failing clients, the transparency of auctions, and use of the BMKB guarantee scheme. The government defended the practice as in the client's interest, rejected concerns about deliberate harm to clients, and provided purchase and portfolio figures while stating it saw no reason to intervene.
Due to confidentiality of company data, payments to individual banks are not disclosed.
Vanwege vertrouwelijkheid van bedrijfsgegevens worden uitkeringen aan individuele banken niet geopenbaard
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het stoppen van de woonvergoeding aan huurders door de inspectie

An MP asked why the housing inspectorate ILT ordered housing corporation Havensteder to stop a rent compensation scheme for low-income tenants, and whether the government will help such households. The minister answered that corporations may not grant income-related subsidies under the applicable rules, that the ILT was right to stop the scheme without requiring repayment, and that existing instruments like rent allowance and rent adjustments address affordability, while declining to cut the landlord levy.
Under the Besluit beheer sociale-huursector (Bbsh) and MG 2001–26, corporations are not permitted to provide 'subsidies' and/or take income-related measures.
Op grond van het Besluit beheer sociale-huursector (Bbsh) en de MG 2001–26 is het corporaties niet toegestaan «subsidies» te verstrekken en/of, inkomensgebonden maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat Turkije wel meewerkt aan het onderzoek naar Joris Demmink

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that Turkey is cooperating in the Demmink investigation, contrasting this with the OM's claim that it is not, and asked for clarity on the degree of cooperation and the timing of mutual legal assistance requests. The minister said consultations with Turkish authorities are ongoing and declined to give details on the execution of the requests, citing the risk of disrupting the process.
As long as the investigation is ongoing and international coordination takes place, there is a risk that statements about it could disrupt the process and cause harm.
Zo lang het onderzoek loopt en internationale afstemming plaatsvindt, bestaat de kans dat mededelingen daarover dit proces verstoren en schade toebrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Oskam en Knops over de komst van een megamoskee in Gouda

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the government's position on the Gouda mega-mosque had changed after the Prime Minister's remarks on financing doubts, whether the municipality had withdrawn the original plan, and whether the sale of the former PWA barracks should be suspended. The Minister replied that the government takes no position on this local matter, described the PwC financial investigation and pending Bibob advice, noted the mosque board's offer of a smaller building, and refused to suspend the sale, stating that Muslims in Gouda have the right to build a mosque provided they obey the law.
In line with the constitutional structure of the Netherlands, the cabinet has taken no position on this local matter.
Het kabinet heeft conform de staatkundige inrichting van Nederland geen standpunt ingenomen over deze lokale kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Fokke over het bericht dat Gemeentewiet rendabel kan worden

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice Minister whether Heerlen's municipal cannabis cultivation plan, which projects 26 million euros in revenue, is realistic and whether such municipal cultivation could be profitable and studied for other municipalities. The minister answered that regulation of cultivation is not permitted under international treaties and is not the solution, and declined to speculate on the plan's revenue, while pointing to continued integrated enforcement.
As indicated under question 2, regulation is not permitted and is not a solution to the problem outlined.
Zoals aangegeven onder vraag 2 is regulering niet toegestaan en geen oplossing voor de geschetste problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over illegalen die maandelijks ruim 200 euro leefgeld krijgen van de gemeente Eindhoven

An MP asked how undocumented migrants with a legal departure obligation can receive over 200 euro monthly subsistence money from Eindhoven, and whether such municipalities should be curbed. The state secretary replied that a Central Council of Appeal ruling requires minimal provision for such migrants, temporarily co-funded by the national government, but that unrestricted cash support falls outside that and will not be reimbursed.
Providing financial support for free use by the foreign national goes further than providing only a basic provision.
Het bieden van financiële ondersteuning, ter vrije besteding door de vreemdeling, gaat verder dan het bieden van enkel een sobere voorziening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Knops over het bericht dat criminele organisaties in Zuid-Limburg minderjarigen inzetten op hennepplantages

MPs Oskam and Knops asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that criminal organisations in South Limburg use minors to trim cannabis plants, and what is being done to protect them, prosecute recruiters, and tackle the phenomenon through the RIEC and regional teams. The minister replied that the Public Prosecution Service found no information on minors in cannabis cultivation, that the chief prosecutor urged anonymous reporting, that the offences are already criminal under the Opium Act with sentencing able to reflect involvement of minors, and that intensified undermining-crime teams have been active since late 2014 with reported arrests and seizures and accountability reports to follow.
However, the investigation has yielded no information about minors being deployed in cannabis cultivation.
Het onderzoek heeft echter geen informatie opgeleverd over minderjarigen die worden ingezet bij de hennepteelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Fokke over minderjarigen die werken in wietplantages

Two MPs (Rebel and Fokke, PvdA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about minors working in cannabis plantations after a TV report, including whether such cases are known, how parents are approached, and whether legalising cannabis cultivation would help. The minister said no cases involving minors in plantations were reported to the Public Prosecution Service in 2014 or 2015, one case in 2013, that police make a child-protection referral, and that legalisation would not solve the problem given export and international law constraints.
I refer to answers 2 and 3 to the parliamentary questions from MPs Oskam and Knops
Ik verwijs naar antwoord 2 en 3 op de Kamervragen van de leden Oskam en Knops
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het bericht dat een antisemitische ambtenaar niet ontslagen hoeft te worden vanwege een IS-tweet

MP Van Klaveren asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he agreed that an advisory committee's recommendation to keep an antisemitic civil servant (project leader at the National Cyber Security Centre, who had posted an IS tweet) in service was unacceptable, whether such a person posed a state-security risk, and what the advice cost. The minister referred to his letter to the House of 31 March 2015 for the substantive answers and said he had no insight into the committee's costs.
For the answers to these questions I refer to my letter to the House of Representatives of 31 March 2015.
Voor de antwoorden op deze vragen verwijs ik naar mijn brief aan de Tweede Kamer van 31 maart 2015
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat illegalen in Amsterdam een gratis OV-kaart krijgen

An MP from the PVV asked whether it is acceptable that rejected asylum seekers in Amsterdam receive free public transport cards, and what the government will do to stop it and return them to their countries of origin. The State Secretary answered that Amsterdam offers only basic night shelter with two single transit tickets valid one hour, that the national government cannot enforce returns against those who refuse to cooperate, and that public order measures are for mayors.
It is not for me to intervene in public order measures taken by mayors.
Het is niet aan mij om in openbare orde maatregelen die door burgemeesters worden genomen op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de wens van forensisch rechercheurs om geen uniform te dragen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about forensic investigators' objections to wearing the new police uniform, including safety concerns about being unarmed and unable to act in emergencies, and asked why the duty to wear uniform was not dropped entirely. The minister acknowledged some concerns, said uniform wearing is not mandatory in situations where it hinders work, and stated the uniform is the standard for all police staff, with a final decision to follow after consultation with the corps leadership and works council.
Until that moment, wearing the uniform is not mandatory.
Tot dat moment is het dragen van het uniform niet verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Leijten over het bericht dat ex-daklozen hun huis verliezen door te hoge huren

MPs Karabulut and Leijten asked about reports that ex-homeless people lose their homes due to high rents, including numbers, waiting times and rent subsidy gaps. Minister Blok answered that data on these cases is largely unavailable, pointed to reinstated fit-for-purpose rent rules and corporation and municipal measures against evictions, and did not commit to new concrete steps beyond existing motions.
No data is known about this.
Hier zijn geen gegevens over bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over woningcorporatie Vestia

MP Monasch (PvdA) asked the minister how market interest rates and Vestia's liquidity would develop, and when Vestia would switch from selling homes to continuing to operate them. The minister said he could not forecast the market rate, described Vestia's liquidity improvement and the conditions (rate thresholds of 4% and 3%) under which its sales strategy would change, while noting the CFV is already discussing alternatives with Vestia.
I cannot estimate how market interest rates will develop in the coming years.
Ik kan niet inschatten wat de ontwikkeling is van de marktrente in de komende jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht "ABN AMRO CFO: Nieuwe kapitaalbodems kunnen buffer hard raken"

Two MPs from the VVD asked the Finance Minister about a report that international supervisors plan capital floors per loan type that could hit Dutch banks' capital buffers, and about effects on mortgages, SME lending and securitisation. The minister answered that the Basel Committee is consulting on a new floor based on the standardised approach and a revised standardised approach, that effects depend on final design and are likely to raise risk-weighted assets for large Dutch banks, that the government will watch for disproportionate impacts, and that existing EU securitisation rules remain in force.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het leuren met Nederlandse sociale huurwoningen in Londen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing whether officials were promoting sale of social rental housing to British investors in London, what transactions occurred with foreign investors in 2012-2014, and how this fits the coalition goal of maintaining the social housing stock. The minister answered that no quantitative or qualitative targets apply, that only two foreign transactions occurred in 2014 (Vestia and Servatius sales), and that the Herzieningswet and municipal consent rights will guard the regional stock while sales are seen as aiding middle-segment supply.
It was made clear that the central government sets no quantitative or qualitative targets for the sale of housing association dwellings.
Daarbij is duidelijk gemaakt dat er vanuit het Rijk geen kwantitatieve of kwalitatieve doelstellingen gelden voor de verkoop van corporatiewoningen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de aanvraag van het Centraal Orgaan opvang asielzoekers (COA) tot omzetting van een opvanglocatie naar een asielzoekerscentrum (AZC) met een capaciteit voor  800 tot 1000 pe

An MP asked whether the Midden-Drenthe municipal executive bound itself to COA to expand the Oranje reception site to 800-1,000 places without council involvement, and whether a council opinion should have been sought for the deviation from the zoning plan. The State Secretary declined to assess the municipal executive's conduct, citing the division of responsibilities between government tiers, and answered none of the questions on substance.
It will be clear to your House that, given the division of powers between the tiers of government in our country, it is not appropriate for me to give such an assessment.
Het zal uw Kamer duidelijk zijn dat het mij, gelet op de in ons land geldende bevoegdheidsverdeling tussen de bestuurslagen, niet past een dergelijke beoordeling te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Jacobi over het verlies van banen bij het gerechtshof in Leeuwarden

MPs Recourt and Jacobi asked whether plans could cost at least 54 jobs at the Leeuwarden Court of Appeal and how this fits earlier assurances of no relocations. The Minister replied that no decision has been taken, that four scenarios are being explored (three involve moving jobs within the court's area, two of them moving 54 jobs from Leeuwarden), and that the Rvdr will report soon.
The Rvdr will inform me shortly of its findings following the discussions with court boards and its own research.
De Rvdr informeert mij binnenkort over zijn bevindingen naar aanleiding van de gesprekken met gerechtsbesturen en eigen onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Aukje De Vries over het bericht dat justitiebanen verdwijnen in Leeuwarden en dat uitholling dreigt voor het Leeuwarder Gerechtshof

MPs Van Oosten and Aukje de Vries asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether reports that justice jobs and services will leave Leeuwarden, weakening the Arnhem-Leeuwarden Court of Appeal, are accurate, and whether they would consult the Council for the Judiciary. The minister answered that he understands local concerns, but no decision has yet been made on the court's future accommodation, and the Council for the Judiciary will inform him soon.
However, there is currently no decision-making regarding the future accommodation needs of the court's organisational units.
Er is echter op dit moment geen sprake van besluitvorming over de toekomstige huisvestingsbehoefte van de organisatieonderdelen van het gerechtshof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over een boete voor racistische uitspraken onder voetbalselfie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why only three people received fines for racist remarks under a football selfie, whether penalties and prevention measures against racism online and in government posts should be strengthened, and whether a racism reporting point for government roles should be created. The minister answered that three suspects received transaction offers, that criminal law is a last resort within a broader anti-discrimination policy, that discriminatory remarks are incompatible with civil service conduct and may be disciplined, and that no separate reporting point is needed.
I am not aware whether any of the perpetrators holds a government position.
Het is mij niet bekend of een van de daders een functie bij de overheid heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Albert de Vries en Çegerek over het verlies van banen bij het gerechtshof in Arnhem

MPs asked whether the Arnhem-Leeuwarden court of appeal may relocate from Arnhem to Zwolle, with possible job losses, and how this fits the goal of spreading government jobs. The Minister said the court board is only exploring housing scenarios with no decision taken, that some scenarios move posts out of Arnhem, and that a decision on locations would be made after the Rvdr's review rather than waiting for the 2018 evaluation.
The board of the Arnhem-Leeuwarden court of appeal is currently exploring the future housing needs of the court's organisational units.
Het bestuur van het gerechtshof Arnhem-Leeuwarden voert op dit moment verkenningen uit naar de toekomstige huisvestingsbehoefte van de organisatieonderdelen van het gerechtshof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de buitenwerkingstelling van de Wet bewaarplicht telecommunicatiegegevens

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the court ruling suspending the data retention law would be implemented immediately for all obligated parties, and how providers would be prevented from retaining user data. The Minister answered that the ruling has direct effect, that retention without business purpose is no longer allowed, and that Agentschap Telecom will supervise deletion.
Supervision of the storage and processing of traffic data for business purposes has been assigned to Agentschap Telecom.
Het toezicht op het opslaan en verwerken van verkeersgegevens voor bedrijfsdoeleinden is belegd bij Agentschap Telecom.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Kerstens over de bezoldiging van de directie van Buma/ Stemra

MPs Oosenbrug and Kerstens asked whether the government would ensure that Buma/Stemra's director pay is capped under the WNT, after reports that the director was trying to block a salary cut to a minister's level. The state secretary replied that the WNT applies via article 25a of the Wet toezicht, that the College van Toezicht Auteursrecht monitors pay and can issue directions or penalties, and saw no reason to revisit the cap.
Since 1 July 2013 the College closely monitors the remuneration of the board and other senior officials of Buma/Stemra and other collective management organisations.
Sinds 1 juli 2013 houdt het College nauwlettend toezicht op de hoogte van de bezoldiging van de directie en de overige topfunctionarissen van Buma/Stemra en andere collectieve beheersorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer, de Rouwe en Pieter Heerma over de mantelzorgboete

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers about the AOW cost-sharing norm, the municipal rules and evidence required for exempt mantelzorg (care-related) dwellings, and related questions on house numbers and social security treatment. The government answered that the AOW household norm is postponed to 1 July 2016 with a report on care effects expected before summer 2015, that municipalities assess mantelzorg needs with open-ended evidence, and that social security uses the actual living situation rather than the building rule.
The decision-making on the cost-sharing norm in relation to its effects on informal care is expected to be sent to your House before summer 2015.
De besluitvorming over de kostendelersnorm in relatie tot de effecten op mantelzorg zal naar verwachting voor de zomer van 2015 naar uw Kamer worden gezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het inhuren van dure ICT-specialisten

The SP MP Gesthuizen asked the Minister of Security and Justice why external ICT specialists were hired at a reported cost of 50,000 euro to search for a receipt related to a settlement, how many externals were hired, why the ministry lacks this expertise, what it spends on external hiring, and how it decides between hiring externals and training staff. The minister answered that three external and six internal staff were involved at a cost of 6,902.50 euro for the external staff, that external hiring is used when expertise is unavailable internally, and that shared service centres are being built to bundle expertise.
The ICT costs for the external staff amounted to 6,902.50 euro.
De ICT-kosten voor de externe medewerkers bedroeg € 6.902,50,-.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de berichten “Varkensschuur in Putten in de as gelegd” en “40.000 kippen omgekomen bij brand in Veendam”

An MP asked the government whether two barn fires (a pig barn in Putten and a poultry barn in Veendam) met fire-safety rules, how existing barns are being adapted under the Stalbranden action plan, and for a progress overview. The government answered that both barns complied with the rules in force, that new fire-safety requirements apply to new or rebuilt barns since April 2014, and that a progress report will be sent to parliament this autumn.
A progress report on the action plan is planned for this autumn. I will send this report to your House.
Een voortgangsrapportage van het actieplan is voorzien voor dit najaar. Ik zal uw Kamer deze rapportage toesturen.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes (Groep Bontes/Van Klaveren) aan de Ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over een nieuwe bijeenkomst van islamitische geweldspredikers (ingezonden 20 fe

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Foreign Affairs about a planned fundraising gala in Utrecht featuring preachers reportedly advocating violence, including whether visas were granted and how such entries and organisers could be stopped. The ministers answered that no visa had been requested for the named preacher, that his statements would be unacceptable in the Netherlands and could be prosecuted if made publicly here, and outlined a stricter visa screening process with an alerting list maintained by the NCTV.

In the letter of 3 March 2015 I already reported that visa-required speakers from abroad who wish to spread intolerant, anti-integrative and/or anti-democratic messages in the Netherlands and thereby threaten public order or national security are not welcome.

In de brief van 3 maart 2015 heb ik reeds gemeld dat uit het buitenland afkomstige visumplichtige sprekers die in Nederland onverdraagzame, anti-integratieve en/of antidemocratische boodschappen willen uitdragen en daarmee de openbare orde of nationale veiligheid bedreigen, niet welkom zijn.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA) en Segers (ChristenUnie) aan de Ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het Megabenefiet-gala «Het is nu of nooit» in Utrecht (ingezonden 20 februari 2015).

MPs Omtzigt and Segers asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers whether they knew of a March 2015 Utrecht gala with a cleric who had endorsed jihad in Syria, and about visa screening for attendees. The ministers answered that the cleric was not known to have attended, that the cleric's 2013 message reflected a broader Sunni position on a legitimate jihad in Syria, and that no visas were known to have been requested for the gala.
No visa has been requested at the Kingdom's representations abroad in the name of the preacher (Sheikh) Assim Al-Hakeem named in the announcements.
Bij de vertegenwoordigingen van het Koninkrijk in het buitenland is geen visum aangevraagd op naam van de in de aankondigingen genoemde prediker (Sheikh) Assim Al-Hakeem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Vliet over de splitsing van activiteiten door woningcorporaties

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about the splitting of housing corporations' commercial activities, citing losses and non-market returns, and asked whether a legal split better protects the core task than an administrative separation, how commercial risks will be prevented from shifting to the core, and whether bankruptcy of corporations should be examined. The minister replied that a legal split offers stronger safeguards, that an administrative separation carries extra conditions (market test, financial test, supervisor powers to force divestment), that both options remain open, and that the revised Housing Act foresees sanitation focused on core activities with bankruptcy possible if sanitation is not pursued.
For that reason, the bill for the revised Housing Act provides that with an administrative separation a number of additional conditions apply to carrying out non-core activities.
Om die reden is in het wetsvoorstel voor de herziene Woningwet geregeld dat bij een administratieve scheiding een aantal extra voorwaarden geldt voor het uitvoeren van niet-DAEB-activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht «Fiasco dreigt voor Leidsche Rijn centrum»

An MP asks the government about the risk of vacancy at the Leidsche Rijn shopping centre and wider retail overcapacity, and whether provinces and municipalities are acting adequately. The minister replies that retail spatial policy is decentralised, that the government supports local action and will address the issue in the forthcoming Retailagenda.
Spatial policy regarding retail has been decentralised.
Het ruimtelijk beleid met betrekking tot detailhandel is gedecentraliseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over betere benutting van restwarmte

An MP asked the ministers whether residual heat should be used more widely to reduce gas dependence, what barriers heat suppliers face, and whether the findings of a dissertation would be incorporated. The minister agreed that residual heat can help, said the best option depends on local conditions, acknowledged remaining barriers, and promised to address the topic in a forthcoming heat vision.
In my heat vision, which I will send to your House before 1 April, I will address the possibilities for better utilising the heat potential.
In mijn warmtevisie, die ik voor 1 april a.s. naar uw Kamer zal sturen, ga ik in op de mogelijkheden om het potentieel aan warmte nog beter te benutten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Van der Linde over beschikbaar kapitaal voor woningen dat niet geïnvesteerd kan worden

MPs Monasch and Van der Linde asked whether they know that around 650 million euro of investable capital cannot be placed in housing due to a lack of products, and asked about the causes (land prices) and solutions. The minister answers that record investment of about 3 billion euro was made in 2014, that the market should balance supply and demand without a direct government matching role, and points to housing reforms, corporate sales to investors and transformation of vacant buildings.
It is up to the market itself to bring about a balance between supply and demand.
Het is aan de markt zelf om een balans tussen vraag en aanbod tot stand te laten komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over de verkoop van sociaal bezit door het Woninginvesteringsfonds

An MP asked the minister about the planned sale of about 3,800 social rental homes by the Woninginvesteringsfonds to Round Hill, including the bidding process, certificate-holder and municipal opposition, leakage of social capital abroad, refinancing as an alternative, and whether the sale can be stopped. The minister answered that the ILT, acting independently, approved the sale on 5 February 2015 after a sales process, that the sale is at market value, and that objections are open through the normal appeal route, so no irreversible step is being halted.
The ILT approved the sale on 5 February 2015.
De ILT heeft de verkoop op 5 februari 2015 goedgekeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over langdurige onbereikbaarheid van overheidswebsites

An MP asked why rijksoverheid.nl and other government websites were unreachable for hours on 10 February 2015, what caused it, its impact, and what technical measures and actions are planned. The minister answered that a DDoS attack caused the outage, which lasted because the supplier first diagnosed it as a technical fault, and that a supplier improvement plan involving the NCSC is being prepared.
The supplier will draw up an improvement plan, with the Ministry of General Affairs and the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) closely involved.
De leverancier zal een verbeterplan opstellen, waarbij het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken en het Nationaal Cyber Security Centrum (NCSC) nauw betrokken zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over een op non-actief gestelde topambtenaar die toch bij de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) aan de slag ging

MPs Leijten and Jasper van Dijk asked how a senior civil servant placed off duty at Defence could later work at the Dutch healthcare regulator NZa, whether this was a favour, and what the usual practice is. The minister replied that the official was never suspended or placed on non-active status but offered his post himself after IT restructuring, that the Defence Minister's investigation is awaited, and denied any favour or cover-up, while declining to give a full overview of reassignments.
I want to emphasise that in this case there is no question of an official who is or has been placed on non-active status.
Ik wil benadrukken dat er in dit geval geen sprake is van een ambtenaar die op non-actief is of wordt gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Verhoeven over het bericht dat Valkenburg de ideale plek is voor een ‘Unmanned Valley’

MPs Van Veldhoven and Verhoeven asked the government about a report proposing Valkenburg airfield as a testing site for unmanned vehicles, and whether the land-use plan for housing, work and recreation is consistent with the government's innovation ambitions. The minister answered that the masterplan allows room for smaller drone testing but not larger drones, that a self-driving car test regulation has been sent to parliament, that the central government re-offered an alternative solution to local parties in January 2015, and declined the request for a one-week answer deadline.
In July 2014 the central government offered the solution direction mentioned in the answer to question 4 to the parties involved.
Het Rijk heeft in juli 2014 de oplossingsrichting, zoals genoemd in het antwoord op vraag 4, aangeboden aan de betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Wolbert over de Stichting Maatschappij der Weldadigheid te Frederiksoord

MPs Monasch and Wolbert asked the minister about the Stichting Maatschappij der Weldadigheid in Frederiksoord, whose high WOZ-based landlord levy and monumental housing may hinder renovation and preservation. The minister answered that the levy burden follows from low rents relative to property values, that monumental homes do not face special obstacles, and that the position of such landlords will be reviewed in the 2016 evaluation of the levy.
However, the evaluation of the landlord levy, which I will send to your House in 2016, will also pay attention to the position of this type of landlord.
Wel zal in de evaluatie van de verhuurderheffing, die ik in 2016 aan uw Kamer zal doen toekomen, ook aandacht geschonken worden aan de positie van dit type verhuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Kuiken over (ver)bouwplannen voor de huisvesting van asielzoekers

MPs Albert de Vries and Kuiken asked whether local and regional firms could be given a chance in building and renovating asylum reception centres, and whether the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and COA could draft tenders allowing local participation. The state secretary replied that COA is responsible for works, that local involvement is encouraged within procurement rules (including a 10 percent regional sourcing requirement in framework contracts), and that mandatory local preference would breach tender rules.
Mandatory use of local or regional companies conflicts with procurement rules because it leads to distortion of competition.
Het verplicht gebruik maken van lokale of regionale bedrijven is strijdig met de aanbestedingsregels omdat dit leidt tot concurrentievervalsing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Omtzigt en Knops over de vestiging van een mega-moskee in Gouda

CDA MPs asked the government about the financing of a planned large mosque in Gouda, its links to salafist fundraising, and the sale of the former Prins Willem Alexander barracks with a nuclear bunker. The minister answered that the sale and onward sale are a local matter, that PWC found no obstacles and a Bibob advice is pending, that the bunker will be demolished, and that national security is not a criterion for such sales.
The proposed decision on the onward sale to El Wahda may be changed by the mayor and aldermen after receipt of the Landelijk Bureau Bibob advice.
Het voorgenomen besluit over de doorverkoop aan El Wahda kan door het college van burgemeester en wethouders eventueel worden gewijzigd na ontvangst van het advies van het Landelijk Bureau Bibob.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ulenbelt over het conflict over pensioengeld bij woningcorporaties

SP MPs asked whether housing corporations keep the pension premium reduction instead of passing it on to employees, and whether the government will ensure the reduction reaches workers. The minister replied that wage and pension arrangements are for social partners, that the government is not a party to the corporation-sector talks, and that the wider enquiry does not concern this matter.
Employers and employees, and their organisations, are themselves responsible for making working-conditions agreements.
Werkgevers en werknemers, en hun organisaties, zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het maken van arbeidsvoorwaardelijke afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de problemen met het energielabel

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Housing about many problems with energy label issuance, whether the government would oppose the EU directive requiring them, whether the estimated energy use of homes was deliberately overstated amounting to misleading, and how homeowners could be freed from this burden. The Minister answered by referring to a separate letter on the implementation of the housing energy label, without addressing the questions on substance.
The written questions from MP Fritsma (PVV), question number 2015Z01561, have been answered by means of the letter 'Response to implementation of the energy label for homes'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV), vraagnummer 2015Z01561 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op uitvoering energielabel voor woningen»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de onrust rond het energielabel

The MP Smaling (SP) asked the minister about confusion over the new home energy label, including a spokesperson's remark about discarding the letter, the number of complaints and helpdesk contacts, the number of incorrect labels, and a step-by-step plan for reliability by end 2015. The minister answered only by referring to a separate letter to the House (Kamerstuk 30 196, nr. 295), without addressing the questions in substance.
The written questions from MP Smaling (SP), question number 2015Z01575, have been answered by means of the letter 'Response to implementation of energy label for homes'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Smaling (SP), vraagnummer 2015Z01575 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op uitvoering energielabel voor woningen»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de gevolgen van eenvoudiger bouwregels

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about a report of dwellings without outside views and whether simplified building rules allow extensions of existing outbuildings without a permit, and what role fire and building supervision keeps. The Minister confirmed the report, pointed to existing rules on permit-free extensions, said daylight is required in dwellings, and stated that supervision roles stay the same for permit-free projects while a new quality-assurance system is being prepared.
I hope to present the bill to your House before summer 2015.
Ik hoop het wetsvoorstel voor de zomer van 2015 aan uw Kamer aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat huurwoningen schaarser zijn door de komst van vluchtelingen

An MP from the PVV asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice and the Minister for Housing about reports that rental homes are scarcer due to refugees, whether priority allocation for asylum seekers is unfair, how many applicants are disadvantaged, and whether asylum inflow will be stopped. The government answers that refugees with residence permits get priority to support integration and reduce COA centre congestion, that a direct effect on waiting times cannot be given, and that it will not stop asylum intake because international obligations and individual assessment apply.
No, asylum seekers who have been granted a permit are housed with priority in order to promote outflow from COA centres and integration.
Nee, asielzoekers die een vergunning hebben gekregen worden met voorrang gehuisvest teneinde uitstroom vanuit de COA centra en de integratie te bevorderen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de voor 3 februari geplande vliegshow met onbemande commerciële systemen (drones) op vliegveld Valkenburg niet door dreigt te gaan

MPs Van Helvert and Agnes Mulder asked whether the planned drone show at Valkenburg airfield, part of the TUSExpo 2015 event, is threatened by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf starting demolition of the runway, whether consultation took place, and why demolition begins now. The minister answers that the demolition follows a Masterplan and a contract signed in December 2013 that was widely known, that the organisers only contacted the agency on 26 January, that the agency offered alternative venues which were declined, and that the sloop proceeds under that contract.
The demolition has therefore been known for some time and has received media attention.
De sloop is hierdoor geruime tijd bekend en heeft media-aandacht genoten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de gevolgen van de uitspraak van het College van de Rechten van de Mens dat er sprake is van leeftijdsdiscriminatie als een uitkering van functioneel leeftijdsontslag stopt op

MPs Ulenbelt asked how the government responds to a College voor de Rechten van de Mens ruling that ending the UGM military disability benefit at 65 while the AOW age has risen amounts to age discrimination, and what it will do about the resulting income gap. The minister says the ruling concerns UGM benefits, that Defence is negotiating a fix with unions and a temporary ABP bridging scheme runs to 2016, and that the AOW gap is a deliberate sustainability measure with a temporary OBR bridging benefit; no structural change is promised.
Until then, the Minister of Defence is obliged to apply the existing terms of employment and no individual deviating arrangements will be made.
Tot die tijd is de Minister van Defensie gehouden de bestaande rechtspositieregeling toe te passen en worden geen individuele afwijkende regelingen getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over criminele netwerken en hennepteelt in Zuid Nederland

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about municipalities stopping recovery of costs for clearing cannabis plantations, police and prosecution capacity for organised crime, financial investigators, and whether cannabis should be regulated. The minister answered that municipalities set their own policy, that cost recovery is a local matter, that cannabis regulation would not solve the problem, and that investigations and capacity are being strengthened, while stating that some data is not held centrally.
I am not aware whether, and if so how many municipalities for what reason have since 2012 stopped the administrative clearance of cannabis plantations and recovery of costs from the offender.
Het is mij niet bekend of, en zo ja hoeveel gemeenten om welke reden sinds 2012 zouden zijn gestopt met het bestuurlijk ruimen van hennepplantages en het verhalen van gemaakte kosten op de dader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de verkoop van sociale woningen aan een Duitse vastgoedinvesteerder

MP Karabulut asks why the government did not block the sale of Vestia social rental homes to German investor Patrizia despite objections from 32 municipalities, and how this fits with the new Herzieningswet strengthening local roles. Minister Blok answers that the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) judged the sale in the interest of social housing after weighing municipal objections, that the sale followed existing rules, and that undoing it is premature while a second-package objection procedure is ongoing.
The ILT then decided that the planned sale to Patrizia is in the interest of social housing, giving heavy weight to the importance of the sale for Vestia and the sector as a whole.

De ILT is vervolgens tot het besluit gekomen dat de voorgenomen verkoop aan Patrizia in het belang van de volkshuisvesting is, waarbij het belang van de verkoop voor Vestia en de sector als geheel zwaar is meegewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de problemen bij de uitvoering van de SBF-regelingen

An SP MP asked why the SSC sent wrong letters and wrong income data to former SBF-leave staff, whether 123 staff were paid the AOW-gap compensation too early, and who the contact points are. The minister acknowledges the errors, says all staff now have correct information, offers staff the choice to keep or repay the early payment, and reports new contact points and regular SSC-P Direkt coordination.
I deeply regret the course of events.
Ik betreur de gang van zaken zeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Monasch over de salarissen van bestuurders van woningcorporaties

MPs Kerstens and Monasch asked the government about housing corporation executive salaries exceeding WNT norms, salary increases in 2013, transitional rules, and whether bonuses were paid unlawfully. The Minister answered that 44 of 728 top officials exceeded the 2013 norm, that the 2013 regulation was set aside so some pay rises were lawful under transitional rules, that no unlawful bonuses are known, and that the government will not interfere with transitional rights but welcomes voluntary restraint.
I have received no information showing that there are unlawful bonuses.
Mij heeft geen informatie bereikt waaruit blijkt dat er sprake is van onrechtmatige bonussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de toename van koolmonoxidevergiftigingen door cv installaties

An MP asked the minister whether he endorses reports of rising carbon monoxide poisonings from faulty central heating installations and whether he will ban or phase out open-flue appliances and tighten installer certification. The minister deferred most substantive answers until the Safety Board report expected in spring 2015, citing EU product rules against a ban and pointing to voluntary replacement and planned quality assurance from 2016.
Once the results of this investigation are available – expected in spring 2015 – I will inform the House of Representatives further on this.
Zodra de resultaten van dit onderzoek beschikbaar zijn – naar verwachting voorjaar 2015 – informeer ik de Tweede Kamer nader hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Van Veldhoven over de Rijksverkoop van natuur in Nationaal Park

MPs Ouwehand and Van Veldhoven asked whether the sale by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf of the Vafamil nature site in Bloemendaal, which lies within the EHS, Zuid-Kennemerland National Park and Natura 2000, should be stopped or transferred to a nature manager. Minister Blok answered that the site remains protected by zoning and Natura 2000 obligations regardless of buyer, that sales follow state-aid rules, and that zoning changes are a municipal responsibility.
For this reason, in principle it does not matter to whom the site is sold: a large nature manager or another private legal entity.
Om deze reden maakt het dan in beginsel niet uit aan wie het terrein wordt verkocht; een grote natuurbeheerder of een andere particuliere rechtspersoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Smaling over het instortingsgevaar van balkons en galerijen

MPs Bashir and Smaling asked the minister about collapse risks of balconies and gallery walkways in flats, including the Escamp flat in The Hague, and about owners' payment problems and government guarantees. The minister said building owners and municipalities are responsible, pointed to the 2012 inspection protocol and a new inspection duty instrument, opposed a mandatory APK for buildings, and described loan options for owners' associations.
Responsibility for safety lies with building owners and municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de veiligheid ligt bij de gebouweigenaren en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over gevaarlijke situaties in wooncomplexen in beheer bij VvE’s

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about the risk of collapsing concrete gallery floors in older flats, including whether the problem concentrates in owners' association (VvE) buildings and how VvEs with inadequate reserves can be helped. The Minister answered that the problem is not specific to VvEs, outlined planned legislation on VvE maintenance savings and borrowing, and declined an APK inspection scheme while noting a new inspection power for evident safety problems.
I am not in favour of an APK for buildings because this would lead to a higher burden for building owners.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een APK voor gebouwen omdat dit leidt tot een lastenverzwaring voor gebouweigenaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over tienduizenden huurders die huurtoeslag mislopen

An SP MP asked the minister about tens of thousands of tenants missing out on rent allowance (huurtoeslag) because rent increases are not reported, and who is responsible for reporting them. The minister answers that tenants are responsible for reporting changes, that about 75% of landlords already report, and that rent allowance can be recalculated retroactively once the correct rent is provided.
There is no exact information on the number of tenants who missed out on rent allowance over the past two years.
Er is geen exacte informatie over het aantal huurders dat de afgelopen twee jaar huurtoeslag is misgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Omtzigt en De Rouwe over het bericht ‘Overheid sluit deal voor behoud pinautomaten’

CDA MPs asked whether the government's intention agreement with SNS RegioBank on cash-machine provision in rural areas, and its relation to a Finance Ministry pilot on avoiding ATM 'white spots', was lawful and coordinated. The minister answered that the agreement concerns local liveability rather than ATM retention, that the ACM saw no reason for a competition assessment, and that the pilot's competition-law compatibility is still under discussion with the ACM.
For an assessment under the Competition Act by the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) there is therefore no reason.
Voor een beoordeling op grond van de Mededingingswet door de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) bestaat dan ook geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert De Vries over de strijdigheid van Komo-keurmerken met Europese regels voor vrij handelsverkeer

An MP asked the Minister for Housing and Central Government Affairs whether KOMO quality declarations for construction products conflict with EU free-movement rules and whether the minister would act against them. The minister acknowledged conflicts with the CE-marking rules, said KOMO has committed to splitting its documents and that enforcement by the ILT will follow from 1 January 2015, while leaving the legal robustness and the choice of certification approach largely to the market.
If KOMO and the Certification Bodies fail to adapt a specific assessment guideline in time, the quality declarations falling under that guideline will be withdrawn.

In het geval het Komo en de Certificerende Instellingen niet lukt om een specifieke beoordelingsrichtlijn op tijd aan te passen, zullen de kwaliteitsverklaringen die onder die beoordelingsrichtlijn vallen worden ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over koolmonoxidevergiftigingen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about carbon monoxide poisonings from faulty home heating, and whether installers are qualified, whether installations are checked, whether mandatory inspections and a periodic APK-style check should be introduced. The minister said installer competence is left to industry certification, that owners are responsible under the Woningwet, that building-quality assurance is being tightened from 2016, and that a mandatory inspection for existing homes is too burdensome for now, with a study of the Woningwet duty-of-care article and results promised for spring 2015.
I am awaiting the report of the Dutch Safety Board on carbon monoxide poisonings before determining my position further.
Ik wacht overigens het rapport van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid naar koolmonoxidevergiftigingen af
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat mensen moeten solliciteren op een huurwoning

Karabulut (SP) asks the housing minister whether municipalities may require prospective tenants to work or perform unpaid community service, or let residents choose who gets a social rental home, and how this relates to discrimination. The minister says only the Wbmgp allows excluding non-working applicants in designated areas, that no new legislation is needed to block such initiatives, and that enforcement lies with the province.
I do not consider it necessary to develop new legislation that would prevent such initiatives.
Ik acht het niet nodig nieuwe wetgeving te ontwikkelen die dergelijke initiatieven verhinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over belastingvrij schenken in 2015

An MP asked the ministers whether the temporary increased gift-tax exemption for home purchase or renovation in 2014 could still be used via a 'Groninger akte' (deferred-payment deed) in 2015, and whether the rules required a house to be owned at the time of the gift. The government answered that the exemption requires the recipient to already own the home in 2014, that spending may extend to 2016 for renovations, and that a Groninger akte does not change the regular conditions.
The temporarily increased exemption for maintenance or improvement can only be used if the recipient of the gift already owns the home in 2014.
Er kan alleen gebruik worden gemaakt van de tijdelijk verruimde vrijstelling voor onderhoud of verbetering indien de begunstigde van de schenking de eigen woning al in 2014 heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Jan Vos over ‘de belabberde kwaliteit van de indicatieve energielabels’

MPs Albert de Vries and Jan Vos asked the Minister for Housing about the poor quality of indicative energy labels, based on the WoON2006 median, the energy label atlas, and the calculation method. The minister defended the method as a cautious first indication, said the atlas is run by a private foundation, ordered an external second opinion, and explained how owners can convert the provisional label to a definitive one.
I have also decided to commission a second opinion from an external agency.
Tevens heb ik besloten een «second opinion» uit te laten voeren door een extern bureau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over de mogelijkheden van collega woningcorporaties om Vestia bezit over te nemen

An MP asked whether local housing associations should get a first right to buy Vestia's Den Bosch housing stock rather than foreign investor Patrizia. The minister answered that sales rules allow deviating from the offering order for rescue corporations, that the ILT assesses the sale by weighing interests, and that corporation interest is considered but a first right of purchase is not preferred.
As indicated, housing associations were able to show their interest through the public offering and at Vestia's invitation. I do not consider further research into this necessary.
Zoals aangegeven hebben woningcorporaties via de openbare aanbieding en op uitnodiging van Vestia hun belangstelling kunnen tonen. Nader onderzoek daarnaar acht ik niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de huisvesting van de belastingdienst in Tilburg

An MP asked why the Defence building in Tilburg was ruled out for Tax Authority offices, given the municipality disputes that talks took place, and why extra rented space is kept open in Eindhoven and Breda while a state-owned building is available in Tilburg. The minister says no match with demand existed at the time, that Defence was consulted, and that Tilburg options will be reviewed in the masterplan update, though current Eindhoven and Breda plans are defended on efficiency grounds.
In the meantime, the alderman for Economic Affairs has been informed that the possibilities of the central government in Tilburg will be examined again during the update of the masterplans.
Inmiddels is aan de wethouder van Economische Zaken toegelicht dat de mogelijkheden van de rijksoverheid in Tilburg nogmaals zullen worden bekeken bij de actualisering van de masterplannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Cegerek over het bericht “Duurzaam betekent niets meer”

MPs de Vries and Cegerek asked about a report claiming that 'sustainable' no longer means anything in construction, questioning builders' attitude to environmental rules, innovation, the National Environmental Database, and the reliability of certificates. The minister rejected the claim that builders reject environmental rules, defended the Nationale Milieudatabase and Green Deals, and said the government will study how consumers use certification labels and report to parliament.
The Tweede Kamer will be informed further about the results.
Over de resultaten wordt de Tweede Kamer nader ingelicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het tekenen van de deal ‘Stroomversnelling’

Smaling (SP) asked the minister about the signing and financing of the 'Stroomversnelling' energy-renovation deal for owner-occupied homes, including cost figures, targets, evaluation and planned legal changes. The minister answered that the deal is a private initiative of 175 parties, that the Rijk only facilitates it through the Energiesprong programme, and that evaluation and regulatory changes are being pursued, though the answers largely restate programme details and defer to initiators.
The Rijk is not a co-signatory, but facilitates via the Energiesprong innovation programme.
Het Rijk is geen medeondertekenaar, maar faciliteert wel via het innovatieprogramma Energiesprong.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat een ICT-bedrijf fraudeerde met overheidsaanbestedingen

An SP MP asked ministers whether ICT firm Ordina committed procurement fraud with government tenders, how investigations would be followed, how such leaks of confidential information could be prevented, and whether an overarching anti-fraud authority is needed. The government answered that investigations are ongoing and information is limited for investigative reasons, outlined existing safeguards and planned conflict-of-interest rules, and deferred the anti-fraud authority question to a later letter.

Insofar as informing your House does not conflict with the investigative interests, you will be informed by the relevant ministers about the outcomes of ongoing investigations and measures, where there is cause to do so.

Voor zover het inlichten van uw Kamer het opsporings- en onderzoeksbelang niet in de weg staat zal u – indien daartoe aanleiding bestaat – over de uitkomsten van de lopende onderzoeken en maatregelen worden geïnformeerd door de desbetreffende Ministers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over de berichten dat personeel bij de rechtbanken in Leeuwarden en Assen weggehaald wordt

Segers (ChristenUnie) asked whether the Noord-Nederland court's plan to move office staff from Leeuwarden and Assen to Groningen was known to the minister, how it fits the judicial map revision and regional employment commitments. Minister Opstelten said the plan has been withdrawn, that court sittings in Leeuwarden and Assen are unaffected, and that office organisation is a matter for the judiciary itself, with the Raad voor de rechtspraak to report back.
The judgement whether a sitting location must also have an office function is primarily for the Judiciary itself.
Het oordeel of een zittingsplaats ook een kantoorfunctie moet hebben is primair aan de Rechtspraak zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en De Rouwe over bericht ‘Personeel rechtbank weg uit Leeuwarden’

MPs Oskam and De Rouwe (CDA) asked whether all office staff of the Leeuwarden court and clerk's office staff of the Assen court will move to Groningen, and how this fits with promises to keep Leeuwarden a full justice city and to protect employment in Fryslân. The Minister answered that Leeuwarden and Assen remain hearing locations with clerk's offices, that the Public Prosecution Service will keep 30 workplaces in Leeuwarden until 2016, and that the Council for the Judiciary will consult court boards on the office function.
Leeuwarden remains a full justice city.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat huurbemiddelaars een andere werkwijze hebben toegezegd

MP Karabulut asked the Minister for Housing about reports that rental agents would stop charging tenants brokerage fees, and what is being done for tenants already charged and for studentrooms. The minister welcomed the change, said the ACM enforces against unfair practices, announced a bill to ban two-sided brokerage fees for all housing by end 2014, and stated that recovering fees is a matter between tenant and agent, not the government's.
The cabinet intends to submit a bill to the House of Representatives in 2014 removing the exception for room rentals from the ban on charging brokerage fees to both sides.

Het kabinet heeft het voornemen om nog in 2014 een wetsvoorstel bij de Tweede Kamer in te dienen, waarin de uitzondering voor kamerverhuur op het verbod op tweezijdig bemiddelingskosten in rekening brengen uit de wet wordt geschrapt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over de gevolgen van de toename in de uitstroom van erkende asielzoekers uit de reguliere opvangcentra op het aanbod van beschikbare woningen

MP Monasch asked the minister about the surge in recognised asylum seekers leaving reception centres and competing for regular social rental housing, and whether the national housing quota could be met within the existing stock. Minister Blok answered that municipalities and housing associations are primarily responsible, that the 2015 quota of about 14,450 homes is roughly 6% of annual turnover, and that he will not impose redistribution of the quota between municipalities from above, while a platform with VNG and ministries is being set up.
I do not intend to impose the redistribution of the quota between municipalities from above.
Ik ben niet voornemens om de herverdeling van de taakstelling tussen gemeenten onderling van bovenaf op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht dat de Schenkingsvrijstelling nieuwbouw volgens NVB-bouw in feite nu al verlopen is

MP Krol asked the minister whether the temporarily expanded gift tax exemption for new-build homes effectively expired before 1 January 2015 because payments in instalments fall outside the window, and whether the government would show flexibility. The minister acknowledged the strict wording, said the exemption will not be extended but that a flexible approach will be taken for homes under construction, with conditions to be published in a policy decision.
The cabinet has decided not to extend the temporarily expanded exemption, but considers it desirable to apply the rules flexibly for homes under construction.
Het kabinet heeft besloten de tijdelijk verruimde vrijstelling niet te verlengen maar acht het wel wenselijk om soepel om te gaan met de regels waar het gaat om een woning in aanbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Smaling inzake het wonen op antikraakcontracten

Two SP MPs asked why people on low incomes increasingly live without legal protection under anti-squatting (antikraak) contracts, and what the government will do about asbestos risks, oversight, the Wet Kraken en Leegstand, and tenant protection. The minister answers that he will not impose statutory requirements on antikraak contracts, sees the choice as voluntary, will evaluate the squatting and vacancy law in early 2015, and points to a voluntary keurmerk for vacancy managers.
For that reason I will not develop proposals to impose further statutory requirements on antikraak contracts.
Om die reden zal ik geen voorstellen ontwikkelen om verdere wettelijke eisen te stellen aan antikraakcontracten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Van Weyenberg over het hoge ziekteverzuim bij de Rijksoverheid

MPs Schouw and Van Weyenberg asked why sick leave in the central government (5.2% in 2013) is above the national average and the highest of all sectors, whether a target exists, what it costs, and how re-integration and wage sanctions by the UWV can be improved. Minister Blok confirmed the figures, argued that the comparison with the national average is misleading because of age and job-type differences, declined a separate study, set no single sector target, and promised further re-integration measures and a review of sick-pay agreements.
In 2013, a wage sanction was imposed in 23% of WIA applications submitted by employees in the central government, police and judiciary sector.
Bij 23% van de WIA-aanvragen die zijn ingediend door werknemers in de sector «rijksoverheid, politie en rechterlijke macht», is in 2013 een loonsanctie opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de schenkingsregeling bij een koophuis

MP Bashir asked the State Secretary of Finance about the temporarily expanded gift-tax exemption for home purchases, which was used far more than the 20,000 expected, and about its revenue loss, effect on house prices and whether it should be extended. The government answered that exact figures are not yet available, estimated a cumulative revenue loss of about 100 million euros over 30 years, and said the temporary exemption will not be extended.
Exact realisation figures will only become available after the tax return data has been processed in the Tax Administration's automated systems.
Exacte realisatiecijfers zullen pas beschikbaar komen nadat de aangiftegegevens zijn verwerkt in de geautomatiseerde systemen van de Belastingdienst.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over de tweet waarin een ambtenaar van het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie stelt dat ‘Islamitische Staat (IS) een vooropgezet plan van zionisten is die bewust de Isl

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a civil servant's tweet claiming IS is a Zionist plot, and whether IS is monitored online and what policy applies to civil servants who support or excuse IS. The minister distanced the government from the tweet, explained that the NCSC monitors digital security rather than all online expressions, and set out the limits on civil servants' freedom of expression under the Ambtenarenwet, with disciplinary sanctions possible after advice from an advisory committee.
I completely distance myself from the content of the tweet.
Ik neem volledig afstand van de inhoud van de tweet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht over parkeergarages

An SP MP asked the ministers about a Grontmij report claiming most parking garage designs are unsafe and inaccessible, and about whether national norms such as NEN 2443 should be written into the Bouwbesluit. The minister answered that Grontmij had no national study, that preventing car damage is not a national government task, that the Bouwbesluit protects persons rather than cars, and that no new parking dimension rules will be added.
It is not the task of the national government to prevent damage to cars in parking garages.
Het is niet aan de rijksoverheid om schade aan auto’s in parkeergarages te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Monasch over het bericht dat de gasleiding van honderdduizenden Nederlanders lekt

MPs Albert de Vries and Monasch asked about reports that gas pipes leak in hundreds of thousands of homes, including claims of explosion risk, deaths, lost gas, lapsed municipal inspections and a periodic inspection scheme. The minister answered that leaks are rare and mainly in older homes, that owners are responsible under the Building Decree, that a national inspection programme is not justified, and that a possible ministerial regulation will be explored with municipalities and report in 2015.
The Minister for Housing and Central Government Organisation will take the initiative for this exploration and will inform the House of Representatives further on its results in 2015.
De Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst zal het initiatief nemen voor deze verkenning en zal in 2015 de Tweede Kamer nader informeren over de resultaten hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Bisschop over de toegang van ge-moedsbezwaarden tot Nationale Hypotheek Garantie (NHG)

SGP MPs asked whether conscientious objectors recognised by a court, who refuse life-insurance coverage, can obtain a maximum NHG-guaranteed mortgage, and whether a 100% financing model backed by a buy-out amount, or separate case assessment, could be considered. The minister answered that NHG can be granted without life insurance if the bank demonstrably bears the mortgage-death risk, that this is the lender's choice, and that the fund's structure rules out a motor-insurance-style model or case-by-case assessment.
It is up to the lender to assess whether it is willing to do so in such cases.
Het is aan de geldverstrekker te beoordelen of zij hiertoe in voorkomende gevallen bereid is.
Antwoord op vragen van van het lid Karabulut over onrust onder huurders door een fout van de Belastingdienst

MP Karabulut asked about unrest among hundreds of Welbions tenants after the Tax Authority wrongly demanded retroactive repayment of rent allowance, and how many such demands were issued and how the error happened. The State Secretary confirms the procedural error, says the demands were reversed and the allowance paid within days, that about 390 cases were affected through an error in the landlord administration, and that measures are being taken to prevent recurrence.
The wrongful reclaims have been reversed and the rent allowance, which had also wrongly been stopped, was paid out to the tenants concerned a few days after the original payment date.
