De onterechte terugvorderingen zijn hersteld en de huurtoeslag, die eveneens ten onrechte gestopt was, is enkele dagen na de oorspronkelijke betaaldatum aan de betrokken huurders uitgekeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de gevolgen van de verhuurderheffing voor hofjeswoningen

MP Karabulut asks whether the rental levy (verhuurderheffing) should exempt historic hofjes run by foundations, citing the Essenhof in Haarlem, and whether the levy's small-landlord threshold could be raised from 10 to 50 or 70 homes. Minister Blok answers that the levy applies objectively to all landlords without distinguishing purpose, that the threshold change would be considered in the 2016 evaluation, and that no exemption is planned.
I therefore see no objective grounds to make such a distinction within the levy.
Ik zie daarom geen objectieve gronden om binnen de heffing een dergelijk onderscheid te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert De Vries en Wolbert over het bericht dat het RIVM heeft geconcludeerd dat bewoners van Krimpregio’s zich gemiddeld minder gezond voelen

MPs Albert de Vries and Wolbert asked about the RIVM finding that residents of shrinking regions feel less healthy on average, and whether equal health rights, care provision and local action are being ensured. The minister acknowledges the socioeconomic link, points to primary responsibility at local level and existing programmes, and promises follow-up letters on curative care and the RIVM study after the summer.
Proximity of care, also for the patient/citizen in the shrinking regions, is one of the policy priorities.
Nabijheid van zorg, ook voor de patiënt/burger in de krimpregio’s, is één van de speerpunten van het beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over ontwijken van de verhuurderheffing

MP Knops (CDA) asked the minister whether liberalising rented homes to avoid the landlord levy is occurring, its scale, and whether offering sitting tenants a switch to liberalised contracts should be halted. The minister said he has no signals of liberalisation aimed at avoiding the levy, will assess effects in the evaluation due in early 2016, and will not intervene because contractual freedom applies.
Should the practice you have identified occur frequently, this will become visible in the evaluation.
Mocht de door u geconstateerde praktijk zich veelvuldig voordoen, dan zal dit in de evaluatie zichtbaar worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van der Linde, Verhoeven, De Rouwe en Baay-Timmerman over gouden handdrukken bij woningcorporatie Rochdale

MPs asked the Minister for Housing about severance payments of about 4.5 million euros at housing corporation Rochdale, including whether tenants were effectively paying for them and whether the sums could be reclaimed. The Minister answered that the payments were made under a social plan to five non-top employees, that no legal framework was breached, that no recovery is possible, and promised to look into comparable rules in Germany and Denmark later.
That possibility does not exist, because there is no question of excessive severance payments in relation to the Normalisation of Top Incomes Act or the Housing Act.
Die mogelijkheid is er niet, omdat er geen sprake is van te hoge ontslagvergoedingen in relatie tot de Wet Normering Topinkomens of de Woningwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de huren 10% zijn gestegen in twee jaar tijd en de huurtoeslag wordt gekort

An SP MP asked the minister whether rents rose about 10% in two years, whether a 2.7% annual rent increase above inflation is planned, and why housing benefit is being cut while promising affordable rents. The minister confirmed the rent rise figures, said the 2.7% refers to a maximum rent-sum increase under the housing accord, denied an extra cut beyond the announced 31 million euro, and defended the housing benefit policy.
I do not intend to make further cuts to housing benefit in 2015 beyond the 31 million euro reduction already announced in the Spring Memorandum.
Ik heb niet het voornemen om, naast de reeds bij Voorjaarsnota aangekondigde bezuiniging van € 31 mln., in 2015 verdere bezuinigingen op de huurtoeslag door te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Amsterdamse huurders die hun huis uit moeten van woningcorporatie Ymere

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about Ymere evicting 180 Amsterdam social tenants for renovation and sale, and whether this is lawful, whether rents will rise up to 100%, and whether housing policy should change. The minister confirmed the plans, explained that 'dringend eigen gebruik' renovation grounds are lawful but sale alone is not, said Ymere is responsible for its own choices and offered tenant protections, and declined to revise policy.
I do not have data on the rent-to-income ratios.
Over de huurquotes heb ik geen gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over de voorgenomen verkoop door Ymere van 180 woningen in Amsterdam

An MP asked the minister whether Ymere's plan to evict 180 tenants in Amsterdam Centrum via dringend eigen gebruik to sell the homes is lawful, and how renovation costs and sociale huur segregation bear on it. The minister answered that sale alone cannot justify dringend eigen gebruik, that courts decide case by case considering renovation necessity and tenant interests, and that Amsterdam sets its own housing agenda.
If sale of the dwelling is the sole objective, a landlord's invocation of urgent own use upon termination of tenancy is therefore not permitted.
Als verkoop van de woning de enige doelstelling is, is een beroep van een verhuur op dringend eigen gebruik bij huuropzegging dus niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat een corporatie miljoenen claimt bij de overheid vanwege de sluiting van de verzorgingshuizen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about a corporation's reported claim against the state over care home closures, the 1999 compensation arrangement, its potential financial exposure and the government's cost-cutting policy in care. The government says it knows of no claim, cannot speculate on hypothetical claims, notes that the compensation arrangement has never been used, and refers to earlier letters on long-term care reform.
I am not aware of any claim, so I cannot respond to it either.
Mij is geen claim bekend, dus ik kan daar ook niet op in gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het bericht dat woningcorporatie WoningNet Holland Rijnland sinds 1 mei 2014 alle informatie uitsluitend per e-mail laat verlopen

MP Knops asks whether housing corporation WoningNet Holland Rijnland may end registrations of applicants without an email address, and how digital-only service fits government policy on accessibility for less digitally skilled people. Minister Plasterk answers that corporations are not obliged to use particular channels, that a fallback exists for applicants without email, and that digitalisation is government policy, leaving support to the corporations.
Housing corporations are not obliged under the regulations to communicate with their tenants and applicants in any particular way.
Corporaties zijn op grond van de regelgeving niet verplicht om op een bepaalde wijze met hun huurders en woningzoekenden te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over verlaging van RVOB-grondtarieven

An MP asked why the government lowered the SDE+ land compensation for wind on land, whether RVOB's land rates are above market and how they compare with coal and biomass plants. The minister confirmed the reduction to limit price-raising effects on land, stated RVOB sits at the low end of market-conform prices, and said land pricing is primarily RVOB's responsibility.
I am in principle not involved in land transactions.
Ik ben in beginsel niet bij grondtransacties betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over een uitspraak van de Raad van State over woonboten

Albert de Vries (PvdA) asked the minister about a Council of State ruling that houseboats count as buildings, with consequences for permits and local rules. Minister Blok confirmed that many existing houseboats may now be illegal, that local ordinances lose force, and that a legislative amendment with transitional rules is planned for late 2014.
I expect to send the proposal for the necessary legislative amendment to the House of Representatives at the end of 2014.
Ik verwacht het voorstel voor de daarvoor benodigde wetswijziging eind 2014 naar de Tweede Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Karabulut over het dwarsbomen van de kamerverhuur in verzorgingshuizen door de verhuurderheffing

MPs Siderius and Karabulut asked whether the rental levy (verhuurderheffing) is pushing poorer elderly people out of care-home rooms, and asked for data on rents, vacancies and exemptions. The minister gave mostly data gaps and defended the Woonakkoord, promising only a future evaluation of the levy.
There is no overview of the amount of care real estate owned by care providers and the portion that is rented.
Er is geen overzicht van de hoeveelheid zorgvastgoed die in bezit is van zorgaanbieders en het deel dat wordt gehuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de Stichting Bouwkwaliteit (SBK) en de Nationale Milieudatabase (NMD)

An MP asked the minister about the resignation of the NMD's daily manager, a quaggy overlap of roles for a quality-assurance consultant who also chairs the SBK supervisory board and advised on merging NMD and SBK, and whether a subsidy to IBK for that consultant's role was properly awarded. The minister answered that the resignation stemmed from an internal disagreement, that the roles are separated across organisations, that no contracts were awarded to the consultant, and that the IBK subsidy was granted because it fits the government's policy direction.
Given the separate responsibilities as given in answer 2, there is no undesirable accumulation of functions in one person.
Gegeven de gescheiden verantwoordelijkheden als in antwoord 2 is gegeven, is er geen sprake ongewenste stapeling van functies bij één persoon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht “Rammelend systeem huurcommissie leidt tot onzekerheid over huurprijs”

An MP asks the minister why the Huurcommissie's online rent-check tool produced errors, since when the minister knew, and what harm was done to tenants and foreign investors. The minister replies that the tool is only an informational aid, that errors are acknowledged as inherent to simplification, that the tool is being rebuilt with tenant and landlord representatives, and that the old tool has been removed.
I had myself informed and then learned that the Huurcommissie had already started renewing the rent-check tools.
Ik heb mij daarop laten informeren en vernam toen dat de huurcommissie reeds was gestart met het vernieuwen van de huurprijschecks.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht ‘Groot deel van lege kantoren rijp voor de sloop’

An MP asked whether demolition is the best solution for many empty offices and what role the government sees for itself in speeding up demolition. The minister says demolition can be best for poor buildings or locations, points to regional office funds and to municipal and provincial facilitation, and welcomes 'slimme sloop' initiatives.
Although reuse possibilities are often greater than thought, for certain offices (poor building/poor location) demolition can be the best solution.
Hoewel de herbestemmingsmogelijkheden vaak groter zijn dan gedacht, kan voor bepaalde kantoren (slecht pand/slechte locatie) sloop de beste oplossing zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het bericht dat een kwart van het winkeloppervlak in de toekomst leegstaand en kansloos zal zijn

An MP asked the ministers whether the projected 25 percent reduction in retail floor space and rising shop vacancy warrant government intervention, including convening stakeholders and new regulation. The minister answered that shop vacancy is a market-driven, structural issue best handled through regional tailor-made agreements via the Winkeltop, and that existing instruments suffice, with a PBL analysis due in autumn.
For now I choose to actively facilitate the efforts from the Winkeltop to stimulate regional parties to reach tailor-made solutions
Ik kies er vooralsnog voor om de inzet vanuit de Winkeltop, om regionale partijen te stimuleren om te komen tot maatwerkoplossingen, actief te faciliteren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Siderius over het bericht dat een chronische aandoening een struikelblok is voor het kopen van een woning

MPs Jansen and Siderius (SP) asked the ministers whether a chronic illness obstructs obtaining a mortgage or life-insurance policy and whether this amounts to discrimination, and what action is needed. The government answered that about 97% of consumers are accepted on normal terms, that insurers may use medical assessment, that the market functions, and that the Wgbh/cz anti-discrimination law may be amended as part of ratifying the UN disability convention.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Fritsma over het bericht met spoed gezocht: 100.000 seniorenwoningen

MPs Agema and Fritsma asked about reports of a shortage of 100,000 senior housing units and whether the government will postpone the ZZP 1-3 extramuralisation measure until enough suitable housing exists. The State Secretary replied that extramuralisation will keep 30,000-35,000 people at home longer, that existing stock is largely sufficient, and pointed to a regional transition agenda for living independently longer.
In our view, housing people who face an increase in limitations is therefore well feasible.
Naar onze mening is daarmee het huisvesten van mensen, die met een toename van beperkingen te maken krijgt, goed uitvoerbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een verdubbeling van de verzoeken aan de Huurcommissie in 2013

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing whether the doubling of rent-dispute referrals to the Huurcommissie in 2013, mainly caused by income-dependent rent increases, warrants revising housing policy, and raised burdens, landlord win rates, Belastingdienst capacity and the Huurcommissie's deficit. The minister said the increase was largely due to the income-dependent rise, that inflows were far below the 9,000 projected, and that no policy revision was warranted, while answering the other questions with explanations of cost-sharing, legal fees and risk-based referrals.
I see no reason, based on these inflow figures, to revise housing policy.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om op basis van deze instroomcijfers het woonbeleid te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Hamer over het bericht dat de grenzen wagenwijd open staan voor buitenlandse bouwers

MPs Monasch and Hamer asked whether German administrative requirements imposed on Dutch construction firms, such as prior registration of workers and posting of deposits, conflict with EU free movement and whether Dutch SMEs can be protected, including via a LIMOSA-type register. The minister replied that host-state rules must be necessary and proportionate, that the government will push for reduction of disproportionate requirements, and that a registration system and identity passes are being considered in implementing the new enforcement directive.
The Netherlands is currently examining which control measures it wishes to adopt and will make a proposal for this when implementing the Enforcement Directive.
Nederland beziet thans welke controlemaatregelen zij wenst over te nemen en zal hiervoor een voorstel doen bij de implementatie van de Handhavingsrichtlijn.
Vragen van het lid Van der Linde (VVD) aan de Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst over een bezoek aan de Margrietstraat in Rotterdam (ingezonden 28 april 2014).

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about foundation damage and possible evacuation of homes in Rotterdam's Margrietstraat caused by nearby demolition, asking about demolition rules, liability, early intervention and a pilot project. The minister answered that the municipality issued permits and set conditions, that liability follows the Civil Code with municipalities liable only for serious negligence, and that the national government has no role, while noting the pilot is for the municipality to pursue.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het Grondwetfestival en de openstelling van overheidsgebouwen

An MP asked whether the Grondwetfestival and opening of government buildings such as parliament, ministries and the Catshuis should be seen as a success, and whether such buildings should be open to the public at least annually, including Het Torentje. The minister agreed it was a success and said the ministry will take the initiative, with The Hague and partners, to explore a suitable follow-up to public openings of constitution-related buildings.

Following the findings of the National Committee 200 Years Kingdom on the Grondwet Festival, the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations will take the initiative, in consultation with The Hague municipality and other partners, to examine how a suitable follow-up can be given to attention for the Constitution and the opening of related buildings.

Mede naar aanleiding van de bevindingen van het Nationaal Comité 200 jaar Koninkrijk over het Grondwet Festival zal het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties het initiatief nemen om in overleg met de gemeente Den Haag en andere partners te bezien op welke wijze een passend vervolg kan worden gegeven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over woningcorporaties die de huurprijs van sociale huurwoningen fors verhogen

An SP member asked the Minister for Housing about press reports that housing corporations are raising rents sharply on re-let social housing to fund the landlord levy, and about rising evictions. The Minister replied that rent increases on vacated homes are a normal part of rent policy, cited planned measures on allocation and a rent-sum rule, said corporations have other options than rent rises, and pointed to a forthcoming monitoring report.
I attach great value to the affordability and availability of social rental housing for the target group.
Ik hecht veel waarde aan de betaalbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van sociale huurwoningen voor de doelgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de veranderde regels omtrent de Nationale Hypotheekgarantie

An MP asked whether the Nationale Hypotheek Garantie can unilaterally change rules for existing mortgages after a Radar broadcast, and about alimony and the adjusted leennormen. The minister answered that no existing contracts changed, that the rules were adjusted with the guarantee fund and approved by him, that alimony is generally not counted separately but case-by-case exceptions exist, and that no further change to the criteria is planned.
There is no change to the existing contracts.
Er is geen sprake van wijziging in de bestaande contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over het toezicht op woningcorporaties

MP Paulus Jansen asked whether the Centraal Fonds voor de Volkshuisvesting had made sanction requests that were not granted, and why the minister would move corporation supervision to the Interior Ministry before the parliamentary inquiry reports. The minister answered that the CFV reported no such refused requests, that he will in principle honour CFV sanction requests, and that policy development will not wait for the inquiry.
As I wrote to the House last December in a letter on the organisation of supervision of housing corporations, I will in principle honour all CFV requests to use sanction powers.

Zoals ik de Kamer december jl. in een brief over de inrichting van het toezicht op corporaties heb geschreven, zal ik in beginsel alle verzoeken van het CFV tot het inzetten van sanctiebevoegdheden honoreren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Paulus Jansen en Kooiman over "een groeiend aantal huisuitzettingen van gezinnen met kinderen".

SP MPs asked whether evictions of families with children and demand for emergency shelter are rising, whether this breaches the Convention on the Rights of the Child, and whether evictions involving children should be banned. The government confirmed 6,980 evictions from housing corporations in 2013 (up 8%) but said the rise is mainly single adults, not families, and that a ban is unnecessary because courts already weigh tenants' housing interests and a noodmoratorium exists.
A forced eviction will therefore only take place after judicial review; this is related to the special character of residential accommodation.
Een gedwongen ontruiming zal dus alleen plaatsvinden na een rechterlijke toets; dit heeft te maken met het bijzondere karakter van woonruimte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Verhoeven en Hachchi over drones die huizen fotograferen

MPs from D66 asked whether the commercial drone firm Billionhomes may photograph homes from the air and publish them without owners' consent, and how privacy is protected under the Wbp and drone permit rules. The Minister answered that the Wbp applies only where data are traceable to persons, that the ILT has received no permit application from Billionhomes, that privacy is not part of the aviation-safety permit assessment, and that a WODC study on privacy and drones is under way.

I have recently informed your House about a study that the WODC is carrying out at the cabinet's request into various questions surrounding unmanned aircraft (UAS), with particular attention to the possible negative effects of their use on privacy and how that privacy can be safeguarded most effectively.

Ik heb uw Kamer recent geïnformeerd over een onderzoek dat het WODC op verzoek van het kabinet uitvoert naar diverse vragen rondom onbemande luchtvaartuigen (UAS), met daarbij bijzondere aandacht voor de mogelijk negatieve effecten van het gebruik van onbemande luchtvaartuigen op de privacy
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over asbestsanering in Louweshoek te Amsterdam

An SP MP asked the ministers about the asbestos removal in Louweshoek, Amsterdam, covering inspection, certification, residents' relocation and costs. The government answered that the matter is locally responsible, described the inspections and the stop order, and said Woonzorg Nederland and the municipality decide on relocation and resumption, without quantifying social costs.
However, this is a local matter with local responsibility, so I do not know all the details of the removal.
Het gaat hier overigens om een lokale kwestie met lokale verantwoordelijkheid waardoor bij mij niet alle details van de sanering bekend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Knops over gemeentelijk voorrangsbeleid bij het uitgeven van bouwkavels

MPs Van Hijum and Knops asked whether the Minister opposes Raalte's rules giving local-binding priority in building-plot allocation, and whether municipal autonomy and the Huisvestingswet allow this. The Minister answered that such binding criteria require a huisvestingsverordening under the Huisvestingswet, which Raalte lacks, so its rules conflict with the law; the municipality has said it will comply, and a pending bill would further restrict such local rules.
It has emerged that no housing ordinance has been adopted in the municipality of Raalte. The criteria it set therefore conflict with the Huisvestingswet.
Gebleken is dat er in de gemeente Raalte geen huisvestingsverordening is vastgesteld. De vastgestelde kaders staan daarom op gespannen voet met de Huisvestingswet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de Huisjesmelker van het Jaar 2014

An SP MP asks the ministers about the 2014 Huisjesmelker van het Jaar award, the enforcement against landlords exploiting student tenants, a national rental permit scheme, fire and installation safety checks, and the student housing shortfall. Minister Blok responds that gemeenten already have enforcement tools, that a Woningwet amendment strengthening municipal enforcement is pending, that a national permit scheme is unnecessary, that safety oversight is for municipalities to decide, and that the 16,000-unit student housing target is on schedule and sufficient.
The cabinet is therefore committed to combating landlord exploitation, including by amending legislation and expanding municipalities' enforcement instruments.
Het kabinet zet zich dan ook in om huisjesmelkerij tegen te gaan, onder meer door wetgeving aan te passen en het handhavingsinstrumentarium van gemeenten uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de explosieve stijging van de OZB voor huiseigenaren

An MP asked the minister whether he knew of reports that homeowners face sharply higher property tax (OZB) and whether he would act so that OZB cannot rise when WOZ values fall. The minister said municipalities set their own OZB rates under the Gemeentewet, that he would not change this, and that the revenue norm is under evaluation.
Under the Municipalities Act, it is each municipality's autonomous power to set its OZB rate every year.
Ingevolge de Gemeentewet is het een autonome bevoegdheid van iedere gemeente om jaarlijks hun OZB-tarief vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over de verkoop van alle huurwoningen in Stuifzand

An MP asks the Minister for Housing whether he knows of housing corporation Actium's plan to sell all social rental homes in Stuifzand, and whether this breaches the municipality's housing vision and the MG 2013-02 sale rules. The Minister confirms the plan, states that corporations need no prior permission for sales to owner-occupiers, and says new legislation will strengthen the municipality's role, while denying any breach of the rules and seeing no reason to change policy.
I have regulations in preparation that will strengthen the role of the municipality.
Ik heb regelgeving in voorbereiding waarmee de rol van de gemeente versterkt wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Smaling over de fusie van woningcorporaties Ymere en De Woningbouw (Weesp)

MPs Jansen and Smaling asked the minister whether the merger of Ymere and De Woningbouw (Weesp) followed the 'nee-tenzij' principle, what alternatives and public-value tests were used, and whether merger benefits are monitored. The minister answered that the merger was approved on the basis of the 2002 merger criteria, that no separate public-value test or alternatives study is required, that monitoring of benefits is primarily the corporation's responsibility, and that he will strengthen merger rules through new legislation.
I also intend, through the Revision Act for approved housing institutions, to require that it be demonstrated that a merger is preferable to other forms of cooperation.

Ik ben bovendien voornemens via de Herzieningswet toegelaten instellingen volkshuisvesting te regelen dat aannemelijk gemaakt moet worden dat een fusie te prefereren is boven andere vormen van samenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de PUR-schuimproblematiek

MP Albert de Vries asked the Minister for Housing and Central Government Affairs about the EU SVHC Roadmap, the classification of isocyanates used in PUR foam insulation as substances of very high concern, and whether the Health Council was asked to study PUR insulation. The minister confirmed knowledge of the Roadmap, said isocyanates have not yet been nominated for the candidate list but may be later, and said no Health Council advice was requested for sprayed PUR insulation, committing to involve the Council if new information arises.

Should isocyanates be placed on the list in the future, there will at least be a moment to examine at European level, in consultation with industry, whether alternatives are technically and economically feasible and, if so, within what period.

Mochten isocyanaten in de toekomst op de betreffende lijst geplaatst worden, dan ontstaat in ieder geval een moment om in overleg met het bedrijfsleven op Europees niveau na te gaan of alternatieven technisch en economisch haalbaar zijn en zo ja, binnen welke periode.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het door de overheid in eigen beheer nemen van de bezorging van reguliere pakketten, het verzorgen van koeriers- en transportdiensten en de bezorging van gerechtelijke briev

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked the government about worker anxiety, job security, staff numbers and service quality as the state plans to bring parcel delivery, courier services and delivery of court letters in-house via IPKD. Minister Blok answered that no decision on staff transfers can yet be given, that Valid Express workers will be taken over where no suitable post exists at PostNL, and that legal quality standards for court letters will be ensured.
What consequences the in-sourcing plans will have for staff of companies currently performing these tasks cannot be stated in advance.
Welke gevolgen de inbestedingsvoornemens hebben voor personeel van bedrijven die deze taken nu uitvoeren, is niet op voorhand te zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de rechtsbescherming van erfpachters

An SP MP asks the ministers whether they will change the law so leaseholders (erfpachters) can compel a reluctant ground lessor to amend contracts marked 'code rood', rather than having to sue, and whether they will act on NVB suggestions such as statutory protection, court review and AFM supervision. The minister maintains that the leaseholder must go to court, but says consultation with stakeholders on the evaluation of the banking guideline and possible steps will take place shortly.

This does not alter the fact that, as also indicated in the earlier answer of 7 February 2014, consultation with relevant parties will take place shortly to jointly consider which steps are conceivable based on the experiences gained.

Dit laat onverlet dat, zoals ook aangegeven in eerdergenoemde beantwoording van 7 februari 2014, op korte termijn overleg zal plaatsvinden met betrokken partijen om aan de hand van de opgedane ervaringen met elkaar te bezien welke stappen denkbaar zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over de gevaren van open verbrandingstoestellen

Schouten (ChristenUnie) asks the Minister of Housing about deaths and hospitalisations from carbon monoxide poisoning by open combustion appliances and whether the phase-out period of about 10 years should be shortened, and whether mandatory CO detectors should be introduced. The Minister answers that existing measures (maintenance, CO detectors, a 2009 handbook and a convenant with landlords) are sufficient, that CO detectors will not be made mandatory because enforcement behind front doors is difficult, and that no new agreements will be made.
I am of the opinion that the central government is currently doing sufficient in this regard.
Ik ben van mening dat hiermee vanuit de Rijksoverheid op dit moment voldoende wordt gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Fritsma en De Graaf over Oost-Europese overlast op vakantieparken

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers about nuisance and overcrowding caused by Eastern European migrant workers housed on holiday parks, including whether a deterrence policy should replace the national housing declaration and whether work permits should be reintroduced. The government answered that municipalities enforce nuisance rules, that regional agreements have added 31,000 housing places, that free movement of workers cannot be reversed under the accession treaties, and that permanent occupation of recreational homes is a municipal matter.
Statistics Netherlands examined, in the municipalities of the 9 regions of the Flexwonen Arbeidsmigranten programme, how many migrant workers are housed in which municipality.
Het CBS heeft onderzocht in de gemeenten uit de 9 regio’s van het programma Flexwonen Arbeidsmigranten hoeveel arbeidsmigranten er in welke gemeente gehuisvest zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de bedreiging van complexen monumentale arbeiderswoningen door de verhuurdersheffing

An SP MP asked whether the rental levy (verhuurdersheffing) threatens non-profit landlords of monumental social-rental housing, and whether the government will exempt them or evaluate the levy's impact. The minister answered that the levy is general, sees no grounds for distinguishing these landlords, notes rent increases and harmonisation are available, and promised a fundamental evaluation by early 2016.
Both in the debate in the Senate and in the House of Representatives I indicated that I would report on the effects of the rental levy.
Zowel in het debat in de Eerste als in de Tweede Kamer heb ik aangegeven verslag te doen van de effecten van de verhuurderheffing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries (over het bericht tienduizenden huizen nog altijd onverkoopbaar door erfpacht

MPs Visser and Aukje de Vries asked about reports that tens of thousands of homes on leasehold land remain unsaleable because banks refuse financing. The minister defends the banking guideline agreed between the notaries and the banks as self-regulation, says he will consult stakeholders shortly, and rules out bringing leasehold contracts under financial supervision or declaring the guideline generally binding.
I will shortly consult with the parties involved about the outcomes of this evaluation.
Ik zal op korte termijn in overleg treden met betrokken partijen over de uitkomsten van deze evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het bericht dat er minder verkochte woningen zijn geregistreerd en er meer gedwongen verkopen waren

An MP asked the housing minister about the Kadaster report of fewer home sales in late 2013, rising forced sales, and when households with negative equity will recover. The minister attributed the December dip to a tax-driven peak in 2012, argued that sales recovered in Q4, said forced sales are a lagging indicator, and listed measures to help households with restschulden move.
I see signs of growing confidence in the housing market.
Ik zie tekenen van groeiend vertrouwen op de woningmarkt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klein en Baay-Timmerman over de artikelen “Stichting verrijkt zich ten koste van bewoners serviceflats” en “Oud CDA-politicus verrijkt zich ten koste van bewoners seniorenflats”

MPs Klein and Baay-Timmerman asked the minister about press reports that a service-flat management foundation (SDS) cut services while charging high prices, had conflicted managers, and pressured residents into selling homes below cost. The minister answered that service flats are a market initiative governed by general rules, residents may go to court, and existing branch certification is sufficient, so no new measures are planned.
Ultimately it is up to the judiciary to pass judgment and not for me to comment on the substance.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de rechterlijke macht om een oordeel te vellen en niet aan mij om hier inhoudelijk op in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Van Klaveren over Arabische informatiebrieven van woningcorporaties

PVV MPs Fritsma and Van Klaveren asked whether housing corporations send information letters in Arabic, whether others do so, and what measures will stop it. The minister said one letter about waste collection in Leeuwarden was sent in Dutch, English and Arabic on behalf of the municipality, that no national overview exists, and that communication should be in Dutch with exceptions; he committed to no new measures.
No national overview exists of the information housing corporations provide, or in which language they do so.
Er bestaat geen landelijk overzicht van de informatie die door corporaties wordt verstrekt noch in welke taal zij dit doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Omtzigt en Bashir over bijstellingsregeling directe belasting

MPs Knops, Omtzigt and Bashir asked when the Secretary of State learned of the 2014 indexation raising the eigenwoningforfait from 0.6% to 0.7%, why earlier calculations assumed 0.6%, and how the rise affects taxpayers, provisional assessments and cost estimates. The government answered that the indexation follows the statutory mechanism, was signed on 18 December 2013 and published without notifying parliament, and that provisional assessments used 0.65% with later requests recalculated at 0.7%, with a commitment to adjust the trial calculation.
It is not customary to share the outcomes of statutory indexation mechanisms with members of the cabinet.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om de uitkomsten van wettelijke indexeringsmechanismes aan leden van het kabinet mede te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baay-Timmerman over de invoering van de Verhuurdersheffing

An MP asks whether the rental levy on private landlords will push rents in cheap private rental housing up sharply, forcing tenants out of big cities, and whether excessive increases can be prevented. The minister confirms an average levy of about 775 euro per dwelling by 2017, argues rent rises are capped and that rent allowance compensates low incomes, and promises a three-year evaluation including landlord organisations.
In this evaluation I also want to involve the landlord organisations.
Bij deze evaluatie wil ik ook de organisaties van verhuurders betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Van Klaveren over het extreme graaien door corporatiebobo's

Opposition MPs Fritsma and Van Klaveren asked the minister whether he knew of reports that housing corporation directors would receive a 42% pay increase, requested a salary overview, and asked what measures would bring the salaries down. The minister confirmed the reports, referred to an earlier overview of 2012 pay, said the 2014 maximum-pay regulation allows higher maxima than before while at least 40% of current directors must be brought down over time, and stated that all corporations are bound by the regulation and will be enforced against.
All housing corporations are bound by the 2014 Regulation on maximum remuneration of senior officials of recognised housing associations, and enforcement will take place accordingly.
Alle woningcorporaties zijn aan de Regeling bezoldigingsmaxima topfunctionarissen toegelaten instellingen volkshuisvesting 2014 gebonden en daarop zal gehandhaafd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht ‘Waarom zitten Vestia-bestuurders niet zes jaar vast’

An MP asks the minister how a Vestia supervisory board chair who was involved in derivatives losses at another company can now oversee similar problems, and whether housing corporation supervisors will be required to be expert enough to defend tenants' interests. The minister replies that corporations appoint their own supervisors without accountability to him, that the chair's appointment followed the departure of the responsible supervisors, and that the revised Housing Act sets quality and independence requirements for supervisors, including disqualification for prior financial-economic offences.
Housing corporations are themselves responsible for appointing supervisory board members and are not required to account to me for this.
Woningcorporaties zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het aanstellen van commissarissen en zijn daarbij niet gehouden zich hierover aan mij te verantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over leegstand van het CBS-gebouw in Leidschendam-Voorburg

An MP asked the Minister for Housing and Government Service about the long-vacant CBS building in Leidschendam-Voorburg, including fire-safety, vacancy costs (about 2.4 million euro for 2008-2012, 150,000 euro in 2013), book value, budget and sale negotiations with the municipality. The Minister answered each question, confirmed the building is vacant and the sale is open to bids, and gave figures, while stating that no procedural agreements with the municipality currently exist.
The property has been vacant since 1 September 2008. The vacancy costs from 2008 through 2012 amount to approximately € 2.4 million.
Het object staat sinds 1 september 2008 leeg. De leegstandskosten bedragen sinds 2008 t/m 2012 ca. € 2,4 mln.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Gerven over een lagere watertemperatuur bij drinkwaterinstallaties, in relatie tot energiebesparing bij gebouwverwarming en warmtapwaterbereiding

MPs Jansen and Van Gerven asked whether warm tap water may be set at 50 degrees where certified copper-silver ionisation systems are installed, and whether lower temperatures could enable energy savings from waste heat and solar heat. The minister answered that such lower temperatures are permitted only via pilots under expert supervision and strict legal restrictions, and that the potential savings are limited to specific situations.

If the results are satisfactory, agreement can be given from a public health perspective to lowering the hot tap water temperature and/or flushing frequency at all locations where the system concerned is installed.

Indien de resultaten bevredigend zijn, kan uit oogpunt van de volksgezondheid akkoord worden gegaan met verlaging van de warm tapwatertemperatuur en/of spoelfrequentie op alle locaties waar het betreffende systeem is geplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Albert de Vries over de kosten van een hypotheek in krimpgebieden

Two MPs asked whether mortgages are more expensive in shrinking regions, whether this lowers housing demand, and whether lenders may impose such costs given mortgage rules and the tax deduction. The minister answered that the NVM and lenders do not recognise higher rates in specific regions, that rates reflect demonstrable risk, and that lenders' code bars refusing applications solely on location.

Lenders have, through the Mortgage Lending Code of Conduct, committed to the rule that the mere fact that the mortgaged home is located in a particular district or postcode area may not be grounds to reject the application in its entirety.

Financiers hebben zich middels de Gedragscode Hypothecaire Financieringen wel gebonden aan de bepaling dat het enkele feit dat de hypothecair te verbinden woning is gelegen in een bepaalde wijk of postcodegebied geen grond mag zijn om de aanvraag in zijn geheel af te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over woningcorporaties die nog steeds met anti-kraakcontracten werken

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing whether housing corporation Woonstad's use of anti-squatting (anti-kraak) occupancy agreements for residents of a block in Rotterdam conflicts with a parliamentary motion requiring only temporary contracts under the Leegstandwet, and asked how many corporations use such agreements and whether the minister would end the practice. The minister replied that Woonstad is extending tenancies where legally possible before demolition, that the practice cannot in all cases be avoided according to Aedes, and that he will not take measures to definitively end anti-kraak contracts, while committing to report on the scope of temporary letting as the motion requested.
I am not aware of this information.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Monasch over de berichtgeving omtrent zijn werkbezoek aan Noordoost-Friesland

MPs Albert de Vries and Monasch asked minister Blok whether he told Northeast Friesland it cannot expect help from The Hague in tackling population decline, and whether rules that hinder the response will be reviewed. The minister confirmed the remark, said the regions bear primary responsibility while the state provides conditions and support, and pointed to existing tools and an inventory of obstacles.
I did indeed indicate on site that no ready-made solutions can come from The Hague for the shrinking and anticipating regions.
Ik heb inderdaad ter plaatse aangegeven dat er geen kant en klare oplossingen vanuit Den Haag kunnen komen voor de krimp- en anticipeerregio's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over het vragen van inkomensafhankelijke huurverhoging door verhuurders met minder dan 10 woningen

An SP MP asked whether landlords with fewer than 10 homes, exempt from the landlord levy, may request income-dependent rent increases and whether this is consistent with the law's purpose. The minister answered that all regulated landlords may propose such increases regardless of size, and that the government sees no reason to change the rules.
All landlords who rent out regulated homes may propose an income-dependent rent increase to the tenants of those homes.
Alle verhuurders die woningen gereguleerd verhuren mogen aan de huurders van die woningen een inkomensafhankelijke huurverhoging voorstellen

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over het akkoord tussen de koepelorganisatie voor de woningcorporaties Aedes en het kabinet, waarin onder meer is afgesproken dat de integratieheffing komt te vervallen

MPs Omtzigt and Knops asked about the August 2013 agreement with Aedes that abolishes the integration levy, whether this applies to all sectors, the budgetary effect, and timing. The minister confirmed the levy is abolished entirely via the Belastingplan 2014 from 1 January 2014, with a total revenue loss of 95 million euros per year, of which about 35 million is attributed to housing associations.
The proposal that forms part of the Belastingplan 2014 aims to abolish the integration levy entirely and not only for the housing association sector.
Het voorstel dat onderdeel uitmaakt van het Belastingplan 2014 beoogt de integratieheffing in het geheel te laten vervallen en niet alleen voor de corporatiesector.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Fritsma over het onophoudelijke graaien van woningbobo's

Two PVV MPs asked the minister whether he knew of reports that housing corporation directors' salaries were rising again, requested a 2012 salary overview, demanded that excess pay be repaid and apologies offered, and asked what measures he would take. The minister confirmed awareness, said no Wopt report for 2012 exists and offered confidential 2012 salary data later, stated that excess pay cannot yet be formally established under the WNT and that he finds high pay inappropriate, and said he will intervene for 2013 overruns where applicable.
For remuneration in 2013 I can and will intervene in case of breaches of the applicable norms, insofar as they do not fall under the transitional law of the WNT.
Voor de bezoldiging over 2013 kan en zal ik bij overschrijdingen van de geldende normen en voor zover niet vallend onder het overgangsrecht in de WNT ingrijpen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Monasch over het bericht dat corporatiedirecteuren in Limburg massaal salarisverhoging krijgen, tegen de nieuwe salarisnorm in

Monasch (PvdA) asked whether pay rises for housing corporation directors in Limburg, reported as breaching the new salary norm, are unacceptable and whether the minister will reverse them. Minister Blok replied that the 2012 data do not confirm the newspaper figures, that most rises matched the CAO Woondiensten, and that no reversal is possible yet under the WNT transitional rules, though action will follow if 2013 pay exceeds them.
If the accountability for pay in 2013 shows increases that do not fit within the transitional rules, action will be taken.
Indien bij de verantwoording over de bezoldiging over het jaar 2013 blijkt dat er sprake is van verhogingen die niet passen binnen het overgangsrecht dan zal worden opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot, Monasch en Omtzigt over het mislukken van het overleg over directe huurtoeslagbetaling aan woningbouwcorporaties

MPs Groot, Monasch and Omtzigt asked why the motion-based arrangement for direct payment of rent allowance (huurtoeslag) to housing associations failed. The State Secretary answered that housing association umbrella body Aedes judged the partnership arrangement commercially unviable, and that no alternative route for direct payment is available within the legal framework.
I see no possibilities, within the statutory scheme and the conditions attached to it, to give direct payment of rent allowance to housing corporations an alternative form.
Ik zie geen mogelijkheden om binnen de wettelijke regeling en de daarbij geldende randvoorwaarden een directe betaling van huurtoeslag aan woningcorporaties op alternatieve wijze vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de positionering van het toezicht op woningcorporaties in het licht van het WRR-advies “Toezien op publieke belangen”

The MP asks how the minister will apply the WRR advice on supervision to the housing corporation sector, whether bureaucratic cost reduction and a fit-and-proper test should be left to corporations, and how the supervisor's style, instruments, personnel and budget will be set. The minister answers that the Woningwet revision will strengthen supervision and that a fit-and-proper test will be anchored in public law, but defers detailed choices on supervisory style, personnel and budget to later, promising to keep parliament informed.
I consider it too early to go into detail now on how the new supervisor will operate and how its personnel policy will take shape.
Ik acht het nog te vroeg om nu al in detail in te gaan op de wijze waarop de nieuwe toezichthouder zal gaan opereren en hoe het personeelsbeleid vorm gaat krijgen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat de brandweer zorgen heeft over de borging van brandveiligheid in het omgevingsrecht

An MP asks the government whether fire-safety responsibilities of municipalities and safety regions will be safeguarded under the planned Omgevingswet and private quality assurance in construction, given fire service concerns. The minister replies that municipal fire-service responsibility is unchanged, private quality assurance will keep the Bouwbesluit 2012 as the test framework, and further details will follow in a letter this autumn.

The Omgevingswet proposal, however, contains no such changes and does not alter the principle that the tasks and powers for the physical living environment that government must address lie primarily with the municipalities.

Het voorstel Omgevingswet bevat dergelijke wijzigingen echter niet en brengt geen wijzigingen aan in het beginsel dat de taken en bevoegdheden voor de fysieke leefomgeving die de overheid moet behartigen in de eerste plaats bij de gemeenten liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het sociaal beleid en de personele gevolgen van het sluiten van gevangenissen

An SP MP asked about social policy and staff consequences of prison closures under the DJI Masterplan, including unclear communication, uncertainty over the 'van-werk-naar-werk' scheme, early closures, placement numbers, the timing of plans and the SBF scheme. The government answered that closures follow planned dates, consultation with unions is ongoing, staff are being placed elsewhere, and a new offer on the SBF scheme is under discussion without details.
The content of that cannot be communicated while the consultation is ongoing.
Over de inhoud daarvan kan lopende het overleg geen mededeling worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Groot over de gevolgen van het inflatiecijfer op de huurstijgingen

Two MPs from the Labour party asked the ministers whether the Woonbond's claim that the inflation figure inflates rent increases is valid, and whether the calculation method should be changed. The minister rejected the Woonbond's three arguments as consistent with international guidelines and declined to start a study of an alternative inflation measure.
I therefore see no reason to start a study into a different inflation figure as the basis for rent policy.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om een onderzoek te starten naar een ander inflatiecijfer als basis voor het huurbeleid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over "over het huren van kantoren door het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) van bedrijven die niet in Nederland gevestigd zijn"

MP Ulenbelt asked whether UWV leases offices owned by foreign investors such as Fortress and whether UWV should run integrity checks on landlords. Minister Asscher confirmed the landlords are registered owners in the Netherlands and Germany, said UWV can now use the Bibob integrity law and is drafting a policy, and said no integrity screening of buyers happens when public property is sold.
UWV is currently drawing up a Bibob policy line and will apply this policy when leasing premises.
UWV stelt hiervoor momenteel een Bibob-beleidslijn op en zal deze beleidslijn toepassen bij de huur van panden.

Vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Tongeren (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie Nederland in gebre

MPs Voortman and Van Tongeren asked the minister and state secretary about the European Commission's infringement notice against the Netherlands for not implementing the energy performance of buildings directive, and what the government would do to meet the obligations and reduce voluntary measures. The government answered that it takes the notice seriously, is in consultation with the Commission and simplifying the energy label, and expects the EU targets to be met with the chosen mix of measures, with an evaluation planned for 2016.
I of course take this notice seriously.
Ik neem dit bericht uiteraard serieus.
Vragen van het lid PaulusJansen (SP) aan de minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst over de huurprijzen van studentenkamers (ingezonden 22 juli 2013).

An SP MP asked the housing minister about a Savills-based report showing rising and very high rents for student rooms, including whether the rent protection for rooms is meaningful. The minister said no reliable research confirms the figures, declined to state a per-square-metre price, and pointed to the existing rent-review route and the national student housing action plan.
Due to the lack of valid and reliable research on rents for student rooms and their development (see also answer 2), there is no insight into the level and development of the price per square metre.

Vanwege het ontbreken van valide en betrouwbaar onderzoek over huurprijzen voor studentenkamers en de ontwikkeling daarvan (zie ook antwoord 2), is er geen inzicht in de hoogte en ontwikkeling van de vierkante meterprijs.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Visser en De Caluwé over de organisatie ‘Dutch International Guarantees for Housing’ (DIGH)

MPs Visser and De Caluwé asked whether Dutch housing corporations guaranteeing DIGH loans for social housing in developing countries amounts to an implicit state guarantee, whether these fall under ODA rules, whether guarantees are reviewed for necessity and fee cover, and whether such activity belongs to corporations' core tasks. The minister answered that corporations guarantee loans with their own capital, the state is not directly liable, no new guarantees have been issued since mid-2012, and the Herzieningswet novelle will address corporations' activities abroad.

In my proposals within the novelle to the Herzieningswet, in light of this cabinet's aim that corporations serve the public interest in their area, I will further address the limits arising from this for corporations' activities abroad.

Ik zal bij mijn voorstellen in het kader van de novelle bij de Herzieningswet, mede in het licht van de doelstelling van dit kabinet dat corporaties dienstbaar zijn aan het publieke belang in hun werkgebied, nader ingaan op de beperkingen die hieruit voortvloeien voor activiteiten van woningcorporaties ten behoeve van het buitenland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de heffing van vennootschapsbelasting bij waarborgfondsen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether corporate tax now applies to former tax-exempt guarantee funds, when it started, whether any minister was consulted, the state's backstop exposure, and the effects on housing corporations' investment and VAT. The State Secretary declined to give fund-specific tax positions citing article 67 AWR, stated no change in the tax authority's position occurred, and said the requested effect studies were not carried out and would add nothing.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR) does not allow me to provide information on the tax positions of individual guarantee funds.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) staat mij niet toe informatie te verstrekken over de belastingposities van individuele waarborgfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het totaal mislukte Vogelaarbeleid

An MP from the PVV asks ministers whether they recognise the link between immigrant overrepresentation in crime and neighbourhood decline in the Vogelaar districts, why hundreds of millions were spent without results, and how future waste and lawlessness will be prevented, including deportation of offenders. The minister replies that the districts were selected on 18 indicators, that evaluations show mixed results, that the structural funding is ended except for nurses, and that further information on liveability will follow in autumn.
In the vision on liveability that you will receive this autumn, I will go into this further.
In de visie op leefbaarheid die u dit najaar ontvangt, zal ik hier verder op in gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het rentebesluit van de ECB

MP Monasch asked whether the minister knows the ECB will keep rates low for a long time, how this affects mortgage interest deduction in the Netherlands, and whether he will consult banks about lowering mortgage rates. The minister confirmed the ECB position, explained that banks decide themselves how much of lower funding costs to pass on, and pointed to recent measures and an ACM study on competition in the mortgage market.
It is up to providers themselves to decide whether and to what extent they pass on the possible benefit of low financing costs through a lower mortgage interest rate.
Het is aan aanbieders zelf om te bepalen of en zo ja in welke mate zij het eventuele voordeel van lage financieringskosten doorberekenen middels een lagere hypotheekrente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het bericht dat huiseigenaren door de bank als melkkoe worden gebruikt

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether banks' mortgage margins are historically high, whether the price-leadership ban on Dutch banks should be ended, and what measures will lower mortgage rates. The minister replied that the ING price-leadership restriction has ended and the ABN Amro ban is being weighed in ongoing Commission talks, and referred to earlier answers on mortgage rates without announcing new measures.
See the answers to questions 2 and 3 from MP Monasch (PvdA) to the ministers of Finance and for Housing and Government Organisation on the ECB interest rate decision.
Zie beantwoording van de vragen 2 en 3 van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de ministers van Financiën en voor Wonen en Rijksdienst over het rentebesluit van de ECB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het aanbieden van overheidsinformatie

An MP asked the ministers whether the government would adopt the G8 Open Data Charter, including its open-by-default principle, a priority list of high-value datasets and data quality standards. The minister supports open-by-default in principle and cites the Open Data Next project and a forthcoming Open Government action plan, but declines to adopt the Charter integrally and sees no need for a general data quality benchmark.
I support the principle of open by default, open unless...
Ik ondersteun het principe « Open by default», open tenzij....
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over extreme stookkosten in het Hilwiscomplex in Amsterdam

An MP asks the minister about extreme heating costs for tenants of the Hilwiscomplex in Amsterdam, including whether tenants can contest the costs, whether they can force installation of efficient boilers, and whether the rules on tenant-installed facilities should change. The minister answers that the Huurcommissie and courts can review costs, that tenants can enforce energy-saving measures via civil law, that existing rules already provide compensation, and that he will not reintroduce the withdrawn bill.
For rent-regulated dwellings, tenants can have the advance payment and the settlement of service costs reviewed by the Huurcommissie.
Bij huurwoningen met een gereguleerde huurprijs kunnen huurders het voorschot op en de afrekening van de servicekosten door de huurcommissie laten toetsen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Visser over nieuwe erfpachtvoorwaarden van de gemeente Amsterdam

An MP asked the minister about Amsterdam's proposed new ground-lease (erfpacht) conditions, including whether municipal leases serve as a revenue product, whether they affect mortgage financing and valuation, and whether they amount to a burden on homeowners and comply with property rights and legitimate expectations. The minister answered that municipalities are bound by general principles of good governance and civil-law reasonableness, that the choice of land policy is a local political matter, and that the municipal council and courts provide the checks, without committing to new national action.
It is for the local government to ensure, in its decision-making, the relationship between the Charter, the principle of legitimate expectations and their applicability when conditions are changed.

Het is aan het lokaal bestuur zich bij zijn besluitvorming te vergewissen van de verhouding tussen het Handvest, het vertrouwensbeginsel en de toepasselijkheid hiervan bij een wijziging van voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Paulus Jansen over asbestsanering in Emmen

MPs Van Gerven and Paulus Jansen asked the government about asbestos remediation at the Visserhoek flat in Emmen, including whether the housing corporation, contractor, inspection body and municipality acted improperly. The state secretary answered that certified firms did the work, that no legal violation was found by the Inspectie SZW, that municipal supervision lies with the provinces, and that the wider sector is responsible for safe work.
Interadministrative supervision of municipalities is vested in the provinces under the Wet Revitalisering Generiek Toezicht.
Het interbestuurlijk toezicht op gemeenten is middels de Wet Revitalisering Generiek Toezicht neergelegd bij de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Tony van Dijck over 25% meer betalingsachterstanden op de hypotheken

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers of Housing and Finance about the 25% rise in mortgage payment arrears, whether the government's policy is causing harm, and whether the PVV's proposal to keep mortgage interest deduction should be pursued. Minister Blok answered that arrears are hard to forecast but not expected to fall soon, that the government's measures give clarity and that he will not change current mortgage rules.
I can agree with the view that stability in the housing market is necessary.
Ik kan mij vinden in het standpunt dat rust op de woningmarkt noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Aukje de Vries over het artikel «Politiek verslikt zich in bezuinigingsoperatie auditfuncties»

MPs Van der Linde and Aukje de Vries asked the government whether a newspaper article about cuts to internal audit functions, including centralisation into the Auditdienst Rijk and reliance on external hiring, was accurate and how it fits the goal of efficiency. The minister rejected the claims of a duplication and monopoly, said the Auditdienst Rijk remains each department's internal audit function, and explained that framework contracts reduce external hiring costs while no new action is planned.
The Auditdienst Rijk is and remains the internal audit function of the individual departments.
De Auditdienst Rijk is en blijft de interne auditfunctie van de afzonderlijke departementen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over verdere problemen met PUR isolatie

An MP asked the minister for Housing about health complaints from residents linked to PUR floor insulation in Heerenveen, and whether a moratorium should be imposed. The minister said a GGD investigation and TNO research are pending, promised to inform parliament in August, and described alternative insulation materials and EU/REACH rules.
I will inform your chamber about both reports and my response to the reports in August, when the reports become available.
Ik zal uw kamer over beiden rapporten en mijn reactie op de rapporten in augustus – bij het beschikbaar komen van de rapporten – nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de zwijgplicht over de huizenprijzen

An MP asked the housing minister whether he agreed with the big banks not to publish house price forecasts, and whether any such agreement excluded information from Parliament. The minister denied any such agreement, said he does not seek to influence bank research, and stressed the importance of reliable, independent housing market data.
No, this report is not correct. I also do not wish to exert influence over what banks research and publish.
Nee, dit bericht klopt niet. Ik wens ook geen invloed uit te oefenen op wat banken onderzoeken en publiceren.
Antwoord vragen Voortman over de aangenomen resolutie over sociale huisvesting in de Europese Unie

An MP asked the Minister for Housing whether the government shares concerns that the €34,229 income ceiling for social housing blocks middle-income households, whether Dutch discretion over the target group could be widened, and whether the government will renegotiate with the European Commission after a European Parliament resolution. The minister answered that the income limit is a member-state competence within EU competition rules, that waiting times for eligible households have fallen, and that renegotiation with the Commission is not considered necessary.
I do not consider it necessary to consult the European Commission on this again.
Ik acht het niet noodzakelijk daarover opnieuw met de EC te overleggen.
Antwoord vragen Monasch over de stand van zaken in het juridisch onderzoek naar bestuurders van woningbouwcorporatie Rentre

An MP asked the housing minister about the status of the legal investigation into former executives of housing corporation Rentree, including civil liability, cooperation of the current board, and whether limitation periods for former supervisors were being interrupted. The minister replied that the investigation stems from earlier reports, that Rentree has summoned the former executive for civil liability, that former supervisors are not being pursued, and that no interruption is needed because a procedure is underway.
Rentree states that the former executive was summoned on 26 April 2013.
Rentree geeft aan dat op 26 april 2013 de voormalig bestuurder is gedagvaard.

An MP asks whether the Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw delays decisions on guarantee capacity for housing corporations until December 2013, cutting their access to guaranteed capital markets and the 6% VAT rule. The minister denies any such delay, says the guarantee volume for 2014 was provisionally capped and a fast-track process is in place, and promises to keep pressing the fund to inform corporations in time.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren over de bouw van een Turkse enclave in Rotterdam

An MP from the PVV asks the ministers whether they will stop a planned Turkish-only neighbourhood in Rotterdam, whether ethnic segregation is undesirable, and whether Turks should be advised to leave the Netherlands. The minister answers that a neighbourhood exclusive to one ethnic group would be undesirable and that the municipality says it will be open to all, but that the project is a local matter and no national measures will be taken, and that return is an individual choice.
I will not take any measures. The possible development of this project and projects like it is a local matter.
Ik zal geen maatregelen nemen. De eventuele ontwikkeling van dit project en projecten als deze zijn een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Mohandis over de kosten van kamerverhuur

MPs Monasch and Mohandis asked about the high cost of student rooms in Amsterdam and Utrecht, the norm rent used for student housing, and how many extra student rooms are needed beyond the national action plan. The minister answered that rents are set by free contract with limited tenant remedies via the rent commission, that housing shortages are tied to tight local markets, and that the action plan's additional units are considered sufficient with private landlords expected to expand supply.
In rent law for residential accommodation, the principle of contractual freedom applies in principle.
In het huurprijzenrecht voor woonruimte geldt in beginsel contractvrijheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over de ontwikkelingen rondom het thema lage loonschalen

An MP asks the minister for Housing and Civil Service why government is re-internalising low-paid facility work it had outsourced, whether it is cost-effective, and how many people are involved. The minister answers that business cases on insourcing security, post, printing, cleaning and catering are still being prepared, with no numbers or timelines yet.
To check this, I am now having business cases drawn up that calculate the financial consequences of insourcing work currently done by lower-scale staff.
Om dit na te gaan laat ik nu business cases opstellen waarin de financiële gevolgen worden berekend
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de regeling aanwijzing groep chronisch zieken en gehandicapten

MP Voortman asked the government whether the narrow hardship clause for chronically ill and disabled tenants under the income-dependent rent increase should be widened, covering those who cannot reasonably move, including people with mantelzorg-reduced care indications and those who paid for adaptations. Minister Blok defended the existing criteria as needed for enforceability, offered only limited coulance for adapted dwellings and deferred on the mantelzorg compliment, promising to revisit that scheme.
No, I do not have this data available.
Nee, over deze gegevens beschik ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over particuliere erfpacht

An MP asks the ministers of Housing and Justice about private leasehold (particuliere erfpacht): how many homes have been refused mortgages under the bank guideline, whether the guideline should be made generally binding, and what has been done on advertisement transparency. The minister says no precise figures are held, rejects a general binding declaration or an Erfpacht Act, and points to existing contract-law protections and voluntary measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Monasch over de naleving van de Woningwet en de Wet op het overleg

MPs Jansen and Monasch asked whether a housing corporation may restrict the statutory right of tenants' organisations to make binding nominations for supervisory board seats, the board size and tenure rules, and what sanctions apply. The minister answered that corporations cannot deviate from the mandatory two binding nominations, that the supervisory board may refuse a nominee who does not fit the profile, and that the Herzieningswet will entrench tenant rights, but that no ministerial intervention is currently warranted, only a call on the parties to act.
The corporation cannot include deviating provisions on this point in its statutes, because otherwise the minister for Housing and Government Service would not approve the amendment to the statutes.
De corporatie kan geen afwijkende bepalingen op dit punt opnemen in de statuten, omdat anders door de minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienstgeen goedkeuring voor de statutenwijziging wordt verleend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de huisvesting van het UWV

An MP asked the minister whether UWV rents office space from companies based in tax havens, how much rent is involved, and whether the state's own leasing avoids such landlords. The government answered that UWV rents from Dutch and German owners (about 10 million euro of 81 million to German owners), that it does not investigate group structures, and that the state does not as a rule do business with criminal firms but companies may choose their seat.
UWV does not investigate this structure before concluding an agreement.
UWV verricht geen onderzoek naar deze structuur alvorens een overeenkomst te sluiten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Van Veldhoven over het herbestemmen van Rijksvastgoed

D66 MPs asked whether empty Rijksgebouw parking garages could be opened to the public in evenings and weekends to ease city parking problems, and what security obstacles exist. The minister answered that parking is a municipal responsibility, that five Hague garages are already partly public, and listed conditions for opening garages, plus a list of locations with more than 25 spaces.
Parking policy is a municipal responsibility.
Het parkeerbeleid is een gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over het vaststellen van de borgings- en investeringsruimte voor woningcorporaties door WSW en CFV

An SP MP asked the minister for Housing whether delayed decisions by the WSW guarantee fund on housing corporations' guarantee and investment room, due to capacity shortages and the Hoekstra advisory work, would block corporation investments and the 6% VAT maintenance rate. The minister answered that the 2013 guarantee volume is known, the WSW has set up a process to give corporations timely clarity on 2014 volumes, and corporations can make optimal use of the VAT reduction.
As the answers show, the 2013 guarantee volume is already known, and the WSW has organised the process so that the 2014 guarantee volume will also be known in time.
Zoals uit de antwoorden blijkt is het borgingsvolume 2013 al bekend en is door het WSW het proces zo ingericht, dat ook tijdig het borgingsvolume voor 2014 bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over gebreken bij het verstrekken van inkomensgegevens door de Belastingdienst

An SP MP asked the ministers about a glitch on 11 April 2013 in the Tax Authority system that gave landlords income data for income-dependent rent increases, plus remedies, error rates, damages claims and administrative burden. The minister answered that the glitch was fixed within a day, that landlords were advised to re-request data, that five landlords have made liability claims, and that some figures cannot be provided for privacy or data reasons while a fuller update will follow after the summer recess.
For reasons of privacy, only the information necessary for this purpose is generated.
Om redenen van privacy wordt alleen de hiervoor noodzakelijke informatie gegenereerd.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen over het liberaliseren van huurwoningen uit het gereguleerde segment

An SP MP asked minister Blok about liberalising about one million regulated rental homes, their composition, what counts as high quality, where households with children and disabled people would live, and what the 'iron stock' of family and accessible homes should be. The minister answered that about 72% are family homes and 23% single-storey homes, that corporations decide which homes to liberalise, that no fixed occupancy norm beyond the Bouwbesluit applies, and that WoON2012 shows sufficient family and accessible rental stock.
It is up to the housing corporation to make targeted choices here, also with regard to local and/or regional housing demand.
Het is aan de corporatie om hierin gerichte keuzes te maken, ook met het oog op de lokale en/of regionale woningvraag.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de hardheidsclausule voor chronisch zieken en gehandicapten bij de inkomensafhankelijke huurverhogingen

An SP MP asks why the promised hardship clause for chronically ill and disabled tenants against income-dependent rent increases was not yet clarified, when rent notices were due within three weeks, and on what date the ministerial regulation would be published. The minister replies that the regulation was sent to parliament on 25 April 2013, published on 29 April and in force from 1 May, defines the eligible group, places costs on tenants and landlords, and relies on public information to make the objection route known.
I sent the regulation to your House on 25 April 2013.
Ik heb uw Kamer de regeling op 25 april 2013 toegezonden.
Antwoord vragen Albert de Vries over de toename van de kantorenleegstand en de voortgang van de uitvoering van het convenant Aanpak Leegstand Kantoren

An MP asked the minister for Housing and Government Service, jointly with the minister of Infrastructure and Environment, about rising office vacancy and progress on the convenant tackling office vacancy, including regional office funds, regional policy frameworks, and VAT on conversions. The minister answered that the convenant partners remain committed, that eight of twelve provinces have anchored limits on new development, that no regional office funds exist yet, that a study on mandatory levies was completed and a policy response is being drafted, and that the reduced VAT rate does not apply to office conversions though options are being explored.
The relevant study has now been completed and was sent to your House by the minister of Infrastructure and Environment on 22 April 2013.
Het betreffende onderzoek is inmiddels afgerond en door de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu op 22 april 2013 naar uw Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over de marktverstorende overheid en herintredende overheidsdiensten

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked why the government takes back in-house activities it had outsourced, whether this distorts markets under the Wet markt en overheid, and how it squares with the compact civil service goal. The minister answered that the state may freely choose between outsourcing and in-house work, that in-house activities fall outside the market-conduct law, and that employment considerations will be presented in May.
I consider it desirable that government service providers assess per activity whether it is sensible to put an assignment on the market or to carry out the activity themselves.
Ik vind het wenselijk dat overheidsdiensten per activiteit beoordelen of het verstandig is om een opdracht in de markt te zetten of om de betreffende activiteit zelf uit te voeren.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Nijboer over grote winstmarges voor banken op hypotheken

MPs Monasch and Nijboer asked about reports that Dutch banks' mortgage profit margins rose between January 2012 and January 2013 despite small rate cuts, and about the size of the extra margin and its effect on borrowers and the housing market. The minister confirmed margins have risen since 2011 per an ACM study, but said the absolute size is uncertain and gave an estimated increase of 0.24 to 0.74 percentage points, with ACM promising further research into competition in the mortgage market.
The ACM has indicated it will conduct further research this year into possibilities for improving market competition in the banking sector, including the mortgage market.
