De ACM heeft aangegeven nog dit jaar nader onderzoek te zullen verrichten naar mogelijkheden voor verbeteringen van de marktwerking in de bancaire sector, waaronder de hypotheekmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over kredietverstrekking aan en bankgaranties voor bouwbedrijven

An SP MP asked the ministers of Finance and Housing about bank collateral demands and guarantees for construction firms after a reported credit stop by ING threatened a bankruptcy. The minister answered that DNB lacks firm-specific collateral data, that collateral rules follow from capital requirements, and that disputes are left to contracting parties.
There is no specific insight into whether construction firms are asked for more or less collateral than other firms.
Er is geen specifiek inzicht in de mate waarin van bouwbedrijven meer of minder onderpand dan van andere bedrijven wordt gevraagd.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen over het aangekondigde onderzoek naar woningcorporatie Woonbron

An SP MP asks the minister for Housing about a planned investigation into the financial problems at housing corporation Woonbron, including delays, the unprofitable SS Rotterdam project, and whether the regulator should have acted on suspected disguised subsidies. The minister answers that Woonbron will be asked to investigate recoverable damage after the ship is sold, that the regulator detected no disguised subsidy, and that the regulator's oversight of group affiliations is limited to financial exposure.
I have asked Woonbron to carry out such an investigation as soon as the SS Rotterdam has been sold.
Ik heb Woonbron verzocht een dergelijk onderzoek te laten verrichten, zodra de ss Rotterdam verkocht is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fritsma en Helder over het bericht “Misdaad levert een huurwoning op”

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether it is acceptable that criminals receive priority for rental housing while ordinary citizens wait years, and whether such priority can be ruled out. The minister replied that the Amsterdam 'Pak je kans' project offers temporary housing only to former offenders who work or study, on a strict protocol, in former municipal service dwellings not part of the regular stock, and that there is no priority for regular rental housing.
There is no question of priority for the named group in obtaining a regular rental home.
Er is voor de genoemde groep geen sprake van voorrang voor het krijgen van een regulier huurhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch, Albert De Vries Albert en Otwin Van Dijk over mantelzorgwoningen en groepswonen

MPs asked about the savings potential of care annexes (mantelzorgwoningen) and group housing for elderly care, the status of housing experiments, deregulation under the BOR, the risk that temporary housing becomes permanent, and a barrier inventory for care providers. The government answered that savings cannot be quantified, experiments have ended and a new programme is being discussed, deregulation is planned via the BOR, enforcement remains with municipalities, and a municipal guidance note is expected after the summer.
On the subject of care annexes, a guidance note for municipalities is being prepared.
Op het terrein van mantelzorgwoningen is een handreiking voor gemeenten in de maak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouten over het bericht dat er meer huurders uit huis worden gezet

Parliamentary member Schouten asked about reports that more tenants are being evicted, including whether debt counselling and debt rescheduling are offered often enough to prevent evictions and whether early warning of debts can be improved. State Secretary Klijnsma answered that evictions rose about 10% in 2012 per housing association survey, that corporations prevent evictions where they can and cooperate with municipalities, and that the government will raise the issue with Aedes and municipalities and explore expanding early-warning and credit-registration systems with concrete proposals before summer.
I have taken note of the report.
Ik heb kennis genomen van het bericht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over de verkoop van het voormalig Mobiliteitscomplex (MOB-complex) in Deurne

An MP asked the minister for Housing and Government Service about a 2008 offer by the Deurne mayor to Domeinen, via a private email, to lower the sale price of the former MOB complex in return for ending a legal challenge, and whether such offers are common. The minister said Domeinen did not regard the offer as bribery but would be more restrained in hindsight, called the mayor's secrecy at odds with a trustworthy government, and said such buy-offs are not known to be frequent and would be undesirable.
Otherwise there is a risk that conducting legal proceedings is financially rewarded, because ending the proceedings gives entitlement to financial compensation.
Het risico bestaat anders dat het voeren van juridische procedures financieel wordt beloond doordat het staken van de procedure aanspraak geeft op financiële vergoedingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Kooiman over de stijgende kosten van een aansluitovereenkomst brandbeveiligingsinstallaties

Two SP MPs asked why the fee for a fire alarm connection agreement in Noord-Holland Noord rose sharply and whether businesses are unfairly burdened as the regional safety board compensates lost income. The minister replied that the safety board, as the responsible authority, chose the tariff increase and that the matter is a local responsibility, while offering to take no action beyond noting the board's role.
The decision to compensate the shortfall from falling OMS subscriber numbers by raising the OMS tariff from 1 January 2013 was taken by the daily board of the safety region.

Het besluit om het tekort door de daling in de aantallen OMS-abonnees te compenseren door een verhoging van het OMS-tarief per 1 januari 2013 is genomen door het dagelijks bestuur van de veiligheidsregio.

Antwoord vragen Knops en Omtzigt over de problemen als gevolg van de huidige regelgeving met betrekking tot  hypotheekrenteaftrek die kunnen optreden voor mensen met een eigen woning die in scheiding liggen

MPs Knops and Omtzigt asked the government about problems for divorcing homeowners with negative equity under current mortgage interest deduction rules, including sale times, tax treatment at divorce, and bank conditions. The minister replied that existing measures (restschuld financing, temporary tax deduction on residual debt, divorce exceptions, extended move-out periods) are sufficient within budget limits, declined to extend the divorce term or relax the amortisation requirement, and said banks reassess the finances of the remaining partner.

Within the tight budgetary margins caused by the current economic crisis, this is currently the maximum that can be done about the problem of homes being underwater and its consequences for taxpayers going through divorce.

Binnen de – door de huidige economische crisis – krappe budgettaire marges is dit op dit moment het maximale dat gedaan kan worden aan het probleem van het «onder water staan» van woningen en de gevolgen daarvan voor belastingplichtigen die aan het scheiden zijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Visser over het besluit van de gemeente Assen om zelf huurwoningen te bouwen

An MP asks the housing minister about Assen municipality's decision to build social rental housing itself, given that housing corporations have stopped doing so, and about implications for corporate duties, the WSW guarantee and market distortion. The minister answers that municipal building is permitted but not a core municipal task, carries financial risk, and that corporations should keep their role, with the government strengthening municipalities' position toward corporations through the Woningwet revision.
It is preferable that the municipality reaches agreement with one or more housing corporations about building social rental housing.
Het verdient de voorkeur als de gemeente tot overeenstemming komt met één of meerdere woningcorporatie(s) over de bouw van sociale huurwoningen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Knops over het bericht verstandelijk beperkt echtpaar in de vrieskou

MPs Van Toorenburg and Knops asked about a couple with intellectual disabilities evicted from a Dordrecht senior flat over rent arrears, and about cooperation to prevent evictions. The minister answered that the eviction followed a court ruling, that prevention is mainly the landlord's responsibility, that a new prevention covenant with Dordrecht was signed, and that the government will underline the importance of prevention in consultations.
Preventing evictions is a responsibility of landlords.
Het voorkomen van huisuitzettingen is een verantwoordelijkheid van verhuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de effecten van het woningmarktakkoord voor de noordelijke woningcorporaties

An SP MP asks the housing minister whether he accepts that the housing-market agreement would cut northern housing corporations' investment capacity by 52% for 2013-2018, versus 14% under the Rutte II coalition agreement, and how he will prevent a dramatic drop. The minister disputes the model's assumed rent-setting basis, points to ABF research showing a manageable temporary mismatch between rent revenue and the levy, and says no dramatic investment drop need occur.
The recalculations of the Housing Agreement's arrangements show that for the corporations in the northern provinces there need not be a dramatic drop in investment levels.

Uit de doorrekeningen van de afspraken uit het Woonakkoord blijkt dat voor de corporaties in de Noordelijke provincies geldt dat er geen sprake hoeft te zijn van een dramatische terugval in het investeringsniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over het over de nieuwe financieringsconstructe voor koopwoningen uit het woonakkoord

An SP MP asked the minister about the new two-part mortgage (annuity loan plus a second loan financing part of the repayments) under the housing accord, covering notary costs, bank interest, tax treatment, risks on forced sale, cooperative ownership and rental alternatives. The minister answered that the government gives advance clarity on tax consequences but does not intervene in bank product design, that risk suitability is left to lenders and the AFM, and that the government sees no case for cooperative or rental-based reform.
In line with the answer to question 2, it is not appropriate to seek contact with banks or other financial institutions to establish whether there is interest in offering a second loan.
In lijn met het antwoord op vraag 2 ligt het niet in de rede contact te zoeken met banken of andere financiële instellingen om na te gaan in hoeverre er interesse bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Fritsma over het bericht dat «consumenten 1,3 procent teveel hypotheekrente betalen»

MPs Van Klaveren and Fritsma asked whether banks' mortgage margins are excessive, whether the Brussels price-leadership ban causes lack of competition, and what measures the government will take to lower mortgage rates. The minister says CPB and DNB find no systematic higher funding costs, that the ABN AMRO price-leadership ban remains and will be discussed with the Commission, and points to a forthcoming NMa margin study and new consumer-protection rules from 1 January 2013.
The Central Planning Bureau (CPB) states that there are no indications that financing costs in the Netherlands are systematically higher than in the surrounding countries.
Het Centraal Planbureau (CPB) stelt dat er geen aanwijzingen zijn dat de financieringskosten in Nederland systematisch hoger zijn dan in de ons omringende landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Visser over het bericht «Huiseigenaren richten hun woede op bankdirecteuren»

MPs De Vries and Visser asked whether banks are earning excess profits on mortgages, why Dutch mortgage rates exceed those in neighbouring countries, and whether more competition or transparency is needed. The minister says he awaits the NMa's update on mortgage margins, notes structural differences that make cross-country comparison difficult, and points to transparency measures and lifting ING's price-leadership ban as steps toward more competition.
I do not have this insight, so I cannot give you this explanation.
Dit inzicht heb ik niet, waardoor ik u deze toelichting niet kan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Van Klaveren over het CPB rapport «De Nederlandse woningmarkt – hypotheekrente, huizenprijzen en consumptie»

MPs Tony van Dijck and Van Klaveren asked the government to respond to a CPB report finding Dutch mortgage rates about 1 percentage point above neighbouring countries, and asked how to end excessive margins, quantify lost consumption, housing wealth and tax revenue, and recover losses from the financial sector. The minister acknowledged the rate gap, attributed house price changes to several factors, and said a quantification of 'excessive' interest and lost revenue was not feasible because no objective benchmark exists.

A calculation of the loss of purchasing power due to possibly 'excessively paid' interest is not feasible in my view, because there is no unambiguous and objective measure for the possibly 'excessively paid' part of the interest.

Een berekening van het verlies aan koopkracht als gevolg van eventueel «te veel betaalde rente» acht ik niet goed mogelijk omdat er geen eenduidige en objectieve maatstaf is voor het eventueel «te veel betaalde» deel van de rente.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over verlichting en energiebesparing

An MP asks whether the Netherlands should follow France in requiring offices and shops to switch off lighting at night to save energy, and how much energy this would save. The minister answers that switching off unnecessary lighting is sensible, estimates 2 PJ savings, but rejects a blanket obligation, pointing to existing building and activity-decree rules and promising a further energy-saving plan in spring 2013.
An obligation to switch off all lighting is not an obvious course in the Netherlands.
Een verplichting om alle verlichting uit te schakelen ligt in Nederland niet voor de hand.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Monasch over het bericht dat Nederland meer zonnepanelen wil

MPs Jan Vos and Monasch asked whether the government will engage with the energy and construction sectors to take firm steps toward more solar panels in new buildings, given public support. The minister welcomed the enthusiasm, said the market is growing well and that intervention would distort it, so he sees no reason for extra action.
I therefore see no reason to undertake additional activities.
Ik zie daarom geen reden om extra activiteiten te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over het stimuleren van innovatie en concurrentie bij aanbestedingen

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked about a court ruling on a government ICT tender for SAP licences, the legal unity of the state in procurement, reuse of systems, vendor lock-in and openness to innovative suppliers. The minister answered that the ruling gives no reason to revise procurement policy, that the tender was lawfully split into two lots, that the state's procurement decision levels follow EU criteria, and that the government aims to avoid lock-in and engage the market.
The ruling in this case gives no reason to revise the Dutch central government's current procurement policy, whether or not for ICT.
De uitspraak in deze zaak geeft geen aanleiding het huidige aanbestedingsbeleid van de Rijksoverheid, al dan niet ten aanzien van ICT, te herzien.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over energiebesparing door minder en duurzame verlichting

An MP asked the government about reducing energy use through less and more sustainable road and building lighting, including switching off road lighting after 21:00, dimmable or presence-sensitive lighting, LED road markings, cooperation with provinces and municipalities, night-time lighting rules for offices and shops, and designating dark areas. The state secretary answered that the road-lighting switch-off was being prepared for spring 2013, that presence-sensitive lighting is unsuitable on main roads, that existing rules already cover energy-saving measures in buildings, and that dark-area designation is a provincial responsibility, though the topic can be raised with local climate ambassadors.
However, I am willing to raise this topic at the local level in the consultations with the 'climate ambassadors'.
Wel ben ik bereid om in het overleg met de «klimaatambassadeurs» dit onderwerp op lokaal niveau te agenderen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Monasch, Jan Vos en Albert De Vries over de milieuprestatieberekening bij aanvragen in het kader van de omgevingswet

Three PvdA MPs asked why some municipalities do not require environmental performance calculations under the Omgevingswet and what the minister will do about it. The minister answers that no thresholds exist yet at the request of industry, that municipalities must still check submitted documents, and that enforcement responsibilities are shared with the provinces, with binding requirements possibly set around 2015.
First-line supervision of building regulations still lies with the municipality.
Het eerstelijns toezicht op de bouwregelgeving ligt nog steeds bij de gemeente.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jacobi en Albert de Vries over doorboringen van het rioolstelsel

MPs Albert de Vries and Jacobi asked the minister about a RIONED report on sewer pipes pierced by cables and pipes, the scale of incidents, enforcement of the KLIC reporting duty, and whether concrete measures with sector parties are needed. The minister corrected the incident count from 16,000 to 4,000, described WION rules, enforcement by Agentschap Telecom with fines totalling EUR 303,250 in 2012, and said the WION evaluation (due Q1 2013) would inform any additional measures.
Article 51 of the Wion states that the Wion will be evaluated within 5 years and the House of Representatives will be informed of the results.
Artikel 51 van de Wion geeft aan dat binnen 5 jaar de Wion geëvalueerd wordt en de Tweede Kamer geïnformeerd wordt over de resultaten daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over gebrek aan veiligheid in overdekte zwembaden

An MP asks about a lamp falling in a Dordrecht indoor swimming pool, use of corrosion-prone stainless steel fixings, the status of a 2004 practice guideline, enforcement gaps by municipalities, and whether the national government will re-inspect pools. The minister answers that the guideline remains usable and NEN will update it, that the Rijk no longer has interbestuurlijk toezicht over municipalities since oversight moved to provinces, and declines a new ILT inspection.
Supervision of the municipalities no longer lies with the national government but with the provinces.
Het toezicht op de gemeenten ligt niet meer bij het Rijk maar bij de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Omtzigt en Van Hijum over de Nationale Hypotheekgarantie

CDA MPs Knops, Omtzigt and Van Hijum asked the ministers about the Nationale Hypotheekgarantie (NHG): claim numbers, debt write-offs, sale methods, approval of forced sales, controls on lenders and the maximum state risk. Minister Blok answered with WEW data, noting forced-sale approval rules were tightened from 1 January 2013 and that the maximum exposure is well below the guaranteed EUR 149 billion.
The WEW states it has no data on this.
Het WEW geeft aan hierover geen gegevens te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Omtzigt en Van Hijum over executieveilingen en onderhandse executies

Three CDA MPs asked ministers about foreclosure auctions and private sales of homes, citing lower prices, falling auction numbers, bank conduct, notaries' role and NMa cartel fines. Minister Blok answered that auction prices are lower for structural reasons, that data on private foreclosure sales are incomplete, that the pending bill on foreclosure auctions and existing NHG and AFM measures are the response, and that no new legislation or research is planned.
There is no publicly available data on the number of private foreclosure sales for the entire Dutch housing market.
Er zijn geen openbaar beschikbare gegevens over de aantallen onderhandse verkopen voor de gehele Nederlandse woningmarkt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over het bericht van 4 januari jl. in het Financieel Dagblad “Toezichthouder negeerde risico Vestia”,

MPs Knops and Omtzigt asked the minister whether the Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw (WSW) lawfully guaranteed loans for housing corporation Vestia despite its large equity and its derivative exposure, and who is accountable. The minister answered that the WSW followed its own rules, declined to disclose individual loan and derivative details citing commercial sensitivity, and said the CFV and WSW each had a limited supervisory role.
Information at the WSW on individual loans and derivatives is commercially sensitive, so the WSW cannot provide it without prior written consent from the participant.

De informatie bij het WSW met betrekking tot (individuele) leningen en derivaten is bedrijfsgevoelig en kan het WSW derhalve niet verstrekken zonder voorafgaande schriftelijke toestemming van de deelnemer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Raak over de aankoop door de Rijksgebouwendienst van een kantoorpand in Den Haag

SP MPs Paulus Jansen and Van Raak asked why the Rijksgebouwendienst bought an office building in The Hague near the Eurojust site, questioning the fit with the vacant-office convenant and whether vacant state property could have been used, and asked for an overview of state-owned offices. The minister confirmed the purchase for €7.9 million as part of arrangements for a possible future Eurojust expansion, said it does not conflict with the convenant, and promised an overview plus a forthcoming joint plan with the municipality.

With the purchase of the building, effect is given to the agreements between the Dutch State and Eurojust to make a possible future expansion of Eurojust feasible in the immediate vicinity of the new building.

Met de aankoop van het pand wordt invulling gegeven aan de afspraken tussen de Nederlandse Staat en Eurojust om een mogelijke uitbreiding van Eurojust in de toekomst mogelijk te maken in de directe nabijheid van de nieuwbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heijnen over mogelijk opkopen van rijksgebouwen door de provincie Overijssel

An MP asked the Minister of Housing and Central Government Affairs whether the province of Overijssel was buying up central government buildings and whether provincial financial contributions influence where state offices are located. The minister denied knowledge of such constructions, said only Zwolle is interested in two state buildings for housing, and stated that provincial contributions should play no role in location decisions.
Incidentally, the kinds of practices you ask about are objectionable and I will not cooperate with them.
Overigens zijn het soort handelwijzen waarnaar u vraagt verwerpelijk en zal ik er niet aan meewerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over energielabels en energiebesparing

An MP asked the minister about energy label issuance, compliance with the EU EPBD directive, verification of label obligations, the rental sector energy savings covenant, and energy use in government buildings. The minister reported 33% of homes had a label at end-2012, admitted the label obligation at sale/rental is not checked, said the bill was rejected and a new proposal is planned, and promised further steps and research.
At present, the obligation to provide an energy label when renting or selling a home in 2012 is not checked.
Op dit moment wordt de verplichting om een energielabel te overleggen bij de verhuur c.q. de verkoop van een woning in 2012 niet gecontroleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Yücel over de renovatie van woningen door corporatie Eigen Haard

Two PvdA MPs asked ministers about a housing corporation renovating a flat building for Muslim residents, including whether religious wishes should be funded from guaranteed public loans and whether allocation should avoid segregation. The minister answered that corporations may consider residents' wishes but that housing must not become suitable for only one religious group, that the extra tap cost is minor and pragmatically accepted, and that allocation stays with the top of the waiting list.
It is good that housing corporations take residents' wishes into account. However, this may not lead to homes being suitable only for residence by a single religious or philosophical group.

Het is goed dat woningcorporaties rekening houden met wensen van bewoners. Dit mag er echter niet toe leiden dat woningen enkel nog geschikt zijn voor bewoning door één religieuze of levensbeschouwelijke groep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Azmani over het bericht “Woningen speciaal voor Moslims in Amsterdam”

MPs Visser and Azmani asked whether housing corporation Eigen Haard's renovation of 188 flats in Amsterdam was tailored to Muslim residents' wishes (shoe cabinets, ritual-washing taps, sliding doors, satellite reception) and whether this constitutes misuse of public funds and segregation. Minister Blok answers that the reported details are largely inaccurate, the extra cost was only about 25 euro per tap, the flats are allocated under regular rules, and he finds religion-specific housing undesirable and will raise it with Aedes and, if needed, use legal instruments.
I will discuss this with Aedes.
Ik zal hierover met Aedes in contact treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over bemiddelingskosten bij tijdelijke verhuur van corporatiewoningen

MP Monasch asked whether housing corporation De Sleutels outsourced temporary letting of 125 Leiden homes to Villex and whether tenants paying a deposit plus fees was acceptable. The minister confirmed the outsourcing, said Villex charges one month deposit and a 42.50 euro admin fee matching De Sleutels' own, that two addresses were overcharged and refunded, and stated that tenants may in general not be charged brokerage costs.
In general, no brokerage costs may be charged to tenants at all.
In het algemeen mogen aan huurders in het geheel geen bemiddelingskosten in rekening gebracht worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voorman over het bericht “Verhuurders van kamers studenten zwaar getroffen”

An MP asked the minister for Housing whether the government's rental rules (rent at 4.5% of WOZ value) threaten student room rentals and the 30,000-room shortage, citing cancelled projects in Delft and Leiden, and whether student housing could be exempted. The minister said he is consulting parties and will inform parliament in spring after analyses, deferring decisions on individual projects to the clients.
I have already indicated to the House that, alongside talks with stakeholders, I want analyses of these measures on the (rental) housing market to be carried out first.
Aan de Kamer heb ik reeds aangegeven naast de gesprekken met betrokkenen ook eerst analyses over deze maatregelen op de (ver)huurmarkt te willen laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over het verruimen van de overgangsperiode voor het omzetten van een bestaande aflossingsvrije hypotheek in een (bank)spaarhypotheek tot 1 april 2013

An SP MP asked how large the fiscal costs would be in 2013 and later if all homeowners with interest-only mortgages switched to savings mortgages before 1 April 2013, and what the basis and financing of the extended transition period was. The minister, on behalf of the state secretary of Finance, answered that the budgetary loss is expected to be nil in 2013 and in the long run, assuming owners who chose interest-only mortgages deliberately chose not to save and few would now switch.
The budgetary loss resulting from the introduction of this transitional arrangement is expected to be nil in 2013 and in the long term.
De budgettaire derving als gevolg van de introductie van deze overgangsregeling, zal in 2013 en op lange termijn naar verwachting nihil zijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de gegevens waarop de doorrekening van het CPB zijn gebaseerd

An MP asked whether the CPB's costing of the coalition agreement accounted for a 15% fall in house prices and falling WOZ values since 2008, and whether it used the baseline including mandatory annuity mortgage repayment and the phased cut in mortgage interest deduction. The minister answered that the CPB uses a stable growth path from 2005 that roughly matches the CBS house price index, and that the baseline and all housing measures were fully included.
Yes, in the costing of the housing market measures in the coalition agreement, all measures in the owner-occupied and rental markets were fully included.
Ja, in de doorrekening van de woningmarktmaatregelen in het Regeerakkoord zijn alle maatregelen op de koop- en huurmarkt integraal doorgerekend.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Hijum en Knops over de hypotheekrenteaftrek

Three CDA MPs asked the state secretary of Finance about the planned phased reduction of the mortgage interest deduction top rate (fourth bracket) from 52% to 38% and its effect on marginal tax rates. The government confirmed the plan, said details on the marginal tax effects and the mechanism (no tax credit route) would follow in a bill, and stated that the phasing-down timetable runs over 28 years to give housing market certainty.
It is premature to make statements now about the tax rate that will then apply in the third bracket or the combined tax and premium rate in the second bracket.
Het is voorbarig om nu uitspraken te doen over het dan geldende belastingpercentage in de derde schijf of het gecombineerde belasting- en premiepercentage in de tweede schijf.
Antwoord vragen Voortman over de berichtgeving dat Nederland haar eigen inkomensbeleid mag voeren als het gaat om sociale verhuur

Voortman (GroenLinks) asks the minister of Housing about reports that the Netherlands may set its own income policy for social rental housing, citing PBL findings that waiting times rose for middle-income groups after the 34,085 euro income limit and asking why the limit was kept rather than raised. Minister Blok replies that member states set their own boundaries within EU competition rules, that waiting times fell for households below 34,000 euro but rose for higher incomes, and that the 10% allocation room for incomes up to 38,000 euro was chosen as a targeted measure with no final decision yet on a wider exception.
Member states are free to set their own limits within the European competition rules.
Het staat de lidstaten vrij om binnen de Europese mededingingsregels de eigen grenzen te bepalen.

Vragen van de leden Monasch en Nijboer (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers voor Wonen en Rijksdienst en van Financiën over de striktere regels omtrent de Nationale Hypotheek Garantie bij oversluiten van een hypotheek (ingezon

MPs Monasch and Nijboer asked the ministers whether stricter NHG rules requiring annuity or linear repayment when remortgaging would apply to all existing NHG mortgages, and why. The minister answered that the rule was unintended, asked the WEW to amend it so existing savings and interest-only NHG mortgages can move to a new home without mandatory repayment change, and the WEW agreed to do so.

I have therefore asked the WEW to adjust the rules so that existing savings and/or interest-only mortgages with National Mortgage Guarantee can be carried over to a next home without owners being required to repay annuity-style.
Ik heb daarom het WEW verzocht de regels zodanig aan te passen dat bestaande spaar- en/of aflossingsvrije hypotheken met Nationale Hypotheek Garantie meegenomen kunnen worden naar een volgende woning

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Gerbrands ter vervanging van nr. 7 over het verbod op winstuitkering
Amendment bars care providers with profit-seeking status from subcontracting care, lets an AMvB exempt categories, and adds a four-week pre-submission period so parliament can see the exemptions.
The submitter considers it desirable that parliament has insight into how the government uses that power.
De indiener acht gewenst dat het parlement zicht heeft op de wijze waarop de regering van die bevoegdheid gebruikmaakt.
Amendement van het lid Gerbrands over het verbod op winstuitkering

Bars care institutions subject to the profit ban from subcontracting care to for-profit subcontractors, limits AMvB exemptions, and adds a voorhang requirement so parliament sees exemption decisions first.
The submitter considers it desirable that parliament has insight into how the government uses that power.
De indiener acht gewenst dat het parlement zicht heeft op de wijze waarop de regering van die bevoegdheid gebruikmaakt.
Motie van de leden Agema en Gerbrands over een verplichte bestuurderstoets in de zorg
Asks the government to introduce a mandatory director suitability test for all management positions in healthcare, placed with the NZa.
requests the government to introduce a mandatory director suitability test for all management functions in healthcare and place it with the NZa
verzoekt de regering, een verplichte bestuurderstoets in te voeren voor alle bestuursfuncties in de zorg en deze onder te brengen bij de NZa
Motie van de leden Agema en Gerbrands over het afschaffen van het eigen risico
Asks the government to propose abolishing the statutory deductible (eigen risico), starting with primary care.
requests the government to come with a proposal to abolish the deductible
verzoekt de regering, te komen met een voorstel voor het afschaffen van het eigen risico
Motie van de leden Agema en Gerbrands over een dragerschapstest bij ivf-behandelingen
Asks the government to make the carrier test more known and offer it as standard in IVF treatment; a health policy request not bearing on executive checks.
requests the government to ensure the carrier test becomes better known and is offered as standard in IVF treatments
verzoekt de regering, ervoor zorg te dragen dat de dragerschapstest meer bekendheid krijgt en deze standaard aan te bieden bij ivf-behandelingen
Motie van de leden Agema en Gerbrands over fysiotherapie bij reumatische aandoeningen
Asks the government, with the rheumatology field and the Zorginstituut, to find a workable alternative to the conditional access track for physiotherapy.
requests the government, together with the rheumatology field and the Zorginstituut, to arrive at a workable approach
verzoekt de regering om, samen met het reumaveld en het Zorginstituut te komen tot een werkwijze die wel haalbaar is
Amendement van het lid Gerbrands over het oprichten van een Geneesmiddelenfonds
Shifts funds within the health budget to set up a humanitarian medicines fund for rare diseases, with savings from expired patents directed to it.
have the Minister set up a humanitarian medicines fund for rare diseases
door de Minister een humanitair geneesmiddelenfonds zeldzame ziekten op te laten richten
Amendement van het lid Gerbrands waarmee de ambulanceverpleegkundige blijft bestaan
Amendment requiring that emergency ambulance care always include at least one BIG-registered ambulance nurse, leaving planned care to ambulance professionals.
This amendment provides that in urgent ambulance care at least one BIG-registered ambulance nurse must be present.
Dit amendement regelt dat bij spoedeisende ambulancezorg er minimaal een BIG-geregistreerde ambulanceverpleegkundige aanwezig dient te zijn.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Gerbrands ter vervanging van nr. 10 waarmee de ambulanceverpleegkundige blijft bestaan
Amends the ambulance care law so that urgent ambulance care must include a registered ambulance nurse present on the vehicle.
that in urgent ambulance care at least one BIG-registered ambulance nurse must be present
dat bij spoedeisende ambulancezorg er minimaal een BIG-geregistreerde ambulanceverpleegkundige aanwezig dient te zijn
Amendement van de leden Agema en Gerbrands over een uniforme barcode op implantaten
Amendment requiring implants to carry a uniform identification code, passed on to the implant register, and prohibiting use of unmarked implants, with enforcement under the Economic Offences Act.
It is prohibited to apply a medical device that is an implant without a uniform identification code.

Het is verboden een medisch hulpmiddel dat een implantaat is als bedoeld in artikel 1, eerste lid van de Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg, toe te passen, indien dat medisch hulpmiddel niet is voorzien van een geüniformeerde identificatiecode.
Motie van het lid Agema c.s. over monitoren van de ligduur
Motion asks the government to monitor the length of hospital stays to test whether the introduction of a co-payment reduces hospital care use.
requests the government to monitor the length of stay to establish the possible link with the introduction of the co-payment.
verzoekt de regering, de ligduur te monitoren om hiermee het mogelijke verband met de invoering van de eigen bijdrage vast te kunnen stellen
Motie van het lid Agema c.s. over uitbetaling van de gehele compensatie in januari
Motion asking the government to pay the full deductible compensation in January instead of spreading it over the year.
requests the government to pay the full deductible compensation in January
verzoekt de regering, de compensatie voor het eigen risico in zijn geheel in januari uit te betalen
Motie van het lid Agema c.s. over een eigen bijdrage voor slechts één hoortoestel
Asks the government to limit the 25% co-payment for hearing aids to one device for people who need hearing aids in both ears.
requests the government, for people who need a hearing aid in both ears, to apply the co-payment to only one hearing aid
verzoekt de regering, voor mensen die aan beide oren een hoortoestel nodig hebben, de eigen bijdrage slechts voor één hoortoestel te laten gelden
Motie van het lid Agema c.s. over maximaal tien dagen eigen bijdrage voor het liggeld
Motion asking the government to cap the hospital bed-day co-payment at ten days per year.
requests the government to set a maximum of ten days per year for paying the co-payment for bed-day charges
verzoekt de regering, een maximum van tien dagen per jaar in te stellen voor het betalen van de eigen bijdrage van het liggeld
Motie van het lid Agema c.s. over in het basispakket houden van de rollator
Asks the government to drop smoking cessation from the basic health insurance package and keep the rollator and walking aids in it.
requests the government to remove smoking cessation from the package and keep the rollator and walking aids in the package
verzoekt de regering, stoppen-met-roken uit het pakket te Iaten en de rollator en de loophulpmiddelen in het pakket te houden
Motie van het lid Agema c.s. over ongedaan maken van de verhoging van het eigen risico
Asks the government to reverse the increase in the compulsory health insurance deductible (eigen risico) introduced via the healthcare allowance.
requests the government to reverse the increase of the deductible
verzoekt de regering, de verhoging van het eigen risico ongedaan te maken
Motie van het lid Agema c.s. over de herziening van het DSM-classificatiesysteem
Asks the government to have the health insurance advisory body CVZ study whether revising the DSM classification undermines appropriate use of care.
Requests the government to have the CVZ investigate the extent to which the DSM revision affects appropriate use of care.
verzoekt de regering, het CVZ te laten onderzoeken in hoeverre de herziening van het DSM-classificatiesysteem het gepast gebruik van zorg aantast
Motie van het lid Agema c.s. over uitvoering van compensatie via CER
Asks the government to run compensation for the eigen risico increase exclusively through the CER scheme and states that raising the eigen risico is undesirable.
asks the government to have compensation for the eigen risico increase run exclusively via the CER
verzoekt de regering, de uitvoering voor compensatie van de verhoging van het eigen risico uitsluitend via de CER te laten verlopen
Motie van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over kosten voor tijdelijk onderdak voor daders van huiselijk geweld
Asks the government to recover from perpetrators of domestic violence the costs of their temporary shelter.
to recover from the perpetrators themselves the costs incurred to provide temporary shelter to perpetrators of domestic violence
de kosten die gemaakt worden om tijdelijk onderdak te bieden aan daders van huiselijk geweld, te verhalen op de daders zelf
Motie van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over de richtlijn ouderenmishandeling
Asks the government to finalise the elder abuse guideline as soon as possible and make its measures policy for care providers.
requests the government to finalise the elder abuse guideline as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering, de richtlijn ouderenmishandeling zo spoedig mogelijk gereed te maken
Motie van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over een drie keer hogere straf bij ouderenmishandeling
Asks the government to introduce a threefold higher penalty for abuse of elderly persons.
by analogy with violence against care workers, introduce a threefold higher penalty also for abuse of the elderly
naar analogie van geweld tegen hulpverleners ook bij ouderenmishandeling een drie keer hogere straf in te voeren
Motie Graus en Gerbrands over een verruiming van de mededingingsregels
Motion asks the government to broaden competition rules so growers and fishers can get fair prices from retailers and processors.
requests the government, in consultation with retailers and processing companies, to reach a structure creating more room in competition rules
verzoekt de regering in overleg met retailers en verwerkende bedrijven tot een structuur te komen waarbij er meer ruimte wordt gecreëerd in mededingingsregels
Motie Graus en Gerbrands over een onafhankelijke fosfaattest
Asks the government to commission a phosphate test by a more independent party than IMARES to assess effects on fish stocks.
requests the government, given poor fish stocks and the situation of Dutch fisheries, to commission a phosphate test as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering gezien de slechte visstand en de situatie waarin de Nederlandse visserij verkeert, zo spoedig mogelijk een fosfaattest uit te laten voeren

Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Koopmans en Gerbrands ter vervanging van nr. 23 over het van toepassing verklaren van het bezoldigingsmaximum bij inhuur op grond van een arbeidsovereenkomst of aanst
Lowers from twelve to six months the period after which the pay maximum applies to officials hired via management companies or agencies instead of employment contracts.
Motie Smilde c.s. over de introductie van uitkomstfinanciering
Asks the government, in consultation with all parties, to reach a broadly shared vision leading to outcome-based funding in healthcare by 2020.
calls on the government, in consultation with all parties, to reach a broadly shared vision resulting in the introduction of outcome-based funding by 2020
roept de regering op, in overleg met alle partijen te komen tot een breed gedeelde en breed gedragen visie met als uitkomst de introductie van uitkomstfinanciering uiterlijk in 2020
Asks the government not to transfer Zvw and AWBZ aids to the Wmo but keep them under the Zvw, leaving current Wmo aids unchanged.
requests the government not to transfer Zvw aids and AWBZ aids to the Wmo
verzoekt de regering geen Zvw-hulpmiddelen en geen AWBZ-hulpmid delen over te hevelen naar de Wmo
Amendement van de leden Gerbrands en Brinkman over het brengen van zorgverzekeraars onder bijlage 3 en de zorgsector onder bijlage 1
Moves insurers from the list of bodies under the sectoral salary norm to the general salary maximum and adds several health-sector bodies to the list under the salary norm.
The health insurers that have registered as such under article 25 of the Health Insurance Act or article 33 of the General Exceptional Medical Expenses Act.
De zorgverzekeraars die zich overeenkomstig artikel 25 van de Zorgverzekeringswet of artikel 33 van de Algemene Wet Bijzondere Ziektekosten als zodanig hebben aangemeld.
Amendement van de leden Gerbrands en Brinkman over van toepassing verklaren van het bezoldigingsmaximum bij inhuur op grond van een arbeidsovereenkomst of aanstelling voor meer dan drie maanden
Lowers from twelve to three months the period after which the pay cap applies to interim or contracted top officials not employed under an employment contract or appointment.
the phrase 'for more than twelve months' is replaced by: for more than three months
wordt de zinsnede «voor meer dan twaalf maanden» vervangen door: voor meer dan drie maanden
Motie-Koppejan c.s. over minder vergaande maatregelen

Asks the government to urgently study the effect of closing eel fishing areas on silver eel migration and eel recovery, and to consider with the sector whether less far-reaching measures than three-month closures could meet EU targets.
requests the government to urgently commission research into the effect of closing areas on the silver eel migration and the related eel recovery
verzoekt de regering versneld onderzoek in te zetten naar het effect van het sluiten van gebieden op de schieraaluittrek en het daarmee samenhangende aalherstel
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Koopmans c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 40 over het niet afwijken van de Europese beoordelingsmethode

Amends the plant protection law so that Dutch authorities may set rules by or under a general administrative order for uniform principles, without deviating from EU assessment methods, with a light pre-consultation procedure.
The proposal for a general administrative order under the first sentence is not made until four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers.

De voordracht voor een krachtens de eerste volzin vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Koopmans c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 14 over het niet afwijken van de Europese beoordelingsmethode
Bars deviation from EU assessment methods for plant protection products, moves the rules into a general administrative order and adds a light pre-consultation procedure for parliament.
and that a light pre-consultation procedure applies when the general administrative order is adopted
en dat bij de vaststelling van de algemene maatregel van bestuur een lichte voorhangprocedure geldt
Amendement van het lid Koopmans c.s. over het niet afwijken van de Europese beoordelingsmethode bij toetsing
Amends the crop protection act so that the Netherlands cannot depart from the EU-expert assessment methods when evaluating pesticide effects on water and environment.
cannot depart from the assessment methods laid down in guidelines jointly established by EU member state experts
niet kan worden afgeweken van de beoordelingsmethoden die zijn opgenomen in door experts van de lidstaten van de Europese Unie gezamenlijk vastgestelde richtsnoeren
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over vieze endoscopen in ziekenhuizen

An MP asked the minister about contaminated endoscopes in hospitals, following a report that Erasmus MC found duodenoscopes often dirty, and whether patients were informed and inspectorates involved. The minister answered that only duodenoscopes were studied, patients could not be individually informed due to batch cultures, the IGJ was informed and keeps monitoring, and the WIP guideline lapsed with a successor expected in 2018.
The inspectorate is not taking additional measures following the study results, closely monitors signals and draws attention to this on its website.
De inspectie neemt geen extra maatregelen naar aanleiding van de resultaten van het onderzoek, volgt nauwlettend signalen en vraagt aandacht hiervoor op haar site.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat tientallen medewerkers van het HagaZiekenhuis ongeoorloofd een medisch dossier hebben ingekeken

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that dozens of HagaZiekenhuis staff unlawfully viewed a patient's medical record, and whether this shows the EPD/LSP system is unsafe. The minister said the LSP is not involved, the hospital's own records are access-controlled and under investigation, unlawful access would bring warnings or dismissal, and whether a breach occurred is for the Data Protection Authority to judge.
Whether there is a violation and whether measures must be taken is for the assessment of the Data Protection Authority.
Of sprake is van een overtreding en of er maatregelen moeten worden getroffen is ter beoordeling van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat het Erasmus MC buitenlandse patiënten naar Nederland wil halen

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister whether Erasmus MC's plan to attract more foreign patients reflects temporary or structural overcapacity in highly complex care, whether it displaces Dutch patients, and whether specialised equipment should be reserved for Dutch insured patients. The minister replied that there is no overcapacity, that the hospital already treats foreign patients and focuses on tertiary care, that waiting-list oversight lies with insurers and the NZa, and that foreign patients pay passant tariffs.
No, I am not responsible for this.
Nee, hier ga ik niet over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat bevallen in Emmen niet mogelijk is

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Medical Care about the reported temporary closure of obstetric and children's wards at Scheper Hospital in Emmen, including causes, financial mismanagement, the 2008 merger and plans to reopen. The minister answered that the wards stay open a week longer, that the Inspectorate saw no unsafe care beforehand but staffing shortages posed a risk, and that the hospital and insurers are primarily responsible, declining to give internal financial details.
Treant has informed me that it cannot provide information on this, because it is internal business information.
Treant heeft mij laten weten hier geen informatie over te kunnen geven, omdat dit interne bedrijfsinformatie is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat een ziekenhuis professionele tolken in gaat zetten

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister about a hospital's decision to use professional interpreters after a wrongful hysterectomy, including who pays and whether patients should bear responsibility for their Dutch language skills. The minister called the hospital's measures good, said the hospital bears the interpreter costs itself, and stated that communication is essential to good care and that patients are responsible for managing language barriers.
These costs are not reimbursed by central government.
Deze kosten worden niet van rijkswege vergoed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over miljoenen aan onwettige subsidies verstrekt door ZonMw

An MP asked the Minister of Health about grants awarded by ZonMw in which committee members could assess their own applications, and whether those grants should be re-assessed and the committee members removed. The Minister acknowledged that the exception clause in ZonMw's conflict-of-interest code weakened safeguards against the appearance of conflicts, said it was no longer applied from 2016 and would be scrapped, but rejected re-assessment and denied any unlawful grants or personal enrichment.
Article 4 will be scrapped in that process.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Gerbrands over wel of geen deal met Vertex Pharmaceuticals inzake het geneesmiddel Orkambi

PVV MPs Agema and Gerbrands asked the health minister whether the refusal to reimburse Orkambi reflected a price dispute with Vertex, questioning the cost-effectiveness assessment, the delay and the negotiation tactics. The minister defended the delay on price and cost grounds, said she had now reached an acceptable price and would add Orkambi to the basic package from 1 November, while answering many points by referring to the Zorginstituut or to other countries.
Vertex, however, has not given insight into its development costs.
Vertex heeft echter geen inzage gegeven in hun ontwikkelingskosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over het bericht dat stervende patiënten overgeplaatst worden om het sterftecijfer laag te houden

Two PVV MPs asked the minister whether hospitals moving dying patients to keep mortality rates low, as reported in a column, is shocking and whether the Inspectorate will act. The minister replied that the column contains no concrete evidence of substandard care, that hospital mortality ratios need nuance, and that she sees no reason for further action or sanctions.
Concrete indications of substandard care for dying patients cannot be derived from the article.
Concrete aanwijzingen voor tekortschietende zorg bij stervende patiënten zijn aan het artikel niet te ontlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over ernstige misstanden veroorzaakt door kinderkwakzalvers

An MP asks the Health Minister whether she shares concern about 16 serious harms to children caused by alternative child healers, how parents are informed of risks, and whether the list of misconduct should be published or such practitioners without medical background banned from treating children. The minister responds that the Wkkgz requires alternative practitioners not to cause harm, that the IGZ supervises this, that she will not amend the rules or publish the list, but considers it important that the list is shared with the IGZ.
I do not intend to amend the existing laws and regulations, nor to make this list of misconduct public.
Ik ben niet voornemens om de bestaande wet- en regelgeving aan te passen, dan wel deze lijst met misstanden openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over het bizarre bericht 'In de zorg is gevoel belangrijker dan taalkennis'

PVV MPs asked whether it is acceptable that 37,000 care workers were dismissed while recruitment of refugees and status holders is pushed, and whether language and VOG (certificate of conduct) standards are being lowered. The State Secretary replied that care quality standards apply equally to all, that language requirements remain in law (Wkkgz, BIG), that a VOG can be requested for status holders, and that no standards change for new recruits.
The standards and requirements that care workers must meet are the same for everyone in the Netherlands.
De gestelde normen en eisen waaraan medewerkers in de zorg moeten voldoen zijn in Nederland voor iedereen hetzelfde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over het bericht dat verpleeghuizen Careyn bijna kopje-onder gaan

MPs Gerbrands and Agema asked whether a Careyn internal guide for IGZ inspection visits, the use of unqualified holiday staff, and the size of the organisation endanger oversight and resident safety. The State Secretary answered that IGZ is not being hindered, inspections are unannounced, the guide is only facilitating, and an organisational break-up is not an IGZ power but a matter for the board if quality is at stake.
The IGZ must of course never be hindered in carrying out its tasks.
De IGZ mag vanzelfsprekend nooit in de uitvoering van haar taken belemmerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over het bericht 'bezuiniging ouderenzorg nutteloos'

PVV MPs Gerbrands and Agema asked whether journalistic calculations showing that cuts to elderly care achieved nothing are correct, why earlier objections were dismissed, and whether the government will restore care cuts for older people. The Secretary of State rejected the calculations as incorrect, argued that the cuts were needed to bend spending growth and shifted responsibilities to insurers and municipalities, and said the government has invested in nursing home quality without committing to reverse the cuts.
The conclusion that the cuts to elderly care were useless is incorrect.
De conclusie dat de bezuinigingen op de ouderenzorg nutteloos zijn geweest is incorrect.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat door een tegenvaller van 400 miljoen de zorgpremie gaat stijgen

An MP asks the Health Minister how a shortfall of 400 million euros in the health insurance fund could raise premiums, and whether insurers should use reserves or pass on savings. The minister answers that insurers set premiums themselves, the shortfall stems from fewer chronic-disease cost groups in the equalisation payment (not fewer hospital treatments), and the government will publish its premium estimate on Prinsjesdag.
The cause of the decline in the DKGs is not yet known; this is now being further investigated by the Zorginstituut, in consultation with VWS, NZa and insurers.
Oorzaak van de daling in de DKG's is nog niet bekend; dit wordt nu verder uitgezocht door het Zorginstituut, in overleg met VWS, NZa en verzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over het bericht 'Tekort aan handjes: zorg smeekt ontslagen werknemers terug te keren'

PVV MPs Gerbrands and Agema asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport whether the government's care reforms caused unnecessary job losses, why refugees and migrants are being recruited into care, why some nursing programmes still have admission stops, and when staff will stop being used as pawns. The state secretary answered that reforms caused job losses but measures were taken to manage them, that recruitment plans and a 72 million euro boost aim to address shortages, and that care quality remains guaranteed.
The cabinet has in recent years carried out necessary reforms, because the demands we place on the organisation of care changed and care grew faster than society could afford.

Antwoord 2 De afgelopen jaren heeft het kabinet noodzakelijke hervormingen doorgevoerd, omdat de eisen die we stellen aan de organisatie van de zorg veranderden en de zorg harder groeide dan we als maatschappij aan konden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Wilders over het bericht dat bepaalde wijken in Den Haag 30% meer zorgkosten declareren

PVV MPs Gerbrands and Wilders asked the Health Minister to respond to a report that healthcare costs in certain The Hague neighbourhoods are 30% higher, and whether this reflects fraud or non-Western migrant background. The minister answered that socio-economic factors such as income and education explain the higher costs, that insurers are responsible for checking claims, and that there is no data on extra costs from Ramadan.
Checking is a task of the health insurers. The NZa supervises this as the regulator.
Het controleren is een taak van de zorgverzekeraars. De NZa ziet daarop toe als toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen getroffen zijn door ransomware-aanvallen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Health about reports that hospitals were hit by ransomware, including how much data was lost, whether ransom was paid, how many hospitals run outdated medical equipment, who is responsible for securing it, and what will be done. The minister answered that the NCSC registered five hospital ransomware reports since 2014 with no known ransom payments or data losses, that hospitals are primarily responsible for securing their equipment, and listed new measures such as an action plan, the sector CERT Z-CERT and an information-sharing body.
It is not known whether ransom has been paid.
Er is niet bekend of er losgeld is betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over de verdubbeling van het aantal datalekken door ziekenhuizen

An MP asked the Minister of Health why data breaches at hospitals had doubled, what measures would reduce human error, and whether losing a USB stick counts as serious negligence. The minister said hospitals are responsible for their own security, pointed to an action plan on patient data security and a sector CERT, and referred the causes and enforcement questions to the Data Protection Authority.
It is for the Data Protection Authority to explain the causes of the growth in the number of data breaches.
Het is aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens om te verklaren wat de oorzaken zijn van de groei van het aantal datalekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Agema over het niet vergoeden van een medicijn tegen taaislijmziekte

Two PVV MPs asked the minister why Orkambi, a cystic fibrosis drug, is not reimbursed despite a petition, and about alternatives, price negotiations and reimbursement elsewhere. The minister answered that the price of around 170,000 euros per year and the budget impact make reimbursement not responsible at present, while offering to reconsider a new proposal and to hold talks with the manufacturer on 20 June.
I have a meeting with the manufacturer on 20 June to discuss a possible continuation of the talks together with the Netherlands and Belgium.
Ik heb op 20 juni aanstaande een gesprek met de fabrikant om te praten over een mogelijk vervolg van de gesprekken tezamen met Nederland en België.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het declareren van yogalessen als psychiatrische behandeling

An MP asked whether yoga, massage, meditation and personal training billed as psychiatric treatment via day-care by a mental health provider should be reimbursed, and whether the rules should be tightened. The minister answered that such wellbeing activities are not covered by the basic package, that the NZa rules exclude them from day-care, that no such claims have yet been made by Vitalis, and that a bill on verification is pending.
Yoga lessons and massages are therefore not separately identifiable in the reimbursement system.
Yogalessen en massages zijn dus niet apart herkenbaar in de vergoedingssystematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands, De Graaf en Wilders over speciale voorzieningen in ziekenhuizen tijdens de ramadan

Three PVV MPs asked the health minister whether it is the hospital's task to provide special Ramadan facilities, whether this raises patient risks, who pays, and whether it breaches the Hippocratic oath. The minister answered that the material is supportive, that patients and their care providers decide on managing diabetes during Ramadan, that costs are covered from DBC revenue, and that she sees no breach of the oath and will not intervene.
I see no breach arising of the Dutch physicians' oath, which is derived from the Hippocratic oath.
Ik zie geen inbreuk ontstaan op de (van de eed van Hippocrates afgeleide) Nederlandse artseneed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het niet vergoeden van een hoopgevend maar peperduur geneesmiddel

MP Gerbrands (PVV) asked the Minister of Health about the non-reimbursement of the expensive drug eculizumab (Soliris), questioning its efficacy, patient impact, development origin, alternatives, patent expiry, and international reimbursement. Minister Schippers answered that the drug is effective and fully reimbursed for PNH and aHUS, that Alexion's pricing is undisclosed, that a price negotiation and decision will follow, and that a full international price overview cannot be given due to confidential agreements.
Alexion has so far not provided information on the price structure or profit margin for eculizumab.
Alexion heeft vooralsnog geen informatie verstrekt over de prijsopbouw of de winstmarge voor eculizumab.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat barcodes op medicijnen 47 sterfgevallen per jaar kunnen voorkomen

An MP asked the Minister why barcoding on medicines, which could prevent around 47 deaths a year, has been delayed and why about 20% of medicines still lack a barcode, and whether it should be made mandatory. The state secretary answered that a cost-benefit study found about 20% of hospital medicines lack a primary-pack barcode, that a national mandate is not considered efficient, and that follow-up consultations with stakeholders have been agreed.
In the letter of 31 May 2013 the Minister stated that it is not efficient to proceed to a national legal obligation regarding uniform barcoding for medicines.
247 ) heeft de Minister aangegeven dat het niet doelmatig is om over te gaan tot een nationale wettelijke verplichting met betrekking tot uniforme barcodering voor geneesmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat patiënten langer kunnen leven door een super eenvoudig pompje

An MP asked the minister how the health system can be sick if a cheaper chemotherapy pump extending life for colorectal cancer patients is funded by the KWF and not yet available in the Netherlands, and asked for immediate availability. The state secretary said the Zorginstituut considers the intra-arterial liver infusion method in principle reimbursable but the specific drug and patient group under study are unclear, and that reimbursement depends on the Zorginstituut's determination of standard of science and practice.
As long as it has not been established whether the applied intervention meets the standard of science and practice, the treatment cannot be reimbursed under the Health Insurance Act.
Zolang niet is vastgesteld of de toegepaste interventie volgens «stand van wetenschap en praktijk» is, kan de behandeling niet worden vergoed ten laste van de zorgverzekeringswet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over de Alrijne ziekenhuizen die verlies draaien

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether extra supervision of the financially troubled Alrijne hospitals was coming, whether an inquiry into the 2015 merger would be held, and whether the Medical Specialist Company model should be replaced by salaried specialists. The Secretary of State said the Inspectorate is monitoring the situation and has asked the board for a response, that no inquiry is warranted because managing finances is the board's responsibility, and that hospitals and specialists must choose their own governance model.
Financial signals can give the IGZ reason to ask further questions about ensuring the quality and safety of care.
Financiële signalen kunnen voor de IGZ reden zijn om nadere vragen te stellen met betrekking tot de borging van de kwaliteit en veiligheid van de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het toch niet beschikbaar komen van canules voor de heer Vercoutre, waarmee hij kan praten en hij minder benauwd is

An MP asked the minister why custom cannulas for a patient, which would let him speak and breathe more easily, still had not become available despite earlier answers and urged expert consultation. The state secretary replied that the patient died on 4 May 2017 from kidney problems at Erasmus MC and expressed condolences to the family.
I regret to inform you that Mr Vercoutre died on Thursday 4 May from the consequences of kidney problems at Erasmus MC in Rotterdam.
Ik moet u helaas mededelen dat de heer Vercoutre op donderdag 4 mei jl. aan de gevolgen van nierproblemen is overleden in het Rotterdams Erasmus MC.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat Nederlandse ziekenhuizen miljoenen teveel betalen voor implantaten

An MP asked the health minister how to respond to a report that Dutch hospitals overpay for orthopaedic implants, and whether a near-25% margin should be tackled. The state secretary called the signal worrying, pointed to suggested remedies such as switching suppliers, benchmarking and joint purchasing, and said he would discuss any bottlenecks with the parties without committing to new measures.
I assume that the parties will take up these suggestions, and I am happy to discuss with them if bottlenecks emerge.
Ik ga er vanuit dat partijen deze suggesties oppakken en ik ga graag met hen in gesprek indien daarbij knelpunten naar voren komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat het LUMC zich inzet om vluchtelingen aan een baan te helpen

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister whether it is a hospital's task to create training places for refugees, how much money goes to language and support for these trainees, and whether this circumvents the numerus fixus and preferential rules for refugees. The state secretary answered that the LUMC's initiative is a matter for the institutions, that the places are apprenticeship posts under regular funding with no displacement effect, and that no numerus fixus applies to level-4 nursing.
It is the joint responsibility of training and care institutions to ensure that sufficient training places with associated practical placements are available in view of future care demand.

Het is de gezamenlijke verantwoordelijkheid van opleidings- en zorginstellingen om ervoor te zorgen dat er met het oog op de toekomstige zorgvraag voldoende opleidingsplaatsen met bijbehorende praktijkplaatsen beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat honderden mensen per jaar worden opgenomen door onjuist gebruik van pijnstillers

An MP asked the minister how patients will be warned about dangerous use of opioid painkillers such as oxycodone combined with alcohol, why there are no precise national figures on deaths from painkiller misuse, and whether prescribing should be limited to three months. The state secretary replied that the CBG and Lareb see insufficient reason for additional measures, that prescribers are responsible for patient information, that no national registry of such deaths exists, and that the ministry is consulting stakeholders on implementing medication safety recommendations, while declining to restrict prescribing duration.
There are no exact figures known on possible deaths from misuse of medicines because there is no national registration of such deaths.
Er zijn geen exacte aantallen bekend van mogelijke sterfgevallen door verkeerd gebruik van geneesmiddelen omdat er geen landelijke registratie is van dergelijke sterfgevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat de topinkomens in de zorgsector explosief zijn gestegen

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether top incomes in the healthcare sector had risen sharply, why the Governance Code failed to stop this, and what action would be taken against healthcare executives earning above the Balkenende norm. The state secretary answered that the WNT applies to the sector, that the reported tripling is inaccurate because medical specialists were included who fall outside the WNT, that the Governance Code sets no pay limits, and that the WNT will be enforced by the CIBG where violations occur.
In case of violations, the WNT supervisor in healthcare, the CIBG, will enforce the law.
Bij overtredingen zal de toezichthouder op de WNT in de zorg, het CIBG, de wet handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Fritsma over het bericht ‘Grote onrust in verzorgingshuis Zuidoost over opvang illegalen’

PVV MPs asked why a care home in Zuidoost houses rejected asylum seekers while elderly people with care indications ZZP 1-3 are no longer admitted, and whether such people should be removed. The state secretary replied that vacant care home rooms are being repurposed in the trend toward aging at home, that he sees no reason to change the Wet langdurige zorg for ZZP 1-3, and that deportation is unrelated to his policy.
I see no connection between my policy in the field of long-term care and the action you suggest.
Ik zie geen relatie tussen mijn beleid op het terrein van de langdurige zorg en de door u gesuggereerde actie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht ‘Mijn bloeddruk schiet omhoog’

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary whether it is responsible to house vulnerable elderly residents in a care centre alongside young people with justice-system contact, and how their safety, including against elder abuse, will be protected. The state secretary replies that the plan, developed by Careyn and Socius for four flats for young people in re-integration, has voluntary support from residents and the client council, with careful selection and intensive supervision, and that a closure of the centre would be a separate matter for individual residents.
The elderly residents and the client council are closely involved in Careyn's plan.
De ouderen en de cliëntenraad zijn nauw betrokken bij het plan van Careyn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht “Wonen in aanleunwoning is riskant bij calamiteiten”

An MP asked the state secretary about fire safety risks for elderly residents of aanleunwoningen (sheltered flats) compared with verzorgingshuizen, and whether research would be done. The government answered that the ministries are investigating how to better protect elderly people against fire, to report to parliament later in 2015, and explained that the Bouwbesluit requires only smoke detectors in aanleunwoningen while verzorgingshuizen need a full fire alarm system.
In the course of 2015, your House will be further informed about the results of this.
In de loop van 2015 wordt uw Kamer nader geïnformeerd over de resultaten hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht “Tarieven Wmo over de kop”

An MP (PVV) asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport whether large differences in Wmo care tariffs between municipalities affect care quality, and whether he would investigate their consequences for residents. The state secretary replied that municipalities and providers are responsible for quality under the Wmo 2015, that tariff differences follow from local negotiation and policy choices, and that he sees no reason for additional measures or specific research.
I therefore see no reason at this time to take additional measures.
Ik zie dan ook op dit moment geen aanleiding om aanvullende maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat het aantal meldingen over mishandeling van ouderen met bijna de helft is toegenomen

An MP asked the state secretary about a reported 43% rise in elder abuse reports in big cities and whether cuts to care and closures of care homes explain it. The secretary says the figures are partly inaccurate, attributes the rise to greater awareness and the meldcode rather than more abuse, and rejects the link to cuts while arguing care reforms can help.
I therefore regard this increase – which, incidentally, began a few years ago – as an intended effect of policy.
Ik beschouw deze toename – die overigens dus al een paar jaar geleden is ingezet – daarom als een beoogd effect van beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht “Jos de Blok: deze transitie in de zorg moet je niet willen”

Member Gerbrands (PVV) asked the State Secretary for Health whether the 2015 care reforms, criticised by Buurtzorg's Jos de Blok as too complex and bureaucratic, will add overhead, and what will be done about the split between wijkgerichte and individual wijkverpleging funding. The State Secretary rejects the claim that the reforms are too complex, acknowledges administrative burden signals, and commits to a letter on reducing it and to revisiting the S1/S2 funding split.
I will inform your House more on this in the progress report on long-term care.
Ik zal uw Kamer hier nader over informeren in de voortgangsrapportage Langdurige Zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat Samsom op vrijdag ouderen wast

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary whether it is acceptable that a non-professional (Samsom, a volunteer) washes and dresses elderly people and assists with wound care, and whether this is consistent with the view that intimate care should be done by professionals. The state secretary answers that these tasks are not reserved under the BIG act, that Samsom is accompanied by a district nurse who performs reserved acts, and that the volunteer work is a welcome form of openness, not a political experiment.
Actions such as washing, dressing and assisting with wound care are not designated as reserved acts.
Handelingen zoals wassen, aankleden en het assisteren bij het verzorgen van wonden, zijn niet aangemerkt als voorbehouden handelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het bericht dat een bejaarde Rotterdamse gevangen zit in een zwaar versoberd verzorgingshuis; Zorgen om Nelly van 101

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether a 101-year-old Rotterdam resident, reportedly confined to a heavily austere care home after a change to living and care arrangements, reflects the intended closer-to-home care, and whether she really wants this. The state secretary acknowledged the report, said some residents may dread more independent living, and stated that existing residents' situations should be preserved as far as possible while a suitable solution is sought with the care office, provider and client.
That is why, in consultation between the care office, the care provider and the client, a suitable solution must be sought if an institution moves to separate housing and care.
Daarom moet in overleg tussen zorgkantoor, zorgaanbieder en cliënt gezocht worden naar een passende oplossing indien een instelling overgaat tot het scheiden van wonen en zorg.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Agema en Gerbrands over het nieuwe softwaresysteem van zorgaanbieder HWW Zorg te Den Haag

MPs Agema and Gerbrands asked the state secretary about HWW Zorg's investment in new software while staff were allegedly dismissed for lack of money, and about the use of the Agema funds and care shortages. The state secretary said the investment amount is not known to the ministry, that no staff were dismissed for lack of money according to HWW, that the 2.8 million euro was spent on staff training and team leaders, and that the zorgkantoor and IGZ supervise the institution.
The amount is not known to me because it concerns an individual investment by an institution.
De hoogte van het bedrag is mij niet bekend omdat het gaat om een individuele investering van een instelling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gerbrands over de bemoeienis van fabrikant Tena met incontinente patiënten

An MP asked the minister about insurer Achmea's per-day pricing of incontinence supplies, apotheker delegation of patient assessment to manufacturer Tena, and whether patient data sharing was lawful. The minister said the insurer-pharmacy contracts are a matter between them, that pharmacists remain responsible, and that the privacy regulator CBP had asked Tena questions but would decide itself whether to investigate.
I do not have access to the contracts concluded between the insurer and the pharmacist.
Ik heb geen inzage in de contracten die zijn afgesloten tussen verzekeraar en apotheker.
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands over het bericht ‘Vierstroom verplicht familie tot meewerken’

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Health whether a care home may oblige relatives to help with care, on what legal basis, and what steps will protect patients and families. The state secretary referred to answers to parallel questions, said the experiment aims at higher resident wellbeing rather than staffing, and stated that the Nza has been asked to scrutinise the experiment and will meet the care home.
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands over het bericht ‘Promens Care en NOVO bereiden fusieaanvraag voor’
