An MP asked the state secretary for health about the planned merger of Promens Care and NOVO, whether works councils and client councils were consulted, whether continuity of care is at risk, and whether a pilot review by the NZa and IGZ is possible. The state secretary said merger assessment belongs to the NMa, that the boards will be urged to involve stakeholders in line with the pending stricter care-specific merger review bill, that no IGZ signals on continuity exist, and that a pilot is not opportune because the review is already planned in the bill.
I will call on the boards of Promens Care and NOVO by letter to already act in line with the bill that tightens the rules for care-specific concentration review.
Ik zal de besturen van Promens Care en NOVO per brief oproepen nu alvast te handelen in lijn met het wetsvoorstel waarmee de regels voor zorgspecifieke concentratietoetsing worden aangescherpt.
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands over het bericht ‘Careyn wil HWW Zorg overnemen’

PVV MP Gerbrands asked the state secretary about reports that Careyn wants to take over HWW Zorg, including job losses, salary risks for staff, client impact and Inspectorate oversight. The state secretary said talks are ongoing as a condition set by the NZa after Meavita's bankruptcy, that no information on job losses is yet available, that staff terms are for the institution itself, and that the IGZ will remain alert regardless of any takeover.
Given the state of the talks, no information is currently available on this.
Gegeven de stand van de gesprekken is daarover op dit moment geen informatie beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dille en Gerbrands over het pubergesprek

Two PVV MPs asked the health minister why the government plans a yearly conversation between adolescents and a doctor, questioning whether it is needed given most teens have no problems and whether parents, not doctors, should handle this. The minister defended the extra youth contact moment as part of a healthy-lifestyle investment under the 2013 budget agreement, answered most questions on substance, and refused to drop the plan.
I am not willing to stop this action plan.
Ik ben niet bereid om dit actieplan te stoppen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders en Gerbrands over het bericht dat het College voor Zorgverzekeringen wil stoppen met het vergoeden van dure medicijnen voor enkele zeldzame ziekten

PVV MPs Wilders and Gerbrands asked the health minister whether the CVZ's draft advice to stop reimbursing expensive drugs for rare diseases was ethical, what limits on patient numbers and drug costs should apply, and whether she would follow the advice. The minister replied that no final advice exists yet, that the decision rests with her as the political primacy, that rare-disease drugs have a legal prevalence ceiling and no fixed cost limit, and that the CVZ backlog has been resolved.
The final decision rests with me and is therefore the primacy of politics.
De uiteindelijke beslissing ligt bij mij en is daarmee het primaat van de politiek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gerbrands over de mogelijke besmetting van patiënten in het ZBC Medisch Centrum Biltstraat.(zelfstandig behandelcentrum)

An MP asked the health minister about a possible infection of patients at the Medisch Centrum Biltstraat, including whether staff were checked, whether notification was too late, whether the Inspectie was involved, and whether an independent inquiry would be held. The minister answered that 903 patients are in a lookback procedure, that staff were not screened because they were not exposed, that the Inspectie advised the lookback, and that an independent inquiry is not considered necessary at present.
No, I do not see the need for that at this moment.
Nee, daar zie ik op dit moment de noodzaak niet van in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Agema en Gerbrands over het bericht dat verplicht thuis wonen in plaats van in een verzorgingshuis slecht uitpakt bij een proef in Neede

PVV MPs asked the state secretary about a Neede pilot in which very old people required to live at home instead of in a care home reportedly became lonely and needed more care, and whether the Kunduz accord plan to close care homes should be reversed. The state secretary acknowledged loneliness as a concern, argued that hybrid home-and-institution arrangements already exist, said the trend toward care at home predates the plan, and promised to elaborate the measure and its property effects.

I indicated in my second progress report on the Long-Term Care Reform of 25 June that I will further elaborate the measure from the budget agreement and also take the effects on property into account.

Ik heb in mijn tweede voortgangsrapportage Hervorming Langdurige Zorg van 25 juni jl. aangegeven de maatregel uit het begrotingsakkoord verder uit te werken en daarbij ook de effecten op het vastgoed te betrekken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht ‘Medewerkers verpleeghuis Slotervaart luiden noodklok over inkorten diensten’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that staff at Slotervaart nursing home raised alarms over shortened shifts and whether the inspectorate's findings on staffing risks were considered. The state secretary said shift changes aim at a more even staffing spread over the day, that the inspectorate found no fault with total staffing but flagged flex-staff risks, and that the inspectorate will revisit the organisation Cordaan after its reporting.
The IGZ will indeed visit care organisation Cordaan again in the coming period.
De IGZ zal in de komende tijd inderdaad zorginstelling Cordaan opnieuw bezoeken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gerbrands over de nieuwe kritiek op het psychiatrische handboek DSM-5

MP Gerbrands asked the minister of Health about new criticism of the DSM-5 psychiatric handbook, including whether insurers should base reimbursement on it and whether DSM-4 should be kept. The minister replied that the APA is responsible for the classification, that unnecessary medicalisation should be prevented, and that the CVZ will advise on the basic insurance package, with a second advice due December 2012.
On the basis of this, I will adjust my policy where necessary.
Op basis hiervan zal ik zonodig mijn beleid aanpassen.
Antwoord vragen Agema en Gerbrands over het bericht ‘Ouderen drogen uit in zorgcentrum’

MPs Agema and Gerbrands asked whether elderly residents at care centre Klepperwei were dehydrated due to cost-cutting, whether materials were missing, and why the Inspectorate did not act on a complaint. The state secretary replied that the Inspectorate found no reason for further inquiry in 2010, that the complaint is pending the care provider's external investigation, and that the Inspectorate will decide on action after that outcome.
Only once this report has also been adequately investigated can I give a judgement on whether elderly people were dehydrated at care centre Klepperwei.
Pas als ook deze melding adequaat is onderzocht, kan ik een oordeel geven over de vraag of er ouderen uitgedroogd zijn in zorgcentrum de Klepperwei
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands over de veiligheid van bewoners van verpleeghuis Mariahoeve

An MP asked the state secretary for Health about deaths of nursing home residents after ingesting a chlorine tablet and a plastic glove, and about a nurse stopping morphine without doctor or family consent, and whether the inspectorate had visited the home. The state secretary said the incidents were reported to the Inspectorate, which found the provider pays attention to safety, that the chlorine tablet case is not yet closed, and that the Inspectorate had visited the group in 2010 and 2011 but not this location specifically, deferring further measures until the investigation ends.
The case of swallowing the chlorine tablet is not yet concluded. After the investigation is completed, the IGZ will consider the measure to be taken.
De zaak van het inslikken van de chloortablet is nog niet afgerond. Na afronding van het onderzoek zal de IGZ zich bezinnen op de te nemen maatregel.
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands over de nieuwe baan van oud-bestuurder van het Maasstad ziekenhuis, de heer P. Smits

Gerbrands (PVV) asked the minister whether the former Maasstad hospital director Smits taking an interim board seat at Zorgpartners Friesland, after alleged failures in the Klebsiella outbreak, was acceptable, and whether a board-suitability test would be introduced. The minister replied that appointments are the responsibility of the care provider and its supervisory board, that the IGZ found no grounds for corrective measures, and that a letter on good governance this summer would only describe the pros and cons of a suitability test.
As minister of VWS I have no role in the appointment or dismissal of directors; this is an exclusive competence of the supervisory board
Als minister van VWS heb ik geen rol bij de benoeming of het ontslag van bestuurders, dit is een exclusieve bevoegdheid van de raad van toezicht
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands over het bericht ‘Ongeschoold personeel deelt medicijnen uit in verpleeghuizen’

An MP asked the state secretary whether a short medication-administration course for unqualified nursing-home staff is sufficient, whether annual refreshers should be required, and whether the sector body Actiz should be held responsible for claims that medication errors are rare. The state secretary answered that training content is the responsibility of the profession and employers, pointed to the Inspectorate's monitoring and the taskforce's safe-principles guide, and said Actiz bears no responsibility for errors.
The Inspectorate for Health Care monitors the quality of elderly care in general and medication safety in particular.
De Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg ziet toe op de kwaliteit van de zorg op het gebied van de ouderenzorg in het algemeen en de medicatieveiligheid in het bijzonder.
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands over het bericht ‘Tijd voor kleur’

An MP from the PVV asks the minister whether a government-funded programme ('Intercultureel fundament', part of 'Kansen voor de Zorg') should be halted, since the coalition agreement ends diversity policy based on sex and ethnicity, and whether care staff should be expected to adapt to other cultures. The state secretary replies that the project received EUR 630,389.93 (EUR 300,000 from VWS), that the programme aims to recruit under-represented groups to address staff shortages, that there is no reason to stop it, and that client-oriented care requires alignment with all clients' needs.
I therefore see no reason at all to stop this programme.
Ik zie dan ook geen enkele reden om te stoppen met dit programma.
Antwoord vragen Agema en Gerbrands over het bericht dat voor diefstal veroordeelde bejaardenverzorgers zonder problemen terecht kunnen in anderen tehuizen

Two PVV MPs asked whether a national registry or blacklist should be set up to stop convicted carers from theft moving to other care homes, and whether care managers who do not report theft are complicit. The state secretary said a registry is still being examined with industry and the Inspectorate, that reporting is primarily the client's responsibility while care homes should support it, and that sentencing falls under the Justice minister.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht ‘Oud-topambtenaar wordt tijdelijk boegbeeld IGZ’

An MP asked the health minister about reports that a former senior civil servant would serve as interim Inspector-General of the Healthcare Inspectorate, and how this fits with keeping the current IG until a successor is found and with the government's plan to curb costly external hiring. The minister confirmed the interim appointment, explained the IG will leave at retirement rather than stay on, and said the hiring of extra inspectors and mystery guests is not affected.
Initially Mr Van der Wal would stay on at my request until his successor was in place. The IG is giving up on that.
Aanvankelijk zou de heer Van der Wal op mijn verzoek aanblijven tot in zijn opvolging was voorzien. Daar ziet de IG van af.
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands over het bericht dat aansluiting op het Landelijk Schakelpunt (LSP) een minimale kwaliteitseis is

An MP asks the health minister to react to reports that connection to the national switchpoint LSP would become a minimum quality requirement set by health insurers, and asks for no such requirement before a professional norm exists. The minister answers that quality requirements are set by the care professions themselves, that no connection requirement exists yet, and that insurers have said they will not include it in contracts before the profession adopts it.
At this moment there is no requirement to connect to the LSP yet.
Op dit moment is er nog geen sprake van een eis tot aansluiting op het LSP.
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands over het bericht ‘Jeugd met taakstraf meteen aan de slag’

An MP asked whether juveniles serving community sentences are deployed as elderly care workers and whether this is acceptable. The state secretary denied they do personal care, saying their tasks are kitchen, coffee delivery and cleaning, with supervision and risk assessment in place.
In practice, their work in elderly care mainly consists of working in the kitchen, delivering coffee or cleaning.
In de praktijk komen hun werkzaamheden in de ouderenzorg vooral neer op het werken in de keuken, het rondbrengen van koffie of schoonmaakwerk.
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands over het onderzoek van het Nibud naar de waskosten in zorginstellingen

An MP asked the state secretary why care home residents may pay around 75 euro monthly for laundry, why the Nibud estimate is far above the government's 20-35 euro range, and what measures will prevent excessive charges. The state secretary replied that residents often pay 10-50 euro, the government range rests on a 2009 study, the care provider and client council decide on laundry pricing, and listed cost-saving options without committing to new measures.
The care provider and the client council must jointly decide how the laundry process is organised and what amount is passed on to residents.
Zorgaanbieder en cliëntenraad moeten samen beslissen hoe ze het wasproces vormgeven en welk bedrag wordt doorberekend aan de bewoners.
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands over het bericht ‘Hausse aan fusies zorginstellingen’

An MP asked the health minister about reports of a surge in healthcare mergers, the number of registered partnerships since the moratorium, and her talks with providers with merger plans. The minister said no complete registry exists, that she has personally urged several providers to act carefully, and that the IGZ and NZa have limited powers to assess mergers.
However, there is no statutory obligation to report or register partnerships.
Er bestaat echter geen wettelijke verplichting om samenwerkingsverbanden te melden of te registreren.
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands over het bericht ‘Ouderen achter slot en grendel’

An MP asked the state secretary about a housing-care complex that locked its main entrance around the clock, preventing care staff from reaching residents, and whether the owner refused key lockers. The state secretary answered that the building door was locked for residents' safety after unauthorised persons entered, that residents arrange key policies with care providers, and that no action against the owner is needed.
Given the above answers, I do not consider it necessary to take action in this situation.
Gegeven de bovenstaande antwoorden vind ik het niet nodig om actie te ondernemen in deze situatie.
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands over het tekort aan maag-darm-leverartsen (MDL-artsen)

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister about a bed-admission stop at the Jeroen Bosch hospital caused by a shortage of gastroenterology specialists, whether alternatives were considered, the national shortage and training numbers, the advice on training places, and effects on bowel cancer screening and the numerus fixus. The minister defended the hospital's proportionate measures, reported growing training numbers and screening phased in from 2013 to 2019, and promised a letter on the numerus fixus in spring 2012.
The letter is expected to be sent to you in spring 2012.
Naar verwachting wordt de brief in het voorjaar van 2012 aan u aangeboden.
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands over het bericht dat de zorgverzekeraar de vestiging van huisarts bepaalt

MP Gerbrands asked whether insurers effectively decide where GPs may settle, in light of the NMa fine on the LHV, and whether Menzis should be barred from providing GP care. Minister Schippers answered that the NMa fine concerned LHV advice on settlement policy, not insurer contracting, that the NMa examined insurers' role without fining them, and that she is working on measures to prevent vertical integration of insurers and providers though it is currently still permitted.
I am working on developing measures to prevent integration between health insurers and care providers.
Ik ben bezig met de uitwerking van maatregelen om integratie tussen zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders te voorkomen.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat vis niet meer kan leven in het IJsselmeer (ingezonden 1 december 2011).

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary about reports that fish can no longer live in the IJsselmeer, questioning the phosphate standpoint of IMARES and the government and proposing a phosphate test in the lake. The secretary states that water quality has improved but phosphate levels remain too high under the EU Water Framework Directive, that fishers' knowledge is valued but not a substitute for research, and that no phosphate-addition study will be carried out or financed.
In light of the above, I do not intend to carry out or finance a study into the effects of phosphate addition on the IJsselmeer.
In het licht van bovenstaande ben ik niet voornemens een onderzoek naar de effecten van fosfaattoediening op het IJsselmeer uit te voeren of te financieren.
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands en Van Klaveren over de vergoeding van anti-homotherapie

PVV MPs Gerbrands and Van Klaveren asked whether insurers must reimburse 'anti-homosexuality therapy' offered by a recognised care institution and how it will be removed from the basic package. Minister Schippers answered that such therapy is not part of the Zorgverzekeringswet package, that IGZ inspection found no such therapy being provided, and that IGZ will act if a complaint is filed.
However, the inspection visit that the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) paid to the institution in question shows that no such therapy is being provided.
Uit het inspectiebezoek dat de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) aan de betreffende instelling heeft gebracht blijkt echter dat er geen sprake is van het verlenen van een dergelijke therapie.
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands over het bericht ‘Bejaarden gedwongen in containers’

An MP asked whether 145 elderly residents of Huize Bernardus were being forced into container housing during a care home demolition, and whether the OsiraGroep board should face action. The state secretary replied that residents move temporarily into a prefabricated care centre rather than containers, and that the board acted properly with consultation of the residents' council and inspectorate.
In my view there is, on this subject, no question of the Osira Amstelring board acting wrongly.
Er is wat dit onderwerp betreft naar mijn mening geen sprake van verkeerd handelen van het bestuur van Osira Amstelring.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de aangekondigde fusie tussen twee GGZ-instellingen (ingezonden 21 december 2011).

An MP asks the minister of Health about the announced merger of two mental health institutions and how to prevent further mergers before stricter merger rules take effect. The minister says she cannot judge individual mergers, has no legal power to impose a merger moratorium or require a merger impact report yet, and will urge providers to act in the spirit of the coming rules.
I will also address the GGZ institutions concerned on this.
Ik zal hierop ook de betreffende GGZ-instellingen aanspreken.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de «big business» in hoortoestellen (ingezonden 7 december 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about the high share of premium hearing aids sold, the gap between purchase and retail prices, transparency on price and quality, a possible cartel probe, and abolishing reimbursement limits. The minister says market forces set prices, refers cartel questions to the independent competition authority NMa, points to insurers and a quality protocol, and defers the reimbursement decision to spring 2012.
I will bring the hearing aid market to the attention of the NMa.
Ik zal de hoortoestellenmarkt onder de aandacht brengen van de NMa.
Vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Dille (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het succes van de Opvoedpoli (ingezonden 6 december 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary for health, welfare and sport why the private youth-care provider Opvoedpoli appears more efficient and cheaper than traditional institutions, and whether such providers complement or replace them. The state secretary welcomed new entrants as innovation, said Opvoedpoli fills a gap for simpler problems but cannot cover residential care, and said municipalities will decide how to pay providers by performance, with the ministry still exploring guidance.
As part of the system reform, I am examining what guidance can be provided for this.
In het kader van de stelselwijziging onderzoek ik welke handreikingen daarvoor kunnen worden geboden.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat de Scheveningse vissers door jarenlang niets doen van de gemeente Den Haag vertrekken naar IJmu

An MP asks the state secretary of Economic Affairs whether the Scheveningen fish auction, reportedly losing fishing vessels to IJmuiden because of years of municipal inaction, should be preserved and whether The Hague should be held to account. The state secretary answers that the auction has grown to a top-three position in the Netherlands, shows turnover figures, and sees no reason to act against the municipality.
I see no reason to do so, partly in light of my answer to question 5.
Ik zie daar geen aanleiding toe, dit mede in het licht van mijn antwoord op vraag 5.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat er zeer hoge risico’s bij thuiszorgorganisatie Parnassus zijn geconstateerd (ingezonden 12 december 20

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of very high risks at home-care organisation Parnassus, including unauthorised medication changes, lack of training and whether the inspectorate should have acted earlier. The state secretary said no patient harm had been reported to the inspectorate, the inspectorate acted on a medication-safety complaint, measures were imposed, and the board would be given the chance to reduce risks, with the Raad van Toezicht deciding on the board's position.
The inspectorate is closely monitoring this. If this leads to insufficient results, other enforcement measures are not ruled out.
De inspectie volgt dit nauwlettend. Indien dit tot onvoldoende resultaat leidt, worden andere handhavingsmaatregelen niet uitgesloten.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat garnalenvissers worstelen met Vibeg (ingezonden 6 december 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation how he reconciles reports showing no harmful or even positive effects of fishing on the seabed with the proposed restrictions on coastal fishing, and whether the VIBEG agreement can be postponed to allow a proper consultation of fishers. The state secretary replies that the reports do show ecological grounds for restricting beam trawling, that the VIBEG agreement is being signed today with the fishing sector, and that consultation was conducted through sector leaders.
No, the VIBEG agreement is being signed today, including by the fishing sector.
Nee, het VIBEG akkoord wordt vandaag getekend, ook door de visserijsector.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het RIVM een huisarts voor de rechter daagt (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

A PVV MP asked the health minister whether she agrees with RIVM suing a GP who publicly questioned flu vaccination and the integrity of RIVM's director, and about the institute's conflicts of interest with industry. The minister defended RIVM's action, said openness on industry ties is important, and maintained that vaccination is effective.
Full openness about relationships with the (pharmaceutical) industry is of the utmost importance to me, both for advisers we work with and for civil servants of my ministry (including RIVM).
Volledige openheid over relaties met de (farmaceutische) industrie vind ik van het grootste belang, zowel voor adviseurs waarmee wij werken als voor ambtenaren van mijn ministerie (inclusief RIVM).
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de stijging van de kosten voor de tandarts (ingezonden 15 november 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about sharply rising dental insurance premiums and treatment tariffs following the liberalisation of dental prices, and whether the free-pricing experiment will be stopped. The minister answers that the experiment is still to start, asks dental bodies and insurers to show restraint, and says the NZa will monitor it and the experiment will be ended early if access, quality or affordability are endangered.
I have given the Netherlands Competition and Consumer Authority... rather, the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) an instruction to accompany and monitor the free-pricing experiment.
Ik heb aan de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) een aanwijzing gegeven om het experiment met de vrije prijzen te begeleiden en te monitoren.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de acute geldnood van ziekenhuizen in 2012 (ingezonden 18 november 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about reports of acute cash shortages at hospitals in 2012, whether a national advance-payment scheme is needed, and whether hospitals should cut external staff hiring. The minister replies that insurers and hospitals can agree advance payments locally, expects them to follow the agreements made, and declines to say hospitals must reduce external hires since that is their own judgement.
In my view, insurers and hospitals are fully capable of reaching advance-payment arrangements through local consultation.
Verzekeraars en ziekenhuizen zijn mijns inziens uitstekend in staat om in lokaal overleg tot afspraken over de bevoorschotting te komen.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de fusie tussen twee Tilburgse ziekenhuizen (ingezonden 21 november 2011).

The MP asks whether the government will require a merger impact assessment and a fusion test by NZa and IGZ for the planned merger of two Tilburg hospitals, and how it will stop the merger absent a moratorium. The minister answers that the assessment and NZa fusion test will be legislated for 2013, that current law gives no power to block the merger, and that she will urge the hospitals to act in line with the new rules.
Based on this debate, we are currently translating those intentions into legislation, which will also anchor the obligation to draw up a merger impact assessment.
Mede op basis van dit debat vertalen wij die voornemens op dit moment in wetgeving, waarmee ook de verplichting tot het opstellen van een fusie-effectrapportage wordt verankerd.

Vragen van de leden Agema en Gerbrands (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Medicijnkastjes ouderen jaarlijks doorgelicht» (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

PVV MPs asked the state secretary about a report that elderly people's medicine cabinets are checked yearly, including whether elderly patients are wrongly prescribed medicines and whether GPs check medication use often enough. The minister said better monitoring is positive, cited national hospital-admission research and a forthcoming polypharmacy guideline, and said yearly comprehensive medication review is advisable while rejecting extra funding for GPs.
I do not have such specific research results at national level.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke specifieke onderzoeksresultaten op landelijk niveau.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het vermeende weren van vissers uit de Klaverbank door Greenpeace (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

An MP asked whether Greenpeace broke the law by dumping stones on the North Sea seabed (Klaverbank) that blocked fishing, and whether the vessels should be removed and crew prosecuted, and also raised the link between phosphate reduction and declining North Sea cod. The state secretary answered that dumping without a permit violates the Waterwet, but the stones pose little added fishing hazard given natural boulders, so a penalty payment was imposed to prevent repetition; on cod, research points to food mismatch and very high fishing pressure rather than nutrient reduction.
Dumping stones without a permit nevertheless remains in violation of the Water Act.
Het storten van stenen zonder vergunning blijft evenwel in strijd met de Waterwet.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat Greenpeace «bermbommen» dumpt in de Duitse Noordzee (ingezonden 5 augustus 2011).

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary about Greenpeace dumping rocks and concrete blocks in the North Sea, including whether they will be removed and whether the government's marine protection statements encourage such actions. The government answers that the Dutch state cannot remove blocks in German waters, that the marine protection policy is an EU obligation, and that engaging with Greenpeace is a matter for the parties themselves.
It is up to Greenpeace to decide which debate it takes part in or not.
Het is aan Greenpeace te bepalen aan welk debat men deelneemt of niet.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat er vissoorten verdwijnen, door EU-subsidies (ingezonden 7 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether EU and state subsidies to the Spanish fishing fleet create an unfair playing field and harm fish stocks in other countries, and whether the government will push for fairer rules in Europe. The state secretary said the journalists' figures were not substantiated, listed the EU fisheries funds available to Spain, noted that the Commission enforces state aid rules and can suspend funds for non-compliance, and said the government will keep pressing for a level playing field.
However, a substantiation of these figures, the way in which the calculation of these contributions was made, is not made available by the ICIJ.
Een onderbouwing hiervan, de wijze waarop becijfering van deze bijdragen tot stand is gekomen, wordt echter niet door het ICIJ beschikbaar gesteld.
Vragen van de leden De Mos en Gerbrands (beide PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over ecologische braaklegging (ingezonden 16 september 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation whether a 5% ecological fallow requirement is unrealistic and whether private management should be expanded. The state secretary said the EU greening proposals for the 2014-2020 CAP are still under review with a cabinet response due by month-end, and that private parties and farmers should be involved more in nature management, citing an approved subsidy scheme for land purchase.
I intend to send the cabinet response to the Commission proposals to your House before the end of the month.
Ik ben voornemens om uw Kamer voor het einde van de maand de kabinetsreactie op de Commissievoorstellen aan te bieden.

Vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Agema (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Verpleegkundigen doen zelden aangifte van geweld» (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

PVV MPs asked the state secretary about a report that nurses rarely file police reports after violence, including how often violence occurs in hospitals and care homes, whether patients should pay for care when they are violent, cultural causes, reporting obstacles, self-defence courses and attractiveness of care work. The minister answered that violence against care workers is unacceptable, reporting rates are rising, the government will stimulate reporting and damage recovery, and points to its labour market letter for measures.
The willingness to report is increasing.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat patiënten donderdag moeten aankloppen bij de huisartsenpost (ingezonden 5 oktober 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister whether patients forced to use out-of-hours GP posts during a GP strike would be charged the higher out-of-hours rate, and whether this was acceptable amid spending cuts. The minister answered that regional agreements meant the daytime GP rate applied, that extra costs were settled with GPs or their associations, and that no extra cost falls on premium payers.
In regions where no agreements were made, the services are billed through the patient's own GP to the insurer.
In de regio’s waar hierover geen afspraken zijn gemaakt, worden de verrichtingen via de eigen huisarts bij de verzekeraar in rekening gebracht.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de invoering van het medisch kerndossier in de regio Rijnmond (ingezonden 28 september 2011).

An MP from the PVV asks the health minister about a medical summary record (medisch kerndossier) pilot in the Rijnmond region, its relation to the national EPD/LSP, whether the privacy regulator CBP reviewed it, whether it is adequately secured, and the DigiD login risk after the DigiNotar affair. The minister answers that the project is a standardisation initiative separate from the national infrastructure, that the CBP did not review it, that security assessment is for the IGZ and CBP, that DigiD is considered safe again, and that the questions could not be answered before the scheduled debate.
The medical summary record has not been reviewed by the CBP.
Het medisch kerndossier is niet getoetst door het CBP.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de diensten van SOS Arts mogen beginnen (ingezonden 22 september 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about the NZa rule allowing 'zorg op afroep' (on-call care at home) to be delivered by any BIG-registered doctor, not only registered GPs, and about the quality standards and oversight. The minister answered that the rule is not restricted to GPs, that quality is governed by verantwoorde zorg norms supervised by the IGZ, and that care quality must be guaranteed.
The Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) supervises this.
De Inspectie voor de gezondheidszorg (IGZ) houdt hier toezicht op.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat Polen de Nederlandse wateren leegvissen (ingezonden 16 september 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary whether Polish anglers stripping Dutch waters should face the same strict enforcement as Dutch fishers, and whether direct on-the-spot fines could be imposed. The state secretary answered that rules and enforcement apply equally to foreign and Dutch fishers, that direct collection of fines is not possible under the Fisheries Act, and that making violations punishable under the Economic Offences Act is planned.
Direct collection of fines is however not possible on the basis of the Fisheries Act.
Directe inning van boetes is echter op basis van de Visserijwet niet mogelijk.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat niet alle slachterijen de verplichte BSE-t

An MP asked the health and agriculture ministers about reports that some slaughterhouses did not carry out mandatory BSE tests, asking about the risk, sanctions, recall and improved oversight. The minister answered that the risk is negligible since untested cattle were born after 2001, that four firms were suspended and one faces criminal investigation, that a proportionate recall was done, and referred to letters on strengthened supervision.
Because the BSE tests were not carried out, 4 companies have been suspended.
Vanwege de niet uitgevoerde BSE-testen zijn 4 bedrijven geschorst.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de doorstart van het elektronisch patiëntendossier (EPD) (ingezonden 23 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about a proposed relaunch of the national electronic patient record (LSP/EPD), including whether patient consent is required and how the estimated ten million euro annual cost would be financed through higher provider tariffs passed on to patients. The minister answers that the proposal was received and assessed, that providers are responsible for their own information systems funded from regular budgets, that consent is generally required under the WGBO unless exceptions apply, and that the Senate motion prevents government funding.
I am not aware of which precise agreements have been made between care providers and health insurers about the financing.
Het is mij niet bekend welke precieze afspraken er zijn gemaakt tussen zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars over de bekostiging.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over reservaten in de Noordzee (ingezonden 19 juli 2011).

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary why 10-15% of the North Sea is being designated as reserves when fish stocks appear healthy, whether this rewards Greenpeace, and what evidence supports it. The state secretary answers that the designations follow EU Habitat and Bird Directive obligations under a plan dating from 2005, that the affected fisheries are being consulted, and that the scientific basis is set out in an earlier letter.
For the ecological justification of the Natura 2000 areas to be designated in the North Sea, I refer you to my letter of 14 June.
Voor de ecologische onderbouwing van de aan te wijzen Natura2000 gebieden op de Noordzee verwijs ik u naar mijn brief van 14 juni jl.
Vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Van Bemmel (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het Windbos (ingezonden 28 juli 2011).

PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether Staatsbosbeheer should be involved in the green energy market through wind-forest projects, whether residents were consulted, how the projects are financed, and whether windmills endanger birds and bats. The state secretary answered that Staatsbosbeheer is a multifunctional body allowed to produce renewable energy, that no concrete projects yet exist so no consultation has occurred, and that bird and bat risks can largely be avoided through site choice and turbine placement.
Currently there are no concrete wind forest projects yet.
Momenteel is er nog geen sprake van concrete windbosprojecten.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de directeur van het Maasstad Ziekenhuis per direct zijn functie neerlegt en een vertrekbonus krijgt van 2,5 t

An MP from the PVV asks the minister whether the Maasstad Hospital director who resigned with a 2.5 million euro severance should be prosecuted, and what action will be taken to reverse it. The minister refers to earlier answers, acknowledges the severance was too high, notes the government has no instrument to intervene in existing contracts, and points to a pending bill capping executive pay and severance at 75,000 euro for new contracts.
Neither I nor fellow cabinet members have an instrument to intervene in existing employment conditions.
Noch ik, noch collega-bewindslieden hebben een instrument om te kunnen ingrijpen in bestaande arbeidsvoorwaarden.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Zorgpersoneel op dievenpad» (ingezonden 22 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about a report that care staff steal from elderly clients, including whether staff theft should lead to immediate dismissal, fines like shoplifters receive, and whether a certificate of good conduct is enough to keep such staff out of care. The minister said he had no figures on staff theft, that theft from clients is unacceptable, that employers can dismiss under existing law, and that the certificate of good conduct requirement is anchored in a pending bill.
The report is known to me.
Vragen van de leden De Mos en Gerbrands (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het artikel «Hongersnood dreigt in Nederland» (ingezonden 13 mei 2011).

PVV MPs De Mos and Gerbrands asked the state secretary whether drought endangering Dutch harvests and natural projects converting farmland to marsh or causing salinisation are acceptable, and whether this shows the need to preserve freshwater and farmland. The state secretary agreed that water must be managed carefully, pointed to the water allocation priority list and the Delta Programme's freshwater sub-programme, and said nature projects may be needed to meet international obligations while negotiations with provinces continue.
To meet international obligations on nature conservation and/or restoration, it may be among the possibilities to proceed with the measures mentioned in this question.
Om te voldoen aan de internationale verplichtingen omtrent natuurbehoud en/of natuurherstel kan het tot de mogelijkheden behoren om over te gaan tot de in deze vraag genoemde maatregelen.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over compensatie binnenvissers (ingezonden 22 juni 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary why inland fishers have not yet been compensated for the early termination of fishing leases and whether they will receive retraining support. The state secretary explains a three-track compensation plan (returned lease fees, a tegemoetkoming under the lease terms, and a possible catch-related scheme pending EU approval), and says there is a general social safety net and business-plan help, but no specific retraining support.
I promised you during the debate on the amendment of the Fisheries Act on 16 March that I want to compensate the fishing businesses concerned via 3 tracks.
Ik heb u tijdens de behandeling van de wijziging van de Visserijwet op 16 maart jl. toegezegd dat ik de betreffende visserijbedrijven via 3 sporen wil tegemoetkomen.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat een hoogleraar patiëntveiligheid/anesthesioloog opstapt bij het Maasstad ziekenhuis (ingezonden 29 juli 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about reports that a patient-safety professor and anaesthesiologist was leaving Maasstad hospital, whether the board refused expert help during a multi-resistant bacteria outbreak, and whether the board should be removed. The minister said the departure is a personal choice, that the hospital uses RIVM and UMCU expert support under IGZ-linked supervision, that the IGZ will examine the hospital's response, and that dismissing a hospital board is a matter for the supervisory board and the Ondernemingskamer, not the government.

As I indicated in earlier answers to parliamentary questions, the hospital has been placed under intensified supervision and further IGZ investigation will have to establish whether there was 'inadequate response' or 'irresponsible conduct'.

Antwoord 4 en 5 Zoals ik in eerdere antwoorden op Kamervragen (de datum 25 juli 2011, 2011Z11786 ) heb laten weten, is het ziekenhuis onder verscherpt toezicht gesteld en zal nader onderzoek van de IGZ moeten uitwijzen of en in hoeverre er sprake is geweest van «niet adequaat reageren» of «onverantwoord handelen».

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de besmetting in het Maasstad ziekenhuis mogelijk al dateert uit 2008 en dat groot alarm al veel eerder nodig

An MP asks the health minister whether a hospital infection outbreak at Maasstad hospital may date back to 2008, whether the board should resign, why the Inspectorate was unaware, and whether other hospitals should isolate former patients. The minister answers that the original source cannot be determined, the board director has resigned, the hospital is under heightened inspection, reporting duties rest on the hospital board, and the research team recommended isolation only for suspected cases.
The IGZ investigation must establish whether something fundamentally went wrong at the Maasstad hospital.
Het onderzoek van de IGZ moet uitwijzen of er iets fundamenteel is mis gegaan in het Maasstad ziekenhuis.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de nieuwe interim-bestuurder van het Maasstad ziekenhuis (ingezonden 23 augustus 2011)

An MP asked the minister whether the appointment of an interim hospital director at Maasstad ziekenhuis was a mistake that should be reversed, how trust can be restored, and whether she would place the board under supervision. The minister replied that the appointment is for the supervisory board and works councils, that the IGZ is already conducting intensified supervision, and that she sees no need for an additional instrument such as administrative supervision of the board.
I therefore do not see the need for administrative supervision as an additional instrument.
Ik zie dan ook niet de noodzaak voor bestuurlijke ondertoezichtstelling als extra instrument.

Vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat topsalarissen in de zorg gewoon worden doorbetaald. (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

PVV MPs Gerbrands and Wilders asked the health minister how she responds to reports that the executive pay code for healthcare directors (BBZ) is failing, given that most top salaries exceed the norm, and whether she will enforce it and include it in the Wet normering topinkomens. The minister replied that the code applies only to new contracts and disputed the reported non-compliance, promised to analyse the 2010 figures and speak with the sector bodies, and noted that the pay-cap law would make the code binding.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het aanstellen van een interim-bestuurder in het Maasstad ziekenhuis (ingezonden 22 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether a supervisory board member of Maasstad hospital becoming interim director, and the resulting governance and trust concerns, were acceptable under the sector governance code. The minister answered that the board and councils are responsible, the code is self-regulating and not enforceable by government, and the hospital must explain any deviation, while the IGZ already supervises the hospital.
It is not for me to intervene in individual hospitals in a possible governance crisis.
Het is niet aan mij om bij individuele ziekenhuizen in te grijpen bij een mogelijke bestuurscrisis.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het verband tussen fosfaat en de visstand in de Noordzee (ingezonden 14 juli 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation how the claimed link between phosphate inflows and North Sea fish stocks squares with contrary studies, whether fisheries are wrongly blamed, the impact on migratory birds, and whether phosphate fertilisation of the sea should be tried. The state secretary answers that fertilisation has no scientific basis and is not desirable, that causality is hard to establish, and that reduced fishing pressure has restored stocks.
Since the economic situation is determined in large part, but not solely, by the size of fishing opportunities, I do not consider such a trial desirable.
Daar de economische situatie voor een belangrijk deel, maar niet louter wordt bepaald door de omvang van de vangstmogelijkheden, acht ik een dergelijke proef niet gewenst.
Vragen van leden De Mos en Gerbrands (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over waterschapslasten (ingezonden 2 augustus 2011).

PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether it is undesirable that farmers pay disproportionate water board levies because of infrastructure value in their water board areas, and whether the Taxatiewijzer for infrastructure should be made optional in 2012. The state secretary said infrastructure value is legally part of the valuation, that Delfland's tariffs rose after the new tax system, that research on tariff relief within the current law has not yet produced a solution, and that the results will be reported to parliament.
I will report the results to the House of Representatives.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer over de resultaten berichten.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de Unieke Zorgverlener Identificatie (UZI)-pas voor het grijpen ligt (ingezonden 13 juli 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about a report that UZI professional cards were easily accessible and whether their use remains safe, and what sanctions apply for non-compliance. The minister answered that the card meets strict security standards, that pharmacies and users are responsible for proper use, and that the Inspectorate can enforce compliance through orders, penalties and disciplinary action.
This study gives no reason to doubt the security of the card itself.
Dit onderzoek geeft geen aanleiding om aan de veiligheid van de pas zelf te twijfelen.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat patiënten verkeerd worden voorgelicht door zorgverzekeraars (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether insurer Achmea acted carelessly by misinforming patients about prostate surgery, whether other insurers' referrals should be checked, and what measures will bring quality indicators for prostate operations. The minister said insurers give advice rather than referrals, Achmea found only two misleading messages out of 54 and changed its procedure, no review of other insurers is planned, and quality indicators will be mandatory in 2012.
Based partly on the answer to question 3, I see no reason to have the accuracy of information provided by health insurers investigated.
Mede op basis van het antwoord op vraag 3 zie ik geen reden om de juistheid van de informatieverstrekking door zorgverzekeraars te (laten) onderzoeken.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het Maasstad ziekenhuis heeft gefaald bij de aanpak van een gevaarlijke bacterie (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about reports that Maasstad hospital failed to tackle a dangerous antibiotic-resistant bacterium, infecting 34 patients, and whether the board acted irresponsibly. The minister says about 70 patients carry the bacterium, the inspectorate is investigating the outbreak and timeline, and the hospital has been placed under heightened supervision with a coordinating microbiologist, with further steps to follow after the inspection's findings.
To this end, the IGZ placed Maasstad Hospital under heightened supervision on 20 July 2011 and imposed additional requirements on the hospital.
Daartoe heeft de IGZ d.d. 20 juli 2011 het Maasstad Ziekenhuis onder verscherpt toezicht gesteld en extra eisen aan het ziekenhuis gesteld

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het Maasstad Ziekenhuis zich niet aan de infectierichtlijnen heeft gehouden (ingezonden 13 juli 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister how she would respond to reports that Maasstad Hospital breached infection guidelines, whether this would be investigated, what consequences the hospital board would face, how compliance is monitored, and whether 21 infected patients died from the Klebsiella bacterium. The minister answered that the Inspectorate (IGZ) is investigating, has placed the hospital under heightened supervision and required a hygiene coordinator, may consider an admissions stop if the situation worsens, and that the cause of death of the patients is still under investigation by an external commission.
On 20 July 2011 the IGZ placed Maasstad Hospital under heightened supervision.
Op 20 juli 2011 heeft de IGZ het Maasstad Ziekenhuis onder verscherpt toezicht gesteld.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat er vorig jaar door ziekenhuizen voor 4 miljoen aan exitpremies is uitgegeven (ingezonden 7 juli 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister about reports that hospitals spent 4 million euros on severance payments for executives, asking whether this is acceptable during cuts, whether hospitals are complying with the executive pay code, and about transparency. The minister replied that the code is largely complied with, that the pay norm act applies only to new contracts, that non-compliant hospitals will be asked for explanation, and that existing transparency rules work well.
If that explanation is insufficient, I will ask the relevant Supervisory Board to take action.
Wanneer die uitleg onvoldoende is, zal ik de desbetreffende Raad van Toezicht vragen om actie te ondernemen.

Vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Graus (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over in beslag genomen dieren die doorverkocht worden als voer (ingezonden 17 juni 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether seized, mistreated animals were resold by the Dienst Regelingen to traders who use them as snake food, and whether this should stop and proceeds go to a rescue foundation. The secretary confirmed awareness of the report, explained that seized animals are placed with contracted holders, adopters, shelters or traders case by case with welfare first, and said a motion banning resale as food will be implemented with a later update to parliament.
This means that, first and foremost, placement looks at the welfare of the animal as far as possible.
Dit houdt in dat er in de eerste plaats bij plaatsing zoveel mogelijk naar het welzijn van het dier gekeken wordt.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over subsidies voor niets doen in landbouw (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether agricultural subsidies should be checked structurally, whether payments to landholders doing nothing with their land should be recovered immediately, and whether the government would seek to recover EU money for Dutch farmers. The state secretary answered that payments are already fully administratively checked and 5% physically checked under EU rules with sanctions, that recovery is not at issue because payments are lawful, and that the Netherlands is preparing for the new CAP from 2014.
I share the view that subsidies must be structurally subjected to controls. This also happens.
Ik deel de mening dat subsidies structureel aan controles onderworpen moeten worden. Dit gebeurt ook.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de «sloopchirurg» gewoon zijn gang kan gaan (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

An MP asks the health minister why the Inspectorate for Health Care has not referred about 300 complaints against a surgeon to the disciplinary tribunal and why he remains on the register, and what action will prevent him ever operating again. The minister answers that the surgeon has not worked since April 2010 under an agreement with the Inspectorate, that investigations by the hospital and the Inspectorate are ongoing, and that disciplinary or criminal referral will follow if disfunctioning is confirmed.
If during or after completion of these investigations it becomes established that the orthopaedic surgeon has been underperforming, the IGZ will take appropriate measures.
Als tijdens of na afronding van deze onderzoeken het voor de IGZ vast komt te staan dat er sprake is van disfunctioneren van de betrokken orthopeed, dan zal de IGZ passende maatregelen nemen.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de plannen van zorgverzekeraar De Friesland (ingezonden 9 juni 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about insurer De Friesland's reported plans to reorganise hospital care in Friesland, including closing some maternity and emergency units, and whether competition there remains adequate. The minister declined to judge the unconfirmed plans, stressed the insurer's duty of care and emergency-access norms, and pointed to the competition authority NMa's finding that competition in Friesland remains sufficient.
However, I cannot give a judgement on the concrete plans or intentions of health insurer De Friesland based on the interview.
Ik kan op basis van het interview echter geen oordeel geven over de concrete plannen of voornemens van zorgverzekeraar De Friesland.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de mogelijke toevoeging van de Noordoostpolder aan de Werelderfgoedlijst (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about the possible inclusion of the Noordoostpolder on the UNESCO World Heritage list, its conditions and effects on building permits, and local draft support. The government explained the World Heritage obligations and the draft criteria, and declined to list the Noordoostpolder after the municipal council refused to back it.
Following the municipal council's decision, I find that there is insufficient support for placing the Noordoostpolder on the provisional list.
Naar aanleiding van het besluit van de gemeenteraad constateer ik dat er onvoldoende draagvlak is voor plaatsing van de Noordoostpolder op de voorlopige lijst.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over radioactief besmette containers (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

An MP asks the government about radioactively contaminated containers from Japan after Fukushima, whether the number found is too high, whether the disaster is worse than stated, and whether sea-based container checks should be extended. The state secretary answers that 15 of 38 containers exceeded limits and were cleaned, that the sea checks were stopped because no contamination was measured there, and that port checks and EU food sampling continue.
The decision to stop these measurements was reached in good consultation between the government bodies involved and the business sector.
Het besluit om deze metingen te stoppen, is in goed overleg tussen de betrokken overheidsinstanties en het bedrijfsleven tot stand gekomen.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Gerbrands (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretarissen van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het dreigende faillissement van de Nederlandse vissersvloo

PVV MPs asked the state secretaries about the threatened bankruptcy of the Dutch fishing fleet, including whether strict EU environmental rules are to blame, whether climate funds could pay fishers to collect plastic, and for an overview of climate spending. The government answered that the fleet's viability is primarily the fishers' responsibility, that environmental rules are set at EU and international level with no national room to deviate, that climate funds are not earmarked for plastic fishing, and that it will discuss a possible pilot with the Commission.
There are no possibilities to deviate from that nationally.
Er zijn geen mogelijkheden om daar nationaal van af te wijken.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het opvragen van gegevens over derden bij GGZ Friesland (ingezonden 14 juni 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about a GGZ Friesland webpage that suggested relatives could phone a hotline to find out whether a person was in mental health treatment, and whether such practice is lawful. The minister answered that the passage was an error, has been removed, that disclosure without consent breaches medical confidentiality and the civil code, and that the Inspectorate can act within its supervisory remit.

Making statements by a treating professional about whether persons are in treatment is incompatible with medical confidentiality and the provisions on the medical treatment agreement in the Civil Code.

Het doen van mededelingen door een behandelaar over het in behandeling hebben van personen verdraagt zich niet met het medisch beroepsgeheim en de bepalingen inzake de geneeskundige behandelingsovereenkomst uit het Burgerlijk Wetboek.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de vertrokken top van het Medisch Centrum Alkmaar (MCA) vorig jaar ruim een miljoen euro incasseerde (ingezond

An MP asks the health minister about reports that the departed top management of Medisch Centrum Alkmaar received over one million euros, and whether this is acceptable and within the norms of the planned executive pay law. The minister says the Wet normering topinkomens will apply only to new contracts, notes the hospital's positive 2010 result, and says she currently lacks instruments to intervene in care-sector salaries, urging Parliament to pass the bill quickly.
I therefore called on the House in that question hour to ensure that the current bill on top incomes can take effect on 1 January 2012.
Ik heb de Kamer daarom in dat vragenuurtje opgeroepen om ervoor te zorgen dat het huidige wetsvoorstel over de topinkomens per 1 januari 2012 in werking kan treden.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de aangekondigde opnamestop door de GGZ (ingezonden 20 juni 2011).

An MP asked the health minister for her reaction to a mental health sector announcement of an admissions stop and whether she would oppose it. The minister said the growth in mental health care must be curbed, patients should not suffer, providers must ensure emergency care, and she asked the Inspectorate (IGZ) to stay alert and act on any abuses.
I have asked the IGZ to be extra alert during the action period where continuity of emergency care and care is concerned.
Ik heb de IGZ gevraagd in de actieperiode extra alert te zijn daar waar het continuïteit van de spoedzorg en zorg betreft.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de uitzending «Sluimerend bewustzijn» van KRO Brandpunt (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about a KRO Brandpunt broadcast on coma patients, including claims of misdiagnosis, a Liège consciousness test, and insurance coverage of tests and therapy. The minister rejected the misdiagnosis claim, said further information is needed before the CVZ can judge the test, and pointed to research funding as the route to improving coma care.
Further research must show the ways in which the outcome for coma patients can be improved.
Nader onderzoek moet de wegen aantonen waarlangs de uitkomst voor comapatiënten verbeterd kan worden.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over megastallen in Noord-Holland (ingezonden 27 mei 2011).

An MP asks whether the government's megastal dialogue and the parliamentary moratorium request are consistent with a news report that megastables are welcome in Noord-Holland. The state secretary answers that the provinces were asked not to process new applications requiring zoning changes for large stables, while noting a formal moratorium via a voorbereidingsbesluit is not possible, and describes Noord-Holland's existing rules limiting intensive livestock expansion.
Regarding a moratorium to be established through a preparatory zoning decision, I informed your House and explained that this is not possible.
Over een in te stellen moratorium door middel van het nemen van een voorbereidingsbesluit, heb ik uw Kamer bericht en uiteengezet dat dat niet mogelijk is.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat «bizar weinig» specialisten aan functioneringsgesprekken deelnemen (ingezonden 16 mei 2011).

An MP asks the health minister how to respond to reports that very few medical specialists take part in performance appraisal talks and whether all specialists in all hospitals can be required to participate. The minister says the IFMS evaluation is voluntary and peer-based, that it cannot be made mandatory, and that the matter may be addressed in the model admission agreement and by the hospital board.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen een zorgconsulent voor allochtonen moeten aanstellen (ingezonden 19 mei 2011).

An MP from the PVV asks the health minister whether she agrees that hospitals appointing allochtone care consultants sends the wrong integration signal and urges her to advise against it. The minister replies that hospitals decide for themselves, that patients generally struggle with medical terminology, and that learning Dutch is the responsibility of newcomers, but she does not commit to any action toward the hospitals or the foundation.
It is up to the hospitals themselves whether or not they want to use it.
Het is aan de ziekenhuizen zelf of zij hier al dan niet gebruik van willen maken.
Vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Graus (beiden PVV) aan staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over koeien in de wei (ingezonden 23 mei 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary about a Nieuwsuur report that a quarter of dairy cows never reach pasture, whether permanent housing harms animal welfare, and whether FrieslandCampina's pasture-milk guarantee matches reality. The state secretary confirmed the figures, said pasture access matters for welfare and that he supports integrated sustainable barns, and said the Campina brand's milk is guaranteed pasture milk.

Vragen van de leden De Mos, Gerbrands en Bontes (allen PVV) aan staatssecretarissen van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het artikel «Limburgs grondwater nog decennia vuil» (i

Three PVV MPs asked whether the Netherlands should tighten manure rules to meet the 2015 Water Framework Directive nitrate target, and whether further study or postponement to 2027 was wise. The state secretary replied that nitrate concentrations are falling, that policy changes will follow careful study, that no extra research is needed now, and that extending the deadline to 2021 or 2027 may be considered.

That does not necessarily mean that on the basis of this recent research the manure rules will be tightened in the short term merely to meet the 2015 target date of the European Water Framework Directive.

Dat betekent niet per definitie dat op basis van dat recente onderzoek op korte termijn de mestregels zullen worden aangescherpt, om maar de streefdatum van 2015 uit de Europese Kaderrichtlijn Water te halen.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de slechte telefonische bereikbaarheid van huisartsen (ingezonden 10 mei 2011).

An MP asks the Health Minister about poor phone reachability of GPs, citing NIVEL research and IGZ norms, and whether past measures were adequate. The minister confirms the norms, admits earlier measures were insufficient given a 2010 IGZ finding that one in four practices missed the 30-second emergency norm, and says the IGZ will enforce the norms.
These measures have so far proven insufficient, as recently shown by the IGZ investigation into telephone accessibility in 2010.
Deze maatregelen zijn (nog) niet afdoende gebleken, zoals recent is gebleken uit het IGZ onderzoek naar de telefonische bereikbaarheid in 2010.
Vragen van de leden De Mos en Gerbrands (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over met dioxine vervuilde wateren (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

PVV MPs De Mos and Gerbrands asked the state secretary about dioxin-contaminated waters and polluted river eel, asking whether the waters will be cleaned up quickly, how long they have been contaminated, and whether fines for illegal industrial discharges should be raised by 500%. The state secretary answered that historical sediment contamination cannot feasibly be fully removed, that targeted measures are planned, and that a sharp fine increase is disproportionate and would overshoot its goal.
Raising fines for illegal water discharges significantly is, in that light, not proportionate to me and would moreover overshoot its goal.
Het fors verhogen van de boetes voor illegale waterlozingen acht ik in dat licht niet proportioneel en zal bovendien zijn doel voorbij schieten.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat het ministerie van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie een dag per week alleen een vegetar

The PVV MP asked whether the ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation serves only vegetarian lunch one day a week as part of EatGreen day, who approved it, and whether government should stay out of individual diet choices. The state secretary replied that the vegetarian meal is offered daily alongside the regular meal as demand-driven catering, that staff have free choice, and that the ministry has no overview of other agencies taking part.
As indicated in the answer to question 2, there is no question of paternalism or an imposed choice by the department.
In het antwoord op vraag 2 is al aangegeven dat er geen sprake is van betutteling dan wel een opgelegde keuze door het departement.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat er sprake is van corruptie en hoge kosten bij zorgverzekeraar Agis in Marokko (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

A PVV MP asked the health minister whether a newspaper report alleging corruption and inflated costs at health insurer Agis in Morocco is true, whether Agis should publish audit results, and whether the Dutch premium money should be reclaimed. The minister denied the allegations, said no investigation exists beyond routine audits, and said the NZa sees no reason for an additional inquiry.
The NZa has informed me that, in view of the information now available and its contact with Agis, it sees no reason to launch an additional investigation.

De NZa heeft mij laten weten dat zij naar aanleiding van de nu voorliggende informatie en het contact dat zij hierover met Agis hebben gehad, geen aanleiding ziet om een aanvullend onderzoek in te stellen.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat Menzis huisartsenpraktijken opkoopt (ingezonden 30 maart 2011).

An MP asked the health minister for reaction to reports that insurer Menzis is buying GP practices in East Groningen, whether this vertical integration escapes competition review, and what the government will do. The minister answered that Zorgpunt is an independent subsidiary, that the competition authority cleared the structure in 2010, that she opposes vertical integration and will legislate a ban with exceptions, and that alternative local solutions are being pursued.
I am not in favour of structural vertical integration between insurers and care providers because it leads to distorted purchasing considerations at the insurer.
Ik ben geen voorstander van structurele verticale integratie tussen verzekeraars en zorgaanbieders omdat dit leidt tot onzuivere inkoopafwegingen bij de verzekeraar.

Vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat verpleegkundigen in de academische ziekhuizen hun onregelmatigheidstoeslag voor een groot g

MPs Gerbrands and Wilders asked the health minister about reports that nurses in academic hospitals would lose much of their irregular-hours allowance, and whether the minister would cut manager pay instead. The minister replied that the matter is a collective labour agreement negotiation between the employers' federation NFU and the unions, to which the ministry is not a party, so it holds no substantive view.
VWS is not a party to these collective labour agreement negotiations.
VWS is geen partij in de deze cao-onderhandelingen.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het Elektronisch Patiëntendossier (EPD) al volop «in de lucht» is (ingezonden 24 maart 2011).

An MP asks the health minister why patient data is being exchanged through the national EPD (electronic patient record) before the law is passed, given unresolved privacy, security and patient access concerns, and questions the subsidy link and evidence for patient safety. The minister answers that connections were voluntary, that after the Senate rejected the law no further connections will occur and involvement in the LSP will be ended, and cites evidence that the EPD can reduce medication-related harm.
Now that the Senate has rejected the bill and submitted motions, no further connections will take place and all involvement in the LSP will be ended within a reasonable time.
Nu de Eerste Kamer de wet heeft verworpen en moties heeft ingediend, zullen er geen aanmeldingen meer plaatsvinden en zal binnen gerede tijd elke betrokkenheid bij het LSP worden beëindigd.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de apothekersruzie het kookpunt heeft bereikt (ingezonden 25 februari 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about reports that the pharmacy dispute has reached boiling point, including allegations that the Thuisapotheek holds patients' medical data, that the Centrale Apotheek offers doctors bonuses, and that telephone sales and fragmented dispensing mislead patients. The minister answers that the IGZ is investigating the data and telephone sales issues, a court rejected the bonus claim, dispensing is patient choice with pharmacists obliged to check medication, and no further rule tightening is needed.
The Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) is launching an investigation into this.
De Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) stelt hiernaar een onderzoek in.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het feit dat apothekers in Noordwijk weigeren een patiënt van medicijnen te voorzien (ingezonden 14 februari 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about Noordwijk pharmacies refusing to dispense medication to a chronically ill patient and whether they will be reminded of their duty of care. The minister says the Inspectorate for Health Care is investigating, condemns the refusal as unacceptable, and will act on the investigation's outcome.
However, the Inspectorate's investigation has not yet been concluded.
Het onderzoek van de Inspectie is echter nog niet afgerond.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat er Q-koorts is ontdekt op zes kinderboerde

An MP asked the health and agriculture ministers about reports that Q fever was found on six Brabant children's farms, how large the infection risk is, and whether the farms were named or signposted. The minister answered that the data are from a 2009 study, that vaccination and isolation measures were introduced, and that farm names were not published because the study was a 2009 snapshot.
No. The study was a snapshot in 2009.
Nee. Het onderzoek was een momentopname in 2009.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gevaarlijke bijwerkingen van het Mexicaanse griepvaccin (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about reports linking the Pandemrix pandemic flu vaccine to narcolepsy in children in Sweden and Finland, whether children were vaccinated in the Netherlands, whether they are being monitored, and whether vaccine adverse effects will be studied nationally. The minister answers that Finnish and Swedish authorities are investigating, that Lareb monitors adverse reports (two child narcolepsy reports in the Netherlands so far), that Pandemrix was used once in 2009, and that an EU-wide VAESCO study is due in summer 2011.
I follow developments closely, both nationally through the Dutch Adverse Drug Reactions Centre Lareb and internationally through the European Medicines Agency EMA
Ik volg de ontwikkelingen op de voet, zowel nationaal via het Nederlandse Bijwerkingen Centrum Lareb, als internationaal via het Europees Geneesmiddelen Agentschap EMA
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de BSE crisis (ingezonden 23 februari 2011)

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary whether the EU Commission might yield to Polish pressure to allow animal meal in feed, whether the Netherlands has an escape clause to keep the ban, and whether the Dutch government will explain the dangers to the Commission. The state secretary answered that no such change is expected, that the proposal only concerned pig and poultry meal, that the risk is considered negligible, and that improved analysis methods now allow safe reintroduction under anti-cannibalism rules.
There is no question of the European Commission yielding to pressure from Poland.
Er is geen sprake van dat de Europese Commissie zal bezwijken onder de druk van Polen.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over misleidende informatie in het bezwaarformulier Elektronisch Patiëntendossier (EPD) (ingezonden 2 maart 2011).
