An MP asked the health minister whether the EPD objection form misleadingly states that deleting data cannot be undone, when objections can be withdrawn, and asked for that sentence to be removed. The minister acknowledged the sentence, explained that deletion is irreversible while the objection itself can be withdrawn but previously sent data must be re-sent by providers, and declined to remove the sentence while promising an extra FAQ on the website.
As indicated in answers 3 to 5, the information included in the explanation on the objection form and on the website www.infoEPD.nl is correct.
Zoals in de antwoorden 3 t/m 5 aangegeven klopt de informatie zoals opgenomen in de toelichting op het bezwaarformulier en op de website www.infoEPD.nl.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het feit dat tien van de veertien maaltijden in het Hagaziekenhuis in Den Haag halal zijn (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about a hospital reportedly offering mostly halal meals, questioning whether halal food aids recovery and whether patients understand it, and asking what would be done to stop 'islamisation'. The minister said the hospital's claim was incorrect (nine of fourteen or thirty-two meals are halal), that halal meals can be healthy and are provided for religious reasons like other dietary requirements, and saw no reason to intervene.
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over massale boskap (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation about large-scale tree felling by Staatsbosbeheer for heathland restoration in Schipborg, Baarn and Nijmegen, including whether the felling will be halted and whether it complies with EU forest policy. The state secretary answers that the planning process involved residents adequately, that felling of 16.8 ha was limited to exotic species under the Heiderijk project, and that he sees no reason to intervene under the Wet verzelfstandiging Staatsbosbeheer.
The Wet verzelfstandiging Staatsbosbeheer gives me the power to intervene if Staatsbosbeheer, in my view, does not properly carry out its statutory tasks.
De Wet verzelfstandiging Staatsbosbeheer geeft mij de mogelijkheid om in te grijpen als Staatsbosbeheer naar mijn mening haar wettelijke taken niet naar behoren uitvoert.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het patiëntenonderzoek van de (Nederlandse Patiënten Consumenten Federatie (NPCF) (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

An MP asks the health minister whether she shares alarm at an NPCF patient survey finding that two-thirds of patients reported communication failures and inadequate aftercare after medical errors, and what she will do about it. The minister says she is shocked, will discuss with the sector how to improve communication and patient-centred care under the VMS safety programme, and points to progress made and new instruments such as the GOMA code.
Yes, within the VMS safety programme I will discuss with the relevant field parties how they take their responsibility.
Ja, ik zal in het kader van het VMS veiligheidsprogramma met de betrokken veldpartijen bespreken hoe zij hun verantwoordelijkheid nemen
Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gesponsorde pandemie van de Mexicaanse griep (ingezonden 22 november 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about claims that the WHO changed the pandemic definition to justify vaccine purchases, about pharmaceutical-industry ties of Gezondheidsraad members, and whether influenza vaccine efficacy should be studied. The minister defends the vaccine purchase as a risk-based decision, says the Gezondheidsraad's conflict-of-interest procedures are sound, and refuses a new study of vaccine efficacy.
I do think it is important that full transparency is practised in this regard.
Ik vind het wel belangrijk dat hierbij volledige transparantie betracht wordt.

Vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Fritsma (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over het bericht dat volgende maand de eerste allochtonenkliniek opent in A

PVV MPs asked whether the minister would act against a new clinic in Amsterdam aimed at Turkish-origin patients, which they called discrimination and Islamisation, and whether Agis and oversight bodies would investigate overtreatment. The minister rejected the discrimination framing, said the clinic is open to all, noted Agis's own finding of overtreatment in Turkish clinics, and stated that monitoring is the insurer's task rather than the Inspectorate's.
No, it is the task of the health insurers that conclude care contracts with the clinic to ensure that care is provided efficiently, in line with applicable professional standards.
Nee, het is de taak van de zorgverzekeraars die zorgcontracten afsluiten met de kliniek om er op toe te zien dat de zorg doelmatig – conform geldende professionele standaarden – wordt verstrekt.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Gerbrands (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over verdubbeling in het aantal legionellagevallen

The MPs asked whether the government will investigate weather effects, water quality and prevention measures after a doubling in Legionnaires' disease cases. The state secretary answered that research points to warm, wet weather, that sources remain unclear, that monitoring duties exist for some installations, and that information campaigns and a separate letter will follow.
You will be informed separately by letter about this issue and the measures to be taken.
Over deze problematiek en de te treffen maatregelen wordt u separaat bij brief geïnformeerd.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de fusie tussen het Vlietland Ziekenhuis en zorgverzekeraar DSW toch doorgaat (ingezonden 27 oktober 2010).

An MP from the PVV asks the health minister how she will prevent the contested merger between Vlietland Hospital and insurer DSW, which the parties say needs no approval from the competition authority, and whether a 2009 motion banning such mergers is being implemented. The minister says the NMa must review any merger requiring transfer of control, that cooperation without a merger falls under cartel supervision, that the coalition agreement announces a ban on insurer-provider mergers, and that a bill will follow as soon as possible.

As long as there is no additional legal instrument, I point out, following my answer to question 2, that the merger between Vlietland Hospital and DSW, if control is transferred, requires a permit from the NMa.

Zolang er geen aanvullend wettelijk instrumentarium is, wijs ik in het verlengde van het antwoord op vraag 2 erop dat de fusie tussen het Vlietland Ziekenhuis en DSW – indien sprake is van het overdragen van zeggenschap – een vergunning van de NMa behoeft.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht van een ongekend grote ontslaggolf bij MSD in Oss (ingezonden 1 juli 2010).

An MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Health about reported large job losses at MSD in Oss and whether public investments should be reclaimed. The minister regretted the cuts, said talks with stakeholders were ongoing, noted about 2,175 jobs would be lost by end 2012, and refused to reclaim the subsidy as long as conditions were met.
As long as the conditions under which the subsidy was granted are met, there are no possibilities to reclaim the subsidy.
Zolang voldaan wordt aan de voorwaarden waaronder de subsidie verleend is, zijn er geen mogelijkheden om de subsidie terug te vorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Smeets over het fixen van matchfixing

MPs Van der Laan and Smeets asked about match-fixing, including how bookmakers, the FIU, the Wwft and privacy rules affect timely reporting to sports bodies, and who is responsible for what. The minister answered at length, setting out each actor's role, explaining that Wwft confidentiality can delay signals reaching sports bodies, and describing a planned 'fast lane' at the FIU to be evaluated after a year.
To prevent possible delay, it has been agreed with the sports federations that a so-called fast lane will be set up at the FIU-Netherlands for signals of possible match-fixing.
Om mogelijke vertraging te voorkomen is speciaal voor signalen van mogelijke matchfixing met de sportbonden afgesproken dat bij de FIU-Nederland een zogeheten fast lane zal worden vorm gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeets, Van Nispen en Bikker over de ontstane onduidelijkheid bij de detentiefasering door invoering van de Wet straffen en beschermen

MPs Smeets, Van Nispen and Bikker asked the Minister for Legal Protection about uncertainty over when the Wet straffen en beschermen (Wet SenB) takes effect and how it affects detainees' phasing and casework before that date. The Minister answered that the law partially takes effect on 1 July 2021 and the penitentiary programme rules on 1 December 2021, that DJI will communicate the changes to detainees, and that current rules apply until then.
These entry-into-force dates (1 July and 1 December 2021) will be given effect in an entry-into-force decree to be published by mid-June 2021.
Deze inwerkingtredingsdata (1 juli en 1 december 2021) krijgen hun beslag in een inwerkingtredingsbesluit dat uiterlijk medio juni 2021 zal worden gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Smeets over functionaliteit vermist-kind-alertering

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice Minister about the planned discontinuation of the AMBER Alert child-abduction alert service and its integration into Burgernet 2.0, including technical readiness, reach, international searches, safeguards, costs and loss of expertise. The minister answered that the switch rests on Burgernet 2.0's national messaging and image capabilities, that continuity and quality will be maintained, that a transition period with some manual linking is planned, and that Netpresenter's cooperation is uncertain.
The starting point of the integration is that the current quality, continuity and functionality of the missing-child service will be maintained.
Uitgangspunt bij de integratie is dat de huidige kwaliteit, continuïteit en functionaliteit van de vermist-kind-voorziening gehandhaafd blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeets, Kuik, Jasper van Dijk, Ceder en Piri over het bericht ‘Tina en Jacob moeten weg!’

MPs from D66, CDA, SP, ChristenUnie and PvdA asked whether Armenian Syrians facing revocation of asylum status are treated unequally, and why some keep their permits while others lose them. The State Secretary answered that re-assessment is individual, that the IND does not register these figures, and that a 2021 court ruling concerned insufficient reasoning on equality, not discrimination.
The requested numerical data cannot be provided.
De gevraagde cijfermatige gegeven kunnen niet verstrekt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schilder en Van Meetelen over het bericht 'Uit huis geplaatste kinderen uit Noord-Nederland jarenlang ernstig mishandeld'

MPs Schilder and Van Meetelen asked the government about abuse of children placed in a Northern Netherlands foster home, possible supervisory failures, the William Schrikker Stichting's repeated involvement in serious incidents, and whether dismissal, prosecution and tougher sanctions would be introduced. The State Secretary answered that inspectorates are investigating and that enforcement and sanctions are for inspectorates, employers, the Public Prosecution Service and courts, declining to pre-empt the outcome and refusing new legislation on dismissal or prosecution.
We will inform your House about the outcomes of the investigation.
Wij zullen uw Kamer over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek informeren.
